—muci smyo/ dzo.a rubyebhin gna'ardzas khang du bzhugs pa'i si tu paṇa chen gyi phyag bris rib 'dzin rje'i 'a' thang /
ri /rgyu ñtsakau 4 rgubyedi 77meci tsu3rirīcho ——sna oṃrmi sgo ju d+ku ram̐ māṃ tram̐ tshoX/rte 2 rdzo ༷—wa

dpe sgrun gsal bshad/spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu bdun par sku 'khrungs pa'i mkhas pa'i dbang po kaḥthog rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor ba mchog gi gsang 'bam 'di ni/ rje 'di nyid kyi sprul ba'i ra mi ༄༄ rig sku'i mtshan gyi cod pan gyis mdzes pa'i mchog sprul pad+ma dbang chen rdo rje lags kyis lo mang 'bad brtson chen pos 'dzam gling rgyal khab dang sa cha khag du ma nas 'tshol bsdu byas te legs bsgrigs gnang ba ltar dpe skrun zhus pa yin la/ kaḥthog rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu mchog gis bod khul khams dbus mnga' ris dang / bal 'brug 'bras ljongs sogs nas bshad sgrub las gsum gyi 'khor lo bskor te 'gro don rgya cher spel myong ba dang / khong la shul bzhag gsung chos ha cang gal chen mang du yod la/ de las lo rgyus skor la mtshon na/ mnga' ris phyogs kyi lo rgyus kyi dpyad gzhi'i yig cha gal chen zhig tu chags yod pa lta bu red/ da lta bsdu rub byas te pod brgyad du longs pa de dpe deb chen po stod smad bar gsum du phyes nas bsgrigs yod la/ nang don thad la/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i mdo sngags kyi gsung chos du ma dang / sgra/ rtsis/ lo rgyus/bstan rtsis/ chab shog rang rnam sogs nang don phun sum tshogs pa zhig yin pa gsung chos mjal ba tsam gyis nges pa 'drongs nus/rtsom pa po'i rnam thar dang gsung chos 'tshol bsdu'i skor mchog sprul pad+ma dbang chen rdo rjes mdzad pa'i sgrig pa po'i gtam dang / mdzad pa po'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus bcas su gsal bas 'dir bskyar zhu ma byas shing / gsung 'bum 'dir brda rnying dang yul skad du song ba du ma yod pa las bcos su ma btub pa rnams rang dgar sor bzhag byadi yod

pas phyis su mkhas pa'i dbang po rnam dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyis zhu dag gis gtan la dbab rgyu byung na par thengs rjes ma'i skabs su dag bcos zhu chog pa dang /'dir mchog sprul pad+ma dbang chen rdo rje lags kyis rgyu tshegs kyi 'o brgyal la ma 'dzem par 'bad brtson chen pos gsung 'bum 'di bzhin phyogs bsgrigs byung ba la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / mkhan po kun dga' bzang po mchog nas yi ge glog klad du 'jug pa dang zhu dag sogs kyi bka' drin bskyangs pa dang / de min sgrig pa po'i gtam du gsal ba'i gsung 'bum 'di nyid phyogs sgrig byed pa la rgyab skyor gnang mkhan mkhas dbang skyes mchog rnams la sor bcu snying gar zum te bka' drin che zhes zhu rgyu bcas/krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2006lo'i zla 12pa'i tshes 10la/

sgrig pa po'i gtam/o ṭ+wā sti/ gsang bdag dpa' bo'i thugs kyi nyin byed las/ /brtul zhugs 'od snang 'gyed pa'i nag po ba/ /mkha' bskyod nam mkha'i snying po'i gar bsgyur ba'i/ /tshe dbang nor bus bden pa'i shis pa stsol/ /de yang kaḥthog rig 'dzin chen po zhes 'phags yul gyi grub pa'i dbang phyug spyod pa'i rdo rje nag po ba dang / bod yul dpal chen grub pa nam mkha'i snying po'i ye shes sgyu ma'i rol ba/ skyes ma thag nas sngon gnas rjes dran gyis dgongs pa klong rdol na'ang bstan pa'i mig ltos la dgongs 'phags pa'i skyes bu gnam gyis sa bkab pa lta bu mang po rtag sbyor dang gus sbyor gyis bsten te/'phags bod gdams pa'i chu klong chen po mkhas pa'i las gsum gyis 'dzin skyong spel ba'i 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i gos can yongs su khyab pa/ bla dpon mkhas btsun che dgu'i gtsug gi rgyan du bsten kyang snyems pa'i ral ba gnam la ma gzengs par bya btang rnal 'byor gyi rnam thar bdag gir bzhes te/bdog pa'i dngos po ci mchis pa rten gsum bzhengs pa dang mchod sbyin gyis rnam par dge ba'i sa bon smin par mdzad pa/ gzhan don gyi 'phrin las nyal 'gro'i rgyun bzhin skad cig kyang dal ba med par 'brel tshad rnam par grol ba'i lam du sbyor ba'i dge mtshan gyi rba rlabs gnam du 'phyo ba/ dben gsum bsil zer 'phro ba'i gnas mchog khag tu sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs te tshe gcig zung 'jug gi go 'phang mngon du mdzad pa'i skyes bu chen po de nyid kyis/ gnas dus rten 'brel phun sum tshogs shing 'byung 'gyur mngon par gsal ba'i dgos pa dang rgyu mtshan chen po gzhir bzung / don la ston pa'i bstan bcos byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od mchog tu 'bar ba du ma bstan pa'i btsas su bzhag pa dgagadul bya'i bsod nams kyi zhing du bka' bsdu ci ltar mdzad pa'i gtam gyi sbyor ba gleng pa la gnyis/sngon gyi lo rgyus dang / skabs 'dir sgrig tshul lo/ /dang po/ brag dkar chos kyi dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i rnam thar dad pa'i rol mtsho las/mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa thugs su chud pas gang la'ang chags thogs med pa'i ngag gi dbang phyug chen por gyur te/ bstan bcos bka' rtsom gyi rim pa'ang ji snyed cig yod par nges kyang phal cher yig char ma 'khod cing 'ga' zhig so so'i 'dod ngo de dang der bstsal ba rnams ni kha 'thor bas phyogs gcig tu ma 'dus par snang / zhes pa ltar/ rig 'dzin rje rtag 'dzin can rnams kyi ngor sku 1

mya ngan las 'das shing thugs 'od gsal du mnal ba'i tshul bstan ma thag sku gdung so so'i yul du gdan 'dren ched/ mnga' ris la dwags rgyal po/ glo bo stod smad kyi rgyal po/ mdo khams kyi slob rigs/sa skyong sde dge'i rgyal po/ spo rong sa skyong dbang phyug rdo rje sogs kyis rtsod gleng yun ring por byas pa'i mthar/ 'brug chen dang / dpa' bo rin po che gnyis kyis chos dang mthun pa'i gtam gyis rgyal rnga brdung ba na thams cad kha gcig mthun 'og bla ma dang mched grogs kyi dam tshig la dgongs sku gdung mang yul ri bo dpal 'bar rang du bzhugs su gsol na'ang sku'i nyer spyad dang / phyag dpe sogs so so'i phyag tu yod pa dad rten du nyar ba las thams cad gros byas te gcig tu dril ba zhig ma byung la/lhag par khams phyogs dang bal yul du bzhugs pa rnams ni gnas kyis bskal bas sa gnas de dang de'i 'gro ba rnams kyi bsod nams kyi skal bar lhag pa las kun gyi spyod yul du ma gyur bar gsal lo/ /snga rjes ci rigs par bstan pa'i chag sgo mi nyung ba byung yang zhal slob chos rgyun dang bcas pas bstan dang 'gro la sman pa'i thugs bskyed kyi go cha btsan po gzhom du med pas gsung rtsom thor bu rnams ci ltar bsdus pa'i tshul ni/ dang po / sku mya ngan las 'das ma thag par bka' brgyud kyi bstan 'dzin kun gyi dbus na nya gang zla ba'i 'od snang ltar bshad sgrub las gsum gyi mdzad pa mngon par 'phags pa/ rig 'dzin rje'i rdo rjes lung las chos bdag las can gyi skyes bu mchog tu bsngags pa lo ri chos kyi rgya mtshos bka' 'bum rnyed do cog pod chen drug du bsdus nas phyogs bsgrigs mdzad cing dkar chag yan lag drug sbyar bya ba mdzad/gnyis pa/ grwa 'jam gling pa sngags 'chang shes rab 'byung gnas kyis 'bad rtsol chen pos gsung rtsom rigs ji snyed pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus te sde tshan bcu gnyis su phye ba la/ 1 rnam thar rtogs brjod kyi skor/ 2 zhal gdams gsung mgur gyi skor/ 3 dgongs gter gyi skor/ 4 bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi skor/ 5 dbang khrid brgyud pa'i bla ma'i gsol 'debs kyi skor/ 6 bstod tshogs kyi skor/ 7 khrid yig nyams len man ngag gi skor/ 8 sgrub thabs dbang dang gtor chog gi skor/9 lo rgyus rnam bshad kyi skor/ 10 bcu pa rig pa'i gnas kyi skor/ 11 chab shog gi skor/12 smon lam bzang po'i skor te glegs bam lnga/ rnam thar dad pa'i rol mtshor/ glegs bam lnga bo 'di bzhin las gzhan du bka' yi bsdu ba po su zhig kyang ma byung bar mngon/ 'di dag las phyogs su cung zad 'phel 'dug cing gong smos kyi tshig lung kyang phal cher sngags 'chang 'di nyid kyis thugs rtsol chen pos gsan thub par gnang bas rjes su yi rang ba'i gnas su 'khums mod/ deng sang ni dad ldan skal ba can re 'ga' tsam gyi spyod yul las gzhan du tshig lung lta ci/ dpe don gnyer tsam yang byed mi 2

dkon par mchis so/ /zhes gsung ba 'di chos la 'jug pa'i bskul ma byed pa las gzhan du sa phyogs du mar par ma dang bris ma sogs dpe rgyun sogs da lta yang cung zad snang na khong bzhugs pa'i skabs su de las kyang smos ci dgos/ bris ma der ma 'khod pa/ da lta rin chen gter mdzod du bzhugs pa'i dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi khrid yig rnam gnyis dang / rtsa rlung rdzogs rim khrid yig dgongs gter sgrol ma dmar mo'i skor/ bsam pa lhun grub kyi chog 'grig sogs yod/ grwa 'jam gling pa'i dpe 'dir mang yul skyid grong dge slong gi phyag dper grags shing pod lnga bo ma nyams par da lta rgya gar du bzhugs/gsum pa/ gnas nang dpa' bo rin po che dang / bka' brgyud dris lha sprul ba'i sku rin po ches dkar po rnam par 'phel ba'i slad du gsung 'bum thor bu po dong du shing par du bskrun pa'i dpe cho ga'i skor dang / rdzogs rim rtsa rlung khrid yig smon lam sogs 'ga' zhig deng dus yang mthong rgyu mchis mod par shing ni dus 'gyur gyi skabs su byin za'i klong du thim par gyur to/ /'dir snga mor 'ga' zhig gis pod chen mda' tshad ma bzhi yod zer ba dang / 'ga' zhig gis pod brgyad yod zer ba sogs bshad srol sna tshogs 'dug mod/ da lta mig sngar mthong ba rnams dpe thung thig phreng lnga can zhig las mi 'dug pas dpe gzhan yod min ma 'tshal lo/ /bzhi pa/ la dwags rgyal sras rin po ches mar yul phyogs na bzhugs pa thams cad pod brgyad du dril zhing bzhengs par phyis su stag tshang bla brang du bzhugs pas stag tshang bla dper grags pa de byung /'di spyi lo 1960lo'i bar cha tshang bar bzhugs na'ang bla chen dang bdag gnyer ba dbang chen du mas sger dbang du spyad pas phyed tsam dmigs pa med pa'i dbyings su rgyas btab te bltar mi mngon par byas pa dang lhag ma pod bzhi tsam 1982lor dilbir 'od par du bskrun/ rdzogs chen nam mkha' sum sprugs/ gcod yul ho ru ka dgyes pa'i gad mo/ gsang rnam bag chags yid kyi rang gzugs sogs grwa 'jam gling pa'i dpe la med pa du ma bzhugs/ ma dpe dngos dang skyar par byas pa dum bu re rna pa la dang rgya gar/ nub phyogs rgyal khab sogs su sger ba kha shas kyi lag tu yod pa mthong thos kyi yul du gyur la lhag par la dwags ching yig rgyas pa jar man gyi bhan slob grwa chen mor 'khyams nas yod pa re zhig lag tu son dka' bar gyur/lnga pa/ sku dngos bzhugs pa'i dus na sri zhu mi lhod cing mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshe na'ang dad dam mchog tu dge ba lha btsun 'gyur med chos 'dzin nam pad+ma chos 'dzin zhes mi dbang pho la bsod nams stobs rgyas kyi sku sring du gyur ba'i rang byung gi rnal 'byor ma chen mo des bla ma'i dgongs rdzogs la dmigs te/ gsung 'bum cha tshang ba bsdus te yi ger bkod/ rnying ma rgyud 'bum rin po che yang dbu 3

ldeb rnams gser bris la dkyil du gu ru rin po che gtso 'khor gsum/ pod re bzhin g.yas su rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu bzhugs stangs dang rnam 'gyur sna tshogs pa la g.yon du rje 'bangs nyer lnga re re bzhugs pa yang bzhengs te dkar ye dgon par skye 'gro'i mchod sdong du brtan par gsol/ gsung rab 'di phyis su dbyin ji'i dmag dpon chen po dbyang ha su bhan gyis khyer/ rgyud 'bum da lta dbyin ji'i rgyal spyi'i dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs mod/ sngar pod sum cu brgal ba yod par nges kyang da lta dkar chag ta dum pa/ oṃ dum pa bcas ma tshang / ca dum pa la dbu ldeb med/ sha dum pa dang a dum pa'i dbu ldeb kha skong byas 'dug āḥdum par chu skyon chen po shor yod/ hūṃḥdum pa yod med ma 'tshal/gzhan rnams shin tu spus gtsang nyar tshags gnang 'dug na'ang rig 'dzin gsung 'bum ni ldeb ma gcig kyang dbang bo'i yul du mi snang bas gang du 'thor ba'i rgyus su la yang mi snang bas mdzub mo 'dzug sa'i yul mi rnyed do/ /'di la rgyus yod tshul bshad mkhan mang du 'dug mod zhib tu dpyad tshe gna' gtam go thos tsam las tshang bar klog myong mkhan da bar ma rnyed do/ /drug pa/ gter ston chen po sur+ya sedha'i gdung rgyud/ rig 'dzin rje'i thugs zin gyi slob ma rje mgon nang pa'am/ yol mo pa 'phrin las bdud 'joms zhes grub pa'i skyes bu chen po/ rig 'dzin rje'i chos brgyud dar spel la stod phyogs su 'gran zla bral ba'i bka' babs gdung 'dzin du don gyis grub pa de nyid kyis rgyud 'bum dang rig 'dzin rje'i gsung 'bum gtso bor gyur ba'i chos kyi puste ka brgya phrag lhag bris te yol mo'i yul stod dar chen sgang gi gtsug lag khang du bzhugs pa/ chos kyi khe tshong sgrub par blo rig 'dre las skyen pa'i bla gzugs 'gas phyogs phyogs su btsong ste da lta dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi dpe pod re gnyis las gcig kyang mi snang ngo / /bdun pa/ mdo sngags rig pa'i gnas la rang byan tshud pa'i ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta si tu chos 'byung gnas kyis bla ma'i sku rten zhal thang mthong grol chen mo/ gsung rten dgongs gter bstan bcos yod tshad/ thugs rten dngul gyi mchod rten sogs bzhengs pa'i si tu'i rang rnam dang ngag rgyun du grags/par shing de yang dpal spungs rang du yod kyang phyis dus 'gyur gyi 'tshub ma dang mnyam du 'jig rten gzhan du gshegs par mngon/brgyad pa/ rong ston chen po pad+ma bde chen gling pa'i gdung brgyud/ rig 'dzin chen po'i sku mched du gtogs pa lcags bla chos skyong mgon po zhes drag sngags kyi bka' babs shing rdzogs phrang srog gsum la rang dbang 'byor bas dreg pa'i stong srog rnal du dbab cing lha srin sde brgyad bran du bkol ba'i rigs sngags 'chang ba de nyid kyis yon sbyar te khams brag dmar dbang chen gling du gsung 'bum 4

cha tshang ba'i shing par brkos pa skye bo'i bsod nams kyis ma chun par cha tshang ba zhig mthar ma phyin yang rgyal ba rnams kyi 'phrin las chud mi za bas phyis su brag dmar sprul sku pad+ma rgyal mtshan gyis 'jug yongs su phud cing de las 'phros pa'i rgyun cung zad dar mod/ mthar spyi mthun gyi las dbang ldog tu med pas rig gsar gyi dus kyi me lce 'bar ba'i klong du lhag med du thim par gyur to/ /dgu pa/ glo ba rgyal pos mthun rkyen sbyar te gsung 'bum cha tshang bris shing kha shas zhig par tu brkos pa'i rgyun las dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi rdzogs rim skor sogs byung ba da lta dus kyi gzhan dbang du gyur bas kha 'thor te cha tshang zhig med na'ang gna' dpe rnying pa re gnyis da lta yang yul de'i bsod nams kyi dpal du bzhugs so/ /bcu pa/ badz+ra a tsār+ya zhes gor ṣa rgyal po'i dbu blar bzhugs pa/ rig 'dzin rje la mi byed pa'i dad pa ldan zhing bal yul phyogs kyi rgyal tshab gcig pur gyur ba de nyid la sku bzhugs pa'i skabs su na bza' cha tshang / mchod cha/ mi rkang / phyag dpe mang po gnang ba'i nang gi nyer spyad 'ga' zhig slob dpon gyi gdung rgyud logs dha ra san zer ba'i phyag tu bzhugs mod/ slob dpon 'di nyid kyis rig 'dzin rje'i gsung 'bum cha tshang bris ma dang par yang re zung brkos yod par grags na'ang da lta yod pa bka' shog re gnyis tsam du gyur/ bcu gcig pa/ rje btsun mi la ras pa'i zung 'jug gi go 'phang mngon du mdzad pa'i gnas kyi rgyal po brag dkar rta so'i bstan pa'i bdag po/ mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i skyes bu chen po brag dkar chos kyi dbang phyug gis gsung 'bum kha shas par du bskrun pa dang / don gnyer chen pos stod phyogs kyi dpe phal mo che bsdus te yi ge gnyis par zhal bsgyur ba da lta yang ma nyams par nub ri slob dpon 'gyur med ces sbas pa'i rnal 'byor ba chen por bzhugs pa de'i phyag tu mchis kyang skal ba ldan pa re gnyis las kun kyi spyod yul du ma gyur ba zhig go/ /skyabs rje ka li rin po ches brag dkar phyag dpe 'dir nag rtsis las 'bras gsal sgron dang / rtsa rlung thig le'i khrid yig gi mchan 'grel sogs yod par gsungs kyang re zhig thun mong gis bltar mi mngon pa'i gnas su lhag go/ /rig 'dzin chen po'i sgrub thabs dang bskyed rdzogs skor mdo khams stod smad du cung dar na'ang / chab shog skor dang brgyud yig chos 'byung / dkar nag rtsis kyi rim pa/ sgra 'grel sogs khrid rgyun lta ci lung rgyun dang phyag dpe tsam yang dkon pas/ dbang lung khrid kyi rim pa tha na dpe rgyun thor bu tshun chad da lta stod phyogs dang / nai pāl dang rgya gar du ma nub tsam zhig gnas pa 'di skyabs rje brag dkar rin po che slob rgyun dang bcas pa'i bka' drin nyag gcig yin no/ /5

bcu gnyis pa/ khams phyogs su rgyal ba'i lung gis bsngags pa kong sprul blo gros mtha' yas kyi thugs smon stobs su gyur te/ mdzod chen lnga yi chos kyi sgo 'phar yangs por phye tshe sgrub thabs dang khrid yig gi skor mang po zhig rin chen gter mdzod chen por bstan pa'i btsas su bzhugs par gsol ba'i bka' drin gyis rig 'dzin rje'i gter chos kun gyi snying por gyur ba bsam pa lhun grub thabs bcu gsum gyi skor dang / dgongs gter sgrol ma dmar mo'i rtsa ba'i cho ga sogs shin tu gal che ba'i rigs kyi brgyud pa yangs pa'i sa chen po 'dir ma nyams par gnas pa'i bka' drin bsam mi khyab pa'i yul mtho/ /bcu gsum pa/ sge'i gter bdud 'joms gling pa dang gling sprul pad+ma lung rtogs/ grub chen nag po spyod pa'i sprul bar yongs su grags pa'i kaḥthog rig 'dzin chen po'i skye srid rig 'dzin 'gyur med rab rgyas sam 'jigs med rab brtan sogs kyi zhal slob mchog tu gyur pa reb gong sngags pa 'jigs med rdo rje rnam rgyal zhes theg pa rim dgu'i don la byang chub dpal chen sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi bsnyen sgrub them pas 'bod rbad bsad pa'i las sogs drag sngags la rang dbang thob pa de nyid kyis mdo khams phyogs kyi rig 'dzin rje'i gsung 'bum gyi dbang lung ci rigs pa thugs brtson chen pos mnos/ reb gong du khrid yig rnams par du bskrun zhing sgrub skor rnams dbu med du bris pa tshar du ma yod par grags kyang dus kyi rgud pa'i rang gshis bsgyur du med pas da lta dpe rgyun rtsad gcod byas tshe nam mkha'i 'ja' bzhin ltar yod kyang 'dzin du mi btub pa zhig go/ /a mdo'i phyogs su rig 'dzin chen po'i dbang lung khrid kyi brgyud pa dar spel gyi mdzad par grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po 'di nyid bka' drin mchog tu che ba yin no/ /skabs 'dir sgrig tshul/ dus 'gyur gyi 'khrugs long gnam sa bla 'og bsgyur ba lta bu byung zhing rgyal ba'i bka' dang dgongs 'grel/ man ngag gi rno so bsgrigs pa'i gdams pa sogs zhabs tog med par bag la zha ba'i skabs/ bstan dang 'gro la sman pa'i mdzad bzang bdag gir bzhes pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi thugs bskyed dang / rgyal khab kyis chos dad rang dbang gi cong brda mthon por bsgrags pa na yul dus dang bstun sgo thams cad nas bshad sgrub kyi grwa nyams gso dang / gsung rab par bskrun sogs lo shas ring bod kyi rig gnas dar rgyas phun sum tshogs par phyin pa mthong ba'i chos mngon par gyur zhing / go skabs bzang po 'di nyid dam 'dzin zhig ma byung na 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa'i gzhan dbang du gyur bas phyi 'khor yug nang tshe srog bcas snon pa med par chud za ba'i tshul mdo rgyud du ma nas gsungs phyir/ nam zhig srid pa'i chu klung chen po bzhi yis khyer ba'i tshe na 6

gang bsam 'dod thog tu phyin pa zhig yong dka' bas dka' ba'i las 'dir brtson pas 'jug pa'i spobs pa rnyed par gyur to/ /'das pa'i lo shas sngon bya bral rig gsal rin po ches rig 'dzin bsam lhun gyi cho ga kha 'thor zhig gnang zhing nam zhig 'di nyid cha tshang bar byas shing dpe gnyis par spel ba'i khur khyod la babs zhes bden pa'i gsung gis bskul ma mdzad pa snying la bcangs pa'i mur/ lo ngo bco brgyad tsam gyi ring la zan la gdung ba'i bya rgod bzhin phyogs kun tu 'khor zhing / gsung 'bum 'di'i nang gi sho lo ka gcig tshun chad la do snang cher bskyed nas bsdu sgrig byed pa'i las la gzhol/rang rgyal gyi bod gangs can gyi ljongs nas bzung the wan sogs dang / phyi rgyal nas nai pāl dang rgya gar brgyud/ phyi sog a ri/ h+pha ran si/ dbyin ji sogs kyi dpe mdzod phal mo cher phyin zhing bla ma mched grogs du ma sbran nas gsung 'bum 'di nyid nyams gso la rgyab skyor byed par bskul/ phyogs bsdu byed pa'i gnas tshul sgra 'dzin gyi lam du son pa dang bod kyi chos dang rig gnas la thugs khur che ba'i dam pa 'ga' zhig gis rma bya'i dbyar rnga thos pa ltar mthun 'gyur byed par dam bca' mdzad de/ 'bras ldan dus kyi shing lo bzhin phyogs kun tu 'thor zhing lo dang zla ba'i rlan gsher gyis gdung ste rul la nye ba'i ldeb shar kha 'thor/ shog lte hral hrul dag bstan la thugs stobs rgyas shing rig pa 'dzin pa'i gsung rab gtsug gi rgyan du bkur ba'i dad gus dang / lhag bsam dkar po'i rlung shugs kyis ci nus su bsdus te kho bo'i sug par bskyal/ 'ga' zhig la pusti ka re gnyis yod pa'i kha pho 'brug ltar ldir yang lag len sgyu ma'i bu mo'i reg bya ltar re sgug dang dngul gyi 'gro gron sogs ci btang yang don 'bras smin pa'i skal ba phra mo tsam yang ma byung / skabs rer ldeb shar re gnyis kyi don du sprang pos zas slong ba ltar mgo bo smad de zhu ba lan mang phul ba na yus dang bcas dpe bshus cung zad thob pa dang ma thob par tshig ngan gyi dbyug pas bsnun te bskrad pa'i skabs yang byung / skabs rer gnam gru dang mgron khang gi gla cha dang bdag gnyer mkhan rnams la ngo 'dzin sogs kyi 'gro gron brtsis na ldeb ma re la a sgor brgya phrag lnga re tsam shor song ba'i dus kyang 'dug mod stong log ma byung bas yi dga' bde'i gang ba las gzhan ci yod/ gzhung 'di bsdu sgrig phyogs la thugs khur dang rgyab skyor bla na med pa gnang ba'i mdzad rjes rlabs po che mnga' ba rnams gsham gsal/ mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i mkhyen pa'i chu gter chen po gcig tu 'khyil zhing / bstan pa'i mig ltos la dgongs 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi 'du ba rgyang bsrangs/ gnas dben pa'i ri khrod sha stag tu sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan bla mthor btegs te 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i lta sgom spyod pa klong du gyur ba'i gsang chen bstan pa'i shing rta skyabs rje bya bral ba sangs rgyas rdo rje dang / bya bral rig gsal rin po ches thugs bskyed bden pa'i 7

stobs kyis bya ba lam slong yong bar byin rlabs dang bskul ma mdzad pas bar du gcod pa'i tshogs la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa sbyin/ rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling ba'i skye srid de ma thag pa spang rtogs kyi yon tan gang gi cha nas 'phags yul gyi grub chen brgyad cu dang zhal mi gnyis pa/ mdo mkhyen brtse ye shes rdo rje zhes mtshan snyan skye ba lnga ba'i sgra dbyangs sa gsum na mngon par grags pa'i 'khrungs rabs gser gyi ri bo tshar du dngar ba'i khrod na mngon par 'phags pa grub dbang gzan dkar bar grags pa de nyid kyi sku phreng dang gdan sa 'dzin pa'i mchog sprul smra ba'i seng ge skyabs mchog thub bstan nyi ma zhes snyigs ma'i dus 'dir sa chen po'i steng gi rgyal bstan 'dzin skyong spel bar bsnyel ba med pa'i thugs bskyed brtan pos gsung rab nyams gso'i mdzad pa 'phags bod bstan 'dzin rgyu skar phreng ba lta bu'i nang na bde 'byung gtsug rgyan ltar mngon par gsal ba de nyid kyis/ rig 'dzin rje'i phyag bris phyag mchan du ma bsdu pa dang yi ger gsar 'jug sogs kyi bya bar bka' drin tshad med pa bskyangs pa dang / phyi nang gi chos dang rig gzhung spyi dang khyad par bod kyi gtsug lag gi gzhung lugs nyams gso'i thugs stobs rmad du byung zhing dka' ba brgya phrag la ma 'dzems par phyi gling gi ljongs su bod kyi gna' dpe srung skyobs dar spel byas pa'i lag rjes la mchog gi skyes bu du mas bsngags brjod kyi rol mo 'bum du dkrol ba a ri rgan 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal lam jen si men bya bas rig 'dzin rje'i bde mchog phyag mchan dgyes bzhin bstsal ba dang / gangs ljongs rig pa'i gnas la srog ltar btsa' zhing bal bo nai pāl sogs su gna' dpe srung skyob kyi khur chen phrag par bzhes nas lo ngo nyi shu tsam la dal ba med pa'i par bskrun sogs kyis 'tsho ba'i dus 'da' zhing / gso rig rgya mtsho'i phreng ba mgul du bcangs pas gzhan phan rjes 'dzin gyi 'phrin las la dbang 'byor ba la dwags sman rams pa bkra shis rgang pas/ bgrang bya'i phreng ba mang po'i nang du ldeb re nas bsgrubs pa'i rig 'dzin rje'i gsung rtsom thor bur gyur pa'i dpe rnams dga' mgu rjes su yi rang dang bcas pas lhag lus med par 'di gar phul ba gsung 'bum 'di'i rmang gzhi gtso bo yin/ kun gzigs snang ba mtha' yas paṇa chen bcu ba chen po'i rdo rje'i lung las la dwags lo tsā ba zhes pa'i mtshan gyi cho lo bstsal ba mnga' ri la dwags ljongs kyi gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas dbang bkra shis rab rgyas nas rig 'dzin rje'i rnam thar chen mo dbyin yig tu bsgyur ba chabs cig gsung 'bum bsgrig pa la bskul ma dang dpe khungs sogs ji snyed pa legs par bstan cing thugs khur che bzhes gnang / phyag rdzogs zung 'jug gi gdam ngag chu bo gcig 'dres su bzhugs pa rig 'dzin rje'i rang lugs gtsang ma la rgyu mtshan shes pa'i dad gus dang srung skyob 'chad spel sogs kyi 'phrin las kyi 'od snang 'bar ba bla ma wa gin+d+ra pusbyi sirnyis gsang ba'i 8

yig cha lung bstan sogs ci rigs pa bstsal ba gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi snon mar gyur/ gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i phreng ba mgul du 'phyang ba'i sa skya mkhan po kun dga' bzang pos yi ge klog klad du 'jug pa dang zhu dag sogs gang la mgo 'dren lam ston rgyun chags su bstsal bas dus yun thung ngu zhig gi nang du gsung 'bum 'di legs 'grub byung ba'i mdzad rjes gzhal du med/ krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang gis deb gzugs ring min skye bo yongs kyi thun mong du spyod pa'i thugs khur dang rgyal gces chos gces kyi lag len dngos su bstar zhing dpe skrun gnang bar rnam par dkar ba'i las la rjes su yi rang dang bsngags pa byed 'os pa byung / de ltar bka' drin gzhal du med pa'i skyes bu de dag dang gzhan yang ldeb ma re gnyis dang dpe dkon min kyang dpe cung zad re mi 'dra ba'i rigs sogs bsdu bar rgyab skyor dang rogs ram mi dman pa gnang ba'i mched grogs mdza' bshes rnams kyi lhod pa med pa'i brtson 'grus dang / zhum pa med pa'i snying stobs la bsten nas bka' 'bum 'di par du legs par bskrun thub pa yin pas 'dir de dag la thugs rje che zhu'o/ /ji ltar sgrig tshul/ snga mor rgya gar du glog klad du bcug kyang mthar 'khyol ba zhig ma byung ba'i khar dpe re gnyis la gnod skyon mi nyung ba thebs/ rjes su the wan ljongs su rang dgon gyi a khu blo gros tshang dang / skal bzang rgya mtsho/ dge 'dun sbyin pa bcas la ched mngags kyis glog klad du 'jug par bskul ba dang lhag par bswe grwa tshul khrims rgya mtshos brtson 'grus thang lhod med par brten mi ring bar glog klad du cha tshang 'jug thub pa byung yang yig gzugs dang zhu dag gi thad blo bde bo zhig ma byung bas re zhig gyi nar 'jog dgos byung / skabs 'dir skyabs mchog gzan dkar rin po che'i lam ston 'og kun gyi 'dren byed kyi lam du shar thub pa byung zhing / sgrig tshul yang chos tshan so so byes/ ma dpe re gnyis la gsal bshad dgos rigs so so'i mgo'am gsham du mchan gyi tshul du bkod/ brda dag dang mi mthun pa'i yig nor nges pa rnams dpe gzhan dang bsdur dpyad pa gsum gyis brtags te drang por bsrangs/ brda rnying ngam gsung pa po'i dgongs pa gang yin ma nges pas tshig gi cha la dpyad mi bzod pa dang / rtog ge'i tshig las lkog tu gyur pa dang / don la ston pa'i ming tshig rnams ma bcos par rang dgar bzhag spyir rig 'dzin rje'i gsung 'bum par ma dang bris ma gang yin yang yul skad kyis shan zhugs pa/ 'bri nor/ bcos nor sogs yig skyon lu gu rgyud du 'byams shing dpe phan tshun gyi tshig kyang gcig mtshungs med pas dpyad dka' ba'i gnas su gyur na'ang / 'dir don gyi cha nas dpe cung zad khungs btsun pa mang yul skyid grong grwa 'jam gling pa'i phyag dpe gtso bor bzung / der yig nor sogs ci yod stag tshang bla brang gi dpe dang bstun ci thub bgyis/ lhag par bde mchog gi mchan 9

'grel 'di rnga yul bswe sog po tshang gi rigs smra ba blo gros rnam rgyal mchog gis thugs khur che bzhes kyis glog klad du bcug pa yin yang / ma phyir yig nor dang brda rnying gang yin ma nges pa dang / ma phyi mi gsal ba/ mchan gang nas yin dpyad dka' ba/ gong 'og gang du 'brel dgos cha ma 'tshal ba'i rigs mang du yod pas/ glog klad du 'jug tshe mchan re gnyis gang du bcug dgos ma shes par gang dang thag nye ba'i tshig gi mgo snga gang rung der rgya mar rgya rdo 'dogs pa ltar byed pa las thabs zad/dus tshod kyi dbang gis ha cang dpyad pa'i long ma byung bas rjes su blo dang ldan pa'i zhib 'jug dang gsung rab la go ba mchog tu zab pa dag gis ma phyi dngos la gzigs nas yid brtan pher ba'i zhu dag gnang na bstan pa'i rgyun la phan pa bla na med par 'byung nges so/ /slad mar bstan pa'i khur chen bdag gir bzhes mkhan yod tshe mchan 'grel ma phyi cha tshang 'bul nges yin la zhal bzhes mang la phyag bzhes nyung ba dang ltad mo tsam dang co 'dri ba'i rigs la ni phul yang don gyis dbul lo/ /dpe 'dir shin tu gsang bar 'os pa'i lung bstan kha shas dang / gsang rnam bka' rgya ma nyung ngu las gzhan tshigs su bcad pa gcig tshud chad lag tu ci 'byor cha tshang bsgrigs nas yod pas/ 'dir ma 'dus pa'i dpe yod tshe yig ldeb gcig yin yang bstan dang 'gro la sman pa'i thugs bskyed gtso bor bzung nas rma yul mu ra dgon du 'brel ba gnang na skyes dang bcas skyar par sogs kyi zhabs zhu dga' zhing spro ba'i sgo nas sgrub nges lags so/ /gsung 'bum sbyi'i grub cha/ bod kyi rgyal rabs/ bstan rtsis/ chab shog dkar rtsis/ nag rtsis/ sgra 'grel/ phyag chen/ rdzogs chen/ cho ga chos spyod/ chog 'grig zin bris/ gter chos sogs 'dus/ lo rgyus skor la mtshon na/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che byang phyogs su byung ba'i bod rje lha btsan po'i gdung rabs tshig nyung don gsal yid kyi me long / bod rje lha btsan po'i gdung rabs mnga' ris gung thang du ji ltar byung ba'i tshul deb ther dwangs shel 'phrul gyi me long / bod kyi rgyal rabs gser gyi phreng bar grags pa las mnga' ris stod mar yul bdag po'i deb ther/ mar mi dwags po jo bo yab sras sogs dam pa 'ga' zhig gi rnam thar sa bon gyi dus kyi nges pa brjod pa dag ldan nyung gsal/ lha rje mnyam med zla 'od gzhon nu'i bka' brgyud phyag chen gdams pa ci tsam nod pa'i rtogs brjod legs bshad rin chen 'byung khungs sogs/ 'das pa'i lo rgyus dang rje yi gdung rabs/chos kyi 'byung khungs/ bla brgyud dang slob brgyud kyi dpyad gzhi'i yig cha bla na med pa zhig dang / khyad par mnga' ris khul gyi lo rgyus la mtshon na da yod kyi yig cha rnams kyi nang nas ches phul du byung ba zhig red ces phyi nang gi mkhas pa mang pos rtsa chen du brtsi/ bod ljongs spyi tshogs tshan rig khang gis 10

bsgrigs pa'i bod kyi lo rgyus rags rim g.yu yi phreng ba bya bar yang mang che shos khong gi gsung rtsa bar bzung pa sha stag red/rig gnas skor/ rtsis kyi skor la mtshon na/ rig 'dzin grub rtsis bya ba ni/ kha gsal la don 'dus pa/ gzhung chung zhig gis rgya bod kyi rtsis spyi'i go don gsal bor shes thub pa/ bod rtsis dang /dus 'khor/ rdo rje gdan bzhi/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ thal 'gyur sogs kyi rgyud rtsis rnams phal skad tshig nag gi sgo nas ston pa'i sngar med legs bshad cig yin/ nag rtsis las 'bras gsal sgron sogs kyang 'dzin bde la dgos mkho che bas gdugs zhabs kyi bla chen nas grong chog sngags ban kun la med du mi rung ba zhig yin/ gzhan sgra ṭīka dang / skad gnyis shan sbyar sogs dus 'gyur gyi dbang gi re zhig cha tshang ba zhig lag son ma byung yang brgyud pa rna pāl yul gyi a tsār+ya rnams la yod pa thos so/ /chab shog skor la mtshon na/ gong zhabs bdun pa dang / mi dbang pho la bsod nams stobs rgyas/ la dwags rgyal po khag bka' rnying gi bla sprul khag sde dge rgyal po sogs la bskur ba'i yi ge khag nas de'i skabs kyi 'brel yod kyi mi sna/ chab srid kyi rgyab ljongs/ nang khul gyi snyog dra/ spyi tshogs kyi gnas stangs sogs gsal bor yod pas snyan ngag mkhan gyi rab btags kyi rgyan lta bu ma yin par lo rgyus zhib 'jug par gson nyams ldan pa'i gnas tshul zhig mkho sprod thub nges/'grel zin skor/ rdzogs chen nam mkha' sum sprugs/ dam pa'i zhi byed kyi khrid/ ni gu chos drug gi khrid/ bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i sgrub thabs khrid kyi yi ge sku gsum lam rim mchog gi sgo 'byed zhes bya ba/ dpal phyag rgya chen po rang babs kyi man ngag ga'u ma'i rtsa sdom sa bcad zhib mor smos pa rgyal ba'i snying po zhes bya ba/ phyag chen ga'u ma'i khrid yig sa bon tsam gyur bdud rtsi'i thig le zhes bya ba/ rtsa ba'i bla ma che tshang drug pa karma rig 'dzin gyi zhal gdams tshig gsum gyi don gsal bar bstan pa gser gyi zhun ma sogs man ngag gi khrid yig rnams ni rgyas bsdus ran la/snying po bton pa/ brgyud pa'i man ngag ldan pa/ tshig gi spros pa bskyung nas zab don rjen par phyungs pa bka' rnying snga rabs kyi bshad srol grwa ma nyams pa/ nyams len mkhan por yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang mtshungs pa sha stag yin/ khyad par khrid yig gu ru'i dgongs rgyan ni/ kaḥthog khrid chen bcu gsum gyi ya gyal te bka' rnying kun la grags shin tu che'o/ /cho ga chos spyod skor/ rdzogs chen sngon 'gro'i ngag 'don/ rdor sems rnying thig gi ngag 'don/dus 'khor sbyor drug gi ngag 'don/ ni gu chos drug gi ngag 'don/ gzhan bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi sgrub thabs/ dus 'khor/ gur drag phur ba/ bsam lhun sgrub thabs sogs snga 'gyur rnying ma dang /11

phyi 'gyur gsar ma gnyis ka la mkho ba'i rgyun gyi chos spyod cha tshang la 'don bde ba/ khyad par du rgyun khyer rnams bka' rnying gi bla ma gong ma rnams kyi thugs dam byed myong la byin rlabs thob pa'i lo rgyus kyang grags che ba/ gzhan grong chog mkhan po rnams kyi gson po'i skyabs 'jug dang / shi bo'i lam sna 'dren pa la med du mi rung ba'i lag cha yang mang du mchis/ gzhan bla ma/ yi dam/ mkha' 'gro sogs kyi gsol 'debs/ chos skyong rnams kyi bsang gsol mang nyung du ma mchis pa de dag bod kyi spyi tshogs dang kha bral dka' ba/ ban+de dang bon po/ mi nag skya bo su yin yang za ba'i dus kyi tshogs mchod/ dus bzang rnams kyi bsang mchod/ phor ba khar tshad kyang / mdung rtser dgrar tshad kyang kha nas 'don dgos pa dang khog par shar dgos pa'i lag cha/ spros pa can la dga' ba'i ring po/ le lo can dgyes pa'i thung ngu sogs grangs mang ba zhig yod pa 'di bod mi rnams la sha 'dod kyi sha dang / tshil 'dod la tshil du 'gyur ba ni smos ma dgos so/ /khong gi rnam thar skor da lta yod pa/ dag snang / lam yig gsang ba'i rnam thar gnyis sogs rang gis mdzad pa che chung brgyad tsam dang / brag dkar rin po ches mdzad pa'i rnam thar rgyas pa ldeb sum brgya lhag yod pa dang / bsdus pa gnyis bcas bzhugs so/ /gzhan 'ba' ra ba dang ngag dbang ye shes dang / rta nag pa pad+ma 'od gsal sogs kyis mdzad pa'i rnam thar yod pa gsal yang dus 'gyur gyi dbang gis kun gyi thun mong gi yul du ma gyur pa'o/ /ces bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs 'phrul par du bskrun pa'i tshe/ kaḥthog rig 'dzin chen po'i skye ming tsam du grags kyang don du dug gsum gyi khol bor gyur pa mur smyon pad+ma dbang chen gyis rab byung bcu bdun pa'i shing sprel lo'i zla bdun pa'i dkar phyogs dga' ba dang po'i dus bris pa dge/

mdzad pa po'i lo rgyus mdor bsdu/kaḥthog rig 'dzin chen po tshe dbang nor bu/ spyi lo 1697da 1755bar/ mdo khams spo 'bor sgang gi char gtogs/ re khe sa ngan gyi yul ljang chu'i g.yon phyogs khams kyi ri bo bkra bzang ngam btsan rgod ri bkra'i nye zur/ ri bo bya khyung gi mdun sa/ dung dkar ri khrod du grags pa'i bsam gtan gyi bskyil bur sku 'khrungs/ chung ngu'i dus nas rong ston pad+ma bde chen gling pa/ brag dmar kun bzang khyab brdal lhun grub sogs kyis rig 'dzin pad+ma nor bu'i skye srid kyi mtshan gyi cod paṇa dbu la gsol/ chos rgyun gnyis kyi sprul skur ngos 'dzin mdzad pa ltar na/ kaḥthog lugs su rig 'dzin chen po sku phreng gnyis pa dang / jo nang lugs la sku phreng lnga bar bgrang pa yin/ mtshan gyi rnam grangs la/ rig 'dzin gter bzhad rtsal/ 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/ 'od gsal bde gshegs snying po/ dpa' bo don grub rdo rje/ rnal 'byor ma rab tu dgyes pa'i rdo rje/ rdo rje drag po/ kun bzang 'phrin las 'gro ba yongs 'dul rtsal/ bsod nams theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs mtshan mchog brgya rtsa'i phreng ba tshar du dngar/ khong gi sku che'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus na rmad byung mdzad chen bzhi zhes grags pa ni 'di lta ste/dmag dang 'khrugs rtsod thabs kyis bzlum zhing mi 'jigs skyabs kyi sbyin pa bstsal/ rten gsum gso dang phyogs med sbyangs te ris med grub mtha'i srol tshugs pa/ mkhas grub dam pa'i thugs zin zhing brgyud pa dkon po'i srog mthud pa/ gson dur sba pa'i rgyun bcad de gzhan phan dge ba'i lugs spel ba dang bzhi'o/ /'ga' zhig gis/ rten gsum dang brgyud pa nyams gso/ kha mchu dang gson dur rgyun bcad pa ste bzhir bgrang / yang 'ga' res/ sbyang ba mdzad de mkhas par gyur ba/ nyams len byas pas grub pa thob pa/ brgyud pa nyag phra rming nas gsos pa/ gson dur bcad cing kha mchu bzlum pa dang bzhir bshad/ rnam thar rnams gung bsgrigs na mdzad pa de dag rgyas par gsal mod dmigs sar gyis mdzad chen bzhir bgrang ba ni ngag rgyun la yongs su grags pa zhig las rnam par dpyad cing kha tshon bcad pa'i yig rnying ni re zhig bltar chog pa'i bsod nams kyi skal bar ma gyur to/ /'dir rnam thar spyi don tsam brjod na/ rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying po'i lung bstan nyi zla kha sbyor las/ kaḥthog lho ru nor bu'i mingaḥ ya mtshan shes rab snying rjer ldanaḥ dpal mgon chos dang 'phrad srid naḥdangos grub myur du thob pa 'byung ཿ zhes dang / pad+ma nga sprul nag po'i byin rlabs shingaḥ nam snying 13

thugs kyi 'od zer zhugs gyur paḥ kaḥthog lho phyogs btsan ri'i nye 'dabs suḥ mchog dman spangs pa bar ma dag gi rigasaḥ mgon dang mtsho zhes bya ba gnyis kyi buḥ dbang ngam nor bu'i ming can snying stobs canaḥ mi che mi chung sgeg pa rdo rje'i lusaḥ rtsa rlung thig le skyon med mkha' 'gro 'duḥzhes dang / gab rgya can las/ thugs kyi grub chen nam snying yang sprul zhigaḥ mdo khams bu 'byor nye ba'i phyogs nas 'byungaḥ ma ṇi badz+ra 'gro 'dul snying stobs ldanaḥ rten 'brel ma chug mchog gi gter lnga spyodaḥ 'dzam gling 'gro ba 'dren pa'i sgron me 'draḥ zhes 'phags yul gyi grub chen nag po ba dang /gu ru'i thugs sras las can dag pa'i 'khor lnga'i ya gyal gnubs chen nam mkha'i snying po/ zur chung shes rab grags pa dang sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ rje btsun sgrol ba'i mgon po sogs ye shes sgyu ma'i gar gyis rol ba de nyid/ thog mar kaḥthog rgyal sras bsod nams lde'u btsan la gtsug phud phul bas bsod nams theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan nges gsang grub pa'i shing rta phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde zhes pa'i mtshan gyi ba dan gzeng 'thor bsgreng / kaḥthog ma dgon du gdan drangs nas gser khrir mnga' gsol te dgon ma lag brgya rtsa'i bstan pa'i bdag por dbang bskur/ sngon sbyang bag chags stobs su gyur pas dka' spyad brtson pas slob gnyer la rag ma lus kyang / sprul gzhi phun sum tshogs pa'i gleng sgros dang chen po'i go 'phang tsam la skyabs mi 'cha' bar bstan pa'i mig ltos kho na bka' btsan par byas nas thun mong rig gnas dang thun min man ngag gi skor gyi dbang lung khrid gsum/ gar thig dbyangs gsum cho ga'i phyag len tshun chad grub thob so so'i bzhed gzhung ma 'dres par byas te bslab/ de skabs byed pa rgyu mthun las kyis chu sna gar khrid du rgyugs pa'i jag tshogs zhig gis brag dmar dang gnas nang sogs kyi lha rten 'phrog bcom dang grwa btsun mang po bsad rmas sogs dmyal ba'i bud shing 'bad pas bsgrub pa na/ gter ston bde chen gling pas bstan dgra tshar gcod pa'i 'phrin las rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu la gtad pa yin ces bka' lung nor bu'i me long gtsug tu bkod/ gang gis las ngan thabs kyis 'dren pa'i thugs bskyed brtan pos bla ma'i bka' bzhin bgyid par dam bcas te drang srong gza' nag gi chos skor gter nas bzhes/ yul gsum gyad du gyur pas dregs pa'i stong srog la dbang bsgyur zhing srung ma las la rbad te gtor zor 'phang pas ming rus yod pa'i jag gtso bdun cu rtsa lnga tsam grib gyis non nas lnga ba'i lam du bzhud/ phyogs gtogs rnams kyi gdugs pa'i rlang spyod rtsub mo spa bkong bar byas shing phyag rgya gnyan po'i zil 'og tu bcug der dgon chen gyi mi chos byed pa la thugs sun nas bya bral gyi mdzad pa bskyangs/ zur mang bka' brgyud tre hor chos kyi dbang po dang mjal bas/ a le/ sa bzang pa de 'di na 'dug gsungs nas thugs 14

mnyes pa chen pos rjes su bzungs shing bka' rnying jo gsum gyi zab chos mang du gsungs nas nang thugs kyi sras gcig pur gyur/ khong ni lung bstan ltar dbus gtsang gi phyogs su phebs te chos lung byang rtser jo nang chos rje kun bzang dbang po dang mjal zhing chos 'brel thog ma zhus/ rim par dgung lo sum cu rtsa grangs skabs snga rjes du mar/ grol mchog zhabs kyi khrid brgya/ kun mkhyen yab sras kyi gsung 'bum/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum sogs jo nang lugs kyi chos skor gyi rgyun ci bzhugs lhag lus med par zhus shing bla ma la bka' drin gso ba'i phyir maṇ+ḍal dgu tshan du ma phul/ chos rje mchog gis sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi yang srid dngos yin zhes pa'i bka' gnang te jo nang ri khrod du chos khrir mnga' gsol mdzad/ de nas bzung jo nang gi chos skor 'chad spel rgyud mi chad pa bgyis te snying po phyir mi ldog pa 'khor lo'i gtam gyis yangs pa'i sa chen po khyab par byas/ mang yul skyid grong gi phug pa zhig tu sbyor ba yan lag drug gi nyams len yun ring mdzad pas brag ngos nas bdud rtsi chu ltar babs/ dgun gyi dus su nam mkhar 'ja' shar/ yul de'i gnas bdag zhing skyong rgya gar lha mo dngos su mi la phebs shing 'phrin las sgrub par zhal gyis bzhes/ phug pa der kaḥthog bdud rtsi phug ces grags pa deng sang yang yod do/ /jo nang ri khrod du rten bzhengs rgya chen po byas/ rtag brtan dgon du dus 'khor lha dgu'i sbyor 'jag spyi rdzas phul te bskal ba ma stong bar du mi chad pa'i yi ge bris pa bka' 'bum du da lta yang ma nyams par bzhugs/ sde dge'i par khang du nges don snying po'i mdo bcu'i shing par bzhengs shing dkar chag mdzad/ gting skyes dgon pa nyams gso dang bde mchog sgrub pa sogs btsugs/ kun mkhyen dol po ba'i chos khri'i khar bzhugs nas nges don snying po'i bka' khrid rgya cher gnang ba'ang rnam thar chen mor gsal/ kong po nas sgrol ma dmar mo dang rig byed ma'i skor gter nas drangs te rgyal dbang skal bzang rgya mtsho la phul bas khong gi gsang ba'i dbu blar gyur/ phan tshun chos kyi 'brel ba dam pa'i skor gsang rnam dang kong sprul gsung dang / gu ru bkra shis kyi chos 'byung sogs su gsal/ phyis su bsil ldan kha ba'i ljongs kyi rgyal bstan ma lus gdan thog gcig tu nyams su len pa'i tshul la ma rmongs pas ris med bstan pa'i srol 'byed du yongs su grags/ mi dbang pho lha bsod nams stobs rgyas kyi bla mar bkur te khong la sgos su gsung ba'i bka' gter gyi gdams pa du ma dang bod kyi dus 'gyur legs par gsal ba'i lung bstan chen mo mdzad/ rna pāl rgyal po dang kor+ṣa rgyal po sogs kyis gdan drangs pa ltar bal yul du phebs nas rgyal po khag gi ched du dus 'khor cho ga dang / yang dag grib sel/ phur ba'i cho ga sogs mdzad/ mchod rten bya rung kha shor dang / 'phags pa shing kun bcas nyams gso rgya chen po mdzad pa'i tshul gsal bor 'khod pa'i rdo ring da lta 'phags pa 15

shing kun tu yod/ nā ga ko ṭi'i grong la me'i 'jigs pa byung ba rdzu 'phrul gyis bzlog pa dang / ne+e pāl rgyal po'i sras kyi gdung sdigs mdzub kyis bsreg cing khyo ka shi na bud med yang gson dur du 'jug pa'i srol ngan rgyun bcad/ nai pāl rgyal po chad don la ma gnas par he ru'i skur bzhengs nas phyag 'bebs gnang bas ci bgos bka' las mi 'da' ba'i dam bca' phul/ glo bo rgyal po dang mang yul gung thang rgyal po/ sa skyong sde dge rgyal po sogs che dgu yongs kyi bla mar gyur/ rgyal dbang skal bzang rgya mtsho'i sku tshab byas te la dwags yul du ching sgrig la phebs shing bka' las 'gong zhing dam la mi gnas pa'i la dwags rgyal po bkra shis rnam rgyal rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs kyis dbang du bsdus/ blta stangs mdzad pas rgyal po dran med du brgyal zhing ci gsung bka' bsgrub khas len byas te 'khrugs rtsod chos kyi phyogs su zhi bar mdzad nas gong sa mchog gi bka' 'grub par bgyis/ zangs yig rnam lnga dang chings yig chen mo bzhag te bgrang bya du ma'i ring du 'khrugs rtsod med par bde skyid kyi 'tsho bar longs su spyod pa byung / he mi dgon pa sogs su bca' khrims gtan khel ba byas te dam chos log pa'i phyogs su 'grel zhing mi ser gyi bde skyid 'joms pa dang / dam nyams khrims 'gal/ 'chal bar spyod pa'i tshogs rnams dge 'dun pa'i gral nas byung zhing ming gi lhag mar bzos/ gzhung sa nas kong po ljon pa lung dgon 'bangs bcas pa rig 'dzin chen por mchod gzhis su bstsal yang khong dgongs pa rdzogs rjes bka' brgyud pa'i bdag po byas yod pas zhwa dmar ba'i don rkyen gyis phyir rtsis bzhes mdzad pa yin/ bal yul/ 'brug 'bras ljongs/ bod yul sogs kyi dgon sde brgya phrag lhag nyams gso dang gsar bzhengs mdzad/ karma pa sku phreng gsum pa dang zhwa dmar bcu pa sogs khong gi lung bstan ltar ngos 'dzin mdzad cing khrir bkod/ khong gi gsung las skyes pa'i zhal slob kyang / gong gsal ltar/karma pa zhwa dmar nag si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas/ 'brug chen dpag bsam bzang po/ gnas nang dpa' bo rin po che/ karma 'phrin las bdud 'joms/ skyes mchog 'ba' ra ba/ kaḥthog lcags bla chos skyong mgon po/ mi dbang pho lha bsod nams stobs rgyas/ la dwags rgyal blon khag 'brug lho brag sde srid/ bka' blon rtse mgron ja sag nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ smin gling mkha' 'gro 'phrin las dpal sgron lcam sring / bal yul gyi dbu bla badz+ra a tsār+ya/ lcags zam chos rje/ 'dod dpal mkhan chen sogs bka' rnying gi bla chen phal mo che sku'i zhal slob tu ma gyur pa med la chos rgyun gzhan gyi skyes chen mang pos yang rje 'di nyid kyi zhal gyi bdud rtsi myong ba'o/ /rje 'di chos rgyun spyi dang khyad par shangs pa bka' brgyud dang jo nang pa gnyis la bka' drin lhag par che ste/ shangs chos phal cher khong la ma brgyud pa med cing/jo nang gi grol mchog zhabs kyi khrid brgya dang / tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum sogs kyi dbang lung khrid kyi 16

brgyud pa mdo khams la yongs su khyab par khong gi brgyud pa la ma 'dus pa phal cher med de/ kong sprul rin po che'i khrid brgya'i brgyud yig dang / a lag grong mang tshang gi mdzad pa'i tā ra nā tha'i bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi dbang lung khrid gsum gyi brgyud yig las/ tsha grang bkres skom dka' ngal khyad bsad nas/ /dbus gtsang gnas byon gsang chen bdud rtsi thob/ /brtul zhugs grub pa'i dpa' bo sgrol ba'i mgon/ /tshe dbang nor bu'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs pas shes so/ /nai pāl yul gyi 'phags pa shing kun tu rig 'dzin rjes si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas la nges don snying po'i mdo rnams bka'adhekhrid gnang zhing lta ba gzhan stong byas na mdzad 'phrin phyogs kun rgyas pa dang / bstan dang 'gro la phan pa rgya cher 'byung ba/ sku tshe yang mthar phyin pa'i bka' babs pa si tu'i rang rnam du gsal lo/ /phyis su si tus kyang bla ma'i bka' bzhin bgyis pas jo bstan mdo khams yongs dang 'jang yul tshun la dar ba yin no/ /si tu'i zhal slob zur mang tshe dbang kun khyab dang / 'jam mgon gong sprul/ 'ju mi pham gyi dus 'khor brgyud pa'ang rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu la gtug pa sha stag yin la/rnying ma dang bka' brgyud phyogs la jo nang gi nyams len khyab brdal du spel ba rje rig pa 'dzin pa 'di nyid kyi 'phrin las las byung ngo / /da lta'i 'dzam thang dgon/ 'brog dge dgon/ bswe dgon sogs su gtsang pa dge slong gi brgyud pa'ang cung zad yod mod/ gdams ngag mang che shos kyi brgyud pa rig 'dzin chen po mchog nas byung ba jo nang chos 'byung dang thob yig bla brgyud gsol 'debs sogs bsdur na shes te/ jo nang chos 'byung zla ba'i sgron me'i lhan thabs su/ rje 'di nyid chos lugs rnying ma pa yin yang rang re'i chos bka' chen po'i srol bzung gi sgo nas 'dzin skyong spel gsum rlabs po che'i mdzad bzang nye bar mnga' bas bka' drin lhag par che ba rje 'di gter chen brgya rtsa'i gras su'ang bzhugs/ zhes 'khod yod do/ khyad par rnga yul a lag grong mang rin po che rig 'dzin rnam snang rdo rje khong gi skye srid dang chos brgyud 'dzin pa'i gtso bor gyur pas rnga yul bswe dgon chen du rig 'dzin rje'i bka' srol dam sel gyi slad ma zhugs pa/ byin rlabs kyi 'od snang 'bar ba/ ma dang mkha' 'gro'i zhal rlangs thu le ba 'di nyid bzhugs pa yin te/ dper na/ a lag grong mang rin po che'i mdzad pa'i dus 'khor sbyor drug bla brgyud du/ chos rje kun bzang dbang po la gsol ba 'debs/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu la gsol ba 'debs/ /paṇa chen chos kyi 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs/ /ces gsungs so/ /bde mchog gi bla brgyud du/ chos rje kun bzang dbang po nas/ 'phags pa'i yul du kaṇ+ḍa pa chen po/ /gangs can ljongs 'dir nam snying byams pa 'bum/ /sgrol ba'i mgon po'i zlos gar bsam bzhin du/ /tshe dbang nor bur bsgyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /ces pa nas si tu paṇa chen la 17

brgyud yod/ 'jigs byed bla brgyud du/ rwa ba ngag dbang 'phrin las kun bzang dbang / tshe dbang nor bu paṇa chen chos kyi 'byung / /zhes pa nas be lo tshe dbang kun khyab la brgyud do/ /mgon po trag shad kyi tshogs mchod du/ kun bzang dbang po tshe dbang nor bu'i zhabs/ 'phrin las shing rta gtsug lag chos kyi snang / /zhes rig 'dzin rje'i zhal slob 'brug pa bka' brgyud 'phrin las shing rta nas si tu dang de nas be lo tsā bar brgyud yod/ lam 'bras la/ kaḥthog rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu dang / /si tu paṇa chen dharma kā ra la/ /zhes dang / phyag chen lhan skyes la/ 'khor lo'i mgon po brtse chen kun tu bzang / /tshe dbang nor bu ngag dbang rnam par rgyal/ /zhes dang / sgrol ma rnal 'byor mar/ bka' drin mnyam med kun bzang dbang po dang / /brtul zhugs spyod 'chang tshe dbang nor bu la/ /zhes dang /thams cad rig par/ gsang rgyud rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag kun bzang dbang / /grub brnyes rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'i zhabs/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang kyai rdor/ yid bzhin 'khor lo/ tshe ring mched lnga'i bskang gsol bla brgyud sogs mang che ba rig 'dzin rje'i mtshan gsal bor yod do/ /mdor na bswe dgon chen thub bstan phyogs las rnam rgyal gling gi brgyud pa ma lus pa spyod 'chang nag po dngos byon rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'i brgyud pa sha stag yin pas byin rlabs kyi babs gzhan las khyad par du 'phags so/ /snga 'gyur chos skor gyi brgyud pa grub chen nag po spyod pa'i sprul bar yongs su grags shing /kaḥthog si tu dang khrag 'thung bdud 'joms gling pa'i slob chen/ a mchog mkhyen rab rgya mtsho dang khe tshang rdo rje 'chang / bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi mkhas dbang jun gar mkhan po dang dbal mang paṇ+ḍi ta'i yang sprul sogs kyi dbu blar gyur pa/ kaḥthog rig 'dzin chen po'i sprul ba'i mtshan gyi cod paṇa 'dzin pa rdzu ma bla ma 'gyur med rab rgyas kyis thugs rjer brten mgo log phyogs dang / khro kho/ reb gong phyogs su dar rgyas mi dman tsam yod mod/ da lta mu ra dgon pa gcig pu las gzhan gyi lo rgyus ma nges pas smra bar dogs so/ /de ltar rig 'dzin rje'i sku tshe gang bor bstan 'gro'i don 'ba' zhig mdzad cing brgyud 'dzin gser ri'i phreng ba lta bu sa chen por khyab par mdzad nas mthar phag lo hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes nyer lnga'i nyin tshogs 'khor bskor zhing rdo rje'i glu len pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma bcas gu ru snang srid zil gnon gyi bzhugs stangs kyis gshegs so/ /gsung rtsom skor la/ kaḥthog khrid chen bcu gsum gyi ya gyal khrid yig gu ru'i dgongs brgyan/rig 'dzin grub rtsis/ dbyangs can sgra mdo'i bsdus 'grel/ phyag chen/ rdzogs chen/ cho ga chos spyod/chog 'grig zin bris/ bod kyi rgyal rabs/ bstan rtsis/ chab shog gter chos/ mgur 'bum sogs da lta bsdus yod pa pod brgyad lhag yod do/ /khong gis bskyangs pa'i dgon sde thams cad la chos 18

lugs ris med byed dgos pa'i bka' gnang zhing / slob sbyong byed tshul yang / tshad ma dang phar phyin dge lugs ltar/ dbu ma dang mdzod jo nang dang sa skya'i lugs ltar/ 'dul ba mtsho sna ba ltar/ dus 'khor dang bde mchog sogs sngags gsar phyogs kyi rgyud sde thams cad rje tā ra nā tha'i dgongs pa gtso bor bzung / phyag chen la shangs pa'i ga'u ma sogs dang / bka' brgyad sogs snga 'gyur ltar mdzad/rdzogs chen kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i bzhed pa rtsal du bton/cho ga chos spyod skor la/ snga 'gyur gyi bka' ma dang / gter ma'i phyogs la pad+ma bde chen gling pa bdud klong rnam gnyis mdzad/ phyi 'gyur phyogs la tā ra nā tha sha stag yin/ de ltar khong phyogs zhen bral ba'i mdzad pa la 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos ris med bstan pa'i srol 'byed chen po zhes bsngags brjod/ phyis su 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po ches kyang rig 'dzin chen pos mdzad pa'i gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rnam bzhag pad dkar 'phreng ba la dpe byas pa'am/ rgyas su btang te shes bya kun khyab mdzad par grags shing / gter brgya'i rnam thar sogs su'ang rje 'di nyid la bsngags pa brjod pa'i rol mo phyogs kyi tha gru kun tu khyab par mdzad/rig 'dzin rje'i rnam thar skor da lta yod pa/ dag snang / lam yig gsang ba'i rnam thar gnyis sogs rang gis mdzad pa che chung brgyad tsam dang / thun mong ma yin pa gcig brag dkar rin po ches mdzad pa'i rnam thar rgyas pa ldeb sum brgya lhag yod pa dang / bsdus pa gnyis bcas bzhugs so/ /chos rje 'ba' ra ba ngag dbang ye shes dang / rta nag pa pad+ma 'od gsal sogs kyis mdzad pa'i rnam thar yod pa gsal yang dus 'gyur gyi dbang gis kun kyi thun mong gi dbang po'i yul du ma gyur to/ /sku'i sprul ba 'dzin pa'ang yul tha dad du 'byung bar gsung pa gsang rnam khag dang badz+ra a tsār+ya'i bka' lan lung bstan las gsal bor gsungs shing / skyes rabs gsol 'debs zhal gsung ma yid bzhin dbang gi phreng ba las kyang / dus der brgya dang nyer lnga brgya rtsa brgyad/ /'gro 'dul snang bar gsung la gsol ba 'debs/ /ces sprul ba lnga dang yang sprul nyer lnga byin gyis brlabs pa brgya rtsa sogs 'byung bar bden par gsungs shing dri ma med pa'i zhal gyis bzhes so/ /'on kyang thub bstan spyi dang khyad par rig 'dzin rje'i bka' srol la thugs las chung ngur gyur cing rang lugs grub mtha' rang rkang tshugs pa ma 'dres par shes pa lta ci/ rig pa'i gzhung lugs spyi dang nang bstan thos bsam sgom pa'i phyogs la g.yag chad ri la 'dzegs pa ltar gom gcig spo bar dka' yang / nga de dang de'i skye ba'o zhes sprul gzhi grub pa'i dbang phyug la snyad btags kyang kla klo'i brtul zhugs dang du blangs te thub bstan thur du rgud pa'i dus 'dir skabs blta zhing klag 'tshol ba/ mtho rtsom par byed pa'i rigs su gyur pa bdag lta bu 19

ni khyi ming la seṅge btags pa bzhin rang blo lkog tu ma gyur kyang gzhan gyis lkog nas 'phya zhing dam pa khrel ba'i rgyu ru lhag pa'i ngo gnong dgos pa zhig go /mdor na sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sprul ba tshad bzung mi btub bas sprul sku yin na rang gi mnga' ris dang / bod yul dang sku sngon ma'i nye 'brel sogs kho nar 'khrungs dgos pa'i nges pa med pas gang du bstan dang 'gro ba'i don 'byung na/ de dang der 'phrin las dal 'gro'i rgyun bzhin chad pa med par 'jug cing sgo thams cad nas bshad sgrub zung 'brel rta ljang gi 'od snang gdul bya'i zhing kun khyab par mdzad nges pas/ thub bstan ris su ma chad pa'i pad tshal mchog tu rgyas pa'i zhal kun las gzhan phan dri bsung mngar mo phyogs kun tu ldang zhing / rig grol dge 'dun bung ba'i khyu tshogs kyis mkhas pa'i las gsum gyi dbyangs snyan srid pa'i khams kun yongs su 'geng ba dang / gsung 'bum la 'brel thogs pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pa'i tshe 'dir chos mthun gyi bsam don ma lus pa gegs med du 'grub pa dang / na tsha rkyen ngan sogs bar du gcod pa'i tshogs rnams rmeg med du zhi zhing sa lam gyi yon tan mig 'phrul lta bur skyes te mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams nam mkha' rnam par rol ba'i zhing du bde bar gshegs pa nam mkha'i thig le dang ston 'khor tha mi dad par byang chub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces pa'ang kaḥthog rig 'dzin chen po'i mtshan gyi byin brlabs kyi sprul ba tsam du sgro btags pa/blun mongs 'du shes gsum pa pad+ma dbang chen rdo rjes rab byung bcu bdun pa'i shing sprel lo'i zla brgyad pa'i tshes nyer brgyad la bris pa dge/ /20

dkar chagakaḥthog rdo rje gdan gyi rig 'dzin chen po tshe dbang nor bu'i zhabs kyi gsung 'bum bzhugs so (1)dpal rig 'dzin kaḥthog chen po tshe dbang nor bu'i zhabs kyi rnam thar mdor bsdus dad pa'i sa bon zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (159)rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu yi rang myong legs nyes cha shas tsam smos shing dam pa'i chos la blo gzhugs pa'i gros 'debs rtogs brjod ri thang mtshams kyi sman mchog ces bya ba bzhugs so/ / (165)rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu rang nyid kyi spyad rabs las byung ba mu ma nas snyim pa'i chu ltar sa bon tsam zhig smon pa 'dir bzhugs so/ / (222)ma bcos pa'i zog po sngags rig 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu rang nyid spyad rabs chu klung las thigs pa tsam kyu ru lugs su smos pa snyim pa'i chu skyes ces bya ba bzhugs so/ / (234)snyigs dus ser gzugs snyom las mkhan gyur tshe dbang nor bu bdag nyid gangs ri'i ljongs kyi yul gru du mar rgyu tshul lam yig phyi nang gsang ba kho na nyid kyi glu dbyangs sna tshogs pad+ma'i 'phreng ba bzhugs so/ / (256)snyigs dus rnal 'byor gzugs 'dzin sprang ban tshe dbang nor bu bdag nyid phyogs kun rgyu ba'i rtogs brjod las 'phros skyo shas glu dbyangs sna tshogs pad+ma'i phreng ba bzhugs so/ / (269)rnal 'byor pa tshe dbang nor bu'i rgyun spyod dge ba'i lam rim glu ru blangs pa thar pa'i 'jug ngogs ces bya ba bzhugs so/ / (300)nar ma'i rnal 'byor sdom tshig rdo rje'i phreng zhes nyams len snying po'i sme yig gong khug ma bzhugs so/ / (307)dpal rig pa 'dzin pa chen po tshe dbang nor bu'i gsung mgur zhal gdams kyi tshogs ji snyed pa bzhugs so/ / (308)1

lha rje mnyam med zla 'od gzhon nu'i bka' brgyud phyag chen gdams pa ji tsam nod pa'i rtogs brjod legs bshad rin chen 'byung khungs/ (367)yang zab yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i dgongs pa'i gter u pa de shaḥgu ru'i sgrub thabs kun gyi yang zhun snying gi thig le yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i man ngag bsam pa lhun grub dngos grub ma lus 'byung ba'i gter khyim zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (401)zab lam u pa de sha'i skor las 'pho ba'i ngag 'don bde chen lam bzang bzhugs so// (422)zab lam thugs gter u pa de sha las/ gcod yul snying por dril ba ye shes mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag bdud rtsi'i yang zhun bzhugs so/ / (423)snyan brgyud ḍāk+ki'i gan mdzod rdo rje snying po'i skor las don dam thig le ye shes kyi dgongs pa 'od gsal snang bar brjod pa rnal 'byor gyi rdo rje'i thol glu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (427)ḍāk+ki gsang lam lasoḥ tshe yi bsgrub pa spros med snying po bcud dril rdo rje pha lam/ (428)ḍāk+ki gsang lam las gsol 'debs rin po che yi phreng ba bzhugs so// (429)bla med sngags kyi ston mchog gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi rnam thar gsol 'debs dad pa'i pad tshal rgyas pa'i las can nyin mo byed pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (431)bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi rim pa mdor dril zab mo (437)rgyal ba kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol 'debs rnal 'byor thun mong ma yin pa byin rlabs yid bzhin gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so/ / (451)grub pa kun gyi gzhung lam rmad byung ting 'dzin rgyun dbang snying gi bdud rtsi yang dag bla ma'i rnal 'byor bzhugs so/ / (455)bla ma'i rnal 'byor bshags smon dang 'brel ba rmad byung bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so (458)dbang khrid man ngag gi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol 'debs ji snyed pa bzhugs so/ / (461)sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung gnas la nges pa don gyi sgo nas bstod dbyangs yan lag bdun pa grub mtha' nges pa'i snying po theg chen bstan bcos rgya mtsho'i sgra dbyangs rgyun mi chad pa rin po che'i gter zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (529)bcom ldan 'das spyan ras gzigs dbang / dpal (sprul pa)rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la gsol 'debs rab snyan lha yi rnga sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (533)2

'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi bstod pa pad dkar rgyas pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (536)rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sku rmi lam du mjal ba la bstod pa mdongs mtha' can gyi gar bsgyur zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (538)'jam dpal gyi lha tshogs la phyag 'tshal ba rdo rje dga' ba'i rgyud mang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /(540)dpal dam pa dang po'i sangs rgyas dus 'khor brgyud pa'i bla ma rgyal sras gyur sham+bha lar seṅge'i gdan can chos rgyal rig ldan rnams la phyag 'tshal ba gangs can zla ba'i chu gter zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (544)dpal rig 'dzin chen po'i gsung rtsom las bde chen gling pa'i 'khrungs rabs sogs gsol 'debs kyi skor 'ga' zhig bzhugs so/ / (557)dpal rig 'dzin chen po'i gsung 'bum las/ bshes gnyen ris su ma chad pa la ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad 'bul ba ji snyed pa bzhugs so/ / (589)dpal rig 'dzin chen po'i bka' 'bum las grub dbang pad+ma nor bu'i 'khrungs rabs dang rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs pa'i rim pa ji snyed pa bzhugs so/ / (614)rdzogs chen thun mong spyi'i sngon 'gro'i ngag 'don rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (643)yang gsang bla na med pa rdzogs pa chen po'i chos spyod ngag 'don yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (651)bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i snying po yang gsang rdzogs pa chen po gser gyi yang zhun gyi thun mong sngon 'gro chos spyod ngag 'don gyi rim pa bzhugs so/ / (653)rdo rje sems dpa' snying thig gi chos spyod ngag 'don gyi rim pa chu 'babs su bkod pa bzhugs so (658)zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sbyor ba yan lag drug gi 'jug ngogs chos spyod ngag don snying po zung 'jug lam sbyin zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (662)zab lam ne gu gser chos kyi 'jug ngogs chos spyod ngag 'don gyi rim pa nges sangs snying po'i sgo 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ / (668)'phags pa thugs chen po'i spyan ras gzigs kyi lam rim dmar khrid spyi'i 'jug ngogs sngon 'gro'i ngag 'don bzhugs/ (673) 3

chos zab dgu kun gyi yang zhun bla sgrub dmigs pa'i rkang grangs 'dzin tshul pad+ma'i 'phreng ba bzhugs so/ / (675)bla sgrub bsnyen pa'i grangs tshad 'dzin tshul mdo tsam ston pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (682)bla med theg pa'i yang snying lam zab bdud rtsi'i thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (683)bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i sgrub thabs khrid kyi yi ge sku gsum lam rim mchog gi sgo 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ / (689)dpal phyag rgya chen po rang babs kyi man ngag ga'u ma'i rtsa sdom sa bcad zhib mor smos pa rgyal ba'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (699)phyag chen ga'u ma'i khrid yig sa bon tsam gyur bdud rtsi'i thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (701)rtsa ba'i bla ma che tshang drug pa karma rig 'dzin gyi zhal gdams tshig gsum gyi don gsal bar bstan pa gser gyi zhun ma lta bu bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs lags/ (707)rdo rje phag mo the ba brtsegs ma'i bsgom bzlas mi gtsang kun 'joms rdo rje pha lam bzhugs so/ /(712)rnam thar sgo gsum gyi ming don gsal bar bstan pa 'jigs med dpa' bo'i mtshon cha zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (714)sdug bsngal zhi bar byed pa dam pa'i chos mchog chu shel snying po'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /(716)rnal 'byor grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po kun bzang 'gyur med klong grol la gsol 'debs bla ma'i rnal 'byor mchog gi gter sbyin zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (718)chab shog khag bzhugs so/ / (725)4

gag/kaḥthog rdo rje gdan gyi rig 'dzin chen po tshe dbang nor bu'i zhabs kyi gsung 'bum bzhugs so//sngago/ashār+yashrad+dhasulamitasāranāmashrībibyādharamahābadz+ra.ayuyishāmaṣ+ṭhapādasu༄ga/dpal rig 'dzin chen po rdo rje tshe dbang nor bu'i zhabs kyis rnam par thar pa'i cha shas brjod pa bimok+ṣapārabatsubiharatismaḥngo mtshar dad pa'i rol mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so//༄gi/oṃswāstisid+dhatsabit+yādharasarbatsakrasubahārtishrīmahābadz+ra.ayuriyishāmaṇigatabi༄gi/oṃ bde legs su gyur cigagrub pa dang rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba chen po dpal rdo rje nayabadz+rasatwaparamasubimok+ṣapārabatsā/tshe dbang nor bu 'gro 'dul rdo rje sems dpa' mchog gi rnam par thar ba'i cha shas brjod pa/༄ga/ashwar+yashrad+dhasulalitasāranām/shrīmesargyorutsatram̐pādapad+mayabhaltenanamoḥ༄gi/ngo mtshar dad pa'i rol mtsho zhes bya ba/dpal ldan bla ma dam pa de nyid kyi zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo//mahātākṛpākālatram̐byusarbamabasgrasamudhārāhā/brtse ba chen pos dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du rjes su bzung du gsol/༈ prat+yakabida.ak+ṣaragāh+ye//rang rig mi 'gyur gzung 'dzin las//parimut+ta.ayuridz+nyānasu//yongs grol tshe dang ye shes kyis//shāratsit+tanamaṇiparam//dbang phyug yid bzhin nor bu mchog/shrīmeguruwepādayanamo//dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// ༈prasadasar+bhadzir+sātriguh+yasu//

rab 'byams rgyal kun gsang gsum gyi/ /prabhutsakram ṇ+ḍa la tsakra nā the/ /khyab bdag dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon/nusta raman+t+ra sushastopa ram//bla med sngags kyi ston pa mchog /auḍi ya ṇa sunā tha bi dzayaskyoḥ.au ḍi ya ṣa'i mgon khyod rgyal/ /rgyal ba kun gyi yab gyur dang po'i mgon po 'od snang mtha' yas ye shes rdo rje'i rang gzugs rdul/ /sid+dha'i mtsho gling pad+mo'i ze'u khar 'khyil las rang byung ngo mtshar mtshan dpe'i sgyur 'phrul rdo rje'i gar/ /bsgyur mkhas bla med sngags kyi ston par yongs grub rdo rje'i sku bsnyes dpal ldan sangs rgyas pad+ma skyes/ /res 'ga' dri med bla mar grags 'bar sa gsum skyobs pa mtshungs med mtsho skyes rdo rjes bdag skyongs shig /mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar nges pa lnga ldan 'jig rten gsum gyi gtsug tor nor bu'i mngon mchod lha yi lhar gyur yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /zhi ba bdud rtsi'i char gyi 'dod chags bskal me'i tsha gdung mtha' dag bsil mdzad drug cu'i dbyangs kyis skye dgu'i ma rig gnyid slong dam pa'i chos /'khor ba'i las nyon zug rngu drung 'byin sman pa che mchog rgyal sras byang 'phags nyan rang tshogs mchog rig grol zung ldan dge 'dun ste/ /srid zhi'i gdung sel nam yang bslu med skyabs kyi phul gyur mchog gsum rin chen thugs rje yongs 'du'i grib bsil dam pas rtag tu bsrungs/ /stobs bcu'i bdag nyid rdzogs sangs rgyas des bcu gnyis mdzad pas rnam rol 'dzam gling dbus 'gyur 'phags yul grub pa'i zhing / /gang der gsang ba bsam mi khyab dpag mi lang mtha' klas mdzad pa'i rol gar gyis rtsen pa'i/ /mkhas dang grub gyur skar tshogs dbus na de yi bdag bzhin spyod 'chang kasna pa/ /thugs kyi rig 'dzin rgyu ka ra sogs ye shes sku can ma lus bdag gi snying la rol/ /gangs can 'dzin mar thub bstan nyin mo'i snang ba ris med gdul bya 'dab brgya'i dpal du spro mdzad cing / /phul byung thugs bskyed dpe zla bral zhing btsun mkhas bzang dang grub pa'i tshul 'chang grags pa'i gzi rgyas can/ /shing rta mchog gyur spyi dang khyad par dri med 'od zer kun tu 'gyed mkhas klong chen sgrol mgon sogs/ /theg mchog nges gsang rdo rje snying po'i ring lugs phyogs brgyar gsal mdzad dngos brgyud rnam 'dren yongs la 'dud/ /dag dang ma dag mtha' klas zhing du cir phang 'char bzod ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i gar mkhan po/ /dus gsum kun tu tshad dang grangs rnams gzhal byar rgyal ba kun kyang ngal ba'i khur 'dzin pa/ /gang gi sngon rabs 2

skye ba'i phreng ba mchog tu bsngags 'os yon tan rgya mtsho'i dpal yon can/ /srid 'dir bskal bzang phan bde'i dga' ston stsol mdzad kun la dad pa'i ba spu gyen du lang / /rgya chen mkhyen rab ye shes gzigs pa'i rnam spyod ral gri'i 'khri shing g.yo bas rgyal bstan gsal mdzad 'jigs med smra ba'i seng ge ni/ /phyogs bral gdul byar brtse bas smin grol chos kyi gru char yongs 'bebs srog chags kun la mi 'jigs sbyin pa'i snying rje'i lha/ /'gran med nus mthus mi dang mi min log 'dren zil gnon kla klo'i dpung tshogs mthar bcil gsang bdag drag po 'khor lo can//rgud pa'i mun sel nyin byed phan bde'i bdun rtsi'i bsil sbyin zla dbang yin bzhin re bskongs tshe dbang nor bu khyod kho na/ /gang gi rlabs chen mdzad bzang rin chen 'byung gnas gting mtha' dpogs min kyang / /skal bzang dad pa'i nor ldan mos 'dun so ka'i tsha bas gdung gyur la/ /phan bde'i dpal ster dge legs char 'gyed cing rnam grol sgyu gu ni/ /bskyed phyir ngo mtshar gtam gyi sbyor ba cung zad spel la gnang ba stsol/ /gang yang 'jig rten 'di yi sna tshogs gtam/ /mi dge rnam bzhi'i do rar 'khyams gyur pas/ /kun rtog nyes brgya'i rba klong 'khrug par zad/ /'dir ni legs byas don ldan kho na nyid/ /chu 'dzin lte bar dbyar gyi rnga sangs kyis/ /mdong mtha' can rnams dga' bas gar bsgyur bzhin/ /gang gi smad 'byung mdzad pa'i gtam snyan po/ /thos tshe yid dga' dad pa'i spu long g.yo//gzhan du phyogs lhung gdon gyi btab pa'i mig /log snang gis sgrib mtshan rdu'i gnyis skyes dag /yon tan rjod byed nye 'dzin 'bras ldan slad/ /dam pa'i rnam thar nyin byed rgyas pa'i zer/ /bzod par nus min mun par gnyid byos shig /gzhan las khyad zhugs zla med 'khor los bsgyur/ /rnga yab zhing mgon snyigs mthar sgyu ma'i rdzu/ /pho nya'i zol 'dzin gang 'di'i mdzad pa'i mtha'/ /gzhal nus bdag lta'i spyod yul ga la zhig /'on te sngon byung rtog brjod bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /cha shas blo gros bum par 'khyil ba las/ /ji tsam nus pa'i yi ge'i dga' ston 'gyed/ /de la 'dir phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba ma lus pa'i khyab bdag chen po shrī au ḍi ya na ma hā a tsar+ya pad+ma sam+bha wa'i sgyu 'phrul chen pos zlos gar lnga brgya mtha' ma rtsod dus snyigs ma'i yid can dag la rgyu med par yang gcig tu gnyen gshin pa'i ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes chen po bh+rad+ma dang / bik+ṣi dang / ma ho shwa ra la sogs pa 'jig rten 'di'i chen por rloms pa rnams kyi stobs kyang thum zhing smad pa dang bral ba'i ye shes kyi 'jug pa phra mos yongs rdzogs su snyil bar mdzad cing khams gsum pa kun gyis gtsug gi nor bus gang gi zhabs kyi pad+mor kun tu btugs pas dog por bgyis pa zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i stong nyid ye shes kyi 'jigs med seng ge'i sgra dbyangs sangs mthor sgrags pas log pa lta ba dang / smra ba ngan pa'i wa skyes tshogs kyi klad pa 'gem pa/ dbang bcu 3

dang / lta gdang brgyad la sogs pa'i rdzu 'phrul dang / mngon par shes pa chags thogs med par ji lta ba'i ye shes kyi gzigs pa dag pa'i spyan mnga' ba/ rnam dpyod kyi dkyil 'khor ji snyed pa'i shes bya'i gnas kun la thogs pa med par gsal bas kun rmongs ma rig pa'i mun pa mtha' dag drung nas 'byin pa'i nyin mor byed pa/ mkhas mang rgyu skar gyi dbus na mkhyen brtse yon tan gyi cha shas yongs su gang bas nyon mongs pa'i tshad gdung gsal zhing phan bde'i bdud rtsi'i bsil ba ster ba'i zla snang / rang dang gzhan gyi grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son cing thar 'dod kyi lus can mtha' dag rnam grol thar pa mchog gi gling du khrid pa'i ded dpon/ gcig tu gzhan gyi don las nam yang mi g.yel zhing dug lnga'i gcong nad 'byin pa'i ye shes lnga'i sman pa chen po/ log pa'i lam las ma nor bar yang dag pa'i lam la 'dren cing gzung 'dzin gyi sgrib pa'i rab rib thams cad bsal nas snying po don gyi gnas lugs ye shes gcer mthong du ston pa'i mig 'byed mkhan/ snang srid dag pa rab 'byams su 'byams klas pas rtsa gsum rab 'byams dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo grangs med pa 'khor mo yug tu zhal gzigs shing rjes su gnang bas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub rnam pa gnyis la rang dbang 'byor ba/gdug pa can mtha' dag zil gyi gnon pas mi dang mi ma yin dregs pa can rnams tshar gcod par mdzad cing rdo rje'i bsrung ma rnams dang sde brgyad lha srin thams cad bran du bkol ba'i nus mthu thogs pa med pa'i dpa' bo chen po/ mdor na mthong thos dran reg gi 'gro ba thams cad 'brel tshad don ldan du sbyor zhing 'di phyi'i dgos 'dod bsam pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du bkang ba'i nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po/ chos kyi rgyal srid mtha' dag la dbang bsgyur ba'i chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba chen po/ mkhas pa dang / grub pa dang / rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu 'gro 'dul rdo rje sems 'chang pad+ma theg mchog nges gsang grub pa'i shing rta phyogs las rnam rgyal grub mchog dbang po'i sde zhes mtshan gyi rnga sgras dang sa 'og mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du yongs su grags pa gang gi gsang ba gsum gyi yon tan gyi tshogs ni bsam mi khyab pas bag chags shin tu bsrab pa'i sa bcu pa 'phags chen rdo rje'i ljags ldan rnams kyis bskal par brjod kyang zad par mi 'gyur na/ bdag cag thun mong mun pa'i mal du gyi nar 'khyams pa'i byis pa'i blo can dag gi spyod yul du lta ga la 'gyur te/ yab sras mjal ba'i mdo las/ bya lam nam mkha' dpag par nus kyang srid/ /rgya mtsho bum pas gzhal du rung kyang srid/ /ri rab srang la gzhal du rung yang srid/ /sangs rgyas yon tan mtha' ni dpogs mi nus/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar nam mkha' la 'doms kyis gzhal ba'am tshon ris kyi 'du 'god rtsom pa dang mtshungs mod/de lta na'ang dam pa'i spyod tshul yongs su dag pa'i rnam par thar ba'i cha shas tsam zhig brjod pas kyang bsod nams kyi 4

tshogs mtha' yas pa thob par 'gyur ba'i nges shes kyis rgya chen po'i spyod pa dam pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'i rgya mtsho lta bu las chu thigs kyi theg ma tsam zhig dad pa dang mos pa'i ku sha'i rtse mos blangs te skal bzang mos ldan gyi gdul bya'i sgra 'dzin gyi bcud len du brnyad par bya ba la gnyis te/ sngon byung skye ba'i rabs sprul pa'i rnam par rol pa'i tshul ji ltar ston pa dang / sku tshe 'di nyid kyi thun mong gdul bya'i snang ngor mtshams par 'char ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ bdag nyid chen mo 'di nyid gdod ma nyid nas khams kyi dri ma mtha' dag dang bral ba rang rig pa'i ye shes chos kyi sku'i ngo bor mngon par byang chub pa brnyes te/ de'i ngang las ma g.yos bzhin du nges pa lnga ldan gyi longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur rang snang ba rtag pa rgyun gyi 'khor lor lhun gyis grub pa nas/ dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje dang smon lam gyi dbang gis dag pa dang ma dag pa'i gdul bya sna tshogs pa'i ngor sprul pa'i rnam rol bsam gyis mi khyab par bstan nas mtha' yas pa'i gdul bya so so'i skal ba dang mtshams par lam gyi rten dang / lam dang 'bras bu la 'god pa'i 'phrin las tshad med pas 'dul bar mdzad pa ni/dngas pa'i chu snod ji snyed par zla ba'i gzugs brnyan de snod du 'char ba ltar bsam gyis mi khyab te/rgyal tshab mi pham mgon pos theg pa chen po'i rgyud bla ma las/ thugs rje chen pos 'jig rten mkhyen/ /'jig rten kun la gzigs nas ni//chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par//sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyis//zhes dang / phal po che las kyang / kye rigs kyi bu/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa ni tshad med de/ 'gro ba gang dang gang 'dul ba de dang de'i gzugs dang kha dog dang ming gis don mdzad do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar mtha' gcig tu ma nges phyir phyogs rer zhen pa'i skye ba'i rabs dang / sprul pa'i nges brjod dang /rab rtags kyis kun slong brjod pa la yid brtan 'cha' ma dgos kyang / re zhig zhing 'dir gdul bya'i cha shas 'ga' zhig gi mthun snang du grub pa'i mdzad pa las cha shas tsam zhig 'chad pa'i dbang du byas na/ rang gter stag tshang rdo rje gro lod nas byon pa'i thugs gter gsang ba'i lung byang las/ pad+ma nga sprul nag pos byin rlabs cing : nam snying thugs kyi 'od zer zhugs gyur pa: ka thog lho phyogs btsan ri'i nye 'dabs su: mchog dman spangs pa bar ma dag gi rigs: mgon dang mtsho zhes bya ba gnyis kyi bu: dbang ngam nor bu'i ming can snying stobs can: mi che mi chung sgeg pa rdo rje'i lus: rtsa rlung thig le skyon med mkha' 'gro 'du: spyod pa ma nges byis pa'i tshul du spyod: kha dog nyin re la yang nges med 'gyur: lta ba'i gdengs ldan rgyu 'bras shan 'byed mkhas: rig pa ngar thob gyong tshig tal mar smra: shes bya khog yangs gdul bya dkri la mkhas: ting 'dzin gsal thebs gzhan snang zil gyis gnon: sbyangs pa sngon song mdo rgyud dgongs don grol: blo gros mthu ldan chos dang chos min 'byed: 'phral du rtag na mi 5

shes glen pa'i tshul: yun du 'grogs tshe mkhas kun snyems pa 'phrog: yon tan ldan pa sbas tshul rnal mar spyod: res ni mi rtag skyo shas 'chi ma 'khrug: res ni gang la'ang mi 'jigs dpa' skad 'don:res ni nga rgyal res ni dman pa'i tshul: res ni nyon mongs drag tu zhen pa ltar: res ni byang sems zhi dul brtse ba'i nyams: res ni nor la skam chags zhen po'i tshul: res ni gser dang sa rdo snyom bzhin spyod: de sogs ci bder sgyu ma ltar spyod cing : sna tshogs thabs kyi 'gro ba 'dul byed pa:ma nges 'khor 'du bud med khyu dang bcas: tshangs spyod tshul gyis rgyal ba'i bstan srog 'dzin: mthong thos dran reg thar pa'i lam la sbyor: skye ba dman cing rigs ngan bud med kyang : de yi gsang ba'i grogs 'brel thar lam zin: lan bdun sten pas mtshams med spyad pa yang : dam tshig ma nyams bde 'gro nges par thob: gzhan gyi gdul dka' bdud kyang sun dbyung ba'i+oḥ dpa' bo'i ngar dang btul zhugs nus mthu ldan: mang po'i seb na lhag par gzi bajid che: nga sras skyes bu de lta bu zhig 'byung : zhes dang : gab brgya can gyi gsang ba'i lung byang las: thugs kyi sgrub chen nam snying yang sprul zhig: mdo khams bu 'bor nye ba'i phyogs su 'byung : ma ṇi badz+ra 'gro 'dul snying stobs ldan: rten 'brel ma chugs mchog gi gter lnga spyod: 'dzam gling 'gro ba 'dren pa'i sgron me 'dra: 'on kyang sngon phral rten 'brel 'ga' zhig gis: de lta ji bzhin 'grig par ma gyur tshe: dgongs gter bka' babs bka' dang gter rnying skyongs: dus der phan pa'i sa bcos lung byang dang : chos zab gdam phran kha yar 'don par 'gyur:zhes gsungs pas gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir dge slong nam mkha'i snying po zhes mtshan gyi dbyar skyes rnga bo che yongs sa grags pa gang gi sprul pa'i zlos gar nyid du lung gi bsngags shing ༷ rje nyid kyi gsang ba'i sha ca ///5rnam thar bag chags yid kyi rang gzugs gsal ba'i me long las/ bdag gi sems kyi rgyun 'di sngags rnying lugs kyi rgya bod kyi rig 'dzin brgyad dang grub chen brgyad du grags pa'i ya gyal thugs kyi rig 'dzin rgyu ka ra dang / grub chen gnubs nam mkha'i snying po'i sprul pa yin zhes gu ru pad+ma'i gter lung rtsod bral rnams nas bstan mod/ de lta na yang rang nyid kyi blo la ni des byin gyis rlabs pa tsam la sprul pa'i tha snyad du gyur par khas blang bar bya/ zhes dang nam mkha'i snying po'i skye sprul min yang byin gyis brlabs pa'i nus pas yin te 'ong / chung ngu nas da lta'i bar de yi bag chags yad yud zhig ni nges par shar/ zhes don gyi zhal gyi bzhes so/ /de ltar na nam mkha'i snying po'i sprul gzhi ni dpa' bo thugs kyi rdo rje zhes bya ba ste/ don gyi gsang ba'i bdag po dang ngo bo gcig cing / gnas skabs su rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dngos kyi slob ma rdo rje theg pa thams cad kyi spyi mes o rgyan gyi rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti gsang ba'i bdag por gyur pa de yin la/ de nyid bzhugs pa'i gnas ni 'og min chos dbyings me ri 'bar ba'i 6

dur khrod na yin pas kun na snang ba ste/ slob dpon chen po'i gsol 'debs le'u bdun pa'i gnyis par/ ri rgyal me ri 'bar ba'i rtse mo ru: phyag na rdo rje thugs kyi dgongs pa yis: rgyal po dza yi gnas su gsang sngags byon: zhes so/ /bye brag tu 'dir ni deng sang 'phags yul dang / nai pā la'i yul gyi phral skad du dza ga ba zhes 'bod la/ legs par sbyar ba'i brdar o ḍi yā ṇa dang / zur chag gi or yan dang /bod 'dir o rgyan du 'bod pa'i yul de ni mi rnams kyi mthun snang du ma kha dang nye ba'i yul stag gzig gi yul gyi 'gram zla phyed kyi lam gru gsum gyi lung pa can la lha dang / mi ma yin pa dang / dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang / 'byung po phal gyi snang ngor bde ba can dang phyogs 'dra ba'i dpag tshad bye ba 'bum gru gsum pa'i dbus der bsti gnas dpag tshad 'bum phrag gsum dang : pho brang dpag tshad stong dang snying po dkyil 'khor lnga/ dpag tshad brgyad yod pa de na bzhugs pa ste/ phyag na rdo rje'am/ rdo rje sems dpa' te ru ka'am/ rdo rje 'chang / in+d+ra bhu ti'am/ pad+ma badz+ra yang pho brang de na bzhugs la don gyi dgongs pa gcig pa nyid de/ nang gter bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i lo rgyus be+e ros mdzad pa las/ston pa kun tu bzang po nyid dang thugs gnyis su med pa: byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje chos zhes kyang bya: rdo rje sems dpa' zhes kyang bya: lag na rdo rje zhes kyang bya: rdo rje drag po rtsal zhes kyang byoḥ mi'i thod pa rtsal zhes bya ba de nyid dang : lhan cig tu thos pa'i 'khor rig 'dzin gzhan rnams 'khor gyi tshul du byas: rang nyid ston pa'i tshul du byas te+oḥ tshom bu dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi nang du snang bar byas nas: rang gi tshig gis mtshams sbyar nas: thog mar ngag tu bsdus: de nas pu ste dang gleg bam du bkod te: gser gyi gleg bam la be+eḍūr+ya zhun mas bris nas: spyi dang bye brag gi rgyud sde rnams so so'i phyogs su sdebs te: gleg bam du byas shing gzhan la snang bar mdzad do: zhes ston pa dang dgongs pa mi gnyis pa'i bka'i bsdu ba por gsungs so/ /de ltar o rgyan gyi gnas de ni rig sngags 'dzin pa'i gnas mkha' spyod kyi zhing zhes sprul pa'i sku'i zhing mchog gyur rnams dang rjes su mthun pa yin la/ mi yi 'jig rten 'dir sprul pas 'gro don mdzad pa mang po zhig de nas 'byon par gsungs shing / jo nang rje btsun sgrol mgon zhabs kyang zhing de nas byon pa dang / gzhan yang rnying ma'i gter ston shas che ba zhig dang /gsang rnam du/ bdag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / chos 'brel nos pa'i bla ma kha shas kyang zhing de nas byon par rtogs/ zhes gsungs pa gter ston pad+ma bde chen gling pa'i bai ro'i rnam sprul yin phyir de yi sprul gzhi yang dpal gsang ba'i bdag po nyid te gzugs sku'i rnam pa tha dad par ston pa ni/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i zhabs ring 'phags pa kun dga' bo dang / sham bha lar chos kyi rgyal po zla ba bzang po/in+d+ra bhu ti chung ba'am rgyal po dza sogs yin pa spyir grags pa ltar dang / bye brag tu nam mkha'i snying po'i 7

skye brgyud gter lung gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar na/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i spyan sngar nyan thos chen po btsun pa'i mchog dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i bka' bsdud pa po 'phags pa nye ba 'khor dang / theg chen gyi slob dpon 'dul 'dzin yon tan 'od/ rgyal sras zhi ba lha/ gsang chen sgrub pa chen po bka' brgyad kyi rig 'dzin brgyad kyi nang mtshan yang dag thugs kyi bka' bab brnyes pa rig 'dzin rdu ka ra rnams yin par gsungs pa de kun thugs rgyud gcig pa la dgongs par nges so/ /dmigs gsal rang gter lung byang gi don/ pad+ma nga sprul nag pos byin rlabs cing : zhes gsungs pa'i/ pad+ma nga sprul ni/gong du smos pa'i dpa' bo thugs kyi rdo rje dang pad+ma badz+ra nyid ngo bo gcig ste pad+ma badz+ra ni mtshan gyi rnam grangs las don du slob dpon chen po pad+ma sam+bha wa nyid du som nyi med par grub pa ni/ rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i gu ru rin po che'i rnam thar gsol 'debs su ar+ya de bas spyod bsdus sgron mer/ /khungs su mdzad pa'i pad+ma badz+ra/ /pad+ma las byon khyod nyid mtshan yin/ /gzhan yang sa ra ha dang bi ru/ /ḍirdzi spyod 'chang kat+na pa/ /o rgyan pad+ma badz+ra rnam gsum/ /kun kyang chos sku'i cho 'phrul nyid yin/ /zhes dang / sa hor khyad par o rgyan yul du/ /tsha ba'i me dbus gsil ba'i rdzing bu/ /pad+ma ge sar sdong po'i rtse ru/ /'od lus bzhugs bzhin thugs kyi rdo rje/ /'od dpag med kyi thugs kar thim nas/ /ya mtshan mchog brnyes rgyud kyi ston pa/ /dpal chen pad+ma badz+ra zhes grags/ /zhes so/ /nag po ni/ 'phags yul gyi grub thob chen po nag po spyod pa yin la/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi dpal ldan 'bras spungs nas spyan drangs pa'i dpal mgon pos rgyud brgyad kyi snying po nag po chen po mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud las/ de ltar yul u ru bi shar yang mtshungs par nges pa'o/ /der skyes bu brtson 'grus chen po dang ldan zhing sbyor ba brtson pa ra ma ṇa'i bka'i 'jug pa dang mtshungs pa/ sde mtshan dang po'i dang po dbyangs mig dang pos brgyan pa/ bdun pa'i bzhi pa cung zad na la zhon pa'i ming can rnal 'byor dbang po skyes bu'i mchog gcig po 'dis ral gri la sogs pa'i dngos grub chen po brgyad thob par 'gyur ro/ /'dzam bu'i gling du ma byung zhing 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud phyi ma 'gyur rnying las/ kha ṭaṃ ka dang rus rgyan cang ste chang snod thogs pa nag po'i ming can 'byung bar 'gyur/ zhes 'khrungs pa'i yul dang / mdzad pa dang / mtshan dang bcas bstan pa'i kasna zhes pa slob dpon 'di nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i mtshan te/ kasna tsar+ya'am/ 'phral skad du/ kan+ni pa zhes grags te don du nag po spyod pa nyid do/ /de ltar na gsang ba'i rnam thar du jo nang / rje btsun dam pa tā ra nā tha dang thugs rgyud gcig par gsungs pa lung 'dis 'grub cing rje btsun dam pa'i sku phreng sku skye bcu gcig par grags pa las 'bar ba'i gtso bo nas nag po spyod pa 'dren pa las gsang rnam du sprul gzhi'i nges brjod gsal bar ma 8

gsungs kyang don gyi sprul gzhi yang gsang ba'i bdag po nyid du nges la/ grub pa'i slob dpon chen po de ni/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang po mya ngan las 'das nas lo stong dang lnga brgyar nye ba na 'phags pa'i yul du byon zhing / de nyid dgung lo brgyad bcu bskor lhag tsam na bod yul lho brag dang nye ba rgya gar yul ti phu ra yi phal skad du ka sa raṅga zhes bya ba yul nyer bzhi ya gyal de wi ko ṭar
