rnam smin gyi lus btang nas bar do rdzogs sangs rgyas pa he ru ka yi skur bzhengs te lo brgya lhag tsam na nam mkha'i snying po nyid du sku 'khrungs par bzhed do/ /de yang thun mong gi gdul bya'i snang ngo dang mthun pa'i nam snying gi sku yi skye ba'i tshul ston dngos ni/ snga ma rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du bram ze'i rigs kyis yab gu ṇa sirnyi yon tan dngos grub dang / yum rgyal rigs pu dz+nyā likhri masmo rab dpal mo/ zhes pa'i sras bram ze dze ta bya bar gyur te sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma ka ra ma gu ta yi brag phug tu bzhugs par rin chen gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul nas dbang bskur ba nos pa'i mtshan nam mkha' rdo rje zhes su btags par mdzad nas skye ba de yi 'og tu bod yul du skye bar lung bstan/ de ltar yang thang yig gser 'phreng ma'i le'u don drug par/ rgya gar yul gyi mu tra na: bram ze gu ṇa sidhi dang : rgyal mo legs gzher bya ba'i bu: dge slong dzi na tshe 'phos pas: nam mkha'i snying po bya bar skyes: zhes gsungs pa ltar gtsang gi phung po ri bo che yi shar phyogs gnub yul rong zhes bya bar yum 'chim za 'od de rgyan zhes pa'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ thog mar 'phags pa 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa chos kyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi blon por gyur cing / de nas dam pa'i chos la yang dag par mos pas 'phags pa'i yul nas slob dpon chen po spyan 'dren pa'i pho nya skyar shog pa mi bdun gyi thog mar byon te bal yul nyi ma khud kyi mtsho 'gram du mjal/ bod du mkhan chen shan+ta rakhri ta te zhi ba mtsho las rab tu byung zhing dge slong gi dngos por bsgrub/ rgyal pos kyang lo tsā ba brgya rtsa brgyad kyi nang nas nam mkha'i snying po dang be+e ro gnyis gtsug gi bla mar bskur/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma yar 'brog mu tig shel gyi spa ma gong du bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar byon te rin chen gser gyi pa ṭa maṇ+ḍal du bkod nas phul bar/ slob dpon chen pos/ kye/ nam mkha'i snying po bde'am/ zhes bka' stsal nas smin mtshams nas 'od zer byung / nam mkha'i snying por phog pas dran med du yug cig rgyal nas/sad tshe skye ba dran par byin gyis brlabs/ de nas rta gdong dkar mo thugs kyi gnas lho brag mkhar chu bod yul gyi de wā'i ko ṭa zhes dpal he ru ka lhan skyes yab yum brag ri la rang byung du gsal bar bzhugs pa'i 'dabs brag ri dung dkar gyi dbyibs su gnas pa'i mkhar chu lcags phur can du phebs nas yang dag bkol byang gi dkyir 'khor du dbang bskur bar mdzad/ gsang mtshan thugs kyi rdo rjer grags/ phyis rgya gar du byon nas brag phug gser gyi bya skyibs can du yang dag gi bka' bab pa'i rig 9

'dzin rdu ka ra dang mjal nas bla med ma yi rgyud la mkhas par sbyangs nas sgrub pas grub pa chen po nyams 'og tu chud par gyur nas bod du byon/ mkhar chu gtso bor gyur pa'i gnyal smad sge ri la sogs pa'i sgrub gnas du mar sgrub pa yun ring mdzad pa'i tshul bstan/ spyod pa'i phyag rgya lung bstan byung ba ltar gtsang rta nag shel dkar bza' rdo rje mtsho sgron rnyed de las kyi phyag rgyar mdzad/ brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa gsum brkyangs/ de bzhin slob dpon chen po'i bka' bzhin mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal la brten nas mi 'gyur bde ba chen po'i sku phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin yang dag par bsnyes sgrub mtshan kyang mkhar chur brag la sku rjes dang / bsam yas su nyi ma gtod la gnon pa/ gnam lcags kyi thog 'on ljang rdo'i brag la phab/ 'byon gzhud skabs nyi zer la 'chibs nas gshegs pa sogs rdzu 'phrul dpag med bstan/ lo brgya phrag gcig lhag nges par bzhugs pa'i mthar rnam smin gyi lus 'ja' ltar yal nas ye shes kyi sku mkha' khyab tu bzhugs so/ /de ltar nam mkha'i snying po nyid mchog gi dngos grub ji bzhin pa 'phags lam zung 'jug rdo rje sems pa'i go 'phang sku lus des bsnyes par mdzad pa'i phyir 'phags pa'i go 'phang bsnyes pa'i sprul pa ni bsam gyi mi khyab pa rdzogs sangs rgyas dang 'phags pa sa bcu pa kho na'i spyod yul las gzhan su zhig gi dpogs par nus/ 'on kyang gangs ri'i khrod 'dir gdul bya'i ngor ji tsam snang ba'i skye rabs kyi phreng ba ni rje nyid kyi rdo rje'i gsung 'khrul pa med pa 'khrung rabs gsol 'debs byin brlabs yid bzhin gter mdzod las/ khyod kyi sgyu 'phrul rim gyis gcig car tshul/ /dpe med grong 'khrungs rin chen rdo rje 'dzin/ /bod sngags sbyor sgrol rtser son shes rab grags/ /'od gsal 'khor yug mes tshom dwags sgom tshul/ /mkha' 'gros yong mchod nam 'od tsā ri ras/ /byams dpal byams 'bum gzhan phan mkha' ltar gdal/ /e ma ma ṇi rin chen 'gro 'dul mkhas/ /thang dbon grags dpal 'od gsal rdo rje'i thugs/ /bde chen zhing gshegs ri khrod dar rgyas zhabs/ /zab gter mdzod 'byed byang chub gling pa dpal/ /sangs rgyas blo gros rtsa gsum sgrub pa'i gtso/ /byang chub sems brnyes chos kyi rin po che/ /'ja' lus rdo rje'i skur gshegs bsod nams mchog /lung rigs rnga sgra rgod pa sangs rgyas 'phel/ /rnam dag tshul khrims 'dzin mkhas bzod dpal grub/ /mkhas dbang dam pa ye shes rgya mtsho'i sde/ /sbas tshul bsngags brjod pad+ma ma ṇi sogs/ /sprul pa'i zlos gar cir yang bsgyur ba po/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'dir rnam thar ri thang mtshams kyi sman mchog dang gsang rnam/ 'khrungs rab gsol 'debs gzhan rnams don bsdus te smos na/ dpal chen nam mkha'i snying po 'pho med 'od skur gshegs nas lo skor kha shas rags rtsis su song ba na/ kasmi ra'i yul gyi grong khyer dpe med du bram ze'i rigs su 'khrungs pa rin chen rdo rje ni dpal nā ro ta pa dang chung ngu nas grogs por gyur/ in+d+ra bho dhi 10

chung ba la thug cing yi dam bde mchog gi sgo nas grub pa thob/ phyis bi kra ma shi la'i gtsug lag khang du mkhas pa sgo drug tu grags pa'i dbus kyi ka chen gnyis kyi dang por gyur cing mthar sku che'i smad o rgyan du byon nas 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku bsnyes/ zur chung shes rab grags ni snga 'gyur bka' ma'i mkhas grub bde gshegs zur po che shākya 'byung gnas kyi dbon dang chos sras ka ba bzhi'i nang gi mchog gyur sbyor sgrol gyi nus pa smad du byung zhing dpag par dka' ba'i rdzu 'phrul ston pa por gyur/ gtsang rong gi mes ston tshom bu ni shrī sidha'i sgyu 'phrul sgra bsgyur lo tsā ba chen po mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyi thugs sras bzhi'i nang mtshan 'od gsal la bka' bab bsnyes/ dwags sgom tshul khrims snying po ni rgyal bas snying rje pad dkar dang ting 'dzin rgyal po sogs nas lung bstan pa'i mnyam med dwags po lha rje bsod nams rin chen gyi rigs kyi dbon thugs kyi sras rgyal tshab dam par bzhugs shing rje sgam po pa'i slob ma phyi tshar rnams kyi bla mar yang gyur pa rgyal po bka' 'bum nas lung gis gsal bar bstan pa de nyid do/ /lha ri nam mkha' 'od ni zhang 'gro ba'i mgon po g.yu brag pa brtson 'grus grags kyi sras dam par gyur pa mnga' bdag myang ral chen po dang dus mtshungs par byon pa zhig go/ /'gro ba'i mgon po tsā ri ras pa ni dbus g.yor po gzhung du rgyal ba lo ras pa dar ma dbang phyug gi lcam sring gi sras su 'khrungs/ rje lo ras pa nyid las gdams pa rdzogs par nos shing grub pa bsnyes/ khro phu lo tsā ba chen po byams pa dpal ni kha chen paṇa chen shākya shrī dang bal po bud+dha shrī/ grub chen mi tra dz+wa ki sogs kyi rjes su bzung / byams pa'i sku khru brgyad bcu pa bzhengs pa sogs mdzad pa rgya che'o/ /mdo khams kaḥthog pa byams pa 'bum ni dam gtsang byams gsum du grags pa'i ya gyal dam pa bde gshegs kyi zhabs la thug cing gtsang ston las smin grol gyi yon tan rdzogs par mdzad/ gtsang ston gshegs nas kaḥ thog gi gdan sa bzung ste gdul bya rgya cher bskyangs shing karma pak+ṣa'i bla mar gyur pa de'o/ /lho brag slob dpon e ma ni skyi ston gyi rigs las 'khrungs shing spyan ras gzigs dbang 'gro 'dul gter ston gyi skur sprul pa gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gi thugs sras su gyur/ 'di dang dus mtshungs su ma ṇi rin chen zhes pa byon pa chos dbang rin po che'i dngos slob yin/ stag lung sangs rgyas dbon zhes pa mtshan dngos grags pa dpal ni rje sangs rgyas yar byon gyi dbon yin zhing byang stag lung gi brag gdong nas gu ru pad+ma kau'u ri ma brgyad kyi bskor ba'i bla sgrub gter nas bzhes/ mdo khams su byon nas ri bo che yi dgon pa btab cing gzhan phan rgya che'o/ /gzho lung rdo rje rgyal po ni gter ston dri med lhun po'i yi dam tsit+ta'i rgyan cig gis lung bstan nyi ma'i 'od zer las/ da lta'i gnub ban nam mkha'i snying po ni: 'bri ru rdo rje rgyal po rmu rgod 'dul: zhes gsungs pa de nyid yin te/ gnas chen ti sgro brag dkar gyi sgo dbye bar mdzad/ 'bri khung 11

pa'i rnying chos kyi dbu yang 'di nas brtsam par grags so/ /ri khrod dar rgyas ni/ karma pa rang byung rdo rje dang / zhwa dmar grags seng gi slob mar gyur/ 'di dang dus mtshungs par jo nang kun mkhyen dol po pa shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi dngos slob sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen blo gros rgyal mtshan du 'khrungs/ mang po gter ston byang chub gling pa ni/ dpal khud bya mang por 'khrungs/ gzhon nu'i skabs su sgyu 'phrul zhi khro yang phur/ sems phyogs zur tsho lugs su grags pa la sbyangs/ gter ston tshe brtan rgyal mtshan gyi kha byang phug tu byung ba ltar dpal mo dpal thang gi srin mtsho'i nub byang brag bya khyung gi mchu 'dra ba nas kun bzang thugs gter ston nas sku tshe'i smad gnya' nang gser phug tu bzhugs/ rig 'dzin rgod ldem dang sangs rgyas gling pa dang dus mtshungs/ de gnyis ka dang dngos su ma mjal kyang slob mas sbrel te thugs mdza' bcugs su gyur zhing gter chos phan tshun gsan bzhes dang / dam rdzas phab rgyun gcig tu spel bar mdzad ces gsungs/ sangs rgyas blo gros ni/ kong yul snying phur gter ston sangs rgyas gling pa'i gdung rigs las byon pa dpal rta mchog gi dngos grub bsnyes pa zhig go/ shang pa bsod nams mchog gyur ni/ bo dong paṇa chen 'jigs med grags pa'i chos sras pho nya'i lam mchog thar phyin pas 'ja' lus su gshegs/ de dang dus 'ol spyir mtshungs pa 'bras yul skyad tshal gyi kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel ni/ gtsang rong chen snar du sku 'khrungs/ thog mar rong byams chen gyi grwa sar bzhugs pas byams chen rab 'byams par grags/ phyis 'bras yul rdzong dkar skyed mo'i tshal gyi bshad grwa btsugs/ gangs ljongs 'di'i bshad grwa phal che ba zhig 'di nas gyes so/ /'khon ston bzang po dpal ni/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa'i dbon sa skya'i gdung rabs rnams kyi spyi mes grags che ba zhig go/ /bdag smyon kun dga' legs pa ni/ dpal ldan sa skya'i gdung las byon zhing myang gi drag dmar gyi snying po dung phyur 'grub par grags/ gzhan yang / zla ban gzi brjid 'bar/ gter ston grwa pa badz+ra/ dbus pa blo gsal/mkhas pa gtsang nag pa thugs rje seng ge/ snar thang gi mkhan po bzod pa dpal grub/ kaḥthog tshul khrims 'bum/ jo nang rje btsun tā ra na tha'i thugs sras ting skyes rgyal po'i sras 'jam dbyangs ye shes rgya mtsho/ mdo khams kaḥthog dang nye bar 'khrul zhig dbang drag rgya mtsho/ gter ston rat+na gling pa'i gdung las kun dga' bstan 'dzin gter ston kun skyongs gling pa'i sras nyi zla bzang po/ lho ljongs su sgrub brgyud bstan pa rgyas par mdzad pa mthu stobs chen po'i mtshan 'chang ngag dbang rnam par rgyal ba sogs sprul pa'i bye brag tu gsung zhing / de dag las phal cher ni slob dpon chen po'i lung gis zin pa dang / 'ga' zhig rje nyid sku'i na tshod shin tu phra ba'i skabs su thugs kyi dran pa dang / la la zhig phyis su sad byed kyi rkyen la rten nas thugs su dran pa yang mang du byung zhes gsungs la/ skye ba'i rabs kyi phreng 12

ba de rnams kyang kha cig rim gyis brgyud pa dang / la la thog mtshungs dang snga phyir yul dus ci rigs su byung ba rnams ni gcig car du byon pa'am/ de dang des byin gyis brlabs pa dang thugs rgyud gcig par zhal gyis bzhes pa ste sems can chos pa sna tshogs pa'i ngor 'dul byed kyi sprul pa sna tshogs pa gcig car du ston pa ni 'phags chen byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ngo mtshar gyi 'phrul chen po ste/dper mtshon na phyag rdor dbang bskur gyi rgyud du/ kun tu bzang po skye ba brgyud pa phyag na rdo rjer bshad nas de gnyis ka nye ba'i sras chen brgyad kyi nang du dus mnyam par byon pa bzhin mtha' gcig tu ma nges pas a thas zhen 'dzin gyi log rtog mi bya'o/ /gzhan yang gsang rnam las/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi ljong zhig tu sdig spyod kyi rgyal por skyes pa nang pa'i grub thob zhig gis de las zlog nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa la gus pas mchod pa dang / yang grub thob chen po la li ta badz+ra kyi skabs su sngags 'chang ma nus pa che ba zhig kyang skyes nas grub chen gyi tshogs kyi gzung mar sngags kyi bkug nas las kyi phyag rgyar byas shing byin gyis brlabs pas da lta rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud la mos shing bag chags sad pa dang /in+d+ra bhu ti chung ba'i slob ma kam+bha la zhes mkha' 'gro ne gu ma yi bla mar gyur pa des rjes su bzung ba'i lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram du tshong dpon gyi rigs las byung ba'i rnal 'byor pa zhig tu gyur pa dang / bal yul ye rang du skyes pa'i ma rgyud chos kyi bdag po dza ya se nar gyur pa yang dran zhes dang / de bzhin rgya gar gyi lho 'gro lding gi gling na rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i sku'i skye ba dngos yin pa/ su kha nā tha bya ba'i slob ma tsi kra nā tha bya ba zhig nged dang rgyud gcig par yod/ gzhan yang / rgyal po/ dge bshes/ sngags kyi rnal 'byor gyi gzugs su byas pa yang yod mod kyi zhib par brjod ma btub/ sngon rig 'dzin pad+ma ma ṇi'i skabs su/ de dang rgyud gcig pa'i stod hor ste stag gzig gi ma kha'i yul na jing gi mi gan zhes rgyal po dang /'bras ljongs kyi phyogs su mon gyi ling pa'i tshul dang / lha ldan du bud med mdze yi gdung ba'i tshul can yod gsung pa ltar/ da ltar yang zhang zhung gi yul mthar mon gyi ling pa dang / ma hā tsi na'i phyogs su smad tshong gi gzugs su yod par 'dod/ spyir 'dzam bu gling 'dir dpal chen po nam snying gi dngos brgyud sprul pa byin gyis brlabs pa khyon lnga phrag lnga re dus phal cher 'byon par bzhed/ ces gsungs zhing / yang gsang rnam thar smig rgyu'i chu bo las/ gzhan yang skye ba snga ma'i yang snga ma gaja rung zhig gi las kyi bcom ldan 'das dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i dbang bskur skabs dge mtshan mthong zhing bskyed rdzogs la yang go ba bzang por chags pa dang / dpal che mchog la yang de dang cha mthun tsam pa byung la/'jam dpal dkar po/ dbyangs can dmar mo/ mi g.yo dkar po rnams kyang skye sngon yi dam du byas pa'i mtshan ma cung zad re mthong / rgyal ba'i bstan bsrung chen po'i skur bstan pa ye shes kyi mgon po phyag 13

bzhi drug dang / mgon po bram gzugs/ zhing skyong seṅge nag po/ dbyings kyi ma mo ral pa gcig ma/ drang srong chen po rnams rab tu nye ba'i ltas shar yang skye ba snga ma'i las 'bras su go zhes kyang gsungs so/ /bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid kyi sku'i yang srid snga ma ni/ grub pa'i dbang phyug stag ras pa pad+ma nor bu kun bzang dri med rdo rje gzi bajid 'phrin las 'gro 'dul du grags pa de nyid yin par yongs su grags shing rje nyid kyi zhal gyi bzhes pa'i tshul rnam thar snyim pa'i chu skyes las/ grub dbang nam mkha'i snying po yi/ /sprul pa'i skyes bu rig pa 'dzin/ /pad+ma nor bu zhes bya ba/ /o rgyan zab gter kha byang 'dzin//dam pa de nyid yin no skad/ /zhes gsungs pa'i skyes bu chen po de'i rnam par thar pa'i tshul zhib mor yi ge'i ris su 'khod pa ni mthong thos kyi spyad byar ma gyur kyang / rje nyid kyi gsung 'khrungs rab gsol 'debs mut+ta ka yi mā li 'dod don kun 'byung las gong du smos pa'i skyes rabs kyi phreng ba rim par bstan pa'i rjes su/ de la sogs te skye ba'i phreng ba ni/ /sna tshogs 'gro 'dul sprul pa'i zlos gar che/ /ma nges grangs med skal ldan kha lo bsgyur/ /gang 'dul der mtshungs ston la gsol ba 'debs/ khyad par 'bri rgyud re kha'i gdul bya'i don/ /stag bur dam pa'i gdung rigs las skrun te/ /skyes nas bag chags bzang sad gsang sngags chos/ /legs 'chang mchog sprul de la gsol ba 'debs/ /nar son gter grub du mas rjes bzung nas/ /thugs sras dbang bskur rgyal tshab cod paṇa byin/ /smin grol mnga' brnyes pad+ma nor bu zhes/ /rgyal sras dam pa de la gsol ba 'debs/ /dkyil 'khor rab 'byams bsnyen sgrub drod tshad thebs/ /stong nyid don rtogs snang sems mngon sum 'dres/ /bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen man ngag don byan tshud/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug de la gsol ba 'debs/ /rnga yab dpal rir gu ru pad+ma'i drung / /dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs bskur nas gsang ba'i mtshan/ /gu ru zhi ba'i blo gros zhes bya bar/ /grags gyur rig 'dzin de la gsol ba 'debs/ /kun bzang dri med rdo rje gzi brjid dang / /pad+ma chos dbyings 'phrin las 'gro 'dul rtsal/ /pad+ma dbang drag pad+ma rnam rol ste/ /sku gcig mtshan mang grags la gsol ba 'debs/ /pad+ma zab gter bdag por mnga' gsol zhing / /'brel tshad don dang ldan par dbugs rab dbyung / /skye ba'i phyi mar kha byang 'dzin lung bstan/ /dus gsum 'gro don mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /khyod kyi dgongs pa phyag rgya chen po'i gshis/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i gsang dang dbyer med par/ /thim kyang slar yang sprul pas 'gro ba'i don/ /rgyun chad med par mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsang ba gsum gyi yon tan mdzad pa rnam par thar pa rnams tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis 'doms par mdzad pa ltar grub pa'i khyu mchog de nyid rnga yab pad+ma 'od du zhing khams 'phos nas bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid du sku'i skye srid gzung ba'i tshul ni rnam thar snyim pa'i chu skyes las/ de nas 'phos 14

tshe dag pa'i sku/ /pad+ma 'od du dbugs dbyung zhing / /ma dag gdul bya 'dul ba'i phyir/ /blo gsal lag 'gro'i tshul yang bzung / /de 'phos da lta'i lus 'di srid/ /ces gsungs so/ /de ltar na rje nyid kyi gsung gi gsang ba las byung ba ltar sku tshe snga ma rnams kyi mdzad pa 'phrin las dang skye ba'i phreng ba zur tsam zhig smos pa yin no/ /bzod ma nyid nas yang dag ye shes mchog brnyes gangs khrod grub pa 'bum gyi bla na mngon mtho nam mkha'i snying po sgyu 'phrul gar/ /chu klung kun tu gcig car zla gzugs grangs med 'gyed las dbang phyogs mdo smad nor 'dzin lte bar bsam bzhin sprul pa'i snang brnyan ni/ /bskyed byed yum gyi 'phang par rtsen pa nyid nas rgyal bstan bdag por gyur pa'i dge mtshan ma dmad grags pa'i rgyal rnga sangs mthor sgrags/ /rgyal ba rgyal sras mdzad pa mtha' dag bdag gir mdzad pa'i mgon khyod dpe zla srid 'dir rnyed min de phyir snying nas phyag bgyi'o/ /mi zad snyigs dus ston gyi mtha' 'dir yang //rgyal bstan snying po'i ut+pal 'dab brgya'i tshal/ /kun tu bzhad pa'i rnam 'dren nyin mor byed/ /skye rgu'i legs byas shar ri'i phrag nas ngoms/ /gang gi gsang gsum ngo mtshar grags bstan ni/ /phyogs kyi 'khor lo'i pha mthar khyab gyur pa/ /'brel tshad mthong thos dran reg don ldan phyir/ /skal ldan kun dga'i zlos gar da bsgyur cig /da ni sku tshe 'di'i mdzad pa bdag cag gdul bya dman pa rnams dang mthun par 'jug pa'i tshul yan lag brgyad ldan dal 'bab kyi chu bo'i rgyun lta bu las thigs pa tsam zhig sgro 'dogs dang skur pa'i mtha' gnyis spang ste brjod par bya ste/ de la/ bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid gang du sku'i skye ba bzung ba'i yul ni/ 'phags mchog lag na pad+mo'i gdul bya'i zhing khams gangs ri dpal dang ldan pa'i mu khyud kyi ra bas yongs su bskor ba'i ljongs/ 'dod rgyal gyi sgra las sgo ṭa zhes bod dang bod chen gyi zlas phye ba'i bod chen po/ de la yang stod smad bar gsum las mdo smad kyi cha/sangs rgyas gnyis pa slob dpon chen po pad+mas byin gyis rlabs pa'i gnas kyi gtso bo kaḥthog rdo rje gdan gyi lho/ mdo khams stag tshangs seṅge bsam 'grub kyi byang sgang chen lnga'am drug tu dbye ba'i bum por sgang dang / smar khams sgang dang / zla rgyud sgang gsum gyi bskor ba'i dbus su gyur zhing cung zad tsam gyi chum por sgang dang nye ba bcom ldan 'das 'phags ma dam tshig sgrol ma'i sku brnyan brag la rang byung du gnas pa las dal 'bab kyi rgyun 'babs pas ming yang ljang chu gshis su grags shing lung pa kha byang du phyogs pa'i mdo gser gyi 'dren pa'i chu klung chen po rgyu ba las ljang chu'i g.yon yul de'i sa yi thig le mdo khams kyi ri bo bkra bzang ngam btsan rgod ri bkra dang btsan ri rdo rje brag zhes kyang brjod pa/ o rgyan gu ru'i byin gyis rlabs pa'i gnas chen zab gter bcu gsum tsam bzhugs pa zhig ste/ ri dbyibs rdo rje rtse lnga lta bu la rgyab ngos kyi cha cung zad tsam las mtha' skor du chu mig bar mi chad pa brgya 15

phrag du mas bskor ba/ ri ngos su gyen du de wa dha ru dang / sa la dang / ni tsu la dang / a shwata tha dang / a ka ru la sogs pa'i nags tshal gyi phreng ba bzang po ste shing sna brgya dang brgyad yod par grags shing kun tu thug pa dang / de rnams kyi bar mtshams brag ri dkar dmar gyi phreng ba dang / grog po dang / sha la dkar po'i gyen 'greng ba gdugs kyi rtsib ma lta spel zhing shin tu mdzes pa/ stag gzig dam dred gung sram gsa' spyang 'phar ba sogs bod 'dir mchis pa'i gcan gzan ma tshang ba med pa lta bu dang / de bzhin bya rgod khra glag ne tso bya wang gu ling gung mo sogs bya rigs kyang sna tshogs pa dang mi rgod spre'u phyi ba dang ri dwags kyi rigs rna ba gla ba ri gong sogs sems can rigs mi gcig pa du ma 'phyo ba bag bro zhing byin che ba/ skyi za zhing ya nga ba ya ma cha yi gnas ri bo de'i ngogs su mi rnams rgyu 'grul ches dka' ba/ o rgyan chen pos rgya gar dur khrod bsil ba tshal dang mtshungs zhes pa dang / gter lung kha cig tu/o rgyan dha na ko sa dang nges par mnyam zhes gsung ba de yi nub byang gi mtshams brag ri'i ngos su 'dab chags mgon po klu sbrul 'dzin te nam mkha' la lding ba'i gzugs brnyan shin tu gsal ba ri bo bya khyung du grags pa'i mdun du brag dung g.yas su 'khyil ba lta bu'i gong sngon rnal 'byor sgrub pa po mang pos bsti bar byas pa'i dung dkar ri khrod du grags pa'i 'dabs bsam gtan gyi spyil bu chung ngu zhig tu sku bltams so/ /de yang o rgyan chen po'i lung bstan las/ dus ngan bar gyi tshigs pa la: skal pa dum bur rtsod pa dar ba yi: sems can zhe sdang rags pa'i dus su: mon bu spyi ring skra yi la ba can zhig: ri bo khyung chen lding ba'i drung du 'byung ngo ཿོ zhes pa'i lung tshig de ni sngon gu ru jo bo rtse mo dang / bar du rat+na gling pa yang mthun par snang la/ phyi ma'i dus 'dir bdag kyang 'grig pa ltar gyur pa zhig go/ /zhes rje nyid gsung pa ltar rgod ldem can gyi byang gter rdo rje phur pa'i lo rgyus karma ma le 'phrin las kyi rgyud las kyang lung tshig 'di bzhin 'byung ba bzhin don du lung bstan tshig gcig gis gang zag mang po lung bstan par gsung pas ji ltar zhal gyi bzhes pa ltar soms nyi med par grub bo/ /rgyal tshab byams pa mgon pos/ rigs dang rus dang cho 'brang dang / /'khor dang skye ba dag dang ni/ /nges 'byung byang chub shing rnams dang / /yon tan phun sum tshogs pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar shes bya mtha' dag lkog tu ma gyur pa'i chags thogs bral ba'i gzigs pa dag pa'i ye shes kyi rol mos gang du rigs rus ma dmad pa gtsang zhing mtho bar 'khrungs na bstan dang 'gro la phan bder 'gyur bar gzigs nas sku'i skye srid gzung bar mdzad pa'i phyir/ bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid kyi rigs ni/ sngon gyi tshe khams mi nyag gi yul du dkar po sgo yi rigs las sgo bza' lha mo zhes lha'i bu mo la 'gran par bzod pa lha dang mi ma yin mang po dang brtsen nus pa zhig byung zhing / yul de'i lha mthu bo che bzhag bra lha rtse'i rtser nam mkha'i lha 16

zhig rmu thag la rten nas bab ste sgo bza' lha mo dang bshos pa las rim par 'chad pa ni spyir grags pa dang / bye brag tu yul de'i gzhi bdag de skyes bu mi las 'das pa'i lha'i bu tshar sdug 'od du chags pa dung gi go cha can zhig tu rdzus te sgo bza' lha mo dang bshos pas sang phod dus su khye'u zhig byung ba las rim par brgyud pa ste rje nyid kyi bzhed pa ltar na phyi ma 'di 'thad par gsungs/ bzhag bra'i lha de ni srid pa'i lha chen po rma chen spom ra'i bu dgu yi mthu bor grags la/ spom ra rang nyid gnod sbyin gyi dbang po rnam thos sras te de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang gi rnam sprul sa brgyad pa'i sems dpa' chen po de'i sras su gyur pa nor sbyin gyi ngo bor gnas zhes slob dpon chen po pad+ma sam+bha was gsung pa des na 'dod lha rgyal chen bzhi'i rigs las byung bar gsungs shing / gang ltar lha yi khye'u btsas nas mi ring bar ma dang bral bas ba yi 'o mas bskyed bsrings shing ming la ngu rgu zhes su btags pa mi nyag gi skad du ba'i 'o ma 'thung ba'i don dang / de las bod skad du gnas skabs su shis pa'i don gyis deng sang rngu zhes su grags te sa skyongs ba'i dbang phyug sde dge rgyal po dang gdung rus gcig tu bzhed/ de lta bu'i khye'u de lang tsho la bab pa na tsho chen po bco brgyad bdag por gyur cing yul bya rgod kyi nyin lam bco brgyad la dbang byas pa'i phyir rgyal rigs yin la de'i nang mtshan go pa ze'u zhes pa'i brgyud de snyim pa'i chu skyes las/ pha rigs 'od gsal lha bab brgyud/ /hor rgyal stobs chen go be la/ /chos rgyal 'phags pa yon mchod kyis/ /chol kha gsum la dbang bskur skabs/ /mdo khams dpon chen bzhi yi gras//rngu zhes bya ba'i rus khung la/ /mi chos stobs kyi 'khor lo can/ /sa skyongs sde dge zhes pa yi/ /brgyud pa nyams med gnas pa dang / /rgyal bstan 'dzin pa'i skyes bu yang / /'phags yul grub pa'i dbang phyug che/ /ku ku ri phrul chos rdor sogs/ /mkhas shing grub pa'i skyes bu ni/ /chad med 'khrungs pa'i rigs nyid las/ /nang tshan go pa ze'u ste/ /zhes gsungs shing de'i rigs brgyud dri ma med pa las yab kyi khyad par khyim btsun dge bsnyen lha chos su lo mang po'i bar du yi dam gyi bsnyen bsgrub them par byas shing / mi chos su rgyud drangs la khro gtum che zhing dpa' brtul snying stobs kyi ngar dang ldan pa a ti nā tha ri ka te a mgon zhes pa'i dpa' bo chen po zhig go/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i bskyed byed kyi thabs bde ba chen po'i ngo bor gyur pa ni/ gnas chen ri bo bkra bzang gi zhing skyongs gtso bo de yin par bzhed de/ rdo rje brag btsan du grags la/ des na yul lha chen po de ni chos bon gyi skye bos gsol ba'i ming tha dad can dregs byed stong sde'i rje bor gyur pa gter byon gyi sgrub thabs dang mthun par gter grub dam pa rnams kyi gzigs snang du gter bdag gnod sbyin dbang po'i sgyu 'phrul ltar bzhed pa sogs gang ltar mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul gyi mnga' dbang du gyur pa zhig yin zhes gsungs/ gang gi bskyed byed shes rab stong pa 17

nyid yum gyi khyad par du gyur pa ni/ 'bru zhes pa'i che btsan gyi rigs shar phyogs ma hā tsi na'i yul dang bod yul gyi mtshams na/ pā la k+ṣe mdo zhes su grags shing / myur 'gyogs rta zhon dag gis gro skad rer grong khyer chen po'i mtha' skor nus tsam pa'i mnga' 'bangs gi rje bor gyur pa de'i brgyud las zhing skyes kyi mkha' 'gro ma yi rigs su gyur pa mi chos su dgra gnyen gang la'ang chags sdang gi rus thon pa dkon mchog gsum la mchog tu dad gus dang ldan cing rdo rje sems dpa'i snying po yi ge brgya pa 'ba' zhig la yi dam du byed pa bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal mjal ba badz+ra sa mu tra te rdo rje mtsho zhes bya ba yin la/ lhums su 'jug par nye ba'i tshe yab kyi mtshan lam du/ nam mkha' nas gser gyi rdo rje 'od zer kun tu 'bar ba zhig byung ste rang la thim pa dang / yum gyi mnal lam du/ sprin med pa'i nam mkha' dngas pa'i dkyil du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gsum dang / de'i 'og tu 'od dmar po'i dkyil 'khor gcig gi g.yas g.yon du zla ba lta bu'i 'od skor gnyis kyi bar mtshams su 'od zer gyis dra bas sbres pa zhig shar ba mthar rang la thim pa sad tshe lus sems bde gsal mi rtog pa'i bde ba'i ngang du ring zhig gnas par gyur/ gang gi tshe phyugs bdag ste dbang phyug zhes pa me mo glang gi lor yum gyi lhums su zhugs te shes rab stong pa nyid kyi mkha' dbyings der zag pa med pa'i ye shes chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la 'jig rten pa dang mthun par zla grangs them gyi bar snyoms par bzhugs te mthar gyis 'bru mang po ste sa pho stag gi lo zhal gsar du ngom pa bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang / dpal dus kyi 'khor lo rdo rje gdan bzhi sogs rgyud dgongs 'khrul med dang bod snga rabs pa'i lo 'go rgyal gyi zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi tshes bzang gza' skar byed sbyor rten 'brel phun sum tshogs zhing pad+ma ḍā ki rgyud pa'i dus der yum gyi mkha' las 'od zer dang bcas shing a ham gi rang sgra dang bcas yum la gnod pa med par sku 'khrungs shing nyin der phyi rol gyi nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa'i mthing zhun sngon pos khebs pa ltar ches dngas pa'i klong du srid pa'i sgron me nyin mo'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer gyi pa ṭa rab tu gsal zhing bkra bar gyur la gzhan yang snod bcud kyi bkra shis dge ba'i mtshan ma du ma zhig mngon du gyur to/ /de ltar yang rnam thar snyim pa'i chu skyes las/ pha ming a ti nā tha zhes/ /dpa' zhing brtul phod stobs rtsal ldan/ /gzhon nu nyid nas chos sgor zhugs/ /yi dam lha bsnyen mang song zhing / /ya rabs sems ldan zhig yin lags/ /ma ni 'bru zhes che btsan rigs/ /rgya nag bod kyi yul mtshams na/ /pā la k+ṣe mdo zhes grags pa/ /rta zhon dag gi gro skad rer/ /grong khyer mtha' skor nus tsam pa'i/ /dpon po'i de yi rigs skyes pa'i/ /badz+ra sa mu tra zhes pa/ /chos la mos shing dad brtson can/ /lhag pa'i lha yang zhal mjal zhing / /gnyug ma'i ngo mthong zhig yin lags/ /cho 'brang de 'dra'i bu ru bdag /o rgyan gnas dang dbyer med pa'i/ khams 18

kyi btsan ri bkra bzang gis/ /nub byang ri khrod dung dkar zhes/ /bsam gtan sgom pa'i spyil po ru/ /za byed rgyal gyi zla bar skyes/ /zhes gsungs/ de yang skyes rabs kyi 'phreng bar gcig tu 'brel ba'i rigs kyi bdag po rnam par snang mdzad sgyu ma'i rol gar lo chen be+e ro tsa na'i yang srid gter ston sprul pa'i skyes mchog dpal pad+ma bde chen gling pa'i zhal snga nas/ rig 'dzin pad+ma nor bu zhing khams phos pa'i rjes su/ da ste lo gsum 'das shing bzhi lnga'i khongs su yul phyogs 'dir skyes bu dam pa zhig gi skye ba'i srid pa bzung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'i lung bstan gsung gi gsang ba mthon por sgrog par mdzad pa lo bzhi ba'i khong der dam pa de nyid sku 'khrungs pas mngon du gyur cing skabs 'dir 'khrungs nas dgung zhag bdun song ba na rig 'dzin gter ston chen po nyid byon te rang gter bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa rdo rje rgya mdud kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba dang lhan cig rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu/zhes mtshan snyan gyi cod paṇa dkar po bcings pa dang lhan cig mkha' dbyings klong nas rig grub rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas shis pa brjod pa'i me tog ku mu da'i char chen po phab par gyur to/ /de lta na/ rig 'dzin pad+ma nor bu'i sgos lung du/ sprul pa'i skye bas lho phyogs su: kha byang 'dzin cing 'gro blar bdag: ces dang / nyang ting 'dzin bzang po'i rol gar o rgyan 'ja' tshon snying po'i gter byon dpal mgon ma ning gi chos skor las byung ba'i lung bstan nyi zla kha sbyor las/ kaḥthog lho ru nor bu'i ming : ya tshan shes rab snying rjer ldan: dpal mgon chos dang phrad srid na: dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur: zhes sku phreng snga phyi gnyis ka'i 'khrung yul gyi phyogs mtshan sgra dang bcas pa gsal bar bstan pa bzhin no/ /'khrungs nas zla ba gsum lon pa tsam nas tshig gi brda' sbyor bar nus shing lo ru son pa na/ re zhig gi tshe gong ma rig 'dzin pad+ma ma ṇi'i phyag ris bla ma longs sku gsung rdo rje tshe dpag med kyi sgrub thabs kyi dpe zhig rig 'dzin de nyid kyi grwa rigs zhig gi lag tu yod pa gzigs te kho par ma gnang bar thugs skyo ba'i tshul gyis 'di ni nged rang gi dpe yin zhes gsungs pa na grwa pa des kyang rig 'dzin gong ma de rjes su dran pa'i dad dang gdung ba'i shugs kyi mchi ma'i rgyun gyi gdong bsher bar byas te phyin chad som nyi med pa'i gus 'dud lhur byed pa zhig byung / de nas tsam sngon gnas rjes dran gyi ngang tshul lhug par bka' stsol ba'i tshul ni ri thang mtshams kyi sman mchog las/ de nas rim gyi nar son nas lo gsum bzhi'i skabs su gnas mal nges pa med pa'i dbang gi rdo gram zhes pa'i grong chung der sdod kyi yod skabs/ rang gi a phyi 'phags mas byin gyis brlabs par gu rus lung gis zin pa de yi bkar khrid kyi rnal 'byor byed pa mthong bas rkyen sad de phyin chad tshul de la yid rab tu zhugs par gyur pa yi skyongs ba'i rnam 'gyur kho na byas/ de 'phros lo lnga'i sne zin tsam par brag 19

dmar dgon du phyin par tshad thub gter ston mang po'i zhabs la thug cing / gnub chen bud+dha dz+nyā na'i sprul par grags pa kun bzang khyab gdal lhun grub zhes rang gi khu bor bsnyegs pa zhig yod pa de dang yud tsam mjal ba na dgyes pas bdag gral gong du bzhag bzhes pa'i phud nas drangs ba sogs dgongs yul de'i yang srid bang/ga yin min ci ltar yang bus pa shed ma bye ba zhig la sngar gyi go sa'i bab phyogs mtshungs khrel yod ngo tsha shes nas mdzad pa khong kho na nges/ zhes dang / bzhugs gral der bdag byis par song ba'i blo brid pa'i slad du gu ru pad+ma'i sku zhig bri ba gnang zhing bdag gi sngon gnas rjes su dran pa'i tshul las brtsams gsung gleng mang du byung bas rkyen byas 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i man ngag skyongs tshul ci rigs shig de dus nas shes shing dran te da ltar mos pa lam byed tsam du snying gi dbus su bzung ste gnas mod/ deng sang phal ches tshogs dbus 'chor rgyan ngom chos su byed kyi 'dug kyang bdag ni bcom ldan 'das dpal kun tu bzang po dang rig 'dzin mchog dga' rab rdo rje yi lan gcig ma yin par yang nas yang du nan tan chen pos shin tu gsang bar gdams shing gal te 'phyar na snying khrag skyugs te tshe yi dus byas shing / rdo rje dmyal bar bskal pa bdun 'bum du gnas pa'i dmod par 'jigs pas tshul 'di bab chol gyi byis pa nas da lta'i bar nam yang smra ma myong ngo / lar sangs rgyas kyi gsung kun gyi bden par 'dzin na dmod pa 'di ni shin tu gnyan par rtogs dgos su snang lags so/ /zhes gsungs/ de skabs tha mal byis pa'i kun spyod las yongs su 'das pa'i lha sgom pa dang / sngags bzla ba dang / bsam gtan bsgoms pa dang / zab gter 'don pa dang / gnas sgo 'byed pa'i tshul dang /'khor gyi dbus su dbang bsgyur zhing chos 'chad pa'i tshul kho nas dus 'da' bar mdzad cing / lhag par nga dge slong nam mkha'i snying po yin/ /sgrub gnas lho brag mkhar chu yin zhes pa dang / gzhan yang sngon gnas rjes dran gyi gsungs du ma lhug par rtsol zhing / dngos nyams tshan snang du bla ma mkha' 'gro'i byin rlobs pa dang / lha dang 'dre gdon mi ma yin mang du gzigs pa zhig yod 'dug lan gcig byis pa kha shas kyi 'khor dang bcas bzhugs skabs/ khye'u dkar po ral pa'i thor tshugs can zhig gis gser gyi bum pa bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur ba zhig kyang gzigs/ de yang snyigs dus kyi skye bo ma dag pa'i blo can log snang gi rab rib kyis kun tu g.yogs ḍi dag ni/ tshad mar grub pa'i skyes bu dam pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang chos tshul bzhin spyod pa rnams la shin tu sdang shing khyad gsod dang brnyas par byed cing / gang mi dge log par spyod pa'i gang zag mchog dman gang yang dam par 'dzin pa dang / skye ba sprul pa'i gzugs su snang ba dag kyang yin pa la min pa dang / min pa la yin par rloms pa'i phyogs re'i 'dzin gtang gis kun slong drag pos brel ba zhig phyogs kun tu dar zhing rgyas pa zhig 20

'dug pa nas de skabs rje 'di nyid kyang rig 'dzin pad+ma ma ṇi'i rnam sprul min zhes mchog dman bar ma'i skye bo du ma zhig gis brjod pa dang / dad 'dun las phyir phyogs pa'i log rtog gi brnyas thabs sna tshogs pa zhig byung ba'i tshul rnam thaṣe ma bu lam yig dang bcas pa las gsungs pa ltar nges shing /dus der rig 'dzin gong ma'i rigs chos kyi dbon stag ras pa skal bzang o rgyan bstan 'dzin gyis ni thog ma nas som nyi med par ngos bzung bar mdzad la/ be+e ro'i rnam sprul rtsod bral gyi gter chen pad+ma bde chen gling pas sngar gong du smos pa bzhin lhums su ma zhugs pa'i gong du lung gis bstan cing /khyad par skabs 'dir 'di ni 'gro 'dul pad+ma ma ṇi'i sprul par som nyi med par rang gi yid la snyam pa las gzhan du yod re zhes dbu snyung bzhes pa'i gsung dang lhan cig pad+ma ka ras rgyal tshab dbang bskur zhing / /smon lam mthu yi sangs rgyas bstan srog 'dzin/ /'phrin las 'gro 'dul sprul pa'i rig pa 'dzin/ /tshe dbang nor bu dpal la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa'i gsol 'debs tshigs bcad kyang rtsal bar mdzad do/ /ri thang sman mchog las/ de nas mi ring bar rdo gram zhes su phyin cing sdod pa'i skabs gter ston bla rabs kha shas kyi zhal thang mthong bas rkyen byas dus re zhig na/ nyin cig byis pa'i rtsed mor nas kyi sog sbug gcig shags pa'i phyed tshal gyi nang du gter ston rin po che rat+na gling pa/ zhig so gling pa/ nus ldan rdo rje/ klong gsal snying po/ stag sham rdo rje ste grub pa'i skyes bu de lnga gral stabs su bzhugs shing sku'i rnam pa shin tu gsal ba zhig byung ste mngon sum ni ci la yin/ stong gzugs lta bu yang ma yin/ gsal ni shin tu rang yid ngor gsal bas da lta rtag na bskyed rim gyi gsal snang shar ba lta bu zhig 'dug kyang / de dus gsal snang thebs don ni med la gang ltar ya mtshan pa byung / don du ni de dag gi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i ltas zhig yin nam snyam/ gong gi de rnams dang lhan du gzhan yang 'ga' re 'dug snyam rab rib snang yang nges gsal mi dran pas smra ma nus so/ /gzhan yang de skabs phal cher zhig yid kyi ngor gu ru pad+ma'i sku yi bkod pa kho na lam lam par byed la lhag tu slob dpon pad+ma cha lugs spyi dang 'dra ba las phyag g.yas sa gnon rdo rje g.yon mnyam bzhag thod pa gru mor kha ṭ+wāṃ ka 'dzin pa zhig yang yang du lo ngo gcig tsam gyi bar du byung ste/ de yang chu bur mig gi spyod yul can ma yin mod/ ma bsam par yid ngor mngon sum lta bur lam lam pa shar ba zhig go/ /lo lnga pa'i mjug der skyabs mchog 'khor lo'i mgon po rdo rje 'chang nas ka kha yi sbyor klog slob pa'i dbu tshugs shing de 'phror rgan rabs kyis cung zad las gcun ma dgos par da lta'i klog yig 'bring tsam 'di lo drug skabs nyid du tshegs med par khong du chud pa yin no/ /lo drug lon pa'i dpyid der zhang po'i rjes su 'brangs nas khro rgyal dgon du 'khor tsam phyin zhing slar rang gnas ldog pa'i mtshams gzhan rkyen gyi 21

gzer te mang po la rten yul nges pa med pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud dgos pa byung / de dag gi bar skabs rnams su bkres skom dang tsha grang gi sdug bsngal yang ci rigs pa nyams su myongs/ bdag lo bdun pa'i skabs der rje btsun 'khor lo'i mgon po yang re kho smad bswo lci rong tol lam dgon du gdan phab par mdzad cing / bdag cag ltos bcas rnams kyang nged mthun phyogs der sdod gnas byed par shar/ de skabs rang lo bdun brgyad pa'i mtshams rnams su dpal che mchog rdo rje gro lod kyi las byang nor bu'i 'phrengs ba klog 'dzin yi dam bgyis pas bar chad sel ba dang / thog mar dngos grub kyi ltas ci rigs par shar yang phyis bsnyen bsgrubs kyi 'phro 'thud rgyu ma byung bas dngos grub kyi mtshan ma phyir phyogs song / des na phyir 'byung gi byis pa'i dus nas yi dam ldem rgyangs mi rung tshul smra dgos rgyur gda' yang/ nged la de 'dra smra mkhan ma byung ba'i skyon no/ /spyir rang lo brgyad pa'i skabs der rmi nyams kyi rang bzhin ji rigs pa zhig byung zhing lhag tu tshe 'dir o rgyan chen po'i zab gter gyi sgo 'phar 'byed pa dang / mi 'byed pa'i ltas rnams kyang gsal por shar ba yin 'dug lo de'i snga phyi'i khongs su snang ba 'di yang bden zhen med pa dngos dang mi lam dbye gsal mi btub pa 'al ma 'ol zhig shar/ de dus ngo sprod zhig thob na rtsal shin tu che bar yong rgyur 'dug ste ma byung / zhes gsungs/'di dag gi skabs su rnal lam du/ mkha' 'gro ma dang / mi ma yin/ gzhi bdag lha 'dre dregs ldan mang pos gus par btud cing brda' ston sna tshogs dang / khyad par skabs zhig mtshan snang du rnga bo che gcig la chibs nas nam mkha'i lam du gshegs pa na/ lha yul yin zhes pa gzhi 'khod snyoms bde zhing /gsal dngas bsil drod ran pa bde gsal gyi nyams rang bzhin gyis skye zhing shin tu nyams dga' ba'i tshal yid du 'ong ba zhig gi dbus su/ rin po che'i khri bkod phun sum tshogs pa zhig gi steng du dge slong zhi zhing dul ba'i sku mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar ba zhig dang / de'i g.yon du lha yi dbang po yin zhes rgyal po'i chas can 'khor gyi dpung tshogs bcas 'dug pas dri rmed mdzad/ dge slong gi sku lus las zhal ras mi gsal ba las sgrib kyi sgrib pa'i skyon dang / dge slong gi ngo bo byams mgon yin nam zhes gsungs/ yang lan cig nya gu zhes par bzhugs skabs su/ mtshan snang nyams kyi ngor/ mdun gyi mkha' dbyings su/ bcom ldan 'das gdod ma'i mgon po dpal kun tu bzang po nyid sku'i mtshan ma bzung du med pa cig lhang nge lham mer shar ba'i gsung gi rang sgra las/ e ma ho/ kun bzang gzhan min rang rig snang la stong / /'khor 'das so sor ma 'dzin rang gi sems/ /zhes gsungs pa'i ngang nyams las sad cing / nub gcig zang mdog dpal ri yin zhes pa'i ri rtse na bun gyi g.yogs pa dmar zang nge ba zhig tu byon pa na/ gu ru rin po che mjal du 'byon dgos dgongs tshe ri de'i mtha' ma chu chen po zhig gis 22

bskor bas ma thar ba de ma thag sprin gyi gseb nas slob dpon chen po dang / mtsho rgyal yin zhes pa gnyis byon nas byin gyis rlabs cing brda' thabs kyi rten 'brel mdzad pa zhig kyang byung gsung ngo / /ri thang sman mchog las/ lo bcu gcig par rje btsun rdo rje 'chang la bla ma dam pa kun rin pas nyams rtogs kyi gnas tshul zhu gnang mdzad pa thos pa sems kyi 'jog phyogs cha shas shes nas bsgom pas gnas nyams ji rigs pa skyes/ lo bcu gsum lon pa rgyal ba'i dus chen sa ga zla ba'i tshes bzang por bka' drin can byin rlabs can thugs rje can rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang pad 'byung bde chen gling pa'i zhabs pad la spyi bos btud nas dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsgrod pa gcig pa'i lam gyi mthar thug gnas lugs rdzogs pa chen po'i khrid bka'i sngon 'gro dal 'byor rnyed dka' mi rtag 'chi ba 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs thar pa'i phan yon las rgyu 'bras kyi khrid skyabs 'gro sems bskyed de skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim ma tshang ba med pa dang / maṇ+ḍal rdor sems bsgom bzlas byin rlabs bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa bcas/ smin khrid du gtang ba'i rjes su sems 'dzin nas rtsam dmigs pa'i spel bsgyur rim par gnang ba las rtogs 'bul gnyis zin pa'i skabs su rin chen zangs kyi snod rgya ja ngad ldan bsil mas bkang te thog mar bcud dang mthar snod yang rtsal zhing gnas 'gyu rig gsum ji bzhin ngos zin pa'i ma dbyung ba rdo rje'i bka' yi gnang / bla ma'i byin rlabs mthu'i ring po ma thogs par sems ngo cha mthun pa gnas 'gyur rig pa yid ches rkang tshugs skyes kyang lo de'i gzhug la rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma ma ṇi'i rigs dbon rin po che skal bzang o rgyan bstan 'dzin drung nas kaḥthog gi mnga' ris spyi dang bye brag lho phyogs re khe ljongs kyi char rgyal bstan 'dzin gyur yongs kyi spyi phud tshad skyobs dkar po'i rtse mo'i dpal ltar mngon par mtho ba kun mkhyen pad+ma blo gros kyi gdan sar bsu ba'i dgongs bzhed kyi ched du bsngags te gnyer pa spyi rong rol lam du byung bar rten rtsa ba'i bla ma la dgongs pa zhus te gza' skar legs pa la lam du zhugs shing rim gyis gser gyis 'dren pa'i chu klung gnam sngon zhu ba lta bu gtsang thal du ko ba la brten nas brgal te gsal smad du rje bla ma yang nged bsu bar phebs 'dug pa dang mjal ba'i thog ma de kar rig 'dzin gong ma nyid du dgongs bzhin yul phyogs de'i skye rgu mchog dman thams cad kyi gtsug tu lugs gnyis kyi mngon par mtho ba 'jigs med seṅge'i khrir byin gyis brlabs gyur rten 'brel bzang po'i gdan dge ba la bdag 'jog nas gus pa'i phyag dang dgyes pa'i bkur gzo che bar mdzad kyang / nged kyis ni ldang ba dang phyag lan sogs de skabs chos 'brel med pas 'bul ma thub/ ces dang / de nas rjes bla ma'i zhabs phyir dkris te ljangs chu'i grong tsho ji rigs sar phyin/ 'gru srib tu 'byor pa na tshe dbang rgyal ba 'dus pa'i lha dbang gtor 23

ma'i byin rlabs cig zhus/ de nas tsam phud bla ma la zhabs zhus zhes pa ci nus su bgyis/ de nas gtsan ri gnas nang du slebs/ dgun bam̐ de dang lo phyi ma'i dbyar ston gyi bar du der sdad nas 'phral nyer 'kho blo 'dzin than thun bla ma'i bka' ltar bgyis rung grwa tshangs mig srol g.yeng bas slad de sngar gyi nyams phran bu de yang je yal du song / der yang ma zad kyi lo bcu gsum mar btags mtshan mo stong gzugs dang 'brel ba'i lha sku yi snang ba 'jam klas par shar ba dang / mi ma yin mang po'i gzugs brnyan rgyun du mthong zhing / rmi lam gyi snang ba yang 'dun pa gtad res kyi zin pas lha 'dre mang po dam la 'dogs pa dang / legs nyes kyang lkog gyur pa'i gnas rnams gsal por rngo theg pa sogs sgrib pa cung zad srab cing gzhon nu rtsa khams dwangs pa'i nus pa brjod kyi mi lang ba yod pa thams cad me long la snum gyi byugs pa ltar gdan sar sleb nas bzung rim gyi 'grib pa'i dbu tshugs song / de yang grwa tshangs nang nas ni brnyas chos dang khyad gsod kyi yul nyams 'thag pa'i gnas su 'khod pa yin yang /phyi rol nas bla mar dmigs te dkor rdzas 'dra ci rigs sbyin mkhan byung ba'i skyon kyang los yin/ gang ltar tshe 'dir dgos gal che ba mang zhig mi 'grub pa'i sne zin pa der gda'/ zhes gsungs/ de dag la snyim pa'i chu skyes su 'di skad ces/ skyes zhag bdun nas rje dam pa/ /bde chen gling pas rjes su bzung / /tshe dbang nor bur ming du btags/ /zla ngo gsum nas tshig brda' sprod/ /bdun nas dri dang lan 'debs shes/ /lo gsum lhag par dus kun tu/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong gis bsrung ba'i/ /rtags mtshan nye bar gnas pa kun/ /mthun snang nyid du grub byung zhing / /sngon gyi bag chags 'ga' yang sad/ /tshe rabs rtags kyi rigs bdag po/ /pad+ma mkha' la yang yang mjal/ /skye ba snga ma'i yongs 'dzin 'ga'/ /sus ma slad par mtshan bklag cing / /skyabs 'gro lha phyag 'tshal ba dang / /skabs re r+ghaṃ gi glu blangs shing / /dbang bskur chos bshad ngang tshul sogs/ /dam pa'i bag chags nyid la spyod/ /sngon gyi skye gnas 'phreng ba yang //mang zhig rmi lam sad snang ltar/ /yid la yang nas yang du dran/ /skabs su gzhan rgyud shes pa sogs/ /sngon sbyangs mngon pa 'ga' yang byung / /lo lnga lon tshe gong ma yi/ /dbon gyur rnams kyi bdag gi tshod/ /bgom phyir 'dra min chas rnams kyang / /ma 'dres mngon gyur rnyed na'ang / /khrel khrel mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan las/ /phan 'dogs bdag rkyen byas pa med/ /'di lor klog kyang bslab byas pas/ /dbu chen dbu med tshegs med chub/ /drug la rtsa ba'i bla ma'i drung / /snying thig rdzogs chen yongs rdzogs dang / /be+e ro'i dgra lha mgon po yis/ /sgrub skor rab chen phal cher nos/ /bdun pa rdo rje gro lod kyi/ /las byang blor bzung yi dam byas/ /bskyed rim dag la blo yang byang / /'dre bgegs 'dul ba'i snyoms pa skyes/ /lha yi rjes su bzung ba'i rtags/ /thun mong thun min 'ga' yang byung / /chos kun rmi lam lta bur rtogs/ / 24

brgyad la gter ston sangs rgyas gling / /gter chos thugs rje chen po'i skor/ /rgyab chos yang gsang 'od tra la/ /bltas pas tshig la go ba chags/ /rkyen des sad nas da bar du/ /rtsa ba yan lag bla ma la/ /nyams chag med cing gus pa byas/ /bcu la blo gros cung zad rgyas/ /yul de'i rnam dpyod grub pa la/ /chos kyi 'bel mchid gleng bslang nus/ /mang zhig sun phyung kha skyengs bcol/ /deng sang dran tshe las sog par/ /mthong nas 'gyod bshags bgyis shing mchis/ /bcu gcig lon tshe bla ma rje/ /dran mchog srog gi dngas ma'i drung / /klong gsal mkha' 'gro snying thig gis/ /lung rnams lhag lus med par nos/ /gzhan yang dbang lung ci rigs thob/ /snang ba sems su go ba skye/ /sgyu ma lta bur bden med rtogs/ /tshe 'di'i nus pas dben na yang / /skye sngon yi dam lhag pa'i lhas/ /byin gyis brlab mthus de yi skabs/ /gza' btsan klu bdud ma mo sogs/ /dregs pa mang po'i srog snying phul/ /bcu gnyis lon tshe dam pa mchog /gter ston 'gyur med rdo rje yis/ /thugs sras bu musnyi bha tra/ /'dus pa mdo rgyud sems kyi dbang / /gtad brgya bcas te yongs su nos/ /gzhan yang gter gsar skor yongs rdzogs/ /dbang lung cha tshang legs par thob//'di dus byis pa'i tshul med par/ /sdod tshugs brtan zhing dbang chos tshig/ /legs nyan lhag chad med par byas/ /de nas rang lo bcu gsum par/ /ci rong dben pa rol lam du/ /rig 'dzin yongs kyi 'khor lo'i bsgyur/ /dpa' bo pad+ma bde gling drung / /byang chub zla ba'i tshes brgyad la/ /mdo rgyud chos rnams thams cad kyi/ /snying por sems nyid gnyug ma'i don/ /dbang rnams kun gyi mthar thug pa/ /bskyed rim yongs kyi snying po che/ /thabs lam yongs kyi gtso gyur pa/ /lhan skyes ye shes gnas lugs zhes//don gyi sdom dpa'i mchog gyur pa/ /don dam sems ni sems bskyed gtso/ /dam tshig kun gyi bsdus don ni//phyag rdzogs zhes su grags gyur te/ /sbyor dngos rjes tshad smin khrid nos/ /'di skabs gsung tshig khrid thun kun/ /da bar yid la ma brjed cing / /deng sang gzhan la 'chad skabs yang / /bla ma'i gsung nyid shas cher yin/ /'di lor rang gi nyams myong yang / /'jigs 'jigs sbad kham byed chog pa/ /med kyang gnas 'gyu rig pa yis/ /brten phur 'khrul med lam rkang zin/ /mtshan snang phal cher 'dres pa byung / /bka' drin can de'i thugs rje'o/ /rang lo brgyad nas 'di skabs kun/ /nus pa'i bag chags cher med par/ /rje btsun bla ma dam pa la/ /chos kyi dri rmid rtag byas shing / /bka' su stsal mong chu blugs su/ /ma song yid la rab tu 'jags/ /bla ma'i mdzad pa mtha' dag kyang/ /brda' dang rten 'brel ma gtogs pa/ /tha mal tshul spyod yin snyam med/ /dam tshig ched du lus srog la/ /ltos pa med pa'i zhe gdeng yod/ /rang gi dngos chas gang yod kun/ /bla mar 'bul ba'i zhe khams yod/ /'khor ba'i chos la bsun pa ni/ /pang du sbrul zhugs lta bu yod/ /dam pa'i chos la spyod 'dod pa/ /ma gcig bu 'phrad 'dod 'dra yod/ /'di 25

skabs grogs rkyen ngan pa dang / /'grogs med ri khrod brten nas ni/ /da bar nyams len dril ba zhig /byung na rig 'dzin gong ma yis/ /rgyal sa zin tsam 'dug lags te/ /pha ma 'khor slob grogs mang gis/ /da lta chos brgyad gting na mchis/ /bsam zhing snying nas skyo ba skyes/ /lo de'i ston gzhug rig 'dzin rje/ /pad+ma nor bu'i gdan sa ru/ /rje de'i rigs dbon chos kyi sras/ /skal bzang bstan 'dzin sku 'og nas/ /bsu bar byung zhing gdan sar phyin/ /grwa 'khor kun nas mkhas dman pa/ /spu med skom gdan tshul du byas/ /bde dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong / 'di nang chos brgyad zhen pa yis/ /chu mgo thog ma de nas rtsam/ /zhes gsungs de nas ri thang mtshams kyi sman mchog las/ ri bkra gnas nang du sdod pa'i lo de'i dbyar dus der kaḥthog rgyal sras bsod nams lde'u btsan dang mjal nas dbang bka' ljags lung mang du nos pa byin brlabs kyi rgyu khyad par can zhig ni gyur 'dug /ston kha shar tsam na gdan drung rje dbon rin po cher bka'i khrol cha zhus nas bla ma kun 'dus kyi ngo bo rdo rje 'chang bde ba chen po'i zhabs pad brnyen par lci rong gi dben par song / zhes dang / dgung lo bco lnga pa'i skabs thugs dam gyi dam bca' bcu gnyis pa mdzad cing / phyag rgya chen po la rtsal du ston pa'i nyams bzhes la brtson par mdzad pas nyams rtogs khyad par can thugs la 'khrungs/ de nas mi ring ba na dgung lo bcu drug gi sne zin pa la nye ba mgo zla'i gnam stong rdzogs/ rgyal zla'i tshes shar ba/ 'od gsal dus khyad par can der rtsa ba'i bla ma gter chen pad+ma bde chen gling pa de nyid gzugs sku bkod pa chos dbyings su bsdus pa de'i tshe thugs ngal bzod par dka' ba dang gsol 'debs gdung shugs drag pos dgongs pa bskong ba'i thabs tshul rgya cher mdzad pa dang rnal lam dang nyams kyi snang bar gter chen de nyid lan mang du mjal zhing gdam pa dang rjes su gdam pa ji snyed gnang nas byang chen snying po'i bar du 'brel ba med par rjes su bzung ba'i zhal bzhes kyang rtsal ba byung gsungs/ de dag gi tshul rtogs brjod lam yig sna tshogs pad+ma'i 'phreng bar rgyas par gsung pa ltar ro/ /de yang rtsa ba'i bla ma gter chen 'di nyid dang sku'i skye rabs kun tu 'brel ba med pa'i tshul ni rang gter klong gsal mkha' 'gro snying tig gi ma 'ongs lung bstan rab gsal me long las/ ma 'ongs snyigs ma bzhi bcu kha ral mtha': sum cu'i yang mtha' tshe tshad dus kyi tshe: da lta'i bai ro'i skye ba gong zhes grong : pha ni dkon mchog ma ni bzung zhes bu:rnal 'byor shākya'i mtshan can chu yos pa: dmar smug sgeg pa'i gzugs brjid dpa' bo'i rigs: sme ba pad+ma'i do shal rgyan drug spras: chags pa'i mdangs ldan pad+ma bde chen gling : 'byung bzhi dbang bsdud rtsa rlung drod rtags ldan: brtul zhugs stobs ldan bdud 'joms rdo rje zhes: chos min sun phyung bdud sde'i dpung rnams bcom: yon tan sbas tshul dad brtson shes rab can: spyod pa ma nges byis pa'i ngang 26

tshul spyod: gtad med smra tshig man ngag glu ru len: 'jig rten zhen log chos la spobs pa che: 'khor du bud med khyu bcas sgrub bstan tshugs: bskyed rdzogs klong gyur mkhyen ye dpag tu med: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srog shing dam par byed: de 'dra'i las can skyes bu nges par 'byung : zhes gter ston chen po nyid kyi che ba'i yon tan bstan pa'i rjes su/ de la 'dun pa'i chos bdag skyes bu ni: nam snying sprul pa kaḥ thog nye ba'i lhor: pad+ma'i ming can mchan g.yon me bas brgyan: yang gsang ma rgyud chos la mkhas pa 'byung : mkha' 'gro snying tig bskyed rdzogs 'di phrod na: zab gsang bstan 'dzin 'brel tshad smin grol sbyor: zhes dang / zhang sna nam pa rdo rje bdud 'joms kyi rnam rol rig 'dzin rgod ldem can gyi yang sprul mnga' ris gter ston zla ba rgyal mtshan gar dbang rdo rje snying pos mang yul skyid grong gi 'phags pa wa ti bzang po'i gtsug lag khang gi khrus khang nas spyan drangs pa'i thugs rje chen po rtsa gsum snying thig gi lung bstan las/ nus ldan rdo rje'i sku lus mthar: rig sngags 'chang ba pad+ma'i mtshan: de la dad 'dun gtsug gi nor bu'i tshul: zhi ba'i dus na rdo rje sems dpa' zhes kyang bya: zhes gsungs pa gong gi pad+ma'i ming can ni rje nyid kyis mtshan la pad+ma theg mchog zhes pa dang / dgung lo nyer gnyis pa'i skabs shig tu ting rir rig 'dzin pad+ma dbang rgyal la gtum mo'i khrid 'bul ba gnang skabs nub gcig rje btsun dza ya mū tra lta bu rigs sngags 'chang ba zhig gi nye ba'i mgon po'i nag po'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur gnang ba'i mjug pa'i skabs rig pa'i me tog dor bas lhor bab par khri la dbang bar lung bstan pa'i gsang mtshan pad+ma stobs ldan stsal du yang gsol ba/ de'i mtshan sgra dang /'dir nus ldan rdo rje ni spu bo gter ston khrag 'thung bdud 'dul rdo rje dang / stag sham nus ldan rdo rje nyid kyi rjes su rigs sngags 'chang dbang pad+ma'i mtshan te gter ston pad+ma bde chen gling pa byon zhing /de'i thugs sras kyi mchog ni/ de la dad 'dun gtsug gi nor bu'i tshul dang / 'gro 'dul rdo rje sems dpa' stsal zhes rje 'di'i mtshan sgra dngos su bstan pa ste/ des na 'jig rten gyi mig gcig bu lo chen bai ro'i sprul gzhi yang gsang ba'i bdag por gyur zhing gang gi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi sprul pa'i bye brag kyang bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig byung ba'i nang nas dus bab rtsod bral gyi gter chen 'gro 'dul gter bdag gling pa'i rig 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rje dang pad+ma bde chen gling pa gnyis thugs rgyud gcig cing gter gling gi gsang rnam sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i rol mo las/ phyi dus 'khor lo mtha' ma nges don du/ /thogs med smra ba de dang blo chen pa'i/ /yang srid 'ga' zhig bag chags sad 'dra ba/ /sprul pa'i snang ba gnyis pa yin par 'khums/ /zhes pa ni jo nang / rje btsun dam pa tā ra nā tha dang / blo chen pa ni sog bzlog pa blo gros rgyal mtshan yin par gsung pas des na sngar smos pa bzhin don gyi thugs rgyud 27

kyang / gcig tu gyur pa dang byin rlabs 'pho ba chen po'i dbang bskur yang dag par brnyes pas skal ldan las dag pa 'ga' zhig gis dus der rig 'dzin rje nyid bde chen gling pa'i skur gzigs pa yang mang du byung bar snang ngo / /ri thang sman mchog las/ chung ngu'i skabs nas rna bar wang wang zhes pa'i snyan cing skyo ba'i sgra gcig rtag tu yong la lhag par lo de skabs su cher song nas bud med dbyangs snyan po yi glu blangs pa'i ngag rta 'dra ba zhig je gsal je gsal song ste tshig la la ni skyor du yang rung / pha de thos pas 'chi ba dbang med du dran cing bsgom bsgrub ma grub par yid rab tu ngal zhing tshe 'dir snang gi bya ba la 'jug snying mi 'dod par btsan thabs su blo log nus pa cig lo de nas bzung lo gsum bzhi tsam gsal po dang tho re ba lo lnga drug bar tsam byung la/ de nas bar skabs zhig nas je yal du song / mthar lo kha shas nas med song / dus phyis sa bya lo la sngar ltar mi gsal yang wang tsam pa re byung la/ da lta yang skab skabs yongs 'dug de dus lha 'dre mo rgyud zhig gnod pa yin nam snyam yang / deng sang brtag na mi dge ba zhig yin pa 'dra/ gang ltar 'di snang zhen pa bzlog cing chos la bskul 'debs ni che ba rang ma byung bas bka' drin che'o/ /de 'dra zhig ma byung na 'di snang zhen pa chen po zhugs nas 'khor bar 'khyams nges su gda'/ tshe rabs du ma ru sgrubs pa lhag pa'i lha/ /dpal ldan bla ma yi ngo bo nā da'i sku/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro yi mgrin nas glu ru thon/ /skal ldan thar lam du 'gug 'di mi mtshar ram/ /de nas myos byed kyi lo shar tsam skabs gnas chen rdo rje gro lod mjal bar phyin/ lo gzhon skabs da lta'i rgas 'chal ni ma slebs pas skyel che khul zhig yod shis zla bos tshos ni gnas skor yin bsam pa las gzhan med/ yin pa ni rmi lam gyi ltas cig la bsten nas phyin pa yin/ de skabs ltas dang cho 'phrul ci rigs byung ba ni 'dir smra ma gos/ de 'phror gdan sar 'ongs ba'i zhor nyi ma phug gi brag cig klog pa'i gseb nas sa yi ril bu kha dog dkar po che chung sna tshogs bdun bcu lhag tsam gcig byung / bdag rang chung ngu nas chos kho nar sred pa ches pas chos gter shog ser ni mi 'dug 'di dam rdzas yin rgyu'i phyag rtags aḥma'i ri mo yang mi snang / dgos pa ci yod snyams nas rtsigs kyang ma byung la/ phyis de kar bdag rkyen yang ma byas pas zags song / de yang dus der bdag blo chung ba'i skyon te/ dam rdzas aḥmaḥzhes gter ston phal ches mtsho rgyal gyi mtheb mdzub kyi ri mor bzungs yang / la la ni de lta yang yin mod/ phal cher dam rdzas nyid la rang 'byung shar ba yin gyi des na yig 'bru'i gzugs med pa yang mi 'gal zhing / yig 'bru che chung sna tshogs 'byung ba yang don des yin/ 'on kyang rdzun zog gi slad pa'i thal ba ru re rnams dang ma nor ba ni gal che'o/ /lo der yid la ma bsam par rang shar gyi tshig thol thol du ma byung ba thugs gter gyis khul du yi ger bkod pas gu ru raklu thod phreng gi chos skor glegs 28

bam chen por long tsam grub mtshams dgos med cig snying la shar nas me la bsregs pa de dus rgyus yod kyi grwa pa yang mang / deng sang la la zhig la yid la tshig don legs su cha ba de 'dra zhig rang shar du byung na bar chad yin yang spyan ras btsum pa 'dra ste nged ni chung ngu nas bla ma'i gsung la yid ches mkhan cig lags pas de 'dra ci dga' la bor ba yin/ zhes gsungs/ 'di skabs zhig mtshan ltas su/byang nas rlung nag g.yos pas rkyen byas sprin nag 'gug cing / de la rten nas bod ljongs dbus gtsang du dus kyi 'gyur ba shin tu gsal ba'i lung bstan tshigs su bcad pa 'di ltar/ byang sprin nag 'tshub ma'i zlos gar de/ /rlung gi drag spyod de byang shar 'gro/ /sgra mi che mi snyan btsub gyur cing / /byang phyogs nas grags gyur zil dang ldan/ /nub byang mtshams skyin chung ru snon de/ /mthar nang 'thab kyi nub dang byang du 'thor/ /de yun ring bar du mi 'byung ste/ /me 'chi ka'i me stag lan gsum 'phro/ /kho 'gar ba lan gsum nyal zhing lang / /byang gnam mtsho'i 'dam gyi ri mgul na/ /rta rgyug kha mnyam pa mang po rgyug /rgyug 'dod kyang rgyug kha bskyil zhing btang / /lho mon kha gtsang gi lung stod na/ /mi gdug pas lkog nyal byas pa de/ /sus ma tshor skung nas bud kyang nye/ /dbus lha ldan gtsug lag re mos rtsod/ /ri dmar po'i gser gyi gadhe de/ /mthar nub sam byang gi phyogs su khyer/ /shar nyi 'og rgyal po'i nga ro de/ /dbus lan gsum rtsod pa'i tha mar rgyal/ /de mi ring nub phyogs gangs ri'i ngos/ /sprin nag po'i 'phreng ba khrigs nas 'byung / /ser drag po'i bod yul 'ur thabs 'joms/ /'di 'ga' re lo gsar tshun la shes/ /tshig la la e bden lo gsum dang / /lo bdun tshun ltos dang shes nas 'byung / /'di bzlog thabs yod de byed mkhan med/ /zhes gsungs pa shing bya lor mchod yon nang 'khrugs pas sog po o rong gi rgyal po lha bzang khang gi dpungs g.yos pas rgyal ba tshangs dbyangs pa mtsho khar spyan drangs shing bde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho stod lung snang rtser dkrong pa dang / gsang chen snying lugs pa rnams la bka' chad mang du phab pa sogs kyi ze bun cher g.yos pa'i mthar lha bzang rang nyid kyang jun gar pa'i dpung gis bcoms nas mi bsrun pa de dag gis bod khams spyi dang khyad par gsang chen snying po'i bstan la lhag par 'tshe bar byed pa'i tshul sogs lo bdun tshun gyis nges pa dang / yang lha bzang khang gis snga sor rgyal mchog lnga pa chen po'i skabs bstan srid bde thabs su 'gong po ar gtad kyi mnan pa mang du mdzad pa mtha' dag 'byung pos rgyud bskul ba'i skye bo dag gis skyed de gnan pa phal cher gton pa de'i tshe rje 'di nyid kyi mtshan snang du byung tshul gsang rnams chung bar/ res zhig skyes bu sol ba'i rta zhon pa/ /mang byung khyed rnams su yin smras pa la/ /nged rnams 'gong po yin la dbus gtsang du/ /bdag gi grogs 'ga' sngags pa tshos gnon te/ /da res lha bzang gis byung bros thar zer/ /nga yi lhar bskyed 29

phyag mtshan gyis sdigs pas/ /rlung nag 'adzhab mar gyur nas shar phyogs su/ /bros thal rmi zhing sad rtsa sems ma bde/ /de ni 'gong po'i bod khams dkrug par go/ /zhes gsungs pa ji bzhin mngon du gyur pa de ltar ro/ /de nas yang rnam thar ri thang sman mchog las/de nas gdong ngan gyi lo la stag tshang gi gnas chen rdo rje gro lod du sgrub pa lhur len zhig bya snyam na yang grogs ngan stabs kyi lag tu ma long bas ci rong du nas sbas mtha' rol lam du rang shong gi bsgrub khang drag po e long zhes btags pa zhig bcos nas klong gsal mkha' 'gro snying thig gi bla bsgrub gser gyi 'bru gcig gi bsnyen bsgrub khul tsam byas kyang gzhung bzhin bcas pa dam por ma gyur pa dang lhag tu lus yang yengs med tsam sngags bzlas la zhugs tshul gyis kyang yid rnam rtog gi dbang du bskyod pas bsgrub rtags mtshan ma ni mi lam bzang por grub tsam yang ma byung / spyir de dus skabs rtags mtshan la re dogs chen po byas pa'i skyon yang los yin/ phyis bsgrub pa grol mtshams sngags bzlas mang nyung ji tsam song ba'i phan yon gyi ni nam yang mi bslu bas rtags mtshan ma byung na sla'o bsam pa byung bas de ni yin par yang 'dug lar bsnyen bsgrub byed par rlom nas sngags yengs shing bzlas na rtags mtshan gyi re ba ci yod/ de bas lha sgom dang sngags la yid gtad nas rnam rtog gzhan spangs pa rang gal chen du snang yang / de dus rdzogs rim yin rgyu'i go ba lam pa de ngang bzhag pas chog khungs byas te ma shes par gda'/lar 'di dus skyo shas che zhing rang nyid le los chos ma grub par yid rab tu gdung ba byung bas skyo shas kyi glu yang mang du blangs lhag tu mi lam du rang dbang gter gnas su mang du sleb pa dang / zab gter kha byang lung bstan dum bu yang mang du byung mod/ de yi rten 'brel gi sgo ji bzhin pa ni bsgrigs ma nus par zad do/ /gzhan yang de skabs rang nyid ji srid 'tsho yi bar du ngo bsrung khral 'jal lta bu ma yin par rang gis dwangs bas dbang bskur/ khrid rgyun zhus par rtsa ba'i dam tshig srog gi phyir yang mi spang ba dang / gnas skabs kyi dge sbyor tshig bdun gsol 'debs zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ 'dzab sngags badz+ra gu ru/ yi ge drug ma/ rlung bum pa can grangs bcad rnams thog mar zla dus kyi grangs 'dzin byas pa yin yang phyis nyin zhag phrug rer byas/ zhes gsungs/ dgung lo nyi shu pa gser 'phyangs te me mo bya lor bcom ldan 'das badz+ra ku ma ra te rdo rje gzhon nu'i bsnyen sgrubs mdzad tshe lhag pa'i lha mchog de'i zhal bzang sgrib bral ye shes kyi gzigs mor shar zhing / 'phral rkyen las 'og gdon gyi cho 'phrul byung ba zhi ba'i tshul/ yi dam dkyil 'khor ni nam mkha' skar tshogs 'dra/ /ngo mtshar nus pa ni rang sor che mod kyi/ /kun gyi thugs rje dang 'phrin las 'dus pa'i lha/ /bar chad kun sel zhing dngos grub stsol lags pa'i/ /gsang bdag rdo rje 'chang rgud bral gzhon nu'i sku/ /nyi zla ltar gyur pa'i lha mchog tī la ya/ /pad 'byung yab yum gyi yi 30

dam lhag pa'i lha/ /bar chad kun sel zhing dngos grub stsol lags pa'i/ /gsang bdag rdo rje 'chang rgud bral gzhon nu'i sku/ /nyi zla ltar gyur pa'i lha mchog kri la ya/ /de yi ngang nyid la kho bo'i yi dam bgyis/ /phral rkyen spyod dbang gi klu gdon zhugs cha ba/ /lha mchog de nyid kyi nus pas rang sar deng / /gnas skabs cung zad re sngags bzlas de 'dra na/ /gsal gsum yun bsgom na mchog don cis mi 'grub/ /ces kyang gsungs/ bar skabs der kle gsal dang ba zal zhes pa'i yul 'khrug yo lang mi zad pa snga phyir byung ba dag bsdum zhing phan tshun bde ba'i ngal gsor 'god pa dang / skabs cung zad byung rim gyis bsnyen sgrub zhag bdun ma re dang lhag par rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yi bsnyen pa bdun gcig gnang ba'i tshe phyis rim gyis snyan pa mnga' thang je rgyas su 'byung ba'i ltas rkyeng shar tshul dang / lan cig nyams kyi gzigs ngor 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal sku tshad khru gang tsam pa zhig dang / rnal lam du 'od kyi rnam par rdo rje khro lod dkar po zhig kyang gzigs gsungs/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dag snang las byung ba'i gsang lam ḍāk+ki'i snyan brgyud kyi dgongs gter dag kyang 'di skabs su byung zhing dkar shog tu gtan la phab par mdzad/ gzhan yang de dus sngon gyi tshe mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan gyi yig mkhan ldan ma rtse mang gi sprul gar sbas pa'i tshul gyis grub pa bsnyes pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug kun bzang rin chen zhes pa'i drung du/ klong gsal snying po'i gter byon drag po ye shes rab 'bar gyi dbang lung yongs su rdzogs pa dang / drag sngags brgyud pa'i zhal khrid rgyas sdebs snying gzer gyi phyag bzhes 'khrul med zhib rgyas dang / bdud 'dul ba'i sprul sku snying thig tsaṇ+ḍa li yi khrid dang / grub thob maṅga a yu tiṣ+ṭha nas nye brgyud gsang lam chig brgyud kyi thun mong stong sgo thun min 'og sgo'i skor gyi zhal bzhes phyag len dang bcas pa/gzhan yang bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i zhal rgyun mtha' yas pa sogs bum pa gang 'jos su rtsal zhing gang gi bstan pa'i rgyun yongs su rdzogs par gtad pa'i thugs kyi sras su dbang bskur ba ste bka' drin can gyi bla ma gcig yin gsung ngo / /dgung lo nyer gcig pa mi zad te me pho khyi lor bod chen dbus 'gyur chos kyi 'byung gnas kaḥ thog rdo rje'i gdan chen por/ grub pa'i slob dpon chen po r+ghaṃ ka ra dang / rdo rje rig pa'i khyi'u chung gnyis su med pa'i sgyu 'phrul du gyur cing ngang chung dpal gyi rgyal mo'i sku'i skye bar grags pa kaḥ thog rgyal sras bsod nams lde'u btsan gyi drung du byon/rgyal ba lha bab kyi dus bzang por skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang gtsug phud phul bar mtshan/ bsod nams theg mchog bstan 'dzin dpal bzang po/ zhes su gsol/ dam pa 'di las klong gsal rdo rje snying po'i dbang bzhi zhib rgyas rtsa ba yan lag yongs su rdzogs pa/ tshe sgrub yang gsang bla med/ thugs rje chen po yang gsang bla med/ drag po ye shes rab 'bar/ bdud 'dul zhing skyongs kyi 31

srog dbang / stag shams pa'i gu ru zhi ba'i thugs sgrub pad+ma'i gsang tig /bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i thugs sgrub gsal byed nor bu'i lugs sogs pu ste yongs rdzogs kyi bka' gtad/ kaḥ lugs kyi zhi khro phur pa'i dbang sogs gsan/ thugs yid gcig tu 'dres shing me dang rlan med kyi spra ba 'phrod pa lta bur thugs kyi sras dam par rjes su bzung bas bka' drin can gyi bla ma'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa yin gsung / dgung lo nyer gnyis pa me mo phag lor/ btsan ri rdo rje brag gi g.yas ngogs rtsen chen zhes pa'i dgon par dad ldan bdun phrag lhag tsam la zab khrid dang / skabs zhig shin dgu gangs ra zhes par gsang spyod kyi brtul zhugs bzung tshe tshar lhong gi ltas kyang mang du byung / de skabs rnal lam du/gangs dkar spun gsum dang nye bar yin no dgongs pa'i ri de'i 'bur zhig gi steng grong pa mi che ba zhig tu rtsa ba'i bla ma gter chen bde chen gling pa'am bdud 'joms rdo rje'i sprul pa'i 'od zer zhig spro bar gzigs/ rjes su rje nyid kyi chos sras kyi mthu bo dge sbyongs kun bzang ting 'dzin yin zhes gsung rgyun las 'byung / lo de'i mjug stag phu re khe'i ljongs dpal be'u lung gi dben gnas su dad ldan gyi 'dus pa brgya phrag lhag par tshogs bshad rtsal ba na khrid lo legs pa'i kun la ngo sprod theb par byung zhing 'gro don gyi khrid bka' gsung ba'i thog mar gyur pas rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i dge mtshan lhag par che bar gyur/ de nas ci rong ting rir pad+ma bde chen gling pa'i rigs sras pad+ma dbang rgyal la gtum mo'i zab khrid phul ba'i skabs gnas bdag de nyid 'tshub pa'i nyams kyi dgun dus hor zla bcu gnyis par blo bur nyid du thog 'khyug ser ba 'bab pa byung ba na ting nge 'dzin gyis gzir bar mdzad pas sa bdag mo de nyid kyi rang gzugs dngos su bstan nas bka' nyan bran du khas blangs/ de'i mthar gnas de nyid du 'ja' yi rkang pa ya mtshan can stod smad phra ba bar du sbom po phang khra'i gzugs ya mtshan pa dang / phyogs mtshams rnams su 'khor lo dang / rdo rje/ rin chen/ pad+ma/ rgya gram la sogs pa gar mkhan gyi lag pas phyogs mtshon tsam yang bcos par dka' ba khrigs shing nang du mtshan snang gi ltas dge mtshan can yang mang du gzigs/ rje pad+ma dbang rgyal gyis gsung gis bskul ngor klong gsal gyi cha lag gsang ba ye shes kyi bshags bskong dkyil 'khor kun khyabs rgyas byed dri med klong yang dngos grub mchog gi char 'bebs zhes pa bka' rtsom gnang / skabs der 'chi med grub pa'i dbang phyug pad+ma'i ngang tshul can dam pa rgya gar ba mi pham mgon po mngon sum par zhal gzigs shing gdam pa dang rjes su gdam pas bka' gtad byin rlabs kyi mtshan ma bzang po bsnyes pa'i mod la sdug bsngal zhi bar byed pa'i lam gyi rim pa'i nges gsang de kho na nyid me long la pra phab pa bzhin legs par dgongs pa'i klong du 'char ba ltar man ngag de'i rtsa sdom chu shel snying po zhes pa yang bka' rtsom gnang / re zhig chu stag 32

lor 'debs par mdzad pa'i sgrub grwa sman chu zhes par sa 'dul bar byon tshe phyi nang gsang ba'i lhong gis mi zad pa'i rlung nag chen po g.yos te ri bo dag kyang 'gul ba snyam byed pa dang / phyogs kun 'jigs su rung ba'i sprin nag 'khrigs shing klog gi zhags pa cher bskyod pa dang char drag dang skyin thang ser ba rdo rje'i char dang lhan cig gnam lcags kyi thog kyang mang du bab cing bzhugs gnas gzim gur ras dkar gyi lding khang gi nang thams cad me'i 'od kyi go mtshams med par gtam gzigs snang du sprin nag gi klong der mi sdig pa'i gzugs 'jigs rung sna tshogs pa 'jigs pa'i sgra dang gad mo sgrogs pa du ma zhig snang bar gyur/ gam du gnas pa'i 'khor kun dred dngangs tab tab por gyur pa'i tshe rje nyid ni nyam nga khu 'phrig gi rnam pa tsam yang mi mnga' bar dpal chen po he ru ka dpal rta mgrin nag po'i gsal snang nga rgyal chen po'i gsang ba gsum gyi rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang du mnyam par 'jog par mdzad pas skad cig de ma thag cho 'phrul thams cad rang zhir gyur/ tho rangs kyi skabs der rgyal dbang bde chen gling pa de nyid te ru kaḥdang gnyis med par mdzad de zhal bstan cing dpal mgon ma ning gi dregs pa'i srog dbang sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes bcas gnang nas dregs pa can mtha' dag gi srog la dbang bsgyur ba'i byin rlabs dngos grub brnyes/ thugs dam ting nge 'dzin gyi bogs kyang gong 'phel du gyur to/ de'i tshe gter ston rig 'dzin chen po rol pa'i rdo rje mjal bar bzhed pas byon pa na bar lam du gzhan dbang gis bar du bcad pas re zhig 'gyang ba'i mur rig 'dzin de nyid zhi ba'i dbyings su brnal zhing de nas dgung zhag gi bar ma chad pa'i tho rang kha zhig mtshan lam du gter ston de nyid shin tu gsal ba zhig byung ba ni bar do ye shes kyi skus rjes su bzung bar nges so/ /de dag gi don bsdu ba ni rnam thar snyim pa'i chu skyes las/ bcu bzhir skye mang las 'brel ba'i/ /bla ma kaḥthog rgyal ba'i sras/ /bsod nams lde'u btsan zhabs pad brten/ /rtsa gsum dbang bzhi zab rgyas dang / /yan lag dkyil 'khor drug cu tsam/ /dbang dang rjes gnang rgyas par nos/ /skal bzang bstan 'dzin zhabs la yang / /dbang chos gdams pa mang du thob/ /de skabs gdan sa'i las tshan tshos/ /khyad gsod brnyas pa ma gtogs pa/ /bdag la mthong bskur mi mdzad yang / /rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras des ni/ /thugs kyi sras su yongs bzung nas/ /brtse gzigs gzhan las khyad 'phags gnang / /rdo rje rig pa'i khye'u chung gis/ /sprul pas phyi mtha' gzigs par nges/ /lo de'i mjug la ci rong du/ /skyabs mchog bla ma'i zhabs pad brten/ /bco lngar phyag chen gdams pa la/ /nyams len zhi gnas brtan por skyes/ /dgun ngor nyi phug grub pa ru/ /skye bdun sgrub pa'i gral du phyin/ /thugs rje chen po yang tig gis/ /'dus pa chen po'i sgrub dbang nos/ /de ni shin tu skal ba bzang / /bcu drug dag la rdzogs chen gyis/ /sems byang skor dang yang 33

gsang nas/ /gzhan las khyad 'phags sger du nos/ /thabs lam gtum mo'i skor yang thob/ /lhag mthong nyams myong bzang po skyes/ /deng sang rtse gcig skad de lo/ /lo der rdo rje 'chang dbang yang / /chos nyid zhi la gshegs gyur pas/ /dgongs pa rdzogs thabs gang 'grub byas/ /bcu bdun lo la bcar rgya'i khung / /cung zad byas kyang sems nyid kyi/ /'khrul rgyun lugs brgyud ma bcad pas/ /nyams la bogs skyed cher ma byung / /'on kyang rmi lam 'byung 'gyur ltas/ /mtshar mtshar rgyu ba mang zhig dang / /tshe 'di'i rten 'brel gyur 'ga' la/ sngags bsrung tshub kyang ci rigs byung / /mgrin pa'i rlung sbyor nus pa yis/ /brtsom pa sngar las myur tsam byung / /bco brgyad sne la gtsang gro yis/ /gnas mjal song bas nyams myong bogs/ /cung zad thon gyur slar gdan sar/ /phyin zhing 'di lor mkha' 'gro yis/ /cho 'phrul gyur pa mang tsam dang / /gnam gter zhig kyang shar tshad tshad/ /byung yang gnyer kha ma byas shing / /btang snyoms ngang du bzhag byas so/ /de'i rgyu mtshan gang zhe na/ /gnam gter mtshan ldan byung ba ni/ /nang gi gter yig ches zab kyang ske/ /tshad ldan gyur pa re re tsam/ /de bas snyigs dus 'di 'dra yis/ /bslu ba khye nyen che ba dang / /zab mo'i rten 'brel sgrig pa yang / /yod zhes bla ma rje las thos/ /des na do gal yo ma byas/ /lhar re 'drer dogs rnam rtog cher/ /rang rgod lo 'dod dbang gyur pa'i/ /'dres khyed bla rul brgyud pa min/ /rang dbang rang gi ma thob pa'i/ /bsnyen mtshams dag kyang cung zad byang / /yon tan ltas dang lhong tshad yang glu/ /bzod par dka' ba mang du byung / /nyams ngor o rgyan rje dang mjal/ /'byung 'gyur dus kyi lung bstan yang / /rim pa gnyis tsam skabs 'dir byung / /lo mjug gdan sa'i grwa tshang gi/ /yid 'byung rang nyid gcig pu ru/ /bswa la rgyud nas gtsang khro ru/ /sgrub pa byed pa'i 'dod pas phyin/ /de yang rang dbang ma thob ste/ /grogs ngan dbang gi sgrub pa bshol/ /bcu dgur dran mchog dngas ma'i yis/ /bste gnas seng khrom ri ngogs su/ /bsnyen mtshams cung zad zhig kyang byas/ /zab mo'i sgo 'phar 'byed nus pa'i/ /ltas gyur yang yang byung na yang / /rang nyid le lo che ba dang / /grogs ngan rkyen gyi yal te song / /'on te chos zab bdud zab pas/ /'ga' zhig las 'phro bzang ldan yang / /zab mo'i rten 'brel mi 'grig bzhinaske/ /bar chad dbang gi g.yo zol sogs/ /log pa'i lam du gyur mang bas/ /bdag ni khyab bdag bla ma'i mthus/ /rgyu 'bras las la yid ches shing / /re dogs rtog pas mi thugs pas/ /zab mo'i rten 'brel ma 'grig kyang / /log pa'i lam du yongs ma zhugs/ /bdag 'dra phyis 'byung gyur rnams kyang / /'di 'drar bag zon snying nas 'tshal/ /slar yang gdan sa phyogs su phyin/ /yul chung du ma thags ltar bran/ /lo rgyus brjod la dub pa skyes/ /rang lo nyi shu'i sner 'khyol tshe/ /gnas mchog dpal gyi ri bkra ru/ /sgrub mtshams dam por bgyid byas nas/ /lhag pa'i lha yi grangs tshad kyis/ /bsnyen pa bskyal bas yi dam lhas/ / 34

rjes bzung bgegs las grol ba'i ltas/ /mang byung mtha' gzhug cung ma 'khyol/ /slar yang gnas der mkha' 'gro yi/ /bsnyen mtshams byas skabs snyan grags che/ /'byung ba'i ltas kyang legs par byung / /lung bstan than thun 'dra yang shing / /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i snyan rgyud mchog /shin tu zab pa 'ga' yang byung / /de skabs yul der 'khrug longs pas/ /sri brtul khams mchu bsdum pa yi/ /g.yeng bas bstan 'gror phan nges pa'i/ /zab mo'i rten 'brel 'ga' 'chugs song / /rang lo nyer gcig zin pa'i skabs/ /sbas pa'i sangs rgyas grub pa'i dbang / /kun bzang rin chen zhabs brten nas/ /thabs lam zab mo'i gnad chen po/ /yi ge med pa mang zhig dang / /drag sngags phyag bzhes ci rigs zhus/ /drag po ye shes rab 'bar gyis/ /dbang lung smin cing rgyas pa'ang nos/ /lo der ye shes dhāk+ki mas/ /rjes su bzung bltas khyad par can/ /du ma yang nas yang du byung / /rdzas gter phran bu rnyed na yang / /gzhan rkyen rtog pas chud zos song / /nyams kyi snang bar dpal chen po/ /badz+ra ku ma ra'i zhal yang mjal/ /nyams myong sngar dang mi 'dra ba/ /rig pa rtsis gdab med pa yi/ /khral khrol man bun yad ma yud/ /rkyen kun lam du blangs nus shing / /snang sems zung 'jug nyams myong skyes/ /sngar lo 'di lo gnyis ka ru/ /khams mchu'i mching sgrig grong chog sogs/ /mi chos go chod yin 'dra ba'i/ /mjes mjes de 'dra ma byas par/ /rang dbang rang gi thob bzhin du/ /sgrub par nan tan bgyid thub cing / /byin rlabs bla ma'i rten 'brel yang / /'grig par gyur na phyi nang gi/ /mchog la legs par spyod gyur zhing / /rkyen dang 'chi ba yang nas yang / /sun pa ma dgos tsam yong par/ /yod kyang gzhan dbang rkyen gyis ni/ /zab mo'i rten 'brel yal te song / /go ma chod pa'i rtogs brjod lags/ /nyer gnyis lo la rtsen chen du/ /dad ldan bdun phrag lhag tsam la/ /zab mo'i khrid kyang phran bu bshad/ /thabs lam nyams len sngar nas kyang / /byed khul 'di dus gtan la phabs/ /bla ma mkha' 'gros byin brlabs pa'i/ /mtshan ma cung zad tsam rnyed nas/ /gsang lam skor 'ga' yi ger bkod/ /dbyar ngo shin dgu gangs rar phyin/ /lhong tshad tshar tshad nyams tshar ba/ /mang byung ri zhig 'dir ma smos/ /ser tshogs stong phrag gsum lhag dbus/ /mngon spyod gtor ma brjid pas 'phangs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i ltas 'ga' shar/ /lo mjug stag bu re khe'i rdzong / /se'u lung gi dben gnas su/ /brgya phrag lhag la tshogs khrid byas/ /'di dus khrid lo legs pa yis/ /kun la ngo sprod theb par byung / /tshe 'di'i khe drags med ngos nas/ /bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs dmigs nas/ /'gro don yin khul chos bka' khrid/ /bshad pa'i thog ma 'di nas yin/ /de phror ci rong ting ri ru/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i rigs kyi sras/ /dam par gtum mo'i khrid skyar phul/ /gnas bdag 'tshub nyams chen po yis/ /dgun sgang hor zla bcu gnyis par/ /thog 'khyug ser ba bab pa byung / /ting nge 'dzin gyis gzir ba yis/ /phyis 35

ni sa bdag mo des kyang / rang gzugs bstan nas bran khas blangs/ /mthar ni gnas der rab dge ba'i/ /'ja' yi rkang pa ya mtshan zug /'khor lo pad+ma rgya gram dang / /rin chen 'bar ba'i gzugs gyur pa//gar mkhan lag pas phyogs mtshon yang / /bcos par dka' ba'i char pa 'bab/ /rmi lam dge mtshan 'ga' yang shar/ /khyad par dam pa mi pham mgon/ /zhal mjal byin rlabs phyag chen gyi/ /gdam pa bka' gtad zab mo thob/ /nye ba'i mgon po sprin 'dzin gyis/ /thun mong dngos grub bzang po yi/ /rten 'brel dge ba dus der sgrigs/ /nyer gsum sne la mchog sprul rje/ /gter ston la li ta badz+ra/ /zhabs pad snyeg par 'dod na yang / /bsod nams chung ba'i dbang gi bshol/ /ci rong rol lam ri khrod du/ /phur pa'i bsnyen mtshams yod pa'i skabs/ /rmi lam snang bar rig 'dzin de/ /mjal zhing smon lam byin rlabs gnang / /de dus zhing gzhan gshegs tshod gda'/ /mchog de'i zhal skyil ma mjal bar/ /da lta shin tu 'gyod par yod/ /gnas der mdun rgyab thur mar sbyangs/ /de dus rtsol ba ma bshol na/ /srog thur 'dres la tshegs med byung / /'on kyang nyams rgyus chung bas bshol/ /dgon der chos khrid cung bshad pas/ /khong tshor phan tsam byung na yang / /dam tshig gnas min ci rigs pas/ /rang la grib ldang 'khu ldog byung / /de'i 'phror ting ri kro gom du/ /rgyal ba'i sras po'i zhabs drung du/ /zla shas sdod gsung bka' ltar byas/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dgung lo nyer gsum pa kun ldan te lcags byi lor smar khams dben rdzong zhes par/ sgrub brgyud karma kam tshang gi snyan brgyud 'dzin pa dpal zur mang pa zhes snyan pa'i ba dan g.yo ba gang gi bka' srol 'dzin pa'i khyu mchog 'phags pa'i yul du 'od gsal sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs pa glu mkhan rigs las grub brnyes dpal chen po sha wa ri pa dang bod yul du gnyags dri med zla shar gyi sku'i skye ba ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas tshogs chen gtso bo'i ngo bo che tshangs mchog gi sprul pa'i sku drug pa karma rig 'dzin gsung rab rgya mcho'i zhabs kyi pad+mo bsnyen phyir byon/ der snyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyang bzhugs pa mjal bar mdzad cing rang byung zhabs kyi phyag rdzogs don 'dus smon lam gyi lung gsan/ che tshangs pa'i drung du mjal ba'i 'dren pa'ang si tu pas mdzad pa 'byung 'gyur gyi rten 'brel bzang po'i legs byas thog mar sad/ che tshangs pa'i spyan sngar phyag chen gyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dang / mnyam med dwags po'i chos bzhi'i mdo dril phyag chen lnga ldan rgyas bsdus gnyis dang / khyad par du bde mchog snyan rgyud yid bzhin nor bu skor gsum las thugs gnad lugs yid bzhin nor bu'i cha phyag rgya chen po'i sngon 'gro thun mong bzhi sbyor thun min rkyen bzhi dang / khyad par gnad gsum gyi srang la 'grims te phyag rgya chen po snang sems stong pa zung 'jug rnam kun mchog ldan ye shes chen por thugs ngo sprad cing gegs sel bogs 'don lam khyer mthar rnal 36

'byor bzhi rim gyi ngo sprad gnad gdams zhal shes zab rgyas su rtsal ba gsan/ rje nyid kyi gsung las/rang gi yang rang rig gshis kyi ngo bo sngar dus su bying rmugs 'phro rgod kyis kyang cung zad gnod cing yin min gyi the tshom brang breng du yong ba de phyin re dogs the tshom rnam par dag ste sngar gyi nyams myong de 'phel 'grib cher mi 'gro bas brtan par gyur te/ dam pas kyang nyams rtogs zung 'jug gam zhi lhag zung 'jug tu ngo sprad de don la gong du rje btsun bde chen gling pas ngo sprad pa dang don mthun pa yin gsungs/ gzhan yang smin lam dbang gi skor yang / rol rdor gyi phyag rdor nas rdo rje 'chang gi dbang bzhi phyag bzhes zhib rgyas dang / phyag rdor gyi gtor dbang dregs pa'i srog dbang khyad par can/ ma cig grub rgyal gyi tshe dbang zab mo/ rol rdor gyi gter chos kun gyi sgrub thabs rab 'byams dril ba sogs gsan/ rig 'dzin rol pa'i rdo rje'i rigs kyi gcung zhal tshab rung nges pa rgyal sras sad na legs kyi sprul gar gnas mdo ba mkhas grub rā ga a su gang gi sku'i skye ba o rgyan mtshan can la'ang / gter gsar phyag rdor gtum po dregs pa kun 'dul gyi chos skor them can them med skor/ mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma'i sgrub skor yongs rdzogs gsan par mdzad do/ /slar rang gi bsti gnas ci rong ba thal dgon du bskyed pa na tshad rim mgo nad drag po zhig byung bas grwa rigs kha shas kyang grong / gzhan snang gi ngor rje nyid kyang sku shin tu snyel ba'i tshul bzhes pa thugs dam gyi klong du ro snyoms par mdzad/ skabs der phyogs der rgyu ba'i rgyal 'gong gdug pa can de bla ma rab byung chas ldan du brdzus byung ba la/ dpal chen po che mchog rdo rje gro lod kyi sku gzhengs pa'i nga rgyal brtan pos phyag mtshan gyi rdo rjes kho'i lus zang thal khrol tshags ltar ma gyur bar bsnun par mdzad pas phyag 'tshal zhing dam las mi 'da' bar khas blangs bro bor bar gyur/ de la bka' stsal pa/ bdag nad 'di las thar ram ci/ nad 'di bskyed par byed pa'i rgyu gang yin zhes gsungs pas/ kho na re/ gson dang rig 'dzin dam pa lags/ /nad 'di'i rgyu ni bsrung ma yi/ /'khu ldog dag dang khyad par du/ /grib can bud med phyag rgya ru/ /bsten pas mkha' 'gro ma dgyes nas/ /'byung bzhi 'khrugs pa'i nad du shar/ /da res 'chi rkyen mi yong ste/ /rim gror mkha' 'gro grib sel gces/ /zhes zer/ yang gsungs pa/ deng dus mi kha cig gis rgyal po pe har sangs rgyas tshar zer ba bden nam gsungs pas/ /chos 'khor rgyal po pe ha ra/ /da lta bsam yas sgyugs drung na/ /o rgyan yul la kha bsgyur te/ /'dug mod sangs rgyas ga la tshar/ /sum cu'i lo'am sum brgya'i mtshams/ /bsam yas me yi gshegs te 'gro/ /de nas pe har rgyal po de/ /o rgyan gtsug lag khang du 'gro/ /zhes zer/yang gsungs pa/ rgyal po
