pe har o rgyan chen po'i drung du dge bsnyen sgrub nas 'gro ba la 'tshe ba spang bar dam bcas pa dang / sa brgyad kyi byang chub sems dpa' yin par grags tshe sems can spyi dang chos 37

mdzad rnams la 'tshe ba'i don yod dam/ 'khor gdug pa can gyi 'tshe bar byed pa gtso bos shes sam zhes gsung pa'i lan du/ rgyal po 'khor 'das sa mtshams gnas/ /kho rang chos bzhin spyod pa la/ /gnod 'tshe chen po mi bskyal yang / /kho yi sems la ci 'gyu ba/ /phan gnod thams cad sprul pas 'grub/ /gtso bo'i thugs la gang dgongs de/ /'khor gyi thogs med brtson pa yin/ /des na phal cher kho yi shes/ /bdag ni rgyal phran tshul du ni/ /rgyal po chen po'i sprul pa yin/ /zhes zer ro/ /gzhan yang lkog 'gyur gyi gnad mang zhig zhus pa'i mthar phaṭaḥdrag po zhig gsungs pa'i mod shar phyogs su yal song gsungs/lung bstan 'di nyid byung nas lo grangs dgu bcu go bdun du slebs pa rab byung bcu bzhi pa 'dzin byed de me byi hor zla drug pa'i bden chos 'khor gyi dus chen la dpal gyi bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po dbu rtse rim gsum pho brang rten brten par bcas pa bsreg byed zhugs kyis lhag med du sbyangs par gyur pa ni mngon du gyur mod/ sum cu'i lo'am sum brgya'i mtshams/ zhes pa dgongs pa can dang phyed lor rtsis pa'i snga phyi'i dus mtshams zhig tu bstan pa yin nam zhes rje btsun 'brug pa rin po che phyag na pad+mo'i zhal las dngos su thos so/ /gzhan yang gsang rnam chung bar/ dus skabs de dag gi snga phyi ci rigs par/ mdo smad yul gyi gzhi bdag chen po sta ma'u so zhes o rgyan chen po'i zab gter nyi shu rtsa lnga'i lde mig gnyer gtad bka'i bsrung mar bskos pa gsang mtshan rdo rje 'gyur med rtsal zhes pa dang / ljang chu rgyud ste gnas rdzong gi gzhi bdag dge bsnyen dang / chos skyong gi 'gab 'dre byed pa'i rgyal po shel ging dkar po dang / me long dgon gyi dkor bdag dang / ba khrod kyi dkor bdag bdug pa can dang gzhan yang 'gong po spun dgu sogs dregs pa can du mas rang srog snying po mdong sol du phul zhing bka' 'bangs bgyid par rtsis la phab te dam la bzhag lo 'di nas bzung dgung lo bzhi bcu la nye ba'i bar chibs spang te zhabs thang kho nas byon par 'dug go/ /de dag la rnam thar snyim pa'i chu skyes su/ rang lo nyer gsum lon pa yi/ /ston dus rje btsun rdo rje 'chang / /dran mchog rtsa ba'i bla ma yi/ /gnyis pa che tshangs mchog sprul zhabs/ /bsten phyir smar khams dben rdzong phyin/ /phyag chen gdams pa zab khyad dang / /rdo rje 'chang gi smin byed nos/ /rdzogs chen gsang ba ye shes kyi/ /thod rgal don gyi ngo sprod thob/ /pha yi bu ltar brtse gzigs dang / /bka' drin shin tu che bas bskyangs/ /gzhan don gyis zhes dbugs dbyung mdzad/ /slar yang rang gnas yong ba'i mtshams/ /'byung khams 'khrugs pa'i nad kyis nyen/ /lam khyer rtogs pa'i bogs kyang thon/ /de skabs dregs pa 'ga' yis ni/ /srog gi snying po phul ba dang / /bde chen ri dbang pan rag gis/ /yul phyogs de yi gter ston rigs/ /'ga' la tshad ldan yin min gyis/ /lung bstan byas pa dag kyang mchis/ /bshad na khrom seb mdung bskor dgos/ /de 38

ltar dran bsam smin pa nas/ /rang lo nyer gsum 'khor kyis bar/ /chos kyi phyag rgya skad sa yi/ /lha sku bskyed rim sgyu ma ltar/ /rgyun du gsal ngar ma theb kyang / /wal wal rtag tu gang 'dris byas/ /dam tshig phyag rgya rtsa rlung yang / /rdor bzlas rlung sbyor bum pa can/ /gtum mo las dang ye shes kyi/ /rnal 'byor nar mar spyod pa dang / /bcu drug skabs nas bla ma rje'i/ /bka' bzhin lo dgu ras rkyang byas/ /las bzhi'i thig le'i rim pa yang / /bcu gcig skabs su thabs lam gyis/ /yig cha mthong bas mos gus skyes/ /gsang khrid chos zhor ma nos shing / /de nas bzung te nyer gsum bar/ /dam pa 'ga' la gsang khrid skor/legs zhus ye shes shes rab la/ /bsten nas dngas ma skyil bzlog bkram/ /rjes mthun bde stong zung 'jug gshis/ /grol lam snying po'i bogs 'don du/ /thabs lam rang lus byang byas shing / /phyi yi kun spyod mtshangs mtshungs las/ /gdams pa thob nas gom 'dris kyi/ /long med bud med hab thob dang / /'khrul 'khor kyag kyog sad sud rlung / /rdo rjes hur sgra sgrogs tsam la/ /kheng nas zab mo'i gdengs med paraske/ /bag med dbang gi gzhan lus la/ /ring bar rngams pa de ma byas/ /phyag chen gnas lugs gnyug ma'i dngos/ /khreg chod don gyi nyams len kyang / /bcu gcig skabs su zhi gnas skyes/ /bcu gsum lo la ngo sprod thob/ /zhi lhag phyogs re ma yin par/ zung 'jug nyid du skyes gyur kyang / /'on te brtson 'grus dman pa yi/ /gong du cung zad smos pa ltar/ /rtogs pa brtan po ma shar yang / /gegs sel dbang du ye ma gyur/ /'od gsal thod rgal snang bzhi la/ /skye sngon las dbang zhig gis ni/ /lo bzhi skabs nas mngon sum don/ /ngo 'phrod nyams len tshul mtshon shes/ /skyong khul byas pas snang mun du/ /rig pa ci bzhin 'char bar gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas dgung lo nyer bzhi pa 'phar ba te lcags glang lor ko'i sha'i tshal dang mtshungs pa brtse chen dgon du phebs/ bla med dam pa chos skyongs dpal ldan la sogs pa'i dam gtsang skal ldan gyi 'dus pa bdun bcu lhag tsam la bka' gsang rdzogs pa chen po'i zab khrid smin par stsal/ de dus nub gcig kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po klong chen rab 'byams dri med 'od zer dang mjal ba na/ gsol pa/ nyid kyi thugs gter snying thig zab cing rgya gang che ba zhig bdag la zhu zhes zhus pas—/ zhal nas/ thams cad chos kun gyi snying po bcud du bsdus pa yin pas zab gzhan med rung rang gi bka' bab lta bur gyur pas mkha' 'gro snying thig 'di legs pa yin/ zhes gsungs shing snying thig ya bzhi'i puste dbu gtsug tu bzhag nas bka' gtad smon lam gyi mthar khyod kyis rdzogs pa chen po'i chos kyi 'gro ba la phan par gyis shig /ces bka' stsal zhing / de dang mnyam du lus mi mngon pa'i rlung 'tshub kyi nang nas/ sngags kyi bsrung mas/ bu khyod kyis rdzogs chen ji ltar bar ston dang / 'phrin las ngas bsgrub so zhes gsung ba'i mod/ /rnal las sad do/ /de dag gi tshul rtogs brjod lam yig pad+ma'i 'phreng 39

ba las/ gsang las ches gsang yang gsang rdzogs pa che'i/ /khrid btab 'di bas sngon du kho bo yis/ /khrid bka' lan grangs 'ga' re byas na yang / /rten 'brel gnad kyi 'di dus gang 'dzoms pa'i/ /tshom bu de rnams dam sel ma byung na/ /nges par thar pa'i lam rkang tshugs sam sems/ /rang yang 'di skabs rmi lam snang ba ru/ /kun bzang bi ma'i rnam sprul kun mkhyen zhabs/ /mjal nas snying thig skor bzhi'i bka' gtad dang / /rdzogs chen gdam pa gzhan la ston rjes gnang / /sngags kyi ma mo'i bsrung skyobs ri zhal bzhes byung / /rang gi nyams len 'di dus sngar bas bogs/ /rab thon the tshom khu khrig dang bral te/ /rig pa rang ngor zang ka rjen pa mthong / /spyir ni kho bo rang lo nyi shu'i skabs/ /rtogs pa'i rang ngo mthong bar gyur na yang / /brtson pa dman pas ji bzhin rnal ma tshud/ /de skabs dge sbyor skyes pa de nas brtsamaske/ /tshe 'dir nyams len rkang tshugs rtsis su byas/ /dge sbyor gegs gyur tshor dang ma tshor gyi/ /dam tshig 'gal nyams gyur pa bshags pa'i phyir/ /sats+tsha 'dod gsol ldan pa grangs mang dang / khyad par rten gsum drung du dus chen por/ /phyag dang smre bshags phul zhing phyin chad du/ /sdom pa'i phyir du dam bca' bcu gsum ni/ /ji srid 'tsho yi bar du blang bar byas/ /zhes gsungs/ sngar me bya lo mi bsrun log smon can jun gar bas gsang chen snying po'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin bcas pa la mtho mtshams zhing rmeg med du byas pa'i dus kyi chad pa la brten o rgyan smin grol gling nas gter chen rig 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rje'i gdung sras bi ma la mi tra'i rnam sprul 'gyur med rin chen rnam rgyal sku mched rnams mdo khams phyogs su bskyod dgos byung ba 'di skabs rje 'dis kyang mjal bar mdzad cing / myang gter bka' brgyad bde 'dus kyi dbang bzhi zhib rgyas/ dregs pa'i mthu dbang dang bcas pa dang / lung kha 'thor/kun skyongs gling pa'i rdor sems snying thig gter gsar gshin rje dregs 'joms/ chos dbang gi thugs rje chen po yang snying 'dus pa'i dbang / gter gsar rdzogs chen a ti'i don dbang rnams gsan cing /de nyid kyi gcung 'gyur med pad+ma bzang po las/ smin gling chos spyod kyi lung / rdor sems thugs tig sogs gter gsar gyi lung kha yar/ khro rol gyi ljags sgrigs le'u tshan gnyis kyi lung bcas gsan/gzhan yang rig 'dzin bdud 'joms rdo rje'i rigs sras su gyur cing grub chen sna rnam ye shes kyi sprul gar pad+ma dbang rgyal lam/ 'gyur med gzhan phan lhun grub la tshe sgrub yang snying kun 'dus dbang dang /rin chen gling pa'i na ga rathi'i dbang lung tshang ma/ sgrol ma nyer gcig gi bstod pa dang / rnam sras phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang kyi rjes gnang / lokhri dang lha chen gyi rjes gnang / slob dpon chen pos lung bstan pa'i skyes bu kaḥthog drung pa nam mkha' rgya mtsho las ye shes rab 'bar tshe dbang 'chi med rnga sgra/gnub baṇa sangs rgyas ye shes kyi sprul par grags pa ye shes 'jig med la 'ja' mtshon pa'i dkon 40

mchog spyi 'dus/ dbang gi grub thob rgyal ba mchog dbyangs kyi sprul par grags pa dpa' bo gter ston pad+ma chos rje la/ nyang gter thugs rje chen po zhi drag 'gyur rtags kyi dbang lung rnams gsan no/ /'di yan spyir rtsa ba'i bla ma gnyis/ drin chen bla ma lnga/ chos 'brel thob pa bcu ste spyir sdom yongs 'dzin bla ma bcu bdun bsten par mdzad do/ /lo de'i mjug grub pa'i bsti gnas ci rong gser khrom zhes par gdan chags/ ma mgon lcam dral las byed pho nyar bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes/ zla gcig gi ring bsnyen sgrub mthar las la sbyar ba'i drag sngags rmod pa'i mtshon cha'i char chen pos rgyal bstan spyi dang khyad par gsang chen rdo rje snying po'i ring lugs la log par 'khu zhing sdang bar byed pa dang / khyad par bla ma'i sku dgrar gyur cing zhing bcu tshang ba mngon spyod drag po'i gdul byar gyur pa mtha' dag sbad gsad 'phang mnan bsreg pa'i sbyor bas ming dang rjes tsam med par thabs kyi sgrol ba'i cho gas byang sgrol gyi gnas la 'god par mdzad do/ /de dag gi tshul ni snyim pa'i chu skyes las/ rang lo nyer bzhi lon pa'i tshe/ /ko sha'i tshal mtshung brtse chen du/ /skal bzang slob ma bcu phrag bdun/ /lhag tsam dag la yang gsang che/ /rdo rje snying po'i rdzogs chen khrid/ /thod rgal ma gtogs thams cad la/ /nor 'khrul med par zhib bshad byas/ /de skabs rmi lam snang ba ru/ /sngon byon rdzogs chen bla rab 'ga'/ /zhal mjal gsung thos rjes gnang thob/ /de dang khyad par tshe 'di ru/ /rang skal babs pa rdo rje 'chang / /rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam gnyis kyis/ /byin rlabs mtshan ma bzang po ru/ /nyams len bogs kyang ci rigs thon/ /go dka' rdo rje'i tshig rnams yang / /sngar las cung zad blo rgyas te/ /rdzogs chen gnad gsang 'ga' yang khrol/ /gnas lugs gshis kyi ngo bo yi/ /phyogs cha de dus mngon gyur pas/ /bde sdug 'phel 'grib byung kyang rung / /kho rang gnyis min gcig tu 'dres/ /de dang lhag mthong ngo bo ni/ /tha snyad thob rung ma thob rung / /dus der dge sbyor rkang pa tshugs/ /lo de'i dbyar ngor rgyal na phyogs/ /phyin pas yul gyi bdud rtsi'i mthus/ /sngar las nyams myong rtsal kha rgyas/ /gang shar kho yi rol tsam mthong / /sbas yul gser khrom g.yang rar yang / /bsgrod pas pad+ma'i sku brnyan sogs/ /sngon med mang po ltas mor myong / /lo mjug bla ma dam pa yi/ /bsti gnas ci rong gser khrom zhol/ /bstan dang 'gro don lhag bsam gyis/ /lha sgom gyad stobs cung snyems pasarka/ /las byed ma mgon pho nya yi/ /dkyil 'khor zhal phyes zla gcig bar/ /bsnyen dang sgrub pa'i gzhung bzung nas/ /rgyal bstan spyi dang bye brag tu/ /gsang chen snying po'i ring lugs la/ /sdang bar byed pa'i dgra bo dang / /khyad par bla ma'i sku yi dgra/ /gzhan yang nyes med la 'tshe byed/ /mngon spyod gdul byar gyur pa 'ga'/ /dkar dmar nag por bris gyur bkod/ /spyir ni mi khri rta 'bum mtshon/ /bye brag ming gsal bdun bcu lhag /hom du sgrub nas sbad gsad kyi/ /las la sbyar bas rtags kyang rdzogs/ /khyad par 41

ye shes mgon po ni/ /rdo rje slob dpon skur sprul nas/ /dngos su byin rlabs chos bka' gtad/ /mgon por dam tshig bsre ba'i skabs/ /des 'dus grogs rnams 'jigs gzugs kyi/ /rengs la khad pa byung zer zhing / /bsgral dang me hom skabs su yang / /rang la mthong snang 'ga' byung zhing / /nyer dgur drag po'i zor 'phen byas/ /bsregs thal mdze thod dmar por bsgrub/ /gting ring gshin rje'i dong du 'phang / /hom sbyor gzas po ming gsal rnams/ /lo gsum khong du phal che ba/ /lho phyogs grong khyer nyams dgar deng / /dregs gyur mi kun dpa' yang 'khum/ /de ltar las sbyar gzas po la/ /chos khrims gshig cing phyag rdzas dkor/ /brung jag rgyugs pa'i ser gzugs gcig /ma gtogs bstan dang bla ma yi/ /sku dgrar gyur pa 'ba' zhig las/ /rang gi dgra ni gcig kyang med/ /'dir snang zhen dbang drag sngags kyis/ /sbyor bas thar med ngan song gi/ /gting rdo byed mkhan ma yin gyi/ /rgyal ba'i bstan dang bla ma mchog /gnyan phyir mngon spyod drag po las/ /rang 'dod gsal ba ye med par/ /drag sngags sgrub pa'i sngags 'chang yin/ /phyogs zhen nye ring gnyen don dang / /rang 'dod zhen pas sgrub ma myong / /'on te rtag 'khon zhe gnag 'ga'/ /las la sbyor ba ma byas kyang / /bsrung mas bka' chad 'beb par snang / /rngam rngam rtsig rtsig drag sngags la/ /nus pa che che po min yang / /dam tshig dbang gi bsrung ma rnams/ /las la cung zad 'khol te mchis/ /zhes gsungs/ dgung lo nyer lnga pa dge byed ces pa chu stag lor/ gu ru'i gnas chen rdzong 'bur mor byon te bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo dmar mo'i bsnyen sgrub gzhung bzhin gnang ba'i tshe dag pa'i gzigs ngor rgyal yum badz+ra wa ra hi'i zhal bzang bstan cing dngos grub kyi mtshan ma bzang po brnyes/ de nas kaḥthog rdo rje gdan du byon/ rgyal sras chen po bsod nams lde'u btsan gyi zhabs drung du zab chos ci rigs pa gsan cing / rje 'di la thugs dam rtag pa tshe tshad dgos zhes pa mnal lam du mi gcig gi dngul srang gcig la gzhal nas/ zhal la ltas te khyod kyi dngul srang gi srang du yod mnyam na/ srang lnga bcur ma zin tsam du 'dug zer ba'i mthar sad do/ /de'i tshul zhus pas/ nyid la rdor legs kyi zhus pa dang mtshungs 'dug gsung / yang rje de yi phyag tu spu bo nas sprul sku 'phrin las rdo rje dang / rtsa gsum gling par grags pa'i gter chos zung phyag tu phul 'dug pa de yi rten 'brel shar tshul dang rtag pa mdzad dgos tshul phebs par de'i rgyu mtshan re zhig ma bris zhes gsung ba sprul sku 'phrin las rdo rje de ni rig 'dzin bdud 'dul rdo rje dang / rakhri gter ston pad+ma rig 'dzin gnyis su med pa'i sprul gar zab gter la dbang ba zhig ste de nyid la rjes su brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs kyang mdzad 'dug de'i tshe dam pa 'di nyid seng ge'i khri chen por bzhugs su gsol zhing rdo rje slob dpon du mnga' gsol ba'i rgyal thabs spyi blugs kyi dbang bskur/ shis brjod me tog gi phreng ba 42

char du brnyil/ phyir phebs dus rgyal sras rje spyan chab gsil zhing thugs shin tu phreng ba'i tshul dang dam pa nyid kyi phyag nas bzung te kaḥthog gi bstan pa la gzigs shig pa'i phyi mtha' gzigs pa'i gsung mang du rtsal bar phyi phyag mdzad/ de yar rgyud bse dgon du phebs so/ /dgung lo nyer drug pa mdzes byed de chu mo yos lor/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dpal pad+ma bde chen gling pa de nyid kyi sku gdung rin po che snga sor mchod rten gyi nang du bzhugs pa zhugs la zhen par bzhed pa'i rdo rje slob dpon pad+ma dbang gi rgyal pos mdzad cing / rten 'brel sgrig 'os kyi khyad par 'ga' zhig gis rje 'di nyid kyis rgyal thebs mdzad pa'i tshe thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i rtags bsam gyi mi khyab pas der 'dus pa thams cad dad pa'i sa la bkod par gyur/ mi ring bar kaḥthog rdo rje gdan gyi chos kyi rgyal ba'i sras po bsod nams lde'u btsan kyang dag zhing du gshegs pa na dgongs pa bskongs ba'i thabs tshul thugs dam gsal 'debs dang sprul sku 'byung 'gyur gyi smon lam kyang rtsal/ de skabs mtshan lam du/ kaḥthog lta bu zhig tu/ rgyal ba'i sras po chen po de nyid nyi ma nub stod phyogs su gshegs rtsis mdzad cing rje 'di nyid la sa lam gyi gegs sel gsal 'debs mdzad dgos zhes gsung ba zhig byung zhing / de rjes nub gcig rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras po de nyid shwa sha'i dgon rnying zhig tu jo sras su 'khrungs pa gzigs/ de nas drag po e klong zhes pa'i bste gnas su drag sngags sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor ting nge 'dzin la gzhol ba'i tshe phyi nang gi rtags ya mtshan can du ma dang bcas spyi dang bye brag gi mtha' yi dmag tshogs re shig phyir bsring ba'i gsal snang mngon du gyur/ lo de'i mjug bod yul dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing chos kyi 'byung gnas chen por 'byon par bzhed de rig 'dzin gong pa pad+ma ma ṇi'i rigs dbon chos kyi sras gyur gdan sa ba chen po grub pa'i dbang phyug smṛ ti ga ga'i sprul pa'i 'od zer stag ras pa bskal bzang o rgyan bstan 'dzin gyi spyan sngar bskyod/ phyogs med yangs pa'i gnas rnams su bgrod par bzhed pa'i dgongs khrol zhu ba dang bshol 'debs kyi zhu lan mang du mdzad pa'i mthar bkas khrol zhing / dam pa de la 'ja' mtshon snying po'i gter byon yang zab gu ru zhi ba'i dbang bskur gsan pa'i skabs dag pa'i gzigs snang du bla ma'i dbu'i thad kyi bar snang la sprin dkar 'ja' tshon me tog gi dra ba'i dbus su pad+ma dkar po'i 'dab ma rgyas pa'i sbubs su rig 'dzin klong gsal snying po yin nam dgongs pa'i sngags 'chang mnyam bzhag la thod gsol ba zhig bzhugs pa'i mthar dhak+ki mang po'i mchod pa'i tshogs du mas mchod par gzigs pas mos gus cher g.yos pa'i mthar bla ma nyid la thim pa gzigs/ bdud 'dul zhabs kyi gsang bdag gi dbang / tshe sgrub rgyal ba 'dus pa'i dbang lung / bdud 'dul ba'i sprul sku snying thig gi bka' bsrung bdud mgon skor/ bla ma dgongs pa yongs 'dus/ zhig po gling pa'i gter 43

chos zab pa bskor bdun sogs dang / rtse le sprul sku mkhas mchog pad+ma legs grub kyi bka' 'bum/mkhas grub karma chags med kyi ri chos sogs mang du gsan no/ /de nas bla ma dam pa der phyi phyag thugs smon bzang po mdzad cing gzhis bzhugs bla sprul dbon po grwa slob sbyin bdag spyi dgos rnams la phral yun du phan pa'i brtse ba chen po'i zhal gyi gdam pa bdud rtsi lta bus re ba yid bzhin du bskong bar mdzad de re khe ljongs rgyud rim pas go 'jor phebs/ gter chen gar dbang 'gyur med rdo rje'am gter bdag gling pa'i thugs sras dam par gyur pa 'o bran dpal gyi dbang phyug gi sprul par grags pa bla ma dam pa o rgyan rnam grol bzang po'i drung du/ bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi dbang lung / zhi khro bka' ma na rag dong sprug gi dbang / zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol gyi dbang yongs rdzogs/ las 'brel rtsal gyi rdzogs chen mkha' 'gro snying thig gi dbang lung khrid kha tshang ba dang gsang mtshan chos dbyings rang grol du gsol/ma ning srog dbang gter kha bzhi ldan/ sbyor drug khrid gdan thog gcig ma sogs gsan no/ de nas dgung lo nyer bdun pa khro mo te shing 'brug lor smar khams bdud rtsi mthil du phebs/ rtsa ba'i bla ma gnyis pa che tshang pa karma rig 'dzin gsung rab rgya mtsho'i spyan sngar gter ston chen po rig 'dzin rol pa'i rdo rje snying po'i zab gter rgyud gsang ba ye shes snying po'i steng nas gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi ngo sprod zhib rgyas/ yang rlung sems sgra gsum la rten nas sangs rgyas pa'i man ngag 'pho ba bde mchog snyan rgyud dwags lugs pod chung ngag 'don bcas dang brda' bzhi'i dbang / khro rol phur bu bsrung ma bka' rgya can/ bka' phyag chu bo gnyis 'dres kyi khrid lan grangs mang po/ gter chen rat+na gling pa'i zab gter chos skor yongs rdzogs sogs zab rgyas kyi smin grol gdam pa mtha' yas pa zhig gsan/ tshangs par spyod pa'i dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa nos par mdzad pa'i tshe/ karma bstan pa mtha' rgyas su mtshan gsol/ mdor na thugs sras kyi thu bo mchog tu dbang bskur zhing / rje de'i bka' las/ da ni sngon sbyangs dang shes rab la ltos na nyams len 'di tsam nas rang skya 'phel ba'i ri khrod bzung ba dang / gzhan la yang gdam khrid kyi gang phan 'gro don skyongs shig ces rjes su gdam ste don rgyud kyi bstan pa gtad/ zhabs dbang rtsal zhing dbugs dbyung gzeng bstod mnga' gsol shis brjod rgya cher mdzad do/ /der yang o rgyan lhun grub mtshan can las/ klong gsal snying thig ma gtogs rat+na gling pa'i gter chos tshang ma dang gzhan yang 'ga' zhig tshur gsan/ phar la rdzogs chen mkha' 'gro snying thig gi dbang lung smin khrid cha tshang bar rtsal ba la nye dge bar byung ste/ lam yig las/ rgyal khams 'grim pa'i slob ma'i thog ma ru/ /dam pa de gyur rten 'brel legs par go/ /zhes gsungs/ de nas ke rong gnas chen rdo rje lcong phug zhes rig 'dzin rol pa'i rdo rjes zab gter bzhes pa'i gter gnas de nyid mjal bar byon/ 'di dus mi 'gyur 44

rdo rje'i sprul sku 'chi med nus ldan kyang mjal/ rim pas karma rin chen dgon brgyud ri bo cher phebs/der stag lung ma thang pa'i gdung rgyud rdzogs pa'i mtha' ma bkra shis rnam par rgyal spyan sngar/ rje nyid kyi sku'i skye 'phreng du bzhugs pa sangs rgyas dbon gyi zab gter gu ru rin po cher ke'u ri ma brgyad kyis bskor ba'i bla sgrub kyi man ngag dang pad+ma gling pa'i drag po'i gtor dbang gsan/ chos sde'i mkhan po ngag dbang grags pa bstan 'phel gyi gus par btud pa'i chos 'brel kha shas zhus/ 'di skabs mtshan lam du dpal stag lung thang pa'i bstan bsrung chen po jo bo sprag btsan nam dge bsnyen rdo rje 'bar ba de nyid kyi rang gzugs dngos su bstan nas gzhon pa las bab te zhabs la phyag byas shing dga' dang gus pa'i tshul byed pa zhig byung / de dang mthun par mkhan chen des bskul ba bzhin sprag gtsan gyi gsol mchod 'dod don yid bzhin ljon pa zhes bka' rtsom kyang gnang ngo / /de nas rim gyi spar gyi glang ma lung zhes pa gu ru'i gnas chen dang spo bor dong chu'i gtsug lag khang mjal bar thegs/ spu bo stod du rig 'dzin nus ldan bdud 'dul rdo rje'i gdung brgyud nyang ban gyi rol gar rig 'dzin rnam rgyal gyi drung du bdud 'dul ba'i rang gter dbang lung gdam pa ji snyed cig gsan/ de skabs spu bo ye gong gi sar phebs pa na yul de'i sde phan tshun nang 'khrugs shing / chu chen dang la chen rnams kha bas bsdam pas re zhig lcags ra brgyud gnas chen kung lung gi bar gyi sgo dam can skyes bu chen po badz+ra thig le rtsal gyi pho brang dang nye ba'i 'dabs dpal o rgyan chen po'i sgrub phug dom rdzong zhes pa'i bya skyibs su zhabs ring sogs kyang med par gcig pur bzhugs shing 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i bsnyen sgrub dus grangs kyi nges pa gzhung bzhin mdzad pas rtags dang rten 'brel gyi gnad du ma zhig kyang 'grig par gyur/ de yang rje 'di nyid mdo khams su bzhugs skabs snga phyi nges med kyi skabs de dag tu bod yul dbus 'gyur sa yi lte ba lha ldan rdo rje gdan gyi rgyal khab su sa skyong rim par 'pho len dbyar gyi chu log lta bu'i dus 'gyur mang zhing / bstan 'dzin gyi skyes mchog 'ga' zhig dag zhing du gshegs pa dang /khyad par gsang chen rdo rje snying po'i bstan pa'i sgron me gu ru o rgyan chen po'i lung gis zin nges pa'i skyes chen smin gling nas g.yu sgra'i rnam sprul mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa dharma shrī khu dbon gsum/ rdo rje brag sna nam rdo rje zlos gar rig 'dzin pad+ma 'phrin las sogs grags pa dang lkog gyur du ma zhig ni sdig to can mong gol jun gar bas sku la dngos su bsdos pa'i tshul rna thos tsam gyi yang bzod par dka' ba dang zab gter gyi bdag por gyur pa rtsod bral gyi rig pa 'dzin pa brgyad tsam dag zhing du gshegs ste/ stag bsham pa nus ldan bsam gtan rdo rje/ yong dge gnam chos mi 'gyur rdo rje/ pad+ma bde chen gling pa/ o rgyan gter bdag gling pa/ rig 'dzin rol pa'i rdo rje/ chos rje gling pa/ bde ba'i rdo rje 45

sogs phal cher sku tshe'i tshad du yang ma bzhugs par cung zad lo dang zla ba kha shas kyi bar du tho rong gi skar tshogs ltar zhi ba'i dbyings su gshegs pa ni snyigs dus kyi gdul bya'i legs byas kyi skal bas 'phong pa kho nar zad cing rje 'di nyid kyang nges 'byung skyo shas kyi gdung ba'i tshul lhag par bzhes pa'i mgur yang mang du mdzad/ de nas dpon slob rnams spu bo dang kong po'i sa mtshams gnas chen brag gad pad+ma shel phug mjal bar byon nas slar yang sman chu mchog gi sprul pa'i skus gsol ba btab pa ltar sman dgon du phebs/ der dad ldan gyi gdul bya ser skya stong phrag lhag 'dus par bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dbang lung sogs gang la gang mtshams kyi smin grol bdud rtsi'i char phab cing /ri rgya klung rgya rtag 'jags srog chags kun la mi 'jigs pa'i skyabs kyi sbyin pa dang / mthong thos dran reg gi lus can thams cad phral yun phan dang bde ba'i ngal gsor 'god pa'i 'phrin las rgya cher spel bar mdzad do/ /gzhan yang zang yul zhes pa la sogs pa'i yul gru so sor yang byon te so so'i re ba bskang nas slar yang sbas pa'i yul brag gad ljongs nyid du phebs/ gsang ba chen po sbas pa'i gnas chen de nyid kyi tshul ni gang gi rdo rje'i mgur las/ gnas ya mtshan dpal gyi ljongs phur phyin/ /rtags thun mong thun min mang po mthong / /ri dbyibs ni lag sor bkram pa 'dra/ /mtsho rigs lnga tshom bu bkod pa 'dra/ /gnas srung ma bdud btsan klu gsum dang / /sman jo mo gzi 'od 'bar mar grags/ /mthu che zhing gnyan la phrag dog dam/ /dpal o rgyan sgrub phug chen po lnga/ /sgrub chung ngu brgyad dang bya skyibs tshul/ /bcu drug dang sum cu so gnyis lhag /lte sa mig mkha' 'gro 'bum 'dus gur/ /dbyibs zlum po thog tshad lnga lhag tsam/ /lha theg pa rim dgu zhal gzigs spras/ /mthong thos dran bde chen mchog la sbyor/ /mdun mtsho chung chu mig g.yu yi mdog /khar btung tshad tshe rabs sdig mang dag /de byang shar mtsho chung zur gsum logs/ /dmar gtor ma lta bu dkyug dang ldan/ /de bsrung ma gza' yi pho brang yin//spyir mkha' 'gro 'bum 'dus pho brang 'di/ /phyag bskor ba bdun brgya sus nus na/ /yig drug ma dung phyur gcig dang mnyam/ /dung thon nas lhag med mi 'gyur ste/ /skyes thog re ngan song yod re kan/ /de mdun ngos rdo ba gru bzhi'i steng / /bdud ma ṭam bsgral ba'i bam rjes yod/ /rdo de steng phung po mchod sbyin re/ /sus byas na rkyen ngan bar chad grol/ /lho brag logs yi ge trīḥwaṃ mtshan/ /'gyur med pa gter gyi sa rtags yin/ /nub pad 'byung gtso 'khor zhal gzugs yod/ /byang 'jam dpal gshin rje'i dkyil 'khor yod/ /dbus yang dag phur pa'i pho brang mchis/ /rdo dpa' bo zhes su grags pa 'di/ /phyag bskor ba byas pa'i phan yon ni/ /khong gong ma gter grub gsung dang mtshungs/ /mi ngas ni dam can bla rdor mthong //de la sogs ngo mtshar mang na yang / /skabs deng dus ma babs rjes sor bshad/ /dus deng nas 46

lnga phrag lnga lo'am/ /yul 'di ru sngon med rkang gnyis gzugs/ /chas ya ma zung can 'char ba'i dus/ /dpal o rgyan sprul pa zhig byon nas/ /gnas zhal phye zab gter 'don kyang srid/ /gzhan mi ring nye bar mkha' 'gro yi/ /lung bstan thob gang zag skyes bu yi/ /gnas zhal bstan yong las che/ /tshig 'di dag 'ud zob ma yin te/ /nyams rmi lam snang bar mthong ltar smras/ /zhes gsungs/ dgung lo nyer brgyad pa sna tshogs dbyig ces pa shing sbrul lor/ gnas de'i rgyangs phug gangs rar gsang spyod mdzad skabs rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs du ma zhig gi gzigs snang dang byin rlabs dngos grub kyi mtshan ma brnyes shing /gcod yul snying po'i rnal 'byor gsang gtor phung po'i tshogs 'khor ye shes mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag man ngag shugs 'byung rdo rje'i glu mi 'jigs he ru ka'i gad mo zhes pa'i dgongs gter khyad 'phags 'di nyid kyang skabs der dag snang du byung bar mngon/ khyad par sa ga zla ba'i dus chen la gzigs snang byung tshul rje nyid kyi gsung las/ bla ma sku gsum gyi byin rlabs ni kho bo dus snyigs ma'i zog po tshe dbang nor bu bdag shing sbrul byang chub chen po dus chen la gter ston rat+na ba'i thugs sgrub yid bzhin nor bu'i bsten pa bskyal skabasatshes bcu gsum gyi tho rengs skabs su gu ru pad+ma brtul zhugs spyod pa'i tshul can gyi rjes su bzung ba'i snang ba shar bzhin lags/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de'i dbyar ngor gnas chen spu bo'i sa gnad che bar bla ma mkha' 'gro'i lung dang / gnas bdag dkar phyogs yul gzhis mi ma yin dag gi bskul zhing phyogs de'i ser skya dad ldan dag gis gsol ba btab pa'i rkyen dang bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i rtsas kho nar dgongs gnas de'i yas man gnyis su gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa bkod pas 'phags pa gzhengs bar mdzad cing bcom ldan 'das rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa sogs cho ga gsar 'dzugs gnang skabs nag phyogs kyi 'dre srin mi ma yin dag gi cho 'phrul du ma byung yang zil gyi gnan cing gnas yul snod bcud mtha' dag dge mtshan dang ldan par byin gyis brlabs so/ /de skabs zhig thugs dam bar ma'i rnal 'byor rgyun gcod dge ba'i lam rim thar ba'i 'jug ngogs sogs gsungs/ yul de'i ser skya dad ldan gyi 'du ba dbyar gyi sprin lta bu thib par byung ba kun la/ tshe dbang bde can zhing mchog gi dbang / sems bskyed/ yig brgya/ yig drug badz+ra gu ru/ gsol 'debs le'u bdun pa'i lung la sogs pa so so'i re 'dod bzhin dang / ri rgya klung / rgya'i dam bca' khas len gna' gan bzhes shing yul bdag la bka' bsgo gnyer gtad pa yang mdzad de glang phu zhes pa'i gnas chen du bskyod/ gnas 'di yang sbas yul mchog tu gyur pa ngo mtshar ba'i bkod pa du mas brgyan pa zhig ste der bzhugs skabs theg pa chen po'i smon lam yid bzhin nor bu zhes pa bka' brtsom gnang / kong po brag gsum le ri dgon nas sprul sku 'phrin las yongs grags 47

yang srid yab sras byon par 'dod chos smin grol gyi bka' drin rtsal/ de dus kong yul dang thag nye gshis phebs bzhed pa byung bar rtsa ba gsum la gsol ba btab/ rtag pa gnang bas mtshan snang du gzhan mang zhig dang khyad par mdo don gyi rtags su sngags 'chang lang 'tsho dar la bab pa zhig gis me yi sa bon gzhal byar gzhal bas skar chen phyogs la nam mkha'i brgyan pa zhig tu gyur pa rje nyid kyi phyag tu phul zhing tshig gi brjod pa dang bcas nges pa'i rnam grangs de nyid la ma son bar du dus la ma babs par dgongs phebs 'dun bshol bar mdzad do/ /de dag la snyim pa'i chu skyes su/ khro mo shing 'brug dbyar ra ba/ /rtsi bcud rgyas pa'i dus skabs su/ /bla ma'i bste gnas nas thegs te/ /mdo khams gnas mchog ke rong nas/ /rim par karma rin chen brgyud/ /spar gnas mjal nas spu bor phyin/ /rig 'dzin chen po nus ldan pa'i/ /gdung brgyud sku mched zhabs pad brten/ /byin rlabs dbang bzhi'i bdag blo simaske/ /lo de'i mjug la ye gong sleb/ /stong phrag lhag gi tshogs pa la/ /bka' brgyad la sogs zhi bka' bskurane/ /ri rgya klung rgya la sogs pa/ /srog 'don dge ba legs tshogs sgrub/ /sna chogi/ sa dbyig zhes shing sbrul lo/ /sne zin skabs nas brag skas ljongs/ /rgyang phu gangs rar gnas 'brel byas/ /de skabs 'dre dmag snying rlung sogs/ /cho 'phrul mang shar ye shes kyi/ /mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs ltas kyang byung / /dbyar ngor dgon pa yas man gyi/ /lha khang nang rten bzhengs byas shing / /khrid bshad kun kyang legs lam bkod / /ri rgyal rtag 'jags 'ga' yang byung / /'gro phan sgrub pa'i cha shas gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ de nas brag la la nas/ byang kong dang / 'ol kha brgyud ngam shod gdan sa thel kun tu bzang po'i nags khrod du 'phebasaske/ 'gro mgon rin po che dpal phag mo grub pa'i snang snyan 'jag spyil sogs gnas rten rnams zhib mjal mdzad/ rtse thang du thub pa gser gling ma sogs dang / dbu ru khra 'brug byams pa mi 'gyur gling gtsug lag khang dang btsan thang / tshe chu 'bum pa/ yar lung shel gyi brag phug rnams mjal khra 'brug tu gnyags rigs rnal 'byor ma ye shes gsal sgron gyi gsol ba btab pa'i ngor rdo rje sems dpa' phyi nang gsang yang kho na nyid kyi rnal 'byor zab gsal snying gi thig le zhes pa bka' brtsom gnang glu/ bod yul gyi rdo rje gdan gnyis pa shar phyogs tsi na'i skad du zan yang dang / bod du zab yang dpal gyi bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po dbu rtse rim gsum/ gling bzhi gling phran brgyad sogs rten dang brten par bcas pa mjal bar mdzad cing kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin la 'gran bzod pa'i mchod cing theg pa chen po'i thugs bskyed smon lam rgya cher skrun/ shar sgo 'jam dpal gling du bzhugs skabs gnyag rigs rnal 'byor ma ye shes gsal sgron gyi zhus ngor nyams len snying po'i gdam pa snying khrag dngas ma'i sheg ril mgul khug ma zhes pa rtsal/ gzhan yang / mchims 48

phu sogs yan lag gi gnas rten rnams mjal bar thegs shing rgod dkar la rgyud dbus 'gyur pa'i lte ba lha ldan rdo rje gdan du jo shāka rnam gnyis/ 'phags pa bcu gcig zhal rang byon lnga ldan sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rten khyad par 'phags pa rnams la mchod 'bul smon lam rgya cher mdzad de dbu ru stod lung tshur mdo bo yi garjo la chen por phebs/ ma byon sangs rgyas drug pa'i ngo bo gru 'dzin bdag po 'jig rten mgon po'i rol gar dpal karma pa chen po mi bskyod rgyal ba'i cod pan can bcu gnyis pa'i phreng ba 'dzin pa byang chub rdo rje'i zhabs dang / gar gyi dbang phyug 'od mtshan rgyal ba'i cod paṇa can brgyad pa'i phreng ba 'dzin pa dpal chos kyi don grub ste yab sras lhan du mjal zhing so so nas phyag chen sogs bka' 'grel gyi bdud rtsi 'ga' zhig kyang gsan/ mi ring bar dmar nag cod pan 'chang ba yab sras gnyis ka rgya nag bkra shis khri sgor chab gcig tu gshegs par snang ngo / /dgung lo nyer dgu pa zil gnon te me rta lo yul gtsang gi cha shas stag sna chos kyi pho brang du mkhan chen bo rnyi sa twa zhi ba mtsho'i sprul pa'i rnam rol mngal spang mchog gi sprul sku tre bo bzhi pa byang chub chos kyi dbang po'i drung du byon/ phyag rgya chen po dang bka' gsang rdzogs pa chen po 'ja' lus srog sgrub kyi dbang khrid / kun bzang dgongs pa 'dus pa'i thod rgal don gyi ngo sprod gsang chen snying ma rgyud 'bum gyi dbu mtha' bar gsum gyi lung dang bka' gtad sogs dbang khrid man ngag mang du gsan/ de dus gsung gleng zhig gi rkyen las tre bo rin po che'i rdo rje'i tshig cung zad cig la rten sngar thugs dam lta ba'i phra ba'i gnad la dpyad pa phra mo zhig yod pa de ston sprin ltar dngas nas rtogs pa'i ngo bo sngar gyi de la nyams kyi cha nas brgya 'gyur du 'phel zhing lam gang shar la spang blang med zer ba de tshig tu ma lus pa don thog tu phebs pas bka' drin shin tu che ba'i rtsa ba'i bla ma gsum pa yin gsung/ gzhan yang dpal jo nang pa'i lta grub la bsngags pa'i tshul gsung ba'i sad byed kyi rkyen gyis sngon gnas rjes su dran pa'i jo lugs la dngas ba bla lhag tu 'khrungs/ skabs zhig zhabs ring grwa pa zhig la thugs lhag par 'khrugs pa'i rkyen byas/ de rjes thugs dam mnyam rjes dbyer med du 'dres pa'i bogs cher thon pa byung zhes gsungs/ tre bo pas gsung gis bskul ngor gsang chen sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi byung khungs lo rgyus legs bshad bum bzang zhes pa bka' rtsom dang brtan bzhugs kyi gsol 'debs mdzad/ thugs yid chig 'dres su gyur cing dam pa 'di la shis brjod mnga' gsol kyang mdzad do/ /gu ru'i sgrub gnas dpal gyi zab bu lung du byon/ rtsa ba gsum dang khyad par dz+nyā na ḍāk+ki ni'i bsnyen pa gzhung bzhin thugs nyams su bstar/ der 'dus pa'i skal ldan gyi tshogs ji snyed par zab gsang snying gi thig le'i smin grol rgyab rten dang bcas pa rdzogs pa dang /sangs rgyas gling pa'i bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i dbang chen rtsa ba'i tshe dregs pa'i srog dbang gi skabs 49

gter bsrung dngos su gzugs can gyi khog par rlam pa'i gus pas zhabs kyi pad+mor 'dud phyag dang dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur ci yang ston par gyur/ zab phu'i gnas kyi yan lag rje rang byung pas gnas sgo dbye bar mdzad pa'i ya mtshan khyad 'phags can sog po 'dzul khung du grags par byon/ de nas rta nag gi phu bod skyongs bstan ma chen mo sman btsun ug chos rdo rje g.yar mo bsil gnas pa'i 'dabs tsha lung dgon gyi bla ma rgya ston ngag dbang rdo rje las dpal shang pa bka' brgyud pa chen po'i zab mo'i man ngag gi mchog gyur zab lam rna gu chos drug rdo rje'i tshig rkang dang bcas pa gsan/ jo nang rang lugs kyi nai gu chos drug gi dbang lung khrid gsum ni bla ma mgon po dpal zhes pa zhig las gsan par snang /'di skabs mtshan ltas ngo mtshar ba byung zhing lam 'di'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyang mdzad/ sngon jo nang rje btsun dam pa tā ra nā thas gnas gzhi btab par rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal zhes su btags pa phyis grub mtha' bsgyur ba'i deng sang dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du grags pa dang / gangs ri'i khrod kyi sham+bha la jo nang dpal gyi ri khrod bcas mjal bar bskyod nas lha rtse byang rgyud ru lag 'bras sprungs dgon dang sang dgon pa'i ming dang chos brgyud bcas bsgyur ba'i dga' ldan mkha' spyod du grags pa der zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi ring lugs dri med 'dzin cing nges pa don gyi grub pa'i dbang phyug chen por bzhugs pa chos rje kun bzang dbang po'irtsodrung du jo lugs kyi skor gsan par byon/ zhag gsum gyi bar du bzhugs kyang zhal mjal tsam ma byung ba bla ma'i mdzad spyod chos brgyad med pa'i rnam thar la gus pa khrungs shing nye bar gnas pa'i 'khor rnams kyi brtul zhugs la thugs cung zad khrel bar snang / rim par la stod lho ding ri dang / gnya' nang brgyud ne pā la'i yul du bskyod/ rang byung gi mchod rten chen po shing kun la mchod 'bul spros skabs bshags pa mdor bsdus nyes pa kun byang 'khrus kyi rdzing bu zhes pa'ang mdzad/ bya rung kha shor/ gu ru'i gnas chen yang le shod sogs gnas rten mtha' dag mjal skor dang mchod 'bul smon lam rgya cher skyangs so/ /dgung lo sum cu sa spre'u ste me lug lo rgyal ba thub pa'i dbang pos 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud nas lung3 bstan pa'i bal bod kyi mtshams mang yul skyid grong du phebs/ 'phags mchog lag na pad+mor ha ri tsan+dan las rang byung ba'i gzugs kyi sku mched lnga las thu bor gyur pa wa ti bzang po mjal zhing / mdo phal po che nas lung bstan pa dang gu ru chen po pad+ma'i gnas chen ri rgyal dpal 'bar gyi ngogs su byon te klu mo sgang gi rgyab ngogs brag phug zhig tu bzhugs par kaḥthog bdud rtsi'i phug tu grags/ der las zab mo bla ma sgrub pa'i dbang gsum pa'i bsnyen sgrub nyams bzhes gnang / gnas bdag zhing skyongs chen mo rgya gar lha mo las kyi phyag rgyar bzhes/ kun tu ru gu t+ya ga ṇa tsakra ma hā su kha su dzas dges pa bskyed cing thugs dam bogs 50

'don gong 'phel du gyur/ de skabs dad 'dun gyi zhabs tog mthun rkyen sbyor ba pa ni khyim bdag tshe ring don ldan zhes pa'i las skal smon lam dag pa des gus pas sgrub/ la ldebs su gnas skor la byon pa'i zhar grwa bla brang du 'jam gling pa rje blo gros chos 'phel las rta mgrin yang gsang gi dbang lung /skyes mchog 'ba' ra rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos shang 'ba' ra brag gi gnas su zab gter du sbas pa phyis rje ma tis mtshan can 'di nyid la lung bstan dus bab kyi gter nas spyan drangs pa'i bla ma phyi nang gsang gsum phyag chen chos drug bsdus pa'i yang snying stod 'brug 'bar lugs gsang khrid skor/ dril bu rim lnga'i byin rlabs sogs gdam pa'i bdud rtsi mang du gsan/ de skabs rje 'di'i mtshan lam du rje ma ti nyid rgya gar 'phags yul gyi slob dpon chen po kam+bha la chung ba'am/ la ba ti pa'i sprul pa yin zhes mkha' 'gros lung gis bstan pa bzhin thugs shin tu bcugs pa zhig byung ba ni gsang rnam su gsung pa'i in+d+ra bhu ti chung ba'i slob ma kam+bha la zhes mkha' 'gro ma rna gu'i bla mar gyur pa des rjes su bzung ba'i sngon gnas rjes su sad par nges/ ma ti'i sras rje 'ba' ra ba ngag dbang ye shes las kyang yang dgon pa'i ri chos skor tshang ba dang mi g.yo ba dkar po'i sgrub thabs kyi lung sogs 'ga' zhig gsan nas ma lde'i yul gyi phu gangs zhur mor phebs mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bskangs brgya rtsa gnang ba'i dam pa rin po cher thub pa'i dbang pos lung bstan pa'i rdo a ru ra zhes gu ru'i gter gnas khyad par can du gyur pa de dang / dam pa'i sgrub phug dkar zhes pa dang / rje karma pa rang byung rdo rje'i 'khrungs gnas/srid pa'i lha chen dge bsnyen gle ru gnas pa'i gangs dkar rgyal mtshan 'phyar 'dra'i mdun snga thang spang mo che zhes chu mig brgya rtsar grags pa rnams mjal bar phebs shing chu mig brgya rtsar dad ldan gyi 'dus pa'i tshogs la gsung mgur kyang rtsal/ mdo bo che'i sngags 'chang rgyal sras seng ge yab sras sogs bla ma rnams dang 'jam gling pa yab sras/ byams sprin gter dbon bla ma sku mched/ rdzong 'dzin sde pa lcags yang gnyis la sogs mchog dman gyi dad ldan 'dus pa'i tshogs la dbang lung khrid kyi rim pa gang mtshams kyi re ba bskongs bar mdzad/ grwa phu chos gling du gdan drangs nas rje 'ba' ra bar rdzogs chen mkha' 'gro snying thig gi dbang lung khrid bka' smin pa dang khyad par gsang lam mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi gdam pa dang dgongs gter gcod yul ho ru ka'i bgad mo yang 'di skabs gtan la phab cing rtsal/byams sprin gtsug lag khang gi nye 'dabs os phor lung pa'i mdo gu ru'i grub phug tu grags pa'i dngos grub phug tu re zhig bzhugs/ 'di skabs byams sprin gtsug lag khang du gnas de'i bsrung ma ma mo bdun gyi srog snying bzhes phyir zhag bcu bzhi'i bar gsang spyod kyi nyams bzhes mdzad/ de'i tshe lha khang gi dbu rtse'i phyi khyams ldeb ris su tshe dpag med bris pa'i thad nas bsrung ma rdo rje legs ldan ma de bud 51

med nag mo ral pa gting sar slebs pa khros pa'i nyams can zhig dngos su gzigs/ tho reng zhig snga phyi'i dus 'gyur gyi lung bstan mang du phul ba mgur gyi tshigs su bcad de phyag ris mdzad pa phyis gtan la phebs par gyur/ der rig 'dzin yol mo pa bstan 'dzin nor bu'i sku skyes gser zangs sprul pa'i skur bsrung ma 'di'i bka' gtad kyang rtsal 'dug byams sprin pa gter dbon rig 'dzin nyi ma seng ge la rdzogs chen mkha' 'gro snying thig dang / a ti zab don sprul sku snying thig gi dbang lung khrid kyi ngo sprod sogs rtsal/ gzhan yang rje btsun mi la'i grub gnas rdzong drug phug gsum bcas mjal bar mdzad/rkyang phan nam mkha' rdzong du bzhugs skabs mang yul gnas shar pa sogs skye bo 'ga' zhig gis bskur zhus kyi gleng brjod sna tshogs byas par thugs snying rje chen po'i mdangs yin lugs rdo rje'i mgar chen gsung zhing ling ba brag dmar du byon dus nub gcig sku tshe phyi ma gang du khrung pa'i 'byung 'gyur 'ga' zhig rtsol med du thugs la shar tshe bla ma dran pa brgyad kyi mgur gsungs/ gung thang chos sde'i nang brten rnams mjal zhing rdzong 'dzin sde pa zung sogs dad ldan 'ga' la 'dod chos kyang ci rigs rtsal/sngon rje btsun chen po dang gsang bdag ras chung rdor grags thog mar mjal ba'i gnas ra la'i za 'og phug tu re zhig bzhugs skabs gser bzang ras chen 'gyur med klong grol gyi sras gser bzang sprul pa'i skus mjal bar byon cing / tshem bu smar khrid klong gsal mkha' 'gro snying thig gi dbang / tshe dpag med rdo rje rgya mdud kyi dbang lung / rdzogs chen mkha' 'gro snying thig gi smin khrid yongs rdzogs bka' srungs srog bsgrub ma'i rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ thab lam yid bzhin nor bu dang smin gling gter gsar rdzogs chen a ti/ thugs rje chen po bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi chos skor sogs dang / sprul pa'i skur dpa' bo pad+ma stobs ldan shugs 'chang rdo rje snying po rtsal zhes gsang mtshan du gnang / dga' bo lha lding dang / gu ru rin po che'i zab gter mang du bzhugs pa'i brag rin chen spung pa'i mda' ri 'dab sogs brgyud nub ris su 'pheb/ sngon zhang tshal pa 'gro ba'i mgon po g.yu brag pa'i dngos slob lha ri nyi zla 'od kyi slob ma sangs rgyas tshal pa zhes pas btab pa'i tra ska dgon du spa rong rje dbon 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' bstan 'dzin gyi chos sras grub chen zab gsal chos 'phel las phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor bo dong 'jigs bral thams cad mkhyen pa dbyangs can dga' ba nas brgyud pa dang / bo dong lugs dus 'khor gyi man ngag thab lam sbas pa mig 'byed kyi dbang khrid lung gsum gsan/ dus 'khor gyis mchog dbang gsan pa'i thog ma yin cing dge mtshan bzang po yang byung gsungs/ de skabs gzigs snang du/ nam mkha' las sprin dkar po zhig bskyangs ba'i sprin phung gi bseb nas kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbyangs can dga' ba'i zhal bzang dngos su bsten te byin brlabs kyi mtshan ma mnyes/52

gzhan yang sbas tshul gyi grub dbang 'ga' zhig las khrid lung gi rgyun dkon pa kha shas gsan/ za phug pa rgyal dbang seṅge ces lcog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi sku'i skye bar grags pa de'i sprul sku karma gar dbang don grub la bstan gnyis gling pa'i rdzogs chen phung po zag med kyi 'khrid bka' gnang zhing 'di'i brgyud 'debs kyang stsal/ gter ston gar dbang rdo rje'i sprul skur grags pa gar dbang sprul sku/ che chen 'khrul zhig /lha mdun bla ma sogs skal ldan du mar smin grol gyi rjes su bzung / grub chen pad+ma dbang 'dus la gsang lam snyan brgyud kyi man ngag dang mtshan bde chen dbang phyug tu rtsal zhing pho nya'i lam la nyams rtogs mthar son pa zhig byung bar snang ngo / /dgung lo so gcig pa phur bu ste sa spre lo gsar mtshams/gtsang nas mi'i dbang po pho lha ba bsod nams stobs rgyas kyi bka' lung ltar skyid grong ljongs sdod lcags sprag pa dang yang grong nas gnyis kyi do khur bgyis te bal yul mchod rten bya rung kha shor la nyams gso gnang ba skabs 'dir mi'i dbang po'i lung gis rje 'di nyid la rab gnas gnang dgos tshul phebs pa bzhin bal yul du byon dus/ mar lam brag dkar rta so'i mdun klong mdar gdan sa ba g.yu sgra snying po'i 'phrin las kyi sprul pa ras chen karma chos 'phel gyi sprul sku karma mchog ldan mjal du byon par chos 'brel dang brag dkar gyi gnas bstod gsung mgur kyang stsal/de nas bal yul du phebs mchod rten chen por rab tu gnas pa'i me tog 'thor bar mdzad/ 'di skabs rje nyid gnyan khrod brgya rtsa 'grim pa'i dus dang 'grig pas sku'i cha byad kyang ho ru ka'i chas stag bsham rus brgyan dril g.yer gyi bsil sgra can kha ṭ+wāṃ kar bcas te gshegs par mngon/ bya rung kha shor du bzhugs skabs lung bstan las dur khrod chen po lhun grub brtsegs pa'i dngos gzhi kha shor nas gzhu mdom lnga brgya'i sar yod cing der gu ru rin po che'i zhabs rjes kyang yod tshul byung ba mngon du gyur/ mtshan snang du lha 'dre 'ga' zhig srog snying bzhes shing dam la btags/ skyid grong du phebs skabs mi dbang chen po'i btsun mo glang chu'i stod gyang khang du bzhugs pas gdan drangs dbang bka' byin rlabs 'ga' zhig gnang / 'phags pa wa ti mjal nas slar yang ri bo dpal 'bar gyi rtse bdud rtsi phug tu byon te bsam gyis mi khyab pa mkha' khyab mkha'i rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs so/ /de dag la snyim pa'i chu skyes su sngar gyi 'phro nas ston la brag la la nas thon/ bya kong nyan gzhung 'ol kha rgyud/ khra 'brug zan yangs gtsug lag khang / /legs mjal smon lam bzang po thebs/ /mtshur phu bde ba'i pho brang du / /mi bskyod 'od mtshan cod pan can/ /mjal byas chos 'brel tsam re thob/ /zil gnan me rta shar ba'i tshe/ /stag sna chos kyi pho brang du/ /byang sems dge slong rdo rje 'dzin/ /rje btsun byang chub chos dbang po'i/ /zhabs pad bsnyen nas rdzogs pa che'i/ /'ja' lus srog sgrub dbang khrid dang / /kun bzang dgongs pa 'dus pa yi/ /53

thod rgal don gyi ngo sprod thob/ /snying rgyud dbu mtha' bar gsum nos/ /gzhan yang dbang khrid ci rigs zhus/ /thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa byung / /de 'phror zab lung gnas 'brel phyin/ /rtsa gsum mkha' 'gro'i bsnyen tshad bskyal/ /der 'dus dad skal ldan rnams la/ /snying thig dbang khrid lung rdzogs dang / /bla ma dgongs 'dus dbang ka phul/ /dregs pa'i srog dbang bgyid pa'i skabs/ /gter bsrung mi la brlam byas nas/ /gus pas phyag phul dga' tshor tshul/ /du ma byas byung dgyes ltas go/ /slar yang tre bo'i zhabs pad bsten/ /dbang chos dag kyang ci rigs zhus/ /bdag la shis brjod mnga' gsol gnang / /de nas bya btang chas zhugs te/ /sog pa nas rgyud rta nag phu/ /tsha lung bla mar ne gu yi/ /chos drug rdo rje'i tshig rkang nos/ /rmi lam ltas kyang ngo mtshar byung / /phun tshogs gling dang jo nang mjal/ /byang rgyud ru lag ri sul du/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor grub thob mchog /bha ṭa sa man+ta yi drung / /rdo rje rnal 'byor zhu 'dod pas/ /ched gtad phyin nas zhag gsum bar/ /gsol ba btab kyang zhal mjal tsam/ /ma byung bla ma'i mdzad spyod ni/ /chos brgyad med par yi rang zhing / /dad gus mchog tu 'phel ba byung / /grwa pa tsho la cung ma 'gu/spyir ni kho ba'i gshis khams la/ /dag snang grub mtha' phyogs ris med/ /phrad thag mos mos zhum zhum po//rjes su mtha' med yal mkhan min/ /mkhas pa'i spyad pa mi ldan yang / /blun po'i dad pa brtan po yin/ /dad cing dbang lung zhu yul des/ /phyis nas mi bsad rta sgyel ba/ /byas kyang dag snang gang 'byongs las//mi dad log lta med par mchis/ /spyir ni le lo ches che yang / /chos la brtson pa byed khul byas/ /'di dag kho bo'i ngang tshul du/ /zhar byung 'phros su smra bar song / /de nas la stod ding ri nas/ /snye nam brgyud de bal por phyin/ kha shor shing kun mchod rten dang / /yang le shod sogs legs mjal zhing / /lhag bsam smon lam rgya cher btab/ /spre'u zhes grags me lug lor/ /mang yul skyid grong dag tu sleb/ /rang byon wa ti mjal byas shing / /dpal 'bar ri la dbang gsum pa'i/ /bla sgrub bsnyen pa tshad la bskyal/ /zhing skyong ma mo kun tu ru'i/ /ga na tsakra longs yang spyad/ /gnas der 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen ni/ /tshe ring don ldan zhes bya ba'i/ /rnam dkar smon lam dag des sbyar/ /'jam gling bla ma yab sras la/ /gsar rnying 'dod chos 'ga' yang zhus/ /zhur mo gangs ra mjal phyin zhing / /dhā ki'i tshogs bskang brgya rtsa phul/ /bar chad sel ba'i ltas kyang byung / /de yi 'phro nas rim bzhin du/ /mdo bo che yi sngags 'chang dang / /'jam gling drung dang byams sprin gyi/ /bla ma rnams dang rdzong 'dzin pa'i/ /sde pa la sogs mchog dman gyi/ /tshogs pa rnams la dbang lung khrid/ /gang la gang mtshams re ba bskang / /de dag khrod nas chos rgyud la/ /phan par byed snyams 'ga' zung la/ /khreg chod thod rgod zab bshad byas/ /gsang lam mkha' 'gro'i snyan rgyud yang //dz+nyā na shrī bha ṭa zhes/ /skye sngon las bzang 'brel can der/ /chos bka' 'byed byas thog mar bshad// 54

ston la rje btsun mi la yi/ /rdzong drug mjal zhing de zhor du/ /dad ldan 'dod chos 'ga' yang bshad/ /gung thang rgyal khab rten mjal zhus/ /sde pa zung la dbang ka phul/ /re zhig rje btsun bzhad rdor dang / /gsang bdag rdor grags mjal ba'i gnas/ /za 'og phug par sdod pa'i skabs/ /gser bzang grub pa'i dbang phyug sras/ /stobs ldan shugs 'chang rtsal dang 'phrad/ /smin grol spyi dang khyad par du/ /nges gsang snying po'i skor rnams bstan/ /de nas lha lding ri 'dabs rgyud/ /nub rir phyin nas sbas tshul gyis/ /rnal 'byor grub dbang 'ga' zhig la/ /khrid rgyun dkon gyur 'ga' yang thob/ /de dag skabs su rang res kyang / gar dbang rgyal bar sprul sku dang / /che chen 'khrul zhig dam pa sogs/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug grub chen dang / /lha lding bla ma la sogs pa/ /dad ldan tshogs la khrid lung dbang / /so so'i thugs bzhed bzhin du byas/ /phur bu sa spre lo mgo la/ /gtsang nas mi yi dbang po ni/ /bsod nams stobs rgyas lung phebs bzhin/ /bstan 'gro'i don du bal po'i yul/ /mchod rten bya rung kha shor gyi/ /rab tu gnas pa byed phyir phyin/ /'gro ba spyi yi bsod dbang gi/ /rten 'brel legs tshogs ci lta bar/ /'grig par dka' ba chos nyid du/ /gyur kyang 'on te phral cung zad/ /phan pa'i rten 'brel bzang po shar/ /der bsgrod yar mar res gnyis kar/ /mi dbang chen po'i btsun mo la/ /zhi drag dbang bka' mang tsam phul/ /lam zhor wa ti mjal yang phyin/ /zhes 'phros don dang bcas gsung pa/ /ltar ro/ /der bzhugs skabs sku tshe snga phyi'i rten 'brel gyi gnad cung zad 'chugs pa rnams sor chud phyir dang bstan 'gror sman pa'i ched kho nar dgongs mkha' 'gro'i gtor ma chen po yang yang dang / khyad par mnga' ris gung thang chos rgyal gyi bzhengs pa'i bkra shis dpal 'bar gyi gtsug lag khang chen por gangs can bod ljongs spyi'i bde thabs dang / dus ngan gyi mtshan ma mtha' dag phyir bsring ba'i ched du bcom ldan 'das dpal chen po rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod ste rjes kyi las sbyor gzir gnan 'phags pa'i rim pa mngon spyod drag po'i cho ga dang / gnas de'i mdun tu mkha' 'gro'i gling bzhi spyi mdos chen mo sogs kyang gzhung bzhin bsgrub par mdzad do/ /de skabs gser bzang sprul pa'i sku shugs 'chang rdo rje yang byon pa dpon slob lhan du zla mtshams gcad rgyar bzhugs/ rje nyid kyi thugs gter snyan brgyud dang / rdo rje sems dpa'i rdor bzlas kyi dmigs khrid/ sgrol dkar jo bo lugs/ gter gsar gshin rje dregs 'jom/ drag dmar kyi dbang lung sogs stsal/ 'di pas zhus ngor sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bsnyen sgrub kyi yi ge 'chi med bdud rtsi'i gter mdzod dang / bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga dngos grub 'byung gnas/ 'ba' ra sprul pa'i sku dang thun mong nas gsol ba btab ngor rnam thar snyim pa'i chu skyes zhag phyed gnyis kyi thun mtshams khongs su grub par mdzod/ gtsug lag khang gi rim gro pa bkra shis don 55

grub kyi bskul ba po zhus ngor gzigs snang dang mthun pa'i zhing skyong rgya gar lha mo'i mchod 'phrin bskang so rab dga'i rgyud mang zhes pa bka' rtsom gnang / gser bzang sprul pa'i skur yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang / gzhan yang dbang khrid gdam pa mang du rtsal zhing brtan bzhugs khri 'don mnga' gsol shis brjod kyang mdzad do/ /de yang snga sor rig 'dzin yol mo pa bstan 'dzin nor bu gnas der bzhugs skabs mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan dang gzigs snang sogs byung ba ltar zab gter bzhes rgyu'i rten 'brel yol bas bzhes ma thub pa da res sku'i skye ba 'dir/ gung btsan sprul pas dpal 'bar gteraḥ thon na mi lo lnga bcu bdeḥ zhes pa'i lung bstan ltar 'grig la re'i rten 'brel gyi sgrig phyogs du ma mdzad par 'dug kyang don du ma smin pa der bda'/ de nas bod du byon pa'i lam zhor chos mkhar du phebs/ mkhan chen blo bzang chos grags la/ yang gsang mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag lta bu rdo rje'i bzlas pa'i man ngag shog dril gong khug zab khyad can rtsal/ kha la rong sgo brgyud nas pan chen 'jigs med grags pa'i bsti gnas dpal mo chos sding du zhag shas bzhugs/ 'jigs bral chen po'i dbon rgyud rje dbon nam mkha' dpal bzang dpon 'khor skya ser dad 'dus rnams la rdzogs chen phung po zag med kyi khrid bka' sogs dbang chos 'ga' zhig stsal nas snya nam du phebs/ tshong 'dus gnas po ko thang pa dang / bka' sgo ba sogs kyi gus 'dud dang chos 'brel zhus shing bka' sgo ba bstan 'dzin tshe ring gi zhus ngor smon lam zhig dang / rten 'brel zhig gis dgos dbang gi rjes su rdo rje phur pa'i thang ka byin rlabs can zhig kyang rtsal 'dug 'di dus gnya' nang tshong 'dus kyi phu bde skyid 'byung gnas su g.yang chos pa gu ru'i lung zin rig 'dzin nyi zla klong gsal gyi rnam sprul gar dbang phrin las rnam rgyal las/ gter ston gar dbang rdo rje'i snying po'i zab gter bskor nas 'ga' zhig dang gzhan yang kha shas gsan/ de nas gnas mchog la phyi chu dbar mjal du thegs/ de'i tshe gnas kyi nus pas thugs dam rtogs pa'i gsal ngar bogs 'don che ba byung / 'jig rten gyi sha za mkha' 'gro ma'i cho 'phrul sna tshogs zhig ston kyang bar chad kyi glags rnyed par ma nus shing slar phyag rgya chen po'i zil 'og tu gnan te rtsigs la phab/ ding rir phebs nas pha dam pa rgya gar ba'i sgrub gnas glang 'khor gyi gnas rten rnams zhib mjal mdzad/ glang 'khor rdza ri'i dur khrod du gsang gcod mdzad cing bzhugs skabs nye logs kyi rdo zhig gi ngos la phyag sor bzhi'i rjes 'dam la bzhag pa ltar shin tu gsal ba da lta'ang kun gyi spyod yul du rung bar mchis/ rgyal gyi shrī'i lo paṇa dgon du nyang gi gdung rigs 'dzin pa sngags 'chang pad+ma dbang drag la gu ru chos dbang gi gter byon rdzogs chen sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi lung khrid dang / zab lam bde stong rgya mtsho'i bskor gyi dbang lung khrid sogs tshur gsan/ phar la rdzogs chen yang tig gi 56

khregs chod thod rgal zab bshad sogs 'ga' zhig stsal/ dgon 'dir bde chen gling pa'i bka' 'dus snying po yid bzhin nor bu'i zhi khro'i cho ga rgyun 'dzugs kyi sbyor 'jags kyang gnang / rgyal gyi shrī'i gnas rten rnams mjal zhing mchod 'bul dang / phyogs bzhi nas gtor tshogs rgyas pa re mdzod/ la stod lho bram so bso rdzong zhes deng sang rdzong phug tu grags par phebs phyis 'byon par grub thob chen po brlags spyod pa'i gar mkhan rang rig ras chen gyis dngos slob 'jam dbyangs phrin las rab brtan drung du 'jigs bral dbyangs can dga' ba nas brgyud pa'i 'jigs mdzad rdo rje dang / dges rdor/ bsang ba 'dus pa 'phags zhabs lugs gnyis/ mi tri pa dang dam pa mi pham mgon nas brgyud pa'i 'khor lo bde mchog gi dbang / dam pa'i so rig gi khrid bka'/ bar 'brug gi phyag chen lhan skyes kyi khrid/ chos drug ro snyoms/ rten 'brel/ bla sgrub/ bsre 'pho sogs gzhung 'brug gi gdam pa phal cher gsan cing mthar brtan bzhugs dang chos yon gyi maṇ+ḍal bdun tshan lnga sogs phul/ rdzong phu pa dpon slob rnams la byang gter rdo rje phur pa'i smin byed sogs 'ga' zhig rtsal/ de nas lha nga la brgyud ru lag 'bras spungs gi dben gnas su bskyod/ chos rje kun bzang dbang po'i drung du zla ba gsum lhag tsam bzhugs/ de'i ring mdo chos kun gyi mthar thug phyir mi ldog pa 'khor lo mtha' ma'i dgongs don bde gshegs snying po'i gnas lugs gtan la phab pa'i man ngag gzhan stong dbu ma chen mo'i blta khrid dang / sngags chos gnyis med rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang rim bcu gcig dang / bdag po dang bdag po chen po'i dbang chen lan drug dang / rdzogs rim zab mo rdo rje'i rnal 'byor yan lag drug gi nyams khrid lan drug rim pa gnyis kyi bshad pa gzhung man ngag gi lung bshad/ gangs can ljongs 'dir bstan pa ris med pa'i khrid srol grags che ba khyad par can mtha' dag rje btsun dam pa kun dga' sgrol mchog gis phyogs gcig tu sgrigs par mdzad pa'i khrid chen brgya dang rtsa brgyad kyi khrid rgyun dang lung —/bka' 'khor lo tha ma nges don snying po'i glegs bam drug gi lung / kun mkhyen dol po pa shes rab rgyal mtshan dang / thams cad mkhyen pa tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum lung rgyun gang bzhugs/ sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas kyi dbang bka' rjes gnang rig gtad skor yongs su rdzogs pa/ grub pa'i rgyal mo'i tshe dbang tshe khrid sogs ji snyed gsan cing / thugs yid gcig 'dres su gyur/ mthar chos kyi bka' drin gtang rag gi yon 'bul kyang snga phyi bar gsum las snga mar bdun tshan bdun dang phyi ma gnyis su bdun tshan lnga re dngos po shin tu spus gtsang ba sha dag gi dngos 'bul spros te spong ba yongs su dag par mdzad/ chos rje kun bzang dbang pos kyang rje 'di jo nang kun mkhyen dol po pa'i slob ma thugs sras ma ti rnam gnyis kyi ya gyal gcig yin par ngos bzung bar mdzad pa sa bzang pa blo gros rgyal 57

mtshan gyi bag chags sad pa la dgongs pa dang / khyad par gting skyes rgyal po'i sras 'jam dbyangs ye shes rgyal mtshor 'khrungs pa'i sngon gnas rjes dran gyi dbang gis jo nang pa'i lta grub ring lugs la shin tu gus shing thugs zhen lhag par che ba tshul des yin zhes gsungs shing / de skabs kyang jo lugs kyi bka' srol thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa mtha' dag yun tu sbyangs brtson gyi ngal ba la ma ltos par gzigs shing gsan pa tsam gyi bde blag nyid du dgongs pa'i klong zab mor chug par gyur pa ni dpag par dka' ba'i gnas so/ /de ltar ring mo zhig nas bzhed pa'i don thugs kyi bum bzang yongs su gang bar gyur te sngon chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos bod yul gyi sa yi me rtsar ru snon dang mtha' 'dus yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang du ma bzhengs par mdzad pa'i gras ru lag grom pa rgyang gi lha khang dang nye bar gu ru rin po che'i sgrub gnas rgyang yon po lung zhes zab gter mang du bzhugs pa'i slob dpon chen po'i sgrub phug der re zhig zab don gyi rnal 'byor la bzhugs so/ /dgung lo so gnyis pa zhi ba ste sa bya lo gsar du 'char ba bdag cag gi ston pas gnyan yod du cho 'phrul bstan pa'i dus dka' thub can gyi zla ba'i yar ngor bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bsnyen pa'i bcad rgya la bzhugs/bstan bcos 'ga' yang mdzad do/ /bcad rgya grol nas lha rtse'i phyogs kyi skya ser gyi 'dus pa ches mang bar 'dod chos dang khrom dbang rtsal/ zo lung sogs su yang chos kyi ched kho na byon pa'i zhar la mang mkhar rdzong nas se dkar rigs kyi thig le 'dar pa mi rje nor bu dpal 'byor dang / blo bzang bkra shis sku mched kyi gdan drangs te dbang chos sogs kyi thugs bzhed bkang / zo lung rje btsun ma kun bzang 'phrin las dbang mos zhus pa'i ngor zhal gdam gyi mgur gsungs/ de nas la stod byang grub thob thang stong rgyal po'i grub gnas dpal ri bo che'i gnas rten rnams mjal bar bskyod nas bgrod lam dka' tshegs ches che bas sku ngal bar gyur kyang chos phyir snying stobs kyi go cha btsan pos dka' ba mtha' dag khyad du bsad te las lung don grub gling du byon/ der grub pa'i dbang phyug 'dar phya ru ba rin chen bzang po'i rnam rol gnyag rigs gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa mkha' shing grub pa'i khyu mchog kham lung pa chen po pad+ma rig 'dzin dbang gi rgyal po'i spyan sngar zab gsang 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i chos tshul kun gyi phyi mor gyur pa/ 'ja' lus 'chi ba med pa'i sku brnyes pa ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta chen po bi ma la mi tra'i snying thig man ngag brgya dang dgu bcu pa zab pa mdo bzhi yi smin dbang lung bcas yongs rdzogs dang / gzhan yang karma snying tig gi lungartso/ byang gter thugs sgrub yang tig gces sgron gyi zab khrid sogs 'ga' zhig dang / mdo dbang gi gtad rgya yang legs par gsan/ rdzogs pa chen po'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa mchog tu gsung gis dbugs dbyung gzeng bstod thun mong ma yin pa gnang 58

zhing thugs gsang chig 'dres su gyur/ de yang bde legs kun gyi rtsa ba bla ma yin par mdo rgyud kun nas mgrin gcig tu gsungs shing / dus kyi 'khor lo las/ yon tan rgya mtsho'i bla ma la/ /dad pa'i yid kyi mnyes byas na/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub gnyis/ /tshe 'di nyid la thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bshad pa ltar/ snga sor mdo khams stod spu bo rgyud bod kyi shul lam du zhabs skyod pa'i bya bral gyi brtul zhugs bzung bar mdzad pa nas/ skabs 'di kun tu bla ma dam pa yongs 'dzin du bsnyen par mdzad pa kun la chos kyi yon 'bul phyag par dngos po spus gtsang zhing dag pa ci byung yang bla ma'i phyogs su gtong bar mdzad pa las/ bla ma'i rdzas la brnab sems mi bya zhing / sder bcas gnod sems cha dang bcas kun bsdom/zhes pa'i dgongs don ltar phyir gdab lan phebs rdzong bsnyen bskur 'bul dngos rigs gtan nas mi bzhes pa 'di tsam gyi rnam par thar pa'i cha shas kyang gzhan gyis bsgrub par dka' ba nyid do/ /'di skabs gser bzang sprul pa'i sku yang ched du snyegs te byon zhing / khams lung pa chen po'i rigs dbon chos sras kyi thu bo sku skyes rin po che gsang sngags bstan 'dzin dang / rdo dmar ba chen po rig 'dzin pad+ma rdo rje/ pad+mo chos sding gi gdan drung ba sogs bla ma'i rigs dang / zo lung sngags 'chang gnam lcags dpa' bo/ brag nag pa sngags 'chang karma zla 'od rdo rje/ sa kha'i dpon chen no no/ /spo rang rje dbon nam mkha' dpal bzang sogs chos don gnyer ba'i dad ldan phyogs kyi 'dus pa ser skya mchog dman du ma zhig byung ba la rang rang gi bzhed pa ltar gyi zab chos smin grol gyi gdam pa thang mar gdal/ rim gyis nub dgon chen du zhag shas bzhugs/ nub dgon gyi mgon po legs ldan kyang da lta gnas bzhin yin 'dug pas bskang bso sogs la 'bad rtsol gser bzang pa dgos pa'i dka' phebs/gser bzang sprul pa'i sku yang lhan cig tu phebs pa lam bar rnams su yang bka' chos rgyun chags su gnang bzhin par mnga' ris rdzongs dkar du phyag phebs/ ling nga brag dmar rdzong gi grub gnas 'dzin spras ji bzhin med 'dug pas sprul pa'i sku nyid nas 'dzin skyongs gnang dgos tshul bka' phebs par/'di nas bzung lo 'ga' shas 'dzin spras gnang bar grags so/ /der skya ser mang po'i 'du ba la khrom dbang sogs re ba bskong bar mdzad/ de nub ris phyogs su thegs/ gtsang sgang po che zhes mnyam med chos dbang rgyal mtshan gyi bsti gnas der 'tsho mdzad chos bzang mtshan can las byang gter rdo rje phur pa'i dbang gter ston gar dbang rdo rje snying po nas brgyud pa'i nye brgyud can sogs 'ga' zhig gsan/khong la rdzogs chen gyi zab khrid stsal/ rta sga dgon du spo rong rje dbon gyis gdan drangs par bskyod de dbang chos kyi bzhed pa bskangs rta lar grub mchog shākya seṅge zhes rgyal dbang seṅge'i dngos slob de las gtsang smyon ho ru kaḥbargyud pa'i ras chung snyan brgyud gsar ma'i bde mchog gi dbang tshar mang po dang / 59

nor bu skor gsum gyi dbang lung khrid cha lag yongs su rdzogs pa/ gter ston bstan gnyis gling pa'i rdzogs chen ye shes mthong grol gyi dbang lung khrid bka' bcas gsan/ lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi dmigs rkang 'dzin tshul pad+ma'i phreng ba dang / bla bsgrub bsnyen pa'i grangs tshad tshul kyang der mdzad/phyogs de'i dgon yul ser skya mtha' dag gi zhabs kyi pad mor gus pas btud cing chos 'brel sogs kyi 'dod pa yid bzhin du 'jo ba'i bka' drin stsal lo/ /rim par byang thang rgyud mnga' ris glo bo phyogs su phebs/ dpal dges pa rdo rje'i rtsa rgyud rtag pa gnyis pa nas lung gis zin pa'i mu ni sko ṭa'am mu khun k+ṣe ṭa/ zur chag gi skad du mu ta ṣa ṭar 'bod pa yongs grags phyi nang gnyis ka'i gnas su 'dod pa chu mig brgya rtsa zhes rdo dang / chu la rang byung gi me 'bar ba ḍāk+ki sprin ltar 'du ba'i gnas der byon te zhag shas bzhugs/ tshogs gtor mchod pa rgyas par mdzad/ glo bo stod smon thang nas gnod sbyin gyi dbang po rnam sras mdung dmar can gyi sprul par grags pa a ma dpal gyi gdung chos rgyal gyi phreng ba rim par byon pa'i brgyud las rgyal po a mgon bstan 'dzin yab yum bka' yi blon por bcas pas gsol ba btab pa bzhin bskyod/ rdzogs chen mkha' 'gro snying thig gi dbang lung khrid dang bcas pa/klong gsal mkha' 'gro snying thig drag po rta phyag khyung gsum/ bdud 'dul ba'i pad+ma 'od 'bar gyi dbang lung sogs rtsal/ snga sor mar yul bdag po zhabs drung mtsho skyes phun tshogs la mkha' 'gro snying thig yongs rdzogs tshar gcig gnang skabs bskul ba dang / 'di res glo bo rgyal blon rnams kyi zhus ngor dmigs rkang smon lam du spel ba gser gyi 'phreng ba'ang mdzad/ smon thang mkhan po kun dga' phun tshogs sogs la phyag rgya chen po yi ge bzhi pa dang lhan skyes kyi zab khrid gsungs zhing so'i brgyud 'debs kyang gnang ngo / /dge dkar gyi gtsug lag khang dang / bsam phug gtsang rang rnams su zla ba kha shas bzhugs shing dad ldan so so'i 'dod pa bzhin du dbang lung khrid bka' sogs gang mtshams blo'i re ba bskang bar mdzad de dol po'i gnas rnams mjal bar bzhed pas slar yang glo smad phyogs su phebs/ sngon du chu mig brgya rtsar byon skabs dang da res bcas su dzar rdzong gi khri thog par grags pa'i dpon drung che gras rnams kyi zhabs gus chos 'brel zhus shing so so'i sras mo re yang chos sgor bcug pa sogs dad chos btsun gsar ma mang zhig byung / 'di skabs glo dol gyi shul lam de dag kyang la ches mtho zhing / kha ba dang grang reg che ba sogs dka' tshegs che yang tshur mthong gi ngor gnas skor lus kyi sgrib sbyongs du dka' ba bzod par bya dgos pa'i mig srol brda thabs ston phyir sku ngal ba sogs khyad du sad pa'i lam khyer gyi tshul bzhes par bda'/ de'i tshe yul ljongs de'i gzhi bdag srid pa'i lha chen gyi gras rgyal chen khyung chen du grags pa dang / mkha' 'gro ma dang / mi ma yin du mas sbas pa'i yul der 60

byon par bskul zhing gnas sgo 'byed dgos par gsol kyang skabs su ma bab par dgongs te byon pa ma shar/ rim gyi rgya gar 'phags yul gyi cha shas sngon gyi dus ya tse rgyal po zhes chos bzhin du spyod pa byung ba'i shul dus kyi 'gyur bas da lta'i skabs bā li rā dza zhes phyi rol mu stegs byed kyi grub mtha' la mos shing / rgyal phran nyi shur dbang bsgyur ba 'dzum lang du grags pa'i rje bo de'i mnga' 'og zur chag gi skad du smra ba'i yul der/ gangs can gyi ri brgyud pañtsa li zhes pa'i ri'i rgyal po'i mdun sa 'dus zhes rang byung gi dur khrod bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo'i byin gyis rlabs pa'i gnas mchog der zhag shas bzhugs shing tshogs gtor gyi mchod pa rgya cher mdzad/ de skabs phyi nang gi rten 'brel gyi mthu las rnam mang grub mtha'i bzhed pa mtha' dag ma 'dres par dgongs pa'i me long du 'char ba byung gsungs/yul de'i ser skya kun gyi gus par btud cing dbang chos gyi 'brel pa dang / rnam dkar thar pa byang chub mchog gi rgyur dkri ba'i dge bskul rgya cher bskyangs nas rgya bod gnyis kyi mtshams bkag pa'i sbas mtha' bsam 'grub chos sding zhes par bzhugs/ skabs der mon gyi rgyal khag gnyis 'khrugs par bar mtshams 'ching sgrigs gnang zhing so sor bde 'jags su bkod/ mtshan lam du rje btsun sgrol ma'i sku gsal bar gzigs pa de dang mthun pa'i bstod pa mdongs mtha' can gyi gar bsgyur zhes pa'ang gsung brtsam gnang / phyogs de'i gdul bya mtha' dag gi re 'dod char du bsnyil bar mdzad do/ /dgung lo so gsum pa thun mong te lcags khyi lor mon yul gyi cha rta grur byon/ der slob dpon chen po'i g.yu sgra snying po'i sprul par lung gis zin cing / gter ston gar dbang rdo rje'i snying po'i dngos slob chos sras dam pa grub mchog o rgyan bstan 'dzin nas mjal bzhed pas gdan 'dren byung ba bzhin rta glar phebs/ gar dbang snying po'i gter byon zab tig chos dbyings rang gsal dang / thugs rje chen po rtsa gsum snying thig rdo rje phur pa spu gri reg gcod/byang gter thugs rje chen po 'gro ba kun grol lam/ nyon mongs rang grol gyi dbang khrid lung gsum tshang ba/ nus ldan zhabs kyi 'ja' sku'i khrid bka' yang gsan/phar la pad+ma bde chen gling pa'i gter byon klong gsal mkha' 'gro snying tig gi dbang khrid lung bcas rtsal zhing snying thig gi bdag por dbugs dbyung mnga' gsol bar mdzad/ slar yang pa 'dus nas rta rong rgyud de rta rab smad o rgyan gu ru'i gnas chen 'bum par byon te re zhig bzhugs/ zab don gyi rnal 'byor g.yo ba med pa'i ngang nas gdul bya don gnyer can dag la rnal grol lam gyi chu bo'i rgyun ci yang 'beb par mdzad do/ /de dag gi don bsdu ba ni snyim pa'i chu skyes su/ sngar sa spre lo yan la mang yul ri rgyal dpal 'bar du gsung pa de'i phros las/ de nas mang yul sa'i thig le/ /ri rgyal dpal 'bar lte ba yis/ /bdud rtsi phug tu sdod byas te/ /phyi mtshams khul nas rang nyid kyi/ /skye ba snga ma'i rten 'brel 61

gnad//'chugs rnams sor chud phyir dang ni/ /bstan 'gror phan pa'i ched dmigs nas/ /mkha' 'gro'i gtor chen 'ga' yang btang / khyad par gtsug lag khang pa ru/ /rang gi dngos pos gzhi bzung nas/ /bod khams spyi yi bde thabs su/ /dus ngan phyir bsring bsam bzang gi/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yi/ /dkyil 'khor zhal phyes gzir mnan 'phang / /lhag pa'i bsam pa kho nas byas/ /dpal 'bar mdun du gling bzhi yi/ /mdos chen tshul mthun dag kyang bsgrub/ /lam zhugs rim gyis mches mkhar phyin/ /mkhan chen chos grags dag dang mjal/ /rdor sems snyan rgyud zab khrid phul/ /de nas kha la rgal byas nas/ /'jigs med dbyangs can dga' ba yi/ /bste gnas dpal mo chos sding du/ /rje dbon mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs des/ /shog gsung bzhin song zhag shas sdod/ /smin dbang bye brag ji snyed dang / /rdzogs chen zag med khrid bka' bshad/ /de nas snya nam yul rgyud de/ /gnas mchog la phyi chu bar du/ /bsgrod pas gnas kyi nus pa yis/ /nyams rtogs rig pa'i ngar thob cing / /'jig rten dh+wa ki'i cho 'phrul 'tshub/ /ston yang bar chad med pa ru/ /phyag rgya chen pos zil gyis mnan/ /ding rir sleb nas dam pa ni/ /rgya gar nag po'i sgrub gnas mchog /glang 'khor gnas rten zhib par mjal/ /lo paṇa bla mar chos dbang gi/ /gter chos sangs rgyas nyams sbyor gyi/ /khrid lung shin tu smin pa dang / /bde stong rgya mtsho'i skor yang thob/ /phar la rdzogs chen yang tig gi/ /khreg chod thod rgal khrid zab bshad/ /snying gi thig pa lta bu phul/ /rgyal gyi shrī bskor bzhin du/ /phyogs bzhir gtor tshogs rgyas re byas/ /brang sor phyin nas rdzogs phu yi/ /sprul sku 'phrin las rab brtan drung / /'jigs med zhabs brgyud 'jigs dges dang / /gsang 'dus 'phags zhabs lugs gnyis dang / /ras bris la brten rgyas par zhus/ /gzhan yang grub thob rang rig par/ /khong gi zhus bzhin bar 'brug gi/ /chos bskor tshang ma dag kyang nos/ /mi tri pa dang dam pa yi/ /bde mchog dbang dang so rigs kyi/ /khrid bka' shin tu smin pa thob/ /phang la byang gter phur pa yi/ /dbang bka' bla ma dam pa dang / /de 'khor rnams la rgyas par byas/ /de nas lha nga la rgyud nas/ /ru lag dben gnas 'bras spungs yong / khyab bdag dang po'i sangs rgyas dang / /gnyis med rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi/ /grub thob yongs kyi 'khor los bsgyur/ /chos rje kun bzang dbang po yi/ /zhabs snyegs zla ba gsum lhag tsam/ /bsten nas mdo chos mthar thug pa/ /snying po'i gnas lugs gtan phab byed/ /gzhan stong dbu ma'i blta khrid dang / /sngags chos zab chos gnyis med rgyud/ /dus 'khor dbang rim bcu gcig bcas/ /bdag po bdag po chos smin byas/ /rdzogs rim sbyor ba yan lag drug /nyams khrid shin tu smar ba dang / /rim gnyis bshad pa gzhung man ngag /zab rgyas yid bzhin legs par rtsal/ /gzhan yang smin grol gdams pa ni/ /rnam grangs shin tu mang po yis/ /blo yi ngal ba bsrong bar gyur/ /spyir yang kho bo chung ngu'i 62

skabs//kun mkhyen jo nang yab sras kyi/ /mtshan thos nyid nas dad pa g.yos/ /khyad par rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i dbang / /tre bo mchog sprul zhal snga nas/ /jo nang bka' brgyud bsngags pa'i gsungs/ /thos pa tsam gyi dga' bdes khyab/ /rkyen des chos rgyun 'bad btsal nas/ /'di skabs rje btsun grub mchog la/ /gdams ngag rang blo tshim nos nas//kun mkhyen jo nang yab sras kyi//grub mthar thun mong ma yin pa'i//nges shes khyad du 'phags pa thob//'di nas byang chub chen po'i bar//bka' drin snying gi thig ler sim//de 'phror rje btsun sku zhabs nas/ /gram pa rgyang du yongs byas te//sa bya cho 'phrul yar ngo la/ /dus 'khor bsnyen mtshams zhig kyang bgyis/ /grol bstun lha rtse phyogs ser skyar/ /khrom dbang 'dod chos ci rigs byas//zo lung sogs su chos kyi ched//zhag shas phyin zhing de yi zhor//mang mkhar bsam gling rdzong nas ni//se dkar rigs kyi snying po ni/ /'dar pa mi rje sku mched kyis/ /spyan 'dren byung phyin dbang chos sogs/ /thugs kyi re ba kheng par byas/ /de nas rim gyis la stod byang / /bsgrod lam dka' tshegs ches dub yang / /chos phyir snying khams bskyod byas nas/ /sgrugaganas las lung bsam gling phyin/ khyab bdag rdo rje slob dpon ni/ /gnyag rigs gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /mkhas shing grub pa'i khyu mchog che/ /pad+ma rig 'dzin dbang rgyal drung / /legs mjalagasang las ches gsang ba/ /'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i chos/ /kun gyi phyi mo bi ma la'i/ /snying tig zab pa mdo bzhi yi/ /smin dbang lung bcas yongs rdzogs nos/ /gzhan yang karma snying tig lung / /byang gter bskor yang ci rigs pa/ /mdo dbang gtad rgya dag kyang zhus/ /rang rer rdzogs chen bstan pa mchog /'dzin pa'i skyes bur ches bsngags pa'i/ /dbugs dbyung thun mong ma yin gnang / /thugs la shin tu bcug par mdzad/ /de ru sdod ring gser bzang gi/ /sprul pa'i sku dang sku skye drung / /rdo dmar drung dang chos sding gi/ /gdan drung ba sogs bla ma'i rigs/ /zo lung brag nag sngags 'chang dang / /dad 'byor dpal yon stobs ldan pa'i/ /sa kha'i dpon chen no no dang / /'jigs bral dbon rigs a jo sogs/ /phyogs nas 'du mi ci rigs par/ /dbang khrid gang mtshams ci nus byas/ /de nas rim gyi nub dgon rgyud/ /slar yang mnga' ri rdzong dkar phyin/ /de ru 'dus pa'i ser skya la/ /dbang bskur re ba bskang bar gyis/ /de phror nub ri sgang chen phyin/ /mtsho mdzad chos bzang gang de la/ /'dod chos shin tu smar ba thob/ /phar la rdzong chen zab khrid phul/ /rta sgar spong rong rje dbon gyis/ /'bod bzhin phyin nas dbang 'brel bgyis/ /rta lar grub mchog shāka seng la/ /ras chung snyan brgyud bde mchog skor/ /gsar ma'i dbang khrid lung bcas zhus/ /phyogs de'i dgon yul mtha' dag pa/ /mjal byung chos 'brel ci nus byas/ /byang thang rgyud de glo bo phyogs/ /dges rdor rtsa rgyud rtag gnyis nas/ /zin pa'i mu mu ni ṣe ṭa/ /phral du chu mig brgya rtsa zhes/ /rdo chur rang byung me 'bar bar//phyin zhing zhag shas gnas 'brel 63

bcas/ /tshogs gtor mchod pa ci nus phul/ /zung 'jug myur thob smon lam btab/ /spyir ni 'di lo 'khor ngan gyi/ /spyod pas grwa tshang spang snying 'dod/ khyad par khams kyi pho nya ba/ /gsar pa 'di ru sleb gyur zhing / /dam pa mchog rnams zhing gshegs shing / /dus kyi zi bun che thos nas/ /snying nas skyo ba ches cher 'phel/ /rkyen de la rten chos thams cad/ /bden mod sgyu ma ci lta ba/ /phyad phyod yun ring bar du shar/ /de skabs glo stod smon thang nas/ /gnod dbang rnam sras mdung dmar gyi/ /rnam sprul a ma dpal gyi gdung/ /chos rgyal phreng bar byon pa'i rgyud/ /rgyal po yab yum bka' yi blon/ /bcas pas spyan 'dren bzhin du phyin/ /dge dkar bsam phug gtsags rang du/ /zla shas sdod nas smin byed dbang / khyad par khrid bkas thugs bzhed bskang / /de nas dol gnas mjal pa'i ched/ /slar yang glo smad phyogs su slebs/ /snga sor chu mig yong res dang / /de res skabs su dzar rdzong gi/ /khri thog dpon drung che gras rnams/ /rim mjal chos 'brel zhu ba dang / /sras mo re yang chos skor bcug /btsun ma gsar byed mang bar byung / /glo dol lam bar la mtho zhing / kha lhags grang ngar ches che yang / /gnas skor lus kyi sgrib sbyangs du/ /dmigs nas bzod cing lam khyer bgyis/ /skabs 'dir rgyal chen khyung chen gyi/ /gzhi bdag mkha' 'gro ma sogs kyis/ /sbas yul der 'gro bskul na yang / /'di res 'phral du 'gro ma byas/ /rim gyis rgya gar yul gyi cha/ /sngon tshe ya rtse rgyal po'i shul/ /da lta bā li rā tsa zhes/ /phyi rol grub mtha' la mos shing / /rgyal phran nyi shur dbang bsgyur ba/ /'dzum lang grags pa de'i mnga' 'og /mon ring ri rgyal pañtsa'i mdun/ /rang byung dur khrod phag mo'i gnas/ /de ru gnas 'brel zhag shas 'dug /phyi nang rten 'brel mthu yi ni/ /rnam mang grub mtha'i bzhed pa kun/ /ma 'dres blo la 'char nus byung / /phyogs de'i ser skya mtha' dag la/ /rim gyis mjal byung dbang chos kyi/ /'brel btags dge bskul gang 'grub byas//skabs 'dir o rgyan gu ru yi/ /lung zin skyes bu grub pa'i dbang / /o rgyan bstan 'dzin sku zhogs nas/ /'phrad bzhed mdzad bzhin rta glar phyin/ /gar dbang snying po'i gter chos ni/ zab tig rtsa ba gsum snying tig /byang gter nyon mongs rang grol gyis/ /dbang khrid lung gsum tshang ba dang / /nus ldan zhabs kyi 'ja' sku yang / /khrid bka' shin tu smin par nos/ /byin rlabs rgyun gyi bdag rgyud rlabs/ /phar la'ang thugs bzhed bzhin du ni/ /pad+ma bde chen gling pa yi/ /snying thig dbang khrid lung bcas pa/ /dpe rgyun der bzhugs kun phul te/ /snying thig bdag por dbugs dbyung byas/ /de nas slar yang sa 'dus nas/ /rta rong brgyud de rta rab smad/ /gu ru'i gnas chen 'bum par slebs/ /zhag shas rgyun bsnyen kha bso bar/ /mtshams zhugs de phro don gnyer can/ /rnams la chos 'brel gang mtshams bgyis/ /zhes sogs lcags khyi yan 'phros don dang bcas pa grub mchog o rgyan bstan 'dzin gyis gsung gis bskul 64

ba'i ngor rtsal ba ltar rnam thar dngos bstan rnams gsung ji bzhin par bkod pa yin no/ /skabs 'di dag tu rje nyid kyi sku tshe snga phyir smon lam gyi 'brel ba'i thugs sras mdo khams pa gsung sprul o rgyan 'phrin las bstan 'dzin kyang zhabs rjes su bsnyegs te byon pa gsung rtsom phal cher gtan la 'bebs pa po mdzad/ glo bo stod smad bar dang / dol po shel gyi ri bo 'brug sgra la sogs pa'i phyogs de'i gnas dang rten mtha' dag mjal bar bskyod cing tshogs gtor mchod 'bul smon lam sogs gzhan phan gyi gdul bya'i don rgya cher mdzad de 'dzam gling chu bzhi'i mgo bo gangs ri chen po ti ser phebs/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i pho brang du grags pa ti se shel gyi mchod rten dang / ma pham g.yu mtsho/ yan lag gi gnas rten rnams dang bcas pa/ kha cher 'phags pa sogs mjal bar thegs shing mchod 'bul gtor tshogs rgya cher spros ma pham gyi ngogs su bzhugs skabs dus 'khor rdzogs rim rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi 'jug ngogs chos spyod zung 'jug lam sbyin zhes pa'ang mdzad/ nang du rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ting 'dzin brgya phrag du ma la snyoms par 'jug cing g.yo ba med pa nas gzhan snang gi gdul bya mtha' dag gi don rtsol ba med par rgya chen po'i 'phrin las rgyun chags su bskyangs so/ /dgung lo so bzhi pa 'gal byed de lcags phag lo mang yul skyid grong du phebs/ 'phags pa rang byung wa ti bzang po'i spyan sngar nyams rtogs kyi maṇ+ḍal tshul du phul ba'i gsung mgur snyan pa'i tasbu ra seṅge'i rgyud kyi sgra dbyangs zhes pa sho lo ka brgyad cu gya brgyad yod pa zhig mdzad/ 'di slar yang rgyal gyi shrī'i nub brgyud grub pa'i bste gnas bhu ṭar tshigs su bcad pa ci rigs bsring zhing zhu dag par mdzad pa yin gsungs/ 'di dus rgya gar 'phags yul rdo rje gdan dang / grub thob chen po go bo rak+ṣa sogs ye shes kyi sku bsnyes pa du ma'i zhal mjal ba'i ched du 'byon par dgongs kyang bzhed pa ltar ma 'grub par mngon/ mang yul byams sprin du 'ba' ra chos rje ngag dbang ye shes la theg pa chen po dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed rgyas pa dang nyang gter mkha' 'gro chen mo'i dbang sogs rtsal/ de nas bod du phebs pa'i dgongs bzhed kyis yar lam gser bzang sprul pa'i skus rkyang ban nam mkha' rdzong du dgon nas lha khang gsar du bskrun par mdzad pa der bkur bsti chen pos spyan drangs zhag shas bzhugs par phur pa yang gsang bla med kyi don dbang dang lung / 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang dang rin 'byung nas rjes gnang thor bu/ dwags po seng lam bla sgrub kyi spung khrid/ rje nyid kyi zhal gdam gsung mgur thor bu sogs rtsal/ brag dkar rta sor phebs skabs gdan sa ba dge slong ye shes chos grags pas gsol btab par gar dbang snying sos byams sprin gtsug lag khang gi rten gtso rnam snang gi thugs ka nas spyan drangs pa'i thugs rje chen po pad+ma rgyal ba'i sgrub skor zab tig chos dbyings rang gsal gyi dbang lung khrid gsum yongs su rdzogs pa gnang / 'di pas 65

bskul po zhus ngor zab tig gi brgyud 'debs zhig kyang mdzad/ yang zab dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi dbang lung yongs rdzogs/ gter gsar thugs rje chen po bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi khrid bcas stsal nas ling ba brag dmar rdzong du phebs/ gser bzang sprul pa'i skur 'ja' tshon pa'i drag dmar gyi dbang sogs kha shas gnang ste kha la brgyud dpal khud chos sding du phebs/ der bzhugs ring gser bzang sprul sku sogs bla ma mang zhig la/ thugs rje chen po bde gshegs kun 'dus zhi khro nges don snying po / bka' 'dus snying po yid bzhin nor bu/ gar dbang rdo rje'i thugs rje chen po rtsa gsum snying thig bla ma yang tig zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol gyi dbang dang so so'i lung phyag chen lhan skyes dang lnga ldan gyi khrid/dpal dges pa rdo rje'i dbang bzhi bde mchog lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang sogs du ma zhig gnang nas la stod rgyal gyi shrī lha gdong gi gnas su phebs/ der bzhugs skabs spo rong rje dbon nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mngon dga' chos sder rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che dang man khang yig drug chos kyi 'khor lo gsar du skrun pa'i dkar nag bskul ma zhus ngor bka' rtsom bskyangs so/ /de yang slob dpon chen pos lha sras mu khri btsan po sor mang yul gung thang du gsungs pa'i gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun grub ma'i man ngag bcu gsum dgong gter yin bzhin nor bu ni dus ring mo zhig nas dag pa ye shes kyi gzigs ngor sangs rgyas gnyis patshoslob dpon chen po'i sku'i snang ba dngos su bstan te byin rlabs dngos grub kyi mtshan ma lan gcig ma yin par dag snang snga phyi rim pa lan grangs drug tsam gyi bar du byung ba 'di skabs yig char bkod par dgongs tshe lo paṇa chos rje sngags 'chang pad+ma dbang drag nas mnga' ris paṇa chen pad+ma dbang rgyal gyi gter byon rig 'dzin yongs 'dus lugs bsam pa lhun grub ma'i zhal thang zhig 'bul bar mdzad pa rten 'brel zab mo 'grig de nas bu le gangs dkar gyi ngogs su bzhugs skabs dpe shog tu 'bebs par dgongs kyang dus la ma babs pa'i mtshan ma byung ste re zhig 'jog par mdzad/ gnas der rnal 'byor dbang phyug kun bzang klong grol sogs la smin grol gyi gdams pa dang zhal gdams kyang stsal lo/ /dgung lo so lnga pa yongs 'dzin te chu byi lo slob dpon chen po'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas chen zang zang lha drag dang / ri bo bkra bzang gi gnas rten rnams mjal bar thegs/ rtsa ba gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub nyams bzhes dang bstan 'gro'i rgud pa zhi zhing phan bde'i gsos sman du gyur pa'i rten 'brel sgrig phyogs dang gtor tshogs mchod sprin thugs smon
