rgya cher bskyangs/ skabs 'dir bse ston rig pa 'dzin pa kun bzang ye shes zhes rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i nang mtshan dran pa nam mkha' yang srid du lung gi zin pa gang de yab sras la gsang chen smin grol gyi gdam pa spyi dang / khyad par bstan gnyis gling pa'i rdzogs chen yang tig dang / byang gter zab lam bde stong 66

rgya mtsho'i skor sogs chig rgyud du bzhugs pa du ma zhig kyang rtsal/ thugs sras kyi thu bor chos bsngags shing gzengs bstod par mdzad do/ /'di dus mang yul skyid grong dngos grub phug tu rje khams lung pa rigs 'dzin dbang rgyal zhabs dag zhing du gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs rten 'bul 'byor bar thugs rje bskul ba'i smon lam dmigs gsal bka' rtsom dang / gdung rten la mchod 'bul/ ri bo bkra bzang gi sgrub sder zhag bdun gyi dge rgyun sbyor 'jags su mdzad/ lha brag tu bcad rgya la bzhugs pa'i tshe sngar gyi dgongs gter de nyid bka' rgya grol ba'i ltas kyang byung bar snang zhing / de'i dgun la stod lho bram so bsam rdzong du phebs nas skal ldan gyi thugs sras 'ga' zhig la chos sgo cung zad dbye bar mdzad/don gnyer 'ga' la byang gter thugs sgrub yang tig gces sgron gyi khrid sogs zab chos mang bar stsal/de'i brgyud 'debs mdzad do/ /dgung lo so drug pa bag yod de chu glang lor phal cher la stod lho byang du bzhugs/ gtsang stod gye re dgon du khro phu ba lo chen bstan 'dzin dbang po'i dngos slob ma hā lo tsā ba ngag dbang bkra shis rnam rgyal zhes dus theg der sdeb sbyor/ sgra snyan rtsis dkar nag g.yul rgyal sogs tha snyad kyi gtsug lag gzhung lugs du ma la mkhas pa'i rtser son pa de nyid kyi spyan sngar yang byon/brda' sprod dbyangs can sgra mdo'i gzhung la cung zad sbyongs pa'i tshul tsam gnang skabs rtsol ba med par myur du thugs su chud pa na slob dpon nyid kyang thugs lhag par 'phrog par gyur cing kun bshad kyi mtshan kyang / ngag dbang dbyangs can grub pa'i rdo rjer gsol/ mtshan ston du brda' sprod dbyangs can mdo gzhung ston byed bla ma brgyud par gsol 'debs dbyangs can dgyes pa'i snyan glu zhes pa dang /snyan dngags kyi brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa rab tu dga' ba'i tam bu ra zhes pa bka' rtsom gnang / sgra'i bstan bcos zhig kyang mdzad 'dug pa 'phro can du lus/ snyan dngags me long ma'i gzhung le'u gsum pa'i bshad pa/ khyad par rtsis rig skor la gdul bya gzhan dag blo gros kyi 'jug sgo yangs por dkri ba'i phyir cung zad sbyongs ba'i tshul gnang mod/ 'on kyang gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir yongs su grags pa ni grwa mda' phug pa'i lugs gtso bor grags shing / gzhan yang dus kyi 'khor lo dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje gdan bzhi sogs kyi dgongs don rgyud rtsis su grags pa las 'o ma bsrub pa'i snying po bzhin thun mong ma yin pa'i rang bzhed rgyud rtsis gtso bor ston pa skar rtsis kyi man ngag gces bsdus grub rtsis kun mdzes nor bu'i me long zhes pa'i bstan bcos rtsa ba dang yan lag gi yig cha 'ga' zhig kyang mdzad par rig 'dzin grub rtsis su grags/ de skabs dngos slob mdo khams pa lo ri sprul pa'i sku chos kyi rgya mtsho/ spo rong dge slong karma dbang rgyal/ ding ri ba 'phrin las rab rgyas sogs kyi spel bas grags che yang / deng sang ni re gnyis las gzhan du rgyun mi snang ngo / /dgung lo so bdun pa 67

kun dga' ste shing stag lo dpal khud dpal mo chos sding du rdor 'dzin phug pa kun bzang rig 'dzin dbang po la 'jigs bral chen pa'i thugs bcud zab gsal gyi lta khrid dang / rje dbon nam mkha' dpal bzang la sgam po pa'i seng lam bla sgrub kyi khrid rtsal zhing bskul ba po'i ngor brgyud 'debs kyang mdzad/ 'jigs bral chen po'i gzim chung dpal 'dzom du sku gdung mchod rten gser 'bum la bstod smon gyi tshigs bcad can gyi snyan shal bzang gos yug kha dog sna lnga pa dang / dpal dbyangs can dga' bar bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa bsam 'phel dbang gi tshom bu zhes pa mdzad/ de nas la stod byang ru lag grom pa rgyang yon po lung du bzhugs shing de dus dgongs gter dag snang bsam lhun ma'i man ngag de bzhin yig char gtan la 'bebs par mdzad/ gu ru rin po che'i bstod pa rgyas pa grub mtha' nges pa'i snying po theg chen bstan bcos rgya mtsho'i sgra dbyangs rgyun mi chad pa rin po che'i gter mdzod sogs 'ga' zhig kyang gsung rtsom gnang / 'di skabs kyang mang mkhar bsam 'grub rdzong nas 'dar pa mi rje mchog gi zab chos 'ga' zhig gsan/ ru lag 'bras spungs su yang phebs cing rje kun bzang dbang po'i spyan sngar smin grol man ngag gi 'phros 'ga' zhig gsan/ de nas gangs ri'i khrod kyi sham+bha la ri khrod chen mo jo nang du phebs/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i ljags bsnyen gzhung bzhin gnang / kun mkhyen dol po pa shes rab rgyal mtshan dang / rje btsun dam pa tā ra nā tha'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas/ dad 'dus ches mang bar jo lugs kyi chos bka' dbang lung man ngag mang du stsal zhing gtsug lag khang dang sku 'bum chen por nyams gsos mchod 'bul rgya cher mdzad do/ /'di skabs zhig grub thob brgyad bcu rtsa bzhi'i bri yig jo nang rje btsun dam pas mdzad pa dngos ma zhig lha khang zhig gi phyag dar nyal nyil khrod nas sne cung zad chud zos pa zhig rnyed par mdzad pa de nyid gzhir bzhag pa'i grub brgya'i bri yig legs bshad gser thur zhes pa'ang mdzad do/ /sngon rje btsun tār nā tha'i rtsa ba'i bla ma chos sku lha dbang grags pa'i bste gnas brag stod chos sku'i pho brang du grags par bzhugs/ der bkra bzang ba zhabs drung kun bzang ye shes/ lho pha drug rab bzhi sngags 'chang pad+ma 'gyur med/ lha rtse 'og smin gling gi chos sde'i grangs chen bco brgyad bco brgyad 'dzin pa'i rab 'byams pa pad+ma rig 'dzin sogs skal ldan mang por zab gter rgya cher stsal/ bram po bsam rdzong du phebs nas thugs sras 'ba' ra sprul sku ngag dbang ye shes/ pos lnga chos sde'i bla ma kun bzang dngos grub bzang po sogs la 'khor lo sdom pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje jo nang lugs kyi dbang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du stsal/ gzhan yang dad 'dus 'ga' la chos bka' lung khrid sogs rgya cher gnang / 'di skabs bka' brgyud phyag chen gdam pa ji ltar gsan tshul gyi gsan yig rtogs brjod legs bshad rin chen 'byung khungs kyang bka' rtsom gnang 68

ngo / /dgung lo so brgyad pa srin po zhes ste shing yos lo sbas yul 'bras mo ljong gi byang phyogs zar gting skyes 'bri mtshams gsang sngags ri bor byon/ 'jam dbyangs ye shes rgya mtshor 'khrungs pa'i sngon gnas rjes dran gyis phyogs der bstan 'gro'i don rgya cher mdzad cing snga 'gyur gyi rnal 'byor pa blo bzang snyan grags rab brtan gyi bskul ngor lta bsgoms spyod pa'i zhal gdam rin chen mdzod 'dzin gsungs/ de nas g.yas ru byang mdog gzhung du byon/ chos lung byang rtse sogs gnas dgon rnams dang / 'jad gzhung gi gnas brten rnams mjal bar thegs/ dpal ldan sding du sngon khro phu lo tsā ba'i bla ma gru ston chen po'i thugs dam rten phyag rdor sku brnyan byin rlabs can der snyan shal dang / 'phags yul du ha ra'i ral gri bzang po zhig spyan gzigs su phul bar mdzad/ shang ltag snar phebs nas 'ba' ra sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang ye shes/lang 'gro dkon mchog 'byung gnas kyi gdung las byon pa'i snga 'gyur bstan pa'i gsal byed rta nag sgrol phug pa pad+ma kun gsal/ bkra bzang pa chen po kun bzang ye shes/ snga sor skyid grong rdzong 'dzin lcags sprag sde pa nges par 'byung bas sdom rtson rnal 'byor spyod par gyur pa'i dge slong kun bzang gzhan phan sogs skal ba can gyi snod ldan chos sras dag la dgongs gter dag snang bsam pa lhun grub ma'i man ngag zhib rgyas thugs kyi snog chos gdam pa'i nying khu bdud rtsi'i bcud lhug par stsal ba zhal slob so so'i zhal lung gi zin ris kyang mdzad skad/ zab phu lung du yang re zhig bzhugs shing rdzogs pa chen po klong gsal mkha' 'gro snying thig gi dbang lung khrid sogs snga phyir zab chos smin cing grol ba'i rgyun bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig stsal bar mdzad/ 'di dus zab phu mo 'tshor gnyen gyi brag phug nas gnam lcags kyi rdo rje sogs gsang gter 'ga' zhig kyang bzhes par mngon/gtsang gi zha lu ri phug dang / ri ril gyi chos sder phebs/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin chen grub kyi bzhugs khri'i steng nas dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sder chos 'brel dang / khyad par dus kyi 'khor lo'i zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sbyor ba yan lag drug gi khrid sogs 'ga' zhig stsal bar mdzad do/ /dgung lo so dgu pa me zhes pa me 'brug lo phal cher gtsang zab phu dang sog po sogs su bzhugs shing / dres sprul pa'i sku 'jam dbyangs pad+ma 'jigs bral sogs skyes bu mchog gyur du ma dang dad 'dus mang por zab rgyas kyi gdam pa du ma gsungs/ lha khud rje drung la/ lam 'bras rgyu dbang sogs dang / thos bsam gling mkhan por lam 'bras yongs su rdzogs pa lan gsum gyi bar dang / zha lu ba zur 'chad pa'i slob dpon zhig las rtsod dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa chen po bu ston lugs kyi chos skor yongs rdzogs gsan par snang ngo / /rong dkar po cog tu pha tre bo rin po che'i gdung rten sku 'bum bzhengs par mdzad cing rab tu gnas pa brgya phrag tsam gyis byin phabs/ dkar po chos lung du nam snying thugs sprul tsa rir pa'i 69

dbon brgyud las byon pa bla ma pad+ma tshe dbang la rta phyag khyung gsum gyi dbang lung man ngag sogs gnang / gu ru'i sgrub gnas g.yas ru lhang lhang brag gi 'dabs/ khams bu lung gi mtsho rgyal phug tu bzhugs skabs gangs ri'i khrod 'dir 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i bskyed rdzogs kyi lam rim dmar khrid du grags pa'i chu bo mtha' dag rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog zhabs la 'dus shing de las rim par brgyud pa'i smar khrid chu bo kun 'dus yi dam rab 'byams la 'jug pa'i spyi khrid legs bshad nyung ngu rab gsal dngos grub 'dod 'byung rin chen za ma tog zhes pa bka' rtsom gnang / de nas sngon gyi sku phreng gi rab tu bzhugs pa rigs pa'i gter chen kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel gyi ring lugs 'dzin pa'i gtsang rong 'bras yul skyed mo'i tshal du phebs/ sde snod 'dzin pa mkhyen rab bstan pa dar rgyas la sogs pa'i lung rigs smra ba du mas gsol ba btab par dbang khrid lung sogs rgya cher rtsal nas snye mor 'jig rten mig gcig lo chen bai ro tsa na'i sgrub phug tu re zhig bzhugs skabs gangs can ljongs 'dir 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi rnal sprul ris su ma chad pa'i skyes chen mtha' dag la bstod pa pad dkar rgyas pa zhes pa gsung rtsom gnang / rong chos gter gling gi 'od mchog sprul pa'i sku skal bzang 'jigs med lhun grub la thugs bzhed ltar bka' chos kyi rim pa du ma zhig dang / bon lung pa dpal 'byor tshul khrims kyi yang srid gar dbang blo bzang tshul khrims dpal 'bar la'ang bzhed chos mang du stsal lo/ /'di skabs kyang gtsang gi zha lu ri sbug tu mchod 'bul dang / der bzhugs bshes gnyen 'dus pa'i tshogs la chos bka' mang zhig stsal/ zha lu mthil gyi chos sder yang mchod 'bul dang lha mo rdo rje rab bstan mar snyan shal bstod rtsom kyang gnang / zha lu ba dge slong 'jam dpal chos dar gyi bskul ba zhus bzhin mi dbang chen por rje nyid kyi snyan 'bul zhu ba gnang ba'i bka' 'gyur yongs rdzogs sbyor 'jags dang / dge slong gi dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal sbyar bar smon lam bka' rtsom kyang stsal/ myang stod rtsis gnas gsar gyi lha khang sogs gnas gzigs dang grub pa'i bste gnas ra lung mthil du re zhig bzhugs/ rim gyis phyogs bral gyi gdul bya skyongs bzhin par lcags zam chu bo ri'i rtser phebs/rnam 'dren bstan 'dzin rin po che'i sprul pa'i sku skal bzang pad+ma chos ldan la sogs pa'i skal bzang snod ldan mang por zab lam gyi gsung gi bdud rtsi mang du stsal/ skabs 'dir pho brang chen po po tā la'i rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi dge slong blo bzang pad+ma bstan 'dzin dang / dbang phyug rgyal mtshan gnyis la rdzogs pa chen po'i zab khrid stsal zhing khong rnam gnyis kyi bskul ba po zhus ngor rdzogs chen yang gsang bla med nam mkha' gsum gyi nyams len bdud rtsi thig le zhes pa mdzad/ de nas stod lung tshur mdo'i sa yi char shang pa bka' brgyud pa'i brgyud pa rin po che bdun gyi gras grub thob chen po dbon ston skyer sgang pa 70

chos kyi seng ge'i thugs dam 'bul sa la zhig gzos gnang ste grub pa'i bste gnas chen po mtshur gyi garnyo lar phebs so/ /de yang snga sor mtshur mdo'i yang rtse gu ru rin po che'i grub gnas dang de'i rjes dus gsum mkhyen pa sogs dpal karma pa rim par byon pas bste gnas su mdzad pa pad+ma khyung rdzong du rje 'di nyid bzhugs skabs shig nyams kyi 'od gsal la lung bstan gyi tshul 'di skad ces/ o rgyan rdo rje'i bka' ni mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshig brdas bskul ba/ /'thung spyod dang mtshungs srid pa'i rdul dkar thod bcings na bun can/ /chu klung me yi phyogs dag rgyu zhing rkang 'thung mtshams par gnas/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad drug dang / slar yang dge ri gzhung ri'am nye ba'i phyogs na 'byor pas ches dben cing —/ rigs rus rnam dag dge la brtson zhing de na karma ka zhes sogs gsal bar byung ba'i rgyu mtshan kun mkhyen si tu la 'bul bar mdzad cing / ji ltar lung gis gsal ba bzhin skabs der mi bskyod rgyal ba'i cod paṇa can karma ka bcu gsum pa'i snang brnyan bag mdo chu glang khrums zla'i yar tshes su gnyal smad dge ri'i yul du sku 'khrungs/ shing stag lo rje nyid kyi bkas zham ring pa skyid grong la ldebs pa kun bzang 'jigs bral rab gsal zhes phyogs 'dir sgom chen 'jigs bral du grags pa de nyid la karma pa gang du sku bltam pa'i yul gyi bkod pa/ khang khyim/ yab yum dang sras kyi ji byad tshul 'di lta bu'o zhes gdams pa ste bya bral 'byor par brdzu ba'i zol gyis phyin pa na 'khrul pa med par ngos zin te mtshur phur gtam snyan gyi dga' ston rgya cher spel/ me 'brug lor mtshur phu'i dbu che gra zur dpon slob dang sngon gyi gsol gzim mgron bcas byon te slar yang ngos 'dzin zhib thems kyis gtan la phab nas me 'brug lo zhal gsar du tshes pa'i rgyal ba dang po la 'og min mtshur gyi garnyo la chen po'i 'jigs med seṅge'i khri chen por mnga' gsol ba ste de'i tshul ni rags tsam zhig rgyal ba'i dbang po karma pa bcu gsum bdud 'dul rdo rje rang nyid kyi zhal gsung bka' 'bum las kyang 'byung ba ltar ro/ /de nas lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po rten dang brten par bcas pa la mchod pa'i sprin bzang po rgya cher spros shing bstan 'gror phan bde'i thugs smon rgya cher bskyangs/ 'di skabs mi dbang chen po pho lha ba bsod nams stobs kyi rgyal pos kyang mi phyed pa'i gus pa chen pos bskur bstes mchod nas chos 'brel gyi rim pa dang rkyen sel zhi rgyas kyi rim gro dag kyang zhu ba gnang / khyad par bstan srid dang dus kyi bde sdug sogs lung bstan gnang dgos par gsang stabs kyis nan btur chen pos zhu yig phul ba'i lan du 'di skad ces/ rgyal dbang pad+ma'i ring lugs la/ /mchog gus las skal ldan pa yis/ /lugs gnyis mkhyen pa'i dpal rgyas pa/ /mi dbang chen po'i zhabs drung du/ /deng dus snyigs ma'i rang shugs kyis/ /dam sri 'gong po rtsal rgyas pa'i/ /bod khams bde ba 'phrog pa la/ /mi mchog dpyod ldan thugs re 71

skyo/ /spyi yang sum cu kha ral gyi/ /dus kyi tshad ni gsum brgya ste/ /gcig ni dge ba can gyi dus/ /gnyis ni karma mdangs chen 'od/ /gsum ni mi bde chol bur 'khrugs/ /des na deng dus gsum par slebs/ /stod hor dag kyang 'phyo yang nyes/ /de rtags bya mtsho brag tu 'gyur/ /dmar po ri la srin bya 'bab bsam yas kha dog gser gyi bsgyur/ /byang chub chen po srog zhu bgo/ /gzugs med lha 'dre swo sgra 'byin/ /lha sar bud med ltas ngan skye/ /hor gyi dgra lha ngag bcad bzhugs/ /has po ri la lha khang brtsegs/ /khra 'brug rlung gi shing chen bsnyil/ /mi kun sbas yul yid smon byed/ /de sogs spyi yi dus rtags dang / /bye brag stod hor 'byung nges rtags/ /mkha' nas mi sdug sgra skad ni/ /'jigs su rung bas skye bo dngangs/ /lo brag phyogs su ri bo snyil/ /sbyor 'gar nang 'khrugs gsum du gyes/ /bod kyi lha gnyen gangs ri zhu/ /bstan ma bcu gnyis zhal ngo nag /de tshe stod hor cis kyang 'byung / /'on kyang bzlog mkhan skyes bu mi// /bai ro'i sprul pas rtse lnga'i gter/ /thon na bod yul drug bcur bde/ /nam snying sprul pas lho brag gter/ /thon na mi lo lnga bcu bde/ /khye'u chung sprul pas ti se'i gter/ /thon na mi lo bzhi bcu bde/ /gung btsan sprul pas dpal 'bar gter/ /thon na nyer lnga bde bar gsungs/ /klu dbang skye bas phya yi gter/ /thon na nyi shu rtsa gcig bde/ /de kun rten 'brel ma 'grig shing / /bstan pa'i spyi rim ma brtson na/ /bcu phrag gcig dang bdun tshun la/ /nges par stod hor dmag nye g.yo/ /spyi rim byed na deng dus 'gal/ /'on kyang dam sri kha zab pas/ /dus rim phyi shol 'gyur bar nges/ /de dag phyi tshul tho tsam dang / /bye brag zur gsal yig chung ngu //nyid dang rdo rje'i dam tshig gcig /thugs nang gtsang phyir 'bul ba las/ /ding dus 'di 'dra smra ba dka'//drang por bzhag pa'i thig skud 'di/ /yon por gyur pa'i sems la gzan/ /de ltar dus lung snying gi gtam/ /phran bu rigs sngags 'dzin pa yis/ /lha dar rten dang bcas te phul/ /zhes pa rtsal lo de ltar lung gi bstan pa'i don rags rim zhig rjes dpag gi brnyad na/ phyir dus kyi tshad sum cu kha ral gyi nges pa kha cig sna tshogs zhig smra yang / /'dir ni slob dpon chen pos rtsod bral gyi gter lung mang po nas gsung shing khyad par deng sang ni sum cu kha ral nyi shu kha du sleb pa'i dus so/ /zhes kyang thos so/gong pa'i dus rtags rnams kyang gzhan rnams go sla zhing skabs de dang de dag snga phyi ci rigs par mngon sum pa'i spyod yul khyur nar gor ma chag /hor gyi dgra lha ngag bcad bzhugs pa ni dpe har rgyal po ste/ rgyal mchog lnga pa chen po'i sku dus skabs kyang sku dngos hrib tsam re khog zhugs lung bstan sogs nges gsal byung 'dug kyang phyis rim gyis gzugs can gyi khog tu rlam pa'i lung zhu'i rgyun chad pa der snang /mtha' dmag phyir sring ba'i skyes bu/ bai ro'i sprul pas rtse lnga'i gter/ zhes pa rdo rje gling pa'i gter zhabs rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar yod pa gter bdag gling pas thon na bod yul mi lo drug cu'i bar bde bar 72

gsungs pa gnas dus kyi skal bas byon ma thub pa'i tshul gter chen nyid kyi nang gsang gi rnam thar du yang gsal ba ltar ro/ /nam snying sprul pas lho brag gi gter thon na mi lo lnga bcur bde bar gsung pa rje 'di nyid la lho brag gnam skas mkhar chu'i zab gter bzhes rgyu' bka' babs lung bstan yod kyang dus gnad rten 'brel chugs pas don du ma gyur pa'i tshul 'og tu yang 'chad la/ gung btsan sprul pas dpal 'bar gyi gter thon na bod yul lo nyer lnga bde bar gsung pa chos rgyal khri srong gi chos blon 'gos pad+ma gung btsan gyi zlos gar yol mo sprul sku bstan 'dzin nor bus mang yul ri bo dpal 'bar gyi zab gter 'don pa'i kha byang lde mig rgyang yon po lung nas gter nas bzhes zhing lung bstan kyang byung rung gzhan rkyen gyi dus las yol te phyag tu ma son/ khye'u chung sprul pas ti se'i gter dang / klu dbang skye bas phya yi gter gsung ba re zhig cha ma 'tshal bas brjod par ma nus kyang de gnyis kyang rten 'brel ma 'grig pa 'dra zhing / de ltar gter ston rnams kyi zab gter bzhes rgyu dus las yol ba dang /bod kyi bstan srid spyi rim kyang g.yol bar gyur pas me 'brug 'di nas rtsis pa'i lo bcu bdun gyi mtshams rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu bya lor mnga' ris mar yul la dgas rgyal po nang 'khrugs pa'i stod hor gyi dmag gi dpung chen po drangs te bod yul gyi phan bde gzhoms par gdon mi za bar gyur pa de'i tshe rje 'di nyid kyis thugs rje'i byin gyis tu ru ska'i dmag dpung rang gnas su bzlog pa'i tshul yongs su grags shing zhib par 'og tu 'chad par spyir dus lung gi nges pa 'di dag kyang kha cig kun slong ngan pa bag la zha bas rnying ma ba tshos rdzun zog rang rang phyogs re'i rmongs zhen gyis byas par mthong ba'i log rtog gi ngan smras dag sgrog par byed mod/ 'dir ni tshad ma'i lung dang gtan tshigs bzang pos sgrub tu rung ba'i rgyu mtshan gleng bar 'os kyang yi ges 'jigs pas ma spros la gzhan du 'chad par 'dod do/ /'di dus phur bu cog gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po bla ma byams pa rin po che yang mi dbang chen po'i dbu blar bzhugs pas nyin gcig bzhugs gral zhig gi thog g.yas g.yon gyi gral dbur bzhugs gdan gnye 'bol gsol cog sogs 'dra mnyam du byas pa so sor bla ma rnam gnyis bzhugs su gsol bar gsol dpon yang so sor bskos te gsol ja sogs dus mnyam du zhu ba dang /gung gral du mi'i dbang po rang nyid bzhugs te gral 'phros sogs med par rnal yul ba'i zol gyis bzhugs/ rten gyi gtso bor slob dpon chen po'i sku tshab khyad 'phags zhig bzhugs yod 'dug par skabs zhig bla ma byams pa rin po che'i gsung nas/ bla ma khams pa/ gu ru pad+ma'i sku 'di la bstod pa zhig rtsom pa mdzod/ ces gsung bar de ma thag rje nyid nas/ gu ru rin po cher ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis dang tshul mtshungs par rnam par thar pa rnams gu ru mtshan brgyad dang mdzad pa 73

bcu gnyis kyi tshul du bsdus te rgyun chags kyi tshigs su bcad pa tshig don rgyan gyis spud pa phun sum tshogs pa zhig chu 'babs su mdzad pa'i sbyar byang du/ tshul 'di mkhas pa'i mkhas pa byams pa'i mtshan gyis gsung gi bskul ba'i ngor/ zhes sogs yod pa zhig mdzad do/ /skabs 'dir gtsang dga' ldan phun tshogs gling gi dge 'dun 'dus tshogs la mang ja'i thebs su dngul srang lnga bcu rtsa bzhi la nem pā la gyi di nar sum brgya drug cu dang / gtsug lag khang gi rten gtso jo bo phyogs las rnal rgyal shākya mu ne dang /gzhal yas khang gi dus 'khor blos blang / bde ba can gyi ye shes mchod rten/ 'bras spungs dpal reg pa med pa'i mchod rten bcas kyi drung du dus bzang dmigs gsal du mar mchod me'i sbyor 'jags thebs su nem m+bha la yi di nar drug cu rtsa gsum/ dus 'khor gyi sgrub mchod cho ga lo lo bzhin chag med 'dzugs pa'i sbyor 'jags su dngul srang brgya tham pa ste bre chen gnyis/ de'i rjes thu pa mi dbang chos kyi rgyal po'i sras byang chub sems dpa' tho pa la chi gung sku zhabs nas dngul srang lnga bcu thams pa ste dngul bre chen gcig chos rje kun bzang dbang por rje nyid kyi bka' chos gsan skabs snga phyi bar du chos yon spong dag 'bul ba mang du mdzad pa rnams sdom dngul srang brgya dang lnga bcu dngul bre chen gsum 'bul bar mdzad pa de kun khyon dril dngul bre chen drug nem pā la di nar stong phrag gnyis kyi rtsis ldan 'dri ba med nges pa sbyor bar mdzad pa'i deb gsal kyang bka' rtsom gnang ba da lta'i bar yang rgyun 'jags su mchis so/ /de nas zhang 'gro ba'i mgon po'i gdan sa tshal gung thang du phebs/ chu bzang sprul pa'i sku 'jam dbyangs chos 'phel sogs la byang gter thugs sgrub yang tig gces sgron gyi khrid dang / rta mgrin lcags ral can gyi dbang lung sogs dang / 'ba' ra sprul sku ngag dbang ye shes sogs la/ sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang / pha mo sgom drug gi khrid sogs rtsal/ gong zhabs bdun pa rgyal dbang skal bzang rgya mtsho'i zhabs ring 'phyong rgyas ri bo bde chen gyi mkhan po sde snod 'dzin pa chen po bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dang / rtse ba'i mgron gnyer rjes su bka' blon mdzad pa rdza pag bla ma nyi ma rgyal mtshan nas chos bka' 'ga' zhig gsan par mdzad cing 'di nyid kyi zhus ngor nai gu'i phyag chen ga'u ma'i khrid yig bdud rtsi'i thig pa zhes pa'ang mdzad/ 'gro mgon zhang gi sku 'dra rin po che dang / lha chen dpal 'bar/ sku 'bum sogs su mchod 'bul spros/ brag yer par zla shas bzhugs shing ri khrod nyi ma lding du rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po'i ring lugs dri ma med pa'i bshad sgrub snyan brgyud 'dzin pa mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs dgyes pa'i rdo rje las/ gsang bde 'jigs gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang dang / gsang 'dus rim lnga/ bde mchog sbas don kun gsal gyi bshad lung sogs dge ldan skor mang zhig gsan/ bde mchog gi rgyud kyi bshad pa byung tshul kyang bka' rtsom gnang / phan yul nā len+d+rar bco 74

brgyad chos rje'i sprul pa'i skur thugs bzhed ltar gyi dbang lung zab chos 'ga' zhig stsal/ de nas 'bri khung du phebs nas gnas gzigs dang / 'bri khung sprul pa'i sku dkon mchog chos kyi rgyal por phyag chen lnga ldan gyi khrid rgyun dang / do ha skor gsum rtsa 'grel gyi lung sogs gsan/ phar yang zab chos 'ga' zhig 'bul bar mdzad/ rim par ti gro/ dbu ru rgyud shar phyogs kong yul nags ma'i ljongs chen por phebs so/ /dgung lo bzhi bcu pa dmar ser can te me sbrul lor kong po rgya mda' yi yul bā na dz+wa la tsakra 'khor lo 'bar ba'i nags su byon/ gter ston sangs rgyas gling pas bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i kyi chos skor gdan drangs pa'i gter gnas su ri rin chen 'bar bar bzhugs shing / long po gying gi zhal ngo nyang rje rtsad po'i rigs gyur bstan 'dzin 'brug grags yab sras kyi bskul ngor bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi dbang khrid lung gsum stsal zhing de'i brgyud 'debs sogs mdzad/ ljon pa lung gi nye 'dabs myugs kyi ri khrod chos nyid 'od gsal gyi pho brang du grub dbang kun bzang rang grol bde chen rab gsal las bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi chos skor sngar ma gsan pa dang skyar zhu khyad par snying po rdzogs chen gser gyi yang zhun gyi smin khrid gsan skabs thun mong sngon 'gro'i ngag 'don khrigs chags dang / rgyun khyer bdud rtsi'i thigs pa zhes pa yang mdzad/ snga sor mdo khams su bzhugs skabs ljon pa lung nas zab gter bzhes rgyu yod pa'i kha byang phyag tu son kyang gnad byang ma byung bas spu bor sngon ma phebs skabs dus la ma babs pas kong yul du phebs rtsis bshol/ skabs 'dir dus gnad rten 'brel 'grig pas ar+sā tā re ra ga'i mdangs can ma'i sgrub thabs gsang ba'i lung byang dang bcas pa/ bla ma drag po bde gshegs yongs 'dus tī la ya'i man ngag zab gter las bzhes shing chos bdag skal ldan gyi skyes bus gsol ba btab pa'i ngor dkar shog tu yang 'bebs par mdzad/ gsang ba'i lung byang gi don zab gter 'di'i dus skabs dgos don gyi rgyu mtshan brjod du yod mod kyang 'dir 'bri bar mi 'os pa ni gshis lugs so/ /de nas slar yang gnyal nas brgyud dbus 'gyur gyi ljongs su skyod/ g.yo ru khra 'brug bkra shis byams ngos kyi gtsug lag khang chen por mchod sprin rgya cher bstar/ khyad par shel brag pad+ma rtsegs pa'i gu ru'i sgrub phug tu zab don gyi bcad rgya la re zhig bzhugs/ 'di skabs thugs dam gyi thun seng skabs ci rigs su rje btsun tā ra nā thas mdzad pa'i ne gu chos drug gi khrid yig chen mo zab don thang mar gdal ba ma bu'i dgongs don gcig tu bsdus pa'i snying po gdan thog gcig tu sgril nas nyams su len pa'i man ngag yang zab bcud kyi thig le zhes pa mdzad/ mkha' 'gro ltas dang cho 'phrul rgyun mi chad par byung bas gnyan la byin rlabs chen po yod pa'i nges shes skyes gsungs/ gangs ri'i khrod kyi pad+ma 'od o rgyan smin grol gling du phebs/ gtsug lag khang rnams la gnas gzigs dang / khri 75

chen rin chen rnam par rgyal ba dang / rje btsun mi 'gyur dpal sgron bcas la rdzogs chen sems sde/klong sde/ man ngag gi sde/ yang gsang bla med snying thig gnyis kyi dbang khrid lung gsum sogs bzhed pa bzhin 'bul bar mdzad/ khri rin po cher yang rdzogs chen gyi skor 'ga' zhig dang tshe dbang bcas gsan/dpal gyi zan yang mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po rten dang brten par bcas pa la kun tu bzang po'i smon lam la 'gran pa'i mchod 'bul thugs smon rgya cher bskyangs nas gangs can dbus 'gyur sa yi lte ba lha ldan rdo rje'i gdan du jo shāka rnam gnyis sogs khyad 'phags kyi rten rnams la gong bzhin gyi mchod 'bul thugs smon dang / sa chen chos bzhin skyongs ba mi'i dbang phyug chen por mjal zhu gnang / stod lung mtshur phur rgyal ba'i dbang po mthon mthing gi cod paṇa can bcu gsum pa bdud 'dul rdo rje sems dpa' mchog gzhon nur gyur pa'i sku can mi 'jigs seṅge'i khri chen por mnga' gsol ba'i 'bul dngos rdog pa ring du bskyangs bar mdzad cing lhan cig shis pa brjod pa'i me tog lha lam gyi khyon 'gengs pa char du brnyil/ slar yang lha ldan du phebs nas mi'i dbang po dang lhan rgyas gnang / sa dbang mchog nas re zhig bod du bzhugs dgos tshul nan gyi zhu ba gnang kyang de skabs kong yul dang spu bo brgyud mdo khams su 'byon rtsis kyi dgongs pa zhu ba mdzad de rim pas dwags la sgam por phebs/ chos kyi rgyal po zla 'od gzhon nu'i gdan sa sgam po bzang lung du rje sgam po'i sku 'dra rin po che dang / gtsug lag khang gi rten gtso la yag pas gzhengs pa'i sku tshab yid bzhin gyi nor bu gsung 'byon mar snyan shal smon tshig rgyas pa can sogs mchod 'bul thugs smon rgyas par mdzad de/rgyud sde rin po che nas yongs su bsngags pa'i gnas chen tsa ri ṭa ye shes kyi 'khor lo'i gnas gzigs su bskyod/ gnas kyi gtso bo dpal ho ru ka rdo rje btsun mo yan lag ma dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo rten brten par bcas pa dang / gzhan yang mtsho dkar sogs shar nub kyi gnas phran yan lag dang bcas pa mtha' dag mjal bar thegs/ mchod 'bul/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo/ gtor chen stong phrag du ma sogs gnang / dag pa rab 'byams kyi gzigs snang 'jam klas pa ji snyed dang ngo mtshar dpag par dka' ba'i gsang ba gsum gyi rol rtsed mtha' yas pa zhig ston par nges kyang gsang ba chen pos dbyings su rgyas btab pas thun mong gi spyod yul du ma gyur te/ dom tshang rong du phebs skabs zhabs drung sgrel phug pa 'gro phan pad+ma kun gsal gyi bskul ba po zhus ngor zhing skyongs chen po 'phrog byed gdong can gyi 'phrin las dpa' bo dgyes pa'i rol mtsho zhes pa bka' rtsom gnang / tshul khang che chung rnams su tshul gtong kyang gnang skabs dag pa'i gzigs snang du ḍāki'i gtso mo dz+nyā na sa mu dra rā dza dngos su byon te skabs 'di dang gzhan dag tu smon lam 'di ltar thon na rung zhes kun bzang pad+ma 76

thod 'phreng ma'i smon tshig gsung ba ding sang yongs su grags pa 'di yin/ 'di tsam las gzhan gzigs snang dang / gsung mgur sogs ji snyed yod par nges kyang yi ger ma 'khod pas gzhan du 'phel ba ni ma byung bar bda'o/ /dgung lo zhe gcig pa dus kyi pho nya zhes pa sa rta lor/ bod yul dbus 'gyur lha ldan du byon te/ ri bo gru 'dzin gyi pho brang chen por rgyal dbang phyag na pad+mo thams cad mkhyen gzigs blo bzang skal bzang rgya mtsho mchog zhabs pad du mjal phyag dang / lha ldan du mi dbang chos rgyal chen por mjal zhu lhan rgyas gnang / jo shāka yid bzhin nor bu mched kyi spyan sngar mchod sprin rgya cher bstar zhing lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor chen mo rgyas pa sngar mdo khams 'bri rgyud re khe yi cha bso lci rong ba gsal gyi gtsug lag khang du mdzad pa de bzhin 'di dus zhus dag gis slar yang gtan la phabs par mdzad de shar phyogs kong yul phyogs su phebs/ tsa gong / tsa nang / gnas gsar sogs mtha' dag mjal bar bskyod nas kong yul nags ma'i ljongs chen por sangs rgyas gnyis pa slob dpon chen po'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas chen gnas phran ji snyed pa'i gnas gzigs dang bstan 'gro'i don du rlabs chen mdzad pa'i 'phrin las 'gog med chu 'babs su skyongs bzhin par slar yang sbas yul spu bo pad+ma bkod kyi gnas che chung rnams su zhabs bskyod/ pad+ma bkod kyi 'dabs klo yul dkar nag gi mtshams sa yi thig le rtag brtan chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi chad pa rin chen de'u yi rtser re zhig bzhugs/dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i sman sgrub chen mo dang / yang zab dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi dbang mchog sogs bstan bcos 'ga' zhig kyang mdzad/ ('ji nas ma yig chad/ )de nas brag gsum gyi mtsho dbus dgyes mdzad bde mchog 'khor lo yi pho brang chen po rdo rje btsun mo'i e klong mngon sum du snang ba'i gnas mchog ngo mtshar du mas brgyan pa'i skyed tshal mtsho ljong rgyal ba'i bsti gnas zhes drag po'i sku brnyan rmad du byung ba'i gtsug lag khang chen por bzhugs shing na rag bskongs bshags chen mo'i chog sgrigs mdzad/ gzhan yang dga' ldan ma mo'i gtsug lag khang du bzhugs skabs gter ston rig 'dzin chos rje gling pa'i sprul skur karma pa bcu gnyis pas ngos 'dzin mdzad pa de la zab chos mang du rtsal zhing / 'di nyid kyi zhus ngor grub pa kun gyi gzhung lam rmad byung ting 'dzin rgyun dbang snying gi bdud rtsi yang dag bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhes pa yang mdzad do/ /dgung lo zhe gnyis pa don grub te sa lug lor kong po nyang kha'i ri khrod grub pa'i bste gnas 'bol chu mig zhes sngon o rgyan gu rus byin gyis brlabs cing / gter ston rig 'dzin chen po 'ja' tshon snying pos yun ring du bzhugs pa'i gnas der re zhig bzhugs skabs sgrol ma maṇ+ḍal bzhi pa'i cho ga rgyas pa 'dod don yongs su grub pa'i ljon shing zhes pa sogs ljags sgrigs 'ga' zhig mdzad/ skabs 'dir dbus 'gyur sa yi lte ba/ pho brang chen po ri bo gru 'dzin du 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo ngur smrig gar gyi rol pa rgyal dbang bdun pa bskal bzang rgya mtshor chab shog mtshams zhu ngang pa'i bu mo'i glu dbyangs dang / lha ldan rgyal khab chen por sa yi tshangs pa mi'i dbang phyug chen po bsod nams stobs kyi rgyal por zhu yig dpyid kyi dpal mos grangs pa'i ko ki la yi glu dbyangs zhes snyan tshig rgyan gyis spud pa dpyod ldan kheng pa 'phrog byed 'bul rten bcas so sor 'bul bar 77

mdzad/gzhan yang de khul gyi gnas phal cher du bzhugs shing / kong yul bon ri zhes bod kyi rgyal po la snga ba lha gnya' khri btsad po 'phrul thag las bab pa'i ri bo lha ri rgyan mtho'i rtse mor phebs/ nges don gyi mdo nyi shu'i dkar chag sogs mdzad do/ /dgung lo zhe gsum pa drag po te lcags spre lor slar yang spu bo pad+ma bkod kyi nub byang mtshams rtag brtan rin chen spungs par bzhugs/ skal ldan gyi 'dus pa mang por gsang chen smin grol gyi chos char phab cing mkha' 'gro bde mchog gi zhing skyongs spyi dang 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga chen po dngos grub bum bzang sogs bstan bcos 'ga' zhig kyang mdzad/ dgung lo zhe bzhi pa blo ngan te lcags bya lor thang 'brog 'od gsal rtse mo zhes rje sna tshogs rang grol gyi gdan sa der bzhugs shing / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che ji ltar gnas gyur dus kyi nges pa rjes su dran pa bskyed pa legs bshad don gsal rin po che'i sgron me sogs bka' rtsom mang du gnang / 'di dang 'brel bar kong yul smad gu ru'i gnas chen lkog phrang gi mdun chu klung chen po ro nyi ta yi 'gram sngon lha btsad po'i yul gtam snyan glang mkhar rdo ring du phebs/ gzhan phan gyi 'phrin las rgya cher bskyangs so/ /dgung lo zhe lnga pa rnga chen te chu khyi lor kong smad rgya la seng gtam dang / rgya la rba gdong gi gnas sogs mjal bar thegs/ de skabs 'jam dpal gyi thugs rten mchod rten brag la rang byung du snang ba'i ngos 'dzin dang / sku'i rten rba gdong dang / gsung gi rten chu klung sngags sgra sgrog pa de gsum 'jam dpal gyi sku gsung thugs kyi rten du grub pa'i dkar chag shugs 'byung rdo rje'i glu mi 'gyur byin rlabs gzi 'bar zhes pa bka' rtsom gnang / de nas nyang kha lhab ri 'od gsal gling du bzhugs/ 'di dus rje btsun 'gro ba'i mgon po 'brug pa thams cad mkhyen pa bka' brgyud 'phrin las shing rta'i sde'i zhal snga nas dang zhal 'dzoms/ zab chos mang du 'bul bar mdzad/ rje 'brug pas bskul ba po zhus ngor bla ma'i rnal 'byor lam zab bdud rtsi'i thig le zhes pa mdzad/ 'brug chos lding du rje 'brug pa rin po cher jo nang lugs dpal dus kyi 'khor lo bdag po dang bdag po chen po'i dbang sogs gsar rnying bka' gter gyi dbang bka' che chung mang po dang / sbyor ba yan lag drug gi khrid/ ne gu chos drug sogs zab khrid du ma dang / gzhan yang zab chos mang du 'bul ba gnang zhing tshur chos yon gyi dus dngos po'i rigs ni gcig kyang ma bzhes par grub thob khyung po rnal 'byor gyi thugs dam rten thub dbang gi gser sku khyad 'phags sogs sku gsung thugs rten gyi gtsos zang zing gi mtshan grangs bcas rje 'brug pa rin po cher zhabs brtan rgyas par 'bul ba gnang / ljon pa klung du bzhugs skabs kun mkhyen 'brug pa rin po ches gsung gi bskul bar/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i bsnyen yig snying po rab gsal/ dus kyi 'khor lo rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka 'jigs byed mkha' 'gro ma yi dra ba sdom pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs mchog gi rdo rje 'od zer kun tu 'bar ba zhes pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin chen grub kyi gsung la tshad ldan gyi gzhung nas kha bskang ba'i ljags sgrigs dang / rdo rje 'jigs mdzad snying po rgyun gyi rnal 78

'byor yid bzhin mchog sbyin dang / sgrub thabs rgyun gyi rnal 'byor snying po/ lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs rin chen rdo rje me 'od kun tu 'bar ba/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rig pa rtsis la 'jug pa'i sngon 'gro'i rim pa rnam grangs mdo bcas rab tu byed pa dri med 'od zer mdzes pa'i rgyan gyi me tog sogs bka' rtso ma dang / rje 'brug pa rin po che'i gnas kyi slob dpon mkhas dbang rin chen rgya mtshor 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i dbang lung khrid sogs gnang zhing / 'di las snyan tshig gi khu 'phrin dang /snyan ngag gi bya dka'i rgyan kun bzang 'khor lo'i brtan bzhugs phul bar de lan chab shog snyan tshig gi lam nas drangs pa rtsal lo/ /dgung lo zhe drug pa khrag skyug te chu phag lo kong yul sa yi thig le sngon chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgom pos bod yul gyi sa gnad me rtsar mtha' 'dul yang 'dul ru gnon bzhi bcas kyi nang mtshan/ bu chu gter gyi gtsug lag khang du 'phags pa bcu gcig zhal gyi snang brnyan byin rlabs can gyi drung du bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor la rten pa'i dam rdzas bdud rtsi sman gyi sgrub chen smin rgyas su mdzad cing 'di dus co ri grub thob yang bzhugs pas lhan rgyas kyi mdzad par grags so/ /dkyil 'khor de'i steng nas dgongs 'dus kyi dbang chen yongs rdzogs dang / pu ste bco brgyad kyi lung dbang sogs rtsal/ lha ri seṅge'i zhol gu ru chen po'i sgrub phug tu re zhig bzhugs/ de'i mdun klu lnga zhes rig 'dzin yol mo pa bstan 'dzin nor bu sku mched sku bltam pa'i yul der bzhugs skabs sngon grub pa'i slob dpon ku ku ri pa dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sgyu 'phrul ku ku'i gzugs can phyogs der phebs cing bsra khregs rdo ba'i ngos la zhabs kyi dkyil 'khor bkod pa'i gsal snang thugs kyi me long du thol byung nyid du shar ba'i mdo la bstod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa sho lo ka lnga pa zhig gsungs/ de phral rtsad gcod gnang bas zhabs rjes kyang mngon sum gzigs shing kun gyi mig ngor gtan la phab par mdzad pas kun ya mtshan dad pa'i zlos gar cir yang bsgyur ro/ /de nas tshangs pa rgyas pa'i bu ro hi ta yi klung g.yas su 'khyil ba'i ngogs bod yul gyi pad+ma rtsegs pa lho kong sa yi thig le gtsang po mgo dgu zhes rje rtse le ba chen po mkhas mchog pad+ma legs grub sku skye na rim gyi gdan sa der yun ring bzhugs shing dgongs 'dus kyi sgrub chen kyang mdzad/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'jig rten khams kyi rnam bzhag go la legs par bshad pa nyung gsal rnam dag kun bzang 'od snang rab tu byed pa dang / klong gsal mkha' 'gro snying thig gi cha lag tshe sgrub rdo rje rgya mdud kyi bdag mdun bskyed bzlas kyi chog sgrigs sogs bka' rtsom mang du mdzad/ bstan 'dzin gyi skyes mchog du ma sogs bskal bzang gi don gnyer 'dus pa mang por shang chos ne gu chos drug gi lung khrid/ rje nyid kyi mdzad pa'i lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor rgyas pa'i khrid/ ma cig rgyal thang ma'i khrid sogs gsar rnying gi dbang lung 79

khrid rgya cher rtsal lo/ /dgung lo zhe bdun pa mig dmar te shing byi lor/ ljon pa lung du bzhugs shing de skabs shig de mo grwa tshang gi spyan drangs/ rje btsun gtsong kha pa chen po nas brgyud pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang chen yongs rdzogs/ sman bla'i mdo chog rgyas bsdus/ dmigs rtse ma'i khrid lung / lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung / byang sdom sogs gnang / snga sor gdong ngan gyi lor ljon lung gi 'dabs rol 'dzeng zhes par 'dzeng mo skyid 'dzom zhes dad 'byor dang ldan pa zhig gi mi ngo rdzogs skabs bsam yas chos skyong chen po pe har gzugs can gyi khog tu rlam nas lung gisamibaskul ba bzhin mo rang gi dbang ris bdag thob pa yul tshangs ma rje nyid la phul ba'i ngo chen du cub ri grub thob dang / 'brug chos sding gi sprul sku sbran zhing / ljon pa lung gi gzhi bdag drag shul can rnams kyis kyang gsol ba btab pa ltar rtsis bzhes/ de yang ljon pa klung de gu ru'i gnas chen zab phu lung dang mtshungs par bsngags pa'i phyir bstan 'gro yongs kyi bde thabs su dgongs/ sgrol ma 'byung ba bla na med pa'i sku brnyan thog tshad ma dang bcas pa'i gtsug lag khang gzhengs par mdzad cing / 'di skabs yongs su rdzogs par grub pa'i rab tu gnas pa rgyas par mdzad skabs rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi dge mtshan mtha' yas pa byung / chu phag gi lo nas sgrub sde 'dzugs par mdzad pa sgrub pa po nyi shu rtsa brgyad lhag pa dang rdo rje slob dpon bsko bzhag gnang ba'i lo lo bzhin smin drug zla ba nas sa ga zla ba'i bar sgo gsum chig sgril gyi cho ga cho spyod khri phrag long pa dang / badz+ra gu ru/ yi ge drug pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yang snying yig drug rnams dung phyur mang po kha bskongs dang bcas pa'i dge ba'i rgyun chen po nyams pa med par rgyun chags su 'dzugs pa mdzad de skabs rgya nag ha shang gi byung tshul grub mtha'i phyogs snga bcas sa bon tsam smos pa yid kyi dri ma dag byed dge ba'i chu rgyun dang / bod kyi rgyal rabs tshig nyung don gsal yid kyi me long sogs bstan bcos 'ga' yang mdzad do/ /dgung lo zhe brgyad pa khro bo ste shing glang lor/phal cher ljon pa klung kho nar bzhugs shing de dus kun mkhyen si tu rin po che chos kyi 'byung gnas sam bstan pa'i nyin byedalakyong kong phyogs su phebs par zhal 'dzoms/ 'jigs byed ro lang brgyad bskor kyi dbang sogs dang / gzhan yang jo nang lugs dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang / sbyor ba yan lag drug dang gzhan stong dbu ma'i lta khrid sogs jo nang lugs skor ji snyed dang / khyad par yang gsang rdzogs pa chen po'i khreg chod thod rgal gyi zab khrid sogs rnying lugs skor nas dbang khrid lung bcas mang bar bzhed pa bzhin 'bul bar mdzad cing thugs gsang gnyis med gcig tu 'dres par gyur te/ spyir sku phreng sngon mar kong yul snying phur sangs rgyas gling pa'i dgongs 'dus sger chos 'dzin pa mtshan ldan ma tir gyur par ma zad sprul pa'i skye 'phreng gzhan yang bzung ba'i sngon gnas rjes dran gyis kong phyogs 80

der shin tu dgyes pa'i tshul gyis yun ring por bzhugs shing / snga sor mdo khams su bzhugs skabs/kaḥthog rgyal sras bsod nams lde'i btsan gyi zhal nag khyod skye ba phyi mar kong yul lta bur 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i bstan pa la bya ba byed pa'i rigs sngags 'dzin pa zhig tu skye bar 'dug zhes gsungs pa dang / rje nyid sku na shin tu phra ba'i skabs nas kong yul du thugs rab tu gdung zhing der slebs na ang dgongs pa yang yang byung ste tshul 'dir dpags na tshe snga mar yul de'i sngags pa rgad po zhig tu skyes pa 'dra/ zhes kyang gsungs so/ de dus kong yul phyogs su gzhung sa mchog nas sne mo bar bsngags pa rtse lha sgang gi rdzong bzhugs rtsis dpon phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ khang gsar rdzong bzhugs rta ra mdo pa tshe dbang phun tshogs/ o rong sde pa 'phrin las lhun grub/ 'ba' sde pa tshe dbang dpal 'bar/ tshe dbang mchog rgyas sogs sde dpon mtha' dag nas kyang gus par btud cing so so'i 'dod ltar gsung gi bdud rtsi ci yang rtsol bar mdzad do/ /dgung lo zhe dgu pa zad pa te me stag lor/ slar yang dbus 'gyur gyi phyogs su phebs/ dbu ru skyed tshal smad lung rigs smra ba'i dbang phyug bye ba'i 'byung khung dpal gsang phu ne'u thog tu byon skabs 'phags ma sgrol ma'i snang snyan khyad 'phags rtsod rgyal mar mchod 'bul spros shing / der bzhugs skabs o rgyan nas byung ba 'khor lo bde mchog 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs ye shes mchog sbyin zhes pa dang / yang 'khor lo bde mchog 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub dkyil mi bshig bde ba chen po'i thig le kun tu 'phro ba zhes pa yang mdzad do/ /de nas stod lung mda' gzhong pa lha chur phebs skabs gu ru rdo rje drag po rtsal gyi zhal mngon sum du gzigs shing rgyun khye/ ra yid bzhin nor bu zhes pa'ang mdzad/ de nas sa la bskyod pa'i 'og min tshur mdo yi garnyo la chen por byon ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas drug pa seṅge sgra'i ngo bo karma pa chen po dang zhal 'dzoms zhing dpa' bo rin po che dang bcas par thugs bzhed ltar gyi chos bka' 'ga' zhig 'bul ba gnang / rje dpa' bo rin po ches bskul ma mdzad par kar lugs rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral sogs chos skyongs rjes 'brang rnams kyi gtor chog legs ldan dgyes rol 'dod don myur grub dang / rtsa gsum dam can gtor chog sogs bka' brtsom bskyangs nas byang dbu rir rgyal ba lo ras kyi bste gnas su byon te rje lo ras kyi sku gdung mchod rten mthong grol la zhig gso legs par gnang / bod yul bstan ma'i gtsor gyur jo mo gangs dkar ma'i ngogs su re zhig bzhugs shing gcod yul bsdus pa rdo rje'i thol glu dang / sgrol dkar rgyun khyer sogs mdzad do/ /dgung lo lnga bcu pa rab byung bcu gsum pa me yos lor mi dbang chen pos spyan drangs pa ltar lha ldan rgyal khab chen por thegs/ sa dbang chen por rkyen sel gyi sku'i rim gro dang rig pa'i rgyal po nā ga rak+ka'i dbang lung sogs rtsal zhing sgrub thabs dang bde mchog dkar po'i tshe sgrub kyang 81

mdzad/ lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang chen por bstan pa'i gtso bo 'dzam gling rgyan gcig jo bo rin po che rnam pa gnyis/ 'od dpag med/ byams pa chos 'khor/ 'jam dpal nga yol/ bcu gcig zhal sogs jo bo 'od zer lha brgyad 'khor bcas mchod pa'i sprin phung rgya chen pos mchod cing theg pa chen po'i thugs smon kyang de mthun gnang zhing / kun mkhyen si tu zhabs dang dpa' bo rin po che bcas kyang ched du phebs par lhan rgyas zhib tu gnang zhing dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bdag po dang bdag po chen po'i dbang tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang bcas pa rgyas par gnang ngo / /rje dpa' bo rin po che gtsug lag dga' bas bskul ba po zhus par bde ba can gyi smon lam bde can zhing bkod kyi mdo don ji bzhin tshang ba'i tshigs su bcad pa thar ba'i sgo 'byed zhes pa'ang mdzad/ rgya nag tu 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po'i slob grwa'i mkhan po lo tsā ba/ dgung mgon po skyabs dang zhu phrin gyi lam nas thugs bcugs par gyur cing snga phyir chab shog dang / dogs gcod kyi dri ba'i bka' mchid kyang gnang ngo / /de yang mi dbang chos kyi rgyal po yab rje bsod nams stobs rgyas nyid sngon dang phral gyi nye bar len pa'i rkyen gyis sku 'jing la gnyen 'bur du grags pa'i snyel gzhi'i mi ring bar sku gshegs rgyal srid kyi khrir sras mi rje da las pa thur la 'jam dbyangs gong ma ba ga pos wang gi cho lo dang bcas dbang bskur te srid skyong gi skabs su yin par snang zhing / bzhugs gnas lcang lo can du yang yang spyan drangs par/ rgyal po rgyal rigs kyi spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i cho ga dang / smin byed kyi dbang / bka' khrid/ chos bsrung nor lha sogs kyi rjes gnang du ma/ sras la dug dbyung byab 'khrus/ zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg/ bsrung bzlog gi rim pa sogs rkyen sel mang du gnang / mi'i dbang po'i dbu blar bzhugs pa nyang ston bla ma mnga' bdag brag pa rig 'dzin rgya mtshor yang snga phyir dbang lung zab khrid mang zhig stsal lo/ /bka' blon thon pa/ sde pa mda' dpon sogs gzhung gi drung 'khor mang zhig dang / phyogs nas 'dus pa'i bla dpon du mar so so'i bzhed pa ltar gyi dbang chos dang rkyen sel sogs gang mtshams bskyangs shing mi dbang chen po'i sras kyi thu bo mnga' ris gung sku zhabs nas kyang spyan drangs nas dbang chos sogs kyi bzhed pa bskangs/rje btsun 'brug pa rin po che yang chibs kha bsgyur bar zhal 'dzom lhan rgyas dang / bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang stsol/ rje 'brug pas zhabs brtan tshogs 'khor 'bul dngos rgyas par mdzad/ dre'u lhas sprul sku yang byon par/ zhabs drung dbon rin po che sogs 'ga' zhig la shang chos rgyud sde lnga'i dbang lung yongs rdzogs stsal/ gzhung sa mchog gi sku rim dang / tshogs 'khor/ drung 'khor dang phyogs 'dus dad ldan mang pos tshogs 'khor brtan bzhugs/ 'bul dngos kyi maṇ+ḍal spro ba dbyar gyi char sprin gtib pa bzhin byung / de nas mtshur phur phebs skabs zhwa dmar mchog sprul dkon mchog chos kyi nyi ma khri 'don 82

dbu zhwa sgron zhing / khri 'bul mtshon byed dang / bsrung 'khor gyi spyan dmigs/ shis brjod mnga' gsol rgyas par gnang dus phyi rol gnam dpyad kyang 'ja' sprin 'khrigs pa sogs rten 'byung legs par byung bar grags pa yang rje nyid kyi mthu byin las byung bar snang ngo / karma pa chen po dang zhwa dmar ba yab sras lhan rgyas su klong gsal gyi cha lag tshe sgrub rdo rje rgya mdud kyi dbang chen dang / zhwa dmar ba sku sger du tshe dbang lnga tshar dang / sgrol dkar gyi dbang gnang / de skabs zhwa dmar sprul pa'i sku shin tu sku na phra bas rje nyid kyi sku pang du bzhes nas dngul gyi gsol thur gyis gsol zho 'bul ba gnang zhing / ngas khyed kyi don du dka' las chen po rang byas pa yin pas hur thag ma gnang na mi yong gsung ba gsal bar dran zhes sku dngos kyi zhal las so/ /de yang zhwa dmar ba brgyad pa dpal chen chos kyi don grub nyid rgya nag tu gshegs nas de'i yang srid mon spu gro'i phyogs su sku bltam par gdan sar spyan drangs/dgung lo brgyad par zhwa dmar gyi cod paṇa bcing / mi ring bar gcod dbang gis zhing rjes/ de'i sprul sku mon mkhar rnam sras gling du 'khrungs so zhes phal cher cal rgyugs kyi ngos bzung zhing bdag rkyen mnga' gsol nas lo shas kar lugs phal cher de lar 'dun par slar shang bkra shis rtser pan chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes kyi gcung ngu chu khyi lor yang srid ngo ma 'khrungs pa lung bstan mang po'i don mthun pa'i 'khrul pa med par ngos zin kyang bar skabs der phan tshun le 'khon gleng gzhi chen por gyur te gzhung sar thug lo mang po'i bar rtsod gleng byung ba'i mthar lha ldan jo shāka yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i drung du rtag pa sgril bas bkra shis rtse sar bab pas de nyid du thag bcad de rnam gling sprul sku rang gnas su 'byon dgos par shar/ de nas zhwa dmar bcu pa dkon mchog chos kyi nyi ma khri 'don mnga' gsol ba'i bar rje nyid nas dka' ba 'bad pa chen pos thugs khur bzhes shing / rjes su kun mkhyen si tu dang chab gcig tu mdo khams su yun ring du bzhugs /kaḥthog rdo rje gdan gyi khri la bzhugs su gsol zhing mtshan skyongs gnang rgyu sogs 'og tu yang 'chad la/ yab sras kun gyi re ltos che bar mdzad kyang ji lta bus rkyen gyi rten 'brel 'jug sgo chugs pa yin rung phyis shing 'brug lo stod phyogs su byon pas bal yul du sdig to can gor ṣa bas bzung ste bod du ma btang zhing 'o rgyal thugs sun shin tu mang bar byas/ mi ring bar sa spre gor ṣa bas bod du rgol bar lhags shing sde gzar mi zad pa byung tshe bod rnams mgrin gcig tu 'di lta bu'i dmag 'dren par byed pa po ni zhwa dmar ba kho na'o/ /zhes gleng bar g.yon can gor+ṣa bas kyang g.yo zol gyi kha g.yogs par byed/ slar chu byi lo 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po'i dpung 'jug gi bal yul gzhom par nye ba'i tshe gor+ṣa bas 'bangs su khas blang ste dpung chen rnams bal yul dang zhag gcig gi bgrod pas nye ba be ko ṭa zhes pa'i bar du phyin pa slar 83

phyir log de'i lo sngon ma lcags khyi lo tsam nas sbyor ngan gyi snyun gzhi drag po zhig kyang bzhes te mthar dgung lo nga gcig pa chu byi lo chu stod zla ba'i tshes bco lngar bya rung kha shor du gzhan don du gshegs so//de ma thag rgya gor bod gsum nas sku chas rnams lhag med du mi dmigs par rgyas btab/ zhabs gras ltos bcas rigs sogs rgya dpung gi mdun na dkris te shar phyogs tsi na'i yul gru chen por thegs/de'i 'phros lus phyag rdzas dngos rigs dang /zhabs gras khong ltos bying phyogs mthar byer bas gang yang bsags pa'i mtha' zad cing mtho ba dmar lhung ba'i dpe dang rda ston mi lam gyi rtse dga' lta bur gyur/de'i rkyen gyi bka' brgyud pa kha zhan pa'i khar yang skyar snon mar gyur cing zhwa dmar ba skye ba nyer gcig gi bar du 'byon par gsungs pa'i lung don kyang gzhan snang gi ngor rgyun chad pa sogs sgo du ma nas bstan pa'i god chags ches che bar gyur/ tshul 'di dag kyang deng sang phal cher gyi cha rgyus med pas g.yom rgyugs kyi kha na ma mtho ba'i las ngan gyi sdig gsog byed pa mang du snang bas 'dir zhar gyi 'phros su zur tsam gleng bar byas so/ /'di skabs kyang rje 'brug pa thams cad mkhyen pa mchog dang lhan rgyas zab par gnang nas/ byams pa dbu ri'i mdun du gtor chen dang / skyer sgang 'bum par yang zhag bzhugs gtor chen gnang zhing rim pas srin po rir phebs/ de yang srin po ri'i dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi sku brnyen de sngon kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī slob ma paṇ+ḍi ta bi bhu dhi tsan+d+ras bzhengs par paṇa chen nyid kyi rab tu gnas pa'i ye shes pa bzhugs nges pa dang / lo rgyus gzhan las/ paṇ+ḍi ta bi bhu tis bka' brgyud par bka' skyon zhing phyag rgya ba 'di brdzun che ba yin gsung par/ paṇa chen shākya shrī thugs hur phyung te/ bi bhu ti/ bi bhu ti/ de skad ma zer/ sangs rgyas la 'khrul pa mi mnga'/ khyad par 'bru khung pa slob dpon klu sgrub yin/ khyod kyi sdig bsags pas sdig sbyongs du 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku bzhengs shig gsung pa dang / che brjod du rang byon yin pa dang 'khor lo sdom pas 'khor lo sdom pa bzhengs zer ba sogs 'dug mod/ gang ltar rje 'di nyid thugs mos shin tu che bas snga phyir byon zhing bde mchog gi tshogs 'khor dang mchod sprin/ snyan shal la rim gnyis dang mthun pa'i thugs smon tshigs bcad can dang /gser bsil ma phyag gi snyim pa bkang te zhal ras la 'thor ba gnang / 'khor lo sdom pa'i sbyin bsregagator chen sogs rgyas par gnang ste thar pa rtse phebs/ der yang gtor chen gnang zhing 'di skabs bha gong dkar rdo rje gdan gyi chos grwa chen po nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dbang phyug bla ma blo gros rgya mtsho gdan zhu gnang ba de phral du phebs/ slob dpon chen po a bha ya ka ra'i gzhed gzhung dri ma med pa dkyil chog rdo rje phreng ba lha zhe lnga pa ding sang yang gsang sngags gsar mar grags che zhing rgyun ma chad par bzhugs bzhin pa'i dbang rnams rim par gsan pa'i dbu tshugs/ zhag nyer gcig gi khongs su grub par 84

gsan/ rje nyid kyi sku'i skug mar gnas pa'i zhabs ring dang grwa tshangs la lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor rgyas pa'i bka' khrid dang / gong dkar bla ma chos yon gyi dgyes pa bskyed cing / sgrub thabs rin 'byung nas/ sangs rgyas klu dbang bde rgyal po/ phag mo kurma pa ti/ phag mo dpal 'dzin lugs bcas kyi dbang rtsal nas rang gnas su thegs skyel zhu ba gnang / dpal ri sprul pa'i sku phebs par// nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i dbang lung dang smin khrid/ rong chos gter gling gi bla ma sogs 'ga' zhig la rta mgrin gyi dbang /khroms tshogs mang tsam la gar dbang rdo rje'i gter byon zab tig chos dbyings rang gsal gyi dbang stsal/ lha ldan nas mi'i bdag po dbang sku zhabs nas gsang stabs kyi gdan zhu ba 'byor ba bzhin phral du dpon g.yog rags bsdus kyi chibs kha bsgyur/ dga' ldan khang gsar du sa dbang mchog dang lhan rgyas dang / gur drag gi dbang sogs bzhed pa ltar gyi chos bka' kha shas gnang bar zhabs brtan tshogs 'khor dngos 'bul rgyas par bstar ba bzhes shing / gnyes thang nor bu sgang brgyud bka' brgyud kyi gdan sa chen po 'brug se ba byang chub gling du phebs kun mkhyen 'brug pa rin po che rgyal sgo'i phyi rol du zhabs bsur phebs shing gzim chung dag pa rab 'byams su lhan rgyas gsung mol zhib par gnang /tshe dbang smin rgyas 'bul bar mdzad nas chu bo ri thar rtser phebs/ 'di nas bzung gtor chen stong phrag chag med gnang / rje 'brug pa rin po che yang stod phyogs su chibs kha bsgyur ba dang / rje nyid dpon 'khor rnams kyang bal yul du phebs bskyod gnang ba bcas chu bo ri'i gzim phug tu zhal 'dzoms lhan rgyas dang phan tshun du zhabs brtan 'bul bzhed bskyangs/ 'di skabs spong rong zhabs drung rin po che dang rje btsun ma bcas lha sa phebs zhor mjal bar byon pa gur drag gi dbang sogs rtsal ba zhabs brtan tshogs 'khor 'bul dngos rgyas par spel ba bzhes nas rje 'brug pa rin po che dang / lhan rgyas du chibs kha bsgyur ba'i rim pas kha rag ras dgon du phebs/ ras dgon gyi bla ma dge slong gis rje bla ma dam pa rnam gnyis lhan rgyas su tshogs 'khor rgyas par zhus/ 'di nas mdo khams su ltos bcas rnams la gnas tshul dang phyi mtha' gzigs pa'i bka' lung bcas kyi chab shog stsal/ dpon slob lhan du sngon jo nang rje btsun dam pa tā ra nā tha sku bltam pa'i gnas 'brang phur phebs/ rje 'brug pa rin po che la drag po tī la ya'i gtor dbang 'bul bar mdzad cing lhan rgyas zhib mol mdzad/ rje 'brug pa mnga' ris mar yul la dwags ljongs su chibs bsgyur gnang bar gar sha 'phags pa 'gro ba drug sgrol gyi sku brnyan khyad 'phags kyi dbu thog tu gser zangs gi gdugs rin po che'i phra tshom can zhig dang kha che'i mchod rten ka ṇi ka yi drung du mchod 'bul snyan shal smon tshig bcas rje nyid nas 'bul ba gnang rgyu kun mkhyen 'brug pas sku dngos kyi phebs te 'bul ba gnang rtsis zhal bzhes ltar la dwags su phebs 85

skabs dka' tshegs chen pos gar sha 'phags pa'i drung du byon te mchod sprin rgya chen po dang bcas te dbu gdugs phul zhing thugs smon rgya cher mdzad pa mngon/ de nas kun mkhyen 'brug pa rjes su rim pas bskyod rgyu dang / rje nyid dpon 'khor rnams phebs lam dal 'gros kyis stod phyogs su chibs kha bsgyur te/ dgung lo nga gcig pa gnam 'byung ste sa 'brug lor/ gtsang nas rim par la stod lho dang /dpal thang dpal mo chos sding rdzong dkar skyid grong rgyud rna pā la'i ljongs su bde bar phebs so 'di dus kun mkhyen si tu rin po che bstan pa'i nyin byed kyang bal yul gyi gnas gzigs su byon pa rang byung mchod rten chen po shing kun gyi bya 'dabs 'bras spungs gi gtsug lag khang / bod rnams bya rgod phung ri dang / bal po rnams ki ḍor brjod pa der zhal 'dzoms/ dbang lung man ngag rtsal ba dang lhan rgyas yun rine du gnang zhing si tu rin po che bod du chibs kha bsgyur/ rje nyid nas mchod rten chen po bya rung kha shor gyi zhig bzo rgyas par mdzad pa'i ring bal mon bod gsum gyi skye 'gro du mar phan bde rgya chen po'i 'phrin las spel zhing / khrom lnga brgya gdal bar thugs rje chen po 'gro 'dul yid bzhin nor bu'i dbang dang / sems bskyed/ tshe dbang / badz+ra gu ru/ yig brgya/ yig drug gi lung rtsal zhing dge bskul dam bca' bzhes/ 'di skabs bdag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rje mgon nang pa karma bdud 'joms zhabs nyid dgung lo nyer gsum du son pa na yol mo gangs rar rang gi bste gnas su bcom ldan 'das dpa' rdo rje gzhon nu'i bsnyen sgrub kyi bcad rgya la bzhugs pa'i tshe gnas tshul dang rig 'dzin rje'i mtshan gsan ma thag yug cig rnam par rtog med kyi ngang du lus zhes gsungs/ mi ring bar bal yul du mjal bar bskyod/ bya rgod phung rir zhal mjal ma thag brtse bas rjes su 'dzin pa'i bka' bzhes bzang po phebs cing / rje 'di pa sogs bla ma mang por byang gter rdo rje phur pa spu gri dang che mchog gi dbang / thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang / sgrol dkar gyi tshe khrid/ thugs rje chen po'i smar khrid chu bo kun 'dus zla gcig bar smin khrid du stsal/ mi ring bar mchod rten chen po'i nyams gso gegs med mthar phyin par grub te rab tu gnas pa'i me tog 'thor bar mdzad cing de'i tshe rdo rje'i mgur du bzhes pa ni/ e ma ho/mchod rten bya rung kha shor/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rten/ /ma bzhengs lhun gyi grub pa/ /bzhengs nas bsam pa'i don 'grub/ /sangs rgyas 'od bsrung gi bstan pa la/ /bya rdzi yum sras kyi bzhengs pa/ /sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i bstan pa la/ /o rgyan gu ru'i bsngags pa'i mchod rten/ /rtsod ldan snying ma'i dus su/ /sngags 'chang shākya bzang po yi/ /gu ru'i lung bzhin zhig gso byas pa'i mchod rten/ /rtsod ldan snyigs ma'i mthar thug dus 'dir/ /nged cag dpon slob kyi zhig gsol byas pa'i mchod rten/ /e ma/ mchod rten bya rung kha sho/ /rtsig pa mi 'dra skyes pa zhig 'dra 'dug /rgya mtsho'i gting nas rdol ba zhig 'dra 86

'dug /ri rgyal lhun po 'gying ba zhig 'dra 'dug /smon lam gang btab 'grub pa'i mchod rten/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa'i mchod rten/ /'brel gyur 'gro ba mtha' dag bde ba can du skye ba'i mchod rten/ /bal yul sa bcud yong ba'i mchod rten/ /bod yul phun tshogs skyed pa'i mchod rten/ /rgyal khams mtha' dag bde ba'i mchod rten/ /'dzam gling 'di na byin ldan mchod rten/ /lha mi kun gyi mchod pa'i mchod rten/ /'jig rten gsum gyi sgron me mchod rten/ /bkra shis rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang po/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de yi mchod rten/ /yang nas yang du mjal bar shog cig /zhes dang / sa dbang chos kyi rgyal po/ /'gyur med phyogs las rnam rgyal//gangs can yongs kyi bdag po/ /rdo rje'i khri la bzhugs yod//gangs can yongs kyi mgon po/ /rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtsho/ /mi rje chos kyi rgyal po/ /thugs yid gcig tu 'dres yod/ /rgyal dbang pad+ma'i rgyal sras/ /rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu/ /phyogs med 'gro don skyong ba//'brel tshad smin grol bkod yod/ /mthong thos dran reg grol ba'i/ /mchod rten bya rung kha shor/ /bod bal yongs kyi bde thabs/ /zhig gso phun tshogs byas yod/ /dza ya dza ya su dza ya/ zhes gsungs/ de yang /mchod rten bya tri kha sho'am/ bya tri kam sho dang / bod spyir bya rung kha shor du grags pa'i mchod rten 'dir srid zhu nyams gso'i rim pa bskrun pa'i skyes bu gu ru rin po che'i lung gis gsal ba ni/ lo rgyus chen mo las/ mchod rten chen po 'di nyid la yang dag par ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi sku dang dbyer med pas zhig ral nyams pa la sogs pa mi 'byung / kun rdzob ltar snang du 'byung ba bzhi'i rkyen gyis zhig cing ral ba'i tshul 'ga' zhig ston par 'gyur te/ rigs gsum mgon po dang / khro gnyer can dang / rje btsun sgrol ma rnams kyi sprul pa 'ga' res zhig gsos byed par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pas rje 'di pa de dag las rigs gsum mgon po'i nang mtshan gsang ba'i bdag po'i yang sprul du rig par bya'o/ /de nas bod du byon pa'i shul lam du gshegs par phyogs pa'i tshe gzigs snang du byung tshul rje nyid kyi rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba sgra ji bzhin par bkod pa ni/ me yos rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lo de'i mthar mchod rten bya tri kam sho'am bya rung kha shor du grags pa'i zhig gso tshugs nas sa 'brug snron zla'i tshes bco lngar rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bsgrub/ chu stod zla ba'i tshes lnga la kha shor nas bod du yong ba'i lam du zhugs/ tsa bi har du gnas bcas nang mig chung ngu zhig 'dug pa der sdod/ bcag mal zhig byas pa'i tshes drug gi tho rengs khar dngos ni ma yin mod/ gsal snang ni dngos ma las kyang che la/ rmi lam 'am nyams yang rung ste/ nang der bal mo gzhon nu zhig tshang ste byung nas dga' ba dang jo 'dri ba'i tshul sna tshogs byed par/ mi ma yin du shes nas lha yi nga rgyal gyi zil gyis mnan pas/ de chags pa'i nyams 'gyur gyi 'khyud par gyur pa la/ 'du shes gsum gyi bde ba chen por rol bar de yi 87

skabs nyid du yang lus kyi bkod pa du mar 'gyur zhing cho 'phrul gyi gdong yang sna tshogs bsgyur zhing shas cher lce spyang gi rnam pa sogs su ston par sprul pa ji 'dra yang mig gsum mi 'gyur bar gnas par snang /de la khyod gang du gnas ming ci zer dris pas/ nged yam bur gnas/ ming rā ṇi yin zer bar/ 'o na khyod mir sprul pa yod dam smras par/ mir sprul pa med nga rang dngos 'di ka yin khyod kyi grogs bgyid/ nged kyi tshul 'di si tu la bshad du rung / gzhan dam gtsang gsum las ma mang gsung nas yal song / srog sngags ni dri rgyu ma byung / de rjes zla re bzhin rmi lam du yang yang 'ong / gtam yang smra rung /skyid grong du bla ma kha gcig la zur tsam smras pas de tshun 'ong ba nyung du song / da lta skabs re las mi 'ong / gang ltar rang ro'i rgyud 'dzin la 'god zhing mthu che nges zhig tu snang / tshul de sku zhabs la smros zer ba dgos pa yod srid snyam nas da lam phul/ zhes kun mkhyen si tu dharmā ka ra chab shog tu rtsal bar mdzad do/ /de nas rim gyis skyid grong grwa phu chos gling du 'ba' ra sprul pa'i skus spyan drangs pa bzhin byon/ sad gling tshe dpag med rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang / sangs rgyas gsang ba'i lugs kyi tshe dbang / drag dmar 'o bran lugs/ gter kha gong 'og gnyis 'dres kyi bstan ma'i srog gtad/ ras chung pa'i thugs dam tshe dpag med dkar po phyag bzhi pa'i byin rlabs/ 'jam dpal bstod sgrub kyi rjes gnang / byang gter spyan ras gzigs kyi khrid/ rgyal po lugs sku gsum snying po'i don khrid/ byang gter thugs sgrub yang tig gces sgron gyi khrid bcas rtsal/ khyad par rdzogs pa chen po gsang ba snying thig gi dbang gnang ba'i skabs gzigs snang byung tshul rje nyid kyi gsung ngo ma las 'di ltar/ rab byung bcu gsum pa sa 'brug gi lor bshol 'don chu stod zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi tshes bcur shin tu dang rab tu spros med kyi dbang gong ma gnyis bskur ba'i bar skabs 'phros su ngos nas rje nub dgon pa chen po rig 'dzin dbang rgyal zhabs la gsang ba snying thig gi dbang bskur las khrid rgyun ma thos shis des na rtsa ba'i bla ma dang rjes mthun gyi yul gnyen po nyid las gtso khrid rgyun la byed pa yin zhes smras shing / dbang gi bya ba grub nas rang gi mal sar sleb skabs sngags kyi bsrung ma yin nam snyams pa'i bud med zhig dngos su byon nas khyod kyi mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyi sngar nas kyang log lta 'di ltas dngos grub mang po zhig phyir phyogs pa yin/ khyad par da lam dbang bskur ba'i dus sangs rgyas thams cad bla ma'i sku la 'jug ste slob ma la dngos grub byin rlabs khyad par can sbyin pa'i dus der/ de dus rdo rje slob dpon yang tha mal rang rgyud kyi rtog pas ma slad pa dag pa ye shes kyi 'khor lor rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag rgyu la/khyod kyi yid log lta 'khrul snang gi bslad par ma zad ngag tu yang smras pas 'di la sgo gsum 'gyod bshags stobs bzhi tshangs bas tshogs kyi 'khor lo 'bum phrag gcig 'phral du ma bsgrub na mnar med 88

pa'i dmyal bar bar bskal phyed kyi bar du sdug bsngal mi zad pa myong bar 'gyur gyi de la the tshom yod re kan/des na tshogs 'khor 'bum phrag gcig 'phral du sgrub cig des dag gtsang du 'gyur ro/ /gsang ba snying thig gi dbang bskur rnam zhwa ra dag pa gang la nod pa'i yul de ni rtsa ba'i bla ma dang khyad par med pa nyid du gnas pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs te khros pa'i tshul gyi rgyab phyogs nas yal song / zhes gsungs ltar tshogs mchod bdud rtsi'i snying po phral du bka' rtsom dang / tshogs 'bum grangs bsog gnang / 'di skabs rje nyid sku khams kyang snyel ba'i tshul dang / thugs sna shin tu 'thung ba'i zhing khams gzhan du dgongs pa gtad pa'i tshul yang yang bka' phebs par/ thugs sras 'ba' ra sprul pa'i sku nas zhabs brtan gsol 'debs nan gtan du mdzad cing / de nas 'phags mchog wa ti bzang po'i spyan sngar mar me stong tshar du ma'i mchod pa dang / bstan 'gror sman pa'i thugs smon rgya cher bskyangs shing / de mtshungs byams pa sprin gyi gtsug lag khang chen por yang mar me stong tshar du mas mchod par mdzad pa nas thugs mdun kyang bsgyur mdang sku khams kyang dngas pa'i tshul bzhes/ dkar ye dgon du mi dbang chos kyi rgyal po'i lcam mo rje btsun byang chub sems ma dge ba'i dpal yon can pad+ma chos 'dzin gyis spyan drangs/ byin rlabs rkyen sel gyi dbang bka' dang / 'dus tshogs la chos 'brel rtsal nas ab bsam gtan chos gling du zhag shas bzhugs skabs yang zab dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi dbang khrom chos su rtsal zhing / 'ba' ra sprul pa'i sku sogs la ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang dang /mgon po sku rags ma'i khrid/ rta phag yin bzhin nor bu'i dbang lung / rje nyid kyi dag snang gsang gcod kyi khrid sogs gnang nas yar lam brag dkar rta sor phebs/ der chu bzang sprul pa'i sku 'jam dbyangs chos 'phel kyang bzhugs par chu bzang pas zhus ngor gar dbang rdo rje'i phur pa spu gri reg gcod kyi dbang lung dang tshe dbang bcas stsal/ lhan rgyas gsung gleng zhib par gnang zhing zhag bdun bzhugs/'di dus lcags zam pa blo bzang dpal grub kyang byon pa dad ldan 'dus par tshe dbang gnang skabs lhan rgyas nas gnang tshul kyang mchis 'di sngar gtsang phun gling gi gra rigs ri khrod pa zhig ste rjes su grub thob tu grags shing lcags zam bzhi tsam gtsugs par grags so/ /yar lam bkra shis sgang du bzhugs zhag gnang / snga sor dpal mo chos sding gi bla ma phug pa kun bzang rig 'dzin dbang po'i sku skyes kyi gtsug phud phul/ mtshan tshe dbang bstan pa'i gsal byed zhes pa stsal/ ra la za 'og phug gi grub gnas kyi gdan sa bar sko bzhag gnang / 'dis dpal mo chos sding su rje nyid kyi sku mchod zla re bzhin nyer lnga la bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga rgyun 'dzugs kyi rgyu rkyen sbyar ba da lta'i bar yang ma chag par rgyun 'jags su mchis so/ /de nas rdzong dkar du rje btsun chen po mi la yab sras kyi bsti gnas ra la za 'og 89

phug tu re zhig bzhugs/ 'ba' ra sprul sku/ brag dkar dge slong ye shes chos grags/ rje mgon nang pa sogs bla ma mang por grub thob gter ston karma gling pa'i gter byon zab chos zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol gyi dbang chen yongs su rdzogs pa dang / dpal ye shes kyi mgon po gcig shur ma ning nag po'i srog dbang / tshe dbang bcas dang / rje mgon nang par bstan gnyis gling pa'i gter byon yang tig ye shes mthong grol gyi dbang / zhing skyong chen po kun dga' gzhon nu'i rjes gnang shin tu gnyan pa zab khyad can/ lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor rgyas pa sogs rje nyid kyi bka' 'bum gras le mtshan 'ga' zhig dang gzhan yang kha 'thor sna tshogs mang zhig dang khyad par zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol gyi bka' khrid smin pa'i thog gnas lugs don gyi ngo sprod 'dzub gtsugs su bstan pas skad cig mar grol ba bsnyes pa'i tshul sngon grub pa'i dbang phyug te lo pas nā ro pa chen po'am/ slob dpon ye shes bshes gnyen gyis grub chen zhi ba sbas pa'i zhabs rjes su bzung ba ji bzhin no/ /'di skabs mdo bo che'i gur rigs sngags 'chang chen po rgyal sras seng ge las zab chos 'ga' zhig gsan bzhed pas gdan 'dren par mdzad/ snga 'gyur bka' ma mdo sgyu sems gsum gyi bar ma/ tan+t+ra sde bco brgyad kyi snying po phyi ma'i rgyud sgyu 'phrul gsang ba snying po'i dbang lung man ngag dang bcas pa rgyun gang bzhugs tshang bar gsan/ rgyud mgon bsrung ma'i gtso bo dpal ye shes kyi mgon po legs ldan nag po'i dbang gsan par bzhed tshe sngags 'chang rgyal sras pa nyid kyi sku na phra mo'i skabs mes po sngags 'chang nor bu bde chen las gsan thub pa byung min thugs the tshom du gyur pas 'bul mi nus zhes zhus par rje nyid nas/ bla ma rang dbang sgrub mdzod cig dbang rgyun yod med kho bos 'tshal gyis zhes gsungs nas thugs dam dgongs pa la bzhugs pa'i tshe je zhig na dbang khang gi steng du thug chem tsheg sgra 'ur ding gi sgra chen pos der 'khod kun skyi bung zhes byed pa'i 'jigs zil chen po zhig byung bar rje'i zhal nas/ bla ma rang thugs g.yeng gnang mi 'tshal/ dbang gsan nges su 'dug de'i dpang por ye shes mgon po ri bo ma la ya nas dngos su byon byung / zhes gsungs par grags/ sngags 'chang rgyal sras pa 'di nyid las rje ma bdun ras chen nas brgyud pa'i mdo chen bka' brgyud dkar po drug gi khrid lung gi rgyun kyang gsan cing 'di pas zhus ngor zhal gdam gsol 'debs 'ga' zhig kyang gnang ngo / /kun gzigs lo ri sprul pa'i sku chos kyi rgya mtshos zhu 'phrin 'byor bar/ rje nyid kyi gsol 'debs 'gyur med spros bral ma dang / dris lan zhal gdam zab rgyas kyi chab shog rtsal/ bde ba can gyi khrid sku gsum lam rim mchog gi sgo 'byed zhes pa'ang bka' rtsom gnang / rje 'brug pa rin po che bka' brgyud 'phrin las shing rta'i zhabs la brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs kyi dngos 'bul zhu phrin kyang 'bul bar mdzad/ bal yul yam bu rgyal po'i blon po kriḍi 90

sogs kyi zhu yig 'byor ba'i lan tshigs su bcad pa'i chab shog kyang gnang / spo rong rje dbon rdo rje lha skyabs kyi sras kyi gtsug phud phul/ mtshan tshe dbang bstan 'dzin zhes pa rtsal lo/ /dgung lo nga gnyis pa dkar po ste sa sbrul lo 'char ba nas/ sems dpa' chen po mkhas grub rat+na bha dra las karma snying thig gi dbang khrid kyi rgyun dang / yang rdzogs snying thig sogs snga 'gyur gyi rgyun dkon pa 'ga' zhig dang / sngon theg gling pa bsod nams bstan pa'i nyi ma zhes rig 'dzin khams lung pa chen po'i mes por gyur pa'i mkhas grub chen po de nyid las rje nyid kyi sku phreng gong ma grub pa'i dbang phyug pad+ma nor bus zab chos mang du gsan par mdzad 'dug pa'i rgyun la thugs zhen gyis de nas brgyud pa'i gsang chen snga 'gyur rgyud 'bum rin po che'i klags lung yongs rdzogs par gsan par mdzad do/ /de dag gi tshul las tsam te sa sbrul nas lcags lug bar lo ngo gsum gyi mdzad pa rnam thar rags tsam lu ma nas snyim pa'i chu ltar sa bon tsam zhig smos pa zhes rje nyid kyi rdo rje'i gsung 'khrul pa med pa'i le'u mtshan gcig gnang 'dug pa ltar byin rlabs kyi khyad dang yid ches kyi nges pa bskyed phyir bcos slad med par gsung sgra ji bzhin par bkod pa ni 'di ltar ro//oṃ swā ste/ bden par gsung des 'khor ba sdug bsngal zhing / /'dus byas mi rtag shes nas nges 'byung gi/ /thar la gzhol bar gdams bzhin mngon sum du/ /rang gi dger spyad cung zad yang smra ba/ /de yang gnam byung gi lo gzhug nas rtsam snga 'gyur gyi ring lugs bslad med pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa nas da lta la thug gi bar gter dang dag snang zhal gzigs lta bu'i 'phro 'thud pa ma yin pa zhal nas zhal/ snyan nas snyan/ thugs nas thugs su brgyud pa tan+t+ra sde bco brgyad kyi snying po phyi ma'i rgyud sgyu 'phrul gsang ba snying po yi dbang lung man ngag dang bcas pa snga 'gyur gyi rigs sngags 'chang ba sbas pa'i tshul can la legs par thos par byas shing / de bzhin sems dpa' chen po rat+na'i mtshan can la dkar po'i lo 'char ba nas brtsams karma snying thig gi dbang khrid kyi rgyun gyis mtshon snga 'gyur gyi rgyun dkon pa mang zhig dang skyar te yang zhus bzhin rnying ma rgyud 'bum gyi bklags lung yang tshugs skabs nyid du 'phags yul gyi mu khun k+ṣe ṭa zhes bod yul gyi glo bor 'bod pa'i ljongs kyi bdag mo yang yul phyogs der nged yong dgos tshul do gal chen pos byon pa'i nan ma theg pa snron zla ba la mnga' ris gung thang nas thon te chu stod zla ba'i tshes gsum la glo ba'i yul mi ser skya thams cad kyi rang rang 'khos su dpag pa'i rol mo glu gzhas sogs tshad med pas mdun bsus te smon thang rgyal khab tu 'byor/ ring por ma thogs par rang snang gi 'dod mthun tshe dbang gi sna drangs te chos bka' ji snyed dang phyogs der 'khod pa'i skye bo mtha' dag par dbu ma lugs kyi sgo nas sems bskyed thugs rje chen po'i bsgom khrid sogs 91

chos bka' ji snyed dang / khrom mang nyung sna tshogs/ phal cher lnga brgyar long pa la bla ma'i sgrub thabs dang 'brel ba'i chos khrid smar ba bshad cing / de yi nang nas nyung 'thus kha shas par rdzogs pa chen po klong gsal mkha' 'gro snying thig gi zab khrid bshad/ rje rat+na'i mtshan can la rgyud 'bum lung gung thang du ma rdzogs pa'i lhag ma 'dir yang zhus shing / bla ma yang mnyes pa gsum gyi mnyes par byas te rang gnas su phebs pa'i skyel ma bcas btang / nged glo bo smad rdo dang chu la me 'bar ba'i gnas su bsgrod par brtsam nas/ dgon pa sgang du sleb skabs dam can rdor legs dang gnyen chen dge 'dzo dag yong nas bod kyi so kha bsrung tshul dang / 'di lo mtha' dmag gi dogs med kyang nang du lha ngan 'dre brdzu yong 'dra zhes mol/ de nas glo ba'i gnas chen gyi mthil dngos dza lāsna dz+wa lar tshes dgu la 'byor zhing bcu nas brtsam der sdod ring sgo gsum le lo cung zad yang ma song bar dkyil 'khor gsum du ci nus su mnyam par bzhag cing tshogs gtor 'bum phrag tu ma nged rang dngos dang grwa tshogs nas kyang bsags shing ske/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro rnams dgyes pa mnyam byas/ de skabs mkha' 'gro ma yi 'du ba nyams su mthong ba sogs ya mtshan pa'i ltas khra'u khra'u byung / rang dang las smon 'brel ba'i skyes bu dam pa 'ga' zhig gi 'phral gyi 'gal rkyen kha shas zhi nus pa'i ltas kyang mthong / 'di slebs mtshams tshes grangs ma nges pa zhig tu dus zing 'byung ngo zhes pa'i sgra gsal po zhig rna bar byung ba ci yin snyam pa las ha cang cer cer po ma byung / de nas phyi rol pa rnams kyi khyab 'jug gi gnas su 'dod pa'i kag pa ṇi ko ner yang gtor chen zhig gtong bar phyin/ de nas dgon pa sgang du zhag shas ngal gsos shing dgon de'i bdag po bla mas kyang dgon gzhis de bdag la rtsis su phul bzhin rten 'brel la dmigs bdag gir khas blang / sngar thun mong lcags khyi lor dpal chen po gnub nam mkha'i snying po yis rdo rje theg rgyud thams cad kyi bdag por bdag la dbang bskur mdzad pa'i snang ba byung ba'i mal thad der mthing gi r+ghaṃ yig zhig kyang brir bcug sngar ma phyin stabs rgya gad kyi grong bgrod de'i gzhi bdag btsan des kyang dga' nas yul chos dang mthun par rol mo dang gar rtses pa'i nyams snang byung / dge gling dang bdud lcags kyi thor cog can gyi gnas ga ma'i ljongs su yang zhag shas sdad/ de nas gu ru'i gnas chen dge dkar du phyin/ de'i gnas bdag srid pa'i ma mo bdun dang phug bdag chen mo'i nang mtshan rdo rje legs ldan mas dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur ci yang bstan cing mngon sum du mi la brlam nas dam tshig gi mna' chu len pa yang byung / tshogs gtor gyi bya ba ci nus bgyis shing 'dus pa'i skye bo rnams la chos 'brel gyi re ba yang bskang / de nas slar yang smon thang du 'byor sngar bka' chos zhu ba dang / de'i khar dol po nas sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'i zhabs/ dzum le ra dza'i blon po sogs don gnyer 92

can kha shas la nyi ma kha yar gyi bar snying thig gi dbang tshang bar byas/ dol po rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la phur pa jo lugs kyi nang mtshan nyang lugs kyi dbang rdul tshon la brten pa tshar gnyis dang / ras bris steng nas tshar gsum ste khyon lnga zhus/ sngon nas da lta khong la thug gi bar bsnyen chen gsum ldabs bar ma chad byung 'dug par byin rlabs nan ltar du bzang zhing khong nas kyang phyin chad sku tshe'i ring phur bzlas nad sogs ma gtsogs pa ma byung phyin nyin rer nyi khri re chag med du zhal bzhes mdzad song la/don du sbas tshul gyi grub brnyes zhig tu go/ ga mi nas rtsam dmag dpung chen po g.yo ba'i ltas gsal po byung bzhin/ bod khams sdug la gtod pa'i god chags sna 'dren mnga' ris gung nas gro shod du dmag bskul ba'i dus su 'dug de skabs rmi lam du 'phral mar phyogs gzhan du ma bskyod na mi kha dang gleng gzhi che ba zhig yong zhes byung / de nas mi ring ba bod kyi srid skyong chen po dbang nas khri skor yo yi dmag mnga' rir bcug cing / g.yul sprod du cha ba na mi bdag gung tshad rims nad kyi nyen ste/ nged la yang ci ltar 'gyur/ brtag zhu dngul bre chen gcig dang bcas byung bar/ tshe tshad dngos ma yin kyang tshe phrang ni shin tu dam/ yi ge 'di 'byor bstun sku rim 'grub na grol bar srid kyang phal cher thal bar dogs zhes pho nya ba la gsong por smras bzhin/ rgyal zla'i tshes bcu la dus kyi chos nyid du gyur 'dug cing ske/ 'khor rnams g.yul dpung sleb phral phye ma leb rlung gi brdas pa ltar thab 'khrug ye med par so sor gyes shing / nged la yang skyabs zhu bdun bcu skor byung zhing / rang gi lus longs spyod dpon po'i dgongs pa tshoms 'khrung la ma ltas par rang la skyabs zhu tsam ma yin par gung g.yog tshang mar mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa yang dag par 'dun ste thabs du ma'i sgo nas zhu ngo nan du gyis pas thog mar brgya dang dgu bcu ni srog skyon yang rtsis/ mthar gnyis brgya skor srog la skyon med pa 'grub cing /de bzhin gung gi mthu mkhan rim gro pa sogs dgon pa mang zhig la bka' skyon dbyings che tsam 'dug rung —/ de rnams la yang zhu ngo'i khong nas srog skyon rgyang 'bud 'thor god med par 'jam chags su sdod chog pa byung song / rang gi gtan pa med pa'i mi 'jigs sbyin pa dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba las/snyigs dus kyi skye bo de rnams nas re zung ni srid mtha' ma bgag gzhan ni drin du bzo ba yang cung zad tsam yang mi byed do/ /der yang ma zad bod kyi bstan pa'i mnga' bdag dgon sde che khag rnams nas nged rnams gung g.yog la phan thogs cung zad kyang ma nus shing / kho bya bral ba zhig gi phan thogs byas so zhes pa'i gtam 'di rna bar mi snyan cing snying la zug rngu bskyed pa'i tsher ma'o sems nas de la bying mi snyan pa'i tshig sgrub byed pa'i ram 'degs byed pa yang ches mang mod/ gang ltar rang nyid la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dgyes pa'i mtshan ma cung zad zhig byung bas des dbugs 93

dbyung thob/ de ltar bgyid 'os 'gas zla ba kha shas 'gor nas rab myos lcags rta lo sbo zla ba'i tshes gcig la glo bo nas thon te gro shod kyi rgyal po gro chog pa'i mdun du sleb pa na/ rgya nag dang bod kyi lha 'dre rnams sho del bkram ste rgyal 'pham rtsod pa dag kyang mthong / de skabs rim gro la 'bad na bod spyir cung zad bde ba'i go skabs bsnyed par snang yang / spyi mthun gyi las kyi ma grub pas sa sbrul gyi ston po tsam nas mi'i bdag po yang thugs 'gyur ba'i rnam pas legs par gsol ba la mi dgyes pa'i rnam pa re 'dug pas spyi snyan du gsol dka' yang 'di skabs cha shas zhus kyang / sku rim gyi kwa rtsol ba ye nas mdzad ma song / de nas tshes bdun la spra dun du 'byor/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg kha yar dang / tshes bcu sogs dus chen la gtor ma btang / lhag tu tshes bco brgyad kyi nyin byang phyogs kyi de'u de'i rtser phyin gtor ma btang ba la che btsan rol pa skya bdun ral pa bswe yan gyi gseb nas me lce jib jib 'phro bzhin mngon sum du byung nas gtor ma len pa'i nyams byung / der 'dus pa thams cad kyi thun snang du rlung shin tu drag pa dang / brngams zhud tshad med pa byung zer/ de ni dga' ba dang 'tshub pa zung du 'brel ba ste nged la dga' zhing gzhan la 'tshub pa'i mtshan ma'o/ /de skabs rgyal khrims kyi chad pas mi nyi shu tsam gsad pa yin 'dug kyang mang zhig ni gdug 'drer skyes pa'i mtshan ma mthong / 'di lo nged rang bal yul du rang byung mchod rten la mchod 'bul zhib mo zhig bgyid 'dod yin yang dus zing des bshol dgos byung zhing / gung g.yog gi srog skyobs la zhu nan ches pas dgongs pa cung zad ma dgyes pa sel byed du yar 'brog chu tshan du mjal rtsis byas nas dpal mo chos sding du 'byor skabs sbyin bdag gi nan gyi bshol btab nas zhag ma nyung tsam 'gor ba rten 'brel la shin tu gnod pa byung / de skabs mgon po g.yu thog pa'i yum shes rab dpal 'phreng dang mjal nas dbang bzhi bskur zhing 'phral gyi lung bstan kha yar gnang ba yang ji bzhin par 'grub/ la stod lhor phyin snga sor sa sbrul nas brtsam pa'i kun rig gi gzungs sngags dung phyur gnyis grub dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngos shing / gshin rje gshed dmar gyi snying po 'bru bcu bzhi pa dung phyur dang / sgrol ma'i bstod pa 'bum phrag lnga phral du sgrub/ gram pa rgyang / bo dong e/ khro phu rnams su mchod 'bul smon lam dang bcas shing / srad rin chen rtser srid skyong chen po'i drung du tshes bcu la 'byor/ de phral ngos mjal thog bkur bzos sngar dang cha 'dra la thugs gshis 'gyur ba'i rnam pa che zhing sngar ltar dbang chos gsan bzhed kyi spros pa spangs 'dug bla mchod gtso bo shel stod pa yang der bzhugs shing / de skabs khrung bzhes ni nyin mtshan mi shes pa ltar snang /rang gi gsal snang la ni rgyal srid yun ring du mi gnas pa'i 'char sgo bcas nye bar 'khod pa rnams la yang gsal bor smras/ de skabs rgya thag sher spun khrims rar chud de srog skyobs byas kyang phyis drin lan 94

log gzhal sngon de bzhin gshegs pas lhas sbyin la phan gdags pa 'di lta bu'o/ /yang skyog po'i blo can 'gas pho ltar sku rim sri gnon gyi rigs nged nas byas na legs tshul srid skyong la zhus nas nged la bka' phebs byung yang / der brten ma 'ongs gleng gzhi chen po 'byung bar shes nas rang thag chod pa'i sgo nas las bzhi'i sbyin bsreg byed par zhus/ de nas bkra shis lhun por phyin rang re'i zhwa dmar sprul pa'i sku'i sku mched du gyur pa'i rmong zhen gyi rang la ci yod kyi 'bul spang bskyed/ tshur la yang gdab lan ches bzang ba byung / de nas pho lha dang gnas par/ rtse chen rnams rgyud ra lung du zla ba gcig nye tsam sdod/ ya 'brog tu phyin yom po dor gu ru'i phyag rjes mjal/ rje dpa' bo rin po che yang ngos dang 'phral du 'phrad par phebs bzhin mu tig spa ma gong du mjal/ de skabs klu sogs bod kyi lha 'dre rnams 'khrugs pa'i cho 'phrul shin tu che zhing 'tshub pa rang byung / mtshur phu nas drung pa yang can gyi spyod pa ma bzo bas kho rang rgyad 'bud dang dbang ris bdag thob gang yod shel stod pa la sbyar rgyu'i gtam sbir gyi 'jigs shing bskrag ste ngo chen zhu dgos tshul gyi gnas 'dir byung bzhin zhu don legs par mnyal smad dge rir slebs skabs 'grub song ba/ de skabs ni dga' tshor tshad med byed kyi 'dug kho bo yang gting du chos pa'i yang mtha' byed snyam pa zhig mid bdog lho brag gi gnas mtha' dag mjal ba'i ched du phyin yang / der song na mi legs tshul gyi lung bstan byung bas dogs pa skyes rna bo cog nas tshur log gnas der sngar rang nyid chung ngu byis pa'i skabs dang ma mthun pa'i sngon gnas rjes su dran pa sogs gsal snang mang zhing ting nge 'dzin la yang bogs cung zad thon/ de nas mnyal smad du 'gro bar 'dod pa'i bgrod lam lo ro rgyud/ snga sor kun gzigs si tu'i zhabs sogs dam pa rnams la thugs dam brtag dpyad zhib mor zhus bzhin sprul pa'i skur snyam pa
