de yang lha babs kyi dus bzang po la rang dang lhan cig tu dkris rgyur byas mnyal smad dge rir phyin snga phyir gtor tshogs dang / gzhon nu'i ston mo sogs rten 'brel la phan pa rnams bgyis/ der mchod rten mkha' 'gro ma mang pos bzhengs par grags shing / de la nam mkha'i snying pos phyag mdzad pa'i phyag rjes gsal bar bzhugs pa'i mchod rten de ni dus 'khor ye shes le'u nas bshad pa'i mchod rten bzo dbyibs cha tshad 'khrul med du snang bas shin tu ngo mtshar skyes/ 'di skor dre'u lhas sprul pa'i sku rin por cher shang chos kyi bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang ras bris steng nas smin pa dang / chos drug phyag chen sogs khrid chen lnga tshangs bar bshad/ thugs mkhyen rab che zhing snang ba gshim pa byung / de skabs ltas 'tshub che ba gtud mar byung bzhin/ smin drug zla ba'i tshes phug lugs bcu gnyis tshad cing rang lugs kyi bcu gnyis ma chad pa'i nyi ma rtse shar skabs lha ldan du mi'i bdag po rgya nag tā zhing dag gis g.yo thabs kyi dkrong zhing / nyi ma de kar srid skyong rang 95

gi g.yog rigs drag pa 'dras dpung gi sbyor bas tā zhing gnyis kyi mtshon rgya mi gsum brgya lhag tsam zhig lnga pa'i lam du bkod nas kho pa rnams kyang ci bder gyes 'dug tshes bcu drug la dga' paṇa gyi bod gangs can la dbang bsgyur ba'i gtam dang bcas dmag gi bskul brda'i tham ka sngar gyi nag po de dang glu/ mi ring bar gangs can rje bo'i khri la 'khod pa yin zhes tham ka kha dog dmar por byas te byung /de phral rang nyid kyang lha ldan 'gro bar snyam yang chos ltar bcos pa'i brel ba mang po g.yeng nas 'gor/de skabs shed khyab 'jug chen po nam mkha'i kha dog lta bu gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa zhig rmi lam du mthong / 'di ni 'jig rten gyi lha mthu bo che yin pa thun mong gi dngos grub kha cig zhu'o snyam pa byung /lar de skabs mi rnams kyi brjod gleng sna tshogs pas nye/ tsar 'khod pa rnams dogs pa chu ltar du 'khol yang rang nyid ni 'di phyi bar do kun rnam rtog gi ri mo tsam las gzhan med par chos nyid kyi gshis la nges shes lhag par skyes pas legs nyes gang byung yang chog snyam pa las khu khrig gi snyem gang yang ma byung /tshes gsum gyi skabs drag shul can zhig re zhig gnod sbyin du skyes sam snyam pa byung / nged la gzhung sa nas bka' rgya zhig rtsis dpon phun tshogs kyi no bo ched mngags skyel btang ba gzhung rang gi ngan pa dgu 'dzoms du 'dod pa'i nyi ma de la 'byor/ de nyin pho nya ba 'phrad pa dang yi ge len pa gnyis ka ma thub/ de'i sang nyin yi ge khyer nas brngams zil bskyed kyang / nged kyi chu 'bab tsam las sger du bkur bzos bstab ma 'dod/ lta stangs kyi gzir bas ni mthar gdong ro mdog tu song / tshes dgu la lha ldan du 'gro ba'i lam du zhugs/ dal 'gros kyi gser khud chab tshan du yang bcag mal zhig byas/ de nas yongs ba bsham po'i la rtser 'brog pa bzung g.yag la gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ches che ba 'dzugs te yong ba kha yar dang 'phrad pa ni sham po dga' zhing nged rang la legs pa'i ltas su go/ /tshes bcu bzhir yar stod karma lha khang du sdod pa'i nub mor 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa yi brda' thabs kyi sgo nas 'jigs pa las grol ba'i dbugs dbyung / tshes bco lngar khra 'brug tu 'byor/ sbyin bdag chen por snying brtse bas ci ltar 'byor ba'i yo byad kyi snang gsal gtso bor gyur pa'i mchod pa dang / snyan dar yang phul zhing smon lam yang dag pa rgyas btab/ zhor du bya ba dang nya chu lha khang mjal/ bsam yas su 'byor skabs 'ja' dkar po zhig dbu rtse'i thad du ka ba ltar bgreng ba dang / dkor bdag chos skyong chen po des kyang sngar las dga' ba dang gus pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan/ dur khrod ma mo'i rigs yin pa nya bshan gyi bu mo zhig kyang 'phrad/ bcag mal byas te dbu rtse dang rta mgrin gling mchod rten dkar po rnams la mchod 'bul smon lam khra 'brug gi dpe 'dre byas/ byang chub chen po'i zhal ras lan mang du mjal yang 'di res ni mtshan dpe rdzogs pa'i mthar thug pa zhig tu mthong nas yid 'phrog pa byung / rgod dkar la 96

la yang ser bu dang bral zhing nyi ma mchog tu dwangs pa sogs yul bdag de dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur gyi ches bde/ tshal gung thang du bcag mal zhig byas nas nyi shu gnyis la lha ldan du 'byor/ nyi shu gsum la paṇ+ḍi tar mjal kha zhig dgos tshul smras kyang bka' 'dri mang tsam zhig byed rgyu yod pas de ma grub bar mi yong tshul byung ba/ de phral la zhu mkhan btang bas rten 'brel gyi nus pas sang yong ngo gsung pa ltar gru 'dzin gyi pho brang chen por phyin/ kun gyi lkog gyur shib bus gzhung gi dgongs khrel gyi gnas go /zhes smos par byed kyang der 'dus pa'i dbus gtsang gi drung 'khor che phras mtshon brgya phrag du mas gus pa'i zhe sa btab nas mgo bos 'dud par byas shing / sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i gus tshul ston/ yun cung zad lon pa na gser gdung gi steng ba gam srid zhi phun tshogs su gong zhabs mjal ba'i phyag rten du gan dar/ su war+ṇa srang gang / rdo bcud srang bco lnga'i grangs ldan bcas mgron gnyer nyi rgyal brgyud phul zhing / phyag byed pa'i skabs su sku lus drang por bsrang ste ting nge 'dzin gsar zhing mjal rten gyi dar bdag gi lag nas 'dzum bzhin pas phyag gi bzhes shing / g.yas gral der gdan kha gang ma zhig 'dug pa la mgron gnyer du mas nan tur gyis bskul yang babs thob med tshul gyi sa rjen la sdod/ thon gdong slar yang phyag dang bcas te gnas tshul kha shas gsol bas mtshams 'dri dang lan yid la babs pas byab/ bzhugs gral der paṇ+ḍi ta yang srid skyong snga ma rnams dang khri mtshungs par g.yon ngos su bzhugs 'dug pa la yang dar gcig bstab par mgo bos 'dud tsam byas song / kho rang la sger mjal zhus par mi yong zhes rtsegs po byas pa de yang lhus ma thing ba'i rnam pa byung / nged rang ni 'di skabs kun tu snang ba me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bur yul dang yul can mi phyed pa chos thams cad kyi gting la sleb pa 'dra zhig byung / de yang rtog pa'i ngo bo la nyams kyi rgyan btags par snang / ci'i phyir ngo bo 'gyurā ba med kyang gsal snang la 'phel 'grib tu cha bas so/ /de nas 'gro ba'i mgon po 'brug pa mchog kyang nged la gzhung nas dbyings tshoms yong ba'i sgra sbir che gshis de thag ma chod bar brtse ba'i thugs kyi phyogs phebs bshol ste lha ldan g.yu thog khang gsar du bzhugs 'dug pa mjal bar phyin shin tu dgyes par mdzad/ dpal ldan dpa' bo mchog kyang de dang go mthun lha sar bzhugs pa dang yang yang mjal/de'i phyi nyin mkhan rin po che rnyi ra dha ra/ shod nas bkras rab pa bcas rgyu mtshan ma nyung tsam lab pa la lan gang yin pa rnal ma btab/ slar yang tshes brgyad skabs rang gi gnas tshul dang / bstan pa spyi las 'phros pa'i gsol 'os ci snyed zhig yi ge'i lam du bkod de gzhung sar phul/ tshes bcu la slar yang spyir grub mtha' la brnyad cing bye brag bka' 'dri shin tu lci ba brgyad phebs par de la bag tsha ba cung zad tsam yang ma mchis par 'jigs pa med pa'i spobs pas rtsa tho yi ge dang ngag nas rgya cher spel te snyan du 97

btab/ tshul des bod sngags rnying pa'i lta grub 'dzin pa rnams dang bka' brgyud spyi la phan thogs ma chung tsam byung song yang 'gris che ba re zung las gzhan kun gyi shes par dka'/ bka' 'dri de ltar phebs pa'i rkyen ni nged la 'phrin las than thun byung bar ser 'bras kyi kun bslong can kha cig ma dges pa'i zhor dang / gtso bor mtshur bu sgar 'og phyogs rtogs rnams kyis nan gyi dkrugs pa'i mthu las so/ /tshes nyi shu skor la rgya yi zi ling an ban de 'byor nas/ nyer lnga la dbang gi phyag g.yog rgya dpung 'joms par byed pa sngar mthor ba rnams paṇ+ḍi ta rang nyid srid skyong yin rgyu'i rtsis kyi 'dzin sbyangs byas pa nyi shu lhag tsam zhig srog bkum pa la yang snying thag pa nas bsngo smon bzang po byas/ kha cig ngan 'gro chen po'i 'jigs pa las skyobs nus par yang sems/ tshes nyer drug gi nyin chen po kha cig gi rgyud mi ma yin gyi bskul te mtha' dmag bzlog pa'i bya ba sogs slad nas mi brtsam pa'i dag pa dgos zhes gsung byung ba des bdag la rung na rkang brkyang la de bas kyang rung snyam ste ro zhig de ltar khas blangs/ bod spyi'i rten 'brel la ni shin tu gnod tsha che ba rtogs/ gong zhabs kyi yongs 'dzin nu mdo hu'ang nas rang cag khams sog yul chos mthun zhing nged gu ru pad+ma la snying nas mos mkhan yin/khyed rang bya bral gyi spyod pa sngar mu ltar ci bder skyongs shig sogs mdzes tshig ci snyed zhig brgyud de 'phros su byung / de dang gong zhabs nas kyang lha ldan du yun ring sdod na mi dges tshul bka' btud mar phebs shis dgongs sbyar gyis skyes bdag lo cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes gcig la lha ldan nas thon te khyung rdzong brag gi ri khrod du 'byor/ lha sar drung 'khor mang zhig dbang chos kyi 'phro lus pas yid cung zad 'phreng ba byung / gnyal nas brtsam gnas 'dir sleb kyi bar chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur zhan 'khris kyi yul du ma gyur zhing / don dam gyi gshis stong pa nyid snying rje dang zung du 'brel ba byung tshor gyi rtog pa kun sbrul mdud ltar rang sar grol ba bde ba'i go skabs brnyed pa byung / de nas stod lung du gzhan phyogs mi srun pa mang zhig gi dpa' bkong ba'i slad du gzhung nas kyang bskur bzos chen pos byab pa'i 'u lag bcas dal 'gros kyi tshes dgu la skyer sgang du 'byor/ tshes bcu la spyod 'chang ba'i srol ltar 'khor lo bde mchog gi tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgyas pa zhig btang / 'gro ba'i mgon po 'brug pas kyang sgrol ma'i sku dang / gser zho so bdun gyi mtshon dngos po phon che zhing rnam par dag pa dang lhan cig yun 'tsho stsal ba dang / yul mdo khams nas zhwa dmar mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rin po che dang / kun gzigs si tu rin po che nas kyang brtse gzigs kyi ma skyud pa'i chab shog yun 'tsho'i rten bcas ched bsngags kyi bya ma rta yi gdong du der 'byor ba rten 'brel legs pa'i mtshan mar go/ /tshes bcu gcig la yong ba'i lam bar du rta bsu dang / thabs bsu/ ser 'phreng sogs bsu ba'i bkod pa bzang po dang 98

bcas mtshur phur phyin/ de skabs rlung tshub shin tu che/ de yang dgyes pa dang 'tshub pa'i mtshan ma can no/ /thog mar rgyal ba'i dbang po dpal karma pa chen po zhal ras lha khang du mjal bar phyag byas/ mtshur phu drung pa yang sgo 'gag bar bsu ba la byung / rgyal ba'i dbang po ni sku yi bzhugs tshugs/ gsung gi brjod pa/ thugs kyi 'char sgo rnams sngar dang mi 'dra ba bag chags pas yid 'gu ba thob/ de nas mi ring bar sbyor ba yan lag drug gi khrid dang / gzhan khrid bka' kha shas kyang dpa' bo rin po che dang lhan du phul/ mdo lugs kyi khrid rim thams cad kyi rgyal po jo bo rje'i thugs kyi nying khu byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'phro yang gong gi yab sras dang dkar po lcog sprul pa'i sku lhan du phul/ sbo zla'i tshes bco lnga byang bdag sogs kyi rgyal ba sku bltam pa'i dus su 'dod pa der lha chen 'dzam gling rgyan gyi drung du gong gi yab sras gsum dang rgyal tshab bcas la sems tsam dang dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed kyi cho ga yang dag pa gzhung tshig gang yin lhag chad kyi skyon spangs te phul/ de lta na yang bdag ni ma mkhas mi bsdom nyon mongs pa'i tshang tshing drag tu 'khrug pa zhig gi de ltar skabs su mi che ba'i nges pa gting nas bsnyed kyang / slob dpon la tshig gi rgyun thob pa tsam kho nas yur ba ma chad pa'i chu ltar bstan rgyun la che thang du dgongs te bzhes par mdzad pa ni slob ma bzang po'i mtshan nyid du gyur kyang rang nyid byang chub sems dpa'i mtshan nyid mi ldan bzhin slob dpon gyi khur bzung ba la nyes rtsang ci tsam mchis pa kun dpang gyur rgyal ba sras bcas dang dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha rnams kyi spyan sngar snying thag pa nas mthol zhing bshags dgos par snang ngo / /spyir ni der zla ba kha shas sdod ring mthun bar du chos kyi bya ba cung zad tsam las phal che ba zhig 'jig rten dgra 'dul gnyen skyong ltar snang bas dus 'da' ba'i rang bzhin du gyur cing / lha sar yang rgya yi tsong tu am pa phyi ma rnams rim pas 'byor rang lugs kyi sbo zla phug pa'i bshol snga 'don gyi lo gsar skabs paṇ+ḍi ta srid skyongs kyi khri las phabs te bka' blon spyi'i gral du 'khod cing / zla ba de'i tshes bcu gcig la dga' ldan khang gsar nas rdo ring du spo ba dang / zla ba de'i rjes ma'i tshes gcig la hor zla bcu pa'i tshes bco lnga nas gnang ba'i thams dmar de gong zhabs su bzhes nas phyin chad sngar spyi 'dra'i kha dog tu bsgyur ba sogs ya cha ba byung / rang la dad pa can gyi phul ba'i dngos po chud mi za ched du stod hor gyi zab gos gser ma la mu tig gi dra ba stel zhing g.yu dmar gyi phra btab pa gser stong gi rin thang can zhig gzhung debs su sbyar rgyu khri lcam bde ldan sgrol ma la do dam bcol nas bsam yas byang chub chen po'i dbu steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma'i dus chen gnam stong la phul/ yang de skabs rnying ma yi rdor smin byang chub gling pa sogs rnying dgon che kha yi phyag mgron sogs drag rim bkug nas rgyu mtshan dri ba'i phreng ba rgya cher spel ba'i skabs nyid dang / lha sa'i che kha 99

rnams kyang gcig 'og tu gcig mi 'du zhing re 'khong chen po dang bcas mtshon rtse'i rkyal pa bzhin nang mi gshim pa sogs dus snyigs ma'i rang tshang ni gsal por ngom bzhin pas yid skyo ba je cher 'phel ba'i rang gzugs nyid du gyur/ nag zla'i tshes nyi shu la rang byung zhabs kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i snang bcas chos khams la nges shes khyad par can zhig skyes/ 'di skabs snga phyir mnga' ris nas rgyal mo spun dang ske/ mnga' rir rje 'brug pa'i zhal skyin tshul du byon mkhan gyi bla ma lo ri ba/ lho brag rdi tsha sprul sku/ na len+t+ra bco brgyad/ sprul pa'i sku rnams bka' chos kyi ched du byon par so so'i 'dod ltar ci nus kyi chos bka' bshad/ gong zhabs nas dngas bar mdzad pa yi rim gro pa chen po'i lam nas brtag pa bgyid dgos phebs pa yang / 'byung 'gyur gnas cung zad go yang brda' don 'phrod rung tsam zhig las phul ma spob/ 'on kyang de la dgyes pas dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal chung ngu zhig dang / gsor dngul gyi phur ma mtshon byed bcas skyes su phebs/ nag zla'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nub lha chen po ma ho shwa ra 'phags yul gyi sgrub thabs dang mthun par dha ru ra dkar dmar gyi me tog shin tu mdzes pa'i rgyan can zhig kyang mi lam du mthong rka/ 'jig rten gyi lha chen po rnams kyi yang kho bo la yang yang gzigs par sems/ lar ni rang nyid gzhon nu'i skabs su rmi lam dge ba dang mthong snang sna tshogs par rtsis su bzung yang / dus phyis de la gcer cer po med nas lo shin tu mang zhing / mtha' dag yi ger 'brir yang ga la long / gzhan mkha' 'gro rnams kyi yang cung zad bkag pas so/ /de yang lha la dga' ba dang 'dre la mi dga' ba med zhes rtogs ldan rnams kyi zer mod/ mnyam bzhag dbyings su la zla ba'i skabs de ltar yin mod kyang kun rdzob kyi bden pa'i mthus lha mthong ba rnams bag gro zhing nyams dga' ba dang / bgegs mthong na de las ldog cing bar ma btang snyom gyi tshul du 'char ba dang da lta'i phung khams 'di mi 'gyur bde ba'i dbyings su dag pa ye shes kyi skur ma smin bar de ltar yod par go la/ 'on kyang dga' sdug bde mi bde la bzang ngan gyi khyad 'dzin cer cer po med par chos nyid gnyug ma'i dbyings su khad der snyoms pa rnal 'byor thob pa khas che ba rnams kyi rgyud la nges par skye ba'i khyad chos su bya dgos so/ /spyi btang tsam du kun la phan gnod kyi lha 'dre gang mthong yang dge dang mi dge ba'i mtshan ma yid bde dang mi bde ba'i khyad par gyi brtag go zhes grags pa yang mthun pa'o/ /dus de skabs rgyang sher bas blo gros kyi lang 'tsho phyung nas kong po nas phyag gar yang bos/ rnam gling nas sprul brdzu tshur bkug bya ko ba'i lha bu sku skye btson du bcug de'i g.yog tu bya ris pa sogs dam nyams kha shas dkris/ mi 'os pa'i bya ba lhu ru blang nas sngon gyi gleng gzhi rtsa slong gi blo 'dod ches che ba yi phu dkrug mda' dkrug byed kyi 'dug par blos ma bzod par rtse shod kyi mdun na 'don gal che rigs thams cad la rgyu mtshan zhib mo dngos po'i 'bul 100

mnon rang gi rngo gang thog bcas lha sar bang mi yang yang gzer btab/ zhwa dmar mchog gi phyag mdzod mgon po yang lha sar yun ring po'i bar don de skor gyi nyan non nyer len bgyid par bzhugs shing phyag tu dngos po yang srab pas dka' tsam byung tshod dang / dpa' bo rin po che yang don 'di skor la thugs ngal che yang re zhig rang phyogs 'pho 'gyur gling log mi 'byung ba'i rkang tshugs song rung rgyab skyor sku'i rim gro la 'bad dgos ni gal cher snang / de yang zhwa dmar mchog gi sprul pa'i sku re zhig bod du gdan chags na gleng gzhi yang rang sar grol zhing lug lo shar tsam sde dge lta bu'i khams su spyan 'dren gyi dgongs zhu gong zhabs la bgyis na nying chags shing lugs legs pa lta bur snang yang / snga sor me stag lor lha ldan bsam 'grub pho brang du sdod skabs nyi ma shar phyogs kyi sku don ni 'grub zhes lus med kyi sgra gsal por thos pa de skabs don ci bzhin rngo ma thogs kyang yab sras lhan rgyas mdo khams su phebs rgyu'i rten 'brel du go/ /mtshur lugs kyi sa ga dang / gzhung lugs kyi nag pa'i tshes nyi shu lnga la rgyal ba'i dbang po karma pa chen po yang lha ldan du gangs can rgyal por mjal phyag zhu ba'i lam zhugs gnang ba'i skabs karma pa'i skye 'phreng zhwa nag cod paṇa bcing ba'i skyes bu ni bcu gcig gam/ bcu gsum lhag mi 'byon pa'i nges pa lung gi grub bzhin/ karma pa da lta'i sku thog 'dir zhwa dmar ba dang bla slob kyi rten 'brel ma 'chugs pa gnang phyin slad mar zhwa dmar cod paṇa 'dzin pa dang / karma gnyis su med pa'i sgo nas gdul bya'i don mdzad pa las da phyin karma pa'i sprul skur sgro btags nas nag po'i cod paṇa bcings na mi legs par karma pa chen po bcu gsum pa rang nyid kyi thugs kyi dgongs bzhin de don phyag gi a k+ṣa ra dri bzang gi phyag mthil gyi rjes dang bka' rtags phyag rgyas spras pa dpal ldan dpa' bo rin po che dang / zhwa dmar nag gi mdzod pa/ nged bcas 'dus par gnang song zhing bdag ni 'di skabs chams pas bro 'tshal bas phebs bskyal rgyang ring du ma thub par gnam sgo'i mtshams su phyag gsum phrag dag btsal nas phyag dbang zhus/ sku zhabs 'di nub sna dkar du bzhugs rtsis su phebs/tshes nyer drug gza' skar 'grub sbyor bzang po la skyer sgang 'bum pa'i rdza tog de mkhas pa chos mdzad kyi zla ba phyed gnyis kyi bar du bcos nas grub pa'i rtsis su byas kyang yid tshim pa zhig ni ma byung / 'on kyang der 'bad kyi dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngos/ mtshur phu nas rang nyid 'phral du thon rtsis yin yang lha ldan du rnam gling pa dang / gar she sogs nas byed rgyu mang bar bskyar nan gyi rtse shod du zhu yig re 'bul bar rdzang par dgyes pa'i ngang tshul dang bcas rang gi bzhed ltar gnang rgyu'i rtsis su byung / dpal karma pa chen po yang lha sar zla gcig lhag tsam gdan chags par mchog dman mtha' dag nas gus zhabs che zhing gzhung lugs sa ga'i nyer bzhi la/ gong zhabs dang mjal 'phrad skabs ldang ba mthong bzhes bzos 101

go bogs gang ci 'di res rings sngar las legs cha che ba yang rten 'brel gyi mthu las byung 'dug cing /gzhung lugs kyi snron zla ba'i tshes lnga la mtshur du bde bar phebs par phebs bsur mthil du phyin lus kyi ma lnga sa la phab pa'i phyag sngon du 'gro bas phyag dbang zhus/ rje 'bri gung pa yab sras nas kyang lha ldan dang 'di ru yang pho nya snga phyir gnang zhing sngar nas dag pa'i snang ba rgyas bzhin gong 'phel du gyur/ de ltar mtshur du 'di res zhag kha yar las mi sdod pa'i rtsis su byas kyang zla ngo drug dang hril po lnga yi ring 'gor zhing phyi nas dgra zla nang nas 'thab 'khrug bar nas zer gsog che bar ma zad yab sras kyi gra ris nas kyang gzigs phyogs dang brjod pa sna tshogs pas tsher ma'i dong dang shine nad kyi bro tshal ba ltar sgo gsum ngal dub che che 'dra ba byung yang phal che phyag rgya chen po'i dbyings su la zla ba'i khul tsam byas shing / zhwa dmar sprul pa'i sku 'di nyid khrir 'khod pa dang lhan du rang gi las khur des zin pa yis/slad nas 'di skor la 'jug mi dgos pa'i zhu dkrol yang dag grub zin pa yin yang 'di lo shin tu nyen cing 'gyur ba che ba'i skabs su gyur pa yi slar yang yab sras rnams la sman pa'i bya ba sgo du ma nas rgya ma chung tsam grub te 'di kun sngon gyi smon lam gyi 'phen pas rang gi las kyi rgyu bar snying nas nges shes kyi steg bur yid kyi khye'u ngal gsos thob/ skabs 'dir mtha' dang bod yul gyi lha 'dre mthu bo che rnams ches 'khrugs pa'i ltag dang / cho 'phrul thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa du ma bar mi chad du 'byung ba'i skabs su yin/ mtshur sgar chen yar phebs pa'i rjes su yang 'gong po nye 'tshe ba kha shas 'brang ba'i ltas byung bas brdzong na legs tshul smras par/ cha gsum lan kha shas dang tshes brgyad la lha bsang rgyas pa zhig kyang btang song / 'di skabs zhwa dmar mchog dang / si tu rin po che'i sku zhabs su bang mi rdzong rgyu'i zhu yig rnams bris shing / lhag tu si tu rin po che'i zhal sngar bka' brgyud gser 'phreng dang / sgra rig tsan+d+ra pa'i 'grel pa sngags brgyud kha yar la 'gyur zhus sogs sngar nas gsol ba btab bzhin 'di res yang nan bskyed kyi bskul ma dang / yab sras rnams zhabs pad brtan cing nges don snying po'i bstan pa dar rgyas yun ring du gnas pa'i smon lam ma snying thag pa nas rtag tu 'debs bzhin pa'o/ /'dir smras pa/ dus kyi chu gter srubs 'phreng cher 'khrug cing / /'jigs rung 'jigs pas phyogs kun yongs bslad kyang / /pad 'byung thugs rje'i snang bas phyogs bsnyed cing / /bsod nams gru chen blo gros gzer gyi bsdams/ /smon lam rlung gi 'dod pa'i ba dan g.yos/ /skyes mchog skye rgu rnam pa mang po dag /ngal 'jigs las 'das dga' bde'i gling bzang por/ /dbugs dbyung gru chen grub pa'i ngang tshul yin/ /ces so/ /'di skabs kyi spyad rab zhib mor bgyis na ches mang yang 'dir phyogs mtshon tsam ste zhib pa slar brjod par 'dod do/ /zhes gsungs/ de yi 'phros nas zhib par reg zig tu 'khod pa sogs mi 102

snang bas brjod par mi nus kyang rje nyid nas/ gangs can bstan pa'i bdag po gong zhabs bdun pa thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen mo rgyal mchog bskal bzang rgya mtshor 'bul bar mdzad pa'i chab shog las gsung ji bzhin pa rags tsam 'dir btus pa ni gong gi 'phro nas 'di ltar/ grub pa'i gnas tshur gyi garnyo la nas thon ste rkang nad kyi bro ba sel ba'i dbu re'i chu tshan brten par zhag shas 'gor zhing /der don du gnyer ba'i skye bo kha shas la thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid dang yig drug gi dge bskul than thun las gzhan mar thud zho yi skyes phran bu'i ngo 'dzin gyis rang nyid dge sbyor la gnod cing gzhan phan ji bzhin ma yin pas dub par gyur/ de nas thon te char zhod kyi tshegs che bzhin chu 'bem la rgyud jo mo gangs dkar du sngar gtor chen kha shas re gtong bas spyi dang bye brag yul de'i mi phyugs la shin tu phan par byung song bas 'di res kyang lha 'dre rnams 'gu phyir gtor chen zhig sbyin/ de nas dal 'gros kyi zab phur 'byor/ bod du grub pa'i gnas chen bzhi dang / zab phung mkha' 'gro'i 'du ba phal cher yong gsungs ltar mkha' 'gro nges par 'du ba'i bltas sngar nas yong bzhin 'di res kyang de rnams kyi 'di ba'i tshogs ci rigs pa mthong / der gtor tshogs ci nus su bgyis/ der gnyan chen po thang lha dang / dam can rdo rje legs pas bod yul du mtha' dmag mi 'jug pa'i rten 'brel bsgrig dgos tshul byung yang da ni bdag lta so skyes nyams nyes pa zhig gi de lta rngo mi thog pa'i nges pa yid la bcag bzhin ci bder bzhag de nas rgya mtsho phug rdzong su de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku brnyan kha shas bzhengs shing /yul de'i gdol pa kha shas la gter sbyin bzang pos 'gu bar byas nas lo gsum ring lcags sbrul mi gsod pa'i tha tshig blang zhing dpang po yang mi khung ldan la bcol/ de skabs nas bod yul gyi lha 'dres 'thab 'khrug gi tshul shugs mi che tsam zhag shas kyi ring byung zhing / sngar 'di rigs shugs che ba ni 'phral dang shugs mi che ba ni 'gyang tsam nas za zi 'byung ba la lta bar 'dug 'on kyang bar skabs shig nas cung zad zhi song / de nas sog po 'dzul khung du grags pa rang byung zhabs kyi gnas zhal phyes shing rdo rje gling pa'i gter gnas skye bo phal pa rnams kyi zab phu lung dang mtshungs par rtsi 'dug kyang / don du ni zab phu'i gnas phran du gyur pa der gtor tshogs ci nus bgyis/ de skabs rang la rgya 'dre 'gong po'i 'tshub ldong gi 'dzer ba'i rnam pa byung yang ji mi snyam pas lam khyer du byas/ don du gnyer ba rnams la ni zab lam ni gu chos drug la sogs bshad nas bya rgod lding la brgyud a la phug dang ba yag gi 'brog gnas rnams su tshe dbang ma ṇi dge bskul bcas 'jad du thon/ de bar gzhan gyi sbyin pa'i dngos po bdag gir cher ma bzung zhing cung zad blang ba yang lam bar tshes bcu yig drug 'dzugs pas mtshon bsgrub mchod kyi rgyu 'ba' zhig tu spong thag tshul du sbyar/ 'jad nas btsams bal yul dang rgya 103

gar ba rnams kyi swa yam bu s+t+ya ta zhes rang byung mchod rten chen po sangs rgyas rin chen gtsug tor can gyis dpral ba'i mdzod spu'i 'od zer las grub pa yin tshul bdag cag gi ston pa'i gsung dang / de yi rjes su 'brang ba'i bstan bcos ches mang ba dang bal yul du dkar chags da lta yang snang zhing / sngon slob dpon chen po dbyig gnyen gyis kyang yul dbus nas bal yul rang byung mchod rten gzigs par phebs pa lo rgyus khung ma rnams nas 'byung zhing / jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti shas yang bod du phebs pa la rang byung mchod rten gzigs pa'i zol mdzad pa sogs 'phags yul nyid du grags che zhing bod yul du bar skabs mkhas dang grub pas glang ru lung bstan gyi mdor gsung pa'i mchod rten go ma sa larteghaljar ngos bzung zhing / bod yongs su 'phags pa shing kun tu grags pa de zhig grum gog nyams shin tu che ba yisaske/ de la zhig bso'i blo 'dod bya ri kam sho ma'i zhig bsos grub pa nas brtsams ring mo zhig nas byung yang / res rang gi rtag pa ma 'chub/ res dus kyi 'gyur bas rim 'gyangs su gyur pa 'di lo yo byad sngon nas sta gon ma byas stabs zhig bso ji bzhin 'grub par dka' yang srog shing yo ba bsrang ba dang /gser zangs kyi char khebs zhal bso tsam phul thub na yang phan yon bsam gyi mi khyab par shes te nam dus kyi gtugs shing chu mi snyoms pa dang / tshad pa che yang rgyal ba dgyes phyir rang gi lus srog ltos med kyi bal por 'gro bar thag bcad 'jad tshun chad du dad can gyi sbyin pa'i yo byad phal cher bdag tu bzung nas gser dngul du dril ba'i khul byas/ lam zhor du jo nang sku 'bum la mchod 'bul dang /sgrub sder zhabs tog phran bu bcas shing / de'i zhor dge phu'i ri khrod du rang gi khrid brgya'i khrid rgyun dang rka/ dus 'khor sbyor drug smin par zhus pa'i rdo rje slob dpon sbas tshul sgrub pa'i sa la nges par bzhugs pa dpal brtse ba chen po'i sku gdung la gus pa'i phyag dang nyin zhag bdun gyi bar du ci nus pa'i mchod pa dang phyi nang gsang ba'i tshogs 'khor rgyud sde nas bshad pa nyid dang rjes mthun du bsgrub/sngar sems dben mthar thug gi ye shes skye tshul la spyad pa phra mo zhig yod par 'dir nyams rtogs dngos min kyang yid gnyis spang pa yang dag pa'i go ba zhig rgyud la skyes/ bla ma'i sku gdung mchod pa'i byin rlabs la nges shes lhag par brnyed der bal po'i rgyal po dang / ri brag la gor+ṣa rgyal pos kyang shing kun zhig gso la bkag 'gegs mi byed cing grogs ldan phran bu byed tshul gyi yi ge yang dga' bas btang ba 'byor la/ lha rtse rgya mtsho la rgyud la stod rgyal gyi shrī zhes 'dzam bu gling du dpal gyi ri bcu gsum yod pa'i ya rgyal de'i 'dabs su 'byor/ de skabs 'jig rten gyi lha chen po gzhon nu gdong drug dang /ga na sa ti'i gzugs kyi snang ba gsal ba zhig mthong ste bal yul sa yi phyogs la lhag par dbang byed pa'i lha yin par 'dug pas bal por 'gro dgos pa'i rten 'brel yin nam snyam pa byung / snga sor mtshur 104

phur sdod pa'i skabs nyid nas gong ma mchog gi zhabs pad du zhabs brtan zhig 'bul na rten 'brel gnad che ba'i ltas byung yang blo khum pas 'bul ma spob zhing / de rjes gang gi zham rim mkhyen pa mchog tu rgyas pas rten 'brel bzang po'i mthun sbyor sku tsher dmigs pa'i rim gro legs tshul phebs pas kyang bzang po'i las kyi bsos su thob pa bzhin gnas chen rnams su zhabs pad brtan pa'i smon 'dun ci nus bgyis/ der spob pa skyes te spyan lam rngo thog min ji ltar yang dngas shing gus pa'i zhabs brtan 'bul bar rang dang lhan cig spyod pa dge slong bstan 'dzin rdo rje ched du lha ldan zhabs pad du bcar bar brdzangs/ rang nyid 'di nas 'phral du thon te rgyal bas lung bstan pa'i gnas zhi byed kyi ring lugs pa rnams kyi rdo rje gdan lta bu'i ding ri glang 'khor dang / grags pa'i mtsho chen bzhi'i ya gyal ma mo gangs dkar sha med rdo rje spyan gcig ma gnas pa'i dpal mo dpal thang rgyud/ mchod rten gyi shing gor+ṣa rgyal por ltos dgos pa'i stabs kyi skyid grong nas brgyud bal por ci myur 'jug pa'i rtsis su lags/zhes dang / bka' shog lhan rgyas kyi bka' len du 'di ltar/ snga sor skabs 'dzum lang dang / bal yul gyi yam bu'i rgyal po dang 'phags yul gyi cha shas 'bum phrag brgya yi mnga' 'bangs can ti ra hu ti'i bdag po chen po sogs nas rang rang gi yul phyogs su yong dgos tshul byung yang 'gro ba'i spros pa skyung zhing —/ 'di lo dgun spa gro stag tshang phyogs su bgrod rtsis yin yang phral bal po'i rgyal pos yong dgos tshul nan bskyed pa dang / rang nyid nas kyang bya rung kha shor gyi zhig gso grub mtshams 'phags pa shing kun gyi zhig gso bgyid 'dod dung dung pos zhe dam bcas pa yin yang / 'brug lo rang la ltas ma chub cing ske/ sbrul lo'i gzhug gung g.yog rnams kyi srog skyobs khur lci'i dub bzhin pas bgrod ma nus pa dang /rta lo'i mthar slar yangatwas 'gyur gyi lha sar yong dgos sogs kyi rim 'gyangs su gyur pas 'di lo bal po'i rgyal pos kyang yong dgos tshul nan bskyed kyi bskul ba dang / gor+ṣa rgyal po la mchod rten srog shing blang ba'i snga sor nas yig dan yod kyang mon pa'i rgyal po blo 'gyur bla ba bcas phral du pho nya btang bas sngar don bzhin yin tshul byung zhing de lta na'ang rang gi sngar nas bdag 'dzin yo byad 'phra zhing 'phral du blang khul kyang 'byor pa srab pa bcas zhig gso mthar phyin zhig dka' rung bal yul du phral mar 'gro rtsis dpal thang dang nye ba'i sman khab stod kyi char 'byor skabs lags pa mang gnas tshul dang / ched du zhu 'os la/ mchod rten gyi srog shing phul ba tsam gyi phan yon bsam gyi mi khyab pas 'di lo mtshur phur karma pa'i zhu don 'dras sdod yun ring stabs tshad par nam dus kyi btug rung bal yul du 'phral mar 'gro rtsis dpal thang dang nye ba'i sman khab stod kyi char 'byor skabs lags pa yang gnas tshul dang / ched du gsol 'os la dgas rgyal pos ring mo nyid nas yong dgos tshul yi ge bar mi chad 105

byung zhing / snga sor na tshod gzhon nu'i skabs zhig o rgyan gardzo ba yi yul du bgrod na snyams shing / de yi lam zhor du 'khel stabs yong rgyu'i rtsis smras kyang dus phyis zhwa dmar ba'i skor sogs kyis yang bod yul dbus su yun ring 'gor zhing / da cha na tshod kyi gtugs zhing lhag tu rang nyid skye yul mtha' 'khob tu gyur par ma zad/ mi gshis kyi rgyal po rnams kyi mdun na 'jug pa'i mkhas 'jug bkra lag de ma shes stabs chen po rnams kyi mdun na 'jug shos shig yong gi med pa ni kun gyi dgongs mnga' ltar lags na stod phyogs su phan tshun legs bzlum dmag 'khrug zhi zhing stod hor bzlog pa sogs shin tu phan yon che ba yin snang na yang / re zhig bal yul mchod rten chen po'i zhig gso'i khyad bcas stod phyogs su 'gro bar mi spro la/ lar ni lcags pho khyi lo la stod hor bod du 'byung bar gu ru'i lung bstan du gsal zhing / de la yang dus tshigs rim pa kha yar yod pa'i gcig ni me lug dbus gtsang dus zir byung nas lo shas kyi lcags pho khyi de yin pa dang / de bzlog phyir mang yul ri bo dpal 'bar du rten 'brel bsgrig dgos tshul gu ru'i lung bstan byung zhing me lug dang sprel gyi lo snga phyi sdom lo gcig nye ba tsam du de yi rten 'brel la rang nyid kyi 'bad par byas pas de skabs lung bstan du lo nyi shu rtsa lnga'am sum cu so bdun gyi bar stod hor gyi dmag bsrings ba dang / de nas kyang rten 'brel bsgrigs tshul gyi lo ci rigs bsrings ba'i thabs yod la/ rten 'brel gyi gnad 'chugs na dpyad log lta bus dus thung ngur mi dge ba 'char bar gsung ba zhig byung mod/ de tshul dus de skabs nyid du rang la yid ston pa'i slob ma rnams la smras pa tsam las gzhan dmangs rnams la ni dgos pa mi che bas ma smras shing / chen po kha cig la gsol bar de legs bso'i tshig byung na yid 'gu ba las zang zing gi dngos po'i re 'dod mi bdog kyang gzhan dbang gi khrel brdas byed pa las ma byung / 'on kyang de skabs rten 'brel gyi rtsa ba de dang /da dung kyang bsgrigs tshul kha shas ma 'chugs na re zhig ni phyir bsring nus par sems la/ lcags glang gi lo mthar nged mdo khams su yod skabs lung bstan zhig tu rgya nag gi bod la dbye 'byed lan gsum byas pa'i mthar bstan rim la ma brtson na stod hor 'byung bar gsung na/ des na dbye 'byed gsum pa slar 'byung 'dra bsnyam zhing / de rjes bod la stod hor gyi nyen shin tu che ba zhig yod 'dra/ yang shing yos kyi lor bod kyi rje bo mchod yon gyi tshul bzhin du rten 'brel bsgrigs nas spa gro stag tshang gi gter thon na mchod yon 'dza' shing bod spyi la bde ba'i rten 'brel can gu ru'i lung bstan byung yang mi dbang chen po de nyid kyi thugs ches mdzad pa'i stod phyogs bla ma kha cig nas 'di ni zog po'o/ /lhag tu ga ge mo dang che ge mo dang nang gshim pa zhig go/ /zhes pa la brten 'tshams 'dri'i zhu yig tsam yang ma bzhes nas lo kha shas song gshis de tshul snyan du 'bul ma bde shing / rang yang 'tshegs che gshis ci bder 106

'jog dgos byung / de bzhin gong sa skyabs mgon mchog gi sku che'i 'gal rkyen zhi ba'i rten 'brel gu ru'i lung bzhin lan kha yar bsgrigs pa na ning rtalo'i dus 'gyur skabs de khongs yus dang bcas ngo sor 'phyags te gsol bar 'dus sde chen po gsum gyi rten 'brel las lhag pa khyod rnal 'asnyor pha gcig gi ham par zad do/ /zhes gzhung sa nas bka' phebs pa sogs 'di rigasasgros pa bskyudz+wad+ku'i gnas su go zhing / lhag tu da ni rnal 'byor rgagapo 'chi kha ma zhig gi bod spyi la phan pa'i bya ba rngam 'grub pa zhig dka' la/ de bas yul mtha' 'khob rnam g.yeng chung ba'inags gseb zhig tu sngar thos pa byas pa'i chos rgyun dkon po kha shas spel thub na dang / mi nus na dge sbyor byed/ mi nus na sos dal gyi sdod pa zhig la yid smon bca' kyi yod/ de lta na yang stod phyogs su 'gro ba phral ltas ma 'chub la/ yang ltas 'chub nges rigs rang la byung tshe su yam bhu rtsu ta zhig bso grub mtshams lha bcas 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon mchog la yang thugs dam gsal rtags bcas skabs su ji ltar bab kyi 'phros slad mar zhus mchog pa zhu rgyu dang / rang nyid kyi blo 'dod la ni bal yul mchod rten gyi zhig gso grub mtshams mdo khams rgyal mo dang sde dge sogs rgyal phran du mar gyur pas bskul zhing skye yul gyi dgon khag nas kyang lo re bzhin pho nya btud mar btud pa bcas mtha' khob kyi phyogs su rang nyid zod bde zhing skyid la rgyal ba'i bstan pa la yang ci nus sman pa'i slad du bgrod 'dod 'chis la/ gang cir bal por slebs mtshams gnas tshul zhib mo cis kyang 'bul bar spro zhes gsungs/ de yang rang byung gi mchod rten chen po 'phags pa shing kun gyi nyams bso gnang ba'i bzhed pa snga sor kha shor kyis nyams bso gnang skabs nyid nas dgongs par nges kyang bstan 'gro'i don du phyogs bral gyi gdul byar gzhan phan 'phrin las kyi rim 'gyangs su gyur pa nas/ skyes bdag ces pa lcags lug gi mjug der skyid grong rgyud ne pā la yi ljongs su chibs kha bsgyur ba'i tshe gar phebs su ser skya mchog dman bar ma'i gdul bya bsam gyis mi khyab par/ khrom dbang /badz+ra gu ru/yig brgya/ yig drug gi bzlas lung / 'ga' zhig la rang rang gi 'dod pa bzhin gyi dbang lung khrid sogs mtha' yas pa zhig rtsol bzhin par bal yul gyi 'bum sde'i mnga' dbang ma hā rā dza dza ya pra ga su rgyal blon 'bangs bcas kyi bskor ba'i rta dang glang po rgyan gyis brgyan pa sogs bsu ba'i bkod pa rgya chen pos rgyang ring po nas zhabs bsus te rang byung gi mchod rten chen po'i bya 'dab ki ḍo'i gtsug lag khang chen por phebs so/ /de nas kyin rdo be ha rir/ rdo dmar ba dbang phyug rdo rje dang / khro bo'i bla ma rje mgon nang pa gnyis kyi gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ rje nyid kyi dag snang bsam pa lhun grub ma'i sgrub thabs yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i man ngag bcu gsum gyi khrid smin rgyas su stsal/ mgon nang pa sku sger du byang gter thugs sgrub yang tig gcer sgron gyi khrid smin par stsal zhing /107

don gyi ngo sprod rnal 'byor nam mkha'i skad dod dzo ki a khar du grags par stsal/ yam bur rgyal po'i khab yid 'ong skyed mo'i tsha la snye chen sred med bu yirten khang khrus kyi rdzing bu dang ljon shing gi ra ba gnyis skyes du ma dang ritwags sna tshogs pas gang ba shin tu nyams dga' ba'i tshal am bel du bzhugs skabs zhi khro nges don snyidza po'i phur pa'i las byang rdo rje rab 'bar mdzad/ shing kun gyi nye 'dabs 'jam dpal mchod3na du/ mdo chen pa sngags 'chang chen po rgyal sras seng ge sogs bla ma mang zhig la/ byang gter phur pa'i dbang brgyud pa'i bka' srol chu bo drug 'dus kyi dbang chen sogs bka' drin bskyangs so/ /rgyal zla'i gza' tshes dge bar mchod rten chen po'i zhig gso'i sta gon gnang ba'i tshe/ lha chen po bi na ya ga'am/ ga na pa ti ste tshogs kyi bdag po dang / gzhon nu karti ka gnyis nas rang gzugs dngos su bstan te/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che la shin tu gus pa'i blos/mchod rten chen po'i nyams gso sgrub pa 'di'i gser la sogs pa'i yo byad mtha' dag 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung ba'i 'phrin las bdag cag gi bgyi'o zhes khas blang pa dang / de bzhin lha chen po birgyu bram ze'i gzugs su sprul pa zhig dngos su byung nas lha yi mchod sdong dang mtshungs pa'i srog shing chen po 'di ltar yod pas 'dren par mdzod/ ces bskul nas mi snang bar gyur/ de ltar lha chen po rnams kyis 'phrin las yang dag par sgrub pa'i rten 'brel dang / gtso bor rje nyid kyi thugs rje nus pa'i stobs chen pos/ yam bu rgyal po shrī shrī dza ya pra ga sa dang / gor+ṣa rgyal po pri bī na ra ya na bcas la srog shing phral du 'dren dgos par bka' stsal ba so so'i khas blang dam bcas shing / chos kyi 'khor lo bcu gsum gyi zangs gser sogs kyi las gra 'dzugs par mdzad/ de yang / gdugs dang chos 'khor bre rnams kyi zangs gser la slad nas dus dbang gi zhig gso byed pa po yang dkon par dgongs zangs rnams shin tu 'thug gling che ba bgyid du rtsal/ de dag gi tshul gong gi chab shog tu gsal ba'i 'phros nas/ slar yang gong sa mchog tu phul ba'i chab shog tu 'di skad ces/ 'di phyogs rang gi gnas tshul gsol 'os/ rgyal gyi shrī'i ngogs nas mgo zla'i tshes 15la thon te g.yas skor gyi tshul du bong chu brgal/ ding ri phyogs su slebasaske/ lha btsan sgang dmar sogs mi ma yin dregs pa can rnams kyi kyang dga' ba'i ngang tshul bcas bal yul zhig gsor dmigs pa'i gser mang du 'byor/ glang 'khor dam pa'i sku nga thim par grags pa dang /sku gdung ke ru sogs rten gsum khyad par 'phags shing / dam pas gnas 'di nyid rdo rje gdan dang mtshungs pa lta bur bsngags pas snang gsal gyi mchod pa der sdod ring nyin mtshan bar mi chad phul zhing —/ skye bo mang po la sman pa'i slad du gtor chen dang / zhi ba'i sbyin bsregs nan zhig kyang byas/ de bzhin 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i gtsug lag khang dge sding bzhi'i ya gyal na bzlum dge sding du 108

sngon bo dong 'jigs bral la birlu pas lam 'bras mngon sum du gsung nas thim par grags pa birlu pa'i logs ris byin rlabs shin tu che ba de la yang mchod pa'i bye brag ci 'byor ba phul zhing / dge ba'i smon lam ci nus btab/ sman khab smad dang stod brgyud dpal ma dpal khud gzhung lam kho na bsrang / jo mo bya mar grags pa'i ri'i mgu la nas slob dpon chen po srin po 'dul bar phebs pa'i gung thang la thog gi bya lar grags pa de dang nye ba bya rgyud la brgal rdzong khar zhag kha shas bsdad cing / de'i bar mi ma yin 'du che ba'i gnas rnams su dam pa'i zhabs bstan 'gro ba'i bde thabs su dmigs pa'i gtor ma chen po re dang / nyi ma re re bzhin skye bo sum brgya dang lnga brgya dang stong phrag gnyis gsum gyi mtshon pa la dka' tshegs la ma stos par tshe dbang re dang lhag tu yig drug bsgoms bzlas kyi lung 'bog nas lo bcu gnyis yar btags pa rnams la nyin re bzhin yig drug sum brgya re chag med kyi dam bca' bskul/skabs 'gar byang sdom 'bog pa sogs rang nyid yon tan gyi dbon kyang / gzhan blo chos la 'jug gang thub khul du byas/ de nas skyid grong byams sprin dang 'phags pa wa ti la yang sngar rgyun ltar snang gsal gyi mchod pa rgya gang che dang bcas pa'i smon lam rgyas par btab/ yul mtshan so so nas khrom dbang dgos tshul nan che yang spros pa bskyung 'phral du rgyal zla'i tshes nyer gnyis la bal yul gyi lam du zhugs/rdo rje bswe 'byin ma'i pho brang dang nye bar zhabs pad mchog gi bka' rgya son/ bal yul lam du zhugs zin stabs lan gcig bal por 'gro rgyur byas/ bse thang 'di gu ru'i gnas chen yin 'dug pas ci 'byor gyi tshogs 'khor rgyas pa zhig byas/ de nas zla gam gnam sgo'i chu klung gi ngogs sa ḍū dang / ri'i rgyal po ni la kar+sā'i chu klung gi ngogs sgang thog mdung lang zhes ta mangs kyi rigs zur pa smra ba de rnams la khong rang tsho'i 'dod ltar gtor dbang / yig drug gi lung dang / de nas bal bod kyi mtshams nags klung stug po sing ga ba na zhes pa de nyi ma gsum du brgal nas bod mkhar rgyud rig byed kyi gzhung du gsang ba'i gaṅgar 'dod pa'i chu klung de brgal tsha ba tsha shod du mchod rten srog shing ched du zhag bco lnga skor sdad nas bram ze 'dod pa'i rigs sngags zhu ba mang du byung ba la lo tsā brgyud nas rjes gnang mang du byas/ gor+ṣa rgyal po rang nyid kyang rab tu gus pa'i tshul ston cing rigs sngags blang 'dod 'dug kyang rten 'brel dbang gi 'di res 'then/ der bal po shing bzo ba rnams ma byung bas sems 'tshig te lam du zhugs par shing bzo ba rnams lam bar du 'phrad/ rmi lam du re zhig phyogs der bsdad na dge ba'i ltas byung yang rang nyid ci brtol dang / bal po'i rgyal pos kyang 'phral du yongs dgos tshul nan che gshis bal yul mthil du yong / srog shing bya ba ma grub bar gor+ṣa dang yam bu phan tshun 'thab 'khrugs mi byed pa so so nas yi ge blang / na ga ga mir yam bu rgyal po ngos dang bal po'i skye bo khri phrag du mas 109

mdun bsus/ rang nas sangs rgyas kyi phyag rgya bzhi dran bzhin skye bo de rnams kyi bskor te yam bu'i grong du zhugs/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dang gzungs sngags bsgrags zhing dge ba'i smon lam ci nus btab/sems la ni mi rtag pa'i skyo shas lhag par che zhing de yi dgongs mo gnyid yang mi khugs pa tsam byung / de nas rang byung mchod rten chen po'i 'grams bal skad kyi kista zhes gtsug lag khang rnying pa zhig tu re zhig gnas phab/ rang byung mchod rten chen por tshogs dang mchod 'bul ci nus yang yang bgyis shing /kha shor du yang de bzhin bgyid 'dod la gnas dus kyi der gnyug mar gnas pa rnams dkon mchog gi dkor la 'phri bcom che zhing skabs su der rten 'khrug pa 'dra yang 'byung gi 'dug pas dngul srang lnga bcu lhag tsam gyi mar me las mchod 'bul gzhan spros pa bskyung dgos pa byung / bal por sdod ring chos 'khor gyi zangs gser rnams grub na snyam pa ther zug byas shing / rgyal pos kyang de don ltar do khur gang che mdzad song yang las byed 'go mi rnams bal po'i yul lugs kyi cher grub pa zhig mi 'dug pas stod mar yul phyogs kyi dmag 'khrug zhi phyir 'gro ba de yang gal che nyid du rtogs shing / slar yang skyabs mgon mchog gi zhabs pad nas bka' rgya rin po che skyar te phebs pa bcas/ la dwags tshogs su bgrod rgyu'i lam zhugs phral du byas zhes gsungs pa ltar/ de'i tshe 'phags yul ma gha dha'i byang phyogs hi ma la te ri bo gangs can gyi phyogs bzhir ke ta ra bzhi gnas pa'i lho phyogs kyi ke ta ra ti se gangs kyi brgyan pa'i ri kha ba can gyi ljongs bod dang bod chen pos dbye ba'i bod yul gyi cha nas stod hor dang sog po'i rgyu srang / stod mnga' ris skor gsum du grags pa'i sa yi thig le chu klung seṅge kha 'bab tu grags pa ni la'i chu mgo mar yulu g.ya' ris bskor ba'i yul der mang bskur nyi ma'i gnyen gyi gdung bod rje lha btsad po'i rigs las gyes pa mar yul bdag po'i rgyud chad med mngon par mtho ba'i go 'phang can la dwags rgyal po khu dbon nang 'khrugs te/ stod hor du ruṣ+ka'i dmag gi dpung chen po drag tu g.yo ba'i rgyu rkyen la zhugs te bod yul gangs can gyi skye dgu mtha' yas pa la shin tu bzod par dka' ba'i duḥ kha ster bar chas pa la/ sngar bod kyi srid skyongs dbang sku zhabs dā las pa thur rgya khrims kyis rkyen dbang du song rjes/ gangs can mgon po phyag na pad+mo sdom rtson rgyal po'i tshul du bstan pa gong zhabs bdun pa rgyal dbang skal bzang rgya mcho'i srid skyongs kyi thugs khur bzhes pa'i skabs der la dwags rgyal po nang 'khrugs kyi rkyen las mtha' dmag g.yo ba'i tshul thugs kyi ma bzod te ris su ma chad pa'i skye 'gro spyi dang bye brag mar yul la dwags kyi ljongs su thugs rje chen pos dgongs pa'i bar 'ching legs bzlum gnang bzhed pas la dwags rgyal por bka' rgya stsal kyang phan tshun nas dngas len ma zhus pas gnang gtad du gyur cing / dus skabs der mtha' mtshams su dus 'khrug gi yo lang rngam po 110

che'i bar 'ching shin tu dka' zhing tshegs che bas gzhan blos spobs par nus pa dkon pa dang / sngar srid skyongs paṇ+ḍi ta'i skabs ser skya kun slongs can kha cig gi bar du dbyen bcos pa'i bka' 'di mang pos rje nyid kyi thugs bsun phyung bar gyur mod/ 'di dus lab 'ching byed pa por gzhan dag su zhig gzhung sa mchog nas bkas mang kyang dngas len mi zhu la gal srid cis kyang gnang bzhed tshe rig 'dzin rje nyid gnang dgos tshul la dwags pas zhus pa ltar gong sa rgyal dbang mchog nas de mthun bka' blon lhan du bka' phebs pa ltar rtse shod lhan rgyas so so nas bka' rgya rim par stsal ba thog mar sman khab stod dang / gnyis pa se thang du dang / gsum pa bal yul ki ḍor phebs pa dngos gnas so sor bka' len zhib sed du 'bul bar mdzad de 'di dus zhig gso'i dngos gzhi tshugs zin kyang bstan 'gro spyi sgos su thugs rje chen pos lhag par dgongs te gong zhabs rgyal dbang mchog gi bka' lung dang /bka'i mdun na 'don chen po rnams nas kyang nan tan chen pos bkas bskul ba bzhin re zhig mchod rten chen po'i nyams gso dang / srog shing 'dren rgyu'i thad bshol bar mdzad de mnga' ris stod phyogs su chibs kha bsgyur ba'i sgo dod par/ chu spre nag zla 2pa'i tshes 24la lam zhugs kyi dz+wa ki a kar du bskyed cing de mthun gyi gzhung sa chen por dgongs skor 'bul ba dang lhan du stod la dwags pu yang rgyal blon rnams su rje nyid ma phebs bar du 'thab 'khrug dang mtha' dmag gi sna 'dren byas na mi yong tshul gyi bka' rgya sngon chug tu rtsal zhing / de mthun gzhung sa mchog dang phyogs mtshungs su/ rje btsun 'brug pa rin po che thams cad mkhyen pa mchog la'ang la dwags ljongs su de mthun gyi bka' rgya gnang dgos tshul kyang rta bshad steng nas 'bul bar mdzad de rim gyi mang yul skyid grong du phebs/ de skabs mdo chen pa sngags 'chang rgyal sras seṅge sku gshegs pa'i bsngo rten 'byor par dgongs rdzogs su byams sprin 'phags pa sogs su mchod 'bul dang / kun bzang yab yum/ zhi khro gnyis bcas thang ka gsum rgyab byang smon lam dang bcas pa gong bsham dang rab tu gnas par mdzad de sras sngags 'chang 'gyur med rnam rgyal la stsal/ yar lam brag dkar rta so'i mdun klong mdar gdan sa ba bla ma dge slong gi dbang gzhi rteg pa'i khrom dbang tshe dbang sogs gnang /rim gyis bshad rtsol chen pos chibs kha bsgyur bar de snga bzhugs sgar dpon g.yog brgya lhag tsam yod kyang skabs 'dir kha shas mdo khams su rdzong rta gnang zhing / mang zhig chu ma phrod pa'i bro tshal ba sogs kyi skyid grong du shas che ba dang glo bor mang zhig 'jog par mdzad de sku 'khor dngos gzhi hrags bsdus bzhi cu skor zhig bcas stod sgar brgyud gangs chen ti se las gong du ches 'phags pa bod yul rje bo dang la dwags kyi yul mtshams gu ru'i gnas chen bde mchog lha ri dkar por gro zhun zla 7ba'i rgyal ba gnyis par bde bar phyag phebs so/ /'di skabs 111

la dwags rgyal po phan tshun gyis phebs bsu ba snga ma rnams gangs ri'i mdun du 'byor zhing / dngos gzhi'i phebs bsu bar stod nas drug brgya skor dang smad nas bzhi brgya skor yong rgyu byas pa la de rigs khyad 'dren 'thab 'khrug gi rgyur dgongs stod nas brgya skor dang smad nas brgyad bcu skor las yong mi rung tshul bka' nan lci ba phebs shing / la dwags mthil du phebs dgos tshul shin tu nan ches gsol ba btab kyang 'di skabs dgongs pa can gyis zhal gyi ma bzhes te sgar thog dang thag nye khyad wam ler legs bzlum dngos gzhi gnang rtsis de mthun gyi gzhung sar yang gral rtse phul/ de'i tshul chab shog las gsung pa ni/ de yang 'dzam gling 'di na byin che bar grub pa'i nespa la yi ljongs nas nye bar skyod de bal po rdzong gor+ṣa ra dza zhes phyogs de'i ri brag pa'i rgyal phran sngon grub pa'i slob dpon chen po gor+ṣa nā tha'i bste gnas gor+ṣa gu ha zhes slob dpon de'i bsgrub phug yod pa'i 'dabs su slas kyi mkhar bzung bas da lta gor+ṣar grags pa k+ṣe ṭa'i rgyal rigos su gyur pa de'i gam du slar yang rang byung mchod rten gyi bya ba bgyid dgos kyi stabs phyin par mon rje rang lugs kyi dmag mi'i bsu ba dang bcas byung / sdod yul ljongs las phyir bsring ba gtsang ma'i spang gzhong zhig tu bgyis/ rdzong du yong dgos tshul blon po rim can btang nas nan bskyed pas ngo bsrung gyi phyin cing rta dang gser gyi skyes bzang po bstabs/ sang phod mchod rten gyi srog shing dpung gi 'dren pa'i yi ge sogs gang smras la shin tu nyan pas rang yang sems 'gu ba byung / kho rang gi rgyal srid dar rgyas ci ltar sogs kha shas do gal gyi dri bar las ni ma nyams kyang bsod nams rgud pa'i ltas mthong ba gsong por smras/ yang skyar dri bar blon po gtang byung ba la gong bzhin lab/ sku rim rten 'brel gyi bcos byas na phan thabs mthong yang don gnyer mi byed pas btang snyoms su bzhag rgyal po de gnas kyi khyad dzo ki la cung zad gus kyang khyab 'jug la mchog tu lta zhing de bas kyang durga pa ti la lhag par mchod pa zhig go/ /de nas slar yang bal yul du sngar bya ri kasna ma'i zhig gso skabs bal po'i rgyal khag rnams la rang khos dngos po'i yo byad bstabs nas/ zhing la phan slad tsam ma yin par yul chos kyi nags klung stug po mtha' dag mes bzhom ste srog chags grangs med mang po tshad bzung las 'das pa bsreg par byed pa dang / de bzhin du spre'u dang lce spyang gi tshogs dang lhag tu sarba gyi rigs mthong tshad gsod pa dang / de las ldog 'dod kyi kun slong dam po yid la bzung nas yang yang zhu don byas pa rgyal blon rnams nas khas blang yang ji bzhin lag len du ma theb pa 'di lo de'i khar 'phags pa shing kun dang / u gra tā ra dang / go kar+ṇa sogs mkhas pa'i bste gnas rnams kyi nags tshal la mi phyugs glang pos brdza bar mi byed pa'i zangs yig zhu bar gra ngo lo tsā ba sbrags ched sngags brdzang par / rgyal po yang dga' bzhin du zangs yig la gser chus byugs te rgyal po 112

rang gi rigs kyi lha nag po dgu thog tu/ u ma'i ngo bo de wī ta le dzu yi mgrin par zhus don zangs yig btags te/ rgyal blon rnams kyi phyin chad de las mi 'da' ba'i dam bca' ji bzhin blang ba'i dge ba rnam par dag pa nyid du grub cing / slar gu ru bal por ci myur yong dgos tshul gyi yi ge de yis bskul ma byed par bal po badz+ra tsar+ya dpon g.yog gnyis bcas bang mi yang bde bar 'byor/ de nas rim par bgrod de rdo rje gdan gyi byang shar lha mo re ba ti'i pho brang phyi rol rig byed mkhan gyi lha chen po'i gnas khyad par can du rtsi ba ting wa ri'i mtsho bdag de sngar sa spres lor bal por bgrod skabs thog mar cho 'phrul dang bcas mthar dam tshig blang ba byung bas de'i chu klung gi 'gram du gtor chen zhig btang /sang nyin yang gu ru'i tshes bcu'i dus chen yin pas tshugs bcag nas tshogs gtor ci nus bcas smon lam bzang pojibatab/ de nas rim pas mang yul skyid grong du yul grong so sor rang 'khos la dpags pa'i bsu ba bcas/ sngon jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti shas yun ring du bste ba'i ljong gnas zhes par jo bo'i phyag mdzub kyis bris pa'i yig drug mjal bar phyin/ der mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'du ba ni shin tu che—/ mang yul byams pa sprin du zhag shas chu snyom pa'i ched du bsdad/ gtor chen yang lan kha yar btang /gtsug lag khang la rang khos la dpag pa'i phyag dang mchod pa ci 'grub byas/ rang gi 'khor g.yog rnams chu nad kyi bro tshal bas dal 'gros kyi rdzong dkar du phyin zhing der yang zhag shas bsdad/ 'dus pa'i skye bo stong phrag du mar byang sdom dang / thugs rje chen po'i bsgom lung yang nas yang du bshad/ snron zla'i tshes bcu'i mchod pa der bgyis/ la dwags phyogs su rang nyid 'gro ba snyan du phul zin cing / nges kyi bshad brtsol ni ci tsam stobs bskyed kyang 'phral du mi 'byor stabs/mar yul phyogs su 'thab 'khrug dang mtha' dmag sna 'dren sogs byas dogs blo khol gyis rang gi zla bo dang la dwags pa'i bang mi sprags rgyal po khag la yi ge bcas bshad rtsol sngon la brdzangs/ rdzong dkar nas gza' skar legs pa la lam du zhugs lo tsā ba rgyal ba'i tshul khrims kyi gdan sa yang thog mchod rten la rgyang nas phyag byas/sngon sgyu 'phrul gyi bshad grwa ring du byung ba'i gnas 'om phug pad+ma dkar po zhes da lta sgrub btsun phran bu gnas pa de'i 'dabs su tshugs phab/ dgon de'i bla mas 'dir sngar yang rdo char kha shas byung 'dug pa'i 'di lo yang rdo char tho re ba byung ba ji ltar yin 'dri bar phral sel gyi rim gro phogs/ de nas stag khyer lar srid pa'i lha gnyan mang po'i pho brang mngon gshis gtor chen zhig gtang bstan 'gror phan pa'i 'phrin las bcol/ lha 'phreng gi rnam pas kha char che zhing stod du 'gro ba'i lhong gi rta 'drogs nas brdab pa sogs 'tshub pa'i mtshan ma yang kha shas shar bas de gsol la dmigs la brgal mtshams su gtor chen zhig gtang / khams nas bla khag dang sde dge'i yi ge snga phyir byung ba'i lan ma song ba'i 113

'byor lan bcas khams kyi pho nya mang zhig 'di nas brdzangs/ nged rang ngo g.yog rnams bod yul mthu chen bzhi'i ya gyal bswe yi skyes bu gnod sbyin gdod nas gnas pa'i mkhar btsan yul zang thang dmar po dngos gzhi da lta gro shod du grags pa'i ljongs su rim pas zhugs pa'i lam bar du mu khun k+ṣe ṭa'i rgyal blon dang dzuskṛ rā dza yi nang blon gsol kha ba sogs pho nya rim par byung ba dang 'grogs spra gtsug lag khang dang nye ba legs rtser mos ldan rnams kyi don gnyer bzhin tshe dbang chos 'brel phran bu dang / mon pa rnams kyi kyang bod pa'i lad gsos 'dod chos rig gtad than thun zhumong / rgyal blogade rnams grub mtha' ni sa n+ya'i shi la mos shing lha nikhyab 'jug gi chung lasmi mchod par byed pa zhig go/ / mu khun k+ṣe ṭa'i rgyal blon spyi dang dzusmṛ rā dza yis bang mi snga mar skyes bzang po dang bcas te de nas zlog bang mi phyi ma de rigs khung che gras yin 'dug kyang / rgyal po'i gsang ba'i bya bar 'chub pa snang chen du snang bas yul phyogs de'i 'gro ba la phan slad rgyal po la zhib mor bya dgos khyad rjes su dkris te ro hi ta tshangs pa rgyas pa'i chu klung grus brgal te rgyal thabs byang du tshugs phab/ der dzuskṛ ra dza la nged re zhig phyogs der yong mi thub tshul dang / rgyal po chen po rnams ris su ma chad pa'i skye rgu bde bar skyong ba yin pas dmag 'khrug gi bya ba mi rung tshul sogs sems mgu thabs su kha sbag rtsam bu dang bcas don du gzhan la phan pa'i bsam sbyor rnam par dag pa'i rgyal po'i yun dang blon gtso kha shas dang lhag tu rgyal po rang la yi ge dang rten dngos su dge rgyur bsam nged rang gi bzhon pa dngos ma/ gser srang kha yar dang kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i dbang po mchog nas bka' rgya rin po che rta zam rim brgyud sgar nas der phebs pa'i gnang skyes zab gos bzang po de yang bskur nas phyogs de'i skye rgu la lo 'dir bde ba'i brtsas su 'di res kyang 'bad pas bsgrub dgos byung / lar sa phyogs 'dir snga phyi du mar rang sems rnam par dag pas lus srog thams cad bor gyis/ da lta dran yang yid bsun pa 'ba' zhig gi gzhan la phan pa rgya cher bsgrub pa sus kyang shes par mi byed na/ slad mar ni de rigs gtan nas mi thub nges pa'i gtam kho sa shes ldan yin rgyu'i khul rnams phyi tshig snying la slan pa lab/ rang gi zla bo'i khrod nas nad pa dang bgrod par mi skyod pa mang po zhig glo bor brdzangs/ chu stod zla ba'i tshes bcu'i mchod pa rag gam du byas/ de nas gro shod las 'das te mar yul ljongs brgyud de'i la brgal 'phags yul gyis ma no sa ra zhes ma pham g.yu mtsho'i ngogs su snga phyir gtor chen mang du btang zhing tshogs mchod sogs dge sbyor 'grub par byas/ ri'i rgyal po ke ta ra yi mdun dkar leb mgos g.yag tu la dwags rgyal po khu dbon gyis bsu ba rim pas 'byor/ der mon yul ku ma rgyal po'i tshong dpon dang mchod gnas dzo ki zhig kyang 'phrad pa byung / rgyal po de ni sngon dus 'dzam gling 'di na grags che ba tsan+d+ra bdun brgyud kyi rigs dri ma 114

chi med pa yin 'dug cing / da lta rgyal po 'di yis ming dis tsan+d+ra ste grub mtha' ni slob dpon chen po go rak+ṣa nā tha yi slob brgyud dzo gi la mchog tu gus pa zhig yin 'dug pas sems dga' bar byung yul phyogs der yang na ning pak+ṣa'i bka'/ gling gi zla ba la mi sdod pa'i durka'i rigs 'bum phrag kha yar gyi dpung gis nyer 'tshe che bar byas nas da lta phyogs gzhan du song yang da dung yong rgyu yin 'dug pa de la phan pa'i thabs bcos dri ba skad byed/ de nas bya rgod lding la brgal mnga' ris skor gsum mar yul gyi stod sgar thog tu 'byor/ rgyal ba mchog gi tshad med pa'i thugs rje chen pos khyab pa'i mthur sgar dpon dag nas kyang phran la mkhos su phebs pa gnang byung / gro zhun zla ba'i tshes bcu'i mchod pa der byas/rang gzhan la phan pa'i slad du gtor chen yang lan kha yar gtang / 'di lo zla bo rnams chu ma 'phrod pa'i rgyu la brten nad sna tshogs kyi lhag par gtser bas zhag shas 'phrod rten la 'gor zhing la dwags nas mi dpon sogs mdun bsu phyi ma rnams der 'byor/ la dwags nang khul gyi lab 'ching hor zla bdun pa'i nang du 'grub na bltas legs pa byung yang phral du snyegs ma thub stabs/ de rjes hor zla brgyad pa cung legs pa ye shes rgyal po khu dbon rnams dpung mang po ma yin par rags 'thus su la dwags stod wam ler phebs dgos tshul snga 'gros btang zhing rang nyid kyang rim pas brgyud sgar pa yid 'ong gi sku lha de bod yul nub phyogs kyi sgo bsrung mthu che ba zhig yin par snang bas de la gtor ma sbyin zhing las kyi bdo ba yun ring bzlog par dka' yang mar yul rgyal po phan tshun mdza' bshim du 'gyur ba'i 'phrin las bcol/ de nas bod dang la dwags kyi mtshams gu ru'i gnas chen bde mchog lha ri dkar por sman chu'i 'phrod rten bcag mal gcig byas shing dmar phyogs kyi tshes bcu dang 'grig pas gtor tshogs rgyas par btang / skyid grong nas/ tsam 'di yi bar skabs su mi ma yin gyi 'tshub lhong tho re ba byung ba 'di skabs cung zad 'jam song / sgar thog nas brtsams 'di skor du mon khu nu ba pho mo 'phrad mkhan ches mang zhing skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa len pa yang ci snyed zhig byung / de rnams kyang bod skad shes pa ni nyung / phal cher mon skad kho na ste/ de'i rgyal po'i rigs ni gu ge lha btsan po nas gyes pa yin la/ rgyal po la sku mched ni med/ kho rang lo bcu gsum 'gro/ rigs khyad par 'phags pa'i mthu yi yul gzhan du dkon pa'i sman nus ldan 'ga' yang 'byung zer/ rim pas la dwags ljongs dgos yul brgyud pu ri la rgal kha sbyor du zhag gsum bsdad/ der lab 'ching kyi skor thog mar legs lam che ba la/mthar rten 'brel gcos ma byas na cung zad 'dzer ba'i ltas shar/ lung pa de'i yul bdag srid pa'i ma mo mthu chen mo des 'khor rnams kyi yang yang bsu ba'i tshul dang / gtso mo rang yang dga' ba'i nyams 'gyur gyi der son pa rmi lam du mthong / gzhan yang yul de'i dkar phyogs kyi lha 'dre rnams nged lhag 115

bsam gyi yong par shes bzhin mgu ba'i rnam 'gyur dang / nag phyogs rgya 'dre 'gong po'i tshogs ni khro 'khrugs mi dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur mi rnams kyang ldem rgyang nem nur yid gnyis mang po 'phel bar byed pa sogs rtsal 'gran pa'i rnam pa can du mthong der dmigs kyi mchod gtor dang lan chags sbyangs ba dngos dang ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo nas nyin re bzhin ma chad pa'i khul phal cher nar ma nyid du byas/ kha sbyor nas waṃ ler la dwags rgyal blon gyi bsu ba'i bkod pa bzang po bshams pa dang lhan du phyin/ khrums zla'i tshes bcu'i mchod pa der bgyis/ la dwags sa byon yang mul lbe rgyal po 'phral du ma 'byor zhing / snga thabs kho rang gi bka' blon ched bsngags son pa'i gtam du la dwags pa'i pho nya kha cher song ba khong 'tsho'i lam bsdam pas zin pa kha che'i yi ge sleb mkhar gyi mnga' 'og dmag a khu la bdeg na 'di nas kyang dpung ci dgos grogs su yong tshul gyi yi ge mthong nas yong ma bde tshul sogs dab dib mang zhig zer ba rang gi rgyal ba mchog gi bka' lung dang du blang ste bal yul rang byung mchod rten chen po'i zhig gso bgyid 'phro bshol lam bar du dka' tshegs sbyangs spyod thams cad khyad du gsad khong rang rnams kyi 'dod pa ltar 'dir yong ba la da dung dus su mi 'byin pa'i kha che'i dmag skad mang po ci zhig gu snyam nas sems 'khrugs pa zhig byung / rang nyid bya bral spyod pa'i skabs dang 'di res ma 'dra gshis khong shong yangs por bskyed/ yul phyogs der gtso bo rgya 'dre 'gongs po'i mthu las lam du mi rgyug par mthong ba nus pa cher ma mchis kyang deng sang rnal 'byor gzugs can rnams kyi spyi nor zong gi dregs pa can rnams ting nge 'dzin gyis bcun zhing / la dwags slel mkhar rgyal blon la nged 'dir yong bar shes bzhin kha che'i dmag bskul btong ba'i rgyu mtshan dang / mul lbe bka' blon la lab 'ching skabs lam bsdam bkrol rgyu la la dwagasawā'i pho nya 'dzin pa'i rgyu mtshan sogs dris par la dwags pas na ning lug lo hor zla bcu gcig pa'i nang du pho nya btang ba las khyed 'dir yong bar shes nas min tshul dang /mul lbe blon pos khyed kyis wam ler yong tshul yi ge ma phebs ba'i sngon du pho nya zin pa las shes bzhin min tshul sogs rang rang gi gnas tshul rgyas par smrengs/ de nas stod smad gnyis kyi blon po che kha rnams slar yang mdun du bsdus te khyed rnams kyi zer tshul de ltar yin tshe khyod rang rnams 'di phyi kun tu bde ba'i ched du gangs can mgon po rgyal ba mchog gis nged 'phrin las kyi byed por phyogs 'dir bsngags pa mdzad bzhin rang rang rnams kyi tshe 'di las kyang phyi ma'i khe nyen la gzhigs te kha che dang sngar 'brel bzang po'i rgyun ma chad pa las dmag gi sna 'dren sogs bstan 'gro'i bde thabs la gnod pa ye nas mi 'tshal zhing / kha ches kyang khyed rang rgyal po phan tshun gnyis ka'i rgyab rtsa byed par khas blang ba 'di yang dkrugs sel gyi rnam pa can du snang na de don thugs kyi mkhyen 'os dang nged la dwags mthil du re 116

zhig 'gro bar ma shar bas rgyal po bkras rnam yang 'phral mar 'dir byon dgos tshul dang / la dwags pho nya bsgor ba kha che'i yi ge bcas 'phral gtang ma byas na mi 'gab pa dang / der yang ma zad kha cher 'go nad gdug pa med phyin tshong pa'i mi rnams lam bsdam kyang rgyal khams 'khrug pa'i rgyu min pas lhod dgos tshul bcas smras bzhin mulbe'i zhabs phyi ngo ma zhig la dwags rgyal po'i rta shad steng nas 'phral rdzong byas sle mkhar rgyal po phun rnams 'bod par rdzang yang nged la dwags mthil du sleb re yin zhes 'phral du ma byon 'dug pas rgyal po 'di chung ngu'i dus spyang grung 'dzom pa yod rgyu'i khul dang / da ni thugs ka mi bde skad zer yang gang ltar kho rang nang khul gyi legs lam ni phugs legs lam 'gro min mi shes stabs re zhig dpyad dgos 'dug kyang 'phral khu dbon legs bzlum slad slar yang skyar 'bod par brdzangs—/ yang kha che'i dmag yong rgyu'i gtam chol de bden med 'gro yang / nges med bden par srid tshe mi dge ba'i rgyu chen por dogs/ la dwags rgyal po dang mulbe rgyal po gnyis ka nas zhabs phyi do nges re la yi ge/da cha nged khu dbon nang 'grig pa yin pas kha che nas dpung 'degs dang / 'chings sgrigs la 'byon mi dgos tshul kasmi ra yi na mu sur mal gyi skad du na babs rgya nag skad du tsong du 'phags yul gyi se na pā te don gcig par snang babs dang rdzong dpon gnyis ka la yi ge bskul rgyu nged rang gi mig ltar byas/ 'di la kha che'i mu sur mal gyi se na pa ti kha cig bod du rgyu bar spro zhing gnag pa'i sems yod pa byed pa des tshe bod rgyal po'i mi bod kyi dzo ki zhig gi lab 'ching byas pa'i gtam ha cang gi khyab che na mi legs pa'i rgyur shes te 'di skabs gzos shing legs pa'i sgo nas pho nya la yang mngags cha bcas khrums zla'i dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum pa la 'phral myur du thon pa brdzangs/ lar 'di phyogs las sne rags par ma zad phra mo tshun gyi gzos par ma byas na spyi mthun las kyi dus snyigs ma'i mtha' la thug cing du ru ka yi dmag kyang rten 'brel mthus phyir ma bsrings na lhung ba'i dus kyang ha cang gi mi ring gshis rang nas ni de don yid la bzung zhing tsen ne ba'i ngang du byas/ la dwags 'dzin mar 'khod pa kha phye'i sa mtshams tshun gyi skye rgu yi ni rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen gzigs mchod yon mchog nas rig pa 'dzin pa 'dir brdzangs ba bka' drin chen pos khyab pa yin/ gzhan ni da lta 'thab 'khrug yo lang chen por bya ba las ma 'das kyang 'di lo dpyid bla ma lab 'ching la 'byon rgyu'i yi ge 'byor pa nas dbu bzung phan tshun gnyis thad nas ci rigs pa zhi 'jam du song ba yin zhes tshig tu mthun cing dga' tshor chen po'i khul byed pa de cam bu min par don la yang gnas nges su go /'grig zlum byed par nged yong rgyu'i bka' rgya ma phebs na/ 'di lo dbyar gung tsam phyogs 'dir yo lang 'thab 'khrugs rngam chen byung tshar 117

ba gdon mi za ba nges par snang bas/ rgyal ba mchog gi bka' rgya rin po che mchod rten chen po'i srid zhu las lhag pa bstan 'gro'i phan bde sgrub thabs ma 'chis mod kyang 'khon 'gras legs bskum gyi phan bde'i gnas thob tshul la bsngags pa'i bka' lung phebs pa ni lkog 'gyur ji bzhin gzigs par nges payes 'phral la dwags phyogs kyi skye rgu zhi bde'i brnal du phebs pa'i dge tshogs brlab po che yin 'dug snyam pa'i dga' ba gsar thob byung /snying por zhu gsol/ da lta rgyal po phan tshul legs zlum 'dzom dus btab pa dang / kha phyer snga khyad kyi bang mi brdzangs grub zhing khu dbon bar du ni 'thab 'khrug gi gzhi che ba med nges yin 'dra yang /blon po'i sras mo mulbe rgyal po'i khab tu gnas pa yis/ des rgyud bskul de blon sras kyi rgyab skyor rkang tshugs par mdzad gshis/ 'gal mtshams du gyur bar snang zhing / stod nas bka' blon la khrims 'bebs kyi gzhi blon po'i g.yo sgyus rgyal po'i mnga' thang gsum cha gcig lhag kho rang ngo thog gi blang ba yin zhes ho mi sprul pa'i sku dang rgyal po phun rnam dgongs pa gcig dril/ rgyal mo bcas blon po kha shas 'thus te g.yangs skyur gtang ba yin 'dug zhing / bka' blon de pha mes bdun brgyud nas 'brug pa'i sbyin bdag rtsa bar gyur shis/ he mi nas blon sras spun gyi srog skyabs ni snying thag pa nas byas pa yin par snang yang / chos byas nas dgon par sdod tshul la khengs blos ma blang nas bros pa yin 'dug gang ltar phan tshun da lta'i char 'char rgyang gtang ba yin na las lab gzhi he bag che bas 'grig dka' tsam yong 'dra snyam la/ 'di skor phan tshun gnyis da ni 'dzom par nye bas gnas tshul zhib mo slar rim gyis 'bul bar chos dbyings tshom pa med pa nas legs spel nyes bsub ji ltar bya tshul gyis bka' slob yang rim can du phebs pa ci nas kyang mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen dgu ldan du gsol ba 'debs pa lags/ rang re la ni mulbe rgyal po dang blon sras dad pa che che tsam yin la/ stod nas ho mi sprul pa'i sku dang / rgyal mo yang da lta ni gus pa che tsam mdzad 'dug lar 'dir phyogs su lo kha shas nas ltas kyi bye brag sna tshogs pa zhig byung bar skad la/ kha che'i la mtshams nas tshur la res skyes pa gzhon nur brdzus nas gzhan la lto blang zhing / phal cher rnga mong gi gzugs su bsgyur nas dngos su phan gnod kyi bya ba sna tshogs byed pa zhig ring tsam rgyu ba dang / sa sken te hor sog gi la mtshams su chu klung chen po'i nang nas nya bo che dang /sha ba'i gzugs su thon nas des mi skad lta bu'i gtam sna tshogs dngos su smra ba sngon dang 'di lor byung ba dang / zhang zhung dgra lha tsa mun ma yis rtse mo nas glo bur du mi bzod pa'i chu klung drag po brdol ba dang ske/ ma no sa ra nas gnam lcags ur mo'i sgra dang bcas me 'dag 'phro ba sogs legs nyes ci ltar dpyad dka' ba'i rnam grangs du ma zhig yul 'dir ma zad tha gru kun tu byung bar skad pa sogs thos 118

tshul ltar lags shing / pak+ṣa'i rgyal po rang nas khrim ji bzhin rnal ma med pas spun rigs zhig gi rgyal thabs blang skad dang / phyogs der yang dmag 'khrug gi bya ba mang zhing / pa ṭa na yi dpung 'bum phrag du ma zhig kyang ḍi la'i dpung mtshams kyi dpung dang 'thab par gzas pa sogs rgya gar gyi yul gru rnams su da lta rgyal po rgyal phran mtha' dag 'thab 'khrug kho nas skye dgu mnar ba rtsod ldan snyigs ma'i mtha' la thug pa'i ngang tshul shin tu che bar snang zhing / mar yul phyogs su rgyu rkyen med par phra ma stong 'ur lta bus g.yul sprod du nye ba yang byung 'dug cing / sems can gyi las dang mi ma yin gyi 'khrul gyis mdza' ba yang glo bur du 'khon che zhing pha ma spun zla dpon g.yog thams cad gcig yid gcig la mi brten pa dang / drang por spyod par 'dod pa rnams kyang rang dbang med par rnal du mi phebs pa dang / tshig kyang mdun rgyab snga phyi mi mtshungs shing tshad 'dzin par dka' ba yi snyan du 'bul rngo yang mi thogs pa sogs sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor ji bzhin par spyod pa phyogs 'di'i gnas tshul dang / gangs ri'i khrod ni deng dus rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje'i rang gzugs 'jig rten mgon po lag na pad dkar 'chang ba ngur smrig gar gyi rol pa gang gi mthu la brten skye dgu rdzogs ldan gyi dga' ston bzang pos 'tsho bar mdzad pa bka' drin gyi zho sha chen pos 'tsho bar 'khum/ zhes gsungs/ la dwags kha sbyor du rgyal sras rin po che dang rgyal mo bcas phebs bsur byon zhing / legs bzlum dngos zla ba gsum pa'i nang du thag chod rtsis gnang kyang phan tshun thams cad go med ci tol shin tu che ba'i gtam lhag par mang gshis thog mar shin tu thugs 'khrug cing dka' tshegs che ba dang / lhag par mul lbe rgyal po bkra shis rnam rgyal wam ler 'byon dgos tshul bka' nan rtsal kyang dus su ma 'byor ba'i zla shas 'gor ba de'i ring gar sha 'phags pa dang ske/ re phag /maṇ+ḍi ri/ gaṇ+ḍa ri sogs su 'byon par bzhed kyang mul lbe rgyal po sogs kyi bar du bcad te 'byon ma thub par snang / rgyal sras sprul pa'i sku mi pham 'jam dpal rdo rje sogs rgyal blon dang / la dwags khul gyi grub mtha'i ris med nas don du gnyer ba'i ser skya du ma zhig la zab chos dbang lung man ngag gi chos sbyin rgya che zhing rgyun mi chad pa lhug par stsal zhing / nag phyogs kyi 'byung po mi ma yin rgya 'dre gdug pa can gyis skye 'gro'i rgyud bskul te 'thab 'khrugs kyi rgyu dang mtha' yi dmag dpung g.yo bar byed pa dang / bod gangs can gyi rje 'bangs la mi bsrun gdug pa'i ngan 'thab kyi blo 'chang bar byed cing bar 'chings legs bzlum la bar du gcod pa'i mi mthun phyogs mtha' dag zhi ba'i phyir du gtor chen brgya phrag du ma dang lan chags sbyongs ba'i gtor ma sogs rim gro rgyun mi chad rje nyid rang dang grwa tshang nas bka' drin bskyangs shing phyogs de'i dge 'dun stong phrag du long par mang skol dang 'gyed kyi rnam grangs rags rtsis dngul srang nyis brgya lhag tsam bcas sku sger nas gnang ste bstan 119

'gror phan bde'i ched rim gro sgrub tu rtsal/ de skabs wam le bde chen rnam rgyal gyi gtsug lag khang gi rten gtso lha btsun nā ga ra dza'i thugs dam 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal gyi sku brnyan dpal jo bo rje mar me mdzad kyis rab tu gnas par mdzad pa de'i drung du ser skya mchog dman bar ma'i 'dus pa'i tshogs chen por theg pa chen po'i gso sbyongs gi sdom pa dang / dpal mo lugs bcu gcig zhal gyi rjes gnang / yig drug gi bzlas lung bcas rtsal/ 'ga' zhig gi gsol ba btab pa bzhin 'phags pa bcu gcig zhal gyi sgrub thabs gso sbyongs dang 'brel ba'i cho ga rgyas pa mthar gling bgrod pa'i gru rdzing / slob dpon chen po'i rnam thar gsol 'debs rgyas pa dad pa'i pad tshal rgyas byed las can nyin mor byed pa'i shing rta/ gzhan yang lha sna tshogs kyi sgrub thabs/ gzhan kyi 'dod ngor bstan bcosaske/ zhal gdams sogs bka' rtsom mang du gnang ngo / /de skabs dad pa can gyi ji ltar phul ba'i dngos po las gzhan du lab 'ching la rten pa'i dar skud gcig gser dngul se ba gang / gar gum 'jag ma gcig gi mtshon ste yo byad phra mo tsam yang snga phyi bar du bzhes par ma mdzad na rags pa smos ci 'tshal/ der yang ma zad la dwags ljongs su lo phyed gnyis gyi bar dpon 'khor kun gyi gsol chas kyang sku sger kho nas phyag rdzas zong gis bcal nas sgrub par mdzad cing / la dwags pas nyin rer bud shing khur kha shas kyi mthun rkyen tsam las rgyal po yas mas su la'ang bsun rtser dka' tshegs su 'gro ba cung zad kyang rje nyid sku dngos lta ci/ zhabs gras sku 'khor ba drag zhan gang gis kyang bgyid mi rung ba'i bka' nan stsal/ de'i tshe mul lbe rgyal po bkra shis rnam rgyal gyis brgyud mtha' 'dres skyod stabs kyis sku zhabs su ma 'byor bar rgyun ring ba'i mthar mgon po nyid kyi thugs rje nus pa'i zil chen pos rang dbang med par bkug te waṃ ler 'byor ba'i tshe re zhig mjal kha ma gnang bar de gar 'jog par mdzad pa na rgyal po yid rab tu skrag pa'i tsab tsob kyis zhu ngo mang du sgron pa'i zhu ba nan tan du bgyid pa na 'dod pa ltar mjal kha gnang ba'i skabs rje'i zhal ras mthong ba'i mod la tab tab por dran med du brgyal/ brgyal ba sangs nas lus 'dar zhing spyod pas ci bya btol med par gyur pa'i mthar cung zad dran pa rnyed de da bzod blang dor gyi gnas la 'jug pa'i blo las su rung bar gyur zhing bka' ci gsung las nam yang mi 'da' ba'i khas blang dang / lab 'ching kyang bzang dus tsam ma yin par gtan 'ching kho na bka' drin bskyangs dgos tshul gyi gsol ba 'debs par byed cing / sngar yun ring du dus thog ma 'byor bar 'gyang gzhir gyur pa la snying nas 'gyod bshags kyi rten du gzhan gyi rin thang du che ba 'phags yul gyi rin chen gnyis pa'i dong rtse kar+sha pa ṇa phung por spungs pa na/ bka' las rgyal po rang gi nyes pa la nong par bzung ste bshags pa byed pa ni legs kyi de ltar na bshags pa ni 120

len par bya yi/ dngos po ni lab 'chings la rten pa'i rdzas se ba gang yang bdag gir mi bya bas khyed rang khyer cig zhes gong gi rgyu mtshan dang bcas de phral du phyir zlog par mdzad do/ /lab 'chings gi skabs der gtso bor rje nyid kyi dgongs dbyings shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi gzigs ngor chub pas rdo rje'i gsung gcig kho nas tshegs med par brlum par the mi tshom kyang / sangs rgyas rnams ni mkhyen bzhin du yang gdul bya dag gi snang ngo dang bstun pa de dang de'i mdzad pa ston pa gshis lugs te—/ 'dir yang rgyal po phyogs phan tshun nas lab sher cung zad ma byas na ma 'ongs par bden tshig brjod long ma byung bar gcod mtshams byas song zhes pa'i klen ka 'byung bar dgongs/ de dus sku'i nye bar gnas pa'i zhabs ring ba dag dang / sgar dpon gyi sku tshab sbrel po bcas la bkas mngags pa'i phan tshun so so'i 'dod bzhin gyi lab gsher mang ba'i mthar dgos nges kyi mdo don rnams bod yul dbus gyur gyi chos bzhin pa'i khrims srol ji lta ba ni/ rang mtshan gyi yul rang dbang du spyod par 'dul ba yul chos su grags pa gtso bor ma zad rgyal khag mang po'i 'du mtshams rang stobs ci tsam par rgyal po rgyal rigs kyi spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i rgyun chad med nyid du grub bzhin de la bskur bzos kyi sgo nas bzang po'i lugs srol nyid dang mi 'gal zhing / do bdag phan tshun gyi char rang rang gi cha dbang dang —/ de yang bden min so sor 'jam ded kyi zhib dris gal che ba rnams la lan grangs gsum bzhi yang skyar bas kha gcig cung zad ldab yang gal po che la nan gtan gyi dpe ltar phran tshegs 'ga' zhig las phal cher dan bzhin thog mar zin bris mig 'grim gyi bklog brdar bgyid 'jug tu stsal zhing de nas dngos gzhi mdo don yi ger bkod te tshig don kun gyi mtha'i bar yid ches dpang por 'phel bar mdzad rjes phyin chad so so'i blang dor gyi gnas mtha' dag chad mdo snying por dril ba'i rkang grangs su bcad pa mtha' 'doms bcad khrar bkod par mdzad de rgyal po khu dbon zhal ngo nang phan tshun dang blon po dmangs bcas pa'i so so'i rtags the'u bsham gsal bcas chu sprel smin drug zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi dga' ba gsum par thag gtsang mar chod par mdzad do/ /gzhan yang chos sde ho mi'i mtshon rgyal bstan rin po cher zhugs pa rnams nas la dwags rgyal sras sprul pa'i sku rgyal thabs kyi bya ba la bzhugs par des blo lad kyi dge sbyongs dang / rab tu byung ba rnams spyod pa cing hral du gyur na rgyal bstan gyi rma ru che zhing rang rang 'di phyir phung khrol gyi rgyur 'gyur bas der ma song bar bdag cag gi ston pa thub pa'i dbang pos nye bar bcas pa'i dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i bslab khrims la nye bar gnas pas gdul bya'i dngas ba 'dren cing dad ldan gyi dkor rdzas sbyongs ba rang gzhan thar pa'i lam la gzhol ba ci nas kyang dgos tshul bka' nan tsha bajid che ba kun gyi thos sgrags su rtsal ba dang chab 121

gcig par ho mi grwa tshangs rjes 'brang dang bcas pa mtha' dag gi blang dor chos bzhin du spyod pa'i bca' yig zhib gsal kyang bka' drin bskyangs so/ /de nas sngar la dwags yul gyi mthil du pheb rtsis thugs dam gyi ltas su ma chub pa bcas gtan nas ma bzhed kyang / legs bzlum gyi 'phros chod yig gtan 'bebs zhib mor gnang dgos 'ga' zhig dang / rgyal po khu dbon ser skya mchog dman bar ma mtha' dag gi 'dod gdung chen pos mgrin gcig tu gsol ba dang / mi ma yin mthu stobs nus pa can gyi tshogs dang khyad par yul bdag ma rdo rje chen mo sogs kyi yang yang du bskul ba sogs lha mi kun gyi gsol ba mgrin gcig tu btab pa bzhin phebs bsu'i bkod pa mchod pa'i sprin phung rgya chen po dang bcas te yul gyi mthil shel gyi pho brang chen po ga la bar 'chibs kha bsgyur/ der rgyal po rnams kyi legs spel zhib tshags dang / blon po dag la yang sprod 'jags gsar dgos/ he na ku'i rgyal po yang kho rang gi dbang ris bdag thob mos nyi ma'i skabs su 'jags pa gang yin bcos bsgyur med par mul lī dang zangs dkar bzhin gyi gtan 'jags/ kha phye dang la dwags bar gyi tshong pa'i rgyu 'grul la phan pa lam yig zangs kyi byang bu mtha' btsan zangs yig tu grags pa tshar lnga'i grangs su bkod par mdzad cing ske/ mthar thug mdo don mna' rtsigs skor dpal gdong chu bya lo snron zla'i tshes nyi shu brgyad la kun gyi thos sgrags su stsal/ de la phan tshun kun gyis gus pas dngas len yid mthun ci gsung thod bcing du sgrub par byas nas rgyab yig chu stod zla ba'i tshes gcig la bzhes nas gnyis la grub par mdzad/ thams cad kyis nam yang 'da' ba med par bro bor dngos gzhi zla ba de ga'i tshes drug la dpal gyi gtor ma chen po brjid ldan bshams/ yul de'i rten du bzhugs pa'i rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral gyi sku brnyan byin ldan dag spyan drangs te khri'u'i steng du bkod/ grub mtha' ris med dgon khag so so'i rang lugs chos skyongs bsrung ma'i tshogs kyi 'phrin las bskul ba dang / sku zhabs gra tshangs nas kyang de mthun gnang ba dang lhan cig rje bla ma mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag nyid sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma ka ra nyid dang dbyer mi phyed pa mthong na mi mthun med pa'i sku zil dang gzi byin mtshungs pa med pa mtshan dpe brgya phrag gi dpal mnga' ba gang 'jigs pa med pa'i seng ges steg pa'i khri 'phang 'thon por bzhugs te gsung gsang lha'i chos rnga sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i ljags kyis bskul ba'i sngon chad gzhan dag gi lha dang bsrung ma'i rnam par dbye ba'i go don lta ci/ mtshan tsam yang go thos smra bsam gyi yul las 'das pa'i bden tshig drag po dang 'jigs gnyan chen pos bzhes sgra dang bcas sngon du 'gro bas rtsigs kyi 'ching yig chen mo ljags klog legs par bka' drin bskyangs rjes/ rgyal blon 'bangs dang bcas pa'i tshogs kyi spyi bor chos skyongs rnams kyi sku brnyan dang / dpal gyi gtor ma bkod te yig nang gi bro tshig rang 122

rang gi mna' dam bzhes/ des phan tshun spyi sgos thams cad kyang yid ches yid bde'i gnas yang dag par 'khod par gyur to/ /de yi nyin phyi ma tshes bdun la rgyud rtsis lugs nyi ma me bzhi'i 'grub sbyor la smon lam tshigs bcad bzang po dang 'ching yig chen mo'i 'jug tu stsal ba'i smon tshig rgya chen po dang bcas pas mtha' bskang nas rgyud rtsis pa'i tshes bcu drug gi snga char rgyal po phan tshun gyi sna chen zhang blon rgan gtso/ dgon sde'i bla ma las sne bcas tshang ma'i dbus su 'ching yig chen mo thos sgrags su legs par ljags bklog bskyangs te legs spel rjes gtsang thag chod bkra shis dge ba'i 'khor lo phan dang bde ba'i dpal yon zad mi shes pas 'jig rten kun tu bde legs su khyab par mdzad do/ /de dag gi tshul rnams gong sa rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen por 'bul gnang gi chab shog las/ snga sor snyan dbang rin po cher gsol ltar khu dbon lab 'ching wam ler legs pa'i ltas byung bzhin der lab 'ching bzlum legs par zhib tshags phra mo byed rgyu tsam las zla mtshams la grub par byas shing / gzhug tshags kyang der grub na snyam zhing / la dwags mthil du 'gro 'dod ye nas ma shar yang rgyal po khu dbon gyi nan bskyed dang / legs bskum rjes kyi bya ba yang gtso rgan dmangs spyi'i dbus su bgyid na slad mar klan ka byar med cing mtha' btsan par re tsam dang / la dwags rgyal mo yang khye'u btsas ran gyis mthil du spyod par ring zhing / mtha' 'dom sogs rgyal sras bzhugs pa kho nas thag chod pa 'dug na yang / muswe rgyal blon nas rgyal mo ma bzhugs par nem nur mdzad kyi bdug gshis la dwags mthil du 'gro ba'i sgo dod/ de tshe la dwags rgyal po yab yum rnams hor zla lnga pa'i tshes bdun la la dwags su bskyod song zhing / nged ni la dwags mthil du 'gro ba'i bltas ma chub pa'i gegs sel du dmigs gtor chen sogs yang yang btang nas mulbe rgyal po dang lhan du tshes bcu gcig la lam du zhugs wam le'i chu shin tu lci bas lam bar du bsgrod mi bzod cing / 'phags yul dzo ka'i mkhas pa kha cig nas la dwags ljongs 'di gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i mthe bong ma ru'i gnas su 'dod pa/ don la yang gnas nges su snang la/ da lta yang la dwags kyi yul mtha' gar+shad ri 'phag dang nye ba gtsug lag khang rgya gar gyi gzo bos bcos pa'i dbus su rdo yi ling ka mthe bong gi gzugs can la mthe bong ma rur brjod pa dang / la dwags kyi phyogs 'dir spyir shing gal pa dang rtsa sogs ches dkon zhing lhag tu gar+shad dang nye bar rong zhes pa'i sa smo du ni bshag ma dang / bye ma dang / rdza dang / zangs kyi ri bo lta bu'i brag ri'i phung po 'ba' zhig las dbyar dgun gyi dbye ba yang chu la chab rom yod med tsam las gzhan mi rtog pa ma ru'i mtshan nyid tshang ba'i lam 'phrang de dag ngal dub dang / sbyangs spyod chen pos yongs su bgrod nas la dwags mthil gyi yul mgo ho mi las mar mi bsgrod pa'i rtsis byas kyang / yul bdag ma de'i cho 123

'phrul gyi nged dang po la dwags mthil shel kho nar bgrod rgyu'o zhes pa'i gtam 'chol la brten/ rgyal sras rin po che dang rgyal mo bcas der bskyod grub 'dug gshis tshes bcu gcig la nged kyang der son par byas/ zhag shas kyi ring lus shin tu ma bde bas bgyid dgos rnams ji bzhin ma long sems bal por 'gro ba'i ring khyad ches che bcas nyin re bzhin legs bzlum gyi mtha' tshags dgos pa rnams bgyis kyang lab rgyu dang gleng rgyu lhag par 'phel ba yi zla ba gcig lhag gi bar 'phro zhib tshags der skyongs dgos byung / sngar legs bzlum dngos gzhi wam ler legs ltas byung ba de la yang nges shes khyad par can skyes/ 'gor chen po'i mthar hor zla drug pa'i yar tshes bdun la thag gtsang chod de bcu gcig la bcad yig bklags bcu gnyis la la dwags stod pa'i blon po dang / rang re'i gra ngo bcas sler brdzang nas blon bu spun gyi nang rdzas rags rim sprad pa dang / kha che'i mi sna tshang ma 'dus pa'i dbus su kha che dang la dwags bar gyi lam bde ba'i zangs yig bklags nas kho rang tsho la rtsis sprad/ de skobs kha che'i khur pa gyad kyi rigs zhig kyang der gsar du son nas kha che'i yul khams su da lta bde 'jags yod tshul dang 'di lo ma kha'i yul na kla klo'i btsun pa darbe sha zhig gi glang rkang pa brgyad pa zhig dang /glang ltag pa'i ngos su sha yi ral pa khru gang lhag tsam yod pa dag khrid nas kha che'i grong yul bskor ba sogs sngon chad med pa'i mi dang byol song gi rnam 'gyur gnas
