skabs mtshar ba ltar la don 'tshub cha chen por bram ze sogs rgan po nyams can rnams kyi gleng ba dang pak+ṣa nas blon po che kha zhig la skyon phabs te dpung khri phrag lnga tsam zhig gsod par byas kyang blon po ngo thog yul mtha' rgya mtsho'i do zhig tu 'jug pa yin 'dug zhes pa dang / nub phyogs bha ga la kha dang / bhang kha sogs ma 'ongs bod du nges par 'phyo bar lung bstan pa'i stod hor gyi sde de dag rnams kyang da lta 'thab 'khrug gi g.yul bshams kyi sbyor ba la gnas pa sogs kyi gnas tshul yod 'dug nged kyang tshes bcu gsum la rgyal po yas mas nas thon rdzangs kyi rnam par gser dngul gyi snod nye bar bkang zhing kha che'i gur gum ma'i ge sar mtshar du mngar ba sogs ci ltar 'byor ba'i yo byad bstab kyang se ba gang ngam skar ma gcig gam 'jag ma tsam yang bdag gir ma byas shing mulbe rgyal po'i 'gyogs 'phyar la brten de lam bar grong mtshan rnams la yig drug gi dge bskul bcas te ho mir son/ de'i nyi ma phyi mar skye bo khri phrag nye ba la dbu ma lugs kyi byang sdom dang / thugs rje chen po'i rjes gnang bsgoms lung phog de nas 'bu srin nur 'gros kyi bal yul du spyod pa'i lam zhugs su gnas/ 'di phyogs kyi mi ma yin nag po'i phyogs rnams sngar las cung zad zhi yang gting nas da dung 'tshur nges par ldog par mthong bas lo shas bstan rim la 'bad dgos dang / bstan rim la tshul bzhin 'bad na lo shas bde ba snyam byed pas de don 124

bzhin gsong por smras kyang nyan par ni dka' bar sems med/ phyogs 'di'i khu dbon sogs tshangs ma bde 'jags kyi rgyu rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' yi gnang ba'i mthu las byung ba yin tshul yang yang smras bzhin mar yul rje bo'i thugs su yang shin tu 'phrod pas de yi bstan pa la bya ba mdzad bzhed kyi dge dgo dpe thub khri rtse la yang dge rgyun mchod gzhis phran bu sbyor rtsis rgyal sras rin po che nas mdzad kyi 'dug la dngos 'byor skyes cher 'bul rgyu mi 'dug kyang / zhabs pad mchog gi bka' drin dran nas/ bka' drin che gsol bar la dwags stod kyi mnga' 'og tu dpon khag da lta mkhar gyi las mtshan mthon por gnas pa'i spun 'dri khungs dgon gyi bla mar byas pa zhig dang / mulbe'i bka' blon bcarme nged sgar thog tu sleb mtshams gting zin rgyur byas song zhing 'di phyogs su rang gi gnas tshul cha shas rags rim sgrib med phul ba de ltar dang / zhes sogs dang / gzhung sa mchog nas legs bzlum skor la bka' rgya rim can rta zam rgyun mi chad dang / gnang skyes gser dngul dang / zab gos yug mang po sogs gnang ba lab 'ching skabs/ kha che dang na bab sogs mtha'i rgyal khag gi mi sna dang / la dwags rgyal blon phan tshun so sor snang skyes gsol ras stsal dgos rnams phal cher rje nyid rang sku sger gyi sku chas steng nas gang kheb dang / de'i steng du dgos rigs rnams gzhung sa mchog nas stsal ba'i gnang skyes kyi thog nas snon kha gang dgos snal ma tsam yang chud ma zos par gtong bar mdzad cing / rje nyid nas rtser gong zhabs pad mchog dang / lha ldan du bka' blon lhan rgyas su dgongs skor rim can gyi rten chas su stod hor gyi zab gos rin thang gzhal du med pa dag dang / 'phags yul dang kha phye'i yul nas byung ba'i gser gyi dong rtse kar+ṣa pa ṇa grangs ldan sogs 'dul bar mdzad cing / khyad par 'di res legs bzlum gyi legs mdzad rlabs po che skrun pa mtha' dag rgyal dbang mchog gi spyan sngar bsngo smon gyi rgyas 'debs zhu ba'i rten du dngos 'bul gyi maṇ+ḍal dang phyir gzhung sa mchog nas stsal ba'i dngos po phyir 'bul zhu ba dang lhan cig chab shog tu 'bul bar mdzad pa ni rgyal ba mchog gi bka' skye dgu yongs kyi bde thabs su dgongs te phyogs 'dir bsngags par mdzad pa'i lam bar dang snga rabs kyi yi ge mar yul dang da lta mu sur mal gyi ka ra ri bar du brjod cing bod rnams kyi la dwags su sgrog pa yul mthil gyi shel gyi bar du phyin zhing / bal yul nas mar yul lam du zhugs nas da lta bar lo phyed gnyis la nye bar gyur pa de srid du rags rtsis skye bo 'bum phrag gsum la nye bar dbu ma lugs kyi byang sdom dang thugs rje chen po'i bsgoms bzlas lung dang rjes gnang gang bcogs chu sbyin gyi lung rnams sgo gsum 'bad pas dam pa chos kyi sbyin par dmigs pa dang /gzhan yang bsnyen gnas bskung gnas dang so thar skyabs sdom gyi sdom pa len pa yang ches mang zhing tshangs spyod kyi dge bsnyen chos kyi sgor zhugs pa 125

yang snga phyir brgyad brgyar nye bar tsam byung ba dang / gtso bor mar yul gyi rje 'bangs 'khon sel sbyangs nas mthun gshis legs spel la bkod nas gangs can bde ba'i rtsas su bsgrub pa sogs rang gi mkhos la dpags pa'i bsdu dngos bzhi'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ji snyed bgyis pa de kun mkha' khyab 'gro ba pha ma'i rang bzhin yongs dang thun mong du bgyis te/ des kyang bdag tshe rabs kun tu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'phrin las kyi byed po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi bran du gyur te khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mtha' dag sel ba'i byed por 'grub par bsngo smon gyi rgyas 'debs ci nas kyang bka' drin chen pos khyab pa dang / de ltar dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'i dge ba brlabs chen gyur pa'i de yi mthu byin yang dus skabs 'dir ni gangs ri'i khrod lha yi lha 'jig rten mgon po mchog khyed kyi zhabs pad brtan pa dang / gzhan yang bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam par gyur pa rnams kyi sku tshe brtan zhing thugs mthun pa dang / rgyal bstan 'khor lo gsum po rgyas pa dang / mthar thug nges don snying po'i bstan pa mchog tu dar ba'i ched du bsngo ba de de kho na bzhin 'grub par yang thugs smon gyi do ra nas nam yang mi bskyud pa ci nas kyang mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen zhes gsol ba 'debs pa'i dngos po pad+ma'i rnal ma ltar phra yang mos dge kun bzang rol pa'i sprin du dmigs nas phul ba nyid dang / 'chi med bskal pa'i shing gi pad+mo ltar rnam par dkar ba lha'i reg bya srid du ring ba'i maṇ+ḍal la 'phags yul gyi rū pa kar+sha pa ṇi nyi shu rtsa bdun tshom bur bkod cing / bha lag kha yi gser gyi kar+sha pā ṇa dbang po'i grangs ldan gyis kyang mdzes par byas pa snga sor bka' rgya rin po che dang lhan du phul du phyung ba'i snang skyes zab gos ji snyed pa rnams rnal ma gcig yang chud zos ma song ba legs spel gyi rgyur song zhing / su waṇ+ḍa srang gi 'khor lo snga mar lnga/ bar mar gcig phyi mar gsum te khyon srang gi 'khor lo dgu ldan phebs pa de yang gong smos phran gyi rnam dkar dge tshogs sgrub pa rnams byang chen snying po'i bar nyams med rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'i rten du gus pas phul ba rnam kun thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor du chub pa mkhyen mkhyen mkhyenaske/ zhes 'bul bar mdzad do/ /mdo khams kyi pho nya ba snga ma yar res phebs lam sra sun rtse dang phyi ma la dwags nyid du 'byor/ sde dge sa skyongs ba chen po bsod nams mgon po'i sku mched lha btsun bla ma'i drung dang lcam drung bcas sku gshegs pa'i bsngo rten dngul srang brgya phrag gi rin thang can gyi dngos 'bul dang bcas kaḥthog skor gyi snyan bskul gsol bar/ gong smos sde dge'i dngos 'bul gyi steng du rgya dngul dang bod dngul 'dres pa srang gnyis brgya ste khyon srang sum brgya'i rtsis kaḥthog gi zhig gso sgrub pa'i thebs su rtsal zhing kaḥthog rdo rje gdan gyi dgon pa sku 'bum ring mo dang bcas par nyams gso dang rab gnas dgos pa'i bka' khyab dang / zhwa dmar bar khri 'don gnang rgyu sogs sde dge rgyal po 126

bsod nams mgon po la chab shog zhib thems su gnang / kun mkhyen si tu par yang gong mtshungs kyi gnas tshul dang / snga sor sa 'brug lor bal yul nas sgrol ma mtshan brgya'i rgya dpe zhig phyag tu 'byor ba de nyid gsar du bsgyur dgos tshul gyi chab shog 'phags yul gyi gser gyi kar+ṣa pa ṇa'i rten dang bcas 'bul bar mdzad/mtshan brgya 'di bzhin sngar bod du bsgyur ba rnams dang mi 'dra ba'i tshig don gyi char 'di nyid legs tshad phul du byung bar snang zhes kun mkhyen si tu gsung / gzhan yang sred med kyi bus zhus pa'i gzungs dang / sangs rgyas klu sbyin gyi gzungs tshogs ba gi gzungs sogs sngar bod du ma 'gyur ba'i rgya gzhung gsar 'gyur 'ga' zhig dang / sngags brgyud kha yar la 'gyur bcos/ sgra rig tsan+d+ra pa'i 'grel chen/ bka' brgyud gser phreng sogs bstan bcos du ma zhig kyang rtsom bskul zhu ba'i chab shog snga phyir 'bul ba gnang 'dug nges don gyi mdo sde nyi shu gleg bam drug gi bar dang / 'brug pa kun mkhyen pad dkar zhabs kyi bka' 'bum po ti bcu phrag gi par kyang sde dger gsar du brko ba'i bka' khyab mdzad pa ltar mi ring bar grub par snang ngo / /sngar la dwags nas thag nye gshis dza lar+ghaṃ ra dang / kasmi ra/ o rgyan gyi yul sogs su 'byon rtsis mdzad pa de don gong zhabs rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen gzigs mchog la thugs brtag dang gnas tshul 'bul ba gnang bar phyir phebs su/ gnas chen du bgrod pa las nang gi rnal 'byor la spyod pa rgyud sde nas bsngags shing / rgya gar gnas chen de rnams su da lta phyi rol gyi grub mtha' zing bas sngon tsam bal yul mchod rten gyi zhig gso grub nas thos don bsgom la gzhol na legs/ zhes phebs pas thugs 'dun bshol bar mdzad cing / skabs 'dir legs spel 'ching sgrigs dper 'os pa dang /mtha' dmag phyir bsring ba'i tshul la dges 'dzum lhug par grol ba'i bsngags brjod dang lhan cig rtse shod nas legs skye gya nom pa'ang stsal lo/ /de yang / sangs rgyas gnyis pa slob dpon chen pos lung bstan du ma zhig tu ma 'ongs pa na bod du stod hor gyi dmag 'byung bar gsung pa dang / thang yig las/ sna thag pas byas hor dmag bod du khrid: zhes pa'i lung don sa skya pa dang 'bri khung pa gnyis 'khrugs pas so so'i hor dmag drangs pa mthar 'bri khung bcoms pas 'bri khung gling log tu grags pa byung de nas gzung rgyal ba yang dgon pa dang / grub thob o rgyan pa'i skabs sogs snga phyir bod du hor dmag lan grangs du ma byung ba'i lo rgyus mang zhing / 'di dus chu spre lo nang stod hor nges par bod du 'phyo ba'i rtags dang rgyu rkyen mang du 'tshogs pas som nyi ma dgos rung /gtso bor rgyal dbang phyag na pad+mo bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i thugs rjes bskul te rje 'di nyid gdul bya dus la bab pa lta bus mnga' ris phyogs su byon par mi zad 'jigs rung tu ruṣ+ka'i dmag dpung phyir bsring pas da lta bgrang bya drug cu re bdun gyi thog tu son pa'i bar ming tsam gleng med du gyur sdi ni kun gyi 127

shes pa 'di'o/ /snga sor mdo khams su bzhugs pa zhig na stod hor gyi dmag bod du 'phyo bar gyar tsho bzlog par nus pa ni sus kyang dka' ba zhig te/ 'byung 'gyur gyi gnas lkog tu ma gyur par gzigs pas bod du byon zhing / rje nyid gtsang stod du bzhugs pa'i skabs nyid nas mnga' ris mar yul la dwags rgyal pos spyan 'dren pa'i pho nya byung ba de skabs zhal gyi ma bzhes pa'ang dus gnad mkhyen par mngonaske/ sngar mi dbang chos kyi rgyal po bsod nams stobs rgyas la lung bstan stsal ba gong du smos pa ltar/bcu phrag gcig dang bdun tshun la/ zhes pa'i lo grangs kyang 'grig pa dang / sngar lcags lug lor bod kyi srid skyongs dga' bzhi paṇ+ḍi tas kun slong can gyi ser skya g.yon can dag gi bar du dbyen bcos pas rje 'di nyid kyi thugs bsun phyung zhing / mtha' dmag bzlog pa'i bya ba mi rtsam pa'i dbu rtsi dgos tshul sogs byung ba ni gong du rnam thar zhal gsung mar 'khod pa bzhin la/ de skabs kyi gzhung sa mchog nas bka' 'dri mang du phebs pa'i lan gsung dngos nas rgya cher spel bar mdzad pa rnams ni yi ger ma 'khod rung brgyud nas phul ba'i bka' lan rags rim reg zig tu 'khod par/ gangs can gyi ris med grub mtha' spyi dang rnying sngags rnams la sman pa'i slad du rang gi dzi wa la 'phang med kyi zhu tshig seng ge'i rgyun dbyangs zhes pa chab shog gi nang du bzhugs pa la gzigs shing / de skabs bka' skyon pa'i ram 'degs mkhan bshes gnyen chen po 'ga' zhig ni 'di dus gdong du khyod song dpa' bo ngastse byas zhes pa las gzhan ci yang mi gsung ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs so/ /mtha' dmag bzlog pa'i bya ba mi brtsam pa'i dbu snying bzhes dgos zhes pa de yang skabs 'dir ci ltar 'gyur/ phyis sa spre sde gzar gyi rkyen las sa bya lo bod gor 'ching sgrig pa bla dpon che gnyan du ma zhig mang yul skyid grong du byon te legs bzlum gnang skabs g.yon can gor+ṣa bar sa rin du rgya dngul rdo tshad gsum brgya re lo lo ltar bod nas gnang rgyur byas pa'i mthar lo gcig ma song bar gor+ṣa bas bod du brgol bar zhugs pa'i gnya' nang du kun rdzob kyi brdzun phugs gtib ste byus nyes byung ba sogs gzhan du shes pas gsal loglu/ /de ltar na 'ching bzlum gyi tshul dang / mtha' btsan min gyi mdzad pa mtha' dag 'dir ji ltar gsal bas rtogs par 'gyur zhing / zhib tu blta bar 'dod na chab shog dang / 'ching yig chen mo le tshan las bzu bor gnas pa'i blo ldan rnams kyis gzigs pas mkhyen par 'gyur ro/ /zhes bar skabs kyi 'phros su brnyad nas dkyus su 'jug pa/ de ltar mnga' ris mar yul gyi ljongs su 'khod pa'i gdul bya mtha' dag phan dang bde ba'i ngal gsor phral yun kun tu dbugs dbyung ba'i mdzad pa phrin las gzhal du med pas mthong thos dran reg 'brel tshad don ldan du mdzad de rim pas shul lam gyi skye 'gro kun la sngar mus ltar gzhan phan skyongs bzhin par chu bya lo'i mjug tu mang yul skyid grong du phebs/128

gtsang gi stag tshal bkra shis sgang du sngawor dbus phebs skabs sngags 'chang dpal ldan rdo rje la chos 'brel phar spel tshur zhus gnango zhing 'di nyid sku'i skye ba gsum gyi yab yin par gsung / de'i sras rig 'dzin par rta dmar rting dkar zhig sga gang na srab gdan gsum yod pa dang / bal ṭam brgya tham pa bcas gnang zhing bshed dmar gyi tshogs 'khor dang gyad chen gyi bskang gso gang rgyas gtong dgos tshul chab shog stsal/ mi ring bar bal yul tsha ba tsha shod du bde bar phyag phebs so/ /de nas de wi gā ṭa zhes rdo rje phur pa'i bka' bsrung ma mo bcu gnyis las se mo mched bzhi'i nang mtshan rdo rje ya byin gnas pa der mchod rten chen po'i srog shing bsgrub par mdzad/ de yang lo sngon ma chu spre lor srog shing gi rgyur tshad du 'os pa'i ljon shing srid du ring ba kha shas kyi khrod nas 'di lta bu zhig go zhes bka' stsal ba zhabs ring ba 'ga' zhig gi gnas der byon te gzhi bdag la gtor ma dang bcas bka' bsgo ba'i tshe sdong po de'i rtsa ba nas sbrul dkar po zhig don te gzhan du song skad/ srog shing snga ma de ha cang shin tu sbom zhing rags pas 'dren ma thub par 'jog dgos pa byung / da res phyi ma de sgrub par rje nyid sku dngos kyi zhabs kyis bcags shing 'di'i tshad du rtsa ba ngos rer gzhu 'doms gang lhag nges/ rtse mor gzhu 'doms phyed lhag ring thung srid du rgyug khru lnga bcu nga gsum yod par grags/ de skabs rdo rje'i mgur bzhes pa ni/ gnas 'di ni slob dpon pad+ma'i gnas/ /yul bkra shis bal yul tsha ba shod/ /lha bkra shis 'jig rten skyong ba'i gtso/ /dpal mchog dang ldan pa mgrin sngon rgyud/ /lha chen mo dpal mo nyer mtshungs ma/ /dpal bal yul gyi rgyal mo ma lags sam/ /khong chos mdzad yongs kyi dgra lha yin/ /dpal rig pa 'dzin pa'i bsrung ma yin/ /sgos rnal 'byor bdag gi snying grogs yin/ /yul 'dir gnas kyi lha srin sde brgyad rnams/ /kun byang chub spyod pa'i grogs bzang yin/ /yul mi gcig mi rigs mang po yi/ /glu rang rang yul chos mthun pa 'di/ /lha gnyen po khyed la mchod par 'bul/ /gnas 'dir tshogs kyi dpon slob 'khor 'bangs kun/ /las ci la tshogs pa chos la tshogs/ /chos rnam dkar dge ba bsgrub la tshogs| /chos rnam dkar dge ba'i 'bras bu de/ /khyed mi min rnams dang thun mong bsngo/ /don byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /dus gcig tu tshogs pa'i mchod lcam yin/ /dus 'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /dus kun tu lhan cig tshogs par shog /zhes kyang gsungs so/ /dgung lo nga bdun pa dngos po ste shing khyi lo gsar du tshes pa'i dga' ston mdzad/ de nas bal yul du byon/ ki ḍor bzhugs skabs dam can rdor legs dang / gyad chen bcas dngos su byon nas phrin las sgrub par khas blangs pa'i tshe so sor bstod phrin kyang mdzad/ rat+na shi ṣi ṇa'i gzungs kyi rgya dpe gsar du gzigs pa bzhin rje nyid rang nas bod yig tu 'bebs par mdzad do/ /de nas srog shing 'dren pa'i phyir slar yang tsha ba tsha shod kyi 129

ljongs su phebs/ 'di dus shang bkra shis rtser paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i yab yum la chab shog tu stsal ba 'di ltar gsung ste/ rig pa 'dzin pa'ang sngon gyi las kyi rgyu bas tshe stod byis pa nas lo nyer gsum bar mdo khams smad bla ma'i go sa bzung skyid sdug spel ma byung / de nas bya btang byas yangs pa'i rgyal khams 'grim/ 'khor ba'i gdos thag bcad/ snang ba dga' yal le/ skyid me re ba'i ngang lo skor lhag tsam bar ri khrod 'grim/ de nas si tu dang grogs por gyur te/ zhwa dmar sprul sku snga phyi gnyis kyi ched du dpon po'i dgongs pa bsrung / drung 'khor tsho'i ngo srung ci bya gang drag gi bya bas mi tshe gsum cha gcig sdug zad la bskyal/ mthar me yos kyi lo la thag chod/ de ltar dka' ba spyod pa yang bstan pa'i don yin pas 'gyod rgyu med/ phaṭa/ de nas ci bde spyod pa zhig skyong rgyu yin pa la bal yul du 'gro 'dod skyesaske/ der phyin nas bya rung kha shor gyi zhig gso bsgrub/ de la bal pos gtsos bar chad btang mkhan mang pos sdug rgu btang yang mthar zhig gso gegs med du 'grub thub/ de nas lho spa gror 'gro 'dod yin pa la thog mar sku mched 'khrugs/ de nas dbang la rgya nag gi dgongs phog byung / de skabs gzhung gi mchod gnas kyi khul phal che la dbyings tshoms kyi rnam pa re byung ba'i adi dang po de nged la phabs/de skabs khams su phyin na yong ba yod kyang bal yul mchod rten 'phags pa shing kun zhig gso byed 'dod skyes bal por phyin/ tsha reg dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal rjes mthun zhig nyams su blang / de lta na yang mchod rten gyi bya las don med par la dwags khu dbon 'khrugs nas stod hor am cig yong rgyu red zer gzhung nas bka' nan ches pas kha char chu klung phreng ba lta bur bsgrangs nas la dwags su 'byor/mtha' dmag gi kha rlangs mi dang mi ma yin gyi 'tshub kyi sdug ma btang rgu cig de ru btang / mthar gu ru pad+ma'i thugs rjes lab 'ching 'grig thub tsam byung yang de nas yong phyis pas bal yul du dbyar tshad kyi dus la khel/ chu ni mi phrod/ gzugs khams ni mi bde bzhin du las ka ni mang po byed dgos/ nyo mi dgos pa ni chu kho na tsam las gzhan med yo byad kyang ci rigs rdzogs/ zhig gso ni byed dgos/ de ltar lus ngag yid gsum sdug bsngal gyi 'dams du chud pa lta bur snang yang sangs rgyas la yid ches pa'i dad pas rang nyid 'chi yang sdug bsngal cung zad yang ma dmigs par dge ba'i las la dga' bzhin spro bzhin 'jug pa gnas tshul yin/ zhes pa gnang ngo / /rdo dmar zhabs drung kun bzang 'gyur med dang /kho bo'i bla ma rje 'phrin las zhabs sku mched sogs la rdzong chen tshe dbang sgrub thabs kyi lung dang bcas pa rje nyid kyi mdzad pa'i 'jig rten mgon po'i sgrub thabs mchod sbyin gtor ma'i dmigs rim dang bcas/thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi sgrub thabs kyi lung / sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs dmigs khrid sogs rtsal zhing gzhan yang phyogs 'dus kyi bla ma khag dang don gnyer ba mang 130

pos so so'i bzhed pa ltar gyi chos sbyin chags su bka' drin bskyangs/ gor rgyal pri thi nā ra yan la srog shing 'dren pa'i dpung dgos tshul snga sor bka' phebs pa khas blangs kyang skabs 'di dag tu kho rang dmag 'khrug gi g.yul 'gyed pa sogs kyi g.yengs te rim 'gyangs su gyur pa na rje nyid shin tu thugs 'khrugs pas skabs zhig rgyal po nyid sku zhabs su 'bod par mdzad pa glang po'i bzhon pa las gzhol te sku drung du sa gdan zhig gi khar sdod rje nyid ni khri'u shing gi khar bzhugs bzhin pa las sngar khas blangs pa'i don phyir 'gyangs su gyur pa sogs kyi rgyu mtshan dang bcas bka' skyon tsha brjid che ba gnang ba'i mur har gyis gzhengs/ sku'i gam du zangs kyi spos gzhong zhig yod pa phyag tu bzhes te rgyal po la 'phang bar mdzad pa gsol dpon bstan 'phel gyi bar snang nas 'dzin thub/ rgyal po 'khor bcas shin tu skrag cing zhum pas bka' las mi 'da' ba'i khas blang dam bca' yul/ de ma thag khong rang gi yul srol ltar lha gtso che ba gsum gyi gzugs thod du bris pa'i bshams du mchod rten chen po'i zhig gso'i zhabs 'gyur dang khyad par srog shing 'dren par 'gyang med dpung gi tshogs gang dgos mi thogs par gtong rgyu'i mna' dam the'u 'byar ba bzhes nas rgyal po rang gnas su phyir ldog pa'i tshe 'khor rnams la rgyal po na re da ki bla ma khros nas nged rang la deg grab byed pa'i skabs khyed rnams kyi cir mthong byung zer bas/ bla ma rang zhe sdang gis khros shing smra ba las gzhan gang yang ma mthong / zhes smras pas/ rgyal pos/ngas ni bla ma'i dpral ba na mig gcig bcas mig gsum shin tu dmar zhing 'khrug pa dang kha nas me lhab lhab 'bar ba mthong nas shin tu 'jigs te da res las dred pa sngar yong ma myong zer skad/ mi ring bar srog shing 'dren pa'i dpung tshogs grangs med pa 'dus nas drangs/ de dus mnga' ris la dwags nas mdo khams/ bod 'brog glo bo/ skyid grong sogs sku zhabs su 'dus pa'i bod mi drag zhan ser skya pho mo ji snyed pa thams cad kyang srog shing 'dren pa'i las la zhugs te 'brel pa tshud nges par byas so/ /bar skabs shig nas srog shing yong ma nyan par zhag nyi shu tsam sa gcig tu 'gor/ rgyal blon dpon g.yog sa gzhir mi gshong ba tsam gyi dpung chen pos drangs kyang 'dren ma thub de'i tshe nyin gcig thugs 'ur nyams kyis phebs nas/ kho bo'i bla ma rje 'phrin las zhabs la gsung drag pos/ bla ma 'phrin las 'dir shog dang / 'go mi la da ltar rang 'u lag bsdus gsung bar skad gnyis bsgyur ba gnang bas 'phral du lus byung / de nas rig 'dzin rje nyid kyi bden brjod drag po zhig mdzad de srog shing gi sne la phyag reg tsam mdzad pa na/ sho dang po rang la 'doms gang tsam nur gyis byung ba skad cig la rgyang grags lhag tsam slebs pa'i rdzu 'phrul chen po lkog tu ma gyur pa der 'khod mon bod skye rgu kun gyi mngon sum mig gi dga' ston du 'gyed par mdzad do/ /'di dus hor zla bzhi pa'i 'jug gi bar tsha ba'i yul 131

der bzhugs/ mon pa thams cad 'cham par/ 'di lo bod pa thams cad tshad nad kyi 'chi bar 'gyur zhes gleng zhing / gzhan yang 'brum pa dang dmar yams kyi nad kyis mtha' kun skor zhing / mi mang gi yo lang bcas shin tu bag tsha bar byung kyang rje nyid dpon 'khor phyogs kyi 'dus pa dang bcas pa gang la yang skyon gyur ma byung zhing de res nam dus kyi bab nas ston dus bar phro bshol bar mdzad de mang yul skyid grong du chibs kha bsgyur byams sprin gtsug lag khang gi nye 'dab dngos grub phug tu bzhugs so/ /skabs 'di dag tu phyogs kyi rgyal khag gi mi sna mang po'i 'du tshogs kyi thugs brel shin tu che zhing / de dag gi bar mtshams su yang bod rong gi bla ma khag sogs chos don gnyer ba mtha' dag gi rang rang 'dod pa bzhin dbang lung khrid sogs rgyun chags su bskyangs/ rgyal khag so sor chab shog gi rim pa yang gang mtshams su stsal/ ston dbyug zla'i mjug slar yang bal yul du zhabs stegs te lam bar rnams su mthong thos dran reg gi phan bde rgya cher mdzad tshul ni sngar ltar ro/ /dgung lo nga brgyad pa na tshod ldan te shing mo phag lo gsar du 'char ba na/ mchod rten chen po'i srog shing 'dzugs par mdzad cing rka/ bre dang chos 'khor gyi zangs gser rnams las gra sngar mu ltar 'dzugs bzhin pa dang / bar skabs su yam bu rgyal po dang / gor rgyal gnyis g.yul 'khrugs pa'i bar du legs bskum bar 'ching kyang lan grangs snga phyi du mar gnang ba rje nyid mya ngan las ma 'das bar gor rgyal gyis kyang bal yul ma bcoms par phan tshun so sor 'khod cing / mchod rten chen po'i nyams gso ni bar ma chad par sgrub par mdzad pa la rgyal po so so nas kyang de mthun gyi zhabs 'degs sgrub/ de yang rje nyid kyi thog ma'i dgongs gzhir shing kun mchod rten chen po'i sngar bre yan gser zangs las grub par bum pa la zangs gser med kyang skabs 'dir bum pa yang yongs rdzogs zangs gser gyi g.yogs par bzhed cing / bre'i phyogs bzhi'i spyan ras kyi smin ma rnams g.yu dmar sgrigs pa dang / spyan 'bras rnams kyang rin po che las grub par dgongs pas dbus phebs phyi ma'i skabs stod lung yan g.yu'i 'bul ba byung ba phal cher bzhes te bre gang lhag tsam yod skad/ de ltar yang da lta mchod rten gyi drung du nye bar spyod pa dag gi 'bru dang /zhal zas/ mar me/ snyan dar la sogs ji snyed pa'i dngos po dang / bza' ba dang btung bar 'os pa ji rgu spre'u dang su thob chab gcig tu spyod par byed na/ rjes su ma 'ongs par mtha' dbus kyi dmag gi 'jigs pa dang rgyu 'bras la ji mi snyams pa'i skye bo 'jung pa'i blo can dag gis mtho mtshams pas slar mchod rten la mi mdzes shing nyams zhig gi rgyur 'gro bar gzigs te sngon dus bzhin bum pa bcos med dang / bre yan zangs gser/ phyogs bzhi'i 'od ldan bzhi'i ngos su sangs rgyas kyi sku brnyan mang po dang ske/ 'phags yul gyi grub thob 'ga' zhig gi snang brnyan mtshan byang dang bcas pa/ bre'i phyogs bzhir 132

rgyal mtshan bzhi bcas gsar du sgron par mdzad/ sngon grub thob gtsang smyon he ru ka pa dang / brag dkar ba lha btsun rin chen rnam rgyal/ gnas rams pa byams pa phun tshogs bcas kyi nyams gsos skabs chos 'khor gyi mas pad yan gser gdugs 'degs byed kyi ka ba bzhi 'dzugs pa yod 'dug kyang 'di res chos 'khor bcu gsum gdugs tog bcas kho na las ka bci bzhi lhag por dgos pa med cing mchod rten gyi mtshan nyid tshang bar bya ba'i phyir dang phyi rol mthun snang du'ang mdzes khyad bcas ka ba bzhi ma dgos par mdzad do/ /'di skabs mchod rten chen po'i bsrung mar grags shing / bod thang mgon po zhes rang byung gi rdo skur 'dod pa dang / kha cig 'phags mchog sku sgrub kyi phyag gzor yang grags pa gang ltar sngon ye rang dang nye ba'i ri bo phul ḍo zhes par yod pa nam mkha' las dngos su 'phur te bod thang du bab pas bod thang mgon por grags/ bal yul du du ruṣ+ka'i dmag byung skabs mgon po'i sku'i shang la mtshon bsnun te gzhar ba phyis rim gyis gsos par grags pa'i mgon po gri gug can gyi sku brnyan de'i drung du 'bras khal du ma phyung sor spungs pa'i khar sha khog mang pos dmar rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i gtor chen gnang zhing / bstod pa rgyas pa bzhed don lhun gyis grub pa'i dbyangs zhes pa dang de las cung zad bsdus pa zhig kyang bka' rtsam gnang gong du rnam thar zhal gsung mar rtsal ba bzhin lo ro sprul pa'i sku zhes skyes chen dam pa zhig byung ba sku'i nye bar gnas par bzhugs bzhin pa bal yul du sku gshegs par rje nyid kyang gces 'phang thugs ngal gyi tshul mdzad cig gsol dpon bstan 'phel zhes zham ring gi thu bo mdo khams nas bzung 'brel med du byon pa'i bgres lo de yang 'di skabs gshegs/ gshegs khar zhing khams gar thad du 'phos zhes phebs par lcang lo can du 'khrungs par bzhed bzhin smon lam tshigs bcad kyang stsal ba kha 'don du mdzad bzhin par gshegs skad do/ /skabs 'dir 'phags yul grub pa'i gtsug rgyan gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir bsam bzhin sgyu ma chen pos rnam par rol pa rje btsun 'brug pa thams cad mkhyen gzigs bka' brgyud 'phrin las shing rta'i zhabs kyang bal yul gyi gnas gzigs dang rje 'di nyid las zab chos kyi 'phros rnams gsan pa'i ched du phebs/ yam bu rgyal blon rnams kyi rta dang glang po la sogs pa'i bsu ba'i bkod pa rgya chen po dang bcas zhabs tog rgyas par sgrub cing / rje 'di nyid kyis kyang dri bzang gi spos bam po dri bsung mngon par btul bzhin pa dang mjal dar bkra shis pa'i kha btags kha dog sna lnga pa'i zab gos yug ring bcas bsnams te rgyang ring po'i sa nas zhabs bsur byon/ ki ḍo'i gtsug lag khang du yab sras zhal 'dzoms lhan rgyas yun ring du gnang / 'di res kyang mchod rten rnam gnyis so sor mar me stong tshar du mas mchod par mdzad cing / bya rung kha shor du ni gnas 'dzin pa dag mchod rten gyi dkor la 133

shin tu 'jung zhing rngam pas dad pa can gyi rdzas chud zos su 'gyur bar thog mar bal yul du phebs skabs nyid nas dgongs te 'dis mtshon snga phyir mar me la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i phreng ba mtha' dag shing kun rtse dang / ki ḍo'i gtsug lag khang nas kha shor gyi mchod rten phyogs su legs par bshams te mchod sprin dang thugs smon mdzad par snang / tshul 'di bzhin sngon byon dam pa gzhan 'ga' zhig gi rnam thar las kyang 'byung ba des na gnas 'dzin pa dag mchod rten gyi dkor gyi rtag tu 'tsho bas rang gzhan gnyis ka bslu ba'i thabs tshul la shin tu mnga' brnyes zhing smon lam gyi mthu grub pa zhig yin par gda'/ yam bu rgyal po dza ya pra ka su nyid mi phyed pa'i dad pa brtan pos/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i sbyor ba yan lag drug gi man ngag kyang zhus shing 'dis zhus ngor sbyor drug gi rdzogs rim man ngag snying po bsdus pa zhig kyang stsal/ gzhan yang bram ze mang po dang / bal po'i gur bal/ mon pa sogs kyi'ang rang rang 'dod pa'i rjes gnang rig gtad/ man ngag lung sogs zhu ba mang du byung ba ltar stsal/ de dag gi skabs su lo tsā ba ni ti mal bla ma 'jam dbyangs zhes rig pa'i gnas mang por byang chub pa bod yul dbus su'ang yun ring du bsnyen par yam bu rgyal pos kyang bkur bzos kyi ches bsngags pa zhig te nang don rig pa'i skor la'ang rje nyid kyi zhabs la btugs pas rjes su 'dzin pa thob pa zhig go/ /de nas tsha ba tsha shod kyi ljongs su phebs kho bo'i bla ma dam pa rje 'phrin las zhabs la byang gter rdzogs chen ka dag rang byung rang shar gyi khrid dang / shang lugs nag po chen po phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang zab khyad can dang / bram ze zhig dang lhan du nor rgyun dza ma ri'i rig gtad stsal zhing lung bstan zhig kyang gnang /nyin gcig sku mdun du rje 'di nyid bzhugs skabs/ 'brug sgra drag po rlung 'tshub dang bcas byung bar sku'i g.yon phyogs su thugs dam gtor ma bshams 'dug pa nas me stag zhig tsheg sgra dang bcas yar byung ba mngon sum du gzigs gsungs/ drag sngags srid pa'i gter khyim dang / sngags kyi rgyas sdebs snying gzer nag po'i lung dang bka' gtad bcas kyang gnang ngo / rje 'brug pa rin po che'i thugs dam thub pa yum 'khyud kyi zhal thang gi rgyab byang smon tshig phyag ris bka' rtsogadang rab gnas mdzad/ de nas rje nyid dang / kun mkhyen 'brug pa rin po che lhan rgyas chab gcig tu bod du chibs kha bsgyur/ bal yul nas phebs khar rgyal po dang / bal po sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa thams cad kyi rdo rje slob dpon paṇ+ḍi ta sa man+ta bha tra zhes pa kun mkhyen si tu zhabs dang rje 'di nyid kyi dngos slob mi phyed pa'i dad pa can de la sogs pa 'ga' zhig la phyi mtha' gzigs pa'i bka' las/ da cha nged rang dngos sleb thub pa zhig mi yong kyang / slob ma'i gtso bo rgyal ba yab sras lnga dang / badz+ra a tsar+ya sogs nas rang byung mchod rten chen po'i zhig gso'i mjug rnams mthar 'khyol nges pa zhig dgos tshul phebs/ 'di 134

skabs snga phyi ma nges pa gang rung zhig tu se thang gi se mthong zur kha zhes pa'i ri sked du lam phrang yod pa zhig gi rdo zhig la phyag mkhar gyi rjes 'dzub gang lhag tsam nub pa zhig byung ba da lta yang kun gyi mig lam du gyur pa dang / thang yig nas bshad pa'i rdo rje gsang lam zhes pa'i brag gi nye 'dab sogs yar mar kun tu phyag mkhar gyi rjes mang du byung ba bzhi lnga tsam zhig ni kho bos kyang mngon sum mig gi spyod yul rdzun med du mthong ngo / /gzhan gyis zhus ngo tsam ma yin par rong gi gzhi bdag brag bdud lcam dral sogs lha 'dre dregs pa can mtha' dag gis dngos nyams su gus pas btud cing sems bskyed khas blang dam bca' bro bor ba'i tshe gzigs snang dang mthun pa'i so so'i byung khungs cha lugs gnas yul 'khor gyi mngon rtogs gsol mchod 'phrin las rab myur klog gi zhags pa zhes pa zhig kyang bka' rtsom gnang / se thang de gu ru'i gnas chen khyad par can du gyur cing / rdo rje phur pa'i bka' bsrung se mo bzhi'i nang mtshan rdo rje se byin ma gnas pa'i pho brang yang nub phyogs kyi lung pa'i phu zhig tu mtsho dmar po khrag ltar 'khrug pa'i dbus su rdo ba mi langs stabs su byas pa zhig yod zer/ de'i kha gnon dang bal bod kyi sa mtshams su dgos pa khyad par can du gzigs lha khang zhig bzhengs par dgongs/skyid grong gi bla ma 'ga' zhig la do dam khur len sus byed sho rgyab tu 'jug pa gnang bar grwa 'jam gling pa sngags 'chang shes rab 'byung gnas la bab/ phyi nang gi bkod pa dang logs ris 'di dang 'di lta bu gyis shig pa'i ljags bkod rtsal nas skyid grong tshong 'dus kyi phu chos sding du chab snyoms phyir re zhig bzhugasaglu/ de nas dngos grub phug tu phebs pa na se thang gi lha khang de yang grub te rab gnas kyi tshul phul bar/ sngags 'chang shes rab 'byung gnas rang nas rab gnas gnang mthus dang / rje nyid nas dgongs pa gtad pa'i rab gnas spyan dmigs gnang rgyur byin gyis rlabs pa'i me tog rtsal zhing lha khang gi ming yang rten 'brel gyi dgos ched zhig tu dgongs pa'i/ don gnyis lhun grub nges gsang rdo rje snying po'i pho brang bkra shis dge rgyas zhes pa stsal lo/ /'di'i bang mir gzim 'gag pa zla ba tshe ring zhes pas dngos grub phug nas se thang bar nyin thal gyis phyin pa'i rkang 'gyogs kyi tshad du phyin pas phal cher ya mtshan du 'dzin cing rab gnas kyi me tog 'thor mtshams su 'grigs pas rten 'brel ngo mtshar ba byung / de skabs rje 'brug pa thams cad mkhyen zhabs mchog nas bka' chos mang du gsan cing phyogs kyi bla ma khag mang po dang / rgyal khag gi mi sna/ bod rong gi skya ser 'dus pa ches mang por chos sbyin gyi nor bu thang mar brdal zhing / gsung gi skyes chab shog gi phreng ba phyogs su 'gyed par 'os pa du ma zhig rgyun chags su stsal/ mang yul byams sprin gyi gtsug lag khang du bzhugs skabs shig dus 'khor lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs rgyun khyer zhig bka' rtsom gnang nas dpal mo chos sding sgrub sder dus 'khor gyi 135

snying po rnam bcu dbang ldan dung phyur gcig lhag 'don rgyu'i rgyu yon dngos po rgya cher gnang ba'ang mi ring bar grub/ rje 'brug pa rin po cher 'phrin las kyi sgo 'byed du phyogs de'i skya ser mtha' dag 'dus pa'i khrom chen por khrom dbang zhig rtsol dgos zhes rje nyid kyi bskul ba po dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi tshul mdzad cing 'bul dngos kyi mtshan grangs rgya che zhing spam mtho ba 'phreng su bstar ba sogs kyi ljags bkod kyang rtsal/ skabs zhig bar gcod kyi 'tshub lhong dang mi shis pa'i ltas su dngos grub phug gi rgyab ri'i brag nas chad pa'i rbab pha wong chen po du ma zhig dang rbab phran mang du lhung bar rje nyid kyis gzigs te sdig mdzub mdzad pas logs gzhan du byol bar ri 'gram du rje 'brug pa'i gsol mdzo mo gcig tsam rmas pa las gzhan skyon ma byung skad/ dad 'dus 'ga' zhig la lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi zab khrid gsung ba'i skabs rdo la zhabs rjes zhig byung ba ni da lta yang kun gyi mjal du rung ba dngos grub phug tu bzhugs so/ /rje 'brug rin po che sku khams mi bde ba'i snyun tshul bzhes par rkyen sel dang brtan bzhugs mdzad cing de skabs rje nyid kyi sku tshe'i lhag ma yang tshe dbang dang mnyam du 'bul ba mdzad ces grags/ der tshogs kyi dad 'dus ches mang bar tshe dbang de'i zhor las thams cad khyab par stsalaske/ zhabs gras sogs 'khor gyi 'dus pa rnams la/ sku zhabs 'brug pa rin po cher thams cad kyi mos gus gyis la gsol ba thob/ nga dang khong gnyis la don gyi khyad par med pa yin/ zhes bka' phebs pa thugs rgyud gcig pa yin par gsung rgyu yin nam zhes bla ma dpal dar gsungs/ de ltar rje nyid nas rgyal dbang 'brug pa rin por brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs mdzad pa las/ de bzhin spyod 'chang nam mkha'i snying po dang / /nā ro ta pa dbyer med sprul pa'i sku/ /o rgyan rdo rje chos kyi lung bstan pa/ /rgyal dbang bka' brgyud 'phrin las shing rta yi/ /zhes dang / rje 'brug pa kun gzigs chos kyi snang bas/ rnal 'byor sdom pa tshe grub spyod 'chang dbang / dpal ldan nā ro ta par zhes gsungs pa ltar don la som nyi ma dgos so/ /'di dus rje mdo chen pa mgon po'i zhabs 'khrungs nas zla ba brgyad tsam song ba zhig yab sngags 'chang 'gyur med rnam rgyal gyi bsnams te rje nyid kyi drung du gtsug phud phul/ mtshan tshe dbang 'chi med mgon po zhes pa dang lhan cig bzhes can stod kyi shing 'bras kyi phyur por gang ba zhig kyang stsal 'dug de nas rje nyid yun ring mi bzhugs pa'i gsung dngos dang brgyud du phebs shing / nyin gcig rje 'brug pa rin po che dang lhan rgyas yun ring gnang skabs/ bka' las/ nged kyi sug par rtag tu 'chang ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung khyad par can grwa pa mngon shes kyi gter byon dang /bdud 'dul rdo rje'i zab gter las byung ba 'di bzhin sngar nas mang du 'phel yong ba zhig yin kyang 'di lo 'phel ma byung / da cha sku zhabs rin po che nas 'khrus gsol dang re zhig 'brel spang rgyun bzhes 136

su gnang nas slar rang byung mchod rten chen po shing kun gyi srog shing la gzung bzhugs su 'jug rtsis yinaske/zhes gsungs nas 'phel gdung gi mjal kha dang rgyun bzhes kyi za ma tog bcas 'bul bar mdzad/de mus su cung zad sku ltems tshul tsam las gzhan ngor mngon pa dang 'phrod rten gyi rigs ni gcig kyang ma bzhes/ 'byung 'gyur bka' chems kyi rigs 'ga' zhig sku'i gam du nye bar gnas pa'i mchod dpon bstan 'dzin rdo rje la 'ga' zhig gsung bar grags shing gzhan cher ma gnang bar nges la gang gi tshe shing mo phag gi lo khrum gyi zla ba'i dmar phyogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus chen nyer lnga'i nyin sku drang por bsrang ste thugs dam ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs bzhin pa nas zhing 'di'i sku dngos kyi 'dul ba'i gdul bya mtha' dag btul zin te re zhig gzugs sku rags pa'i za ma tog sku gdung gis gdul bya 'ga' zhig 'dul ba'i phyir du bzhag nas zab thugs rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes chos dbyings stong chen gzhon nu bum sku'i klong du snyoms par 'jug pa'i tshul bstan no/ /de'i tshe thugs zab zhi 'od gsal spros bral chos kyi skur mngon par byang chub pa'i phyi'i rtags su kun gsal nam mkha'i khyon thams cad kyang in+d+ra ni la bcag pa'i 'phro'am/ baiḍūr+ya sngon po'i kha dog ltar sngo zhing dngas la gsal ba sprin dang rdul dang ser bu sogs kyi rnyogs pa thams cad dang bral ba'i gdugs shin tu 'jam po kho nar gyur/ de ltar bstan 'gro spyi dang bye brag gi phan bde'i nyin mor byed pa de nyid dus kyi nub phyogs chu lha'i phang par gzhol bas sa 'di re zhig mun pa stug pos byugs pa ltar gyur cing nye bar gnas pa'i zhabs ring pa rnams ni 'jigs pa che sar skyel mas bor ba'am mun pa'i smag rum btug po'i khrod du snang byed kyi sgron me bsnal ba ltar nyams thag sdug bsngal gyi khung bur tshud pas ci bya btol med par gyur la/ dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha dang mi rnams mya ngan gyi non zhing / nag phyogs kyi mi dang mi ma yin pa bdud sde'i rigs su gyur pa phal cher ni dga' ba'i 'dzum mul zhing ca co'i sgra dbyangs sgrog par byed do/ /de ltar yang rje nyid kyi gsung las/ bdag ni ring por mi thogs 'chi ba'i tshe/ /dkar phyogs lha dang gzhi bdag mya ngan byed / /nag phyogs 'dre srin rnams kyi gad rgyangs sgrog /rgyal bstan nges par 'dzin rnams yi mug skye/ /dam nyams bdud rigs rnams ni dpa' gdengs bskyed/ /ltos bcas yod par srid tshe mgo 'phangs dma'/ /'gran sems phrag dog can kun dga' bro 'khrab/ /de lta na yang bdag la phan gnod med/ /bdag ni dag pa dag pa'i zhing du 'gro/ /byar med nam mkha'i rnal 'byor nyams re dga'/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas rje btsun 'brug pa rin po cher thams cad mkhyen pa mchog la thugs dam 'dogs 'bul 'gyogs bsngo'i rten gyi maṇ+ḍal spams mtho ba dang / sku gdung rin po cher dngos 'byor mchod tshogs rgya cher spros te thugs dam bskul ba'i gsol 'debs/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga137

mchod 'bul/ smon lam sogs phyi rol du mi mngon pas gsang khog nas sgrub cing / de ma thag zhabs ring ba nang tshogs su dgos ched kyi dbang gis bka' chems bzhin re zhig phyir chad med pa'i gsang rgya'i the'u bsdus shing dam bcas/ mi ring bar sku dgung rin po che za ma tog gi nang du bzhugs su gsol nas spong rong gi dpal mo chos sding du gdan 'dren pa'i bka' bgros ltar rje nyid kyi dngos slob mi phyed dad pa'i gdung shugs can rtsis rig smra ba'i dbang phyug dge slong karma dbang rgyal gyi gdung gnyer zhus te dre'u gcig dang zhon khal rta gnyis bcas gsang khog nas gdan drangs chos sding gi gzim khang dkar po zhes 'jigs bral thams cad mkhyen pa'i gzim chung der bzhugs su gsol bar/ga bur/ si la/ tsan dan dkar dmar/ bzang drug la sogs pa'i sman spos du ma dang / spur tshwas legs par btams pa'i phyi nas sa phag gi mchod rten bcigs par dkon gnyer dang bcas rgyun mi chad pa'i mchod pas mchod par byas so/ /de yang snga sor shing phag lor skyid grong nas/ spong rong rje dbon rdo rje lha skyabs la chab shog rtsal bar/ nged dpal mo chos sding du sleb par srid pa'ang gang spyi'i 'phros zhib pa slar zhus rtsis zhu/ zhes gsungs pa'ang don 'di la dgongs par mngon/ dngos grub phug tu rje nyid sku mtshams kyi bcad rgyal lo shas bzhugs pa'i rdzu bag dang / gzim chung du sku'i rgyal tshab lta bur thugs sras kyi thu bo mkhas grub chen po kun gzigs lo ri sprul pa'i sku mi pham srid zhi yongs grol nyid sku mtshams bcad rgyar bzhugs shing phyi rol nas thugs dam brtag pa zhu mi dang / bla ma khag dang zhal slob kyi dogs gcod dri ba zhu ba rnams kyi lan/ phyogs kyi che gnyan bla dpon rigs dang / rgyal khag du mar chab shog gnang rgyu sogs mdor na rje nyid dngos bzhugs skabs ji lta ba'i mdzad pa rnams skyongs pa'i khur bzhes/ phyi nang gi tsho 'dzin la rgya'i 'gan bzhes/ phal cher mchod dpon rin po che bstan 'dzin rdo rjes mdzad cing / de'i tshe gsang rgya'i rdzu bag mi 'chor ba'i phyir kun mkhyen 'brug pa rin po che yang re zhig mnga' ris rdzong dkar phyogs su chibs kha bsgyur de dga' bo lha sding zhes pa'i ri khrod du bzhugs 'jags gnang nas dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul dang / mchod rten shing kun gyi nyams gzo gtso bor gyur pa'i la rgya'i mdzad sgo mtha' dag gi rgyab gnyer dang ljags bkod rgyun chags su bka' drin bskyangs so/ /'di dus gzhung sa mchog tu mchod dpon rin po che bstan 'dzin rdo rje ngos phebs kyi rje bla ma dam pa de nyid kyi dgongs rdzogs dngos 'bul spams mtho ba bka' blon bla ma rdza sag bla ma nyi ma rgyal mtshan brgyud gru 'dzin pho brang rtser gong sa rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po skal bzang rgya mtsho'i spyan sngar 'bul ba'i tshe ljags bsngo gnang zhing gnas tshul gyi bka' 'dri yang brtse ba chen pos bskyangs/ rang byung mchod rten chen po'i nyams gso'i mdzad pa 'phro can du lus pa zhabs gras 138

rnams dang / rje 'brug pa rin po ches 'gan bzhes kyi mdzad chog pa zhus tshe/ bka' las/ mchod rten 'di nyid bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i rtsa lag yin shis nyams gsos kyi 'phros rnams mthus tshangs legs par byed dgos zhes dngos kyi bka' dang / mthun rkyen gang dgos gzhung sa mchog nas gnang rgyu'i bka' bzhes rtsal/ gsang rgya'i rdzu bag mi 'chor ba'i khog nas dbus gtsang mnga' ris stod smad/ mang yul skyid grong nas gung thang khul gyi gnas rten mtha' dag la mchod 'bul dang / bla khag rnams su bsngo rtenaske/ dge 'dun gyi 'dus pa che chung kun la mang bskol sogs gnang / mi 'gyang bar mchod rten chen po'i nyams gso'i 'phros rnams sgrub pa la zhugs/ de yang gtso bor rje btsun 'brug pa rin po che nas bla ma'i dam tshig la dgongs shing bstan 'gro'i don du thugs bskyed smad du byung bas gzhal du med pa'i thugs rje'i rgyab gnyer dang / ljags khyabs/ gegs sel gyi skyabs 'jug sogs bka' drin chen pos bskyangs shing / mchod dpon chen po bstan 'dzin rdo rje la sogs zhabs ring thu bo rnams nas rje bla ma de nyid kyi bzhed dgongs 'phro can du gyur pa yang dag par bskang ba'i slad du snying stobs kyi ri bo'i khur chen po phrag pa la thogs nas brtson 'grus drag pos dka' ba brgya phrag bzod par byas te snga sor rje de nyid kyi dgongs bzhed dang zhal skos ji ltar snang ba bzhin sgrub par lcags lug nas zhig gso thog mar dbu brtsam pa nas bzung lo lnga dang / rje bla ma dam pa rig pa 'dzin dbang de nyid chos kyi dbyings su bzhes nas lo gnyis song ba'i mthar 'bru mang zhes pa sa pho stag gi lo zhal gsar du shar ba'i tshe gegs med par zhabs su tshud cing / lo snga ma me glang lo 'jug tsam du rje dpa' bo rin po rdo rje gtsug lag dga' ba yang dbus 'gyur gyi ljongs nas phyogs 'dir zhabs kyi pad mo bkod cing ne pā la yi yul gyi gnas rten mtha' dag mjal gzigs grub nas skabs 'dir mchod rten chen po'i rab gnas mnga' gsol kyi cho ga gnad smin du bka' drin bskyangs/ rje 'brug pa rin po che sku khams mi bde ba'i tshul bzhes pas dngos grub phug rang du bzhugs shing / 'di dang dus tshes chab gcig tu rab gnas kyi cho ga dang 'brel ba'i dgongs pa gtad pa'i me tog 'thor bar mdzad pa na bal yul mchod rten shing kun tu nyi ma phyed tsam zhig la bsil sgra chen po dang bcas pa'i me tog gi char bab pa der 'khod kun gyi mthun snang du grub pa byung zhing / thams cad kyi ltas pa'i tshe bod kyi nas 'bru snyon med par snang bas/ der tshogs pa thams cad yid ches dad pa'i sa la bkod/ rje lo ri ba kun gzigs chos kyi rgya mtshos dbu mdzad grwa tshangs rnams nas ye dhar sogs rab gnas kyi gzungs sgrub smon lam shis brjod kyi zhal 'don grangs bsog mdzad/ rab gnas nyin gsum ma sbyor dngos rjes gtsang du grub rjes gor+ṣa rgyal po ma hā rā dza la dngos po'i gnang sbyin gya noms pa rtsal ba dang lhan cig mchod rten chen po'i 139

gnyer gtad mdzad pa rgyal po nas kyang dngas shing gus pa'i blos khas blangs dam bca' phul de ltar lha dang bcas pa'i yid can kun gyi phan bde'i mchod sdong chen po dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyi yongs su bsngags pa 'dzam gling spyi dang bod ljongs bye brag nem pā la ljongs kyi bde skyid kyi srog rtsa lta bu 'di nyid skye dgu mthong thos dran reg kun gyi bsod nams kyi dpal dang mgon du nyams gsos bskur bste'i sri zhu legs par grub te zhal gro byin che/ 'gro ba skyobs pa'i mthu dpal gzi brjid dang ldan par gyur to/ /de lta bu'i mchod rten chen po 'di nyid kyi zhig gso'i rgyur song ba'i dngos po rnams rags rtsis su cha tsam dkar chag tu 'khod pa ltar smos na/ sngar gyi zangs dang gser rnying pa rnams kyang sbyin bdag bsod nams 'phel ba'i slad du slar 'dab skyor du byas shing sku rgyu'i zangs gsar rnying sdom par bal yul rang gi lugs srol dhar ṇi stong phrag gcig dang sum brgya brgyad bcu gya gnyis la gzhu chad sogs bton te bzos grub nas dhar ṇi stong phrag gcig dang nyis brgya lnga bcu nga brgyad song shing / bre yi phyogs bzhi ha lam parta bzhi/ zur bzhir rgyal mtshan bzhi/ chos 'khor bcu gsum gdugs tog dang bcas par gser to la stong phrag gnyis dang bzhi bcu zhe lnga mā sa drug bcas par bzhu chad sogs bton pa'i gser gtso ma to la stong phrag gcig dang / dgu brgya sum cu so gcig mā sa drug byung ba'i khar gser rnying gtso ma to la gya dgu dang / mā sa bcu bcas bsnan pa'i khyon bsdoms gser gtso ma to la stong phrag gnyis dang nyi shu rtsa gcig mā sa bzhi bcas song zhing / de phyin zhig gso 'di dbu brtsam pa nasaglu/ rab gnas legs 'bul gyi mthar thug pa grub pa'i bar du/ shrī shrī ma hā rā dza la zhu rten/ las byed 'go mi rnams dang gzo rigs pa so sor gnang cha/ gegs sel sku rim dang mchod 'bul gyi rgyu dngos/las byed kyi kha tsa zhes phogs gtong dgos/ de mtshungs srog shing 'dren pa'i slad du gor+ṣa rgyal blon las byed mi dmangs bcas par zhu rten gnang skyes/ kha tsa/ legs 'bul sogs mdor na mchod rten chen po nyams gso'i ched kho nar song ba'i dngos po la gong gsal sku rgyu'i gser dang bcas par khyon bsdoms gser to la stong phrag gsum dang / sum brgya bzhi bcu zhe bzhi mā sa bcu thams pa/ dngul pa ṇi ngo thog stong phrag bzhi dang bdun brgya don bcu don lnga/ rgya dngul dhar ṇi phyed gnyis/ rang byung zangs dhar ṇi gnyis—/ bal ṭam 'gro phor ngo thog khri phrag gcig dang / stong phrag bzhi/ brgya dang drug byung ba de yi khar/kha dgas/ gos chen/ dar ras rnam 'phrug ja mar/ tshwa 'bru cha/ skrum sogs yul dus rin thang bal ṭaṃ du phab pa bcas bsdom par khri phrag bzhi/ stong phrag gsum dang / drug brgya/ sum cu so dgu rags rtsis dang /der rtsis su ma thebs pa'i rta khra spus legs shas che ba'i rta drug bcu re bdun/ gos chen yug nyer gcig kasmi ra yi gur gum gyi ge sar snga phyi dngul stong gi rin yod nges bcas rags rtsis su song ba de 140

dag kun kyang / rje bla ma rig pa 'dzin dbang chen po de nyid sku tshe'i ring chog shes nor bu'i gter gyis/nges 'byung zhen log gi bang mdzod yongs su kheng pas gsol chas phran bu tsam las nor rdzas dngos po'i 'bul nor ye nas mi bzhes par bya btang kun tu spong ba chen po'i brtul zhugs lhur bzhes pa'i tshul rje nyid kyi gsung dngos rnam thar snyim pa'i chu skyes las/ dad pa'i dkor rdzas zang zing rnams/ /rang gi zas zhim gos 'jam dang / /gzhan bslu log 'tshor ma song bar/ /mchod dang sbyin la gang 'gro byas/ /sngar phan chung ngu'i dus nyid nas/ /nor la sred pa che ba med/ /chos kyi grol ba ma lags te/ /rang bzhin mi yi gshis khams gyur/ /'phral du cung zad bsags pa yang / /bstan dang bla ma'i zhabs tog ched/ /bsam las phugs nor bgyid snyam pa'i/ /rtog pa ye nas shar ma myong / /zhes dang / gzhan yang chab shog sogs gsung 'phros du ma zhig las 'byung zhing / sngar rnam thar dngos bstan gyi skabs su rim par smos pa las shes mod/ de ltar yang mchod rten gyi nyams gsos bzhed par 'khrungs shing phyag las kyi dbu brtsams pa nas gzung lha chen po rnams kyis sngon du khas blangs pa ltar/ mthar nyams gsos yongs su grub pa'i bar du stod smad sa phyogs yul rigs so so nas/ dad pa'i nor gyis 'byor pas phyug pa'i sbyin bdag mchog dang / bar ma dang / dman pa'i tshogs kyis ji ltar phul ba'i rdzas dngos po yo byad che phra mtha' dag bar ma dor chud ma zos par/ ji skad du/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las/ ji ltar rgya mtsho che nang chu thig lhung / /rgya mtsho ma skam bar du de mi skam/ /de bzhin byang chub yongs bsngo dge ba yang ske/ /byang chub ma thob bar du de mi mdzad/ /zhes pa'i phan yon gsungs pa ltar du dgongs shing / rjes 'jug gi nyams gso'i 'phros skyongs bar mdzad pa rnams kyis kyang rje bla ma dam pa de nyid kyi dgongs rdzogs bsag sbyangs rnam dkar mchod sbyin las kyi 'khor lo mtha' dag gi nang nas gtso bor gyur pa mchod rten 'di nyid nyams gso mthar phyin pa zhig grub pa las lhag pa med pa bzhin gzhan dang gzhan dag gis kha bsag dang / tshul 'chos dang / gzhogs slong dang / snyed pas snyed 'tshol/ thob kyi mjal ba/dbang shed kyi dpya bsdu ba/ rten bzhengs la snyad pa'i dge bskul 'bul bsdud du grags pa sogs log par 'tsho ba'i kha na ma mtho ba'i sdig pa dang cung zad kyang ma 'dres pa'i 'di ltar dam pa'i chos dang mthun nges pa'i legs byas rnam par dag pa lha dang bcas pas bsngags par 'os pa kho na yin no/ /de nas bla ma dam pa de nyid kyi sku gdung rin po che yang dka' chems kyi don bzhin mang yul ri rgyal dpal 'bar gyi rtser zhugs pa 'bul bar bzhed pas dpal mo chos sding nas spyan 'dren par tsam pa'i tshe/mnga' ris la dwags rgyal po/ glo bo stod smad kyi rgyal po/ mdo khams nas slob rigs/ sde dge'i sku tshab bang mi sogs kyi so so tha dad nas rang rang gi yul phyogs su gdan 'dren rgyu'i tshul gleng bar/ spong 141

rong mi'i rje bo chos bzhin du sa skyongs ba'i dbang phyug rdo rje lha skyabs nas/ da cha rang gi bsod nams kyi dpal du stsol ba med par yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'am/ gser gyi pha wong sgo rtsar 'gril ba bzhin sku gdung rin po che rang nyid kyi mgon du byin pa 'di rang dbang du spyod pa rang dbang che gshis sku gdung ma nyams par bzhugs su gsol ba'am/ zhugs su sbyongs yang rung ste 'di kho na las gzhan du spyan 'dren pa'i gnas skabs mi shar ro/ /zhes gsung pa la so so nas kham chams par rtsod gleng gi gzhi chen por gyur pa na spo rong pas gal te/ la dwags dang / glo bo pa/ mdo khams pa bcas so sos bshed 'khyer gyis gdan 'dren pa'i gnas skabs shar tshe dpung tshogs bshams te brgol bar brtsam pa sngon la phyi chu dbar du rje btsun chen po mi la ras pa'i sku gdung la brin gnya' nang pa 'khrug rtsod byas pa ltar 'dir yang de bzhin 'byung nye ba na/ rje btsun 'brug pa rin po che dang / dpa' bo rin po che lhan rgyas nas khyed cag rnams so so nas bla mar mos zhen gyi gdung bas gsol ba 'debs pa las/ sku gdung rang rang gi yul du gdan 'dren pa'i bsam sbyor gyi gnas ma yin te bla ma'i bka' las 'gal 'gyur zhing | spong rong rje dbon kyang chos phyogs nas dngos slob dang / sbyin bdag thun mong mi phyed dad dang dam tshig brtan zhing sku gdung rin po che'i bzhugs yul bcas dngos gnas de ltar thugs bden par mchis rung / rgos bla ma'i bka' dang dgongs pa kho na sgrub pa gtso che la/ bka' las 'das na dam tshig las 'gal bar nges pas des na da lam ri bo dpal 'bar rang du gdan 'dren rgyu dang / slar byin rten so sor rang rang thugs mi pham pa 'bul zhes bar mtshams gnang bar rje dbon nyid kyang lugs gnyis kyi rnam dpyod yangs zhing thugs brgyud jo bo bzang la dad pa dang dam tshig brtan pas rje dpa' 'brug rnam gnyis kyi bka' bzhin sgrub par zhal gyis bzhes te sku gdung rin po che sngar gyi sa khang nang nas 'gyogs byang la spyan drangs/ phebs lam rnams su yang mos gus gdung shugs drag pos mchod cing gsol ba 'debs pa dang gdung mjal dang byin brlab zhu ba bsam gyi mi khyab pa byung zhing rim pas ri rgyal dpal 'bar gyi rtser phebs bkra shis dpal 'bar gyi gtsug lag khang du bzhugs su gsol bar mchod pa'i sprin rgya chen pos mchod do/ /'di skabs bdag gi rje bla ma 'phrin las mtshan can kyang gdung mjal la byon/ gsol 'debs smon lam gdung shugs drag pos mdzad de rdza khrod du pha wang zhig gi skyibs su gzim gzhugs pa'i brnal lam du rig 'dzin rje nyid mngon sum lta bur gnas der phebs/dgyes pa'i nyams gyis dbang bzhi rdzogs par gnang zhing dbang tshig rnams legs sbyar kyi skad du gsung pa'i mthar dngul dkar gyi bum pa ja bzang gis bkang ba zhig rtsal ba'i mod rnal sad tshe brnal lam gyis don gdung dbyangs mgur du bzhes/ de nas dpa' 'brug rnam gnyis kyang chibs kha bsgyur te 142

klu mo sgang du bzhugs sgar phab gtsug lag khang gi stod gyen du cung zad 'phags par rdza khrod 'ba' zhig yin rung de dag gi nang nas sa nyams cung zad bde ba zhig tu sku gdung zhugs 'bul gyi gra sgrigs gnang / rje de nyid kyi dus dran dmar phyogs kyi tshes bcu mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus chen nyer lngar sku gdung rin po che spyan drangs gdung khang gi nang du bzhugs su gsol/ a ka ru dang du ru ka tsan dan dkar dmar 'ba' zhig gi bud shing dang mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyi mi khyab pa dang bcas rje dpa' 'brug lhan rgyas gtso bor bzhugs pa'i thugs sras bla ma khag sogs bgrangs las 'das pas bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i sgrub mchod dang rjes su 'brel ba'i zhi ba'i bsreg blugs kyi cho ga rgyas par 'bul bar mdzad/ de'i tshe phyi nang gi ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bsam gyi mi khyab pa blo'i yul las 'das pa ji snyed cig byung bar gor ma chag 'on kyang bod rong phyogs dang phyogs mtshams mtha' dag nas 'dus pa'i ser skya mchog dman bar ma'i tshogs bgrangs las 'das pa'i sdod yul gyis sa mi snyed pa lta bus phyogs de dag yongs su khengs zhing / des rkyen gyis gnas bdag zhing skyongs ma mo rgya gar ma khros pa'i 'phrul yin skad sa'i char kyi rgyun nyin mtshan med par 'bab par grags so/ /de'i tshe gdung khang zhal phye bas sku gdung rnams ring bsrel gyi phung por gyur cing / lha sku yig 'bru la sogs pa ngo mtshar dpag par dka' ba du ma zhig byung yod par smos ma dgos kyang rje dpa' 'brug yab sras/ lo ri sprul pa'i sku/ mchod dpon rin po che sogs dpon slob rnams kyi gzigs ngor spyod yul du gyur pa las gzhan su zhig gi mthong rig rtogs par ma gyur la sna thos kyi ngag khyun tsam yang mi snang ste sngar gyi gsang rgya'i khog tu bsdus pa'am gzhan du chos kyi dbyings su thim pa 'dra'o/ /de nas sku gdung zhugs su phul ba'i sa de gar gdung 'bum mchod rten chen po gzheng bar bzhed pas thog mar sa yi cho ga sngon du 'gro bas/ sa bdag lto phye'i thig 'debs pa dang / dngos gzhi mchod rten gyi thig rtsa rnams kun mkhyen zha lu bu ston rin chen grub kyi bzhed pa ltar thams cad mkhyen pa pad+ma dkar pos gtan la phabs pa'i dgongs don byang chen mchod rten gyi thig rtsa ji bzhin kun gzigs lo ra sprul pa'i sku chos kyi rgya mtshos mdzad cing / bal yul nas gzo bo mched du 'bod par mdzad de gdung khang gi sa ras rnams dang bcas rtsigs pa'i skabs/ rje 'brug pa rin po che sku gzugs mi bde zhing zhabs ril gyi rnam pa yod rung phyag gcig gi gzim dpon la bsten phyag ya gcig gi rdo leb bkra shis kha dgas kyi dril ba rnams te klu mo sgang nas gdung 'bum gzheng sa bar gyen 'dzegs che bar yod kyang / nyin re bzhin tshar re 'byon par mdzad/ rje dpa' bo rin po ches sku rgyab tu rdo khur te bsnams nas skyel bar mdzad pa yab sras rnam gnyis kyi skyel bar mdzad pa'i rdo rnams kha che gur gum gyis byugs te bum ldir yongs rdzogs rtsigs 143

pa yin skad/ gzhan yang chos sras bla ma mang pos rang rang gi thugs dam bcas pa'i rdo khur 'dren par mdzad cing / chos 'khor bcu gsum ni rdo leb re re las rang grub tu byas pa dang bum nang gi gu ru rdo rje drag po rtsal yab yum gyi sku yang rdo las grub par mngon/ gser gdugs char khebs nyi zla nor bu'i tog gser zangs las grub pa bcas mi ring bar 'byongs/ de yang bka' chems las/ sku gdung zhugs 'bul ri bo dpal 'bar gyi rtser bya dgos pa dang / zhal gyi sgyur phyogs kyang nub phyogs su bston cing gdung 'bum mchod rten gyi zhal phyogs kyang de dang mthun pa dgos par gsung pa ni dgongs gzhi khyad par can du nges so/ /'di skabs gtsug gtor dri med dang / 'od zer dri med te dri med rnam gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor la bsten pa'i/ dri med mchod rten gyi phyag len kyang gzhung bzhin gnang yod par gor ma chag gzhan du dbus gtsang gi phyogs su yang ding sang 'di'i dbang rgyun dang phyag len ni dkon par yod nges par 'dug go /de ltar bdud 'dul byang chub chen po'i mchod rten bkod pas mdzes pa ring bsrel rnam bzhi'i snying po can phal thog gsum gyi tshad du bzhugs pa'i phyir ka ring bzhis steg pa'i char khebs g.yam 'bub can dang / mar me'i mchod pa khang zhig bcas grub par/ rje dpa' 'brug yab sras slob mar bcas pa'i tshogs kyi rab tu gnas pas mnga' gsol bar mdzad cing 'gro kun mthong thos dran reg gi phan bde'i mchod sdong chen por bzhugs so/ /de lta bu'i gdung 'bum mchod rten chen por phyis chu stag lor rje rig 'dzin 'khor lo'i bsgyur ba de nyid kyi thugs sras slob ma'i gtso bo rgyal ba'i dbang po karma pa/zhwa dmar ba/ 'brug pa/ si tu/ dpa' bo te yab sras lngas bzhugs khang gtsug lag khang bzheng rgyu dang / mchod me'i rkyen bcas su so so nas dngul rdo tshad nas brgya phrag gi bar stsal ba rje de nyid kyi zhabs gras dge slong tshe dbang mchog sbyin gyi do khur 'gan bzhes gnang ste gtsug lag khang ka chen bzhi/ thog rim gsum pa dbu rtser zangs leb la ka thi las byugs pa'i rgya phigs can la kho bos rje bla ma phrin las zhabs nas gser zang gi gardzi ra mda' tshad lhag pa zhig 'bul bar mdzad/ bar khang gi ldeb ris rnams rje mchod dpon rin po che bstan 'dzin rdo rje'i phyag ris dang / 'og thog gi ldeb ris/rig 'dzin rje nyid kyi snang brnyan rdo sku mi tshad ma/ mchod rdzos bcas bkod mdzes su grub par rje bla ma mgon nang pa chen po 'phrin las zhabs nas rab tu gsan pa lan gnyis kyi bar du gnang rjes su la dwags rgyal sras kyi phul bar grags pa'i chos 'khor bcu gsum dang bre yan grangs gser gyi na bza' zhig phul 'dug slar rab byung bcu bzhi pa me byi lor kho bo cag gi 'bad pa chen pos nyams gso dang /mchod rten gyi gdan khri sa 'dzin dge bcu them skas yan yongs su rdzogs par na bza' grang gser gyi byibs byu su bgyis shing / dbu rtse'i khang bzang 'og gi bar thog la zangs kyi rgya phigs kha thi las kyi 144

byugs pa chu khebs 'khor yug tu gzungs sngags dus lan tsha nar 'bur brkos su bgyis pa bkod legs dang / ma ṇi yig drug chos kyi 'khor lo bzhugs khang dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang mchod rdzas dang /mchod me rgyun 'dzugs kyi rkyen sbyar ba po srid zhu cung zad bgyis pa kun gyi spyan lam du gsal ba ltar la/gong gi 'phros nas dkyus su 'jug pa/ der mchod rten la mchod pa'i thebs su thog mar bal ṭam brgya phrag gcig dang / ri bo dpal 'bar gyi gnas 'dzin pa rgang dar bla ma yin pa dang / gnas dang mchod rten gyi srid zhu la gzhan 'gran med pa'i skabs su bab par dgongs pas yin nam/ skabs 'dir gnang sbyin gsol ras dang bcas gdung 'bum rin po che nyid kyi gnyer dam bka' khyab dang / gnas bdag zhing skyongs dpal 'bar mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug rgya gar mar gtang rag gnyer gtad kyi cho ga bcas rgyas par mdzad de rje dpa' 'brug rnam gnyis dpal khud dpal mo chos sding su chibs kha bsgyur/ skabs der rje dpon sa skyongs ba gang gi gsol ba btab pa bzhin re zhig bzhugs 'jags snang zhing rje dbon mchog gi mi phyed pa'i gus pa brtan pos rje bla ma dam pa de nyid kyi gdung rten byang chen mchod rten gser zangs las grub pa thog tshad gcig bzheng bar mdzad pa'i thig rtsa sogs sngar ltar rje lo ri bas mdzad cing bum nang du rje nyid kyi snang brnyan dang bre'i nang du rten sgam nang nas byon pa'i bde mchog lhan skyes kyi sku byin can/ chos 'khor gyi bang rim la 'gro ba'i mgon po gtsang pa rgya ras pa'i sku tshigs nyi shu rtsa gcig la spyan ras gzigs nyi shu rtsa gcig 'khrungs pa'i gras nas 'phags pa bcu gcig zhal gyi sku rang byon mtshar ba/ nang bzhugs rje de nyid kyi sku gdung ring bsrel dang / phyag mkhar byin chen gyi dum bu sogs ring bsrel rnam bzhis byur bur gtam zhing rin po che'i phra tshom gyi phyug pa bkod mdzes can dang / gu ru rin po che gtso 'khor gsum/ rje de nyid kyi gzim mal sku brnyan mi tshad sogs dang /logs ris su rje nyid kyi 'khrungs rab/ dag snang bsam lhun man ngag bcu gsum ma'i lha tshogs dang 'dod lha sogs yod pa/ rje nyid kyi bka' 'bum glegs bam pod lnga bcas rten gsum dang / gser gdung lha khang gsar du bskrun/ gzim khang dkar por rje bla ma'i sku gdung lo mang bzhugs pa'i spud tshwa la sku rjes ma nyams par dod pa gcos med du bzhugs par sman 'dams las rnam rgyal mchod rten thog tshad bcas grub par rje dpa' 'brug lhan rgyas nas rab tu gnas pa'i mnga' gsol me tog 'thor bar mdzad cing rten rnams la sbyin bdag nyid kyi so sor mchod pa'i rgyun chad med kyang 'dzugs par mdzad doske/ /bdag gi bla ma dam pa rje 'phrin las zhabs kyang skyabs rje dam pa lhan rgyas su bka' chos kyi 'phro gsan bzhes kyis byon par rje lhan rgyas nas da lam dam tshig gtsang zhing byin rlabs kyi khyad bcas gzim mal sku bsnyan zhig phyag bzo ba nang dgos zhes phebs pa ltar bka' bzhin sgrub par mdzad pas 145

dges pa bskyed/ gzungs gzhugs dang rab gnas lan mang pos byin phab pa'i sku bsnyan mthong ba don ldan de bzhin deng sang dngos grub phug dgon du bzhugs pa 'di nyid lags so/ /'di dus skyid grong gra dpon pa gong zhes snga sor rig 'dzin kham lung pa pad+ma dbang rgyal zhabs dang / de rjes rig 'dzin rje nyid kyi thugs dang snga phyir 'gal ba'i dam nyams zhig la rje lhan rgyas nas kyang bla ma'i dam tshig kho nar dgongs grwa tshang khag bzhi dang bcas pas mdo bzhes kyis mtshams gcod par mdzad pa deng sang yang grags pa 'di'o/ /rje dam pa lhan rgyas nas kun gzigs lo ri ba chos kyi rgya mtshor rig 'dzin rje nas brgyud pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i gdam pa 'ga' zhig kyang gsan/ de rjes skyid grong phyogs su bzhugs par dgongs pa zhu ba gnang ste yang zhing gi mgon nang ri khrod du bzhugs so/ /de nas rje dam pa rnam gnyis kyang dbus gtsang gi phyogs su chibs kha bsgyur zhing rang rang gi gdan sar phyag phebs so mi ring bar kun mkhyen 'brug pa rin po che gtsang dga' ldan phun tshogs gling gi 'bras spungs bla grang yang rtser bzhugs pa'i dpal reg pa med pa'i mchod rten la che chung thig tshad bkod pa ji ltar ba ched du blangs pa'i gdung rten gser sogs rin po che du ma las grub pa la dwags kyis gzo bo gnyis kyis lo gcig tu 'bad pas sgrub pa rig 'dzin rje nyid kyi sku gdung sogs ring bsrel rnam bzhi'i snying po can la rab tu gnas pas byin phabs te dpal rtsa ri ṭa ye shes kyi 'khor lo'i gcig car dpal gyi nags ljongs kyi phag mo lha khang du mchod rdzas dang bcas te bzhugs so/ /rje dpa' bo'i zhabs nas kyang rig 'dzin rje'i gdung rten dngul gdung zhig bzhengs par mdzad ces thos kyang gang du bzhugs cha ma 'tshal lo/ /gzhan yang stod smad bar du zhal slob dang / sbyin bdag dad pa can dag gi rang rang gi 'byor pa dang dad mos snying stobs kyis cha las gdung rten sku gzugs dang mchod rten sogs dang /mchod pa'i sprin phung ji snyed zhig spro bar mdzad pa gor ma chags te 'dir cha ma 'tshal bas brjod par ma nus so/ /de yang / rje bla ma rig pa 'dzin dbang de nyid kyi sku tshe der rang nyid mnyam rjes 'khor yug gi ting nge 'dzin 'od gsal ye shes kyi thugs las nam yang mi g.yo bzhin du bshad sgrub las gsum gyi 'phrin las dbus gtsang khams kong lho mon byang 'brog mnga' ris stod smad sogs phyogs bral yangs pa'i rgyal khams thams cad du rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang khyad par gsang chen snying po'i ring lugs phyogs brgyar spel bar mdzad cing gzhan phan 'gro ba'i don rlabs po che ji ltar bskyangs pa'i tshul/ thun mong du rnyed par bgyi ba'i tshul cha shas tsam zhig ni gong du brjod zin pa de ltar la/ thun mong ma yin pa chos gsang ba'i rnam par thar pa dpag tu med pa zhig ni rje nyid rang dang spang rtogs yon tan mtshungs pa'i rgyal sras dam pa rnams nang phan tshun kho na'i mngon sum gyi spyod yul 'ba' zhig las 146

bdag lta bu so skyes shin tu rmongs pa las kyang ches rmongs pa'i byis pa'i blo can gyis cha tsam brjod par ga la spobs/ 'on kyang zur tsam zhig ni rje dam pa nyid kyi rdo rje'i gsung gi gsang ba ngo ma las byung ba'i le'u tshan 'ga' zhig las/ rnam par thar pa'i skabs snga phyi ci rigs su smos pa ltar ro/ /spyi sku tshe 'di la mchog gi gter lnga la dbang bar gu ru chen pos lung gis bstan cing / de yang bod yul gyi de wi ko ṭa zhes lho brag mkhar chu gnam skas can gyis thugs gter ni gu ru chos dbang dang / gsang gter ni rat+na gling pas spyan drangs zin par grags la/ zab gter ni rje nyid la dbang bar gsungs te/ 'khrul bral gyi gter ston lnga dang mjal na rten 'brel 'grigs par gsung pa/ gter ston pad+ma bde chen gling pa ma gtogasaske/ gter bdag gling pa/ stag bsham rdo rje/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ chos rje gling pa bde ba'i rdo rje rnams dus snga phyi cung zad dang gnas kyi skal bas ma mjal bar nges shing / spa gro stag tshang nas kyang zab gter bzhes rgyu'i kha byang byung kyang de thams cad dus las yol ba'i phyag tu ma lon par snang ngo /gsang rnams bag chags yid kyi rang gzugs las/ kha bo che 'dir gu ru pad+ma'i zab gter la longs spyod pa'i bskal ba mchog dang ldan pa zhig yin la rten 'brel ma 'chugs na bstan 'gror phan pa rgya chen 'grub par yod kyang sngon las 'phrul rkyen dbang gi sngon chad rngo ma thogs pa der gda'/ slad mar zab gter rten 'brel gyi sgo legs par 'grigs shing bstan 'gror sman pa chen pos gu ru'i dgyes pa 'grub par snying nas smon pa lags/ gter ston rig 'dzin chen po rdo rje 'chang pad+ma bde chen gling pa'i zhal nas bka' 'dus snying po yid bzhin nor bu 'di khyod kyi gter skal yin yang nged la bka' bab nged kyi gter zhabs khyed la dbang ba yin zhes gsung ba yang de ltar la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma 'di dang skye ba mang por las smon dag pas/ bla slob re mos su gyur cing phyi ma'i tshe rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pa na yang tshom bu gcig tu byang chub pa yin/ de bzhin rgyal ba'i sras po karma dam pa yang tshe rabs du mar bla mar 'brel pas byin gyis brlab pa'i rgyu mtshan thun mong ma yin pa mang du yod kyang 'dir ma smos/ zhes gsungs—/ de ltar sku tshe 'dir rten 'brel ma 'grig na sku'i yang srid phyi mar lho brag gi zab gter de nyid bzhes thub pa'i dgongs bzhed kyis 'khrung rab gsol 'debs yid bzhin dbang gi 'phreng ba las/da lta rnal 'byor sbas tshul kun tu rgyu/ /phyi ma lho phyogs de wi ko ṭa nas/ /zab mo'i gter ston bod khams bde bar spyod/ /zhes gsung pa ltar dag zhing du gshegs nas lo skor gcig tsam nas lho brag gnam skas can dang thag ha cang mi ring bar sku'i rnam par rol ba zhig bzung bar nges shing de skabs rje dpa' bo rin po che kong po 'ja' mtshon du bzhugs skabs lung bstan kyang gsal bar byung ba ni sa phag zla 4tshes 28srod la phyag ris su mdzad pa ngo ma las 'di lta/147

dran mchog mgon po'i sgyu 'phrul/ /tshe ring bkra shis don 'grub/ /blo ldan shes rab dbang po/ /rta gdong dkar mo gnas pa'i/ /yul smad lte ba tsam la/ /sngags 'chang shes rab ming can/ /sras po chig brgyud bdag po/ /sgo ni byang du bstan pa/ /g.yas la mthong chung yod cing / /mdun du rdzing bu 'khyil ba/ /gzung ma tshe ring ming can/ /bde ba'i dpal gyi mtsho mo/ /da ltar rig 'dzin rnams kyis/ /tshogs 'khor grangs med gtong 'dug /dngos grub che ba'i rkyen gyis/ /ma ni lha yul gshegs 'dra/ /a pha sngags 'chang bstan 'dzin/ /rig 'dzin sa la 'khod 'dug /mi yi mthong tshul kun la/ /bza' ba tshogs 'khor dkon 'dug /rig pa skye med dbyings su/ /byis pas lta gdangs gnang 'dug /sa dkar bkra shis gong la/ /bkra shis rten 'brel 'grig 'dug /dmar po wa la cog dga'/ /bkra shis tshe 'phel don grub/ zhes pa gnang 'dug kyang re zhig gsang rgya gnang bzhed pa'i mur lcags glang zla 1tshes 15la gzhan don du dgongs rjes/ bka' chems kyi phyag ris le tshan 'ga' zhig gi mur byung skad do/ /de'i tshul mchod dpon bstan 'dzin rdo rjes gsan nas sku na shin tu smin cing sku gzugs mi bde yang dka' tshegs 'o rgyal chen pos chu yos lor mang yul dngos grub phug nas lho brag gi mthil sbrul mtsho pad+ma gling bar byon kyang yang srid dngos 'jal ba zhig ma byung bar phyir log byon/ gang ltar sku na phra mo zhig nas tshe'i bar gcod du gyur pa'i mi ring bar zhing khams gzhan du 'phos par mngon/ de ltar yang / gsang rnams chen mor gong du smos pa'i 'phros las/ kho bo cag skye ba 'di yi 'og tu yul sna tshogs par las dang smon lam dbang gi/ dge bshes mkhas pa'i nus pa can dang / sgrub pa po nyams rtogs kyi brgyan pa gnyis ka yang sdom gsum gyi bcas pa rnam par dag pa 'chang ba ste/ lhag tu 'dul ba la mkhas shing bslab sdom la gnas pa/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig la shin tu gus pas brtson cing gtsang mar spyod pa yi bstan pa'i mig srol la phan par byed pa/ de lta'i skye ba 'ga' zhig dang / gzhan yang sa la dbang ba'i rgyal po dang /de yi kha lo pa dang / dmangs khyim pa chos ldan gyi skye bar yang re bzung blang zhing / re 'ga' tsam na rang gi sgrib pa'i lhag ma sbyang ba dang der gnas pa'i 'gro ba yang smin pa'i ched du dmyal ba dang byol song du yang skye bar byed do/ /yang skye ba ha cang gi mi mang ba'i skabs shed du theg chen gyi lam la spyod pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gon/ rdo rje'i glu len/ mkha' 'gro'i 'dul ba mchog thob cing / skabs phal mo cher mngon gyur gyi rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung ston pa/ yul nyer bzhir spyod pa rgyu ba zhig tu skyes nas 'gro ba'i don rlabs po che la spyod par byed do/ /gang ltar skye ba mang por mi 'gor bar dpal chen po he ru ka gu ru nam mkha'i snying po'i thugs gang du nyi ma la zer 'du ba bzhin ro gcig tu thim par the mi tshom pa'i nges pa can no//mthar ni sangs rgyas kyi zhing nam mkha' rnam par bkod pa na sangs rgyas nam mkha' rnam par rol pa 148

zhes bya ba'i rgyal bar gyur nas 'brel bcas kyi'agro ba rnams der byang chub kyis brnyed par byed do/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di kho na rdo rjes gsung gi zhal gyi bzhes shing som nyi med par grub pas gzhan du brjod bya mang po dgos pas dben par go /mgon po de nyid kyis zhal gyi bum bzang las legs par 'ongs pa'i zab rgyas gsung gi gsang ba zab mo'i bdud rtsi myang ba la bsten nas bstan dang 'gro la phan bde'i dpal yon ster ba'i rtsa lag chen por gyur pa'i zhal slobs kyi rim pa'ang bgrangs ba las 'das zhing / gtso bor gyur pa ni/ sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i sgron me rgyal ba yab sras lnga ste/ ma byon sangs rgyas drug pa seṅge'i ngo bo 'jig rten dbang phyug mi bskyod rgyal ba'i cod paṇa can karma pa chen po bcu gsum bdud 'dul rdo rje sems dpa' mchog dang / gar gyi dbang phyug 'od mtshan rā ga'i cod paṇa 'chang ba bcu pa'i phreng ba 'dzin pa dkon mchog nyi ma/ 'phags yul grub pa'i gtsug rgyan nā ro ta pa bsam bzhin sgyu 'phrul mtshar pos thams cad mkhyen pa'i mtshan kyi rol mo sangs mthor sgrogs pa rje btsun 'brug pa rin po che bka' brgyud 'phrin las shing rta/ rtsod dus kyi yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag gnas lnga rig pa'i ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta chen po kun mkhyen si tu bstan pa'i nyin byed/ slob dpon chen po pad+mā ka ra'i yon tan gyi 'od zer las sprul pa gter ston rin chen gling pa'i skye rabs kyi phreng ba bdun pa dpa' bo gtsug lag dga' ba ste yab sras lnga/ gzhan du bstan pa ris su ma chad pa'i skyes chen dam pa du ma zhig dang 'gro ba'i 'dren pa chen por gyur pa'i skyes rabs kyi 'phreng ba mtshar du mngar ba'i sprul sku/ bshad sgrub kyi sde 'dzin pa'i mkhan po/ slob dpon/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma dang / gdung dang rigs kyi mngon par mtho ba'i sngags 'chang mang po dang / nang gi rnal 'byor la mchog tu bzhol ba'i tshe 'di blos gtang gi rnal 'byor dbang phyug du ma dang / sa dge rnying gsum/ 'bri stag 'brug gsum/ jo zhal bo gsum sogs grub mtha' ris su ma chad pa'i bstan 'dzin/ mkhas pa dang / 'dul ba 'dzin pa dang / grub pa'i go sar bzhugs shing ske/ sbas tshul dang / yongs su grags pa'i dam pa mchog tu gyur ba du ma dang / mdo sngags kyi chos kyi 'brel pa ci rigs pa'i bka' drin nos pa khyim spyod chos ldan gyi skye bo du mas mtha' rten pa bgrangs las 'das pa zhig byung bar nges te 'dir rnam par thar pa'i dngos shugs su rags tsam pa zhig las mtha' dag brjod par ma nus la/ de ltar yang rje nyid kyi rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba ltar/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba gsung gi rdo rje chos gu ru pad+ma sam bha was lung gi bstan pa ltar na/rang gzhan gyi don gnyis 'grub nges pa'i slob ma bdun bcu rtsa lnga/ thar pa'i lam rkang zin nges pa bdun brgya/ phra mo chos kyi 'brel ba khri phrag tu long bar gsungs shing / de dag gi nang nas rang gzhan gyi 149

don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub nges pa'i slob ma bdun bcu rtsa lnga'i nang nas mchog gi skyes bu sum cu rtsa drug nye ba'i bu brgyad/snying gi bu bzhi rnams yod par gsungs so//sa chen po chos bzhin du skyongs ba'i rgyal po dang / rgyal phran dang / blon po'i tshogs du ma zhig nas kyang dam pa'i chos kyis bka' drin nos par gyur la/ gtso bor ni gangs can bstan pa'i bdag po 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug ngur smrig gar gyi rnam par rol pa sdom brtson rgyal po'i tshul 'chang ba thams cad mkhyen gzigs rgyal dbang blo bzang bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i zhabs dang snga phyir lan grangs du ma zhig tu mjal bar mdzad cing zhabs pad brtan pa'i rten 'brel sgrigs phyogs sgo du ma nas gnang rung gzhan rkyen mang pos bar du bcod pa zhig byung mod/ rgyal ba'i dbang po nyid kyi ni ye shes nang phan tshun gzigs pas shin tu dgyes pa chen pos rjes su 'dzin pa'i rten 'brel yang dag par 'grig pa yin la/ spyir rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa 'di nyid kyi sku'i skye phreng mdo rgyud gter lung du ma nas bsngags pa'i tshul rgyas par ni gzhan du bshad pa ltar dang / 'dir dmigs su gsal ba ni chos rje gling pa bde ba'i rdo rjes gter lung las 'di skad cesaske/ srong btsan 'phrin las drag po'i sprul pa zhig: dmar lcags rir 'byung mtha' mi dbang du bsdud: 'gong po'i bar gcod glo bur nyi tshe 'ong : bar gcod rgyal na chab srid dbu mog mtho:zhes dang rka/ srong btsan la yag 'phrin las 'byung ba'i dus: zhes gsungs shing / rje rig 'dzin chen po 'di nyid kyis kong po ljon pa lung nas bzhes pa'i gab rgya can gyi gsang ba'i lung byang las/ da lta'i mnga' bdag rgyal po'i thugs byubaskyed mthus: 'phrin las byin brlabs sgyu ma'i rang 'od zhig: mdo khams shar nas phag gam byi ba'i lor: rgyal lam mtsho zhes sme dkar do shal can: snyan grags ldan pa mtha' nas dbus su 'byung : bod yul yongs kyi bstan pa'i bdag po byed: de la sngon las dbang gi rkyen kha mang :mi dang mi min du mas 'tshe bar 'gyur: khyad par nyer gcig nyer drug zhe drug dang : rang keg bdun zur lo dang de'i snga phyir: rtsub ldan bzlog thabs rten 'brel ma 'khrul 'bad: gdam pa 'di phrod dus tshigs gang yin de'i: bar chad ci rigs smon lam dbang gi sel: the tshom yid gnyis ma gyur shin tu bces: rtag tu 'bad gus chen pos nyams len pa:mi mthun 'gal 'khrul mang zhig 'di yis grol: ji phyir pad+ma bdag gi smon lam dang : 'phags pa'i dam bca' bden pa'i bslu mi 'gyur: zhes sku bltam pa'i yul dang / dgung snying / mtshan sgra/ mdzad pa/ sku tshe'i 'gal rkyen/ tshe 'phrang dang bcas pa gsal bar bstan cing / sngon gyi tshe chos kyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan nyid dpal gyi bsam yas su sku shin tu bsnyun pa'i tshe dge slong nam mkha'i snying po lho brag mkhar chur sgrub pa la bzhugs pa gdan drangs pa na bang chen pa rnams sngon la song shig gsungs/nam mkha'i snying po nyid nyi zer la chibs te skad cig nyid 150

pas lha thams cad la rigs bdag 'od dpag med kyi rgyas btab par gyur/ phyag 'tshal ba ni/ trīḥm bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi skuḥ bde chen longs spyod bla ma chos kyi rjeḥ pad sdong las 'khrungs bla ma sprul pa'i skuḥ sku gsum rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal loḥ mchod pa ni/ hūṃḥ dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul pa'iḥ kun tu bzang po bla med mchod sprin gyis/ mkha' dbyings rnam dag rgya cher yongs bkod de/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rgya mtshos mchod/ bstod pa ni/ na moḥ skye 'gags 'gyur med sku gsung thugs dang ldanaḥ rang byung thugs rjes 'gro kun bsgral slad duḥ phrin las rnam bzhis yid bzhin re ba skong ཿ pad+ma thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ ces dang / hrīḥ rgyal ba thams cad ྾nas thugs rjes sprul sgyur 'gyed la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ ces bstod/ gsol 'debs ni/ e ma hoḥ nub phyogs bde ba can gyi ྾ sogs tshan lnga lan gsum dang / trīḥdus gsum gyi sangs rgyas bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur cing mdzad pa'i phrin las la tha dad mi mnga' bar gyur pa o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /gsol ba 'debs so/ /lus ngag yid gsum smin pa dang grol bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lan gsum brjod la/ de nas dbang bzhi len pa ni/ oṃ āḥrtsu gliḥmadun bskyed sku yi gnas bzhi las/ /'od 'phros dbang bzhi cig char thob/ /slar yang sku las 'od 'phros pas/ /rang thim bdag nyid lhar gsal gyur/ /de nas rang gi thugs kar pad zla rdo rje rgya gram gyi lte bar/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ sum brtsegs kyi mtha' bskor du/ badz+ra gu ru sogs yig 'bru dgu gsal btab la/ 'od zer 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas par dmigs la snying par ci nus su bzla'o/ /gu ru drag po la/ hor sogs ྾ ces lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūṃ trīḥ mdun bskyed sku ྾ sogs kyi dbang len/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃḥ a rtsig ni rtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūṃ rgyu phaṭa phaṭaḥ ā hūṃ rgyu phaṭa phaṭaḥs bon nyi steng rgyu dmar bskyed/ sman bla la/ sems can sgyu lus ྾sogs lan gsum/ gong bzhin dbang len/ na mo bha ga wa te lha ṣa rdzu gu ru bai ḍūr+ya pra bhā rā dzā yaḥ ta thā ga tā yaḥ arta te samyak+shi buchu yaḥ tabya thāḥ oṃ lha ṣa rdzu lha ṣa rdzu ma hā lha ṣa rdzu rādzā sa muṅga te swā hāḥ sa bon zla steng oṃ dkar po/ nor lhar/ 'byung bzhi ྾ sogs lan gsum/ dbang len/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ya dha na me dha nyi trīḥ ḍā ki nī dz+wa la sak+ṣiṃ ram̐ swā hāḥ sa bon pad nyir oṃ baṃ kha sbyor/ rdo rje phur par/ las can ྾sogs gsum/ dbang len/ oṃ a kā ya ha a ma raḥ a ya ma du ru tsa sha naḥ trig shanaḥ spur thum dza dzaḥ dha lo sha pu wamaḥ a dz+ra tri sirnyi pha la dza dza dzaḥ sa bon nyi steng r+ghaṃ dmar po/ seng sgra la/ stag gzig ྾ sogs gsum/dbang len/ oṃ badz+ra gu ru sau ha gaṇ+ḍi dharmā dhā tu hūṃ hūṃ hūṃḥ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṭ+wāṃ ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa r+ghaṃ phaṭaḥ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭaḥ sa bon gnam lcags rdo rje'i lte bar hūṃ mthing 151

ngo ཿ pad+ma badz+ra la/ sa chu me rlung ྾ sogs gsum/ dbang len/ o āḥhūṃ gu ru shrī pad+ma badz+ra trīḥ dhu ma gha ye ḍā ki nī na ma swā hāḥ oṃ āḥ rtsu trīḥ ma ha ri ni saḥ ra tsa trī yaḥ hūṃḥ oṃ āḥ hūṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki nī swā hāḥ trīḥm hā ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya a gro tri dzaḥsarba i ku sha dzaḥ tsit+ta dz+rī trī sarba ba su sidhi ku ru swā hāḥs bon pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad lte bar trī dmar po/ rta mgrin la/ lam srang ྾sogs gsum/ dbang len/ o āḥhūṃ gu ru kro dha ha ya gyi wa kro ta ha ri ni sa sa ma ya dzaḥ kā le shwa ra sirnyi pha la hūṃḥ sa bon nyi steng trī nag po/rdo rje grod lod la/ gang zhig ྾ sogs gsum/ dbang len/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ma hā gu ru bi ru kro dha lo kot+ta ra sarba sirnyi hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭaḥ o badz+ra gu ru gro bo lo ta lo ka sarba sirnyi hūṃ hūṃ hūṃḥ sa bon nyi steng hūṃ dmar po/ pad+ma rgyal po la/ nam zhig྾ sogs gsum/ dbang len/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ trīḥ.oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃḥ sa bon pad zla oṃ āḥhūṃ hrīḥbazhi brtsegs/ snang mtha' la/ sgyu lus ྾ sogs gsum/ dbang len/ oṃ a mi ta bha trīḥn maḥ sarba thā ga ta hri da yaḥ a nu ka teḥ o ku ldu gi ni swā hāḥ na mo rat+na tra yā yaḥ oṃ rka ka ni kai ka ni/ ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/tro ṭa ni tro ṭa ni/ tā sa ni tā sa ni/ pra ti ha na pra ti ha na/ sarba karma pa ram̐ pa rā ṇi me sarba satwa nāñtsa swā hā/ sa bon rdo rje'i lte ba trī dmar po/ kun bzang la/ gzhan yang las dang ྾ sogs gsum/ dbang len/o āḥhūṃḥ'aḥ.aḥshaḥsaḥmaḥhaḥs bon pad zla'i steng du 'od lnga'i thig le'i dkyil du a yig mthing ga'o/ /rtsa ba'i bla mar/ 'gro drug ྾ sogs gsum/ dbang len/ oṃ āḥhūṃḥgu ru dh+wa ki nī dz+nyā na sarba sirnyi pha la hūṃḥ sa bon rdo rje'i lte bar āḥ dkar po/ de nas gu ru yid bzhin nor bu gsal ba'i ngang / mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul/ slar yang rang gzhung gi bdag 'jug blangs la slob mar dbang bskur sogs bya'o/ /rang don bsnyen sgrub dngos kyi khrid gzhung rgyas pa ji ltar nyams su len pa nyid nges par gal che zhing /'di ni dbang sgrub skabs kho nar 'jug bde'i ched du snyam nas/ 7si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos zur bkol spel bar 'gal 'khrul lha la bshags shing dge bas bstan 'gro'i gsos su shog maṅga lo/bsam pa lhun grub yi dam bcu gsum snying po/ oṃ āḥhūṃ trīḥ oṃ lhatshohūṃḥ.a rtsig ni rtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭaḥ.āḥhūṃ k+shi phaṭa phaṭaḥ na mo bha ga wa te hai ṣa rdzu gu ru be+e ḍūr+ya pra bhā rā dzā yaḥ ta thā ga tā yaḥ arta te samyakle budhā yaḥ tabya thāḥ oṃ hai ṣa rdzu lha ṣa rdzu ma hā lha ṣa rdzu rā dza saḥmuṅga te swā hāḥ oṃ a kā yaha a ma raḥ a ya ma du ru tsa sha naḥtrig shanaḥ spur thum dza dzaḥ dha lo sha pu wamaḥ a dz+ra tri sirnyi pha la dza dza dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra gu ru sau ha gaṇ+ḍi dharmā dhā tu hūṃ hūṃ hūṃḥ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba dusgyi ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūṃ phaṭaḥ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭa oṃ āḥhūṃ gu ru shrī pad+ma badz+ra trīḥdhu ma gha ye ḍā ki nī na ma swā hāḥ oṃ āḥhūṃ spyoḥm ha ri ni saḥ ra tsa trī yaḥhūṃḥ oṃ āḥhūṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki nī swa hāḥ trī ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa trī ya a dz+ra tri dzaḥsarba i ku sha dzaḥ tsista spyo spyo sarba bar+sha su sirnyi ku ru swā hāḥ.oṃ āḥhūṃ gu ru gro dha ha ya spyi wa gro ta ha ri ni sa sa ma ya dzaḥ kā le shwa ra sirnyi pha la hūṃḥ.oṃ āḥrgyu ma hā gu ru bi ru kro dha lo kot+ta 152

brjod kyi bskor/ gnyis par zhal gdam dang gsung mgur/ gsum par dgongs gter/ bzhi pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ lnga pa dbang khrid brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ drug pa bstod tshogs/ bdun pa khrid yiganyams len man ngag brgyad par sgrub thabs dbang dang gtor chog dgu pa lo rgyus rnam bshad/ bcu pa rig pa'i gnas/ bcu gcig pa mchog dman bar ma'i tshogs la chab shog bcu gnyis pa smon lam bzang po'i bskor te dkar chag tu bkod pa glegs bam lnga po 'di bzhin las gzhan du bka' yi bsdu ba po su zhig kyang ma byung bar mngon/ 'di dag las phyogs phyogs su cung zad 'phel bar 'dug cing gong smos kyi tshig lung kyang phal cher sngags 'chang 'di nyid kyis thugs rtsol chen pos gsan thub par gnang bas rjes su yi rang ba'i gnas su khum mod ding sang ni dad ldan skal ba can re 'ga' tsam gyi spyod yul las gzhan du tshig lung lta ci/ dpe khyun gyi don gnyer tsam yang byed mi dal 'byor gyi lus rten las kyang dkon par mchis so/ /gzhan yang sa'i phyogs gang dang gang du zhabs kyis bcags pa de dang der mchog dman
