bar ma'i skye bo ris su ma chad pa mtha' dag chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pa rgya chen pos tshim par mdzad cing sdig pa mi dge ba'i rgyun lam mtha' dag bcad de dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam yang dag pa la sbyor bar mdzad pas mngon mtho nges legs kyi lam bzang po la phral yun bde blag tu 'god pa dang gtso bor mtha' dmag du ruṣ+ka mi zad dus kyi chu gter drag po g.yo bar nye ba thugs rje'i rta gdong gi bsreg za rab tu 'bar bas phyir bsnyil bar mdzad pas kha ba ri pa'i skye rgu mtha' dag phan dang bde ba'i ngal gsol bkod pa dang / dus kyi chad pas nyen pa'i skye bo srog ldan mang po zhig 'chi bdag gi kha sgo las thar bar mdzad cing / gnas chen mang po dang / yul 'khor la sogs pa'i ri bsul nags klung nyin bsrib la gnas pa'i bdag med kyi srog chags rkam bsher la gnas pa grangs med par ri rgya klung rgya rtag 'jags sogs mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pas dbugs byung bar mdzad pas mtshon bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi sogs rgyal sras sems dpa' chen po'i spyod pa mtha' dag lhur bzhes pas dus 'da' bar mdzad de/ ji skad du/ bcom ldan o kyi mdzad pa ni/ /'ga' yang don med nyid min te/ /dbugs kyang sems can thams cad la/ /rtag tu phan par mdzad pa nyid/ /ces pa ltar mdor na zhal gyi dbugs tsam yang 'gro ba rnams kyi phan bde'i gsos su mi 'gyur ba'i go skabs kyi dben pas na/ zhal gyi dkyir 'khor mjal ba/ phyag gi byin rlabs stsol ba/ snyan pa'i gsung gi gtam 'dre ba/ phebs par gsung ba/ brtse ba'i thugs kyi dgongs pa/ 'ga' zhig drag po'i 'dul bar 'os pa dag la nus pa drag po'i skur bzhengs shing bka' skyon phyag 'bebs mdzad pa'i tshul dang / dad pas kun nas blangs pa'i rnyed pa dang bskur sti byung ba dag bdag gir bzhes pa'i zol gyis rnam dkar gyi tshogs su spel bar 153

mdzad pa sogs thabs mkhas rmad du byung ba'i mdzad pa dag gis kyang ris med pa'i 'gro bar rnams la thar pa bla na med pa'i sa bon skrun par mdzad pa de'i phyir mthong thos dran reg 'brel tshad don ldan ming du ma lus pa nyid do/ /tshul 'di dag kyang grub mtha'i phyogs lhung dang rmongs zhen gyi brjod pa dang /rab btags dang / phul byung gi rgyan gyis brjod pa zhes/ phal skad du stong shob 'ud kyi brjod pa dang /gcam bu'i tshig gi brjod pa ma yin gyi nges par rang bzhin brjod pa'i tshig gi gtam du byas pa te/sngon dang da lta'i bar gyi gzu bor gnas pa'i blo gros dang ldan pa mtha' dag la mngon sum su grags shing grub pa lags so/ /de ltar yang gong du smos pa ltar gnas gang dang gang du thugs dam zab bzhes bsnyen sgrub sgrub chen gyi rim pa dang / ris su ma chad pa'i bshes gnyen dam pa yongs su 'dzin pa du ma zhig las phyogs bral zab chos kyi bdud rtsi bzhes pa/ skal ba dang ldan zhing don du gnyer ba'i gdul bya mang por rgyal bstan ris med gsar rnying bka' gter spyi bye brag gi zab rgyas kyi chos tshul phyogs brgyar spel ba/ yongs su grags pa dang sbas pa'i gnas chen gnas phran gter gnas ji rnyed par byon zhing bzhugs pa dang gtsug lag khang dang / rten gsum bzhengs pa/ dge rgyun rlabs po che dang mchod pa'i rgyun 'dzugs pa/ ser skya mchog dman bar ma'i 'dus pa brgya stong khri phrag du mar sems bskyed dbang rjes gnang / yig drug yi ge brgya pa/ badz+ra gu ru/ gsol 'debs le'u bdun pa sogs kyi lung gis mtshon pa'i gang la gang 'dod kyi chos sbyin rtsol zhing dge ba'i dam bca' bzhes pa ri rgya klu rgya rtag 'jags mang po/ gzhi bdag lha srin dregs pa can du ma'i srog snying bzhes shing dam la bzhag pa/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i dag pa'i gzigs snang dpag par dka' ba du ma dang / gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa'i zhal gdam/ bstan bcos/ gsung mgur sogs bka' rtsom mtha' yas pa dang / phyag zhabs kyi rjes sogs rdzu 'phrul gyi rol rtsed lkog tu ma gyur pa du ma zhig dang / phyi nang gsang ba'i ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang cho 'phrul dge mtshan byung tshul ma 'ongs 'byung 'gyur gyi lung bstan sogs rnam par thar pa zhib tu yi ger bkod na glegs bam pod chen du ma zhig yod tshod du mchis kyang zhal slob dang / zhabs 'bring ba dag gis 'og tu col bas tshags su ma chug pa'am/ bka' brtsom gyi reg zig sogs yi ger 'khod pa dag kyang bar skabs su zags shing 'thor bas deng sang kha shas tsam las mthong thos gyi yul du ma gyur mod/ ka 'dir gtso bor rje bla ma nyid kyi rdo rje'i gsung 'khrul med ri thang mtshams kyi sman mchog phro can skabs dang po yan dang / snyim pa'i chu skyes 'phros don bcas pa sa spre yan dang / sa sbrul nas lcags lug bar gyi mdzad pa rags tsam lu ma nas snyim pa'i chu ltar smos pa dang / gsang rnam le mtshan rnams las phal cher dkyus su bkod cing / de phyin bar skabs kyi lo tshigs hor khong dang / lo 154

rgyus 'thor bu rnams lam yig skyo shas glu dbyangs sna tshogs pad+ma'i phreng ba dang / chab shog skor sogs bka' 'bum nang nas 'thor ba bsdus pa'i gung sgrigs/ rje nyid kyi gsung dngos ma rnams bcos slad med par bkod cing / bar skabs kyi mtshams sbyor dgos rigs rnams 'brel chags su bkod pa las gsar du tshigs spros skyar zlos rigs dang bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad sogs yi ges 'jigs pas gtang snyoms su bzhag bla ma dam pa gong ma dag gi zhal las dngos su thos pa'i gsung khyun rigs dang —/ rang gis rjes dpag gis gzhal bar 'os pa rnams kyi zur brgyan te smos pa las zhib tu cha rgyud dang mngon shes med phyir tshod dpogs kyi mthar chags su bri bar rngo ma thogs gshis mdo tsam zhig las brjod par ma nus so/ /spyir rje 'di nyid kyi phyi nang gsang ba'i rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar rmad du byung zhing ske/ gangs ljongs kyi bstan 'gro spyi bye brag la bka' drin chen por gyur pa zhig lags na'ang / dag zhing du gshegs nas/ ding sang rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i myos ldan he sa mo yo lo'i steng du sleb pa na bgrangs bya drug cu re bzhi song ba'i bar mi thog gcig tsam las ma 'das kyang / mdzad pa rnam par thar pa'i tshul gzhan lta ci/ mtshan tsam yang phyis 'byung gi skye bo nyi shu kha ral ba rnams kyi thos 'dzin gyi yul du thos par bka' bar snang / bod yul dbus gtsang gi phyogs su ni snga bor rgyal mchog skal bzang rgya mtsho'i skabs la dwags kyi 'ching sgrigs gnang tshul sogs dang / zhwa dmar nag bka' brgyud rnying ma spyi dang bye brag gi don rgya cher mdzad tshul rnam thar dngos bstan gyi dkyus su bkod pa ltar yin kyang deng sang ni/ kar 'brug dpa' gsum dang rnying ma ba 'ga' zhig tsam las gzhan du mtshan gyi 'bug 'bug sgros sgros tsam yang brjod mkhan mi snang ngo / /snga sor sku dngos bzhugs skabs yang kun slong can kha cig gi thugs ka'i hūṃ yig las 'od zer 'phros pa'i cho 'phrul du ma zhig byung bar nges la/ phyis su zhwa dmar bcu pa'i zhor las kyang log rtog gi brjod pa sna tshogs zhig dang / rnying ma nang khul du'ang kha cig gi rang dang phyogs lhung ngam 'gal zhig gis bstod mi shes pas dmad pa'i dpe bzhin mu cor gyi smra ba ci gar gleng ba dag gis kyang zhabs 'degs kyi cig shos su song ba dang / rje de nyid dag zhing du gshegs rjes sku'i rnam rol bstan pa dang / rtogs pa brjod pa bka' bsdu ba sogs gang sar bdag rkyen dang bral ba lta bu zhig byung snang bas gzhan la re khang byed rgyu yang ma mchis so/ /'di dag las mang du spro bar byed rgyu yod mod kyang dgos pas dben cing rnam thar dngos bstan gyi sgrib char 'gyur bas btang snyoms su bzhag go/ /de ltar na rje bla ma rig 'dzin yongs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba chen po de nyid kyi thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam par thar ba rgya mtsho lta bu las chu thig tsam zhig dad pa'i ku shas blang ste tshig gi lam du mtshon par byas pa 'di nyid kyang bdag lta bu rje de nyid kyi dngos dkyil 155

mjal ba dang gsung gi bdud rtsi dngos su thob pa lta ga la zhig mkhas par rloms shing grags 'dod kyi kun nas blangs te brjod pa yang ma yin te/ gong du smos pa bzhin rtogs brjod pa'i cha shas yi ge'i lam du snang ba dang / deng sang thos 'dzin gyi yul du brjod pa po yang ches dkon zhing tshad mar grub pa'i skyes bu chen po gang gi thugs rjes bdag cag mos ldan gyi gdul bya mtha' dag byang chub snying po la reg pa'i bar gyi skye ba dang tshe rabs kyi 'phreng ba thams cad du 'brel med du rjes su 'dzin par 'gyur ba dang / gang gi mdzad pa'i phyogs gcig tsam yang brjod pa dang / de la dad cing gus pa lan gcig tsam skyes pas kyang 'phral yun du mngon par mtho ba dang nges par legs pa'i bsod nams kyi mchog dam pa thob par 'gyur ro snyam du lhag pa'i bsam pa dge bas phyogs su lhung ba dang / rang bzo'i sgro btags kyi bcos mas ma slad par deng dus skye 'gro'i blo ngo dang ji ltar mtshams par 'char ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i rim par phye ba ni de tsam zhig 'bad pa chen pos spel bar byas pa yin no/ /'dir smras pa/dge legs ngo mtshar yon tan chu klung grangs med yongs 'du snying rje'i rlabs phreng srid rtser phyur/ /lung rtogs nor bu'i gter gyis rab phyug gting zab rgya che mkhyen brtse nus pa'i klong 'khor can/ /skal bzang gdul bya mu med gdengs can tshogs kyi bsten gyur 'phral yun phan bde ngal gso'i gzhi/ /zla med bla ma gangs chen mtsho des byin rlabs chu rgyun bdag snying rdzing bur 'bab gyur cig gang thugs zab zhi spros dang bral ba rnam kun mchog ldan stong pa'i dga' mar g.yo med bde chen rdo rje yi/ /mngon par 'khyud pa'i rtse dga'i dpal 'dzin zab gsal ro mnyams kun khyab phyogs bral kun gyi dngos/ /mkha' khyab mkha' yi rdo rje can gcig gdul bya'i mos mtshor cir yang 'char ba'i sgyu 'phrul mkhan/ /mchog tu zhi ba'i dpal chen he ru kaḥ khyod slar yang dran pas 'dud de brtse bas skyongs/ /skye rgu'i gdung sel bsam kun rdzogs byed pa'i/ /'bad rtsol kun bral phan bde 'dod rgu'i dpyid/ /lhun grub 'phrin las srid par rgyun mi chad/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra khyod las skyabs gzhan su/ /gang gi yon tan mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod/ /srid zhi'i phun tshogs ma tshang med gsal bas/ /chos dbyings zhi la gzhol ba'i rgyal ba rnamasaske/ /ngo mtshar gzigs mor dgyes pas slar gzheng snyams/ /'on te byang bstan phug par rta ljang zeraske/ /mi 'jug dngos po'i gshis bzhin log snang gis/ /'dren byed ldong pa'i phyogs lhung mtshan rgyu'i bya—/ /mun par 'chel dag yid la mya ngan sbyin/ /mi zad snyigs lnga'i nags klung tshang tshing khrod/ /yid srub gyis rlams nyes spyod gdug pa'i sbrul/ /dam pa'i mgon la dgrar mthong 'phung byed kyi/ /phud sgra sgrog pa'i brtul zhugs su yi 'gog /'di na srid pa'i khong 'dir snang byed zung / /'grogs pa'i mig stong ldan pas gar nyul yang / /lung rtogs smin grol lam gyi bstan srog 'chang / /rdo rje 'dzin khyod las gzhan 156

'ga' mi mthong / /bsil ldan ljongs 'dir ris bral rgyal ba'i bstan/ /'dzin pa'i mkhas grub bye ba'i zur phud gyis/ /gus bsnyen mtha' dbus dregs ldan rgyal phran 'bum/ /gtsug gi khyod zhabs mchod la dog por bgyid/ /spyi dang khyad par gsang chen bstan pa'i nyi/ /phyogs brgyar gsal mdzad 'gro kun phral yun du/ /gtan bde'i ngal gsor dbugs 'byin bka' drin can/ /tshul 'dir lhar bcas kun gyis cis mi bsngags/ /gang gi mtha' bral yon tan phung po'i cha/ /tshangs pas bskal brgyar brjod kyang zad min na/ /bdag 'dra'i byis blos 'bad kyang ngal ba'i rgyur/ /zad mod dpyod ldan rnams kyang khrel gyur grang glu/ /'on kyang dad pas dam pa'i yon tan ni/ /cha tsam brjod pas skal mnyam gdung sel zhing / /bsod nams mtha' yas thob ces nges shes kyi/ /smra ba'i mgrin pa gyen du steg par gyur/ /sngon chad rmad byung rtogs brjod nor bu'i 'phreng / /tshig rgyan srad bur phyogs gcig spel legs su/ /'khod min phyag dar khrod du'ang dor nyer bar/ /'bad pas byi dor do shal rgyan du spel/ /ring nas nyer goms skyes stobs rnam dpyod bral/ /dus 'dir gzhung lugs sbyangs btson legs byas dman/ /ci tol brjod pas 'gal nong ji snyed pa/ /dpang gyur mgon dang gzu gnas rnams la bshags/ /e ma rmad byung yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab rnam par thar ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /bdag blo rab gus dad pa ku sha'i rtse mos chu thig tsam zhig 'dir blangs te/ /mos ldan gdul bya'i mgron rnams dga' bskyed gdung sel skyes su sbyin 'di'i dge'i/ /don gnyis lhun grub rnam mkhyen mi 'gyur bde chen rdo rje'i bsil ba thob par shog /skye kun chos ldan mtho ris kyi/ /dbang phyug nges legs yon tan rdzogs/ /bstan dang 'gro 'dir phan dang bde'iske/ /bkra shis dge mtshan 'bar gyur cig /grub pa dang rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba chen po snyigs dus pad+ma'i rgyal tshab dpal rdo rje tshe dbang nor bu'i zhal snga nas kyi thun mong gdul bya'i mos ngor mtshams par 'char ba'i rnam par thar pa rgya mtsho lta bu las chu thig tsam zhig dkyus su sdebs pa ngo mtshar dad pa'i rol mtsho zhes pa 'di yang snga sor rje de nyid kyi slob tshogs mchog dman bar ma nyi zla dang rgyu skar gyi 'phreng ba ltar mtshar du mngar zhing / gang gi zhal gsung ma'i phyi nang gsang ba'i rtogs brjod reg zig tu mdzad pa'ang ji snyed cig yod par gor ma chags kyang 'dir rnam thar phyogs sdebs khregs chags su 'khod pa zhig dpe khyun mthong thos kyi spyod yul du ma gyur cing / lo rgyus mtha' dag yi ge'i lam du snang ba ma mchis stabs/ cha rgyus med pa'i gtam bzhin 'bri bar ngo thog pa shin tu dka' yang 'dir gtso bor rje bla ma nyid kyi rdo rje'i gsung 'khrul med ri thang mtshams kyi sman mchog khro can skabs dang po yan dang / snyim pa'i chu skyes 'phros don bcas pa sa spre yan dang / sa sbrul nas lcags lug bar gyi mdzad pa rags tsam lu ma nas snyim pa'i chu ltar smos pa dang / gsang rnam le mtshan rnams las phal cher dkyus su bkod cing / de phyin bar skabs kyi lo tshigs hor khong dang /lo rgyus 'thor bu rnams lam yig skyo shas glu dbyangs sna tshogs pad+ma'i 'phreng ba dang / chab shog skor sogs bka' 'bum nang nas 'thor ba bsdus pa'i gung sgrigs/ rje nyid kyi 157

gsung dngos ma rnams bcos slad med par bkod cing / bar skabs kyi mtshams sbyor dgos rigs rnams 'brel chags su bkod pa las gsar du tshig spros skyar zlos rigs dang bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad sogs yi ge'i 'jigs pas btang snyoms su bzhag bla ma dam pa gong ma dag gi zhal las dngos su thos pa'i gsung khyun rigs dang / rang gi rjes dpag gis gzhal bar 'os pa rnams kyi zur brgyan te don la sgro ma btags par khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po rig pa 'dzin dbang 'phrin las bdud 'joms sogs dam pa du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len cing / he ru kaḥ dpal rig 'dzin kaḥthog pa chen po tshe dbang nor bu'i zhabs de nyid la na tshod chung ngu nas mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob cing gsung gis gsang ba 'dzin par rloms pa bya bral rnal 'byor spyod pa rig 'dzin chos kyi dbang phyug gi ming gzhan mi pham 'chi med grub pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis rang lo zhe lnga pa rig 'dzin rje nyid mya ngan las 'das nas bgrangs bya re bzhi'i thog tu son pa rab byung bcu bzhi pa myos ldan zhes pa sa mo yos lo'i gro zhun zla ba'i nang dbu rtsam bar skabs su rnam g.yengs le lo'i ring du 'gyangs ba nas rgyal zla'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes bco lnga bzang por gangs can grub brgyud kyi chu mgo dpal mi la bzhad pa rdo rje'i grub gnas kyi yangs rtse brag dkar rta sor sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni tshe rig 'dzin pa dbon karma phun tshogs kyi bgyis pa'i dge bas bdag gzhan 'gro ba mtha' dag sa lam gyi yon tan mthar phyin te byang chub mchog gi go 'phang la reg pa dang nges gsang 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i bstan phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cigadage'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ / 158

༄ga /dpal rig 'dzin kaḥthog chen po tshe dbang nor bu'i zhabs kyi rnam thar mdor bsdus dad pa'i sa bon zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru bi bya dha ra a yu rin+d+ra ma ṇi bā da ye/ rang rig ye shes 'od po che/ /gzung 'dzin sprin bral gdod ma'i gshis/ /'gyur med bde chen tshe'i dbang phyug /yid bzhin nor bu bla mas skyongs/ /gang gi yon tan rin chen mdzod/ /rgya mtsho che las chu thigs kyi/ /zegs ma tsam zhig dad pas 'dir/ /mos ldan gdung sel skyes su byin/ /de yang / rgyal ba thams cad kyi mkhyen rtse nus pa'i phung po gcig tu bsdus pa gsung gi rdo rje 'od dpag tu med pa bla med sngags kyi ston par snang ba slob dpon chen po pad+ma sam bha wa'i gsang ba gsum gyi sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol rtsed las byung zhing / sngon gyi tshe bdag cag gi ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i spyan sngar dgra bcom pa nye ba 'khor du gyur pa dang / 'phags yul grub pa'i dbang phyug karno pa ste rgyal bas lung gis bstan pa slob dpon nag po spyod pas byin gyis brlab pa/ bod yul du rje 'bang nyer lnga'i nang nas grub pa brnyes pa dge slong nam mkha'i snying po'i thugs kyi sgyu 'phrul 'gog pa med pa'i rang gzugs ni dpal rig pa 'dzin pa chen po tshe dbang nor bu nyid ste/ thugs gter gsang ba'i lung byang las/ pad+ma nga sprul nag pos byin rlabs cing : nam snying thugs kyi 'od zer zhugs gyur pa: ka:thog lho phyogs btsan ri'i nye 'dabs su: mchog dman spangs pa bar ma dag pa'i rigs: mgon dang mtsho zhes bya ba gnyis kyi bu: dbang ngam nor bu'i ming can snying stobs can: mi che mi chung sgeg pa rdo rje'i lus: rtsa rlung thig le skyon med mkha' 'gro 'du: spyod pa ma nges byis pa'i tshul du spyod: kha dog nyin re la yang nges med 'gyur: lta ba'i gdeng ldan rgyu 'bras shan 'byed mkhas:rig pa ngar thon gyong tshig tal mar smra: shes bya khog yangs gdul bya dkri la mkhas: ting 'dzin gsal thebs gzhan snang zil gyis gnon: sbyangs pa sngon song mdo rgyud dgos don khral: blo gros mthu ldan chos dang chos min 'byedoḥ 'phral du brtag na mi shes glen pa'i tshul: yun du 'grogs tshe mkhas kun snyem pa 'phrog: yon tan ldan pa sbas tshul snal mar spyod: zhes sogs dang / gzhan gyi gdul dka' bdud kyang bsun dbyung ba'i: dpa' bo'i ngar dang brtul zhugs nus mthu ldan: mang po'i gseb na lhag par gzi brjid che: nga sras skyes bu de lta bu zhig 'byung : zhes sku gsung thugs yon mdzad pa 'phrin las dang 159

bcas pa lung du bstan cing : gzhan yang rig 'dzin rgod ldem pa/ 'ja' mtshon snying po/ mnga' ris gter ston zla ba rgyal mtshan/ bde chen gling pa sogs rtsod bral gyi gter ston 'ga' zhig gi gter lung las kyang lung gis zin/ spyir bod yul 'dir grags pa'i sku'i skye 'phreng ni zur chung shes rab grags/dgas sgoms tshul khrims snying po/ gu ru chos dbang gi thugs sras ma ṇi rin chen/ mang po gter ston byang chub gling pa/ kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel/ bdag smyon kun legs/ grub dbang pad+ma nor bu ste 'dir rags tsam zhig smos la/ gzhan du gsang rnams dang / 'khrung rab gsol 'debs sogs su shes par bya'o/ /de lta bu'i dam pa de nyid kyi sku bltams pa'i yul ni bod chen po'i rgyal khams mdo smad 'bri rgyud re khe'i ljong kaḥthog rdo rje gdan gyi lho phyogs btsan ri'i 'dabs zhal dung dkar ri khrod du lha rigs rngu yi brgyud las yab a mgon dang / yul rdo rje mtsho gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs/ 'khrungs ma thag nas sngags bsrungs ral gcig mas skyobs pa dang / byis pa'i skabs nyid nas gu ru rin po che'i zhal yang yang dngos su gzigs/ gter ston grub pa'i dbang phyug pad+ma nor bu'i sku'i skye bar ngos gzung / be+e ro'i sprul pa gter ston pad+ma bde chen gling pas dbang bskur/ mtshan tshe dbang nor bur gsol/ phyag rdzogs kyi smin grol gdams pa rnams gsan cing dgung lo bcu gsum par gnas lugs gdod ma'i rang zhal mngon sum du gzigs/ grub thob shwa wa ri'i rnam sprul cha tshang drug pa karma gsung rab rgya mtsho las kar lugs phyag chen sogs gsar rnying gi zab chos mang du gsan/ bla ma 'di gnyis ni rtsa ba'i bla mar mdzad/ gzhan yang mtshan ldan gyi dge ba'i gshes gnyen mang du bsnyen te gsan bsam rgya cher mdzad cing mkhyen rab kyi klong rdol pas thun mong gi rig gnas dang mdo sngags gzhung lugs spyi bye brag gi dgongs don thugs su chud/ rtsa ba gsum gyi lha mang po bsnyen cing sgrub pas zhal bstan/ bskyed rim la brtan pa thob cing rdzogs rim gyi ye shes la dbang 'byor/ kaḥthog rgyal sras bsod nams lde'u gyi drung du gtsug phud phul cing kun mkhyen pad+ma blo gros kyi gdan sar mnga' gsol/ skabs de dag tu 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad pa dang / mang po'i 'khrug pa bsdum pa'i mi 'jigs skyabs sbyin dang / bstan pa dang bla ma'i sku dgrar gyur pa 'ga' zhig drag po mngon gcod kyi tshar bcad/ dngos gnyis su dregs pa lha srin mang po'i srog snying bzhes pa dang / rgyal po pe har gyi 'khor zhig gis ma 'ong par bsam yas me'i 'jig tshul gyi lung bstan kyang zhus/ mdo khams phyogs su 'gro phan rgya cher mdzad de dgung lo nyer lnga'i mthar bya gtang gi brtul zhugs gzung nas/ spu bo brag gad ljongs brgyud kong po'i gnas rten rnams dang co ri grub thob kyang dngos su mjal bar mdzad cing dbus gtsang du byon/ jo shāka rnam gnyis sogs gnas rten mtha' dag mjal skor mchod 'bul dang / yongs su 'dzin pa'i dam pa du ma las 160

gsar rnying ris med kyi chos rgyun mang du bzhes/ shang stag snar tre bo sprul pa'i sku chos kyi dbang po las zab chos 'ga' zhig gsan skabs kun mkhyen jo nang pa'i gsung 'phros zhig gi sad byed kyi rkyen byas thugs dam la bogs thon zhing de'i lta grub la nges shes khyad par ba 'khrung ste/ byang lha rtse'i 'bras spung dgon du chos rje kun bzang dbang po las dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chen tshar mang po dang / dbu ma'i lta khrid/ sbyor drug gi khrid/ khrid brgya sgrub thabs rin 'byung / sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma/ ne gu'i chos skoraglu/ rje btsun dam pa tā ra nā tha'i bka' 'bum sogs jo lugs kyi gdam skor rgyun gang bzhugs tshang bar gsan/ kun mkhyen dol po pa'i skabs thugs sras ma ti rnam gnyis las sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi sprul pa yin zhes chos rje kun bzang dbang po'i ngos bzung / rig 'dzin rje nyid rang ni yang srid snga ma ting skyes rgyal po'i sras 'jam dbyangs ye shes rgya mtshor 'khrung pa'i sngon nas rje dran gyis jo nang pa'i bstan pa la thugs zhen che ba yang de'i dbang gi yin zhes gsung / grub dbang pad+ma nor bu'i yang srid du grags pa ni thugs rgyud ngo bo gcig la sprul pa'i snang ba tha dad du bstan par bzhed/ dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub mchod 'dzugs pa dang / mchod khang rnams su mchod me'i rkyen dngul bre chen mang po sbyor 'jags mdzad pa'i rgyun da lta yang yod 'dug mdo khams dang /kong po/ zab phu lung sogs nas zab gter 'ga' zhig kyang bzhes/ gter ston gyi bla ma lnga dang 'jal naske/ rten 'brel 'grig nas lho brag gnam skas can nas mchog gi gter lnga bzhes rgyur gter ston bde chen gling pa las gzhan rnams ma 'jal bar rten 'brel dus las yol ste mchog ste lnga bzhes ma thub/dag snang bla ma sku gsum ma dang / yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i bsam lhun man ngag bcu gsum ma/ gsang lam tshe sgrub/ lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ gcod yul rgyas bsdus sogs dgongs gter khyad par can 'ga' zhig mchis/ gtsang stod gye re lo tsā ba bkra shis rnam rgyal las/ sgra rig /snyan dngags/ skar rtsis rnams gsan cing rang bzhed rgyud rtsis gtsor 'don gyi rtsis gzhung gsar du mdzad par rig 'dzin grub pa'i rtsis su grags/ spyi bla ma lnga phrag drug tsam lhag bsnyen te mdo sngags gsar rnying gi chos tshul rgya cher gsan cing / khrid rgyun so so ba dang / khrid rgyun ngo bo gcig kyang brgyud khung tha dad pa rnams khyon bsdoms khrid bka'i rgyun brgya dang brgyad bcu la nye ba bsan pa dang / phyag rgya chen po'i khrid rgyun rang yang rags rtsis kyi sum cu so brgyad gsan pa yin zhes gsungs/ gangs can gyi mgon po rgyal mchog bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i thugs rjes/ gzigs pa tshad med pa dang thugs yid 'dre bar gyur/ mi dbang pho lha ba bsod nams stobs rgyas yab sras dang mchod yon du gyur cing / sras gung dang wang sku mched 'khrugs skabs dang de rjes dpon po dā las bā dur rgya nag nas dgongs tshom chad pas nyen skabs 161

sogs snga phyir mi stong phrag long pa sogs srog gi 'jigs pa chen po las skyabs/ dga' bzhi gung paṇ+ḍi tas lo gcig tsam bod kyi srid skyongs gnang skabs gzhan gyi dbyen bcos te gzhungs nas bka' 'dri shin tu lci ba brgyad kyi mtshon pa'i bka' skyon gyi thugs bsun phyung kyang zhum pa med pa'i grangs thad kyi rgyu mtshan dngos dang brgyud nas rgya cher gsol bas dbyings 'khrel gzhi med du grol zhing / tshul des rnying ma bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa'i srog 'thud pa lta bu'i bka' drin bskyangs/ bal yul mchod rten bya rung kha shor gyi zhig gso dang / rang byung mchod rten chen po shing kun gyi nyams gso rlabs chen zla med pa mdzad/ de dus mnga' ris mar yul rgyal po nang 'khrugs pa'i rkyen gyi stod hor kla klo'i dmag bod du lhags par gdon mi za ba na/ gzhung sa mchog gi bkas bskul te 'ching sgrig pa la 'phebs dgos shar/la dwags rgyal po nang zlum pa'i 'ching legs par 'grig cing stod hor gyi dmag dpung phyir bzlog pas bod yul gyi bstan 'gror phan bde'i ngal gsor 'god pa'i mi 'jigs pa'i skyabs kyi sbyin pa chen po'i bka' drin mdzad 'dug kyang deng sang ni sbrang bu'i skad tsam mi sgrog par snang / tshur phu'i pad+ma khyung rdzong du bzhugs skabs mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan bzhin karma pa byang chub rdo rje'i yang srid bcu gsum pa bdud 'dul rdo rje'i ngos 'dzin dang rjes su zab chos kyang mang bar phul/ bka' 'khor lo tha ma nges don snying po'i mdo nyi shu'i glegs bam drug mdo smad sde dger par du sgrub nas pho brang chen po po ta lar phul te bzhugs su gsol/ sku tshe'i stod du gangs can ljongs kyi stod smad bar gsum gyi gnas che phra thams cad mjal bskor dang chos rgyun rnam dag gsan bzhes/ 'ga' zhig tu sgrub pa nyams bzhes kyang mang du mdzad cing gzhan phan gyi 'phrin las rgya cher spel/ he ru ka'i chas dang bcas gnyan khrod brgya rtsa 'grim / bka' gter gyi chos srungs dang / 'jig rten gyi lha chen po rnams dang / gar phebs su gzhi bdag lha 'dre thams cad dngos nyams su 'du zhing 'ga' zhig dam 'dogs srog snying bzhes/ rdzu 'phrul gyi sku dang phyag zhabs/ phyag mkhar gyi rjes sogs mang du bzhag sku tshe'i smad du dbus gtsang / stod mnga' ris/ glo bo stod smad/ bal yul/ skyid grong bcas su rgyal bstan spyi bye brag 'gro phan kyi 'phrin las rlabs chen phyogs brgyar bdal zhing 'brel tshad don ldan du mdzad/ mtha' dbus kyi rgyal po dang rgyal phran bcu phrag gcig dang gsum gyis gus pas btud/ mthar bal yul shing kun mchod rten nyams bso'i srog shing gtsug nas nyams gso'i 'jug cung zad 'phro can du gyur pa zhal slob rnams su bka' chem nan tan du stsal te skyid grong gi byams sprin gtsug lag khang dang nye bar dngos grub phug zhes pa'i dgon du rab byung bcu gsum pa'i na tshod ldan zhes shing mo phag gi lo khrums zla'i dmar phyogs kyi tshes bcur mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan/ dgos dbang gi lo gsum du nye bar gsang rgya shin tu 162

bsdams shing sku dngos bzhugs pa'i tshul du lo ri sprul pa'i sku chos kyi rgya mtsho sku mtshams bcad rgyar bzhugs shing / de'i ring sku gdung rin po che dpal khud dpal mo chos sding dgon du bo dang 'jig bral chen po'i gzim khang dkar por grags par mi mngon pa'i tshul gyi bzhugs/ bal yul rang byung mchod rten shing kun gyi nyams gso'i 'phros rnams zham ring gi gtso bo mchod dpon bstan 'dzin rdo rje'i thugs khur bzhes shing rje 'brug pa rin po che gong ma bka' rgyud 'phrin las shin rtas rgyab gnyer mdzad de me glang lo nang mthar phyin par grub rjes/ dpa' bo rin chen rdo rje gtsug lag dga' bas rab gnas mnga' gsol mdzad/ de rjes sku gdung rin po che bka' chems bzhin mang yul ri bo dpal 'bar gyi rtse gdan drangs dpa' 'brug rnam gnyis lhan rgyas kyi zhugs 'bul mdzad cing sku gdung lha sku rang byon dang ring bsrel bsam gyi mi khyab pa 'byon par grags/ gdung rten rdo rtsigs kyi byang chen mchod rten phal thog gsum gyi tshad gser gdung dang bcas pa bzhengs bar rab gnas kyi mtha' rten pa'i dgongs rdzogs rgyas par gnang nas dpa' 'brug rnam gnyis bod du chibs kha bsgyur/ rje 'brug pa rin po ches gnas chen rtsa ri/ gcig car phag mo'i lha khang du dngul gdung dpal reg pa med pa'i mchod rtenaske/ dpa' bo rin po che'i tshul phur gdung rten dngul gdung / spo rong rje dbon gyi dpal mo chos sding du gser gdung thog tshad ma sogs gzhan yang thugs sras slob sbyin dag gis rang rang gi gnas su so so'i gdung rten re bzhengs par mdzad ces grags/ gang gi gsung dang thugs las sprul pa'i sras ni/rgyal dbang karma pa bdud 'dul rdo rje/ 'brug pa thams cad mkhyen pa bka' brgyud 'phrin las shing rta/kun mkhyen si tu rin po che chos kyi 'byung gnas/ dpa' bo gtsug lag dga' ba sogs rtsod bral gyis skyes chen rnams gtso bor bzhugs shing / gzhan mdo khams stod smad nas/ mnga' ris la dwags tshun gyi spyir grub mtha' ris med dang / lhag par rnying ma bka' brgyud pa'i lugs 'dzin gyi zhal slob du ma gyur pa 'ga' yang med cing sgyu skar gyi grangs la 'gran par gyur/ gsung 'bum mang du byung bar nges kyang yig char 'khod pa ni pu ti lnga lhag tsam zhig bzhugs mchis so/ /sku'i skye srid phyi ma de wi ko ṭa te lho brag tu 'khrung pa'i lung bstan bzhin yang srid zhig bltam par rje dpa' bo rin po che'i lung bstan du 'ang byung 'dug kyang de ma thag bar gcod rkyen dbang gis zhing khams gzhan du 'phos par mngon/ sprul pa'i rnam pa tha dad pa ni o ṭi ya na'i yul dang / gangs can bod ljongs 'dir yang sna tshogs zhig 'byon par gsungs la/ de nas sprul gzhi pad 'byung nam mkha'i snying po nyid kyis thugs kar nyi ma la zer bzhin 'dus te ma 'ong pa na nam mkha' rnam par bkod pa'i zhing du de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha' rnam par rol pa zhes bya bar mngon par rdzogs par 'tshangs rgya bar gsungs so/ /de ltar sku gsung 163

thugs yon tan phrin las phyi nang gsang gsum gyis rnam par thar pa bsam gyi mi khyab pa ni 'phags pa rnams kyi spyod yul las gzhan du tshangs pa'i lce brgyas bskal pa brgya phrag tu brjod kyang ngo mtshar ba'i yon tan zad par mi nus shing rnam par thar pa rgyas pa sngar khrigs chags su 'khod pa zhig kyang mi snang bas zhib tu spro bar ma 'tshal la 'dir sa bon tsam zhig mtshon par byas pa ni de tsam mo/ /grub dang rig 'dzin 'bum gyi brgyan gyur pa/ /zla med bla ma tshe dbang nor bu des/ /rnam thar ngo mtshar dpag yas kun gsal mtha'/ /gzhal nus stobs bcu mnga' rās rgezharno gyi smren/ /'on te deng dus kha ba'i ljongs 'di na / /mtshan tsam thos 'dzin yul du dkon mthong zhing / /gang gi mdzad pa'ang phyogs lhung log snang gi /blun po'i cal sgrogs rjes su phal cher 'brang / /de phyir skal bzang mos ldan kun dga'i tshal/ /mdzes byed rtogs brjod zol med chu 'babs su/ /cha tsam brjod las dge tshogs gang thob pa/ /bdag kyang tshom bu gcig tu rjes 'dzin shog / ces pa 'di ni gtsang dga' ldan phun tshogs gling gi slob dpon zur pa sdom brtson rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po blo bzang mthu stobs zhal snga nas kyi bkas bskul ba'i ngor rig 'dzin rje nyid kyi zhal gsung rnam thar kha thor chab shog gsung 'bum sogs thor bur gsal ba mthong thos su gyur pa dang / chos sras dang dngos slob dam pa rnams kyi zhal khyun tshad thub las byung ba blo yul du 'ga' zhig nges pa rnams don la sgro ma btags par sa bon ze reg tsam du bya bral ba chos kyi dbang phyug gi 'bru mang zhes pa sa pho stag lo'i dus 'khor ba'i lo mgo nag pa zla ba'i yar tshes 8dge bar phun gling gi 'dabs zhol rgyal byed tshal du sug bris su bgyis pa 'dis kyang gang gi gdul byar gyur pa'i mos ldan rnams kyi dad pa dpyid kyi dpal mo'i lang 'tsho 'phel ba'i rgyu gyur cig dge'o// 164

༄gi/bit+yādhāreshwaramaṇiḥsubedanaṅgamatradzalpatisad+dhasmyuyamatibartatekathamabadārnapar+shatasba ṣan+ta rasroṣadhi pa ram nāmabi ha rati sma/ /༄ོ /rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu yi rang myong legs nyes cha shas tsam smos shing dam pa'i chos la blo gzhugs pa'i gros 'debs rtogs brjod ri thang mtshams kyi sman mchog ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ swā ste/ rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gtso bla med bla ma mchog /rgyal kun thugs 'phrin las chig bsdus 'dren pa mtshungs med dpal/ /ho ru ka chen 'phur 'gro mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang / /thor cog can zhes pad+ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi thugs nyid kun bzang sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i gar/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes drangs thad ston pa'i lam/ /rmad byung rdo rje snying po ci bzhin ston mkhas pa/ /dri med bshes gnyen 'od zer 'gyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thub dbang bstan pa he ru ka yi brtul zhugs che/ /spyod pa'i rgyan du pad+ma 'byung gnas re 'ga' mtshan/ /nag po spyod pa zhes byar ston nas rmad byung sngags/ /mchog gi lam mkhan gang der snying nas 'dud phyag 'tshal/ /grub pa'i dngul chus lcags la cung zad reg pas gser khams bzhin/ /mtshan tsam kho na dag gis byin gyis brlabs pas kyang 'di lta/ /mngon mtho nges legs dpal kun ster mdzad mgon po bka' drin can/ /grub chen nam mkha' snying por rtag tu phyag 'tshal bdag byin rlobs/ /gang khyod zhi la gnas min 'gro la sman ched du/ /sprul pa'i bkod pa rtag 'char dus 'dir grub kun gyi/ /'khor los bsgyur mdzad dran pas 'khrul bcom kun bzang zhal/ /mgon gcig pad+ma bde chen gling la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de dang tha dad mi mnga' rgyal ba kun gyi yab/ /gsang 'dus 'khor lo sdom pa 'jam dpal rdo rje sems/ /mi zol skye sprul rgyal gsang rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i bdag /karma rig 'dzin zhabs rdul bdag gi spyi bos len/ /de bzhin bka' drin gsum nod nus ldan sgyu 'phrul puh+ye'i mtshan/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas mchog dang gnyis med chos rje kun bzang dbang / /yon tan bkod pa'i zhing bdag mngal spang sprul sku chos kyi dbang / /he ru ka dpal gor+ṣa nā tha la'ang phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhan yang dbang bskur rgyud bshad shes rgyud bkrol/ /man ngag lung ston bskang dang 'dren pa'i slob dpon che/ /thar pa'i lam ston bka' drin can gyur bla ma'i tshogs/ /kun la rab tu dngas bas phyag 'tshal byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes phyag 'tshal ba sngon du song nas/ 'dir brjod par bya ba ni rang nyid 165

kyi ngang tshul cung zad gleng ba ste/ de yang bdag 'dra phyogs kun tu 'khyams shing las kyi 'phen pas bla ma'i gzugs su brdzus kyang / rang sems la rang dbang ma thob pas na/ 'khrul pa'i cho rol legs nyes bya ba sna tshogs la spyod pa zhig ste/ tshul de ji lta bu zhe na kho bo cag lus rten 'di la rnam par rtog pa mtha' dag chos nyid dbyings kyi ye shes g.yo med klong du ma grol bas/ rnam rtog gi bskyod pa'i las kun glo bur dri ma nyid du grub nga sa na/ dri ma kun 'khrul pa'i cha shas las ma 'das phyir/ 'khrul pa'i ro chol du de phyir btags te spyir 'khrul pa de ltar la yang bdag 'dzin nyon mongs rang kha yi rnam par rtog pas spyad pa la nyes spyod zhes dang / ma 'khrul pa'i chos nyid kyi lam la dmigs pa'i rnam rtog gi spyad pa'i las la legs spyod zhes su bzung bar bya ste/ de yi phyir bya ba legs nyes sna tshogs la spyod zhes pa'i don des bstan pa yin la/ bdag gi rtog pa brjod pa mtha' dag yang ngang tshul de las mi 'da' bas na—/ kho bo'i lo rgyus rnam pa thar chags su bkod pa kun gyi spyi don du 'di nyid bzhag pa yin gyi kun tu nges par bya la/ de lta na yang deng sang kha cig grub rtags la thogs pa med tshul dang / yi dam zhal gzigs shing mkha' 'gro'i gsang lung phebs pa yin zhes dang / mngon mkhyen sgrib med yod ces snyan pa'i rnga sgra drag tu rgod par byed na yang bdag ni de lta bu'i yon tan mtshar du dngar ba gang yang ngom rgyu med kyi/ ci phyir zhe na ye shes kyi rnam shes zil gyi non pa snang sems ro mnyam du ma shar bas grub rtags gzhan lta ci/ dgun gyi zan 'khyag la swos theb pa'i grub rtags tsam yang med lags/ de bzhin sgrib gnyis kyi bag chags 'thugs pos g.yogs pas/ yi dam gyi lha zhal dngos su ni ci la mjal/ mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan ni dam tshig gtsang ma la 'byung bar gsung pas bdag ni dam tshig deng sang dus la dpags pa'i bsrung lugs rang blos ci nus byas kyang sngon byon dam pa'i rnam thar la dpags na gzhung nas gsung bzhin phra rags mtha' dag tshul bzhin ni 'grub par dka' bas mkha' 'gros gsang lung bstan pa yang kho bo cag lta bu shin tu dkon mod/ mngon par shes pa ni bla ma lha yi byin brlabs zhugs pa'i stobs ni gzhir bzhag gnas skabs zhi gnas lhag mthong yun du bsgom pa dang rtsa rlung thig le la sbyangs pa 'bad brtson bgyis pa'i gsal snang dang / sngon nas sgrib pa bag chags kyis srab pas gzhan brgyud shes pa sogs mngon shes rjes mthun che 'bring chung ngu ji rigs yong bar gsung kyang bdag la ni yon tan de rnams mi ldan pas mngon shes kyi rigs ci la bdog des na mngon gyur gyi yon tan de 'dra med bzhin yod brdzu ba'i mi chos bla ma'i rdzun gyi rtsa ba'i pham ltung bsgrub nas mnar med dmyal ba'i bud shing du skal par sdod nus pa'i snying khams ni med pas smra bar ga la spob/ des na lo rgyus sam rnam thar ni gdul bya'i dngas ba 'dren pa'i ched du yin kyang / nged la ni ngo mtshar ba'i gtam mang po 166

brjod du med pas na kho bo'i ngang tshul la sus kyang re che ma byed cig de lta na brjod rin mi chog bzhin dus kyi gron du ji phyir 'bri zhe na rmongs zhen can mang pos khyod kyi rtog pa brjod par gyis zhes yang yang rna ba'i tsher mar gyur pa sel ba'i slad dang rang nyid kyi bya ba ma nor ba dang / nor 'khrul du gyur pa gsong por brjod pa la rten gzhan rnams kyi spang blangs kyi 'jug sgo la phan par yang srid bsam nas rang nyid kyi ngang tshul rnam dkar gyi bag chags cung zad sad pas rang sems rmu rgod du ma btang bar chos phyir zhus btag rang blos ci lcogs su bgyis nas thar lam la blo kha cung zad phyogs pa'i ngang tshul lhug pa sgro bskur dang bral ba rang rgyus rang gi che ba nas cha shas phra mo zhig ngo mtshar yod med gang ltar yang brjod par bya ste/ de yang dam pa rnams ni yon tan yod kyang khengs bskyung gi med par rdzu bar mdzad cing / dam pa ma yin pa rnams yon tan med kyang yod par brdzu bas dus 'da' ba rang rang gi ngang tshul du grub mod/ kho bo ni dam pa mchog ma yin par rang gi rang la nges pa rnyed pa zhig lags pas ngo mtshar yon tan med la de yi kheng bskyung ni ma dgos/ nyon mongs rang rgyud kyi nga rgyal ni mgo brnyol gang thub dgos rgyur gda' yang mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa ma thob cing dus snyigs ma nyon mongs hrag pa'i skabs su skyes pas mgo bsnyol ba'ang dka' por bda'/ dam pa ma yin kyang rang gi sngon bsags bsod nams dang rtsa ba'i bla ma'i thugs rje la brten/ rgyal ba'i gsung la yid ches pas rang 'dod snying la gab nas gzhan mgo bskor ba'i zag zog gi bya ba ni byed par mi 'gyur zhing sngar yang de 'dra spyod pa'i las la 'gyod dgos su gyur pa yang ma mchis/ des na rang gi cha rgyus la rang nyid zhib pas rang myong thun mong ma yin pa cha shas re yang gleng na nyes par mi sems la drang por brjod pa'i gtam ni gshin rje chos rgyal spyan sngar 'brim par gyur pa dang / sgro bskur med pa 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pas kyang gnang bar grags mod/ 'on kyang mdo nas dge ba gzugs brnyan par gsung pa'i rnam pa bsgro bkur bral ba'i gtam yin pa la/ ngo bos 'gro ba log lam du bkri ba dang / gsang sngags kyi tshig khrom du 'khyar ba sogs ni mi rung gi/ de dag gi ngan 'gro mi bzod pa'i rgyu bsags pa'i phyir ro/ /des na bya bral rigs sngags 'chang ba rang nyid kyi rtog pa brjod pa 'di la yang de lta bu'i skyon gyi sbags pa mchis srid na dpang gyur rgyal ba sras bcas kyi spyan sngar mthol zhing bshags kyi 'di phyi'i sgrib pa med par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de ltar rtsom par dam bca' nas brjod pa'i dngos po la/ spyi don gsum du bzhag te/ de yang kho bo kun gzhi bag chags can gyi yid lus rigs drug gi duḥkha yang yang zo 'khyud 'khor mar brgyud bzhin sa las gnas skabs dus nyi tshe ba la sku skyer btags pa'i gtam 'ol spyi'i rjes su 'brang ste sngon gyi gnas cung zad gleng ba 'phros thung tsam dang / skye ba 'dir sngon gyi las smon phral gyi 167

rkyen la rten nas da lta yan chad legs nyes kyi 'jug sgo sna tshogs spyad pa las 'phros pa'i gtam rags pa zhig brjod pa dang / phyin chad thar pa mchog tu gyur pa'i dam pa'i chos la blo gzhol nas lhag bsam gyi gzhan phan rgya chen po sgrub par smon pa'i gtam gyi sbyor ba cung zad spel ba ste/ de ltar don mtshan gsum du gyur pa de kun gyi spyi chings kyi tshul du gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rnam par bzhag pa sa bon tsam zhig thog mar bkod par bya la/ de yang ji ltar zhe na 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos ma lus mi lus lus pa med pa thams cad kyi 'char gzhi thog ma mtha' ma med pa dus bral gnyug ma la gdod ma'i ming btags pa yang ni ye shes spros pa thams cad dang bral zhing 'dus ma byas pa smra bsam brjod pa'i yul mtha' dag ye stong rtsa bral ka nas dag pa chos kyi rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba gzhi dbyings chen po de las gzhi snang lhun gyis grub pa'i sgo ma 'gags cir yang 'char bas ye thog gdod ma'i kun tu bzang po gzhi las 'phags pa gzhi snang gi dag pa rang rig ye shes chen po'i sgor zhugs nas sgrib pas gos ma myong reg ma myong 'khrul ma myong bar ma 'khrul rang ngo rang shes rgyal ba yongs kyi spyi dpal spyi mes yongs grub thig le chen por rang sangs rang rgyas kun tu bzang po mchog tu grub cing grub pa de las ma g.yos bzhin du rgya chad phyogs lhung med pa khyab brdal zangs thal chen por snang srid yongs kyi mgon dang bcud dang dngas ma snying po dam par bzhugs pa'i byin brlabs thugs rje nus pa la brten nas/nam mkha'i mthar thug pa'i ris med pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag pa thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'bras bu sgrub rung la bsgrub pa'ang glo bur 'khrul rtog gis shun pa gsal bar byed nas rang rig bde gshegs snying po gdod nas bzhugs pa de nyid mngon du byed pa las gzhan ma yin gyi/ glo bur gyi dri ma gsal bar byed pa bde gshegs snying po'i mdangs 'od ste thabs kyi rgyud zhes rgyal ba thabs la mkhas shing thugs rje chen po'i 'phrin las rang byung gi snang bas grub par gyur pa de yi sems can mtha' dag byang chen gyi sa la sbyor bar byed cing glo bur gyi dri ma can dang dri ma dag rim la so skyes mos spyod dang /mthong sgom rgyun mtha'i 'phags par theg chen pas dang gzhan nyan thos skye 'phags dang rang rgyas 'phags pa sogs spang rtogs mtho dman la byung ba'i rnam pa 'jam klas pa dang sangs rgyas kyi sgyu 'phrul gang la gang 'dul gyis sku bsam gyis mi khyab gdul bya'i don du snang bar mdzad pa'ang ste/ de yi tshul yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kho na'i spyod yul du gyur pa las gzhan gyi dmigs bsam blo re las 'das pa nyid du grub mod/ mthar thug bsgrub pa'i 'bras bu zhes pa yang rang gi ngo bo bri ba dang gang ba med pa gdod ma nas lhan cig skyes pa bde gshegs snying po'i mtshan can rang byung rig pa zab gsal bde ba chen po byang chub kyi sems de kho na nyid nges pa'i dbyings gang yin pa de sngon du gyur cing 168

rang sar grol ba la 'bras bu spang ba dang rtogs pa'am bral ba'am smin pa mthar thug pa gtsang bde rtag pa bdag gi pha rol tu phyin pa dpal kun tu bzang po'i go 'phang thob pa zhes bya'o/ /de ltar sangs rgyas pa rnam pa tsam du gzugs sku gdul bya zhing khams smon lam tha dad pa ltar snang yang / don dam par chos kyi sku ro mnyam pa nyid dang gnyis snang las 'das pas thams cad ngo bo gcig pa kho na yang yin te/ de yang dang po'i blo can gyi blo yul du re zhig go bde bar bkri ba'i ched du phyogs tsam mtshon par smos na/ dpe ni rnal 'byor rmi lam sprul bsgyur byang ba zhig gi lus kyi bkod pa gcig char du bzhi dang —/ brgyad dang / bcu drug gi mtshon ci tsam sprul pa de rnams bya byed rnam 'gyur mi 'dra ba re re byed par bstan yang / ngo bo rmi lam gyi skyes bu gcig gi cho 'phrul du snang ba dang 'dra ste/ de ltar rnal 'byor pas rmi lam dang dngos kyang rung lus kyi bkod pa der gnyis snang 'gags pa yang ma yin la/ de bas kyang grub pa thob ste sa dang po la gnas pa zhig gi lus brgya phrag tu snang nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgyar zhugs pa sogs kyang gnyis snang dngos spangs zin yang bag chags phra mo'i rgyun tsam ni yod pas sa gzhan rnams kyang mtshon la/ sangs rgyas kyi gnas skabs su gnyis snang gtan nas spang pa yi gsang ba gsum yang mkha' khyab tu gyur pas na/ don dam par sangs rgyas rnams gcig dang tha dad kyi dbye bas dpyad du med la/ des na dmigs pa'i yul las 'das shing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas su yang dag par shes bya ba'i yul lo/ /'dir smras pa/ kun gzhi kun la khyab pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /ka dag gdod ma'i ye shes gnas lugs don/ /ma 'khrul rang byung sangs rgyas kun tu bzang / /nyag gcig zang thal kun khyab bde ba che/ /spros bral 'od gsal g.yo med mnyam yang ngang / /'bad rtsol med par 'gro don rgyun mi chad—/ /rgya chen mdzad pa nam mkha'i pha mthar thug /rnam pa thams cad chos sku'i klong nyid las/ /brtag dpyad blo yi ra ba las 'das te//'khor 'das ro mnyam gcig dang tha dang bral/ /glo bur gnyis snang srid mas bcings pa la/ /'khor 'das so sor bde sdug bden par grub/ /rmi lam sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor ngo shes bzhin/ /gnyis snang rang gi ngo bos ma grub pas/ /ngo bos gzhan stong chos dbyings snying po'i khamasaske//dus gsum 'pho 'gyur bri gang med pa ste/ /gang de'i rang nyid rtog med dbyings 'jog na/ /rtog bcas dri ma chos nyid dbyings su grol/ /gshis lugs ye shes khams dmigs mnyam bzhag la/ /goms par byed de lam zhugs rnal 'byor grags/ /glo bur dri ma sangs nas ye gdod ma'i/ /gnas lugs yongs grub kyi chos dbyings chen po/ /rang ngo rang grol sku dang ye shes kyi/ /rtsal kha rgyas tshe 'bras bu zhes su grags/ /de ltar rgyu lam 'bras bu don dam khams/ /thig le yang dag gsang ba'i don 'di nyid/ /cung zad go yang blo gros cher bskyed nus/ /tshul 'di deng sang gzhan gyi rtogs dka' yang / /sngon bsags 169

las smon rtsa ba'i bla ma yi/ /thugs rjes mtshams sbyar shing rta che 'ga' yi/ /byin rlabs zhugs mthus tshul 'di ma nor go/ /nyung ngu'i ngag gi gsal dag 'dus par smras/ /tshe gang thos bsam byas pa'i yus can dang ske/ /tshig skam skyor 'dzin rtog ges sbos sogs kyis/ /rnyed par dka' ba'i gnas kun bla ma yi/ /rnal 'byor mchog la 'bad na rtogs par nges/ /zhes so/ /de ltar spyi chings tshul du bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi byang chub mchog bsgrub pa la shes par bya ba'i gnas gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rnam bzhag sa bon tsam bstan zin nas/ da ni rang nyid kyi rtog pa brjod par spyi don rnam pa gsum du bzhag pa yi/ dang po khyod kyi sngon gyi gnas ji lta bu zhig yin dri bar byed pa rnams la/ kho bo cag gi sngon gyi gnas skye ba yin lugs da lta'i ngang tshul 'di yi rjes su dpag ste sgro bskur bral bar smra na 'di lta ste/de yang gdod ma'i rang bzhin sangs rgyas sems can thams cad kyi spyi gzhi dmigs bsam brjod pa'i yul dang bral zhing / dus dang cha dang phyogs las 'das pa ste mtshan nyid rgyu yi theg par don de 'khor ba thog ma med pa zhes su btags bzhin las gzhi las 'phags te gzhi snang lhun grub kyi sgo brgyad las shin tu phra ba'i rlung gi cung zad bskyod pa la rten rang ngo ma shes pas ma dag 'khor ba'i sgor/ rlung sems rang bzhin rtogs tshogs nyon mongs rag pa la rten/ snod bcud brten brten tshul du shar nas/rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi 'khor lo lu gu rgyud bar med du brgyud de khams gsum 'khor bar yang nas yang du 'khor ba'i duḥkhas mnar te/ de yang res zhe sdang gi dbang gi dmyal bar skyes te tsha grang gi sdug bsngal tshad bzung med par yang myong bar byas shing / de bzhin res ser sna 'jur gegs dbang gi yi dwags su skyes nas bkres skom sogs kyi mnar ba dang / res gti mug dbang gi byol song gi skye sgo grangs med par rmong zhing bkol spyod sogs sdug bsngal tshad las 'das pa dang / res phrag dog dbang gi lha min gyi 'thab rtsod sogs pa'i sdug bsngal chen pos mnar ba dang / res nga rgyal dbang gi lha yi 'chi 'pho ltung ba sogs sdug bsngal du mas mnar/ res 'dod chags dbang gi mi yi skye rga na 'chi'i sogs sdug bsngal sna tshogs pas mnar ba de ltar sdug bsngal gyi gnas su re mos kyi mnar ste/ de yang res dmyal ba sogs su skye ba gcig kho na'i yun tshad kyang bskal chen grangs med dang / bskal pa gaṅga klung gi bye ma snyed kyi grangs su bar mtshams med par sdug bsngal bas dos drag tu mnar ba dang / res ni nyin re yi yun tshad la skye 'chi brgya phrag mang po byas nas sdug bsngal drag pos mnar ba dang / yang res ni stes dbang dge ba cha mthun par spyad pa'i mthu la rten/ mtho ris su rgyal po/ blon po/ btsun mo/khyim bdag bram ze/ dam pa phal pa sogs/ bde ba'i 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa myong zhing mthar snying po med par slar yang dge ba'i 'phen pa rdzogs nas sdug bsngal drag pos mnar bad nga / res ni skye ba 170

gcig la yang bde sdug gi myong ba lha mi dbang po'i bde ba lta bu dang mnar med dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal lta bu spel mas mnar ba dang / yang skabs su ni 'jig rten pa'i bsam gtan thob ste de yi ro la myong nas bskal chen mang por gnas pa dang / de bzhin res ni sems la byung tshor gyi rtog pa dang dran sems med pa lung ma bstan gyi ngang du bskal pa grangs can dang grangs med du gnas nas de las sad de slar sdug bsngal la spyod pa ste/ mdor na khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas ris mtho dman du bde ba myong yang yid brtan ma thub/ sdug bsngal myong yang de las gzhan du gyur pa'i go skabs kyang ma snyed cing —/ de dang de lta bu'i bar mtshams med par 'khor ba'i bde sdug ltar snang ji ltar snang yang don du sdug bsngal gsum las ma 'das par 'khor ba mtha' med du 'khyams zhes dus dang yun tshad bzung las 'das shing / mdor na phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams grangs dang mtha' dang mu med pa 'dir skyes 'dir ma skyes zhes brjod du med cing / de bzhin sa yi phyogs 'dir skyes 'dir ma skyes zhes kyang brjod par mi nus la/ bdag nyid kyang sa phyogs yul phyogs gang dang gang du skye 'chi ma byas pa'i gnas cung zad kyang med par rgyal bas ga sungs bzhin pa ste/ de ltar skye 'chi sha khrag gi lus can kho na blangs pa'i gzugs phung yang bsags su yod na/ mi mjed 'jig rten khams 'dir skyes pa 'ba' zhig gi sha dang rus pa bsags pas kyang mi mjed 'di yi sa gzhi ri rab rnams kyi ltos dang mnyam la/ rnag khrag kyang rgya mtsho chen po ji tsam pa'i tshad du 'gyur na 'jig rten khams gzhan gang dang gang du skyes pa yang de snyed kyi rig pas de dang mthun pa nyid do/ /ji skad du/ sha rus bsags na 'jig rten ltos dang mnyamaske/ /rnag khrag bsags na rgya mtsho chen po tsam/ /las 'phro bsags na bsam 'das brjod las 'dasaske/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /don de yi sems can thams cad kyi bdag gi mar ma byas pa yang med la/ phar ma byas pa yang med pa kho na'o/ /de ltar 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas dus da lta la thug gi bar byas pa don med 'khor ba mtha' med kyi rgya mtsho chen por spyod pas a thang chad pa ni bdag sogs sems can so so skye bo thams cad kyi 'khrungs rabs sam skye rabs de las ma 'das pa ste/ de yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung gi rjes su 'brang nas 'khor ba'i gnas lugs sam ngang tshul de lta bur shes par byas nas nyin mtshan med par 'khor ba la skyo shas drag tu skyed de/ nges par 'byung ba thar pa'i lam la gzhol bar 'os so zhes rang gzhan tha dag la gdams pa'o/ /smrasathu pa/ 'khor ba'i rang bzhin ngo bo ma grub kyang / /'khor ba'i gnas tshul sna tshogs sdug bsngal spyod/ /'khor ba thog ma dus kyi dmigs yul 'dasaske//'khor ba spyi btsan mtha' ma med gnas kyang / /gang zag sgos btsan 'khor ba tha ma yod/ /thar pa thob tshe 'khor ba'i 'khrul 'khor 'jigs/ /'khor bas yun ring dub pa'i skyes bu khyod/ /da ni thar 171

pa'i lam du gzhol bar gyis/ /de skad rang nyid chos dang mthun dka' yang / /gzhan blo chos la bskul ba'i lhag bsam can/ /ne tso bzhin du smra ba la dga' ba/ /tshe dbang nor bu dpal de'i glu dbyangs yin/ /de ltar las bdag gi sems kyi rgyun de 'khor ba'i duḥkhas mnar bzhin pa las nam zhig na stes dbang gi dge ba rjes mthun pa mang du spyad pa'i mthu la rten de sangs rgyas kyi mtshan lan cig kho na rna bar gsal por thos par gyur pa'i phan yon las/ bde gshegs snying po'i khams brgyud la lhan skyes su yod pa'i rigs kyi nus pa cung zad sad pa'i rkyen du byas nas/ dus de nas brtsam mtho ris gnas su skye ba du ma blangs nas dge ba'i rgyu tshogs la spyod par gyur zhing / sngon gyi las kyi lhag mas mi dge ba yang spyad pas skabs dang skabs su ngan song du sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba yang myong bar gyur to/ /de lta las nam zhig na dge ba'i rgyu tshogs mang du bsags pa'i mthu gang rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i 'jug pa la brten rigs drug gi gnas gang du yang rung rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dang mjal nas dkon mchog gsum la mos pa'i bag chags 'jog pa'i skal ba can du gyur zhing / de yi dge ba'i mthu la brten phyis zhig sangs rgyas kyi bstan par zhugs nas dam pa'i chos theg pa chen po la spyod pa'i skal ba can du gyur cing de yi dge ba'i mthu chen po la brten sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i snying po 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa dang mjal ba'i rten bzang po khams drug ldan pa rdo rje'i lus kha yar thob kyang le lo'i dbang gi brtson pa chen pos tshe gcig sangs rgyas kyi sar bgrod par ma byas rung / bla ma la mos gus dang ldan cing smon lam bzang pos bag chags bzhag pa tsam byas pas de yi mthu la rten da lta yang dal 'byor gyi rten bzang po rnyed par gyur pa 'di bzhin te/ da ni phyis nas ji 'gyur ma shes pas dam pa'i chos la brtson pas mchog tu 'bad pa'i dus skabs su bab par snang ngo / /de lta ni bdag 'dra tshe dbang nor bu'i rang gi rang nyid la legs par sems nas smra ba ji bzhin pa'i 'khrungs rab sam skyes rab su brjod pa ni de kho na yin no/ /de kho na nyid yin no/ /'dir smras pa/ thog med dus 'ong pa'i gnyug ma'i lus/ /bag chags 'khor ba'i duḥkhas rtag tu mnar/ /nam zhig rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i 'jug pa yis/ /dge ba'i rigs gyur 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi/ /mtshan tsam kho na thos pas yun ring bar/ /bde ba'i go skabs bzang po thob gyur cing / /nam zhig dad pa'i sa bon bzang po rgyas/ /tshul des thar lam bsgrod pa'i stegs su gyur/ /de nas kyang ni mi dges sbags min pa'i/ /bsod nams bzang po mang bsags nus pa yi/ /dal 'byor bzang po khams drug rdo rje'i lus/ /'bras bu sngags chos mjal ba'i skal ldan gyur/ /de lta na yang le lo che gyur zhing / /brtson pa dman pas bde chen ma thob kyang / kha nyen che ba sngags kyi dam tshig zhes/ /de yi snying po bla ma'i mos gus te/ /ma nyams tshul bzhin gsol 'debs 'bad pa'i mthus/ /phun tshogs dal 'byor 'di thob 172

nges shes skyes/ /bdag ni so skye byis sba nyid yin gyi/ /yin lugs ngang tshul gsong por de skad smras/ /des na bsam bzhin sangs rgyas kun 'dus dpal/ /bla ma'i bka' drin nam yang 'khor thabs ji/ /kwa ye lam mchog gsang sngags la zhugs rnams/ /sgyug dong sbrul 'jug lta bu'i dam tshig gnyen/ /rang srog brgya phrag las lhag btsa' rigs kyi/ /snying po bla mar gus 'tshal kha chems yin/ /de yang ngos lkog ldem rgyang med pa ru/ /bla ma dgyes pa'i thabs la 'bad byas shing / /smon lam bzang por rtag tu spyod pa dang / /byang chub mchog gi rgyu ru yongs bsngo bya/ /rim gnyis brtson pa dman yang tshul de ltas/ /ring por mi thogs byang chub mchog 'bras 'grub/ /de las gzhan du phyogs na rim gnyis la/ /'bad kyang sangs rgyas lam du 'gyur ba min/ /bla ma'i mos gus gnad dang bral ba yi/ /ngan song sdug bsngal spyod do nges par gyisaske/ /dal 'byor rten 'di chu nang sbu ba bzhin/ /yud tsam gcig nas 'jig pa'i chos can ste/ /des na myur du dam pa'i chos spyod la/ /'jug brtson gyis zhes kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /rigs drug mtho dman gnas su bde dang sdug/ /spyad tshul sangs rgyas kyis kyang brjod dka' zhing / /de dag kun la snying po ma mchis na/ /gtan bde thar pa mchog la da 'jug 'tshal/ /lus 'di bor nas gar skye cha yang med/ /rten bzang dal 'byor theg chen sngags lam dang / /'phrad pa da res kho na tsam yin gyi/ /nor bu rnyed stor ma byed shes ldan rnams/ /'khor ba thog med dus nas dus da bar/ /byas pa don med snga ma de tsam yin/ /da ni 'khor ba'i las la skyo dub pas/ /bde chen btsan sa bzung na mi thad dam/ /zhes so/ /de ltar rang gi yin lugs ji lta ba'i skye rabs brjod zin nas/ da ni sgro btags la brten skye ba'i ngang tshul ji lta bu mchis zhes na/ de yang bdag skyes nas lo gsum mar btags tsam du nged nam mkha' snying po yin/bsgrub gnas lho brag mkhar chu yin zhes zer skad pa dang / de bzhin sngon gnas skye ba'i ngang tshul yin gyu'i cal col mang po zhig byis sba mno med kyi ngag nas ci thod thod byung rgyal du brjod pa las gzhan gyi bzo bcos sogs ni med nges yin/ tshul de la brten ming sku skyer bla btags par gyur te/ don du ni de dag byis sba'i bla brdol tshig tsam las ci zhig lhag par dpal chen po nam mkha' snying po lta bu ni/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes te sangs rgyas kyi sar gshegs pa ste/ de lta'i rnam rol bdag lta bu ga la zhig ste/ dge slong nam mkha' snying po yin zhes byis sba mno med kyi kha ham pa mtho ba kho na ste/nges pa'i don du nged cag lta bu'i so skye byis sba la de 'dra yi dpyad pa yi gnas tsam yang ma re cig 'on kyang mgon po des gdul bya thun mong dman pa'i ngor so so skye bo phal par byin gyis brlabs nas gzhan phan smon lam dbang gi spyod pa zhig yin par gyur na srid mtha' ma dgags so/ /de ltar yang gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi gter lung du ma nas rdo rje tshig gi lung bstan pa dang bka' drin mtshungs med 173

rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / grub brnyes dam pa mang pos mgrin gcig dang dbyangs gcig tu dpal chen po nam mkha' snying po'i sprul pa'i rnam grangs so/ /gsungs par mdzad na de de lta bur gyur cig ces rang gi yang rang la smon lam gyi yul du byas nas 'dir cung zad gleng bar bya ste/ de yang dpal chen po nam mkha' snying po de nyid nges pa'i don du gsang bdag dpa' bo thugs kyi rdo rje dang gnyis su med pas gdod ma nyid nas grub pa'i dpal chen po dngos su gyur pa zhig ste bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas dang /de bzhin dgra bcom 'phags pa nye ba 'khor dang / theg chen slob dpon chen po yon tan 'od dang /rmad byung rgyal ba'i sras po zhi ba lha dang / rig 'dzin chen po r+ghaṃ ka ra rnams kyang dpal chen po nam mkha' snying po yi skye ba'i rnam grangs de ltar 'dzin pa yin zhes mchog gi bdag nyid slob dpon chen po mang zhig gi de ltar gsung zhing rdu ka ra dang bla slob tu 'brel pas kyang mtshon/ de rnams la la dngos la la sprul gzhi'am thugs rgyud gcig par bzhed par snang ngo / /gzhan yang bod kyi rgyal po mes ag tshom can gyi sku ring du rgya phrug sang shing rta zhes byang chub sems dpa' kha gcig gi 'di sba gsal snang du lung bstan pa yin yang zer/ rta skad kyi sprul par rgya yi slob dpon mngon shes can gyi lung bstan pa der gyur nas theg pa chen po'i mdo sde kha yar spyan drangs bstan pa la phan par byas/ de 'phos pa'i skye ba nam mkha' snying po yin zhes lha ri nam mkha' 'od kyi skyes rabs rnam thar las 'byung ba yang thugs brgyud gcig par go la/ dngos gnas byang chub sems dpa' rta skad ni dpal rta mgrin dang / de yi sprul pa sang shing ta/ tshe 'phos pa'i skye ba ni dbu ru ngam lam bon gyi rigs su 'khrungs pa dge slong sngags kyi grub thob rgyal ba mchog dbyangs yin par kun tu grags so/ /des na dpal nam mkha' snying po thun mong gi gdul bya'i snang ngor dang mthun pa'i sku yi skye ba'i tshul ston dngos ni snga ma rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du bram ze'i rigs kyi yab gu ṇa sirnyi yon tan dngos grub dang / yum rgyal rigs su dz+nyā lismre masmo pa'i dpal moslas bram ze dza ta bya bar gyur te mgon po 'od dpag med pa rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes bya ba'i sku sprul pa de ma ku ta yi brag phug tu bzhugs par rin chen gser gyi pa tra maṇ+ḍal du byas nas dbang bskur ba nod pas gsang ba'i mtshan nam mkha' rdo rje zhes su btags par mdzad nas skye ba de yi 'og tu bod yul du skye bar lung bstan/ de nas gtsang gi phung po ri bo che yi shar phyogs gnub yul rong zhes bya bar yum 'chim za 'od de rgyan zhes pa'i sras su dpal nam mkha' snying po sku 'khrungs pa yin la/ kha cig nas gnyal smad sham bu mkhar du sku 'khrungs par 'dod kyang rong du 'khrungs pa 'di tshad mar gyur bar rtogs so/ /de yang dus 'khor mkhan po rnams kyi bstan rtsis bzhed pa ltar na bdag cag gi ston pa rtsa can du mya ngan las 'das nas rags rtsis lo stong dang lnga brgya tsam na rgya gar shar 174

phyogs yul u ru bi shar bram ze'i rigs las/ brtul zhugs spyod pa'i dbang po kasna pa ste nag po pa sku 'khrungs shing / gang de dgung lo brgya bcu bskor lhag tsam na bod yul lho brag dang nye ba rgya gar gyi yul ti phu ra yi phu phal skad du ka sa raṅga zhes bya ba yul nyer bzhi'i ya gyal de wi ko ṭar rnam smin gyi lus btang nas bar dor rdzogs sangs rgyas pa ho ru ka yi skur bzhengs te lo brgya lhag tsam na grub pa'i slob dpon 'di gtsang rong du 'khrungs par shes so/ /de ltar grub pa'i slob dpon 'di thog mar 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa rgyal po khri srong gi lde'u btsan gyi blon por gyur cing / de nas dam pa'i chos la yang dag par mos pas o rgyan chen po bod du spyan drangs pa'i pho nya ba yang bgyis shing / mkhan po zhi ba mtsho la shākya'i dge slong gi dngos po bsgrub dus lan gcig na slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas yar 'brog mu tig shel gyi spa ma gong du bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar byon nas rin chen gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul bar slob dpon chen pos/ kyai/ nam mkha' snying po bde'am/ zhes bka' stsal nas smin mtshams nas 'od zer byung nam mkha' snying por phog pas dran med du yug gcig brgyal nas/ sad tshe skye ba dran par byin gyis brlabs/ de nas rta gdong dkar mo thugs kyi gnas lho brag mkhar chu bod yul gyi de wī ko ṭa zhes te/dpal he ru ka lhan skyes yab yum brag ri la rang byung shin tu gsal bar bzhugs pa'i 'dab brag ri dung dkar gyi dbyibs su gnas pa'i mthar chu lcags phur can du phebs nas yang dag bkol byang gi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bar mdzad gsang ba'i mtshan ni thugs kyi rdo rjer grags/ phyis rgya gar du byon nas brag phug gser gyi bya skyib can du yang dag gi bka' bab pa'i rig 'dzin r+ghaṃ ka ra dang mjal nas/ bla med ma yi rgyud la mkhas par sbyangs nas bsgrubs pas grub pa chen po nyams 'og tu chug par gyur nas bod du byon/ mkhar chu gtso bor gyur pa'i gnyal smad dge ri la sogs bsgrub gnas du mar bsgrub pa yun ring du mdzad pa'i tshul bstan/ spyod pa'i phyag rgya lung bstan byung ba ltar gtsang rta nag nas shel dkar gza' rdo rje 'tsho sgron snyed de las kyi phyag rgyar mdzad de brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa gsum bskyangs/ de bzhin gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi bka' stsal ltar mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal la brten mi 'gyur bde ba chen po'i sku phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin yang dag par grub pa ste/ de yang gdul bya thun mong rnams kyi snang ngor sku lus de ka rags rtsis su lo brgya phrag gcig lhag nges shes par bzhugs pa'i mthar rnam smin gyi lus 'ja' ltar yal nas ye shes kyi sku nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur te/ de ltar sngags kyi phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin gyi go 'phang sgra ji bzhin pa nges par brnyes pa ni sngags rang lam gyi sa brgyad pa thob pa yin la/ gsang sngags thabs kyi spyod pa rmad du byung ba la brten mdo lam kho nas bsgrod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sa bcu pa dang dgongs spyod mnyam par gsung zhing / mdo lam gyi 175

bsgrod pa'i sa bcu pa'i yon tan ni mdo sde sa bcu par byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying pos ji ltar bshad bzhin te/ de ni ji lta bu zhig snyam na/ tshul de mdo sde der gsung pa'i don nyung ngu ngag gi brjod/gzung dang ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan tshad med par rgyas te gdul byar phan bde'i yon tan mtha' dag bskyed par byed cing / sangs rgyas ltar ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du sprul pa sna tshogs pas sems can gyi don mdzad pa dang / chos kyi dbyings la dbang ba'i gnas su rtogs shing / rnam par smin pa ni lha yi dbang phyug chen po zhes gnas gtsang ma'i dag por 'gyur ba dang / yon tan ni sa dang por sangs rgyas brgya mthong zhing brgya g.yo sprul pa brgya ston pa sogs yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis su gsungs pa bzhin 'dir ni phyogs bcu'i zhing khams brjod du med pa yang brjod du med pa'i rdul phra rab kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i yon tan de rnams thob cing / mkhyen pa ni sangs rgyas dang rjes su mthun pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa'i gnas thob ste ye shes kyi pha rol phyin pa la gtso bor spyod pa ste/ de yang gong du bshad ma thag pa ltar spyir dag pa'i sa gsum las khyad par sa bcu pa'i skyes bu yi gzugs skus 'gro ba'i don du mdzad 'phrin ni sangs rgyas nyid dang mtshungs par bshad na/ de phyir yon tan gyi tshad bzung bar mi nus pa kho na'o/ /'dir smras pa/ 'phags pa'i sar bzhugs skyes bu'i rnam par thar/ /rdo rje'i ljags ldan rnams kyi spyod yul las/ /tshur mthong byis sba'i blo yi rtogs 'dod pa/ /sbrang ma'i rtsal gyi nam mkha'i mtha' gzhal 'dra/ /gang gi mdzad pa bsam mi khyab pa la/ /brtag dpyad gnas su spyod pa rang ngal mthong ske/ /de bas ngo mtshar dpag med 'byung ba'i gnas/ /der gus mos pa'igadung shugs bskyed pa na/ /phun tshogs 'bras bu 'grub la som nyi ci/ /don de gus pas gsol 'debs 'bad par byos/ /bdag kyang tshe rabs rtag tu mgon de la/ /rtse gcig gsol 'debs byed sor smon lam btab/ /ces so/ /de ltar grub pa'i slob dpon chen po de ni gong du smos pa bzhin mkha' khyab ye shes kyi bdag nyid chen por gyur pas na sprul pa'i rnam rol 'di tsam zhes su zhig tshad bzung bar nus/ de lta na yang gdul bya yul dus su nyi tsher grags tshod tsam yang chu nang gi zla gzugs bzhin tha dad kyi tshul dang gcig tu ston pa sogs du mar snang bar mdzad pa mtha' dag gleng bar mi spob mod/ spyir yang bdag lta so so skye bor gyur pa la skye ba'i phreng ba dam pa bgrang pa ni shin tu mi mjes pa zha nye'i rdog pa la 'di yi rgyu yid bzhin gyi nor bu zhes bsngags pa'am/ mi 'os pa sprang po mdze khyer zhig la 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po 'o zhes brjod na rgyal khrims kyi nyen pa bzhin rab tu mi legs par 'di phyi'i duḥkha'i rgyur 'gyur bar yang yongs su shes shing khong du chud mod/ 'dir smras pa/ su zhig mdze khyer sprang po ngan ngon de/ /'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po yin no zhes/ /'khor los bsgyur ba'i 'bang la ston pa na/ /rgyal po'i khrims kyi nyen 176

par cis mi 'gyur/ /ches dman gang zag tha mal so so skye/ /dang po'i las can dmu to ngan ngon pa/ /kun nas nyon mongs mdze skyas yongs zin zhing / /gzhan phan rnam dag nor dang mi ldan 'di/ /grangs med bskal pa'i pha rol tshogs bsags nas/ /bdag don chos sku mngon gyur spyi bo skyes/ /gzhan don rin chen bdun ldan dung gis phyug /mi mchog de lta yin zhes su yi smra//gal te rang 'dod dbang gi smra ba po//mchis na las kyi rgyal khrims btsan po yis/ /tshe rab mang por dmyal ba'i khrims mun tu/ /'jug par nges mdo tshul 'di 'jem 'os mthong / /zhes so/ /de lta na'ang 'dir rang la bka' drin che ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rdo rje sems dpa' dang gnyis su med pa rnams kyi gsung gi lung bstan pa ni sngags kyi rdo rje slob dpon gyi gsung sangs rgyas kyi bka' ltar shes par 'os pa'i gnas dang / zol zog med pa'i zab gter gyi lung byang bslad bral rnams nas gsung pa ni mi bslu nges pa rdo rje'i tshig yin pas de don ltar kha shas cig rang nyid dad mos kyi gsos su phyag 'tshal ba sngon du byas nas smra na/ gter lung gi gsal ba ni/ kha cher bram ze rin chen rdo rje/ dwags po bsgom tshul/ lha ri nam mkha' 'od/ kaḥ thog byams pa 'bum/ tsa ri ras pa byang chub 'bum/ lho brag slob dpon e ma stag lung sangs rgyas dbon/gzho lung pa rdo rje rgyal po/ gter ston byang chub gling pa rnams te rags rim zhig go/ /gzhan ni rig 'dzin pad+ma nor bu'i skye ba bdag yin par srid tshe/ de la khams gter ston nus ldan bdud 'dul rdo rjes gnang ba'i lung bstan du/ zur chung rab shes grags/ gter ston grwa pa badz+ra/ mkhan po ston bzang po dpal/ kaḥ thog tshul khrims 'bum/ kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel/ bdag smyon kun dga' legs pa rnams skye ba'i phreng bar ngos bzung bas de kun kyang dpal nam mkha' snying po'i sprul par bzhed pa'o/ /bdag rang la dpal brtse ba chen pos bkas stsal ba ni jo nang kun mkhyen dol po pa'i thugs sras ma ti rnam gnyis kyi ya gyal de dang jo nang rje btsun dam pas byin gyis brlab pa zhig go gsung ste/ rang yang 'di phyogs su bag chags shin tu 'thug pas mad par mchis/ de bzhin bdag gi bla ma grub pa'i dbang pos khyod mkhas pa gtsang nag pa'i skye ba snang gnang ba de la bag chags sad rgyu zhig kyang 'dug de rnams ni rang re'i bye brag gi skye rgyus tshul du byung ba rags rim tsam zhig ste mtha' dag ni 'dir ma smos shing ske/ gzhan ni bod 'dir dpal nam mkha'i snying po'i sprul par gter lung sgo du mar shin tu mang bar snang ba ni brir ma lang shing / skabs 'dir ni smra yang ma dgos mod/ don du ni rang rgyud la rang gi brtag nas gzhal na gong du smos pa de rnams kyi skye ba dngos smos ci 'tshal sprul pa yang sprul gyi cha yang /ma lags rung ye shes thob pa ni ku re kyal kha'i tshul mdzad pa yang / don dam du gyur nas gzhan phan nus pas mtshon dam pa'i gsung la bsnyas pa cung zad yang mi ring zhing / don de lta bu'i bskal bzang 177

la bsam nas 'dir bkod pa las g.yo sgyu'am mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyi 'phyar ba ma yin te/ rang gi gnas tshul skye rgyud dngos bstan gong du brjod zin pa de ka'o/ /'dir bar skabs tshigs su bcad de smras pa/gang zhig rgyal ba mchog gi go 'phang la/ /nye bar zhugs nas gdul bya 'dren pa'i slad/ /gang 'dul gzugs sku'i snang snyan cir yang shar/ /'gro la brtse chen rnam thar de la ji/ /bdag ni nam mkha'i snying po'i sprul pa zhes/ /ming tsam kho na las gzhan nam yang min/ /des na dam pa'i skye 'phreng bsam 'phel gyiske//nor bu 'phreng ba ji bzhin mdzes pa la/ /so skye bdag lta zha nye'i rdog pa bzhin/ /nam yang mdzes pa'i go skabs yod ma yin/ /'on kyang nor bu ke tas reg byas pas/ /ba tshwa can kyang brgyad ldan chu bo bzhin/ /dam pa gang gi mtshan gyis dbang bskur mthus/ /mgon po de yi byin rlabs 'jug gyur cing / /gang gi 'phrin las byed pa'i 'bang gyur nas/ /'gro kun thar par gzhol byed nyid du smon/ /zhes pa yang smras so//de ltar gong du smos pa'i skyes bu chen po de dag dus snga phyi ci ltar byung mi 'khrul phyir go rim cha shas smra na/bram ze rin chen rdo rje'i zhabs ni/ mi chos kyi yul kha che ru bram ze paṇ+ḍi ta ha ri bha tra zhes pa'i sras su 'khrungs zhing rtsa ba'i bla ma in+t+ra sgo dhe chung ngu la thug yi dam 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgo nas dngos grub brnyes shing bde mchog gi bsgrub lugs srol kha gsar pa yang gtod/ khong gi bla ma in+t+ra bho dhe 'di ni rdzogs chen gsang ba snying thig gi babs gzhung du bi ma las mchod gnas mdzad pa'i in+t+ra bho de de yin par mngon/ bram ze rin chen rdo rje 'di nyid nā ro ta pa dang chung ngu nas grogs po yin la/ phyis bi kra ma'i gtsug lag khang du mkhas pa sgo drug tu grags pa'i dbus kyi rka chen gnyis kyi dang por gyur cing mthar sku tshe smad o rgyan du byon nas 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brnyes par grags/ de ni dpal nam mkha' snying po 'ja' skur gshegs nas lo skor kha shas song ba na byung bar snang / dwags po bsgom pa tshul khrims snying po ni mnyam med dwags po lha rje'i rigs dbon te dus mkhyen dang phag gru las lo drug gi gzhon zhing lha rje'i slob ma phyi tshar rnams kyi bla ma yang yin/ chung ngu nas phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa klong du gyur/ de ni kha che rin chen rdo rje 'ja' lus gshegs nas lo drug ci nye skor gcig na byon par rtogs soske/ /lha ri nam mkha' 'od ni mnga' bdag myang gi gter lung du dpal nam mkha' snying po'i skye ba dngos yin par gsungs kyang de skabs khro phu lo tsā byams pa dpal sogs nam snying gi sprul par lung bstan pa dus mtshungs kha shas yod pas de rnams las khong nyid thugs kyi sprul par rnam par bzhag par go la/ dus yang myang ral dang rag par mtshungs/ zhang 'gro ba'i mgon po brtson 'grus grags kyi thugs kyi sras dam pa yin/ zhing 'di nas 'phos te sangs rgyas nam mkha' rnam par rol par 'gyur ba zhal gyis bzhes/ rang gi dngos slob lha ri'i gdan sa mdzad pa po sangs rgyas so lha dges bya ba de khong nyid 178

kyi thugs kyi sprul pa yin par dbugs dbyung ba sogs mdzad pa ngo mtshar ches mang ba bstan dam pa de dwags po bsgom tshul gshegs pa'i lo de ka 'am de yi cung zad snga phyi tsam du sku 'khrungs pa yin/ mdo khams kaḥ thog byams pa 'bum ni/ dam gtsang byams gsum du grags pa'i ya gyal de/ de yang dam pa bde gshegs kyi zhabs thug pa tsam dang / gtso bor gtsang ston la brten nas smin grol gyi yon tan rdzogs par mdzad/ gtsang ston gshegs nas kaḥ thog gi gdan sa bzung ste gdul bya shin tu che ba bskyangasaske/ dpal karma pak+shi yang khong gi slob ma yin/ gu ru pad+mas nam mkha' snying po'i sprul pa dang / de skabs rgya gar nas spyan ras gzigs kyi sgyu 'phrul mi tra dzo ki'i nag po spyod pa'i sprul par lung bstan/khong nyid kyi kyang skye ba mang du gsungs de ni lha ri nam mkha' 'od dang sku tshe stod smad tsam las dus mtshungs su byon no/ /'gro ba'i mgon po tsā ri ras pa ni dbus g.yor po gzhung du rje lo ras kyi lcam sring gi sras su 'khrungs rtsa ba'i bla ma yang lo ras dar ma dbang phyug yin/ spub ri dang gtsang rong gnub dkar po chos lung sogs su 'gro don ci rigs pa bskyangs/ sku tshe pad+ma kho thing lha khang gi zhig bso mdzad der bzhugs/ khong ni lha ri nam mkha' 'od zhi bar gshegs pa la phyogs pa na 'khrungs bar mngonaglu/ lho brag slob dpon e ma ni rigs ni skyi ston yin/ gter ston gu ru chos dbang gi thugs las skyes pa'i sras dam par gyur zhing / lkogs gyur du 'gro ba'i don dpag med mdzad pa las mngon gyur gyi 'phrin las ni ha cang de tsam ma byung bar snang / gang ltar tsā ri ras pa'i sku tshe'i smad du byon par grub/stag lung sangs rgyas dbon zhes pa ni mtshan dngos grags pa dpal rje sangs rgyas yar byon gyi dbon yin/ byang stag lung gi brag gdong nas gu ru pad+ma kau'u ri ma brgyad kyi bskor ba'i bla sgrub gter yang bzhesaske/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa drug pa'i skabs mdo khams su byon nas ri bo che yi dgon pa btab gzhan phan 'phrin las shin tu che bar gyur/ de ni ka thog spyan snga byams pa 'bum zhi bar gshegs te lo kha shas nas byung ba'i sprul par snang ngo / /gzho lung rdo rje rgyal po ni/ gter ston dri med lhun po'i yi dam tsit+ta'i rgyan cig lung bstan nyi ma'i 'od zer las/ da lta'i gnub ban nam mkha' snying po ni: 'bri ru rdo rje rgyal ming rmu rgod 'dul: zhes 'byung ba de yin te/ gnas chen ti sgro brag dkar gyi sgo dbye ba snang zhing / 'bri gung gi rnying chos la spyod pa'i dbu yang khong nas brtsam par grags/ dgung lo drug cu rtsa brgyad bar bzhugasaske/ mung po gter ston byang chub gling pa ni gzho lung rdo rje rgyal po gshegs pa'i lo de yi phyi ma chu 'brug la 'khrungs/ gzhon nu'i skabs su sgyu 'phrul zhi khro yang phur/ sems phyogs zur tsho lugs su grags pa la sbyangs zhing phyis gter ston tshe brten rgyal mtshan gyis bston pa'i kha byang phyag tu byung ba la brten dgung lo nyer lnga bzhes skabs la stod dpal mo dpal thang gi srin mtsho'i nub byang brag bya khyung gi mchu 179

'dra ba nas kun bzang thugs gter ston nas sku tshe smad snye nam gser phug tu bzhugs par mdzad/khong rang gi gter lung du de skabs nam snying sprul pa gsum las thugs kyi sprul pa yin par bshad/ rig 'dzin rgod ldem can dang sangs rgyas gling pa dang dus mtshungs/ de gnyis ka dang khong dngos su ma mjal kyang slob mas sbrel te thugs mdza' bcug tu gyur zhing gter chos phan tshun gsan bzhes dang /dam rdzas phab rgyun gcig tu spel bar mdzad do/ /de ltar gter lung nas bstan pa rags rim gyi dus kyi go rim dang / gzhan nus ldan bdud 'dul rdo rje'i lung las byung ba'i zur chung shes grags ni snga 'gyur bka' ma la grags shin tu che zhing sbyor sgrol gyi nus pa rmad du byung ba thob pa'i bod kyi grub thob chen por gyur pa dang / gter ston grwa pa badz+ra ni mkha' 'gro dgongs 'dus gter nas 'don pa po yin zhes gsungs kyang gra sgom chos kyi rdo rje dang cig min dpyad pa las gzhan sngar cha ma 'tshal/ 'khon ston bzang po dpal ni 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i dbon sa skya'i gdung rabs rnams kyi spyi mes grags che zhing rtogs sla ba nyid do/ /kaḥ thog tshul khrims 'bum ni snga phyi gnyis byung ba'i snga ma ni karma pa rol pa rdo rje'i sku tshe'i rmad tsam du byung zhing skal ldan gyi 'du ba yang mang du bskyangs/ bka' gter gyi bstan pa rgyas par mdzad/ de yi slob ma ni kaḥ thog chos 'bum dang / de yi slob ma bu 'ber ye shes rgyal mtshan/de yi slob ma byang sems chos rje/ de yi slob ma dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ de yi slob ma tshul khrims 'bum phyi ma ste sku tshe'i smad la kung lung gnas sgo dbye zhing sgrub sde 'debs pa po yin/ kong po rgya ra nam mkha' chos kyi rgya mtsho yang 'di yi slob mar gnang / kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel ni gtsang rong chen snar du sku 'khrungs/ thog mar rong byams chen gyi grwa sar zhugs/ byams chen rab 'byams par grags/phyis 'bras yul rdzong dkar skyed mo'i tshal gyi bshad grwa btsugs/ bod gangs can gyi bshad grwa phal mo che 'di las gyes shing / khong rang gi slob ma rnams kyi rgyal sras zhi ba lha'i sprul pa dang / gtsang rong mes ston mtshon po'i skye bar bzhed/ spyod 'jug smon le'i tshig shugs kyi lung bstan par yang 'dod 'dra rung yang yod/ bdag smyon kun dga' legs pa ni/ sa skya'i gdung rigs las 'khrungs myang gi drag dmar snying po dung phyur grub par grags/ skyid rong gnas rams pa byams pa phun tshogs kyis 'bras yul skyid tshal du khong dang mjal skabs lam 'bras pa'i chos skad du khams 'dus te rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes phebs/ zhes gnas rams pa'i rnam thar du khod snang bas dus ni skyid tshal 'og ma 'debs pa po chos rje lha dbang blo gros dang rags rtsis su mtshungs par grub/ jo nang kun mkhyen dol po pa'i thugs sras ma ti rnam gnyis las sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen la dgongs so snyam shing / jo nang rje btsun gyi sku yi skye ba snga phyi rnams spyan snga byams pa 'bum pa'i 'khrungs rabs dang shin tu 'brel shing de dag dang 180

thugs brgyud gcig pa'i bla slob tu nges par gyur pa zhig go/ /mkhas pa gtsang nag pa ni 'khrungs yul gtsang jo mo nags rgyal gyi 'dab nags phug tu 'khrungs/ dge bshes phya pa chos kyi seng ge'i zhabs la thug thugs sras seng ge dgu yi ya gyal gcig ste mtshan dngos thugs rje seng ge/ 'jam dpal gyi dngos grub thob cing smra ba'i seng ger gyur kyang sngon gyi rten 'brel dang gnas skabs mi chos dang mi bstun pas zang zing gi 'du ba shin tu chung zhing chos kyi slob ma yang cher ma byung / 'on kyang mkhas pa'i grags pa ni da lta'i bar ma nyams pa der snang / sku gtsang thob rgyal du yal/ sku spur sbyangs pa'i sa de dad pas zos na shes rab chen po yong zhes da lta yang tshol nas za srol yod 'dug de lta sprul pa'i sku de rnams dang kun rdzob nyid du las smon bzang pos 'brel zhing cung zad tsam zhig bdag byin gyis rlabs par gor ma chag go snyam pa'i mos pa dang / chos nyid don dam gyi ngos nas rtsa ba'i bla mas sems lhan skyes kyi ye shes rang ngo sprad pa'i skabs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku dang rgyud ldan bla ma'i thugs kyi ye shes rang rig zab gsal dbyer med bde chen 'di ka las gzhan du ma tshol zhes gdams par mdzad cing phyag rgya chen po khreg chod lta ba'i rnal 'byor pa kun gyi de ltar khas yang len na/ dpal nam mkha' snying po yi sgyu 'phrul skyes bu de rnams kyi thugs kyi ye shes dang bdag gi sems nyid gshis lugs ngo shes pa'i cha gang yin de dang gdod nas dbyer med ro gcig tu gnas pa yin/ zhes ye shes ji bzhin dngos gnas rtogs na de lta yin mod kyang bdag rang gi ni ma rtogs rung / nyams myong phra mo'am go ba tsam la brten/skabs 'dir stong zob kyi sgo nas deng sang gi chos gzugs phal gyi spyi nor gyi tshul dang mthun par tho co chen pos la bzla bar byas so/ /'dir smras pa/ a ho/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la rtags yod pa'i/ /rnam kun mchog ldan gyi chos dbyings ye shes de/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos gdod ma'i kun bzang mgon/ /tha dad 'bri gang dang dbye ba med zhes na/ /sems can thams cad kun sangs rgyas rang bzhin gyur/ /don dam gshis lugs la 'khor 'das ro gcig mnyam/ /kun rdzob glo bur gyi dri ma spang ma spangs/ khyad par cha shas las gnas lugs gcig go zhes/ /nges don mdo rgyud dang bstan bcos kun las gsungs/ /de ka yin nas kyang yin lugs nges shes skyes/ /de tshe mgon po mchog nam mkha' snying po yang / /mkha' khyab gnas lugs kyi bdag dang dbye ba ci/ /chos nyid bzhugs tshul gyi ngang du de lta yang / /gang zag lam bden la dbye ba yod ces na/ /theg chen sngags lam la zhugs pa'i rnal 'byor par/ /dbang dus ye shes sam bzhi pa'i lam rim skabs/ /ma bcos bsam 'das kyi rig pa zab gsal 'di/ /rang ngo rang nyid kyi shes gyur 'pho ba'i dbang / /byin rlabs bla ma la brten nas thob pa'i tshe/ /snang tshul rgyu yi bla ma yang rang rig 181

gdangs—/ /don dam bla ma ni ngo bo zab gsal bde/ /rang rig rtogs tshul gyi ngo mthong 'di ka las/ /tha dad so so ru nam yang yod min cing / /rgyal kun chos sku yi bzhugs tshul 'di'o zhes/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas su 'dod pa'i nye lam mkhan/ /mtha' dag zhe 'dod cig dbyangs gcig nyid gsung na/ /de tshe kho bo yang bla mas byin brlabs mthus/ /dbang don ye shes sam bzhi pa'i lam rim nyid/ /mngon nas cha shas shig go zhing myong ba'i mthus/ /kun bzang pad+ma 'byung dngos rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /kun rdzob lam dus su mos gus mchi ma 'khrugs/ /lus srog ltos med du de phyogs gtong nus mod/ /don dam bla ma ni sems nyid chos kyi sku/ /rig pa rang ngo yi dbyings su ro mnyam na/ /dpal chen grub pa che nam mkha' snying po yang / /kho bo'i sems nyid kyi dbyings su cis mi gcig /sprul pa yang sprul gyi tha snyad ma lags kyang / /rnal 'byor nyams myongs kyis zhe kha 'grang ba'i tshe/ /gnas lugs don dam dang rjes su 'brel pa'i gtam/ /stong shob thad gog zhig thag na de 'dra mchis/ /tshul de ku re dang kyal ka'i ngang tshul las/ /ji bzhin gnas lugs su nam mkha' khab mig dang / /chu gter dkyil 'khor dang 'khyor chu ji bzhin 'gran/ /rdzas mtshungs rnam grangs su brjod la 'gog kyang med/ /gcig dang mi gcig ces tha dad khas len 'di//smyon pa'i glu dbyangs ltar tshad ma min zhes na/ /'bru chan dag pa de chos nyid gnyug ma'i khams/ /phab rkyen bzang po ni byin rlabs bla ma'i mthus/ /dge sbyor nyams myong gi drod kyi nyer smin te/ /ji bzhin rtogs pa yam cha shas zhim chang ldang / /mdo rgyud gzhung mang gi gtsang chus sbran byas te/ /thos bsgom zung 'jug gi sto ru 'thung ba'i mthus/ /sna tshogs 'gal med kyi dbang po ra yang ro/ /ku yang blo bde yi smyo glu blangs ba na/ /tha snyad tshig skam gyi 'gal rtag byed pa dang / /rtog dpyod the tshom can ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/ /lar ni don dam du gnyis snang las 'das pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yi bshul lam mchog tu gsungs/ /kun rdzob bden ngo ru bzang ngan sgyu ma ltar/ /snang tshul ma 'dres par shar la 'gog mi 'tshal/ /bar skabs su glu ru blangs pa'o/ /da dung de yi 'phros gzhan yang cung zad gleng na/ de yang bdag ma skyes pa'i gong nas lo tsā ba bai ro tsa na'i thugs kyi sprul pa'i sku rig 'dzin yongs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba chen po pad+ma bde chen gling pa'i zhal snga nas da ste lo gsum 'das shing / bzhi lnga'i khong du yul phyogs 'dir skyes bu dam pa zhig gi skye ba'i srid pa bzung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsung gi gsang ba mthon pos sgrogs par mdzad pa la skye bo phal che bas 'phya rgod kyi gnas su byas/ de nas lo bzhi pa'i khongs su bdag skyes pa na mgon po de yi gdul bya gyur pa dag gi ni bdag la sprul pa'i sku zhig snyam nas yid rtse gcig tu brton par byed do/ /gzhan yang yul der sa blas sgrogs pa lta bus rig 'dzin pad+ma ma ṇi'i sprul sku yin 'dug ces kun tu grags so/ /'on kyang gong ma'i dbon rigs rnams nas rje 182

bla ma bskal bzang sogs ni rang nyid zur bzhugs tshul gyi 'phral du do gal med tshul tsam dang / gzhan gzhung bzhugs pa tshe ni rig 'dzin gong ma de nyid kyi lung bstan ltar phal cher rang mdog bstan zin pa dang / ma gzhi nas kyang mkhyen pa zab cing rgya che ba'i rang bzhin gyis gzhan phyogs kyi sku skyes 'dra byung na dgyes tshor spro spro sag sag ni yod tshod ste dus phyis skabs nged kyi khu bo bla ma'i khung sa dmar bkra shis kyi sku skyer grags pa zhig byung ba de la bsu chang bskyal/ dar sogs kyang gnang skad thos na rang phyogs kyi sprul sku dang sku skye'i ming can 'dra byung na dgyes tshor cher med pa ni rang gshis mi yi rigs rus kyi gnas lugs su grub pa la ma mgu mkhong byed pa'i gnas ma yin zhing / bdag lta bu ni khong rnams kyi dad pa'am mi dad pa'i tshul ci 'dra bstan kyang re
