skyes bu mchog la byung ba ltar grub rtags 'byung 'dod pa dang / kha cig ni thog mar rmi lam dngos nyams su bzangaspuzang 'dra rung gi ltas than thun byung bar phyogs 'dzin rlom zhen drag po zhugs shing de gzhan la ngom ngom byed cing mthar gang yang mi yong tshe re dogs kyi yid smon mang po btang ba dang / la la ni mched grogs grwa rigs gnyen tshan sbyin bdag 'dra rang la dad gus yod khung tshos nyid cag ga ge che ge mos lung bstan bzang po byas pa yin zhes pa'am/ grub pa'am gter ston nam dam pa khyad par ba'i skye bar grags pas grub pa'i gnas tshul lkog gyur ba yod pas gsung bar zhu zhes bskul bas rang yang de lta la blo 'dod drag po ldang zhing rang mthong bcas pa dang / kha cig ni rang dang 'gran zlar 'os pa zhig la ngo mtshar byung gtam thos pas de la phrag dog gi rang la yon tan yod rdzu 'dod pa dang / yang kha cig rang nyid gzhan dang mi mnyam lhag pa'i blo 'dod 'am yang rang nyid dman pa'i rwa ba las thar te tshe 'dir kha rje za thang che ru re ba sogs te mdor na lha mjal lung bstan thos/ mngon shes shar/ thun mong gi grub rtags/ mngon gyur ba lta bu zhig 'dod pa'i brkam chags dung dung pas yid kun tu spyod par byed pa de byung phyin bar chad bdud kyi 'jug sgo ches che ba de dod tshar ba yin pas/ de ngos zin par byas shing chos thams cad sgyu mar shes pas rtags mtshan la re dogs mi byed/ tshe 'di yun ring mi gnas myur du 'jig pa rmi lam sad kha lta bur shes nas zhen pa mi byed/ deng dus yid bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa byung ba rnams skye ba snga ma dge ba'i bsod nams bsags pa las yin la/ yid la mi 'dod pa 'byung ba rnams kyang las ngan gyi 'bras bu las byung bas dge sdig la yid ches yang dag pa skyes nas 'dor len nges par byed pa'i yid gdengs su 'cha' bas bdud kyi bar chad 'jug pa las grol te byang chub lam la 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /de lta ma yin par tshe 'di'i gnas skabs kyi bde zhen la blo brtas te/ gzhi cung zad yod pa la sgro btags nas bzang rdzu'i tshig rang 'dod dbang gi smra ba ni bar chad chos min zhugs pa'i rmangs gzhi things tshar ba yin/ gzhi med par lha dang mjal zhing lung bstan mngon shes grub rtags gter kha sogs med pa la yod par thabs su rdzu btang ba ni bdud kyi bar du gcod zin nas las kyang grub pa ste/ mnar med dmyar bar bskal chen du mar bzhugs grab kyi 'byon chog ma de yin/ de ltar mi chos kyi gzhan bslu nas rang nyid phung tshab chen po la sbyor ba'i snying rul po ni sngar yang du ma byung skad la/ da lta yang mthong thos kyi gnas su ches mang mod/ ma 'ongs na yang dus dbang gi mang du ka 'gro nyen gda'/ de dag byed pa'i rgyu ni 'di snang la zhen/ rgyu 'bras ma shes 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs ma thos pas lan te/ de yang skye ba snga ma'i bsags pa bsod nams dman pas grogs ngan rkyen gyis 'byung ba yin no/ /las de ltar spyad pa rnams kyang 'dul ba yi rab byung yan chad 212

la rtsa ba'i pham pa bzhi ste mi chos kyi rdzun tshig gzhi bsam sbyor ba mthar thug tshang phyin slar bshags sdom sogs kyi gso mi gtub pa rdza be'u chags pa dang 'dra bar lus rten de'i thar pa'i dpyang thag chad pa yin par bshad rung / theg chen thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa ltar na/ las bsags pa de dag la dran pas rjes slebs kyi sba gsang med par stobs bzhi tshang ba bshags sdom drag por rtag tu 'bad na sgrib pa dag rgyu yod par bshad mod de/ de 'dra byed mkhan ni dka'/ 'gyod pa khong par cung zad skye srid kyang nged la skyon 'di byung zhes rang mtshangs ngos long mkhan ni shin tu dkon/ las chen po rnams la de ltar ma byas phyin sdig pa 'dag par yang dka'/ sngar byas pa de bshags rung phyis spyad na slar yang nyes pa snga ma yang ldog nas che ru 'gro/ des na sngar las la ngo tsha ba dang phyis mi spyod sdom pa'i ched du nyes byas ming nas thos te bshags pa gal che ste/ sdig bshags thams cad la 'dra/ lar zag zog tshab chen spyad mkhan rnams kyi stobs bzhi tshang ba'i bshags pa byed pa dka'/ de ma byung phyin mnar med du 'byon chog ma yin/ sngar rig 'dzin chen po rol pa rdo rje'i spyan sngar gter ston du rdzu ba zhig gi rang mtshangs ngos len gyi bshags sdom byed par thos pas rjes su yi rang / gzhan zog byed pa mang du mthong thos yang stobs bzhi'i bshags sdom byed skad rang ni ma thos pas yid skyo'o/ /des na gzhan phal gyi ni gang zag gi tshod gang zag gi bzung bar dka' yang / rang la bya ba lkog gyur ci 'dug ni rang gis rtogs par nus pas mi chos zag zog gi bya ba 'dres pa tsho rang sna la rang gi 'dzug mo 'dzugs nas 'gyod bshags pa spang blangs bya 'os pa rnams mi tshe yud tsam pa 'di la ma zhen par rang gis rang la snying rje drag pos 'tshal zhes kho bo rgyal khams pa'i snying gros yang dag pa lags pas gal che/ de ltar yang gzhan la brtse phyir smra ba las zog po tsho yi mtshangs la rgol 'dod de ni ma yin gyi/ ngas ta rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni rnam pa thams cad pa yin pa'i go ba tsam ni yod/ des na zog po yang sangs rgyas kyi sgyu 'phrul du dag snang sbyangs ba rung zhing zog po la mi dga' dang zhe sdang chen po zhig med do/ /bskal pa du ma ru 'grub dka' dal 'byor rten/ /phun tshogs rin chen ni mi lus thob lags kyang / /bsags pa bsod nams de dman pas bdud kyi bslus/ /mnar med dmyal ba de mtho ris gnas nas 'khor/ /kye hud ya nga ni lo zla zhag grangs med/ /yun srid bskal chen zhes thos kyang yid so ngal/ /de bas rang la ni rang gi snying rje ltos/ /'di snang yud tsam la ma zhen rang gros thob/ /zhes so/ /yang dkyus su 'jug par bya ste| de nas gdong ngan gyi lo la stag tshang gi gnas chen gro lod du bsgrub pa lhun len zhig bya snyam na yang grogs ngan stabs kyi lag tu ma long bas ci rong du 'ong nas bas mtha' rol lam du rang shong gi sgrub khang drag po e klong zhes btags pa zhig bcos nas klong gsal mkha' 'gro snying thig gi bla bsgrub gser 213

gyi 'bru gcig gi bsnyen sgrub khul tsam byas kyang gzhung bzhin bcas pa dam por ma gyur ba dang lhag tu lus yang yengs med tsam sngags bzlas la zhugs tshul gyis kyang yid rnam rtog gi dbang du bskyod pas bsgrub rtags mtshan ma ni rmi lam bzang por grub tsam yang ma byung / spyir de dus skabs rtags mtshan la re dogs chen po byas pa'i skyon yang los—yin/ phyis bsgrub pa grol mtshams sngags zlas mang nyung ji tsam song ba'i phan yon gyi ni nam yang mi bslu bas rtags mtshan ma byung na sla'o bsam pa byung bas de ni yin par yang 'dug lar bsnyen bsgrub byed par rlom nas sngags yengs shing bzlas na rtags mtshan gyi re ba ci yod/ de bas lha bsgom dang sngags la yid gtad nas rnam rtog gzhan spang ba rang gal chen du snang yang / de dus rdzogs rim yin rgyu'i go ba lam pa de ngang bzhag pas chog khungs byas te ma shes par gda'aske/ lar 'di dus skyo shas che zhing rang nyid le los chos ma grub par yid rab tu gdung ba byung bas skyo shas kyi glu yang mang du blangs/ lhag tu rmi lam du rang dbang gter gnas su mang du sleb pa dang /zab gter kha byang lung bstan dum bu yang mang du byung mod/ de yi rten 'brel gyi sgo ji bzhin pa ni bsgrigs ma nus par zad do/ /gzhan yang de skabs rang nyid ji srid 'tsho yi bar du ngo bsrung khral mjal lta bu ma yin par/ rang gi dwangs bas dbang bskur/ khrid rgyun zhus par rtsa ba'i dam tshig srog gi phyir yang mi spang ba dang / gnas skabs kyi dge sbyor tshig bdun gsol 'debs/ zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byoraske/ dzab sngags badz+ra gu ru/ yi ge drug ma/ rlung bum pa can grangs bcad rnams thog mar zla dus kyi grangs 'dzin byas pa yin yang phyis nyin zhag phrug rer byas/ lar nged brtson 'grus shin tu chung bas rang la rang yid chad pa'i mchi ma bku bar 'dug lags so/ /rang nyid le lo che la chos bskul phyir/ /mgon po ma gza' dam can dpang btsugs nas/ /dam bca' snying po rtsa ba gcig dang ni/ /yan lag bzhi bgyis dge ba byang chen bsngo/ /lhag bsam gyis zin dge ba che chung gang / /gang gā'i rgyun ltar byang chen mtshor 'jug zhes/ /rgyal bas gsung na sna re'i dge ba yang / /sangs rgyas bsgrub 'dod rnams kyi 'bad par rigs/ /de nas gser 'phyang gi lo la yi dam lhag pa'i lha bcom ldan 'das badz+ra ku ma rwa yi bsnyen bsgrub zhig kyang bgyis pas de skabs su rje gdan drung rin po che phyogs phebs mdzad par phebs skabs phyag dbang zhig zhu bar ma phyin na nged o zob byas pa lta bur 'gro zhing dgongs mi khrel ba'i nges pa med snyam blor shar nas mtshams thun bkral nas phyag dbang zhu bar phyin pas bla ma dam pa dang mched grogs shes ldan tsho mtshams dam por yod pa de mi legs tsam gsung byung yang nged rang blo chung ba'i skyon yin/ gzhan deng sang bla ma kha gcig bka' drin gsum ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma la yang ltag tshugs bzung bar bag gro gro po byed lugs la ltas na chos 'brel thob tsam bka' drin can bla ma phyogs phebs 214

zhabs bskyal la mtshams bkral nas bar chad zhugs dogs mi dgos 'dug nged kyi bla ma'i bya ba de 'dra la snying srab po gcig yod kyi zhe khams chen po bskyed nus mkhan cig min lags/ lar bsgrub pa blo bur du de ltar bkral ba ni bsgrub pa'i g.yang nyams par rgyal ba mang dgon pas gsung 'dug pa de nges par thugs mad 'dug dus phyis bsgrub pa'i 'phro lus pa re rtag tu byung / de 'dra blo gdengs bskyed nas dam bca' gang yin ma grub bar rkyen dbang gi bar ma chod par gal che 'dug bsgrub pa de skabs su sngar ltar rnam rtog dbang cher 'byams pa de ma byas khul yin yang / 'on te gzhung don ji bzhin ma rtogs pas bsgrub pa tshad ldan ni ci la 'gyur/ rtags kyi rim pa yang nad gdon thon pa'i ltas tsam las gzhan ni che ba ma byung / rdo rje rtse dgu pa rwa ma tshangs ba gcig lag tu blangs ba yang yang rmis/rwa ma tshangs ba de yi dam gyi dbang bskur zhus pa'i bla mar ldem rgyang zhig shar yod dam bskyed rim thang lhod shor ba'i ltas gang yin nam ngos ma zin/ yi dam dkyil 'khor ni nam mkha'i skar tshogs 'dra/ ngo mtshar nus pa ni rang sor che mod kyi/ /kun gyi thugs rje dang 'phrin las 'dus pa'i lha/ /bar chad kun sel zhing dngos grub stsol mngags pa'i/ /gsang bdag rdo rje 'chang rgud bral gzhon nu'i sku/ /nyi zla ltar gyur pa'i lha mchog tī la ya/ /pad 'byung yab yum gyi yi dam lhag pa'i lha/ /de yi ngang nyid la kho bos yi dam bgyis/ /'phral rkyen spyod dbang gi klu gdon zhugs cha ba/ /lha mchog de nyid kyi nus pas rang sar dengs—/ /gnas skabs cung zad re sngags bzlas de 'dra na/ /gsal gsum yun bsgom na mchog don cis mi 'grub/ /lo der bsal du nang 'khrug byung ba sogs gdan sa'i dbang gi rnam g.yeng shin tu che bas rang blo khengs pa'i bsgrub pa lag tu blangs rgyu ni bral mod/ 'on kyang dal skabs cung zad byung rim gyis bsgrub pa zhag bdun ma re bgyis shing / bar gcig rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yi bsnyen pa bdun zhag gcig byas pas/ de skabs phyis rim gyi snyan pa mnga' thang cung zad 'byung ba'i ltas kyang byung bas/ rnal 'byor nga dang bya rgyal khu byug gnyis/ /rgyang rgyang 'gro bzhin skad 'phang mtho ru 'gro/ /da lta 'tshogs nang gzhon nu nyams nyes de/ khyad gsod mtho gnon byed pa rang ngal yin/ /chu dang shing rdol sa rdos mi non zhing ske/ /gnas skabs dmod pas mthar thug gnod pa min/ /e bden lo re lo gnyis 'gyang bzhin du/ /tshig 'di je las je cher gsal du 'gro/ /zhes sogs pa'i glu dbyangs mang du blangs shing yi ger yang brisaglu/yang dus der dbus gtsang du jong 'gar gyi dus 'gyur bstan pa'i jus chags de 'byung ltas yang shar rung phyis bar dpyad ma thub/ gzhan yang rmi ltas la rten 'byung 'gyur gnas mang tsam shar/ lo 'di nas bzung rang lo nyer lnga'i bar du bsgom bsgrub tshad ldan bskyal rgyu byung na gu ru pad+ma'i sras kyi grangs mar rtogs pa zhig de skabs nas yongs rgyu de yang gnas skabs nyi che'i rkyen dbang gis yal song / lo 215

der spyir sbyin bdag rim gro bya dgos mang zhing / lhag tu ston sel dang tshangs grib can zhig gi rim gror gdan drung rin po che dang phyag mdzod kyi gsung nan la brten mi 'dod bzhin du phyin pas tshur dgon du sleb mtshams sib nad kyi btab nas spyod lam log pas zla gcig lhag tsam 'chi la phyogs pa'i nad tshabs che ba byung / nged rang 'chi ba yas chung rung / phyag mdzod sogs nas nad na mi chog pa'i bsgyur sbyangs lci bas so ma gsod cing yid skyo rabs byung /spyir yang rje dbon gdan drug rin po ches ni brtse ba'i spyan gyi skyong ba dang lhag tu dbang chos kyi 'brel pa zhus pa'i bla mar gyur pas bka' drin mchog tu che zhes smra mod/ de bas deng sang sku skye gzhan kha cig ltar gdan sar sleb nas dbon rigs grwa 'khor bu slob sbyin bdag rnams kyi bkur bkur cog cog po de 'dra nged la ye nas med pa de kun gsal yin/ lar sku skye zer ba rnams the tshom za ba ni shin tu nas bden gyi nged rang yang de lta bur blo 'gro dka' ba rang yin/ de ltar som nyi yod phyin sku skyer mnga' gsol nas gdan sar bsu ba de mi 'tshal la/ der ni sus kyang mgu mkhong byed du ci la yod—/ de ma yin par gdan sar sku skyer mnga' gsol phyin skye ba yin min the tshom za rung dbon rigs grwa 'khor rang rang 'thad nas ma chad par gang legs re byed dgos pa ni bab mod/ legs po byed zhes pa yang 'jig rten gyi pho sgo gtam gshed ham pa tho co chang 'thung rta rgyugs bag med kyi rtse 'jo sogs blo chos la dred de rgyu 'bras rtsing por spyod pa'i rtsa gzhi dang / dkor sdud lugs hab thob byed lugs zas nor la chos phyir ma yin pa'i bsags bkrun byed lugs sogs 'jig rten 'di snang gi legs legs ltar snang ba'i phug ngan song gi gting rdo byed pa'i mar 'gro'i dpyang thag de 'dra ni slob mkhan dang nyan mkhan thams cad bdud kyi bslus pa ste/ phan pa ltar bstan nas mnar med du bskyur ba yin pas legs so mi zer te nyes pa'i mthar thug pa yin gyi go dgos/ de bas gnas skabs zas gos 'phang med dang nor zas ci rigs bstab cing snyan par brjod pa ni 'jig rten lugs kyi phan 'dogs bzang nges yin mod/ yang dag par ni de yang khams mi che ste/ de ma yin pa'i legs po ji lta bu dgos zhes na/ rang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub par slob pa la zer te/ de ltar na srog 'tsho'i zas ngan ngon tsam dang grang skyobs gos hrul pos chog shes shing / 'dir snang gi nor rdzas mi lam lta bur zhen rgyu ci yod/ de bas chung ngu nas chos min blo dred du ma song bar rgyu 'bras dam tshig gi khe nyen zhib tu bshad nas blo rgyud chos la dkris nas/ bslab shes kyi yon tan la do gal bcug bslab gsum rnam par dag dgos pa'i zhal lta byed/ bsgom bsgrub la brtson pa bskyed pa'i bskul cag btang / khyad par du sa nye ring gang du 'dug kyang bshes gnyen dam pa la mtshams sbyor nas dam tshig rnam par dag pa 216

dang —/ gnas lugs lhan skyes kyi ye shes sgrib med lta bar yang yang du zhi drag du mas 'bad de bskul ba de ni phan 'dogs yang dag pa ste legs pa'i mthar thug yin mod/ de 'dra slob mkhan dkon ni dkon por gda'/ de 'dra slob mkhan byung tshe sku skye'am sugayang rung ste mngon shes grul btub rigs yin na bya ba drin du shes shing gzor yong / de lta bu'i bya ba drin du mi brtsi na rang nyid la mdo ma byung ba yin gyi go dgos su gda'o/ /de ltar chos 'jig rten gyi phan 'dogs gang yang med par sku skyer ngos bzung gdan sar mnga' gsol bzhin de la khyad gsod brnyas pa mtho non ngan slob byed pa ni/ rang rang bla ma gong ma la dad mos gus zhen med pa'i mtshang dang dam tshig nyams chags yang nges par yong ba yin no/ /de yang ji lta bu zhes na skye bar dbugs dbyung shing gdan sar mnga' gsol ba'i sku skyer grags pa de nyid chos la blo kha phyogs shing bstan 'gror phan pa'i lhag bsam gyi don gnyis bsgrub pa'i bsam gzhi yod pa gcig yin phyin skye ba yin min the tshom za ba'am/ gal ste skye ba min par gyur pa zhig kyang brnyas shing khyad du bsod na/ dper na 'jim gzugs kyi shākya thub pa shāka thub dngos min yang de la smod na rnam smin lci ba dang bshig pa sogs kyis ni mi zad pa'i las ngan du 'gro ba dang mtshungs bas so yang 'di la skye ba yin min gang ltar yang bstan 'gror phan 'dogs kyi nus pa med par chos min gyi spyod par dus 'da' zhing rgyal ba'i bstan dang bla ma gong ma'i mtshan la rma 'byin cing dkor gyi spyang kir lta bus sun phyungs na gong ltar nyes pa mi 'byung ste ji zhe na/ sku skyer grags kyang chos min spyod pa de ni mi gtsang ba'i phung por shāka thub yin smra mkhan la sgrib par 'gyur la/ de la 'di mi gtsang ba'i phung po'o/ /shākya thub pa ma yin smra na sgrib par mi 'gyur bar mtshungs par go dgos so/ /de ltar yang phyis 'byung rang 'dra skye bar grags pa rnams dang gdan dbon grwa 'khor kun gyi nges shing rtogs par bya dgos mod/'on kyang sprang po'i glu la snyan tshig yod kyang nyan mkhan med pa'i dpe dang 'dra/ de lta'i 'phros don smra ba ba na zad pa med mod kyi/ da ni dkyus su 'jug na kho bo cag gdan sar ma sleb sngon ni smos kyang ma dgos sleb nas yang rje gdan drung gi thugs rjes gzigs pa de kho na las/ gzhan de skabs kyi dbon rigs grwa 'khor tshos chos kyi phan 'dogs ni rang rang la gzhi ma grub pas ci byed/ 'jig rten gyi phan 'dogs yang ye nas ma byung mod/ de yang phar bzhag gdan sar sleb nas mi lo brgyad kyi bar du gdan sa'i dbon gnyer grwa 'khor drag pa phal che bas spyan ras bzlum pos sprul sku zhes ming zur la bka' skyon rtag tu yong ba'i gnas su byas nas sdod pa yin/ sku skye gzhan ltar nged min zhes pa de yang lags/gang ltar kho bo su zhig gi skye ba yin kyang rung / nged rang la ni khyad cung zad yang mi bdog go/ /rig 'dzin pad+ma nor bu'i sku nye gra rigs mang zhig gi de yi skye ba bdag min par bsgrub bzhin min du rung 217

modaske/ de lta na yang sngon las kyi dbang gis tshe 'dir ming sprul skur grags dgos zhig dang / de yi khral chos rje pad+ma blo gros kyi gdan rabs la mjal dgos byung 'dug pa de la khyed rnams khong khro drag po ma mdzad cing / kho bo ni bya bral kun yangs yan pa blo bde'i skye bar smon gyis mchis lags so/ /de yang gdan sa yi ming can der rang nyid sleb pa nas bzung rgyal khams ma 'grisam kyi bar bla grwa'i nang du 'thon po rnams la 'gran sems med par gong du khur mkhas/ bar pa rang mnyam rnams la mthos mnon med par 'grogs mkhas/ dman pa rnams la khyad gsod med par bkol mkhas su rang ngos nas ni bgyid khul byas/ 'on kyang rgyud mi bsrun pa res 'ga' dang spyo dgos par ni mtha' ma bkag mod/ dus de skabs kyi spyod pa'i lo rgyus yin lugs drang po kun la gsal ba de yin no/ /gang ltar rje gdan drung sku zhogs su sdod ring yul der dpag pa'i sku skye'am sprul sku'i ming can rnams kyi mig srol la nged rang nas spangs rtogs yon tan med pas bzang dpe ni ci la 'gyur/ 'on kyang phyi'i kun spyod la ma dper 'gro ba ni ma byas te 'di skor gyi rtogs brjod cha shas gzhan du bris pa las shes so/ /gser 'phyang gi lo 'di nas phyi'i dgon ris sbyin bdag yul sde yongs ni mgu zhing 'phrin las ni rgyas pa'i dbu tshugs/yin pa ni gzhan don mi nus pa la 'phrin las skye ba bdud kyi phye gtor du ni snying nas nges/ nang gi grwa rigs rnams kyi ni sngar las lhag tsam gyi bka' skyon brnyas pa kho na gnang / rang nyid rnam g.yeng zang zing gi blo 'dod de 'dra snying nas med nges yin zhing / de stabs rje bla mar dgongs pa lan gcig ma yin par yang yang nan du zhus pas/ 'di lo zur mang gter ston drung du 'gro chog pa'i bka' yi khrol cha yang byung la/ de min sdod dgos byung bar kun maphyo dri med 'od zer gyi tshig don mdzod dpe lta byas pas rkyen byas/ de phan chad kyi nyam len mnyam med sgam po pa yab sras kyi rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor du brdar bzhag pa'i gnas 'gyu bar lag 'gyel ba'am gnyis med du rtogs pa ni/khyab bdag rtsa ba'i bla ma kun bzang pad+ma bde ba chen po'i spyan sngar skyes shing ngo 'phrod kyang /'di skabs su de yang phyogs re ba rgya chung ngur song ste sems gzhi med rtsa bral zhes pa de sems 'tshol skabs kyi go bab shes rab can phal che la bla ma myong ba can gyi ngo sprod tshe blo yul du yong ba thun mong de dang ye mi 'dra ba'i myong ba zhig skyes pas sngar gyi tshig de tsho go ba 'ol ci ru song / 'di skabs su yang phyogs gcig nas go bar 'dug kyang go ba de ni yang dag pa'i go ba spros pa chod pa der gyur/ go ba rnam par dag pa ni rtogs pa dang gnyis ha cang gi khyad che ba med zhes grub thob o rgyan pa'i gsung yid bzang brtse ba'i rnam thar du drangs/ nged rang gi shar tshul dang ni mthun gzhan tsho dang mthun min ni ma shes so/ /de yan chad du nyams kyi 'char cha tshad bzung las 'das pa byung ba sngon gyi sbyangs lhag tu gyur 218

pa kyang de ngo cung zad ma 'phrod pa dang tshul bzhin skyong rgyu ma byung bas phyis dkor rdzas la longs spyod tshe 'grib par gyur pa yi tshad bzung ma nus gshis/ des na skabs 'di'i nyams myong nyid tshe 'dir dge sbyor gsha' ma skye ba'i rkang de nas tshugs pa yin/ 'on kyang 'di dus phyag chen ma mos zhen che zhing sems ngo goms 'dris yang de ka'i gzhed pa ltar skyong ba yin pas/ de la bka' rgyud pa gong ma rnams kyi zhal nas phyag chen rtogs pa'i sne zin dge sbyor skyes kyang de skabs brtson pas ma skyongs na bsgom 'grib 'gro gsungs pa de yang shin tu nas thugs mad 'dug de la mkhas grub sogs bzlog pa yab sras rnams kyi ni/ sems phyogs kyi man ngag spyi btang yul lam du byed pa dang / klong chen po yan yul can lam du byed pas rdzogs chen snying thig lugs la ngo bo mthong phyin mi 'grib zhes gsungs pa de yang ci lta ba mkhyen pa'i legs bshad yang dag par mngon no/ /bsod nams mthu yi bde chen gling dang mjalaglu/ /rgyu des chos kyi srog rtsa byin rlabs zhugs/ /smon lam stobs kyi kun mkhyen gsung la mos/ /rkyen des rdzogs chen grub mthar mos gus brnyes/ /de dag stobs kyi nyams len rkang pa tshugs/ /skal ba dman yang skal med min tsam mngon/ /bzang ngan las kun bslu med rgyal bas gsungs/ /ji bzhin ma 'dres snang la ya mtshan skyes/ /zhes so/ /nyams myong de ka'i rgyun la rten nas bla ma gong ma mang zhig gi bzhed pa ltar na bde stong dpe yi ye shes yang / de skabs cha mthun skyes par rlom yang / rgyud sde chen po'i dgongs don ltar na de cung zad min par snang yang / gang ltar nyams myong brtan por skyes pa'i nus pas phyi nang rten 'brel gcig pa'i gnad kyi phyi na yang rang nyid gar gnas de ru sprin smug na bun 'ja'i rang bzhin ya mtshan pa dang / rlung yang dal bar g.yo zhing bag dro yid du 'ong ba'i rnam pa dang /rang gi drung na 'khod pa kun bag phebs pa dga' 'dzum gyi ngang tshul du snang ste/ don la rang sems la bde nyams kyi shar lugs tsam las nges bzung tshad ma ni ci phyir yod/ gang ltar de skabs su bde sdug snyan mi snyan tsha grang gi myong reg rnams kyang rnam rtog gi rang gzugs las gzhan pa'i rang rgyud bye brag par grub pa'i ngang tshul du rtogs pa de dag kun kyang rig ngo ro mnyam nyid du shar ba dang / lha la chags pa 'dre la sdang zhen yang re dogs kyi 'char cha phra mo tsam las gzhan rang sar zhi zhing / mngon zhen re dogs kho rang yang rang shar rang grol chos nyid kyi yo long las gzhan du med pa ni nges shes gting tshugs pa sogs gzhan blor 'gal ba rang blor ma 'gal ba'i myong ba du ma zhig shar te/ de ngang zla ba gsum tsam bar du nyams de ka brtan par gnas song / 'di skabs su dben pa'i gnas brten gtum mo rlung thig gnad du bsnun nas bogs bston dgos rgyu la/ de ltar ma grub pas phyis dge sbyor la bogs bskyed shin tu chung ba byung / spyir ni mi brten pa'i myong ba rnams nyams dang brtan pa ni rtogs 219

pa yin zhes smra yang don la sems nyid rigs rgyun rang gsal gyi ngo bo la ni nam yang 'pho 'gyur med kyang / gnas skabs su kun rdzob rtsa rlung thig le 'phel 'grib kyi rten 'brel dang rkyen dbang rnam rtog rlung gi byed las kyi dge sbyor la 'phel ba dang 'grib pa'i ngang tshul du ma zhig ni ston mod/ 'phel 'grib snang yang 'phel 'grib kyi rnam rtog kho re'i rang ngo mnyam nyid du shas pas rba rlabs rgya mtshor ngo shes pa lta bur snying nas thag chod cing the tshom phra ba ci byas ku yang zol bde ba rtogs pa yin la de ma yin par ngo bor 'gyur med de rnam rtog 'gyur bcas kyi bsgribs nas 'phel 'grib nyams la blang dor dang gang shar de thog tu mi bde ba'i yid gnyis phra mo yod phyin nyams myong phyogs su rang lugs la bzhag go / /de lta'i rnam bzhag dang rang gi nyams myong phran bu skyes pa'i ngang tshul rgyas par yi ge 'jigs pas 'dir ma bkod kyi gzhan du smra bas der rtogs par bya'o/ /'di lo zur mang du 'gro thag chod rtsis kyi rje gdan drung la thon phyag zhu ba'i phyir nyi ma phug tu slebs skabs gdan sa nas pho nya mched mngags kyi phyag mdzod ri bkra gnas nang 'gro lam du glo bur gnam rdo zhig spyi bor lhungs nas che'i dus byas par ji myur du gshed 'phral dang lam bstan yongs dgos tshul phebs pas de phral du sku zhogs su bcar nas gshed phral lam bstan rnams kha zhe med par bsgrub/ de skabs lan gcig nyams kyi snang bar 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal khru gang pa tsam dang / rmi lam du 'od kyi rnam par rdo rje khro lod dkar po zhig kyang mjal/ phyag mdzod kyi gshegs rdzong grub phral du zur mang du 'gro rtsis yin yang phyag mdzod gshegs stabs kyi gdan drung nas re zhig bka'i ma gnang zhing / de nas bya ba gcig grub tshe gcig shar ba chu'i gnyer ma bzhin sangs dus med pas dus 'das nas rang gi blo 'dod la yod pa'i ri dwags smas ma lta bu dben pa'i gnas su rtse gcig tu bsgrub pa la gzhol nas lus rten 'dir grub pa thob pa zhig cis kyang bya'o snyam yang ma grub pa der gda'/ gang ltar gong gi nyams kyi 'phros su 'di skabs ci snang kun lha yi rang bzhin du shar ba zhig byung / de skabs dge sbyor skye tshul tsam las gzhan du ma dmigs yang / dus phyis rgyud gzhung gi don cha shas thos tshe/ rgyud nas bshad bzhin pa'i lus dben rnal ma de skyes pa yin 'dug 'dir smras pa/ bcos med chos nyid bcos ma'i sems kyis bsgribs/ /ma bcos rang rig rang ngo shes pa'i tshe/ /cir snang bde chen lha yi rol par shar/ /zhal phyag can dang zhal las 'das pa'i lha/ /gzo med gnyug ma'i mkha' la rang grub 'di/ /lha sku phyag rgya chen po'i rang 'gros te/ /rdo rje theg pa'i spyi gzhung gsang 'dus kyi/ /rgyud la thug zhes 'phags bod shing rta cheske/ /kun gyi bzhed bzhin nges shes snying nas skyes/ /srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i/ /mtha' bral phyag rgya che 'di rmad du byung / /tshul 'di rang yang skal bzang nyid du sems/ /zhes so/ /lhag tu 'di 220

dus zur mang gter ston rin po che badz+ra la lī ta dang mjal dgos yod kyang rang dbang du ma gyur te/rin chen chos dag dkon la rtag tu 'tshe ba mang / /zhes pa ltar phyag mdzod dus las yol ba des/ nged rang la ni gdan sa'i khur gyis chos kyi bar chad shin tu che ba byung / /phyis chos bsgrub bzhed rnams phyi bshol dbang du yud tsam yang btang mi rung bar gda'o/ /lo der ba bal gyi nang 'khrug stobs che ba de yang bzlum pas thog mar dka' tshegs che yang rang gi 'bad pa chen po byas shing mthar 'grig la nye skabs rje gdan drung dang kun rnam yang byon pa yin/ lo de'i ston gzhug la kaḥthog tu phyin rgyal ba'i sras bsod nam lde'u btsan zhabs mjal zhing lha las bab pa'i dus bzang por tshangs spyod dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa zhus nas skra phud yang de skabs su phul bas ming bsod nams theg mchog bstan 'dzin dpal bzang por btags/ skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya sdom pa ni sngar nas yang yang thob mod/ skra phud ni de skabs bar phul rgyu ma byung / yin pa ni grogs kyi mig srol ngan pa'i skyon dang rtsa ba'i bla ma zhal ma bzhugs phyin gang byung du 'bul bar blo ma phyogs pa'i don kyang yin/ de bas sngon la pho mo skra bcad ni mang du byung yang ske/ rang gi rgyud la skyabs 'gro sdom pa yod pas ltung ba chen po ni mi 'gyur rung rang gi skra ma gcod par gzhan gyi skra breg par ni nyes byas ni yong bar byed dgos lar skyabs 'gro nas tshangs spyod kyi dge bsnyen bar blangs yul ma 'byor na/ dkon mchog rten gyi drung du rang gis blangs bar yang rung bar bzhed pas so/ /'di des rig 'dzin rol pa rdo rje nyag gshis phyogs su bzhugs yod 'dug pa mjal 'dod skom nad can chu'i gdung ba lta bus rgyu shas gru kha bar phyin kyang zla bo gnyis 'gro ma 'dod pa'i g.yo rgyus de nas log dgos byung / de min nged rang gcig pur 'gro mchog mod kyang / mi rnams kyi smyo 'dug zhes pa'i kha zer la 'jigs nas 'gro ma btub/ tshe 'di'i gtam mi snyan par dogs pas bslus pa yin/ dam pa'i lha chos snying nas bsgrub pa rnams tshe 'di snang lo 'dod kyi gtam mtha' dag rgyab tu bor dgos 'dug go /mi tshe yud tsam la mi yi phya khrel ngan brjod ci byung bzod par lha chos gsha' ma zhig dgos par gda' ste da res nged blo tshan an chung bas bla ma ma mjal gyis phung ngo / /de yang grogs ngan spyang ki rgyab ser rkyen las byung ba yin/ chos kyi gegs byed pa'i grogs de lta bu'i dbang du 'di nas byang chub nam thob bar du mi 'gro bar smon gyis 'grub pa'i dpang po rgyal ba sras dang / slob ma des gsung bka' lung rnams kyis mdzod cig221

a+yo+o /rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu rang nyid kyi spyad rabs las byung ba mu ma nas snyim pa'i chu ltar sa bon tsam zhig smon pa 'dir bzhugs so/ /oṃ swa ste/ bden par gsung des 'khor ba sdug bsngal zhing / /'dus byas mi rtag shes nas nges 'byung gi /thar la gzhol bar gdams bzhin mngon sum pas/ /rang gis dger spyad cung zad yang smra bske/ /de yang gnam byung gi lo gzhug nas rtsam snga 'gyur gyi ring lugs bslad med pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa nas da lta la thug gi bar gter dang dag snang zhal gzigs lta bu'i 'phro thud pa ma yin pa zhal nas zhal / snyan nas snyan/ thugs nas thugs su brgyud pa tan+t+ra sde bco brgyad kyi snying po phyi ma'i rgyud sgyu 'phrul gsang ba snying po yi dbang lung man ngag dang bcas pa snga 'gyur gyi rigs sngags 'chang ba sbas pa'i tshul can la legs par thos par byas shing / de bzhin sems pa chen po rat+na'i mtshan can la dkar po'i lo 'char ba nas brtsams karma snying thig gi dbang khrid kyi rgyun gyis mtshon snga 'gyur gyi rgyun dkon pa mang zhig dang skyar te yang zhus shing rnying ma rgyud 'bum gyi bklags lung yang tshugs skabs nyid du 'phags yul gyi mu khun k+shi ṭa zhes bod yul gyi glo bor 'bod pa'i ljongs kyi bdag mo yang yul phyogs der nged yong dgos tshul do gal chen pos byon pa'i nan ma 'theg par snron zla ba la mnga' ris gung thang nas thon te chu stod zla ba'i tshes gsum la glo bo'i yul mi ser skya thams cad kyi rang rang 'khos su dpag pa'i rol mo'i glu gzhas sogs tshad med pa'i mdun bsus te smon thang khab tu 'byor/ ring por ma thogs par rang rang gi 'dod mthun tshe dbang gi sna drangs te chos bka' ji snyed dang phyogs der mkhod pa'i skye bo mtha' dag par dbu ma lugs kyi sgo nas sems bskyed thugs rje chen po'i bsgom khrid sogs chos bka' ji snyed dang / khrom mang nyung sna tshogs la phal cher lnga brgyar long pa pa la bla ma'i sgrub thabs dang 'brel ba'i chos khrid smar ba bshad cing / de yi nang nas nyung 'thus kha shas par rdzogs pa chen po klong gsal mkha' 'gro snying thig gi zab khrid bshad/ rje rat+na'i mtshan can la rgyud 'bum gyi lung gung thang du ma rdzogs pa'i lhag ma 'dir yang zhus shing / bla ma yang mnyes pa gsum gyi mnyes par byas te rang gnas su phebs pa'i bskyal ma bcas btang / nged blo bo smad rdo dang chu la me 'bar ba'i gnas su bsgrod par brtsam nas dgon pa sgang du sleb skabs dam can rdor legs dang gnyen chen ge 'dzo dag 222

yong nas bod kyi so kha bsrung tshul dang / 'di lo mtha' dmag gi dogs med kyang nang du lha ngan 'dre brdzu yong 'dra zhes sogs mol/ de nas glo bo'i gnas chen gyi mthil dngos dza lāsna dz+wa lar tshes dgu la 'byor zhing bcu nas brtsams/ der sdod ring sgo gsum le lo cung zad yang ma song bar dkyil 'khor gsum du ci nus su mnyam par bzhag cing tshogs gtor 'bum phrag du ma nged rang dngos dang grwa tshogs rnams nas kyang bsags shing / dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro rnams dgyes pa mnyam byas/ de skabs mkha' 'gro ma yi 'du ba nyams su mthong ba sogs ya mtshan pa'i ltas khra'u khra'u byung / rang dang las smon 'brel ba'i skyes bu dam pa 'ga' zhig gi phral gyi 'gal rkyen kha shas zhi nus pa'i ltas kyang mthong /'dir slebs mtshams tshes grangs ma nges pa zhig tu dus zing 'byung ngo zhes pa'i sgra gsal po rna bar byung ba ci yin snyam pa las ha cang cer cer po ma byung / de nas phyi rol pa rnams kyi khyab 'jug gi gnas su 'dod pa'i kag pa ṇi ko ner yang gtor chen zhig btong bar phyin/ de nas dgon pa sgang du zhag shas ngal gsos shing dgon de'i bdag po bla mas kyang dgon gzhis de bdag la rtsis su phul bzhin rten 'brel la dmigs bdag gir khas blangs/ sngar thun mong lcags khyi lor dpal chen po gnub nam mkha'i snying po yis rdo rje theg rgyud thams cad kyi bdag por bdag la dbang bskur mdzad pa'i snang ba byung ba'i mal thad der mthing gi r+ghaṃ yig zhig kyang brir bcug sngar ma phyin stabs rgya gad kyi grong bgrod/de'i gzhi bdag btsan des kyang dga' nas yul chos dang mthun par rol mo dang gar rtsed pa'i nyams snang byung / dge gling dang bdud lcags kyi thor cog can gyi gnas ga mi'i rdzongs su yang zhag shas sdad/de nas gu ru'i gnas chen dge dkar du phyin/ de'i gnas bdag srid pa'i ma mo bdun dang phug bdag chen mo gu'i nang tshan rdo rje legs ldan mas dga' ba'i nyams 'gyur ci yang bstan cing / mngon sum du mi la rlom nas dam tshig gi mna' chu len pa yang byung / tshogs gtor gyi bya ba ci nus bgyis shing 'dus pa'i skye bo rnams la chos 'brel gyi re ba yang bskang / de nas slar yang smon thang du 'byor/ sngar bka' chos zhu ba rnams dang / de'i khar dol po nas sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'i zhabs/ dzum le ra dza'i bka'i blon po sogs don gnyer can kha shas la nyi ma kha yar gyi bar snying thig gi dbang tshang bar byasaglu/ dol po rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la phur pa jo mo lugs kyi nang tshan nyang lugs kyi dbang rdul tshon la brten pa tshar gnyis dang / ras bris steng nas tshar gsum ste khyon lnga zhus/ sngon nas da lta khong la thug gi bar phur pa'i bsnyen chen gsum ldabs bar ma chad byung 'dug par byin brlabs nan ltar du bzang zhing khong nas kyang phyin chad sku tshe'i ring phur bzlas nad sogs ma gcogs pa ma byung phyin nyin rer nyi khri re chag med du zhal bzhes mdzad song la/ don du sbas tshul gyi grub brnyes zhig tu go /ga mi nas rtsam 223

dmag gi dpung chen po g.yo ba'i ltas gsal po byung bzhin/ bod khams sdug la gtod pa'i god chags sna 'dren mnga' ris gung nas gro shod du dmag bskul ba'i dus su 'dug de skabs rmi lam du 'phral mar phyogs gzhan du ma bskyod na mi kha dang gleng gzhi che ba zhig yongs zhes byung / de nas mi ring ba bod kyi srid skyong chen po dbang nas khri skor yo yi dmag mnga' rir bcug cing / g.yul sprod du cha ba na mi bdag gung tshad rim nad kyi nyen ste/ nged la yang ci ltar 'gyur brtag zhu dngul bre chen gcig dang bcas byung bar/ tshe tshad dngos ma yin kyang tshe phrang ni shin tu dam/ yi ge 'di 'byor bstun sku rim 'grub na grol bar srid kyang phal cher thal bar dog zhes pho nya ba la gsang por smras bzhin/ rgyal zla ba'i tshes bcu la dus kyi chos nyid du gyur 'dug cing / 'khor rnams g.yul dpung sleb phral phye ma leb rlung gis brdas pa ltar thab 'khrug ye med par so sor gyes shing / nged la yang skyabs zhu bdun bcu skor byung zhing / rang gi lus longs spyod dpon po'i dgongs pa tshoms 'khrungs la ma ltas par rang la skyabs zhu tsam ma yin par gung g.yog tshangs mar mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa yang dag par 'dun ste thabs du ma'i sgo nas zhu ngo nan du bgyis pas thog ma brgya dang dgu cu'i srog skyon yang rtsis mthar nyis brgya skor srog la nyes skyon med par 'grub cing / de bzhin gung gi mthu mkhan rim gro ba sogs dgon pa mang zhig la bka' skyon dbyings che tsam 'dug rung / de rnams la yang zhu ngo'i khong nas srog skyon rgyang 'bud 'thor god med par 'jam chags su sdod chog pa byung song / rang gi gtan pa med par mi 'jigs sbyin pa dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba las/ snyigs dus kyi skye bo de rnams nas re zung ni srid mtha' ma bgag gzhan ni drin du bzo ba yang cung zad tsam yang mi byed do/ /der yang ma zad bod kyi bstan pa'i mnga' bdag dgon sde che kha rnams nas nged rnams gung g.yog la phan 'dogs cung zad yang ma nus shing / kho bya bral ba zhig gi phan 'dogs byas so zhes pa'i gtam 'di rna bar mi snyan cing snying la zug rngu bskyed pa'i tsher ma'o sems nas de la byings mi snyan pa'i tshig sgrub byed pa'i ram 'degs byed pa yang ches mang mod/ gang ltar rang nyid la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dgyes pa'i mtshan ma cung zad zhig byung bas des dbugs dbyung thob/ de ltar bgyid 'os 'gas zla ba kha shas 'gor nas rab myos lcags rta lo sbo zla ba'i tshes gcig la glo bo nas thon te gro shod kyi rgyal po gro mchog pa'i mdun du sleb pa na/ rgya nag dang bod kyi lha 'dre rnams sho rdel bkram ste rgyal 'pham rtsod pa dag kyang mthong / de skabs rim gro la 'bad na bod spyir cung zad bde ba'i go skabs bsnyed par snang yang ske/ spyi mthun gyi las kyi ma grub pas sa sbrul gyi ston lo tsam nas mi'i bdag po yang thugs 'gyur ba'i rnam pas legs par/ gsol ba la mi dgyes pa'i rnam par re 'dug pas spyir snyan du gsol ka yang 'di 224

skabs cha shas zhus kyang / sku rim gyi rtsol ba ye nas mdzad ma song / de nas tshes bdun la spra dun du 'byoraske/zhi ba'i sbyin bsreg kha yar dang / tshes bcu sogs dus chen la gtor ma btang / lhag tu tshes bco brgyad kyi nyin byang phyogs kyi de'u de'i rtser phyin gtor ma btang ba la che btsan pa rol skya bdun ral pa bswe yan gyi gseb nas me lce ljib ljib 'phro bzhin mngon sum du byung nas gtor ma len pa'i nyams byung ske/ der 'dus pa thams cad kyi mthun snang du rlung shin tu drag pa dang / brngam zhud tshad med pa byung zeraske/ de ni dga' ba dang 'tshub pa zung du 'brel ba ste nged la dga' zhing gzhan la 'tshub pa'i mtshan ma'o'i/ /de skabs rgyal khrims kyi chad pas mi nyi shu tsam gsad pa yin 'dug kyang mang zhig ni gdug 'drer skyes pa'i mtshan mar mthong / 'di lo nged rang bal yul du rang byung mchod rten la mchod 'bul zhib mo zhig bgyid 'dod yin yang dus zing des bshol dgos byung zhing / gung g.yog gi srog skyob la zhu nan ches pas dgongs pa cung zad ma dgyes pa sel byed du yar 'brog chu tshan du mjal rtsis byas nas dpal ma chos sding du 'byor skabs sbyin bdag gi nan gyis bshol btab nas zhag ma nyung tsam 'gor ba rten 'brel shin tu gnod pa byung / de skabs mgon po g.yu thog pa'i yum shes rab dpal 'phreng dang mjal nas dbang bzhi bskur zhing 'phral gyi lung bstan kha yar gnang ba yang ji bzhin par 'grub/ la stod lhor phyin snga sor sa sbrul nas brtsam pa'i kun rig gi gzungs sngags dung phyur gnyis grub dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngos shing / gshin rje gshed dmar gyi snying po 'bru bcu bzhi pa dung phyur dang / sgrol ma'i bstod pa 'bum phrag lnga phral du bsgrub/ grom pa rgyang / bo dong e/ khro phu rnams su mched 'bul smon lam dang bcas shing / srad rin chen rtser srid skyong chen po'i drung du tshes bcu la 'byor/ de phral ngos mjal thog bkur bzos sngar dang cha 'dra ba thugs gshis 'gyur ba'i rnam pa che zhing sngar ltar gyi dbang chos gsan bzhed kyi spros pa spangs 'dug bla mchod gtso bo shel stod pa yang der bzhugs shing de skabs khrung bzhes ni nyin mtshan mi shes pa ltar snang / rang gi gsal snang la ni rgyal srid yun ring du mi gnas pa'i char sgo bcas nye bar 'khod pa rnams la yang gsal por smras/ de skabs rgya thag sher spun khrims rar chud de srog skyob byas kyang phyis drin lan log gzhal sngon de bzhin gshegs pas lhas byin la phan ga'ags pa lta bu 'di'o/ /yang skyog po'i blo can dgas pho lhar sku rim sri gnon gyi rigs nged nas byas na legs tshul srid skyong la zhus nas nged la bka' phebs byung yang / der brten ma 'ongs gleng gzhi chen po 'byung bar shes nas rang thag chod pa'i sgo nas las bzhi'i sbyin bsreg byed par zhus/ de nas bkra shis lhun por phyin rang re'i zhwa dmar sprul pa'i sku mched du gyur pa'i rmongs zhen gyi rang la ci yod kyi 'bul spang bskyed/ tshur la yang gdab lan ches bzang ba byung / de nas pho lha dang gnas gsar/ rtse chen 225

rnams rgyud ra lung du zla ba gcig nye tsam sdod/ ya 'brog tu phyin yom po dor gu ru'i phyag rjes mjal/ rje dpa' bo rin po che yang nges dang 'phral du 'phrad par phebs bzhin mu tig spa ma gong du mjal/ de skabs klu sogs bod kyi lha 'dre rnams 'khrug pa'i cho 'phrul shin tu che zhing 'tshub par byung / mtshur phu nas drung pa yang gcen gyi spyod pa ma bzo bas kho rang rgyang 'bud dang dbang ris bdag thob gang yod shel stod pa la sbyar rgyu'i gtam sbir gyis 'jigs shing bskrag te ngo chen zhu dgos tshul gyi gnas 'dir byung bzhin zhu don legs par gnyal smad dge rir slebs skabs 'grub song ba/ de skabs ni dga' tshor tshad med byed kyi 'dug kho bo yang gting du chos pa'i yang mtha' byed snyam pa zhig mi bdog lho brag gi gnas mtha' dag mjal ba'i ched du phyin yang / der song na mi legs tshul gyi lung bstan byung bas dog pa skyes rna bo cog nas tshur log gnas der sngar rang nyid chung ngu byis pa'i skabs dang cha mthun pa'i sngon gnas rjes su dran pa sogs gsal snang mang zhing ting nge 'dzin la yang bogs cung zad thon/ de nas gnyal smad du 'gro bar 'dod pa'i bgrod lam lo ro rgyu/ snga sor kun gzigs si tu'i zhabs sogs dam pa rnams la thugs dam brtag dpyad zhib mor zhus bzhin sprul pa'i skur snyam pa de yang lha babs kyi dus bzang po la rang dang lhan cig tu rjes su dkris rgyur byas/ gnyal smad dge rir phyin snga phyir gtor tshogs dang / gzhon nu'i ston mo sogs rten 'brel la phan pa rnams bgyis/ der mchod rten mkha' 'gro ma mang po'i bzhengs par grags shing / de la nam mkha' snying pos phyag mdzad pa'i phyag rjes gsal bar bzhugs pa'i mchod rten de ni dus 'khor ye shes le'u nas bshad pa'i mchod rten bzo dbyibs cha tshad 'khrul med du snang bas shin tu ngo mtshar skyes/ 'di skor dre'u lhas sprul pa'i sku rin po cher shangs chos kyi bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang ras bris steng nas smin pa dang / chos drug phyag chen sogs khrid chen lnga tshangs bar bshad/ thugs mkhyen rab che zhing snang ba gshim pa byung / de skabs ltas 'tshub che bar btud mar byung zhing / smin drug zla ba'i tshes phug lugs bcu gnyis chad cing rang lugs kyi bcu gnyis ma chad pa'i nyi ma rtse shar skabs lha ldan du mi'i bdag po rgya nag tā zhing dag gis g.yo thabs kyi dkrong zhing / nyi ma de kar srid skyong rang gi g.yog ris drag pa 'dras dpung gi sbyor bas tā zhing gnyis kyi mtshon rgya mi sum brgya lhag tsam zhig lnga pa'i lam du bkod nas kho pa rnams kyang ci bder gyes 'dugatshes bcu drug la dga' paṇa gyi bod gangs can la dbang bsgyur ba'i gtam dang bcas dmag gi bskul brda'i tham ka sngar nag po de dang / mi ring bar gangs can rje bo'i khri la 'khod pa yin zhes tham ka kha dog dmar por byas te byung / de phral rang nyid kyang lha ldan 'gro bar snyam yang chos ltar bcos pa'i brel ba mang pos g.yengs nas 'gor/ de skabs shed khyab 'jug chen po nam mkha'i kha dog lta bu gzi 226

brjid phun sum tshogs pa zhig rmi lam du mthong / 'di ni 'jig rten gyi lha mthu bo che yin pas thun mong gi dngos grub kha cig zhu'o snyam pa byu nga / lar de skabs mi rnams kyi brjod gleng sna tshogs pas nye bar 'khod pa rnams dog pa chu ltar du 'khol yang rang nyid ni 'di phyi bar do kun rnam rtog gi ri mo tsam las gzhan med par chos nyid kyi gshis la nges shes lhag par skyes pas legs nyes gang byung yang chog snyam pa las khu khrig khrig snyem gang yang ma byung / tshes gsum gyi skabs drag shul can zhig re zhig gnod sbyin du skyes sam snyam pa byung / nged la gzhung sa nas bka' rgya zhis byis dpon phun tshogs kyi no bo ched mngags skyel btang ba gzhung rang gi ngan pa dgu 'dzom du 'dod pa'i nyi ma de la 'byor/ de nyin pho nya ba phrad pa dang yi ge len pa gnyis ka ma thub/ de'i sang nyin yi ge khyer nas brngams gzil bskyed kyang /nged kyi chu 'barba tsam las sger du bkur bzos bstab ma 'dod/ lta stangs kyi gzir bas ni mthar gdong ro mdog tu song / tshes dgu la lha ldan du 'gro ba'i lam du zhugs/ dal 'gros kyi gser khu tshab tshan du yang bcag mal zhig byas/ de nas yongs ba sham po'i la rtser 'brog pa bzung g.yag la gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ches che ba 'dzugs te yongs ba kha yar dang phrad pa ni sham po dga' zhing nged rang la legs pa'i lta bu go/ /tshes bcu bzhir yar stod karma lha khang du bsdod pa'i nub mor 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa yi brda' thabs kyi sgo nas 'jig pa las rnam par grol ba yi dbugs dbyung / tshes bco lngar khra 'brug tu 'byor/ sbyin bdag chen por snying brtse bas ci ltar 'byor ba'i yo byad kyi snang gsal gtso bor gyur pa'i mchod pa dang / snyan dar yang phul zhing smon lam yang dag pas rgyas btab/ zhor du bya sa dang ka chu lha khang mjal/ bsam yas su 'byor skabs 'ja' dkar po zhig dbu rtse'i thad du ka ba ltar 'greng ba dang / dkor bdag chos skyong chen po des kyang sngar las dga' ba dang gus pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan/ dur khrod ma mo'i rigs yin pa nya shan gyi bu mo zhig kyang 'phrad/ bcag mal byas te dbu rtse dang rta mgrin gling mchod rten dkar po rnams la mchod 'bul smon lam khra 'brug gi dpe 'dre byas/byang chub chen po'i zhal ras lan mang du mjal yang 'di res ni mtshan dpe rdzogs pa'i mthar thug pa zhig tu mthong bas yid 'phrog pa byung / rgod dkar la la yang ser bu dang bral zhing nyi ma mchog tu dwangs ba sogs yul bdag de dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur gyi ches bde/ tshal gung thang du bcag mal zhig byas nas nyi shu gnyis la lha ldan du 'byor/ nyi shu gsum la paṇ+ḍi tar mjal kha zhig dgos tshul smras kyang bka' 'dri mang tsam byed rgyu yod pas de ma grub bar mi yong tshul byung ba/ de phral rtse la zhu mkhan btang bas rten 'brel gyi nus pas sang yong ngo gsung ltar gru 'dzin gyi pho brang chen por phyin/ kun gyi lkog gyur shib bur gzhungs kyi dgongs 'khrel gyi gnas so zhes smos par byed kyang der 'dus pa'i dbus 227

gtsang gi drung 'khor che phras mtshon brgya phrag du mas gus pa'i zhe sa btab nas mgo bos 'dud par byas shing / sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i gus tshul ston/ yun cung zad lon pa na gser gdung gi steng ba gam srid zhi phun tshogs su gong zhabs mjal ba'i phyag rten du gan dar/ su war+ṇa srang gang / rdo bcud srang bco lnga'i grangs ldan bcas mgron gnyer nyi rgyal ba brgyud phul zhing phyag byed pa'i skabs su sku lus drang por bsrang zhing ting nge 'dzin gsar zhing mjal rten gyi dar bdag gi lag nas 'dzum bzhin pas phyag tu bzhes shing / g.yas gral gdan kha gang ma zhig 'dug pa la mgron gnyer du mas nan tur gyis bskur yang babs thob med tshul gyi sa ljen la sdod/ thon gdong slar yang phyag dang bcas te gnas tshul kha shas gsol bas 'tshams 'bri dang lan yid la bab pas byab/ bzhugs bral der paṇ+ḍi ta yang srid skyong snga ma rnams dang khri mtshungs par g.yon ngos su bzhugs 'dug pa la yang dar gcig bstab par mgo bos dud tsam byas song / kho rang la sger mjal zhus par mi yong zhes rtsegs rtsegs po byas pa de yang lhus ma thing ba'i rnam pa byung / nged rang ni 'di skabs kun tu snang ba me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bur yul dang yul can mi phyed pa chos thams cad kyi gting la sleb pa 'dra zhig byung / de yang rtogs pa'i ngo bo la nyams kyi rgyan btags par snang / ci phyir ngo bo 'gyur ba med kyang gsal snang la 'phel 'grib du cha bas song / de nas 'gro ba'i mgon 'brug pa mchog kyang nged la gzhung nas dbyings tshom yong ba'i sgra sbir che gshis de thag ma chod bar brtse ba'i thugs kyi phyogs phebs bshol ste/ lha ldan g.yu thog khang gsar du bzhugs 'dug pa mjal bar phyin shin tu dgyes par mdzad/ dpal ldan dpa' bo mchog yang de dang sgo mthun lha sar bzhugs pa dang yang yang mjal/ de'i phyi nyin mkhan rin po dhi ra dha ra shod nas bkras rab pa bcas rgyu mtshan mang nyung tsam lab pa la lan gang yin pa rnal ma btab/ slar yang tshes brgyad skabs rang gi gnas tshul dang / bstan pa ci las 'phros pa'i gsol 'os ci snyed zhig yi ge'i lam du bkod de gzhung sar phul/ tshes bcu la slar yang spyir grub mtha' la brnyad cing bye brag bka' 'dri shin tu lci ba brgyad phebs par de la bag tsha ba cung zad yang ma mchis par 'jigs pa med pa'i spobs pas rtsa tho yi ge dang ngag nas rgya cher spel te snyan du btab/ tshul des bod sngags rnying pa'i lta grub 'dzin pa rnams dang bka' rgyud spyi la phan thogs ma chung tsam byung song yang 'gris che ba re zung las gzhan kun gyi shes par dka'/ bka' 'bri de ltar phebs pa'i rkyen ni nged la 'phrin las than thun byung bar se 'bras kyi kun slong can kha cig ma dges pa'i zhor dang / gtso bor mtshur phu sgar 'og phyogs rtogs rnams kyis nan gyi dkrug pa'i rgyu las so/ /tshes nyi shu skor la rgya yi zi ling an ban de 'byor nas/ tshes nyer lnga la dbang gi phyag g.yog rgya dpung 'joms par byed pa sngar 'thor ba rnams 228

paṇ+ḍi ta rang nyid srid skyong yin gyu'i rtsis kyi 'dzin sbyangs byas pa nyi shu lhag tsam zhig srog bkum pa la yang snying thag pa nas bsngo smon bzang po byas/ kha cig ngan 'gro chen po'i 'jigs las skyob nus par yang sems/ tshes nyer drug nyin chen po kha cig gi rgyud mi ma yin gyi bskul te mtha' dmag bzlog pa'i bya ba sogs slad nas mi brtsam pa'i dag pa dgos zhes gsung byung ba/ des bdag la rung na rkang brkyang la de bas kyang rung snyam ste re zhig de ltar khas blangs/ bod spyi'i rten 'brel la ni shin tu gnod tshab che bar rtogs/ gong zhabs kyi yongs 'dzin nu mod hu'ang nas rang cag khams sog yul chos mthun zhing nged gu ru pad+ma la snying nas mos mkhan yin/ khyed rang bya bral gyi spyod pa sngar mu ltar ci bder skyongs shig sogs mdzes tshig ci snyed zhig brgyud de 'phros su byung / de dang gong zhabs nas kyang lha ldan du yun ring sdod na mi dges tshul bka' btud mar phebs gshis dgongs sbyar gyis skyes bdag lo cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes gcig la lha ldan nas thon te khyung rdzong brag gi ri khrod du 'byor/ lha sar drung 'khor mang zhig dbang chos kyi 'phro lus pas yid cung zad 'phreng ba byung / gnyal nas brtsam gnas 'dir sleb kyi bar chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur zhen 'khris kyi yul du ma gyur zhing / don dam gyi gshis stong pa nyid snying rje dang zung du 'brel ba byung tshor gyi rtog pa kun sbrul mdud ltar rang sar grol ba bde ba'i go skabs rnyed pa byung / de nas stod lung su gzhan phyogs mi srun pa mang zhig gi dpa' bkong ba'i slad du gzhung nas kyang bskur zos chen pos byab pa'i 'u lag bcas dal 'gros kyi tshes dgu la skyer sgang du 'byoraglu/ tshes bcu la spyod 'chang ba'i srol ltar 'khor lo bde mchog gi tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgyas pa zhig btang / 'gro ba'i mgon po 'brug pas kyang sgrol ma'i sku dang / gser zho so bdun gyi mtshon dngos po phon che zhing rnam par dag pa dang lhan cig yun 'tsho stsal ba dang / yul mdo khams nas zhwa dmar mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rin po che dang / kun gzigs si tu rin po che nas kyang brtse ba'i thugs kyi ma skyud pa'i chab shog yun 'tsho'i rten bcas ched bsngags kyi bya ma rta yi gdong du der 'byor ba rten 'brel legs pa'i mtshan ma go/ /tshes bcu gcig la yong ba'i lam bar du rta bsu dang / thabs su/ ser 'phreng sogs bsu ba'i bkod pa bzang po dang bcas mtshur phur phyin/ de skabs rlung 'tshub shin tu che/ de yang gyes pa dang 'tshub pa'i mtshan ma can no/ /thog mar rgyal ba'i dbang po dpal karma pa chen po zhal ras lha khang du mjal bar phyag byas/ mtshur phu drung pa yang sgo 'gag bar bsu ba la byung / rgyal ba'i dbang po ni sku yi bzhugs tshug gsung gi brjod pa/ thugs kyi 'char sgo rnams sngar dang mi 'dra ba bag chags pas yid mgu ba thob/ de nas mi ring bar sbyor ba yan lag drug gi khrid dang / gzhan khrid bka' kha shas kyang dpa' bo rin po che dang lhan du phul/ mdo lugs kyi khrid rim thams cad kyi rgyal po jo bo rje'i thugs kyi 229

nyid khu byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'phro yang gong gi yab sras dang dkar lcog sprul pa'i sku lhan du phul/sbo zla'i tshes bco lnga byang bdag sogs kyi rgyal ba sku bltam pa'i dus su 'dod pa der lha chen 'dzam gling rgyan gyi drung du gong gi yab sus gsum dang rgyal tshab bcas la sems tsam dang dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed kyi cho ga yang dag pa gzhung tshig gang yin lhag chad kyi skyon spangs te phul/ de lta na yang bdag ni ma mkhas mi bsdams nyon mongs pa'i tshang tshing drag tu 'khrug pa zhig gi de ltar skabs su mi che ba'i nges pa gting nas bsnyed kyang / slob dpon la tshig gi rgyun thob pa tsam kho nas yur ba ma chad pa'i chu ltar bstan rgyun la che thang du dgongs te bzhed par mdzad pa ni slob ma bzang po'i mtshan nyid du gyur kyang rang nyid byang chub sems pa'i mtshan nyid mi ldan bzhin slob dpon gyi khur bzung ba la nyes ltung ci tsam mchis pa kun dpang gyur rgyal ba sras bcas dang dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha rnams kyi spyan sngar snying thag pa nas mthol zhing bshags dgos par snang ngo / /spyir ni der zla ba kha shas sdod ring mthun bar du chos kyi bya ba cung zad tsam las phal che ba zhig 'jig rten dgra 'dul gnyen skyong ltar snang bas dus 'da' ba'i rang bzhin du gyur cing / lha sar yang rgya yi tsong du am pa phyi ma rnams rim pas 'byor rang lugs kyi sbo zla phug pa'i bshol snga 'don gyi lo gsar skabs paṇ+ḍi ta srid skyongs kyi khri las phabs te bka' blon gyi'i gral du 'khod cing / zla ba de'i tshes bcu gcig la dga' ldan khang gsar nas rdo ring du spo ba dang / zla ba de'i rjes ma'i tshes gcig la hor zla bcu pa'i tshes bco lnga nas gnang ba'i tham dmar de gong zhabs su bzhes nas phyin chad sngar spyi 'gre'i kha dog tu bsgyur ba sogs ya cha ba byung /rang la dad pa can gyi phul ba'i dngos po chud mi za ched du stod hor gyi zab gos gser ma la mu tig gi dra ba bsgrel zhing g.yu dmar gyis phra btab pa gser stong gi rin thang can zhig gzhung debs su sbyar rgyu khri lcam bde ldan sgrol ma la do dam bcol nas bsam yas byang chub chen po'i dbu stengs su rtsa ba'i bla ma'i dus chen gnam stong la phul/ yang de skabs snying ma yi rdor smin byang chub gling pa sogs snying dgon che kha yi phyag mgron sogs drag rim bkug nas rgyu mtshan 'dri ba'i phreng ba rgya cher spel ba'i skabs nyid/lha sa'i kha che rnams kyang gcig 'og tu gcig mi 'du zhing re mkhong chen po dang bcas mtshon rtse'i rkyal pa bzhin nang mi gshim pa sogs dus snyigs ma'i rang mtshangs ni gsal por ngom bzhin pas yid skyo ba je cher 'phel ba'i rang gzugs nyid du gyur/ nag zla'i tshes nyi shu la rang byung zhabs kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i snang ba dang bcas chos khams la nges shes khyad par can zhig skye/ 'di skabs snga phyir mnga' ris nas rgyal mo spun dang / mnga' rir rje 'brug pa'i zhal skyin tshul du 'byon mkhan gyi bla ma lo ri ba/ lho brag dhi tsha sprul sku/ na len+d+ra bco brgyad sprul pa'i sku rnams bka' chos kyi ched du byon par so 230

so'i 'dod ltar ci nus kyi chos bka' bshad/ gong zhabs nas dwangs bar mdzad pa yi rim gro ba chen po'i lam nas brtag pa bgyid dgos phebs pa yang / 'byung 'gyur gnas cung zad go yang brda' don 'phrod rung tsam zhig las phul ma spob/ 'on kyang de la dgyes pas dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal chung ngu zhig dang /gser dngul gyi phur ma mtshon byed bcas skyes su phebs/ nag zla'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nub lha chen po ma hes shwa ra 'phags yul gyi sgrub thabs dang mthun par dha ru dkar dmar gyi me tog shin tu mjes pa'i rgyan can zhig kyang rmi lam du mthong / 'jig rten gyi lha chen po rnams kyi yang kho bo la yang yang gzigs par sems/ lar ni rang nyid gzhon nu'i skabs su rmi lam dge ba dang mthong snang sna tshogs par rtsis su bzung yang / dus phyis de la cer cer po med nas lo shin tu mang zhing / mtha' dag yi ger 'brir yang ga la longs/ gzhan mkha' 'gro rnams kyi yang cung zad bkag pas so/ /de yang lha la dga' ba dang 'dre la mi dga' ba med zhes rtogs ldan rnams kyi zer mod/ mnyam bzhag dbyings su la bzla ba'i skabs de lta yin mod kyang kun rdzob kyi bden pa'i mthu'i lha mthong ba rnams bag gro zhing nyams dga' ba dang /bgegs mthong na de las bzlog cing bar ma btang snyom gyi tshul du 'char ba da lta'i phung khams 'di mi 'gyur bde ba'i dbyings su dag pa ye shes skur ma smin bar de ltar yod pa go la/ 'on kyang dga' sdug bde mi bde la bzang ngan gyi khyad 'dzin cer cer po med chos nyid gnyug ma'i dbyings su khad der stom pa rnal 'byor thob pa khas 'che ba rnams kyi rgyud la nges par skye ba'i khyad chos su bya dgos so/ /spyir btang tsam du kun la phan gnod kyi lha 'dre gang mthong yang dge dang mi dge ba'i mtshan ma yid bde dang mi bde ba'i khyad par gyi brtag go zhes grags pa yang mthun pa'o/ /dus de skabs rgyang sher bas blo gros kyi lang tsho phyung nas/ kong po nas phyag gar yang bso/ rnam gling nas sprul brdzu tshur bkug bya ko ba'i lha bu sku skyed rtse drung du bcug de'i g.yog tu bya ris pa sogs dam nyams kha shas dkris/ mi 'os pa'i bya ba lhu ru blangs nas sngon gyi gleng gzhi rtsa slong gi blo 'dod ches che ba yi phu dkrug mda' dkrug byed kyi 'dug par blos ma bzod par rtse shod kyi mdun na 'don gal che rigs thams cad la rgyu mtshan zhib mo dngos po'i 'bul mnon rang gi rngo gang thogs bcas lha sar bang mi yang yang gzer gtab/ zhwa dmar mchog gi phyag mdzod mgon po yang lha sar yun ring po'i bar don de skor gyi nyan non nyer len bgyid par bzhugs shing phyag tu dngos po yang srab pas dka' tsam byung tshod dang / dpa' bo rin po che yang don 'di bskor la thugs ngal che yang re zhig rang phyogs la 'pho 'gyur gling log mi 'byung ba'i rkang tshugs song rung rgyab skyor sku'i rim gro la 'bad dgos ni gal cher snang / de yang zhwa dmar mchog gi sprul pa'i sku re zhig bod du gdan chags na gleng gzhi yang rang sar grol zhing / lug lo shar tsam sde dge 231

lta bu'i khams su spyan 'dren gyi dgongs zhu gong zhabs la bgyid na nying chags shing lugs legs pa lta bur snang yang / snga sor me stag lor lha ldan bsam 'grub pho brang du sdod skabs nyi ma shar phyogs kyi sku don ni 'grub zhes lus med kyi sgra gsal por thos pa de skabs don ci bzhin rngo ma thogs kyang yab sras lhan rgyas mdo khams su phebs rgyu'i rten 'brel du go/ /mtshur lugs kyi sa ga dang gzhung lugs kyi nag pa'i tshes nyi shu lnga la rgyal ba'i dbang po dpal karma pa chen po yang lha ldan du gangs can rgyal por mjal phyag zhu ba'i lam zhugs gnang ba'i skabs karma pa'i skye 'phreng zhwa nag cod paṇa bcing pa'i skyes bu ni bcu gcig gam/ bcu gsum lhag mi 'byon pa'i nges pa lung gi grub bzhin karma pa da lta'i sku thog 'dir zhwa dmar ba dang bla slob kyi rten 'brel ma 'chug pa gnang phyin slad mar zhwa dmar cod paṇa 'dzin pa dang ske/ karma pa gnyis su med pa'i sgo nas gdul bya'i don mdzad pa las da phyin karma pa'i sprul skur sgro btags nas nag po'i cod paṇa bcings na mi legs par karma pa chen po bcu gsum pa rang nyid kyi thugs kyi dgongs bzhin de don phyag gi a k+ṣa ra la dri bzang gi phyag mthil gyi rjes dang bka' rtags phyag rgyas spras pa dpal ldan dpa' bo rin po che dang / zhwa dmar nag gi mdzod pa/ nged bcas 'dus par gnang song zhing bdag ni 'di skabs chis pa'i bro 'tshal bas phebs bskyal drang rings su ma thub par gnam sgo'i 'tshams su phyag gsum phrag dag btsal nas phyag dbang zhus/ sku zhabs 'di nub sna dkar bzhugs rtsis su phebs/ tshes nyer drug gza' skar 'grub sbyor bzang po la skyer sgang 'bum pa'i rdza tog de mkhas pa chos mdzad kyi zla ba phyed gnyis bar du bcos nas grub pa'i rtsis su byas yang yid chim pa zhig ni ma byung / 'on kyang der 'bad kyi dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngos/ mtshur phu nas rang nyid 'phral du thon rtsis yin yang lha ldan du rnam gling ba dang / gar she sogs nas byed rgyu mang bar bskyar nan gyi rtse shod tu zhu yig re 'bul bar brdzangs bar dgyes pa'i ngang tshul dang bcas rang gi gzhed ltar gnang rgyu'i rtsis su byung / dpal karma chen po yang lha sar zla gcig lhag tsam gdan chags par mchog dman mtha' dag nas gus zhabs che zhing gzhung lugs sa ga'i nyer bzhi la gong zhabs dang mjal 'phrad skabs ldang ba mthong bzhes bzos sgo sogs gang ci 'di res rings sngar las legs cha che ba yang rten 'brel gyi mthu las byung 'dug cing / gzhung lugs kyi snron zla'i tshes lnga la mtshur du bde bar phebs par phebs bsur mthil du phyin lus kyi ma lnga sa la phab pa'i phyag sngon du 'gro bas phyag dbang zhus/ rje 'bri gung yab sras nas kyang lha ldan dang 'di ru yang pho nya snga phyir gnang zhing sngar nas dag pa'i snang ba rgyas bzhin gong 'phel du gyur/ de ltar mtshur du 'di res zhag kha yar las mi sdod pa'i rtsis su byas yang zla ngo drug dang hril po lnga yi ring 'gor zhing phyi nas dgra zla nang nas mthab 'khrug bar nas zer gsog che 232

bar ma zad yab sras kyi gra ris nas kyang gzigs phyogs dang brjod pa sna tshogs pas tsher ma'i dong dang shig nad kyi bro tshal ba ltar sgo gsum ngal dub che che 'dra ba byung yang phal che phyag rgya chen po'i dbyings su la bzla ba'i khul tsam byas shing / zhwa dmar sprul pa'i sku 'di nyid khrir 'khod pa dang lhan du rang gi las khur des zin pa yis/ slad nas 'di skor la 'jug mi dgos pa'i zhu bkrol yang dag grub zin pa yin yang 'di lo shin tu nyen cing 'gyur ba che ba'i skabs su gyur pa yi slar yang yab sras rnams la sman pa'i bya ba sgo du ma nas rgya ma chung tsam grub ste don 'di kun sngon gyis smon lam gyi 'phen pas rang gi las kyi rgyu bar snying nas nges shes kyi steg bur yid kyi khye'u ngal gsos thob/ skabs 'dir mtha' dang bod yul gyi lha 'dre mthu bo che rnams ches 'khrug pa'i ltas dang / cho 'phrul thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa du ma bar mi chad du 'byung ba'i skabs su yin/ mtshur sgar chen yar phebs pa'i rjes su yang 'gong po nyi tshe ba kha shas 'brang ba'i ltas byung bas brdzong na legs tshul smras par cha gsum lan kha shas dang tshes brgyad la lha bsangs rgyas pa zhig kyang btang song / 'di skabs zhwa dmar mchog dang / si tu rin po che'i sku zhabs su bang mi rdzong rgyu'i zhu yig rnams bris shing lhag tu si tu rin po che'i zhal sngar bka' rgyud gser 'phreng dang / sgra rig tsan+d+ra pa'i 'drel pa/ sngags rgyud kha yar la 'gyur zhus sogs sngar na gsol ba btab bzhin/ 'di res yang nan bskyed kyis bskul ma dang / yab sras rnams zhabs pad brtan cing nges don snying po'i bstan pa dar rgyas yun rings su gnas pa'i smon lam la snying thag pa nas rtag tu 'debs bzhin pa'o/ /'dir smras pa/ dus kyi chu gter rlabs 'phreng ches 'khrug cing / /'jigs rung 'jigs pas phyogs kun yongs bslad yang / /pad 'byung thugs rje'i snang bas phyogs bsnyed cing / /bsod nams gru chen blo gros gzer gyis bsdam/ /smon lam rlung gis 'ded pa'i ba dan g.yos—/ /skyes mchog skyes dgu rnam pa mang po dag /ngal 'jigs las 'das dga' bde'i gling bzang por / /dbugs dbyung gru chen grub pa'i ngang tshul yin/ /zhes so/ /'di skabs kyi spyad rabs zhib mor bgyis na ches mang yang 'dir phyogs mtshon tsam ste zhib pa slar brjod par 'dod do/ /sarba maṅga lo//233

༄7ོ//prakṛtamāyikaman+t+rabīt+yādhareshwaramargyat+mabatsaritakathenāt+yāḥbirtsamatraṛdzubrabītādzikhyadzināmabidzaharaske//༄sto /ma bcos pa'i zog po sngags rig 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu rang nyid spyad rabs chu klung las thigs pa tsam kyu ru lugs su smos pa snyim pa'i chu skyes ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /a ho: skye ba 'di nas byang chub che/ /thob par rigs bdag gcig pu la/ /pad 'byung bde chen gling pa dang / /dpa' bo gsung rab rgya mtshor 'dud/ /gang de'i bka' 'bangs tha shas su/ /gyur pa'i tshe dbang nor bu bdag /sngon nas sbyangs stobs yon tan chung / /'phral du thos bsam sgom pas dben//des na thun mong thun min gyi/ /rnam thar brjod 'os gtan nas med/ /'on kyang mos pa'i brtul zhugs canak+ṣi/ /dam pas bskul phyir cung smra yang / /thun mong skye bo'i kun spyod dang / /mthun la smra ba'i dgos pa ci/ /thun min yon tan rig gyur pa/ /rlom nus med pas ci zhig smra/ /gang ltar sgro dang bkur bral ba'iske/ /gtam ni rgyal bas legs par gnang / /des na bzhad gad 'chor ba'i rgyur/ /rtogs pas sa bon tsam brjod bya/ /de yang kho bo'i sngon gnas ni/ /rang gi dran pa dka' mod kyang / /rje btsun bla ma mchog rnams kyi/ /bka' lung ma brten gzhan rnams la/ /grags tshod ltar du smra ba na/ /grub dbang nam mkha'i snying po yis/ /sprul pa'i skyes bu rig pa 'dzin/ /pad+ma nor bu zhes bya ba/ /o rgyan zab gter kha byang 'dzin/ /dam pa de nyid yin no skad/ /de nas 'phos tshe dag pa'i sku/ /pad+ma 'od du dbugs dbyung zhing / /ma dag gdul bya 'dul ba'i phyir/ /blo gsal lag 'gro'i tshul yang bzang / /de 'phos da lta'i lus 'di srid/ /pha rigs 'od gsal lha babs rgyun/ /hor rgyal stobs chen go be la/ /chos rgyal 'phags pa yon mchod kyis/ /chos kha gsum la lung bsgyur skabs/ /mdo khams dpon chen bzhi yi gras//rngu zhes bya ba'i rus khung la/ /mi chos stobs kyis 'khor lo can/ /sa skyong sde dge zhes pa yi/ /rgyud pa nyams med gnas pa dang / /rgyal bstan 'dzin pa'i skyes bu yang / /'phags yul grub pa'i dbang phyug che/ /ku ku ri 'phrul ches dor sogs/ /mkhas shing grub pa'i skyes bu ni/ /chad med 'khrungs pa'i rigs nyid las/ /nang tshan go ba ze'u ste/ /pha ming a ti nā tha zhes/ /dpa' zhing brtul phod stobs rtsal ldan/ /234

gzhon nu nyid nas chos sgor zhugs/ /yi dam lha snyen mang song zhing / /ya rab sems ldan zhig yin lagasaglu/ /ma ni 'bru zhes che btsan rigs/ /rgya nag bod kyi yul mtshams na/ /pā la k+ṣe mdo zhes grags parka/ /rta zhon dag gi gro skad rer/ /grong khyer mtha' skor nus tsam pa'i/ /dpon po de yi rigs skyes pa'i—/ /badz+ra sa mu tra zhes pa/ /chos la mos shing dad brtson can/ /lhag pa'i lha yang zhal mjal zhing / /gnyug ma'i ngo mthong zhig yin lags/ /cho 'phrang de 'dra'i bu ru bdag /o rgyan gnas dang dbyer med pa'iske/ khams kyi btsan ri bkrag bzang gis/ /nub byang ri khrod dung dkar zhes/ /bsam gtan sgom pa'i spyil po ru/ /za byed rgyal gyi zla bar skyes/ /skyes zhag bdun nas rje dam pa/ /bde chen gling pas rjes su bzung / /tshe dbang nor bur ming su btags/ /zla ngo gsum nas tshig brda' sprod/ /bdun nas bri dang lan 'debs shes/ /lo gsum lhag par dus kun tu/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi bsrung ba'i/ /rtags mtshan nye bar gnas pa kun/ /mthun snang nyid du grub byung zhing / /sngon gyi bag chags 'ga' yang sad//tshe rab rtags kyi rigs bdag po/ /pad+ma mkha' la yang yang mjal/ /skye ba snga ma'i yongs 'dzin 'ga'/ /sus ma slab par mtshan bklag cing / /skyabs 'gro lha phyag 'tshal ba dang / /skabs re r+ghaṃ gi glu blangs shing ske/ /dbang bskur chos bshad ngang tshul sogs/ /dam pa'i bag chags nyid la spyod/ /sngon gyi skye gnas 'phreng ba yang / /mang zhig mi lam sad snang ltar/ /yid la yang nas yang du dran/ /skabs su gzhan rgyud shes pa sogs/ /sngon sbyangs mngon pa 'ga' yang byung / /lo lnga lon tshe gong ma yi/ /dbon gyur rnams kyis bdag gi tshod/ /bgam phyir 'dra min chas rnams kyang / /ma 'dres mngon gyur rnyed na'ang / /khrel khrel mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan las/ /phan 'dogs bdag rkyen byas pa med/ /'di lor klog kyang bslab byas pas/ /dbu can dbu med tshegs med chub/ /drug la rtsa ba'i bla ma'i drung / /snying thig rdzogs chen yongs rdzogs dang —/ /bai ro'i dgra lha mgon po yis/ /sgrub bskor rab chen phal cher nos/ /bdun la rdo rje gro lod kyi/ /las byang blor bzung yi dam byas/ /bskyed rim dag la blo yang byang / /'dre bgegs 'dul ba'i snyems pa skyes—/ /lha yi rjes su bzung ba'i rtags/ /thun mong thun min 'ga' yang byung / /chos kun rmi lam lta bur rtogasaglu/ /brgyad la gter ston sangs rgyas gling / /gter chos thugs rje chen po'i skor/ /rgyab chos yang gsang 'od tra la/ /bltas pas tshig la go ba chags/ /rkyen des sad nas da bar du/ /rtsa ba yan lag bla ma laske/ /nyams chags med cing gus pa byas/ /bcu la blo gros cung zad rgyas/ /yul de'i rnam dpyod grub pa laske/ /chos kyi 'bel mchid gleng bslang nus/ /mang zhig sun phyungs kha skyengs bcol/ /deng sang dran tshe las sog par/ /mthong nas 'gyod bshags bgyis shing mchis/ /bcu gcig lon tshe bla ma rje/ /dran mchog srog gi dngas ma'i drung / /klong gsal mkha' 'gro snying thig gis/ /lung rnams lhag lus med par 235

nosaske/ /gzhan yang dbang lung ci rigs thob/ /snang ba sems su go ba skyes/ /sgyu ma lta bur bden med rtogasaglu/ /tshe 'di'i nus pas dben na yang / /skye sngon yi dam lhag pa'i lhas/ /byin gyis brlabs mthu'i de'i skabs/ /gza' btsan klu bdud ma mo sogs/ /dregs pa mang pos srog snying phul/ /bcu gnyis lon tshe dam pa mchog /gter ston 'gyur med rdo rje yis/ /thugs sras bi mut+ta bha tra/ /'dus pa mdo sgyu sems kyi dbang / /gtad rgya bcas te yongs su nos/ /gzhan yang gter gsar skor yongs rdzogs/ /dbang lung cha tshang legs par thob/ /'di dus byis pa'i tshul med par/ /sdod tshugs brtan zhing dbang chos tshig /legs nyan lhag chad med par byas/ /de nas rang lo bcu gsum par/ ci rong dben pa rol lam du/ /rig 'dzin yongs kyi 'khor los bsgyur/ /dpa' bo pad+ma bde gling drung / /byang chub zla ba'i tshes brgyad la/ /mdo rgyud chos rnams thams cad kyis/ /snying po sems nyid gnyug ma'i don/ /dbang rnams kun gyi mthar thug pa/ /bskyed rims yongs kyi snying po che/ /thabs lam yongs kyi gtso gyur pa/ /lhan skyes ye shes gnas lugs zhes/ /don gyi sdom pa'i mchog gyur pa/ /don dam sems ni sems bskyed gtso/ /dam tshig kun gyi bsdus don ni/ /phyag rdzogs zhes su grags gyur te/ /sbyor dngos rjes tshang smin khrid nos/ /'di skabs gsung tshig khrid thun kun/ /da bar yid la ma brjed zhing / /deng sang gzhan la 'chad skabs yang / /bla ma'i gsung nyid shas cher yin/ /'di lo rang gi nyams myong yang / /'jig 'jig sbad kham byed chog pa/ /med kyang gnas 'gyu rig pa yis/ /brten phur 'khrul med lam rkang zin/ /mtshan snang phal cher 'dres pa byung / /bka' drin can de'i thugs rje'o/ /rang lo brgyad nas 'di skabs kun/ /bus pa'i bag chags cher med par/ /rje btsun bla ma dam pa la/ /chos kyi dri smad rtags byas shing / /bka' stsal me long chu blugs su/ /ma song yid la rab tu 'jags/ /bla ma'i mdzad pa tha dag kyang / /brda' dang rten 'brel ma gtogs pa/ /tha mal tshul spyod yin snyam med/ /dam tshig ched du lus srog la/ /ltos pa med pa'i zhe gdeng yod/ /rang gi dngos chas gang yod kun/ /bla mar 'bul ba'i zhe khams yod/ /'khor ba'i chos la bsun pa ni/ /spang du sbrul zhugs lta bu yod/ /dam pa'i chos la spyod 'dod pa/ /ma gcig bu 'phrad 'dod 'dra yod/ /'di skabs grogs rkyen ngan pa dang / /'grogs med ri khrod brten nas ni/ /da bar nyams len dril ba zhig /byung na rig 'dzin gong ma yis/ /rgyal sa zin tsam 'dug lags te/ /pha ma 'khor slob grogs mang gis/ /da lta chos brgyad gting na mchis/ /bsam zhing snying nas skyo ba skyes/ /lo de'i ston gzhug rig 'dzin rje/ /pad ma nor bu'i gdan sa ru/ /rjed de'i rigs dbon chos kyi sras/ /skal bzang bstan 'dzin sku shog nas/ /gsu bar byung zhing gdan sar phyin/ /grwa 'khor kun nas mkhas sman pa/ /spu med skom gdan tshul du byas/ /bde dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong / /'di snang chos brgyad 236

zhen pa yi/ /chu mgo thog ma de nas brtsam/ /bcu bzhir skye mang las 'brel ba'i/ /bla ma kaḥthog rgyal ba'i srasaske/ /bsod nams lde'u btsan zhabs pad brten/ /rtsa gsum dbang bzhi zab rgyas dang / /yan lag dkyil 'khor drug cu tsam/ /lung dang rjes gnang rgyas par nos/ /skal bzang bstan 'dzin zhabs la yang tso/ /dbang ches gdams pa mang du thob/ /de skabs gdan sa'i las tshan tshos/ /khyad gsod brnyas pa ma gtogs par/ /bdag la mthong bskur ma mdzad yang / /rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras des ni/ /thugs kyi sras su yongs bzung nas/ /brtse gzigs gzhan las khyad 'phags gnang / /rdo rje rig pa'i khye'u chung gisaske/ /sprul pas phyi mtha' gzigs par nges/ /lo de'i 'jug la ci rong du/ /skyabs mchog bla ma'i zhabs pad brten/ /bco lngar phyag chen gdams pa la/ /nyams len zhi gnas brtan por skyes/ /dgun ngor nyi phug grub pa ru/ /skye bdun sgrub pa'i gral du phyin/ /thugs rje chen po yang tig gis/ /'dus pa chen po'i sgrub dbang nos/ /de ni shin tu skal ba bzang / /bcu drug dag la rdzogs chen gyis/ /sems byang skor dang yang gsang nas/ /gzhan las khyad 'phags sger du nos/ /thabs lam gtum mo'i skor yang thob/ /lhag mthong nyams myong bzang po skyes/ /deng sang rtse gcig skad de lo/ /lo der rdo rje 'chang dbang yang chos nyid zhi la gshegs gyur pas/ /dgongs pa rdzogs thabs gang 'grub byas/ /bcu bdun lo la bcad rgya'i khung //cung zad byas yang sems nyid kyi/ /'khrul rgyun lugs brgyud ma bcad pas/ /nyams la bogs skyed cher ma byung / /'on kyang rmi lam 'byung gyur ltas/ /mtshar mtshar rgyu ba mang zhig dang / /tshe 'di'i rten 'brel gyur 'ga' la/ /sngags bsrung tshub kyang ci rigs byung / /mgrin pa'i rlung sbyor nus pa yis brtsom pa sngar las myur tsam byung / /bco brgyad sne la gtsang gro yis/ /gnas mjal song bas nyams myong bog /cung zad thon gyur slar gdan sar/ /phyin zhing 'di lor mkha' 'gro yis/ /cho 'phrul gyur pa mang tsam dang / /gnam gter zhig kyang shar tshad tshad/ /byung yang gnyer kha ma byas shing / /btang snyoms ngang du zhag byas so/ /de'i rgyu mtshan gang zhe na/ /gnam gter mtshan ldan byung ba ni/ /nang gi gter yin ches zab kyang / /tshad ldan gyur pa re re tsam/ /de bas snyigs dus 'di 'dra yis/ /bslu ba khye nyan che ba dang / /zab mo'i rten 'brel sgrib pa yang / /yod zhes bla ma rje las thos/ /des na do gal ye ma byas/ /lha re 'drer dogs rnam rtog cher/ /rang rgod lo 'dod dbang gyur pa'i/ /'dre khyer bla rul rgyud pa min/ /rang dbang rang gis ma thob pa'o/ /bsnyen mtshams dag kyang cung zad byas/ /yon tan ltas dang lhong tshad yang / /bzod par dka' ba mang du byung / /nyams ngor o rgyan rje yang mjal/ /'byung 'gyur dus kyi lung bstan yang / /rim pa gnyis tsam skabs 'dir byung / /lo 'jug gdan sa'i grwa tshang gi/ /yid 'byung rang nyid gcig pu ru/ /bswo la rgyud nas gtsang khro ru/ /sgrub pa byed pa'i 'dod pas phyin/ /de yang rang dbang ma 237

thob ste/ /grogs ngan dbang gis sgrub pa bshol/ /bcu dgur dran mchog dngas ma yis/ /bsti gnas seng khrom ri ngogs su/ /bsnyen mtshams cung zad zhig kyang byas/ /zab mo'i sgo 'phar 'byed nus pa'i/ /ltas gyur yang yang byung na yang / /rang nyid le lo che ba dang / /grogs ngan rkyen gyis yal te song / /'on te chos zab bdud zab pas/ /'ga' zhig las phro bzang ldan yang / /zab mo'i rten 'brel mi 'grig bzhin/ /bar chad dbang gi g.yo zol sogs/ /log pa'i lam du gyur mang pas/ /bdag ni khyab bdag bla ma'i mthus/ /rgyu 'bras las la yid ches shing / /re dogs rtog pas mi thugs pas/ /zab mo'i rten 'brel ma 'grig kyang ske/ /log pa'i lam du yongs ma zhugs/ /bdag 'dra phyi 'byung gyur rnams kyang / /'di 'drar bag zon snying nas 'tshal/ /slar yang gdan sa phyogs su phyin/ /yul ljongs du ma thag ltar bran/ /lo rgyus brjod la dub pa skyes/ /rang lo nyi shu'i sner 'khyos tshe/ /gnas mchog dpal gyi ri bkra ru/ /sgrub mtshams dam por bgyid byas nas/ /lhag pa'i lha yi grangs tshad kyis/ /bsnyen pas bskyal bas yi dam lhas/ /rjes bzung bgegs las grol ba'i ltas/ /mang byung mtha' gzhug cung ma 'khyol/ /slar yang gnas der mkha' 'gro yi|/bsnyen mtshams byas skabs snyan grags che/ /'byung ba'i ltas kyang legs par byung / /lung bstan than thun 'dra yang shar/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i snyan rgyud mchog /shin tu zab pa 'ga' yang byung / /de skabs yul der 'khrug long pas/ /sri brtul khams mchu bsdum pa yi/ /g.yeng bas bstan 'gror phan nges pa'i /zab mo'i rten 'brel 'ga' 'chug song / /rang lo nyer gcig zin pa'i skabs/ /sbas pa'i sangs rgyas grub pa'i dbang / /kun bzang rin chen zhabs brten nas/ /thabs lam zab pa'i gnad chen po/ /yi ge med pa mang zhig dang / /drag sngags phyag zhes ci rigs zhus/ /drag po ye shes rab 'bar gyis/ /dbang lung smin cing rgyas pa'ang nos/ /lo der ye shes dhāk+ki mas/ /rjes su bzung bltas khyad par can/ /du ma yang nas yang du byung / /rdzas gter phran bu rnyed na yang / /gzhan rkyen rtog pas chud zos song / /nyams kyi snang bar dpal chen po/ /badz+ra ku ma ra'i zhal mjal/ /nyams myong sngar dang mi 'dra ba/ /rig pa rtsis gdab med pa yis/ /khral khrol ban bun yad ma yud/ /rkyen kun lam du blangs nus shing / /snang sems zung 'jug nyams myong skyes/ /sngar lo 'di lo gnyis ka ru/ kham mchu'i mching sgrigs grong chog sogs/ /mi chos go chod yin 'dra ba'i/ /mdzes mjos de 'dra ma byas par/ /rang dbang rang gi thob bzhin du/ /sgrub par nan tan bgyid thub cing / /byin rlabs bla ma'i rten 'brel yang / /'grig par gyur na phyi nang gi/ /mchog la legs par spyod gyur zhing / /skye dang 'chi ba yang nas yang / /sun pa ma dgos tsam yong par/ /yod kyang gzhan dbang rkyen gyis ni/ /zab mo'i rten 'brel yal te song / /go ma chod pa'i rtog spyod lagasaglu/ /nyer gnyis lo la rtsen chen du/ /dad ldan bdun phrag lhag tsam la/ /zab mo'i khrid kyang phran bu 238

bshad//thabs lam nyams len sngar nas yang / /byed khul 'di dus gtan la phabs/ /bla ma mkha' 'gros byin rlabs pa'i/ /mtshan ma cung zad tsam rnyed nas/ /gsang lam skor 'ga' yi ger bkod/ /dbyar ngo shin dgu gangs rar phyin/ /lhongs tshad tshar tshad nyams tshar ba/ /mang byung re zhig 'dir ma smos/ /ser tshogs stong phrag gsum lhag dbus/ /mngon spyod gtor ma brjid pas 'phongs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i ltas 'ga' shar/ /lo 'jug stag bu re khe'i rdzong / /pe'u lung gi dben gnas su/ /brgya phrag lhag la tshogs khrid byasaske/ /'di dus khrid lo legs pa yis/ /kun la ngo sprod theb par byung / /tshe 'di'i khe drag med ngos nas/ /bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs dmigs te/ /'gro don yin khul chos bka' khrid/ /bshad pa'i thog ma 'di nas yin/ /de phror ci rong ting ri ru/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i rigs kyi sras/ /dam par gtum mo'i khrid skyar phulaske/ /gnas bdag 'tshub nyams chen po yis/ /dgun sgong hor zla bcu gnyis par/ /thog 'khyug ser ba bab pa byung / /ting nge 'dzin gyis gzir pa yis/ /phyi ni sa bdag mo des kyang / /rang gzugs bstan nas bran khas blangs/ /mthar ni gnas der rab dge ba'i/ /'ja' yi rkang pa ya mtshan zug /'khor lo pad+ma rgya gram dang / /rin chedz+wa'abar ba'i gzugs gyur pa/ /gar mkhan lag pas phyogs mtshon yang / /bcos par dka' ba'i char ba 'bab/ /rmi lam dge mtshan 'ga' yang shar/ /khyad par dam pa mi pham mgonaske//zhal mjal byin rlabs phyag chen gyi/ /gdam pa bka' gtad zab mo thob/ /nye ba'i mgon po sprin 'dzin gyis/ /thun mong dngos grub bzang po yi/ /rten 'brel dge ba dus der sgrigs/ /nyer gsum sne la mchog sprul rje/ /gter ston la li ta badz+ra/ /zhabs pad snyegs par 'dod na yang / /bsod nams chung ba'i dbang gi bshol/ /ci rong rol lam ri khrod du/ /phur pa'i bsnyen mtshams yod pa'i skabs/ /rmi lam snang bar rig 'dzin de/ /mjal zhing smon lam byin rlabs gnang / /de dus zhing gzhan gshegs tshod gda'—/ /mchog de'i zhal dkyil ma mjal bar/ /da lta shin tu 'gyod par yod/ /gnas der mdun rgyab thur mar sbyangs/ /de dus rtsel ba ma bshol na/ /srog thur 'dres la tshegs med byung / /'on kyang nyams rgyus chung bas bshol/ /dgon der chos khrid cung bshad pas/ /khong tshor phan tsam byung na yang / /dam tshig gnas min ci rigs pas/ /rang la grib ldang 'khu ldog byung / /de 'phro ting ri gro gom du/ /rgyal ba'i sras po'i zhabs drung du/ /zla shas sdod gsung bka' ltar byas/ /kyai ma/ rang lo nyer gsum zin de'i bar/ /rang gi nyams myong rtogs pa ni/ /phyogs cha tsam zhig mthong na yang / /lta ba klong du ma gyur zhing / /mos gus gnad du 'gro mi 'gro/ /nyams rtogs 'phel grib tshad bzung med/ / ldang grol shar cha tha zad cing / /skabs su gnas lugs ngo mthong ba/ /de las lhag 'dod ltos gzhi sgrib/ /skabs su bcos sgom dri can la/ /yin rlom khengs pas ngo bo sgrib/ /sngon las 239

dbang dang 'phral rkyen stabs/ /rtsa rlung thig le'i byed pa yis/ /khams 'dus snying rlung la sogs dang / /bde gsal mi rtogs la sogs pa/ /brjod pa'i mtha' gzhal su yi nus/ /skabs su snang sel 'dre 'dra zhing ske/ /skabs su gzung 'dzin phra rags 'tshubs/ /skabs su stong nyid rtogs 'dra zhing / /skabs su a thas zhen dbang shar/ /skabs su lta gdengs thob 'dra zhing / /skabs su yid gnyis mang po ldang / /de kun nyams kyi shar ba ste/ /'phel 'grib kho yi cho 'phrul 'char/ /de skabs dus kun rang nyid kyang / /lus gnad mnyam bzhag lta stangs la/ /dga' zhing gzhan la'ang ma yengs zhes/ /yang yang bskul ma 'debs shing yod/ /de yang nyams thug zhad du 'dug /sems kyi rang mdangs phyi nas yang / /dngos dang khyad par nyams kyi skabs/ /yengs ma lam dang yad yud du/ /yi dam lha dang ut+ta ra/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong lha 'dre tshogs/ /yid ngor zad med mthong ba sogs/ /rtog tshogs rang mdangs cir yang snang / /skabs su chos tshigs ngo mtshar ba/ /tshigs bcad gnyis gsum bzhi la sogs/ /ma bsam kha nas thol thol rdol/ /gtam rgyud ngo mtshar 'ga' zhig dang / /chos kyi go don zab pa yang / /yid la ma dpyad shugs 'byung 'charaske/ /rnal 'byor nyams dang dbyar gyi spangs/ /ci yang rdol ba'i dbe ru snang / /de dus nyams kyi bogs 'don mkhan/ /lta gdengs thob pa'i bla ma zhig /mjal ba'i dung pa ches che zhing / /rgyal khams 'grims 'dod shar na yang / /sngon gyi las smon khyad par du/ /'phral rkyen grogs po chos sems can/ /med pas gzhan du thon ma thub/ /rang yul der ni dus de skabs/ /nyams rtogs mthar phyin nges shes su//gyur cing rang gi blor babs pa/ /skye sngon las 'brel thob pa yi/ /bla ma zhig ni ma byung bas/ /dbang lung 'brel pa tsam ma gtogs/ /nyams len bgegs sel bogs 'don sogs/ /zhu 'dod med pas ci bde lusaske/ /de dag zhar gyi gleng mor smras/ /rang lo nyer gsum lon pa yi/ /ston dus rje btsun rdo rje 'chang / /dran mchog rtsa ba'i bla ma yi/ /gnyis pa che tshangs mchog sprul zhabs/ /brten phyir smar khams dben rdzong phyinaske/ /phyag chen gdams pa zab khyad dang / /rdo rje 'chang gi smin byed nos/ /rdzogs chen gsang ba ye shes kyiske//thod rgal don gyi ngo sprod thob/ /pha yi bu ltar brtse gzigs dang / /bka' drin shin tu che bas bskyang //gzhan don gyis zhes dbugs dbyung mdzad/ /slar yang rang gnas yong ba'i mtshams/ /'byung khams 'khrug pa'i nad kyis nyen/ /lam khyer rtogs pa'i bogs kyang thon/ /de skabs dregs pa 'ga' yis ni/ /srog gi snying po phul ba dang / /bde chen ri dbang ban rag gis/ /yul phyogs de yi gter ston rigs/ /'ga' la tshad ldan yin min gyis/ /lung bstan byas pa dag kyang mchis/ /bshad na khrom seb mdung bskor dgos/ /de ltar dran bsam min pa nas/ /rang lo nyer gsum 'khod kyis bar/ /chos kyi phyag rgya skad pa yi/ /lha sku bskyed rim sgyu ma ltar/ /rgyun du gsal ngar ma theb kyang / /wal wal rtag tu gang 'dris 240

byasaske//dam tshig phyag rgya rtsa rlung yang / /rdor bzlas rlung sbyor bum pa can/ /gtum mo las dang ye shes kyi/ /rnal 'byor nar mar spyod pa dang / /bcu drug skabs nas bla ma rje'i/ /bka' bzhin lo dgu ras rkyang byasarka/ /las bzhi'i thig ge'i rim pa yang / /bcu gcig skabs su thabs lam gyis/ /yig cha mthong bas mos gus skyes/ /gsang khrid chos zhor la nos shing / /de nas bzung ste nyer gsum bar/ /dam pa 'ga' la gsang khrid skor/ /legs zhus ye shes shes rab la/ /brten nas dngas ma skyil bzlog bkram/ /rjes mthun bde stong zung 'jug gshis/ /grol lam snying po'i bogs 'don du/ /thabs lam rang lus byang byas shing / /phyi yi kun spyod tshangs mtshungs las/ /gdams pa thob nas gom 'dris yi/ /long med bud med hab thob dang ske/ /'phrul 'khor kyag kyog sad sud rlung / /rdo rjes hu sgra sgrogs tsam la/ /khengs nas zab mo'i gdengs med par/ /bag med dbang gi gzhan lus la/ /ring bar rngams pa de ma byas/ /phyag chen gnas lugs gnyug ma'i dngos/ /khregs chos don gyi nyams len kyang / /bcu gcig skabs su zhi gnas skyes/ /bcu gsum lo la ngo sprad thob/ /zhi lhag phyogs re ma yin par/ /zung 'jug nyid du skyes gyur yang / /'on te brtson 'grus dman pa yi/ /gong du cung zad smos pa ltar/ /rtogs pa brtan po ma shar yang / /gegs gol dbang du ye ma gyur/ /'od gsal thod brgal snang bzhi la/ /skye sngon las dbang zhig gis ni/ /lo bzhi skabs nas mngon sum don/ /ngo 'phrod nyams len tshul mtshon shes/
