/skyong khul byas pas snang mun du/ /rigs pa ci bzhin 'char bar 'gyur/ /zhes rang lo nyer gsum pa yan gyi rtogs brjod sa bon tsam song ngo —/ /de yi 'phros brjod pa/ rang lo nyer bzhi lon pa'i tshe/ /ko sha'i mtshal chung brtse chen du/ /skal bzang slob ma bcu phrag bdun/ /lhag tsam dag la yang gsang che/ /rdo rje snying po rdzogs chen khrid/ /thod rgal ma gtogs thams cad la/ /nor 'khrul med par zhib bshad byas/ /de skabs mi lam snang ba ru/ /sngon byon rdzogs chen bla rab 'ga'/ /zhal mjal gsung thos rjes gnang thob/ /de dang khyad par tshe 'di ru/ /rang skal babs pa rdo rje 'chang / /rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam gnyis kyis/ /byin rlabs mtshan ma bzang po ru/ /nyams len bogs kyang ci rigs thon/ /go dka'i rdo rje'i tshig rnams yang / /sngar las cung zad blo rgyas te/ /rdzogs chen gnad gsang 'ga' yang khrol/ /gnas lugs gshis kyi ngo bo yi/ /phyogs cha de dus mngon gyur bas/ /bde sdug 'phel 'grib byung kyang rung / /kho rang gnyis min gcig tu 'dres/ /de dang lhag mthong ngo bo ni/ /tha snyad thob rung ma thob rung / /dus der dge sbyor rkang pa tshugs/ /lo de'i dbyar ngor rgya yan phyogs/ /phyin pas yul gyi bdud rtsis mthus/ /sngar las nyams myong rtsal kha rgyas/ /gang shar kho yi rol tsam mthong / /sbas yul gser khrom g.yang rar yang / /bsgrod pas pad+ma'i sku brnyan sogs/ /sngon med mang po ltas mor myong / /lo 'jug bla ma dam pa yi/ /bsti gnas ci rong gser khrom zhol/ /bstan dang 'gro 241

don lhag bsam gyis/ /lha bhem gyad stobs cung snyems pas/ /las byed ma mgon pho nya yi/ /dkyil 'khor zhal phyes zla gcig bar/ /bsnyen dang sgrub pa'i gzhung bzung nas/ /rgyal bstan spyi dang bye brag tu/ /gsang chen snying po'i ring lugs la/ /sdang bar byed pa'i dgra bo dang / /khyad par bla ma'i sku yi dgra/ /gzhan yang nyes med la 'tshe byed/ /mngon spyod gdul byar gyur pa 'ga'/ /dkar dmar nag por bris dkyur bkodaske/ /spyir ni mi khri rta 'bum mtshon/ /bye brag ming gsal bdun cu lhag /hom du sgrub nas rbad bsad kyi—//las la sbyar bas rtags kyang rdzogs/ /khyad par ye shes mgon po ni/ /rdo rje slob dpon skur sprul nas//dngos su byin rlabs chos dka' gtad/ /mgon por dam tshig bsre ba'i skabs/ /der 'dus grogs rnams 'jigs gzugs kyi/ /rengs la khas par byung zer zhing / /bsgral dang me hom skabs su yang / /rang la mthong snang 'ga' byung zhing / /nyer dgur drag po'i zor 'phen byas/ /bsregs thal mdze thod dmar por grub/ /gting ring gshin rje'i dong du 'phang / /hom sbyor bzas po ming gsal rnams/ /lo gsum khong du phal che ba/ /lho phyogs grong khyer nyams dgar dengs/ /dregs gyur mi kun dpa' yang 'khumaske/ /de ltar las sbyar gzas po la/ /chos khrims bshig cing phyag rdzas dkor/ /brung jag rgyugs pa'i ser gzugs gcig /ma gtogs bstan dang bla ma yi/ /sku dgra gyur pa 'ba' zhig las/ /rang gi dgra ni gcig kyang med/ /'dir snang zhen dbang drag sngags kyis/ /sbyor bas thar med ngan song gi /gting rdo byed mkhan ma yin gyi/ /rgyal ba'i bstan dang bla ma mchog /gnyan phyir mngon spyod drag po las/ /rang 'dod gsal ba ye med par/ /drag sngags sgrub pa'i sngags 'chang yin/ /phyogs zhen nye ring gnyen don dang ske/ /rang 'dod zhen pas sgrub ma myong / /'on te brtags 'khon zhe gnag 'ga'/ /las la sbyor ba ma byas kyang / /bsrung mas bka' chad 'phebs par snang / /rngam rngam rtsig rtsig drag sngags la/ /nus pa che che po min yang / /dam tshig dbang gi bsrung ma rnams/ /las la cung zad 'khol te mchis/ /nyer lnga'i lo sner rdzong 'bur mor/ /phag dmar bsnyen pa tshad la bskyal/ /bar chad med par mtha' ru son/ /bskyed rim phra mor gom 'dris gyur/ /ba zil dgon du tshogs chen la/ /phyag rdzogs khrid bshad dag kyang byas/ /de bzhin pe'u lung tshogs pa ni/ /mchog dman sum brgya lhag tsam la/ /khri bshad gu ru'i sgrub chen btsugs/ /de 'phror bla ma rin po che/ /kun rnam dang bcas gle gsal gyi/ /nang 'khrugs bsdum nas bde bar byas de nas bod chen rdo rje gdan/ /kaḥthog rgyal ba'i bste gnas mchog /der phyin rgyal ba'i rgyal sras gang / /legs mjal smin grol chos char bab/ /'byung 'gyur mkhyen bzhin rgyal tshab tu/ /rab bsngags dbugs dbyung rdo rje'i khrir/ /bkod nas shis brjod legs tshogs brtsams/ /de nas mi ring zhi bar gshegs/ /de nas yar rgyud bso dgon phyin/ /mdzes byed dbyar ra'i tshes bcu la/ /bla ma'i sku gdung 'od zhu phul/ /de 242

'phror drag po e klong du/ /drag sngags sgrub pas phyi nang rtags/ /ya mtshan dang bcas mtha' yi dmag /re zhig bsring ba'i gsal snang shar/ /lo de'i 'jug la rang dbang cung / /thob pas dbus gtsang dag zhing chas / /thog mar dpal ldan bla ma yi/ /gdan sa smar khams bdud rtsi thil/ /phyin nas rdor 'chang mi yi zolaske/ /rgyal ba kun gyi yab gcig pu/ /ho ru ka dpal bde ba mchog don gyi bslad nas mtshan gsol ba/ /rig 'dzin gsung rab rgya mtsho zhes/ /bdag gi rigs bdag dran mchog mgon/ /de yi zhabs pad nyer brten nas/ /tikhri nas bzung chig rgyud bka'/ /yi ge'i rgyun la ma 'phel ba'i/ /snyan rgyud rtsa ba zab don dang / /kam tshang snyan rgyud nor bu'i skor/ /gsum ldan bum pa gang byo nos/ /gzhan yang gdams ngag ci rigs thob/ /khyad par rang sems zhes bya ba/ /kun gyi rtsa ba kho thag chod/ /da lta rtogs gdeng mi ldan yang / /'byung 'gyur bskal bzang lung bstan tshul/ /phyag chen rtogs pa'i ngo sprad rtsal/ /gang ltar thar pa'i lam rkang ni/ /mgon de'i bka' drin mchog las rnyed/ /spyi yang lhan skyes sems nyid kyis/ /ngo sprod mkhan der dbang chos gzhan/ /tshig gcig ma thob na yang rung / /rtsa ba'i bla ma dngos yin la/ /dbang khrid rgya mtsho ltar nos kyang / /sems nyid ngo sprod ma thob phyin/ /drin chen bla ma los yin kyang / /rtsa ba'i bla mar mi 'dzin zhes/ /bka' brgyud bla ma yongs kyi bzhed/ /spyir ni sdom pa gsum ldan dang / /dbang rgyud man ngag nos yul de/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma yin no zhes/ /snga phyi shing rta che rnams gsungs/ /don la 'phags bod gnyis ka na/ /gnas lugs don dam ngo sprad mdzad/ /de ni rtsa ba'i bla ma ru/ /'dzin mthun bod yul phyag chen pa/ /rnams ni spros bral ngo bo nyid/ /ston mdzad de na rtsa bar bzhed/ /de yang dengs sang dus dbang gis—/ /phyag chen ngo bo phyogs mthong ni/ /rtse gcig skabs su yin gsung pas/ /zhi lhag zung 'jug rtse gcig gi /ngo bor bogs 'don ngo sprod mkhan/ /de la rtsa ba'i bla mar mdzad/ /'on kyang snying lugs rdzogs chen gyi/ /khregs chod ngo sprod theb tsam dang / /thod rgal snang ba mngon bstan bzhin/ /go don ma nor skyes pa na/ /de ston rtsa ba'i bla mar nges/ /bdag ni sems nyid ngo mthong ni/ /rig 'dzin bde chen gling pas sprad/ /de bogs gsung rab rgya mtshos ston/ /rtogs ni gnyis ka'i drin las rtogs/ /de na tshe 'dir sangs rgyas las/ /lhag pa'i drin can rtsa ba yi/ /bla ma dam pa de gnyis lags/ /gzhan gyuragang zag ngo mtshar dang / /chos 'brel thob pa'i bla ma kun/ /khong gnyis rnam 'phrul rol par go /rtsa ba'i bla ma gnyis po yang / /da lta rang sems gcig dang 'dres/ /mdangs la mos gus lhang lhang snang / /bsam bzhin bla ma'i bka' drin dran/ /de ltar rang los lnga phrag lnga/ /cha shas lhag bcas lo yi tshigs/ /ma chad sa bon tsam smras shing / /zhib par rtogs pa brjod pa ni/ /gzhan du ston pa las shes bya/ /de 'phro nas bzung da bar du/ /rgyas par lam yig la bkod rung / /'di ru mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i/ /bzhed pa ji bzhin cung 243

zad smras/ /khro mo shing 'brug dbyar zla ba/ /rtsi bcud rgyas pa'i dus skabs su/ /bla ma'i bste gnas nas thegs te/ /mdo khams gnas mchog ke rong nas/ /rin par karma rin chen brgyud/ /spar gnas mjal nas spu bor phyin/ /rig 'dzin chen po nus ldan pa'i/ /gdung rgyud sku mched zhabs pad brten/ /byin rlabs dbang bzhi'i bdag blo sim/ /lo de'i 'jug la yi gong sleb/ /stong phrag lhag gi tshogs pa la/ /bka' brgyad la sogs zhi bka' bskur/ /ri rgya klung rgya la sogs pa/ /srog 'don dge ba legs tshogs sgrubaske//sna tshogs dbyig zhes shing sbrul lo/ /sne zin skabs nas brag skas ljongs/ /rgyang phur gang rar gnas 'brel byas/ /de skabs 'dre dmag snying rlung sogs/ /cho 'phrul mang shar ye shes kyi/ /mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs ltas kyang byung / /dbyar ngor dgon pa yas man gyi/ /lha khang nang rten bzhengs byas shing / /khrid bshad kun kyang legs lam bkod/ /ri rgya rtag 'jag 'ga' yang byung / /'gro phan sgrub pa'i cha shas gyur//ston la brag la la nas thon/ /byang skong nyan gzhung 'ol kha brgyud/ /khra 'brug zan g.yang gtsug lag khang ske/ /legs mjal smon lam bzang po thebs/ /mtshur phu bde ba'i pho brang du/ /mi bskyod 'od mtshan cod pan can/ /mjal byas chos 'brel tsam re thob/ /zin gnon me rta shar ba'i tshe/ /rtag sna chos kyi pho brang du/ /byang sems dge slong rdo rje 'dzin/ /rje btsun byang chub chos dbang po'i/ /zhabs pad bsnyen nas rdzogs pa che/ /'ja' lus srog sgrub dbang khrid dang / /kun bzang dgongs pa 'dus pa yi/ /thod rgal don gyi ngo sprod thob/ /snying rgyud dbu mtha' bar gsum nos/ /gzhan yang dbang khrid ci rigs zhus/ /thugs yid chig tu 'dres pa byung / /de 'phror zab lung gnas 'brel phyin/ /rtsa gsum mkha' 'gro'i bsnyen tshad bskyal/ /der 'dus dad skal ldan rnams la/ /snying thig dbang khrid lung rdzogs dang / /bla ma dgongs 'dus dbang ka phul/ /dregs pa'i srog dbang bgyid pa'i skabs/ /gter bsrung mi la brlam byas nas/ /gus pa'i phyag phul dga'u tshor tshul/ /du ma byas byung dgyes ltas go/ /slar yang tre bo'i zhabs pad brten/ /dbang chos dag kyang ci rigs zhus/ /bdag la shis brjod mnga' gsol gnang / /de nas bya btang chas zhugs te/ /sog po nas rgyud rta nag phu/ /tsha lung bla mar rna gu yi/ /chos drug rdo rje'i tshig rkang nosaske/ /rmi lam ltas kyang ngo mtshar byung / /phun tshogs gling dang jo nang mjal/ /byang rgyud ru lag ri sul du//rdo rje'i rnal 'byor grub thob mchog /bha ṭa sa man+ta yi drung / /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor zhu 'dod pas/ /ched gtad phyin nas zhag gsum bar/ /gsol ba btab kyang zhal mjal tsam/ /ma byung bla ma'i mdzad spyod ni/ /chos brgyad med par yi rang zhing / /dad gus mchog tu 'phel bar byung / /grwa pa tsho la cung ma 'gu /spyir ni kho bo'i gshis khams la/ /dag snang grub mtha' phyogs ris med/ /'phrad thag mos mos zhum zhum po/ /rjes su mtha' med yal mkhan min/ /mkhas pa'i dpyad pa mi ldan yang / /blun po'i dad pa brtan po 244

yinaske/ /dad cing dbang lung zhu yul des/ /phyis nas mi bsad rta snyel ba/ /byas kyang dag snang gang 'byongs las/ /mi dad log lta med par mchis/ /spyir ni le lo ches che yang / /chos la brtson pa byed khul byasaglu/ /'di dag kho bo'i ngang tshul du/ /zhar byung 'phros su smra bar song / /de nas la stod ding ri nas/ /snye nam brgyud de bal por phyin/ kha shor shing kun mchod rten dang / /yang le shod sogs legs mjal zhing //lhag bsam smon lam rgya cher btab/ /spre'u zhes grags me lug lor/ /mang yul skyid grong dag tu slebs/ /rang byon wa ti mjal byas shing / /dpal 'bar ri la dbang gsum pa'i/ /bla sgrub bsnyen pa tshad la bskyalaske/ /zhing skyong ma mo kun tu sgyu'i/ /ga na tsakra longs yang spyad/ /gnas der 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen ni/ /tshe ring don ldan zhes bya ba'i/ /rnam dkar smon lam dag des sbyar/ /'jam gling bla ma yab sras la/ /gsar rnying 'dod chos 'ga' yang zhus/ /zhur mo gangs ra mjal phyin zhing / /dhā ki'i tshogs bskang brgya rtsa phul/ /bar chad sel ba'i ltas kyang byung / /de yi 'phro nas rim bzhin du/ /mdo bo che yi sngags 'chang dang | /'dzam gling drung dang byams sprin gyi/ /bla ma rnams dang rdzong 'dzin pa'i/ /sde pa la sogs mchog dman gyi/ /tshogs pa rnams la dbang lung khrid/ /gang la gang mtshams re ba bskang / /de dag khrod nas chos rgyud la/ /phan par byed snyam 'ga' zung la/ /khregs chod thod rgal zab bshad byas/ /gsang lam mkha' 'gro'i snyan rgyud yang / /dz+nyā na shri bha ṭa zhes/ /skye sngon las bzang 'brel can der/ /chos ka 'byed byas thog mar bshad/ /ston la rje btsun mi la yi/ /rdzong drug mjal zhing de zhor du/ /dad ldan 'dod ches 'ga' yang bshad/ /gung thang rgyal khab rten mjal zhus/ /sde pa zung la dbang ka phul/ /re zhig rje btsun bzhed rdor dang / /gsang bdag rdo grags mjal ba'i gnas/ /za 'og phug par sdod pa'i skabs/ /gser bzang grub pa'i dbang phyug sras/ /stobs ldan shugs 'chang rtsal dang 'phrad/ /smin grol spyi dang khyad par du/ /nges gsang snying po'i skor rnams bstan/ /de nas lha lding ri 'dabs rgyud/ /nub rir phyin nas sbas tshul gyi/ /rnal 'byor grub dbang 'ga' zhig la/ /khri rgyun dkon gyur 'ga' yang thob/ /de dag skabs su rang res kyang / /gar dbang rgyal dbang sprul sku dang / /che chen 'khrul zhig dam pa sogs/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug grub chen dang / /lha lding bla ma la sogs pa/ /dad ldan tshogs la khrid lung dbang / /so so'i thugs bzhed bzhin du byas/ /phur bu sa spre lo mgo la/ /gtsang nas mi yi dbang po ni/ /bsod nams stobs brgyas lung phebs bzhin/ /bstan 'gro'i don du bal po'i yul/ /mchod rten bya rung kha shor gyi/ /rab tu gnas pa byed phyir phyin/ /'gro ba spyi yi bsod dbang gi/ /rten 'brel legs tshogs ci lta bar/ /'grig par dka' ba chos nyid du/ /gyur kyang 'on te phral cung zad/ /phan pa'i rten 'brel bzang po shar//der bsgrod yar mar res gnyis kar/ /mi dbang chen po'i btsun mo la/ /zhi drag dbang bka' mang tsam 245

phul/ /lam zhor wa ti mjal yang phyin/ /de nas byams sprin la brgyud de/ /da lta mnga' ris mang yul dbus/ /ri bo dpal 'bar ri ngogs su/ /zab mo'i gnas lugs skyong bzhin du/ /bstan 'gror phan 'dun gang drag byas/ /cog ger gnas pa 'di ka lags/ /slad mar tshe mthar 'khyos thub na/ /bla ma'i thugs kyi dgongs rdzogs ched/ /bstan 'gro'i don du sgrub tshugs la/ /dmigs srol 'dren par nus pa zhig /bgyid blo mchis kyang ci zhig cha/ /snyigs dus tshe 'di glog dbang 'dra/ /nam 'chi cha med skyo ba'i gnas/ /myur du bsgom la bskul re ran/ /de ltar lo rkang ma chad tsam/ /sum bcu'i sne zin yan chad kyi/ /rtog brjod sa bon tsam song zhing / /zhib tu blta 'dod gzhan du shes/ /dngos dang rmi lam snang ba la/ /khyad par nyams snang stong gzugs su/ /rtsa gsum mjal dang chos skyong rnams/ /'go ba'i mtshan ma bstan pa dang / /lha 'dre gzhi bdag la sogs pa'i/ /gzugs bstan gtam thos gyur pa ni/ /sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor ji lta bar/ /bden med rdzun med ngang snang ba/ /brjod pas ci bya ci bde bar/ /rang gi ngo bo rang nyid thims/ /'on te dad ldan 'ga' yi ngor/ /cha shas tsam ni slar brjod srid/ /lar ni chos kun rang rig mdangs/ /gtad med ban bun a la la/ /kye ma ho/ tshe dbang nor bu zhes bya ba/ /zog kyis khengs pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /sgyu ma'i khye'u chung 'khrul pa'i sras/ /rmongs gyur bdag gi ngang tshul nyid/ /da dung yang ni 'di skad smra/ /rang lo nyer gsum sne nas bzungs/ /da lta sum bcu sne zin bar/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i dgongs rdzogs su/ /dmigs nas lhag bsam dag ngos nas/ /rang gzhan don gnyis gang grub khul/ /bgyid blo ma dor tsam pa byas/ /bskyed rim snang stong sgyu ma'i 'gros/ /bsam gtan dug gi ma sbags par/ /gsal snang brtan pa gang thob dang / /rgyun bsnyen 'bad rtsol ci nus gyis/ /zung 'jug 'bar zhu myong ba yang / /zhen med mnyam sbyor 'dus shes pas/ /rdul can phyogs ni rigs kyi sgrangs/ /longs spyod sdom 'dzin rje mthun sgrub/ /sems nyid gnyug ma'i ngo bo yang / /gol shor log nor mtha' spang nas/ /dri med rig pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /rang stobs gtan la gang phebs byas/ /mngon sum dbyings rig snang ba yang / /bshad pa kha la ma khyer bar/ /phyogs re ma yin zung 'jug dngos/ /dbang por spyod la gang nus kyi/ kha 'byams tshig gdeng ma khur bar/ /sems kyi sgro 'dogs ci chod byas/ /rang nyid zhi bde gnyer min par/ /gzhan phan bsam pa gang nus byas/ /bya ba gang dang gang byas pa/ /rgyal ba dgyes pa'i thabs su bsngos/ /dus kun mi rtag 'chi ba de/ /nam yong cha med dran nges byas/ /snang ba thams cad sgyu ma bzhin/ /yad yud ban bun lam blangs byas//rgyal bas gnang rnams ma gtogs par/ /rtsa sdom snying gi nor bur byas/ /nyes ltung cha shas gos kun yang / /bzang rdzus zo ler ma bzhag par/ /bslu med las la rab 'jigs pas/ /sun 'byin stobs kyi 246

bshags sdom byas/ /las 'bras dag la yid ches pas/ /'dor len rang gi gang nus byas/ /gzhan rgyud chos mthun sbyor bsam las/ /tshe 'di'i kha drag bslab ma myong / /rang skyon rang gi brtags dpyad byas/ /gzhan skyon 'ba' zhig rtags ma myong / /tshe 'di'i bya ba la zhen nas/ /ha cang gzhan dang bstun ma myong / /shugs 'byung gzhan phan sgrub pa la/ /ha cang 'brel thag bcad ma myong / /rang dbang rang gi gang thob lasaske/ /sna thag gzhan la gtad ma myongs/ /dkor nor rdzas la zhen pa yi/ /gzhan sgrub log 'tsho spyod ma myong ske/ /mtha' mod gsar 'grogs khrel med sogs/ /klad chung spyod pa skyong ma myong / /bya ba thams cad dam chos dang / /mthun par spyod pa gang nus byas/ /chos rnams thams cad rmi lam bzhin/ /zhen med snying po'i nyams len byas/ /de dag kho bo'i ngang tshul ni/ /sgro bkur bral ba'i rtogs brjod lags/ /kwa ye sngon las pha ma'i rtsa rigs dbang / /kho bo'i mi yi gshis tshul khams/ /sba gsang bral ba'i rtog brjod zhig/yang zhig da dung 'di skad lo/ /rtsa ba'i bla mar mos gus ni/ /bla ma'i ched du lus srog la/ /ltos med mchis pas deng sang gi /dus babs dang bstun dga' rab rlom/ /nyams len rtogs pa mi mtho yang / /phyag rdzogs chos kyi gnas lugs don/ /nor 'khrul skyon med tshul bzhin go /rang skya pher ba'i gdeng tshad long ske/ /spyod pa gzhan don mdzes mdzes dang / /lkog tu chal spyod med pa ru/ /ngo lkog gnyis po gang mtshungs su/ /rang sems dpang po bcas te byas/ /'on kyang las 'bras phra bcas la/ /yid ches gyur kyang snyigs ma'i dus/ /dug lnga rags pa'i skabs skyes pas/ /'dor len spyod pa che dka' yang / /rang rgyud chos dang gang 'dres su/ /spyod lo ma dor rtag tu byas/ /gsang sngags dam tshig gnyan po 'di/ /'jigs dang phan yon la sems pas/ /rang gi srog las lhag bltas nas/ /shin tu 'bad pas bsrung blo byas/ /sngar phan phral spyod 'ga' zhig ni/ /mi chos ltar du snang srid kyang / /bstan 'gror phan thabs lhag bsam dang / /ldan las rang 'dod zhe rnog med/ /tshe 'dir gzhan dbang bla gzugs kyi/ /gdul bya za zir 'du ba'i thabs/ /sngar yang ye nas ma byas shing / /da yang ye nas byed mi 'gyur/ /rang shugs 'du ba'i gdul bya yang / /zhen med chos la gang 'byor bgyis/ /dad pa'i dkor rdzas zang zing rnams/ /rang gi zas zhim gos 'jam dang / /gzhan bslu log 'tshor ma song bar/ /mched dang sbyin la gang 'gro byas/ /sngar phan chung ngu'i dus nyid nas/ /nor la sred pa che ba med/ /chos kyi grol ba ma lags te/ /rang bzhin mi yi gshis khams 'gyur/ /'phral du cung zad bsags pa yang / /bstan dang bla ma'i zhabs tog ched/ /bsam las phugs nor bgyid snyams pa'i/ /rtog pa ye nas shar ma myong / /nor rdzas chags pa chung shos te/ /bud med la ni dga' se yin/ /snying la bud med bcangs bzhin du/ kha mdzes btsun zog tshong don med/ /'on kyang phral du dga' ba las/ /phugs su zhen sred chen po med/ /mi spangs mi sgrub lam khyer las/ /ha cang 247

'chi spar tham mkhan min/ /zhe sdang 'phral du lang rkyen la/ /phugs su yal ba 'gyogs pa mchis/ /rkyen cher kyis bslad khong khro ni/ /lang ka gting nas rab gnas pa/ /bzlog par 'dod kyang mi gshis kyi/ /'phral du bsgyur bkod dka' tsam 'dug /'on te gzhan ngor sngon bka' rgyud/ /zhe sdang khong khro ci skyes kyang ske/ /gting na snying rje'i sa bon ni/ /med pa nam du yong ma myong / /sems ni khro 'khrug 'bar bzhin du/kha nas g.yo sgyus tshig 'jam po/ /smra ba'i bskal ba ma thob pas/ /mdo khams nas bzung 'di yi bar/ /gyong ba'i grags pa 'ba' zhig thob/ /nga rgyal can dang 'grogs pa'i dus/ /bdag kyang nga rgyal can du yodaske/ /nga rgyal chung dang 'grogs pa'i dus/ /bdag kyang nga rgyal med par yod/ /chos la bzod pa ma thob pas / /grogs spyod dbang gi 'char bar 'dug /phrag dog da bar shin tu chung / /ma 'dris mi la smra ba dog /'dris shing ngag kyang smra bar yod/ /tshur la rang dang bstun bzhin du/ /phar la gang nus bstun mkhan yin/ /tshur la yang yang brnyas pa na/ /byang gi g.yag rgod 'dra ba yin/ kha sag 'dza' 'dza' mi shes pas/ /mi rnams mi 'gu 'dug na yang / /'di nang chu yi ri mo la/ /gtad so med do ci bder chug /sam sam rdzig rdzig che 'dod kyang / /byed med ci bder spyod mkhan yin/ /'di phyi kun gyi re ltos yul/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma gcig pu brten/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras thams cad kyang / /de la ma 'dus gcig kyang med/ /'di nas sangs rgyas ma thob bar/ /smos kyang ci dgos de bas kyang / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob na yang / /rigs kyi bdag por yongs su mchod/ /snyam pa'i mos gus brtan po ni/ /gnas skabs tsam min dus kun yod/ /bla ma dkon mchog dgyes pa na/ /su ma 'gu yang zhe blo bde/ /zhe blo bde ba'i gdeng mchis kyang ske/ /da dung 'brel thag mi chod mtshar/ /dam chos rdzogs chen nyams blangs nas/ /lhag med 'od skur snyegs pa zhig /byed bsam byis pa'i dus nyid na/ /mchis kyang dben pa snyegs pa'i dbang / /las kyi ma byung kye hud kye/ /ri gzar rbab ltar ldog med blo/ /che bzhag chung bshol byas nas ni/ /dben pa'i gnas su ma bros na/ /'khor ba'i du kha thar ba yi/ /go skabs ye nas mi rnyed par/ /rnam g.yeng bdud du ngo shes kyang rka/ /klu yi rgyal po e la bzhin/ /las kyi grub 'di dka' ba'i gnas/ /bdag skyon kun gyi che shos su/ /le lo 'di che brtson 'grus chung / /de la bsam zhing rang nyid kyi/ /rang la che skyo 'chi ma dku /'on kyang rdo rje theg pa'i lam/ /bla ma'i thugs rje la brten nas/ /ye shes rtogs na sus ci smra/ /de ltar rang gi skyon gyur kun/ /bzang bzang phag tu ma sbas par/ /gang shar lhug par brjod pa ste/ /'dam gyi nang nas nor bu dang / /mi gtsang 'dam nas pad+ma bzhin/ /skyon gyur dag nas yon tan bsgyur/ /'gyur bar yongs su rgyas btab ste/ /smras 'di kun gyi khrel lam snyam/ /da dung yang ni zog po che/ /stong shob mkhan des 'di skad smras/ / 248

a ho/ tshe 'di snang ba rmi lam bzhin/ /yad ma yud 'di ya re cha/ /ya cha kho yang a thang chad/ /byar med ngang du ta la la/ /legs nyes dga' sdug bde mi bde/ /thos par byed dang de gzhan 'chad/ /gcig la blangs nas gzhan la rten/ /zhib dang rtsing por spyod pa sogs/ /tha dag sgyu ma'i 'phrul 'khor bzhin / /ngo bo cir yang ma grub pa'i/ /stong nyid rnam kun mchog ldan mkha'/ /brjod du bral ba'i ngo bor ltosaske/ /ltos zhes tshig kyang phyi shun te/ /phyi shun nyid kyang yang dag don/ /yod la med pa'i snying po can/ /med la yod pa'i nges pa can/ /yod med mtha' bral klong du thim/ /thim min thim mo brjod pa yang ngo bor ltas na ya re cha/ /gang mang med do cir yang shar/ /skye 'gag gnas mtha' bral lo skad/ /phyi nang kun rtog bcos mas bslad/ /ma bcos bzhag na phyi nang ci/ /phyi nang med pa'i nyams len bral/ /yod med kho rang gzhi rtsa stong / /rtsa ba bral ba'i rig pa 'di/ /'di zhes gtad so kun dang bral/ /gtad med chad stongs yang ma song / /sangs rgyas kyis kyang brjod dka' ba/ /kho yi gnas lugs ngo bo mtshar/ /'khor ba myang 'das bden par grub/ /bden min sems nyid gcig gi shes/ /gcig min gnyis min 'di yang mtshar—/ /skye dang 'chi dang bar ma do/ /gcig la rnam rtog yo lang gi/ /mang por 'dzin pa ya re cha/ /rnam rtog gcig tu zhi bar mtshar/ /gcig la ma 'dres mja' ltar snang / /snang ba chos sku'i rol rtsal de/ /chos sku de yang ming dang bral/ /ming med ming btags rgod re bro/ /zhe sdang snying rje 'dod chags bde/ /gti mug 'od gsal skad pa yis/ /nyon mongs ye shes grags pa yang / /lba rlabs rgya mtshor thim pa bzhin/ /sems byung sems la thim las ci/ /'khor ba med do myang 'das med/ /gnas med 'gyu med mnyam rjes med—//gshis la gang gi yang ma gos/ /'pho med zung 'jug rdo rje sems/ /gzhon med dngas ma bde ba che//mtha' bral 'od gsal chen po 'di/ /'di'o smra mtshon ma mchis te/ /rgyal bas yang ni smra rgyu med/ /gdul bya byis par gyur pa la/ /ming med ming btags byas pa 'di/ /blo chung 'ga' yi bden par bzung / /med par smra ba su'i nus te/ /ye shes rang rtsal ma 'dres pa/ /mngon sum gyur pa 'di la ltos/ /rang la rang gi gad mo shor/ /sems zhes snang ba 'di nyid la/ /dbu phyag zhi gcod rdzogs chen sogs/ /du ma'i ming du btags nas kyang / /grub mtha' dbye ba rgod re bro/ /tha snyad tshig gi ji zhig phan/ /rnam kun mchog ldan mthong na phan/ /ma mthong bar du mthong 'dod che/ /mngon sum mthong tshe mthong bya yal/ /don dam ngo bo ma mthong bar/ /grub mtha' khyod las ma mtho zhes/ /bsdur kha btang ba stong las zad/ /ngo bo dri med de mthong tshe/ /grub mtha' kun kyang ro cig bro/ /'dres dang ma 'dres brjod bya gtor/ /byar med ngang du gar stabs bgyis/ /gtad med ngang du zhabs bro rgob/ /'dzin med gdod ma'i bhā ga la/ /brjod med rig pa'i rdo rje bsnun/ /blo bral nyag gcig bar snang la/ /blo byas mdung rnon da skor cig phaṭaḥ phaṭaḥ phaṭaḥ de 249

skad bla ma'i thugs rje yis/ /tshig don snying la nyams myong ba'i/ /zog po tshe dbang nor bu des/ /shugs 'byung glu dbyangs nyams tshar song / /he he/ de ltar sprang ban smyon pa ni/ /yan pa blo bde zhes kyang bya/ /tshe dbang nor bu grags bdag gi /spyad tshul chu klung las thig pa/ /tsam snang kyu ru lugs brjod pa/ /snyims pa'i chu skyes zhes bya 'di/ /kun gyi khrel rgod 'chor rten las/ /ya mtshan brjod pa tshig gcig kyang / /med pa'i nges pa rang rgyud rang / /shin tu zab par gyur pas na/ /mi smra'i brtul shugs 'dzin spro yang / /'phags mchog mig mi 'dzum sras kyi/ /thugs rje'i zlos gar bsgyur ba las/ /yongs shar badz+ra dhe wa yi/ /skye mtha' rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku/ /shugs 'chang rdo rje snying po'i gter/ /kun tu gzhad mdzad mchog de dang ske/ /sngon tshe las sad smon lam 'brel/ /mchog brnyes dam pa'i tshul spyod pa/ /sdom rtson rnal 'byor dbang phyug che/ /o rgyan ngag dbang ye shes dpal/ /gang de'i dngos brgyud du ma ru/ /rjes 'jug mos pa'i gsol 'debs su/ /rang re'i ngang tshul gleng zhig zhes/ /lcog par ma nus bri tshad tshe/ /rang la yon tan cang med par/ /rtog brjod gzhan gyis cis mi 'khrel/ /rang yang rang gi snang ba la/ /gad mod snying gi dkyil nas shor/ /'on kyang sgro bkur skyon spang ba'i/ /rang spyod gang shar ma bcos smras/ /de la phyi yi rnam thar du/ /ming btags ngom 'pher spyad rab med/ /gsang ba'i rnam thar ming btags nas/ /sba dgos skyon yon gnyis ka med/ /nang gtsang ngag 'khyal chal chos te/ /nang gi rnam thar ming du 'dogs/ /gzhan dag mgu dang mi mgu dang / /ci ltar dgyes dgyes nyid du mdzod/ /spyir yang kho bo'i 'phel tsam tshig /shugs 'byung smras gyur 'di rnams la/ /bzod thob skyes bu mchog rnams ni/ /chos kun la bzod mi dgyes med/ /log lta can gyi skye bos ni/ /snang kun skyon mthong sus mi bzlog /gzhan rgyud shes shing cher mkhas pa/ /gzu bor gnas pas spyad mdzad nas/ /legs nyes dgag sgrub gnang ba na/ /snying nas yi rang thal mo sbyar/ /lhag ma gzhan gyi chal chol tshig /'brug ltar sgrogs kyang kho bo yis/ /ba spu yang ni g.yo mi byed/ /gdul byar 'gyur bar snying nas smon/ /de skad bal bod sa yi mtshams/ /mang yul sa yi thig le niske/ /ri yi rgyal po dpal 'bar ngogs/ /mi shig rdo rje'i spyil po ru/ /sa spre hor zla bzhi pa yi/ /dmar phyogs tshes brgyad tshes dgu yi/ /thun skabs cung zad re bris shing / /tshes bcu'i snga char legs par sgrub//yig ris phul byung 'gyur med pa'i/ /dad ldan phun tshogs dge legs so/ /'di bris nyes gyur gsang sgrogs sogs/ /chos mi mthun kun bla mar bshags/ /legs gyur dge ba mchis pa na/ /bdag dang 'brel tshad 'gro ba kun/ /khams gsum 'khor ba las grol te/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i sa chen brnyes/ /rdo rje sems dpa' myur thob shog /maṅga lo/ dza yaskyo/a tha/ mtshungs med drin can rtsa ba yi/ /bla ma rnams kyi zhabs kyi rdul/ /gser gyi bu gar 'khor 250

lo yi/ /chu skyes dbus su 'brel med par/ /sgo gsum gus pas rab btud nas/ /rang gi spyad rab rang nyid kyis/ /mdo ru sa bon tsam smras gyur/ /snyim pa'i chu skyes dag pa'i 'phro/ /brjod par gyis zhes yang nas yang / /bla ma mchog gyur dam pa yi/ /gsung ngor cung zad 'di gleng byas/ /de nas mang yul sa'i thig le—/ /ri rgyal dpal 'bar lte ba yi/ /bdud rtsi phug tu sdod byas te/ /phyi mtshams khul nas rang nyid kyis/ /skye ba snga ma'i rten 'brel gnad/ /'chug rnams sor chud phyir dang ni/ /bstan 'gror phan pa'i ched dmigs nas/ /mkha' 'gro'i gtor chen 'ga' yang btang / /khyad par gtsug lag khang pa ru/ /rang gi dngos pos gzhi bzung nas/ /bod khams spyi yi bde thabs su/ /dus ngan phyir bsring bsam bzang gis/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhotshonu yi/ /dkyil 'khor zhal phyes gzir mnan 'phang / /lhag pa'i bsam pa kho nas byasaske/ /dpal 'bar mdun du gling bzhi yi/ /mdos chen tshul mthun dag kyang bsgrub/ /lam zhugs rim gyis mches mkhar phyin/ /mkhan chen chos grags dag dang mjal/ /rdor sems snyan rgyud zab khrid phul/ /de nas kha la rgal byas nas/ /'jigs med dbyangs can dga' ba yi/ /bste nas dpal ma chos sding du/ /rje dben mkhyen pa'i spyan spangs des/ /shog gsung bzhin song zhag shas sdod/ /smin dbang bye brag ji snyed dang / /rdzogs chen zag med khrid bka' bshad/ /de nas snya nam yul rgyud de/ /gnas mchog la phyi chu bar du/ /bsgrod pas gnas kyi nus pa yis/ /nyams rtogs rig pa'i ngar thob cing / /'jig rten dhā ki'i cho 'phrul 'tshur/ /ston yang bar chad med pa ru/ /phyag rgya chen pos zil gyis mnan/ /ding ri sleb nas dam pa ni/ /rgya gar nag po'i sgrub gnas mchog /glang 'khor gnas rten zhib par mjal/ /lo paṇa bla mar tshes dbang gi /gter chos sangs rgyas snyam sbyor gyi/ /khrid lung shin tu smin pa dang / /bde stong rgya mtsho'i bskor yang thob/ /phar la rdzogs chen yang tig gi /khregs chod thod rgal khrid zab bshad/ /snying gi thig pa lta bu phul/ /rgyal gyi shrī bskor bzhin du/ /phyogs bzhir gtor tshogs rgyas re byas/ /brang sor phyin nas rdzong phu yi/ /sprul sku 'phrin las rab brtan drung / /'jigs med zhabs brgyud 'jigs dges dang / /gsang 'dus 'phags zhabs lugs gnyis dbang / /ras bris la brten rgyas par zhus/ /gzhan yang grub thob rang rig par/ /khong gi gsan bzhin bar 'brug gi/ /chos bskor tshang ba dag kyang nos/ /me tri pa dang dam pa yi/ /bde mchog dbang dang so rigs kyi/ /khrid bka' shin tu smin par thob/ /phar la brang gter phur pa yi/ /dbang bka' bla ma dam pa dang / /de 'khor rnams la rgyas par byas/ /de nas lhang nga la rgyud nas/ /ru lag dben nas 'bras spungs yongs/ /khyab bdag dang po'i sangs rgyas dang / /gnyis med rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi/ /grub thob yongs kyi 'khor los bsgyur/ /chos rje kun bzang dbang po yi/ /zhabs snyeg zla ba gsum lhag rtsam/ /brten nas mdo chos mthar thug pa/ /snying po'i gnas lugs gtan 251

phabs byed/ /gzhan stong dbu ma'i blta khrid dang / /sngags chos zab chos gnyis med rgyud/ /dus 'khor dbang rim bcu gcig bcas/ /bdag po bdag po ches smin byas/ /rdzogs rim sbyor ba yan lag drug /nyams khrid shin tu rmar ba dang / /rim gnyis bshad pa gzhung man ngag /zab rgyas yid bzhin legs par stsal/ /gzhan yang smin grol gdams pa ni/ /rnam grangs shin tu mang yo yis/ /blo yi ngal ba bsrong bar 'gyur/ /spyir yang kho bo chung ngu'i skabs/ /kun mkhyen jo nang yab sras kyi/ /mtshan thos nyid nas dad pa g.yos/ /khyad par rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i dbang / /kre bo mchog sprul zhal snga nas/ /jo nang bka' brgyud bsngags pa'i gsung / /thos pa tsam gyis dga' bdes khyab/ /rkyen des chos rgyun 'bad btsal nasarka//'di skabs rje btsun grub mchog la/ /gdams ngag rang blo tshim nos nas/ /kun mkhyen jo nang yab sras kyi/ /grub mthar thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /nges shes khyad du 'phags pa thob/ /'di nas byang chub chen po'i bar/ /bka' drin snying gi thig ler sim/ /de 'phror rje btsun sku zhabs nas/ /grom pa rgyang du yongs byas te/ /sa bya cho 'phrul yar ngo la/ /dus 'khor bsnyen mtshams zhig kyang bgyis/ /grol bstun lha rtse phyogs ser skyar/ /khrom dbang 'dod chos ci rigs byas/ /zo lung sogs su chos kyi ched/ /zhag shas phyin shing de yi zhor/ /mang mkhar bsam gling rdzong nas ni/ /se dkar rigs kyi snying po ni/ /'dar pa mi rje sku mched kyis/ /spyan 'dren byung phyin dbang chos sogs/ /thugs kyi re ba kheng par byas/ /de nas rim gyis la stod byang / /bsgrod lam dka' tshegs ches dub yang / /chos phyir snying khams bskyed byas nas/ /sgrub gnas las lung bsam gling phyin/ /khyab bdag rdo rje slob dpon ni/ /gnyag rigs gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzinatso/ /mkhas shing grub pa'i khyu mchog che/ /pad+ma rig 'dzin dbang rgyal drung / /legs mjal gsang las ches gsang ba/ /'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i chos/ /kun gyi phyi mo bi ma la'i/ /snying tig zab pa mdo bzhi yi/ /smin dbang lung bcas yongs rdzogs nos/ /gzhan yang karma snying tig lung / /byang gter bskor yang ci rigs pa/ /mdo dbang gtad rgya dag kyang zhus/ /rang ngor rdzong chen bstan pa mchog /'dzin pa'i skyes bur ches bsngags pa'i/ /dbugs dbyung thun mong ma yin gnang / /thugs la shin tu bcug par mdzad/ /de ru sdod ring gser zangs gi/ /sprul pa'i sku dang sku skye drung / /do dmar drung dang chos sding gi/ /gdan drung ba sogs bla ma'i ris/ /zo lung brag nag sngags 'chang dang / /dad 'byor dpal yon stobs ldan pa'iske/ /sa kha'i dpon chen no no dang / /'jigs bral dbon rigs a jo sogs/ /phyogs nas 'du mi ci rigs par/ /dbang khrid gang mtshams ci nus byas/ /de nas rim gyis nub dgon rgyud/ /slar yang mnga' ri rdzong dkar phyin/ /de ru 'dus pa'i ser skya la/ /dbang bskur re ba bskang bar gyis/ /de phror nub ri sgang chen phyin/ /'tsho mdzad chos bzang gang de la/ /'dod chos shin tu smar ba thob/ /phar la rdzogs chen 252

zab khrid phul/ /rta sgar spong rong rje dbon gyis/ /'bod bzhin phyin nas dbang 'brel bgyis/ /rta lar grub mchog shākya seng la/ /ras chung snyan brgyud bde mchog bskor/ /gsar pa'i dbang khrid lung bcas zhus / /phyogs de'i dgon yul tha dag pa/ /mjal byung chos 'brel ci nus byas/ /byang thang rgyud de glo bo phyogs / /dges rdor rtsa rgyud rtag gnyis nas/ /zin pa'i mu mu ni k+ṣe ṭa/ /phral du chu mig brgya rtsa zhes/ /rdo chur rang byung me 'bar bar/ /phyin zhing zhag shas gnas 'brel bcab/ /tshogs gtor mchod pa ci nus phul / /zung 'jug myur thob smon lam btab/ /spyir ni 'di lo 'khor ngan gyi/ /spyod pas grwa tshang spang snying 'dod / /khyad par khams kyi pho nya ba/ /gsar pa 'di ru sleb gyur zhing / /dam pa mchog rnams zhing gshegs shing / /dus kyi zi bun che thos nas/ /snying nas skyo ba ches cher 'phel/ /rkyen de la brten chos thams cad/ /bden med sgyu ma ci lta ba/ /phyad phyod yun ring bar du shar/ /de skabs glo stod smon thang nasaske/ /gnod dbang rnam sras mdung dmar gyi/ /rnam sprul a ma dpal gyi gdung / /chos rgyal phreng bar byon pa'i rgyud/ /rgyal po yab yum bka' yi blon/ /bcas pas spyan 'dren bzhin du phyin/ /dge dkar bsam phug gtsang rang du/ /zla shas sdod nas smin byed dbang / /khyad par khrid bkas thugs bzhed bskang ske/ /de nas dol gnas mjal ba'i ched/ /slar yang gro smad phyogs su slebs/ /snga sor chu mig yong res dang / /da res skabs su dzar rdzong gi/ /khri thog dpon drung che gras rnams/ /rim mjal chos 'brel zhu ba dang / /sras mo re yang chos sgor bcug /btsun ma gsar byed mang bar byung / /glo dol lam bar la mtho zhing / kha lhag grang ngar ches che yang / /gnas skor lus kyi sgrib sbyang du/ /dmigs pas bzod cing lam khyer bgyis/ /skabs 'di rgyal chen khyung chen gyi/ /gzhi bdag mkha' 'gro ma sogs kyi/ /sbas yul der 'gro bskul na yang / /'di res 'phral du 'gro ma byas/ /rim gyi rgya gar yul gyi cha/ /sngon tshe yad rtse rgyal po'i shul/ /da lta bā li rā tsa zhes/ /phyi rol grub mtha' la mos shing / /rgyal phran nyi shur dbang bsgyur ba/ /'dzum lang grags pa de'i mnga' 'og /mon rong ri rgyal pañtsa'i mdun/ /rang byung dur khrod phag mo'i gnasatso//de ru gnas 'brel zhag shas 'dug /phyi nang rten 'brel mthu yi ni/ /rnam mang grub mtha'i bzhed pa kun/ /ma 'dres blo la 'char nus byung / /phyogs de'i ser skya tha dag pa/ /rim gyis mjal byung dbang chos kyi/ /'brel btags dge bskul gang sgrub byas/ /skabs der o rgyan gu ru yi/ /lung 'dzin skyes bu grub pa'i dbang / /o rgyan bstan 'dzin sku zhogs nas/ /'phrad bzhed mdzad bzhin rta glar phyin/ /gar dbang snying po'i gter chos ni/ /zab tig rtsa ba gsum snying tig /byang gter nyon mongs rang grol gyi/ /dbang khrid lung gsum tshang ba dang / /nus ldan zhabs kyi 'ja' sku yang / /khrid bka' shin tu smin pa nosaglu/ /byin rlabs rgyun gyis bdag rgyud rlabs/ /phar la'ang thugs bzhed bzhin du ni/ /pad+ma bde chen 253

gling pa yang / /snying tig dbang khrid lung bcas pa/ /dpe rgyun der bzhugs kun phul te/ /snying tig bdag por dbugs dbyung byas/ /de nas slar yang sa 'dul nas/ /rta rong rgyud de rta rab smad/ /gu ru gnas chen 'bum sar sleb/ /zhag shas rgyun bsnyen kha bso bar/ /mtshams zhugs de 'phro don gnyer canaske/ /rnams la chos 'brel gang mtshams bgyis/ /de ltar rang gi spyad rabs cha/ /sa sprel nas bzung lcags pho khyi'i/ /lo 'go bar gyi ngang tshul rnams/ /bla ma'i bka' bzhin mdo tsam smras/ /deng sang 'chang thub phal che yi/ /mkhas btsun tshul dang mngon par shes/ /grub rtags ston tshul la sogs pa/ /rang rang gdul bya'i sgo skal la/ /du ma gleng bar thos na yang / /bdag ni mi mkhas ma bsdam zhing / /mnyam par bzhag la ma brtson phyir/ /las nyon sgrib pa ches 'thug pas/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan ni/ /cung zad tsam yang ma mchis mod/ /'on kyang sngon tshe tshul khrims sogs/ /bsod nams la brten dal 'byor lusaske/ /skyen bral mdo khams kaḥthog lhor/ /chos ldan pho mo'i bu ru skyes/ /bstan pa'i 'jug sgo ma nor te/ /theg chen gsang ba sngags dang mjal/ /rgyud phug bla ma ma nor ste/ /rgyal kun ye shes gcig dril ba/ /'chi med sangs rgyas 'od mtha' yas/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas de la thug /mtshan ldan bla ma ma nor te/ /pad 'byung thugs dang dbyer med pa'i/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam gsum dang / /rdo rje slob dpon bco lnga brten/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma gang de ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi chos sku'i dngos/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i dbang phyug gtso/ /yin pa'i nges shes kha tshigs tsam/ /ma yin snying nas rab nges pas/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yi dam lha/ /mjal yang de yi rnal 'phrul las/ /gzhan du med pas smon rgyu bral/ /des na rgyal ba rgya mtsho dngos/ /dpal ldan bla ma mjal ba 'di/ /kho bo'i zhal gzigs mthar thug yin/ /nyams len dam chos rims pa yang —/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa rnam mang kun/ /gdul bya'i blo rim 'dren phyir ste/ /ris med dag pa'i snang bas khyab/ /rang gi grub mtha' ma nor ste/ /theg pa kun gyi mthar thug pa/ /bla med sngags kyi bla ma mchog /sangs rgyas ye shes drang thad du/ /ston pa'i lam mchog rdo rje snying / /a ti 'od gsal rdzogs pa che/ /grub mtha'i rtse rgyal de dang 'phrad/ /rang nyid bsam bzhin bskal bzang 'khums/ /bya spyod tshul yang ma nor tsamaske//dge sdig yid ches spangs blangs bsgrub/ /dam tshig ngos lkog med byas shing / /rig pa gnas lugs don rtogs khul/ /de dag kho bo'i spyad rabs las/ /skyon sbas legs shos smras gyur pa/ /ma nor lnga yi rtog brjod 'di/ /rang dang skal mnyam rdo rje mched/ /kun gyi thun mong rtog brjod du/ /gyur las bdag nyid gcig pu yi/ /bye brag khyad chos ma yin te/ /rang re bla ma grub pa'i mtha'/ /gcig gyur rnams kyi dgongs par 'tshal/ /de skad bod yul gangs ljongs stod/ /mnga' ri smad gyur dol po zhes/ /lum ba'i tshal dang gnyis 254

med pa/ /jo nang kun mkhyen 'khrungs pa'i yul/ /de dang mi ring nye ba ru/ /yang dag 'jog la gnas skabs su/ /sngon tshe gu ru'i spyan snga ru/ /g.yu sgra snying zhes rnam sprul ni/ /o rgyan bstan 'dzin zhes bya ba/ rdo rje slob dpon de nyid kyis/ /yang yang bka' nan gyis bskul ngor/ /lcags khyi nag zla'i tshes bcu la/ /kaḥthog par grags rig pa 'dzin/ /tshe dbang nor bu de yi smras/ /rtog brjod ya mtshan can med kyang / /rdzun zog ma yin drang po'i gtam/ /chu bab brjod la nyes ci yod/ /nyes na lha dang bla mar bshags/ /dge mchis 'od dpag med ci bzhin/ /bdag bcas tshom bum yongs 'grub shog dge'o/ /maṅga lo/ /

༄ga /snyigs dus ser gzugs snyom las mkhan gyur tshe dbang nor bu bdag nyid gangs ri'i ljongs kyi yul gru du mar rgyu tshul lam yig phyi nang gsang ba kho na nyid kyi glu dbyangs sna tshogs pad+ma'i 'phreng ba bzhugs so/ /na maḥ ma hā gu ru mū la pad+ma sam+bha wa/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yab gcig kun bzang rdo rje thod 'phreng rtsal/ /sku gsum lhun grub ngo bo nyid sku bde chen rgyal po 'od dpag med/ /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po srid 'dir mtshungs med mtsho gling pad+mar skyes/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug dran mchog 'khor lo'i mgon der rtag phyag 'tshal/ /dpal ldan dang po'i sangs rgyas gdul bya'i don/ /gang 'dul ma nges gzugs sku rig pa 'dzin/ /pad+ma thod 'phreng gnyis pa grub pa'i dbang / /rtsa ba'i bla ma bde chen gling zhes dang / /bde mchog mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi dra ba sdom/ /bcom ldan rab dgyes ye shes rdo rje 'chang glu/ /rnam rol he ru ka dpal che ba'i mchog /karma rig pa 'dzin dbang zhabs la 'dud/ /gzhan yang 'dzam bu shing los brgyan pa'i 'tshal/ /'di ru 'phags pa'i yul dang gangs ri'i ljongs/ /byon gyur mi yi seng ge phyogs gyur pa/ /rgyal ba nyid gyur tshad thub tshul bzung ba/ /rig 'dzin zung bzhi grub gyur bcu phrag brgyad/ /lnga phrag lnga dang brgya dang rtsa brgyad la/ /rab tu gus pa chen pos lag pad+mo/ /rtse mo bde ba'i sa ru zlum byas shing / /'di ru snyigs dus ser gzugs snyom las mkhan/ /tshe dbang nor bu zhes su grags bdag gi /sgyu ma'i lus la dbyar khang rten bcas nas/ /dge dang mi dge btang snyom las gyur pa/ /sna tshogs spyod tshul rab rib du ma las/ /'di ru phyogs su rgyu tshul lam yi ge/ /zhes grags rten pa sems kyi cho rol las/ /brten gyur sgyu lus bya las sgyu ma'i phrul/ /sngon 'phral las kyi 'phen pas spyad pa'i rabasaske/ /du ma dngas ba'i chu snod sems byung tshul/ /sna tshogs ma 'dres gzugs brnyan sems nyid rtsal/ /kun tu brtags pa byis pa'i rang bzhin can/ /nges par dgag min sgrub min mnyam nyid klong / /kye ho/ye nas rang 'khor 'khrul pa'i khye'u chung / /thog med mun par mi zum ngal chen po/ /cung zad ngal gsor rgyal bas byin stegs su/ /chags tsam re zhig nyid nas sgyu ma'i bu/ /gzhi yi rgyud la rang byung 'khor 'das lamaske/ /du ma brjod yig ci lta ci snyed bkra/ /ma rig gzhi la 'khrul pa'i lam byung bas/ /sna tshogs sgra yi yi ge sdug bsngal shar/ /ka dag gzhi la rig pa ye shes lam/ /mkhyen gnyis rgyas pa'i yi ge kun tu 'char/ / 256

rnal 'byor sems nyid gzhi la nyams rtogs lam/ /bye brag ji snyed yi ge rab tu rgyas/ /de ltar 'khor ba myang 'das tha dag kun/ /lam la tshig dang tshig bral yi ge che/ /snang gyur tha dpog sus kyang nus min te/ /gcig la ltas nas chos kun sems kyi 'phrul/ /tha dad ltas na ma 'dres 'ja' ris gzugs/ /yin min sus brjod ye don rang bzhin gshis/ /ma skyes rang rig 'dod nas rnam par dag /ma 'gag zung 'jug chos nyid rol pa rgyas/ /de don brjod pa'i spros pa mtha' yas kyi/ /'di ru lnga 'dus brten brten 'di kho na'o/ /byed las phyi nang gsang ba kho na nyid/ /lam la zhugs tshul tha snyad yi ge'i rgyu/ /spel gyi mkhyen bral blun po'i skyes bu yi/ /'khyal tshig glu dbyangs lkug pa'i ngag las drangs/ /don med brjod 'di rang 'dra'i blun tshos gson/ /de la lung rig dpal gyi mngon mtho'i par/ /nges med las la goms pa'i skyes bu che/ /lnga rig smra ba'i tshogs kyis blun bdag gi tshig la thugs 'khrel mi gnang bzod bzhes shing k+ṣi//bdag tshul phyi nang gsang bcas rdzun med par/ /brjod la 'gal 'khrul nor pa'i cha mchis dang //gsang sgrogs rgyu dang nyes pa'i sar lhung kun/ /rtsa gsum la bshags dus mkhyen gyis gnang gsol/ /de yang phyi ltar kun rdzob lus ngag yid/ /dngos snang phyogs kun rgyu nas dge sdig tshul/ /nang ltar sems nyid 'khrul pa'i bag chags kyi/ /spub nas mi lam snang bar spyod pa'i tshul/ /gsang bar gzhan snang nyid las phyir dpag nas/ /sngon dang phyi ma'i gnas tshul sba 'os dang / /kho na nyid gyur sems rig cho 'phrul gyiske/ /rang la nyams rtogs ci ltar shar tshul bcas/ /'khrul dang 'khrul med 'khor ba myang 'das rgyur/ /bsags gyur phyi ltar rgyal khams lam bgrod tshul/ /nang ltar snang ba gsang ba rten 'brel lam/ /kho na nyid gyur zhi dang lhag mthong las/ /bgrod tshul phyi ltar gzhan snang mthun yi ge/ /nang ltar rang nyid gsang ba rgyu 'bras dang / /mthun pa'i yi ge kho na nyid kyi gnas/ /nyams len dang mthun yi ge cung zad duske/ /brjod las rgyas par smra bar mi nus kyi/ /'khrul pa'i rnam rol chu gter chen po las/ /khol bur lam yig lam gsum sa yi rgyun/ /de la yang bkol 'di ru snyim gang chu/ /tsam du brjod 'di rnam rtog can 'gu ba'i/ /spyod pa med kyang blun po rang 'dra ba'i/ /ris la dad pa can gyur byis sba rnams/ /mgu dang ngal sel chu thig tshig 'di byin/ /de yang rnal 'byor gzugs 'dzin sngags 'chang zol/ /ti rgan tshe dbang nor bu zhes grags bdag /'bras bu'i khur gyi lci ba'i lo bdag cher/ /bskyed byed dpal mo'i 'dren pa zla ba'i rgyal/ /dus tshe rnam par dge zhing legs pa'i dus/ /lnga phung bskyed brten mkha' dngas mi shig pa/ /phan pa rab gnas tshigs dbyangs len pa yi/ /mngal las thon pa kun gzhi sa bon nyid/ /dpag med bsod nams chu khur 'thug po la/ /ye shes sprin gyi myug ma 'khyud dang stabs/ /smon lam bzang po'i dbyar skyes sgra sgrogs shing / /rnam par dag pa'i dal rlung gis bskul nas/ /gzhan phan sprin 257

skyes mu tig gdul bya yi/ /'dzin mar yongs su chu chags bzhin 'jug pa yi/ /rgyu byas dal 'byor sā lu ljon pa'i khams/ /rab thon ston skyes 'di nyid 'grub skad de/ /zhing gsher brlan lud rnam dkar las 'brel pas/ /dge yul dam pa rgyu ba'i skyed mo'i tshal/ /nyid du 'dzom nas rang gzhan kun btags sgrar/ /bsgrags pa'i 'bras bus khur che ma mchis kyang / /bla med sras des byin gyis rlabs so zhes/ /cha shas grags de ngal med ma song tsam/ /bya bar sems pa'i snying stobs 'dzin pa las/ /ya mtshan tshig smra cung tsam 'dir mi bdog /de ltar srid pa'i sha gzugs shing rta 'di/ /bskrun nas kun byed khye'u chung gis gzhon bzhin/ /snang ba'i yul du sems kyi 'phang lo nyid/ /'di ltar spyod zhes rgyus brjod grangs med lasaske/ /cha shas tsam gyur 'dir bshad ces smras la/ /ci snyed rol rtsed rnam pa du ma'i dpyid/ /rnal 'byor mnyam nyid sgyu 'phrul thig le che/ /ku yang 'jur bu ma nges bltas pa yi/ /tshul gyur nyer len nas bzung lnga phrag lnga/ /lo grangs bsgrod pa'i rtog pa brjod pa ni/ /gzhan du brtan las 'di ru ma yin gyis/ /skabs 'di nyid du gleng mo bya ba'i rgyu/ /rang lo phyogs 'dab 'dod yon grangs 'khod pa'i/ /'khor khyim nyal 'gror rgyu ba dpa' bo yi/ /gzhon can kha lo lto 'gros kyis bsgyur tshe/ /bsgrod bdag skyes bu skyo shas can mang po/ /yul gru gzhan gyur zol bde bsil ba'i sar/ /'gro la yul 'dir rnam g.yeng mes gdung zhes/ /smra zhing chas tshe sems ldan skye bo'i tshogs/ /phyogs su 'then nas bshol stab btang gyur cig /de ngor bdag gi 'bad byed skyes bu mchog /ha cang mi ring bde ba'i gnas dam par/ /sdod par bskul mthus brag dkar zur gsum pa/ /ko ṭa ya zhes rgyal ba gong ma yi/ /zhabs bcags bste gnas de ru ngal bso bar—/ /mdzad de bdag ni yid rab sim ldan zhing / /rang nyid phyogs med dben pa'i rgyal khams su/ /drang song chen po brten nas nyon mongs nad/ /sel byed chos kyi bdud rtsi myong 'dod pa'i/ /gdung bas rtag tu mnar bzhin lhag pa ru/ /yul der rang sems skyo sun bskyed pa'i rgyu/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i tshul mang mthos thos shing / /khyad par rkyen gyur phyi nang gsang ba dgu/ /phyi ni dus bskal snyigs mas skyo shas shing ske/ /nang na sde dpon 'pho chug grangs mang dang / /gsang ba rgyal bstan dar rgud du ma bcas/ /bltas pa'i snying po sgyu ma lta bur mthong / /bsags pa'i nor ni sbrang ma'i rtsi 'dra mthong / /'grogs pa'i grogs ni tshong 'dus mgron ltar mthong / /byas pa'i las ni mdo med stong par mthong / /nang ni phyi ru rang yul 'khrug rtsod dang / /nang du chos gegs mi chos zang zing chos gegs mang / /gsang ba rnam g.yeng 'khrul pa'i rgya ma chod/ /don med mi tshe stong zad ngang du 'jam/ /tshe ni mi rtag rtswa kha'i zil 'drar mthong /mnga' thang ston mjug na bun lta bur mthong / /snyan grags skad cig brag cha ltar yal mthong / /ltar snang thams cad chu yi sbu 'dra mthong / /gsang ba phyi nang grwa 'khor nye gnas rnams/ /tshul min a thas zhen 258

pas yid kyang sun/ /nang na bla slob nye 'brel rnams kyang gshegs/ /gsang ba rang nyid smin grol gdeng ma snyed/ /dal 'byor thob 'di chud zos nyid du mthong / /rang gzhan mgo skor long bas long khrid de/ /rin chen gling nas stong log byas 'dra mthong / /yud tsam bde bas gtan mchis bslus pa mthong de dang de 'dra'i tshul ni zad med ste/ /rnam pa du mas yid 'di sun zhing skyo/ /khyad par mtshan ldan bla ma gshegs pa dang / /rang sems 'khrul mun dri ma ma sang pas/ /yin yin 'dra ba'i bla ma'i go sa dang / /dar cig mdzes mjes dpon slob mnga' thang dang / /yud tsam snyan snyan bdud kyi bslu ba dang / /legs legs ltar ston gtan bde bcom pa'i rgyur/ /mthong bas bskul te mngon zhen mi gtsang dri/ /rnam g.yeng bya ba de las rgyang sring ste/ /thar pa byang chub chen po'i pad tshal du/ /don gnyis ro mngar bcud mchog blang ba'i phyir/ /snyom chung rkang drug brtson pa'i sgro gshog gnyis/ /bskyod nas kun tu rgyu bar 'dod nas niglu/ /thog mar ston dus ming 'dzin tshang tshing shing / /rtsub mo'i nags tshal ngam 'brog brag ri 'khrigs/ /mi dang mi min mi bsrun gdug pa can/ /mtshon cha'i char 'bebs tshig rtsub dbyar rnga sgrogs/ /chu klung drag 'beb gcan gzan gtum rgyu zhing / /dug lnga rag cing gdul bar dka' gnas der/ /rang nyid g.yog 'khor cung zad bcas chas te/ /phyogs gzhan sgrod pas brel yang gdul bya yi/ /blun dad tshig gi bskul ba ma bzod par/ /dkar dmar sgrod pa zung brgyad 'phos kyi bar/ /gnas byas mchog dman 'dus tshogs sum brgya lhag /tsam la bka' rgyud smad byung mthon mthing gi /cod paṇa mchog 'dzin srol la skyes pa yi/ /ma hā mu tra gnas lugs yid bzhin nor/ /sbyor dngos rjes tshang chos kyi sbyin gtong dang / /'ga' la ma hā sin+ta'i gsang khrid gdab/ /'dus byas chos ni byang chub gzhir shes pas/ /'dus par dge bskul zang zing mchod sbyin spel/ /slar la yul ljongs phun tshogs khur ldan nas/ /don gnyer can gyi bskul nas phyogs de ru/ /phyin dang stabs su 'gro skyob ya mtshan rir/ /dam pa mchog phrad la dungs sug pa'i 'gros/ /'brel bzang grogs bcas stsal gyis bskul bzhin du/ /gnas su sleb nas mchog kyang dgyes spro bcas/ /yid rab spen gyur slar yang brel stabs kyis/ /myur bar phyir bsgrod rang gi sngon nas su—/ /grags gyur mkhas dang grub snyan grags ldan gyi/ /go sa la zhugs mchog gyur ka pā la/ /zhal skyin blta bar ga la ba der phyin/ /dam pa des kyang spro bzhin dus re zhig /'phral du phyogs gzhan gshegs su mi rung bar/ /bsnyad ngo ma cogs de phral der nye ba'i/ /grong khyer dag tu 'khon zhugs nyon mongs pas /lus srog mi 'dzin gsod gcod brtson pa 'ga'/ /bsgral phyir mchog bla kun bzang rnam rgyal bcas/ /bzod pa'i go gyon sbyin pa'i gro khur te/ /grong khyer der zhugs 'gro phan sems bzang pos/ /zla ba zung gnyis bar du de dag gis/ /skye bo 'khrugs kun zhi byas byams par bkod/ /slar yang gdan sar stag 259

ras pa chen po/ /bha ṭa snyun pa'i sa nas bka' phebs stabs/ /myur phyin sku ni rab tu stem 'dug pas/ /tshe la bar chad 'gyur ram brtags pa yis/ /lcags kyi rdo rje zhig gi rwa sbrul ba/ /slar la sbyar rmis bar chad grol go zhing / /kun bzang rnam rgyal mchog zhabs spyan drangs nas/ /bar chad sel phyir rje la dbang bka' mdzad/ /rang gi r+ghaṃ lugs bka' brgyad sngags dbang dang / /tshe bsgrub dbang phul snyun kyang rim bzhin grol/ /skabs der kaḥthog dag tu bya ma rta/ /gsum rdzang rgyal sras phebs par bskul na yang / /rang gi mnyam bzhag gsal ba'i yid yul du/ /bar chad yong bar sems nas bdag dpon slob/ /dgu phrag bcas te gdan sa chen por song / /rig 'dzin rdo rje hūm̐ kar sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /nus ldan bdud 'dul bsod nams lde'u btsan zhabs/ /bsam mi khyab pa mtshan dpes brgyan pa mjal/ /dgyes spro yab sras phrad ltar rmad byung bas/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i 'brel 'byung du ma dang / /dpa' bo stag sham rdo rje'i zab gter las/ /thugs sgrub bzhi dang rtsa gsum don sbyor bskor/ /dbang lung bka' gtad zhib rgyas yongs su 'jos/ /nyer gcig zhag gnas slar yang rang yul ldog /de phral nyid du lci rong sa yi cha/ /rgyal mchog gdan sa nyid nas thu bo pas/ /'ong bar nan bskul lam zhor sku lha ru/ /gnas 'brel bcu gcig zhag 'dug 'od dpag gi /bzung chog cung tsam byas tshe rgyal ba yi/ /thugs rjes kun rdzob bum par bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /dngul chu'i mdog 'dra lud pa mngon par gyur/ /de nas gser ldan klung rgal bla ma yi/ /gdan sar sleb byas mchog gdung zhug zhen nas/ /skabs der rang nyid mngon spyod drag sngags kyi/ /bsnyen sgrub drod tshad thob byas 'di dus lo/ /mdzes byed kyis bsgyur sa ga zla ba ste/ /byang sog gis bskul go 'gyo sde dge yi/ /sde gzar dus yin rmi ltas brtag pa yi/ /phyogs kun sprin nag 'khrigs shing drag rlung g.yo—/ /skyin thang 'beb shom 'dug pa gang zag rigs/ /gzhon nu dar bab zhig gi rten 'brel mthus/ /yal bar mthong bas re zhig skyon med go /de skabs kaḥthog rgyal yang zhing gzhan phebs/ /rang yul der yang khrims med drag dman gyi/ /spyod pas ban dmag bskul ba'i dgos pa bcas/ /rnam pa du mas rang yul zhen log rgyur/ /gyur cing pad+ma dbang yang yul de phyogs/ /mi sdod zhal bzhes dbu snyung mang mdzad cing / /bdag dang lhan du stag dgon pe'ur phyin/ /rang sems sngar nas blo thag chod bzhin du/ /slar yang rang don zhe gding ldan pa zhig /ma grub bar du phyogs kun rgyu nas ni/ /dam pa bsten dang gdams pa nyams len zhing / /sgo gsum sgrib sbyangs thabs byed zhe dam bcas/ /slar yang bla ma mchog la phyi phyag tuske//'tshal phyir btsan ri dgon du chas pa'i zhar/ /rang gi chu stag lor stab sgrub grwa che/ /sman chu zhes par sa 'dul byed du phyin/ /de ru phyi nang gsang ba'i lhong dag gi/ /rlung tshub ri g.yo rdo rje'i char pa 'bab/ /'od kyi go mtshams med par rab tu gtam/ /'jigs pa'i sgra dang char ser drag po 'tshub/ /yid yul mi 260

sdug gzugs kyang mang shar zhing / /khong kun byed dngas tab tab por gyur cing / /rang nyid sems la khu 'phrig ma byung bar/ /ho ru ka dpal nag po rta mgrin can/ /gsal ba gsum gyi ngar btab mnyam bzhag pasaske//rang zhir song mthar tho reng 'od gsal skabs/ /rig 'dzin rgyal pos dregs kun gtso bo yi/ /srog la dbang byin brlab pa'i grub pa snyed/ /rang yang sngar bas nyams la bogs 'thon song / /de nas bya bral chas byas bdag dpon slob/ /chu klung che rgal gsal sgrod gdan sar phyin/ /bka' drin can gyi zhal la blta byas shing / /gus pas thal sbyar dad pa'i zhe sa bcas/ /mgon de'i snyan gyi dbang por 'di skad gsolaske/ /e ma mtshungs med bla ma chos kyi rje/ /bka' drin can khyed drung du gsol ba'i mchid/ /bdag ni rigs dman rmong phyug so skyes zhig /sngon sbyangs las 'phro bzang dang mi ldan zhing / /tshe 'dir theg pa'i sbyang bsgrod ma nus bzhin/ /blun las ches blun ti rgan gyur pa bdag /sprul sku zhes pa mi tsams grags pa lasaske/ /yang dag don gyi lta spyod mi ldan te/ /spang dang rtogs pa'i yon tan rtsal ma rdzogs/ /glang po'i gzugs ris glang por ngos bzung zhing / /bla gzugs tsam gyur mi chos nyon mongs las/ /chung ngu nyid nas bsags pa'i las rab lci/ /bdag 'dra'i ser gzugs las ni phal gyur pa/ /skye bo chos ldan zhig gi ci mi lhag /chos med bdag ni skye nas 'khrul par 'byams/ /mtshan ldan mjal yang gdams pa'i phugs ma chod/ /khrid lung thob yang nyams rtogs go yul lus/ /dam chos sang byed snang byed ngang du bshol/ /mi tshe gar song cha med sdug la zad/ /'jig rten bya las zin med nyid la spyod/ /ngal ba don med tha mal 'khrod du 'khyams/ /ci bya thabs med 'chi ba nam 'ong ang / /mtho ris gnas su dar cig lus snyed 'di—/ /stong log slar yang ngan song cis mi 'khor/ /sngon chad spyod pa stong las 'khrul pa gzhi/ /da ni sum cu kha ral tshe dus 'dir/ /tshe yang tshad la khyol nye rgan po song / /da lta nyi shu rtsa lnga'i lo grangs la/ /'khod gyur tshe de'i phyed lhag gnyid dbang song / /phyed nyung son yang sum gnyis le lor gyur/ /sum gcig dkar nag 'dres ma'i gnas su snang / /da ni tshe la ci tsam mi shes shing / /da ring sang nyin mi 'chi'i gdeng su'i nus/ /rang gi spyod pa snga mar skyo zhing sun/ /rang nyid 'brel tshad don ldan ma grub na/ /grub thob sprul sku yin zhes ci zhig phan/ /bong bu gzigs lpags kyis 'geb don mtshungs mod/ /bstan pa ma thob nyams myong 'al 'ol gyi/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la ci phyir 'god/ /ha la'i dkor 'bag mi gtsang dar thum gyi/ /blun rgan bdag ni 'chi ba'i dus bab tshe/ /nges par 'khor bar 'khyams so gdon mi za/ /rgya lam na ni sngon las bzang po'i 'phro/ /cung zad tsam mchis srid kyang tshe 'di la/ /rnam dkar byang chub rgyu zhig ma grub na/ /snga ma'i dge zad phyi mar dmyal ltung nges/ /de na tshe 'dir bya las sngon chad kun/ /dam pa khyed kyi zhabs phyir gyur ma gtogs/ /gzhan kun bya ba snying po med nges su/ /snying nas mthong bas da 261

ni tshe lhag ma/ /ci tsam yod kyang chos gcig kho na las/ /rang don ma grub long bas long khrid 'di/ /nges par spang ba'i zhe gdengs thag chod kyi/ /gnas 'dir sdad sdad sngon 'gro kho na ste/ /de bas phyogs zhen bral ba'i yul gru ru/ /bsgrod par 'dod dang khyad par mchog bla ma/ /tshe tshang sku zhabs mjal 'dod 'dun pa dang / /zhar du lha ldan khra 'brug bsam yas kyi/ /sprul pa'i gtsug lag mjal skor byed pa'i ched—/ /dam pa khyed kyi cis kyang bka'i gnang zhu/ /zhes zhus 'go 'phang smad de 'dug pa/ /dam pas dar cig dgongs bzhugs 'di skad gsungs/ /e ma mchog gi sprul sku tshur gson dang / /grub chen pad+ma nor bur grags de ni/ /sngon tshe dge slong nam mkha' snying po yi/ /sprul pa mchog gyur 'brel tshad don ldan du/ /gter grub rig 'dzin mang pos 'khrul med par/ /dbang bskur lung bstan gzeng bstod dbugs kyang dbyung ske/ /rgyal ba pad 'byung dngos gzugs bdud 'dul rjes/ /slob ma'i mchog gyur phyir mi ldog mthu boske/ /dam par zhal bzhes phyi nang gsang ba yi/ /grub pa'i rtags thob gsang sngags brtul zhugs la/ /mnga' brnyes rdzogs chen rnal 'byor dbang phyug tu/ /brtsod pa bral bar mchog tu gyur de yi/ /sprul pa'i skye bar khyod nyid yin zhes par/ /skye bos kun brtag sgra las ma ltos par/ /rig 'dzin chen po bde chen gling de yi/ /'di ni sprul min sprul rdzur yin snyam med/ /'khrul med pad+ma nor bu'i rnam shes su/ /rang gi yin par snyam las yod re zhes/ /dbu bsnyung bzhes pa'i gsung 'phreng bdag la stsal/ /de na bdag gi'ang 'khrul med nyid thag chod/ /khyed rang ngos kyang thos bsam shes rab ldan/ /mthong thos 'gro ba kun 'gu snyan grags ldan/ /lugs gnyis gang la rnam dpyod bzang po ldan/ /rdzogs chen nyams len rtogs pa'i don dang ldan/ /'gran sems chung bas grwa dpon kun dang mthun/ /dam tshig ldan pas bdag gi sems dang mthun/ /khog rgya che bas bstan don bya las grub/ /gzhung rgyud bzang bas 'gro ba kun kyang mgu /shes rab ldan pas chos dang chos min phyed/ /smon lam dag pas rnam dkar las la brtson/ /tshogs gnyis bsags pas mchog dman kun gyi bkur/ /skam chags chung bas dam pa'i chos dang 'dres/ /khyad par khyod ni bla ma mchog phrad cing / /sngon sbyangs las sad nyams myong bzang dang ldan/ /des na de sngon spyod pa byas kun yang / /yul khams bde zhing rgyal bstan bya las dang / /bla ma'i zhabs tog dge ba'i las su song / /rtsub drag spyod dgos du mas sun na yang / /ma nus mgon med skyob pa'i sbyin pa yin/ /rang 'dod med na las kun rnam dkar rgyu/ /gzhan lhum zhal lce gcod sogs dka' 'tsher yang / /g.yo med drang por spyod na 'gro phan yin/ /zang zing rnam pa gtan nas spang 'dod la/ /ha cang thal na byang sems nyams pa'i rgyu/ /gdul bya spang nas rang nyid zhi bde ru/ /gnyer 'di theg chen mkha' nas sa lhung rgyuske//rang ngo shes pas ma chog thob 'dod kyi/ /ltos 'di som nyis rtsa ba'i ltung ba yin/ /deng sang dus dang 262

bskal pa 'di 'dra bar/ /phyogs gang mthong thos chos kun gzugs brnyan ris/ /lus med pos rlam dmag gis zang zing gis/ /bsgrod lam dka' 'jigs ngal ba don med che/ /dam pa mchog gyur phal cher mya ngan 'das/ /re zungs bzhugs kya nga dus stab kyis dben 'grim/ /rnal 'byor mchog grub dam pa yongs srid kyang / /de dag sbas tshul 'tshol yang snyed par dka'/ /gzhan yul bsgrod tshe bla ma phal che ba/ /sku gnyan sku che mjal ba'i gnas kyang dka'/ /brgya lam mjal yang gagams khrid thob par dka'/ /bkres skom grang 'khyag sdug bsngal theg dka' 'byung / /'chi gar gdang dbyangs rig gnas mtshan nyid kyiglu/ /grwa pa la ni khyod yid gtad mi 'dug /dben brten rtse gcig bskyed rdzogs don sgril na/ /zang zing spang nas dben pa brten pas chog /khyod nyid rgyang ring byon na pha ma dang / /bdag sogs rgad pos phyis su mthong bar dka'/ /gong ma nas bzung grags ldan gdan sa yang / /bdag nyid shi shul khyod min gzhan gyis dka'/ /gzhan yang deng sang phan tshun dgon gnas spyi/ /bye brag rang la ltos bor khyad par duk+ṣi/ /bla ma pad+ma dbang yang skun zin bzhin/ /khyod gzhan gshegs pa shin tu mi thad kyi/ /cis kyang phebs yang zur mang rin po che/ /che tshang sku zhabs las ni gar ma byon/ /slar yang rang gi gnas 'dir phebs mdzad de/ /dben pa gang mos sku mtshams bcad rgya mdzod/ /zhes gsungs de la rang gi dar cig par/ /byas sam byas phral len phul mi spob kyis/ /zhag shas bar du rang bsam gzhib nas ni/ /dam pa'i drung du zhu ba 'bul lo smras/ /de nas rang nyid lam 'ong bsam gzhib kyang / /bla slob yon bdag bstod bsngags byas na yang / /rang la phyi nang yon tan ma ldan tshe/ /khā ta mkha' lding rgyal po yin no zhes/ /bsngags kyang de yi yon tan sha chas med/ /ko mgo chu la bskal pa'i rgya mtsho dang / /gor mo'i rdo la yid bzhin nor bu zhesaske//bsngags dang cha mthun rang gis rang la spyod/ /gzhan blta mig yin rang blta me long dgos/ /rang gi rang la spyad tshe chos med nges/ /rang sems rnam par dag pa'i mthu med tshe/ /bya ba thams cad 'khrul la 'khrul bsnon mthong / /rang yul 'di ru sdod kyang sngar bshul las/ /dam chos bsgrub pa ri bong rwa dang 'draske/ /de bas bla ma mchog la dam tshig sel/ /med par dgongs pa zhus nas phyogs gzhan du/ /skyes mchog bzhugs gyur zhal blta gtsug lag rten/ /mjal phyir 'gro bar blo thag sbed bcad de/ /slar yang dus tshes dge bar sku zhabs su/ /phyin nas gus btud spros bas 'di skad zhus/ /e ma mchog gyur rig 'dzin snyan gson dang / /dam pa nyid bkas bdag la snyan brjod cing / /sngon nas da bar bka' drin khur gyi lci/ /lugs gnyis kyis skyong pha ma bu ltar yin/ /phyogs gzhan 'gro la 'brel bar sems yang 'phreng glu/ /zab gsang smin grol gdams pa zab mo'i bcud/ /'chad pa nyid lhag gzhan du 'tshol kyang med / /phyogs mthar dus dbang bsgrod par dka' yang shes/ /sprul skur ming tsam grags kyang rang nyid 263

kyiske/ /ci bzhin gsal ba'i stobs dben cung zad tsam/ /dran yang de la rlom bskyed chos spang na/ /las ngan 'khor ba'i gnas su cis mi 'khyams/ /phral mdzes thos bsam snyan grags rnam dpyod yang / /'chi dus dgos med skad cig brag cha 'dra/ /rdzogs chen thos kyang bsgom long ma byung bas/ /nyams rtogs ma skyes mo bsham bu dang 'dra/ /mthun pa'i grogs dang deng sang 'grogs na yang / /'chi dus mi phan rgyal khams mgron po 'dra/ /dam chig bsrung ba'i zhe gdeng yod na yang / /phra zhib las 'khyal shin tu sems 'gyod ldang / /khog chen gzhung bzang shes rab ldan zhes kyang / /'phral legs ltar snang mthar ni sgyu ma 'draske/ /rnam dag smon lam tshogs gnyis bsags skad kyang / /rang sems 'khrul pa gzhan dang khyad med mthong spyo/ /mchog dman mang pos bstod bskur snyan brjod kyang / /'chi dus dgos med ston gzhug sprin yal 'dra/ /'jig rten ngo len mi chos spyod pa 'di/ /'pher ba mdo med chu yi sbu ba 'dra/ /'khrugs bsdum zhal lce chos yin sems na yang / /'bad pas rang ngal dge sdig 'dres ma'i rgyu/ /rtsub spyod ma nus skyob byed sems na yang / /phal cher log mthong ngan 'gro bsags pa'i rgyu/ /rang nyid grol ba'i rang gdeng ma tshud na/ /gong ma phyir mi ldog pa'i skyes bu zhig /yin no zhes pa'i ming la blo gtad ni/ /phan med rgyal po'i khri la yid smon 'dra/ /dus dang skal pa rtsub 'gyur che ba dang / /dmag 'khrugs zang zing bsgrod pa'i gegs gyur kyang / /chos phyir lus srog 'phang ba'i sems kyang med/ /zas nor ched du lus srog btang ba minaske/ /bkres skom skyid sdug lus kyi ma thegs na/ /chos phyir dka' spyad yin zhes ngo yang tsha/ /rgyal ba gong ma'i rnam thar shul rjes zhig /snyegs par 'dod nas phyogs gzhan bsgrod mos zhing / /de bas rang gi rang ngo shes pa 'di/ /gong sgrod ltos gzhi lta ba'i sgrib pa ste/ /yang dag rtogs pa mi ldan nyams len la/ /chog shes che ba thar pa'i gegs su che/ /bdag ni sngon nas shes rab rtsal kha chung / /da ni rgan song rig gnas lob par dka'/ /byung na phyag rdzogs chos shig zhu wig bsam/ /ma byung na yang rang mgo thon thabs gcig /byed par thag chod blo yi gdeng su shar/ /mtshan ldan bla ma 'bad pas btsal ba dang / /snying nas dad dung gus mos gsol btab na/ /rgyal ba'i thugs rjes 'gro ngor cang srid dam/ /gal te dus dbang stabs kyi ma mjal yang / /'dren pa mchog gyur bde gling che tshang zhabs/ /las lhag gzhan med des chog thag chod pas/ /de gsung chos de go yul ma lus pa/ /gnad thog rgyud la khel zhig ma byung b.raske/ /phyogs gzhan bsgrod nas bsgrub la ma dril na/ /'di ru sdod kyang sngon gyi rnam g.yeng 'phror mi tshe dus 'da' de ngang 'chi bar nges/ /nam zhig rang don tshad la phebs pa'i tshe/ /bka' gcong yin yang gdan sa 'di'i bstan don/ /bdag nyid rtsing spyod rtsal chol 'di 'dra bas/ /gdan sa sdod kyang bstan las bya dka' yang / /'on kyang la rgya nam yang g.yel min par/ /bstan khur rang gi gang nus khur lags 264

kyiske/ /de bas gdan sa gser ri lhun shul du/ /bdag 'dra rdul phran gyis sob nus min gyi/ /nyid dka' gnang la 'gal ba mi 'gro dang / /da lam cis kyang che tshang mjal stabs su/ /phyogs kyi rgyal khams ltas mo blta ba dang / /zhen med gar bde'i spyod pa skyong ba bcas/ /cis kyang 'gro bar dgongs pas gnang nas kyang / /bdag gi 'di phyir sgrib rgyur men zhu zhing / /bdag nyid phyogs bsgrod kun rdzob don dam gyi/ /dge tshogs nyid la maṇ+ḍal 'bul gyis bzhes/ /zhes pa zhus tshe bla ma mchog gis yang / /'o na de ltar nan du zhu ba na/ /de sngon rang nyid dam sel spu tsam med/ /da res ci btol gyis bshol dam sel rgyu/ /des na re zhig gnas bskor 'gro chog gi /zhag shas tsam sdod gong ma'i sku nye dang / /yon bdag tshos yang zhal mjal byin brlab mdzod/ /zhes pas 'then mdzad de ltar bya'o zhus/ /rang gi'ang bla ma'i zhabs nas 'ja' lugs kyi/ /zhi ba'i dbang bskur zhus tshe yid snang bar/ /bla ma'i dbu thad bar snang sprin dkar 'ja'aske//me tog drwa ba'i dbus su pad dkar sbub/ /rig 'dzin klong gsal snying po yin snyam pa'i/ /sngags 'chang mnyam bzhag lwa thod gsol ba zhig /bzhugs mthar dhāk+ki mang po'i mchod 'bul mthong mos gus cher g.yos mthar ni bla mar thim/ /bdud 'dul zhabs kyi gsang bdag dbang bskyar zhus/ /sngon nas yin bzhin bsnyen bsgrub khas len byas/ /de skabs rje yi sku nye pha tshan la/ /bdag nyid bshol bar ma thub rdzong btab par/ /bskul mthus sa dmar yul du 'ong dgos zhes/ /rdo rje byung nas yang yang nan ches pas/ /'gro bar 'tsher yang ngo gcogs ma nus phyin/ /yul der sleb tshe de nub dkor bdag de/ /bdag la mi bzod 'chi ma khrag tu 'bab/ /'khur shes phyir na nye gnas yengs pa'i skabs/ /rta las lhungs te pus po brdab zhag 'gror/ /gnod pa tsam las skyon cher ma byung ngo / /de skabs shing sgo gangs rar grwa pa gsum/ /kaḥ thog drung pa'i gdung las grub brnyes tshe/ /rje btsun nam mkha' rgya mtsho mjal bar dang / /zhar du kaḥ thog gdung grags bstan 'phel nyid/ /bsur btang rang nyid de nas 'brog phyin nasaske/ /rjes gnang byin brlab 'pho lung gdams phran gyis/ /rang rang re bskang bdag la 'bul rdzong tshul—/ /rta gcig zang gnyis sha mar thud bzang po/ /sprang la ngom tshod gnang byung rjes yi rangs/ /de zhar gter gnas chen po spung ri ru/ /mjal 'gro mdun yang lam stab 'grig ma nus/ /myur bas slar log sa dmar yul phyin skabs/ /brag dmar dbang chen gling gi gdan sa nas/ /sprul sku phrin las ye shes rgya mtsho zung —/ /theg mchog gtsos pa'i bla grwa mang zhig gis/ /dar ras ja sogs bsnam nas bdag phrad par/ /byon la dbang bkas dgongs pa'i re 'dod bskangs/ /snub chen sprul pa khyab brdal mchog sprul sku/ /mjal 'dod brel stab ma 'grig kun rnams ni/ /de dus spom bzhugs ma mjal sems yang 'phreng / /de ka'i 'brog yul sku nye tsho rnams kyi/ kha rgyab ma phyid sprang bdag gar gnas yang / /'gro sa med pa'i 265

dgongs pas mngon mkhyen bzhin/ /phral du ma 'gro zhes pa'i tshig bzang tsam/ /zer la gang yang bka' sgrub mi nus zhus/ /dus der brag dmar gnas su spu bod nas/ /rig 'dzin nus ldan bdud 'dul gdung bon mched/ /phebs pa rtsem du 'ong bar gzhed dgongs la/ /bab ltar chib bsu sku dbon 'phrin ye btang / /de nub spra thang tshug btab par zhal 'dzom/ /de ru nag 'bom yag chung bu na zhes/ /gdan 'dren nan yang ma song tsam du sleb/ /gdung rgyud mched kyi dgongs bzhed la babs bzhin/ /kun mkhyen chos rje'i thugs gter yang tig mchog /yid bzhin nor bu'i lung dang kar gling gi/ /zhi khro'i dbang bzhi tshul ldan zhib rgyas par/ /de bzhugs grwa tshang dang bcas brgya lhag la/ /phul zhing gzhan yang phyogs kyi yul gru nas/ /mchog dman ser skya mang po bdag mjal bar/ /rlung ltar 'tshub la rang yang nam 'chi ni//cha med 'di bdag rnams kyang myur mi rtag /bsam pa'i rnam dkar smon lam bzang po bcas/ /dka' sun ma bsam rjes gnang gzhan re bskang / /de skabs spo nas rang gi grwa pa gsum/ /bstan 'phel ma bu gnyis kyang bde bar sleb/ /bdud 'dul zhabs gdung bsnyen bskur legs zhus nas/ /slar yang brag dmar gnas theg bdag nyid kyi/ /nag 'bom yon bdag bang chen bskyar ma yi/ /nan ches 'ba' rom la kha bar du phyin/ /byin rlabs byas shing de ru zhag pa'i nub/ /lcags mdud rgyal po seng ge bzang po de/ /btsun gzugs gos kun nag mdangs se theb can/ /gzugs brtan mnyam par bzhag pas yal de song ske/ /'khor la gdon dog ting 'dzin bsar byas shing / /phyir nang phrin ye na yang cang ma skyon/ /lam zhar zhe stod zhe smad nag 'bom yul/ /sman ri gzung sngon re ril ban bon bcas/ /khyon cig skya ser khrom tshogs stong lhag la/ /dbang byas brel bas myur du rang gnas sleb/ /de tshe grwa tshang kun gyis bla rgan la/ /bdag bsol bskul mthus rten 'brel mtshon bya ru/ /thub sku chos rnga maṇ+ḍal la sogs pa/ /bshol bstab tshul bcas bdag la dus re zhig /phyogs su ma 'gro 'di ru sdod dgos tshul/ /bla grwa rnams kyi mgrin gcig gsungs pa'i tshe/ /de tshe rang gi gus pas 'di skad gsol/ /e ma bla ma mchog dang rdo rje mched/ /bdag gi mang po brjod pa'i don med kyi/ /cha shas zhus pa don 'di bka' gnang zhu/ /skye gnas sprul sku'i ming tsam bdag grags kyang / /rang don ma grub rgyal bu sprang 'khyams 'dra/ /dal 'byor lus 'di da res yud thob kyang / /dge ba ma grub nor bu snyed gtor 'dra/ /mtshan ldan bla ma mi tshe yun 'grogs yang / /chos bzhin ma rten sde pa'i hor 'dra 'dra/ /snying rus 'bad pas chos gcig ma byas na/ /khrid lung tshar gcig 'ja' yi ltas mo 'dra/ /'a 'ol phyogs cha'i nyams myong yod na yang / /bstan pa ma thob dbul mo'i gser skyid 'dra/ /rang blo chos thog cig thag ma bcad na/ /'jig rten las la zad med chu gnyer 'dra/ /rtse gcig dran dus chos la ma 'bad na/ /rnam g.yeng zad med rgyal srang 'grim 'grul 'dra/ /da lta nyid du 266

bsgom bsgrub ma brtson na/ /sang byed snang byed ston thog sad shor 'dra/ /rang nyid ma smin gzhan la dbang khrid kyang / /ma smin 'bras bu sa bon btab pa 'dra/ /'gro don yin khul phyogs bsgrod gdul bya yang ske/ /rang 'dod ma zad tshong pa'i khe grags 'dra/ /phan btags grogs re grwa 'khor bsten pa yang / /phal cher phan med khā tas bu gsos 'dra/ /rnam g.yeng 'a 'ur bla slob gdan sa yang / /myur du mi rtag sgyu ma'i ltas mo 'dra/ /'jig rten chos brgyad dgon chung khra mo yang / /rang bzhin 'jigs pa mi lam grong khyer 'dra/ /byas pa don med tshe 'di'i nor rdzas yang / /nam phug gzhan spyod sbrang ma'i rtsi dang 'dra/ /'jig rten 'di snang las su gyur pa kun/ /snying po med pa chu yi sbu ba 'dra/ /nyams len rtogs ldan mi ldan chos snyan yang / /rgyug 'gral mkhan gdong gser mtshon byugs pa 'dra/ /dpon slob 'dus pa yud tsam skyid na yang / /myur du 'brel ba nam langs skar ma 'dra/ /sku gsung thugs rten mchod pa'i zhing sa steske/ /zhen pa ches na dar gyi sked 'gag 'dra/ /da res nges pa'i thar lam ma zin na/ /phyi ma cha med mun khung mda' dang 'dra/ /des na bdag nyid lha chos bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /phyogs med 'gro ba bung bas rtsi tshol 'draske/ /dpal ldan bla ma mchog gi bka' gnang 'tshal/ /chos min spyod na bla mas dgag bya yin/ /chos bzhin spyod la rje yi bka' gnang zhu/ /dam tshig sel med yang yang mjal bar smon/ /tshe dbang nor bu kun btags ming 'di thog /brten pa'i bla ma chos 'brel thob pa bcu/ /drin can lnga yod rtsa ba'i bla ma gnyisaske/ /rang lo nyer gsum phan byed de tsam la/ /tshe rabs kun tu mtshungs med bla ma ni/ /rdo rje slob dpon thod 'phreng rtsal yab yum/ /dbyer med rtsa ba gnyis ni bde gling dang / /mgon mchog gsung rab rgya mtsho'i mngag bdag yin/ /drin can lnga nas gtso gyur mabon khyod yin/ /des na mgon po khyod bka' bdag nyid kyi/ /lus srog phye mar gyur kyang cag min kyang / /da lam bdag gi dgongs pa zhu 'di'i don/ /phyogs med yangs pa'i rgyal khams chen po la/ /zhen med sgyu ma'i ltas mo blta ba dang / /mtshungs med skyes mchog mang po'i zhal mjal zhing / /'khrul med zab gdams snying po len pa dang / /'gran med chos rgyal gyis gzhengs gtsug lag la/ /bslu med smon lam bzang po btab phyir dang / /'dzin med dag zhing sprul pa'i gnas mchog la/ /ngal med tshogs bsags phyag bskor byed phyir dang / /ma dag sgyu lus 'khrul pa'i rten gyur 'di/ /rab dag bsod nams tshogs chen bsags phyir dang / /ma dag 'khrul sems nyon mongs rtog pa 'di/ /yongs dag ye shes sku ru 'grub phyir dang / /khyad par bdag gi yongs 'dzin 'dren pa che/ /rgyal kun ngo bo che tshangs sku zhabs su/ /yongs bar zhus kyang rnam g.yengs kyis rab 'gyangs/ /da ni lo gsum sner song da lo la/ /ma mjal gyur na rdo rje slob dpon la/ /rdzun brjod ltar song bdag nyid 'chi ba las/ /sdug bsngal 'di che kye ma kye hud do/ kha sems mchis na bsrung mas bdag srog bstung / /267

des na mgon khyod brtse ba'i thugs rje yi/ /bdag gi don gsol 'di ka gnang bar zhu/ /grwa 'khor rnams kyi'ang mgrin gcig bkas gnang nas/ /bdag la gegs med dge shing shis par mdzod/ /zhes zhus bla mas de ltar che tshang zhabs/ /mjal bar chog kyang dbus su sang phod kyi/ /drod bab bar du 'gro bar mi bya gsung / /de ltar bgyis zhus grwa tshos nan skyar bar/ /cis kyang ma 'gro zhes su smra ba'i tshe/ /de la kho bos rang bzhin 'di skad smras/ /e ma gson dang mched gyur grwa slob rnams/ /dal 'byor lus 'di u dum wa ra 'dra/ /'chi ba thog bab ston zhugs ba mo 'dra/ /ngan song chu rgyun gzhung ring mtha' med la/ /yud tsam mi lus chu dkyil lbu ba 'di/ /nam yal cha med myur du 'jig par nges/ /de la zhed nas kho bos chos gcig bsgrub/ /chos la bskul byed su byung rdo rje'i mched/ /chos gegs byed pa su yang mi mthun dgra /des na bdag la da lam bshol du med/ /bshol na bar chad rgyur 'gyur spang bar gyis/ /spyir yang nges 'byung mkha' la skyo shas kyi/ /bskul ba'i bzhed bya thabs kyi rlung gzhon nas/ /brtson pa'i gshog pas 'dod phyogs lding ba la/ /zang zing bya phran gyi bags nus pa min/ /de bas khyed rnams bla ma'i bka' bzhin mdzod/ /ha la'i dkor la bag med mi spyod cing / /rnam dkar dge ba'i bya ba'i 'grub thabs dang ske/ /dam tshig ngos lkog tshul mtshungs spyod par zhu/ /zhes smras bshol med re zhig phyogs gzhan du/ /'gro thag chod de bla ma mchog zhabs nas/ /bla mar 'bul rgyu bdag la gnang rdzong tshul/ /dngul srang phyed dang bcu bzhi ja khag drug /zung dang chos gos rdor dril man da la/ /dkar yol gos ling ras yug ma hardzi dang / /cha lang kha dar dang bcas dgu mtshan lnga/ /grangs lang gnang byung rje yi sku zhabs nas/ /skabs der stag phag nor bu'i dbang bskur zhus/ /'di dus bswo ban dpa' rtsal che smra ba/ /pad+ma 'phrin las nags seng zla 'od nang / /ba rgan khra bo mthong bar stag yin par/ /sems nas bros pa'i bang rtsal che byung ba/ /kha don ma mtshungs rang bzhin mtshar rkyen gyur/ /de nas rang nyidi chas grab shul zhugs pa'i//grwa 'khor rnams la chos dang 'jig rten gyi/ /bslab bya rang gi shes tshad 'bel byung dang / /khyad par kun gyi bla rgan rin po che'i/ /gsung sgrub grwa tshang nang mthun chos bzhin spyod/ /sprul dbon tshos yang rig gnas thos bsam dang / /bslab sbyang byed dang khyad par gnas lugs don/ /nyams len dril nas rang gzhan don 'grub cing / /rgyal ba gong ma'i ding dus bla ma mchog /skal bzang bar gyis bstan srol ma nyams bzhin/ /mdzad cing kun kyang nang sel med pa dang / /thugs yid gcig 'dres gzhan gyi 'phya khrel gnas/ /ma song ba ru dgos tshul nan tu zhus/ /de ltar lam gyi yi ge smra ba'i zhar/ /rang lo nyer lnga zin nas spyad pa rab/ /cha shas bcas dang yul phyogs gzhan chas tshul/ /cung zad brjod pa rim pa de ltar ro/ /zhes lam gyi yi ge brjod pa sna tshogs pad ma'i phreng ba las/ khog don dang phyogs su chas tshul 268

smras pa'i skabs de dang po'o/ / dge'o/ /༄ga /snyigs dus rnal 'byor gzugs 'dzin sprang ban tshe dbang nor bu bdag nyid phyogs kun rgyu ba'i rtogs brjod las 'phros skyo shas glu dbyangs sna tshogs pad+ma'i phreng ba bzhugs so/ /dus snyigs mar rnal 'byor gzugs brnyan tsam du 'dzin pa'i dkor zan snyom las mkhan tshe dbang nor bu dpal gyi rgya mtsho bdag nyid snang ba sgyu ma'i ltas mor phyogs kun rgyu ba'i rtogs brjod kyu ru lugs su sa bon tsam nges par byung ba skyo shas kyi glu dbyangs smos pa sna tshogs pad+ma'i phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di lta ste/ oṃ swā sti/ bla med bla ma 'khrul spangs ye shes rgyas/ /dpe dang don sbyor skyob pa'i dpal dam pa—/ /rgyal ba'i bstan spyod tshogs zhing rgyal sa bon/ dkon pa'i mchog gyur gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba rab 'byams dkyil 'khor kun 'dus gtso/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje mtshungs med 'gro ba'i mgon/ /dran mchog bde chen 'khor lo'i dbang phyug che/ /snying nas gsol 'debs bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /kwa ye rang tshul rang gi cung gleng na/ /skyon gyur nyon mongs chu gter rab 'khrugs shing / /yon tan phun tshogs nor dang mi ldan pa/ /tshe dbang nor bur grags pa'i tir rgan bdag /pha ni gnyid chang la sred zhe sdang cheske//khog drang g.yo rgyu chung zhing dge la mos/ /ma ni ngang thung nga rgyal ser sna che/ /gzhungs bzang dad gus lha sngags bzla la mos/ /de lta'i pha ma skyon yon gnyis ldan pa/ /mgon dang mtsho zhes bya ba gnyis kyi bur/ /kaḥ thog lho phyogs 'jang chu nye ba'i g.yon/ /skye ma thag tu dam chos phrad par skyes/ /pad 'byung be+e ro'i thugs kyi sprul pa che/ /zab gter mnga' bdag bde chen gling pa yi/ /dbang bskur ming gnang skal bar ldan pa yi/ /skyes bu 'ong bar lung bstan gzeng yang bstod/ /chung ngu lo shas dus su sngon gnas tshul/ /gsal bar dran zhes khong tsho'i ngag las thos/ /nga rang yid la ci byas cha ni med/ /yid la nges par lha bsgom sngags bzla dang / /khyad par sems ngo thod brgal bskyang tshul spro/ /gter ston gnas sgo phye tshul rtse mor spyod/ /sems gsal snang ba zhen med rmi lam 'dra/ /dngos nyams rmi lam lha dang 'dre mang mthong / 269

gzhan gyi yid la ci bsam 'ga' yang shes/ /de dag byis pa'i tshul gyi spyod tshul yin/ /tshul 'di sngon las 'phro bzang cung zad cig /yin par srid tsam mtha' ma bkag na'ang / /nar son bla ma'i gzugs brnyan tsam zhig 'di/ /bzung mthus yon tan rgyab kyi rab phyogs te/ /lha chos 'od mchog ba lang spyod du gzhol//'di nang chos brgyad shar ri'i phrag nas 'phos/ /bzang rdzu khe drag dbyar mtsho bzhin du rgyas/ /dam pa'i rnam thar ston 'jug rtsi tog 'dra/ /phral bsam rang mgo bskor na skyid skyid la/ /phug bsam phyi ma dran tshe glo snying 'dar/ /rang gi rang nyid tshul 'di gzhib bsam na/ /skyo zhing sdug bsngal rgyu las gzhan ci zhig /kwa ye da dung bdag tshul mdo tsam smra/ /chung ngu'i skabs su sngon gnas cung dran pas/ /de dus sprul pa'i sku ru yin min zhes/ /sna tshogs gleng gyur 'ga' dang 'ga' yi ni/ /grub chen pad ma nor bu'i sprul sku de/ /yul 'dir mi 'khrungs lung bstan yod do skad/ /la las bla ma gnas rigs 'dem nus te/ /a mgon rang dga'i bur skye mi srid zer/ /la las pha mas ngag bslab bzo bcos kyis/ /sprul min sprul pa'i sku ru rdzu 'dug zer/ /la las a khu gong ma'i grwa rgan gshis/ /de mtshos bslab nas gang dran brjod 'dug zer//la las sprul sku yin kyang sngon gnas tshul/ /'di tsam gsal ba 'dre yi bslu sam shes/ /la las rong ston bu dang tsha bo kun/ /gang che gang drag sprul skur bzo 'dug zer/ /gang ltar nga yi skye ba dman stobs kyis/ /sprul sku'i ming tsam las kyi grags pa de/ /kun gyi zhe khrel ha rgad rgyur bdag byas/ /yun ring rgyus yod 'grogs pa'i grogs po 'gas/ /skye ba dran tshul bag chags bzang po bcas/ /sprul sku bslu med 'dug ces bstod par byas/ /gong ma'i dbon nye grwa tshang gang gis kyang / /sprul sku yin min the tshom bcad tsam yang ske/ /ma mdzad tshe na bdag rkyen smos ci dgos/ /grub rtags rdo la zhabs rjes bzhag gyur pa'i/ /grub chen pad+ma nor bur grags pa de'i/ /sprul skur bdag 'dra sprang phrug mu to zhig /yin yang gang yin min par thugs re bden/ /des na gter ston khyung grags rdo rje zhes/ /grags des sprul sku min par gsung mthon por/ /bsgrags de rang gis rang la brtag pa'i tshe/ /rjes su yi rang lan grangs brgya brgyar 'bul/ /'on kyang phyi dus bdag nyid rol lam du/ /yod skabs gter chen mchog ste stag bu ru/ /gdul byar phebs skabs 'khrul med sprul sku ru/ / yin zhes rdo rje'i gsung gi bsgrags mdzad pa/ /skal med bdag 'dra las ngan sprul brdzu yang / /chos la spro ba skyed phyir rjes bzung tshig /gnang 'dug sems nas gus pa'i thal sbyar las/ /ma mchis de dag phral tshul cung zad lags/ /de bas gzhan gyur rang nyid byis pa'i dusaske/ /bzung nas deng dus lnga phrag lnga lo bar/ /dge sdig bzang ngan dga' sdug legs nyes tshul/ /zhib par brjod pa bgrang gis mi longs shing / /smras kyang kun gyi khong khrel rgyu bskyed las/ /legs bshad yon tan tshig don mi 'brel bar/ /snag shog chud zos kho na'i rgyus ci byas/ /des na rgyas par 'di ru mi smos 270

kyiske/ /mdo tsam bde sdug gleng mo'i tshul bshad nas/ /rang lo bdun pa'i skabs su sgyu ma yi/ /nyams skyes bcu gsum lon dus 'dren pa rje/ /rgyal kun spyi gzugs pad 'byung bde gling zhabs/ /bdag gis mgo bos reg byas dam pa de'i/ /drung du phyag chen gnas lugs yid bzhin nor/ /don brgyud ma nyams stod 'brug smar tshang zung / /chu bo gcig 'dres gdams pa lhad med dang / /theg kun rtse mo 'od gsal rdo rje snying ske/ /gsang las ches gsang yang gsang bla med pa/ /rdzogs chen klong gsal ḍā ki snying tig bcas/ /sngon 'gro khyon gcig bye brag man ngag gnad/ /ma 'dres ma nor ma chug ma thor bar/ /ji bzhin byang chub sar sbyor lam sne nyid/ /tshugs par khrid mdzad bka' drin brjod pa na/ /nam mkha'i mtha' ru ma shong de bas ci/ /'on kyang rang nyid chos la las 'phro dben/ /snying rus brtson 'grus dag gis ma pher bas/ /nyams rtog ci bzhin mtha' ru ma phyin kyang / /gol shor log nor lam la ma song bas/ /dge sbyor 'khrul med skyong shes tsam 'di gyur/ /de yang bdag gi nyams len skye lugs 'di/ /nyams rtogs skye bul skyes pa sa chod che/ /rtsal rdzogs dka' yang phyin ci ma log 'char/ /des na gang zag rim skyes rab tu rtogs/ /thog mar sems 'dzin bsten la rig pa nyid/ /sngon bsu rjes gcod da lta'i rtog dpyod kyi/ /ma snyogs rang bab rang grol nyid bzhag pas/ /gnas cha dang po ri gzar chu ltar 'chags/ /rim bzhin gnas yun thung yang gsal dngas shing / /da dung 'gyu dus phal cher ngo ma
