shes/ /nges par 'di yi bsgom go mi chod yang / /rang gis bsgom yin snyam nas bros skye 'dug /de nas lus bde sems gsal rjen hrig ge/ /rnam rtog gang shar phal cher thug phrad grol/ /mtshan mo'i rmi lam skabs 'gar dge sbyor zin/ /gnad la rang dbang tshud 'dra dga' spro 'char/ /deng sang bsgom chen 'ga' yi thugs dam mthil/ /'di 'drar gtad tshod 'dug kyang lam 'di ni/ /'dus byas dge ba rnams kyi mchog yin pas/ /srid rtse'i zhi bde grub pa'i thabs zab kyang / /mya ngan 'das pa'i sa dang rgyang thag ring / /de bas chos nyid don la gzigs 'tshal zhu/ /de yi mus su dge sbyor kho na zhig /skyong rgyu byung na rtogs ldan yongs 'dug ste/ /nyams len de tsam rang lo bcu gsum zhugs/ /kho bo lha skyabs gong ma'i grwa rgan zhen/ /che gshis stag dbon bskal bzang drung phyin nas/ /sprang phrug bdag 'dra sprul sku yin zob kyis/ /bskul nas phyag mdzod tshe mgon bdag bsur btang / /rkyen des 'jang chu ri kra'i dgon du phyin/ /lo gcig 'du byas bde sdug sna tshogs cig /nyams myong slar yang bswo dgon rol lam du/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i drung phyin 'di snang la/ /rgyab phyogs lha chos kho nar dril sems yang / /grogs ngan rkyen dang bdud kyi phye gtor la/ /g.yeng ba'i 'gyod pa deng dus phyis su song / /bar skabs dge sbyor cung zad byed khul gyis/ /nyams kyi 'char tshul lhong grol sna tshogs pa/ /zhib par 'di ru brjod par mi lang zhing / /mdo tsam gang gi nyams len de yi 271

'phroske/ /zhi gnas dwangs cha lhag mthong tsal gyis zin/ /rim bzhin sems dang sems byung dbyer med pa/ /gang shar shar grol rang ngo rang gsal bar/ rjen cer lhin ne skye 'gag mtha' bral ba/ /zhi lhag bsam gtan shes rab zung 'jug nyid/ /rang sems rnal mar cung zad 'byor tsam gyur/ /de ni rtogs tshod 'ol bzhag ma yin par/ /nyams myong sems la rdo rus btugs tshul byas/ /gzhan yang dran mchog zhabs de'i bka' drin gyis/ /bskyed rim lha sngags ting 'dzin dam pa dang / /rdzogs rim pho nya thabs lam rim pa sogs/ /gang 'dod yid bzhin rmad byung rtsal bar mdzad/ /mdor na rje btsun mchog de'i byin rlabs chabaske/ /bdag sems bum par cung zad bltams byas mthus/ /bdag la spang rtogs yon tan phran bu'i tshogasaske/ /mchis pa ma lus de drin kho nar smra/ /rang gi rang la spyad tshe las ngan pa/ /bdag 'drar dam pa de yi ba spu gcig /bye ba ther 'bum bshag 'tshal ye shes rtsal/ /'pho ba yin zhes smra spobs zhum lags kyang ske/ /gzhan ngor snang tshul blun dang dad can 'ga'/ /yun ring 'grogs pa'i mched grogs re zung gis—/ /bdag lus rje btsun mchog de'i skur mthong zhing / /rang gi'ang 'phrig pa'i rjes 'brang dpag zhig dang ske/ /khyad par rig 'dzin dngos kyi zhal nas kyang / /rdo rje'i gsung mchog gsang ba'i tshig 'ga' zung ske/ /bdag la lan mang gsung ba'i don mthun pas/ /rgyud la ye shes cung 'phos sems tsam 'gyur/ /des na rang lo bcu drug skabs son dus/ /rig 'dzin mchog gi sku dngos gdul bya ni/ /rdzogs tshul le lo can rnams sun dbyung phyir/ /hor zla bcu gcig gnam stong tho rengs dus/ /gzugs sku'i chu shel chos nyid stong la bsdus/ /bde chen pad+ma'i sbubs su gshegs gyur pa/ /thos ma thag tu bdag snying gas pa ltar//rab tu mya ngan khang bu dam por chud/ /lus mdar sar 'gre gdong pa mchi mas rlams/ /kye ma kye hud sdug re bsngal smras shing / /dam pa de yi zhal mjal gsung thos kyang / /rang nyid las ngan le lo snyoms las pas/ /chos bzhin spyod pa brtson pas ma 'pher nas/ /nyams rtogs klong du ma gyur ce rer long / /gang du rtsal yang yongs 'dzin de mtshungs par/ /rnyed dka' da ni bdag gson ci zhig bya/ /dam chos mi 'grub sgyu lus sdug rgog 'di/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i dgongs pa ma rdzogs tshun/ /bor na res dga' res skyid snyam pa zhig /zhes phugs rus pa'i gting nas yang yang shar/ /kye ma de ltar sems yang phan ci yodaske/ /rtags snang le lo'i mngon mtshan der mthong yang / /'gyod pa phyis song rang nyid a thang chad/ /bsam bzhin skyo shas gnas las ci zhig gu /bla ma'i sku brnyan sgyu ma'i zlos gar 'dra/ /zhal mjal gsung thos rmi lam sad pa 'dra/ /grwa tshang bye bral tshong 'dus mgron po 'dra/ /rang nyid ci bya med pa do 'phrug 'dra / /phan brtags grogs po nyin mo'i skar ma 'dra/ /don med gnod skyal mun 'tshub rgyu skar 'dra/ /phan med btang snyoms bzhag pa sa rdul 'dra/ /byas pa don med sran chang bkab pa 'dra/ /bla mar dung yang 272

zhal mjal gsung thos med/ /sdug bsngal tshe yang bya ba'i thabs ni med/ /gdams zab ma zhus 'gyod kyang phan pa med/ /ci ltar bsam kyang sems khral nyid las med/ /'di snang bya ba sgyu ma smig rgyu 'dra/ /mthong bzhin rang blo dred 'di a re 'gyod/ /bla ma'i zhal ras u dum wa ra 'dra/ /mjal dus skyid par mi shes a re 'gyod/ /bla ma'i gsung ni 'chi med bdud rtsi 'dra/ /ci thos dngas blangs mi shes a re 'gyodaske/ /bla ma yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po 'dra/ /ci 'dod gsol btab mi shes a re 'gyod/ /bla ma gtan bde'i sar skyol gru rdzing 'dra/ /'khor ba'i chu brgal mi shes a re 'gyod/ /bla ma nyon mongs nad sel sman sdong 'dra/ /gang dgos myong bar ma shes a re 'gyod/ /kye ma kye hud bdag 'dra'i las ngan pa/ /bla ma'i sku ni rtags snang ngang du 'byams/ /dam pa'i chos ni yid smon ngang du lus/ /bya ba sngon song 'gyod pa ci zhig phan/ /nyin mo'i zas 'gag mtshan mor gnyid mi khug /rang gi rang la bsam zhing sems skyo sdug /bla ma bzhugs dus skyid dga' ma shes shing / /snyoms las dbang song mtshang de mthong na yang ske/ /nam mkha' spar mos mi khyig ci byar yod/ /sems khral byed pa rang sgyid lug pa'i rgyu/ /bla ma bzhugs dus dam chos snying po la/ /snying rus 'bad par ma nus 'di dus su/ /sdug bsngal snying sprig gas tsam byas na yang / /rang nyid ngal ba'i rgyu las gzhan ci zhig /'on kyang sdug bsngal phal dang mi mtshungs teske/ /sdug bsngal byas pas tshe 'das gzhan la gnod/ /bla ma'i ched du sdug bsngal cung zad dang / /'chi ma sran tsam rlag gyur mi de yis/ /bskal pa stong du bsags pa'i sdig sgrib kun/ /yongs su dag par 'gyur zhes rgyal bas gsungs/ /des na bla ma'i ched du sdug bsngal ni/ /gang byas don ldan yin pas shes par byos—/ /rang ched bla ma'i thugs sun yud tsam dang / /bskal par mtshams med lnga spyod mnyam par gsungasaske/ /tshul 'di shes na spang blangs byed par gces/ /gang yang bla ma bzhugs dus dgyes thabs dang ske/ /dam tshig tshul ldan chos la ma brtson na/ /'das rjes zhe 'gyod phyis song shes par gyis/ /kye ma gson dang las ngan bdag 'dra yi/ /bla ma bzhugs dus le lo snyoms las dang / /rtag snang zhen pas gshegs rjes zhe 'gyod cher/ /byung tshul brjod 'di kun gyis i go bsam/ /kwa ye gson dang bla ma mtshan ldan gyi/ /grwa 'khor byed pa'i mched grogs dang phyis tsho/ /bslab bya yin khul blun po'i 'chal tshig tshig /brjod par thugs sun mi gnang dngas blangs 'os/ /deng sang dus ngan snyigs ma lnga bdo 'dir/ /chos bzhin spyod pa ri bong rwa dang mtshungs/ /dug lnga rag cing g.yo sgyu'i las la mkhas/ /bden smra chos bzhin spyod la dad pa nyung / /des na tshogs dben grwa tshogs gang na yang / /bslab gsum ngos lkog mtshungs pa rus sbal spu/ /chos la mos pa'i gang zag dam pa yang / /de 'dra'i grogs dang 'grogs tshe spyod ngan pa/ /'go bar 'gyur bas bag yod yid bsdam zhing / /sdig can grogs po dug sbrul bzhin du spongs/ /le lo 273

rnam g.yeng can dang rgyang thag bsring / /'di snang zhen pa can dang 'grogs mi 'tshal/ /kye ho/ grogs po tsho rnams kho bor tshur gson dang / /snang ba 'di ni sgyu ma'i grong khyer 'dra/ /mi rtag chos can 'di la yi re phya/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni mtshan dpe yi/ /rab brgyan rdo rje'i sku mchog ye shes zhal/ /mtha' yas nam mkha'i mthar ni zad srid kyang / /sku yi mthar ni mdzad mi shes 'da' dka'/ /mchog kyang 'dus byas mtshan nyid bstan pa'i phyir/ /mdzad pa mtha' ma mi rtag tshul bstan te/ /bzang po mthong bskal 'dir yang sangs rgyas la/ /'khor ba 'jigs dang gser thub 'od srungs che/ /shākya thub sogs mya ngan 'das la bsam/ /de bas bsod nams mthu yi lha chen po/ /tshangs pa dbang phyug khyab 'jug brgya sbyin dang / /'khor los bsgyur rnams rang dbang ma mchis par/ /sdug bsngal che dang bcas te 'chi gyur na/ /sems can bsod nams phran bu'i chu bur lus/ /thob 'di myur ba nyid du cis mi 'jig /phyi nang gsang ba mi rtag tshul 'di 'dra/ /mthong yang mi 'jigs snying sran can re sdug /'jig rten khams 'dir rtag pa mthong thos sam/ /mi che'i yun ni skad cig yud tsam ste/ /yud tsam mi la yud tsam nyid nas ro/ /mngon sum snang ba 'dir ltos a tsa ma/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams snyigs dus 'gro ba la/ /phan gdags bla ma'i sku ru ston rnams kyang / /skye rga na dang 'chi ba'i tshul bstan bltos/ /'di snang zhen pa can rnams a tsa ma/ /kye hud deng sang grwa 'khor btsun gzugs 'ga'/ /dpon slob yin khul bla ma min na yang / /bla ma'i yon tan mi rtag skyon la rtags/ /mi gzugs bya spyod 'gran sems mnyam 'grogs byed/ /dam tshig ngos dang lkog gnyis mi mtshungs spyod/ /dad pa kha dang zhe gnyis so sor 'jolaske//mi rtag 'chi ba cha tsam mi dran par/ /'di snang yud tsam bde thabs skyid thabs dang / /kha rgyab phyi thabs khe drag sgrub pa'i thabs/ /rab 'bad bag yang mgo shor rtse rgyur 'brang / /chang la zhen cing bud med dag la gdung / /gnyid la dga' zhing ro nyal snyoms las spro/ /nyes ltung mi rtsi dkor la rngams zas byedaglu/ /chog shes med par rgyu rdzas gang 'chor byed/ kha gcig chos phyir bla ma brten khul du/ /drung du sdad kyang dam tshig mi bsrung zhing / /yon tan snying po bsgom la mi byed par/ /gyer 'chams rig gnas la gnyer re dog bsgrub/ kha gcig ngos la dad khul zhe sa 'bul/ /zhi zhi gus gus kha 'jam sding skyon bcas//dbang chos chog shes med par zhu byas te/ /lkog tu mi mos gshe 'bar dam tshig nyams/ /la la dbang gi dam tshig bsrung sdom mtshams/ /khe nyen skyon yon mi shes mtshar 'dod dang / /rtse mo'i rnam par mtshungs sems dbang lung zhu/ /phan las nyes ltung che ba'i rgyu rab bsags/ /kye hud dbang chos zhu ba grangs mang yang ske/ /dam tshig mi 'dzin lam kha'i rdo bzhin bor/ /bkur bsti zhabs tog mya ngan thang gi chab/ /dad mos ci bzhin dgun bzhug me tog 'dra/ kha gcig rang nyid rig gnas cung zad la/ /blo kha phyogs par 274

khengs shing dregs byas te/ /bla mas dbang chos bshad la blo ma rdzogs/ /byin rlabs ma zhugs nyams chags rgyur 'gro mang / kha gcig tog ge'i shes rab phran bu yi/ /bla ma'i mtshan nyid brtag pa'i khul byas teglu/ /yid gnyis the tshom mang po'i rgyar chud cing / /gshe bskur ngan brjod ngan 'gror g.yang ba mang la la bla mas rang la bdag rkyen bzang / /byas na dad pa ma byas log par smon/ /la las zhabs tog phran bu 'grub na yang / /de la ngas byas drin dang drin lan rtsod/ /la las mched grogs nang du bla ma yi/ /bdag rkyen che chung chen chun bzhin du 'dren/ /la las rang nyid che dang grags 'dod kyis/ /mtho dman dga' sdug chu tshan bzhin du khol/ /la las rang la yon tan ma mchis par/ /bla mas bdag rkyen ma byung re 'kheng byed/ /la las rang sngon bsod nams ma mchis bzhin/ /gdul bya 'dod smon che 'dod rlung ltar 'tshubasaske/ /la las bla ma'i phyag rdzas 'dod yon la/ /nyes ltung mi rtsi dud 'gro tshwa ltar rngams/ /la las g.yo sgyus bla ma'i dbu rmongs byas/ /phyag rdzas dkor la thabs kyis brung jag rgyugs/ /la la bla mas phan bya'i bslab bya la/ /log par rtogs nas 'khon du bzung bar byed/ /la las bla ma nye 'brel pha khu ru/ /mthong nas mnyam 'grogs dam dang 'gal bar byed/ /la la bla mar tshod yod brnyas chos kyis/ /thugs sun dbyungs nas ngan 'gro'i rgyu rang bsags/ /la la thog mar zhabs phyi legs bsgrub mthar/ /ma legs spyod cing dam tshig rab nyams byed/ /mdor na deng sang dus bskal ngan pa'i mthus/ /grwa sa rgan gzhon su la bltas kyang rung / /mi rtag 'chi dran dngos por zhen log dang / /chos la snying rus mthar phyin su ma mthong ske/ /pha tsho'i chis dang nye 'brel gza' tshang chis/ /'bad rtsol zang zing ched du srog blos btang / /bla ma mjal bas bud med gdong skya zhig /mthong na yid dga' 'dzum gyi bsu ba mang / /gdams zab gcig las chang phor gang 'dam zhing / /bla ma'i gsung bas khram sham tshig la rtsi/ /bde skyid byung na bla ma'i drin mi shes/ /skyid nas skyid 'dod rgyas shing rgyas par 'dod/ /'di bas lhag gcig gzhan na yod do bsam/ /dpe lung gzhan legs bsgrangs shing bla mar 'bar/ /dge sbyor bskul ma chos khrims bsgrigs pa la/ /yid mi dga' zhing de la dgra ru 'dzin/ /bla ma'i ched du dka' las cung zad cig /byung ba rkyen mi theg shing sdug bsngal gyis/ /che shos rtsi nas rtag tu yus che bsgrangs/ /rang don tshong khe mdo dbus bsgrod pa'i sar/ /tsha grangs bkres skom sdug bsngal bzod med kyi/ /gces srog chad kyang ngal med dang du blangasaglu/ /'jig rten bya bar mi tshe bskyal na yang / /da dung ngom med de la rab tu gdungs/ /dge sbyor mtshams bsgrub 'am ni bla ma yi/ /zhabs phyi zla shas tsam zhig bsgrub pa na/ /sun dub ngal snang byed cing ngas byas kyi/ /drin brtsi ngom so khyer so rgyun du byed/ /grwa sa 'ga' zhig 'phral phugs bsam pa la/ /gzhib mi shes par bag med ci dgar spyod/ /la la rgan yang bsam pa ma rdzogs par/ /byis pa'i rtse grogs legs 275

nyes mkhyen rgya dben/ /grwa sa 'ga' zhig yon tan bslab khul yang / /gnas phugs mi gnyer tshe 'di'i shes byar 'bad/ /bla mas dam chos 'chad kyang blo dred nas/ /chu nang rdo ltar sems la 'go ma thub/ /la las kha nas bshad bshad chos smra yang / /rang brgyud ma phan ne tso'i chos bshad 'dra/ /kha cig dam tshig rgyu 'bras shes bzhin du/ /bsrung sdom mi byed rdo rje dmyal ba bsgrub/ /phal cher dam tshig bsla dus bsrung zol la/ /dka' dus rgyu 'bras dam tshig rgyab du bor/ /gang ltar mi rtag 'chi ba mi dran zhing / /dge sdig rgyu 'bras skyon yon ma shes bzhin/ /dam tshig gnyan po khe nyen ma shes na/ /nyon mongs rang khar yan tshe tshul de 'dra/ /zad pa'i mtha' med brjod kyi ci phyir lang / /grwa tshang 'tshang la bdag gi rgol min yang / /skyon ma shes na yon tan bsgrub med pas/ /cung zad smras 'di brlang po'i tshig gyur nas/ /mched grogs rnams kyi thugs 'khrugs rkyen song na/ /bdag nyid rab tu gnong ngo bzod 'tshal zhing / /gang zhig chos la snying nas spyod pa rnams/ /spyod ngan de 'dra cha shas yang spang 'tshal/ /mi tshe mun par glog 'gyu 'dra ba 'diglu/ /rtag snang tshe 'di'i rnam g.yeng kho na la/ /rab 'byams phan nges bslab byar nyan mkhan dkon/ /rang sems gyong po 'di la sus ci phan/ /kye hud dus ngan snyigs ma las yang snyigs/ /'di dus bdag sogs spyod tshul 'di ltos dang / /bsam bzhin mchi ma shor ba'i rgyu las ni/ /gzhan med 'chi ba thogs bab nam 'ong ang / /chos med ban de 'chi khar 'gyod pa ni/ /mgo bo chad nas gso byed rtsal ba 'dra/ /de bas da dus long skabs sprin bar gyis/ /nyi shur tsam 'dir chos la 'bad re ran/ /kye ho grogs dag kho bor tshur gson dang / /rang gis rang nyid chos la ma bskul na/ /chos la bskul 'debs byed mkhan mi cig kyang / /'ong bar dka' 'o rang bsam theg re ran/ /de bas da dus bla ma'i drung sdod dus/ /grwa tshang rtse dga' ha bzhad ku re'i ngang / /nyin mo'i snang ba kha yengs mig yengs 'jams/ /zad med las dang mtshan mor gnyid la sred/ /dben par mtshams bsgrubs byed khul sdod na yang / /ro nyal snyoms las bag yangs ci dga'i ngang / /gnyis 'dzin 'khrul rtogs mang po rgya yan 'jam/ /don med byi ba khung du nyal 'dra zhing / /tshogs dben gang du'ang de dang de 'dra'i ngang / /mi tshe yud tsam gar song cha med par/ /dam chos thos lo bsgom lo tsam byas kyang / /don dam rgyal po'i gdan sa smon 'drar lus/ /mtshan ldan bla ma mi tshe yun brten yang / /yon tan ma gos chu dang dngul chu 'dra/ /nam zhig tshe na rang nyid thog babs su / /'chi dus bab nas blo snying 'dar ba'i tshe/ /chos la ma 'bad mi tshe stong zad du/ /song ba'i mtshang mthong 'gyod kyang ci zhig phan/ /yang na rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /re ltos yul de gshegs so 'das so zhesarka/ /mthong thos gyur tshe bden nam mi bden nam/ /a kyang mi bden mi lam o yin ang / /snyam zhing sems skyo yid phya sdug lhang lhang / /grwa tshang rnams kyang bsam pa so sor byed/ /chos bzhin spyod pa rnams 276

ni ri khrod 'grim/ /bsgom chen rnams ni 'tshams khang bzung du 'gro/ /mdo med rnams ni sa mthar mkhyar nas 'gro/ /khrel med chos dred dkor la hab sha bkyed/ /la las gos rlam la las gser la brlam//la las ja dar la las gser dngul brlam/ /la las sku gzugs la las puste brlam/ /la las grwa 'khor la las dgon gzhis brlam/ /la las mchod cha la las snod spyad brlam/ /la las sbra gur la las sge nor brlamaglu/ /mi rtag pa yi ngo sprad mngon sum shar/ /grwa tshang phal cher tshong 'dus mgron ltar gyes/ /bsgom chung gsar pa rnams ni bsgom ni yal/ /bsgom chen rtogs ldan rtogs pa'i bskul ma 'debs/ /mdor na bsam shes ldan pa'i grwa pa rnams/ /zhe 'gyod mang po'i shugs ring nar nar 'byin/ /chos 'dod rnams kyi dam chos ma zhus 'gyod/ /shes rab can gyi dri ba ma byas 'gyod/ /dbang bskur 'dod rnams phyag len ma byas 'gyod/ /man ngag 'dod kun zhal shes ma zhus 'gyod/ /bsam chung rnams ni phan gnod mi shes paraske/ /ci mi snyam pa ci dga'i ngang du spyod/ /bla ma bzhugs dus chags nyams song ba 'ga'/ /dran pas rjes sleb bshags sbyang ma 'grub 'gyod/ /la las bla ma ci gsung ma bsgrub 'gyod/ /la las 'brel med zhabs tog ma bsgrub 'gyod/ /la las bsgom la brtson pa ma byas 'gyod/ /la las yon tan bslab sbyangs ma byas 'gyod/ /la las bla mas rang la bdag rkyen bzang / /mdzad dus skyid par ma shes rab tu 'gyod/ /gang ltar log pa'i bdud ris/sa gad mo 'byin/ /dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha rnams mya ngan byed/ /zhing bcu tshang ba rnams kyi skyid glu blang / /re ltos byed pa'i bran 'khor sdug shing bsngal/ /bstan shig dgra bo rnams kyi zhal ras 'dzum/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams kyi thugs khral byed/ /rang gis phyogs la zhen kun yi mug skye/ /bla mar snying rtse byed kun mchi ma bklags/ /grwa pa dam nyams kha gcig dga' spro byed/ /nye gnas dkor zan 'ga' zhig khong rgod shor/ /chos min 'dod rnams bag yang spyod cing bde/ /phal cher dga' sdug med par btang snyoms gnas/ /de 'dra'i dus gcig nges par 'byung ba ste/ /sngon byon rig 'dzin grub thob bka' brgyud kyi/ /bla ma'i tshogs rnams gshegs bzhud ma thos sam/ /da yang nye bar mthong 'di bsam zhig 'tshal/ /de bas mched grogs grwa 'khor legs dgongs dang / /da lta bla ma sangs rgyas mjal dus 'dir/ /mi la snying yod snying la rus pa thon/ /chos la 'bad pa mdzod cig skal ldan tsho/ /e ma chos la sems pa'i mched grogs tsho/ /bslab bya'i snying po 'di dag thugs zhog dang / /deng sang bla ma bsten pa'i slob ma'am/ /nye gnas gyur gang bla mar mnyam 'grogs las/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' nyid/ /yin par shes pa'i mi ni shin tu dkon/ /la la thog mar cung zad dad na yang / /yun 'grogs cung zad rkyen gyis log lta mang / /bla mar skyon gyi cha shas ci mthong yang / /thams cad rang sems 'khrul pa'i skyon kho na/ /rab rib can gyis 'bras la skra bshad dang / /mkhris can dung la ser por 277

mthong ba bzhin/ /rang skyon 'di nyid nang nas ma dag par/ /phyi nas skyon gyi snang ba zad med 'char/ /sangs rgyas nye gnas dge slong legs skar gyis/ /shākya thub pa skyon gyi phung por mthong rang sems 'khrul pa'i skyon du gyur pa la/ /sangs rgyas dngos su mjal dang tshul de 'dra/ /des na bla mar skyon 'dug sems pa kun/ /bla mar skyon med rang sems skyon yin no/ /gang zhig bla mas bka' skyon phyag 'bebs sogs—/ /rang la gnod pa skyal ba mthong ba yang / /rang nyid las sgrib ngan pa'i skyon gyis ni/ /de ltar mdzad pa'i snang ba 'char ba yin/ /ci zhes dmyal ba'i sems can nyon mongs pas/ /kun tu bzang po gshin rje'i rgyal por mthong / /dam chos gsung ba rgob gsod dgra ru go/ /de yang rang gi sems 'khrul snang ba las/ /nges par bden na lcags bsregs su yi bzo/ /gshin rje rang yang sems can bsreg btub kyis/ /las de'i sdug bsngal me yi mi 'jigs bsam/ /de kun dmyal sems rang gi 'khrul snang yinaske/ /des na bla mas bka' skyon brdung btsog kun/ /rang las ngan pa'i snang bar ngos bzung la/ /log par mi blta sdig sgrib phyags ma ru/ /shes nas dngas bar gyis dang don chen 'grub/ /legs par soms dang 'khor ba thog med nas/ /brdeg btsog sdug bsngal skye 'chi grangs med pa/ /byas kun ngal ba don med kho na ste/ /da res thar pa'i lam ston bla ma yi/ /bdeg tshogs tshig rtsub ci dang ci mdzad pa/ /rnam kun byang chub rgyu ru nges 'gyur na/ /bya ba'i snying po don chen 'grub pa ste/ /bka' skyon brdung tshogs 'di rang bka' drin che/ /bka' skyon tshig rtsub dam chos khyad 'phags yin/ /phyag 'beb brdung btsog dbang bskur snying po yin/ /de don go nas lhag par dad gus pa/ /srid zhu gyis dang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'grub—//spyir ni mtshan ldan bla ma dam pa yis/ /grwa slob nye gnas chos la spyod bzhin du/ /skyon gyur phran bu tsam yang sun phyungs nas/ /mi gnyes tshul bstan bka' skyon mdzad yul des/ /thugs la gces shing thar pa 'grub rtags yin/ /grwa 'khor chos min spyod cing log lta can/ /dam nyams rnams la mi dgyes tshul med par/ /ngo bsrung zang zing gnang sbyin bcas byed yul/ /de ni thar pa'i lam thag yong chad de/ /ngan 'gror bsgrod cing thugs dka' mi dgyes shing / /thugs rje mi 'dzin pa yi rtags yin pas/ /'di dag gal chen gnad yin shes par gyis/ /de 'dra'i dgongs pa can gyi mdzad spyod la/ /kha cig mi mos snang ba shar ba dang / /rnal 'byor la la bdud kyis bar gcod kyis/ /sems la nga yi dad gus zhabs tog byas/ /chos bzhin 'di ltar spyod kyang mi dgyes shing / /bka' skyon brdung thag spyod pa'i 'di 'dra bskyed/ /khong tshos dam 'gal chos min spyod na yang / /dgyes 'dug snyam nas log lta skye ba'am/ /yang na bdag la zas gos mi ster zhing / /gzhan la 'phang med 'di 'dra byin snyam 'khrugs/ /la la gzhan la gdams ngag zas ster 'dug /nga la ma ster snyam nas nyams chags bsags/ /de dang de 'dra chags sdang snang ba'i tshogs/ /278

gang shar bdud kyis byin gyis brlab pa ste/ /de skyon nges bzung rnal 'byor rab rnams kyis/ /chags sdang gzhi med rtsa bral lam du khyer/ /'bring gi bla ma rang rig dbyer med bsre/ /ting 'dzin gyi dbang blangs bshags pa bya/ /tha mas bla mar dngos su 'gyod bshags phul/ /zhe bcad dam bca' drag pos bsrung sdom bya/ /de ltar byas pas nyams chags sor chud cing / /bdud kyang kha skyengs bar chad brtsams mi nus/ /bla ma'i thugs dgyes rang gi mchog mthun thob/ /gces pa'i bslab bya yin no yid la bzung / /kye ma ho/ dal 'byor snying po len pa dam chos yin/ /dam chos rtsa ba dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob byed gsang sngags chos/ /de ston rtsa ba'i bla ma rab gnyan pas/ /dam tshig bsrung mtshams khe nyen dug sbrul mgo'i/ /nor bu bzhin du phung 'tsheng gnyis 'grub pas/ /bag yod dran pas dus rtag zin bzhin du/ /dam tshig srog pas lhag mdzod snying gtam yin/ /bla ma'i mtshan nyid thog mar brtags pa la/ /dbang chos zhus rjes rtag par mi rung ste/ /bzang rung ngan rung lha'am bdud kyang rung ske/ /ci mdzad dag snang sbyong zhig snying gtam yin/ /bla ma'i mdzad pa 'phrin las bzhi'i rjes 'gros/ /zhe sdang 'dod chags gti mug dug lnga'i tshul/ /spyod kun log par mi blta rgyal ba yi/ /mdzad par blta bar bya'o snying gtam yin/ /ci zhes zhe sdang tshul gyis srog bcad kyang / /shākya thub pa rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i dus/ /dur khrod gnas su gshin rje gshed chen por/ /bskur bstan bdud sde phye mar gzhom byas shing ske/ /de bzhin 'dod chags gdung ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /bde mchog 'khor lo sdom pa dgyes rdo rje/ /gsang ba 'dus pa dus kyi 'khor lo dang / /rta mchog yang phur he ru ka yi tshogs/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs bcas dus rtag par/ /lhan skyes gsang ba'i yum 'brel med par/ /rdo rje pad+ma zung sbyor 'khril snyoms ltos/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi mdzad pa de 'dra dang / /bla ma'i mdzad pa mtshungs par shes bgyis shig /gzhan yang rgya gar rig 'dzin chen po brgyad/ /grub chen brgyad cu sogs dang bod yul du/ /rje 'bang nyer lnga sprul pa'i gter ston dang / /mar rngog sa ngor kam 'brug 'bri stag gis/ /skyes bu mchog rnams bde chen skyed pa yi/ /gsang ba'i yum la dgyes bzhin brten nas ni/ /dga' ba bcu drug ro la myong ba dang ske/ /grub thob birlu pa dang sha wa ri/ /byā li pa dang rgyal ba zhang sogs kyis/ /bya dang ri dwags srog chags ling byed cing / /zhe sdang drag po'i tshul gyi g.yul 'khrugs mdzad/ /de bzhin lā wa pa sogs grub chen 'ga'/ /lo zla zhag dus mang por thun gcig dang / /gnyid cing rtag tu gnyid la brtson pa sogs/ /rigs grub rnams kyi mdzad spyod dpag dka' dang / /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas na ye shes kyi/ /mkha' 'gros chang 'tshong tshos 'tshong smad 'tshong ma/ /shan pa rdol pa rgas khog mi sdug par/ /sprul nas gdul byar phan gdags du ma sogs/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi mdzad spyod sna tshogs pa/ /mtha' yas rol pa du mar 'char 279

ba nyid/ /tshad bzung las 'das spyod pa'i rnam grangs kyis/ /'gro rnams don mdzad thos shing shes byas teske/ /des na rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma yi/ /mi dgye'i rnam pa ci dang ci mdzad kyang / /'khrul pa mi mnga' nyes pa'i skyon bral bas/ /dad gus mos pa rab tu brtan par byos/ /de ltar dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma yi/ /sku gsung thugs spyod dge dang mi dge'i las/ /thams cad rgyal ba'i mdzad par dngas blangs shing / /chos nas chos bzhin spyod mdzad snying gtam ste/ kha cig bla ma grub thob mdzad spyod rjes/ /dpag nas nyon mongs bag yangs spyod pa la/ /slob bu blo chung zhugs par mi bya ste/ /mi dge'i spyod pa cha shas spang yang 'tshal / /ci zhes rma byas btsan du dug za ba la/ /dpag nas khu tas btsan dug zos na 'chi/ /de bzhin gsang sngags lta spyod dgongs pa'i phug /ma lon bag med sprod pa 'chal nyog la/ /gsang sngags spyod par rlom zhing khas che na/ /mtshams med lnga la bskal par spyod pa yi/ /sdig pas 'di che rdo rje dmyal ba ru/ /ltung bar nges pas rab tu mdzes par gyis/ /ka ye/ legs par gson dang deng dus grogs po tsho/ /chos la bsam nas btsun pa'i gral zhugs shing glu/ /gdams ngag bsam nas bla ma brten pa kun/ /bslab bya'i gtso bo 'di ko yid bzung 'tshal/ /rang re mi tshe sprin bar nyi shur tsam/ /skad cig tsam du bde 'dir ma zhen par/ /gtan bde'i zhing du thar 'dod brtson pa che/ /rab bskyed lus ngag dge ba'i las la 'khol/ /snang ba sgyu ma'i ltas mor a ma thas/ /mi rtag 'chi ba snying nas dran par gyis/ /ngan song gnas gsum sdug bsngal dpag dka' zhing / /tshe yi tshed kyang bgrang bar nus min gyi/ /da res mtho ris gnas su yud tsam zhig /phyin kyang slad mar de ru 'khor ba'i rgyu/ /de bas da lta thar pa chen po'i sar/ /'khod thabs myur du bsgrub pa'i dus la bab de ring sang nyin mi 'chi'i gdeng med pas/ /dge ba'i las la da lta nyid gyis shig /mkhar zhing bang mdzod nor phyug nye 'brel yang / /'chi dus shul lus rang nyid gcig pur 'gro/ /rang gi dge sdig ci byas rang la smin/ /grogs med pha rol 'gro nges 'di la bsam/ /de na dus der phan thabs zab mo zhig /sgrub pa'i dus ni da lta yin nges so/ /phan thabs rgyal bas gsung pa grangs mang don/ /bsdu na spyod pa sdom pa rnam pa gsum/ /bsgom pa'i gtso bo lam 'bras phyag chen dang / /lta ba'i gtso mo dbu ma rdzogs pa che/ /de la spyod pa sdom pa rnam gsum yang / /'dul ba dang bstun so sor thar pa yang / /rtsa ba mi dge bcu spang dge bcu bsgrub/ /yang snying rtsa bzhir chang lnga spang ba gtso/ /rtsa ba srog bcad spang nas zhi dul spyod/ /rtsa ba ma byin len spang bag yod spyod/ /rtsa ba bud med spyad spang khrel yod spyod/ /rtsa ba rdzun smra spang nas drang por brjod / /chang ni rgyal bas yang yang bkag pa la/ /shes byas ha la'i dug ltar spang ba gces/ /'di dag ma spangs nyes ltung spang phan yon/ /bka' bstan ltas nas spangs blang nan tan spyod/ /theg chen rtsa ba byang 280

sems bslab spyod kyang / /rtsa ba tshad med bzhi dang phyin drug bsgrub/ /yang snying byams pa snying rjes gzhan phan bsgrub/ /de yang gzhan la 'di phyi bde thabs nyid/ /gsang sngags rtsa ba dam tshig spyod pa yang rtsa ba sku gsung thugs gsang nyid bsrung 'du/ /yang snying lha bsnyen bla ma dgyes thabs yin/ /de yang rdo rje slob dpon gsung bsgrub gtso/ /des na thog mar bla ma gus pas bsten/ /bar du ci gsungs bka' bzhin gus pas bsgrub/ /mtha' ru dam sel med par nyams len dril/ /ri khrod dben pa bsten 'tshal snying gros la/ /da dung gal che gnad gyur 'di skad smra/ /snying rjes kun blang rgyal bstan phan pa las/ /gzhan srog 'tshe ba spang ba rab tu gces/ /ngan sngags bsgrub par mi 'tshal snying gros yin/ /bstan pa'i zhabs tog gzhan phan dge bslab chen/ /'grub na ma rtogs ma byin len spang gces/ /rgyal bka'i gnang ngam gdung brgyud 'dzin ched dam/ /rtsa rlung grogs las mi gtsang spyod spang gces/ /'gro phan don chen bsgrub dang gsang spyod ched/ /ma gtog rdzun tshig mi smra shin tu gces/ /rtsa bzhi chang lnga mdo sngags thun mong du/ /rab sdom mdzad de 'di nyid yel dor na/ /chos pa yin zhes ming gi tsam zhig phan/ /dper na sdong po bcad pa'i yal ga'am/ /sa bon bsreg pa'i snye ma dag dang mtshungs/ kha cig lta ba rtogs tshe rgyu 'bras la//rtsing spyod chog ces bdud kyis tshig smra ste/ /lta ba rtogs tshe rgyu 'bras rtsing chog na/ /shāka thub spyod lam gsungs dang bcas pa yi/ /rgyu 'bras kho nar phra zhib mdzad pas na/ /shāka thub lta ba ma mthong smra lags sam—/ /de bas smra cor rmu ba snying re rje/ /sngags nas dug lnga mi spang gsungs ba yang / /snying rjes zhe sdang zhen bral 'dod chags dang / /'od gsal gti mug byar med nga rgyal dang / /rang grol phrag dog dug lnga ye shes lngar/ /shar ba'i phyir las nyon mongs rang ga ma/ /spyod ces rgyud sde gang na'ang gsungs pa med/ /chang yang rten 'brel rdzas dang bag yod du/ /rten las chang 'thung ra ro 'khrul snang ba/ 'byams par gyis zhes rgyud lung gang na'ang med/ /rang gi nyon mongs mgo ma non pa la/ /sngags spyod kha g.yar 'dul khrims rtsam med dor/ /lta ba rtogs pa'i gdeng dang mi ldan par/ /bag med chol nyog ngang du rtsing spyod dang ske/ /tho co glang po'i bya ba byed pa ni/ /'di dag gsang sngags bstan la dma' byed las/ /sngags don cung zad tsam yang ma go 'khrul/ /'on kyang rgyal ba'i sprul pa sna tshogs spyod/ /tshul gyi 'gro ba 'dul byed yod srid pas/ /de dag rnams la skyon brjod ma lags shing / /de bas tshul ngan 'di 'dra spang 'tshal gnadaske/ /gzhan yang deng dus mthu rdzas sngags kyi ni/ /mi srog bcad la nyes pa med smra thos/ /de ni rgyu 'bras ma go 'khrul tshab che/ /ci zhes shākya'i rigs la sangs rgyas des/ /sdig pa bgyis dang yid rang byas pa gnyis/ /nyes pa mnyam zhes gsungs na rang nyid kyis/ /lus ngag sems kyi 'bad de sbyor ba'i las/ /281

nyes pa'i rnam par smin pa cis mi 'byung / /pad+ma skyes des sngags pas mthu bsgrub shing / /bsgrub khang gos gon mthu rdzas bsogs gsungs dang / /rgyal bas gdug byams rtsa ltung bcur gsungs rnams/ /sangs rgyas bstan dang nyes med sems can la/ /'tshe bar byed pa bsgral nas bstan pa mchog /gnyen phyir byed las rang 'dod rung ma gsungs/ /spyir yang zhing bcu bsgral bar gsung pa yang / /las ngan de dag mtshams med rnam smin gyi/ /dge zad thar pa'i dpyang thag chad pa la/ /mngon spyod mthu yi myur du bsgral byas te/ /thar pa byang chub sa bon gzhag gnas ni/ /dag pa'i zhing du grangs pa'i dgongs pa yin/ /de bas rang dang rtsa ba'i bla ma'i skur/ /'tshe na ma gtogs ngan sngags nus pa'i mthus/ /gzhan srog mi gcod kho bos snying gros 'debs/ /'di yang gal che gnad yin thugs bzhag 'tshal/ /mdor na dge sgrub sdig spong rgyu 'bras gzhib/ /kun gyi rtsa ba rang sems gyong po btul/ /zhi dul bzod ldan bya spyod rab brtson par/ /ngos lkog med par mtshungs pa spyod pa'i gtso/ /bsgom pa'i gtso bo lam 'bras phyag chen yang ske/ /mtshan bcas sgom pa lam 'bras thabs kyi gnad/ /ye shes dhu ti rlung sems gnyis med du/ /rab chug thig le zag bral dbyings thim zhing / /mtshan bral bsgoms pa phyag rgya chen po ni/ /gnas lugs gnyug ma brjod mtshan spros tshogs la/ /rab 'das ngo bor cir snang chos sku'i lam/ /ma g.yeng mi sgom nyams len rtsa ba yin/ /blta ba'i gtso bo dbu ma rdzogs chen yang / /mtha' bral dbu ma nyid du 'ang mi dmigs pa/ /gcig dang tha dad yid blo'i spros zhi ba/ /chos nyid skye 'gag zab bral rgya che mchog /rdzogs chen ka dag blo 'das chos sku'i thugs/ /mngon sum nyid myong gsang las ches gsang ba/ /khregs chod thod rgal rang byung rig pa'i don/ /brda' dag zung 'jug rtsol bral nyams len gtso/ /mdor na chos tshig dpe la ma lus par/ /rang rig don la nyams myong kho thag gnad/ /ched na 'di phyi bar do gsum gang rung / /grol ba'i gdeng yod chug dang de rang chog /lta sgom spyod gsum gzhi lam 'bras bu sogs/ /mang mang bshad kun tshig yin ma 'byams par/ /bla ma mtshan ldan zhal gdams rang nyid kyi/ /snying bur brtson bskyed bsgom zhes snying gtam ste/ /kye ma/ deng sang dus ngan snyigs ma'i dus/ /bdag gi de skad smra bas ci zhig phan/ /sngon byon da ltar bzhugs par gyur pa yi/ /skyes mchog mi yi sangs rgyas dngos byon dus/ /gyur pa rnams kyi gdul byar phan pa'i phyir/ /gsung mgur zhal gdams drang nges gdams pa che/ /du ma gsung yang de la ci lta btso/ /spyod pa nyin skar dang mtshungs de bas kyang / /rgyal gsung 'ga' zhig bra phyi'i tshangs stan du/ /rtsis med dor gyur 'di 'dra kye ma hud/ /de bas sprang ban dmu to bdag 'dra bas/ /phan 'dod bslab bya yin khul brjod pa ni/ /don med thang steng khyi zag cir mi yong / /lar yang thar pa dge ba'i chos ci yin/ /282

bshad las tshong khe g.yo sgyu zol zog tshig /gus par nyan 'dir bsam shing yi re mug /de bas chos bzhin spyod 'dod mched grogs tsho/ /bag med 'khrul pa'i tshig rjes mi 'breng bar/ /bden smrar gus nyan rnam par dge ba la/ /'bad par 'tshal zhes bdag gi gros chen de/ /de skad da lta'i dus dang phyis 'byung gisaske/ /bla ma'i nye gnas grwa 'khor gyur rnams la/ /skyo bas bskyed de nges par 'byung ba'i gtam/ /cha shas tsam zhig skabs 'dir smra byed 'di/ /bden par brjod la rtsub mo'i tshig kyang med/ /dge bar bskul las 'khrul pa'i gtam yang min/ /des na tshig don legs par bsam gzhib ste/ /'chi dran chos 'bad bla ma mnyes bgyid 'tshal/ /zhes pa zhar byung tshigs su gleng byas te/ /da ni gang phros blun rgan bdag spyad tshulaglu/ /cung zad tsam zhig slar yang smra byed na/ /bcu drug lo 'jug rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /gshegs pa'i rkyen dang phyi nang gsang ba'i tshul/ /du mas yid skyo yid bsun rab byung phyir/ /khyad par bsam blo nyin mtshan kha sbyor yang / /dal 'byor mi lus rnyed dka' da res tsam/ /thob dus 'di ru kha gting med pa yisaglu/ /chos cig byas nas gtan bde'i mdun ma zhig /'grub ma thub na phyi ma ci lta bu/ /'gyur pa cha med mun khung mda' dang 'dra/ /des na mi tshe skad cig yud tsam der/ /thabs mkhas 'jig rten chos brgyad dang bstun nas/ /dgon gnas mgo 'dzin bla ma'i ming bzung ste/ /rang mgo g.yog na phral du skyid gyur kyang ske/ /lo brgya thog gcig zad la shor ba yin/ /phyi ma ngan 'gror sdug bsngal bzod med par/ /myong bar gyur na yud tsam bde skyid kyi/ /ci phan bde bas chos la gnas dgos nges/ /chos kyang drang nges bye brag shin tu mang / /drang don mtshan nyid theg pa bzang na yang / /grangs med mang por tshogs bsags sgrib sbyongs nas/ /byang chub sgrub 'di ha cang rgyang thag ring / /nges pa'i don 'gyur sngags kyi theg pa yang / /phyi rgyud bya spyod rnal 'byor spros bcas kyi/ /bskyed bzlas ting 'dzin rim pa legs na yang / /skye ba grangs chen byang chub snying po 'gyangs/ /nang rgyud ma hā a nu bskyed rdzogs chos/ /rdo rje gsum sbyangs rtsa rlung thig le'i gnad/ /brdzun par byed 'di ngo mtshar che na yang / /blos byas sgrib dang ma bral cung zad bul/ /des na tshe gcig sangs rgyas rdo rje snying / /rdzogs chen sems sde phyag rgya chen po'i don/ /rdzogs chen klong sde 'od gsal ye shes gshis/ /rdzogs chen man ngag khreg chod ka dag che/ /yang gsang bla med thod rgal mngon sum du/ /snang ba blo 'das kun bzang thugs kyi snying / /theg dgu'i rtse mo de la rab zhugs nas/ /'di phyi bar do grol bar thob phyir las/ /kun rdzob chos gyur phyi yi rig pa'i gnas/ /sgra snyan mngon brjod zlos gar sdeb sbyor dang / /sman rtsis 'khyug dpyad mo spra rdzas sngags mthu/ /gzo dang mtshan nyid rig pa la sogs kun/ /da lta yud tsam mkhas grags mdzes na yang / /nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus la bab pa'i tshe/ /shes byar gyur pa de dag gang gis yang / /bde 'gro mtho ris thob nus 'ga' zhig las/ /rang sems 'khrul pa 283

sangs bar mi nus kyi/ /byang chub chen po'i go 'phang 'god nus min/ /de bas shes bya'i yon tan rig gnas la/ /gnyer ba'i don med ji bzhin byang chub kyi/ /nyams len snying po nang gi rig pa'i gnas/ /gcig shes kun grol gnad de bsgom gdung yang / /de ston bla ma mtshan ldan ma 'phrad na/ /ci ltar byas kyang thar lam mi zin pas/ /des na deng sang dus kyi snyigs ma 'dir/ /mtshan ldan bla ma mchog gyur phal cher gshegs/ /zhal bzhugs la la sa thag rgyang pa'i stabs/ /rang nyid lus zung ma rdzosas phyin ma nus/ /la la sku bsgres mya ngan 'da' nye bas/ /chos kyang thob dka' gdams pa rdzogs mi nus/ /la la kham che chos kyang zhib mi thob/ /la la khrid lung rtsom gyur blo ma khengs/ /la la bla ma ngo bo bzang na yang / /sku na ma smin bslab sbyongs rtsal ma rdzogs/ /'ga' zhig lta dgong che ba'i snyan grags kyang / /legs brtag tshe na byis pa'i 'ja' mtshon mthong / /'ga' zhig rtogs ldan nyams khrid btsun khul yang / /gtan la phabs tshe khungs med blun bsgom mang / /la la bshad rgyu'i tshig la mkhas na yang / /don dang ma 'brel nad la sman bshad 'dra/ /la la nyams myong don la mkhas grags kyang / /rnam rtog ma bral bya shog ya bral 'dra/ /mdor na rang nyid mthong thos shes rab chung / /lkog gyur mngon par shes pa ma thob phyir/ /bla ma gang bsten bsam nas sems mnga' zhing / /rang dbang chos la ma thob sdug bsngal myong / /chos phyir phyogs med rgyal khams 'grims 'dod kyang / /nye 'brel bla slob grwa 'khor rnams gshol ngos/ /bzlog par ma nus ci byas thabs med du/ /gyur na re zhig 'bri 'jags sa phyogs der/ /'dug pas rim gnyis rnam g.yeng lta bu'i bdud/ /'dod yon gdul bya je las je cher 'phel/ /mi tshe lo grangs zhag re bzhin du zadaske/ /chos la brtson 'grus sang byed snang byed lus/ /chags 'dzin sdang 'khrugs zhen pa je cher song /rnam g.yeng mi chos rim gyi yar yar 'phel/ /'khrul pa'i rtog tshogs bu yug ltar du 'tshub/ /sems la 'dod smon mang po rlung ltar ldang / /de dang de 'dra'i 'khrul snang rab 'byams nas/ /mi rtag 'chi ba de yang skabs re brjod/ /dad pa dag snang de yang rims kyi dred/ /nyams myong bsgom pa de yang phar phar yalaske/ /skabs rer ri khrod brten par 'dod na yang / /rang dbang mi thob mi khoms las la 'byams grwa 'khor yon bdag bla slob phal che bas/ /rang don mi dgos khyod kyis sngon dus grub/ /da res sprul sku 'gro don phyir du yin/ /'gro don bor nas rang nyid zhi bde de/ /theg dman nyan rang lam du mi gol lam/ /de bas 'gro don gyis zhes bskul 'debs shing / /kun gyi rang la bstod snyan tshig bzang pos/ /rang nyid glo bo dga' bar byed gyur nas/ /de 'dra'i skabs su rang yang bdud kyis byin/ /rang nyid spang rtogs yon tan med bzhin du/ /rang mthong nga rgyal bsam pa snying nas shar/ /tshul 'dir bsam zhing deng sang rang nyid bred/ /skabs re rang gi bsam gzhig btang ba'i tshe/ /rgyang pa'i sa ni kho tshos bshol btab cing / / 284

'di ru 'dug tshe mi khom brel bas g.yeng / /da ni chos med mi tshe stong zad du/ /nam 'chi a snyam rang gros 'di skad btab/ /kye ma/ gson 'tshal tshe dbang nor bu ba/ /sgyu ma'i ltad mor byis pa zhen zhen nas/ /mtha' med g.yeng 'khyams snga ma de tsam yin/ /da dung rang gros rang la btab re ran/ /'chi bdag bdud po zhes pa sgra bo che/ /ston bzhugs lhag pa bzhin du tshur tshur nye/ /'chi la na tshod rgan gzhon ci yang med/ /nam 'chi cha med lha chos sgrubs re ran/ /gal te mi tshe ring yang gzhon dus su/ /dam pa'i chos zhig snying nas ma 'bad na/ /nad sor gyur tsher 'byung ba'i tshogs rgud cing / /sems 'thib dbang po nyams tshe chos dran yang / /bsgom pa'i long med nyams len rtsal rdzogs dka'/ /de bas ding dus chos la 'bad re ran/ /kye ma/byas pa don med mgo 'khor smyon pa'i las/ /bag chags 'khrul zhen snga ma de tsam yin/ /da ni 'khrul med byang chub bsgrub 'dod na/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma bsten pa dang / /spros med dben pa'i ri khrod 'grims pa'i phyir/ /pha yul bdud kyis btson ra spangs re ran/ /g.ya' ri gangs khrod mi med lung stong du/ /bya dang ri dwags bag yangs rgyu ba'i sa/ /lhung lhung chu sgra 'jam par 'bab pa'i ngogasaske/ /rang bzhin shugs kyis bsam gtan 'phel ba'i sar/ /grogs med gcig pur da dung rgyu re ran / /dgra med gnyen med chags sdang zhen pa med/ /phan med gnod med re dang dogs pa med/ /'khrul med 'dzin med gnas lugs snying po'i don/ /mngon rtogs rang gzhan don gnyis myur 'grub phyir/ /phyogs med yangs pa'i rgyal khams 'grims nas ni/ /dam pa mchog gyur brten pa'i dus la babs/ /'phral snang legs legs bslu brid bdud kyi las/ /rang don ma 'grub shi gson dkor la 'bag /mi chos bla gzugs mi gtsang dar stum 'dra/ /mi rtag 'dus byas lus 'di bor tsam na/ /dkar nag las 'bras bslu med 'char ba'i tshe/ /kye hud bla gzugs khyod la mgon su zhig /de bas deng dus thar lam snyeg re ran/ /ces sogs skyo bas glu dbyangs mang blang nas/ /rang la rang gi chos phyir bskul na yang / /re zhig mi chos bla ma'i gzugs bzung mthus/ /bla ma bsten dang dben pa 'grim pa'i thab/ /ma snyed le lo btang snyoms ngang du ni/ /rang lo nyer gnyis nye la sleb kyi bar/ /skabs su bsod snyoms bla ma'i zhabs tog byas/ /skabs su grong chog yon bdag ngo lon byas/ /skabs su yul sde mi sde 'khrugs pa bsdum/ /skabs su yi dam bsnyen bsgrub nyung re byas/ /skabs su 'gro don yin khul khrid chos bshad/ /bde sdug myong ba phal cher ro snyoms bsgom/ /spyod pa bla ma dkon mchog dgyes thabs dang / /zas nor rnams la sred zhen chung bar bslab/ /su 'brel rnam dkar la sbyor gang nus dang / /g.yo sgyu zol zog rang 'dod nyung bar bslab/ /khe drag phrag dog gyur pa spangs thabs dang / /chos kyi spyod pa ci 'dres byas na'ang / /285

sngon tshe 'khrul pa'i bag chags ngan goms dang / /chos nyid don la bstan pa ma thob phyir/ /phyi tshul ltar snang bla gzugs bzung na'ang / /rang skyon rang gi brtag tshe rang nyid kyis/ /shes rgyud gyong po dug lnga shugs kyi rag /des na spyod pa dge sdig dkar nag chos/ /'dres ma chal chol ma nges ngang du song / /de 'dras mtshan ldan bla ma ma mjal zhing / /dbang khrid chos kyang nyung las ma thob ste/ /sdug bsngal mtshan mo'i gnyid kyang phal cher yangs/ /rang lo nyer gsum sne la zin pa'i tshe/ /dgos med snying nas shar te glu 'di blangs/ /e ma ho/ legs par som dang tshe dbang nor bu ba/ /dal 'byor bco brgyad brgyan pa'i mi lus 'di—/ /yang yang thob dka' bskal ba da res tsam/ /don med gser gling stong log cang srid dam/ /mi tshe 'di ni yud tsam nyid yin te/ /lus ni mi rtags khang rgan 'gyel nyen 'dra/ /ngag ni mi rtag tshong 'dus sgra snyan 'dra/ /sems ni mi rtag nam mkha'i sprin dang 'dra/ /nam 'chi cha med 'di snang bya ba 'di/ /dgos pa med do zhen pa btang re ran/ /bca' bca' bkod bkod dgon gnas gdan sa yang / /ston 'jug me tog byis pa rlom pa 'dra/ /rang nyid 'chi tshe dgon gnas shul du lus/ /byas pa'i snying po sgyu ma'i ltad mo 'dra/ /de bas dben gnas 'du 'dzi nyung ba'i sar/ /gtan gyi 'dun ma lha chos sgrub re ran/ /mdzes mdzes sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams kyang / /ha cang sred na chags sdang 'ching zhen rgyu/ /'chi dus de dag dgos med shul du lus/ /yud tsam snang zhen byis pa 'ja' 'ded 'dra/ /des na zang zing rten gyi dgos pa ci/ /gtan gyi snying po dam chos bsgrub re ran/ /brtse brtse dung dung pha ma nye 'brel yang / /'chi dus bab tshe brtse bas bshol du med/ /tshong 'dus mgron ltar so sor phye nas 'gro/ /de bas gtan grogs bla ma bsten re ran/ /grwa 'khor zang zing mi chos mdzes na yang / /thar pa'i grogs min chags sdang 'khrul ba'i rgyuske/ /'gro don dus min rnam g.yeng lha bu'i bdud/ /ring du spangs nas lha chos dril re ran/ /blo thag rang gi rang nyid ma bcad na/ /thar pa'i grogs byed nyin mo'i skar ma tsam/ /chos kyi phyi bshol byed pa rab tu mang glu/ /de bas bsam 'di deng dus bsgrub dus bab/ /ces smras rtsem chen dgon nas bla rgan la/ /bka' zhus rig 'dzin rol pa rdo rje mchog /zhal mjal 'dun pas glo bur nyid chas nas/ /ba zal phyin tshe mchog sprul bla ma rjes/ /bshol mthus re zhig mtshams sdad de skabs su/ /rig 'dzin chen po zhi bar mya ngan 'das/ /thos nas sdug bsngal bsam mi khyab byung zhing / /ci kyang rang yul sdod 'dod ma shar nas/ /dbyar dus bab tshe grogs po gnyis khrid de/ /rig 'dzin de yi rtsa ba'i bla ma ru/ /gyur cig chos bdag rnams kyi gtso bo mchog /che tshang zhes grags mkhas shing grub de'i drung / /song ste de sngon ngo shes med yul du/ /byes 'gro byed ma myong zhing dkon mchog gi /thugs rjes dka' tshegs med par sku mdun sleb/ /286

grogs gnyis phyir log rang nyid gcig bu ru/ /zla ngo gsum 'dug gnas lugs thugs kyi mdzod/ /phyag chen snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu'i khrid/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang la rgyas par thob/ /de zhar karma si tu chos 'byung ba'i/ /zhal mjal chos 'brel rang byung smon lam nos/ /rig 'dzin chen po'i rigs gcung chos kyi sras/ /zhal tshab rung nges o rgyan mtshan 'chang drung / /gter gsar phyag rdor them chen them med dang / /mkha' 'gro seng gdong sgrub bskor yongs rdzogs thog /gar dbang sprul sku la yang dbang 'brel nos/ /de nas slar yang rang gi pha yul nas/ /zhang po shi ba'i skad ma sleb pa dang / /grwa pa 'brug grags de kar bdag gi sar/ /sdod ma 'dod nas bla ma rnam gnyis kyis/ /shog ces nan chags gsung 'phreng yod rdzus nas/ /rang yul log nas ba zal dgon phyin pas/ /tshad rims nad kyi rang nyid 'chir thug tshe/ /nad nyid ro snyoms bsre la e nus tshad/ /de tshe zug gzer de yang stong lhang nge / /ngo bo'i gshis la nad dang ma nad zhes/ /tha snyad tshig dang mtshan ma las 'das dang / /rang mdangs rten 'brel 'byung bzhi 'khrugs pa yi/ /zug gzer 'gag med bkra dngas khyug se rgyugs/ /na zhes kun rtag zug gzer drag po dang / /rang rig ngo bo brjen ne gzo med gnyis/ /lhan skyes mnyam nyid tha dad blo yi ni/ /ma snyog ngang du gang shar skye 'gag las/ /'das gyur mtha' bral gnyug ma'i chos nyid la/ /mnyam bzhag rang 'bab klong skyong gang nus bya/ /zla gcig tsam song nad de las thar de/ /de 'phral bla ma snyun pa'i zhabs phyi bsgrub/ /bsnyen grol tshe na bdag nyid rtsem chen du/ /bsu ba ye shes blo gros dpon slob rnams/ /phebs byung de dus bla ma pad dbang gi/ /gnal gyi snang bar rnga yab dpal ri yi/ /pho brang bkod pa rig 'dzin gtso 'khor bcas/ /ya mtshan snang ba gsal bar gyur pa dang / /lung bstan rjes gnang 'ga' re byung bar 'dug /gzhan yang dag snang 'ga' re shar bar mngon/ /de nas rtsem du 'gro zhor pe'u lung phyinaske/ /'di skabs nye gnas bar chad dbang song nas/ /glo bun yid dkrug sems mi bde ba byung / /las dbang 'khrul snang 'di la yid re skyo/ /myur du rtsem chen bla ma'i sku zhabs sleb/ /spro ba'i dri med dgyes pa'i spyan ras 'dzum/ /de yid dbyar dngos nag pa zla ba la/ /rgyal ba'i sras gyur dharmā pā la dang / /sprul sku pad+ma dz+nyā na sa sikhyi/ /o rgyan karma dhi ra dha ra dang / /bla ma dam pa pra ni dha na dang / /rang slob snga shos dharmā dha ra ṇi/ /yongs dril bla slob bdun bcu lhag tsam la/ /gsang las ches gsang bla med rdzogs pa che'i//khrid btab 'di bas sngon du kho bo yi/ /khrid bka' lan grangs 'ga' re byas na yang / /rten 'brel gnad kyi 'di dus gang 'dzems pa'i/ /tshom bu de rnams dam sel ma byung na/ /nges par thar pa'i lam rkang tshugs go sems/ /rang yang 'di skabs rmi lam snang ba ru/ /kun bzang bi ma'i thugs sprul kun mkhyen zhabs/ /mjal nas snying tig bskor bzhi'i bka' gtad dang / /rdzogs chen gdams pa gzhan la 287

ston rjes gnang / /sngags kyi ma mos srung skyob zhal bzhes byung / /rang gi nyams len 'di dus sngar bas bog /rab thon the tshom khu khrig dang bral te/ /rig pa rang ngor zang ka rjen pa mthong / /sngon tshe 'khrul snang tshor dang ma tshor nas/ /dam tshig 'gal nyams gyur pa bshags pa'i phyir/ /sāts+tsha 'dod gsol ldan pa grangs ldan dang / /khyad par rten gsum drung du dus chen sogs/ /phyag dang smre bshags phul zhing phyin chad du/ /sdom pa'i phyir du dam bca' bcu gsum blang / /de nas bzung ste zang zing bsdu byed la/ /'gro don ming btags grong 'byams zob tshong ste/ /gtan nas spang pa'i nus pa ma rnyed kyang / /'phral du chog med bsod snyoms 'bul bsdud dang / /grong chog gdan 'dren bya ba phal cher bor/ /gar phyin 'gro ba rang 'dod med khul gyis/ /dbang chos phran bshad dge ba'i las la bskul/ /skabs su khrid gdams bstan nas 'gro phan dang / /skabs su bstan don drag sngags kha yar bsgrub/ /skabs su yi dam lha yi bsnyen bsgrub dang / /skabs su rang nyams bog 'don gang nus byas/ /mdor na rnam dkar las la rgyal ba yi/ /gsung pa'i spyod par rang gi lus ngag yid/ /gang nus la yang 'bad pa'i khul du byas/ /de skabs yul de'i 'gro ba kha cig ni/ /gus shing dad dung bdag la thal sbyar zhing / /kha cig mi mos gshe bkur sna tshogs dang / /mi ngan 'di nyid ma shi ang zer thos/ /la las 'dre 'di yul 'dir med na zer/ /de dang de 'dra 'khor ba'i snang ba ni/ /sgyu ma lta bu ci yang 'char ba'i rgyu/ /zhen med chos nyid 'od gsal dag pa'i klong / /lam du 'khyer mdzod rang gi rang la gdams/ /de nas mdzes byed chu yos dbyar ra ba/ /dus chen sa gar rig 'dzin chen po'i gdung / /hril por mchod rten sgrom du zhugs pa de/ /zhugs la zhen pa'i rdo rje slob dpon ni/ /pad dbang gis mdzad rgyal theb bdag gis byas/ /thun mong thun min ya mtshan ltas bzang pos/ /skal ldan thams cad rab dga' sa la bkod/ /de rjes bdag nyid mtshams su sdad byas skabs/ /kaḥ thog rdo rje gdan gyi chos kyi rje/ /rgyal dbang bsod nams lde'u btsan mtshan 'chang de/ /sa ga'i tshes lngar dgongs pa dbyings thim pa'i/ /skad thos pa yi sems bsngal rab g.yos shing / /'phral der kaḥ thog gnyer pa rta mgrin zhes/ /dgongs rdzogs mchod bsngo ched du byung ba las/ /sprul sku 'byung 'gyur smon lam bris te bskur/ /de nas rang sems sngar nas pha yul la/ /yid sun bzhin du lhag par bla ma rnams/ /gshegs 'gyur rkyen des re zhig phyogs med du/ /gnas bskor rten mjal bla ma rten pa'i phyiraglu/ /'gro ba'i blo thag snying gi dkyil nas bcad/ /spyir yang rang don ma grub 'gro don 'dis/ /be'u m+bil g.yang du lhung dang ci zhig khyad/ /de bas rang don ci bzhin skyong dgos sems/ /ci zhes 'gro don dus la babs ma babs/ /tshad ni rang don zad dang ma zad yin/ /rang don nges par zad tshe 'gro don du / /babs pas gzhan don ske rags bcing dus yin/ /de bas bdag ni rang 'dod ma zad las/ /rang 288

don snang ba gzhan las che zhing 'khregs/ /de tshe 'gro don ming btags 'ar 'ur ni/ /'khrul la 'khrul snon ngan 'gro'i rgyur bsags nges/ /'di ni kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin te/ /snying khung rus pa'i gting nas min re kan/ /deng sang kha cig phyi tshul btsun khul la/ /rang nyid sangs rgyas dngos 'drar rlom pa mang / /phyi la ma blta nang gi mtshan nyid brtag /rang sems rang ltos rang mtshang phud par gces/ /yang cig deng sang bdag 'dra'i ser gzugs 'ga'/ /sbyangs pa sngon song da lta mi dgos skad/ /de lta na yang bskal bzang sangs rgyas des/ /bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags shing / /grangs med gsum du sgrib pa sbyangs byas las/ /skye ba gcig gis dge bas ngom ma gsungs/ /mthar yang gzigs stangs lnga yi 'dzam gling 'dir/ /gling bzhi 'khor los bsgyur rigs go tam gdungs/ /zas gtsang sras 'khrungs rgyal bu don grub des/ /khyim med rab byung na ra dza ta'i 'gram/ /lo drug dka' ba spyad nas sangs rgyas thobaske/ /des na sangs rgyas las lhag rang cag min/ /tshe 'dir dge sgrub sdig spangs dam chos la 'bad pa nan du bya 'tshal gros chen gdab/ /da dung gson dang rdzogs chen thos grol la/ /sbyangs bsgrod mi dgos zer ba 'ga' yang thos/ /de ltar thos grol bka' drin gyis bskyangs kyang / /rdzogs chen ston pa dga' rab rdo rje zhes/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rig 'dzin tshul snang de/ /ri bo snang byed bya bar lo mang por /ting 'dzin don la mnyam par bzhag zhes pa/ /rdzogs chen bla med lo rgyus rnams nas gsungs/ /de bzhin 'jig rten 'di na 'gran bral ba/ /mtsho skyes bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen yang / /gsang sngags sgrub dang nyams len dka' spyad tshul/ /dpag med rdo rjes lces kyang brjod nus min/ /gzhan yang rgya bod rig 'dzin grub chen dgu'i/ /bsgrub la dka' spyad snying rus mdzad tshul dang / /so zur sems sde'i bla rgyud snub dang dam gtsang byams pa 'bum/ / klong sde'i bla brgyud rtsang rgan mi pham myang ston sha ba can/ /myang ban lce btsun man ngag snying thig bla brgyud kun mkhyen mchog sogs pas/ /chos la nyams len dka' spyad tshul dpag med/ /rgyal ba gong ma skyes chen de tsho yi/ /rdzogs chen yin no thos chog yin no zhes/ /bag med ro nyal ngang du 'ja' lus skur/ /gshegs pa min pas tshul 'di shes bgyid 'tshal/ kha cig rdzogs chen sa lam rtsi ba med/ /gcig chod yin zhes smra ba 'ga' thos te/ /der rten kha cig yid mi rang ba dang / kha cig gnas lugs som yor lus pa mthong / /de ltar gyur na bla med khreg chod dang / /don mthun rdzogs chen sems sder nyams rim bzhi/ /gnas dang mi g.yo mnyam nyid lhun grub zhes/ /re re la yang g.yo gom brtan thob pa/ /sbyangs khams dbang gi gsum gsum dbye bar mdzad/ /'di dang phyag chen rnal 'byor bzhi rims rnams/ /mthun sbyor kaḥ thog dam pa yab sras dang / /mkhas grub mang pos mdzad pa'i gzhung mang yod/ /de bzhin thod rgal snang ba bzhi zhes pa/ /mngon sum snang ba mthong lam don mthun dang / / 289

gong 'phel sgom lam tshad phebs bla med lam/ /zad pa chos zad mya ngan 'das pa ste/ /de dag re re la yang rim gyi dbang / /snang ba mched dang nyer mched thob nyer thob/ /bzhi bzhir dbye ba bcu drug sa ru gsungasaske/ /theg pa chung ngu'i sa lam phra zhib che/ /de bas gcig char zhes grags skyes bu ni/ /ngo sprod rtogs dang rtsal rdzogs dus mnyam pas/ /gcig chod grangs med sa lam med pa min/ /de ṭa gsar rnying yongs la re 'ga' tsam/ /des na kha 'byams lta gdengs mi 'tshal bar/ /yang dag gnas lugs nges pa'i sgro 'dogs chod/ /'on kyang rdzogs chen thos pa'i phan yon ni/ /bsam mi khyab par rgyal bas bsngags na yang ske//ma bsgom phyi bshol sangs rgyas rgyang thag ring / /ci skad chos rje yang dgon sa chen pos/ /gang zag rang nyid rdzogs chen ma gyur pas/ /dam chos rdzogs chen gyur kyang ci zhig phan/ /gsungs pa'i don de yid la 'chang byed nas/ /rdzogs chen thos chog go yul ma bzhag par/ /nyams len gnad phur tshe gcig kun bzang gi /dgongs pa mngon gyur sku gsum lhun grub mdzod/ /de bas dam chos gzhan las ches 'phags kyang / /rang gi nyams len dag gis ma pher na/ /glen mos sgyed po gser du btsug pa dang / /dbul po'i khyim du nor gter med dang mtshungs/ /ka ye da dung deng sang 'di skad do/ kha cig zab gdams phyag rgya chen po'i skor/ /zhugs lo thos lo tsam byas zhag zla tsam/ /song tshe bdag ni rtse gcig spros bral dang / /ro gcig sgom med yin khas blangs 'ga' mthong / /he te bla mar dad gus gsol 'debs dang ske/ /bsgom la snying rus zhag gcig mi dgos par/ /de 'dra'i ngang du rtogs ldan yongs tshod na/ /nga 'dra'i le lo can tsho skyid re bro/ /a kyang sngon byon rgyal ba'i mdzad spyod la/ /dpag na slob dpon 'jam dpal gshin rje gyi/ /sprul pa gung thang mi la ras pa de/ /lo grangs bzhi bcur bla ma'i zhabs tog byas/ /brag dkar rta sor mi lo bcu gsum bar/ /grogs med dka' thub bsgrub la snying rus gton/ /gzhan yang bsgrub gnas du mar dka' spyad mthar/ /dgung lo re gcig chu pho la lar dgung snying lcags 'brug tu gsungs pa ltar na don gsum yin/ 'brug gi lor/ /mgrin pa'i rtsa mdud zhig nas ro gcig rtogs/ /brgyad cu rtsa bzhi mya ngan 'da' ba'i dus/ /ro gcig che yin lhag ma'i rnal 'byor rnams/ /mngon dga'i gnas su sbyangs ba yin no zhes/ /rgyal ba yang dgon dpa' bo gtsug lag dang / /stag lung bkra shis dpal grub rnams kyi gsungs/ /yang cig mnyam med dwags po lha rje zhes/ /sngon dus byang chub sems dpa' zla 'od zhal/ /da lta a shā ka zhes zhing khams su/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas gyur dri ma med pa'i 'od/ /gyur pa des kyang bsgom med chen mo ru/ /zhal bzhes res gnang res mi snang ba ru/ /mdzad ces si tu mchog gi sprul pa'i sku/ /kun mkhyen chos kyi 'byung des bdag la gsungs/ /gzhan yang de slob dus mkhyen phag gru dang / /'bri 'brug g.yam stag smar 'tshal grags pa yi/ /rgyal ba gong mar gyur tshe zhen log dang / /mos 290

gus dka' spyad snying rus mdzad nas ni/ /phyag rgya chen po rtogs par gsung pa las/ /bla mar dad dam gus gsol mi dgos par/ /chos la thos chog ro nyal bag med dang / /phyag chen rtog go grol lo ye ma gsungs—/ /des na sngon byon skyes mchog de dag las/ /lhag zhes khas len nus pa ding yod dam/ /de dag drang don brda' chos yin no skad/ /rgyal bas drang don gdul bya drang phyir yin/ /rang re rgyal ba de dag gdul bya ru/ /yin na de yi rjes slob cis mi dgos/ /da dung kha cig lta dgong mtho drag na/ /sa lam dman la cha rgyus med do skad/ /ha ha tshig 'di mkhas gyur gyis gsan na/ /thugs nas khrel rgod rgyur rkyen cis mi 'gyur/ /lhun po kha nas gling bzhir ltad mo dang / /ri chen rtse nas ri phran ltad mo ru/ /mngon 'dir bltos la smra ba de gyis shig /kun bzang rdor 'chang shāka thub pad 'byung sogs/ /sa lam dman la phra zhib gsungs 'dir spyod/ /rgya gar sa ra ha dang te lo pa/ /bod du gling ras rang byung mkha' spyod sogasaske/ /gcig car skyes bu mchog gyur de tsho yi/ /lta ba mtho drag sa lam dman pa la/ /cha rgyus med ces gtan nas gsungs pa med/ /des na tshig 'di mkhas pas spang bar 'os/ /yang gcig deng sang phyogs rer zhen pa 'ga'i/ /rgyal ba gong ma'i dka' spyad de 'dra yin/ /rtogs tshul de 'dra gyur tshe deng dus kyis / /rtogs pa skye zhes smra 'di mi bden par/ /gzung dang kha gcig las 'phro ldan pa yi/ /skyes bu mchog gyur rnams kyang tshe 'di la/ /brtson 'grus dka' spyad ma byas rtogs pa ni/ /mi shar zhes pa'i kha tshon gcod pa yi/ /spobs pa skye bar gyur pa mang mthong ste/ /de la blun po kho bos sems pa ni/ /tshe 'dir mi rtogs phyi mar rtogs dgos na/ /theg pa thun mong rnams dang ci khyad cing / /gsang sngags tshe gcig nye lam don dang 'gal/ /des na tshe 'dir mi rtog smra mi 'os/ /rgyal ba rgyal sras mdzad pa dpag dka' ba/ /rgyal ba nyid min gzhan gyi rtogs ma gsungs/ /de tshe gang zag mchog tu gyur pa yi/ /dka' spyad snying rus kho nar rag ma lus/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa mtha' gcig mi bkag ste/ /snang mdzad sku tshe grangs las 'das pa dang / /tshogs chen gtso bo sku tshe nyin gcig tshad/ /shāka thub dka' ba lo drug bar du spyad/ /byams pas dka' spyad med par rdzogs 'tshang rgya/ /de dag tshul don rgyal bas gzhan gyis min/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa de ste rgyal ba'i sras/ /skyes bu rnams tshul de dang mi 'dra zhes/ /tha na rgya bod rig 'dzin grub thob ni/ /gcig char rtogs grol gyur pa grangs med yod/ /mnyam med 'tsho byed kho na'i drung du yang ske//mjal ba'i lam dang sgam po'i ri mthong dang / /gzims spyil mthong dang zhal mjal tshig re yis//spros bral ro gcig sgom med skyes pa mang / /de 'drar mnyam med mchog de'i zhal nas kyang / /rna ba sngon yod pa las rwa rjes skyes/ /mthong ba'i dpe bzhin bka' brgyud snga ma yi/ /dka' spyad lta bu ma dgos deng dus su/ /bdag gi slob ma rtogs pa rtogs 'gyogs pa/ /yin zhes rdo rje'i gsung gi bsgrags pa dang / / 291

gling ras phag grur zhag gsum khrid bskyangs pas/ /sgom med skyes dang rgyal sras spom brag pa/ /dgung lo gsum nas rang byung sgom med skyes/ /rgod ras khrid bskyangs zhag bdun spros bral rtogs/ /yang dgon dgung lo bdun la spros bral rtogs/ /grub thob o rgyan pa yi rgod tshang gi/ /gzim lcil mthong ma thag tu spros bral rtogs/ /chu phur shāka rin dgung lo gsum dus nas/ /spros dang bral ba'i rtosag pa shar ro skad//de bzhin gsar ma'i skyes chen du ma dang / /rnying ma'i gter grub gyur pa mang po zhig /spros bral ro cig sgom med gcig char du/ /shar ba'i lo rgyus ya mtshan rnams la gzigs/ /des na gang zag mchog tu gyur pa zhig /spros bral ro gcig sgom med rtogs pa la/ /dka' spyad sdug rtsir blun las mi 'dug zhes/ /sgro bkur rgyu 'di spang bar 'os sam snyam/ /khyad par snyigs ma lnga mthar thug dus 'dir/ /'dul bstan gzugs brnyan tsam yin mkhas la grags/ /theg chen mar me 'chi kha ltar gsal dang / /khyad par rdzogs chen kun bzang thugs kyi 'dul/ /dus yin zhes su snying thig nas gsungs pas/ /snyigs dus rtogs pa mi skye khas len 'di/ /rang nyid ngal ba'i rgyu ru 'gyur ram sems / /gzhan yang mdo khams kaḥ thog mi ring bar/ /gnas gyur gang zag khas len kha cig gis/ /yab sras sprul sku yin zhes chen po yi/ /go sar phyung nas zhugs gyur 'di 'dra dang / /gter ston yin no de sras yin no zhes/ /grags dang stag bur bla ma'i ming 'dzin 'ga'i/ /chos khrid bshad 'di thos dang bsam tsam gyis/ /don dang mi ldan ci phyir rang cag ltar/ /bsgom la tshe 'dir sbyangs yun ma nus shing / /thos bsam sgom dang rgyab gyes yin no zhes/ /smra ba'i snying khams bskyed pa 'ga' thos te/ /de ltar thos na rgya bod rig grub tshod/ /lnga rig la byang skyed rdzogs rtogs 'bras bu/ /tshe 'dir 'od phung yal ba grangs med cing / /pad 'byung klu grub rnam par thar la gzigs/ /shes rab can bsgom khyung chen sa chod dang / /shes rab med bsgom byi'u chung rtsal rlabs tu//rgyal bas gsungs te sgom pa'i sngon 'gro ni/ /thos bsam yin no thugs la dgongs 'tshal lo/ /dmar nag zhwa sogs mchog gi sprul sku rnams/ /skyes ma thag nas nyams rtogs shar ba las/ /rtsal rdzogs mngon mkhyen grub rtags ston la ltos/ /gter ston nyi shar dbyugs pas mi khebs kyi/ /stag bur blun rgan bla gzugs bdag tsam las/ /gzhan kun 'od gsal rdzogs chen snying po yi/ /don gyi rang gzhan ma bslus gding la 'khod/ /thos bsam gsang sngags snying bstan rtsa lag tu/ /gyur la gshe yang dgongs pa ci dgyes mdzod/ /spyir yang mi shes skye bo'i tshogs rnams la/ /mkhas pas brtag min rang bzhin btang snyoms so/ /kwa ye/ so so skye gyur mi shes blun bdag gi /chos kyi mtshan nyid rtogs pa'i mig zum yang / /rgyal ba gong ma'i gsung gi rjes 'brangs te/ /cha shas smras 'di snying gtam yin khul te/ /mdor na rtogs pa 292

shar ro mi shar zhes/ /'di dag thams cad tha snyad tshig yin gyi/ /tha snyad tshig kun phyi yi shun sar mthong //gsang sngags chos ni byin rlabs lam sa yin/ /byin rlabs mos gus lam yin don des na/ /ma nor ma 'khrul yang dag bla ma la/ /slad med chugs med gdams pa legs nos nas/ /gsol 'debs snying khung gting nas phar btab na/ /byin rlabs dbang med snying dkyil 'char nas 'ong / /bla mar snying nas dad mos ma skyes na/ kha tsam gsol 'debs don med ca co yin/ /yang dag rtogs pa rgyal po'i khrir smon 'dra//bka' ba spyad dang ma spyad zhes pa dang / /sngon sbyangs yod med smra ba thang chad rgyu/ /tshig rjes ma 'brangs gnas lugs don la soms/ /dad mos gus pa chos kyi rtsa ba yin/ /byams dang snying rje chos kyi gzhi ma yin / /rgyu 'bras dam tshig chos kyi srog shing yin/ /phyir mi ldog pa chos kyi skyel so yin/ /rtogs pa'i ngo bo rig pa gnyug ma yi/ /shes par rang ngo rang gi shes pa ste/ /de ni bla ma'i thugs rjes dag la rten/ /mthong 'di dpe bral ye shes chen por grags/ /rtogs dang mi rtogs blo yi ltos gzhi 'di/ /nges don snying po sgrib pa'i dri ma yin/ /des na rtogs cug ma rtogs na yang chug /rang rig ma bcos zang kha rjen pa la/ /spang blangs re dogs dgag bsgrub las 'das par/ /ma g.yeng rgyun spyod gdams pa'i snying po yin/ kha la bshad pa dpe yi mtshon pa dang / /blo yi dpyad dang yin min khu 'khrig dang / /grub mtha'i tha snyad tshigs su gyur pa kun/ /yang dag rtogs pa'i tshe na rdzun po che/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs snying la zhugs pa'i mi rang sems rang gi mthong ba'i rnal 'byor la/ /chos nyid bden mthong zhes pa'i sgra bo che/ /pha rgan bka' brgyud gong ma'i gshegs shul te/ /ring po'i bar min rang sems drung na yod/ /yun du 'gor min skad cig bsgrod lam yin/ /de ltar ma rtogs byis pa'i tshogs 'ga' yi/ /rgyal ba gong mas dbang rim gdul bya'i don/ /dka' ba spyad dang dka' ba mi dpyad tshul/ /drang don gtso dang nges don gtsor ston tshul/ /mdzad pa du ma brgyad khri bzhi stong sgo/ /bcu gnyis yan lag rgyu 'bras theg che chung / /dgongs dang ldem po ma sbas chos nyid don/ /dpag par dka' de rgyal dang de sras kyi/ /legs mdzad tha dpog skye mtha' byang chub shing / /drung du rgyal de las ni nam mkha'i mthas/ /snyegs mi de sras gyur pa phal gyi'ang min/ /des na gang zag chos kyi tshul gyur pa/ /mtha' der 'thas nas rta ljang dbyug 'gegs bzhin/ /chos spang las gyur ngan 'gro'i rgyu lci bar/ /'gyur la rtag tu kun gyi spang bar bya/ /yang dag don la sgyu ma'i rtsed mo bzhinaske//sus bkag sus sgrub mnyam nyid don la ltos/ /kye ma/ bdag 'dra ser gzugs mkhas min blun las kyang / /ches blun rkang gnyis lus la rkang bzhi'i sems/ /gyur pa kho bos phyi nang gzhan gsum dang / /drang nges chos tshul dbye nus ma lags kyang / /deng sang dus dbang phyogs 'dir bdag mtshungs ris/ /'ga' yi rmu cor tshig gi skye bo'i tshogs/ /rnam 293

rtog du ma slong ba'i rgyur mthong ste/ /de dag las ngan 'dzad nus bdag med kyang / /mtha' rer 'dzin pa'i zhags pa bgrol 'dod nas/ /gang shar blun tshig glu ru blangs pa 'di/ /thos bsam bsgom pa'i yon tan cher dben kyang / /bla ma'i byin rlabs mthu las cha shas tsam/ /thos myong las byung tshigs su smras pa yin—/ /bre mo 'khyal tshig brjod pa min khul te/ /mkhas mgu sdeb sbyor blun mgu'i ngo 'jam med/ /don med rdzun tshig brlangs po'i tshig kyang med/ /des na rnal 'byor nyams len spangs ljang la/ /legs bshad chu klung me tog sna tshogs bkra/ /don gyis ma rgyu cha shas mchis srid na/ /blo ldan ra yig gnyis pa'i dga' ston mdzod/ /kye ma ho/ grogs tsho da dung bdag la tshur gson dang / /deng sang dus bskal snyigs ma'i mtha' la thug /tshe yang sum bcu kha ral nyid gyur 'dir/ /nam 'chi cha med tshe tshad nges bzung med/ /myur ba nyid du 'chi bar the mi tshom/ /de bas bdag ni nyi shu rtsa grangs zin/ /tshe yi tshad kyang 'khyol la nye ba ste/ kha chems yin no snying gtam tshig 'di smra/ /thun mong dal ba khyad par 'byor pa bcu/ /gsang sngags nges pa'i don dang 'phrad pa'i lus/ /'di 'dra bskal pa grangs med bsam yas las/ /da res tsam yin chud zos btang phod dam/ /dmyal ba'i sems can rnams ni mthong gyur tshe/ /yi dwags byol song lus gyur srid pa tsam/ /byol song kha 'thor lha ma'i gnas su ste/ /der bltas mi lus srid tsam 'di la bsam/ /dbyar dus sha yi phung po sa gzhi'i khyon/ /khengs pa ma lus 'bu yi rang bzhin gyis/ /sa gzhi khengs gyur bar ma de'i sems can/ /gyur pa de yang nyung du nyid yin la/ /de la dpag tshe mi lus srid pa tsam/ /u dum wa ra'i me tog lta bur mthong / /mi lus tsam gyur 'gro ba 'dir ltos dang / /dam chos dar sar skyes gyur srid pa tsam/ /dam chos dar sar skyes kyang chos kyi sgor/ /zhugs par gyur pa nyin mo'i skar ma tsam/ /chos sgor zhugs kyang chos bzhin spyod pa ni/ /rus sbal spu ltar dkon gyur kye ma hud/ /tshe 'dir sgyu ma'i 'khrul snang nyid la 'byams/ /rnyed dka' mi lus don med chud zos btang / /phyi ma gar skye'i cha ni ma mchis te/ /mun khung long ba'i mda' ltar ya re cha/ /kye ma snying ldan grogs tsho 'dir dgongs dang / /ngan song gnas kyi sdug bsngal skad cig yang / /mi la brgya stong phye ba du ma la/ /mi tshe bde ba ring yang lo brgya steske/ /de yang mi skyol glo bur du mas 'jig /de bas gtan gyi lam bzang theg pa che/ /byang chub mchog gi go 'phangs 'khod 'dod kun/ /tshe 'dir chos la snying rus byed re ran/ /deng sang dus ngan snyigs pa tshe thung 'dir/ /thos bsam mang po byed pa'i long merdo kyi/ /yang dag snying po phyag rdzogs nyams len la/ /dril bar mdzod cig kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir mtshan ldan bla ma dkon/ /'dra min bzang ngan brdar sha legs gcod la/ /gcig chog rgyal po mtshan ldan rnyed dus der/ /le lo med 294

par chos mdzod snying gtam yin/ /'khrul med gter lung dgong mas zin pa dang / /rtsod bral grub brnyed dam pas thag gcod pa'i/ /skyes bu rnams kyi mdzad spyod ci 'dra yang / /brtag dpyad med par chos mdzad snying gtam yin/ /gang yang rang gis dbang chos ma 'brel sngon/ /shes rab ldan pas brtag dpyad byed pa las/ /dbang gdams 'brel nas lha bdud su yin chug /the tshom mi 'tshal mos mdzod snying gtam yin/ /spyir yang gsang sngags gegs kun the tshom yin/ /brtag dpyad mang po ngan 'gro'i rgyu ru 'gyur/ /tshad ma'i khung ldan mngon shes med phyin chad/ /brtag dpyad ma mang kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /spyir ni rnam dpyad mthong rgya che ba las/ /blun po dad pa brtan na dngos grub myur/ /gsungs pas dag snang phyogs med sbyongs ba dang / /thag chod chos gcig chog mdzod snying gtam yin/ /grwa 'khor mched gyur nang du sdod pa'i tshe/ /mtho dman nga rgyal phrag dog kun spangs la/ /zhi dul 'jam ldan kun dang mthun byed mkhas/ /nyon mongs las bsags mi rung snying gtam yin/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i sde snod mang po yang / /mdor bsdus bdag 'dzin 'khrul pa zhig thabs yin/ /de don chos kun gtso bo phyag rdzogs te/ /nyams len gnad du phur cig snying gtam yin/ /zang zing bsags nas 'dus byas dge ba cheske//spyod pa phal cher dge don sdig bsags mang / /de bas rgyal dgongs dges pa bsgrub pas bsgrubs/ /zag bral dge sgrub mchog yin snying gtam yin/ /'jig rten thabs mkhas mi chos rnam dpyod dang / /mdzes btsun tshigs bcas snyan grags bskyed pa 'di/ /'phral legs nam phug don med las ngal yin/ /snyoms chung bag yod spyod mdzod snying gtam yin/ /brtsod pa can gyi gnas dgon brten pa dang / /khe grags che ba'i grong du bsdad pa 'di/ /nyon mongs shugs kyi 'phel byed sa bon te/ /ring du spangs bar mdzod cig snying gtam yin/ /mig ser can gyi grogs dang 'grogs pa dang / /rgyud ngan mi la grogs po byed pa 'di/ /chags sdang zhar du 'phel ba'i rgyu yin pas/ /ring du sring byas legs so snying gtam yin/ /'du 'dzi zang zing zas gos mang po yi/ /grwa 'khor bsdud 'di bstan pa yin sems yang / /snyigs dus chos bzhin ldan pa rab dkon zhing / /rang don bar chad rgyur 'gyur snying gtam yin/ /yul sde 'khrugs bsdum kha mkhas phyag yangs shing / /kun gyis bskur byed rang mthong bcas pa 'di/ /'phral du yin yin 'dra ba'i bla gzugs te/ /nam phug dgos chung dben brten snying gtam yin/ /sha chang longs spyod 'du long spel ba 'di/ /mi tshe yud tsam mchin pa skyid lags kyang / /nam phug dkor gyi rnam smin rang nyid la/ /lci nges bag med spangs 'tshal snying gtam yin/ /ltar snang mdzes pa'i mnga' ris 'khor 'bangs 'di/ /'jig rten snang bar mi kha chod na yang / /snying po med cing chos min 'phel ba'i rgyu/ /chos bzhin ri la spyod legs snying gtam yin/ /phan par re nas rang gi zas gos kyi/ /bskyang pa'i grogs 'ga' thar ni 295

dgrar gyur mang / /de bas grogs la re dogs chags sdang spangs/ /gang byung chog shes mdzod cig snying gtam yin/ /rang gi blo gtad khel sems byas na yang / /snying gros bris nas mis kyang blo brku bas/ /dus ngan 'di 'drar sus kyang blo khel dka'/ /blo gtad dkon mchog gsum mdzod snying gtam yin/ /yin min mkhas dang gros gzhib legs na yang / /snyigs dus mi rnams khrel med g.yo sgyu mkhas/ /rang gi brtag dpyad yin nges gding tshod tshe/ /rang thag rang gis chod 'tshal snying gtam yin/ /khung med mi la 'dun gros byed pa dang / kha mang mi la gsang gros bshad pa ni/ /tha ma brjod ngan 'byung ba'i gzhi ma yin//ngag la bag dang ldan 'tshal snying gtam yin/ /rgyud ngan mi la che bkur byed pa dang / /mdo med mi la gnyer kha gtad pa 'di/ /tha ma 'thab 'khon khro 'khrugs rgyu ru 'gyur/ /de 'dra rang sar 'jog legs snying gtam yin/ /sems ngan mi la phan cher btags pa dang / /log lta che la nye gnas bcol ba yis/ /mthar ni sgro bkur ngan pa'i rgyur 'gyur bas/ /thabs kyi bskyangs legs kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /'dod po che la las sgo gnyer gtad dang / /khog chung mi la gtam bshad bcol ba ni/ /tha ma zhe sun zer ra'i rgyu rkyen yin//btang snyoms bzhag mdzod kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /gzhung ngan mi la bzang len re ba dang //khrel med mi la blo gtad byas pa ni/ /don med rang yid chad pa'i rgyu ru 'gyur/ /phan gnod ma re bab zhog snying gtam yin/ /dge med mi la rgyu 'bras bsrung re dang / /dred med chos med dam tshig bsrung re ni//rang sems rang gis ngal ba'i las su che/ /ring du spang ba kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /ngo 'jo can gyis chos byed brjod pa dang / /chags sred can gyis blos gtang yin zer 'di/ /rang tshang rang gis ston pa'i rgyu rkyen yin/ /de 'dra'i tshogs rjes ma 'brang snying gtam yin/ /bla mar gus med gdams ngag la gdung dang //brtson 'grus mi ldan chos la sred pa ni/ /mthar ni chos kyi rkang 'dren gzhi yin pas/ /ngo bsrungs zas tshig kyis bskyangs snying gtam yin/ /las med re ba chen po byed pa dang / /mgu khang rags pa'i rigs su gyur pa de/ /ring par btang snyoms ngang du ma bzhag na/ /dpon slob sems sun gzhi yin snying gtam yin//dam tshig ngos lkog byed pa'i las ngan dang / /dkor sreg skog lab mkhas pa'i mi ngan 'di//rgyang grags bcu yi pha rol ma bskrad na/ /grogs kun spyod ngan de 'go snying gtam yin/ /grwa tshang nang sel phra ma mkhan po dang / /za 'dod 'gul tsher ro nyal dga' ba dang / /khong khros gzhan gyis sems rgyud sad byed rnams/ /nang 'khrugs rgyu yin spang mdzod snying gtam yin/ /don med smra ba mang po byed pa dang / /drang po'i tshig la lan med smra sgo dog/ /'di dag sems dkrug bskyed pa'i rgyu yin pas/ /lhod bzhag ngang bor legs so snying gtam yin/ /rang don tshad la ma rdzogs gdul bya che/ /zang zing snyan grags 'ar 'ur lta bu'i bdud/ /rang nyid 'khor bar skyur ba'i zhags pa yin/ /rang don dben pa 296

'grims shig snying gtam yin/ /chos nyid don gyi bzod pa ma thob par/ /grogs 'khor mang po'i nang du 'dug pa 'di/ /khro 'khrugs chags sdang mang po bskyed rgyu ste/ /ri khrod 'grims legs kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /sems dang mi mthun grogs dang nan che bas/ /'grogs kyang blo mi bde ba'i rgyu yin gyi/ /gcig pur gnas na rang blo bde ba'i rgyu/ /chos min grogs spangs legs so snying gtam yin/ /rang 'dod zhe yi phug tu 'chang ba yi/ /phyi thag med pa'i 'dza' bo bsten pa 'di/ /'dod don rlung gis khyer ba'i rgyu rkyen yinaglu//rang tshugs zin par gyis shig snying gtam yin/ /yon bdag ngo bsrung mi chos btsun po 'di/ /rang sems rang gis 'ching ba'i zhags pa yin/ /rang babs chos mthun spyod pa ma gtogs pa/ /ngo 'dzin che gnyer mi byed snying gtam yin/ /'jig rten las kun snying po ma mchis te/ /legs par ltar snang nyes pa'i rgyu bskyed pas/ /'di snang bya ba shugs kyis rgyang bsrings nas/ /thar pa mchog lam zhugs mdzod snying gtam yin/ /'bad pas brtsams pa'i zang zing mchod sbyin dang / /sems skyed ma zin 'dus byas dge 'ga' yang / /thabs kyi ma spyad chags sdang bskyed rgyu ste/ /rang bab spyod mdzod kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /snying ring grogs dang chos la blo dred dang / /zur za phyin ci log blo gsal ba dang / /'grogs na las ngan rgyu bsags gzhi yin pas/ /de 'dra 'brel thag bcad legs snying gtam yin/ /dam la mi gnas blo dred byed mkhan dang / /tshod yod brnyas bcos ngan 'khregs grogs po de/ /nyon mongs zhar bsags ngan song gting rdo yin/ /gtan nas spang mdzod kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /zhen med zang zing tshogs bsags gzhi yin kyang / /ha cang mdo na dgra bo mang ba'i rgyu/ /rngam sems che na rang srog skyel ba'i gzhi/ /zhen pa chung mdzod kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /zas nor tshong skyes rgya dbus mdo bsgrod 'di/ /'phral du mnga' thang bde skyid yin khul la/ /nam phug cha med sbrang ma'i rtsi dang 'dra/ /chog shes ldan par mdzod cig snying gtam yin/ /dgra btul gnyen skyong rang rgyal gzhan 'pham las/ /brtson 'di phral du mi kha chod 'dra yang / /rang sems gze re re dogs sdug bsngal gzhi/ /thar pa'i gegs che spang mdzod snying gtam yin/ /lha mchod rten gzhengs khrom tshogs bsdu ba 'di/ /'brel tshad rnam dkar don ldan mthu med na/ /las 'di phal cher 'khor ba'i rgyur 'gyur mthong / /de bas spros med dge 'dril snying gtam yin/ /'di snang yud tsam bde bde skyid skyid kyi/ /bya ba 'di yis gtan chis bslu nges pas/ /srog 'tsho tsam gyi zas dang lhag skyobs kyi/ /gos tsam ma gtogs bde skyid ched gnyer spangs/ /'chi dus phan nges dgongs 'tshal snying gtam yin/ /tshe 'di'i snyan pa skad cig brag cha 'dra/ /mngon mtho'i stobs 'byor ston bzhugs lho sprin 'dra/ /'phral snang mig mdzes 'ja' yi ltad mo 'dra/ /mi rtag som dang chos ran snying gtam yin/ /'khor ba'i las la zin pa'i mtha' yang med/ /ma shi'i bar du brel ba sangs dus med/ dam 297

chos gal byung ngang du lus pa 'di/ /kye hud da lta chos kyis snying gtam yin/ /da dung gson dang 'di skad smra/ /deng sang gangs ri'i ljongs 'di'i tshul/ /du ma ldan kun sangs rgyas bstan pa las/ /phyi rol pa yi chos lugs cher ma mchis/ /des na 'gro ba dbang khams ci snyed pa/ /'dul phyir theg pa'i rnam grangs mang por sprul/ /kun kyang byang chub snying por sbyor byed de/ /spang blang ma byed dag snang phyogs med gces//khyad par rdzogs pa'i rim pa cher grags pa/ /byang chub sems mchog la bkod blo sbyangs dang / /mtha' bral dmigs med zab mo dbu ma'i gzhung / /sngags lam gsang ba rim lnga'i gdams pa che ma ya dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor rnam pa gsum/ /dgyes rdor rdzogs rim nā ro ni gu yi/ /chos drug bir wa'i bzhed pa lam 'bras dang / /dang po'i sangs rgyas dus 'khor rdzogs rim du/ /sangs rgyas pa la mngon sbyor sbyor drug dang / /sdug bsngal zhi bar byed pa'i zhi byed dang / /'khrul snang bdag 'dzin gzhig byed spyod yul dang / /mnyam nyid gnyug ma'i ngo bo phyag rgya che/ /thams cad rdzogs gyur 'gran bral rdzogs chen ste/ /de kun gzhi mthun byang chub sems bskyed yin/ /de kun lam mthun tshogs bsags sgrib sbyang yin/ /man ngag gnad mthun dad mos gus pa yin/ /bsrung bya mdo 'dus sdom dang dam tshig yin/ /spyod pa don mthun rgyu 'bras blang dor yin/ /'bras bu mthar gcig mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas yin/ /lta ba mi mnyam ngo gdang rtsal gyi khyad/ /bsgom tshul mi gcig thun mong khyad dang mchog /gyur pas lam la nye ring du mar snang —/ /kun gyi yang rtse phyag rdzogs nyid yin la/ /de yang phyag rgya chen po zhes grags ni/ /ngo bo spang blangs slo mtshan spros pa'i tshogs/ /yongs bral gnyug ma lhan skyes ye shes khams/ /yid la mi byed chos nyid rnal ma nyid/ /lam du byed pa phyag chen rtsa ba yin/ /de nyid 'byung gnas 'gro ba'i gzhi rtsa gcod/ /gzhi med rtsa bral snang ba rang gi sems/ /sems nyid stong pa stong nyid zung 'jug dang / /rnam kun mchog ldan gdod nas dag pa cher/ /go dang myong ba rtogs dang mngon du gyur/ /mtha' ru phyin pa'i dbang du byas nas ni/ /bsam gyis mi khyab gsang ba'i rgyud don dang / /bstun nas sa lam tshod 'dzin rnal 'byor bzhir/ /rgya bod rigs grub 'ga' yi bkral ba dang / /khyad par yongs su grags che dwags po rje'i/ /khyad chos nyid du snang ba de nyid las/ /de rjes zhugs gyur grub gnas gsal mdzad de/ /de la dbye lugs bag gcig ma 'dra ste/ /phag tshal kam 'brug 'bri stag so so la/ /kun kyang don mthun babs pa gcig lags kyang / /deng sang ma rtogs rtogs dang ma grub grub/ /tshul 'ga'i rang rang rtogs nyams dang mthun par/ /yin skad mnyam med rnal 'byor don la sgrib/ /'on kyang spang blangs shan 'byed bdag 'dras min/ /rang gis ma rtogs gzhan la ci zhig smra/ /de yang rgyal gong rdor gsung sor bzhag ste/ /bsam bzang gzhan phan srid mnyam 'di skad brjod/ /de yang spangs rtogs mchog ldan bla ma yi/ /rgyud pa byin ldan dam sel dri 298

med pa'i/ /mtshan ldan bla ma yang dag mchog gi drung / /'khor bar yid sun byang chub snying po la/ /gus ldan slob ma mtshan nyid ldan pa yi/ /tshe 'di'i rnam g.yeng rgyab tu dor byas te/ /chos la chig dril gdams par nges shes bskyed/ /bsgrub la brtson 'grus snying rus ngar 'don zhing / /yon tan che grags lo 'dod ma song zhing / /gang bsgrod ltos gzhi med par nyams len la/ /'bad tshe bla ma'i byin brlabs zhugs gyur te/ /nyams rtogs rnal 'byor gang zag dbang khyad kyi/ /gcig char rim gyis thod rgal nyid 'char te/ /de yang rim gyis dbang btang ltar don na/ /thog mar sems nyid mi gnas gnas pa'i thabs/ /mtshan bcas mtshan med du ma'i thabs kyis ni/ /gnas pa dang po bar pa mthar gyis ni/ /rgya mtsho rlung gi mi bskyod ltar du chags/ /de ltar gnas pas zhi ba nyid rnyed nas/ /'gyu thog rang grol lhag mthong rtsal gyis zin/ /gnas 'gyu dbyer med rtse gcig ngo bo mthong / /de la bar ma chad par nyams blangs pas/ /rim bzhin goms thob rten la che 'bring chung / /bsgrod de de la mdo phyogs sa lam dang / /mthan par sbyor na tshogs dang sbyor lam gyis/ /nges 'byed bzhi dang mthan par gong mas gsungs/ /de ri ca sha ringayang rtse gcig zhes don sems gnas pa/ /thun thub ngang du 'gyur rtsal 'gag med cha/ /shar ba rang ngo shes shing snang ba sems/ /nyams myong rnal ma rgyud la 'byor bas grags/ /de bas deng sang kha cig zhi gnas pa/ /'thug lding blos byas go ba'i tshig tsam las/ /'gyu ba phra rags ngo ma mthong ba yi/ /rtse gcig ngo sprod 'di ni bdag blo tshom/ /gzhan yang rnam rtog rjes ded gzung 'dzin gyis/ /phra rag ngo mthong rlom nas 'phrul snang gi /'phreng rgyun skor la lhag mthong 'dod pa ni/ /grub thob gong ma'i gsung dang rgyab gyes mngon/ /de la sogs te 'dra min nor gol sa/ /'ga' la zhen pa deng sang mang mthong yang / /rang skyon ma dag gzhan skyon brjod nus min/ /de bas btang snyoms nyer bzhag rgyal bas gnang / /kye ho/ /rtse gcig rnal 'byor zhes grags de nyid ni/ /mtshon bral dpe med rang byung ye shes kho/ /rnam rtog 'khrul snang dri ma glo bur gyis/ /ring por sgribs te de ring bla ma'i drin/ /dri ma dag pa cung zad phyis pa'i mthus/ /rang ngo rang mthong yid bzhin nor bu de/ /rang la yod pa deng dus shes byung ste/ /dbul mo'i gter rnyed lta bu'i ('di nas ma dpe ldeb ma gcig chad/) 299

༄ga / rnal 'byor pa tshe dbang nor bu'i rgyun spyod dge ba'i lam rim glu ru blangs pa thar pa'i 'jug ngogs ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /ha ho/mi bdag gi bde chen 'khor lo'i steng / /skyabs kun 'dus ngo bo pad+ma 'byung / /sku dkar dmar pad zhwa gser mdangs can/ /rtse rma bya rgod ldems rdo rje mtshan/ /mdun rgya gram nyi zla nor bus brgyan/ /phyag g.yas na rig stong rdo rjes gsor/ /g.yon bde stong thod pa tshe bum bsnams/ /sku sngags phod mdo yi chos gos gsum/ /'khor bsgyur chas ber chen lnga ldan gsol/ /gsang gos dkar rdo rje'i sku reg cings/ /mgul nor bu phyag zhabs gser gdub 'khrol/ /zhabs sag lham rin chen phra yi brgyan/ /zhal 'dzum mdangs spyan gsum lta stangs gzigs/ /gru kha ṭaṃ brda' rtags du mas brgyan/ /sku 'od dang 'od zer rab 'bar dpang / /ma mtsho rgyal dkar sngo mjes 'dzum 'khyud/ /dbu lcang lo nor bu'i thor gtsug can//dar cod pan dmar rgyan srog zhu gsol/ /rus rin chen rgyan drug dar dpyangs phur//phyag rdo rje thod pa bdud rtsi stobs/ /yab yum gnyis dgyes bde zag med rol/ /de g.yas phyogs gsang 'dus ho ru ka/dpal bde gling dmar skug rnal 'byor chas/ /phyag gsang rnga ban dha bdud rtsi'i bkang //sku stag sham rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ /g.yon phyogs su bde chen 'khor lo sdom/ /rje karma rigs 'dzin gsung rab zhabs/ /sku dkar gsal chos gos rnam gsum gsol//phyag rdo rje dril bu thugs kar bsnol//de lta bu'i rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /'khor rtsa gsum mchog gsum sprin du 'khrigs/ /thugs tshad med snying rjes rab dgongs pa/ /dus rgyun chad med par spyi bo ru/ /bzhugs sgom zhing gsol ba 'debs yul yin/ /mi nga la skyabs yul khong bas med/ /blo lings kyi bor pa 'di rang yin/ /tshe 'di phyi'i bde sdug ci byung dang / /yul mtho dman gar btang khong rnams shes/ /de nga yis chos kun snying po'o//mi bdag gis bskyed rim bsgom pa ni/ /gzhi mngon byang lnga dang ting
