'dzin gsum/ /de skad cig dran rdzogs he ru ka /sku snang stong zhen med chu zla bzhin/ /sems phyogs 'jog yin snyam ma yin par/ /dbu skra rtse man nas rkang mthil yan/ /phra zhib gsal sku mdog phyag mtshan brgyan/ /tshul ma 'dres sems dpa' gsum ldan dang / /rjen lhang nger rtag thub bkod pa ste/ /mchog thun mong dngos grub sgrub phyir 300

dang //sems nyams dang rtogs pa bogs 'don phyir/ /mi nga yi bskyed rim bsgom tshul yin/ /yang bdag gi bzlas pa bzla ba ni/ /sngags ma dag bzlas pa'i skyon lnga spang / /sems ma yengs myur bul zhan drag ran/ /sgra che dang shub bu gsang 'gog bzlas/ /don ma 'dres rang rang skabs bab ltar/ /mi nga yi gsang sngags bzla tshul yin// mi bdag gi thun mtshams dge sbyor ni/ /dngos yid kyi mdun mkha' seng khri'i steng / /dkon mchog rten grangs med gsal ngang du/ /phyag bskor ba maṇ+ḍal bstod pa phul/ /lam theg pa chen po'i smon lam bcas//yig 'bri dang kha thon don sems sogs//de thun mtshams bya las tshul yin no//mi kho bo'i nyams len snying po de/ /lus dal 'byor bco brgyad rin chen 'di/ /dus nam yang mi thob da res tsam/ /de gser gling stong log mi byed par/ /tshe phyi ma ci 'gyur cha med kyi/ /lus 'di yi thar pa sgrub nges gces/ /don de phyir chos la 'bad lo yin/ /phyi 'byung ba bskal pa chags 'jig bcas/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas byang sems tshangs brgya byin/ /kun mi rtag gshegs pa'i tshul bstan na/ /rang chu spur lus can dus snyigs ma/ /tshe sum cu kha ral skyes pa'i mi/ /dus myur du 'chi bar thag chod pas//tshe 'dir snang rgyu rdzas zas nor dang / /gnas khang zhing bran 'khor 'bangs la sogs/ /chos dge ba'i phyir du ma rtogs par/ /tshe 'di yi lo 'dod kheng grags phyir/ /spyod don med bya ba gang la yang / /chos shes shing 'bad bkag med pa 'di/ /rje bka' rgyud gong ma'i gshegs shul te/ /mi nga rang 'jug lam zab rgyas shar—/ /mi bdag gi za zhing bsgom tsa na/ /'di phyi nang gsang ba'i go rim gyis/ /zas za shes tshul ni mang na yang / /mdo don 'dril rang lus rgyal ba'i dkyil/ /dgos khyad par mgrin par pad zla'i steng / /skyabs mtshungs med pad+ma yab yum la/ /mchod tshul du lag sor mchod lha mo/ /zas tshogs 'khor shes nas zhal gru gsum//lce me lha yar skan snang mtha' yas/ /skan 'og ma gos dkar ya so ni//dpa' bo dang ma so ni mkha' 'gro ma/ /shes byas te zas zos bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /rje o rgyan yab yum dkyil 'khor lha/ /mchod bsam pa 'di phyi yi tshogs 'khor tshogs/ /nang gsang byugs gnad kyi nyams len te/ /sdig dkor sgrib mi 'byung tshogs bsags thabs/ /mi nga yi za lugs snying po yin/ /skom btung ba bdud rtsi dkar dmar du/ /shes byas te rang lus lha la mchod/ /zag med pa'i bde chen rgyas mos 'di/ /mi bdag gi btung ba btung tshul yin/ /yang bdag gi 'gro zhing bsgom rtsa na/ /mi kho bo'i phrag g.yas nam mkha'i klong / /sku gzugs dang glegs bam mchod sdong bcas/ /lha rtsa gsum rgya mtsho sprin du 'khrigs/ /lha mchog du o rgyan yab yum gsal/ /de bskor bar bsam nas goms pa 'dor/ /des 'gros la chud zos mi 'gyur zhing / /lus sgrib pa sbyangs ba'i man ngag 'di/ /bdag tshe dbangasnor gu'i 'gro bsgom yin/ /mi kho 301

bo 'dug cing bsgom tsa na/ /lus rnam par snang mdzad chos bdun dang / /dbugs 'gro 'ong steng bcas bum pa bcas/ /steng 'og rlung dang kha sbyor rlung du dril/ /rngub dgang gzhil 'phang bcas sbyor ba bzhi/ /gnad ma chugs ngang nas spyod pa 'di/ /rlung rgyu tir gcun pa'i man ngag te/ /mi bdag gi 'dug nas bsgom tshul yin/ /bdag nyal zhing nyal nas sgom pa ni/ /gzhogs g.yas phab seng ge'i nyal stabs la/ /mgrin 'khor lo'i dbus su aḥdakar la/ /sems gtad nas chos kun rmi lam ltar/ /shes ngang der ma yengs dran pa bcas/ /gnyid log nas rmi lam 'od gsal sbyangs/ /de nyal nas sgom tshul cha shas lags/e ma/ mi tshe dbang las kyi rdo rje dang / /dus lan re gti mug ngang du bsgom/ /de skad cig rtog med 'phra ba de/ /lam rim pa 'od gsal ngang du sbyangs/ /btang snyoms gnas ngang du wal le de/ /sems mi rtog rang gshis ngang du sbyangs/ /gnyid bag chags rmi lam 'thug po de/ /don rtsol med chos nyid ngang du sbyangs/ /spyir rmi lam zin pa 'di nyid kyang / /'jam bag chags rtsub mos zin pa 'ga'/ /khong la la dga' brod rlom pa zhugs/ /de ma zin mi dge'i snang ba 'char/ /don rmi lam mi bden sgyu ma'i dpe/ /der dga' sdug de tsam 'phel ba na/ /dngos a 'thas 'khrul snang ci phyir chod/ /don des na rmi lam snang ba 'di—/ /nyin nyams thog mtho dman gang yin gyi/ /tshad rmi lam dag la bzung tsam las/ /nyin ma sgom mtshan la ci phyir rtogs/ /mi la las rmi lam zad do skad/ /mi la las rmi lam mi dmigs skad/ /'di tha dad ci bzhin rtogs pa'i mthus/ /'khrul mi lam rgyun thag chad pa ni/ /dus deng dus rgya lam res 'ga' tsam/ /nyams rtogs pa 'dra min mang ba'i phyir/ /'dra nyams dang don nor byis pa 'ga'/ /tshul 'di 'drar zhen pa ya re mtshan/ /mi nga ni rmi lam zin dga' dang / /zin ma thub 'gyod pa'i sems kyang med/ /gang byas kyang bde'o rnal 'byor pa/ /lar nyin mor 'khrul med bsgom yod na/ /mtshan mi lam ma zin na yang bzod/ /nyin 'khrul pa'i snang ba 'byams pa na/ /mtshan rmi lam zin kyang dgos pa chung / /don des na 'khrul snang bag chags dbang / /btang mi bya 'bad rtsol ma mchis ngang / /yengs med pa'i bya ra btang la 'bungs/ /lung ma bstan snyoms las spang 'tshal te/ /mi kho bo'i gti mug nyams len yin/mi bdag gi 'dod chags ngang sgom pa/ /rgyu zang zing dngos po'i zhen chags de/ /'khrul mig yor sgyu ma ltar du sbyangs/ /sems 'dod smon bzang ngan du ma de/ /de zhen med nam mkha'i rlung ltar sbyangs/ /yul chags sems bud med bsten pa yang / /sems chags mkhan ngo bo cer bltas zhing / /chags bral ba stong snying don la sbyangs/ /de ngang las ma g.yos rig pa'i rtsal/ /lha yi dam yab yum lam gyi bsgom/ /gsang rdor pad hūṃ sam phaṭaḥgyis mtshan/ /sku snang stong dbyer med 'khril sbyor gyis/ /spyi gtsug tu bla ma pad+ma 'byung / /longs sku'i chas mtsho rgyal yum dang 'khril/ /rang zhen med yum dang sbyor byas te/ /khams 302

thig le dbab dkyil bzlog dang dgram/ /gnad mkhas pa bzhi yis sbyangs byas te/ /bde dga' ba bzhi la nyams len nas/ /don rang byung rtogs pa'i bogs 'don 'di/ /dug sman du 'gyur ba'i bdud rtsi 'dra //grogs bud med bsten pa'i sngags 'chang gis/ /sems 'dod chags nyams len byed tshul lo/ /yang zhe sdang ngang du sgom pa'i tshe/ /rkyen gyis dkrug rnam rtog rags pa de/ /rang ngo bo nyid la cer klog pas/ /phyi yul dang nang gi rang sems gnyis/ /dmigs mtshon med zhen med gnyis snang bral/ /'di 'di 'o spros pa'i ming las 'das/ /gzung 'dzin bral rig pa rjen par 'char/ /de ngang du bzhag las gzhan 'gyu pa/ /zhe sdang ba dgag bsgrub spang bsgrub sogs/ /blos bcos bral yang med ci dga' 'di/ /mi nga yi zhe sdang nyams len yin/ /spyir dug gsum ngo bo de dag dang / /nga rgyal ba phrag dog la sogs pa/ /kun sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i 'phrul 'khor bzhin/ /spangs blangs bral a 'thas ma bzhugs par/ /sems rang gshis ka dag gdod ma'i khams/ /gzhi bde gshegs snying por lta ba 'di/ /bu tshe dbang nor bu'i nyams len yin/ /mi bdag gi thun bzhir nyams len na/ /dus tho rangs dang por bab pa'i tshe/ /gnyid gti mug 'khrul pa bskyog byas te/ /lus stong ra gsal dang rlung gsum 'bud/ /sems ting nge 'dzin gyi bdag dbang len/ /ngag bzlas brjod bsngags bzhi tshar bdun bsgrag /rje gu ru'i gsol 'debs tshar bdun bklag /de ma yeng ngang nas snying po bsgrang / /sngags yang snying yig brgya brgya phrag bzla/ /lha rdor sems sgom nas bstod bshags byas/ /rjes rang rig rdor sems dbyer med stem/ /blo shes rab 'phel phyir 'jam dkar dang / /sdig sgrib pa sbyangs byed spyan ras gzigs/ /bar gcod pa sel byed phyag rdor sku/ /bsgom byas nas bzlas pa gang nus bskyal/ /de tho rangs thun gyi bya las yin/nam langs tshe skad cig lhar gsal dang / /thugs ye shes sems pa'i snying ka ru/ /srog mi shig sa bon ka ba gtsug /sngags bzla lugs bzhi yis 'khrul 'khor bskor/ /'phrin lan bzhi gang 'dod dmigs pa bsgyur/ /de ngang nas thugs dam lhag pa'i lha/ /sngags dza pa ti dbyangs grags ldan sgrogs/ /skabs dga' rung 'phral gyi spyod pa dang / /tshig 'brel 'byung 'ga' yang smra ba yin/ /zhar bab byung dge sbyor 'ga' yang byed/ /mdor dril ba rang gzhan dge la bskul/ /de nyin mor spyod pa'i mthun yin no/ /dus sgong mor bsrung mar gtor bsngos dang / /rang 'khor bcas bsrung dang bstan don du/ /bsrung bzlog dang bsad pa'i drag sngags bzlas/ /gnas gzhi bdag dkar dmar gsur gyis mchod/ /yul ris med mchod sbyin gtor mar 'bad/ /de dgong mo'i dus kyi thun spyod do/ /srod bab tshe skad cig gtum mo'i sku/ /ldangs byas te bla ma'i rnal 'byor spyod/ /lus rtsa yi stong ra 303

bum chen sbyangs/ /rje 'bar ba a bshad bya las dang / /bde skyed pa ham gyi rgyun 'bab la/ /yid gtad nas nyams len rlung la 'bad/ /rjes dmigs med ngang du mnyam bzhag dang / /bsngo smon lam bzang po'i mtshams sbyor dang / /lus phung po mchod sbyin zhen med dang / /don nyams len ma yengs lta ba'i ngang //mtshan gung du rang babs ngang du rnal/ /de rnams ni srod dang sgong thun yin//e ma/ mi nga yi nyams len mdor dril na/ /lus zhen med lha skur gsal ba 'di/ /de bskyed rim yongs kyi 'du so yin/ /gtum ham a 'bar 'dzag srog stsol 'di/ /rlung thabs lam bsgom pa'i 'du so yin—/ /ngag sngags la rtag tu brtson pa 'di/ /lha yi dam nus bsgrub 'du so yin/ /sems ma yengs rig pa rgyun chags 'di/ /chos bskyed rdzogs yongs kyi 'du so yin/ /sems rang babs brjod bral blo 'das gshis—//'di lta ba yongs kyi 'du so yin/ /gang shar kun rtsol med mnyam bzhag 'di/ /bsgom nyams len kun gyi 'du so yin/ /dgag sgrub bral rgyu 'bras phra zhib 'di/ /'di spyod pa yongs kyi 'du so yin/ /re dog bral rig pa rang gdeng thob/ /'di 'bras bu yongs kyi 'du so yin/ /rje bla ma mi brjed dran pa'i rgyun/ /chad med 'di nyams len yongs kyi 'du so yin/ /dus rtag tu dad pa 'gyur med 'di/ /chos rnam dkar ma lus 'di so yin//dus rtag tu 'da' med dam tshig 'di//chos gsang sngags bsgrub pa'i srog rtsa yin//las dkar nag rgyu 'bras gzhib pa 'di/ /bka' rgyal gsung ma lus 'du so yin/ /dus rtag tu bag yod spyod brtson pa/ /'di thar pa sgrub pa'i grogs mchog yin/ /dus rtag tu gzhan phan sems bskyed pa/ /'di sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i sa bon yin/ /dus rtag tu ma bcos dran pa 'di/ /bsgom nyams rtogs myur rdzogs snying po yin/ /dus rtag tu rang gzhan dge sbyor ba/ /'di bka' brgyud gong ma'i rnam thar yin/ /sems g.yo sgyu med pa'i drang po 'di/ /spyod pa ya rabs yongs kyi 'di so yin/ /rang 'dod pa khe grags chung slobs 'di/ /chos sha ma bsgrub pa'i lam rkang yin/ /rkyen ci byung ro snyoms gang nus 'di/ /khong rtogs ldan yongs kyi rnam thar yin/ /'di rnal 'byor tshe dbang nor bu yi/ /nyams len tshul brjod pa'i snying po yin/ /e ma/ mi bdag gi bsgom tshul ci 'dra na/ /lha a 'thas bsgom pa a 'thas yin/ /a ma 'thas stong gzugs chu zla bzhin/ /sems skye med mkha' nas 'gag med stsal/ /dbyings mja' tshon ltar du rang rtsal sbyangs/ /deng la las bskyed rim bsnyen bsgrub la/ /rdzogs rim la chos blo mi byed 'dug /'di rtag lta'i phyogs su 'khyams dogs che/ /yang cig rdzogs rim stong pa skad/ /lha bskyed rim bsgom par mi mos shing ske/ /sems rnam rtog yo langs ci byas zer/ /'di stong pa chad pa chad lta'i rgyur/ /'gro dogs pa yang yang bzab dgos mthong / /ci phyir zhes sems kyi rnam rtog rgyun/ /'phral mi char thabs ni ma mchis kyi/ / 304

de bag yangs rgyal bas ma gsung zhing / /gnas 'gyur tshe sor rtog ye shes bzhed/ /sems ma dag dngos po'i rnam rtog la/ /dus ye nas sgom ste da bar 'khrul/ /de ngo shes tsam gyi dang chog na/ /kho thar pa nag po ci phyir gol/ /sa brgyad pa'i sems dpa' yin par grags/ /don des na ma dag dngos zhen 'di/ /sbyang phyir du rgyal ba thabs mkhas des/ /lha bskyed rim sgyu lus mang du gsungs/ /thabs bskyed rim shes rab rdzogs rim la/ /zung 'jug nas nyams len khyad chos yin/ /de zung 'jug kyang sngar yin yin pa las/ /sngar mi cig pa gsar du bstas pa min/ /sems nyid kyi ngo bo ye stong de/ /rdzogs rim gyi tha snyad ma lags bsamaske/ /rang mdangs ni rnam pa thams cad la/ /'gag med du shar ba'i lha sku de/ /bskyed rim zhes tha snyad mi gtogs bsam/ /bskyed rdzogs gnyis don de ye nas gcig /da bskyed rim cig bsgom kyang rdzogs rim dngos/ /rdzogs rim zhig sgom kyang bskyed rim nyid/ /da rnal 'byor smyon pa ni gtad med ste/ /gtad med kyi nyams la de ltar bdog /bskyed rdzogs ni ro gcig ngang du song / /zab gsal gyi ngang du ta la la/ /rig stong gi ngang du rjen ne ne/ /bya ba kun chos nyid khrol lo lo/ /gang byas kyang sgyu mar 'al ma 'ol/ /'di kho yi rnam thar yang tig ste/ /tig tig cig smyon pa ci la yong / /tig tig cig med kyang rang nyid spro/ /mjal dgos kyi mtshan ldan bla ma mjal/ /dam tshig la ngo lkog spu tsam med/ /thob dgos ni phyag rdzogs man ngag thob/ /ma go ba'i khong phran rdul tsam med/ /mthong dgos kyi sems ngo phyogs tsam mthong //the tshom zhig gcod dgos da ni med/ /rang yin lugs ni cung zad da snyed pas/ /skye skye dang sprul sprul min kyang chog /nyams myong ni bde chen gling par skyes/ /rtogs pa ni gsung rab rgya mtshor thug /nyams myong gang phyag chen gdams pas bshad/ /rtogs gding ni rdzogs chen gzhung gi chud/ /lta grub mtha' ni klong chen rab 'byams lugs/ /dag snang ni rgyal bstan spyi la sbyongs/ /rang gdengs ni sems la chud pas bde/ /chags sdang gi zhags pa mi dam pas/ /rang sems 'di gu yang chal ma phyogs/ /skye sngon nas theg chen smon lam thebs/ /skyes mchog gi bla ma 'ba' zhig mjal/ /nges don sgom bag chags rtag tu bzhag /ci nus kyi 'gro don kho nar spyod/ /'di dag ni kho bo'i ngang tshul ste/ /rang nyid kyi nyams len tshul ji bzhin/ /yin lugs kyi glu dbyangs de skad ni/ /ri mgo kun gangs dkar mche brtsigs 'dra/ /klung nags kyi dom lpags bsgyangs 'dra ba/ /chu bo kun rba klong drag 'khrug 'beb/ /mi kun kyang khro gtum gdug pa che/ /sbas yul mchog brag skad rdzong zhes pa'i/ /yul khu'i dbus mkhar chu'i dben gnas su/ /dag pa zla ba'i tshes bzang bco lnga la/ /rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu'i smras/ /yi ge pa lha lding go sa'i rigs/ /dag 'gyogs skyen blo dbang gi bgyis so/ /dge ba ci mchis pas rang gzhan kun/ /dge blo gang bskyed nas dge sbyor 'bad/ /dge 'bras kun myur min rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /dge bsngo yi dbang 305
dib/sa ba

༄sto /nar ma'i rnal 'byor sdom tshig rdo rje'i phreng zhes nyams len snying po'i the yig gong khug ma bzhugs so/ /nar ma'i rnal 'byor sdom tshig rdo rje 'phreng ba zhes bya ba/ bde chen 'khor lo'i dbang phyug pad+ma sam bha wa yab yum sras dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi ltar dus drug nang ltar chos spyod drug /gsang ba rnal 'byor drug rnams yi ge drug /rgya yi btab pa ci srid lus dang sems/ /ma bral bar du spang blangs med chos yin/ /tho rangs nam gung srod ste mtshan dus gsum/ /snga dro nyin gung dgongs kha nyin dus gsum//chos spyod skyabs su 'gro ba'i bslab bya 'dzin//so thar rtsa bzhi chang lnga dus min spangs//byang sems dkar nag chos brgyad spang dang blangs/ /rig 'dzin dam tshig rtsa ba yan lag bsrungs/ /lha sngags bsam gtan dag la 'jog pa dang / /thun mong chos spyod dge ba ci nus brtson/ /phung khams sgyu lus dag pa lha ru gsal/ /bla mar gsol 'debs ting 'dzin dbang bzhi blangs/ /rdo rje 'gog shub sil ngar man+t+ra bzlas/ /gtum mo 'bar 'dzag thabs lam bde ba spor/ /bsam med nam mkha'i rnal 'byor yang dag 'jogs/ /'od gsal snang ba'i rtags la nyin mtshan sbyor/ /de ltar chos spyod rnal 'byor rnam pa drug /nyin mtshan dus drug yul dang ma bral bar/ /'da' ba'i gnas med nyams len nar ma ru/ /don gnyis lhun grub 'bras bu bcud du men/ /gnas kyi sa thob rang lo'i rkang brnyes tshe/ /dal 'byor rnyed pa'i snying po nyer blangs phyir/ /rgyal ba'i bka' btags rang la nyer bsgrags nas/ /nar ma'i rnal 'byor sdom tshig rdo rje'i phreng / /'di ni mdo sngags chos kun snying po mchog /nyams len 'brel spang snying gi dum bu ste//rang 'dra skal mnyam kun gyi nyer bsgrub ste//rdo rje sems mchog skad cig 'dir thob shog/sku dang ye shes rdo rje drug gi dngos/ /rang byung yi ge drug gi rgyaḥ yi btab/ /oṃ lha rgyu hoḥ haṃ k+ṣaḥzhes rdo rje rnal 'byor la mos pa lam du byed pa tshe dbang nor bu rdo rje sems dpa' rtsal gyi bod yul stod kyi cha mnga' ris gung thang nub ri lho mon bod kyi yul mtshams bas mtha' ta la bya bar sa bya hor zla bdun pa'i tshes nyi shur rang gi nyams len gyi sa spyad rkang du bstan pa ste/ 'gro kun dran mchog shrīḥpad+ma ma hā su kha'i go 'phang la reg par gyur cigadage'o/dge'o/dge'o//maṅga lo/oṃ āḥrgyu me r+ghaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sgrig rgyu/ oṃ trīḥṣ+ṭi wi kri ta na na r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra rgyu r+ghaṃ rgyu phaṭa swā hā/oṃ shrī badz+ra ho ho ru ru kai rgyu hūṃ phaṭaḥ ḍāk+ki ni dz+wa la sam+bha ram̐ ṭ+wā hā/oṃ lhaspyoḥrgyu/maṅga lo/ /307

༄ga /dpal rig pa 'dzin pa chen po tshe dbang nor bu'i gsung mgur zhal gdams kyi tshogs ji snyed pa bzhugs so/ /kwa ye/ sprul skur ming thogs tshe dbang nor bu lags/ /le lo snyoms las can khyod tshur gson dang / /khyod la 'di nang mi chos bslab bya mkhan/ /mang mchis mod kyang gtan bde'i lam bzang mchid/ /slob mkhan dus snyigs dus 'dir bdag tsam ste/ /des na gros tshig 'di kun ma yengs bzung / /rtag tu bre mo brjod dang 'di mi 'dra/ /snying med mdo shor mi la ci cha yod/ /kye ma/ dal 'byor lus 'di sngon bsags las 'phro ste/ /rnyed dka' ma shes byis pas nor rnyed 'dra/ /zog med skye dran bag chags srab lags kyang / /chos bzhin ma spyod nor bu 'dam bying 'dra/ /las 'phro bzang sad chos la mos na yang / /gnad thog ma khel dbul mo'i gser sgye 'dra/ /smon lam bzang pos mtshan ldan mjal na yang / /gsol 'debs ma shes sprang nag pad tshal 'dra/ /dad dang dag snang cung zad shes na yang / /brten phur ma tshugs sa rgod nas btab 'dra/ /dam pa'i bka' drin khrid lung nos na yang / /ci bzhin ma rtogs rgyang nas bya ra 'dra/ /zab legs snyan snyan chos mang thos na yang / /rang gi ma pher rdo rgyab chu blugs 'dra/ /rgyu 'bras dam tshig phyogs tsam go na yang / /rgyud la ma 'byor ko gyong snum dred 'dra/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma yun bsten yang / /chos bzhin ma rtogs sde pa'i hor 'dra 'dra/ /bla ma mchog mjal dam chos zhur yod dus/ / brtson 'grus ma byas gser gling stong log 'dra/ /dge ba'i las la bag tsam spyod na yang / /rang 'dod gis bcings zas bzang dug 'dres 'dra/ /chos brgyad 'khor ba'i btson ra yin shes kyang / /spang bar ma nus srin mo'i gzugs chags 'dra/ /mi rtag 'chi ba breng tsam dran na yang / /'di snang tshul 'dzin shes bzhin dug 'thung 'dra/ /chos tshul nyams len skyong bde shes na yang / /rgyud thog ma 'brel rig 'dzin rnyed gtor 'dra/ /dam chos sgrub pa'i zhe gdengs yod na yang / /sang byed snang byed ston thog sad khyer 'dra/ /kha mkhas tshig btsun chos bshad rnar 'jebs kyang / /rang nyams ma myong sman med sman bshad 'dra/ /rgyu 'bras dam tshig gzhan la bshad bshad kyang / /rang gi ma spyod ne tso'i chos bshad 'dra/ /nan skyed sdug rtsir bca' khrims bsgrigs na yang / /khengs drags dbang gyur dpon po'i dmag khrims 'dra/ /rang la phan re bcas bskyang grwa 'khor yang / /phal cher phan med 'dab chags byi'u bsos 'dra/ /chos dang mthun res skyong ba'i sbyin bdag 308

yang / /phal cher spra sprel mi ltog srog shugs 'dra/ /rtsa rlung grogs re gsang grogs rten pa yang phal cher mnyam grogs 'jig rten gza' sdeb 'dra/ /dam tshig gnyen 'brel bslab pa'i slob bu yang / /ci bzhin tshul ldan nyin mo'i skar ma 'dra/ /yul sde 'khrug rtsod mi tshe bskyal na yang / /las la zad med chu nag gnyer ma 'dra/ /bya ba bskor tshe chos la 'bad bsam kyang / /bya ba zad med rgya srang 'grim 'grul 'dra/ /chos bzhin ma rtogs chos pa'i gzugs 'dzin kyang / /phyi tshul mdzes te mi gtsang dar btum 'dra/ /rgyal bstan ma phan gdan sa sprul ming yang / /myur du mi rtag nam langs skar ma 'dra/ /'ur 'ur zang zing mnga' thang 'phral bde yang / /skad cig nyid 'gyur sgyu ma'i ltad mo 'dra/ /bca' bca' bkod bkod bya byed mdzes legs 'di/ /da lta nyid 'jig sad kha'i rmi lam 'dra/ /snyan snyan tshe 'di'i mi chos bslab bya de/ /'phral mdzes mtha' med tshong 'dus ltad mo 'dra/ /dpon slob war 'ur mdza' 'phral skyid na yang / /mi rtag sgyu ma skyes bu'i grong khyer 'dra/ /gos 'jam zas zhim 'phral du bde na yang / /rtag par mi 'gyur nyi shar shing zil 'dra/ /mtshan nyid mi ldan bla gzugs bdag 'dra ni/ /don gnyis mi 'grub be'u stel g.yang lhung 'dra/ /yon tan med par sprul skur bsgrags na yang / /bong bu gzig shun gyon pa'i g.yon can 'dra/ /rang don ma grub 'gro don yin rlom 'di/ /skyes bu smyon pa tshogs dpon song ba 'dra/ /bsam pa sna mang tshig dril med pa ni/ /gar yang mi phog long ba'i mda' 'phen 'dra/ /da ni chos blo chig dril ma byas na/ /mi tshe stong zad rgyal sa yid smon 'dra/ /kye ma de skad 'dra dpe so brgyad 'di/ /rang gi tshul la rang nyid skyo nas gleng / /phyi nang gsang ba dus kyi 'gyur ldog rnams/ /mthong ngam thos sam tshe dbang nor bu ba/ /rigs drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal skye 'chi'i tshul/ /dran na snying 'dar nyams su myong tshe ci/ /da ni thog tu bab la myur du nye/ /yang nas yang 'khor las 'di ya re tsha/ /kwa ye deng nas dam bca' tshul bzhin du/ /rang gis rang la gdams 'di brtan phur tshugs/ /sngon chad sdug pa'i las la gnong zhing 'gyod/ /bag med snyoms las bya bar rab khrel nas/ /phyin chad gtan bde lam bzang byang chub 'bras/ /myur thob deng tshe ri khrod dben par snyegs/ /chos min chos pa'i gzugs su ma 'chos par/ /rang sems dpang tshugs mdo rgyud dgongs pa'i don/ /chig dril sems nyid brdar sha legs gcod cing / /'dul khrims mi 'chal bag yod spyod par rems sems bskyed mi nyams snying gi nor bur 'chang / /dam tshig phra bcas rgyud la rab 'jog 'tshal/ /grogs med brtul zhugs dben pa'i ri khrod brten/ /nges med spyod pas rgyal khams yongs la bskor/ /bdag med don dam rtogs pa'i sgro 'dogs bcad/ /zhen med pha yul bya ba btang re ran/ /da ni ci bzhin rang don ma grub par/ /'chi bar gyur pa'i srog la bab kyang sla'i/ /bsam thog chig dril cho~X 0༵ rab

'bungs nas/ /pha yul 'di ru da ni sdod re kan/ /chos nas chos bzhin bsam pa bzang po 'di/ /bar chad log pa'i bgegs dang yongs bral nas/ /ci bzhin 'grub rogs bla ma yi dam lha/ /mkha' 'gro bsrung mas mdzod cig mthu ma chung / /zhes pa'ang rnal 'byor snyoms las ro nyal mkhan/ /tshe dbang nor bur grags de'i gang shar glu/ /rang gzhan chos la bskul phyir yul gzhan du/ /bgrod 'dun byung nas mdzes byed ston zla yis/ /tshes bzang nyer gsum nyin par bkod pa ste/ /yig ris rang gi slob ma mchog sprul sku/ /'phrin las bstan 'dzin bzang pos yongs bgyis pa/ /kun gyi tshig 'di snying la 'jug par shog /kye ma ho/ bskal par rnyed dka' dal 'byor rin chen lus/ /da res thob 'di stong log mi 'tshal te/ /sngon chad las kun g.yeng ba bag med dang / /nyon mongs rags pa chos brgyad dbang du song / /tshul de dran na skyo shas 'phel ba'i rgyu/ /mi tshe ngal kun lag stong can du bcug /deng nas bzung ste lhag bsam dril bar bya/ /'grub par rtsa brgyud bla ma'i byin gyis rlobs/ /kye ma/ tshul min bag med lus kyi spyod mang 'di/ /gzhan snang mi mthun thar pa'i gegs su che/ /de bas spyod lam kun tu bag yod zhing / /tshul ldan byed na dam bca' gcig pa yin/ /kye ma/ thabs kyi ma zin rlung nus ma thob bar/ /bud med grogs brten rang 'khril ngan song ltung / /de bas thabs ldan nus pa ma 'byongs bar/ /bud med mi brten dam bca' gnyis pa yin/ /kye ma/ ngag 'khyal brel mo 'chal tshig brjod pa 'di/ /rang gzhan chags sdang don 'chal bzlas brjod bdud/ /de bas ngag la bag chags tshig dam zhing / /chos min mi smra dam bca' gsum pa yin/ /kye ma/ bdag gzhan bstod smad tshig gi sgro bskur 'di/ /rang gzhan phyogs 'dzin duḥkha'i rgyu bsags pas/ /de bas dag snang phyogs med bstod smad spangs/ /btang snyoms bzhag pa dam bca' bzhi pa yin/ /kye ma/ rdzun tshig 'di ni kun tu mi mthun zhing / /gsung gi yon tan 'joms pa'i ha la 'dra/ /des na gting dpag dka' phyir ma gtogs par/ /rdzun du mi smra dam bca' lnga pa yin/ /kye ma/ dkon mchog mna' spang 'di ni mnar med par/ /rdo rje dmyal bar ltung byed zhags pa ste/ /de yang bstan phan gal lci ma gtogs par/ /brjod par mi byed dam bca' drug pa yin/ /kye ma/ ro nyal le lo snyoms las g.yeng ba 'di/ /mi tshe stong zad dngos grub gnyis kyi gegs/ /de bas ro nyal le lo nyung byas shing / /chos brjod brtson bskyed dam bca' bdun pa yin/ /kye ma/ chos kun rtsa ba rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /'gal na rab 'jigs rdo rje dmyal ltung nges/ /des na dam tshig srog dang khyad med par/ /'da' med bsrung ba dam bca' brgyad pa yin/ /kye ma/ sems kyi re dogakā ༵dod smon byed pa 'di/ /bya ba chos 'dres byed pa'i sel ngan yin/ /de yang mi byed gang shar

zhen med par/ /sgyu ma ltar sbyangs dam bca' dgu pa yin/ /kye ma/ dge sbyor rang nyid gcig pu'i zhi bde nyid/ /bsgrub 'dod nyan rang gol dang gzugs sku sgrib/ /des na dge sbyor bya ba gang yang rung / /mkha' mnyam 'gro bsngo dam bca' bcu pa yin/ /kye ma/ rang la yon tan med par yod brjod pa'i/ /zol gyi tshig 'dis mthar thug thar 'bras brlag /des na dad ldan spro phyir ma gtogs par/ /yon tan sbas spyod dam bca' bcu gcig yin/ /de ltar dam bca' bcu gcig 'di nyid ni/ /tshe 'dir nam yang 'da' bar mi bya ste/ /de yi dge bas 'gro kun sangs rgyas pa/ /myur thob sku gnyis lhun gyis grub par shog /ces tshe dbang nor bus rang lo bco lnga pa chos khrid zhu ba'i skabs su dam bcas pa ste rang gzhan rgyud la phan par gyur cig /gnas lugs don dam pa'i yin lugs ji bzhin par nges shes skyes te smras pa nyung ngu rab gsal rdo rje'i glu yod/ /oṃ swāste/ khyab bdag rdo rje can gyi dngos/ /rtsa ba'i bla mar phyag byas nas/ /rang gi myong ba 'di skad ces/ /smra bas nyes med dge gyur cig /bye brag mdo sde smra ba dang / /rnam bden rnam rdzun sems tsam pa/ /rang rgyud gong 'og thal 'gyur pa/ /tha dad ltar snang grub mtha' kun/ /lan tshwa chu la thim pa ltar/ /chos nyid ngo bor ro gcig 'dres/ /gnas skabs glang po che yi lus/ /dmul long rnams kyis btags pa ltar/ /ngo bo'i phyogs re ngos bsgrub nas/ /grub mtha' 'chad pa de yang mtshar/ /grub mtha' de kun yongs rdzogs shing / /sangs rgyas ye shes kun rdzogs bar/ /brda chad tshig kyi dkri byed chos/ /de la rdzogs pa che zhes brjod/ /snang ba ye shes rig pa rgyun mi chad/ /ngo bo nyid med ye shes rtag brtan 'jing / /chos kun stong bzhin stong nyid rig pa'i rgyun/ /rig stong zung 'jug dpe med bsam brjod 'das/ /chos nyid don ni bsam gyis mi khyab na/ /chos nyid zab mo rtog ges dpyad bya min/ /sangs rgyas gsung la yid ches bla ma la/ /mi phyed dad pas gsol ba btab na rtogs/ /chos dbyings chos sku yongs grub gang / /rig pa ye shes de la bya/ /de ni 'gro 'ong gnas pa bral/ /blo yi ra bas yongs mi 'khyud/ /srid ni myang 'das ro mnyam na/ /blang dang dor ba'i gnas ma mchis/ /de lta na yang bdag nyid la/ /rnam rtog yod pa de srid du/ /chos nyid de la yongs dmigs nas/ /'dus byas dge ba la 'bad bya/ /de ltar nyung ngu'i tshig dag ni/ /zab mo'i gnad 'ga' gsal bar smras/ /i thi/zhes pa kun dga' chu stod zla bas tshes bcu bdun par bod yul gtsang la stod lho byang gi mtshams lha chen po lha rgod mdung rtse'i la mgul spang gshong zhig tu 'gro bzhin pa'i ngang la bla ma'i byin rlabs kyi tshul de ltar go ba slar rtogs pa brjod par la stod ding ri glang 'khor ze ru kun dga' shing stag gro bzhin zla ba'i dmar phyogs tshes dgur smras pa gasnyir rgyaḥ dge'o/ /snyan gson dang sgrub chen dad pa can/ /tshe 'di phyir phan pa'i zhal gdams shig /da~X yang

yang gsung ngo ma lcogs tsam/ /tshig glu las drangs te smra yi gson/ /lus dal 'byor 'di 'dra rtag rnyed dka'/ /de mi rtag yud tsam rmi lam 'dra/ /phyis sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i thar dus med/ /bde 'dod na da lta chos bsgrub brtson/ /chos yang dag snying po byed pa la/ /tshe 'di snang zhen pa log pa dgos/ /bstod snyan grags bde skyid blos thong dgos/ /skyabs bla ma mtshan nyid tshang nges 'tshol/ /lam gnad 'gag che shos 'di yin pas/ /de ma nor 'khrul med rnyed pa gces/ /de rnyed nas log lta mnyam grogs dang / /gsungs bcag dang som nyi smos ci dgos/ /mthar ku re bre mo tsam yang spangs/ /dpe bag gsar khyo khyim zhugs pa bzhin/ /sems yengs med bag yod bla ma bsten/ /yid gus pa dam tshig srog ltar bsrung / /las rgyu 'bras yid ches ngang du longs/ /chos bsgrub la le lo phyi bshol spang / /skyabs phur tshugs bla ma dkon mchog bzung / /mkha' mnyam 'gror sems bskyed snying la phur/ /sgrib sbyangs shing tshogs bsags las la 'bad/ /dus kun tu bla ma spyi bor bsgom/ /lam dbang bzhi ting 'dzin thun drug blangs/ /tshe 'di la grol blo'i brtson 'grus brabs/ /dal long med mi rtag 'chi ba bsgom/ /blo khyod shes bla mar lings kyis 'bog /'di chos kun gnad tig rtsa ba ste/ /med thabs med rtag tu yid la bzung / /chos smin byed dbang bzhi tshang zhus la/ /de so so'i dam tshig gzhung bzhin bsrung / /lam grol byed bskyed rdzogs rtsa rlung yang / /lha bskyed rim mngon byang lnga dang ni/ /ting 'dzin gsum skad cig thol skyes sogs/ /rang yid la gang bder gzhung bzhin bsgom/ /dus grangs rtags bsnyen pa tshad ldan skyol/ /sgrub las sbyor nus pa ldan par mdzod/ /don rdzogs rim sgom yang kha 'byams dang / /yid yul dang blos byas bcas bcos sogs/ /sgom yengs dang re dogs gtan nas spangs/ /sems ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang du glod/ /rgyas btab dang dgag sgrub spang blangs dang / /bsgom gang bgrod stos gzhi nyid kyang grol/ /sgom yin min the tshom dga' sdug sogs/ /sems gzung 'dzin dang bral lhug par zhog/bsgom bzhag thabs gnad la mkhas pa na/ /lam gegs dang gol pa shin tu nyung / /lar bla ma nyams myong ldan phrad gces/ /dpe tshig skam rjes su mi 'brangs gces/ /chos nyams len gnad du 'khel ba gces/ /sems rus gting brdar sha chod pa gces/ /rkyen gang shar lam du khyer ba gces/ /spang blangs kun 'bur 'joms nus pa gces/ /gnas 'gyu ba mdor len mi 'tshal gyis/ /kun rang sems chos sku'i rol rtsal yin/ /da ma bcos rang bab ring du zhog /'khrul rtog dbang ma shor gcer gyi ltos/ /don tha mal shes pa gzo bral 'di/ /rang rang ngo shes pas grol ba lags/ /nyams rtogs pa go rim rnal 'byor bzhi/ /gnas 'gyu ba dbyer med rtse gcig dang / /yul gnyis 'dzin blo byas spros dang bral/ /gnyidī stus kun dbyer med ro gcig 'dres/ /chos kun zad sgom med rnal 'byor grags/ /'di rdzogs

pa chen pos khreg chod rtags/ /gzhan zhi spyod dbu phyag zhes kyang zer/ /kun rang rig gcig po'i ming yin la/ /de skyong thabs yengs med dran pa gces/ /mdor dril na dus dang rnam pa kun/ /rje bla ma'i thugs dang rang sems bsres/ /sems ma bcos rang ngo rang gis ltos/ /las spang blangs dam tshig nyams med mdzod/ /mthar sgom med sgom bya rang sar yal/ /mnyam rjes gnyis med 'dres par brtson 'tshal lags/ /lam thod brgal yang zab de yi grogs/ /dus kun tu dbyings rig gcun gzir 'tshal /thabs rtsa rlung thig le skad pa yang / /don dbu ma'i rtsa mdud grol thabs de/ /de zhu bde nyams su blang ba nyid/ /rten srog stsol sbyor bzhi'i dbang du bsdus/ /rtsa gsum 'dus sgra gcan kha ru bza'/ /me a mdangs zhus pas dpa' bo bzhu/ /lam dkyil 'khor bzhi ru brtul byas te/ /bde drod sbyor stong nyid rang zhal blta/ /mthar bzlog khyab rjes shes gnad du bsnun/ /'di khyad che nyen chung thabs lam yin/ /de las gzhan lus thabs nus rtsal rdzogs tshe/ /rkyen rigs ldan brtags shing 'gugs sgrib nas/ /lam mnyam pa gsum po sngon 'gro bas/ /gnas skyon bzhi gsal nas mkha' bzhi sbyangs/ /phyi bo la ka ko la sbyor zhing / /nang mu kha sgra gcan bu gar sbyor/ /gsang nyi zla e klong gcig tu sbyor/ /don a ham skye med mkha' la sbyor/ /khams srog gi dbyug gur yongs su khengs/ /gnas brtan g.yo'i mdud pa yongs su bkral/ /rlung khyab rgyu bdud rtsi'i rgyu bar thim/ /kun dwangs ma'i snying po bcud du smin/ /'di rdo rje theg lam rmad byung yang / /kho nyen che dug sbrul nor bu 'dra/ /gnad 'di la shin tu thabs mkhas gces/ /'on deng sang tshul ldan nyin skar tsam/ /khong la las thabs lam yin no skad/ /khrom kun rgyu bud med mthong zhon byed/ /sems chags sred sngar bas je cher song / /spyod 'di 'dra ding sang mang tsam mthong //don nyams len gnad du 'khel ba na/ /yul snang ba kun kyang bde bar 'char/ /sems chags zhen 'dzin rtog rang grol shar/ /de thabs lam gnad du song rtags yin/ /lar lta ba'i gdeng tshad gcig med na/ /las phal cher 'jig rten lam du 'gro/ /gnad man ngag rgyud la ma 'khel na/ /thabs phal cher 'khor ba'i rgyu ru 'gyur/ /lar ched du mi spang mi sgrub par/ / gang byung ba lam 'khyer gnad du che//kun zhen bral sgyu ma'i ngang du sbyong / /'di nyams len gnad yin thugs la zhog /lar lus ngag yid gsum bag yod dang / /phyi gdul bya'i dang ba 'dren pa dang / /nang dad ldan dkor zas 'ju ba dang / /gsang bstan pa'i mig rgyan phan thabs gsum/ /dus kun tu mdzad 'tshal thugs la bzung / /gnad zhal gdams mdor bsdus smras zin gyis/ /thugs gting la lhan ner spyod 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa mang yul gung thang rgyal khab khyung rdzong dkar po'i shar phyogs za 'og zhes/ rje mi la ras pa dang ras chung pa thog mar mjal ba'i gnas mchog der mdo khams kaḥ thog pa tshe dbang nor bus rang gi slob ma skyid grong gnas nub o rgyan gyi sgrub ba pa kun bzang chos dbyings dpal 'bar gyis bskul ngor me lug smin drug zla ba'i tshes bco brgyad kyi snga rtaḍi3 gang

dran smras pa'o/ /kwa ye/ snyan gson dang 'dir 'dus dad pa can/ /kun mi rtag sgyu ma'i tshul 'dir sems/ /dus deng sang snyigs dus las shugs kyi/ /las bsam zhing bsam zhing yi mug skye/ /lo re re song bzhin dus ngan 'gro/ /mtha' dmag 'khrug 'ur sgra 'brug las che/ /khral 'u lag mang po zad mtha' med/ /gcig gong na gcig btsan thams cad sdug /dus pham rgyal re dogs sdug bsngal che/ /rang dbang med gsos phrug dgra la 'thab/ /nor bsags pa sus spyod cha yang med/ /dpon mang po'i ngo 'dzin blo sems khol/ /phan re ba 'ga' yang gnod par 'gyur/ /mi btsan zhan mang po go ldog brjes/ /grogs yid mthun grogs med so sor bral/ /dpa' srog gi skyel so dgra la byed/ /las spyad tshad 'ga' yang sdig par 'gro/ /dus sang phod gnang phod bde re byas/ /de mi bde sngar bas je yang thu/ /tshe de dang sdug zad gyur nas 'chi/ /'chi bdud po'i zhags pas thebs tsam na/ /las brel bas bshol med ngang du 'gro/ /chos dran kyang sdod pa'i dbang mi thob/ /'chi tsher yang thabs med a tsa ma/ /bsam shes nas zas nor la zhen nas/ /thabs g.yo sgyu du mas bsags pa'i nor/ /dus de dus rang dbang 'khyer rgyu med/ /de bsam bzhin lha chos snying nas 'tshal/ /de snying rtse grogs 'khor gnyen 'brel rnams/ /'brel mi phod gcig sems gcig la chags/ /'chi babs tshe thabs med so sor 'brel/ /de bsam bzhin snying nas lha chos 'tshal/ /dus yud tsam bde ba rmi lam 'dra/ /de mi rtag skad cig nyid la 'gyur/ /da 'gyur med bde ba bsgrub 'dod na/ /chos yang dag bgyid na mi 'thad dam/ /da gson dang 'khor ba'i bya ba 'di/ /yun rtag thub gyur pa gcig kyang med/ /kun mi rtag 'chi ba nyid du 'gyur/ /de dran par shes na blo snying 'dar/ /rje bla ma mi rtag 'ja' yal 'dra/ /dpon srid 'dzin mi rtag na bun 'dra/ /nang nye 'brel tho rangs skar tshogs 'dra/ /nor longs spyod sbrang ma'i sbrang rtsi 'dra/ /stobs mnga' thang ston 'jug shing lo 'dra/ /tshe yud tsam bar snang glog dang 'dra/ /sems shing kha'i byi'u chung 'phur kha 'dra/ /dpe de 'dra'i mi rtag zad mtha' med/ /de bsam nas chos gcig snying nas 'tshal/ /las mi dge sdig pa dug ltar 'dzem / /las dge ba'i bya bar ci nus 'bungs/ /pha bla ma gtan gyi dpon por gyis/ /chos gdams ngag gtan gyi nor skal gyis/ /tshogs bsags khyab gtan gyi zhing skal gyis/ /byams snying rje gtan gyi sku mkhar gyis/ /chos 'jig rten bya ba gang la yang / /gzhung bzang zhing phyi thag ring ba dang / /khrel ngo tsha ldan zhing bag yod 'di/ /tshe 'di phyi'i kun spyod yang rab yin/ /khrel ngo tsha rna gzhung mi rtsi bzhin/ /brten mi thub bskyod kha sla ba dang / /dad mos gus 'gyur ldog rkyen pa ni/ /tshe 'di phyi kun hā1 rdor 'dre yin/ /mdor dril na dus rnams thams cad du/ /blo bslu med dkon mchog gsum la

gtod/ /rten 'di phyi'i skyabs gnas de rang bzang / /rje bla mar mos gus snying nas dril/ /las rgyu 'bras bslu med zhib tu rtsis/ /chos kun gyi rtsa ba rang rgyud thul/ /gnad phyin ci ma log dam tshig bsrungs/ /sems yengs med nyams len nan tan gyis/ /lar 'chi khar 'gyod pa med pa zhig /dus deng sang byas na mi legs sam/ /chos sang byed gnang byed mi tshe zad/ /rkyen de dbang ma shor chos la dril/ /lar mi rtag 'chi ba ma dran na/ /chos byed blo'i ngang du phyi bshol 'gro/ /don des na mi rtag dran par gyis/ /kun dam pa'i chos la 'bad 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa mang yul gung thang gi dben pa ga'u lha sdings su dad ldan rnams kyi bskul ngor mi rtag skyo shas bskyed pa'i glur mdo khams kaḥ thog gi char skyes shing phyogs kun nyul ba tshe dbang nor bus smras pa'o/ /e ma/ snyan gson dang tshe dbang nor bu lags/ /lus dal 'byor thob pa da res tsam/ /de snying po dam chos mi brtson par/ /las stong log phod dam snying nas bsam/ /da kho bo'i bslab bya snying khrag cig /bu khyod la bshad kyi yid la zungs/ /lus bag med ro nyal byas pa 'di/ /chos thar pa'i dgra bo 'di bas su/ /tshig bstod snyan dkor gyi 'du long 'di/ /lam dkar po'i lam gegs 'di bas su/ /tshe 'di snang kheng dregs chos bshad 'di/ /las log pa'i g.yang sa 'di bas su/ /rang skyid 'dod zhen pa che ba 'di/ /tshe stong zad bde dbyen 'di bas su/ /sems phyogs 'dzin chags sdang snang ba 'di/ /dmyal sdug bsngal sa bon 'di bas su/ /rang sems rgyud ma dul khengs pa 'di/ /dge sa bon bsreg me 'di bas su/ /gzhan rnams la zur za phrag dog 'di/ /gtan byus phung byur sri 'di bas su/ /grogs 'khor la zhen pa skye ba 'di/ /mchog bsgrub la bar chad 'di bas su/ /ja sha chang zhim zas sred pa 'di/ /gnas dben 'joms jag pa 'di bas su/ /sman sha mdzes gzugs la chags pa 'di/ /mar 'then pa'i gting rdo 'di bas su/ /nor zang zing gsog 'dod 'dzin pa 'di/ /bde bcom pa'i chom po 'di bas su/ /chos bshad mkhas rang rgyud ma dul 'di/ /rang rang gis mgo skor 'di bas su/ /tshig snyan snyan gnad thog ma khel 'di/ /don stong las mdo med 'di bas su/ /chos sang byed snang byed bshol ba 'di//bdud nag po'i bslu ba 'di bas su/ /gzhan ngo bsrung rang dbang ma thob 'di/ /rang rang 'ching zhags pa 'di bas su/ /kha chal chol bre mo rtse dga' 'di/ /'phags nor 'phrog rkun ma 'di bas su/ /sems ngang thung khong khro skye ba 'di/ /bzod 'jig byed phung 'dre 'di bas su/ /de kun ni chos kyi dgra bo ste/ /dgra de tshos 'phral du phan pa ltar/ /khyod mgo bo bskor ba ma shes te/ /dbang de la song ba ya re nga / /da mi rtag chos kyi bya byung bas/ /dgra de dag lag nas thar tsam zhig /dus da lta 'bad na ran te gda'/ /dus da lta nyid la ma 'bad na/ /las sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i btson dong du/ /lam ༵༵ yang

'khor ba'i zhags pas bsdams/ /rang bya byas mtshon chas glo snying 'bigs/ /skyabs mgon med gyur tshe ci drag phyis/ /don de bas da lta bros na thar/ /gnas ri sul dben pa'i btsan rdzongs su/ /khong skyabs gcig mtshan ldan bla ma bzhugs/ /dgra 'khor ba 'joms pa'i mtshon cha yod/ /rkyen dug lnga zhi ba'i bdud rtsi yod/ /sems sdug bsngal zhi ba'i dpa' bo mchis/ /dpung nyon mongs bcom pa'i go yang btsan/ /gnas de ru bros na de nas thar/ /bu khyod kyis nga yi tshig nyan na/ /dus da lta 'chi ba sgrub re ran/ /'chi thog babs nam yong cha med kyis/ /de dus su 'gyod med deng mdzad mtshal/ /zhes gung thang rgyal khab kyi shar phyogs ra la za 'og phug zhes rje btsun mi la'i sgrub gnas su me lug smin drug zla ba'i tshes bcu bdun skabs rang nyid skyo bas gsal byed til me'i mdangs la rang gi bslab bya gang dran smras pa lags/ bkra shis/ /a hoḥ tshe rabs kun tu bka' drin mtshungs med pha/ /sangs rgyas kun las lhag pa'i pad+ma 'byung / /dran zhing dbang med dad pa'i 'chi ma 'khrugs/ /dad pa can gyi bu la thugs rjes gzigs/ /skye ba kun tu skyong mdzad drin can ma/ /rgyal kun yum mchog ye shes mtsho rgyal dran/ /dran zhing dbang med dad pa'i 'chi ma 'khrug /dad pa can gyi bu la thugs rjes gzigs/ /dus kun 'brel zab bla med ston mchog pha/ /'gran bral lo tsā bai ro tsa na dran/ /dran zhing ྾ dad pa ྾ rang sems 'di nyid byin gyis brlabs pa'i pha/ /grub dbang gnubs ban nam mkha' snying po dran/ /rang gzhan don gnyis g.yel med grub pa'i pha/ /da lta sems nyid pad+ma nor bu dran/ /yang dag thar pa'i lam bzang ston pa'i pha/ /bslu med dran mchog dwangs ma bde gling dran/ /gegs sel sogs 'don snyan brgyud ston pa'i pha/ /mtshungs med bla ma gsung rab rgya mtsho dran/ /zhal mjal gsung thos dad pa thob pa'i pha/ /rgyal dbang dmar nag mchog sprul snying nas dran/ /chos med ser gzugs dred po snyoms las mkhan/ /dal 'byor stong log rta rgan bdag 'dra la/ /thugs rje gzigs shig 'phags mchog bla ma rnams/ /bdag ni las ngan dug lnga sgrom bu che/ /spyod kun 'khor ba ngan song rgyu ru 'phel/ /bya ba gang byas mi chos nyid dang 'dres/ /nyams rtogs rtsal kha rdzogs pa'i dus ma mchis/ /chos min rnam rtog je las je cher 'phel/ /bsam bzhin skyo ba snying gi dkyil nas skye/ /re dogs 'dzin pa 'di la ya re nga / /ma rig phra ba 'di la yi re mug /da ni dben pa'i ri sul snyeg re ran/ /las kyi skye mtha' tshe 'dir bcad re ran/ /bslu med rten 'brel bzang po sgrigs re ran/ /pad+ma'i bka' lung rten 'brel sgrigs re ran/ /rang la brtson pa'i lcags kyi bskul re ran/ /yengs med dge sbyor bzang po skyong re ran/ /'phags mchog gong ma'i zhabs drung skyongs re ran/ /don gnyis lhun grub da lta sgrub re ran/ /tshe dbang nor bu rang gros 'debs re ran/ /rang gros stong tshugs med pa spyod re ran/ /zhes mang yul gung thang smad ling ba brag dmar rdzong du don med pa~X ḍid skyo shas dang dga' bde gnyis ka 'phel zhing rang nyid skye ba phyi ma gar dang gar skye de dang tshul 'ga'

zhig yid la shar ba'i tshe tshe dbang nor bus me lug hor zla bcu pa'i tshes drug nub snang gsal mar me'i gdangs la gang dran bris pa legs so/ /bkra shis/a hoḥ snyan gson dang 'dir 'khod lha 'dre mi/ /sprang phyogs bral kho bo glu cig len/ /skyabs bla ma spyi bo'i gtsug tu bzhugs/ /glu mchod par 'bul lo byin gyis rlobs/ /e ma/ gnas ya la mtshan pa bal bod mtshams/ /ri gangs dkar rgyal mtshan 'phyar 'dra ba/ /khong srid pa'i lha chen gle ru zhes/ /rje o rgyan chen po'i dge bsnyen lags/ /de mdun ngos brag ri rdo rje spo/ /chab bdud rtsi chu mig brgya rtsa zhes/ /sgrub gnas mchog ngo mtshar gzi byin 'bar/ /gtetā zas chos mang po'i gzhugs gnas lags/ /'dir 'dus pa'i dad ldan pho mo rnams/ /sngon tshogs bsags las bzang bskal bar ldan/ /dngos rnam dkar chos la mos pa yi/ /rigs bzang ldan dpa' bo mkha' 'gro lags/ /mi ma yin lha 'dre'i tshogs rnams kyang / /sems byang chub bskyed pa'i sems dpa' ste/ /chos dkar phyogs skyong ba'i bsrung ma yin/ /don dpal chen yab yum sprul pa lags/ /mi kho yong o rgyan gu ru'i sras/ /bsam bzhin du gdul byar skye ba len/ /phyi gzhan ngor gang ltar snang yang rungs/ /don rang ngor bslu ba med snyam bde//chung dran nas sdug pa'i las la 'dzem/ /las dkar po'i dge la snying nas dad/ /rgyu 'bras la rtsis med ma byas te/ /rang bsam na 'gyod pa med pas bde/ /nar son nas o zob ma rgyang bar/ /rje skyes mchog mang po'i zhabs la gtugs/ /spyir mkhas grub bla ma bcu gsum mjal/ /rang bskal bzang gyur pa'i zhe blo bde/ /chos pom spor som nyir ma bzhag par/ /phyi sgra tshad rig gnas ma mkhas kyang / /sems gnas lugs phyag rdzogs nyams len don/ /dgongs mi mtho yang rang sems tshugs pas bde/ /gzhan gyur gyi bla tshul 'dzin pa 'ga'/ /bzang sa dang bslu mkhakhre ci mthong yang / /yid smon dang log lta gnyis ka med/ /rang nyid kyi rang sa zin pas bde/ /rang rgyal gyi rlom pa cher med kyang / /rgyan lhab lhub dang sal sil sgeg 'chos dang / /'khor zang zing gi bcos pa'i bla ma min/ /don gnyug ma'i rnal 'byor yin no bde/ /phyi yul snang kun chu nang zla ris bzhin/ /don bu chung gi sems 'dra dgod re bro/ /nang rtog tshogs kun gtad med sang ma sing / /sgom gnyis 'dzin gzeb na grol lo bde/ /ming snyan snyan gyi sgom ming ma thob kyang / /gnas 'gyu ba yi rang ngo dbyings su zhig /yul gzhi med rtsa bral du rang ngo shes/ /da gang byas kun dge sbyor klong gyur bde/ /lar chung nas skyid nyal ma byas te/ /skyabs rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam gnyis bsten/ /gsung bdud rtsi nges don nyams su len/ /tshig tha snyad la ma 'jal zhe blo bde/ /dus da lta yang rgyal khams 'grim pa 'di/ kha rgyab ma phyid nas 'gro ba min/ /lus snying po len phyir gnas rten mjal/ /yul bdud rtsi brten pa'i bya btang bde/ /gnas gang du song yang zhen ༵ ༵da / /

grogs su dang 'grogs kyang bde sdug chung / /lus skye 'chi gyur kyang ya nga srab/ /sprang stong nyid dbyings su thams cad bde/ /tshig de skad rbad shod che lags kyang / /dbyar rgyas pa'i spangs la ci yang skye/ /mi rnal 'byor nyams la ci yang 'char/ /nga rnal 'byor nyams kyi rgyang glu bde/ /mgu mi 'gug 'char kun ci dgyes mdzod/ /mi nga rang ni nam mkha'i rnal 'byor lags/ /zhes mang yul skyid grong gi sde mthar thug pa bal bod mtshams chu mig brgya rtsa me lug hor zla bzhi pa'i dmar phyogs tshogs 'khor skabs bskul ba po'i ngor rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu karma bstan pa mthar rgyas kyis glur smras pa'o/ /na mo gu ru we/ khyed 'dir 'dus mched lcam tshur gson dang / /sprang phyogs med tshe dbang nor bu bdag /sngon rnam dkar 'bras bu cung zad mthus/ /lus dal 'byor breng tsam 'di nyid thob/ /'on bag chags las bzang byed pa yi/ /chung ma las skyes pa'i rkan mar nas/ /dus da bar kha zas dkor la byus/ /de dran zhing glo snying dbang med 'dar/ /lar rang dbang chos la ma thob pa'i/ /las ci byed ngan 'gror 'phen pa'i rgyu/ /tshul mi chos bla ma'i gzugs brnyan mkhan/ /ming sprul skur btags pa'i skyag zan nga / /chos bshad bshad mang pos gzhan mgo bslu/ /tshul yin yin rlom pas rang don brlag /don bskyed rdzogs gdeng tshad ma lon pa'i/ /ming 'gro don btags pas rang gzhan phung / kha chos bshad mjos kyang sems dang 'dzol/ /blo chos la mos kyang g.yeng bas khyer/ /las bzang bsags spro yang ngan dbang che/ /tshul dge grub dad kyang sdig dang 'dres/ /tshe 'di la zhen pa med smra yang / /gting mtho dman chags sdang chu ltar 'khol/ /spyir chos brgyad bla gzugs bdag 'dra ba/ /rang skyon kun mi ro bzhin du sbed/ /gzhan skyon mthong lha dar bzhin du 'phyar/ /tshig snyan pos rang mgo rang gi bskor/ /sems mngon shes ma thob lung bstan sgrogs/ /zab gdams ngag mi chos ngo dga' bshad/ /rang nyams len rtog pa 'al 'ol la/ kha pho so rbad khog 'brug las che/ /tshul 'di sogs bya spyod mang po des/ /rang rang gis bslus pa mthong lags sam/ /lar gdan sa ming rtags dgon chung der/ /ming chung yang gnyen por sku skye btags/ /las don med rgyal khams dkor bslu bsdud/ /don che ba nyams len gal chung shor/ /chos zab dgu gdams ngag rgyang bor lus/ /goms zol zog kun gyi mthil la thug /tshul ma yin bya ba 'di dag mang / /de bsam zhing snying nas yi re mug /skye yul gyi mi chos rnam g.yeng de/ /gzhan yul du med snyam rgyal khams 'grim/ /ltogs 'khyag gi dka' ba khyad bsad kyang / /rten bzang dang bla ma mjal byas shing / /rnam dkar gyi smon lam thebs tsam las/ /sems nyid ni gyong por tho ma phog /mtho 'dod dang nga rgyal sngar las che/ /tshul mi 'chos sngar bas mkhas su song / /de bsam zhing snying swāsdu skyo shas ldang / /spyir gtam dper byi ba ma brjes na/ /khung brjes yang phan pa chung ngu zhes/ /

tshig de yi mdo don sems la phog /da chos cig snying nas byed snyam la/ /ming chos su btags mtshon chos gzugs dang / khar rtogs ldan smra ba'i stong sgra des/ /rang mgo bskor byas na dgos med mthong / /don yin lugs ma bcos cog bzhag la/ /sems gnas lugs rang ngo gcer la gtad/ /yul tshogs drug snang ba gtan la dbab/ /gzung 'dzin bral ku yang lhug pa'i ngang / /tshul mi chos dgos pa chung ngo bor/ /tshe 'di yi zhen pas bslus so bros/ /gnas dben pa ri khrod lung stong du/ /g.yeng dbang du ma shor chos la brtson/ /las rgyu 'bras 'i/ba tshags bag yod cing / /chos kun gyi srog rtsa dam tshig bsrung / /rje bla ma gang dgyes thabs la 'bad/ /ma 'gro drug yongs la snying rje bskyed/ /rang grogs med gcig pur nges don spyod/ /tshig nyal nyol gleng mol ring spang nas/ /don sems ngo nyams len nyid la dril/ /tshul de 'dra spyod pa'i yid smon cig /mi kho bo'i snying gi dkyil nas shar/ /de myur du 'grub pa'i smon lam 'debs/ /rang ngang tshul rang gi gleng 'di yis/ /mi kun kyang blo kha chos phyogs shor/ /zhes rje btsun mi la ras pa'i sgrub gnas rkyang 'phan nam mkha' rdzong du me lug hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bcu bzhi'i srod la mdun gral skabs su tshe dbang nor bus smras pa'o/ /a'u ye gson dang glu dbyangs la/ /'dir 'dus kyi khrom tshogs che phra tsho/ /rigs kun gyi khyab bdag 'od mi 'gyur/ /rgyal kun gyi ngo bo pad+ma 'byung gnas/ /snyigs dus su 'gro 'dren sprul pa'i sku/ /rje rgyal dbang karma yab sras dang / /zab gter ston rig grub rnams la 'dud/ /bu mos gus can la thugs rjes gzigs/ /deng mdo khams kaḥ thog char skyes pa'i/ /sprang rgyal khams 'khyams pa'i rnal 'byor gzugs/ /ming kun btags tshe dbang nor bu'i sdes/ /glu shugs byung sgro bskur bral ba'i gtam//zog 'chal tshig slad med drang por brjod/ /thugs g.yon por gyur rnams bzod par mdzod/ /bdag chos sku ye shar mi gcig la/ /mi rnams kyi snang ba sna tshogs shar/ /khong la las rgyal ba'i sprul par mthong / /phyag thal sbyor zhal mjal sus thob byed/ /khong la las mi sdug than du mthong / /sna lag pas 'gab cing 'phrad lam byol/ /khong la las dge sbyor bzang por mthong / /yid gus pas skyabs 'jug bsngo 'brel zhu/ /khong la las dkor zan khram par mthong / /sgo bsod snyoms song yang phyir ltas med/ /khong la las nus ldan sngags par shes/ /bka' lha srin bsrung ba'i spring yig zhu/ /khong la las sngags gsar mthu med mthong / /las mi mtshams brnyas bcos sna tshogs byas/ /khong la las thabs lam mkhan du mthong / /tshogs kun tu rgyu yi dga' ston phul/ /khong la las khrel med ya yor mthong / /rkang zur 'gros mig log khrel rgod byed/ /khong la las 'brel tshad don ldan mthong / /sgo gsum gyi gus pas zhabs tog byed/ /khong la las 'dre phung zog por mthong / /phye khyom bu gang yang shor dogs byetā1/9/khong

la las rtogs ldan rnal 'byor mthong / /nyams gegs sel bogs 'don bslab bya zhu/ /khong la las bsgom gsar tha mar mthong / /tshur chos bshad nang rgyas 'brug ltar ldir/ /khong la las pad 'byung sras su mthong / /yid rtse gcig mi phyogs blo gtad byed/ /khong la las rdzun rkyal mkhan du mthong / /tshig bden par brjod kyang log par rtogs/ /de la sogs rang rang las dbang gis/ /'gro so so'i mthong snang brjod mtha' med/ /khong la las mi bzang po yin 'dra zer/ /khong la las mi zog po yin thag bcad/ /khong la las 'di ni rdzus ma yin/ /don yang na bzang la yang na ngan/ /'di lha bdud gang rung yin nges zhes/ /gtam phyogs bcur dril du sgrog thos te/ /'di thag chod ha cang che grags rung / /mtsho chen pos ca co sgrogs min te/ /lung dog po'i chu phran ku co che/ /dpe de bsam rang 'drar gad mo shor/ /spyir shākya thub pad 'byung mnyam ma gtogs/ /phal gang zag tshod 'dzin gang zag min/ /rang bzang ngan rang gi cha med bzhin/ /gzhan tshod 'dzin byed 'di gad mo shor/ /'on dag ni lha bdud gnyis kar rung / /khong dag snang ldan chos bla mar mthong / /gshis log lta log 'tshos bdud du mthong / /phal kun gyi snang ngor so so skye/ /rang rang la ltas kyang de dang 'dra/ /tshul bsam bzhin bsam bzhin mgo bo 'khor/ /bdag rgyal khams sprang po yin lags kyang / /yul gcig tu grong grags re gnyis kyi/ /stabs legs nas bkur ba'i khengs pa med/ /de rtogs pas grol ba ma lags te/ /chung so bzhi bzung nas da bar du/ /mi rang thad che gnyan 'ga' dang 'grogs/ /don des na gsar du khengs rgyu chung / /mi mang pos bshad bkur btab na yang / /tshe 'di zhen phra bas da ya chung / /spyir bstod smad tshig kun brag cha 'dra/ /spang blangs kun rnam rtog rang grol la/ /blo bcos ma'i spun thag chad nas tshar/ /lar rnal 'byor phran chung zog rgan bdag /yul rang yul gzhan yul gar phyin kyang / /phyi gzhan ngor mdzes chas yang ma bsgrigs/ /lkog bag yang spyod ngan yang ma byas/ /ngos lkog mtshungs tshul spyod lhug pa la/ /rang ma khrel tsam byas sos dal bde/ /mtshams bsnyen bsgrub dka' spyad byas tshul dang / /sdom btsun tshig ngom rgyu ma mchis kyang / /rje rgyal ba'i bstan la rjes 'jug tshig /kho 'gro la phan thabs ma gtogs pa/ /mi gzhan snang bslu ba'i kha mkhas dang / /tshig mdzes mdzes mi chos 'bad ma myongs/ /sems rang nyid che 'dod bskur 'dod sogs/ /tshe 'di snang zhen pa chen po che/ /lar chung nas dam pa'i chos dang mjal/ /rje mtshungs med bla ma'i rjes su bzung / /bka' phyag rdzogs gdams pa'i nying khu thob/ /sems rang ngo bcu gsum lo la 'phrod/ /nyams 'dra min gol pas ma bslus te/ /rig dran shes ngo bor rdo rus brtug /nga yin snyam rlom pas ma khyer te/ /phyogs kun 'khyams bla ma gang snyed bsten/ /rang che 'dod ang rdo~X ma byas shing / kha pho zob stong skad ma sgrags par/ /rang shar cha nyams len rdzun med thim/ /

yul zhu 'os kun la bka' 'dri zhus/ /dus da ltar the tshom cher med kyang / /yul zhu 'os mchis na zhu snying 'dod/ /phyi thos bsam mtha' rgya chod dka' yang / /don gcig shes kun grol rang sems gnad/ /sgom nyams rtogs sems la gang 'phel byas/ /da go myong cung zad sems la chags/ kha mkhas mdzangs mi chos ma 'byor yang / /las rgyu 'bras rang ma khrel tsam byas/ /tshul zhi zhing dul dul ma 'byong yang / //sems bsam bzang breng tsam ma chad byas/ /chos kun srog rtsa ba'i dam tshig kyang / /rang sems la ngos lkog med nges la/ /spyir bla ma lnga phrag drug tsam bsten/ /kun dam tshig sel med thugs yid 'dres/ /sgos rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam gsum gyi/ /thugs gting nas gces pa'i thugs sras mdzad/ /khyod rang don grub ces dbugs byung zhing / /da gzhan don gyis zhes gzengs yang bstod/ /spyir skyes mchog gter grub tshad ldan 'ga'/ /las skal mchog ldan zhes bsngags par gnang / /mi rang yang bla mar snying dkyil nas/ /dad gus dang dam tshig bsrung ba'i mthus/ /khong mi min mkha' 'gro ngang gis 'du/ /'dre lha srin 'ga' yang nus pas btul/ /don des na rlung zhags ma bkol yang / /yul gar phyin mi kun nga la mos/ /'brel tshad ni don dang ldan dka' yang / /gang 'brel kun chos la blo kha bsgyur/ /rang 'dod ni ha cang che ba med/ /gzhan phan gyi smon lam gang zab btab/ /lar sgro bskur bral ba'i gtam 'chad la//mi kha cig rang bstod byas snyam khrel/ /nga rang bstod dgos pa'i do gal chung / /tshe 'di yi kha rgyab nam yang phyid/ /bstod snyan grags e yong re ba chung / /dkor 'ju dka' zhen pa gting nas log /rang rang bstod gzhan bslu de mi dgos/ /lar rang 'dod ma dgos tsam zhig bdog /pha rje btsun bla ma'i bka' drin las/ /tshe 'di snang sgyu ma lta bur rtogs/ /bstod snyan grags brag cha lta bur go/ /chos bden med rmi lam lta bur rtogs/ /kun gzhi med rtsa bral rang sems mthong / /las rgyu 'bras bslu med nyid go bas/ /tshul mi chos rdzun ni smra dgos med/ /sgro bskur bral gtam ni rgyal bas gnang / /don des na shugs 'byung glu dbyangs 'di/ /mi 'ga' mi las ngan spang phyir smras/ /rang mngon shes rnam lnga ma thob bar/ /gzhan bzang ngan thag chod smra mi 'tshal/ kha 'jam 'jam gzhan ngor mdzes cha la/ /gting bsgom chung khyad bsod mi mdzad zhu/ /mi kho bo cha ni ci dga' smros/ /tshig de 'dras phan don go ba bral/ /yid mi dga' ba yang cher med kyang / /gzhan sbas tshul gsang sngags rnal 'byor la/ /bkur grags na rang nyid dmyal bsgrub yin/ /don des na smyon pa'i 'chal glu 'di/ /thugs khong khro med par dang bzhes 'tshal/ /zhes brkyang phan nam mkha' rdzong du gnas skabs mang yul gnas shar gyi mi 'ga' zung gi kho bo la 'di phal pa ni min 'dra lha bdud gang rung zhig yin 'dug zhes dril sgrogs tshe/ a a snying re rje snyam nas mdo khams kaḥ thog pa lha btsun tshe dbang nor bus hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bcu bdun la der 'dus rnams la smras pa ho ho phaṭa/ lnga pa las 'phros pa'i tshigs bshad kha shas glur blangs ba rang lugs gsal ba'i lam ston zhes bya ba yod/ / 321

na mo pad+ma kā ra ya/ bde chen 'khor lor mos pa'i rang gzugs las/ /legs skyes ge sar 'dab ma 'bum ldan dbus/ /'khor 'das brtan g.yo kun gyi bcud dang mgon/ /mtsho skyes rdo rjes bdag blo rtag skyong mdzod/ /bdag ni dal 'byor rten thob mtshan ldan gyis/ /bla mas rjes bzung zab dgu'i gdams ngag thos/ /de mthus bdag blo dman yang mdo rgyud kyis/ /nges don ma nor blor chud phyag rdzogs kyis/ /dgongs pa ji bzhin smra bar spobs pa 'di/ /khyab bdag bla ma'i drin las gzhan ci zhig /bka' drin snying nas dran no bla ma che/ /glu dbyangs mchod par 'bul lo gu ru je/ /rnal 'byor bdag nyid nyams la 'di ltar snang / /phyi rol yul du btags pa'i bem po dang / /bdag nyid sems su btags pa'i shes pa yang / /gcig dang tha dad brtag pa'i rmongs pa 'khrul/ /gcig kyang chos nyid gnyis kyang chos nyid dang / /de yang chos nyid de min chos nyid ste/ /gdod ma'i gshis la thams cad cha mnyam zhing / /cha med kun 'gro snar tshogs khyab pa po/ /sems dang sems byung rnam rtog rtag btags pas/ /rtag pa'i rgyu zad mi rtag don kyang ci/ /ngo bo 'gyur med rnam pa thams cad pa/ /gzhan ltos bu la tshe 'di rmad du byung / /bzung 'dzin kun btags rang gi ngo bos stong / /rnam shes gzhan dbang mthar thug 'bras bu stong / /yongs grub chos nyid spros pa mtha' yis stong / /stong pa'i tshul 'di nges don mthar thug bzhed/ /tshul 'di rtog ge'i nga rgyal khregs po dang / /spom yor che tshul 'dzin 'ga'i blor ma shongs/ /'khor lo rnam gsum dgongs pa gcig dril zhing / /nges don mthar thug 'khor lo mtha' ma'i don/ /rang rig rang gsal gzhi med spros bral ba/ /'di ko lta ba'i mthar thug nyid du go/ /tshul de thun mong lam gyis bsgom pa la/ /gangs can phyogs 'dir phyag rgya che zhes grags/ /don de thun mong ma yin zab mo'i gnad/ /lta ba gtan phab bsgom pa la bzlo na/ /gcer mthong cog bzhag gnad kyi che rtsa 'di/ /rdzogs chen khreg chod yin ces kho bos smra/ /kye ho sgyu ma'i grogs po tshur nyon dang / /snang ba 'al 'ol 'di la gtad pa ci/ /yul du bden pa 'dzin na 'khrul pa'i blo/ /yul min sems su rlom pa 'dzin pa'i yid/ /de don brtag dpyad byed kun kun brtags sems/ /de bral 'char gzhi tsam 'di rnam shes te/ /rnam par shes dang ye shes khyad par ni/ /sman dang dug 'dra sprin dang nam mkha' 'dra/ /gser dang g.ya' 'dra 'dam dang nor bu 'dra/ /rnam shes ye shes dbye la mkhas dgos zhes/ /gangs can 'di na mkhas pa'i mkhas pa mchog /dri med 'od zer rton pa bzhi ldan dang / /rang byung zhabs dang sgrol ba'i mgon sogs kyis/ /gsung 'di dpyod ldan rnams kyis go lags sam/ /don de ma 'khrul rgyal ba'i dgongs bzhed mthil/ /yin pa nges don mdo rgyud gzigs lags sam/ /mi tshe yud tsam tshong khe'i sdu 2༵ sogs/ /cung zad re la'ang rtog dpyod cher bcug na/ /tshe rabs gtan gyi 'dun ma dam

chos kyi/ /'jug sgo ma nor dpyad pa cis mi bcug /bdag lta rmongs zhing 'khrul pas zin na'ang / /sngon bsags smon lam rnam dkar ci bsags pa/ /de yi nges don snying po'i chos dang mjal/ /yid ches der zhugs rang la dga' ba skyes/ /mkhas 'ga' lta ba yan lag yin smra yang / /pad 'byung bi ma la dang bai ro sogs/ /sangs rgyas dngos byon 'ga' yi theg pa'i khyad/ /lta bas dbye gsung bdag ni de rjes 'brang / kha cig dbu ma las lhag lta ba med/ /sgrogs kyang theg chen lta ba dbyer med na/ /sems tsam dbu ma'i lta ba dbye don ci/ /dbu ma yin phyin khyad par med lags na/ /rang rgyud thal 'gyur dbye ba ci phyir mdzad/ /spros med tsam gyi lta ba'i mthar thug na/ /rang rgyud pa las thal 'gyur ci zhig lhag /des na lta ba thal 'gyur las lhag pa/ /med khyab 'di'ang skyo ma snga btsan go/ /des na rang lugs thal 'gyur las lhag pa'i/ /lta ba mdo lugs rnam rig dbu ma dang / /sngags kyi mthar thug lta ba rdzogs pa che/ /spros bral yin yang spros pa bral ba'i gzhi/ /ji bzhin yang dag gnad la bsnun pas so/ /des na rnam rig sems tsam yin bzung dang / /rdzogs chen lta bar khyad chos med sems rnams/ /da dung rnam dpyod spyan ras bzang po de/ /yar la spang blangs rgyal bka' mdo rgyud gzhung / /gzigs nas lam bzang 'di la 'jug mdzod kye'i/ /bdag ni shes pa chung zhing rmongs lags kyang / /rgyal ba'i bka' la yid ches gyur pa yi/ /tshul 'di gzhan gyi nam yang mi phyed pa'i/ /chos kyi rjes 'brang dad pa brtan po yod/ /des na rang dang rigs skam mthun pa rnams/ /dga' ba skyes phyir gtam du smras pa la/ /ma 'khrul lta ba'i gnas lugs de go yang / /rtogs byed sgom pa'i lam la 'bad kyang rigs/ /bsgom gyi rtsa ba bla ma'i byin rlabs te/ /'jug thabs mos gus gnad du bsnun yang 'tshal/ /rang la bka' drin che ba'i bla ma de/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun las lhag go zhes/ /rgyud sde kun nas mgrin gcig dbyangs gcig tu/ /gsungs pa 'di la yid ches byed kyang 'tshal/ /ji srid rnam par rtogs pa yod kyi bar/ /las kyi 'bras bu dag kyang skyed nus pas/ /rgyu 'bras 'dor mod gnad ma 'chug par/ /rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin tshul ldan spyod yang 'tshal/ /drod thob tsha na sngags kyi spyod pa yis/ /rim gnyis gong 'phel byed pa rmad byung yang / /de srid bar du 'dul ba dang bstun nas/ /gsang sngags gsang ste spyod pa ngo mtshar che/ /mdor na rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig gis/ /gtan phur btsugs pa bla ma'i gsol 'debs dang / /stong nyid lta ba gzhan stong snying rje mchog zung du 'brel bas bsod nams bsags pa'i las cher 'bad rgyal ba kun gyi gshegs shul yin/ /de skad rab byung nyi ma'i shing yos lor/ /pad+ma'i sbas yul mchog gyur 'bras ljongs byang / /'bri mtshams zhes grags dben gnas gsang sngags rir nag zla'i tshes pa bcu gnyis dus bzang por/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus smras pa yis/ yig rigs dge slong 323

kun bzang gzhan phan no/ /'dis kyang 'gro kun ma nor theg chen lam/ /bzang por 'jug pa'i rgyu ru grub gyur cig /nyams len snying po zhal gdams snying khug dwangs ma'i shog dril mgul khug ma yod/ chig chog ri chos zab/ bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i zhabs pad du/ /rtag tu phyag byas de yi gsang ba'i don/ /rang gi go myong dang bstun man ngag gnad/ /snying khrag thig pa lta bu 'dir ston no/ /rgyal chos bye brag grangs med kun 'dus so/ /rang rig ngo rtogs sangs rgyas thabs yin no/ /de thabs mchog ni dbu phyag rdzogs pa che/ /yang zhun rdzogs chen nyid do ngo mtshar che/ /de don mdor dril lta bsgom spyod 'bras bzhi/ /nyams len sbyor ba 'khor bar yid sun nas/ /nges 'byung bsam pas skyabs sems tshogs bsags dang / /sgrib sbyang khyad par bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'bad/ /dngos gzhi bsgom thog lta ba ngos bzung ste/ /bsgom pa'i ngo bo khreg chod yin no kye/ /khregs chod ngo bo ka dag ye shes te/ /nyams su len pa'i thog mar bzhag thabs ni/ /'khor bar snang ba phyi nang phra rags kyi/ /'gyu rtog nyid dang mi rtog gnas pa dang / /sems nyid gzung 'dzin blo yi brtag gzhib dang / /bcas bces dgag sgrub gang yang ma byed kyi/ /rang gi rang sgrib gser nyid g.ya' yi sgrib/ /dwangs pa'i chu bo gzo byas snyogs mas sgrib/ /rang rig ngo bo glo bur sems kyis sgrib/ /gnyug ma'i ngo bo gzung 'dzin bcos mas bslad/ /kye ho/ rang byung gdod nas ka dag rdzogs pa che/ /glo bur dri bral rang bzhin ngo bo'i gshis/ /'di la dpe mtshon rtag dpyad tshig gi yul/ /ma yin yin no mtha' dang bral lo kye/ /mi rtog gnas pa sgrub dang de nyid gshis/ /gang yang dri ma yin no ci gnas chug /'gyu ba rtog tshogs dgag dang de 'phro thud/ /gang yang rnam rtog yin no rang thog lhod/ /dus gsum dus med rtog pa'i ngo bo 'di/ /sngar 'das rtogs pa'i 'phro rjes la ma zhen/ /phyis 'byung rnam rtog mang pa'i sngon ma bsu/ /da lta'i rtog par brtag dpyad bcos slad spang / /rnam rtog ma dgag gu yangs klong du zhog /rnam rtog ma grub rang ngo nyid la ltos/ /the tshom ma byed gang shar gding nged thong / /blo yis ma bzo ci shar nyid du zhog /zhog ces ched gnyer med do ci bder chug /yan zhes phul so med do lhan ne zhog /yengs med rang rig ngo bos rtag tu 'tsho/ /bsgom med shar grol khyab brdal yan mdzod kye/ /hai/ bsgom med bsgom pa'i ngo bo de 'chad tshe/ /bag med 'khrul dbang thun mtshams ma shor bar/ /mnyam rjes chig dril kun bzang ye shes che/ /zang thal ka dag nyid la rtag gnas mdzod/ /gser gling sa rdo phal pa mi nus bzhin/ /gang shar chos sku'i ngang du rtogs gyis shig /gnyen po med kyang rdo rje'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /phra rags dri kun 'joms par mdzod do kye/ /༵ ༵/ lta ba yid dpyod las 'das rdzogs pa che/ /lhun grub thod brgal snang ba de ltos shig /

rdo rje lus kyi rten 'brel bzhugs stangs gsum/ /gang rung 'am ni gtso bo'i drang srong stangs/ /ma 'gul kha snang rlung stel dal byas te/ /mig zim dbyings 'od stong pa thig le dang / /shes rab rang byung sgron mdangs rdo rje sems/ /lug rgyud shel lam mu tig 'phreng ba'am/ /rta rnga'i mdud 'dra 'gro 'ong ldan pa de/ /dus gsum rgyal ba yongs kyi zhal yin gyis/ /de mthong de ni sangs rgyas yongs kyi sras/ /yin zhes kun bzang rdo rje'i ljags kyis gsungs/ /des na de la rtag tu ma yengs ltos/ /blta bya blta byed gcig min gnyis kyang min/ /ma bzung ma 'dzin brtag dpyad mang ma byed/ /snang yul nyid la ched du ma zhen la/ /ched du ma glod gu yangs blo bde'i ngang / /rang bab rang gshis der stos ngo mtshar kye/ /khregs chod ma rtogs snang yul 'ja' 'od la/ /ched du 'thas na gzugs khams sa bon dang / /mtshungs zhes kun tu bzang pos rgyud du gsungs/ /zhen med snang ba 'di ni ye shes te/ /kun bzang gdod ma'i sangs rgyas de nyid kyi/ /thugs kyi rang mdangs 'di yin e ma kye/ /de ltar thod brgal nyams su len pa la/ /mi 'gul gsum gyi gzhi bcas sdod pa gsum/ /tshad du bzung bas rim bzhin ye shes la/ /gom tshod snang ba bzhi ru 'char ba ste/ /mdor dril snang sems lus ngag yid kyi rtags/ /ci byung chos nyid rol rtsed nyid shes nas/ /bzang por dga' ba ma byed seng nger glod/ /ngan par sdang ba ma shar 'phyal mer zhog /rtag tshad re dogs med pa khyab brdal ngang / /nyams len le lor ma shor dril gyis shig /btang pas mi 'gro bzung pas mi zin pa/ /'di la btang bzung byed par rlom pa ni/ /blun las ches blun rig pa rang bab ngang / /rig mdang lug brgyud brtson du da bzung cig /gnad 'di lta ba thod brgal yong zab don/ /yin pas rab tu gces pas nyams su longs/ /spyad pa bla med thabs lam zung 'jug chos/ /zab lam gtum mo'i gdams pa 'dir ston nyon/ /rang lus mi dmigs rten brten stong pa'i ngang / /skad cig rnam pa chos 'byung o rgyan yul/ /dbus su e dmar pad nyi baṃ ro'i steng / /a las phag mar khro mo'i chas rdzogs pa/ /g.yas g.yon gri thod zhabs gnyis gar stabs rol/ /lus nang stong ra dar dmar gur phub 'dra/ /dbus su rtsa mchog dbu ma shel spub ltar/ /mtshan nyid bzhi ldan g.yas g.yon ro rkyang zung / /mar sna lte 'og gnyer nas dbu mar chud//dbu ma'i yar sne tshang bug ro rkyang sna/ /'khor lo bzhi bcas gsal snang 'dus gsum kha/ /lte 'og sor bzhir nyi steng bla ma dang / /dbyer med ram dmar me 'bar yid gtad ngang / /bla mar gsol btab gnad ldan rlung dgu 'bud/ /dal rngub dar gcig lhod bzhag slar rngub 'dod/ /shar tshe rngub chung bsnan bcas lte 'og bsnan/ /ro rkyang nas brgyud dbu mar rlung zhugs pas/ /ram las me 'bar lte ba'i rtsa 'dab gang / /rim bzhin goms nas gsang gnas snying ga khengs/ /bsam byas 'pho skor ñtshaspya skor

skabs skabs bya/ /mi thub snyam tshe mig zim rigs pa nyid/ /lte 'og la gtad rlung dor lhag med bud/ /de ltar rngub sgang bzhil 'bud sbyor ba bzhi/ /gsung pa rlung sgang mi thub pa snyam tshe/ /ba spu'i bu ga khrol tshag ltar bsam nang / /rlung rnams sngo thul song dmigs lus 'dar bton/ /de nas 'bud bya rlung sgang ran tshod gces/ /'di dus 'khrul 'khor yan lag lnga sbyang ni/ /rtsa mdud grol phyir 'bad gces gsung pas bya/ /de la sgom nas ye shes gtum mo ni/ /lte 'og a shad me yi spyi bo ru/ /zla ba ham mgo thur stan drod kyi zhu/ /bdud rtsi babs pa me dang bros ded mthar/ /snying kar 'dres te rim bzhin byang sems rgyas/ /mgrin snying lte gsang 'khor lo rtsa 'dab gang / /dmigs gnad dga' bzhi ngos bzung yas brtan brtag /slar zlog rig pa spyi bo'i mkha' la gtad/ /sbyor ba drug gi 'dren byas mas stan dga'//'khor lo bzhir myong dud 'gro 'gyur bzhi yi/ /tshang pa'i sar skyal seng rol chos 'byung gis/ /bkram byas khu tshur zug pas rtsa mig gdab/ /de nas bde stong chos nyid klong yangs su/ /dmigs brjod zhen bral ngang lhod 'di ni bsngags/ /thabs lam rtsa ba bogs 'don spyod gtso yin/ /de bas thun mong thun min spyod pa ni/ /kun dar kun bzang brtul zhugs rnam rgyal spyod/ /gang zag dbang rim gsum mthun tshogs dben spyod/ /mdor dril phyi ltar tshangs spyod 'dul khrims bstun/ /nang ltar sems bskyed snying rje gtso bor 'don/ /gsang ba thabs lam gsang sngags zab mor spyod/ /kun kyang tho co bag med rtsing spyod dang / /grags snyan lo 'dod rgyu min zhen bral ngang / /rang gi rang ma bslu ba'i gdeng ldan ngang / /bag yod rgyal bas gsung mthun don la spyod/ /e ma 'bras bu zhes grags sgra chen de/ /sngar med gzhan nas byung ba zhig min kye/ /kun rdzob glo bur dri ma rang sangs ste/ /rang rig sgrib bral mthong la 'bras bur btags/ /'khrul pa sangs tshe sku dang ye shes rgyas/ /de las sangs rgyas zhes su brjod pa ste/ /brtson 'grus ldan pas rdzogs chen nyams blang mthar/ /re dogs 'phrang las grol tshe 'bras bu yin/ /de ltar lta bsgom spyod 'bras mdor dril na/ /lta ba rgya mtsho nang gi gza' skar ltar/ /der 'dzin shes pa rtsis gdab bral bar zhog /bsgom pa nam mkha' yangs pa'i klong bzhin du/ /phyogs ris blos byas bsgom dang bral bar zhog /spyod pa sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i 'phrul 'khor bzhin/ /zhen bral rang babs bags yang ngang du zhog /'bras bu ri bo chen po ji bzhin du/ /gong bgrod ltos gzhi re dogs med par zhog /gsang sngags chos kun rtsa ba byin rlabs yin/ /byin rlabs bla mar rag las mos gus gces/ /theg chen bzhi yin gzhan phan sems bskyed gces/ /chos kyi srog yin sdom dang dam tshig gces/ /bstan pa'i gzhi yin tshogs gnyis zung 'jug gces/ /chos kyi lam grogs brtson 'grus snying rus gces/ /kye ma spyir yang chos bzhin spyod pa la/ /dam tshig mi bsrung sangs rgyas re ba ni/ /sol ba phyi brdar byas nas 326

dung 'od bral/ /rgyu 'bras mi bsrung byang chub thob 'dod ni/ /bye ma bcir nas mar khu 'dod pa 'dra/ /bla ma ma dgyes dge ba gang sgrub kun/ /sa bon me la bsreg pa'i ljang bu 'dra/ /de bas rtag tu bla mar gus gyis shig /de ltar zhal gdams tshul 'di rang 'dra ba'i/ /blo rmongs nyams myong dman la phan snyam phyir/ /rgyal bka' grub thob zhal lung khyad par du/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i gsung gi man ngag nyid/ /rang gi nyams su myong ba dang bstun nas/ /smra las mi shes mkhas 'dod tshe 'di yi/ /bstod snyan grags pa sgrub pa'i ched du min/ /'di ltar ston la gtan tshigs lung dang ni/ /man ngag che ba'i tshig tshogs mang po zhig /brjod par yi ger 'jigs pas ma smras shing / /spyir yang nyams su ma blangs tshig skam po/ /'brug stong ldir yang 'chi dus stong skad yin/ /nyams len mthun na rgyal gsung tshig res mchog /rgyal ba'i gsung chos rgya mtsho lta bu la/ /blo rmongs bdag gi tshig gi ci zhig bya/ /'on te bskul ngo ma cog tsam 'di smras/ /'di ni ji bzhin nyams len bu re las/ /'phyar chos byed na de srog ma dam gzab/ /rol mdzod badz+ra sa ma ya gnyag rigs rnal 'byor ma nam mkha' ye shes gsal sgron gyi ngor dam dzaḥnyams len bu la rtag tu grogs mdzod cig /zhes mdo khams kaḥthog lho phyogs stag su'i yul du skyes pa'i lha rigs rngu yi rnal 'byor tshe dbang nor bus shing sbrul hor zla bcu pa'i tshes nyer dgur bod yul gyi rdo rje gdan bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun grub kyi gtsug lag khang shar 'jam dpal gling ga la ba der sbyar ba'i yig ris o rgyan blo gros dbang pos bgyis pa dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /mang yul sa'i thig le skyid grong 'phags pa wa ti'i spyan sngar sngags 'chang tshe dbang nor bu'i nyams myong rtogs pa skyes pa maṇ+ḍal tshul du sgro bskur dang bral ba'i glu phul ba snyan pa'i tardzu ra seng ge'i rgyud kyi sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /sarba maṅga lo bha waskyo/bde chen 'khor lo'i chu skyes 'dab stong dbus/ /rang rig dran mchog dwangs ma'i mgon po che/ /skye 'gag gnas bral slob dpon pad+ma 'byung / /bde ba chen po gsung rab rgya mtshor 'dud/ / 1bka' drin mtshungs med rdo rje slob dpon gyi/ /byin rlabs snying la cha shas zhugs pa'i mthus/ /man ngag nyams myongs glu ru blangs bgyi yi/ /chos bsrung ḍā ki'i tshogs kyi gnang ba stsol/ / 2 sangs rgyas kun gyi rgyud la mngon gyur zhing / /sems can rnams kyi rgyud la yongs khyab pa/ /rnal 'byor nyams la snang ba'i nyams len te/ /kun gzhi bde gshegs snying po de la 'dud/ / 3 rig 'dzin gong ma'i thugs mtshor nyer rol zhing / /bdag blor cha shas shar ba'i ye shes de/ /bdag min nam mkha'i mtha' klas 'gro kun dang / /bdag gi brgyud 'dzin slob ma brgyud bcas shing / / 4 mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba mtha' dag pa'i/ /rgyud la ji bzhin 'char ba'i dge legs stsal/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa grub mtha' rnam pa bzhi/ /theg dman lam la bye smra mdo sde gnyis/ / 5 rnam pa shes pa tha dad bye brag pa/ /༵shā shes

dbyer med smra ba'i mdo sde pa/ /de bzhin theg chen lam la gnyis yin te/ /rnam shes bden grub 'dod pa'i sems tsam pa/ / 6 rnam shes bden med 'dod pa'i dbu ma pa/ /mthar thug dbu ma chen po la yang gnyis/ /dang po 'khor lo bar pa nges don gyi/ /dgongs don thal 'gyur ngo bo nyid med smra/ / 7gnyis pa 'khor lo tha ma nges don gyi/ /mthar thug rnam rig chos nyid yongs grub bstan/ /dbu ma'i mthar thug 'khor lo gsum pa'i don/ /yin zhes rgyal mchog dri med 'od zer sde/ / 8 kun mkhyen dol po rton pa bzhi ldan dang / /rang byung rdo rje bu ston rin chen grub/ /rje btsun chen po tā ra nā tha sogs/ /mkhas mchog thun min mang po'i bzhed gzhung yin/ / 9 des na rnam rig dbu ma chen po yi//bzhed pa rgyu yi skabs su bde gshegs snying / /snang srid snod bcud yongs la 'dus ma byas/ /chos dbyings rang bzhin gdod nas khyab par 'dod/ / 10 lam gyi skabs su mtshan nyid rnam pa gsum/ /gtan phab ye shes dbyings la sbyang bar 'dod/ /'bras bu'i skabs su yongs grub chos kyi sku/ /glo bur dri ma'i skyon dang bral bar 'dod/ / 11 de yang gzung 'dzin rnam shes yul gzhan stong / /rig rgyun chos sku rtag pas gzhan stong brjod/ /mdor ni sangs rgyas mthar thug chos kyi sku/ /shes bya kun khyab 'gro kun mgon bcud du/ / 12 rgyu 'bras ma yin chos dbyings spros bral bzhugs/ /de yod 'khor 'das 'byung bas kun gzhir grags/ /de mdangs 'khor ba'i chos dang 'dzom la lam/ /zer te de lta'ang de yi 'khor ba spangs/ / 13 gang zag 'khrul zad sangs rgyas 'khrul spangs tshe/ /gang zag nyid kyang spangs te snga ma'i shugs/ /gnas 'gyur ye shes sangs rgyas skyes bur brjod/ /rig pa lam gzhan dang 'dres dbyings gcig 'dod/ / 14 de ni mdo chos grub mtha'i rtse mor bzhed/ /bla med sngags rgyud don la shin tu 'byor/ /des na blo ngan rtog tshogs kun spangs nas/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras kun gyi snying po'i lam/ / 15 kun mkhyen chos rje jo nang yab sras kyi/ /lta ba'i lam 'dir tshe rabs thams cad du/ /'jug cing de yi bstan la bya ba mchog/ /byed par smon lam snying gi dkyil nas 'debs/ / 16 yang cig bod yul gangs ri'i 'dzin ma 'dir/ /tha mal shes pa zhes pa'i sgra bo che/ /phyag rgya chen por brjod pa'i grub pa'i mtha'/ /lha rje dwags po'i bka' brgyud chos kyi srol/ / 17 rgya chen gting zab 'chad tshul mang na yang / /dpal ldan sgrub brgyud stod 'brug rgod tshang pa yab sras/ smar kam gyi sman tshang pa'i lugs/ kam tshang snyan brgyud lugs/ chu bo gcig 'dres bdag blor cung 'bab mthus/ /rang gi rtogs tshul cha tsam 'dir brjod kyi/ / 18 mtshan ldan bla mas sems kyi bzhag thabs ni/ /srang gsum rkyen bzhi la sogs rten 'brel gnad/ /legs brten mchog tu mos gus kyis drangs nas/ /gnas 'gyu rig pa'i rang zhal gtan la phab/ / 19 bde gsal mi rtog zhi gnas nyams myong rgyas/ /328

tshogs drug rang grol lhag mthong rang rtsal 'phyo/ /rtse gcig gnas pa sems kyi rgyan du shes/ /spros bral 'gyu ba sems kyi rol par stong / / 20 ro gcig snang sems 'khor 'das mnyam nyid rtogs/ /sgom med sgom bya sgom byed dbyings su stor/ /rnal 'byor bzhi yi nyams len ngang tshul de/ /bla ma'i mthu yis da ni cung zad go/ / 21 yang gcig gson dang kho bo'i nyams len mthil/ /phyag rgya chen po'i tshul de 'di skad do/ /bu chung skyes dus tha mal shes pa dang / /da lta phyag chen rtogs pa'i nyams myong gnyis/ /22 rang ngo shes dang ma shes kho na las/ /bsal bzhag med pa'i ro mnyam gdeng tshad skyes/ /tha mal gnyug ma so ma lhug pa de/ /gol shor las 'das rang sems rang zhal mthong / / 23 yul med rang ngo shes pa'i shes rab rgyas/ /spros dang bral zhing mi spros gang yang med/ /'gal du ltar du snang yang 'gal ba med/ /kho thag chod pa'i phyag chen rgan po bde/ / 24 yang cig zab dgu'i chos kyi snying po ste/ /theg pa kun gyi rtse rgyal mthar thug pa/ /rig 'dzin bye ba 'bum sde gshegs pa'i shul/ /mtshan tsam gyis kyang 'khrul snang hrul por btang / / 25 sangs rgyas ye shes drang thad bstan pa'i chos/ /bla med bla ma 'od gsal rdo rje snying / /pad 'byung bi ma'i bzhed gzhung ji bzhin pa/ /dri med 'od zer maphyo rab zur phud can/ / 26 gang gi bka' srol bdud rtsi cung zad gcig /'thung bas myos te nyams rtogs glu dbyangs len/ /dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /tha dad mi dmigs dad dam gzhir brten nas/ / 27 thun mong thun min khyad par sngon 'gro bas/ /zab gnad du mas sems kyi dri ma bsal/ /yang khyad sems kyi khong bu gnyis snang yid/ /blo yis brtags nas rang mtshang rang gis bshig / 28 'dus byas sems dang 'dus ma byas rig pa/ /so sor dbye nas gnyis med ye shes dngos/ /rig pa'i rang ngo gcer mthong gtan la phab/ /yin lugs rang gi ngo bo rang thog 'phrod / /29 yul dang yul can ye steng la zla zhing / /'khor 'das rig pa mnyam nyid ngang thag bcad/ /gang shar lam la spang blangs yongs bral bar/ /chos kun chos nyid rol par rang sar grol/ / 30 yin lugs cog bzhag bzhi yis gtan la phab/ khams gsum yongs grol gzhi thog 'bras bu bskyal/ /ye shes chig chod rang rig lam rdzogs pa/ /rdzogs chen khreg chod dgongs pa gzer du gdab/ / 31chos tshul gzhan las khyad par bdun byas pa/ /zab gsang 'od gsal mngon sum thod brgal don/ /sgo gsum gnad bzhi byin rlabs 'pho ba la/ /brten nas yid dpyod mun bsgom las 'das pa/ / 32mtha' grol shes rab rang byung sgron ma che/ /ye shes zang thal dri med rdo rje sems/ /lta ba'i stod phur btab nas sku gsum gyi/ /snang ba bzhi rdzogs lo zlas sangs rgyas pa/ / 33 kun tu bzang po'i thugs kyi gsang lam mchog /chos dkon rnyed par dka' ba'i man ngag 'di/ /mjal ba'i dga' tshor 329

nyin mtshan 'khor yug 'byams/ /chos tshul ji bzhin myong ba'i rnal 'byor bde/ / 34 kye ho/ de ltar zab dgu chos kyi mchog /dbu ma phyag rgya rdzogs chen man ngag don/ /go myong rtogs pa'i ngang tshul de ltar te/ /da dung rang gi yin lugs dbyangs 'di len/ / 35 sngon tshe yengs pa'i dgra bor 'jigs pa yi/ /ma yengs dran pa'i so ba rtag tu btsug /da ni yengs ba dran pa'i ngo bor longs/ /ma yengs dran pa kho yang bya rgyu stor/ / 36 sngon tshe phra ba ngo mi shes kyi dogs/ /shes byed dran pa'i rdzi'u rtag tu bzhag /da ni phra ba ngo shes rig par thim/ /yul med rang ngo chos kyi sku ru grol/ / 37 sngon tshe bdag med stong pa'i tshig bshad de/ /smra ba snyan yang gnas lugs sems la sdug /da ni chos nyid stong pa'i dbyings mthong tshe/ /go tshig stong nyid dpyad sgom yul bud shor/ / 38 tha snyad tshig khyod ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/ /yid ches khong nas rnyed pa'i rnal 'byor bde/ /sngon tshe mnyam bzhag rnam rtog rgyun gyis sprur/ /bsal bzhag blo yis chos nyid rang ngo sgrib/ / 39 da ni rnam rtog mnyam bzhag ngo bor grub/ /rnam rtog chos skur zhig tshe gsal bzhag ci/ /spang gnyan mkhan tsho ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/ /gu yangs blo bde rnyed pa'i rnal 'byor bde/ / 40 sngon tshe rnam rtog 'gyu dang rtog med gnas/ /rtog med gnas pa lam gyi rkang du byas/ /da ni gnas med 'gyu med rang ngos stong / /mi g.yo gnas pa'i rgyang thag ring du chad/ / 41 g.yo ba 'gyu 'phro'i spun thag khong nas zhig /yin lugs rig pa'i rang ngo gting nas sad/ /gang shar rig thog grol ba'i bya bral bde/ /gnas 'gyu gdams ngag can tsho ci dgyes mdzod/ / 42 sngon tshe mnyam rjes 'byed la dga' tshor skyes/ /mnyam bzhag brtan po thob pa yid kyi smon/ /da ni mnyam bzhag blo yis bzhag so zad/ /rjes thob yul snang rnam rtog spros pa 'gags/ / 43 mnyam rjes chig chod rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor bde/ /mnyam rjes dbye ba mkhan tsho ci dgyes mdzod/ /sngon tshe lha sku bsgom pa'i bskyed rim dang / /mi rtog stong nyid sgom pa'i rdzogs rim gnyis/ / 44 gcig dang tha dad 'dzin pa'i mgo bo 'khor/ /da ni rang rig ngo bo lha skur shar/ /lha sku bsgom kyang mi rtog stong pa nyid/ /mi rtog stong nyid lha sku'i zhal phyag bkra/ / 45 des na stong pa nyis tshes chog go zhes/ /bskyed rim dgos med nan 'gog sdig can min/ /zab gsal dbyer med rnam kun mchog ldan pa/ /bskyed rdzogs dbyer med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor yin/ / 46 sngon tshe ye shes nyams su myong 'dod pas/ kha sna'i rlung rnams 'gog pa'i dka' spyad dang / /khu chu 'dzin 'dren 'bad pa'i sdug rtsis kyis/ /bya byed dgag sgrub mang po'i gzeb tu chud/ / 47 da ni rdzogs chen rang rig don mthong tshe/ /rtsol byas thabs lam 'bad la rag ma las/ /gang shar lam blang bde ba khong nas shar//gnadī ༵gas lta ba 'di ni go chod po/ / 48 bu phrug med ched khu chu bskyil thabs tsam/ /byas kyang

chags byed zhen pa rang kha can/ /bde stong gnas lugs rang zhal ma gzigs pa'i/ /mi ngan thabs lam kha g.yar ya pho min/ / 49 'pho med bde chen 'bras bur dmigs pa yi/ /kun rdzob rgyu yi thig le spel sbyangs yang / /rig pa'i rang rtsal sgyu ma tsam du myong / /zhen spang zhen ldan thabs lam rnal 'byor yin/ / 50 sngon tshe mi rtag 'chi la ches 'jigs mthus/ /da ni 'chi ba rnam rtog nyid du rtogs/ /rnam rtog stong pa stong nyid rig pa'i snying / /rig pa chos kyi sku ru thag chod pas/ / 51 rnam rtog las gzhan 'chi bya 'chi byed bral/ /des na 'chi bdag bdud khyod sgra che yang / /dga' dang ha cang che ches 'jigs skrag med/ /blo bde khong nas rnyed pa'i rnal 'byor yin/ /52 e ma rtsa ba'i bla ma'i thugs rje la/ /brten nas rang gi nyams myong rtogs pa'i tshul/ /de blta na yang deng sang dus dbang gis/ /chos spun gzhon 'ga' tshul 'di rtogs pa dkon/ / 53 kha cig go ba'i nyams myong bzang tsam la/ /brten nas kha 'byams tshig gis khrom gseb tu/ /gsang sgrogs 'phrar g.yeng dam pa gzhan rnams la/ /smod byas rang nyid mnar med dmyal ba bsgrub/ / 54 kha cig thog mar dge sbyor cung zad skyes/ /bar du brtson 'grus dman pas nyams myong yal/ /tha ma chos myong blo dred kha ltar 'thor/ /gdeng 'cha' rang gi mgo bskor ngan song bsgrub/ kha cig nyams myong tsam la ched 'dzin nas/ khams gsum sa bon dri ma gting la zhen/ /gzhan dang mtshungs min snyam pa'i nga rgyal brtas/ /yin lugs ma mjal 'khor ba'i gnas su 'khyams/ 56 kha cig rtogs pa phyogs re skyes pa yis/ /sems kyi gnas lugs stong pa'i cha mthong ste/ /dge sdig rnam rtog myong ba'i stong zhen gyis/ /rgyu 'bras khyad gsod duḥkha'i gnas su nyung / / 57 de sogs nges pa'i don rlom nges don gyi/ /sgrib byed bdud kyi bar chad rnam mang po/ /mdo rgyud dgongs pa'i gnas phugs ma lon zhing / /yin lugs bla ma'i bka' yis ma zin pa/ / 58bdag lta'i skye bo las rkyen dman pa la/ /gol shor nor 'khrul ches mdo sdang na yang / /bdag ni rtsa ba'i bla ma thugs rje can/ /dran mchog 'khor lo'i dbang phyug bde ba che/ / 59 srid zhi'i gdung sel kun tu bzang po'i zhal/ /dang po'i mgon po mchog de'i byin rlabs mthus/ /gol shor log nor dbang du ma gyur par/ /gnas lugs rang ngo rig pa rjen par 'phrod/ / 60 rnal 'byor rim lam dman don gtan
