phab rtogs/ /bar ma tshul bzhin nyams len gong ma'i don/ /yin lugs ma 'khrul blo des mthar thug pa/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes bzhugs tshul de nyid go/ / 61 de ltar go shes nyams myong rtogs pa yang / /tha dad ma dmigs rang rig gcig pu'i gshis/ /legs par rtogs kyang rang gis bgrod pa rnams/ /skal bas nyams rtogs ma 'dres 'ja' ltar bkra/ / 62 des na nor 'khrul skyon med sems pa yi/ /nyams su myong ba rtogs pa ji bzhin pa/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs mthu yis thob pa gang / /cha shas 331

bka' drin dran bzhin glu ru blangs/ / 63 e ma ltem rgyang med pa'i dad mos kyis/ /rtsa ba'i bla mar chos skur bltas pa 'di/ /kun go gcig gis chod pa'i go chod do/ /go chod khyed kyis gcig shes kun kyang grol/ / 64 de ltar gnas lugs 'od gsal don dam go/ /nyams su myong ba bla ma'i mthus skyes kyang / /da dung rig ngor mnyam rjes ro mnyam du/ /thun mtshams ye nas dbyer med gcig ma gyur//65 'di phyi bar do rnam rtog yin myong yang / /'od gsal ma bu gcig tu zhal ma mjal/ /dpe yi 'od gsal rgyud la myong na yang / /gdos snang sgyu lus ma gyur rtsal ma rdzogs/ / 66 de phyir bsam pa lhag med ma gyur te/ /slad mar rtse cig sgrub la brtson pa yis/ /bskyed 'bras lha yi phyag rgya mngon du gyur/ /thabs kyi g.yo ba dbu mar zhugs nas thim/ / 67 khyad par mos gus mthu yis dkyil 'khor gtso/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs lhag med rtsal chen rdzogs/ /sems dben dpe yi 'od gsal mthar thug pa/ /nyin mtshan mnyam rjes 'khor yug 'od gsal 'dres/ / 68 don dam 'od gsal skad cig mngon du byas//'pho chen zung 'jug sku thob snying nas smon/ /gzhan yang rnam 'dren rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i sa/ /rdo rje gdan du byang chub shing dbang blta/ / 69 dang po'i mgon po grub pa'i dbang phyug che/ /dz+wa ki'i bla ma mchog sogs ye shes sku/ /brnyes paḥmang po'i zhal mjal gsung myong zhing / /'chi ba med pa'i lam mchog yongs grub pas/ / 70 dpag med 'gro ba mang po'i don spyod par/ /rjes kyi bsam smon de 'o 'grub gyur cig /'on kyang gong bgrod ltos gzhi re dogs dang / /gnas yul bsgrod 'dod zhen pa rang rgyud pa/ / 71 med pas des na sgyu ma'i 'phrul 'khor bzhin/ /gang shar blo la gtad med ci bde yin/ /gzhan ngor ye shes thob mthong dag snang dang / /ma dag nyon mongs che ba'i skye bo sogs/ / 72ji ltar mthong yang rang ngo chos nyid kyi/ /dbyings las ma g.yos bya bral bya ba can/ /rang gi rang nyid dpyad bzod ma yin te/ /'di yin gtad pa med pa'i smyon pa yin/ / 73 gang ltar las smon rnam par dag pa'i mthus/ /skye ba kun tu gu rus rjes su bzung / /skye 'phreng du mar rim gnyis drod tshad thob/ /'brel tshad don ldan nus pa'i sngags par rlom/ / 74 de lta na yang rang gi rten 'brel dang / /pha rol 'gro ba so so'i las skal gyis/ kha cig dam pa mchog ces bsngags shing bstod/ kha cig bdud ces smad cing ches gshe yang / / 75 rang gi ngo bo ro mnyam nyid thob pas/ /bstod smad tshig la zhen de 'khu 'phrig gis/ /ba spu gcig kyang g.yo ba'i go skabs med/ /yin lugs dpyad med rang blo ngal bso bde/ / 76 gzhan gyi ha cang bstod dang ha cang smad/ /tshab 'di ches pas bar ma so so'i skye/ /min pa'i tshad ya de yis nges 'gyur mdo/ /gang ltar dgag sgrub med pa'i sngags 'chang bde/ / 77de skahā 3swād yul nyi 'og mdo khams kyi/ /nor 'dzin khus 'gyur kaḥthog rdor gdan lho/ /cong rong ngam

grog chu klung drag po 'khrugs/ /tsher ma'i nags tshal gcan gzan gtum po rgyu/ / 78 mi rnams srin po ji bzhin srog gcod brtson/ /gdul dka'i gnas der 'dul byed rmad byung ba/ /bla med sngags bstan ma nub dar phyogs der/ /'od gsal lha lding rngu yi rigs skyes shing / / 79 shākya'i dge bsnyen tshangs spyod gso dkar 'chang / /gtsug na dbang rtag ralda pa'i gdeng ka can/ /ya dang bag tsha nyung ba'i smyon pa che/ /sha chang bud med tshogs la longs spyod pa/ / 80 grub chen nam snying mtshan gyis byin brlabs pa'i/ /sngags kyi rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu zhes/ /o rgyan gu rus gsang ba'i ming btags pa/ /'od gsal bde gshegs snying po gter gzhad rtsal/ / 81 gang des bod yul stod phyogs mnga' ris smad/ /bal bod sa mtshams mang yul grub pa'i gnas/ /sa yi thig le skyid grong garjo la/ /rang byung sprul pa'i 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ / 82 bde ldan dbang phyug wa ti'i spyan snga ru/ /maṇ+ḍal tshul du nyams rtogs cha shas tsam/ /lcags phag byang chub dus chen sa ga yi/ /yar tshes bzang po bcu gnyis snga cha ru/ / 83 rab tu gus pas glu dbyangs blangs pa de/ /smras pa'i yig ris skye ba du ma zhig /las smon gyis 'brel skal ldan snying gi bu/ /o rgyarne 'phrin las bstan 'dzin dpal des bgyis/ /84 tshig 'di dregs pa nga rgyal che 'dod sogs/ /chos brgyad snang bas dben par snyam na yang / /log rtog can gyi zog dang nga rgyal tshig /bzung yang las mid byang chub rgyur 'gro shog / 85 rang gi ngang tshul gzhan blor shongs dka' yang / /'ga' la phan snyam lhag bsam bzang po yis/ /nyams len myong ba cha shas smras pa 'dis/ /slob ma'i mos gus rten 'brel rgyas gyur cig / 86 nongs gzhan ma mchis gsang ba sgrogs pa yi/ /nyes skyon srid na ye shes spyan ldan la/ /mthol bshags 'di phyi bar dor sgribs med par/ /dag tshangs yid bzhin mchog tu dbugs dbyung gsol/ / 87 dge mchis mkha' mnyam 'gro la bsngo ba'i mthus/ /yin lugs ma 'khrul lta ba tshul bzhin rtogs/ /sa lam yon tan bri med gong du 'phel/ /kun tu bzang po ci 'dra de thob shog /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /de ltar rang gi nyams su myong ba 'ga' zhig 'phags pa wa ti'i spyan sngar maṇ+ḍal tshul du glur blangs pa ste/ slar gtsang la stod rgyal gyi shri'i nub rgyud/grub pa'i bste nas bhu ṭa tshigs gcad ci rigs bsres shing zhus btags yang byas pa'i yi ge pa ni snga ma de nyid do/ /'di nyid grub mtha' gzhan du kha bsku ba tshig bsgyur bcos slad 'dra min bcos pa dang / rang la nyams rtogs ma skyes par 'di ma gzhi mthu rtsom pa byas na/ de'i srog rtsa'i spu gu dam can dregs pa rnams kyis chod cig /sa ma ya dam rgya/rang ma mos pa rnams kyi yi ge 'di la gcigs su bzung zhing log par the tshom che ba rnams la gsang bar bya'o/ /a hoḥ gzhi lta ba'i gnas lugs skad pa de/ /'gro dus khams dbang skal du ma'i don/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis dpag med nyid gsungs te/ /mtho theg dgu'i lta ba zhes grags kyang / /mtha' thug pa nyid ni gdod ma'i gshis/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang ma gzigs shing / /dpe tshig brjod blo ba~X yul

'das la/ /lam 'khor 'das yongs kyi 'char gzhi de/ /phyag chen pos gnyug ma lhan cig skyes/ /rdzogs chen pos ka dag gnas lugs zhes/ /don mtha' med dbus med rtag chad med/ /yid byed pa kun bral mtha' bzhi 'das/ /yul gzhi med rtsa bral rtsa ba stong / /don 'di zhes sus kyang mtshon med cing / /rnam kun tu mchog ldan bde gshegs snying / /phra gsal la zab zhi 'od gsal ba/ /de gzhi gnas skabs su ka dag ces/ /skyon kun bral skyon yon ming yang med/ /gzhi snang ba lhun grub ces bya ba/ /dag ma dag kun gyi 'char gzhi grub/ /don ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje zhes/ /ngo bo la 'khrul pa'i ming yang med/ /rang bzhin dang grol 'khrul thugs rje ston/ /yang dag la brjod bya kun las 'das/ /skye 'gag dang 'gro 'ong gnas kun bral/ /de gdod ma'i gnas lugs gzhi zhes bya/ /lta ba zhes tha snyad ming du grags/ /lam bsgom pa ru bshad pa de nyid kyang / /don dril na rang sems gnyug ma 'di/ /gzo bcos ma skyon gyi yang ma slad/ /yid ched gnyer bsgom rgyu ci yang med/ /yid 'khrul pa'i dbang du yang ma shor/ /'das ma 'ong rnam rtog bsu gcod med/ /dus da lta'i shes par brtag zhib bral/ /de rang bag yengs bsgom bral bar bzhag /'di gsal lo stong ngo bsam du med/ /gnas 'gyu zhes spang blangs dgag sgrub bral/ /rig rang ngo gnyis la ma bcos 'jog /'di rgyal ba yongs kyi gshegs shul lags/ /don ngo bor de las gzhan med kyang / /de go myong rtogs grol gnas lugs kyi/ /lam rnal 'byor bzhi zhes dwags pos bzhed/ /bka' rdzogs chen sems sder nyams bzhir grags/ /phyi tshogs drug rkyen gyi bskyod med pa/ /gnas de nyid rtse gcig rnal 'byor dang / /nang gnyis 'dzin 'phro rgod bying rmug gi/ /rgol med pa spros bral rnal 'byor ro/ /bar snang sems 'khor 'das gnyis chos kun/ /mnyam gyur la du ma ro gcig myong / /chos chos can bya ba kun zad par/ /lhun grub pas bsgom med yin no skad/ /chos phyag rdzogs gnyis kyi lam gzhung ste/ /mdo da lta'i shes pa 'di nyid las/ /yul gang bgrod blo yi ltos gzhi med/ /don rang rig cog bzhag gcig ngang rdzogs/ /phra rags sbom bems kyi rnam rtog kun/ /rkyen rang khar btang ba yang mi 'tshal/ /de spang nas 'jog pa yang ma lags/ /don gnyen po ston rgyu yang ma mchis/ /de gnas nas bskyur ba yang min te/ /khams rang bab ngo la rang zhal blta/ /sems ma rig 'jam dbang ma shor la/ /don ma bcos gnyug ma nyid du zhog /mtsho mtsho rlabs chu la ro gcig ltar/ /sems sems byung ro gcig chos skur 'dres/ /bde mi rtog gsal la mi zhen cing / /sems rang ngo rnal ma ngang nyid la/ /sgom yin min the tshom yongs su spangs/ /zhi gnas zhes gnas che'i rgya mtsho la/ /lhag rang mthong byung ba gza' skar bkra/ /'gyu 'gyu bya yul med rang ngo shes/ /shes shes bya'i rnam rtog dbyidī~X4 su spur/ /'di brjod bral ngang la rtag tu brtsed/ /lam gegs sel bla mar mos gus snun/ /

'gro gzhan phan snying rje rtag tu skyong / /dus kun tu yengs med gnyug mar bzhag /'di bsgom bya kun snying sgom byed bral/ /don rang rig gnyug ma'i babs nyid dang / /bcos med par bzhag 'di sgom pa'i mchog /de bogs 'don spyod pa zhes bya yang / /phyi 'gro ba'i dngas 'dren 'dul khrims bsrung / /nang lha sngags ting 'dzin rol pa brtson/ /gsang thabs lam rlung thig gnad du bsnun/ /de kho na phyag rdzogs nyams len dril/ /las rgyu 'bras spang blang shan dbye zhing / /chos srog rtsa rtsa ba dam tshig gzhig /spyod kun kyang don gnyis sgrub der 'dus/ /ming 'bras bu btags pa'i sgra che yang / /sngar med gcig gsar du byung med de/ /rig rang ngo'i yon tan rtsal rdzogs tshe/ /sku ye shes zhes bya 'bras bur brjod/ /don re med dogs med 'bras bu'i gdengs/ /chos brjod bral gnas lugs lta ba'i gdeng / /sems ma bcos cog bzhag sgom pa'i gdeng / /rtsal gang shar lam khyer spyod pa'i gdeng / /ming gzhi lam 'bras bur grags pa kun/ /yul tha mal shes pa gnyug ma nyid/ /rig ma bcos rang ngo 'di rang ste/ /blo bcas bcos tha snyad dbyings su yal/ /e ma/ mchog dam pa de yi gsung ngo nyid/ /lcogs ma spobs pas na mtshon tsam du/ /gzhi lam 'bras ngang tshul sa bon tsam/ /rje mtshungs med bla ma'i zhal lung nyid/ /thos mthu yi rang nyams go rtogs las/ /shar bzhin du gang shar chu 'bab nyid/ /glur 'bul ba dgongs don la 'jug shing / /'gro don du zhabs pad brtan gyur shog /zhes rnam 'dren rgyal ba 'od dpag med dngos zhwa dmar ba chos kyi don kun grub pa zhabs kyis rigs kyi gcung chos kyi sras dam pa zwa phug sprul sku karma gar dbang don grub kyi bkra shis pa'i rtags kyi yongs su spras pa'i lha reg gangs ri'i mdog can bcas zhal gdams zhig dgos zhes phebs pa ltar/ 'phral der mdo khams kaḥthog gi lho phyogs nags ljongs su skyes pa'i lha rigs kyi sngags 'chang rgyal khams pa tshe dbang nor bu grub mchog dbang po'i sde zhes pas sa sprel zla ba dang po'i cho 'phrul gyi tshes bzang por ra la nas phul/e ma/ snyan legs par gson dang rnal 'byor pa/ /sngon rnam dkar las kyi mnga' ris stod/ /yul glo bor dal 'byor yang dag thob/ /las bzang 'phro dam chos sngags dang mjal/ /sngon zab dgu thob pa rje yi rang / /mgon de rnams gsung gsang bdud rtsi mchog /thob las lhag bdag gi zhal gdams ci/ /'on kyang yang gsung ngo ma spyog tsam/ /tshig nyung ngu mtshon pa zhig 'bul na/ /chos mdo rgyud theg kun snying po ni/ /skyabs kun gtso bla mar rag las shing / /de dgyes thabs las kun dang du long / /snying rus pa'i gting nas mos gus bskyed/ /dus kun tu byin brlab dbang bzhi zhus/ /dam sel med snying srog ltar du bca'/ /mthar rang sems bla ma dbyer med blta/ /'di gnad 'gag kun gyi che shos yin/ /lam bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen gang bsgom yang / /'di med thabs med do ༵༵ gus

gces/ /lha bskyed rim snang stong chu zla ltar/ /bsgom gsung yang yang dag ngo bo la/ /sems skye med gnas lugs rtogs pa'i mi/ /lcags pha bong sgom kyang gol pa med/ /don skye med ma gtogs blo chung 'ga'/ /lha snang stong bsgom yang gzugs med khams/ /don des na zhen 'dzin yul med pa'i/ /chos skye med rtsal 'don bskyed rim gyis/ /lam rdzogs rim rtsal 'don rlung thig yang / /mdor dril na steng sgo 'og sgo gnyis/ /grol thabs lam gnad du bsnun pa ste/ /steng gtum mo dam tshig phyag rgya yi/ /rtsa mdud bkrol zhu bde nyams su long / /'og thabs lam bde chen skad pa yang / /bum dbang mtshungs dbyibs gsum rnal 'byor bslab/ /gsang dbang mtshungs dkar cha dkyil 'dren bkram/ /sher dbang mtshungs dkar dmar gcig tu bsres/ /kun tshig dbang dang bstun rdzogs rim gces/ /lam rdzogs pa chen por grags pa yang / /mdor dril na khreg chod thod rgal gnyis/ /khreg chod ces de ni rang rig don/ /bsam dmigs yul 'dzin pa kun dang bral/ /don mtshon med brjod med blo bral ba/ /de cog bzhag bzhi yi ngang du skyong / /thod brgal zhes sgron drug snang ba yang / /brda' rtags don dpe yi mtshon pa ste/ /don rang rig rang mdangs dbyings su snang / /'di a ti rdzogs chen khyad chos yin/ /chos gzhan gyi rlung rtags bcu bo dang / /cha mtshungs dang khyad par 'di nyid 'phags/ /'on khreg chod rtogs gdeng ma chud par/ /sems zhen 'dzin snang bas 'od mdangs la/ /bltas gyur na gzugs khams sa bon cha/ /mtshungs gyur zhes klong gsal rgyud nas gsungs/ /spyi deng sang bstan pa snyigs dus 'dir/ /chos phyag rdzogs snyan grags che na yang / /rang gnad 'khel gzhan la 'chad nus ni/ /dpe nyin skar lta bur dkon par mthong / /lhag rdzogs chen grub mtha' 'khrul med pa/ /gnad yang dag mkhyen pa re re tsam /de bsam bzhin snying nas skyo gyur yang / /'on bod 'dir lo grangs brgya brgya nas/ /rje bi ma la yi rnam 'phrul re/ /'byon 'gyur nas rdzogs chen gsal byed gsungs/ /de myur 'byon smon lam snying nas 'debs/ /gzhan dus dang rnam kun thams cad du/ /rang nges 'drong bla mar gsol ba thob/ /dgos khyed rang tshe sngon las 'bras kyi/ /rje rta mchog dngos gyur stag sham zhabs/ /las 'phro bzang lags pas rtsa ba yi/ /skyabs bla ma kun 'dus ngo bor bzung / /las rgyu 'bras bslu med zhib tu rtsis/ /sems yengs med dran pa rtag tu skyong / /khong rnal 'byor mchog des bskul ba'i ngor/ /tshig de skad rgyal khams pa des so/ /mnga' ris glo bo chu mig brgya rtsa phyogs su 'khrungs pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug o rgyan lhun grub rgya mtshos gsung gi bskul ngor mdo khams kaḥthog lho phyogs su skyes pa'i lha rigs rnal 'byor pa tshe dbang nor bus bal yul mthil dang bal yul tsha shod kyi mtshams ka kaklo zhes pa'i rtse mor sa sprel nag zla'i tshes nyer gnyis la skad cig gang dran smras pa'o/ /336

a hoḥ snyan dar cig gson dang bskal ba can/ /snying lta bur dam tshig brtson pa can/ /pha smyon pa bza' gtad bral gyur pa/ /khong rgyal khams kyi 'khyams po gu yangs po/ /dpal tshe dbang nor bu grub pa'i sde/ /grags de yi glu dbyangs 'di skad thal/ /dus snyigs ma lnga 'dus da lta'i skabs/ /phyi nang gsang gang bltas skyo ba'i gnas/ /spyir mi rtag chos can 'di yin kyang / /dgos 'pho 'gyur myur 'di yi re mug /dus 'di las sang phod bde re yang / /re bzhin du ma gyur je cher bsngal/ /dpon che btsan re mos 'pho 'gyur gyi/ /ngo zin dka' mi tshe brel bas zad/ /de las kyi phyogs 'dzin re dogs shor/ /mthar don med sgyu ma'i ltad mo 'dra/ /dgos sbyin bdag grwa 'khor gnyen mtshan yang / /dus dbang gi brtag cing brtan brling dka'/ /g.yo sgyu med drang po re re tsam/ /dam tshig bsrung ngo lkog med pa dkon/ /rang bsod nams 'phel bskyed byung ba na/ /mi phal cher nom pa spyod la 'dus/ /rang gdul bya rgud pa zhig byung na/ /grogs gces byas kun kyang so sor bral/ /lar 'di nang zas gos 'byor pa na/ /mi kun gyi bstod pa'i gnas su byed/ /chos tshul bzhin ngo bsrung med pa na/ /mi kun kyang de la sdang bar byed/ /deng snyigs dus tshul 'di gang byas byas/ /don de na bu yi don po khyod/ /gnas bka' brgyud gong ma'i sgrub khang du/ /tshe 'di snang chos brgyad rgyab dor nas/ /pha brgyud pa'i bla ma'i rnam thar bzung / /don tshul bzhin gnas lugs nyams len brtson/ /sems yengs med dran pa'i bya ra thong / /dus rtag tu snying rje'i rtsi yi bzung / /lha yi dam bsnyen bsgrub rgyun ma bcad/ /ma mkha' 'gro'i dus bzang mchod pa bzung / /chos bsrung mar rtag tu gtor mas bskang / /lus phung po tshogs 'khor chag med bya/ /srod tho rengs bum can gtum mor 'bad/ /zer gnyis dus thod rgal nyams len skyong / /dus rgyun du mnyam bzhag ngang du bzhag /lus spyod lam bag yod dngas bar 'tshal/ /deng blo gtad yul gyur mi dkon pas/ /blo bslu med gtad pa dkon mchog yin/ /de sangs rgyas kun 'dus ngo bor bsgom/ /dad dam tshig snying gting rus la phur/ /'gyur ldog med mos gus stobs su bskyed/ /skad mthon pos mtshan bos gsol ba thobs/ /mthar rang sems bla ma dbyer med bsres/ /dus rgyun du yang dag 'jog la 'tshal/ /'di tshig re'i don re mtshon pa ste/ /don gal 'gag yod do thugs la 'chang / /'byung 'gyur gyi lung kyang cung zad mchis/ /'on sgyu ma'i rol pa nyid shes bya/ /dbyangs de skad tshe dbang nor bu yi/ /gnas grom pa'i gtsug lag yang rtse nas/ /dus bzang po cho 'phrul tshes bzang la /yid gces pa'i bu la 'phrin du phul/ /a hoḥ skye sngon las 'phro bskal bzang thob/ /de mthus dal 'byor rten bzang rnyed/ /mjal dka'i bla ma ngo mtshar can/ /rdor sems kyi sgyur 'phrul gter chen mjal/ /ma nor ba'i lam mchog 337

rdzogs chen chos/ /legs 'phrad nas bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /rnam grol zhes yid kyi grogs po khyod/ /dar cig la snyan gyi dbang po ru/ /sprang po ru gyur pa'i blo bde po/ /gu yangs shing bza' gtad bral gyur pa/ /ci bde ru spyod pa'i bhu su ku/ /sgyu ma yi skyes bu de nyid kyi/ /glu dbyangs su 'di skad shugs 'byung thal/ /'dam gyi nang du skyes pa'i pad+ma la/ /rkang drug gi rtsi bcud gnad du slongs/ /de bzhin du bdag 'dra khams dman yang / /glu dbyangs la 'don bcud 'dug na zhes/ /e ma ye rang sems ngo bor ltos/ /e ma rang sems bltas tsa na/ /snang ba 'di chu nang zla ris 'dra/ /dngos snang su 'dzin na byis pa 'khrul/ /bden med du sems na blo ru 'gyur/ /dngos 'dzin dang bden med gnyis ka thong / /gnyis snang gi zhen pa dbyings su khrol/ /nang sems ngo rtag na brtag byed stong / /stong pa ru yin yang brjod don med/ /a 'thas ni de bas yongs don med/ /yod med ni gnyis ka rang sar yal/ /rnam rtog gi shar cha du ma ni/ /rjes mthud du byas na lug rgyud 'gyur/ /'phro bcad du byas na rgyas 'debs shor/ /sgoms nyams shig byung na blo ru 'khrul/ /yid dbang du shor na 'khrul rgya 'byams/ /skyon med kyi rig pa gcer bu de/ /rten med kyi mkha' la spar re thong / /bya bral gyi gnas lugs de skyong 'tshal/khams 'dus sogs snying rlung ci byung yang / /bar snang gi rlung ltar gzhi rtsa bral/ /ched gnyer gyi dgag sgrub ga la 'tshal/ /ci shar kun gdod ma nyid du thong / /a hoḥ snang ba 'di sgyur mar ban ma bun/ /bstod smad sgra grags stong sang ma sing / /gang shar ni chos nyid 'al ma 'ol/ /thams cad kyang rig gdangs ta la la/ /da dung yang cig snyan gson dang / khams drug ldan rdo rje'i lus po la/ /byed bcing gi rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'i tshe/ /rtsa rlung dang thig le'i g.yo 'gul gyi/ /snang sems kyi shar tshogs dpag par dka'/ /ci shar kun rang bab nyid du bzhag go/ /'on te yang rnal 'byor lam bzang kun/ /tshogs sbyor nas 'phags lam thob kyi bar/ /lam de la lhong grol bsam mi khyab/ /de skyon 'dzin bgyis na rnal 'byor 'khrul/ /yon tan du rlom yang mi 'tshal gyi/ /re dogs dang bral ba'i klong du klod/ /spyir rjod byed kyi tshig la dgos pa ci/ /brjod med kyi don la dril ba zhu/ /lar rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dam pa khyed/ /tshe 'di ru ji ltar mdzad na yang / /shes rab kyi spyad pa legs 'dug pas/ /blo gdengs ldan gyi dam tshig brtan tshugs na/ /dus phyi mar ni nges par lam thob 'gyur/ /de gnas tshul yang kho bos cung shes te/ /'dir mi smra'o yid gnyis gyur gyi dogs/ /glu de skad ni ru lag grom pa yi/ /sgrub phug nas tshe dbang nor bu zhes/ /mi smyon pa des gang shar 'phral du bris/ /maṅga lo/'di 'gyur med rnam grol la gnang ba lags/ kye hoḥ skyabs mtshungs med dran mchog 'khor lo'i ༵༵na/ /mtshan dran pas srid pa'i sdug bsngal gzhom/ /khong pad+ma thod 'phreng ma lags sam/ /

mgon de dang dbyer med bdertsechen gling / /mi bdag gi spyi bo'i rgyan bkod nas/ /sems mnyam bzhag ngang nas shugs 'byung glu/ /khyod bskul ba po yi ngo skal du/ /'dir cung zad smra yi snyan dbang gson/ /lus khams drug ldan pa rdo rje'i gzugs/ /chos gsang sngags snod rung 'di 'dra ni/ /thob dka' yi u dum wa ra ltar/ /dus da re tsam yin thugs la zhog /skye 'chi ba 'pho dang 'gyur ba ni/ /dus cha med skad cig nyid la 'gyur/ /tshe long med de nyid snying nas bsam/ /de bsam bzhin dam pa'i lha chos 'tshal/ /chos sang byed gnang byed mi tshe zad/ /las gtan mchis gal chung ngang du lus/ /da skra dkar gnyer ma 'dus sner zin/ /da long med thog bab 'chi yang srid/ /don der sems deng dus dbang yod dus/ /chos ma nor theg chen lam zhugs nas/ /bka' rdzogs pa chen po zhes bya ba/ /chos zab khyad can de bsgom re ran/ /skyabs ma nor gzhan rgyud byin rlabs nus/ /mtshan nges ldan bla ma bstan byas nas/ /g.yo sgyu med dam tshig gtsang mar bsrung / /thugs dges thabs sgo gsum 'bad de bsgrub/ /skyabs dkon mchog gsum la blo snying gtod/ /byams snying rje byang sems gzhi ma thing / /dad mos gus 'gyur med gnad du dril/ /las rgyu 'bras ma nor 'dor len gzhib/ /rje rgyal ba kun 'dus ngo bo nyid/ /mgon rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid ni/ /sku btsun rung mi btsun na'ang rung / /bzang ngan dang mkhas rmongs brtag dpyad dor/ /lar bla ma ma bsten gong du ni/ /blang dor bya'i gnas la rab tu brtag /der nyes pa med pa rgyal bas gnang / /chos zhus nas brtag med dag snang sbyangs/ /de ltar du bka' drin mchog gyur de/ /dus rtag tu spyi bo'i gtsug bsgom nas/ /snying khong nas gsol 'debs dbang bzhi blang / /mthar bla ma rang sems dbyer med bsres/ /de ngang nas sems sbyongs bdun la 'bad/ /lus ngag yid phyi nang ru shan dbye/ /rgyu sa bon bsreg sbyang gnad du bsnun/ /sgo gsum po mnal dbab sor du bzhugs/ /mthar cog bzhag bzhi yi ngang la bzhag /sems sems byung sems rig shan yang dbye/ /de som yor lding sor ma song gces/ /bka' gzhung mthun nyams rtogs gtan la phobs/ /'di gal dgag che ba'i gnad yin kyang / /dus deng sang rdzogs chen 'chad mkhan ni/ /khong mkhas grub re re tsam ma gtogs/ /tshig zar zir phyag rdzogs 'al 'ol las/ /chos ji bzhin bshad pa phyogs 'dir dkon/ kha stong bshad glo skam thug pa bzhin/ /ri klung kun khyab par mthong ba'i tshe/ /mi bdag ni snying nas skyo shas skye/ /khyed snying nas chos gcig byed bsam na/ /kha chos bshad phyi yi shun pa mthong / /don nyams len ngo bo ji bzhin par/ /gnad ma 'khrul rig pa gtan la phob/ /ka ye nas dag pa'i khreg chod de/ /ngo rang thog rang ngo shes pas chod/ /thag gcig thog blo dang bral bas chod/ /gdeng grol thog chos sku'i ngang du zhog /da mdor bsdus sgom med sgom blo phrol/ /yengs 'khrul pa'i dbang du yang ma ༵rdo nga / /

da sgom med yengs med ngang du gzhog /sems g.yo med rig pa rtag brtan cing / /lam mthar thug zab mo thod rgal bsgom/ /dbyings gsum dang sgron dgu gtan la phobs/ /don rig pa lug rgyud btson du bzung / /dbyings ra bar nam yang 'da' med bsgom/ /lam dbyings rig snang ba mngon sum snang / /de nyams med 'phel ba'i gong 'phel yin/ /mthar btsan sa zin pas tshad phebs yin/ /chos chos can kun zad chos zad yin/ /der ming la thod rgal snang bzhi zer/ /nyams blang nus na 'ja' lus lo drug bsnyes/ /bka' gsang sngags snying ma'i khyad chos yin/ /khong sangs rgyas kun gyi nye lam yin/ /chos kun bcud gcig la rdzogs pas na/ /ming rdzogs pa chen po zhes su btags/ /chos zab pa gcig pus mi phan te/ /de ston mdzad bla ma mtshan ldan dang / /rang mos gus snying rus 'dzoms pas na/ /khong tshe gcig sangs rgyas zer ba yang / /thag ring por med do tsa na yod/ /don des na nyams len hril dril mdzod/ /nyams ma myong mkhas kyang 'khrul pa yin/ /nyams myong na su yang byang chub thob/ /da 'di snang zhen pa phyi la thong / /don dgos ngo shes pa'i 'chi rtsis gyis/ /thabs zab mo mi ldan sbyor ba yang ming rnal 'byor btags kyang dmyal sgrub yin/ /sems ma bcos cog bzhag ma shes na/ /skra lcang lo byas kyang 'chor skra yin/ /sems rgyu 'bras zhib tu ma rtsis na/ /gos dmar ser gyon kyang dgos pa med/ /chos kun snang stong sgyu mar ma shes na/ /sdom gsum bsrung a 'thas zhen pa yin/ /don ji bzhin gnas lugs ma rtogs na/ /las gang byas kun kyang 'khor ba yin/ /da gtan gyi thar pa'i lam rkang tshugs/ /dus da res gser gling stong ma log /lar sprang po'i glu dbyangs snyan na yang / /mi chen po'i rna bar sim pa dka'/ /zhes mang mkhar ri sul za lung gi/ /rje bla ma'i dbon mo sngags skyes ma/ /khong kun bzang 'phrin las dbang mo yi/ /yang yang nas zhal gdams dgos gsung nas/ /yul kaḥthog lhor skyes rig pa 'dzin/ /sprang bla chung tshe dbang nor bu zhes/ /ming gangs can 'dzin mar yongs grags des/ /gnas la stod g.yas ru byang zhes pa'i/ /sa mang mkhar dbus 'gyur bsam grub zhes/ /seng dkar po'i rigs gyur thig le ni/ /'dar mi rje'i pho brang ga la bar/ /lo sa bya hor zla gnyis pa yi/ /tshes bcu drug mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus/ /yid gang shar nyams len ngang du bris/ /sarba maṅga lo/a hoḥ dbyings skye ba med pa'i ngo bo la/ /klong lhun gyi grub pa'i 'od gsal che/ /mkha' mtha' bral gnas lugs gdod ma'i gshis/ /don bsam brjod bral ba'i ye shes che/ /dus kun tu 'brel med chos kyi sku/ /sus ma slad phra gsal khyab brdal dang / /yul sems can kun gyi snying pad+mor/ /ye nas 'byung da lta'i bar gnas pa/ /mtshan pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes grags pa/ /de kun la yod kyang ngo ma shes//ngo shes na skad cig ma 'dir yod/ /ngo sprad mkhan rtsa ba'i bla mar grags/ /ngo shes thabs bla mar mos 340

gus gces/ /ngo shes bya shes byed ces pa yang / /don yang dag tshe na cang med kyang / /phral brjod tshig 'di las byed ma thub/ /da tshig skam phyi yi shun par mthong / /snying gting nas bla mar gsol thob la/ /lam dbang blang mthar ni rang sems bsre/ /sems de la bcas bcos ye ma byed/ /bsgom dmigs gtad yod na blo yin gyi/ /yengs rgya 'jam song na 'khrul pa yin/ /'gyu mu mthud 'khrul snang lug rgyud yin/ /sems 'og 'gyu shor na ma rig yin/ /sems ha cang grim na gzung 'dzin yin/ /sems ha cang klod na 'khrul snang 'byams/ /don des na rang sems ngo bo 'di/ /gzung mi zin btang bas yang mi 'gro/ /sems grim lhod bral ba'i ngang la zhog /dran rig pa ma yengs rtag tu tshol/ /bde gsal snang mi rtogs la ma chags/ /gnas dga' dang 'gyu bkag ye ma byed/ /de gnas pa sems kyi rgyun shes shing / /'gyu sems kyi rol par shes pa na/ /las gang byed thams cad bsgom gyi klong / /spyir yid la nyon mongs ci shar yang / /de mi spang mi grub lam khyer dang / /kun thug 'phrad 'bur 'joms btang 'tshal lo/ /tshogs drug snang kun kyang zhen med sbyangs/ /mdor hril dril dus dang rnam kun tu/ /skyabs bla ma yid dang ma bral cig /sdom dam tshig dri mas ma gos bsrung / /sems gnas lugs blta ba ma bral skyong / /ris ma mchis 'gro la snying rje bskyed/ /mched lcam dral kun la dag snang sbyongs/ /dus rtag tu khrel yod ngo tsha sogs/ /lam 'phags nor bdun dang 'grogs par mdzod/ /glu de skad phyogs med rgyal khams pa/ /ming tshe dbang nor bur grags pa des/ /gnas mang yul skyid grong la ldeb kyi/ /phu dkar zhes dam pa'i sgrub phug tu/ /tshogs 'khor lo'i skabs su gang shar tshig /bskul po'i ngo ru blangs pa dge/ /na mo gu ra we/ rje dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi dngos/ /mgon mtshungs pa med pa pad+ma 'byung / /pha de dang dbyer med bde chen gling / /mi bdag gi snying dbus bzhugs par nges/ /bu skal ldan kun dar cig tshur gson dang / /lus dal 'byor gyi rten bzang 'di thob par dka'/ /de yun ring du mi rtag 'jig nges kyi/ /da dam chos zhig bsgrub na myur du 'tshal/ /lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba dge ba'i bshes/ /de ma nor nges shes kyi mtshan ldan dgos/ /'di khe nyen che bas nan tan brtag /mtshan nyid ldan nges kyi rjes su 'jug par 'tshal/ /mtshan ldan bla ma de dus gsum rgyal kun gyi/ /ngo bo kun 'dus su gyur cing kun las lhag /mnyes pa 'ba' zhig la 'bad cing mi mnyes spang / /dam tshig snying dbus su chong zhig skal ldan bu/ /mdo rgyud gzhung lugs kyi rgya mtsho mtha' dag kyang / /snying po yang dag tu dril na gnas lugs don/ /phyag chen dang rdzogs chen las gzhan med do bu/ /mthar thug rdzogs chen ni snying po'i yang rtse yin/ /rdzogs chen mthar thug yang khreg chod thod rgal gnyis/ /khreg chod cog bzhag gsum lam gyi gzhi ma bskyid/ /nam mkha' gsum sprugs kyi rig pa'i rtsal chen spar/ /thod rgal 3snyiḍings

gsum gyi mkha' la sgron drug shar/ /mthar thug rang rig gi ngo bo gzer chen btab/ khams gsum myong grol gyi lam la gzhol ba na/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas su 'grub par gdon mi za/ /lam mchog mthar thug der zhugs mdzod skal ldan bu/ /mdo don snying po ru dril na nyams len mthil/ /bla ma'i mos gus kyi lam gyi gzhi bca' zhing / /ma yengs dran pa yi rgyang so rtag tu btsugs/ /ris med snying rje yi zin pa nyid du 'du/ /de skad tshig tshogs kyi spros pa mi mang yang / /nyams len snying po yi mdo don sne tshang zhig /kong po mchims yul gyi rje rigs dad pa can/ /tshe dbang dpal 'bar gyi gsung ngor glu ru blangs/ /zhes pa yang dpal rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu'i rab byung bcu gsum pa rgyal zla'i dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa la lha ldan bya 'dabs su smras pa sarba maṅga lo/swāsti/ bla ma brgya yod stong yod kyang / /rang sems ngo sprod bla ma'i mchog /sangs rgyas las lhag bka' drin can/ /rtsa ba'i bla mar phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang gi sems kyi ngo bo nyid/ /skye 'gag gnas pa kun las 'das/ /de la rdzogs chen pa rnams kyi/ /rig pa zhes su gdags par mdzad/ /de nyid lam du byed pa la/ /ma yengs mi bsgom kho na las/ /nyams len snying po gzhan yod min/ /des na yengs med gnyug ma skyong / /de yang gnas 'gyu dbyer med zhes/ /gnas pa skye ba med pa la/ /'gyu ba 'gag pa med pa 'phro/ /gnas 'gyu skye 'gag dbyer med do/ /ma yengs dran pa rgyal kun lam/ /yengs pa 'khor ba'i do ra yin/ /des na yengs med dran pa'i ngang / /nyin mtshan 'khor yug 'dres par bya/ /sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /rnam rtog dri ma dag pa dgos/ /'gyu ba spang len mi bya ste/ /'gyu ba ngang gi grol ba dgos/ /dge sbyor skye ba'i rtsa ba yang / /bla ma'i mos gus kho na yin/ /des na bla ma'i rnal 'byor la/ /ldem rgyang med par rtag tu 'bad/ /de sogs bshad bya mtha' yas kyang / /snying po'i nyams len skabs babs bzhin/ /cung zad tsam cig smras 'dis kyang / /nyams rtogs yar zla ltar 'phel shog /zhes mnga' ris smad glo bo yi rgyal po a mgon bstan 'dzin gyi nyams bzhes ched du rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus sa sbrul mgo zla'i dkar phyogs dga' ba gsum par smon thang du smras pa'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ srid 'dir 'dren pa mtshungs med rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rigs mchog 'od dpag med mgon rdo rje chos/ /kun dngos dran mchog rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /byang chub snying po'i bar du phyag byas te/ /skal ldan slob mas bskul phyir gdams ngag gi/ /brjod bya yi ge mdo tsam 'dir bkod bya/ /mngon mtho'i lam la nges par 'jug 'dod na/ /ngan song sdug bsngal shes shing 'jigs pa dgos/ /nges legs thar pa'i lam la gzhol 'dod na/ khams gsum 'khor bas blo snang dub pa dgos/ /dam pa'i lha chos ñtsā~Xs sa spyod pa la/ /rtag tu mi rtag skyo shas dran pa dgos/ /byang chub mchog gi lam la 'jug pa

na/ /gzhan la phan pa'i lhag bsam kho na dgos/ /gsang sngags chos kyi byin rlabs zhugs 'dod na/ /'chi thub na thub bla ma'i mos gus dgos/ /rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi 'jug sgo ni/ /ma nyams phyag len rgyun ldan dbang bskur dgos/ /ma dag dngos snang 'gog pa'i gnyen po ru/ /bskyed rim lha yi gsal snang brtan pa dgos/ /tha mal sgra yi zhan pa gzhom slad du/ /yi dam lha sngags bzlas pa rtag tu dgos/ /yid kyi sems 'khrul chu rgyun gcod slad du/ /ma yengs dran pa'i gru gzings rtag tu dgos/ /de ltar dgos dgu 'dzom pa'i zhal gdams 'di/ /skal ldan slob ma khyod kyi thugs dbus su/ /rtag tu bzhag nas nyams su len bya ru/ /rdo rje slob dpon tshul 'dzin de yis gdams/ /kye ho da dung yang gcig snying po'i gtam/ /yang gsang rdzogs pa chen po'i nyams len gnad/ /lta ba'i rgyal po rang sems chos nyid dbyings/ /skye 'gag gnas bral kun khyab spros bral gshis/ /yod min yin min rtag chad yul bral ba/ khas len ngos bzung bral 'di lta ba yin/ /de ltar ci bzhin lta ba gtan phebs don/ /de la ma yengs rig pa sa le ba/ /ched du ma bsgrim ched du ma lhod pa/ /rang bab cog bzhag mtsho la gza' skar bzhin/ /'dzin pa med la rang ngo shes pa yod/ /ma yengs bsam med bsgom pa'i rgyal po yin/ /rtog tshogs bzang ngan bya ba legs nyes dang / /spyod lam 'gro sdod smra brjod mang nyung dang / /dben pa'i gnas dang tshogs su spyod pa sogs/ /ci byas rang sems yengs med dran pa'i ngang / /rgya mtsho rba rlabs mtha' dag chu gcig bzhin/ /mtha' dag rang rig chos sku'i rang rtsal las/ /spang blang gnyen po tha dad ye med pa/ /'di ko rdzogs chen mchog gi spyod pa yin/ /lta sgom spyod pa'i rim pa de lta ste/ /'bras bu sku gsum zhes pa'i gzhi rtsa yang / /rang sems stong pa 'di ni chos kyi sku/ /rang snang gsal ba 'di ni longs spyod rdzogs/ /gsal stong dbyer med rig pa sprul pa'i sku/ /'di nyid mngon du gyur la 'bras bu ste/ /de bas gzhan du sku gsum rang rgyud med/ /des na gsal stong rig pa sku gsum dngos/ /shes nas gong bgrod ltos gzhi med pa ru/ /rang rig 'di kar kho thag gcod kyang 'tshal/ bshad bshad tshig tshogs spros pa mang na yang / /mdo don blta sgom spyod 'bras bdag 'dir 'dus/ /de yang mthar thug gsang ba snying thig gnad/ /chos nyid mngon sum don la ma yengs shing / /srog rtsal rdo rje'i bzlas par 'bad pa la/ /bla mar sangs rgyas mthong ba'i mos gus kyis/ /ldem 'gyang med pa'i gsol 'debs 'bad nus na/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub par gdon mi za/ /de skad tshig tshogs spros pa ma dor nas/ /nyams len gnad thog dbab pa'i gdams pa yin/ /zhes pa yang bod yul dbus lho rgyud rta mdo yi sde pa dad gus rnam dpyod kyi dpal dang ldan pa tshe dbang ngam phun tshogs gang gi gsung gi nan tan chen pos gsol ba btab pa'i ngor rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus chu 343

phag dbyug gu zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi dga' ba gnyis par kong yul lha yi ri bo zang nge'i zhol gu ru'i sgrub phug dang nye ba'i bya 'dabs khang gsar rdzong gi ba gam rtse yud cig tu bris pa dge legs su gyur cig /sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ rgyal ba kun gyi thugs kyi ye shes dpyid/ /gcig tu bsdus pa'i thig le pad+ma 'byung / /zhabs la srid pa gsum gyis phyag byas pa/ /mgon po de yi rtag tu dge bar mdzod/ /phun tshogs sgo bzhi'i 'du ba rgyal po'i khab/ /rnam mang rtsis mkhan kun gyi gtso bo mchog /gang gi sras gyur dad gus dge sems can/ /rdo rje slob mar gyur pa gang de la/ /dal 'byor don ldan ched du bla ma yi/ /zhal gdams nyams len snying po 'di skad gsol/ /'khor ba thog med dus nas da lta'i bar/ /skye 'chi grangs med sdug bsngal rgya mtshor byings/ /da res bsod nams mthu las dus lan cig /mi lus thob 'di snying po len par gces/ /gzod med ngan song sdug bsngal ma shes na/ /bde 'gro thar pa'i phan yon rtogs min cing / khams gsum 'khor bar zhen pa ma log na/ /gtan bde zhi ba bsgrub la yid mi gtod/ /des na ngan song sdug bsngal yongs shes shing / /khams gsum 'khor bar zhen pa log kyang 'tshal/ /de yi ched du skyabs gnas kun gyi gtso/ /dkon mchog gsum la mi byed skyabs 'gro bya/ /rang nyid gcig pur zhi bde rnyed min par/ /mkha' khyab 'gro la rtag tu sems bskyed bya/ /thar lam chos kyi rnam grangs mtha' yas kyang / /kun gyi mthar thug bla med gsang sngags yin/ /de yi lam rim bskyed dang rdzogs pa ste/ /bskyed rim rnam grangs yang yang snying po ni/ /tha mal bdag 'dzin phung po stong pa'i sdum/ /sems nyid rang gdangs rlung sems gnyug ma'i lus/ /rnam kun lha sku'i phyag rgyar gsal gdab ste/ /med bzhin snang la snang bzhin ma grub pa/ /sgyu ma me long pra phab ji bzhin du/ /rnam pa gsal zhing nga rgyal brtan par bya/ /ye shes phebs sogs bskyed rim ma rdzogs nas/ /tshe ring thun mong mchog rnams 'bad med dang / /bar dor yang dag mchog thob the tshom med/ /ci ltar 'gyang yang phyi ma byang chub 'grub/ /de nas bla med sngags kyi bskyed rim ni/ /yon tan du ma dran bzhin bsgrub 'os yin/ /yan lag rig sngags ngag bzlas rim pa yang / /rnam g.yeng brel dbang spangs pa rtag tu 'bad/ /yid 'gog rlung sbyor rdo rje'i bzlas pa yi/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'bras bu mngon ster byed/ /rdzogs rim mtshan bcas mtshan med grangs mang yang / /snying por dril na sangs rgyas chos kyi sku/ /rang gi sems nyid lhan skyes rang ngo nyid/ /ji bzhin shes las gzhan gyur rdzogs rim med/ /de yang mtshan ldan bla mas man ngag gnad/ /sems kyi 'gro 'ong gnas lugs rtsad gcad de/ /dmigs med brjod 'das spros pa'i mtha' bral ba/ /tshig tsam ma yin ji bzhin gnad phebs gces/ /de yang da lta'i sems nyid rang babs dang / /ha cang 344

mi sgrim ha cang mi lhod par/ /rang ngo shes tsam nyams len rtsa bar bzung / /de bas sgrim na 'jur bu'i gzebs su chud/ /klod na bag med g.yengs ba'i dbang du 'gro/ /grim lhod mtshams pa dar zab skud pa ltar/ /shes bzhin skyong ba nang don mkhan kun bzhed/ /med thabs med pa zab mo'i gnad nyid yin/ /mthar thug rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa na/ /grim dang klod pa'i spros pa ga la yod/ /mtha' brgyad las 'das yang dag lta ba yin/ /nyin mtshan 'od gsal 'khor yug bsgom pa'i mchog /blang dor rnam rtog zad pa spyod pa'i rtsa/ /sku gsum btsan sa zin pa 'bras bur 'dod/ /de lta mngon du gyur thabs rten 'brel gnad/ /mtha' dag bla ma'i byin rlabs kho nas yin/ /de yang dbang chos ma 'brel mngon rol du/ /bla ma'i mtshan nyid legs par brtag pa gces/ /'dres khyer dam sel zag zog can rnams yang / /dbang chos 'brel nas brtag dpyad bya mi rung / /dbang don spyi dang khyad par sems nyid don//ston pa'i bla ma sangs rgyas kun las lhag /'phang tshad mig dang gces tshad snying lta bur/ /ldem 'gyang med par mos gus gsol 'debs 'bad/ /dam chos brgyad khri bzhi stong snying po ni/ /mthar thug sangs rgyas sgrub thabs kho na ste/ /de yi mthar thug smin grol rim pa gnyis/ /de yi srog rtsa bla ma'i chos gus te//med thabs med pa'i chos kyi snying po ru/ /brgya bshad stong bshad rtsa ba de la thug /de 'dra bshad na 'dzad pa'i mtha' med kyi/ /gal tshig mdo tsam smras pa thugs la zhog /zhes kong yul rtse lha sgang gi rdzong bzhugs sde ba rtsis dpon sras phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyi yang yang bskul ba'i ngor shing glang lo phug lugs bshol 'don gyi smin drug zla ba'i dmar phyogs dga' ba gsum par ljon pa klung du rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus bris pa sarba maṅga lo/kye ho dad pa can khyod tshur gson dang / /dal 'byor rin chen 'di ni rnyed dka' zhing / /nam 'chi cha med yid la dran pa dang / /'chi dus phan pa dam pa'i lha chos mdzod/ /bslu med skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum brten cing / /'gro kun pha mar shes pa'i sems bskyed dang / /tshegs chung don che tshogs bsags maṇ+ḍal/ /sgrib sbyangs snying po yig brgya 'bad kyang 'tshal/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa kun nas che thang du/ /bshes gnyen bla ma bsten tshul kho na bsngags/ /des na yid ches gting tshugs bla ma la/ /mos gus ldem rgyang med pa'i gsol 'debs 'tshal/ /sngags lam bskyed rim sbyang stong sgyu ma dang / /rdzogs rim sems nyid rang ngo shes pa yi/ /yengs med dran pa rtag tu brtan pa dang / /de yang byang chub sems kyi zin yang 'tshal/ /mdo don 'khor bar zhen pa log pa dang / /bla ma'i mos gus dam tshig srog phur btsug /sgo gsum le lor ma lus dge la 'bad/ /dal 'byor stong log ma song snying po longs/ /tshig tshogs mang po'i spros pa ma bcad pas/ /mdo don snying por 'dril ba'i gtam 'di nyid/ /snying po 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu yi/ /a jo bstan 'dzin pa la gdams pa yin/ /sarba maṅga lo/345

e ma gsan 'tshal sgrub po rnal 'byor pa/ /tshig spros mang po bri la ma rmongs shing / /dben par yang dag 'jog cing snying 'dra bar/ /bdag ltar rnam g.yengs can gyi zhal gdams ci/ /'on kyang bskul ngo ma cag mtshon tsam pa/ /yin lugs sa bon tsam zhig 'di ru smras/ /'gro drug gnas la dal 'byor thob dka' ste/ /u dum wa ra'i dpe mtshungs da res tsam/ /nam 'chi cha med tshe ni glog dang 'dra/ /chu tshod re yi 'chi la de tsam nye/ /dkar nag 'bras bu bslu ba med nges te/ /chu klung bzhin du las kyi rjes su 'brangs/ /thar pa'i mchog ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te/ /de bsgrub lam la rab tu 'bad par rigs/ /blo ldog bzhi 'di chos kyi rmang gzhi ste/ /thar pa'i lam skas med thabs med pa yin//skyabs gnas kun 'dus ngo bo bla ma ste/ /skyid sdug gang byung blo gtad de la 'cha'/ /'gro drug sems can pha ma'i rang bzhin te/ /dge bsgrub kun kyang 'gro don kho nar bsngo/ /mdo rgyud chos rnams kun gyi yang snying ni/ /rang rig gnas lugs rtogs thabs kho na yin/ /lam gyi bye brag dbu phyag zhi gcod dang / /nā ro ni gu'i chos drug lam 'bras bu/ /sbyor drug rdzogs chen sogs su 'dogs lags shing / /kun gyi mthar thug don gyi gnad 'gag ni/ /byin rlabs bla ma'i mos gus kho na yin/ /'di yod chos rnams kun gyi srog snying yod/ /'di med chos kyi srog rtsa chad pa yin/ /des na skyid sdug dka' sla ci byung yang / /bla ma'i mos gus ldem rgyang med pa yi/ /dad mos dam tshig phur pa snying la btab/ /rang sems chos kyi sku ru ngo sprad pa'i/ /bla ma de ni sangs rgyas kun las lhag /gzhan gyi snang ngor ji ltar shar na yang / /rang gi rdo rje sems dpa' dngos su blta/ /de mthus nyams rtogs 'bras bur smin gyur te/ /nyams rtogs zhes pa'i sgra bo che de yang / /rang ngo shes dang ma shes khyad tsam las/ /da lta'i ma bcos shes pa 'di nyid ste/ /'di zhes tshig kyang ming stong tsam du zad/ /yod med yin min spros pa las 'das shing / /byar med blo yul las 'das chos nyid de/ /de bzhin nyid kyi gnas lugs zhes par brjod/ /de yang gnas skabs mdo don lag blang na/ /sngar 'das rtog pa'i phro bcad ma 'ongs pa'i/ /rnam rtog la sogs da lta'i shes pa la/ /gzo bral gnyug ma brjod mi shes pa'i don/ /rang ngor snang ba 'di ni chos kyi sku/ /gdod ma'i ye shes bya bar mkhas rnams bzhed/ /de yang dus kun spang blangs bcas bcos dang / /yin min re dogs gong bgrod ltos gzhi sogs/ /spangs te ma yengs mi bsgom rang thog tu/ /skyong na gnas lugs dri med mngon gyur thob/ /de yi bogs 'don khyad par gnad bdun gyis/ /'phags pa rdzogs chen thod rgal zhes grags te/ /mkha' gsum sgron bzhi rang rig lug rgyud kyi/ /'ben la longs spyod snang bzhi mngon gyur nas/ /kun bzang dgongs klong skyol byed lam mchog ste/ /rim sdu 4sdor drug sogs kyi rlung rtags dang / /'di mi mtshungs shing khyad par 'phags pa yin/ /des na

mi 'gul gsum dang sdod gsum gyi/ /nyams len 'bad na tshe 'dir sangs rgyas nges/ /nyams len rtsa ba'i snying po de yin la/ /de grogs thabs lam rtsa thig rlung gsum gyi/ /man ngag rnams kyang zhen bral blta ba'i ngang / /skyong bas drod tshad myur du skye bar 'gyur/ /de skad bu le gangs ri khrod gnas pa/ /tshe 'di'i zhen log nges don rdzogs chen gyi/ /rnal 'byor dam pa kun bzang yongs grol des/ /bkra shis bum pa spos khang lha gos rten/ /bcas shing gsung gi bskul ngor mdo khams pa/ /rgyal ba pad+ma'i sras gyur rig pa 'dzin/ /tshe dbang nor bur grags pa'i rgyal khams pa/ /de yi lcags phag mgo zla'i tshes gcig gi/ /snga char gang shar chu bab nyid spel ba'i/ /yi ge pa ni dge tshul dpal 'bar yin/ /maṅga lo/lhag pa'i bsam pa zla ba ltar dkar bas/ /tshigs su bcad pa'i 'od dkar bdud rtsi bzhin/ /skal ldan slob ma'i snying gi ku mud gang / /rab 'dzum dge ba'i dri bsung cher rgyas shog /oṃ swāste/ dpal ldan bla ma'i rigs sras dam pa'i gcung / /thub bstan ngur smrig gos kyi nyer mdzes pa/ /dge slong lag na phyag rdor dbang phyug rdo rje zhes bya ba/ /rang gi slob mar gyur la 'di skad gsol/ /stong gsum lus can ji snyed gnas kun las/ /lus med skra rtse'i mkha' la mnyam 'jug mang / /lus can rnams nas dal 'byor rten bzang ni/ /yang yang thob dka' nges shes gting nas skye/ /snang srid snod bcud kun kyang mi rtag cing / /'phral du skyes nas da bar dgra dang gnyen/ /bar ma'i 'gro kun 'chi 'gyur rang nyid kyang / /myur du 'chi nges mi rtag dus kun bsgom/ /tshe 'di'i snyan grags zang zing 'du long kun/ /sad kha'i rmi lam ji bzhin myur du 'jig /de la zhen med gtan bde'i 'dun ma mchog /dam pa'i lha chos snying gi dkyil nas 'bad/ /chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba rgyu 'bras te/ /rgyu 'bras las gzhan chos 'ga' yod min pas/ /dkar nag las la blang dor ma nor ba/ /rang gi rang la skul ma gdab kyin byos/ /thub bstan gnas pa'i tshad ni 'dul ba ste/ /de yi ngo bo so thar tshul khrims yin/ /des na dge slob go 'phang srid gsum gyi/ /rgyal srid thob pa'i zla min dga' ba 'tshal/ /snyigs dus mig ltos ngan pa'i bsre slad kyi/ /bud med chang gi yo lang spyad pa 'di/ /'dren pa dus gsum byon pa kun gyis bkag /de na de spangs go cha rtag tu brten/ /sngags gyi las rgya nyer thob lhan skyes kyi/ /mtshon byed ched las spros bcas skabs min par/ /sngags nas bkag na mdo nas smos ci 'tshal de bas bud med ring spang zhe la bsnag /rang sems chos nyid mngon sum rtogs pa'i tshe/ /bde stong ye shes de dang lhan cig shar/ /khu khrag 'dres pa'i bde bar rag mi las/ /des na mi 'gyur bde chen bsgrub la 'bung / /tshe gcig sangs rgyas nye lam rtsa ba ni/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla mar rag las pas/ /ma nor rgyud nas bshad bzhin thog mar btsal/ /rnyed nas bsten tshul rgyud nas bshad bzhin 'bad/34/stags

kyi srog rtsa dam tshig kho na ste/ /g.yo sgyu ngom lkog tshul 'chos ma yin par/ /chos dang rang sems gnyis po zhus dag btang / /dri med shel ltar rtag tu 'bad 'os yin/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun las lhag zhes pa/ /tshig tsam ma yin snying gi dkyil nas bsgom/ /sgo gsum 'bad pas mnyes pa'i zhabs tog bsgrub/ /thun drug gsol 'debs chad med snying la bzhag /rgya bod kun tu zab dgu dam pa'i chos/ /yang gsang kun gyi mthar thug rdzogs pa che/ /kun bzang dgongs pa drang thad bstan pa nyid/ /nyams len la 'bad tshe gcig sangs rgyas nges/ /de lta'i brjod bya'i tshig la zad pa ci/ /rnam pa mang po smras kyang ji zhig phan/ /thugs la bzhag na nyung ngu'i ngag des kyang / /don gnyis phun tshogs 'grub par som nyi med/ /de skad rang gzhan grub mtha' rgya mtsho che/ /'jug la 'jigs med blo gros gru gzings can/ /gangs ri'i khrod du rig pa 'dzin pa zhes/ /rgyal khams spyod pa tshe dbang nor bu yi/ /rje btsun chen po'i sgrub gnas za 'og phug /dkar po'i lo zhal gsar 'char rgyal zla yi/ /yar tshes rgyal ba gnyis pa'i thun mtshams su/ /gang shar lhug par brjod 'di dge gyur cig /dge'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/lta sgom spyod pa'i sgo nas zhal gdams mdor bsdus rin chen mdzod 'dzin yod/ oṃ swāste/ rgyal kun ngo bo mtsho skyes rdo rje/ /snying khong rus pa'i gting nas phyag 'tshal/ /phyogs med rgyal khams rnal 'byor pa la/ /zhal gdams dgos zhes gsung gi bskul bar/ /mang mang bri bar khom long ma byung rung //mtshon byed tsam zhig smra bar byas na/ /rgyal bas gsung pa'i chos sgo brgyad khri/ /bzhi stong grags pa'i snying po bsdu na/ /rgyu 'bras theg pa gnyis las gzhan med/ /rgyu la che chung chung ngu nyan rang / 'khor ba sdug bsngal rang bzhin shes nas/ spang 'dod go chas zhi ba phyogs gcig /don du gnyer bas lhag bsam rgya chung / /'bras bu'i sku dang mkhyen la sgrib pas/ /zhi bar gzhol yang myang 'das dngos min/ /des na theg chen blang byar ma bshad/ /rgyu yi theg chen kun kyang bzhed mthar/ /lta ba bdag med gnyis dang bsgom pa/ /smon 'jug stong nyid snying rjer yongs 'brel/ /spyod pa kun kyang lhag bsam gyis zin/ /'bras bu sku dang mkhyen gnyis rgyas bzhed/ /'di ni srid zhi'i mtha' la gnas min/ /byang chub 'bras 'dir mtshungs gzhan yongs med/ /des na byang chub che zhes yongs grags/ /'on kyang theg chen grub mtha'i nang tshan/ /sems tsam pa la rnam bden rnam rdzun/ /dbu ma rang rgyud thal 'gyur rnam rig /rgya bod mkhas pa'i khas len mang yang / /'on kyang rang lugs mkhas pa'i mkhas pa/ /shing rta chen por rgyal bas lung bstan/ /dam pa mang po'i bzhed pa mthun cing / /rdzogs chen lta bar shin tu 'jug pas//'khor lo gsum pa'i dgongs don ji bzhin/ /rnam rig dbu ma'i khas len byed mod/ /de dag rang gi gnas lugs brjod las/ /'god bzhag yig tshogs mang bas ma spros/ /'bras bu'i theg pa sngags sde 348

gnyis las/ /phyi pa thub rgyud skye ba grangs dang / /skye ba'i grangs kyi sangs rgyas bzhed mod/ /nang pa thabs rgyud 'di phyi bar dor/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i 'bras bu 'grub bzhed/ /de ltar sngags rgyud rnam pa kun gyi/ /mthar thug a ti yo ga zhes grags/ /de lta ti gsum sde bzhir grags mod/ /deng sang bka' srol 'ga' dang khyad par/ /snying thig bzhi sogs yang gsang sder nges/ /sngags rgyud kun gyi rtse rgyal lags pa/ /bdag ni grub mtha' de yi bzhed pa/ /ci nus nyid du skyong ba'i khul lags/ /de dag bdag rang lta ba'i gnas lugs/ /ci 'dra'i ngang tshul 'phros su phul la/ /mdo sngags lta ba'i rgyal po de 'drar//skal ldan rnams kyang zhugs par 'os mod/ /yang dag don la lta ba zhes pa/ /lta bya lta byed lta ba'i yul 'das/ /don la ming tshig ming tshig don zhen/ /spros pa'i mtha' kun bral ba de lags/ /bsgom pa zhes grags rim gnyis rnal 'byor/ /bskyed pa sbyang bya sbyong byed rim pa/ /ma 'khrul cho gas lha yi snang ba/ /bsam gtan dug med gsal snang bskyed bcing / /rdzogs pa'i rim pa rten can rten med/ /brten can phra thig bum can gtum sogs/ /rten med gnas lugs dpyad 'jogs kyis bsgom/ /dpyad sgom dag la dmod mi byed yang / /rang lugs tshul bzhin 'jog bsgom gtsor byed/ /'jog bsgom zab pa gtso bor ston dang / /gsal ba gtsor ston bzhed pa mang yang / /zab gsal dbyer med lam gyi snying lags//des na bsgom pa kun gyi mthar thug /zab gsal bde ba che 'di rmad byung / /'on kyang zab mo gtan la ma phab/ /gsal ba'i ye shes gnad du bsnun min/ /zab mo gnas lugs chos nyid de yang / /zhi gcod phyag sems bzhed pa dbyings gcig /gnas skabs khas blang 'dra min mang mod/ /de yi man ngag rnal 'byor brtul tsam 'gyur/ /de yang zab mo'i mthar thug khreg chod/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gzhi dang 'bras bu/ /rang rig rang gsal rang byung rjen pa/ /de nyid gtan la phab pa'i khyad chos/ /sngon 'gro sems kyi kho bu bshig cing / /dngos gzhi gcer mthong rang grol ngo bo/ /rang ngo rang sprod rang thag dbyings gcod/ /grol thog gdeng bzung sku bzhir la zla/ /mdor na rig stong lhan skyes zang kha/ /blo yul go ba tsam min rjen pa/ /ched kyi bsgom rgyu rdul phran tsam med/ /yengs ba'i dbang du nam yang ma shor/ /rang ngo rang shes yengs med zang thal/ /'di ka skyong las gsal bzhag gzhan med/ /gong bgrod ltos gzhi nam yang mi 'cha'/ /gshis thog go bar ma shor gnad lags/ /cog bzhig bzhi dang gsum gyi ngang la/ /dus rtag skyong la rdzogs chen khreg chod/ /gnad gdams kun kyang de ru 'du bas/ /snying po'i nyams len nyid la brtson 'tshal/ /gsal ba'i nyams len rnam grangs mang mod/ /sngags rgyud thun mong kun nas bskyed rim/ /la bzhed 'gas ni ma brtag sku dang / /de bzhin 'od gsal stong gzugs la'ang bzhed/ /rang lugs rdzogs pa che ni thod brgal/ /dbyings gsum sgron ma dgu dang drug gam/34/zlozhir

bzhed snying po shes rab rang byung / /dpe don rtags kyi gtan la phab pa/ khams gsum yongs grol dgongs pa nyid dang / /mi 'gul mi 'gyur thob gdeng 'cha' 'dis/ /thod brgal gnad kun de la 'du bas/ /bya ba dgu sprug btang nas 'bad 'tshal/ /bsgom pa'i rtags tshad snang bzhi'i nyams rim/ /mthar thug chos zad dbyings su bskyal te/ /'di la gsar ma'i mkhas pa 'ga' yi/ /chos zad tshig la dpyad par mdzad kyang / /chos ni rnam shes blo yul don gcig /de ma zad kyi bar du sgrib ldan/ /de nas sa bcu pa yang rnam shes/ /cha shas kyis ni shes bya'i sgrib grags/ /des na blo yid bzhi yi rnam shes/ /de zad pa la chos zad ming btags/ /mkhas mchog 'ga' ni 'di la gnas 'gyur/ /ming du btags mod don la gnad gcig /de ma go 'ga' chos zad zhes pa'i/ /tshig tsam nyid la dngangs skrag skye rnams/ /rtog ge'i blo yi 'phyang mo nyug ste/ /tshig gi smig sgyur ri dwags g.yom po/ /yang dag don la chos nyid ye shes/ /zad dang ma zad rtags kyang der min/ /zad mi zad ni ming btags kho na/ /chos nyid don ni khas len las 'das/ /'di la tshig tshogs yi ge'i 'jigs pas/ /skabs 'dir rgya cher spro ma byas mod/ /'on kyang nyid sogs dam pas zin cing / /rtse gcig gnas lugs 'jog la brtson pas/ /bsgom byung shes rab nang nas rgyas tshe/ /don dam rtogs la som nyi ci zhig /bdag ni chos mang thos bsam shes kyang / /rnam g.yeng bdud kyi bsgom pas dben gyur/ / ne tso bzhin du tshig tshogs klog la/ /ngo mtshar ldan zhes rang gi mi sems/ /des na rnal 'byor bsgom la brtson par/ /bdag lta'i zhal gdams ming gis ci zhig /'on kyang snang ba dag pa'i gzigs pas/ /zhal gdams dgos zhes gsung ngo tsam lags//yang cig spyod pa zhes su grags de/ /spros dang spros med bhu su ku sogs/ /rgyud sde nas bshad rnam grangs mang mang / /mdor bsdu gnas skabs lag tu blang bya/ /tshul khrims rtsa ba las 'bras la gzhib/ /btsun tshugs gzhan gyi dwangs ba 'dren dang / /mdzes khrig gzhan ngo tsam min snying nas/ /'gro phan lhag bsam nam yang dor min/ /gsang sngags chos kun srog rtsa dmar po/ /dam tshig gnyan la snying nas 'bad 'tshal/ /de dag kun gyi snying po dril na/ /lta ba dmigs med rang bzhin ye shes/ /bsgom pa zab gsal bde chen zung 'jug /spyod pa blang dor ma 'khrul brtul zhugs/ /kun gyi gzhi rten bla ma'i mos gus/ /gnad kyi yang tig rdo rje'i dam tshig /nam yang g.yel med snying la gzer nas/ /rim gnyis bsgom la brtson bskyed byas te/ /der ma 'du ba 'ga' yang ma mchis/ /des na snying po'i don der spyod 'tshal/ /de skad dgos yul 'bri mtshams bzhugs pa'i/ /kaḥthog gyang ris tshal kha'i rgyud 'dzin/ /snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa'i rnal 'byor/ /blo bzang snyan grags rab brtan gang gi/ /gsol ba btab ngor mdo khams dbudī ༵gyur/ /kaḥthog rdo rje gdan gyi mnga' ris/ /sa yi thig le 'bri rgyud phyogs skyes/ /pad 'byung

lung gi mngags pa'i pho nyar/ /rlom pa lha rigs shākya'i dge bsnyen/ /gzhung lugs rgya mtsho smra la mi 'jigs/ /spobs pa'i mgrin pa'i lang tsho brgyan gyur/ /tshe dbang nor bu dpal gyi rgya mtshos/ /pad+ma'i sbas yul 'bras ljongs byang phyogs/ /grub pa'i bste gnas gsang sngags ri bor/ /shing yos nag zla'i tshes nyer gsum gyi/ /thun skabs gcig tu gang shar bris pa'i/ /yig ris rang gi slob mar gyur pa/ /o rgyan bstan 'dzin rdo rje'i bgyis so/ /maṅga lo/ dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /oṃ swāste/ rgyal bka' mdo rgyud grub thob gong ma'i gsung / /nyams su blangs na de kun zhal gdams yin/ /gsar du bdag gi smras pas ci zhig bya/ /'on kyang bskul ngo ma bcog cung zad cig /smra na dal 'byor rin chen mi yi lus/ /u dum wa ra ji bzhin rnyed dka' zhing / /nam 'chi cha med ring min myur 'chi ba/ /dal 'byor don ldan brtson pas chos la 'bad/ /chos la mos kyang snyigs dus grogs rkyen gyi/ /chos min log pa'i lam du dkri mang bas/ /chos mthun grogs brten rang skyon rang gis brtag /bka' brgyud gong ma'i rnam thar bsam bzhin bslab/ /chos kun las 'bras bslu med yid ches su/ /shes bzhin sngags chos kun gyi rtsa ba'i gnad/ /bla ma'i mos gus dam tshig kho na la/ /lus srog ltos pa med pa'i ngang du bskyed/ /gnas lugs phyag chen zhes pa'i sgra bo che/ /rang sems ma bcos rang bab lhug pa la/ /ma yengs dran pa rgyun chags brten pa las/ /gzhan med nyin mtshan 'khor yug de la 'bad/ /thun mtshams 'gro la snying rje gzhan phan gyi/ /smon lam bzang po dung dung rtag tu bya/ /lha bsgom sngags bzlas kun kyang dge sbyor grogs/ /yi dam snying po ci nus 'bad pa gnad/ /de skad sgrub po sbyin pa rgya mtsho'i ngor/ /rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu yi/ /gang shar tshigs bcad smras te don ldan par/ /rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas rgyu ru 'gro bar shog /sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāsti/ kun tu rgyal ba'i sprin tshogs spro dang bsdu/ /ma lus byed po lag na pad+mo can/ /dbyer med 'khor lo'i mgon po bde ba che/ /de yi byang chub mchog bar bsrung gyur cig /gang khyed yul dbus mkhas mang 'du ba'i ljongs/ /thub bstan sgor zhugs ngur smrig gos kyis mdzes/ /sngon bsags ma smad shes rab bslab gsum rgyas/ /mtshungs med mgon gyis rjes bzung dam par nges/ /bdag ni mtha' 'khob yul skyes chos kyi dbul/ /skye dang sbyangs pas mngon par mtho ba'ang min/ /'on kyang mchog gyur mang pos rjes bzung mthus/ /khyed zhal ma bskyung tsam du 'di skad gsol/ /rnam dkar kun gyi sngon 'gro dge ba'i chos/ /mtha' dag bskyed pa'i gzhi rten dad pa ste/ /'dod 'dun mi phyed dag pa'i dad pa nyid/ /rgyud la bskyed pa shin tu gal che mod/ /de yang ji bzhin bskyed pa'i gzhi rten ni/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la yid ches skye ba ste/ /de yi mdzad pa che ba'i yon tan rnams/ /rtag par rjes dran snying gi dkyil 351

du bzhag /khams gsum gzugs 'dod gnas skye 'gro ba kun/ /yongs su sdom kyang mkha' khams ba spu'i khyon/ /gzugs med bag nyal sems can cha shas yang / /bzung bar nus min 'khor sems rdzogs mtha' ci/ /lus can 'gro ba drug las lha mi'i rten/ /chos dkon de las dal 'byor phun tshogs lus/ /ngo bo rgyu dpe rnam grangs du ma nas/ /rnyed par dka' tshul du ma'i sgo nas brtag /mi'i lus 'di shin tu 'jig sla ste/ /dri za'i grong dang chu yi sbu ba 'dra/ /gnod mang phan nyung 'chi rkyen du ma la/ /bsam byas snying nas mi rtag skyo shas bskyed/ /des na cung zad khom long ldan dus 'dir/ /mgo la me shor 'phang du sbrul zhugs bzhin/ /mngon mtho nges legs lam la ma brtson na/ /don med stong las mkhan du cis mi 'gyur/ /'khor ba'i mtshan nyid 'bar ba'i me 'obs dang / /tsher ma'i gdan dang tīm pa'i 'bras bu bzhin/ /sdug bsngal gsum gyi 'khor ba thog med nas/ /da lta'i bar du gdung 'di yid re skyo//da yang de yi bzlog thabs ma 'bad na/ /nam mkha' ji srid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ru/ /sdug bsngal 'dzin khri'i nyer kheng bar med du/ /bcir 'di rang gi rang la snying rjes ltos/ /chos dbyings khams la gzhan pa'i chos thams cad/ /rgyu rkyen rten 'brel rol pa las grub na/ /mi dge'i las kyi ngan song duḥkha dang //dge yang bdag ldan mtho ris 'gyur bcas rgyu/ /rnam kun bde ba thar pa'i lam bzang ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan las gzhan yod min/ /des na de gsung las 'bras dam pa'i chos/ /ci nus spyod pa gnad kyi nyams len ste/ /sngon byon rgyal ba sras slob kun gyi tshul/ /'di gzigs thar la gshegs par nges byas nas/ /sngon 'gror ming btags gnang chung 'di mi 'dzin/ /nyin mtshan thun drug bsgom dgos chos mchog yin/ /sdug bsngal rgyun las sgrol ba'i skabs gnas ni/ /mtshungs pa gzhan med dkon mchog rin chen gsum/ /'di nas byang chub bar du skyabs kyi yul/ /re gnas gcig pur mkhas blang blo thag bcad/ /de yang skyid dus rang gi pho sgo dang / /sdug dus dkon mchog gsum la yus 'tshong 'di/ /ma rabs byis pa rnams kyi ngang tshul te/ /rang cag dam pa'i lugs su de mi spyod/ /skyid na bla ma dkon mchog thugs rjer nges/ /sdug na sngon las rnam smin lhag ma ste/ /de dag kun kyang gtad med sgyu ma bzhin/ /shes par bya ba dam pa'i ring lugs yin/ khams gsum 'khor ba las grol thar pa yang / /gnyis te chung ngu rang nyid zhi bde'i 'bras/ /nyan rang theg zhes nges 'byung rma med tsam/ /skyes bu 'bring po'i lam du mgon rnams bzhed/ /pha ma'i rang bzhin khams gsum sems can rnams/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal du mas gzir ba la/ /mi blta rang nyid zhi bde'i ngo tsha chung / /khrel bor tha chad 'di yi ci zhig bya/ /zhi ba'i 'gog pa la gnas bgrangs yas bskal/ /pha mtha'i bar du byang chub spyad spyod pa'i//gegadī ༵di ring spang rgyal dang de sras 'phags/ /kun gyi gsung na blo can su zhig 'jug /kye ho grogs

po tshur gshegs thar pa'i lam/ /srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' gnyis las 'das pa/ /don gnyis lhun grub rgyal ba'i gnas dam pa/ /'di la lhan cig tshangs par mtshungs spyod mdzod/ /sems bskyed cho gas len pa bzang yod kyang / /theg chen bsam pa gtso bor gyur pa yi/ /des na lhag pa'i bsam pa 'ba' zhig pas/ /mtha' yas 'gro la phan pa rtag bsgrub tshal/ /mdo dang shing rta chen po'i gsung rnams su/ /smon 'jug bslab bya rgya mtsho ltar gsung mod/ /mdor bsdus sangs rgyas la smon de rgyur 'jug /phyin drug bsdu dngos bzhi la 'du bar rtogs/ /'phral du dkar nag chos brgyad spangs blang dang / /pham pa bco brgyad ma gos pa yang gces/ /don dam sems bskyed sher phyin chos nyid gshis/ /de nyid rtogs thabs bsags sbyangs las la 'bad/ /'on kyang phar phyin lam gyi dbang bsnon ni/ /bskal pa grangs med gsum nas 'tshang rgyar bzhed/ /'khor lo gsum pa'i lam rim 'jog bsgom lugs/ /de bas kyang ni myur bar 'dod pa'ang mthong / /dbang brtul grangs med bskal pa so gsum dang / /smon lam mthu'i ni de lta yang ma nges/ /'di yi tshul mang mthong dang bshes gnyen mchog /zhal lung zhib mor nyan pa'ang gnad du che/ /theg chen thun min gsang ba sngags kyi lam/ /de yi mthar thug bla med rdo rje theg /myur de rdzogs pa'i lam mchog der 'jug par/ /ston byed rdo rje slob dpon mtshan ldan gces/ /de yang dbang khrid lung gi rgyun tsam la/ /'dres khyer dam sel med pa kho nas chog /ji bzhin 'dren pa nyid du brten pa la/ /sangs rgyas 'byung nas zhal dang thugs kyi sgor/ /gnas pa nyid las gzhan gyi nus min zhes/ /dpal ldan dang po'i sangs rgyas nas rgyud gsungs/ /'on kyang snyigs dus skyon yon 'dres gyur kyang / /yon tan mang na bla mar brten 'os zhes/ /lag na chu skyes 'chang ba mgon po des/ /don dam bsnyen pa'i gzhung du legs par gsungs/ /deng sang ma brtag gsang sngags gya tshom dbang / /shas cher spyod na bshad tshod las ci zhig /'jig rten phal gyi zhag shas grogs la yang / /bzang dang ngan zhes nan tan brtag byed na/ /gtan bde'i lam mkhan rtsa ba'i bla ma gang / /gya tshom ma yin brtag dpyad shin tu gces/ /sngags kyi 'jug ngogs gzhi rten smin byed dbang / /rgyal bas rgyud nas gsung bzhin grub pa'i srol/ /ma nyams lhag chad med par mnos byas nas/ /de yi bcas pa snying gi dkyil du gcags/ /sngags kyi lam la zhugs pa'i srog rtsa ni/ /med thabs med pa bla ma'i dam tshig yin/ /bla ma la yang rtsa ba yan lag gnyis/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas kun las lhag /yan lag kun kyang de yi sprul par blta/ /nyin mtshan med par gso ba phur tshugs gdab/ /ci mdzad legs blta ci gsung tshad mar 'dzin/ /de la mi 'du dam tshig 'ga' yod min/ /yi dam lha yang bla ma'i sgyu 'phrul te/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong de yi rang mdangs tsam/ /rtag tu shes bzhin bsgom sgrub la 'bad na/ /dngos grub myur du thob la so~X ༵ ci//

sngags lam mdor bsdus bskyed rdzogs rim pa gnyis/ /skye sbyangs ma dag dngos snang 'gog bskyed rim/ /gsal brtan dag pa ldan pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo rag sbom phra gsal ba/ /thun dang nyin zhag mnyam par bzhag nus na/ /thun mong grub chen zhag zlas nyer 'grub cing / /thun min phyag rgya che yang ring min zhes/ /rdo rje can zhabs dpal gyi mgur nas thos/ /rdzogs rim la yang mtshan bcas mtshan med gnyis/ /mtshan bcas yig 'bru thig le rlung sbyor sogs/ /nyer brten bod 'dir chos drug rigs gnyis dang / /lam 'bras la sogs sngags kyi myur lam mang / /mtshan med dbang bzhi'i ye shes rgya bod du/ /'dod tshul mang mod re zhig bod yul 'dir/ /zhi byed spyod yul mda' snun lugs phyag chen/ /rdzogs chen sems klong gsang skor rnams la bzhag /gang ltar rang rig zab gsal bde ba che/ /mngon sum rtogs na bzhi pa'i ye shes yin/ /de yang zab mo'i phyogs nas gzhal ba na/ /phar phyin lta ba'i khrid dang shin tu mthun/ /mi 'gyur bde lam sngags kyi khyad par chos/ /gsal ba dkyil 'khor 'khor los yang ni so/ /'phags klu'i rim lnga ye shes zhabs grol thig /dus 'khor sbyor drug rdzogs chen yang gsang gi/ /bzhi pa'i lam rnams sangs rgyas kyi ye shes/ /bzhugs tshul nyid dang mthun par nges shes skyes/ /'di don zhib mor bla ma'i zhal lung las/ /dpe klog 'phrin bskur tsam gyi nus ma yin/ /mdo ru gzhan gyi brjod min lhan cig skyes/ /ye shes des ni bla ma'i byin rlabs mthu/ /nam zhig snying la zhugs par gyur pa'i tshe/ /mngon sum byed las dpe tshig spyod yul min/ /rgyud don mkhas pas bzhag pa de lta yang / /rtogs ldan rnal 'byor rnams kyi glen tshig tu/ /rtsa ba'i bla mar snying nas gus pa yi/ /phur tshugs gsol 'debs khams 'dus rjes shes su/ /dus gsum rnam par rtog pas ma bslad pa'i/ /rang rig rjen pa sa le sing nge ba/ /rang bab gnyug ma'i ngang du gnas pa 'di/ /bsgom med yengs med ngang du bskyang nus na/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi bgrod gcig lam/ /sems nyid chos kyi sku ru ngo sprad zhes/ /tshig la mkhas rnams mgu'am mi mgu rung / /nged cag rnal 'byor rnams kyi nyams len yin/ /de yang tshig dang go nyams rtogs pa bzhi/ /ma 'dres so sor spu ris 'byed pa gces/ /tshig tsam kho na'i rjes bzlos ne tso'i dpe/ /go ba ma bsgrod yul bkod thos sems bzhin/ /nyams myong yul bkod shog khra mthong sems tsam/ /rtogs pa mngon sum mig gi spyod yul bzhin/ /tshig tsam 'dra yang rang gi sems thog tu/ /bzhag tshe de rnams khyad par shin tu che/ /'on kyang gnas lugs nyams len snying po la/ /bsgom 'dod blo yin yengs dbang 'khrul pa nyid/ /gnas dang 'gyu la dgag bsgrub re dogs gzab/ /des na rang bab ma yengs tsam skyongs gnad/ /rnam rtog rags sbom phra ba mi slong bar/ /gnas nyams tsam gyi thar la 'gro min gyi/ /des na rags sbom phra ba'i spu ris gang / /legs par 'byed 354

nas lam du slong ba 'di/ /dus 'dir dus gsum rgyal kun 'dus pa'i zhal/ /bdag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje can/ /gang gi byin rlabs gsung gi cha phra mo/ /snying la gnas pa khyed la brtse bas gdams/ /deng dus gnas nyams ban bun skyes pa'am/ /rbad gshod rtsing hral tsam la yid mgu na/ /bdag gi gcigs su bzung nas phra mo'i gnas/ /'di yi ci bya rang nyid ngal bar zad/ /'on kyang nyid nas dag pa'i snang ba yi/ /zhal gdams dgos zhes gsung gi bskul ba na/ /gal 'gag zab gnad 'ga' zhig mdor bsdus na/ /'di ru gsol la nyes pa med par sems/ /de skad lag na pad+mo'i gdul bya'i zhing / /rdul dkar rab brgyan dbyig 'dzin dkyil 'khor la/ /dbang bsgyur gru 'dzin bdag po rgyal ba mchog /'jig rten mgon po skal bzang rgya mtsho yi/ /zhabs pad nye bar bsnyen pa dge ba'i bshes/ /'phyongs rgyas ri bo bde chen mkhan po che/ /sde snod 'dzin pa bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho yis/ /gsung ngo ma cog tsam du zhal gdams tshul/ /phyogs med rgyal khams kun spyod bya bral ba/ /rgya bal bod yul kun du grags gyur ming //rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu zhes pa yi/ /rab byung bcu gsum skyes bdag lo gsar 'char/ /dkar phyogs dge ba'i dus tshes bzang po la/ /grub pa'i bste gnas stod lung mtshur phu ru/ /gang shar chu bab thun gcig la grub par/ /smras 'di dge legs 'phel ba'i rtsas gyur shog /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/swāste/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gi rang gzugs mchog /dran pas srid zhi'i rgud pa yongs sel mgon/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma bde chen gling pa de/ /spyi bor dran bzhin khyod la 'di skad smra/ /dal 'byor rten bzang thob 'di rnyed dka' na/ /don med stong zad ngang du ma song gces/ /'chi bdag bdud po nam yongs cha med kyi/ /dge ba'i las la snga 'gros chub pa gces/ /las 'bras 'di ni nam yang mi bslu bas/ /dge sdig 'dor len snying nas 'bad pa gces/ /gtan gyi 'dun ma dam pa'i lha chos te/ /mthar thug sangs rgyas lam la 'bad pa gces/ /bag med rnam g.yeng dbang du ma song bar/ /chos spyod bcu la ci nus 'bad pa gces/ /ma dag dngos snang 'gog pa bskyed rim ste/ /lhag pa'i lha yi sku la sems gtad gces/ /bar chad zhi zhing sgrib pa sbyangs pa'i mchog /yi dam rigs sngags bzla ba'ang mchog tu gces/ /chos rnams kun gyi snying por gyur pa ni/ /bla ma'i dam tshig yin pas srog ltar gces//de yang rdzogs sangs rgyas la yid ches pa'i/ /dad pa brtan po snying gi dkyil nas gces/ /byang sems bslab pa gzhan phan 'ba' zhig ste/ /rtag tu byams dang snying rje bsgom pa gces/ /de 'dra brjod na mdzad pa'i mtha' med pas/ /mdo don snying po re zhig de tsam bzung / /de skad mnga' ris phyogs nas dad pa can/ /phun tshogs zla bas lan grangs yang nas yang / /gsol ba btab pa'i ngo dga' ༵ zloskyung

bar/ /rgyal khams par gyur rig pa 'dzin pa des/ /lhag pa'i bsam pas cung zad smras pa 'di'i/ /dge bas khyed kyang byang chub 'bras smin shog /sarba maṅga lo/swāste/ dad pas bdag la yang yang 'dud byed pa/ /blo gsal nyi ma rdo rje'i 'phrin yig son/ /grangs med rtswa ldum dbus nas dal 'byor gyi/ /ut+pal dkar po rnyed pa da res tsam/ /bag med rnam g.yeng sad la ma bskur bar/ /bskyed rdzogs rtse gcig bsgom na don ldan yin/ /mi bzad nad ni sngon gyi las yin pas/ /snying nas dam chos bsgrub na bskul ma yin/ /las kyi bsdus pa'i gdon rigs 'byung po yang / /snying rje gting nas skyes na grogs su 'gyur/ /bla ma mi ru bzung ba'i 'dzin tshugs dang / /dad pa ldem rgyang can la dngos grub med/ /des na skyid sdug legs nyes ci byung yang / /bla ma sangs rgyas mos gus ldem rgyang spangs/ /lha dang bla ma dbyer med ngo shes nas/ /yi dam bsgom bzlas 'di phyi'i don chen 'grub/ /khro 'khrug sems kyi drag sngags mang na yang / /gnas skabs rkyen sel 'gyur srid gtan bde min/ /des na gtan gyi bde ba la dmigs nas/ /byang chub sems bskyed yi dam bsgom bzlas 'bod/ /bdag la snying nas mos gus skyes gyur na/ /mos pa'i rang ngo rang rig rjen par ltos/ /de mthong rang rig bla ma'i ngo bor shar/ /lam zab bla bsgrub snying po de rang yin/ /tshig tshogs mang po spros na zad mtha' med/ /nyams len snying por bsdu na de la 'du/ /de skad sangs rgyas thog ston gyi dbon rigs/ /skyid rong tshong 'dus bla ma nyi rdor ba/ /nad gdon gyis brtser de la brtse sems kyis/ /phyogs bral nam mkha'i rnal 'byor rgyal khams pa/ /rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu yi/ /lha mo sgang nas spel ba'i li khi tam/ /sarba maṅga lo/swāste/ srid pa'i drwa ba mtha' dag yongs gcod cing / /zhi ba'i mal sar rnal bar mi mdzad pa/ /gnyis med gsung ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /rtag tu phyag 'tshal kun tu dge legs stsol/ /rigs rus rnam dag skye shing 'phreng ba'i dbus/ /mngon mtho sā la'i shing 'dra lce yi gdung / /lugs gnyis mkhyen dpyod ldan pa sprul pa'i sku/ /gang de'i thugs ngal gso phyir 'di skad gsol/ /'dus byas chos rnams thams cad mi rtag pa'i/ /nges par rgyal ba sras bcas kun gyi gdams/ /des na mi rtag pa'i ngang tshul gang / /ji bzhin dran par bya ste de yi tshul/ /yul ljongs mi rtag dri za'i grong khyer 'dra/ /'dus tshogs mi rtag tshong 'dus mgron po 'dra/ /nang mi mi rtag tho rengs skar ma 'dra/ /pha ma mi rtag tshes gsum zla ba 'dra/ /rang nyid mi rtag thal grang me stag 'dra/ /longs spyod mi rtag rtswa kha'i zil pa 'dra/ /rje dpon mi rtag ston gzhug me tog 'dra/ /mnga' thang thob shor mig mangs rtse ba 'dra/ /snyan pa'i k+taspyazlo ni brag cha smra ba 'dra/ /bde ba'i go skabs mun khung glog 'khyug 'dra/ /sdug bsngal 'dzad

med chu yi gnyer ma 'dra/ /gtam gsar mang po sol me'i 'gar sbud 'dra/ /ji ltar snang kun bden med sgyu ma 'dra/ /gang ltar snang yang rmi lam sad kha 'dra/ /'khor ba'i mtshan nyid kun nas sdug bsngal zhing / /bye brag snyigs ma lnga bdo'i mthar thug 'dir/ /bsam bzhin skyo ba skye las gzhan med na/ /dam pa'i chos la rtse gcig gzhol bar 'os/ /des na gnas dus 'gyur ba che ba'i skabs/ /yab rje gshegs pa shin tu ma legs kyang / /kun rdzob chos kun mi rtag mtshan nyid du/ /shes bzhin thugs ngal ring du spong bar mdzod/ /'khor ba'i mngon mtho kim pa'i 'bras bu bzhin/ /'phral du bde yang nam phugs sdug bsngal rgyu/ /gang la bltas kyang snying po mi 'dug pas/ /gtan bde'i 'dun ma dam pa'i lha chos la//snying nas 'bad pa'i bskul ma nyid la ltos/ /snyigs ma'i dus skyes chu bur lta bu'i lus/ /myur du 'jig par 'gyur ba smos ci 'tshal/ /bsod nams mthu ldan 'khor lo'i bsgyur rgyal dang / /tshangs dang rgya byin rnams kyang mi rtag la/ /de bas ches mchog rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /mtshan dpe rdo rje'i sku yang brtul mdzad na/ /lus can 'gro ba gzhan rnams smos ci 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi nges don chos dbyings zhing / /mthug po bkod par rten 'gyur longs spyod rdzogs/ /brten pa chos sku sku dang ye shes tshul/ /zung 'jug bral min rgyal ba gang de las/ /gzhan gyur mtha' dag mi rtag tshul can te/ /des na rtag brtan bde ba sib pa'i gnas/ /gang gi go 'phang sgrub la snying khams kyi/ /brtson par bskyed dus 'di la 'bad par rigs/ /des na tshe 'di'i bde sdug snang ba kun/ /bslu med las 'bras nyid la yid ches shing / /gzhan phan lhag bsam rgya chen gzhi ru 'dings/ /bla ma'i mos gus dam tshig srog phur btab/ /gnam sa go ldog rgya mtsho'i lto 'khrug kyang / /rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog gsum yongs mi spongs/ /ma brjed snying gi dbus su wa ler bsgom/ /des ni gtan bde byang chub lam rkang tshugs/ /chos rnams kun gyi mthar thug bskyal po ni/ /bla ma'i mos gus gnad du bsnun pa'i tshe/ /byin rlabs snying la zhugs pas rang mdangs su/ /chos nyid gdod ma'i gnas lugs chos kyi sku/ /rang rig stong gsal 'dzin pa kun las 'das/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang gzigs min stong pa nyid/ /'khor 'das mtha' dag 'char gzhi 'od gsal gshis/ /gang de phyogs su bslan pa nyams myong dang / /phyogs cha mthong ba rtogs pa'i tha snyad de/ /sa lam gong bgrod mthar thug sangs rgyas yang / /'di nyid mngon du gyur las gzhan yod min/ /gtan bde 'chi med gnas 'di la 'bad 'tshal/ /rgyal gsung brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kun yang / /mthar thug snying por dril pa 'di las med/ /des na dal 'byor thob dka' 'jig sla ba/ /yud tsam skabs 'dir gtan gyi bde ba mchog /grub pa'i las la snyom las ma yin par/ /de don brtson 'grus bskyed pa'i dus la babs/ /de lta'i ngang tshul mchog la zhugs tsa na/ /gtan rje pha mchoṭ+wāṃ 5shā ba'i

bla ma yin/ /gtan gyi ma ma ma mo'i mkha' 'gro yin/ /gtan gyi grogs po chos skyong dam can yin/ /gtan gyi 'dun ma thar pa'i lam bzang yin/ /gtan gyi nor skal 'phags pa'i nor bdun yin/ /des na sems kyi ri dwags 'phral bde yi/ /smig sgyu ma zhen gtan bde'i lam mchog la/ /'jug par mdzod cig skal ldan snying gi bu/ /dam pa khyod la kho bos 'phrin du gdams/ /de skad sa la spyod pa'i 'og min mchog /dpal ldan mtshur phu mo brang garjo la/ /'jig rten dbang phyug mchog gi bste gnas nas/ /phyogs med ris med sprang po bya bral ba/ /dpal ldan rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu yi/ /bco brgyad chos rje na len+t+ra sa yi/ /yab rje gshegs pa'i thugs la sel byed du/ /gang shar gsol 'dis dge tshogs 'phel 'gyur shog /sarba maṅga lo/swāste/ bla ma brgya yod stong yod kyang / /rang sems ngo sprod bla ma'i mchog /slob ma brgya yod stong yod kyang / /sems ngo 'phrod pa slob ma mchog /sdom pa gsum zhes bya ba yang / /tshul khrims nang nas sems gtso la/ /byang sdom don dam sems bskyed gtso/ /dbang bskur nang nas bzhi ba gtso/ /des na gnas lugs nyams len gnad/ /sdom gsum rtsa ba stong / /dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag ces/ /gsang sngags mkhan la grags che ba/ /de yang dbang ni don dbang gtso/ /don dbang sems phyogs nyams len yin/ /rgyud bshad pa yang mthar thug pa/ /nyams len sems kyi 'dril thabs yin/ /man ngan de'i lam ston dngos/ /de phyir chos kun sems la 'du/ /des na rang shar phyag rgya che/ /de la snying nas gus par bgyi/ /rang shar phyag rgya chen po yang / /da lta'i shes pa sa le ba/ /ngos bzung med la ngo shes yod/ /de ga rtag tu skyong ba las/ /phyag rgya che zhes don gzhan med/ /de phyir de la yang dag 'bad/ /de yi rtsa ba bla ma yi/ /mos gus ldem rgyang med pa gces/ /tshul 'di gnas la 'khel nus na/ /chos gzugs tsam la rag ma las/ /mkhas dang go 'phang che rnams yang / /don 'di ma rtogs stong yod nges//des na bdag gi rjes 'jug bu/ /gser ram za 'og ras ma bzhin/ /nges don snying po'i lam bzang la//dga' ba'i glu dbyangs blangs kyin shog /zhes dad pa can pra tiṣ+ṭha k+ṣa ra'i ngor skyid grong rang byung 'phags pa'i 'dabs su dpal gdong chu bya rgyud rtsis gshol med rgyal zla'i dmar phyogs kyi thob pa dang po'i thun mtshams skad cig mar rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu'i yang dag par brjod pa dge'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/ri khrod pa 'od gsal zla ba la gdams/ rgyal ba'i gsung pa'i chos kyi grangs/ /rgyal ba nyid las su yi rtogs/ /chos kun bsdu na snying po ni/ /mdo sngags theg pa gnyis la 'du/ /de yang snying por dril shā 5sdugs/ /de yi rtsa bar bla mar rag /des na de la gsol ba thob/ /de yi byin rlabs zhugs pa

na/ /gcig shes kun grol zhes bya ba'i/ /rang sems rang bzhin 'od gsal rtogs/ /de dang snying rje zung 'jug spyod/ /des ni rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob/ /zhes pa yang tshe dbang rig 'dzin pad+ma ka'i pho nyar gyur pa des so/ /maṅga lo/swāsti/ bla ma'i mos gus gnad du gyur pa na/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab bslab gsum rdzogs/ /sgo gsum gus pa'i spyod pa rtsom pa 'di/ /bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud kyi man ngag rdzogs/ /bla ma'i sku gsung thugs su lam khyer ba/ /bla med rgyud sde'i dgongs pa yang tig yin/ /mdor na theg pa rim dgu'i chos rnams kun/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor dag la ma 'dus med/ /de yang ci mdzad legs mthong ci gsung nyan/ /mos gus 'phel 'grib med pa kho nang 'du/ /mthar thug snying po rang rig ngo bo gang / /des med bsam bral zab gsal bde ba che/ /'di ka bla ma'i ngo bor go yul tsam/ /ma yin snying gi dkyil nas nam rtogs tshe/ /rang sems ngo shes bla ma chos sku zhes/ /rnal 'byor rgad po rnams kyi rlung ltar bsgrags/ /des na don gnyer skye bo mtha' dag kyang / /lam mchog nges pa de la 'jug bya yin/ /de phyir thar 'dod khyod kyang dam pa yi/ /gdams pa ji bzhin nyams su bzung bar 'os/ /de skad snying nas gus pa'i dpal 'dzin pa/ /a 'thas rje btsun gang gi dad pa'i gsos/ /rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus brjod pa yin/ /maṅga lo/swāsti/ nges par byung ba'i bsam pa ma smad cing / /don bsgom mchog la zhugs pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /bod chen phyogs skyes rin chen don yod kyi/ /nyams len rtogs pa phul la lan 'di gsol/ /rgyal bas gsung pa brgyad khri bzhi stong chos/ /kun gyi mthar thug theg chen nges don chos/ /de yi mthar thug rdo rje theg pa ste/ /de yang smin grol gnyis la ma 'dus med/ /smin byed dbang gi mthar thug bzhi pa ste/ /grol byed lam gyi mthar thug phyag rgya che/ /de nyid mngon sum rtogs par byed pa'i thabs/ /tshogs bsags sgrib sbyangs bla ma'i rnal 'byor las/ /gzhan gyur nye ba'i lam du yong ma yin/ /des na bla ma'i mos gus gnad du bsnun/ /bla ma'i rang bzhin chos sku mkha' khyab ste/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal nges pa lnga yi bdag /gang 'dul der ston bdag gi 'dren pa ste/ /ci mdzad legs mthong ci gsung tshad mar 'dzin/ /nyin mtshan thun drug gsol 'debs rgyun mi bcad/ /ldem rgyang med pa'i mos gus srog tu bzung / /bla ma'i byin rlabs snying la zhugs pa na/ /bla ma rang rig dbyer med gcig tu rtogs/ /smra bsam brjod tshig dpe yi yul las 'das/ /skye 'gag gnas pa'i spros pa khong nas zhig /'di kho mkha' khyab rgyal ba'i ye shes kyang / /gzhan du yod min gdod nas rnam par dag /'di rtogs rgyal ba kun dang ro mnyam pas/ /phyag chen gcig chod zhes kyang de skad lo/ /de yang blo byas yid da~Xhā 'dra

min dang / /gol shor dbang du ma gyur shin tu gces/ /'on kyang mos gus dran pa snying rje gsum/ /gcig tu dril na gegs rnams kun grol nges/ /de lta spros pa'i tshig tshogs mang po zhig /bshad na zad pa'i mtha' yi mi btub pas/ /snying po sa bon tsam zhig smras pa 'di/ /dad dang ldan khyod dge ba'i rgyu 'phel shog /de skad skyes bdag lo zhal gsar 'char ba/ /gangs can rtsis pa phal gyi mchu zla dang / /rang lugs rgyud rtsis dag pas sbo zla ru/ /bzhed pa'i dkar phyogs zla ba dwangs pa'i dus/ /'jig rten mgon po'i pho brang mtshur phu nas/ /rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'i spel 'di dge/ /sarba maṅga lo/rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin du/ /rgyu 'bras blang dor gyis/ /bla ma'i mos gus 'bad/ /dam tshig snying phur bzung / /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la/ nam yang zad pa med/ /mi tshe yud tsam ste/ /yad yud ngang la 'gro/ /nam zhig 'chi dus su/ /lag stong mchan du bcug /de 'dra ma song bar/ /bskyed rdzogs bsgom par 'tshal/ /de 'dra brjod pa na/ /nam yang zad pa med/ /snying gtam nyung ngu zhig /'di ru smras pa ste/ /snying la bzhag pa na/ /bde 'bras thob par nges/ /nam 'chi cha med de/ /yid la mi sems par/ /sdod shom long 'khyam 'dis/ /nam phugs bslu bar nges/ /snying med mdo shor la/ /bltas shing snying nas khrel/ /dgos med bya ba la/ /spyad cing skyo ba skye/ /'chi bdag bdud po la/ /bsam bzhin snying rtsa 'dar/ /'dus byas rang mtshang de/ /myur du bstan la khad/ /kye ma 'o re brgyal/ /'chi chos snying nas 'tshal/ /dus kyi 'pho 'gyur la/ /nam zhig bskul mar snang / /dben pa'i sgrub gnas su/ /btsan pa bzung bar rig /de 'dra smra mkhan gyi/ /rnal 'byor smyon pa de/ /'chi ba mi dran par/ /skye 'chi bar do kun/ /sgyu mar 'al ba 'ol/ /gtad med shag ma shig /blo bde'i ngang la 'dug /gar 'gro gtad pa brdog /bde ba can du'o/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan/ /thar pa'i lam du'o/ /de 'dra dam gdeng tshad zhig /med na snying nas bsgom/ /kye ma ya re nga / /phyi ma ci 'dra 'gyur/ /byas pa don med la/ /bsam nas don ldan mdzod/ /zhes pa yang rig pa 'dzin pas sgrol ma ba dpon slob rnams la glu ru blangs pa ste dge'o/ /oṃ ṭ+wāsnyi/ 'chi med gzhon nu lang tsho'i drod rgyas pas/ /chags ldan dpyid kyi dpal mo'i ljon shing khar/ /sems kyi khu byug rgyag nas sa ṭag zhes/ /yang yang sgrogs pa 'di mtshar gnas/ /rnam pa thams cad sku'i rang mdangs te/ /cir snang rig pa'i rang rtsal thag chod tshe/ /chags zhen dred pa bde chen dbyings su nub/ /nyon mongs shar kun ye shes grogs su che/ /de 'dra lta ba'i gnad lugs ma rtogs par/ /spyod lam 'jam des khrel yod ngo tsha'i gos/ /rab bgos btsun tshugs bzung ba kho na nyid/3/༵ra lam kun gyi gzhi yin 'bad par 'os/ /yang dag ye shes rgyud la ma skyes pa'i/ /lcang lo ras

gos bgos pas ci zhig phan/ /mi 'gyur bde ba'i grogs su ma song na/ /chos pa pho mo sdeb pas rgyal ba bslu/ /de bas dad pa'i mig gi yar bltos la/ /rnyed dka' dal 'byor mi lus thob dus 'dir/ /brgal dka' 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho sgrol slad du/ /bslab sdom dag pa'i gru chen rtsis su bzung / /de skad snying nas brtse bas bslab bya'i tshig /mi mo gzhon nu mang po'i tshogs dbus su/ /'dzem med 'khril sbyor las la rtag spyod pa/ /rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'i glu ru blangs/ /sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ kun la khyab pa bde ba chen po'i dngos/ /kun tu bzang po'i rang bzhin chos kyi sku/ /rang rig ngo bor ston mdzad 'dren pa mchog /rtsa ba'i bla mas khyed la shes par mdzod/ /nyid ni mtho ris lang tshos ma smad cing / /lugs gnyis mkhyen spyod pad+ma'i 'dab ltar yangs/ /blangs dor gnas la rmongs par ma gyur na/ /de la bdag gi zhal gdams ci zhig bya/ /'on kyang chen po'i gsung gi bskul bas na/ /zhal ngo ma skyung tsam du rnal 'byor pas/ /gang shar chu 'babs nyid du cha shas tsam/ /dge ba'i sems kyi gsol la nyes yod min/ /nges legs gtan gyi 'dun ma dam pa'i chos/ /mngon mtho mtho rang lam kyang de mi stegs/ /zung du 'brel zhes dam pa'i dam pa rnams/ /yang yang gsung bzhin don de sim par 'tshal/ 'jig rten 'di na rnyed par dka' ba'i lus/ /dal 'byor bco brgyad tshang ba'i mi nyid ste/ /de nyid thob pa shin tu dkon shes na/ /stong log ma yin rnam dkar dge la 'bad/ / a ho ye gnas 'di gang yin zer tsa na/ /gu ru'i gnas chen ljon pa lung / /ma dang mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i zhing / /mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing khams lags/ /bla ma su yin zer tsa na/ /dgu ldan rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i sras/ /'brel tshad don ldan thugs rje can/ /rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu yin/ /mi nga rang su yin zer tsa na/ /'di snang pha yul rgyab tu bor/ /rje mtshan ldan bla ma'i chos kyi sras/ /dal 'byor don ldan gyur pa'i rnal 'byor lags/ /chos lugs gang yin zer tsa na/ /bka' mdo rgyud snying po kun gyi bcud/ /chos 'khor lo gsum pa'i lta ba mchog /dpal 'od gsal rdo rje snying po lags/ /khyod lta ba gang yin zer tsa na/ /nga mtha' bral gyi lta ba rdzogs pa che/ /theg brgyad kyi yid chos las 'das rtse/ /rtsod bral ka dag lhun grub kyi dgongs pa yin/ /khyod bsgom pa gang yin zer tsa na/ /sems mnyam bzhag dus gsum spros pa bral/
