/lam gang shar gnas la spang blangs med/ /nga bsgom pa phyag rgya chen po yin/ /khyed spyod pa gang yin zer tsa na/ /phyi 'dul ba ltar du tshangs par spyod/ /nang rnal 'byor ltar du gsang sngags spyod//gsang 'ub chub blo 'das spyod pa yin/ /khyed 'bras bu gang yin zer rtsa na/ /nga rang don chos sku'i 'bras bu yin/ /gzhan don du gzugs sku'i rol gar can/ /dpal sku gnyis mthar thug 'bras bu yin/ /de 'dra blangs zhing zhabs bro rgyab/ /zhabs bro g.yas su chem se chem/ /g.yas su dpa' bo'i 361

zhabs bro chem/ /zhabs bro g.yon du chem se chem/ /dpa' mo'i zhabs bro ldem se ldem/ /e ma hoḥ mchod rten la bya rung kha sho/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rten/ /ma gzheng lhun gyis grub pa/ /gzheng nas bsam pa'i don grub/ /sangs rgyas 'od bsrung gi bstan pa la/ /bya rdzi yum sras kyis gzhengs pa/ /sangs rgyas shāka thub kyi bstan pa la/ /o rgyan gu ru'i bsngags pa'i mchod rten/ /rtsod ldan snyigs ma'i dus su/ /sngags 'chang shākya bzang po'i gu ru'i lung bzhin/ /zhig gsos bgyis pa'i mchod rten/ /rtsod ldan snyigs ma'i mthar thug deng dus/ /nged cag dpon slob kyi zhig bso bgyis pa'i mchod rten/ /e ma mchod rten la bya rung kha shor/ /rtsigs pa mi 'dra skyes pa zhig 'dra 'dug /rgya mtsho'i bting nas brdol pa zhig 'dra 'dug /ri rgyal lhun po 'gying ba zhig 'dra 'dug /dgung sngon dbyings na snyogs pa zhig 'dra 'dug /bco lnga'i zla ba shar ba zhig 'dra 'dug /smon lam gang btab 'grub pa'i mchod rten/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa'i mchod rten/ /'brel gyur 'gro ba mtha' dag /bde ba can du skye ba'i mchod rten/ /bal yul sa bcud yongs pa'i mchod rten/ /bod yul phun tshogs bskyed pa'i mchod rten/ /rgyal khams tha dag bde ba'i mchod rten/ /'dzam gling 'di na byin ldan mchod rten/ /lha ma'i kun gyis bstod pa'i mchod rten/ /'jig rten gsum gyi sgron me mchod rten/ /bkra shis rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang po/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de yi mchod rten/ /yang nas yang du mjal bar shog cig /dza ya dza ya su dza ya/ /sa dbang chos kyi rgyal po/ /'gyur med phyogs las rnam rgyal/ /gangs can yongs kyi bdag po/ /rdo rje'i khri la bzhugs yod/ /gangs can yongs kyi mgon po/ /rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtsho/ /mi rje chos kyi rgyal po/ /thugs yid gcig tu 'dres yod/ /thugs yid gcig tu 'dres yod/ /rgyal dbang pad+ma'i rgyal sras/ /rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu/ /phyogs med 'gro don skyong ba'i/ /'brel tshad smin grol bkod yod/ /mthong thos dran reg grol ba'i/ /mchod rten bya rung kha shor/ /bod bal yongs kyi bde thabs/ /zhig gso phun tshogs grub yod/ /dza ya dza ya su dza ya/ /gnyal dge ri nas/ na mo gu ru pad+ma ya/ dal 'byor gyi lus rten 'di thob mod kyang / /dus snyigs dus su skyes pa 'di yid re skyo/ /rje mtshan ldan gyi bla ma mjal lags kyang / /mos gus 'khor yug tu ma song 'di yid re skyo/ /zab dgu man ngag bdud rtsi thob mod kyang / /nyams len brtson pa yi ma phor yid re skyo/ /pha yul bdud ra ru shes nas spang lags kyang / /mi yul chos brgyad kyi 'ching 'di yid re skyo/ /lhag med 'ja' lus la blo gdeng gtad 'dod kyang / /'khor ba'i 'khrul snang la 'byams 'di di~X re skyo/ /phyogs med rgyal khams la 'dun pa gtad mod kyang / /che gnyen du ma yi bla mar

bkur 'di skyo/ /'jig rten 'khrul zhig la blo phug gtad mod kyang / /'khrul snang zhen pa yi 'ching 'di yid re skyo/ /'gro phan rlabs chen la snying nas 'dun mod kyang / /da dung rang don yang ma 'grub 'di yid re skyo/ /sa sbrul glo bor phebs skabs/ e ma gzhan phan gyi 'khor lo 'khor/ /e ma sems can gyi don la brtson/ /gzugs can mi yi 'khu 'phrig sangs/ /gzugs med lha 'dre'i ya kha zhi/ /dam can rnams kyi dam tshig bsos/ /sems bskyed can gyi sems bskyed gsos/ /'dre rnying pa'i dam bca' dran par byas/ /gsar skyes rnams la g.yar dam phog /kun kyang byang chub lam bzang po/ /thar pa phun tshogs rgyu ru bsngo/ /bdag gi tsha ngam rtsub spyod yang / /gting nas snying rje rol pa yin/ /khyed mi min lha 'dre 'byung po kun/ /snying nas mos gus dga' ba bskyed/ /nga byar med nam mkha'i rnal 'byor la/ /gzung yul dang 'dzin pa kha der 'dres/ /skye med du rtogs pa'i blo gdeng de/ /'gag med kyi 'char ba zhen med spyod/ /sgyu ma dang rmi lam ltad mo bzhin/ /yul med dang yul can mnyam nyid shar/ /snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams kun/ /rang rig cho 'phrul nyid du khums/ /de yang gcig dang tha dad pa'i/ /spros pa'i tshogs kun nye bar zhi/ /tshul 'di rtsa ba'i bla ma'i mthus/ /gdod ma'i gnas lugs de ltar rtogs/ /des na lha 'dre'i tshogs rnams kyang / /bdag gi rnam rtog ri mo tsam/ /med la yod pa'i snang tshul ste/ /bden gnyis zung 'jug ngang du shar/ /'di ru gdul byar gyur pa rnams/ /spro ba bskyed phyir cung zad smras/ /mi min lha 'dre khyed rnams kyang / /de ring phyin chad rgyal ba'i sras/ /byang chub lam la nges zhugs pas/ /dga' dang spro ba bskyed par bgyis/ /deng nas nges don bstan pa mchog /gnyen phyir bsrung ma drag po mdzod/ /rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu yi/ /rjes 'jug bu bzhin skyong bar mdzod/ /rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu yi/ /lhag pa'i smon lam dag pa'i mthus/ /byang chub spyod pa mthun spyod cing / /tshom bu gcig tu sangs rgyas kyi/ /nyams dga'i gzhad mo thig le gyis/ /spro ba'i zhabs bro khrig ge rol/ /kun tu dge ba bkra shis pa/ /byang chub sems kyi do ra 'di/ /lha mi 'gro ba mtha' dag pa/ /phun tshogs dpal la rtag spyod shog /oṃ/ gdod ma'i ye shes kyi thig le de/ kha dog dbyibs bral gyi 'od zer 'phro/ /kun khyab spros bral gyi thig le de/ /mtha' yas mu med kyi 'od zer 'phro/ /rang byung bde chen gyi thig le de/ /byang chub tshor rtog med kyi 'od zer 'phro/ /lhun grub 'od gsal gyi thig le de/ /lnga ldan rang mdangs kyi 'od zer 'phro/ /mi shig gzhom med kyi thig le de/ /rlung sngags rang mdangs kyi 'od zer 'phro/ /'pho med rig pa yi thig le de/ /rang shar rang grol gyi 'od zer 'phro/ /chos nyid gnyug ma yi thig le de/ /byas ༵tā gzo

bral gyi 'od zer 'phro/ /rang gsal ye shes kyi thig le de/ /ma 'dres ngang rdzogs kyi 'od zer 'phro/ /don dam chos sku yi thig le de/ /gzugs sku rnam gnyis kyi 'od zer 'phro/ /snang med 'od gsal gyi thig le de/ /snang byed dbyings grol gyi 'od zer 'phro/ /dran med khyab brdal gyi thig le de/ /rang shes rang grol gyi 'od zer 'phro/ /yid gnyis blo bral gyi thig le de/ /dri med rjen pa yi 'od zer 'phro/ /'ub chub blo 'das kyi thig le de/ /snang stong dbyer med kyi 'od zer 'phro/ /lnga ldan ye shes kyi thig le de/ /'byung lnga dbyings grol gyi 'od zer 'phro/ /chos nyid skye med kyi thig le de/ /'gag med 'jam klas kyi 'od zer 'phro/ /rtag brtan dbu ma yi thig le de/ /mtha' dbus yongs bral gyi 'od zer 'phro/ /'bri med gang med kyi thig le de/ /bral smin yongs rdzogs kyi 'od zer 'phro/ /mi 'gyur bde chen gyi thig le de/ /zhu bde rang grol gyi 'od zer 'phro/ /du ma ro gcig gi thig le de/ gcig dang du bral gyi 'od zer 'phro/ /sgom med byar med kyi thig le de/ /yeng med rang shes kyi 'od zer 'phro/ /zhen med rang grol gyi thig le de/ /tshogs drug 'gog med kyi 'od zer 'phro/ /dbyings chos ye bral gyi thig le de/ kha sbyor zung 'jug gi 'od zer 'phro/ /gnyug ma bsgom med kyi thig le de/ /yengs med rang shes kyi 'od zer 'phro/ /smra bsam brjod med kyi thig le de/ /'khor 'das sna tshogs kyi 'od zer 'phro/ /mar yul gyi rgyal blon spyi/ kha che yi tshong ba bcas/ /nga gnyom chung gi rnal 'byor la/ /dad gus la rjes yi rang / /phyogs med kyi bya bral ba/ /gza' gtad ni ci yang med/ /gang shar ni gdong ded min/ /phyogs med du 'gro bar ring / /da lta phan lo zla ru/ /mar yul gyi rgyal blon rnams/ /phan bde yi btsas su re/ /sgo gsum gyi dka' ba spyad/ /ci nus kyi 'bad 'bungs bton/ /lhag bsam ni rnam par dag /srab 'jam gyi gos bzang ni/ /shar phyogs kyi dbus su mdo/ /sha thud kyi kha zas ni/ /la stod kyi lho ru mdo/ /skom mchog gi ja bzang ni/ /mdo khams kyi smad du mang / /nyi tshe yi dad rdzas ni/ /gang du yang phyin na yod/ /mtshar sdug gi nā ri ni/ /tho re ba gang du'ang snang / /mtshan ldan gyi mkha' 'gro ni/ /gnas chen mtsho'i 'dabs su mang / /snod ldan gyi slob ma ni/ /las smon nyid mthun par mchis/ /sbyin bdag tu rnyed pa ni/ /rgyal khams pa kun tu yod/ /rna ba yi so gsod ni/ /phyogs gzhan 'gro na bde/ /rgyal po yi mchod gnas las/ /rgyal khams kyi bsod snyoms bde/ /ring min du 'chi ba la /'di snang la de tsam ci/ /sle mkhar sogs la dwags kyi/ /rgyal khams su 'gro ba ni/ /sprang po yi blo yul du//'jug pa zhig 'di 'dug pas/ /do gal du mi 'tshal te/ /'dab chag ni snyi rgya las/ /thon pa bzhin shar phyogs su/ /bgrod pa yi go skabs lags/ /tshe rabs kyi rgyal po ni/ /rdzogs pa yi sangs rgyas lags/ /blo gtakā nā dpon po ni/ /rtsa ba yi bla mar byas/ /'khor bu yi longs spyod ni/ /dam pa yi lha chos yin/ /

rdzas nor gyi bang mdzod ni/ /chog shes 'di kho na bzang / /snying sdug gi mdza' mo ni/ /ma mo dang mkha' 'gro legs/ /gtan tshigs dang rgyab dpung ni/ /rgyu 'bras kyi blang dor gshis/ /dmag mtshan dang dpung grogs ni/ /chos skyong bsrung ma dge/ /bran 'khor dang g.yog po ni/ /'jig rten lha 'dre bzang / /gzugs can gyi mi rnams ni/ /'phel 'grib sgang shong che/ /kho bo ni de bas ka phyogs med rgyal khams legs/ /sa phyogs gnas gcig tu sdod pa yang / /dgos pa ni che ba med lags kyi/ /da ni phyogs gzhan du 'gro na legs/ /rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu ni/ /orgyan gyi rgyal po'i pho nya ste/ /'brel tshad ni don dang ldan par rlom/ /ldan gcig tu mthong zhing spyod pa na/ /phal pa yi mi dang mtshungs 'dra yang / /res 'ga' las yang yang phrad par dka'/ /de bas na snying nas gsol ba thob/ /tshe rabs kun tu yang yang 'phrad par nges/ /gtan bde yi sa bon gsos su 'gyur/ /de skad ni rig 'dzin rgyal khams pa/ /smyo 'chol dang 'dres pa de yi smras/ /sgam sgam dang tig tig ma mchis pa'i/ /mdo khams kyi rnal 'byor sprang 'chal la/ /rgyal blon rnams thugs kyi mi khrel zhu/ /dga' bde yi glu dbyangs len par shog /ha ha hi hi rgyu r+ghaṃ/ bkra shis shog /e ma e hoḥ dag snang 'dab rgya yi ge sar bzhad pa'i steng / /rang rig rang gsal gyi ngo bo pad+ma 'byung / /zung 'jug lhun grub kyi gshis lugs bde chen gling / /byang chub thob nas yang 'bras ba'i thabs ma rnyed/ /e ho/ ngo bo brjod med la rnam pa brjod bcas brda'/ /sems nyid gshis lugs kyi mtshan nyid cha shas gcig /shugs 'byung 'gag med kyi glu ru blang lags na/ /gnyis med rang grol gyi ngang du khrol lo lo/ /nam mkha' 'dus ma byas skye 'gag gnas dang bral/ /'di yin 'dzin gyi dngos po 'dug gam kyai/ /sems nyid spros bral gyi ngo bo de 'dra na/ /kun khyab ye shes de nges pa cis mi skye/ /the tshom nges shes kun rnam rtog brlab phreng ste/ /rba rlabs rgya mtsho kun chu yi ngo bor gcig /gsal lo stong ngo zhe blo yi ri mo tsam/ /gsal stong dbyer med kyi ngo bo rig pa nyid/ /shar grol dus mtshungs su sbrul mdud nam mkhar grol/ /phyogs dus gnas skabs kyi rtog dpyod kun dang bral/ /dpyod bral brjod med kyi ngang nas rten 'brel shar/ /ngang tshul 'di lta ni kho bo'i myong ba ste/ /legs kyang chos nyid kyi cho rol nyid du zad/ /nyes kyang kun rdzob kyi rdzun khung brdab pas bzang / /nges pa med pa la nges shes thob pa 'di/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs mthu yi rtogs/ /gtad med yid kyi khye'u nyams dga' des/ /zhen med brag cha lta bu nyams myong glu/ /'dzin med bar snang sir bu rgyu ba bzhin/ /smra 'di mnyam bzhag ngang du ta la la/ /de skad yon tan mang pos brgyan pa'i yul/ /mtha' bral dbu mar gnas pa gung thang ljongs/ /'chi med grub pa'i gnas mchog bzang po der/ /rig pa 'dzin pas dge 365

ba'i ston mor spel/ /zhes 'phags yul du dkar por 'bod pa sa sbrul gyi lo bdag cag gi ston pas zla med pa'i cho 'phrul gyi 'dul bar mdzad pa'i dus chen dbo zla'i dkar phyogs kyi rgyal ba dang por za 'og phug tu dam pa'i chos thos bsam gyi skabs/ rang gi rtogs pa skad cig ma gcig la rgya mtsho dngas ba'i ngos bzhin snang ba la ched du brjod pa'i glu dpal rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu'i yang dag par brjod pa'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/ r+ghaṃ rdu/ rnam rtog gi dur khrod chen po nas/ /rtog med kyi rig pa ho ru ka /brjod med kyi drag sngags nā da'i dbyangs/ /'dzin med kyi ngang du 'di skad sgrogs/ /r+ghaṃ rgyu/ khyed mi min lha 'dre dregs pa'i tshogs/ /yang dag gi don du spyi rol ci/ /nang ngar 'dzin rtog pa'i rang mdangs yin/ /de rtog med kyi dbyings su tshar gcod cig /rgyu r+ghaṃ/ don de yang lha 'dre gang yang med/ /kun 'od gsal dbyings su ta la la/ /kun rdzob tu lha yod 'dre yang yod/ /gnod bgegs kun ma gnas phyir dengs shig /r+ghaṃ ju/ yod med dang yin min dgag sgrub kun/ /tha snyad kyi tshig las don dam ci/ /tshig nyid kyang don dam gshis kyi gdangs/ /gdangs ye yin 'di las ma 'da' shig /hūṃ r+ghaṃ/ mar mtho ba lta ba'i bgegs dang bral/ /mar dma' ba spyod pa'i 'phrang las grol/ /bar thad so gnas lugs rig pa 'di/ /don yin lugs dbyings las spring yig smras/ /rgyu rdu/ tshur sems nyid ngo bo la bltas tsa na/ /chos nyid kyi rig pa ljen ne ljen/ /phyi tshogs drug gi yul la bltas tsa na/ /snang ba gtad med kyi dbyings su phya la la/ /hūṃ rdu/ da de 'dra la 'dre bgegs ci 'dra zhig /btsal bas kyang rnyed pa ma yin mod/ /'on te yang rtog tshogs ma zad par/ /'dre bgegs la zad pa yod re shi/ /r+ghaṃ rgyu/ de bas rnam rtog ma lus kun/ /'dzin med dang rog med dbyings su bzhag /'dre bgegs dang 'byung po thams cad kun/ /sems nyid kyi rtsal du grol gyur phaṭa/ /r+ghaṃ rgyu/ zhes gang shar gza' gtad med pa'i rnal 'byor pa des ci shar chos nyid kyi glu rang shar grol ba'i spring yig ngang shar gyi klong nas spel ba ha ha/hi hi/ hum hum/ ho ho/ ho ho/ ham haḥ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na badz+ra ཿ ma ya rak+ṣa rak+ṣaḥganas 'di ni slob dpon pad+ma'i gnas/ /yul bkra shis bal yul tsha ba shod/ /lha bkra shis 'jig rten skyong ba'i gtso/ /dpal mchog dang ldan pa mgrin sngon rgyud/ /lha chen mo dpal mo nyer mtshungs ma/ /dpal bal yul gyi rgyal mo ma lags bsam/ /khong chos mdzad yongs kyi dgra lha yin/ /dpal rig pa 'dzin pa'i bsrung ma yin/ /sgos rnal 'byor bdag gi snying grogs yin/ /yul 'dir gnas kyi lha srin sde brgyad rnams/ /kun byang chub spyod pa'i grogs bzang yin/ /yul mi gcig mi rigs mang po yi/ /glu rang rang yul chos mthun pa 'di/ /lha gnyen po khyed la mchod par 'bul/ /gnas 366

'dir tshogs kyi dpon slob 'khor 'bangs kun/ /las ci la tshogs pa chos la tshogs/ /chos rnam dkar dge ba bsgrub la tshogs/ /chos rnam dkar dge ba'i 'bras bu de/ /khyed mi min rnams dang thun mong bsngo/ /don byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /dus gcig tu tshogs pa'i mched lcam yin/ /dus 'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /dus kun tu lhan cig tshogs par shog /sarba maṅga lo/༄ga /lha rje mnyam med zla 'od gzhon nu'i bka' brgyud phyag chen gdams pa ji tsam nod pa'i rtogs brjod legs bshad rin chen 'byung khungs/('di nas ldeb gsum khad)ljongs zhes pa 'dir gdul bya 'dul dka' ba'i dbang gis 'phags mchog snying rje chen po lag na pad dkar 'chang bas bdag gir mdzad pa'i mthu las/ mes dbon rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis thugs rje chen po la brten rgyal ba'i bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pas bod yul nyin mo lta bur gyur cing / ngo mtshar mchog gyur skyes bu dam pa bgrang gi mi langs ba snga phyi kun tu byon nas bshad sgrub kyi sde bzang po dar zhing rgyas pa las/ rgyu skar gyi phreng ba'i khrod nas nyi zla lta bu nges don gyi bstan pa mtha' dag gi snying khu 'gran zla dang bral ba ni phyag rgya chen po dang /rdzogs pa chen po yin par grags shing grub pa las 'dir ni phyag rgya chen po'i chos rang gi ji ltar nod pa'i tshul brjod par bya ba ste/ de yang bod yul 'dir phyag rgya chen po'i bka' srol mang du byung mod kyang skabs 'dir brjod bya ni bram ze yab sras las nye bar brgyud pa ste/ spyir yang phyag rgya chen po mtha' dag gi chu mgo bram ze chen po sa ra ha la thug zhes rgyal ba yang dgon pas gsung pa yang don la gnas par snang la/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha la thug ste/ de yi man ngag srol 'dzin gtso bo grags che ba 'phags pa klu sgrub dang / de la slob ma shin tu mang yang phyag rgya chen po dwo ha'i sgo nas grub pa thob pa dpal chen po sha wa ri pa ste ri khrod dbang phyug yin la/ de yi slob ma lū hi pa ni grub pa thob pa bye bar phrag grangs las 'das pa'i 'byung khungs su gyur pa dang dus phyis paṇ+ḍi ta bi bhu ti tsan+ta dang / bā na rat+nas kyang dngos su mjal nas gdams pa stsal ba sogs 'thor bu yang mang du byung mod/ 'on kyang phyag rgya chen po brgyud pa'i bka' srol gtso bor 'dzin pa po ni mkhas pa sgo drug dang rags rtsis su dus mtshungs pa mnga' bdag mi tri pa chen po yin te/ de yang mtshan dngos mi tro gusta zhes byams pa sbas pa 367

dang gsang mtshan ro mnyam rdo rje ste/ de yi rjes 'brang rnams kyi sha wa ri pa yab dang rgyal ba mi tri sras te ri khrod dbang phyug yab sras su bsgrags so/ /de yi rgyud 'dzin bod 'dir bshad bsgrub gnyis su byung ba las/ 'dir phyi ma gtso bor gyur pa'i gleng mod/ bshad pa'i bka' la yang jo bo rje lha gcig dang / de bzhin mar pa chos blo/ be+e ro/ kor ṇi ru pa/ rgya gar phyag na/ bal po a su/ ras chung rdo grags/ mnga' ris nag po bcas brgyad tsam byung ste byung sngon dar rgyas su gyur rung / deng sang bshad dka' dngos nyag phra yang / do ha'i lung dang man ngag zab mo ni rnying ma'i phyis kyi bstan bcos du ma dang gsang sngags gsar ma mtha' dag par ma khyab par med pa lta bur snang zhing / spyir do ha'i man ngag gtso bo ni phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor nyid du grub mod/ bye brag tu do ha rang gi man ngag tu grags pa'i rgyun sa bon tsam dang / do ha bskor gsum rtsa ba dang ṭika bshad lung da lta'i bar ma chad pa rang gi ci ltar thob pa yang 'og tu spro'o/ /phyag rgya chen po'i bka' srol dar rgyas su byed po gtso bo phul du gyur pa ni mnyam med sgam po pa yin la/ de la bka' babs kyi chu bo chen po gnyis gcig tu 'dus pa yoganyug ma lhan gcig skyes sbyor gyi 'byung khungs gcig ni mkhas mchog shārnyi pa dang / be+e tri pa'i slob ma sa ho ra yi paṇ+ḍi ta jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha dri paṃ kā ra shrī dz+nyā na'i zhal snga nas yin la/ gcig ni dpal nā ro tā pa dang / mnga' bdag mi tri pa yi zhabs la thug pa dpal lho brag mar pa lo tsā chos kyi blo gros yin te/ de las nye bar 'ongs pa'i gdams pa'i skabs 'dir brjod bya'i gtso bo ste/ gzhan yang dam pa mi pham dbang po'i phyag chen dri med thig pa dang / grub thob khyung po rnal 'byor gyi rang shar phyag rgya chen po yang ri khrod yab sras kyi rjes su 'brangs ba yin no/ /der ma zad snga 'gyur gyi bod sngags snying ma'i skabs su do ha 'gyur zhing man ngag nyams len gyi rgyun byung bar tshad thub dam pa kha cig gi gsung bar grags pa dang / de mthun rdzogs chen sems phyogs a ro'i man ngag 'jam dbyangs mgon po'i yi ger yang snang bas/ yid ches su gyur mod kyang da lta snga 'gyur nas brgyud pa'i man ngag yod ces yongs la ma grags shing mi snang mod/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi mdzad pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i bka' srol gter nas byung ba ji snyed mchis la/ de nas rang gi cha shas thob pa ni gzhan du brjod par bya'o/ /de yang mnyam med sgam po pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya'i dbang pos nges don bstan pa'i bdag por mdo sde rnams nas lung gi bstan par mdzad shing / rgyal ba thams cad kyi gsung gi rdo rje 'od dpag tu med pa pad+ma ka ra yi thugs kyi rol rtsed mnyam med dwags po lha rje dar ma skyabs sam/ kun dga' snying po'am/ snyi bsgom bsod nams rin chen zhes byang chub sems dpa' chen po me tog zla tshes zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa de yi thog mar jo bo rje yab sras nas brgyud pa'i man ngag gi 368

bsam gtan bzang por brnyes par byas shing / de nas lho brag mar pa'i thugs kyi sras mi la gzhad pa rdo rje las thabs lam chos drug gi man ngag legs pas gnas lugs ye shes kyi rang zhal ji bzhin du gzigs pas bka' gdams man ngag chu bo gcig 'dres su de ltar grags so/ /de yang sngon mar pa dang mi la zhabs kyi gdul bya rnams la chos drug gi gdams pa byin nas gtum mo'i nus pas zhu bde ye shes bskyed cing / 'od gsal las rang bzhin 'od gsal gyi skabs sems nyid gnas lugs kyi ngo sprad mdzad nas do ha sogs zab mo'i man ngag khyad par can gzhan gyi de la nges pa bskyed pa tsam las phyag chen zhes khrid srol rkang tshugs zur du dbye ba yang ma mdzad mod/ /rje dwags po nas gdul bya dkri ba la mkhas pas jo bo rje yi lhan cig skyes sbyor dang mar myi yi 'od gsal phyag chen gyi dgongs pa gcig tu bsdur nas sems nyid gnyug ma'i ye shes rjen par ngo sprad nas sa lam gyi tshad rnal 'byor bzhi yi rim pas dbye ba phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor zhes khrid tshul rang rkang tshugs pa gud du mdzad nas gdul bya mchog dman mtha' dag gi 'dzug pa bde zhing / lam bla na med par bka' drin chen pos khyab pa yin no/ /de yang phyag rgya chen po de lta bu'i gzhung mdo ting nge 'dzin rgyal po yang yin par grags la/ mgon po byams pa yi rgyud bla ma yang yin par mnyam med sgam po pas zhal gyi bzhes shing gtso bor bram ze chen po'i do ha ri khrod dbang phyug yab sras nas brgyud pa dang / te lo nā ro yi gdams pa 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i dgongs don zab mo'i cha gtsor bton byas pa'i man ngag chos nyid kyi don gtan la phabs pa'i rim pa ste/ de nyid sngags rgyud thams cad kyi dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes zab mo'i cha yang rma med par 'gyur mod/ dbang bzhi'i ye shes dngos ni zab gsal bde chen zung du 'jug pa la bzhed kyi/ de lta'i dus skabs 'dir phal rnams kyi zhe 'dod du bzhag pa'i phyag rgya chen po 'di tsam la sngags kyi dbang bzhi'i phyag chen yongs rdzogs de kho na nyid du sems na dbu ma chen po'i lta khrid la sngon 'gro bzhi sbyor tsam gcig bsnan pas kyang der 'gyur rig ste/ zab mo'i lta ba rnam dag ni dbu ma yang yin phyir ro/ /de yin na sngags kyi grub mtha'i mthar thug dang phar phyin la khyad ma zhugs pas bsam par bya'o/ /des na bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas sdom gsum du yul dus la dgongs nas sngags kyi phyag chen la dpyad pa de ni yang dag pa yin la/ phyogs snga ma long ba rnams kyis la dwags la ngag smras su sems sdig bsags par mi bya'o/ /yang bka' brgyud pa'i mkhas pa'i khyu mchog chen po yid bzang rtse pas/ mnyam med dwags po'i phyag chen thun mong ni rgya gar gyi slob dpon lhan skyes rdo rje'i de kho na nyid bcu yi 'grel par ngo bo pha rol tu phyin pa sngags dang rjes su mthun pa ming phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba'i khyad par gsum dang ldan pa'i de bzhin nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes gsal bar 3༵py-id

pa ltar yin zhes gsungs mod tshul de zhib mor ma dpyad pa'i skabs phar phyin dang sngags kyi phyag chen gnyis kyi khungs legs bshad che ba ltar snang yang / zhib mor byas tshe slob dpon lhan skyes rdo rje'i dgongs pa de ni lta ba pha rol phyin pa dang mthun pa nyid la lam sngags kyi rim pa dbang gi smin par byas te lta ba gtan la phab pa dbang don gyi ye shes rnam par mi rtog pa de bzhin nyid kyi rnal 'byor zab mo la 'jug pa ni gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po'i don yin pas ming yang de ltar gdags par gsungs pa ste/ de ni rgya bod du rdo rje slob dpon ches mang po yi bzhed pa yang yin pas/ tshig de phar phyin mdo yi phyag chen yod lugs dang / yin tshul gyi khungs su 'gro bar dka'o/ /spyir dbang gi ma smin zhing mdo lugs kho na ltar byas pa'i bsam gtan 'jog bsgom tsam la phyag rgya chen por 'dod pa ni 'phags yul du ma grags par nges shing / bod du yang sngon byon dam pa rnams kyis de ltar ma bzhed pas mdo yi phyag chenadang sngags kyi phyag chen zhes tha dad du dbye ba ni bod phyi rabs pa'i rnam rtog nyid du gsal lo/ /gzhan ni rgya bod gnyis kar du dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes zab mo'i cha gud du phyes te rtsal du 'don pa ni ches mang du byung rung / de la phar phyin lugs kyi phyag chen yin zhes gzhung che ba gang du yang ma gsungs so/ /zhu bde la brten pa'i phyag rgya chen po ni mnyam med dwags po lha rje la rje mi las kho bo'i gtum mo a thung 'di bsgom dang bzod sems kyi ngo bo mthong bar 'gyur zhes gsungs pa sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i rang bzhed kyi phyag chen de dang gcig tu 'bab pa yin no/ /de yang rgyud nas brdar bzhag pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i mtshan nyid ni dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes la zer ba yin gyi de ni de kho na nyid don gyi 'od gsal zab mo bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin can te dngos gnas zung 'jug 'phags pa'i bsdus pa'i ye shes dang lam byed rnal 'byor rnams kyi rtogs pa'i ye shes te gang de ming dang tshig gi sgro bskur las 'das mod/ de lta na yang phyag k+ṣiṃchen po dang rdzogs pa chen po zhes sogs don la rton te thabs mkhas kyi brdar btags par mdzad pa ste mthar thug don dam kyi dbyings de ltar phyag chen dang rdzogs chen dang rim lnga dang lam 'bras dang sbyor drug sogs lam tshul dang po'i 'jug sgo tha dad pa las 'bras bu gcig tu gyur pa yin smra la/ 'on kyang lam gyi dus su rgyal bas gdams tshul dang grub pa thob pa rnams kyi phyag bzhes gang zag dbang po'i rim pa dkri tshul tha dad pas 'jug sgo zab pa dang ches zab pa dang / ches cher zab pa dang / rmad du byung ba yi lam myur bul gyi khyad par ni yod do/ /tshul 'di yang go ba la phan pa'i slad du 'dir cha shas phyogs tsam smos pa ste des kyang blo ldan rnams la nges par sbyin par nus la spros pas chog go /gzhan yang deng dus phyag rgya chen po yi sa lam gyi nges 'byed rnal 'byor bzhi zhes yongs su grags pa 'di yi rtsa ba'i khungs ni rje btsun dam pas rgya dkar la bka' 370

babs pa'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa a li ka li chu klung chen po'i rgyud du ting nge 'dzin bzhi dang rnal 'byor bzhi sbyor ba dang / de yi man ngag in+d+ra sgo dhis rnal 'byor bzhi yi ngo sprad rnams dam pas myi lar gnang myi las sgam po par stsal bar grags pa dang / slob dpon chen po shārnyi pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi yi rim pa jo bo rje la stsal zhing / jo bo'i lhan skyes kyi shes rab go cha'i bsgom pa'i lam rim rnal 'byor bzhir mdzad pa/ rgya lcags ri gong ka bar mnyam med sgam po pas gsan pas de dag don gcig tu 'bab par gzigs nas rang gi myong ba dang bstun/ gzhan la rgya cher bsgrags te phyi rab rnal 'byor rnams kyi bsam gtan gyi mig gam sgron mer bka' drin gyis khyab par mdzad pa ste rnal 'byor bzhi yi mtshan nyid snga 'gyur rnying ma'i gzhung rnams la yang don gsal por 'byung bar ma zad ming gi brda chad mthun pa yang ci rigs snang zhing / khyad par du rdzogs chen sems phyogs kyi rnal 'byor nyams rim pa bzhi dang gnad gcig tu 'bab pa nyid do/ /'dir smras pa/ pha rol phyin pa dbu ma chen po lta ba'i nam mkha' la/ /sngags lam phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor nyi ma shar/ /dbang po mchog dman kun phan mi shes mun gsal mgon/ /gang gi 'od kyi lam bzang mtha' dag ma nor ston par byed/ /sa lam nges 'byed lag tu blang bde byin rlabs don brgyud kyi/ /chu bo mtha' dag gcig tu 'dus gyur shin tu grags ldan pa/ /nor 'dzin lho ru nyi zla ltar khyab nges don sgron me che/ /grub thob mang po 'byon pa'i gter khungs lta bu lam 'dir rmad/ /zhes ched du brjod pa'o/ /da ni phyag rgya chen po'i chos tshul de lta rang gi skal bas ji ltar thob pa brgyud pa'i rtogs pa brjod par bya ba la gnyis te/ byin rlabs kyi yang snying nyams myong rtogs pa gang las skyes pa rtsa ba'i don gyi lung mchog gyur brgyud pa'i rim pa dang / mos gus mig yangs pos brgyud pa'i bka' srol gzhan gyi zhal lung byin rlabs kyi rgyun ji ltar babs pa'i tshul las/ dang po la yang / rig pa'i me tog thog mar babs pa'i yul ni/ dran mchog dwangs ma 'khor lo'i mgon po mchog gyur he ru ka dpal rig 'dzin grub pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba pad+ma bde chen gling pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mo tshangs pa'i gnas su bkod pa'i thugs rje chen po'i mthu las grub pa ste/ de yang sngon rgyal ba'i spyan sngar byang chub sems dpa' zla 'od gzhon nu'i nges don bstan pa spel bar zhal gyi bzhes tshe bcom ldan 'das rang nyid kyang de yi grogs su 'byon par zhal bzhes ltar dwags po lha rje'i phrin las kyi grogs rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul 'jig rten gsum gyi 'dren pa phag mo gru pa zhes 'gro ba'i mgon po rdo rje rgyal po gang gi bka' brgyud las byung ba yin la/ de yi brgyud 'dzin ches mang bas spyir tshogs pa brgyad brgya la gdugs thogs pa lnga brgya zhes pa lta bu yin cing / mchog tu gyur pa'i slob ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi ste/ de las 'dir snyi 7ne+e 'gro

ba'i mgon po'i nye ba'i sras bzhi'i ya gyal smar pa shes rab ye shes las snang ba'i smar tshangs zhes yongs su grags pa'i grub thob zam ma chad par byon pa'i bka' brgyud de nyid rtsa bar gyur cing / de la phag gru'i mthar thug bu bzhi'i mchog gyur gling ras pad+ma rdo rje'i bka' rgyud las byon stod 'brug tu grags pa yang chu bo gcig 'dres kyi tshul du bzhugs pa yin la/ de ltar brgyud pa yid bzhin nor bu zhes/ byin rlabs kyi rgyun bar ma chad pa bka' brgyud bla ma slad med gser gyi 'phreng ba lta bur byon pa'i mtshan tsam yang brjod par dka' rung cung zad smos na/ de yang phyag chen 'phags yul gyi brgyud pa'i rnam grangs deng sang te lo nā ro nas 'dren pa shas che zhing / de ni rje mar pas nā ro pa la kyai rdor sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing dbang don ye shes ngo 'phrod pas zhu bde dang 'brel ba'i phyag rgya chen po rang bzhin 'od gsal gyi ngo sprad la ni brgyud pa de ltar yin mod/ 'on kyang deng sang phyag rgya chen po'i zab khrid rang rkang tshugs pa gud du btab pa 'di lta la ni rje ri khrod yab sras la brgyud pa 'dod pa nges par 'thad ste/ sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyi yang de ltar bzhed pa yin la/ ci phyir mar pa rang gi mgur las/ rje mnga' bdag me tri'i zhabs la thug /rgyud zab mo'i bstod pa glur blangs thob/ /chos phyag rgya che la rtogs pa bskyangs/ /sems dngos po'i gnas lugs gtan la phab/ /bzhi chos nyid don gyi ngo bo mthong / /zhes dang / rje mnga' bdag chen po'i bka' drin gyis/ /gzhi chos nyid skye ba med par rtogs/ /sems stong pa nyid la spar 'dzin byas/ /mi kho bo'i spros pa de nas chod/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /deng sang rnal 'byor rnams kyis ni bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ba dang chos thams cad yid byed bral ba'i khas blangs mdzad dgos byung ba'i stabs kyi brgyud khungs la dpyad pa zhib mo mi byed pa ni de kas yin te 'ong / gzhan yang jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha las 'ongs pa'i bka' gdams kyi lam rim 'di la bka' bab gsum 'dus par deng sang yongs su grags bzhin pa zab mo lta ba/ rgya chen spyod pa/ byin rlabs rtogs pa'i chu bo gsum dril ba rje sgam po pa la 'dus par 'dod bzhin dang / der ma zad lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi go cha gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon chen po shārnyi pa'i man ngag gtso bor gyur pas na brgyud pa'i chu bo de yang 'du ba yin te/ gong ma chu bo gsum gyi bla rgyud tshul ni lam rim gyi gzhung kun tu grags che bas 'dir ma smos la/ shārnyi pa'i man ngag lhan cig skyes sbyor ni rdo rje 'chang nas rim par slob dpon chen po 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ de nas nyi zla 'od/ nyi ma'i dngos grub/ dgyes pa'i rdo rje/ nyi ma seng ge/ lha yi dbang phyug de la slob ma pho gnyis/ smṛ ti pa dang shārnyi pa/ mo gnyis dge ba ma dang grags 'dzin ma de las smṛ ti bod du byon nas slob ma rta nag tshul sbyi~Xs snying po/ des sba bsgom bsod nams ye shes/ des kha rag bsgom chung la bshad zhes grags

shing / slob dpon chen po shārnyi pa'i slob ma ni jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha des lhan gcig skyes sbyor gyi gdams pa nag tsho lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba/ des bya sor ba/ des rgya lcags ri gong ka ba/ de la rje mnyam med dwags po lha rjes gsan pa yin zhes sngon gyi yi ge ches snying pa nas 'byung ba mthong bas yid ches pa'i gnas su drangs pa'o/ /phyag rgya chen po ji bzhin mngon sum rtogs pa'i rim pa rje btsun chen po mar pa las 'ong ba'i rgyud pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub/ glu mkhan sha wa ri pa zhes pa spyi dang / yang sa ra ha che chung zhes pa sa ra ha nas sha wa ri pa dang / yang rdo rje 'chang nas sha wa ri pa bgrang ba yang ste/ de dag grub thob rnams kyi lugs yin pas rung mod/ de nas mnga' bdag mi tri gubha/ des mar pa lo tsā ba chos kyi blo gros/ des mi la bzhad pa rdo rje/ des dwags po lha rje zla 'od gzhon nu la'o/ /de nas slob ma rnams la rgya cher mched pa las 'dir phag mo grub pa rdo rje rgyal po/des smar pa shes rab ye shes/ shar yang dgon pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rmog spyan snga ba byang chub grags pa/ sha dbu rtse bsod nams ye shes 'dis nyag ras se bo nas brgyud pa'i phyag chen yang gsan pas de yang chu bo gcig 'dus su bgrangs/ de la snal rin chen gling pa'am rin chen rgyal mtshan/ dpang mkhan chen 'od zer bla ma/ shing mgo dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rngu ban chos kyi rdo rje/ 'di grub thob ku ku ri ba'i sprul par grags/ de yi slob tshogs rgya cher 'phel ba las/ mkhas grub dz+nyā na ke tu/ byang sems rgyal ba seng ge/ 'di'i gter ston rat+na'i zhabs la thug gong ma dang gnyis ka rat+na'i chos bdag rtsa ba'i bu brgyad kyi ya gyal yin/ grub thob dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ 'di zab phu lung du rgyun ring bzhugs/ gu ru pad+ma'i zhal dngos su mjal/ dbus gtsang gi mkhas grub mang por thug stod 'brug bka' brgyud kyi chu bo yang 'dir 'dres pa yin/ mtshan ldan dkon mchog rdo rje/ yongs 'dzin shākya rgyal mtshan/ rtogs ldan bho dhi sing ha/ rje btsun bkra shis rgya mtsho/ 'di gter ston zhig po'i chos bdag yin/ khong gi nang don yig cha yang mang tsam mdzad/ 'khrul zhig bstan pa seng ge/ 'di la stag bu pa kun mkhyen pad+ma blo gros kyis kyang chos 'brel gsan/ ba khyim chos nyid rgya mtsho/ 'di ni bstan pa seng ge dang dbang drag rgya mtsho gnyis kar thug 'on kyang rtsa ba'i bla ma bstan pa seng ger mdzad/ dam pa shes rab rgya mtsho/ 'di la slob ma mang yang mchog tu gyur pa gter ston rig 'dzin chen po klong gsal snying po yin la/ gzhan yang rnal 'byor dbang phyug gser sang ye shes seng ge'am/ ye shes rgyal mtshan du grags pa dang / rdo greb rtogs ldan ye shes snying pos kyang don rgyud kyi chu bo dam pa 'di kho na'i drin las snyed pa yin 'dug cing rig 'dzin chen po klong gsal snying po dang / rnal 'byor pa ye 373

shes seng ge gnyis kar/ dpal pad+ma bde chen gling pas thug ste/ byin rlabs rtogs pa'i bka' yang dag par bsnyes pa'o/ /'on kyang brgyud pa'i gtso bo rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog ni rig 'dzin chen po klong gsal snying por mdzad pa khums/ yang smar tshang bka' rgyud 'khrul zhig rang grol dbang drag rgya mtsho nas brgyud pa ni/ bu 'bor ba mkhas grub tsā na ke tu nas/ mtshungs med yon tan dpal ba/ mtshan ldan shes rab dbang phyug rin po che sangs rgyas rin chen/ rtogs ldan 'khor ba dongs dkrug zhes mtshan dngos sangs rgyas rdo rje/ dpal 'bar drung ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ 'khrul zhig rang grol zhes dbang drag rgya mtsho/ sgar rje bla ma kun spangs chos skyong rgya mtsho/ kaḥ thog rig 'dzin klong gsal snying po/ des rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma bde chen gling pa de'i thugs rje brtse ba chen pos rnal 'byor gzugs 'dzin snyoms las pa bdag tshe dbang nor bu rjes su bzung ba'o/ /de ltar smar tshang bka' brgyud la chu bo gcig 'dres su bzhugs pa'i dpal stod 'brug bka' brgyud ni/ phag gru rdo rje rgyal po nas/ rtogs pa'i mthar thug gling ras pad+ma rdo rje/ de la chos rje gtsang pa ye shes rdo rje/ des rgod tshangs pa mgon po rdo rje/ des rang las lhag pa'i bu yang mgon chos rje thugs kyi rdo rje/ rim bzhin spyan snga rin chen dpal ldan/ zur phug pa rin chen dpal bzang / skyes mchog rgyal mtshan dpal bzang / mkhas grub nam mkha' seng ge/ dam pa kun dga' chos rgyal dam pa kun dga' dpal ldan gsung ba 'dug mon rdzong ras pa zla ba rgyal mtshan/ des grub thob dkon mchog rgyal mtshan pa ste/ de man smar tshang brgyud pa snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /yang rgyal ba rgod tshang pa/ mgon po rdo rje nas dka' spyad rang mnyam gyi sras phug ri ba dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku bde chen lhun grub/ ma cig chos kyi sgron ma/ dka' bzhi nam mkha' 'od zer/ grub thob thang stong rgyal po/ byang sems kun dga' nyi ma/ grub thob dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ de nas sngar bzhin bgrang ste/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi stod 'brug gi brgyud pa 'di la gtso che tsam mdzad 'dug 'khrul zhig rang grol dbang drag rgya mtshos stod 'brug gi rgyud par gcigs su mdzad kyang / brgyud pa'i gyes mtshams rgyud rim ni/ zhal slob tshos smar tshang brgyud pa gcig pus chog shes kyi brtul zhugs kyis/ stod 'brug bla brgyud bum nang mar me ltar gyur la ding sang kaḥ thog nub phyogs pa'i rgyud 'debs stod 'brug smar tshang bsre slad byas pa de ni khyab ches bar 'dug rung / ma brtag par nyams dga' ba tsam las snying pos dben pa nyid do/ /de ltar rtsa ba'i bka' brgyud smar tshang lugs su grags pa 'di la/ kho bo gcig pu ma gtogs rtsa rgyud bla ma de dag thams cad ma mtha' yang skye med spros bral gyi rtogs pa thugs la ma 'khrungs pa med cing / shas cher ro gcig nas bsgom med kyi bar 'khrungs pa 'ba' zhig yin la/ de bzhin brgyud pa 'di la chu bo 374

gcig 'dres su bzhugs pa'idapal stod 'brug gi rgyud pa'i rnam grangs dag kyang rtsod med yongs grags kyi grub thob 'ba' zhig tu byon pa der gda'/ de ltar brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams nyams myong rtogs pa'i drod tshad rgyud la rdzogs pa/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po bar ma chad par byon pa'i thugs rje la brten/ deng sang skabs su yang phyag rgya chen po 'di la yon tan brgyad kyi khyad par dang ldan te/ yi ge nag 'ded kyi khrid lung dpe bshad 'ol ci tsam ma yin par zhal gdams yid bzhin gyi nor bu rdo rje'i tshig re'i don rgya chen po khrol nus shing myong khrid bzang pos gtan la phabs pa dang / 1 rang gi blo nus cung zad kyis dpag pa'i go ba rab rib tsam ma yin par bla ma'i zhal gdams gnad tig can rgyud tshan ma chad pa dang / 2 sngon gyi tshig sgros bzang po tsam la brten nas ma mthong phyogs kyi 'dzub tshugs 'al 'ol ma yin par nyams rtogs mngon sum gyi srol ma nyams pa dang / 3 zla chos su ming btags pa'i go myong gang yang ma skyes rung khrid rdzogs go grub so thob so zhes ming rkyang gi sgro btags can ma yin par lo zla du ma'i bar du dge sbyor spros bcas kyi g.yeng ba med par bla ma'i spyan sngar bsgom nas nyams rtogs la rdo rus gtugs pa dang / 4 khrid tshul mtha' gcig pa kad de rkyang nge ma yin par slob ma'i myong ba dang mthun pa'i khrid tshul gang la gang mtshams dmigs pa'i spo len thogs pa med pa dang / 5 nyams gnas pa bde gsal gyi cha srang sring skyes pa'i ros mi khengs par yin lugs lhag mthong gi ngo bor skyel bar byed pa dang / 6 sems nyid stong pa'i bzhugs tshul mi rtog pa'i dge sbyor skye lugs go nyams bzang po tsam re byung ba la yang cher cher por mi mdzad par yid la mi byed blo 'das phyag rgya chen po'i ji bzhin gyi mthil la gtugs pa dang / 7 mdor na gol sa shor sa 'dra min nor 'khrul gyi gnas su nam yang ma lhung bar mnyam med dwags po lha rje yab sras kyi bzhed pa ci bzhin pa'i phyag chen lta bsgom gtsang sing nge ba mdzub khrid du bstan pa'i rgyun ma nyams pa dang / 8 brgyad de/ de ltar brgyud pa'i bka' srol 'di la 'dres khyer gyi ma slad cing dam sel skyon gyi ma gos pa/ sngon rab kyi bka' brgyud bla ma'i phyag bzhes ji bzhin dri ma med pa'i khrid tshul yon tan chen po brgyad ldan 'di lta bu dang phrad pa ni u dusmra ra'i me tog snyed pa ltar bskal ba ches bzang zhing dga' bdes blo rgyud yongs su sim par 'os pa'i gnas so/ /yang rig 'dzin chen po dpal pad+ma bde chen gling pa la don rgyud kyi chu bo'i bka' babs gcig ni/ dpa' bo chen po stag sham nus ldan bsam gtan rdo rje la brnyes pa yin te/ de yang ring brgyud ni/rgyal ba rgod tshang pa mgon po rdo rje'i thugs sras brtul zhugs rang dang mnyam pa o rgyan pa rin chen dpal nas brgyud pa'i phyag chen gso rig pa rnal 'byor ngag dbang chos 'phel la gsan pa yin la/ de 375

yi bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan ni slad mar mdo khams su slebs tshe khungs bcad nas 'dir bkod par bya la/ nye brgyud khyad par ba byin rlabs kyi tshan kha ma nyams pa don dam rtogs pa'i chu rgyun ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin rgyal po'i mdor lung bstan pa nges don bstan pa'i bdag po rgyal sras sa bcu mnyam med zla 'od gzhon nu la/ rdo rje 'chang gi byin rlabs don gyi 'pho ba chen pos ji bzhin ye shes mchog gzigs pa'i don brgyud brnyes pa thugs kyi sras dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bor zhal gyi bzhes pa phag gru rdo rje rgyal por bab cing / de la rtogs pa sa ra ha dang mnyam par yongs su grags pa gling ras pad+ma rdo rje dang / des de yi byin rlabs 'phos rgya ston dri med bshes gnyen/ de'i byin gyis brlabs pa ye shes sgyu ma'i sku mnyes mchog ldan rdo rje grags 'bum/ de'i ye shes kyi skus rjes su bzung zhing thugs rgyud gnyis su med pa dpa' bo stag sham nub ldan bsam gtan rdo rje/ de'i slob ma rtogs pa'i bka' babs pa dran mchog pad+ma bde chen gling pa/ de'i thugs rje chen pos bdag rjes su bzung ba'o/ /rgyud pa 'di ni mchog gi dngos grub thob pa 'phags chen gyi skyes mchog 'ba' zhig yin pas nan ltar byin rlabs che bar ma zad dpa' bo stag sham pa las phyag chen gyi rtogs pa'i bka' bab brnyes pa'i sras kyi mthu bo ni bdag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pas brgyud pa 'di la gcigs su bya'o/ /de ltar rnam 'dren rdo rje 'chang dpal pad+ma bde chen gling pa la bdag gis phyag rgya chen po sbyor dngos rjes tshang rgyab chos rnal 'byor bzhi yi rnam bzhag zhal lung khyad par can tshig nyung la don rgya che ba du ma legs par mnos shing / de'i mthus chos phyag rgya chen po go ba'i sgo nas nges pa yang dag pa rnyed cing / nyams su myong ba yang gnas 'gyu dran pa rdo rus thug cing bsam gtan zhi gnas shes rab rig pa lhag mthong gis nyams myong gi sna kha cung zad zin pa'i mthu las/ phyis kyi dge sbyor thams cad skye ba'i rmang gzhi lta bur gyur pas/ des na tshe 'di'i bla mar gyur pa rnams kyi mchog bka' drin rmad byung rtsa ba'i bla ma'i gnas su 'dzin pa'i rgyu mtshan de yi yin no/ /de bas gzhan rmongs zhen tsam gyis ni dgos pa ma mchis te/ ci phyir de dgos pa che na rta mi yi bdag tu bzung ba'i byol song phal cher yang 'tshangs tshar 'dug /rmongs zhen de tshos yang shes/ spyir yang gnyen bshes bsam rang la snying nye byams pa tsam gyis bla mar 'dzin mi 'os te des yong na bka' drin pha mas che/ mgo bza' dpon gyis bton/snying thag nag mos nye/ mdza' khram grogs dang che ste/ de dag la rtsa ba'i bla mar bzung nas gsol ba btab pa'i lugs srol sngar ye nas byung lugs med/ da ni dus kyi dbang gi yin yin mor rlom pa 'ga' res kyang de 'dra la gsol ba gdab rigs su gda'/ ci'i phyir zhe na dbang bshad man ngag zab mo tho~X shāng go myong bzang po bskyed mkhan de gnad chung du bzung zhing / de bas pha khu bza' dpon

sogs mdza' grogs gnyen bshes su rtogs pa'i bla mar chos kyi go myong rtogs gsum gyi dra dri ye nas ma byung yang chos rab rib than thun dang / man ngag dum dum cung zad re thos pa la rmongs zhen kho nas bskyod de rtsis che che so/ /bka' drin mtshungs med rtsa ba'i bla ma yin yin mo byed pa yang mang du mthong bas so/ /lar tshigs bcad gcig nyan pa la yang dad pa mos gus yang dag par bya rigs na/ chos rab rib than thun dang man ngag dam dum thos pa'i yul la dag snang mos gus bkur sti rim gro mi dgos zer ba ni ma yin ste/ chos 'brel yod phyin gus pas bsnyen dgos pa yang gzhir bcas/ gzhan yang kha cig lung sul dben po rer sdod yun ring du byas shing chos kyi go myong blo gros ye nas med pa la dbang bskur chos bshad blo gros kyi snang ba bskyed cho ga phyag len yang ci rig/sa blor tshud tshe/ de dag sngar nas shes gyu gyu yod gyu gyu las phan btags drin du mi gzo zhing byas pa mnyam mnyam 'dra 'dra'i khul gyi da dung mched grogs tsam yin gyu'i o zob can khrel ngo tsha chung ba de 'dra yang dus dbang gi mang rab mthong yongs rigs 'dug ste/ sngar mched grogs yin rung dbang lung khrid bka' zhu zin nas mched grogs 'dzin ga nas rung bla ma yin par nges/ sems ngo sprad na bla ma las kyang rtsa ba'i bla ma gnyan shos der gda'/ rang gi dbang lung ma nod kyang / bla mas rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur ba'am/chos kyi 'gro don skyong nus pa de ni mnyam 'grogs kyi gnas ma yin rang gzhan gnyis kas chos kyi 'gro don spyod nus na yang dag snang sbyangs ba gces/ de mi shes mkhan tsho yin pa lta ham pa mig che byed rgyu la bsags pa ni rdo rje dmyal ba'i las bsags pa tsho phe tsha re/ pha pha/ lar chos kyi bka' drin che sa la mi rtsi chung la rtsi/ sems ngo sprad par rtsa ba'i bla mar mi 'dzin/ ma sprad pa la 'dzin pa rnams 'ga' zhig ni ma go ba'i skyon yang yin/ phal cher zhig ni rang bsod nams dman pas 'di phyi phung ba'i phung 'gong de snying la zhugs nas 'di snang khe grags yad yud kyi byed mang bdud las su bsgrub pa yin mod/ngo shes mkhan ni nyung / zer mkhan yang dkon rigs snang ste/ smra dgos nges rang gzhan skyon la 'dzub tshug dam pa'i chos dang mthun pa de mi byed par/ phyi zhi dul gyi kha gsag rtsed rtsed mkhas 'jug skyen po la nang byang sems brlan gyis ma gos par chags sdang phrag dog chos brgyad kyi yo lang 'tshub pa tsho tshig rtsub 'di 'dra smra dgos ma bab cing tshul de dge ba'i bshes gnyen du yang 'gyur re kan/ gzhan yang khrid thob snga ba tsam zhen yang bya rgyu med do/ /rgyu 'bras la 'phrig ma tshud/ dam tshig gi khe nyen ma shes shing / go ba nyams myong gang yang ma byung na ming khrid du btags kyang don la klags lung tsam dang khyad par ma byung bas de la rtsa ba'i bla ma mi zer/ de ma zad sngon bskal pa bzang dus su sngar go myong tsam skyes kyang phyis rtogs pa'i ye shes dngos gang la skyes pa de la rtsa ba'i bla mar mdzad pa yin kyang / deng 377

sang de kha skad tsam las dngos mthun e yod rang ma shes/ yod 'gro nyen yang che/ yod na de kas 'thus pas 'dir brjod ma dgos/ de dag ni 'phros don tsam ste rgyas par 'dir brjod ma langs gzhan du ci rigs spro bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar shes pas chos kyi go ba nyams myong ma byung yang chos thob snga ba tsam dang / phyogs 'dzin rmongs zhen gyi bya ba ma gos par tshul bzhin chos kyi rjes su 'brang bas rtsa ba'i bla ma ngos bzung ba'i yin lugs cung zad brjod pa yin no/ /mnyam med rgyas sras zla 'od gzhon nu 'chi med mes po'i ral pa las/ /legs 'ongs 'od gsal phar phyin phyag chen dag byed lha mo bye ba'i gtso/ /thub chen bshes gnyen tshul gyur phag gru skal ldan shing rta'i snying stobs kyis/ /legs drangs yon tan brgyad ldan rgyun bzang bde gling dza hu'i mchod byas shing / /slar yang gdul bya mtha' dag gyur pa stobs ldan las skyes brgyad khri'i gdung / /sems kyi dri ma 'khrud par mdzad phyir sa gsum kun tu 'gro ba po/ /rmad byung man ngag legs par bcad pa'i ca co sgrogs byed 'chor sgeg lha mo'i tshig /bdag gi cung zad thos pas nyon mongs skoms tshad gdung sel dbugs dbyung byas/ /zhes pa'ang smras so/ /de ltar dpal pad+ma bde chen gling pa'i thugs rje las phyag rgya chen po la go ba ma nor ji lta ba dang nyams myong gi sna kha nas kyang zin mod/ 'on kyang phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa dngos ni rang nyid kyi sgrib pas de skabs su ma shar bas/ rtogs pa ni/ mnyam med dwags po'i thugs sras rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu sngon gyur pa ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas bskal bzang 'dren pa drug pa seng ge sgra yi ngo bo kre bo karma pa dus gsum mkhyen pa'i dpal zhes chos kyi grags pa'i zhabs nas brgyud pa karma kam tshang du grags pa'i bka' brgyud bye brag tu kam tshang snyan rgyud 'dzin pa dpal zur mang pa zhes snyan pa'i ba dan srid rtser g.yo ba gang gi bka' srol 'dzin pa'i khyu mchog dpal chen po sha wa ri pa'i sgyu 'phrul ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas 'tshogs chen gtso bo'i ngo bo rdo rje 'chang che tshangs mchog gi sprul pa'i sku drug pa 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo karma rig 'dzin gsung rab rgya mtsho phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba ho ru ka dpal gang gi bka' drin chen pos khyab par gyur pa ste de nyid kyi zhabs pad du dka' ba spyad de lan gnyis kyi bar bsnyen par byas shing / phyag rgya chene po spung khrid tshar gsum/ smin khrid lan gnyis mnos shing / khyad par sems nyid ngo bo chos kyi sku ru ngo sprad pas rtsa ba'i bla ma yongs kyi gtso bor bzhugs shing sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur mod/ spyir yang sems nyid chos skur ngo sprad pa'i bla ma de la dbang bka' klags lung tshigs su bcad pa'i gcig tsam yang ma thob rung rtsa ba'i bla ma yin la/ sems nyid chos skur ngo ma 'phrod na glegs bam brgya stong tsam gyi klags lung rdoḍi8 pa'am dbang bskur gyi bum chu'i sho rgyug cod paṇa kyi thib 'og tu non pa nod pa'i yul kyang /

lan lag gi bla ma yin la/ dbang bskur gnyan po 'ga' res rtsa ba'i bla ma'i khongs su gtogs dgos pa ni yod/ khrid kyi rgyun tsam zhus pa yang de dang 'dra/ dper na mi las rong ston dang rngog ston la khrid cha tshang ba re gsan cing / de bzhin dwags pos bka' gdams kyi man ngag sngar gsan pa dang / phag gru'i sa chen lo bcu gnyis bsten cing gdams khrid mtha' yas pa gsan pas de rnams la go myong bzang po skyes kyang rtogs pa gsha' ma de phyis skyes pas/ de dag gis/ mar pa dang mi la/ dwags po rnams rtsa ba'i bla mar mdzad pa'i rig pas shes so/ /gzhan yang de lta bu'i lo rgyus ches mang yang skabs 'dir rgya mi bskyed do/ /de ltar bdag gi tshe 'dir phyag rgya chen po yi rtogs pa'i sna kha nas cung zad zin par gyur cing rdo rje'i gsung gi dbugs dbyung bar mdzad pa po gang rdo rje 'chang du shes pas rang ngo la bla ma brgyud rim la mi ltos mod/ 'on kyang gzhan rnams yid ches par byed pa la ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas bka' drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar chos rgyun ma chad cing byin rlabs ma nyams pa zhig dgos pa ni gzhir bcas/ gzhan du ni byin rlabs med na rgyud khungs yod kyang ngo mtshar med la/ byin rlabs yod na rgyud khungs med kyang rung ba'i go skabs ni yodalpod/ 'dir ni rgyud par ldan cing byin rlabs ma nyams pa las kyang che ba'i rgyud pa yid bzhin nor bu zhes bla ma rnams kyi mtshan nas bgrang bar bya ste/de yang phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bo ni sngar bshad pa nyid yin kyang skabs 'dir rang gi rgyud la skye tshul sngags kyi phyag chen gyi rgyas thebs pa dang / chos bde mchog snyan brgyud dwags po lugs nor bu skor gsum gyi gnas lugs yid bzhin nor bu yin par bzhed pas na/ des na skabs 'dir dpal til brdung zhabs nas brgyud pa'i lugs su bya ste/ de la/ bha ga wan badz+ra dha ra/ badz+ra yo gi ni/ gu ru tislo pratsā bha ṭa/ nā ro ta tsā na sirnyi/ lo tsā na dharmā ti/ yo ga ha su badz+ra/ de wa su mi pusbya rat+na karma ka shrī dharma kirti/pusbya girti/ pusbya badz+ra/ karma ga dharma gu ru/ o rgyan rat+na shrī/ karma ka su yam bhu badz+ra/ badz+ra shrī/ karma ka li la badz+ra/ khe tsa ren+t+ra badz+ra/ karma ka dharma shrī/ 'di nas 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgyu 'phrul dpal teslo pa yi sprul par zhal gyis bzhes shing / de bzhin gshegs pa gzi bajid mtha' yas kyi ngo bor gyur pa ya se rtogs ldan blo gros rin chen/ des tshab shir rnal 'byor chos sku 'od zer seng ge/ des jo gdan blo gros grags pa/ des bya btang blo gros rgya mtsho/ 'di gter ston rasna'i rtsa ba'i chos bdag yin/ des rtogs ldan don grub bkra shis/ des sngags 'chang sangs rgyas rin chen des tsher lung drung pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ 'dis lo drug rdo rje dkyil krung cig ma bshig par bzhugs shing ro gcig chen po'i rtogs pa thugs rgyud la 'khrungs/ karma pa'i sprul par yang grags shing thugs smyud gcig par yang mngon de/ zhwa dmar chos kyi dbang phyug gi yongs 'dzin du yang brten/ des gar dbang karma bstan skyong / 37spyis che

tshangs bsod nams 'gyur med/ 'dis bsgom med chen mo rtogs par zhal gyis bzhes shing lta stangs kyi chu bo gyen du bzlog par yang grags/ des sprul pa'i sku dkon mchog bstan 'dzin zhabs/ des dran mchog 'khor lo'i mgon po he ru ka dpal karma rig 'dzin gsung rab rgya mtsho ste/ des brtse ba chen pos bdag karma bstan pa mtha' rgyas sam/ dpal rnal 'byor rab tu dgyes pa'i rdo rje rtsal rjes su bzung nas don brgyud brnyes pa'o/ /yang karma pa dus gsum mkhyen pa'i dpal chos kyi grags pa nas/kaḥ thog dam pa bde gshegs su grags pa mtshan dngos spob pa mtha' yas/ gtsang ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga byams pa 'bum/ des grub thob chen po karma pag shi zhes chos kyi bla ma nas sngar ltar brgyud zhes/ rje mi bskyod zhabs kyi gsung zhes drung kun dga' rnam rgyal ba'i snyan brgyud chos 'byung las so/ /yang phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi don rgyud gcig ni/ dwags po nas/ phag gru/ gling ras/ rgya ras zhabs/ rgod tshangs pa/ o rgyan rin chen dpal nas rgyal ba'i sras mchog karma rang byung zhabs te/ de nas sngar dang 'dra/ yang cig ya pe rtogs ldan nas/ rag shi bsod nams dpal grub/tsher dkar chos kyi grags pa/ dgongs dus pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ a wa dhu ti pa blo gros rgya mtsho de nas sngar dang 'dra/ yang a wa dhu ti nas/ rtogs ldan don grub bkra shis dang / de nas rje btsun sprul pa'i sku karma legs bshad sgra dbyangs/ rgyal ba'i sras po ma snyi'i mtshan ldan/ sngags 'chang sangs rgyas rin chen/ drung kun dga' rnam rgyal/ sprul pa'i sku karma bstan skyong / che tshang lnga pa bsod nams 'gyur med/rin po che dkon mchog bstan 'dzin/ tsher lung drung pa karma bstan pa rnam rgyal/ de gnyis kar dran mchog rtsa ba'i bla mas thug mdo/ 'on kyang phyag chen rtogs pa'i don rgyud ni sngar bstan pa kho na'o/ /yang rje btsun rdo rje 'chang 'di yi zhabs pad du/ phyag chen lnga ldan gyi khrid rgyas bsdus gnyis spung khrid du chos 'brel gyi thog mar thob pa'i brgyud pa gcig ni 'di lta ste/ phag gru rdo rje rgyal po nas skyob pa rin chen dpal/ spyan snga grags 'byung ba/ 'bri gung dbon rin po che/ gcung rdo rje grags/ rgyal sras thog kha ba rin chen seng ge/ 'tshams bcad pa grags pa seng ge/ chos sgo ba rdo rje ye shes/ rin po che rdo rje rin chen/ rin po che rdo rje rgyal po/ rin po che chos kyi rgyal po/ thugs sras rin chen dpal rgyal mtshan/ chos rgyal rin chen dpal bzang / kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang / rig 'dzin rin chen phun tshogs/ de sras chos rgyal phun tshogs/ rig 'dzin dkon mchog chos kyi grags pa ste/ de yan chad 'bri gung bka' brgyud do/ /de nas zur mang sprul pa'i sku dkon mchog bstan 'dzin dpal bzang po/des rtsa ba'i bla ma rig 'dzin zhabs la ste/ brgyud pa 'di rnams phyag chen rtogs pa bskyed byed myong khrid dngos kyi brgyud pa'i go rim rang ni min par sems la chos gsan bzhes yod cing gdan rabs kyi 380

go rim dang mthun phyir mdzad par rigs so/ /phyag chen lnga ldan 'di la brgyud pa'i rnam grangs gzhan yang yod par nges kyang de skabs zhu ba ma byung / slar khung chod tshe bri bar 'dod do/ /gzhan yang dwags po bka' brgyud kyi brgyud pa bye brag pa du ma dang / byin rlabs man ngag gi rgyun bka' srol ci rigs zhig /smar tshang kaḥ thog lugs dang / kam tshang zur mang lugs la 'du ba ste/ de brgyud pa'i bla ma so so'i rnam thar gyis shes shing / de dag kho bos cung zad cig gzhan du spro bar 'dod kyi 'dir ni yi ge mang bas mi bri'o/ /dpal ldan bka' brgyud dbyig 'dzin khyen gyi rgyan gcig kam tshang dpag bsam shing / phrin las rnam par rgyal las snyan brgyud 'bras bu g.yur gyur zur mang ba/ gang gi byin rlabs ro bcud mdzod 'dzin 'chi med dbang po che tshang zhabs/ gang khyod bdag snying dbus su zhen no yongs 'dus dga' ston cis mi ster/ bsam bzhin dran no dran mchog 'khor lo'i dbang phyug karma rig pa 'dzin/ rgyal ba kun gtso kun gyi ngo bo tshe rabs yongs 'dzin bla ma'i zhabs yongs 'dus/ me tog bdag mgor bkod mthu'i nges don bdud rtsi cha shas gcig /thob pa yis kyang bdag tshe 'bras ldan skal bzang 'di ni khyod kyi drin/ zhes pa yang smras so/ /de ltar rtsa ba'i bla ma dag la phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag ci tsam thob pa'i tshul dang / rtsa ba'i bla ma ngos 'dzin tshul bka' brgyud gong ma'i bzhes pa yang cung zad bcas smras pa ste/ de yang bdag lta bu so so skye bo bag chags sgrib pa 'thug pos g.yog pa la phyag rgya chen po'i nyams rtogs dngos ci phyir skye/ 'on kyang nyams dang rtogs pa'i gzugs brnyan tsam zhig skyes pa 'di ni rje btsun bla ma de gnyis kyi thugs rje kho nar brten pa ste/ dpal pad+ma bde chen gling pa'i bka' drin gyis da go myong gi rmang gzhi thing zhing / karma rig 'dzin zhabs kyi byin rlabs mthus rtogs pa'i sne cha shas cung zad zhig zin par gyur pa 'di nyid ste/ slar ring por mi thog phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes ci lta ba mchog gi dngos grub de nyid myur du thob par smon gyi gegs med du 'grub pa dang / gang ltar yang / bde rung / mi bde rung / skyid rung / sdug rung / na rung / 'chi rung / bsgom rung / yengs rung / rtogs rung / ma rtogs rung / grol rung / 'khrul rung / mdor na rang sems kyi cho 'phrul ci ltar snang yang / don dam par gnas lugs rang bab phyag rgya chen po skye ba med 'gag pa med gnas pa med 'gro 'ong med brjod du med bsam du med/ rtsol byed yid byed kyi spros pa thams cad dang bral ba 'di nyid ngo shes shing zhe gdengs su cung zad du gyur pa 'di ni/ o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po gu ru pad+ma ka ra gsung gi rdo rje 'chang 'od dpag med pa dang dbyer ma mchis shing de yi ngo bor gyur pa rtsa ba'i bla ma zung gi thugs rje'o/ /byin rlabs so/ /bka' drin no/ /dus 'di nas bdag yid ji srid du re sa gzhan ni med kyi ci mdzad khyed rang shes so/ /bdag byang chub chen po ma tho~X 8༵ra du

brjed pa'i go skabs med/ bral ba'i go skabs med/ byang chub thob kyang rtag brtan g.yung drung rigs kyi bdag por bzhugs par bzhugs su gsol zhing bzhugs par nges pa'o/ /mgon po khyod kyi 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i phyir dgyes na bdag bskal pa'i bskal pa rgya mtsho'i bar du 'khor ba'i gnas su mchis la/ gang ltar na'ang mgon po khyod dgyes pa'i las rnams la bdag 'jug shing mi dgyes pa skad cig tsam yang srog 'dor na yang mi bgyid par bsnyen par bya lags so/ /bdag srog 'di ni rnyed par mi dka' yi/ /ji bzhin ye shes bskyed mdzad ches dkon pas/ /dam tshig gnyan ni tshe rabs gtan gyi grogs/ /mi 'brel snying la bcangs 'os yid bzhin nor/ /phun tshogs 'dod dgu yongs ster dpag bsam shing / /yang dag thar lam la 'dren lcags kyu mchog /'di go dam tshig snying po mos gus te/ /ldem rgyang med do rtsa ba'i bla ma rje/ /zhes pa yang mos gus la ched du brjod do/ /zhes byin rlabs kyi yang snying nyams myong rtogs pa gang las skyes pha rtsa ba'i don rgyud zhal lung mchog gi rgyud rim cha shas tsam brjod pa'i skabs te dang po'o/ /tshe rabs du mar bsags pa'i bsod nams mthu'i/ /dbang phyug brgyad ldan rdo rje slob dpon gyi/ /rjes bzung ma nor lta bsgom spyod pa'i gnad/ /tshul bzhin nor bu rnyed 'di ngo mtshar rmad/ /da ni spyi don gnyis pa brgyud pa'i bka' srol gzhan gyi zhal lung byin brlabs kyi rgyud ji ltar babs pa'i tshul brjod pa la/ de yang dpal dwags po bka' rgyud kyi srol 'dzin nam mkha'i skar ma ltar bkra ba las/ khyad par ba/ kam tshang / sgam po/ tshal pa/ phag gru/ 'bri gung /stag lung / 'brug pa/ smar g.yam/ 'bam rom pa sogs/ brgyud pa'i bye brag bsam gyi mi khyab cing /so so'i khyad par gyi bka' babs byin rlabs re dang 'brel nas gnas pa la/ rang gi mos gus kyi mig yangs pas so/ /kun la sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma nges pa don gyi rdo rje sems dpa' gang gi sgyu 'phrul du shes par byas nas bka' brgyud bye brag gi byin rlabs don khrid kyi chu bo ci snyed cig thos pa'i tshul 'dir brjod pa la/ de dag sde tshan so sor bsgrig na mdzes mod kyang / 'di ni rang gi ci ltar thob rim bzhin brjod bde bas de ltar bya ste/ de la dang po ni rtogs pa'i gar mkhan grub mchog 'od gsal dbang po la ci ltar nod pa'i tshul las/ dang po sgam po gdan rabs kyi bka' srol phyag rgya chen po'i spung khrid tsam nod pa'i bla ma brgyud pa ni/ mnyam med zla 'od gzhon nu yan chad snga ma dag dang 'dra la/ de nas bsgom pa tshul khrims snying po la yag pa byang chub dngos grub/ mkhan chen bye dkar ba/snyi bsgom chen po/ 'bri gung gling pa mched/ lha lung pa/ lha btsun pa jo sras rdo rje blo gros/ spyan snga chos kyi rgya~X 8༵tshan/ chos kyi seng ge/ chos kyi dbang phyug mkhan chen rgyal mtshan bzang po/ spyan snga bsod

nams rgya mtsho/ bsod nams lhun grub/ sgam po paṇa chen bkra shis rnam rgyal/ spyan snga bsod nams mtshan can/ sprul sku nor bu rgyan pa/ spyan rin chen rdo rje/ sprul pa'i sku mchog bzang po rdo rje dpal/grub mchog 'od gsal dbang po/ des bdag tshe dbang nor bu la stsal ba'o/ /brgyud pa 'di las byung ba'i 'khor lo bde mchog gi dbang bzhi zhib rgyas zhig kyang nod la sgam po paṇa chen gyi gsung 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi bsdus lung dang pod dbang yang nan tan can zhus pa lags/ yang phyag rgya chen po lhan skyes kyi khrid rgyun lugs gcig ni/ kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar po yan bar 'brug lugs 'og nas 'byung ba dang 'dra la/ de nas sems dpa' rin chen dpal bzang / des sprul pa'i sku dpag bsam dbang po dang / 'gro smon chos rje 'jam dpal bzang po/ de gnyis kas cog gra sprul sku snyan grags dpal bzang /des khyab bdag 'od gsal dbang po la stsal ba'o/ /brgyud pa 'di dam tshig sel med khungs dag yin zhes gsungs brgyud pa 'di las thod dbang me yi 'khor lo dang / gtum mo tsub shing ma'i myong khrid bcas thob cing / de dang 'brel mtshungs su/ sgam 'brug gi lus sbyangs 'khrul 'khor yongs rdzogs lung nod kyang brtson pa dman pas blo la ni ma 'jags so/ /gnyis pa phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag mchog tu gyur pa dpal dwags po lha rjes brag sgom zhwa 'dra ba ru gter du sbas pa phyis sprul sku 'ja' tshon snying pos gter nas bton pa'i gseng lam bla bsgrub tu grags pa'i lung khrid nos pa'i bla ma brgyud pa ni/ deng brgyud du mi la ras pa'i bar sngar brjod pa dang 'dra mod/ 'dir nye brgyud gtso che bar mngon pas/ nye brgyud ni/ bcom ldan 'das ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po zla 'od gzhon nu/sprul sku 'ja' tshon snying po/ mchog sprul bzang po rdo rje dpal/ khyab bdag 'od gsal dbang po/ des bdag la'o/ /de yi smin byed dbang snying khong ma yang thob pa'i rgyud pa ni/ chos sku ye shes mkha' 'gro/byang chub sems dpa' nor bu brgyan pa/ spyan snga rin chen rdo rje/ mchog sprul bzang po rdo rje dpal/khyab bdag 'od gsal dbang po/ des bdag la chos dbyings don grub rdo rje rtsal zhes ming dang bcas te stsal ba'o/ /mgon po de cog grwa sprul sku'i chos sras dam par gyur cing / lhag tu sgam po mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rin po che bzang po rdo rje'i zhabs pad nye bar bsnyen cing / de sras mchog rnams dang bcas brten nas dka' spyad snying rus kyi go cha drag pos mthar bton gyis phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa skyes pa la som nyi med pa yin 'dug pas/ des na rang gi rtogs pa'i cha spros bral la yang nyams rtogs spu ris zhib mor dbye ba la nyams bsdur gyi sgo nas dogs pa bcad pas/ mnyam bzhag ni khong brtan par 'dug rtsal ni nged rang bzang ba tsam byung / ngo bo ngos bzung la ni khyad cung zad kyang ma byung bas spros bral gyi rnal 'byor la phyogs gcig gis sgro 'dog der chod song bas khong yang bka' drin shin 383

tu che ba zhig yin/ gzhan zla chos re grub tsha na spros bral nas bsgom med bar gyi khas len byed pa grub thob gling ras kyi rtogs pa skye tshul las kyang bzang ba ci rigs yong gi ni 'dug sangs rgyas rkun ma gar yod mi shes pa'i dpe de 'dra yod shas yang che/ 'on kyang skyes bu shed rtsal che bas rang dang lang tsho mnyam pa la rtse ba bzhin rang dang nyams rtogs mtshungs nas nyams bsdur ba'i 'os su ni sngar phan grub chen de tsam las som nyi med pa'i rtogs ldan pa nga rang skal dman pas mjal ba dkon pa nyid byung /spyir yang kho bo spyi brtol che ba'i rigs su gyurasnyepas yin te 'ong / gzhan gyi bsgom zhes sla chos su byed kyang / nged kyi ni phral gyi nyams brang breng dang / rtogs pa'i cha cung zad re byung bar zhen pa dang dga' tshor yed yed po de gtan nas ma byas/ des na nyams rtogs ma skyes par ku co sgrogs pa ni smos ci 'tshal/ cung zad skyes pa la yang rgyal ba'i bka'/ bla ma'i man ngag gis/ rang gi nyams myong gtan la phab pa las/ phyogs cha zhig la yin gyu gyu yod gyu gyu ba de ye nas byed mi 'dod pa gcig yin/ da lta yang nyams len la rang skya 'pher nges tsam las nged rtogs ldan rnal 'byor pa chen po zhig yin snyam yang med/ yin yang min/ rab gi nyams rtogs la rang nyid mgu dka' bas gang yin rdo rus btug 'dod mkhan cig yin/ lar mi gzhan ltar nyams rtogs skye myur po de nged min par gda'/ dbang dman rim gyis pa zer ba der 'dug pas skyag re yang ci la yod/ 'on kyang nyams rtogs mi mtho yang gang skyes de spus gtsang mar rloms/ de ltar grub mchog 'od gsal dbang po dang dge sbyor nyams bsdur la brten rang gi yang lhag mthong la nges shes ci rigs pa rnyed/ grub mchog bla ma dam pas kyang sngar gyi dge sbyor la da res khyod dang nyams rtogs 'bel mchid zhib mor byung ba des bgo ci rigs thon rgyu byung zhes dgyes tshor gnang kyi bdug gzhan kha cig ltar phan thogs kyang ma thog khul gyi g.yo can de min pa bzang po'i rnam thar der gdab/ bstan pa'i srog shing dpal ldan sgam po pa/ /mchog gi sprul sku bzang po rdo rje dpal/ /gang gi zhal skyin 'od gsal dbang po yi/ /bdag blo the tshom mun pa sel 'di rmad/ /zhes so/ /da ni brgyud pa'i rnam grangs gsum pa ni/ kam tshang bstan pa'i gtso bo pa la gnas pa'i 'og min dbu ru stod lung mtshur phu rgyal ba'i bsti gnas su rgyal ba'i sras po karma pa sku bcu gnyis pa dang /spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa zhwa dmar brgyad pa'i zhabs la reg te/ karma pa la byin rlabs kyi rgyun shin tu che ba'i chos 'brel kha shas dang / zhwa dmar ba la phyag chen lhan skyes kyi yig cha/ rje rang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i lung khrid nos pa'i rgyud rim 'og tu 'byung bas rtogs kyis/ 'dir ma bstan no/ /mchog tu gyur pa rtsa ba'i bla ma gsum pa pha tre bo chos kyi rje/ rgyal ba kun gyi yab gyur rgyal ba'i 384

'khor los bsgyur ba chos kyi dbang po'i zhal snga nas phyag rgya chen po lhan skyes sbyor gyi smin khrid gdan thog cig tu sbyor dngos rjes tshang yang nas yang du thob ste/ de yang dam pa 'di nyid sprul pa'i sku karma pa yab sras kyi yongs 'dzin rtsa ba'i bla ma yin la/ slob ma thams cad kyi gtso bo'i tshul yang mdzad pas/'dir ni khrid bka' gnang skabs kyi gsung rgyun bzhin phyi ma dang mthun par bkod na/ karma pa dharma shrī ste/ karma pa de bzhin gshegs pa yan chad sngar zur mang bka' brgyud skabs su bstan pa ltar yin la/de nas sog dbon rig pa'i ral gri/ mtshan dngos rat+na bha ṭa/ karma drug pa dar+sha pa ti/ ban rgar ba maspru shrī bha dra/ rgyal tshab pa shrī bhu kyārla sirnyi/ karma pa bdun pa sa ro ru ha badz+ra/ sangs rgyas gnyen pa maṅga la shrī bhu ti/ karma rab brgyad pa agho bh+ya badz+ra/ zhwa dmar rat+na ga /karma dgu pa i shwa ra badz+ra/ zhwa dmar dharmi shwa ra/ karma pa bcu pa badz+ra dharma dha tu/ zhwa dmar tsā na garta/ karma pa bcu gcig pa dz+nyā na badz+ra/ 'di la pha tre bos phyag rgya chen po gsan cing / karma pas kyang rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur chos kyi khri la mnga' gsolabar mdzad/ mtshan karma gu ru 'phrul can rtsal zhes kyang 'dogs par mdzad cing / gang ltar chos sras thu bo dam par gyur pa'o/ /karma bkocu gcig pa de la zhwa dmar dpal chen rat+na dharma sirnyirla ste/dkon mchog chos kyi don grub kyis kyang thug tsam byung yang / phyag rgya chen po'i gdams pa ji bzhin ni 'dren mchog chos rje kre bo la gsan pa yin la karma pa bcu gnyis pa sgo dhe badz+ra gyis zhwa dmar ba la gsan par mdzad mod/ dngos gnas kyi brgyud rim ni de ltar ste/ 'on kyang rje btsun chos kyi rjes thugs mos kyi karma pa byang chub rdo rje la phyag chen gyi khrid bka' slar yang tshur la bzhes nas brgyud rim ni de bzhin du mdzad snang bas/ des na/ karma ye shes rdo rje/ dpal chen chos kyi don grub karma pa byang chub rdo rje/ pha chos kyi rje tre bo byang chub chos kyi snying po/ des bdag tshe dbang nor bu/ karma rin chen mchog tu dga' ba dge ba'i dpal la dgyes pas stsal ba'o/ /dam pa 'di la phyag rgya chen po'i zhal lung yang dag par thob shing / kun mkhyen jo nang pa'i bzhed pa rdo rje'i tshig cung zad cig thos pa la brten sngar phra ba'i gnas la dpyad pa phra mo zhig yod pa de ston thin ltar der dwangs nas/ rtogs pa'i ngo bo sngar gyi de la nyams kyi cha nas brgya 'gyur du 'phel song zhing / lam gang shar la spangs blang med zer ba de tshig tu ma lus don thog tu phebs pas na bka' drin shin tu che bas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i gnas so/ /de phyin dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i bla ma mang du brten khrid bka' yang shin tu mang ba zhus kyang / yon tan cha shas tsam re las de dag gis rtogs pa la ji bzhin gsar du bskyed thon rgyu zhig sngar phan ni ma byung /de yang bla ma gzhan byin rlabs chung ba ni min/ rang gi mos gus med pa yang min/ des na tshe sngon gyi las 'bras che chung dang / rang gi dge sbyor yang sad pa'i dus la bab mi bab kyi khyad ni yin par nges/385

gzhan sngon byon gyi skyes mchog dam pa 'ga' yi byin gyis brlabs pa'i snang ba dang gsung gi mthus ni rtogs pa'i bogs mang du thon song yang skabs 'dir brjod mi dgos par 'dugaphyag chen khrid pha tre bo rin po cher rgyas bsdus mang du thos la/ slar yang karma pa dbang phyug rdo rjes mdzad pa'i khrid yig chen mo tshang dril gyi rgyun rtsa ba tshigs bcad kyi lung bcas shing yos lor shangs zab phu/ mdor bla ma bsgrub chen mtshan bla btags mnga' ris bu chung du grags pa'i drung du nan tan gyi zhus pa yin no/ /des zhabs drung tre bo rin po che'i drung du lo ngo gnyis su zhus pa yin gsungs/tre+e bo rin po che nas karma pa bcu gcig ye shes rdo rje la gsan par+yān 'dug la/ tre+e bo rin po che nas khrid yig chen mo tshangs dril lan gcig las gnang ba ma byung zhes bla mas gsung ngo / /de la gzhan yang ne gu cha tshang sgrol dkar gyi khrid rgyun sogs mang zhig nod pa bka' drin can yin no/ /de ltar phyag chen rgyal ba yab sras nang rgyud las ci ltar thos pa'i tshul ste/ bzhi pa tre bo rang lugs kyi brgyud pa ni yod par gor ma chag kyang / brgyud pa ci bzhin sngar ma 'tshal bas slar dri bar 'dod/ de yang brgyud pa'i gyes 'tshams ni/ karma pa bdun pa'i zhabs nas tre chung chos kyi rgya mtshos thug de la spyod 'chang nag po'i sprul pa kun dga' grol mchog gi thug /de la tre bo gnyis pa dpag bsam dbang pos 'thug cing /rtsa ba'i bla ma yang grol mchog la mdzad/ de yi sbrul sku tre bo gsum pa karma bstan pa dar rgyas dang /de'i sprul sku rdo rje 'chang tre bo byang chub chos kyi dbang po zhes/ bdag cag gi 'dren pa mtshungs pa med pa de nyid do/ /dus gsum rgyal ba yongs kyi 'phrin las pa/ /karma pa zhes snyan pa'i ba dan can/ /gang gi rnam 'phrul byang chub rdo rje semag /chos kyi don grub mchog gis bdag skyong rmad/ /dpal ldan kam tshang bstan pa'i srog shing mchog /mtshungs med bla ma chos kyi dbang po zhes/ /gang de bdag snying dbus su zhen lags kyi/ thugs rjes gzigs shig yongs 'dzin chos kyi rje/ /khyod kyi cung zad rjes su bzung bas kyang / /cir snang phyag rgya chen po'i 'khor lo 'khor/ /mngon mtho nges legs yon tan cir yang rgyas/ /bka' drin dran no rtsa ba'i bla ma rje/ /tshe dpag med mgon spyan ras gzigs dbang gi/ /thugs rje'i chu gter bsrub las yongs byung ba'i/ /'gro 'dren bla ma yid bzhin nor bu khyed/ /byang chub bar du bdag gtsug rgyan mdzod cig /zhes pa smras so/ /de ltar pha tre bo chos kyi dbang po'i zhal snga nas phyag chen zhus pa yan gyi sems phyogs gdams pa nod pa kun myong khrid du dmigs shing nyams rtog gi cha la sgro 'dogs ci chod du byas/ phal che ba zhig ni chod nas yang song / nyams len ngo thog la ni yid gnyis dang the tshom gyi gnas spu tsam yang med par gdings rkang tshugs pa'i lugs su byas/ de yang phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bo mthong ma mthong nyams rtog gi cha nas sgro 'dogs gcod pa las gegs sel bogs 386

'don dang gol shor du ma song ba'i gnad kyi go ba bzang po ni bu chung gi skabs nas yod/ /'on kyang bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams ban bun gyi zhe kha 'grang zhing chog shes ma byas par nyams rtogs ldan pa'i dam pa rnams kyi spyan sngar rdo rus gtug pa yin/ de ka yang rtsa ba'i bla ma gcig chog rgyal po gcig gi ngo sprad pas mchog 'dod kyi/ de la yid gnyis byung nas dogs gcod byas pa yang min/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dag dngos su mjal ba'i skal ba dman pa byung tshe nyams rtogs kyi spu ris phra mo gsar du dpyad pa zhugs pa la zhun mthar ci chod du bgyis pa lags/ de lta na yang ngo bo ni sngar che tshang sprul pa'i sku'i spyan sngar skyes pa de kar gda'/ nyams myong gi sgo ni mi 'dra ba du ma byung/ spyir yang de la gegs sel bogs 'don mi dgos pa de ga nas yin/ de tsam nas bzung de dag gzhan la stos nas byed ma dgos par rang skya 'pher ba yin/ byin rlabs kyi 'pho bas ye shes kyi snang ba gsar du bskyed rgyu mod pa yang bzhir bcas/ spyir yang de rnal 'byor lam zhugs gsar bu pa mi dgos/ tshogs sbyor kyi lam mthon por zhugs pa la yang gegs sel dgos pa'i skabs yod na sa/zhan lta ci smos/ bogs ni 'phags pa'i sa la zhugs pa rnams kyang rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi bar bton dgos na gzhan la smra ma dgos/ deng sang rnal 'byor la bogs bton rgyu med pa'i khas len can tsho/ de som dang blun po mgo bskor gyi shab shob las chu shing gi snying po lta bu'i gtam de la dpyod ldan su zhig yid ches/ gzhan kha cig ni sa lam bgrod pa'i tshig 'di 'dra lam shor du 'dzin pa yang 'dug ste/ de ni sems nyid ngo bo bla mas ngo sprad pa la yid ma ches shing da lta'i shes pa 'di go ma chod pa'i gong bgrod kyi ltos gzhi 'cha' ba la zer gyi/ sa lam ye nas bgrod rgyu med pa ga nas yin/ de ma go bar zad kyi mang du smra mi dgos mod/ de dag ni zhor byung gi 'phros te/ gang ltar dus de tsam nas rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams kyi thugs rje la brten/ rang gi dge sbyor gyi ngo bo la ma bde ba'i dogs gcod byed rgyu ni mi 'dug pas de phyin gyi bla ma su la yang ma byas/ tshur ra nyams rtogs tshad mtshungs na dogs gcod nyams bsdur la dgyes sag sag kyi bsngags pa gnang mkhan yang sngar phan ni ma byung / des na sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i khrid bka' zhu ba ni de tsam yan la chog shes byas/ bka' babs byin rlabs kyi rgyun la dmigs shing bstan pa la lhag pa'i bsam pas/ bla ma rnams la dag pa'i snang ba legs par sbyangs nas khrid rgyun zhus pa ni de phyin nas ches mang ba ste/ de yang mang yul skyid grong grwa 'jam gling bla ma dam pa ma dhi dharma warta zhes rgya dkar gyi slob dpon kam+bha la chung bas byin gyis brlabs pa sbas tshul khyim pa'i cha byad kyi 'gro ba 'dul ba gang gi zhal snga nas la khrid rgyun lnga pa stod 'brug bka' rgyud kyi sdong po lta bu 'ba' ra ba skyes mchog rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po nas brgyud pa'i phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor khrid gzhung man ngag zur 'debs dang bcas pa thob ༵༵ bla ma

brgyud pa ni/ skyes mchog 'ba' ra ba yan chad ni rtsa ba'i bla ma bde chen gling par nod pa'i stod 'brug gi rgyud pa dang 'dra ba'am/ yang na/ yang dgon pa nas/ lcags ston grub chen/ 'khrul zhig sangs rgyas/ byang chub bzang po/ des skyes mchog 'ba' ra ba la/ de nas bya bral pad+ma bzang po 'jam dbyangs sprul pa'i sku sangs rgyas/ zur khang pa bsod nams bzang po/ skyes mchog sprul sku nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ gung thang pa nam mkha' rdo rje/ mkhas mchog lhun grub rgyal mtshan/ 'jam gling pa sangs rgyas chos 'phel/ mang yul grwa pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku rin chen bstan pa'i gsal byed/'jam gling rin po che blo gros chos 'phel/ des bdag tshe dbang nor bu la'o/ /yang na nam mkha' rdo rje nas/ nam mkha' dpal 'byor/ nam mkha' mgon po sangs rgyas chos 'phel nas 'dra/ yang na/ sprul sku nam mkha' rgyal mtshan nas/ rin chen chos dpal/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ karma gnas mchog /la/rma gsal byed/ dkon mchog rgyal mtshan nas 'dra yang / mon rdzong ras chen zla ba rgyal mtshan la sprul sku nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyis 'bar chos yongs rdzogs gsan pas de ltar brgyud na yang rung bar mngon brgyud pa 'di la 'ba' ra'i gsang khrid skor yongs rdzogs dang / dril bu rim lnga/ byin rlabs dang bcas pa yang mnos/drug pa skyes mchog 'ba' ra'i man ngag khyad par 'phags pa phyag chen chos drug bla sgrub kyi yang snying rmad du byung ba shangs 'ba' ra brag tu gter du btsal pa/ 7 rje btsun rdo rje 'dzin pa blo gros chos 'phel zhal snga nas spyan drangs pa cha tshang dril du dgyes pa chen pos rtsa ba'i bla ma brgyud pa ni/ skyes mchog 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang / bla ma dam pa blo gros chos 'phel/ des rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu la'o/ /dam pa 'di la bdag blo shin du bcug pa zhig byung bas sngon gyi las 'brel bzang po yod par nges so/ /skye ba sprul sku dpal ldan lha gdong pa/ /gang gi gsung gi sgyu 'phrul 'ba' ra ba/ /de yi srol 'dzin snying po 'jam gling rje/ /blo gros chos 'phel bdag blo'i dbus na mdzes/ /zhes pa'ang smras so/ /yang phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid bka' bdun pa tshal pa skye med zhang rin po che nas brgyud pa man lung 'khrul zhig nam mkha' bstan 'dzin la legs par zhang gi mdzad pa'i yig cha'i steng nas smin sor nod pa'i bla ma brgyud pa ni/ de yang gu ru pad+ma'i sprul par zhal gyis bzhes shing grub pa zhang rin po che brtson 'grus grags pa yi rtsa ba'i bla ma dpal sga lo mal yer pa/ dwags po bsgom tshul/paṇ+ḍi ta rdo rje snang mdzad ste/ de dag bde mchog phag mo/ thub pa/ sgrol ma yin nges pas yin nges bzhi dang / gzhan yang gnyis bcas kyi man ngag byin rlabs kyi rgyun mtha' dag mnga' ba las/ de yan 388

gyi brgyud pa'i rnam grangs so so ba yi ge mang bas ma bris la/ 'dir ni phyag chen lhan skyes kho na la ni/ rdo rje 'chang nas dwags po lha rje zla 'od gzhon nu'i bar gzhan ltar las/ de nas dwags po bsgom pa tshul khrims snying po/ des rgyal ba zhang bde ba rdo rje/ de nas rim bzhin man lung grub thob byang chub man lung byang seng ge rnam thar gser bris skya pod gnyis kar rgyal ba zhang dngos la thug pa 'dra zhig byung yang zhib mor byas na tshal pa nyi zla 'od kyi slob ma yin par snang ste/ tshal pa nyi zla 'od ni me stag la 'khrungs/ gya lnga lcags stag la gshegs pas 'grig go /'on kyang byang seng bas lo rgya lhag nges gcig bzhugs na 'grig rung ba'o/ /lo rgyus gzhan du tshal chen pa lha phyug nyi zla 'od kyi slob mar gsungs shing / tshal chen dang men lung byang seng mched grogs yin gsung bas de 'thad pa 'dra sems so/ /seng ge/ de sras chos rje sprul sku ston pa/ 'di zhang sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms kyi sprul sku ste de yi skye ba phyi ma rig 'dzin rgod ldem pa yin par grags/ sprul sku ston pa'i sras po chos rje 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ des byang sems dpal ldan gzhon nu/ rim pas rig 'dzin dkon mchog dpal ldan/ sngags 'chang 'jam dbyangs bsod nams/ mkhas grub ye shes dpal ldan/ rgyud 'dzin chos skyong 'phags pa/ sprul sku 'jam dbyangs dpal ldan/ mnyam med chos skyong dpal ldan/ byang sems bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang chos 'bar bzang po/ kun mkhyen nyi zla 'od dkar/ mkhas grub chos skyong seng ge/ sngags 'chang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang bstan pa'i nyi ma/ sngags 'chang bstan 'dzin seng ge/ sprul sku nam mkha' dpal ldan/ 'khrul zhig chen po chos rje nam mkha' bstan 'dzin nyi ma/ des bdag tshe dbang nor bu 'jam dbyangs seng ge la'o/ /tshal lugs kyi phyag chen khrid rgyun 'di shin tu dkon pas sngon lho brag dpa' bo gtsug lag 'phreng ba'i skabs tsam nas grags che med par des mdzad pa'i bka' brgyud chos 'byung du gsal la/ des na da lta khrid rgyun yod pa khong tsam du zad pa'i stabs kyi khrid yig rgyas bsdus gnyis ka'i steng nas smin khrid gnyis su zhus pa yin la byin rlabs don brgyud kyi chu bo yang dag par thob pa'o/ /brgyud pa 'di las byung ba'i zhang gi gsung 'bum yongs rdzogs klags lung dang mgon po bya rog gi dbang lung tshang ba thob bo/ /e ma skye med zhang ston chos kyi sku/ /gang gi grags pas sa gsum khengs na yang / /khyod kyi don rgyud 'dzin pa nyin skar bzhin/ /gyur la nye tshe man lung 'khrul zhig gam/ /bka' drin bzang po'i mthu las bdag skal gyi/ /rnyed 'di ngo mtshar gnas su cis mi 'gyur/ /des na mgon po dbyings nas dgyes rig zhing / /tshul 'di dag kyang sngon smon nyid du nges/ /zhes pa'ang smras so/ /yang brgyad pa mnyam med dwags po'i man ngag phyag rgya chen po la yi ge bzhi par mtshan gsol ba de nyid za phug sgrub chen sbas pa'i sangs rgyas bkra shis rgya mtsho 'am shākya seng ger grags pa gang gi zhal snga nas gtsang smyon he ru ka yi bzhed pa ji bzhin du min khrid lan grangs du ma'i bar du zhus shing 389

man ngag zhal gdams sba 'phri med par nos pa'i bla ma brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje snying po/ te lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mi la/ dwags po/ phag gru/ de yi nye ba'i sras bzhi'i ya gyal dgyer sgom zhig po rdo rje/ de nas rim bzhin gser lding pa gzhon nu 'od zer/ de sras kun ma.o chos sku 'od zer/ jo nang kun spang thugs rje brtson 'grus/ jo nang byang sems rgyal ba ye shes/ mkhas grub blo gros bzang po/rnal 'byor 'od zer seng ge/ la phyi ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ la phyi 'dul 'dzin ngag dbang / stag lung ngag dbang grags pa/ sha ra rab 'byams sangs rgyas seng ge/ gtsang smyon pa rus pa'i rgyan can sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ thugs sras lha rgod rnam gnyis/ gnas rab blo gros rab yangs/ ras chung sprul sku grub mchog dbang po/ rngog ston karma blo bzang / gur phug pa rgyal dbang seng ge/ de yi chos sras thu bo shākya seng ge/ des bdag tshe dbang nor bu mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug la'o/ /yang lugs srol gcig ni/gtsang smyon chen po nas/ paṇa chen dngos grub dpal 'bar/ byams pa lha btsun grags pa/ ngag dbang grags pa/ byams pa rnam rgyal/ byams pa rdo rje/ byams pa rnam rgyal/ ye shes dpal 'byor/ sangs rgyas shes rab/ byams pa kun dga'/ sangs rgyas yar 'phel/ sangs rgyas bsod nams/ de la spung khrid tshul du gdan thog gcig tu rdzogs par zhus pa lags brgyud yig 'di bris pa'i lo phyi ma shing yos lor zhus pa yin/ sarba maṅga lo/yang dam pa de la phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag khrid rgyun dgu pa dpal te lo pa yi thugs bcud phyag chen gaṅgā ma dang chos nyid gnyug ma'i do ha yi bshad 'grel dang / chos nyid gnyug ma'i khrid yig zin bris steng nas smin par nos pa'i bla ma brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / te lo pa/ nā ro ta pa/ mar lo/mi la ras pa/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa/ khyung tshang ye shes bla ma/ de la mar ston tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ tar bsgom pa/ ma cig ang jo/ de gsum la zhang lo byang chub 'od/ de la 'gro mgon dhā ra shrī/de nas rim bzhin byang sems bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ ma cig kun ldan ras/ mkhas btsun gzi brjid rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ ri khrod pa gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ ras chen gdan gcig pa/ ldong ston nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ 'dul 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ sha ra rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas seng ge/ gtsang smyon phyogs las rnam rgyal te/ de nas shākya seng ge'i bar yi ge bzhi pa'i brgyud pa dang 'dra/ gzhan yang brgyud pa de nyid las gtsang smyon lugs kyi ras chung pa'i bde mchog snyan rgyud drug cu pa'i dbang lan bcu gsum gyi bar du zhus shing lung khrid bshad bka' legs par nod cing lus sbyongs sogs gdams pa'i mtha' yang ci rigs pa chod pas bka' drin che'o/ /e ma ye shes mkhaswā ༵gro'i dbang phyug ni/ /dpa' bo chen po til brdung ho ru ka /gang gi thugs bcud yid bzhin

nor bu mchog /ster mdzad shākya seng ge phyag gi gnas/ /zhes pa'ang smras so/ /bcu pa phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid bka' brgyud srol gcig 'jigs med dbyangs can dga' ba'i zhal snga nas brgyud pa/ ltas sga grub chen zab gsal chos 'phel zhabs las rtsa sdom ('di nas ma dpo ldeb ngos gnyis chad 'dug)rdor nor bu dang / dpal 'bar grub chen dpag bsam ye shes/ de gnyis ka la rang rig ras pa kun dga' rgya mtsho/ des 'jam dbyangs 'phrin las rab brtan/ des bdag tshe dbang nor bu la'o/ /yang na sprul sku dpag bsam dbang po nas/ grub dbang cog gra snyan grags dpal bzang / gnyis ka la rang rig ras pa yi thug par mdzad pas de dag brgyud pa'i rnam grangs su bgrangs rung yang / don rgyud kyi chu bo yang dag pa ni gong du bshad pa de kho na yin zhes gsungs so/ /yang rgyal dbang rje
