gsum pa mi pham pad dkar zhabs nas/ sprul sku mi pham chos kyi rgyal po/ de sras mi pham bstan pa'i nyi ma/ de sras mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ de yi slob ma grub mchog dbang gi rgyal po/ des rje btsun rang rig dpa' bo ste/ de yang byin rlabs nus par ldan pa'i brgyud pa'o/ /brgyud pa 'di gnyis ka so so bar dam tshig sel med byin rlabs ma nyams pa yin cing phyis byung gi slad de med pa'o/ /rgyud pa 'di yi rjes 'brel mi rmi lugs kyi bde mchog bcu gsum gyi dbang bzhi zhib rgyas dang / bsre 'pho 'grel chen gyi lung khrid du dmigs nas nyan yang / khrid yig dngos ma logs su bzhugs pas khrid thob pa'i go ma chod do/ /bla sgrub rten 'brel ro snyoms rnams kyang legs par nod pa yin la byin rlabs kyi cha shas kyang zhugs par rlom mo/ /yang bdag gi 'dren pa 'phrin las rab brtan zhal snga nas de'i sprul pa'i sku mi pham yongs 'du la/ phyag chen man ngag gi snying po mtshon pa tsam cig gsan cing / de dang rtsa ba'i bla ma rang rig zhabs tha dad med par gsol ba btab pa'i yul du mdzad pas na/ des na rje rang rig pa/ rje mi pham yongs 'dus rje 'jam dbyangs 'phrin las rab brtan/ zhes bgrang na yang rung mod/ dam pa 'di la bo dong lugs kyi phyag chen lhan skyes yang mnos pa'i brgyud pa/ rin po che nam mkha' nor bu yan gong gi skabs su bshad pa ltar las/ de la dam pa 'di'i gsan pa'o/ /yang phyag rgya chen po'i khrid kyi rgyun bcu gnyis pa yi ge bzhi pa bo dong lugs nod pa'i bla ma brgyud pa ni/ stag lung ngag dbang grags pa nas/ sprul sku 'chi med dpal bzang po/ /'jam gling rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas lhun grub/ rje dbon gyi bla ma nam mkha'i rin chen/ 'dul 'dzin nam mkha' rgyal po/ mkhas grub nam mkha' dkar po/ rin po che nam mkha' nor bu/ rje 'jam dbang 'phrin las rab brtan/ des bdag tshe dbang nor bu la'o/ /de ltar yongs su grags che phyag rgya che/ /'dzin ma'i lto kun 'gengs mdzad pad+ma dkar/ gang gi ring lugs 391

snyigs med bar 'brug zhes/ /gdams pas bdag blo tshim mdzad rdzong phu ma/ /zhes pa'ang smras so/ /phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid rgyun bcu gsum pa rtogs pa'i gar mkhan dbus smyon he ru ka dpal kun bzang grub pa'i dpa' bo nas bka' srol nod pa'i bla ma brgyud pa ni/ skyes mchog 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang yan chad stod 'brug skabs spyi dang 'dra ba/ de nas ras chen brtson 'grus dar po/ chu bo ri pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ dbus smyon ho ru ka dpal kun bzang grub pa'i dpa' bo/ des mnga' ris dol po rnam grol bzang po/ tshar kha chos skyong rdo rje/ bar lung khri gnyer ba yon tan rgya mtsho/ kun spang shākya bzang po/ bar lung khri gnyer ba yon tan rgyal mtshan/ bar lung ra brang ba dpal ldan rdo rje/ rje o rgyan rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des bdag tshe dbang nor bu la'o/ /yang na/ yang dgon pa thugs kyi rdo rje nas/ grub chen rgyal mtshan 'bum/ rtogs ldan shes rab mgon/bla chen rin chen gzhon nu dpal/ spyan snga bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ brag cog rin chen bzang po/dbus smyon kun dga' bzang po/ rnam grol bzang po nas sngar ltar ram/ yang na/ ga mi bsod nams blo gros/ rje chos skyabs dpal bzang / mtha' skar chos skyong dpal bzang / rnal 'byor karma rdo rje/ rje o rgyan rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des so/ /yang dbus smyon nas brgyud pa'i khrid rgyun 'di la dpal kun tu bzang po'i nags khrod phag gru gdan sa mthil gyi gdan rabs nas brgyud pa de yang chu bo gcig 'dres su zhugs pas/ des na brgyud pa'i rnam grangs bcu bzhi par bgrangs te/ de yang 'gro ba'i mgon po rdo rje rgyal po nas/ 'bri gung 'jig rten rin chen dpal/ spyan snga rlang lha gzing pa grags pa 'byung gnas/ rgyal ba grags pa brtson 'grus/ bcu gnyis rin chen rdo rje/ spyan snga grags pa ye shes/ gnyis mchod pa grags pa rin chen/tshes bzhi grags pa rgyal mtshan/ bcu gnyis grags pa shes rab/ tshes bzhi grags pa byang chub/ des spyan snga kun spang bsod nams grags pa dang / bla ma rin chen gzhon nu gnyis ka la/ spyan snga bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos gsan cing / brag cog rat+na bha ṭa nas dbus smyon man 'dra/lugs srol 'di la brgyud pa'i rnam grangs mang zhig 'dug kyang 'dir brjod pa ni snying po tsam mo/ /dbus smyon ho ru ka dpal 'di nyid ches che ba'i grub thob yin 'dug kyang deng sang chos rgyun 'dzin pa dkon par 'dug pas de la brgyud pa'i phyag chen zhig thob 'dod che bar byung bzhin/ dol po bla ma o rgyan rgyal mtshan zhal snga nas la dmar bsgom chos skyabs dpal bzang gi khrid yig steng nas zla gcig gi bar du smin khrid du skyong bar byas shing / de skabs shig tu yi dam lha'i snang ba bcas dge sbyor bzang por mngon pa yang byung bas byin rlabs don gyi chu bo yang thob par nges so/ /mda' bsnun rtogs par 392

co 'dri mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug che/ /'od gsal sgyu ma'i sku brnyes bde chen dpa' bo mchog / /kun dga' bzang po phyag rdzogs don gyi rnal 'byor pa/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'khrungs grub des ljongs 'di mdzes rgyan byas/ /gang gi rung lugs byin rlabs ma nyams brgyud pa yi/ /srad bu las byung phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag gi/ /rin chen 'phreng ba rnam par mdzes de bdag gi brgyan/ /bcings po o rgyan rgyal mtshan dpal der snying nas 'dud/ zhes so/ /da ni bka' drin mtshungs med rtsa ba'i bla ma bzhi pa 'dren mchog sbas pa'i sangs rgyas dpal brtse ba chen po sa man+ta bha dren+t+ra gang gi zhal snga nas/ rgya dkar gyi slob dpon spyod 'chang nag po'am sgyu 'phrul rje btsun dam pa kun dga' grol mchog zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i khrid chen brgya dang brgyad kyi gnad sdom sa bon lta bu mdzad pa de yi bklags lung yongs 'dzin ngag dbang 'phrin las la gsan mod/khrid kyi rgyun ni dge slong snying po mtha' yas la gsan par mdzad pa yin zhes gsung zhing / dge slong de rje btsun dam pa'i sprul sku shing rta chen po kun dga' snying po'i zhabs la zin cing / phyis su yang de'i rgyal tshab 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgya mtsho dang / jo nang rje btsun ma 'phrin las dbang po'i zhabs la yun ring du thug pas/ khrid rgyun bzhugs par som nyi ma dgos shing / de la bdag gi yongs 'dzin sbas pa'i sangs rgyas brtse ba chen pos khrid rgyun gyi tshul du gsan pa yin 'dug la/ de yang bla mas bshad/slob mas go ba la khrid zer gyi/ gzhan bla mas ma bshad slob ma la go myong ma byung na/ khrid rgyun du 'gro dka' mod kyang / 'dir ni bla slob gnyis kas khrid rgyun du dmigs na gsan bzhes mdzad pas mos pa'i stobs dang / dge slong de yang rdo rje'i rnal 'byor bzang po yin 'dug la/ bdag gi 'dren pa ni sngon sbyangs mthu chen pos sku rdo rje dang / gsung rdo rje snga ma'i sa la nges par bzhugs pas/ ye shes kyi mthu yi des na khrid rgyun rnam dag tu 'grub par 'dug pas/ bdag gis kyang 'bad pa chen pos zhus shing / rje bla ma rin po ches rtsa sdom dag gsal lhag chad nor 'khrul gyi skyon med gsung rim bzhin de rnams kyi go don spu ris ma 'dres par blo la lam lam par 'char nges su byas pas na nged rang nas kyang khrid rgyun thob pa'i grangs su 'gro nges byas la/ de ltar ma byung na bla ma la khrid rgyun tsam yod rung go bshad dang ma 'brel na bklags lung nyid las gzhan ma yin te/ deng sang dus ngan dbang gi lung khrid shan mi dbye bar gang yin med pa'i chal chol byed mkhan mang du yod kyi 'dug pa ni rgyal bstan gyi srog rtsa bcad pa'i dmar las mkhan las gzhan ma yin no/ /des na lung rgyun dang bshad rgyun dang / khrid rgyun rnams so sor phyes pa shin tu gces so/ lung rgyun thob pas khrid thob pa'i go chod na/ dbang dpe'i bklags lung thob pa tsam gyis dbang de thob pa'i go chod dgos par thal/ de lta'i go skabs ni ye shes 393

thob na ma gtogs med pa'i phyir ro/ /de bas na/ ye shes gcig pu'i las kun byed/ /ces pa grub pa thob nges dang / /smon lam gyi dbang bskur can rnams ma gtogs/ bklags lung khrid du 'dzin nas bshad na bdud las rlabs po che ste/ bskal pa rgya mtshor dmyal ba'i bud shing du 'gyur bas go bar gces so/ /des na ding sang snyigs ma'i dbang gi rdo rje 'chang gi gsung gtsang ma rgyud sde'i khung dang 'brel ba'i khrid bka' khyad par can rnams skye bo don gnyer chung bas ched du nye ba 'ga' rgyal bstan la lhag bsam dag pas rang gzhan gyi don che bzhag chung bshol zhing dka' ba khyad du bsad nas 'bad pa drag pos ri sul lung skyogs kyi dgon chung re re bzhin 'grim kyin/ ya ki yongs grags kyi bla chen nas ma ki grong pa'i khyim btsun yan chad brten cing / rang gi mngon rlom ltag tshugs khe grags khengs pa mtha' dag btang nas sgo gsum dman pa bzung bzhin gus pa'i bsnyen tshul dang mi bral bar byed cing shes rab bsgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal dang zang zing gi bsnyen bskur 'phang med ltos med kyi sgo nas mnyes par byed pa 'di rgyal ba'i gsung dri ma med pa mi nas mi ru brgyud pa zam ma chad pa la rtsis su byed pa'i don yin gyi de bas dka' tshegs chen po de khur dgos don ci zhig yod de/ yang rang gi lam sna ma zin pa cig yin na da chos byed phyin bla ma mi bsten nas sdod rgyu ga la yod kyang / nged ni skye ba snga ma nas 'dren pa bzang ba la dmigs nas pad+ma bde chen gling pa'i zhabs drung du skyes/ bsam bzhin yongs 'dzin du de brten nas smin grol gyi gdams pa yang rang skal dang mthun par thob/ gdams pa'i srog gyur dam tshig la skyon gyur 'gal ba spu tsam yang med par/ de nas yongs 'dzin zhig brten pa de slob dpon pad+mas gter lung du ma nas zin cing mkhas btsun bzang po'i mthar thug pa karma rig 'dzin zhes rgya dkar grub thob shā wa ri pa'i sprul sku de yi zhabs pad bsnyen nas bla ma brten tshul yang rgyud sde nas bshad bzhin pa byas/ sems nyid kyi ngo bo mthong ba yang rdo rje 'chang des dbugs dbyung bar mdzad/ de 'phror rang don 'ba' zhig don du gnyer 'dun gyi tsā ri ṭa lta bu mi med dben pa'i gangs khrod gcig tu tshe dang bsgrub pa snyoms pa zhig yong e thub bsam yang / sngon las kyi de ma grub cing dbus gtsang phyogs 'dir slebs nas rje karma pa dang spyan snga zhwa dmar ba dang pha tre+e bo chos kyi dbang po sogs dam pa mang du mjal/ bstan pa la sems khur yin khul gyi chos la thos bsam dang / 'chad spel ci rigs pa byas mod/ de yang phyogs gcig nas rang 'dod 'di snang gi khe grags min pas 'gro don gyi gzugs brnyan tsam grub par yang rlom/ 'on kyang rang don ci bzhin pa zhig 'grub na gzhan don shugs kyis 'grub rgyur gda' ba la/ chos rgyun dkon po la gces 'dzin gyi mi tshe 'di yad yud kyi ngang la rdzogs nas bsgom sgrub byas pa'i rjes med pa 'di yang skyo ba 'phel rab tu gda'/ a kyang 'ga' 394

zhig chos 'jig rten gyi bya ba gang yang ma grub par 'chi ba de tsho las nged rang gi thos bsam gyi g.yeng ba 'di los grags/ da 'gyod rgyu med phaṭa ṭaḥ 'on kyang phyin chad bsgrub pa la gzhol nas/ 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku 'grub pa zhig dang / de lta min kyang tshe dang bsgrub pa mnyam pa zhig smon pa lags/ de ltar bstan pa la lhag bsam kho na las de min nged rang bsgrub pa brgyab nus na nyams len gyi rkang ni rtsa ba'i bla ma gnyis kyi thugs rje khams nas gdeng cung tshugs pa de ka ltar lags/ de 'dra cha rgyus med pa'i mched grogs 'dra dang bla ma rnams kyi grwa 'khor tshos bskyed rdzogs ye nas go myong med pa'i rnal 'byor gsar zhugs khams gang yang med pa zhig tu brtsi ba dang / la las ni de yod par shes kyang mi gzhan gyi snang ngor rang rang che 'dod kyi sgo nas khyad gsod mig brnyas ci rigs pa byed mkhan yongs kyi 'dug kyang / phal cher ni nged rang gi sdig sgrib kyi rang gzugs su nges pas bzod pa bsgom nus na sdig sgrib kyi phyag ma ru de 'dra bzang ba yin pas e ma hoḥ lar rang gi gnas tshul ji bzhin par brjod na nga rgyal du 'gro/ ma brjod na gzhan gyi mig brnyas yul du bzung nas rang gzhan las ngan gyi gnas su bsag gang byas kyang stabs mi bde ba 'di yang rang sems slad med chos rgyun rnam dag gi ched du yin pas bya ba don ldan te dga' ba bsgom pa'i gnas su shes par bya'o/ /bstan la lhag bsam grogs la phan pa'i las/ /ci ltar spyad kyang gzhan dag mi mgu zhing / /khyad gsod brnyas bcos ham pas mnar na yang / /byams pa'i ma ltar bdag gi blta nus shog /bzang byas phar la drin yus tshur ra rtsi/ /sgo gsum 'bad pa'i las la gnong chung bzhag /mched grogs dus ngan rang gzugs bstan na yang / /bdag sems mi 'khrug de la bzod par shog /bdag ni skye ba 'di nas byang chen bar/ /dus kun rgyal bstan srog las lhag blta bas/ /gzhan gyi ngan smras brnyas pa khyad gsod sogs/ /cis kyang mi byed byang chub grogs gyur shog /de bzhin kun tu rdzogs sangs rgyas dang sras/ /mtshan ldan bla ma dgyes pa'i bya ba la/ /lus srog phye mar gyur kyang sran bzod cing / /de nyid 'ba' zhig bdag gi dang len shog /bdag gi tshe rabs snga mar nyon mongs dbang / /chos spun mtshan ldan rig mar ma gus brnyas/ /las des tshe 'dir nye ba'i spun rnams kyi/ /sems la zug rngu 'byin pa de dag shog /phyin chad bdag gi mched la mi sdang zhing / /rdo rje spun gyis bdag la mi sdang bar/ /gsang sngags rgyud nas gsung bzhin phan tshun byams/ /tshom bu gcig tu byang chub 'grub par shog /ces pa yang bar skabs kyi 'phros su smras pa ste/da ni dkyus su 'jug par bya la/ de yang phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag khrid rgyun bco lnga pa thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag karma kam tshang gi khyad chos/ bskyed rim lhan cig skyes ma/ rdzogs rim rlung sems dbyer med du grags pa las/ bskyed rim lhan skyes smin byed rgyas pa pha tre'o chos kyi dbang po~X py-ibs

pad du legs par nod la/ rdzogs rim rlung sems dbyer med kyi man ngag gnad ci rigs pa rtsa ba'i bla ma karma rig 'dzin las thos shing / khrid rgyun dngos ni khrid brgya las byung ba ltar bgrang ste bla ma brgyud pa ni/ rdor 'chang phag mo te na mar mi sgam/ /dus mkhyen ras chen som brag pak+shi gnyag /rang byung mgon rgyal rol rdor gu shri pa/ /ye shes 'jam dbyangs skyob lce tre'o chung / /grol mchog lha dbang kun dga' snying po'i zhabs/ /rin chen rgya mtsho 'phrin las dbang mo che/ /snying po mtha' yas kun bzang dbang po'i sde/ /des bdag la'o/ /yang phyag chen khrid rgyun bcu drug pa karma pa'i dgongs bcud sku gsum ngo sprad du grags pa'i khrid kyi bla ma brgyud pa ni rdor 'chang pak+shi o rgyan rang byung g.yung / rol rdor mkha' spyod de gshegs mthong don ldan/ /ban sgar chos kyi grags pa 'phrin las pa/ /de nas kun dga' grol te de ltar ro/ /sku gsum ngo sprod 'di karma pa byang chub rdo rje dang / /pha tre'o rtsa ba'i bla ma karma rig 'dzin gsum gyi phyag chen khrid rgyun la chu bo chig 'dres su zhus pas de 'dod kyang rung ngam sems shing / lhag tu dbang phyug rdo rje yan kam tshang spyi brgyud ltar la de nas tā ra na tha ste/ de man chad sngar bshad pa ltar ro/ /phyag rgya chen po'i khrid rgyun gyi rnam grangs bcu bdun pa phag gru thel skor gyi khyad chos nod pa'i bla ma brgyud pa ni/ rdor 'chang te nā mar mi dwags phag 'bri/ /spyan snga rin rdor grags pa rin rgyal ba/ /grags gzhon bsod rgyal spyang lung paṇa chen gzhon/ /de nas kun dga' grol mchog man sngar ltar ro/ /yang phyag chen khrid rgyun bco brgyad 'bri gung pa'i khyad chos dgongs zab dang 'brel pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdor 'chang te nā mar mi dwags phag 'bri/ /bsod grags rdor grags thog kha mtshams bcu gnyis/ /nyer brgyad chos rgyal sman sgom la phyi pa/ /'dul 'dzin ngag dbang 'brug dbon stag lung dbon/ /de nas kun dga' grol mchog te 'dra/ /yang phyag chen khrid rgyun bcu dgu pa stag lung thang pa nas brgyud pa'i rim pa ni/ rdor 'chang te nā ma mi dwags phag stag /sku yas yar byon bkras bla sangs rgyas dpal/ /ka ra gu ru kun spang bkra shis dpal/ /byang rgyal ngag dbang rnam grags stag lung dbon/ /de nas gong ltar ro/ /skabs 'dir stod 'brug brgyud pa'i man ngag gi rgyun yod kyang sngar bshad pas 'dir mi bgrang / phyag chen khrid rgyun nyi shu pa smad 'brug gi thub pa lnga ldan du grags pa la/ rdor 'chang te nā mar mi dwags phag gling / /rgya ras lo ras dga' ldan bsod dar ba/ /'gir phu 'od rgyam sangs ras skyes mchog pa/ /g.yam spyil 'brug dbon stag lung sprul pa'i sku/ /de nas grol mchog ste sngar ltar ro/ /yang phyag rgya chen po'i khrid rgyun nyer gcig pa phyag chen man ngag mtha' dag gi gzhi ma sdong po 396

lta bu grub thob yongs kyi spyi mes sa ra ha yi do ha'i khrid bka' zab mo legs par nos pa'i brgyud pa ni/rdor 'chang bde mgon sa ra ha klu sgrub/ /shā ra mi tri phyag na mnga' ris ba/ /gro shul sar bu dgyer bsgom sangs rgyas dbon/ /brag 'bur gzhon rin dkon rdor chos sgo ba/ /rdza khol smon lam ngag dbang grags pa dang / /paṇa chen yab sras de nas sngar ltar ro/ /deng sang do ha'i bklags lung tsam las khrid kyi rgyun ni dkon par snang bas/ des na 'di la gcigs su bya ba'i gnas so/ /yang phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag mnyam med/ sgam po'i dgongs bcud mtsho maṇ+ḍal nag por sbas pa gter ston dung mtsho ras pas ston pa sems khrid yid bzhin nor bu'i khrid rgyun ni/ rdor 'chang te nā mar mi sgam ye rdor/ /dung mtsho sne ras chos dbyings mgar rdzongs mgon/ /tshul rgyal mkhyen rab gzhon nu chos grub pa/ /de nas grol mchog ste sngar ltar ro/ /gzhan yang rje btsun bla ma 'di la khrid chen brgya dang brgyad kyi rgyun yongs su rdzogs pa dang / sbyor ba yan lag drug gi myong khrid lan drug gi bar du zhus shing rang gi tshe snga ma'i las 'brel gyi bag chags mthug pa'i stabs kyis tshe 'dir sangs rgyas kyi ye shes bzhugs tshul gyi go ba bzang po de/ jo nang pa'i grub mtha' las skyes pa yin pas/ des na jo nang pa'i chos rgyun phal che ba dam pa 'di las thos pas bka' drin mchog tu che ba zhig yin no/ /dpal ldan bde 'byung bdag po sa bcu rgyal ba'i sras po mchog /shi ta'i lho 'dir gang gi ring lugs rgya cher spel ba'i phyir/ /jo nang par grags rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs 'dren pa'i shing rta che/ /mtshungs med 'jig rten mgon de bdag gi snying dbus rgyan du gyur/ /de yi bstan pa'i srol 'dzin gcig pu sa 'og gter bzhin du/ /gnas shing mi snang nye bar gyur tshe bdag gi 'bad pa ches/ /legs rnyed chos kyi nor bu legs thon bdag blo'i rgyal mtshan rtser/ /bcings mdzad kun bzang dbang po bdag blo'i mdzes rgyan rmad du byung / /zhes pa yang smras so/ de ltar bdag gi 'bad pa btsal ba'i phyag rgya chen po yi khrid kyi rgyun/ rtsa ba'i bla ma zung las byung ba drug dang / bka' drin can rdo rje slob dpon gzhan las nod pa'i khrid rgyun nyi shu rtsa gnyis te/ khyon dril rags rtsis kyi nyi shu rtsa brgyad nod la/ 'bri stag nas brgyud pa gong du yang yod mod la/ slad mar 'bri stag gi brgyud pa bskyar ma zhig dang / skyes mchog 'ba' rom nas brgyud pa zhig cis kyang zhu 'dun yin la/ gzhan da lta khrid rgyun ma nub yongs grags su gnas pa ni de tsam du 'khum mo/ /gong gi rags rtsis de dag la nang gses zhib mos brjod na du ma yod do/ /zhes brgyud pa'i bka' srol du ma'i byin rlabs kyi rgyun rnam par dag pa rang gis ci tsam nos pa'i tshul brjod pa'i skabs te gnyis pa'o/ /bsod nams mthu yi dam pa rnams dang mjal/ /theg mchog grub mtha' la zhugs nges don rnyed/ /bstan 'dzin mos pa'i snying stobs ci yang 'chang /39/ḍidi ko

tshe dbang nor bu'i ngang tshul yin/ /zhes so/ /bdag gi tshe 'dir 'bad pa'i snying po khrid rgyun 'ba' zhig pa don du gnyer/ de yang rgyun yod med brgyud khungs dag mi dag la gser ltar brtag /zhal gzigs lung bstan rmi lam yad yud la skyabs ma bcos brgyud pa'i khungs nas brtsam ste mi yi rten can gyi skyes bu dam pa zam ma chad pa'i brgyud pa gang rnyed byas pa ste/ spyir chos khungs can gyi dpe rgyun tsam la dbang khrid bshad rgyun ye nas med na/ ye shes mchog thob pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams la yi dam lha dang bla ma rnams kyi byin gyis brlabs cing bka' yi gnang ba thob pas rgyun gso ba las 'os med mod/ mi nas brgyud pa yod phyin de kho na gtso bor 'don pa las zhal gzigs brtan po yod na go mi chod pa tsa ma yin yang / gdengs de la mi 'gal ba chos rgyun la 'bad rtsol gal che'o/ /gal che'o/ /bdag ni sngar phan gyi khrid rgyun so so ba dang khrid rgyun ngo bo gcig kyang brgyud khungs tha dad pa rnams khyon bsdoms khrid bka'i rgyun brgya dang brgyad bcu la nye ba nos pas/ chos kyi bskal pa ni ha cang rang mi dman par zlom mo/ /de yang nged kyi snying por bsdu na bdag gi skra bcad skyabs sdom zhus pa ni kaḥthog rgyal sras bsod nams lde'u btsan yin/ sems ngo ni pad+ma bde chen dang / karma rig 'dzin gyis sprad/ chos 'brel zhus pa'i bla ma ni lnga bcu lhag tsam yod/ spyir mdo yi lta ba ni jo nang pa'i bzhed pa skyong / khyad par ba ni klong chen rab 'byams pa'i rjes su 'brang / grub mtha' ni pad 'byung bi ma la zhi ba sbas pa'i gsung bzhin 'dzin/bka' brgyud kyi grub mtha' ni karma kam tshang dang smar sa stod 'brug gi gdams pas sems ngo 'phrod pa lags kyis de kho nar khyab pa 'chang / spyir dag snang la phyogs ris med cing grub mtha' mtha' dag la mi mos pa ye nas med nges yin/ tshe rabs gtan gyi bla ma ni o rgyan pad+ma yin/ dkon mchog gi thugs rjer brten rang mgo ni rang gi bton pa lags/ tshul 'di dag ni kho bo'i yin lugs te/ deng sang kha cig gis nged la grub mtha' 'chug 'dug zhes smra mkhan yang 'dug mod/ nged kyi grub mtha' su yin dang mgo sus ston des shes par mi gda' 'am/ zhes pa yang ku re zhu ba lags/ phyag rgya chen po chos kyi rgyun byin rlabs dang ldan pa gcig gi chog mi shes pa ma yin kyang / rang rang mos pa'i dbang dang / de dang de yi bstan pa rin po che mi nyams yun du gnas pa'i phyir lhag pa'i bsam pas phyag chen kyi rim pa du ma la thos bsam bgyis pa'i ngang tshul de ltar lags/ deng sang rgyud khungs la don gnyer chung ba 'dug kyang chos brgyud khungs dang mi bral ba gal che shos su snang bas brgyud 'di rnams kyang khungs chod par byas shing / rang gi dran pa'i gsos dang gzhan don du gnyer ba yod na phan 'dod kyi blo'am/ yi ger phyogs gcig tu rtogs brjod ci rigs pa bcas bkod pa'o/ /dpal mchog dang ldan dwags po'i 398

rings lugs ngo mtshar dga' ba'i tog /rmad byung mchog de bdag blo'i ko mog dbus na mngon gnas mthu'i/ /'khrul pa'i rnyog ma kun sel 'gro ba'i gdung skyobs brgyad ldan chab/ /dri med 'di yi bskal bzang skye bo rgyun chad med rgyas shog /zhes lha rje mnyam med zla 'od gzhon nu'i bka' brgyud phyag chen gdams pa ji tsam nod pa'i rtogs brjod legs bshad rin chen 'byung khungs zhes bya ba 'di yang bka' brgyud kyi rtogs ldan rnal 'byor gyi/ tha shal pa rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho'am karma rin chen mchog dga' dge ba'i dpal bzang pos bod yul gtsang la stod lho brang mtsho bsam rdzong gi bla brang bsam 'grub tu rang lo sum cu'i gong du slebs pa kun dga' shing stag gro bzhin zla ba'i yar tshes kyi thun skabs su cung zad re bris pa'i 'phro tshes bcu gsum nyin gung du grub par byas pa'i yig ris/ lha lding dar rngu yi rigs gyur rnal 'byor kun bzang blo dbang ngo / /'dis kyang mtha' dag 'gro bas phyag rgya chen po myur du rtogs shing de yi gzhi rtsa brgyud ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs 'jug par gyur cig sarba maṅga lo/rgyud yig 'di bris zin nas lo gnyis 'das pa me 'brug lor 'bri gung sprul pa'i sku rin po che chos kyi rgyal po'i sku zhabs su phyag chen lnga ldan gyi khrid rgyun legs par blangs pa'i rgyud rim sngar rtsa ba'i bla ma karma rig 'dzin las thob pa dang rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa'i bar mthud dgos mod/ 'on kyang 'dir mtshan 'dra min du byung bas 'bri gung 'jig rten gsum mgon nas/ mkhan po tshul khrims rdo rje/grags pa 'byung gnas/ rdo rje grags pa/ rin chen seng ge grags pa bsod nams/ rdo rje rin chen/'dzam gling chos kyi rgyal po/ don grub rgyal po/ rin chen dpal gyi rgyal mtshan/ chos rgyal rin chen dpal bzang po/ rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ rin chen chos kyi rgyal po/ thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ rgyal dbang rin chen phun tshogs/ bsod nams dpal gyi rgya mtsho/ chos rgyal phun tshogs bkra shis dpal bzang po/ rje btsun dkon mchog rin chen/chos kyi grags pa 'phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde/ dkon mchog 'phrin las rnam rgyal/ dkon mchog 'phrin las bzang po/ sprul pa'i sku dkon mchog chos kyi rgyal po/ /des bdag la'o/ /do ha skor gsum gyi rtsa 'grel yang de'i skabs thos/ rgyud yig 'di bris pa'i shing stag nas lo bco lnga'i steng du slebs pa sa 'brug lor mdo chen sngags 'chang rgyal sras seng ge la dkar po drug gi khrid ma bdun pa'i phyag chen don brgyud chu bo 'dres pa thob pa'i bla ma brgyud pa ni/ 'gro ba'i mgon po gtsang pa rgya ras nas/ skyes mchog lo rgod rnam gnyis/ de gnyis kas ma bdun ras chen/ de nas rim par gdan sa rin chen/ byin rlabs rdo rje/ sangs rgyas dbon/ bsod nams dbang phyug bsod 399

nams snying po/ lhun grub bkra shis/ mgon po dpal/ kun dga' gzi brjid/ dkon mchog rdo rje/nam mkha' lhun grub/ nam mkha' seng ge nor bu bde chen/ bstan pa'i nor bu/ sngags 'chang chen po rgyal sras seng ge des bdag rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu la'o/ /bram ze chen po'i do ha skor gsum rtsa ba dang / 'grel bshad rje btsun karma 'phrin las pas mdzad pa'i steng nas thos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po/ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ klu sgrub/ shā wa ri dbang phyug mnga' bdag me tri pa/ rgya gar phyag na/ bal po a su/ mnga' ris zhang jo ston/ gro shul ba chos rab grags pa/ sar bu blo gros seng ge/ snye phu shug gseb kyi sgyer bsgom/ zhig po tshul khrims seng ge de'i dbon po rin chen phun tshogs/ ri pa mgon rin/ chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab/ rdza khol jo ston/ bla ma smon lam pa/ stag lung ngag gi dbang po/sha ra rab 'byams bsod nams ye shes/ chos rje sangs rgyas bsam 'grub/ karma 'phrin las pa/ spyan snga bkra shis rgyal/ yongs 'dzin bud+dha'i mtshan can/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog rin chen/ bla ma rin po che rat+na karma bi dza ya/ des 'bri gung dkon mchog 'phrin las bzang po/ des 'bri gung sprul pa'i sku dkon mchog chos kyi rgyal po/ des bdag tshe dbang nor bu la'o/ / 400

༄ga /yang zab yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i dgongs pa'i gter u pa de shaḥgu ru'i sgrub thabs kun gyi yang zhun lhang gi thig le yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i man ngag bsam pa lhan grub dngos grub ma lus 'byung ba'i gter khrim zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo pad+ma badz+ra shrīḥ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi phyag gi gnas/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas kun bzang 'od dpag med/ /'gro 'dul pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes bya ba/ /de bzhin gshegs kun rgyal po der phyag 'tshal/ /rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gtso che ba'i mchog /bla med bla ma'i sgrub thabs bye ba 'bum/ /yang snying zhun tig mos gus gsol 'debs nyid/ /de yi mthar thug dgos 'dod kun 'byung gter/ /gangs can lha gcig sangs rgyas pad 'byung gis/ /bod yul thun mong sku dngos gdul bya rnams/ /btul byas rnga yab gshegs skabs gung thang lar/ /rje 'bangs rnams la zhal chems tshul gsungs pa'i/ /gsol 'debs rgyal po bsam pa lhun grub zhes/ /man ngag bcu gsum bsam 'phel dngos grub mdzod/ /gang gi sgrub thabs yang snying paṇ+ḍi ta/ /bsdus la gsal ba ma nor tshul bzhin du/ /pad 'byung nyid kyi byin rlabs thugs rje'i chab/ /bdag blo'i bum par cha shas phra mo zhig /zhugs pa'i mthu las skal ldan 'gro ba'i bsod/ /gdams bzang bdud rtsi dus 'dir bshad par bya/ /de la spyi dang bye brag gnyis kyis bstan/ /spyir ni snod bcud mtshan ldan 'dzoms pa'i dus/ /yid 'ong dben par blo sbyang phyag rgya bzhi/ /bsags sbyangs sngon 'gro'i phyi nang dbang bskur bya/ /de nas dngos gzhi rtsa ba'i sgrub pa la/ /mthun rkyen bsod nams tshogs zhing mdun mkhar dmigs/ /skyabs sems yan lag bcu phul tshogs kyi zhing / /rang la thim pas dbyer med ro mnyam 'dres/ /ye shes tshogs phyir snang sems rtsa yan lag /bdag med stong sbyang rtog bral ngang la bzhag /mi mthun sel byed bsrung ba'i 'khor lo drug /sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las ye shes so/ /zhing khams gzhal yas pad sdong 'od thig sogs/ /gang 'dod yon tan 'phrin las me rlung chu/ /de yang sems nyid ngo bo ye shes kyi/ /rang snang sgyur ma lta bur spro ba'o/ /snying por bdag nyid phung khams skye mched sogs/ /yi dam gdan gsum tshang ba'i sku ru bsam/ /spyi bo'i gtsug gam mdun gyi nam mkha' ru/ /rgyal ba kun 'dus pad+ma 'byung gnas gsal/ /dīkā ḍidun

gdung shugs drag pos zhing gi mchog /bde ba can nas 'od dpag med mgon gyi/ /thugs kyi dbus nas gu ru pad+ma 'byung / /spyan drangs dam tshig ye shes ro mnyam zhugs/ /phyag mchod bstod phul gsol 'debs tshan lnga yi/ /yon tan rjes dran thun mong tshul gsol 'debs/ /thun min rgyal ba kun gyi srog gi snying / /badz+ra gu ru'i phur tshugs mos gus bskyed/ /mthar ni 'bru bzhi'i 'od zer gyis dbang blangs/ /don des 'khor lo kha sbyor rgyun gyis bskangs/ /rang rig ngo bo bla ma'i ye shes yin/ /yin lugs shes bzhin ro gcig ar la gtad/ /sems dpa' sum brtsegs rdo rje bzhi yi dngos/ /gzer du btab nas bcu gnyis rdo rje'i sgra/ /ma yengs yid kyis bskyed bzlas rdzogs pa'i rim/ /phyag chen yi dam snying srog de nyid bsgrub/ /gnyis pa bye brag yid bzhin nor bu bzhin/ /bcu gsum sgrub pa'i man ngag zab mo la//re rer mdun bskyed gsol btab dbang bzhi blangs/ /bdag bsre rjes bsdud rdzogs rim drug gis bsdom/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar gu ru ji 'dod sku/ /gsal btab spyan 'dren bzhugs dbang rgyas btab mchod/ /'dod don gsol 'debs gzhung bcas rtse gcig bsam/ /gsol 'debs rgyun chags dag gis dbang bzhi blangs/ /de yang gu ru'i dpral nas rang 'dra'i sku/ /'phro 'du dang bcas bdag gi dpral bar bstem/ /de bzhin thugs ka'i sa bon sngags 'phreng ba/ /ljags nas 'phro 'du bcas te bdag lcer thim/ /thugs las rang mdog thig le ma sha'i tshad/ /rab 'tsher 'phro 'du dang bcas bdag snying gar/ /de dag rnams kyi bum gsang shes rab kyi/ /sbyang thob smin byas sgo gsum rang bab dang / /gu ru'am sku gsung thugs dang ro mnyam pa/ /bzhi pa'i dbang don rgyud la skyes par bsam/ /mthar ni gus pa'i gdung shugs chen po yis/ /bla ma rang thim bdag nyid de'i skur gyur/ /sems dpa' sum brtsegs 'phro 'du rang sngags bzlas/ /thun mthar rjes gzhig stong gzhil lha skur ldang / /cho ga rgyas bsdus gang zag blo sgor dpag /rdzogs rim man ngag gnas la thebs par btab/ /man ngag bcu gsum dang po me 'phreng rtsal/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /dbu dgu bco brgyad phyag ldan gang mos sku/ /khro gar dur khrod dpal chas yum dang bcas/ /'khor du 'jig rten dregs pa yongs kyi gtso/ /ya ma skos rje glog 'phreng me dbal gza'/ /klu bdud lha chen ma hā ka la brgyad/ /za byed re ti khrag mig mi bsrun ma/ /gnam sman lcam gcig u ma dung skyong ma/ /sngags bdag ma mo brgyad dang lhan du rol/ /gzhan yang sngags bdag sde dpon dpal mgon po/ /sde brgyad sde rigs grangs las 'das pas bskor/ /gsol ba btab tshe me 'phreng thugs ka nas/ /khro bo grangs med sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ /me rlung mtshon chas spyi la mtha' dmag dang / /bye brag rgyal po'i 'tshe ba tshar bcad nas/ /tshur 'dus bsrung ba'i dī~Xr lo rdo rje me/ /khro bo dregs pa'i gur khang rab tu brtas/ /mthar ni rang nyid gu ru drag po'i

sku/ /thugs dkar rgyu dmar sngags 'phreng 'od 'phro 'dus/ /dregs pa'i srog snying gta' blang gdan du gzir/ /rtse bsnol 'khor los dgra bgegs phye mar gtang / /mdor na mchog mthun dngos grub gang 'dod pa/ /rtse gcig g.yeng med bskyed bzlas nyid la brtson/ /oṃ āḥrdu artsig nir cig na mo bha ga wa te hūṃ hūṃ ཿṭaḥphaṭaḥ.aḥr+ghaṃ phroṃ ཿṭaḥphaṭaḥ rgyal ba yongs kyis byin rlabs drag po'i sngags/ /gnas skabs brgya stong bzlas cing bgegs zhi zhing / /nyams chag dag byed bar dor lam sna zin/ /mang du bzlas pas de phyir smos cidagos/ /las sbyor sde brgyad drogs pa'i srog snying la/ /'gugs gzir gcod byed mnan bsad gang 'dod sbyor/ /tshul des kha bsgyur lde thung rig pa'i mda'/ /spyod pas bsam 'phel yid bzhin nor bu yin/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa nyams su len pa ni/ /phyi yi dmag 'khrug nang gi sdang sems mdangs/ /gnyen po byams pa snying rje byang chub sems/ /rang mdangs sgyu ma lta bu'i lam khyer bsgom/ /de yang ma dag sgyu lus la dmigs nas/ /snang srid bden med nyen med gtan la phab/ /dag pa sgyu lus lha sku la dmigs nas/ /bskyed rim lha khrid zab gsal bsgom la 'bad/ /man ngag gnyis pa gu ru sman bla bsgrub/ /mdun gyi mkha' la gu ru sman gyi bla/ /bde gshegs brgyad kyi thugs smon gcig bsdus dpal/ /a ru rigs lnga bdud rtsi lhung bzed 'dzin/ /'khor du bde gshegs mched brgyad shar nas rim/ /be+eḍūr+ya 'od mchog sbyin rnam rgyal 'dzin/ /mngon mkhyen rgyal po chos grags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs/ /dmar po mchog sbyin zu ngan med pa'i dpal/ /dmar po mnyam bzhag gser bzang dri med ni/ /dkar ser rin chen zla ba dmar la ser/ /mtshan legs ser po g.yas pa mchog sbyin rgya/ /shākya thub dbang gser mdog bdud 'dul rgya/ /kun kyang mtshan dpe yongs rdzogs g.yon mnyam bzhag /bde gshegs tshangs spyod chos gos rnam gsum gsol/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyas stong dang bdud rtsi sman/ /rigs grub drang srong lha dang lha mos bskor/ /gsol ba btab tshe sman lha bde gshegs brgyad/ /thugs ka mdzod spu phyag gi za tog nas/ /nad 'joms 'chi med bdud rtsiwī bsdu'i rgyun/ /'od zer bcas bab sems can mtha' dag gi /spyi bo nas zhugs lus nang kun khengs nas/ /nad kyi gzhi rtsa dug gsum ma rig pa/ /nad kyi dngos po rlung mkhris bad 'dus pa/ /nad kyi byed las tshor ba sdug bsngal ba/ /mtha' dag bsangs sbyangs sgrib med shel sgong ltar/ /dngas shing snyog bral 'chi med sku ru gyur/ /'od zer tshur 'dus snang srid 'byung khams bcud/ /bdag thim 'chi med tshe yorig 'dzin bsam/ /bye brag rang gzhan na ba'i lus gnas der/ /gu ru sman bla gtso 'khor gsal dngas sku/ /che chung ran las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas/ /nad rnams sel sgoms rtse gcig gsol ba btab/ /de yang rlung la bdud rtsi mar khu'i mdog /mkhris par dkar po bad kan la dmar mo/ /'dus par sngo skya gdon la khro chu ༵༵na / /

me 'od dang bcas sgrib sbyangs shel mdog bsgom/ /rang nyid sman bla'i thugs kar zla'i steng / /oṃ mthing cha lnga mtha' la gzungs sngags bkod/ /de las 'od byung rgyal bar dgyes mchod phul/ /sems can rnams la phog pas de dag kun/ /sangs rgyas gu ru pad+ma 'od dpag med/ /bde gshegs dgu yi thugs bskyed smon lam gyi/ /mthu yis sdig sgrib sdug bsngal mtha' dag sbyangs/ /mthar ni sman bla'i skur gyur gzungs sngags ldir/ /na mo bha ga wa te/ bh+yo ṣa rdzu gu ru baiḍūr+ya pra bha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyakle buchu ya/ tadru thā/ oṃ lha ṣa rdzu lha ṣa rdzu ma hālha ṣa rdzu/ sa mud ga te swā hā/ gzungs ring ci nus mthar ni gzungs thung bzla/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /de yi gzungs sngags phan yon bsam mi khyab/ /shes nas dad gus spro bas gzungs sngags bzlas/ /skabs su sman bla bde chen zhing mdo bklag /'od dpag med dang bde gshegs brgyad mtshan rdzogs/ /brjod nas phyag sogs yan lag bdun pa 'bul/ /thun mtshams chos spyod bcu la brtson par bya/ /des ni tshe rabs grangs med sdig sgrib 'dag /'di dang phyi ma'i nad gdon ma lus zhi/ /bde ba can gyi zhing du skye bar byed/ /de sogs phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab thob/ /'on kyang las 'bras smin 'os dus bab ni/ /'phags pa'i go 'phang brnyes kyang mi ldog na/ /gzhan la ci smos sgrib sbyangs tshogs rdzogs lam/ /'bad rung las 'bras smin la log rtog spangs/ /dge 'bras smin tshab che chung stobs kyi dus/ /'di phyi bar do gang ris bde gong 'phel/ /thob nges sangs rgyas gsung ni mi bslu bas/ /yid ches spro bas dge la 'bad gces so/ /rdzogs rim phyi lus tshor ba drag po'i nad/ /gzhi rten nang na rmongs pas bdag 'dzin blo/ /bdag gces bzung ba 'dzin pa'i ming yin la/ /de ni 'khrul pa glo bur dri ma yin/ /gnyen po bdag med stong nyid ye shes te/ /bsgom thabs mi g.yo bzhi ldan sgo gsum mig /mkha' la rang bab dus gsum blos byas kyi/ /rnam rtog las 'das rang rig rjen par bzhag /de la rim gyis goms pa'i nyams rim bzhi/ /gnas dang mi g.yo mnyam nyid lhun grub pa/ /re rer g.yo goms brtan pa thob par sbyor/ /sa lam nges 'byor bla ma'i man ngag yin/ /man ngag gsum pa gu ru nor lha bsgrub/ /mdun gyi mkha' la gu ru dzam+bha la/ /pad zlar gter bum zhabs sprod nyi ma'i steng / /rdza baṃ smug 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i dra ba bsdoms/ /dmar po brjid ldan chags rgyas yid tsam khro/ /g.yas g.yon nor bu ne'u le thugs ka dkur/ /'dzin cing rin chen rgyan spras g.yas brkyang stabs/ /yum mchog bde rgyas nor bu thod khrag 'khyud/ /gzhan yang ngo bo gu ru rnam par ni/ /smug 'dzin dkar ser dmar nag ljang gang mos/ /sgom rung 'khor du nor bdag gtso bo che/ /shar nas phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi g.yas rim du/ /nor bzang zla shel gang ba bzang sbyin ma/ /nor sbyin sbyin bzang rnam thos bu 'phags ma/ /mā li rab bzang 'jam 'khyil rab sang 404

ma/ /zhal dbang lha mo spyod dbang dbyangs can ma/ /yab yum kha sbyor phyogs mtshams brgyad du gnas/ /gzhan yang nor lha'i rigs gyur bye ba brgya/ /grangs las 'das pas rin chen char 'bebs shing / /dgos 'dod dngos grub chen po sprin du gtibs/ /gsol ba btab tshe gtso 'khor thugs ka nas/ /'od zer lcags kyu lta bu phyogs dus kyi/ /rgyal ba rgyal sras slob mar bcas pa yi/ /smin mtshams thugs ka zhal sgo phyag mthil nas/ /yo byad dbang phyug nam mkha' mdzod chen gter/ /rin chen rnam par spyan drangs de las gzhan/ /'jig rten dpal 'byor 'byung ba'i dngas bcud kun/ /bsdus byas de dang lhan cig gu ru yi/ /sbyor mtshams lte ba zhal sgo ne'u le'i kha/ /gter bum rnams nas rin chen char rgyun babs/ /bdag dang dbul phongs bkres skom nyams thag 'gro'i/ /lus dang gnas khang thams cad phyur kheng bas/ /bsod nams dpal 'byor longs spyod mnga' thang rgyas/ /mthar ni kun kyang 'khor los bsgyur rgyal gyur/ /de dag zhing mchog sangs rgyas mchod bkur la/ /brtson pas kun kyang byang chub mchog thob bsams/ /rang nyid dzam dmar snying dbus rang 'dra'i sku/ kha sbyor mtha' mar gu ru'i snying pos bskor/ /ye shes thugs kar sa bon dzam+bha la'i/ /sngags 'phreng 'od zer sgro bsdu'i gong ltar gyi/ /skyabs yul byin rlabs snang srid dngas bcud bsdus/ /sa bon la thim bdag lus rin chen khengs/ /bsod nams tshad med dpag tu med pa rgyas/ /khams gsum 'gro kun bdag gi dbang gyur bsam/ /oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ye dha na me rnyi trīḥ ḍā ki ni dza la sam+bha ram̐ swā hāḥ mthar 'gro 'khor bsgyur smug 'dzin kun bdag thim/ /rang nyid mthu dpal gzi byin cher rgyas bsam/ /mthun mtshams chu sbyin 'byung po spyi gtor btang / /gser 'od nor rgyun mdo bklag mchod sbyin 'bad/ /khyad par bla ma mkhan slob pha ma dang / /dge ba'i bshes gnyen sku gsung thugs rten mchod/ /brtson pas tshe rabs sgrib sbyangs bsod nams rgyas/ /dbul bral rtag tu 'byor ldan lus thob 'gyur/ /'di yi rdzogs rim phyi yi mu ge'i rten/ /nang na chags zhen ser snas bcings pas len/ /gnyen po bden med chags med chos thams cad/ /zhen med ngang la mchod sbyin brtson pa yin/ /de yang bdag gi drod dbugs sha rus khrag /kun gyis dkon mchog mchod cing dam can bskangs/ /rigs drug tshim zhing lan chags 'khyed bar sbyin/ /'khor gsum dmigs med ngang bzhag snyan smra spyod/ /ma yengs sgom pa'i ngang bzhag don spyod cing / /bsgom bral blta bar la zla don mthun par/ /de ltar bsdu dngos bzhi yi nges don la/ /sgyu ma lta bur mnyam rjes med par 'bad/ /man ngag bzhi pa gu ru yi dam bsgrub/ /de la ngo bo bla ma rnam pa sku/ /yi dam rang gi yid la gang mos las/ /mtha' bzung gcig min gang zag blo rigs dang / /mthun mod 'on kyang rgyud lung man ngag gi /zin nges yi dam gsol btab de'i ngo bo/ /bla mar shes las rgyud dang man ngag 405

gi /ma zin blo bcos lta bsgom byin rlabs med/ /de bas byin rlabs ma nyams gzhung man ngag /ldan la nyams len byed pa gal 'gag yin/ /'dir ni thugs sgrub rdo rje drag rtsal lam/ /thugs sgrub gser zhun rdo rje thod 'phreng rtsal/ /yang na che mchog rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku/ /gang mos yum can mdun gyi mkha' la bsgom/ /bde gshegs yongs su 'dus pa sgrub sde brgyad/ /gtso bo 'jam dpal rta mgrin yang dag thugs/ /che mchog phur pa dregs 'dul stobs ldan la/ /yum mchog ro langs gzi ldan rdor dbyings ma/ /gnam zhal rgyas 'debs sri 'dul 'byung lnga'i bdag /'khril sbyor khro gar dur khrod dpal chas rdzogs/ /gzhan yang yi dam theg dgu rgyud sde drug /zhi ba khro bo zhi ma khro ma sogs/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams tshom bu 'bum/ /grangs med sprin phung gtib ltar bskor bar bsgom/ /gsol ba btab tshe phyogs dus rgyal ba kun/ /'dus nas sku ni che chung ma nges par/ /char bzhin babs pas bdag gi lus byin rlabs/ /de bzhin gsung la yig 'bru sgra dang bcas/ /thugs la thig le phyag mtshan sna tshogs pa/ /yon tan 'od lnga 'phrin las me rlung chu/ /'bar ba'i tshul gyis bdag la thim pa yi/ /sgo gsum dbang po rlung rnams byin gyis brlabs/ /gter bdag dregs pa mthu chen kun 'dus nas/ /bdag la dngos grub che mchog rnams stsol dmigs/ /mthar ni rang nyid yi dam kun 'dus dpal/ /che mchog rdo rje thod 'phreng sku ru bsam/ /chos skyong dam can kun gyi srog snying po/ /dbang med bdag la phul nas 'phrin las bsgrub/ /snang srid kun kyang gzhal yas lha yi sku/ /gnyis med ye shes rang sngags sgrogs par dmigs/ /gsal ba gsum ldan dgongs pas yi ge rdu/ /zhi bar rkyang ded drag por nyis brtsegs dang / /dbang la lnga sgril rgyas par bdun sgril bzlas/ /mthar thug dbugs nyid r+ghaṃ ste rgyun chad med/ /gzhan ni rang gi yi dam lhag pa'i lha/ /gsang sngags bzla zhing dmigs pa'i gzer gdab bya/ /skabs su thugs sgrub kun gyi yang snying mchog /snying po gser gyi yang zhun 'dzab kyang bzla/ /de bzhin bla ma dgongs 'dus rgyud kyi snying / /rtsa gsum spyi dril snying po 'di rnams bzla/ /oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ trīḥ badz+ra gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki ni sarba sirnyi pha la rgyu aḥ de ltar sgrub pa'i gang zag de nyid kyi/ /yi dam rtsa ba gsum zhal dngos nyams rmir/ /mjal zhing lung ston byin rlabs gnas lugs don/ /rjen mthong mchog thun dngos grub mdzod la dbang / /gter dbang gang zag yin na tshul 'di nyid/ /gter sgrub mchog ste dngos grub myur thob 'gyur/ /rdzogs rim don la spyir ni rgya che'i don/ /'khor 'das snang srid kun kyang gter yin la/ /'don tshul bsam gyis mi khyab brjod mi langs/ /'on kyang mkhyen gnyis sgrub la yongs su 'du/ /gter gyi mdo don snying po zab pa ni/ /dri med rig pa chos kyi sku yin te/ /de ni gter du ji ltar bzhukāsdu bhe na/ /'khrul snang brag ri'i dbus na tshogs bdun gyi/ /rgyas gtab kun gzhi rin chen gter

sgrom na/ /'bri gang med pa'i zab gter mchog de bzhugs/ /de nyid rgyal ba'i bka' lung kha byang la/ /bla ma'i man ngag byin rlabs snying byang ste/ /dad mos gus pa dam tshig brtson 'grus can/ /skal ldan bu yin des kyang tshul bzhin du/ /bla ma dgyes byas sgom sgrub la brtson pas/ /gter rnams kun gyi rgyal po de snyed 'gyur/ /de skad spyi don gleng gzhir bstan byas nas/ /snying po nyams len gtan la phab pa ni/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi bgrod gcig lam/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor kun gyi srog snying mchog /sangs rgyas ye shes drang thad ngo sprod pa/ /rig pa'i gcer mthong khregs chod gdams pa mchog /sngon du the tshom sems kyi dri ma gsal/ /dngos gzhi ngo sprod thag chod gdengs cha'o/ /de nyid nyams len brtson pa ma bral na/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas rdzogs rim rgyal po yin/ /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun grub zab gter 'di/ /su'i thon rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po yin/ /man ngag lnga pa zil gnon gu rur bsgrub/ /mdun mkhar gu ru zil gnon drag po rtsal/ /dkar dmar khro 'dzum ber phod chos gos gsol/ /pad zhu khyung ldem phyag g.yas gnam lcags kyi/ /rdo rje rtse dgu me 'bar kha gdangs 'phyar/ /g.yon pas dregs pa sde bcu'i snying 'phreng 'dren/ /dpral mgrin snying lte gsang bar 'jam dpal nag /rta phyag mgon po sgra gcan dkyil 'khor rdzogs/ /'khor du zhing skyong bswe lcags dung skyes phyogs/ /rdor legs rma thang dre'u zhon lha mo mtshams/ /gzhan yang dge bsnyen brtan ma srid pa'i lha/ /che gnyan drag btsan ri dbang mgur lha sogs/ /kun kyang bka' gnyan gsung bstod bran gyi tshul/ /rin chen rang rtags srog gis gu ru mchod/ /gsol ba btab tshe gu ru'i thugs ka nas/ /'od zer 'bar bas 'khor rnams gnad dbab pas/ /kun kyang sngon gyi g.yar dam rjes dran nas/ /snyigs ma lngas dben bde ldan sbas pa'i yul/ /bdag la ster zhing rang nyid gang gnas phyogs/ /de ru dpal g.yang thams cad bskyed par bsam/ /mthar ni rang nyid pad+ma zil gnon sku/ /gnas lnga'i lha bcas thugs ka'i 'od zer las/ /'khor 'das lha tshogs bsdus nas gnas lngar thim/ /gang 'dod dngos grub yid bzhin thob par bsam/ /hūṃ a kā ya ha a ma ra/ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na/ trid nan/ sbur thums dza dzaḥ dha lo sha pu wa ma/a gi tri sidhi pha la dza dza dzaḥ gsang sngags 'di la 'khor 'das 'byung po'i srog /kun tshang pho mo ma ni gnyis su med/ /bzlas na mchog thun dngos grub kun thob cing / /'pho tshe bde ba can du skye bar gsungs/ /khyad par sbas pa'i yul gyi sgo 'byed par/ /ched mngags gu ru'i sgrub thabs mchog yin pas/ /sbas yul 'jug dang sgo 'byed 'dod rnams kyi/ /gu ru'i gsol 'debs sgrub thabs 'di nyid la/ /'bad pas dngos nyams rmi lam snang ba ru/ /sbas yul 'byed dang mi 'byed lung ston 'byung / /'byed pa'i lung bstan byung na lam yig ltar/ /sta gon byas nas dal la brtson bskyed 'jug 407/lung

ston med par sbas yul 'jug 'dod kyi/ /skam chags drag pos rang nyid ngal byed yin/ /de bas thog mar gu ru'i sgrub pa la/ /nan tan rmi lam mtshan ma thob pa gces/ /spyir yang dam tshig shes rab brtson 'grus can/ /rten 'brel thabs la mkhas pas brtsam bya yin/ /bab chol byas na mi rung cho 'phrul 'byung / /des na tshul bzhin spyod pa zhib tu bgyis/ /sbas yul 'byed sogs min yang 'di bsgrub pas/ /gong du bshad pa'i yon tan kun thob cing / /sde brgyad dregs pas bka' nyan 'phrin las bsgrub/ /gu ru'i byin rlabs zhugs nas mchog thob 'gyur/ /rdzogs rim phyi ltar snyigs ma lnga skyob phyir/ /sbas pa'i yul sde nang na 'khrul snang gi /dben pa mi 'gyur bde chen sbas yul te/ /de nyid lam byed thabs grol steng 'og sgo/ /'dir ni steng sgo phyi nang stong ra'i mthar/ /rlung sbyor bzhi ldan gtum mo'i me sbar zhing / /a haṃ 'du 'phrod bde drod ye shes bskyed/ /brtan pa thob nas de bgo 'og sgos bton/ /de yang ro 'bar rkyang 'dzag dbu mar zhugs/ /'khor lo bzhi bsreg ri bong can 'dzag 'khyil/ /yas mas dga' ba rjes dran ting 'dzin pa/ /lam rim ma 'dres nges 'byed shes par bya/ /man ngag dag pa gu ru seng sgrar bsgrub/ /de yang mdun mkha' gsang bdag seng ge sgra/ /khro gtum rdo rje sdig mdzub drag mos 'khyud/ /skra gseb seng zhal dur khrod dpal chas rdzogs/ /'khor du dpa' bo rigs bzhi yum bcas phyogs/ /'gugs 'dzin stobs rgyug ging bzhi yum bcas mtshams/ /gzhan yang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ging pho mo/ /bye ba grangs med 'khor du bskor bar bsam/ /gsol ba btab tshe gur ru'i thugs— ka nas//'od 'phros phyogs dus rgyal ba'i thugs rgyud bskul/ /tshur 'dus bdag gi 'jigs pa mtha' dag zhi/ /'gro kun gdug pa'i sems can gnod las sgrol/ /mthar ni rang nyid gsang bdag gsal btab cing //ye shes sems dpa' rdo rje rtse dgu'i lter/ /r+ghaṃ mthar sngags 'phreng 'od zer 'gal me ltar/ /'khor zhing me 'bar bsrung ba'i gur khang bstas/ /phyi yi bar chad bdug pa'i gcan gzan dang / /nang gi ma rungs phra man gnod pa'i tshogs/ /gsang ba byad kha rbod gtong ngan pa rnams/ /rang gshed rang dbab thal ba'i rdul brlag bsam/ /oṃ badz+ra gu ru sidha gaṇ+ḍi dhārma dhā tu rgyu r+ghaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭa ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūṃ phaṭaḥ aḥ kaḥ saḥ maḥ raḥ tsaḥ shaḥ daḥ raḥ saḥ maḥ raḥ yaḥ phaṭaḥ de ltar rtsa sngags spyi dril mtshan brgya pa/ /bdud 'dul drag mo'i gsang sngags yang snying te/ /gang mos gtso bor bzla zhing rtags rdzogs tshe/ /las rdzogs gang brtsams thogs med 'grub par 'gyur/ /rdzogs rim phyi na 'brog chen 'jigs pa'i 'phrang / /nang na rnam rtog 'pho bcas dbang gi ni/ /skye 'chi bar dor 'khyams pa'i 'brog chen ste/ /'jigs skyob lam khyer bar do'i gdams bsgom gces/ /de yang bar do drug las rnam rwa 0kāsum/ /rang bzhin bar dor 'du la der lam bsgom/ /'dir ni 'chi ka chos nyid srid pa ste/ /

me long ma sang wa 'jug tshul du gdams/ /man ngag bdun pa pad+ma badz+ra sgrub/ /de yang mkha' la dgu rdzogs theg pa'i gdan/ /de steng 'od dpag med mgon bde ba che/ /pad+ma badz+ra zhal gsum phyag drug dmar/ /khro 'dzum rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'gying pa'i sku/ /g.yas dkar g.yon mthing thor tshugs ral pa'i rtser/ /'od dpag med brgyan lha lcam gsang ye 'khyud/ /g.yas gsum rdo rje ral gri tshe yi bum/ /g.yon gsum dril bu bhardzo nam mkha'i dbyug /gzi brjid 'od dpag med mgon thugs rje'i sku/ /dkyil 'khor yongs kyi 'khor los bsgyur mdzad dpal/ /bla ma dgongs 'dus dkyil 'khor gtso mchog yin/ /'khor du 'byung bzhi'i lha ni rigs lnga ste/ /de phyir mkha' 'gro sde lnga yab yum yin/ /'dir ni dkyil 'khor gtso 'brel rgyud don bzhin/ /rigs lnga te ru kar bstan rdo rje brgyad/ /zhe sdang rdo rje nga rgyal rdo rje dang / /'dod chags rdo rje phrag dog rdo rje sems/ /gti mug rdo rje bde ba rdo rje sems/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje khrag 'thung rdo rje 'chang / /yum brgyad bskyed byed gshin rje 'joms ma dang / /bsreg byed tsan ti ka dang rmongs byed ma/ /māl mar+ghaṃ ra ba gsod byed ma/ /'khril sbyor de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa brgyad/ /ye shes rang 'od me rig kha dog lnga/ /'khrig dbus zhi ma khro tshul gzi 'od 'bar/ /gzhan yang 'byung lnga'i mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum/ /grangs med kun kyang bdag la brtse bas bzhugs/ /gsol ba btab tshe gtso 'khor thams cad kyi/ /thugs las 'od 'phros phyi ltar 'byung ba'i dgra/ /nang ltar 'du 'khrug 'byung ba tsha grang gegs / /gsang ba nyon mongs dug lnga'i rnam rtog zhi/ /mthar ni rang nyid pad+ma badz+ra rtsal/ /thugs kar nyi zla'i steng du rdo rje'i lter/ /'dab brgyad dbus su sangs rgyas 'od dpag med/ /mnyam bzhag tshe bum nang du rdo rje gsum/ /thugs kar hrīḥ bcas sku mthar sngags 'phreng 'khor/ /'od zer spro bsdu rgyal kun thugs byin bsdus/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus bdag gyur zhing 'di yang / /'byung bzhi'i gnod bral bde ba can du bsam/ /oṃ ldir+ghaṃ gu ru shri pad+ma badz+ra trīḥ dhu ma gha ye ḍāk+ki ni na maḥ swā hāḥ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ trīḥm ha ri ni saḥ ra tsa hri ya dza r+ghaṃḥ oṃ āḥrgyu gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki ni ṭ+wā hāḥ hriḥ maḥ ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya a dri tri dzaḥ sarba a gu sha dzaḥ tsit+ta hring hring sarba ba su sirnyi ku ru swā hā/ de ltar pad+ma badz+ra rtsa sngags dang / /mkha' 'gro yab yum srog sngags rtsa gsum gyi/ /spyi dril sngags te rang gi gang mos bzla/ /yang snying badz+ra gu ru dag kyang ngo / /las sbyor 'byung bzhi'i gnod pa las skyob byed/ /dmigs pa rten 'brel rdzas sngags kha yang bsgyur/ /nang ltar 'byung 'khrug rtsa rlung thig le'i gegs/ /bsal la gang 'os man ngag bzhin du bya/ /rdzogs rim gsang ba ting 'dzin sems kyi gegs/ /bsal mkhas zab gsal man ngag bsgom pa ste/ /bying smug 'thib pa gti mug sa yi gegs/ /'phro ba 'dod chags chu ste rgod sdang me/ /'thor ba phrag dog rlung yin gegs de dag /sel thabs bsgrim klod rang bab rang grol 409

bzhag /de bzhin bsam gtan dang po gnyis gsum bzhir/ /'dod pa dga' g.yo brtan pa'i nyes bsal nas/ /mu bzhir ma lhung lhag mthong ye shes kyi/ /rang zhal blta ba bsgom med yengs med bya/ /de yi gnad ni mnyam bzhag mtshan nyid bzhi/ /phra dngas bsal la mi rtog ngang du bzhag /steng 'og rdzogs rim gegs sel bogs 'don pa/ /phal cher 'di la tshang zhing gnad 'dus pas/ /zab mo'i rdzogs rim 'di la goms 'dris gces/ /des ni 'dra min gegs gol bral bar byed/ /gsal ba 'byung khams rtsa rlung thig le rnams/ /dag byed stong pa'i gzugs sgra bde ba che/ /g.yo med lam gyi bsnyen sgrub la 'bad nas/ /mi shigs rdo rje gsum 'bras mngon sbyor byed/ /man ngag brgyad pa gu ru rta mgrin bsgrub/ /de yang rgya mtsho me dpung keng rus stag /ru dra nyi steng khro mchog rta mgrin nag /mi thung gel tshul phyag gnyis seng rnga brdung / /rdo rje khros ma gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud/ /phyogs bzhir phyag brgya bzhi 'dzin mkha' 'gro bzhi/ /spyi bor pad+ma thod 'phreng thod rnga dril/ /rdo rje phag mo gri thod 'dzin dang rol/ /gsang ye sde bzhi cang ti'u dril bu thogs/ /gzhan yang khro bo khro mo grangs med pa/ /bu yug ltar 'tshub me lce rdo rje ra/ /kun tu 'phro dbus 'jigs su rung bar bskyed/ /gsol ba btab tshe me dpung 'phro zhing 'du/ /rab 'bar 'khor los dgra jag chom rkun dang / /byur gegs ltas ngan sri kha kogs chags byed/ /nyams nga mtha' dag phyer brlag bsrung gur gyur/ /mthar ni rang nyid gu ru rta mgrin sku/ /zhal nas me 'phros phyi gnod bar chad bsreg /nang du bkug pas nang gdon nad bcas bsreg /bar gyi gnyis snang mtha' dag stong par sbyangs/ /oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ gu ru kro dha ha ya gyi wa kro ta ha ri ni sā mā yā dzaḥ kā la shwa ra sirnyi hā la r+ghaṃḥ las sbyor phyi ltar dgra jag chom rkun bcings/ /nang ltar gza' klu gdug pa'i gnod pa bcing / /de dag yengs med bskyed rim sngags nus pa/ /rnyed pas las rnams thogs med 'grub par nges/ /rdzogs rim gsang ba rnam rtog lam du 'khyer/ /de yang phra sbom rags pa tshogs drug gi /yul la zhen pas 'khor ba'i rgyu bskyed byed/ /zhen med spangs gnyen bral ba'i gshis la bzhag /man ngag dgu pa gu ru grol leb bsgrub/ /mkha' dkyil rdo rje'i gur khang me dpung klong / /rdo rje grol lod dmar smug 'chol ba'i sku/ /zhal gdangs mche bcigs spyan gsum sdang mig gzigs/ /dbu skra dmar ser gyen brjes thod skams brgyan/ /zhabs gnyis gar stabs ling ling 'gying bag rol/ /za 'og ber phod chos gos rus rgyan gsol/ /phyag gnyis rdo rje rtse dgu phur bu gsol/ /'khor du bdud 'dul khro bo chen po bcu/ /hūṃ kar rnam rgyal gshed chen rta skad can/ /bdud rtsi dbyug sngon mi g.yo gzhan mi thub/ /khams gsum rnam rgyal stobs chen khro bo bcu/ /kun kyang mthing nag gnam lcags phur bu 'dril/ /sgra 'byinā ༵da' snyems dur bdag tsaṇ+ḍa li/ /rlung 'byin sder mo gtun khung bskul byed ma/ /gsod byed ma

ste yab yum lhan cig rol/ /gzhan yang khro chu rdo rje'i bu yug 'tshub/ /gsol ba btab tshe thugs ka'i sa bon dang / /ba spu'i bu ga dbu skra phyag mtshan las/ /khro bo mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa yi/ /bdag la sdang sems ldan pa'i dgra bgegs kun/ /phye mar brlag cing sha khrag rus pa la/ /khro chung lcags sdig rnams kyis hab hab rol/ /tshur 'dus steng 'og phyogs mtshams rdo rje yi/ /gur khang mi phyed gong bu gcig tu gyur/ /mthar ni rang nyid rdo rje khro bo mod/ /ye shes thugs kar rdo rje nas 'bras tsam nyi steng r+ghaṃ dmar mtha' ma sngags 'phreng 'khor/ /'od 'phros rgyal mchod sems can las sgribs sbyangs/ /mi dang mi min gdug pa'i bsam sbyor zhi/ /sngon las phral rkyen bar chad kun sel bsam/ /oṃ lhutsū ma hā gu ru bi ru kro dha lokat+tar sarba sirnyi rdzu r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ rtsa sngags de'am a rtsig ni rtsig gam/ /yang na zur chag skad gyur rtsa ba'i sngags/ /oṃ badz+ra gu ru khro bo lota lo ka sarba sirnyi r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ rgyu/ 'di gsum rang gi blo la gang mos bzlas/ /skabs su rtsa sngags sham bur r+ghaṃ phaṭa ces/ /ngar ldan mang bzlas snang ba'i yul rnams la/ /thogs brdug med par rig pa'i rtsal yang sbyang / /rnying ma 'ga' dang gsar ma re zung na/ /zur chag sngags 'gyur 'di 'dra byung ba la/ /to ge pa 'ga' rgya min bod min zhes/ /dgag pa rang nyid chos spong sgribs bsags las/ /ji bzhin don la 'byor ba ma yin te/ /'byor zhes smra na o rgyan sham+bha la/ /'gro lding srin po klu yi skad la sogs/ /tshul bzhin shes pa phyogs 'dir smos ci dgos/ /legs sbyar skad la dpyad par rlom na yang / /legs sbyar mtha' dag dbang pos mi shes na/ /phal pa gzhan gyi spyod yul ga la zhig /'phags yul legs sbyar mdo gzhung yongs rdzogs pa/ /bod 'dir med cing yod pa cung zad kyang / /bram ze'i gsang tshig tshig bsdud gyur pa ni/ /bod kyi lo tsās rang gar rtogs nus med/ /lhag tu gsang chen rnying ma'i man ngag rnams/ /legs sbyar kho nas ston pa ma yin gyi/ /tshul 'di bsam gyis mi khyab kho nar dran/ /de lta na yang gang zag blo skyon gyis/ /bar skabs bcos bslad brdzun zog yig nor sogs/ /yin min bsreg bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin brtag /tshad ldan yin na bsgrub na rtags ldan zhing / /bzlas na nus 'byung bsgom na nyams rtogs 'char/ /'di phyi bar do bde skyed thob na yin/ /de skad zab mo'i sngags la log rtog blo/ /dgag phyir tshe dbang nor bu'i zhar byung smras/ /de ltar khro lota rtsa sngags gang mos la/ /bzlas zhing nus pa thon nas las la sbyor/ /de yang mtshon bzlog rigs sngags rgyal po 'di/ /dmigs pa'i kha bsgyur ting 'dzin ngar dang bcas/ /oṃ rnal 'byor sod bzlog chum dril ṭ+wā hā/ bzlas zhing rten 'brel rdzas 'khor bsrung ba yang / /byas pas mtshon gyi gnod pa bzlog par byed/ /de yang sngon las ci rigs phyir nur byed/ /'phral rkyen yin na nges par bzlog 'gyur ro/ /phyi ltar mtshon cha'i gnod pa de nyid kyang / /nang na nyon mongs hrag pa ༵snyi las

byung / /des na nyon mongs lam khyer rdzogs rim bsgom/ /de yang zhe sdang ngam gyi skyes pa na/ /'phro rjes mi 'thud kho yi rang ngor blta/ /ltas pas rang yal spangs gnyen yul las 'das/ /rig pa gsal stong rjen pa cer gyi 'char/ /de ni me long lta bu'i ye shes yin/ /de bzhin 'dod chags nga rgyal phrag dog dang / /gti mug la yang de ltar nyams myong bas/ /nyon mongs rang dag ye shes chen por 'char/ /nyon mongs bral la ye shes smra bar bya/ /man ngag bcu pa pad+ma'i rgyal por bsgrub/ /de yang mkha' la ye shes rang 'od dbus/ /pad+ma rgyal po sku dmar zhal gcig pa/ /phyag gnyis thal sbyar gsang ye yum la 'khyud/ /zhi tshul longs sku'i chas rdzogs rdor skyil bzhugs/ /thugs kar rdor sems spyi bor snang mthas brgyan/ /phyi rim 'dab brgyad nye sras sems dpa' brgyad/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyas byang sems grangs med bskor/ /gsol ba btab tshe gtso 'khor 'od zer gyis/ /'gro drug sgrib sbyangs 'od zer lcags kyu yis/ /bde ba can gyi zhing du kun drangs nas/ /pad+ma las 'khrungs snang mtha'i zhal mjal bsam/ /mthar ni rang nyid lhar gyur thugs dbus su/ /pad nyi'i gdan steng 'bru bzhi brtsegs ma'i mthar/ /rgyal ba kun gyi yang snying yi ge drug /'khor bas snod bcud dag pa'i rang bzhin gyur/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ trīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me rgyu/ skabs su sangs rgyas byang sems mtshan brgya dang / /za ma tog bklag nyin mtshan thun drug tu/ /'chi kha gnad gcod sdug bsngal mi 'byung zhing / /bde ba can du skye ba'i smon lam btab/ /rdzogs rim 'chi ba lam khyer bsgom pa ste/ /'chi ba'i rgyu ni 'pho bcas rtog pa yin/ /lam khyer rtog med 'thug po'i 'od gsal bsgom/ /de la goms na 'chi kha grol ba thob/ /man ngag bcu gcig 'od dpag med mgon bsgrub/ /mdun mkha' sangs rgyas zhing khams bde ba can/ /dbus su sangs rgyas 'od dpag med mgon ni/ /dmar po mnyam bzhag chos gos snam gsum gsol/ /byang chub shing mchog rin chen pad+mo ni/ /rnam par snang la sku rgyab brten nas bzhugs/ /phyi rim shar du sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa/ /de nas g.yas bskor sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun/ /sangs rgyas rnam gzigs sa gnon mnyam bzhag mdzad/ /gtsug gtor can ni mchog sbyin mnyam bzhag byed/ /thams cad skyob ni skyabs sbyin mnyam par bzhag /'khor ba 'jig ni ting nge 'dzin gyi rgya/ /gser gyi thub pa chos 'chad mnyam bzhag mdzad/ /'od bsrung mchog sbyin chos gos ri dwags rna/ /shākya thub pa chos 'chad phyag rgya mdzad/ /bdun ka gser mdog chos gos rnam gsum gsol/ /kun kyang mtshan dpe yongs rdzogs rdor skyil bzhugs/ /rang rang byang chub shing la sku rgyab brten/ /gzhan yang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gaṅga'i klung / /bye ma'i grangs dang mnyam pas mtha' bskor ba/ /gsol ba btab tshe gtsug tor mdzod spu nas/ /'od kyis 'gro ba'i sgrib pa yongs su sbyangs/ /kun kyang 'phags pa'i sa la yongs bkod de/ /bde chen pad mo'i gdan la 'khod par 412

bsam/ /mthar ni rang nyid 'od dpag med du bsgom/ /thugs kar zla steng rdo rje lte bar trīḥ mtha' mar mtshan gzungs 'khod les 'od 'phros pas/ /don gnyis yongs rdzogs snod bcud sangs rgyas zhing / /oṃ ā mi ta bha hri/ zhes dang 'od dpag med kyi mtshan brgya'i sngags/ /dpa' bo bdun dang mi 'khrug gzungs sngags bzla/ /thun mtshams dkon rtsegs 'od dpag med mdo klags/ /sems bskyed 'gyur ba bcu yang ci nus 'bad/ /rdzogs rim bar do'i snang ba'i gzhi rtsa ni/ /kun gzhi rnam rtog las rlung bskyod las shar/ /bar do lam khyer nyams len snying po ni/ /rmi lam ngo bzung sbyang spel bsgyur bcad bya/ /man ngag bcu gnyis bla ma kun bzang bsgrub/ /mkha' nyid 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i zhing //dbus su 'od lnga'i thig le bkrag 'tsher ba/ /snying por kun bzang yab yum gcer bu'i sku/ /mnyam bzhag yum gyis rdo dril mthing dngas gsal/ /mdun du rigs 'dus dpal ldan rdo rje sems/ /phyogs bzhir rnam snang rin 'byung 'od dpag med/ /don grub rang rtags phyag mtshan yum la 'khyud/ /mtshams bzhir bdud bzhi 'dul mdzad khro bo'i rgyal/ /rdo rje gzhon nu badz+ra he ru ka /rta mgrin rgyal po 'chi med bdud rtsi 'khyil/ /ye shes me 'od lnga ldan dbus na bzhugs/ /gzhan yang zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya dang / /rigs lnga rigs gcig rang bzhin grangs med pa/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba bsam gyis mi khyab sku/ /dpag gis mi lang mkha' khams khengs pas bskor/ /gsol btab ye shes rang 'od me dpung gi /khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgyu rtsa drung nas phyungs/ /kun kyang rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor byin rlabs nas/ /mi 'gyur bde chen mchog la spyod par dmigs/ /mthar ni rang nyid kun bzang yab yum gyur/ /thugs kar ye shes thig le lnga ldan dbus/ /'bru dgu brtsegs pas 'gro kun sgrib pa sbyangs/ /kun bzang skur gyur sngags kyi rang sgra sgrogs/ /oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ 'a a sha sa ma haḥ 'di ni kun bzang dgongs pa'i yang snying ste/ /rdzogs chen 'bum phrag drug bcu'i snying po yin/ /bzlas pas rigs drug sdug bsngal drung nas 'don/ /mngon sum snang ba tshad la myur phebs 'byung / /thun skabs sangs rgyas sras gcig sa bon rgyud/ /btags grol rgyud drug gser gyi zhun ma'i rgyud/ /kun tu bzang po'i smon lam mchog la sogs/ / gang mang bklag cing don la sems par bya/ /rgyal ba thabs mkhas chos kyi sgo mang yang / /'khrul snang btsan thabs bzlog cing sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phangs myur bsgrub sangs rgyas ye shes dngos/ /ston byed rdzogs chen rgyud klog chos spyod mchog /sdug bsngal drag po'i rgyu ni dngos zhen gyi/ /'dzin pa dam pos byas te de bzlog byed/ /'khrul snang rang grol chos nyid mngon sum blta/ /thun min 'pho ba'i gdams pa nyams su len/ /man ngag bcu gsum rtsa ba'i bla ma bsgrub/ /rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma ni/ /spyir ni sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /khyad par pad 'byung sgyu 'phrul nyid du nges/ /de nyidwa stu ru rtsa

sgrub skabs ltar ram/ /yang na ghu ru mnyam bzhag phyag mthil du/ /nor bu bsam 'phel 'tsho rgyal yum dang bcas/ /dran pas sdug bsngal gtan nas 'joms par bsam/ /phyogs bzhir rigs 'dzin bzhi ste sku'i cha lugs/ /gtso bo ji bzhin 'khor lo rdo rje dang / /pad+ma rgya gram mnyam bzhag phyag rgyas 'dzin/ /mtshams bzhir slob dpon bzhi ste thod bum 'dzin/ /gzhan yang rig 'dzin bye 'bum gzi brjid 'bar/ /rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma sprin bzhin 'khrigs/ /gsol ba btab pas dad pa'i mthu nus kyis/ /gnam sa 'thab pa lta bu'i dga' bde bcas/ /byin rlabs dngos grub rten phebs rab 'byams kun/ /rang bab rang thim char bzhin rab tu bab/ /rgyal ba yongs 'dus gu ru pad+ma yi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi nus byin bdag la zhugs/ /mthar ni rang nyid bla ma'i sku ru gyur/ /snying gar rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes mchog /gcig bsdus bla ma'i sku gzugs mtshon gang sa/ /thugs ka'i dbus su rig pa rtse gcig gis/ /rdo rje thig le mngon sum snang ba bcas/ /bsam gyis mi khyab sku dang zhing khams rdzogs/ /sa bon sngags kyi 'phreng bas rgyal kun gyi/ /ye shes bdag gi rgyud la skyes par bsam/ /oṃ ghu ru dhā ki ni dz+nyā na sarba sirnyi rgyu/ zhes pa ci nus nyid dang thun mtshams su/ /tshig bdun gsol 'debs gdung shugs drag pos bya/ /mdor na man ngag bcu gsum thams cad kyi/ /yang snying bla ma mos gus khrid 'dir 'du/ /de yang rgyal ba'i gsung rab mtha' dag gi /'jug sgo med thabs med pa 'di kho na/ /lam gyi gzhung shing 'bras bu'i skyel so che/ /bla ma sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa las/ /lhag pa'i chos gzhan nam yang yod ma yin/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas nye myur zab mo'i lam/ /bla med sngags chos kun kyang 'dir rag las/ /'di med sngags lam snying med lus khog 'dra/ /des na bla mar dad gus mos pa'i khrid/ /'di ni dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi lam/ /zab myur khyad 'phags chos kyi rgyal po mchog /'khor los bsgyur ltar mtshungs pa med pa yin/ /zab zab legs legs chos tshul ci 'dra ba/ /bsgom yang dad pa mos gus dang bral na/ /byin rlabs 'jug pa'i sgo dang bral ba yin/ /mos gus can la bla ma'i byin rlabs 'jug /bla ma'i byin rlabs snying la zhugs pa na/ /byang chub lam la rang dbang med par 'gro/ /sa lam yon tan mi 'dod na yang 'char/ /yi dam mkha' 'gro zhar byung nyid la 'grub/ /ci phyir yi dam bsgrub kyang byin rlabs sgo/ /bla ma las gzhan ma yin chos thams cad/ /bla ma'i mos gus ltem rkyang med la 'du/ /khyad par rdo rje theg pa'i srog snying ste/ /'di yod srog yod 'di med srog med 'gyur/ /des na dka' sla skyid sdug ci byung yang / /bla ma'i mos gus dam tshig bral mi rung / /rang la bka' drin che ba'i bla ma de/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus pad 'byung ngo bor bsam/ /pad+ma 'byung ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /'phrin las thugs rje smon lam gciki ḍi4sdus pas/ /rgyal ba gzhan las snyigs dus thugs rje myur/ /don des snyigs dus skyes pa'i 'gro

ba rnams/ /blo gtad phur tshug byas pa pad+ma 'byung / /lhag tu bod kyi lha skal spyan ras gzigs/ /bla ma'i skal ba pad+ma 'byung gnas yin/ /e ma ngo mtshar sangs rgyas 'od dpag med/ /dngos gyur mgon 'di'i gdul byar skyes pa yi/ /bsod nams 'di 'drar rang sems dga' bde ches/ /nyin mtshan khor yug de nyid kho nas khyab/ /des na thun drug kun tu gu ru yi/ /gsol 'debs dung dung bklag la shin tu 'bad/ /des ni tshe 'di 'am ni bar do dang / /phyi ma gang rigs byang chub lam rdzogs 'gyur/ /rdzogs rim dag ni bla ma rang sems dang / /ro mnyam zab gsal bde ba chen pos khyab/ /rang mdangs bla mar mos gus tshad bzung bral/ /de ni bla ma chos skur mjal zhes bya/ /rdzogs rim kun gyi mthar thug snying po ste/ /don 'di rtogs la gcig shes kun grol zhes/ /mdo rgyud dgongs don ma nor byan chud cing / /byang chen 'bras bu mchog la 'khod par 'gyur/ /de ltar bsgrub pa'i rim pa kun la yang / /bskyed rim gsal brtan nga rgyal dag dran pas/ /rnam dbye las dang po dang ye shes phebs/ /ches phebs ye shes la dbang lam rim bsgrod/ /sngags rim brda 'gyur bzlas pa'i skyon lnga spangs/ /ma yengs yid dang kha sbyor gyis 'gog bzlas/ /khyad par kun rdzob don dam rdor bzlas kyi/ /srog rtsol d+ku tir gzhug gnas thim par byed/ /rdzogs rim mtshan mar gyur la gang gi gang / /ji ltar gnad du bsnun pa ma 'chug gzir/ /mtshan med gol shor mtha' spangs zhi lhag gi/ /nyams rtogs so so'i spu ris ma nor zhing / /mnyam bzhag bsgrim slod bsgom yengs bral ba yi/ /rang ngo zab gsal rig pa gtod la phur/ /rang gdangs rnam rtog ci ltar shar na yang / /kro bsdu blang dor med par la yang zla/ /rjes thob skabs su dge sdig shan dbye bas/ /mi dge sdig spangs dge ba ci nus 'bad/ /nyams len gegs sel bogs 'don mthar thug ni/ /bla ma'i sgrub pa dang mtshungs gzhan yod min/ /nyams myong rtags mtshan bzang po ci byung yang / /dga' brod rlom pa mi bya dbyings su bsgyur/ /ltas ngan cho 'phrul sems lhong ci byung yang / /snyem 'phrig ya nga sgyid lug sogs mi bya/ /bzang ngan kun kyang rnam rtog rten 'brel gyi/ /rol par shes shing sgyu ma lta bur ltar/ /dus kun gu ru yid dang mi 'brel bar/ /dad gus phur tshug gsol 'debs rgyun mi gcad/ /dam tshig rang gi srog las lhag par blta/ /ngos skog med par rang sems dpang tshugs bya/ /de dag bskyed bzlas rdzogs pa'i rim pa yi/ /gnad kyi man ngag zhal thems tshul du bkod/ /rjes kyi bya ba dge tshogs byang chen rgyur/ /bsngo zhing 'gro don smon lam rgya chen gdab/ /spyod lam kun tu stong pa nyid snying rje/ /zung du 'jug pa mi 'brel rtag tu skyongs/ /gdams pa'i kha skong 'gro dus bskor ba dang / /zas ni tshogs 'khor dbugs ni gsang sngags sgra/ /rig pa chos sku rnam shes sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /cir yang chos nyid rol par lam du khyer/ /mdor na rgyal ba'i bka' la yid ches pas/ /bla ma sangs 415

rgyas byang sems dgyes pa'i las/ /bskyed rdzogs lta ba rtogs pa'i gdeng tshad bskyal/ /lhag bsam gzhan phan las la ci nus 'bad/ /rang gzhan mi bslu gtan bde'i lam bzang por/ /'jug la ngal med spyod pa brtsam pa ste/ /ting 'dzin shes rab sdom gsum rnam dag par/ /byang chen lam kun yongs su 'du bar 'gyur/ /e ma/ rab 'byams rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ /kun gyi mthar thug snying gi thig le ni/ /gcig chog bla ma'i sgrub thabs zab mo ste/ /de yang mtshungs med bla ma pad+ma 'byung / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gzi brjid 'od dpag med/ /de bsgrub yang snying yid bzhin bsam 'phel dbang / /ji bzhin man ngag mchog gyur bcu gsum gyi/ /bskyed rdzogs sbyor dngos rjes tshang zab 'dril gnad/ /don bzang don rgyas don gyi mdo mtha' dag /legs bshad legs gdams legs par bkod pa nyid/ /slar yang de don man ngag snying po'i sdom/ /sa bcad mdo ru bsdus pa 'di lta ste/ /bla ma'i sgrub thabs kun 'dus nor bu lugs/ /de yi bskyed sngags rdzogs rim rtsa ba yin/ /sgrub thabs bcu gsum me 'phreng sman gyi bla/ /smug 'dzin dag gis dmag dang nad chug bzlog /rdo rje thod 'phreng zil gnon seng ge sgra/ /gter dang sbas yul sgo 'byed 'brog chen sgrol/ /pad+ma badz+ra rta nag khro bo lota/ /'byung bzhi'i gnod pa ar jag dgra bo zhi/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang snang mtha' kun bzang gi /'chi dang bar do duḥ kha drag po sel/ /kun gyi ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma ste/ /de bsgrub ghu ru'i thugs rjes 'pho med gzigs/ /phyi yi de nyid nang la sbyar ba yi/ /man ngag nor bu rdzogs rim bcu gsum byung / /phyi nang sbyar ba'i bshad pa spro ba na/ /mang mod 'dir ni zur tsam kho na nyid/ /sgyu lus bdag med phung po mchod sbyin gsum/ /dmag nado mu ge'i bzhi rtsa dug gsum sel/ /khreg chod lta ba thabs lam gtum mo yi/ /chos nyid gter dang bde chen sbas yul 'byed/ /lam gyi cha rkyen bar do'i gdams pa yi/ /nang gi 'brog chen 'jigs pa sel bar byed/ /ting 'dzin gegs sel rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /nang gi 'byung khams 'khrul snang gzhi rtsa gcod/ /tshogs drug lam khyer nyon mongs lam khyer gyis/ /nang gi ar jag dgra bo'i gnod pa sgrol/ /'od gsal rmi lam 'pho ba'i man ngag gis/ /'chi dang bar do'i 'khrul snang rang dag byed/ /bla ma rang sems dbyer med man ngag gi/ /'od gsal khor yug 'bras bu mngon su byed/ /rdzogs rim 'di rnams rgya che zab brling don/ /bla ma'i man ngag kho nar rag las pas/ /tshig gi na yam 'ol spyir ma song bar/ /gnad don ma 'khrul yang dag gtan phabs gces/ /man ngag chen po rdzogs rim bcu gsum don/ /tshul bzhin go na brgyad khri bzhi stong chos/ /kun gyi dgongs don rdzogs rim ma lus pa/ /bde blag rtogs shing rang byan tshud par 'gyur/ /nyams su blangs pas tshe gcig rdzogs sangadī nās/ /sku bzhi'i dbang phyug chen po nges thob bo/ /a ti gardzir gu kyā ithiḥ sā mā yāḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ

dha thim/ de ltar gu ru'i sgrub thabs rnam mang po/ /bye ba phrag brgya'i rtse mor gyur pa ni/ /gu ru tsin+ta ma ṇi'i skor brgya rtsa/ /kun gyi yang zhun bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug chos/ /man ngag yid bzhin nor bu dbang gi rgyal/ /'di phyi gtan bde dge legs phun tshogs dpal/ /ma lus 'byung gnas bsam pa lhun grub zhes/ /gu ru'i bka' chems sgrub thabs mchog 'di nyid/ /gzhan gsung gzhung brkus kha bsgyur bsre bslad bcos/ /bka' la gzu lum ras chod don nor 'khrul/ /chos min chos brdzu dran gsal rtog ge'i blos/ /snyogs pa'i skyon gyur nam yang yod ma yin/ /'on kyang gzhung 'di bshad la nyes pa'i cha/ /bdag rmongs so skye byis blo'i dri ci sbag /dpang gyur rtsa gsum spyan sngar mthol bshags kyi/ /sgrib med dag tshangs mchog gi dbugs dbyung stsol/ /e ma gu ru'i sgrub thabs mchog gyur gyi/ /gtso kun gcig dril 'di 'dra ngo mtshar rmad/ /bskyed rdzogs 'di dag gna' nas bzhugs bzhin te/ /don des bskyed rdzogs sngar med 'dir brjod med/ /man ngag bcu gsum bskyed rdzogs go rim gyi/ /'chad tshul 'di 'dra sngon chad gzhan dag gi /ma myong bas na sngon med legs bshad nyid/ /pad 'byung yab yum thugs rje'i gzigs pa yis/ /ma dor mthu las bdag bskal bzang pos brnyed/ /rtsod bral sprul sku rig 'dzin pad+ma dbang / /gter byon man ngag bcu gsum yon tan mdzod/ /shin tu thugs rje'i byin rlabs che gyur pa/ /sngon nas skal ldan rnams la snang gyur mod/ /de ni shog ser 'di ni dgongs gter khyad/ /brgyud khungs lugs srol tha dad shes kyang bya/ /dgongs gter snga ma'i rjes 'brang gsar 'byon mod/ /brda mthun phan tshun yang skyar 'byon ma mthong / /dgongs gter brda chad ci bzhin shog ser du/ /'byon pa dag ni mang du mthong mod pas/ /des na phyi ma'i dus sam da lta'ang rung / /sprul sku gter ston tshad ldan gyur pa yi/ /sgrub skor 'di 'dra shog ser nas thon srid/ /de bas phyis 'byung gzhan kun 'di mthur nges/ /sā mā yā dh+wa thim/ de skad rnga yab gling nas pad 'byung gi /dgongs gtad rjes su gnang bas byin brlab mthus/ /rig 'dzin bla ma'i man ngag kun 'dus shing / /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis gtad rgya sbyin pa'i chos/ /slad med ches zab chos bka' khungs ldan zhing / /byin rlabs nus mthu drod ma yal ba 'di/ /pad+ma ka ra'i thugs kyi sgyu 'phrul ni/ /grub mchog bye bas mchod 'os nam mkha' snying / /gang gi mtshan tsam kho nas byin rlabs kyang / /dge ba'i snying stobs rgyas la som nyi ci/ /tshul des rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'am/ /'od gsal bde gshegs snying po gter bzhed rtsal/ /de yis gzhan phan lhag bsam dag pa yis/ /tshul bzhin yi ge'i ris su bkod pa ste/ /bshad tshe ma nor ji bzhin smra spobs cing / /sgom pa nyams myong byin rlabs rgyun ma chad/ /brgyud par dam sel 'dres khyer ma chud cing / /rang gzo bsre bslad zog gi skyon med pa/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bka' drin nyid du nges/ /chos 'asnyi1 shād+ma he

ru ka'i bka' 'bangs/ /sngags bdag dregs pa'i sde dpon mi bsrun pa/ /mthu chen dam can rgya mtshor gnyer gtad kyi/ /thub par bsrung mdzod badz+ra sā mā yā/ /nyin mtshan dus drug chos 'di'i bya ra gyis/ /legs nyes stang bzung rtags mtshan 'phral du ston/ /zab brling snying po bsdus pa'i gzhung yin pas/ /des na bka' 'grel rgyas bshad ci rigs dang / /gang zag mos bstun bskyed rdzogs dum dum khrig /ci 'dod ma nor spel ba'i rjes gnang gi /de la chos bsrung ko long med pa dang / /dgyes pas dbugs dbyung dge legs bstsal du gsol/ /gzhung 'dis rjes su 'jug min phan tshun du/ /'dra min bzo bcos bsre bslad kha bsgyur brku/ /brtsam gzhi'i yi ge 'thu ba sogs byas na/ /de yi tshe srog drod dbugs dus der bsdus/ /snying dang snying khrag dgyes pa'i dga' ston rol/ /mthu nus rtsal shugs ma zhen dam can tshogs/ /chos 'di la mos nyams len 'chad nyan klog /gus pas yi ger 'dri sbyang byed pa rnams/ /rig 'dzin bka' sdod rgya mtsho'i grogs mdzod la/ /yid bzhin mchog thun dngos grub mchog stsol cig /'di ni snyigs dus duḥ kha kun sel zhing / /skal ldan gsos gyur bdud rtsi bla med de/ /mi rnams dam chos don gnyer chung ba dang / /phyogs 'dzin gdon gyis bslad cing phrag dog dbang / /phal cher lam bzang 'di la 'jug dka' yang / /gu ru'i spyan sngar smon lam bzang po'i mthu//thob gyur bka' bab dam pa mang po yi/ /'dul byar gyur pa man ngag rgyas spel nges/ /rdzogs rim rnams la ye gsang rgyaḥyod pas/ /tshul bzhin ston nus skyes mchog re re tsam/ /'on te mos pa'i brtul zhugs kho nas kyang / /mi bslu don gnyis 'grub pas gtad pa'i rgyaḥ bslu med dgongs gter rnam par dag pa la/ /rgyaḥdes bcings pa kun la shes kyang bya/ /kye ma deng sang dus kyi dbang nyid kyis/ /nyams med mu tig do lo rin thang mnyam/ /chos bzhin spyod pas chos min g.yo can brin/ /tshul bzhin shes shing gzur gnas re re tsam/ /rgyu 'bras yid ches zog med drangs tshig las/ /mi chos bla brdzun 'ur 'ur sgrogs la mgu/ /thos bsam la g.yel che 'dod 'dre thong 'ur/ /dkon mchog mchod dang 'dre mchod ngo so mnyam/ /drod med sngags sgros 'dul 'dzin nag chang rngams/ /khrel med rnal 'byor tho co grub thob zol/ /'ga' zhig chos brgyad snying gab gter ston badzu/ /tshul min chos ltar byas pas rgyal bstan smad/ /zhi dul gzugs la nyon mongs cher rgyas sems/ /bsgom chen zol gyur chos brgyad yo lang mkhan/ /de lta na yang 'ga' ni gnas tshul nyid/ /phal cher bdag snang ma dag kho na'i skyon/ /'on kyang ma smras rgyal bstan sems khur chung / /smras na kun gyis ltas ngan dgra ltar 'dzin/ /mi rnams ma brtags gsar ngas dad 'jug rkyen/ /nam zhig log ltas ngan song skyed 'phel btang / /de bas tshul bzhidwa ༵gas dus dpyad dka' yang / /chos 'brel med skabs cha shas tsam dpyad gces/ /de ltar rang

blo gzu bor gnas sems rung / /gzhan blos log mthong sdig par ma gyur cig /bdag ni spangs rtogs yon tan cang med kyang / /rang gzo gzhan gyi rtsal sgrog ma yin par/ /pad 'byung rdo rje'i gsung gi dbugs dbyung mthu'i/ /gzhan don sems rung bzod pa ma thob stobs/ /ji ltar byas kyang 'gro ba mgu dka' zhing / /dman bzung khyad bsod drangs tshig nga rgyal 'dzin/ /gzhan bstun mi chos ma bstun gshis ngan bzung / /tshul bzhin shes pa srid mtha' tsam yin rung / /lha bdud ngos 'dzin byed mkhan chu bzhin brel/ /phyogs ris chags sdang phrag dog rlung ltar 'tshubs/ /des na gzhan don mi 'grub rang don g.yel/ /spyir yang rang don tshad ldan sngon song na/ /'gro don bya sa mi snyegs dogs dgos ci/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho zad mtha' med lags so/ /de bas re zhig dben pa'i sar gzhol nas/ /dam sdom rnam dag bskyed rdzogs 'bad bsgom pas/ /nam zhig gdul bya ma dad bzlog nus pa'i/ /rdzu 'phrul ya zung mngon par shes pa bcas/ /lus 'di 'byung bzhi'i mi rdzi sgyu ma'i sku/ /thob tshe gdul bya rnams la yan pa'i mchog /rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs ma nor don gsal bar/ /phyogs dus kun tu rgya cher spel bar smon/ /de ltar ma gyur na yang bskyed rdzogs drod/ /ji bzhin nam thob dben par sgom la smon/ /'on kyang bdag la g.yo sgyu bdud las kyi/ /'gro ba bslu ba'i chos ngan ltogs gyur dkon/ /rang nyid gcig pu'i zhi bde 'ba' zhig dang / /'khor ba'i gnas lhung dogs pa'i skyi zing chung / /de lta na yang ma long chang la chu/ /bsing 'dra'i 'gro don yad yud 'di ci bya/ /kye hoḥ bdag ni yang dag bzod pa ma thob bar/ /dal 'byor rten bzang yang thob chos sgor zhugs/ /chos ston dge bshes mchog gis rjes bzung nas/ /thos bsam bzang pos nyin mtshan dus 'da' shog /tshe 'di yun thung chos kyi 'tshe mang bas/ /sgom la 'bad kyis dben pa'i gnas su gzhol/ /theg chen mthar thug sngags kyi lam la zhugs/ /mnyes pa gsum gyis slob dpon mnyes par shog /sdom pa gsum la nyes med rnam dag cing / /rim gnyis lam sgom ring por mi thogs par/ /sa lam nges 'byed yon tan gzhung ba'in skyes/ /don gnyis phun tshogs myur du 'grub par shog /de srid bya ba thams cad byang sems zin/ /bdag gi sgo gsum gzhan la sdig mi bsags/ /gzhan gyis bdag la'ang bsog par mi byed cing / /kun dga' bde ba'i dpal la spyod par shog /byang sems spyod pa rlabs chen yongs grub nas/ /gnas skabs legs nyes spyod la mi brtsi bar/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las du ma yis/ /gang la gang 'dul 'gro don spyod par shog /gal te bdag la gshe bskur ngan brjod mkhan/ /rtag tu zhe sdang phrag dog 'khrug rnams kyang / /sdug pa'i rnam smin nam yang mi myong bar/ /bdag gi 'khor gyur byang chub lhan spyod shog /bdag gi longs spyod 'khor gnyen la 'tshe zhing / /brnag dka' lus dang srog la brdo ba yang / /dmyal ༵sdu myur

thar bdag gi byang chen lam/ /spyod pa'i grogs dang 'phrin las byed par shog /rgyal ba gzhan gyi ches cher 'dul dka'i 'gro/ /log sred can rnams bdag gi gdul byar gyur/ /de dag rang dbang med par sangs rgyas la/ /mi phyed dad skyes byang sems bskyed nus shog /bzod pa thob tshe ngan song gnas kun tu/ /bsam bzhin 'jug nas der gnas nyon mongs can/ /kun gyi sgrib pa sbyang zhing byang chub lam/ /yang dag sa la bdag gi bzhag par shog /gang zhig 'gro ba mi dge mtshams med spyod/ /so thar sdom zhig sngags kyi dam tshig ral/ /mi zad sdig can kun kyang bdag gi ming / /thos pa'i sdig zad thar pa'i lam zhugs shog /bdag ni skye ba kha shas tsam kho nas/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mngon thob byed/ /de lta na yang dag pa'i sa gsum la/ /gnas tshul byang chub sems 'dir dbang gyur shog /skye 'gro ji srid sa ru tshul 'di 'dzin/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang sras slob 'phags pa rnams/ /dgyes pa'i spyod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /rgyun chad med par bdag gis 'bad par shog /rgyal dang rgyal sras gzhan gyi 'dul dka' ba'i/ /gdul bya thams cad bdag gi dngas len nas/ /thabs mkhas zhi drag spyod pa du ma yis/ /de dag sangs rgyas sras su zhugs par shog /gang zhig sangs rgyas kyis 'dul 'gro ba la/ /sangs rgyas su sprul de bzhin gang 'dul ba/ /de yi gzugs sprul gdul bya'i blo dbang med/ /bsgyur nas theg chen lam la zhugs byed shog /bdag gi dag pa'i byang sems tshul bzung nas/ /byang sems spyod pas byang sems nye sras brgyad/ /theg chen smon lam mdzad 'phrin mtha' dag kun/ /gcig tu bzlum ltar bdag gis 'grub par shog /nam zhig bdag nyid rdzogs sangs rgyas gyur na/ /bde chen zhing 'dra'i sangs rgyas gaṅga klung / /sku tshe mdzad 'phrin 'dus pa dam chos yun/ /de snyed bdag gis gcig car mngon byed shog /de ltar bdag gi theg chen smon lam kun/ /dkon mchog bden pas bslu med nyid 'grub cing / /bdag gang mthong thos dran reg 'gro bas kyang / /smon lam mchog 'di thun mong spyod par shog /de bzhin bdag gi 'dus dang 'dus ma byas/ /dge tshogs ma gyur 'gro la yongs bsngo bas/ /kun kyang lhag bsam byang chub sems bskyed nas/ /bdag gi smon lam bzang po 'dir 'jug shog /bdag gi chos kyi rgyud 'dzin slob ma'i rigs/ /ci tsam gnas pa de dag thams cad la/ /rig 'dzin rgyal ba rgya mtshos byin brlabs nas/ /byang chub chen po'i 'bras bu myur thob shog /de srid 'jig rten mchog dang 'jig rten las/ /'das pa'i mchog kun 'bad med yongs su thob/ /mdor na bdag gi smon lam mchog gang btab/ /dge 'bras rnams la de dag nges spyod shog /snyigs dus sdug bsngal gyis mnar 'gro ba rnams/ /skyobs byed gu ru'i sgrub thabs thams cad kyi/ /dgongs bcud bskyed rdzogadī ༵na ngag kun 'dus 'di/ /tshul bzhin yi ger bkod pa'i dge ba yang / /bod yul rje 'bangs

bde skyid rgyas pa dang / /shākya'i tog gi bstan pa nyams med cing / /'od gsal rdo rje snying bstan dar zhing rgyas/ /bshad sgrub bzang pos nor 'dzin yongs khyab shog /ma lus 'gro ba'i snying dbus phan bde'i mchog /gu ru pad+ma'i byin rlabs yongs zhugs nas/ /smin grol gdengs thob bde ba can zhing du/ /rgyal tshab sa thob byang chen myur 'grub shog /jo bo 'gro kun lam 'dir 'jug smon pas/ /de ltar gyur nas drin len ldon pa dang / /tshul 'di'i khyab bdag rtsa ba'i bla ma yi/ /dgongs pa bskang phyir bsngo bas dgyes myur shog /de ltar pad 'byung thugs rje'i chu gter las/ /rmad byung dam chos sgra dbyangs rgyun mi chad/ /phun tshogs rin chen mchog gis yongs khengs pas/ /skye dgu dge legs dpal kun rgyas gyur cig /zhes sangs rgyas yongs kyi rgyal po/ sangs rgyas kyi sprin 'phro ba gu ru pad+ma ka ra'i gsol 'debs gtso bo bsam pa lhun grub kyi man ngag 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus 'byung ba'i gter khyim/ bla ma'i sgrub thabs thams cad kyi dgongs bcud yid bzhin nor bu lta bu ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba 'di ni/ gu ru'i byin rlabs kyi mtshan ma rnyed nas dus ring zhig lon pa lcags phag lor la stod rgyal gyi shrī ru yig cha bkod par sems tshe/ nyang gi rigs 'dzin skyes bu mchog gyur pad ma dbang drag nas/ rig 'dzin yongs 'dus lugs bsam pa lhun grub zhal thang zhig gnang ba yang rten 'brel legs lam du gyur cing / de mus su gangs can bu ler phyin nas der 'bri bar brtsams kyang ji bzhin dus la ma bab par rtogs pas re zhig bzhag phyir chu byi lor la stod byang gnas chen zang zang lha brag tu bka' rgyaḥgrol ba'i ltas byung bar brten/ de yi dgun la stod lho gram mtsho bsam rdzong du don gnyer can rnams la chos sgo cung zad phyes shing / slar chu glang lo gzhug tu phyogs nas las bskal smon lam bzang pos grub gyur skyes bu ci rigs pa chos 'di'i ched du 'dus shing gsol ba btab pa dang / mkha' 'gros kyang gnang ba yang dag sbyin pas dus la babs par shes nas/ gu ru'i bsgrub gnas ru lag grom pa rgyang gi bya 'dabs su/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor
