bus rang lo sum bcu'i gung du slebs pa/ hor zla bcu gnyis pa rgyud rgyal rdo rje gdan bzhi dang mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i bzhed pa ltar na kun dga' zhes shing stag gi lo zhal gsar du ngom pa rgyal gyi zla ba'i yar tshes lnga nas thun skabs cung zad rer bris pa'i 'phro tshes bzang bco lnga la grub par byas pa ste bka' rgyaḥganyer rgyaḥ dam rgyaḥ gsang rgyaḥ spel rgyaḥ gtad rgyaḥ gnyan rgyaḥ man ngag 'di la shin tu zab cing rab tu gces pa'i rgyaḥ bdun yod do/ / ithiḥ gu h+yaḥ yang smras pa/ sngon chos zab cher brgyud pa nye ring / /nye rgyud chos la yid gnyis ma byed/ /bla med chos la rtse gcig bsgom 'tshal/ /ring min rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub shog /zhes pa'ang gdams so/ /maṅga lo bha waskyo/ dge'o/ / 421

༄sto /zab lam u pa de sha'i skor las 'pho ba'i ngag 'don bde chen lam bzang bzhugs so//trīḥ bdag lus 'dzin med snang stong 'od kyi lus: phyi ni 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi sku: dkar gsal zhal gcig mdzes 'dzum dwangs pa'i spyan: phyag bzhi dang po thal sbyar 'og ma gnyis: shel 'phreng pad dkar 'dzin bcas zhi ba'i tshul: rin chen dbu rgyan mgul dpung phyag zhabs brgyan: dar dkar gser spras sku yi smad g.yogs shing : ri dwags e n+ya'i pags pas nu g.yon 'geb: rdo rje skyil krung 'od zer bye bas bltam: dbu yi gtsug tor rtse mor pad 'dab brgyad: de steng rtsa ba'i bla ma pad 'byung dang : dbyer med snang mtha'i cha lugs sprul sku'i chas: dbu la gtsug tor zhabs la 'khor los mtshan/ /chos gos gsum gsol mnyam bzhag lhung bzed bsnams: 'khor du brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor bzhugs dmigs: rang lus nang ni 'od kyi gong bu med: stong gsal phru ma phus btab lta bu'i dbus: tshe gtan sad ma dmar po 'dab brgyad pa: ze'u 'bru dmar seng steng du nyi zla mtsher: de steng rang sems thig ge dngul chu'i mdog: sran tsam phrig phrig g.yo ba'i rnam pa bcas: gsang ba dbu ma'i rang bzhin dwangs gsal 'drongs: shel gyi sbub ltar mar sne je phra zum: yar sne je sbom spyi bor pad+ma'i dbyibs: kha gyes dbus su rang sems brten rten gsal:de ngang bla brgyud gsol ba 'di ltar 'debs: oṃ ā:rgyu trī: chos sku kun bzang yab yum la gsol ba 'debs: longs sku 'od dpag med mgon la ྾ sprul sku spyan ras gzigs dbang la ྾ rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas la ྾ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal la ྾ gar dbang 'ja' tshon snying po la ྾ sgrub chen bkra shis 'gro 'dul la ྾ rig 'dzin bdud 'dul rdo rje la ྾ grub dbang klong gsal snying po la ྾ pad+ma bde chen gling pa la ྾ rnal 'byor tshe dbang nor bu la ྾zab lam 'pho bas mkha' la spyod pa dang ྾ 'chi kha mnar spyod sdug bsngal mi 'byung zhing : rnam shes dbu ma tshangs pa'i sgor thon te: bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs: zhes dang / phaṭa brjod tshe na rang sems thig le de: rgyang gi yar 'phos snang mtha'i zhabs la reg: r+ghaṃ brjod tshe na thig le mar bab nas: sngar bzhin pad dbus nyi zla'i steng gnas bsam: thun mthar snang mthar stong gsum tshe bcud 'dus: snang mtha' 'od zhu rang lus bdud rtsis khengs: 'chi med gzhom bral rdo rje'i skur 422

gyur bsam: de ngang badz+ra gu ru brgya rtsa bzla: oṃ ā:hūṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid dhi rgyu trī: des ni tshe bsring 'pho ba'i 'go 'don yin: 'pho ba'i rtags dang 'chi kha'i 'pho ba ni: zhal nas shes shing 'di ni yang zab so: zhes 'pho ba'i ngag 'don gsal ba 'di ni: 'pho ba'i rtags ni/ spyi bo za ba dang /bkrang ba dang / khol ba dang / g.ya' ba dang / rdol ba/ khrag dang chu ser rdol ba sogs byung zhing /sems phya phyo gtad med lhang lhang ba zhig byung ba ste/ de tsam nas dmigs pa tshod bzung ngo / /de nas gsol 'debs la brtson/ phyogs med kyi sprang ban tshe dbang nor bu'i brag gad seng ge gnam rdzong du yos zla'i tshes bcu bdun la sbyar ba dge'o:rog /zab lam thugs gter u pa de sha las/ gcod yul snying por dril ba ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lhang khrag bdud rtsi'i yang zhun bzhugs so/e ma rang rig skye 'gag bral: yod ma myong la grub ma myong : med ma myong la chad ma myong : e ma rang rig sangs rgyas so: brjod du med la bsam du med: tshor du med la myong du med: shin tu gsal la rab tu bkra: stong la thugs rje'i rtsal che ba: mtha' bral sems 'di ya mtshan che: e ma rang rig blo las 'das: sa ler gsal bas sgrib pa med: rjen ner shar bas 'khrul pa bral: wa ler snang bas bzung 'dzin 'das: hrig ger 'char bas rtog med sangs: e ma rang rig rgyal ba'i yul: 'di la su yi gzhom du med: gzhig bral stong nyid rdo rje 'chang : e ma skye med ngo re mtshar: e ma 'gag med shar ba mtshar: e ma rang byung ye shes so: e ma spyod yul rmad du byung : e ma e ma a la la:zhes pa'i don nyams su len pa la mdor bsdus na rnam pa gsum ste: phyi snang ba lha 'dre'i snyems thag gcod pa dang : nang gdos bcas gces 'dzin gyi rtog pa gcod pa dang : gsang ba gnyis 'dzin sems kyi 'khrul rtog gcod pa dang gsum ste: dang po phyi lha 'drer snang ba'i snyem thag gcod pa la gsum ste: 'di lta ste: snang srid sde brgyad lha 'dre'i tshogs: bla mar shes pas gsol ba 'debs: pha mar shes pas snying rje bskyed: rang sems shes pas mnyam par bzhag: zhes pa'i don te: de la nyams su ji ltar blangs zhe na: de la thog mar gnas dben pa gnyan khrod gang du rung bar: lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dngos nyams rmi lam du shar ba'am: rang gi 'khu 'phrig rtogs pas ya nga ba skyi za ba 'jigs skrag gang byung ba'i tshe: de la mi dga' ba'am: mi gus mi mos pa gtan nas med par: lha 'dre de 423

dag ni bla ma'i ngo bo: cho 'phrul de dag ni bla ma'i sprul bsgyur shes par byas nas: e ma bdag gi nyams dang rtogs pa'i bogs skyed 'don zhing 'khrul snang rang sar grol ba'i ched du bla mas rdzu 'phrul 'di lta bu'i bdag rjes su bzung ba bka' drin re che snyam nas: dad pas spu g.yo bar byas nas bla ma la gsol 'debs rgyang 'bod byas la: mthar lha 'dre de dag bla ma rdo rje 'chang pad 'byung yab yum du mos nas dbang bzhi blang rjes rang la bstem ste: rang sems brjod med blo 'das zang kha ma yi ngang du mnyam par bzhag go: des ni lha 'dre rnams bla mar shar bas nyon mongs kyi bdud bcom: gsol ba 'debs pas phung po'i bdud bcom: dbang bzhi blangs pas 'chi bdag bdud bcom: rang sems ngang du bzhag pas lha'i bu'i bdud bcom ste: bdud bzhi las grol nas rtogs mtsho brdol rkyen ngan grogs su sharoḥ mchog gi dngos grub bde blag tu thob pa'o: i thi+oḥ gnyis pa ni: 'di ltar bar gcod rtsom pa'i lha 'dre 'byung po dam sri gzhi bdag pho mo klu dang ma ning gang yang rung ba 'di ye nas bdag gi pha'o: ma'o: bdag gi bu'o: gnyen no: pha mar ma byas pa med la: des na da res bdag gis ci nas kyang lus 'dis drin len rlan par bgyid snyam pa dung nger byas la: phaṭa: zhes brjod pas rang lus la rigs drug sa bon rnams mchis pa bsreg gtor sbyangs nas lus bdud rtsi chen por byin gyis brlab nas lha 'dre'i tshogs la drin las tshul du 'bul zhing : phaṭa: gdab: yang rang gi dge ba'i tshogs rnams lha 'dre la bsngo zhing : lha 'dre'i sdig sgrib rnams rang la bstem zhing : snying rje lhang nge ba byas la: mthar dmigs med blta ba'i ngang la lha 'dre rang sems chos nyid rol par la bzla la mnyam par bzhag go: des ni bsod nams kyi tshogs rlabs po che rdzogs shing : ye shes kyi rtogs pa rgyud la 'char nas mkha' mnyam sems can gyi don thogs pa med par 'grub: 'brel tshad don dang ldan zhing lha 'dre rnams kyi bu ltar du brtse zhing skyong la thun mong gi dngos grub mi 'dod bzhin du 'du'o: ā+o thi: gsum pa 'di ltar snang ba snod dang srid pa bcud kyis bsdus pa'i 'gro ba lha 'dre mi zhes ming gi tha snyad du byas pa mtha' dag ye nas ma grub zhing : gshis gdod nas skye ma myong la: da yang grub pa med kyis: rang sems 'khrul pa'i snang bar ma grub bzhin yod par 'dod pa: des rmi lam gyi skyes bu'am: sgyu ma'i 'phrul 'khor gyi myong reg bzhin du snang ste: de dag kyang rtag chad kyi mtha' dang bral zhing : chu zla'am: dha ru ra yi nus pas mig 'phrul du shar ba ltar: rang bab gshis su thams cad du grub cing thams cad du shar ba kun kyang : chos nyid rang mdangs rang rtsal chen po la ming gi tha snyad du btags pa thams cad blo ste: blo las 'das pa'i tshe na: gang yang ma grub cing gang yang ma 'gag pa: rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs rang las byung zhing rang la gnas rang la thim pa ltar: rang byung 424

rang thim rang shar rang grol gzhi med rtsa bral gdod ma'i gnas lugs nyid du la bzla ste: de lta bu rtogs pa'i skyes bu de la 'khor ba myang 'das/ bde sdug lha 'dre/ mtho ris ngan song gi rtog pa dang bral/ rang bzhin gyi mkhyen pa gnyis dang ldan nas gdul bya'i don la spyod pa'o/ /de ltar yang / dang po'i dus su go /bar du nyams su myong / mthar rtogs/ mthar thug pa'i tshe na rtog pa dang bral ba'o/ /de ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba'i tshig go de yang las dang po'i tshe/ lha 'dre la 'jigs skrag gi rtog pa shar ba'i tshe 'jigs skrag gi rgyu rkyen/ gang nas byung / gang gis bskyed/ mthar 'jigs skrag gi ngo bo de ci 'dra 'dug brtag pas/ 'jigs skrag de thog mar yod pa'i rgyu stong / bar du gnas pa'i rkyen stong / mthar 'jigs bskrag gi ngo bo dang bral bar stong had nge ba/ sngar 'das kyi rtog pa chad/ma 'ongs pa'i rtog pa ma lang / da lta'i rtog pa ma phros pa/ 'di ni dus gsum dus bral skad cig gi shes pa zhes bya ba ste/ de ni sems rig pa la thim pa'i dus sam/ rig pa rang thog tu shar zhes pa yin pas/ de ngang du bcas bcos gang yang mi byed rang bab lhug par skyong bas/ rnam rtog blos byas kyi lha 'dre yal nas don dam blo bral gshis kyi ngo bo nyid rjen la shar nas de kho na nyid mi rtog rtog bral gyi ngo bo mthong bar 'gyur zhing / de mus su dus dang spyod lam kun tu ma yeng mi bsgom par dran pa'i rtsi dang ldan bzhin du nyams su len no/ /de bas deng dus kha cig gis lha 'dre rang sems yin no snyam nas gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa chen pos bcing ba dang / sems stong pa yin no snyam nas blos byas rgyas 'debs kyi shor sar ltung ba sogs kyi gnas lugs don la sgrib pas rang bab gshis gnyug ma'i ngang du rtog dpyod med par klod pa ni gnad dam pa'o/ /gsang ba spyod kyi man ngag zab mo ā+o bhā: de ltar phyi snang yul lha 'dre'i snyems thag gcod par byed pa'i gdams pa ste: da ni gnyis pa nang gdos bcas kyi gces 'dzin rtog pa gcod par byed pa la don rnam pa bzhi ste: 'di lta ste: sgyu ma lus kyi phung po ste: mi gtsang yin pas zhen log bsgom: sa bon yin pas bsreg sbyangs kyis: 'dod yon yin pas mchod sbyin thong : bag chags sgyu lus lam khyer bya: zhes pa ste: de la nyams su ci ltar byang zhe na:thog mar rang gi lus kyi phung po 'jig pa'i chos can 'di nyid/ 'phrul pa'i rnam par shes pa de/ pha ma'i khu khrag gi rgyar 'thum nas/ bag chags kyi lus su snang ba 'di/ phyi nang thams cad srin bu mi zad pa du ma dang / mi gtsang ba'i rdzas sum bcu so bdun gyi yongs su khengs shing / nyon mongs pa rnams yongs su bskyod pa dang yongs su 'thas par byed cing / lus 'di la brten nas/ sdug bsngal ba dang / 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal du ma yi rgyu bsags pa dang / 'phral du yang / zas dang gos kyi gdung bas/ chos las phyir bsres pa la sogs pa/ chos dang mi mthun pa'i rgyu mtha' dag lus 425

'di la zhen sred kyis bcings pa kho na'i skyon te/ de yang / deng lus 'di la brtse gdung gces spras du ma yi/ grang gi dogs na gos dro 'jam mang du gon pa dang / lus tshad pas dub pa gsal phyir bsil bar byed pa'i thabs du ma brten pa dang / de bzhin du zas skom la chog mi shes par ci ltar spyad par bya ba de dag gi gnyer khas phral du mi tshe de ngang du 'jams nas chos kyi bya ba mi 'grub cing / phung po la zhen sred chen po byas pa de ni snying po med par mes sreg chus khyer/ rlung gi g.yeng / sa la sba/shing du bcug pa sogs rkyen du mas 'jig cing / sha za rnams kyi kha zas su 'gyur cing / 'bad pa du mas bsags pa'i zas nor longs spyod rnams kyang gzhan gyis hab thob du khyer zhing / rang gis tshe 'di'i byas pa thams cad don med pa mi rtag pa'i chos can de lta bu la bsam nas/ cis kyang dgos med rgyud la bskyed par bya ste/ de yang dal 'byor gyis bco brgyad ldan pa'i mi lus rin po che 'di nyid shin tu rnyed par dka' ba u dusmra ra lta bur bsngags pa ni/ dge ba'i sa bon bsgrun nus na yin gyi/ de ltar ma yin pa ni/ mi dang re zhig dmyal bar skyes pa mtshungs pa las dmyal ba lhag ste/ ci phyir dmyal ba ni snga ma'i las sbyang pa ste/ mis ni lus 'dis sdig pa bsags shing dge ba ma grub na/ slar dmyal bar sdug bsngal rgyun ring sbyangs pa'i phyir ro: ngan song mtho ris gnas nas 'khor zhes pa ste:des na lus dal 'byor bco brgyad kyis brgyan pa 'di nyid thar pa byang chub sgrub byed kyi sems chags pa'i gnas g.yar khang rnyed dka' tsam du shes nas/ lhag skyob tsam gyi gso dang / srog 'tsho tsam gyi zas snyom gang byung tsam la chog shes shing / dam pa'i chos phyir dka' spyad snying rus brten pa ma rtogs/ lus la zhen sred kyi dbang gis zas gos la chog mi shes par ched du gnyer ba dang / nyon mongs pa 'dod khro lung ma bsten pa nga rgyal phrag dog dregs 'chos rtsing spyod kyi dbang du mi btang zhing / dus rgyun du ro snyoms kyi spyod pa la gnas par bya ste: des ni phung po'i zhen 'dzin las grol: spang blang gi gegs dang bral: re dogs 'phrang las thar: tshe 'dir rnam mkhyen byang chub kyi 'bras bu 'grub par 'gyur ro:zhi thi: gu h+ya: zab rgya: gnyis pa sa bon bsreg sbyangs kyi rim pa la: thog mar gnas yid mthun dben par: sngon du 'gro ba'i bya ba rnams grub nas gdan bde bar lus gnad dang bcas te: rang gi lus la ma rig pas bskyed pa'i rigs drug gi sa bon yi ge drug la brten nas: yang nas yang du 'khor bar 'di ltar sdug bsngal du ma la spyod pa rnams la snying re rje+oḥ da ni lus ma dag pa'i yi ger brten nas rigs drug 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal thams cad dus de ring nas bdag gis sbyangs bar bya'o sems bskyed nas: 426

gag /snyan brgyud ḍāk+ki'i gan mdzod rdo rje snying po'i skor las don dam thig le ye shes kyi dgongs pa 'od gsal snang bar brjod pa rnal 'byor gyi rdo rje'i thol glu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /a ho/ rang rig chos sku ye snang ka dag gshis/ /rang gdangs longs sku 'od gsal lhun grub gdangs/ /rang byung sprul sku gang shar rig pa'i rtsal/ /rang rig bde chen chos nyid dbyings su mchod/ /de gnyis gzhi snang ka nas dag pa la/ /rang rtsal ma 'gags bag chags ldan pa'i dus/ /kun gzhi zhes te ma rig sangs pa'i tshe/ /don dam thig le ye shes rig par brjod/ /zung 'jug kun rdzob thig le bcu drug chas/ /rig snang de shar ngo ma zin pa'i tshe/ /nyon mongs rags pa'i rtog pa zhes su bya/ /ngo zin rang gdangs 'od gsal bde bar shar/ /don la rang rig gu yangs spros bral ba/ /zang kha rjen ne bde sdug rang rtsal ngang / /dga' bzhi bgrod med skad cig cer grol klong / /rig pa brjod med bde stong gcig tu 'dres/ /stong pa chal chad ma yin bde lhang nge / /bde ba ther zug ma yin stong sangs nge / /bde stong ro gcig 'od gsal dbyings su thim/ /thim bya thim rgyu gud med 'di klong rol/ /thabs ro shes kyang dbyer med dbu sku gsum sbub rtsa kyi klong / /don dam thig le ye shes 'od du 'khyil/ /rang gdangs sku bzhi'i lam nas dbyings su thon/ /rang rig rtsol rtsod yongs bral rdo rje'i theg /nam mkha' gsum klong mngon sum dbyings su 'dres/ /brjod tshig dpyod bral snod bcud 'byung lnga dang / /dug lnga dag lus yid 'phrogs thams cad pa/ /rig pa 'od gsal bum pa'i klong las ni/ /gud du rtsal bral 'od gsal 'khor yug ngang / /ri rgyal rtse nas ri phran bltad mo bzhin/ /brjod med ye shes 'od gsal klong yangs su/ /rig pa'i rang rtsal nor bu'i 'od bzhin du/ /dbyer med khyab brdal dbyings su e ma ho/ /de ltar don dam 'od gsal zung 'jug pa/ /rang rig mchog la chos kun la zla zhing / /rtsol med dbang por 'char ba rdzogs pa che/ /nges don rang nyams ci zhig thol glu ste/ /rdo rje snying po 'di la gzhan ci zhig /de bas snyan brgyud rin chen mdzod las ni/ /nor bu mchog 'di glu ru blangs nas ni/ /gang shar rig pa'i gdangs las snang byas so/ /zhes ḍāk+ki zab lam gyi skor las don dam gyi bde ba rang rig 'od gsal gyi dgongs pa rang nyams mnyam bzhag ngang la sngags kyi rnal 'byor tshe dbang nor bu kun bzang 'od gsal gyi rang lo nyi shu tham pa rtsa gcig la 'pho ba'i skabs su ri bo bya khyung gi mgul se'u lung dgon du bris pa'i rig byed ni pad+ma nor bu'i sprul sku tshe dbang nor bus bgyis pa'o/ /maṅga lo/ 427

༄ga /ḍāk+ki gsang lam las: tshe yi bsgrub pa spros med snying po bcud dril rdo rje pha lam/oṃ 'chi med dpal la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /gang zhig 'gro ba'i don dag phyi sgrub dang : rang gi nyams su 'di kho na'o 'di kho na'o/ /blang ba yi: rgyun khyer ḍāk+ki gsang lam gyis chos: tshe bsgrub pa yi gdams pa khyad 'phags ni: trī: tho rangs cha la rang nyid skad cig bskyed rim gis: rta phag lhar gsal rlung ro dgu phrug sngon 'gro bud rjes der: dal bus rlung rngubs bcu drug rang gis lus nang kun: stong stong ra gsal rtsa gsum 'khor lo rtsa yi lnga ldan la: 'khor lo lnga dbus ḍāk+ki yab yum sa bon ni: gliḥmaḥraḥhaḥtsaḥriḥtrīḥniḥya saḥ srog yig bcu de ḍāk+ki yab yum bcuḥ gsal gdams rlung gis lte ba'i lha zhugs bskyed gar bskulaḥ bde chen dbyings nas bde ba'i badz+ra ḍāk+ki lha gar charaḥ rab g.yos rlung btang 'phros gnas lnga dkyil sku gsum dkar dmar mthing mdangs/ lcags kyu'i dbyibs kyis 'khor 'das rang byung khams lnga rnamasaḥ drangs nas rlung bcu bdun 'dus mdangs 'od lnga kun rdar thimaḥ sku gang bde g.yo bdud rtsi nar ma'i rgyunaḥ bdag lus mer gang 'khor lngar rig lnga'i phyag mtshan: srog dngas rgyas 'debs 'byung ba snyoms par snying po dkar dmar blangs: de rjes rang lus phyi ni gnam lcags pha lam gyis: rdo rje rtse lnga gzhom pa bral ba'i me 'bar nang : rtsa gsum 'khor lnga gdab pa rig lnga'i mtshan: chos 'khor sangs rgyas snying dbus rang badz+ra a yu ṇi: bdag bsam: sgo bsrung rtsir rta ha ya gyi wa dmar 'tsher bhe: rdo rje'i bzlas pa gliḥdang rang srog bcuḥ tshe bdag rgyal ba'i dgongs pa 'bru brgyad bzlasaḥ bcud du trīḥ gsum 'bru gsum blang ba'oḥ rdzogs rim 'jog khar dal bus rlung btang dmigs med dang ཿ 'dzin med gang shar rig pas rgyas theb paraḥ sa ler sing nger btang blta mi btang b.raḥ stong gsal khyab brdal chen po'i ngang la bzhagaḥ mṛthiḥ gsang chen nges pa 'di'o bdud rtsi yinaḥ trīḥtrīḥtrīḥ bdud rtsi'i bcud 'di rmu gu'i rtsi ru shogaḥ rda thimaḥ skal ldan las 'phro bzang gi spyod yul shogaḥ skal med log lta can la gsang ngo rgyaḥ khaṃthāḥ zhal shes snyan du brgyud par srolaḥ gu h+yaḥ e ma gsang chen 'di ni rnga yab nasaḥ mgon cig pad+ma thod 'phreng dgongs pa'i bcudaḥ rdo rje ḍāk+ki'i thugs la shar ba'i mdangasaḥ skal ldan bu la bskul nas babs so skadaḥ rda thimaḥ ces pa 'di 428

nyid ni bdag 'dra dus snyigs dus yul mtha' 'khob skyes pa'i rnal 'byor pa tshe dbang nor bu pad+ma 'od gsal lam gar dbang bdag rang lo nyi shur nye ba gser 'a spyang gi sprel zla'i tshes brgyad la ḍāk+kis brdas bskul nas mdo khams kyi ri bo bkrag bzang gis byang phyogs chu bo 'jang chu dal 'bab kyi 'grams su ḍāk+ki gsang lam shar ba'i thog mar snying thig chos tshan 'di nyams nas phyungs te bris pa'i ris byed yang rang gis sprel zla'i tshes 13bzang la snang bar byas so /rog /ḍāk+ki gsang lam las gsol 'debs rin po che yi phreng ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ hrīḥ 'og min mthing nag thig le 'bar ba nasaḥ chos sku kun tu bzang po la gsol ba 'debs soḥ byin gyis rlobs rgyu hūṃ r+ghaṃ trīḥ rig lnga ye shes lnga yi zhing khams nasaḥ longs sku rigs kyi bder gshegs la gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs cigaḥ rgyu r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ hrīḥ dur khrod me ri 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nasaḥ dpa' bo ston pa bcu gsum la gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shigaḥ hūṃ r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ trīḥdur khrod gsang chen rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nasaḥ dpal chen rdo rje 'dzin pa la gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shigaḥ r+ghaṃ hūṃ r+ghaṃ trīḥ ko sha 'od kyi khang pa nasaḥ slob dpon dga' rab rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shigaḥ r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ trīḥ sing kha la yi dur khrod nasaḥ bram ze 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shigaḥ r+ghaṃ rgyu r+ghaṃ trīḥ na na'i 'du khang thog ma nasaḥ rig 'dzin shrī ri sing ha la gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shigaḥ r+ghaṃ hūṃ r+ghaṃ trīḥ bā sing nag gis dur khrod nasaḥ rig 'dzin ye shes dri med la gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs cigaḥrgyu r+ghaṃ rgyu trīḥ rnga yab dpal ri'i pho brang chen po nasaḥ rig 'dzin pad+ma thod 'phreng la gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shigaḥ rgyu r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ trīḥ rnga yab raḥ'i grong khyer nasaḥ ma cig bde chen rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shigaḥ r+ghaṃ hūṃ r+ghaṃ trīḥ thugs rjes sprul pa'i pho brang nasaḥ rig 'dzin chen po lnga la gsol ba byin gyis rlobs shigaḥ hūṃ rgyu hūṃ trīḥ ltar snang sgyu ma'i khong pa nasaḥ rnal 'byor karma 'gro 'dul la gsol la 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shigaḥ rgyu phroṃ r+ghaṃ trīḥ gang 'dul der ston gyi pho brang nasaḥ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shigaḥ rdu r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ trīḥ dag pa rab 'byams dkyil 'khor nasaḥ yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams la gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shigaḥ rtsu r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ trīḥ chos dbyings dur khrod chen po nasaḥ ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shigaḥ r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ trīḥ o rgyan ḍāk+ki'i pho brang nasaḥ rigs kyi mkha' 'gro sde lnga ༵ py-isol

ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shigaḥ hūṃ r+ghaṃ rgyu trīḥ gnas yul nyi shu rtsa brgyad nasaḥ ma mo mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag la gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shigaḥ rdu rgyu rgyu trīḥ bstan bsrung pho brang chen po nasaḥ mgon po ma lcam dral la gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs shigaḥ r+ghaṃ hūṃ r+ghaṃ trīḥ mkha' spyod me 'bar pho brang nasaḥ zhing skyong gzi ldan yab yum la gsol ba 'debs soḥ r+ghaṃ rgyu rgyu hrīḥ bka' rgyud rtsa gsum bla ma laḥ snying nas dad pas gsol 'debs kyi bu la byin gyis rlobs shigaḥ rdu r+ghaṃ hūṃ trīḥ de ltar gsol 'debs kyi bu laḥ dbang bzhi cig car du byin gyis rlobs shigaḥ rdu rgyu ju hrīḥ de ltar gsol 'debs kyi bu bdagaḥ bskyed rdzogs gdings mthar skyol ba byin gyis rlobs shigaḥ r+ghaṃ rgyu r+ghaṃ trīḥ de ltar gsol 'debs kyi bu bdagaḥ snang bzhi mtha' ru gdengs bzhi'i drod tshad rnyed par byin gyis rlobs shigaḥ r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ trīḥ ma 'gag chos nyid kyi lta baḥ ma bsgom rang babs kyi bsgom paḥ ma yengs 'khrul med kyi spyod paḥ ma rtsal bzhi thog gi 'bras buḥ rig grol khyab brdal chen por byin gyis rlobs shigaḥrdu rgyu rdu trīḥtrīḥtrīḥ rdu rgyu r+ghaṃ trīḥ.ā+oṃḥtrīḥ rgyu rgyu rgyuḥtrīḥ oṃ āḥrgyuḥho sarba sirnyi ཿpha laḥ hrīḥ e ma ḍāk+ki gsang lam snying po bcud las niḥ nye bar snang ba'i byin rlabs rin chen mdzodaḥ myur du blang byed 'di las gzhan ci zhigaḥde bas 'di ni ḍāk+ki dus chen sprel zla'i tshes brgyad laḥ ye shes ḍāk+ki srid pa'i ngang tshul desaḥ 'od gsal klong du snang bar brdas bskul nasaḥ dgongs pa bu la gtad de'i mthu yi niḥ rang gis nyams la bkra bar 'di shar snang ཿ ces pa nyid ni rang lo nyi shur nye ba'i gser 'phyang gi tshes bzang brgyad la ḍāk+ki brda' tshig rnams shar yang ḍāk+ki nyid kyi gsung 'di gsol 'debs byin rlabs che bzhes rtsal ba zhig phyung ste saṃskṛta'i skad du 'dug pa ma go yang / rnal 'byor bdag klong nas ri bo bkra bzang gi byang phyogs 'jang chu'i zur chos sna ru gar dbang pad+ma rtsal lam tshe dbang nor bus tshes bcu gsum bzang la bris te snyan brgyud thugs kyi ni rdi'i thog ma nyid du shar ba yin noḥ 430

༄gi /shrachuyaḥpad+māpuṣ+karonul+lakasmikaidiwākarasushakaṭanamot+taraman+t+rasushāstestamahāgurupad+mākarabimok+ṣadhaṣaṇabidzahar/ /khog /bla med sngags kyi ston mchog gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi rnam thar gsol 'debs dad pa'i pad tshal rgyas pa'i las can nyin mo byed pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ swāsnyi/ dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal mchog dam pa dang po'i sangs rgyas//kun tu bzang po kun khyab rgyal ba/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba rdo rje sems gyur/ /'od dpag med pa 'jig rten dbang phyug /sangs rgyas kun gyi 'phrin las byed po/ /rgyal ba yongs kyi snying rje'i rang gzugs/ /gdul dka' 'dul ba'i ded dpon zla med/ /he ru ka shrī pad+ma badz+ra/ /bde chen zhing gi 'khor los bsgyur rgyal//zhing 'dir thub pa'i rgyal tshab tshul sprul/ /khyed la snying nas gus pas gsol 'debs/ /da lta dus 'dir byin rlobs stsol cig /rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes rgya mtshor/ /brtse chen pad+ma'i sbubs su sku 'khrungs/ /rang byung mtsho skyes rdo rje sems dpa'/ /o rgyan rgyal po thor cog can zhes/ /mi la ya mtshan rmad byung sprul sku/ /cho 'phrul gsum gyi 'gro kun 'dren mdzad/ /thub bstan mdzes rgyan gcig pu pa gyur/ /khyed la gsolalha'adebs byin gyis rlobs shig /mi mjed bskal bzang sgron ma bzhi pa/ /thub chen rgyal po chos 'khor bskor tshe/ /gang gi thugs dang gnyis su med pa/ /o rgyan rgyal po in+d+ra bho dhi/ /theg chen thun min kun gyi gleng bslang / /sngags rnams kun gyi sdud pa byed po/ /rgyud kyi bdag po rdo rje 'chang dbang / /khyed la gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs shig /thub dbang gzugs sprul zhi bar brtul nas/ /brgyad gnyis lo lon ka pa'i mtsho dbus/ /mi mjed 'gro ba'i mun pa sel phyir/ /u dum wa ra'i ge sar ze'u 'brur/ /rang byung khye'u pad+ma 'byung gnas/ /mkha' 'gro mkha' 'gro ma tshogs kyis bskor/ /mi min 'gro ba'i ston par snang gyur/ /khyed la gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs shig /o rgyan rgyal po dbang 'byor rim dgu'i/ /lnga gsum bar pa in+d+ra bhu ti'i/ /sras bskal bzung nas pho brang spyan drangs/ /'jig rten mthun 'jug sgyu rtsal du mas/ /dregs ldan brtul zhing btsun mo'i 'khor rol/ /srid gsum kun tu dge mtshan khyab mdzad/ /chos kyi 'khor bsgyur pad+ma rgyal po/ /khyed la gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs4 ṭ+wāṃpya /

dus de nyid du ma la ya rtser/ /rigs can pañtsas rdzogs sangs rgyas la/ /gsol btab mthu yi 'og min gnas nas/ /thub pas rgyal tshab gsang bdag mngags nas/ /rgyud lung bshad tshe pad+ma 'byung gnas/ /ku na dza ra sprul bsdu ba po mdzad/ /rgyal po dzaḥ la pus ste'i dbang bskur/ /khyed la gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs shig /srid pa'i dpal la zhen med ston phyir/ /brtul zhugs spyod pas rgyal po'i srid spangs//rdzu 'phrul mthu yis mkha' la gshegs te/ /shing len gong du rdo rje dbyings bsgrub/ /thun mong dngos grub chen rnams kun thob/ /bsil ba tshal sogs dur khrod gnas su/ /mi min rnams dang lhan cig spyod skyongs/ /khyed la gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs shig /gdul bya 'dul phyir thabs la mkhas pas/ /rdo rje gdan du cho 'phrul brtan cing / /a su ra yi brag phug chen por/ /'phags pa'i dgra bcom kun d+ku dga' bo la/ /rab byung bcu gnyis lo bar thub gsung / /kun gsan chu bo gaṅgā'i dbus su/ /nyi ma'i gung dang lhan cig bsnyen rdzogs/ /khyed la gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs shig /gsang sngags theg par 'jug pa'i tshul gyis/ /mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang mo che la/ /smin byed dbang bskur rdzogs par zhus shing / /pra bha ha ster rim dgu'i theg pa/ /'jam dpal bshes sogs rig 'dzin brgyad dang / /lū hi pa sogs grub thob kun gyi/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs par blang mdzad/ /khyed la gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs shig /gsang 'dus slob dpon ye shes zhabs kyi/ /slob ma'i gtso mchog 'od dpag med dngos/ /bde ba che zhabs khyed mtshan yin zhes/ /zhabs lugs rgyud 'dzin kun gyis ches bsngags/ /spyan ras gzigs sprul mi tra'i slob ma'i/ /tshul yang mdzad ces kha cig tu grags/ /dpag dka' chu snod zla gzugs bzhin sprul/ /khyed la gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs shig /khyed la skabs 'gar 'jig rten gzhan dang / /zhing 'dir shas cher mi min gnas gyur/ /lha klu lha min srin po'i yul dang / /mkha' spyod rang byung gnas yul dur khrod/ /kun tu mi min 'gro ba'i don mdzad/ /skabs su mi yi gnas su snang nas/ /rlabs chen spyod pas sngags kyi bstan spel/ /khyed la gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs shig /ār+ya de was spyod bsdus sgron mer/ /khungs su mdzad pa'i pad+ma badz+ra/ /pad+ma las byon khyod nyid mtshan yin/ /gzhan yang sa ra ha dang bi ru/ /ḍosnyi spyod 'chang kasna pa/ /o rgyan pad+ma badz+ra rnam gsum/ /kun kyang chos sku'i cho 'phrul nyid yin/ /khyed la gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs shig /de ltar 'dzam gling mi yi gnas 'dir/ /snga phyir yang yang dngos su byon zhing / /dus gcig nyid du'ang sku yi bkod pa/ /du ma ston nas gdul dka'i 'gro 'dul/ /khyed byon dus dang sku tshe mdzad phrin/ /mos spyod kyis gzhal smos kyang ci 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas nyid las 'phags gzhan gyis min/ /khyed la gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs shig /sku yi bkod pa rnam 'gyur du mas/ /gdul bya 'dul ba'i thabs la mkhas pas/ /res 432

'ga' za hor rgyal po'i rigs mdzad/ /res 'ga' o rgyan bram ze'i rigs 'khrungs/ /sna tshogs rigs dang sna tshogs gzugs ston/ /sna tshogs spyod pas srid zhi mtha'i dag /sgrol dang bslang mdzad bde ba chen po/ /khyed la gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs shig /sangs rgyas kun las sngar sangs rgyas yang / /thub pa'i bstan la rgyal sras tshul bzung / /ye shes mkha' 'gro rdo rje phag mos/ /dbang bskur rnam smin rig 'dzin bsnyes shing / /a mar ti lar tshe dpag med pas/ /dbang bskur tshe dbang rig 'dzin grub nas/ /sangs rgyas brgya stong du ma'i zhal gzigs/ /khyed la gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs shig /yang le shed du dpal chen bsgrub pas/ /nye ru ka dpal dkyil 'khor tshogs kyi/ /dngos su byin brlabs dbang bskur ba yi/ /phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin mchog bsnyes/ /bsil ba tshal du bdud bzhi kun bcom/ /rdo rje gdan du rgyun mtha' bsnyes gyur/ /lhun grub rig 'dzin yongs kyi dbang phyug /khyed la gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs shig /za hor khyad par o rgyan yul du/ /tsha ba'i me dbus bsil ba'i rdzing bu/ /pad+ma ge sar sdong po'i rtse ru/ /'od lus bzhugs bzhin thugs kyi rdo rje/ /'od dpag med pa'i thugs kar thim nas/ /ya mtshan mchog bsnyes rgyud kyi ston pa/ /dpal chen pad+ma badz+ra zhes grags/ /khyed la gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs shig /dur khrod brgyad du sku yi bkod pa/ /rnam pa brgyad bstan gu ru mtshan brgyad/ /gzhan yang 'dul mtshan mchog bu/ /de bzhin brgya dang stong dang khri phrag /bye ba phrag brgya yang ni ston ste/ /gang la gang 'dul phrin las dpag med/ /'gro ba'i dpal mgon bla med bla ma/ /khyed la gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs shig /rnam bcu dbang dang ldan pa'i bdag nyid/ /tshe dbang khyad par phyag chen rig 'dzin/ /grub ma thag tu phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas/ /kun dang chos kyi 'gro ba mdzad nas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rmad byung 'phrin las/ /rgyun mi chad du chos kyi 'khor lo/ /bskor nas 'gro kun 'khor ba yongs sgrol/ /khyed la gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs shig /yang le shod dang rdo rje gdan du/ /khyed thugs nas spros steng 'og phyogs mtshams/ /nyer lnga brtsegs zhing mchod rten khang bzang / /rdo rje'i ke'u tshang sogs sku yi/ /rnam 'gyur du mar skal ldan 'khor bcas/ /zab mo gter gyi gleng gzhi gleng bslang / /'gro phan bcas su stong gsum 'geng mdzad/ /khyed la gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs shig/ /gdul bya dus babs bod yul zhabs bkod/ /gnod sbyin gdug pa'i 'dre srin klu kun/ /dam bzhag sangs rgyas bstan bsrung bka' bgos/ /gtsug lag sa brtul mtha' 'dul yang 'dul/ /bsam yas ma bzheng rang grub tshul gyur/ /dus der sku yi bkod pa gcig ni/ /'gro lding yul byon sngags bstan rgyas mdzad/ /khyed la gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs shig /'jam dbyangs sprul pa mnga' bdag rgyal po'i/ /chos bzhin re ba mtha' dag skong mdzad/ /o rgyan yul gyi mkha' 'gro'i gtso ༵rdog /

sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje btsun mo/ /bod yul dbus 'khrungs ye shes mtsho rgyal/ /thugs su bzung nas mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod/ /ma lus gangs can bod du rgyas mdzad/ /khyed la gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs shig /'chims phur las can thugs kyi bu dgur/ /bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor bdun brgya nyer lnga'i/ /lha tshogs mngon par bstan nas dbang bskur/ /mnga' bdag rgyal por bla ma dgongs 'dus/ /mu khri btsan por rta mchog rol pa/ /kun kyang lha tshogs dngos brtan dbang bskur/ /grub pas gangs can bod yul 'gengs mdzad/ /khyed la gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs shig /'phags yul gnas dang de bzhin bod yul/ /'chims phu ti gro tsa ri mkhar chu/ /zab phu la sogs gar bzhugs gnas de/ /las can 'khor la sangs rgyas zhing du/ /mngon sum bstan nas rgyud lung man ngag /ston mdzad dkyil 'khor gtso mchog nyid sprul/ /rdo rje srin po 'chal bkod mdzad/ /khyed la gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs shig /'gro phan thun mong gtsug lag kun sprul/ /ṭī nar 'jam dpal nyid dang dbyer med/ /tshangs pa'i drang srong brdzus nas 'byung rtsis/ /zan yang mnga' bdag rgyal pos bskul ngor/ /sman gyi grong khyer sangs rgyas sman bla/ /drang srong gnyis bcas gleng gzhi ltar sprul/ /sman dpyad rgyud bzhi legs par gsung mdzad/ /khyed la gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs shig /stag tshang gnas nyid che 'bar dur khrod/ /mngon sprul rdo rje gzhon nu nyid dang / /rdo rje srin po 'chol pa'i khro bo'i/ /skur bstan bdud dang dam sri kun btul/ /gter chen brgya dang gter phran stong phrag /phra mo khri dang 'bum phrag du ma/ /sbed dang ston pa'i sprul pa 'gyed mdzad/ /khyed la gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs shig /bod kyi phyogs bzhi'i brag mtshor phyag zhabs/ /rjes bkod brag phug gangs chen gangs ra/ /gnas chen bzhi dang lung lnga ljongs sogs/ /sbas yul che phra du ma byin brlabs/ /mdor na bod yul kun tu zhabs bcags/ /ma 'ong sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing / /skyes mchog mang byon smon lam rgyas mdzad/ /khyed la gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs shig /phyed lhag nga lnga'i lo bar bod 'dir/ /gdul bya mang po'i mthun snang nyid bzhugs/ /bod spyir sku dngos gdul bya de tsam/ /dgongs nas zangs gling srin po 'dul gshegs//lha sras mu khri'i gung thang bar bskyal/ /cho 'phrul mang brtan bha la ha zhes/ /rta mchog khrir bzhugs lho nub mkhar gshegs/ /khyed la gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs shig /mtsho rgyal la sogs skal ldan mchog 'gar/ /bal yul lam zhugs tsha shod bar phebs/ /de ru jo mor gdams ngag rtsal sprugs/ /bgegs 'dul phur pa yang ni gsung ste/ /chos nyid zad tshul 'ja' 'od zer bcas/ /gdod ma'i mgon po kun bzang thugs dbyings/ /gshegs tshul jo mor 'das rjes gsum babs/ /khyed la gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs shig /thugs kyi rol pa o rgyan zhing du/ /dkyil 'khor gtso mchog pad+ma badz+ra/ /ye shes 434

dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i yongs skor/ /de bzhin rnga yab srin po'i gling du/ /sku yi bkod pa rak+ka thed phreng / /lha min srin tshogs thar pa la 'dren/ /'dzam gling skye dgu bde la bkod mdzod/ /khyed la gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs shig /zhing 'di'i steng phyogs 'og min dur khrod/ /'khor ba yongs sgrol gnas su khrag 'thung / /bcom ldan dbang chen rngams pa'i skur snang / /zangs mdog dpal ri'i byang phyogs mkha' la/ /gtum drag me 'phreng can bstan yang sprul/ /'chol pa'i khro chung 'dzam gling kun tu/ /dus gnyan skabs nyul gdug pa 'dul mdzad/ /khyed la gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs shig /rnga yab gling du gshegs tshul bstan nas/ /slar yang bod rje khri ral yan du/ /ri gsul gangs brag gtsug lag khang du/ /skal ldan tshogs pa mang po'i dbus su/ /dngos su yang yang zhal brtan chos gsungs/ /de skabs yang ni zab gter mang sbas/ /gangs can mgon po pad+ma 'byung gnas/ /khyed la gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs shig /da lta la sogs phyi ma'i mtha' mar/ /skal ldan rnams la dngos su zhal brtan/ /byin brlabs dbang bskur gdams ngag 'bog mdzad/ /mdor na ma 'ongs rdzogs sangs rgyas pa/ /byams pa 'jig rten ma byon bar du/ /khol bur snod rung 'khor la gsang sngags/ /smin grol mchog bstan sangs rgyas sar bkod/ /khyed la gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs shig /bstan 'dir ji srid gdul byar dgongs/ /nyi zer 'char bsdud mdang la 'byon zhing / /yar ngor tshes bcu'i dus dang khyad par/ /dbang chen sprel lo sgril zla'i dus su/ /gnas yul kun tu mngon sum byon nas/ /sgrub po rnams kyi bar chad sel zhing / /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub yongs ster/ /khyed la gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs shig /khyed kyi sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las/ /lnga tshan lnga las rje 'bangs nyer lnga/ /de bzhin myang dang chos dbang rgod ldem/ /dri med gling sogs sangs rgyas gling sogs/ /gter ston nyid dang chos bdag tshul gyis/ /dmu rgod sems can kha lo gyen bsgyur/ /smin grol gdams pas skye dgu 'dren mdzad/ /khyed la gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs shig /snyigs lnga bdo dus deng nas mtha' bar/ /bdud 'dul bzhi dang snying po rnam lnga/ /nus ldan rdo rje nyi shu rtsa gcig /kun 'dus pad+ma bde chen gling sogs/ /nges don snying po'i brtan pa chad med/ /yang nas yang du spel bar byed pa/ /'di yang mgon po khyed kyi mthu ste/ /khyed la gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs shig /sngon gyi bskal pa mu med gong du/ /'khor lo bsgyur rgyal rtsibs kyi mu khyud/ /khyed de de sras gzhon nu stong yang / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong du gyur cing / /de yi mdun na 'don ni thub dbang / /kun kyang sangs rgyas rin chen snying por/ /thugs bskyed lung brtan brnyes tshul yang ston/ /khyed la gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs shig /'khor lo bsgyur rgyal yul 'khor skyong sras/ /gzhon nu stong dang rdzus skyes gnyis bcas/ /kun ༵ ḍibang

bskur bzang po'i bskal par/ /sangs rgyas stong dang sems dpa' mchog gnyis/ /lung du ston mdzad mgon po khyed ste/ /sangs rgyas nus ldan rdo rje zhes grags/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi 'dren par gyur pa/ /khyed la gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs shig /sngon dus sangs rgyas 'od srung dus kyang / /sa bcu'i mgon po pad+ma 'byung sprul/ /ma 'ongs sangs rgyas byams pa'i dus su/ /pad+ma 'gro 'dul zhes kyang ston ste/ /sangs rgyas stong gi rgyal tshab kun tu/ /khyed ste bya spyod rnal 'byor che sogs/ /sngags kyi bstan pa lhag par spel mdzad/ /khyed la gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs shig /sangs rgyas pad+ma rmad byung bsam yas/ /khyad par bstan pa gsum gyi ston pa/ /grangs med sngon du mngon rdzogs rgyal po/ /da lta thub dbang pad+ma 'byung gnas/ /ma 'ongs dus su 'jam dpal gzhon nu/ /rdo rje theg pa yongs rdzogs chos kyi/ /'gro rnams tshe gcig sangs rgyas sar bkod/ /khyed la gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs shig /de ltar khyed kyi rnam thar mkha' 'dra/ /gzhal dka' ji bzhin rdzogs sangs rgyas dang / /dag pa sa gsum la bzhugs 'phags las/ /gzhan gyi rnam kun rtogs pa'i yul min/ /des na bdag lta so skye byis blo'i/ /khab mig dbus su phyogs bral nam mkha'/ /chud pa'i go skabs med mod 'on kyang / /ma hā gu rur snying nas gus pas/ /rnam thar chu gter dbus nas skra rtse'i/ /khyon tsam las kyang cha shas phra mo/ /cung zad 'dir brjod dge bas yang ni/ /bdag sogs 'brel bcas 'gro ba ma lus/ /dus 'di nas brtsam byang chub mchog bar/ /skye ba tshe rabs kun nas kun tu/ /pad 'byung dngos rgyud sprul pas rjes bzung / /phar phyin khyad par sngags kyi sa lam/ /yon tan ma lus myur du rtsal rdzogs/ /kun bzang 'od dpag med mgon thub chen/ /pad 'byung khyed kyi thugs bskyed smon lam / /ji 'dra de bzhin thob par mdzod cig /skad cig ma 'dir thugs rjes gzigs la/ /dgyes pa'i zhal ras dus 'dir bstan cing / /byin rlabs dbang bskur dngos po mtha' dag /gdan thog gcig 'dir thob par mdzod cig /ces dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo o rgyan gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi zhing 'di'i rnam thar gcig pu yang chu gter lta bu las skra rtse'i zil pa tsam rang gi mos pa kho nas bstod pa tshigs su bcad pa brgyad cu rtsa bdun ste dad pa'i pad tshal rgyas pa'i las can nyin mor byed pa'i shing rta 'di ni rang dang skal ba mtshungs pa rnams kyi dad pa'i gsos su bsam ste rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu sprel rdzogs nye smin drug zla ba'i dkar phyogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus tshes bcu la sho lo ka lnga bcu dang / de'i 'phro rmi lam dge mtshan gyis bskul nas dpal gdong chu bya yi lo zhal gsar du 'char ba rgyal zla'i dkar phyogs rgyal ba dang po la sho lo ka sum cu rtsa bdun bcas mnga' ris stod mang yul waṃ le'i gtsug lag khang du dpal rig pa 'dzin pa rgyal khams pa tshe dbang nor bu rdo rje gzi brjid kyis bkod pa'o/ /'di ni sngar ma grags pa gsar brjod med/ /des na yid ches tshad ma'i gnas su 'os/ /brag cha bzhin du skyar bzlos yang ma yin/ /sngon med lang dz+wa ṭ+wāṃzlor pa'i gtam du'ang rung / /legs par bshad kun bla ma'i thugs rje'i mthu/ /nyes par gyur kun bdag blo

ngan pa'i skyon/ /lhag bsam dag pas bkod pa'i dge tshogs rnams/ /'gro kun gu ru'i go 'phang thob phyir bsngo/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/ /༄ga /bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi rim pa mdor dril zab mo/oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ trī: bdag lus stong ngang skad gcig yi dam lha/ /yab yum rgyan rdzogs ye shes me long gsal/ /spyi bo mkha' dbyings 'od lnga'i gur khang 'khyil/ /seng khri pad zla'i steng du bka' drin can/ /dran mchog bla ma byin rlabs yongs kyi bdag /rgyal kun thugs kyi mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang / /dkar dmar zhi khro bzhad zhal sku gsum chas/ /yongs rdzogs phyag gnyis rdo rje thod pa bsnams/ /rol pa'i 'dug stangs 'od zer mtha' yas 'khrigs/ /rab 'byams zhing khams rgyal kun sku la rdzogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro ma/ /chos rgya mtsho sprin du 'thib dbus bzhugs/ /dam tshig thugs ka'i 'od kyi dag zhing nas/ /ye shes spyan drangs mnyam nyid ngang bstan bzhugs/ /bdag dang rab 'byams mos pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi nang gsang ba de bzhin dag chos 'bul/ /mtshungs med rgyal dbang rtsa ba'i bla ma che//yon tan rgya mtsho rab dran gus pas stod/ /mgon mchog ma hā gu ru rin po che/ /snying nas gsol 'debs bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /oṃ ā:rgyu badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi rgyu:trī: ā: dmigs med spros bral chos sku kun tu bzang / /lhun grub ye shes longs sku rdo rje sems/ /dri med mchog gi sprul sku badz+ra he: /rgyal kun ngo bo nyid sku pad+ma 'byung / /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje spyan gyis gzigs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mkhyen pa'i ye shes gang / /bdag blo'i mun sel de ring nyid rtogs nas/ /'ja' lus rdo rje myur 'grub byin gyis rlobs/ /lhun grub bde chen gzhon nu bi ma la/ /mi slob lam thob mkhas mchog rnam snang mdzad/ /phyag rgya che brnyes dbang phyug nam mkha' snying / /rgyal kun bskyed yum ye shes mtsho rgyal ma/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'am spyan kyis gzigs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 〉〈 bdag blo'i dz+ra 'ja' lus 〉 'od gsal sgyu 'phrul ye shes rol pa'i bdag /gzhom bral mchog grub a yunyid+dha shrī/ /dbyer med blo 'das gar dbang bstan 'dzin bzang / /mchog tu byang chub mngon gyur klong gsal snying / /gsol ba 〉 sangs rgyas tsho bdag blo'i dz+ra 'ja' lus dz+ra zung 'jug lam rdzogs gu ru zhi blo gros/ /mkhyen gnyis thugs chud pad+ma bde chen gling / /don gnyis rab spyad rnal 'byor dgyes pa stsal/ /byin rlabs mchog stsol rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba dz+ra sangs rgyas dz+rabadag blo'i dz+ra 'ja' lus 〉 rang byung rtogs pa'i ye shes chu bo che/ /brgyud pa'i bla ༵3 shā dam

mkha' 'gro la/ /rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bdag blo 'khrul pa'i dri tshogs yongs sangs nas/ /don dam chos sku rtogs pa'i ye shes de/ /skad cig ma 'dir rgyud la rab shar nas/ /zag med 'od gsal 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku/ /mi shig bde chen mchog grub byin gyis rlobs/ /oṃ gu ru dhā tī ni dz+nyā na :sarba sirnyi r+ghaṃ/ gsol ba btab pas gu ru'i dkyil 'khor las/ /bdud rtsi rgyun 'bab bdag lus 'khor lo bzhi/ /yongs khengs sdig sgrib zhi zhing dbang bzhi rdzogs/ /lam bzhi 'byongs nas sku bzhi thob par bsam/ /oṃ ā:r+ghaṃ trī: rjes su bla ma tshangs bug nas mar byon/ /bdag snying dbus gzhugs rdor 'chang sku ru gyur/ /mthar ni bla ma 'od yal rang rig dang / /bla ma dbyer med chos nyid ro gcig ngang / /dmigs med blo bral zang thal khyab brdal che/ /brjod 'das gnas lugs byar med chos kyi sku/ /gtad med rang byung bde chen rig pa'i gshis/ /kun yang 'od gsal rang ngor mnyam par bzhag /dge ba 'di yi bdag sogs 'gro ba kun/ /bdag don tshe 'dir mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas thob/ /gzhan don 'brel tshad 'gro kun byang chub sbyor/ /phyam gcig pad 'byung go 'phang nyid thob shog /ces ud ta ra yo ga khyer bde snying po ru rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu yi shing sgrul hor zla bcu pa'i tshes bzang bco lngar gnas mchog yar lung khra 'brug bkra shis 'byams snyom gyi gtsug lag khang 'dabs su sbyar ba'i yig rigs pa ti in+d+ra yis bgyis pa dge'o/ /sku gsum chas ni/ chos sku bzo bral ral pa lcang lo bsil/ /longs sku sngags chas ber phed rin chen brgyan/ /sprul sku chos gos thang sham mdo lugs rdzogs/ /sku gsum yongs rdzogs chas ni pad zhwa gsol/ /phyag mtshan rdo rje thod bum kha ṭ+wāṃ ka /zhes so/ /na mo r+ghaṃ: skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /'gro la rtag tu brtse ba'i byang sems skyes/ /rigs kun 'dus pa'i bdag nyid rdo rje sems/ /bya spyod rnal 'byor bla med kho na nyid/ /rgyud kyi dgongs pa lha sngags ting 'dzin gyis/ /sgrib nyid bag chags lhad med yongs su sbyangs/ /snang srid snod bcud bdag lus longs spyod kun/ /dkon mchog kun 'dus bla mar yongs su 'bul/ /oṃ ā:r+ghaṃ ho: bdag gi phung khams ye nas lha yi dal/ /'dun khar seng khri pad+ma nyi zla'i steng / /rgyal ba kun 'dus mtsho skyes rdo rje sems/ /dbyer med 'dren mchog rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sku/ /rin chen rgyan rdzogs 'khor los bsgyur ba'i chas/ /bag gro lhun chags rang 'od yum la 'khyud/ /dkon mchog rtsa gsum chos skyong rgya mtshos bskor/ /snang srid thams cad 'od dang sprul pas khengs/ /thugs ka'i 'od kyi rang bzhin zhing khams nas/ /rgyal kun spyan drangs bla ma'i ngo bor 'dres/ /skyabs gnas kun gyi ngo bo mchog de la/ /mi phyed rtse gcig dad pas gsol ba 'debs/ /oṃ ā:r+ghaṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi r+ghaṃ: kun bzang 'od dpag med mgon rdo rje sems/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang4 stu ru pad+ma 'byung / /ye shes mtsho rgyal gar dbang zhig po gling / /maṅga ā yu 'ja' mtshon snying

po'i zhabs/ /bdud 'dul rdo rje pad+ma klong gsal snying / /bde chen gling dang gsung rab rgya mtsho'i ste/ /bka' drin mtshungs med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /snying khongs rus pa'i gting nas gsol 'debs kyi/ /'khrul kun skad gcig de ring nyid la bcom/ /dri med lhag mthong sangs rgyas dgongs pa'i gting / /ma lus gdan thog 'di ru mthar phyin nas/ /khams gsum 'khor ba dong nas sprug par shog /oṃ ā:phroṃ sarba sirnyi pha la rgyu phaṭa: bla ma'i mdzod spu'i 'od zer zla zhun ltar/ /dka' ba bdag gi smin mtshams nas zhugs te/ /lus khengs sgrib sbyangs bum pa'i dbang bskur thob/ /bskyed rim la dbang sprul sku'i sa bon bsnyes/ /yab yum sbyor ba'i byang sems dkar dmar ni/ /lce steng babs pas ngag gi sgrib pa sbyang / /gsang ba'i dbang thob sngags rim sgom la dbang / /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag /thugs las lnga ldan 'od zer srad bu ltar/ /bdag gi snying gar 'thim pas yid sgrib sbyangs/ /sher ye'i dbang thob thabs rim bsgom la dbang / /chos sku'i sa bon rgyud la rgyas par gyur/ /bla ma yab yum rang gi spyi bor byon/ /'od zhu sku gsung thugs dang sgo gsum 'dres/ /sgrib dag dbang rdzogs rdzogs rim bsgom la dbang / /ye shes rdo rje ngo bo mngon du byas/ /de ltar bla ma sgrub pa'i dge ba yis/ /zung 'jug rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang gang / /tshe 'di nyid la mngon du gyur nas ni/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i dpal mgon mchog thob shog /ces bla ma'i rnal 'byor rgyun khyer ngag 'don snying por dril ba 'di ni glo bo chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' blon chos bzhin du spyod pa khri dpon bsod nams chos 'phel gyis bskul ngor/ skye med zhang tshal pa'i man ngag thos don gtso bor byas te rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus glo bo yi yul mthar thug pa mon yul gyi cha shas rdo chu las rang byung gi me 'bar ba mu khu ta k+ṣe ṭa zhes dh+wa gi sprin bzhin du 'du ba'i gnas khyad par du 'phags pa der sa bya dbyug gu zla ba'i tshes lnga'i thun skabs gcig tu smras pa'i yi ge pa ni rig lung rgyud sde smra ba'i mkhas pa o rgyan 'phrin las bstan 'dzin dpal bzang pos bgyis pa dge'o/ /dge'o/ /oṃ swāsnyi/ skyabs gnas dkon mchog rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /mkha' khyab 'gro don byang chub sems bskyed do/ /rang gi spyi bor pad nyi zla steng la/ /rgyal ba kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sku/ /rdo rje dril 'dzin rdor sems dmar po'i tshul/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum dkon mchog rtsa ba gsum/ /ma lus gcig bsdus mtshan dang dpe byad rdzogs/ /gzi brjid 'od phung tshad med lhan ner gsal/ /oṃ ā:r+ghaṃ/ mkha' ltar brdal ba kun bzang rdo rje sems/ /nyi ltar gsal ba pad 'byung bi ma la/ /'od zer ltar 'phro gu ru nam mkha' snying / /'dren mchog sku gsum bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /'dzam gling brtul zhugs kyis mdzes spyod 'chang zhabs/ /gangs can grub pa'i gtso gyur nam mkha'i snying / /dbyer med snyigs dus 'gro 'dul sgyu ma'i gar/ /dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /dus 'dir rgyal bstan mtha' dag gso byed cing / /nges don bstan pa spel ba'i snying stobs can/ /rgyal ba kun 'dus pad+ma~X ḍidung

'tshob pa/ /dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar rtse gcig gus pas gsol 'debs mthu'i/ /skye kun dam pa mgon kyi rjes su bzung / /smin grol legs thob dam tshig rnam par dag /'brel byas rgyal ba'i sa la nyer 'khod shog /oṃ ā:rgyu trī sarba sirnyi pha la r+ghaṃ ā: mthar ni bla ma spyi bo nas snying khar/ /thim pas rang rig bla ma dbyer med ngang / /cir snang dpal ldan bla ma'i sku gsung thugs/ /lam khyer byang chub mchog 'bras myur thob bsngo/ /zhes dres sprul pa'i sku rin po che 'jam dbyangs pad+ma 'jigs bral gyis gsung gi skul ngor dpal rig pa 'dzin pa brtse bas skye bdag dbyug zla'i dkar phyogs rgyal ba gnyis pa la gu ru'i gnas chen sogs so 'dzul khung du smras pa sarba maṅga lo/rang nyid rta phag gsal ba yis/ /spyi bor 'ja' gur sna lnga'i dkyil/ /ku mud pad+ma ut+pal ni/ /dkar dmar mthing ka 'dab stong steng / /nyi zla sgra gcan a li dang / /ka li rab tu mtshon pa'i steng / /trī: las gu ru pad+ma 'byung / /mdog dmar zhi khro chags pa'i nyams/ /rus rgyan stag sham ho ru'i chas/ /phyag g.yas gsang rnga g.yon dril bu/ /pang du gsang phe dmar ser mo/ /gri thod 'dzin pas yab dang 'khril/ /sbyor mtshams bdud rtsi dkar dmar rgyun/ /rang gi tshangs bug nas mar babs/ /'khor lo bzhi khengs dbang bzhi thob/ /sgrib dag lam 'byongs sku bzhi bsnyes/ /mthar ni bla ma rang la thim/ /rang sems rigs pa dka' dag bzhag /oṃ ā:r+ghaṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma dz+nyā na dhā ki ni sirnyi pha la r+ghaṃ a/ de skad bskul ngo ma lcog tsam/ /tshe dbang nor bu rtsal des smras/ /bla sgrub ngo mtshar rmad byung tsin+ta ma ṇi zhes bya ba bzhugs/ na mo gu ru pad+mā kā ra yā/ mkha' mnyam 'gro la phan slad dus rtag par/ /dkon mchog kun 'dus bla mar skyabs su mchi'o/ /rgyal chen byang chub sems kyis sems can rnams/ /sangs rgyas thob phyir bla ma bsgrub par bya/ /rang nyid yi dam lhag pa'i lhar gsal ba'i/ /spyi bor pad dkar nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor dbus/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rgyal kun 'dus pa'i dngos/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje dkar dmar zhi ba'i tshul/ /phyag gnyis rdo rje thod pa thugs kar 'dzin/ /zhabs gnyis rdor dkyil gos dkar mo dang 'khril/ /dar dang rin chen rgyan rdzogs gsor zhu gsol/ /sku la ye shes lnga yi 'od zer 'bar/ /gnas bzhi rdo rje bzhi dngos 'bru bzhi las/ /'od 'phros ye shes spyan drangs dbyer med 'dres/ /de la bdag mos gus gdung phur tshugs pas/ /lus dang longs spyod tshe bsod dge tshogs bcas/ kha zhe med par maṇ+ḍal 'bul byed shing / /mi phyed dad pas bsngags kyis gsol ba 'debs/ /oṃ ā:r+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa ā: zhes pa gsol btab bla ma'i sku las ni/ /bdud rtsi dkar dmar mthing bab bdag gzhan gyi/ /'khor ba thog med nas bsags sgo gsum gyi/ /sdig sgrib ma lus sangs te dag par gyur/ /oṃ ā:hūṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dza: 440

sirnyi hā la r+ghaṃ/ zhes pas gsol btab bla ma'i gnas bzhi las/ /'od zer byung ba bdag gi gnas bzhir thim/ /dbang bzhi thob nas so so'i sbyang smin rdzogs/ /mngon byas sku bzhi thob pa'i skal ldan gyur/ /oṃ ā:r+ghaṃ dz+rī: trī: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi purtse dzha na ā yu sirnyi dza dza/ zhes pas gsol btab yab yum sbyor mtshams nas/ /'khor 'das tshe bcud dngas ma bsdus te babs/ /bdag lus 'khor lnga lus kun bdud rtsis khengs/ /'chi med rdo rje sems pa 'grub par bsam/ /mthar ni bla ma yab yum tshangs bug nas/ /mar byon dbu ma'i lam brgyud snying kar bzhugs/ /rang lus gser gyi rdo rje rtse lngar gyur/ /de yang dmigs med stong nyid ngang du bzhag /slar yang skad cig yi dam skur gyur nas/ /chos kun bla ma'i rol par lam du 'khyer/ /dge ba 'di yi byang chen myur 'grub cing / /mtha' yas 'gro kun sangs rgyas sar bkod shog /ces bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'chi med tshe yi sgrub pa zab mo ngo mtshar rmad gyur tsice ma ṇi zhes pa 'di ni spa gro mon gyi yul lho 'brug pa sde srid rin po che ngag dbang bstan pa'i nyin byed zhal snga nas/ /phyag mdzod dad pa'i dpal ldan dbon sras kun bzang 'chi med dbang rgyal gyi gsung gis bskul shing tshul 'di ltar ma mos pa rnams la phan pa'i ched du rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu 'phrin las 'gro 'dul gyis bod yul dbu ru'i cha gu ru'i sgrub gnas bod kyi ri bo rtse lnga zhes zang yag brag tu khrums zla'i dkar phyogs tshes bcur smras pa dge'o/ /ma no gu ra we/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdag gi 'gro kun 'dren phyir byang sems skyed/ /'khor 'das chos kun bdag med stong pa'i ngang / /rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal spyi bo'i gtsug /pad+ma stong ldan nyi zla dkyil 'khor dbus/ /dran mchog dwangs ma'i mgon po pad+ma 'byung / /dkar dmar zhi 'dzum rdo rje thod bum 'dzin/ /pad zhu chos gos ber phed rin chen spras/ /spyi bor rigs kyi bdag po 'od dpag med/ /dmar po mnyam bzhag mchog gi sprul sku'i chas/ /thugs kar ye shes sems tshul rdo rje sems/ /dkar gsal rdor dkyil rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /de yi thugs dkar zla steng yi ge ā: kun gyi gnasartsagasum yi ge 'bru gsum mtshan/ /'od zer mdangs kyi rgyal ba sras bcas kun/ /de nyid bla ma sangs rgyas yi dam chos/ /dge 'dun mkha' 'gro chos skyong kun 'dus te/ /de la bdag gi tshe bsod dpal 'byor rnams/ /gtan gyi 'dun mar bcas pas yongs su mchod/ /de la phur tshugs rtse gcig dad gus kyis/ /'dzab bsngags bcas pa'i gsol 'debs lan gsum gyis/ /dang po bla ma'i sku las bdud rtsi bab/ /bdag gi sgrib sbyangs bde thob pa rgya ā: gsol 'debs gnyis pas bla ma'i gnas gsum gyis/ /'od zer dag gis bdag la dbang bzhi bskur/ /gsol 'debs gsum pa'i bla ma spyi gtsug nas/ /mar byon bdag snying dbus zhugs rgyud byin rlabs/ /oṃ ā: rgyu badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dza: sirnyi pha la rgyu ā: oṃ ā:rgyu badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi r+ghaṃ: mthar ni snang srid gzhal yas lha yi sku/ /'od zhu rang thim rang nyid bla mar thim/ /de yang ā la mthar ni 'ja' lta~X pyal/ /

bla ma rang sems dbyer med ro gcig dang/ /spros bral rig stong bde ba chen po'i dbyings/ /blo 'das mtha' dang bral ba'i ngang la bzhag /de ltar chos rnams kun gyi snying po ni/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor rtse gcig 'bad pa'i dge /bdag gzhan 'gro kun rdo rje theg lam gyi/ /tshe gcig gnyis la rdo rje sems thob shog /bla ma'i rnal 'byor snying po dril ba rang gi nyam len dang mthun pa 'di ni/ dbang brtul gyi slob ma 'ga' la khyer bde 'di tsam gyi phan par go ba dang / 'phral du la stod mtsho sko'i sde ba bstan 'dzin dgra 'dul gyi yab sras dang gzhan yang don gnyer can 'ga' yi gsol ba btab ngor rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus legs par smras pa'i yi ge pa ni spang ba po dge slong kun bzang gzhan phan no/ /sarba maṅga lo/o swāsti/ dkon mchog gsum la rtag skyabs mchi/ /'gro don sangs rgyas thob par bya/ /bdag nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i/ /spyi bor pad dkar nyi zla'i steng / /gu ru nam snying thugs rdo rje/ /mthing gsal rdor dril rol btab bzhugs/ /mtshan dpe zhi ba'i tshul chas rdzogs/ /gnas gsum rdo rje gsum 'bru gsum/ /'od kyi rgyal kun skur bsdus thim/ /de la mos gus gdung shugs kyis/ /snying nas phur tshugs gsol ba 'debs/ /oṃ chos sku mkha' khyab bla ma la/ /gsol 'debs 'od gsal byin gyi rlobs/ /a: longs sku lhun rdzogs bla ma la/ /gsol 'debs sgyu lus mchog byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyu: sprul sku 'gro 'dul bla ma la/ /gsol 'debs 'gro phan byin gyis rlobs/ /hrī: kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol 'debs bdag rgyud smin grol nas/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /rdo rje 'dzin thob byin gyis rlobs/ /oṃ ā:gu ru gha gha gan+ta sid dhi pha la r+ghaṃ: mthar ni bla ma'i gnas gsum las/ /'od 'phros sgrib sbyangs sku gsung thugs/ /dbang bskur byin rlabs gcig char thob/ /bla ma'i thugs dang rang sems 'dres/ /zab gsal bde ba'i don rtogs 'gyur/ /de ltar bla ma bsgrub pa yi/ /dge ba srid nas 'gro ba kun/ /sdug bsngal dang bral bde la bkod/ /'phral dang yun du bde thob cing / /bla ma sangs rgyas 'od dpag med/ /ji bzhin go 'phang myur thob shog /zhes rgya gar kha che'i yul mtshams mnga' ris skor gsum gyi mang yul cha la dwags kyi rgyal mo dad pa can bstan skyong dbang mo'i ngor me stag sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes la mtshur gyi garnyo lar rig pa 'dzin pas spel ba sarba maṅga lo/oṃ ā:r+ghaṃ/ bdag lus gzhan med snang stong 'od kyi sku/ /he ru ka dpal chu zla ltar gsal ba'i/ /bde chen 'khor lo chos dbyings 'od gur klong / /ye shes lnga ldan thig le gsal tsher dbus/ /rang rig ngo bo pad 'byung rdo rje sems/ /rang mdangs sgyu 'phrul rgyu kar nam mkha'i snying / /dbyer med rang rtsal dran mchog 'khor lo'i mgon/ /rig 'dzin dri med gzi brjid bde gshegs snying / /'phrin las 'gro 'dul dpal ldan bla ma ni/ /dmar smug khro 'dzum thor tshugs dar dmar phur/ /stag sham rus rgyan gru mor t+t+waṃ 4ṭ+wām 'khyud/ /cang te'u dril khrol snang sems zil gyis gnon/ /ha ho be+e phaṭa r+ghaṃ gi gad rgyang

sgrogs/ /me klong rtog med gar ltab bun bun 'khyug /'khor du rig 'dzin dpa' bo 'bum dang bcas//dā— ki chos skyong pho nya sprin ltar 'khrigs/ /spyi bor rgyud pa'i bla ma mtho brtsegs ni/ /rgyu nag klong gsal gter gzha da 'ja' tshon snying / tsho/—mtsho rgyaloji ma pad 'byung dga' rab rje/ /rdor sems rig lnga khyab bdag kun tu bzang / /rang rang chas rdzogasagazi byin 'od phung 'arbare/ /bag dro lhun chags bde ba'i gar chen g.yo/ /be+edagasogs rjesatro'ajug bu le bertser rdagongar+shanas/ /smin grolajidangos spub myong stsol ngo bor gsame/ /a ho/ mtshoṅge bral ye thog sangs rgyas kun —tu bzang / /—gsangacen dkyil 'khor yongs gtso rdo rje sims/ /rgyal kunelha 'phrul 'dus— dngos pad+ma 'byung / /zag med bde chen yongs stsol mtsho rgyal ma/ /byar med klong grol 'ja' tshon gter gzhad snying / /grub kune+ergyal po klong gsal thunes mchog rtsal/ /kun gyi byin rlabs zab gsang mdzod 'dzin pa/ /rang rig dbang 'byor pad+ma nor bu'i mtshan/ /sgyu 'phrul rtsa gsum rab 'byams tshorges bcas la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /thog med nas 'khrul sems kyi mun pa de4/ /bla ma'i byin gyis de ring nyid gsal zhing / /'di snang zhen log nges 'byung snying nas shar/ /dad gus mos pa shes rab brtson 'grus rgyas/ /rgyu 'bras dam tshig spang blangs bsrung sdom gyi/ /rten 'brel gnad la rab tu mkhas par shorgo /skye kun 'brel tshad don ldan mchog khyed dang / /mi 'brel rtag 'grogs hūṃgs chen choṅge dang 'phrad/ /tshig don go yul ma lus gnad du lon/ /phyir mi ldog la rab hūṃ 'khod par shog /chos kun stong nyid rtogs pa'i gdeng tshad dang / /yid spyod las 'das mngon gsum mthar thug rtogs/ /shugs 'byung snying rje 'gro ba'i don chen spyod/ /mthong thos dran reg 'khor ba dong sprug shog /oṃ ā: hūṃ ho/ sarba sidhi pha la r+ghaṃ ā: zhes brjod tshe na bla ma'i gnas gsum nas/ /dkar dmar mthing gsum thig le 'od bcas kyis/ /bdag gi gnas gsum byin rlabs sgrib kun dag /dbang thob bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen don mngon gyur/ /sku bzhi ye shes rdo rje gsum gyi dngos/ /skad cig ma la yongs su smin thob bsam/ /rjes su bla ma mtho brtsegs mas rim thim/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rang dang dbyer med 'dres/ /rang rigs brjod bral dmigs med ka dag klong / /de ltar bsam bsgom don rtogs dge ba'i mthus/ /'gro kun sdug bsngal mtsho las yongs sgrol shog /zhes mang yul skyid grong grwa phu'i chos gling ri khrod du/ rigs bdag bla ma'i sras gyur rig 'dzin shes rab 'byung gnas kyi gsung gis yang yang bskul ngor/ mdo khams kaḥ thog lho phyogs su skyes shing rgyal khams kun tu myul ba'i sprang ban tshe dbang nor bu'i me lug sprel zla'i tshes bzang po la bkod pa dge'o/ / na mo gu ra we/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla mar skyabs su mchi'o/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro don byang chub mchog sems skyed/ /gdod nas 'du bral med pa ye shes sku/ /rang byung rang shar bdag nyi~X py-isang

ba'i bdag /spyi bor bla ma kun bzang rdo rje 'chang / /skad gcig mos pa'i snang ngor lam me ba/ /bdag gi dus gsum tshogs gnyis dal 'byor kun/ /ltos med ling phul gsol ba 'di ltar btab/ /oṃ ā:rgyu/dgongs brda snyan zhu brgyud pa'i bla ma dang / /spyi 'dren sher bskang dbang lung rtsa lan lags/ /byin rlabs rtsa ba kun 'dus 'dren mchog mgon/ /bla oṃ lag na rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /rnam pa thams cad rgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i gar/ /rgyud sde bzhi drug dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lha/ /ma lus spro bsdu'i byed po bcom ldan 'das/ /yi dam phyag na smo chos nyid mkha' la bde chen shugs kyis 'gro/ /sa gsum pho nya mkha' 'gro rgya mcho'i gtso/ /te ru ka dpal dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma/ /mkha' 'gro phyag na mo rgyal ba'i lung rtogs bstan dang mi mthun mchog /ma lus phye mar 'thag mdzad drag shul can/ /ma mgon dregs pa sngags bdag yongs kyi gtso/ /chos skyong phyag 〉 dkon mchog rtsa gsum rab 'byams sdud pa'i spyid/ /dran pa tsam gyis bdud bzhi'i dpung las rgyal/ /ma lus rgyal ba kun gyi gsang gsum bdag /bcom ldan phyag na dz+ra bdag ni 'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /bla ma gsang bdag mgon dang dbyer med par/ /snying nas skyabs su mchi'o thugs rjes gzigs/ /gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag gi sgo gsum nad gdon sdig sgrib zhi/ /'chi med sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje sems/ /lha mchog khyed mthu'i khyed rang ji bzhin par/ /da lta dus 'di nyid du 'grub byin rlobs/ /oṃ ā:hūṃ: mthar ni bla ma rang gi spyi bor thim/ /rang sems bla ma gsang bdag thugs dang 'dres/ /stong gsal sing nge bde ba lhan nge ba/ /spros bral 'od gsal ngang du mnyam par bzhag /de sogs bdag gi dus gsum bsags yod dge /yongs bskum rdor 'chang go 'phang thob phyir bsngo/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas 'gro ba ma lus kun/ /gsang bdag bla ma'i sa la 'god par shog /zhes phyag rdor dang gnyis med pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsol 'debs 'di ni yul dbu ru byang phyogs 'phan yul sha ra yi 'dabs su spyod gyur dpal gsang ba'i bdag po'i rig sngags 'dzin pa rang grol bstan 'dzin gyis bskul pa'i ngor rgyal khams pa rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'i rab byung bcu gsum pa'i thog ma me yos lo chu stod zla ba'i mar phyogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus chen nyer gnyis la chos 'khor dpal gyi lha sar skad cig mar spel ba sarba maṅga lo/bla ma'i rnal 'byor snying gi thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ ā:rgyu trī: skyabs mchog kun 'dus ngo bo/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje pad+ma 'byung / /yab yum sras bcas rnam 'phrul/ /rtsa ba'i bla mar skyabs mchis/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro kun pha ma/ /de dag 'khrul snang gsal nas/ /byang chub sa la bkod phyir/ /lam zab bla bsgrub rgyas 'deb/ /bdag lus 'dzin med gdan gsum lhar gsal/ /spyi bo'i nam mkhar pad+ma nyi zlar/ /'dren mchog rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu/ /dmar smug khro chags 'dres pa'i nyams ldan/44/twen mtshams rdu dang thugs kar ā mtshan/ /stod sngon sham dkar rngul gzan dmar gsol la/ /

rdor dril rnam rol rdo rje dkyil krung / /rin chen prog zhu rus pa'i rgyan can/ /de yi spyi gtsug pad+ma'i sdong po/ /yal ga bzhi ru gyes pa'i dbus su/ /gsung girdo rje pad+ma 'byung gnas/ /rnam rol phyag rgyas rdo rje thod 'tshang / /ho rus chas can rdo rje dkyil krung / /mtsho rgyal gri thod 'dzin dang mnyam 'khyud/ /g.yas g.yon pad+ma'i yal ga gyes bar/ /dri med 'od zer rdo rje gling pa'i/ /ngo bo bi ma la dang be ro/ /mdun rgyab pad+ma gyes pa'i dbus su/ /karma rig༈pa 'dzin dang sgrol mgon/ /ngo bo ri khrod zhabs dang nag po/ /kun kyang rigaspa mnyam rol bajid ldan/ /pad 'byudz+waspyi bo pad sdong steng du/ /'od dpag med la rigs lngas bskor shing / /de yi dbu steng kun bzang yab yum/ /gzhan yang dgong brda snyan brgyud bla ma/ /rig 'dzin brgya mtsho sprin du 'khrigs bzhug /kun gyis gnas lngar 'bru gsum trī:phaṭa/ /thugs ka'i 'od kyi ye shesabakug bstem/ /phyi nang gsang mchod kun bzang sprin phung / /rtse gcig mos gus drag po'i gsol 'debs/ /byin gyis rlobs cig 'dren mchog dang ma/ /'khor lo'i mgon po thugs rje can no/ /oṃ ā:hūṃ trī:phaṭa/ dkon mchog rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i/ /ngo bo gcig mchog bla ma/ /dran pas srid zhi'i gdung sel/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma mkhyen no/ /sku bzhi gnas lnga'i 'od kyi/ /dbang bskur sgrib dag lam 'byongs/ /'bras bu mngon byed bla ma'i/ /byin rlabs bdag la rdzogs gyur/ /bdag ni 'khor tshogs rim bzhin/ /gtso bo la 'dus de yang / /rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ /de bdag ro mnyam 'dres gyur/ /dge ba 'di yi myur bdag /sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma 'grub nas/ /dbang phyug brgyad thob gyur cig /zhes rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs tshul 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes gtsang la stod byang bkra bzang zhabs drung rin po che kun bzang ye shes zhal snga nas dang / lho pha drug rab bzhi dang / sngags 'chang pad+ma 'gyur med dang / grangs chen bco brgyad 'dzin pa'i rab 'byams pa pad+ma rig 'dzin la sogs pa skal ldan mang po'i gsol ba btab pa'i ngor kun dga' dbyug zla'i tshes bco lnga la brag stod chos sku'i pho brang du rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus smras pa sarba maṅga lo/mi bdag gi spyi bo'i gtsug rol na/ /gdan pad+ma nyi zla gsum brtsegs steng / /'ja' 'od phung 'khrigs pa'i gur khang dbus/ /pha drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / /don dbyer med gu ru pad+ma 'byung / /sku dkar dmar mdangs ldan mtshan dpe spras/ /zhal mjos 'dzum spyan gsum zhi ma khro/ /dbu pad zhwa rgod kyis ldem 'phru can/ /phyag rdo rje bar+ghaṃ tshe bum 'dzin/ /yum ḍā ki sbas tshul kha ṭ+wāṃ brtan/ /ber phod ka chos gos ngur smrig gso/ /zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs/ /zhing phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas rnams/ /de thams cad spros med dbyer med thim/ /rje sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i thugs//bka' dam chos thams cad 'dus pa'i gsung / /tshogs dge 'dun thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /skyabs dkon mchog kun 'dus pad+ma 'byung / /bdag gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes bzung / /dus ༵༵ sang

snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus/ /rje sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rje bzung / /bka' dam chos kun gyis dad pa yal/ /lha dkar phyogs skyong ba thams cad khros/ /bdud nag phyogs gdon rigs rlung ltar 'tshub/ /char dus su mi 'bebs lo dgra mang / /dus mi bde mtha' dbus thams cad 'khrug /spun nye du mi mthun the 'khrug byeg /dus de 'dra'i dusazhig byung tsa na/ /skyabs nges pa'i bla ma dkon mchog gsum/ /don gcig 'dus o rgyan rin po che/ /dus de tshe re sa gzhan na med/ /pha4thugs rjes bzung zhig pad+ma 'byung / /tshe 'didang phyi ma bar dogasum/ /skyabs gzhan na ma mchis khyed rang shes/ /bdag gdung shugs drag po'i gsol btab pas/ /rje pad+ma 'byung gnas 'od du zhu/ /mi bdag dang dbyer med gcig tu 'dres/ /don dbang bzhi byin rlabs gcig char thob/ /da tshur ltos rang gi sems la ltos/ /sems bltas pas gzugs dang kha dog med/ /de bltas pas mi mthong ngang la bzhog /don sems ngo mthong shes de la zer/ /sems gnas na gnas pa'i ngang la bltas/ /sems stong gsal ngang la lhan ner bzhog /sems gar 'gro glod la rgyang bsrung gis/ /de chu rlabs chu la thim pa bzhin/ /sems 'phro rgod stong nyid ngang du zhig /rang sems kyis sems la lta ba de/ /rje pad+ma 'byung gnas lta ba yin/ /de ma yengs goms 'gris byed pa la/ /sgom nyams len ming du btags pa yin/ /don tshogs gnyis mtha' ru phyin pa dang / /dus nam zhig 'bras bu sangs rgyas thob/ /mi bdag gis gsol 'debs dge sbyor sogs/ /dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba 'dis/ /tshe 'di la tshe ring nad med cing / /dpal 'byor pa yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel/ /dus nam zhig 'di nas 'pho ba'i tshe/ /nub bde ba can gyi zhing khams su/ /lus rdzus skyesaljul skur thob nas kyang / /rten de la sa bcu rab bgrod nas/ /don bla med byang chub thob par shog /gzhi chos dbyings skye ba med pa dang / /lam rten 'brel bslu ba med pa dang / /skyabs pad 'byung thugs rjes tshad med mthus/ /bdag smon lam btab bzhin 'grub par shogadam pa rgya gar la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs don gyi bcud len zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /dam pa rgya gar la brtan pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs don gyi bcud len zhes bya ba/bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /na mo r+ghaṃ: skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'gro rnams byang chub thob phyir sems bskyed do/ /maṇ+ḍal rnam gsum sangs rgyas zhing du 'bul//sgrib sbyang bzlas mchog badz+ra satwa r+ghaṃ/ /oṃ ā:rdu trī: rang lus phung khams yi dam lhar gsal ba'i/ /spyi bo'i 'ja' 'od thig le'i mu 'byams dbus/ /pad+ma stong ldan ge sar nyi zla'i steng / /ā:yig dkar po yongs gyur ngo bo ni/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma pad 'byung dbyer med pa'i/ /rnam par rgya gar dam pa'i mi pham mgon/ /a tsar dar babs dmar smug du ba'i mdog /dbu skra yo 'bog sdong po ltar zing zhing / / 446

spyan gsum shangs nyag bzhad—zhal tshems dkar 'thags/ /sma ra yig tshom rgya rnams dmar ser snum/ /drang srong 'dug stangs phyakhakhri gnyis thugs ka ru/ /'khor 'dasabaden gnyis rten 'brel phyag rgya mdzad/ /gcer bu rus rgyan stag lpagasalke sham thabs ga sol/ /snang srid gil gyis gnon pa'i sku ru bskyed/ /de yi spyi bora'ijam dpal rdo rdze ni/ /dmar ser cho sa 'chad phyag rgya'i theb mdzub kyi sa/ /usprul yu 'dzin snyan thad kha rgyas pa'i/ /steng du shes rab ral gri pu ti snamaso/ /gdeng trelnga'i steng du rolo pa'i 'ardug5stangs 'gyings/ /dar dang rin chen rgyan cha phun tshogs gsol/ /dekre spyi bor kun bzang rdo rje 'chang / /sngo dwangs longs sku'i chasaljogartso phyoge gnyis kyis/ ri/rnam rol phyag rgyas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /zhabs gnyis rdor skyil rang 'od yum dang dgyes/ /de dag sku yi mtha' skor 'od gur nang / /grub thob pho mo lnga bcu rtsa bzhi dang / /rig gnas g.yo rlung bde nyams phyag rgya brda'i/ /bla ma bcu gcig rig pa ngo sprad kyi/ /bla ma gsum dang mkha' spyod sum bcu drug /thugs dam bde gshegs bla ma bcu gnyis sogs/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras nam mkha'i khyon khengs pa'i/ /mdun du bdag gi sgo gsum gus phyag 'tshal/ /phyi nang gsang ba bla med mchod sprin 'bul/ /byang chub chen po'i bar du skyabs su mchi/ /'gro kun 'dren phyir byang chub sems bskyed bgyid/ /spyi dang bye brag sngags sdom brtan por bzung / /khyed kyi ye shes thugs rje byin rlabs kyis/ /bdag rgyud smin grol zung 'jug rdo rje sems/ /gdan thog 'di ru skad cig de nyid du/ /'grub mdzod rgyal ba nus pa'i mthu ma chung / /zhes 'don sgom sbrag la snang srid kun gyi sgrogs par bsam nas a li ka li tshar bzhi /bzlas/ de nas bla ma'i gnas bzhir rdo rje bzhi/ rang bzhin oṃ a:rdu trī:'od 'bar ba'i/ /zer 'phreng dkar dmar mthing 'dus rang lus snang / /khengs par bsam ngang gsang sngags 'di nyid zla'o/ /oṃ ā:r+ghaṃ gu ru sirnyi r+ghaṃ/ thun bsdu tshe/ spyi bo'i bla ma 'khor rnams la 'dus/ /gtso yang 'od zhu rang gi snying gar thim/ /rang sems bla ma'i thugs dang ro mnyam pa/ /byin rlabs don gyi 'pho ba thob par bsam/ /dar cig sgo gsum rang gnas su skyong ngo / /mthar grub par gyur cig man ngag gi dpal ldan bla ma'o/ /dge ba 'di yi skye bo kun/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs nas/ /bsod nams ye shes las byung ba'i/ /dam pa gnyis po thob par shog /ces brjod/ de ltar grub pa'i dus bsnyen zla ba drug grangs bsnyen sa ya brgyad/ rtags bsnyen bla ma dngos mnyam mi lam du mjal zhing khyad par 'khor ba skyo shas thar par nges 'byung / bla mar mos gus/ 'gro la snying rje gnas lugs nyams rtogs rgyud la skye ba mchog gi rtags so/ /thun mong du yang 'phrin las bzhi dang /lha 'dre mi gsum 'du bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar dus grangs rtags kyi bsnyen pa theb pas rtsa ba yan lag bla mar dam sel ma shor na bar dor byang chub lam na zin par the tshom med par rdo rje 'chang gi zhi byed a 447

li ka li rgyud du gsung pas na mi slu nges pas/ mchog lam don du gnyer ba rnams kyis snying la 'chang zhing / de ltar dam pa'i zhi byed nyams len bcud/ /zab dril nyung min rgya chen don gsal byed/ /cig chos las mchog blo sbyong bla sgrub 'di/ /byin rlabs bla ma'i sku yis smra bar byed/ /dge des 'gro kun thar pa'i lam mchog la/ /zhugs te myu ra du mya ngan 'das thob shog /rnam mang chos la zad pa'i mtha' med kyi/ /chig chos bla bsgrusa'adi la kun 'bad byos/ /zhes dpal chen rdo rje semar+sā dpa' dang gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje slob dpon mang pos rjes su gzung gnas lugs kyi don la blo phyogs pa mdo khams kaḥthog lho phyogs su skyes pa'i rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus mnga' ris smad kyi gus ldan gla ma 'jigs med nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyis gsol ba btab ngor lcags khyi nag zla'i tshes bcur brjod pa dge'o/ /rang mdun nam mkhar seng khri pad zla'i steng / /rig kun khyab bdag rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /sngags spyod chas rdzogs rdor dril thugs kar bsnol/ /rol pa'i skyil krung 'ja' 'od klong du bzhugs/ /de yi thugs kar rig 'dzin gter bdag gling / /dkar dmar mdangs ldan rdo rje thod pa 'dzin/ /bla ma'i spyi bor rig bdag pad+ma 'byung / /kun gyis gnas gsum yi ge'i 'od zer gyi/ /rang bzhin gnas rnams sras bcas rgyal ba kun/ /spyan drangs rtsa ba'i bla mar gnyis med thim/ /oṃ ā:hūṃ/ zhes ci nus su bzlas mthar/ oṃ ā:rgyu kun bzang snang mtha' gu ru pad+ma 'byung / /kun gyi ngo bo rig 'dzin gter bdag gling / /rtsa brgyud bla ma bcas la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag rgyud smin grol mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ /rgyal kun 'dus pa'i spyi dpal dkyil 'khor gtso/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i dbang phyug rig pa 'dzin/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rang rig chos sku'i rang zhal dus 'dir ston/ /oṃ ā:hūṃ sarba sirnyi pha la r+ghaṃ a/ zhes pa'i gsol btab bla ma'i gnas bzhi nas/ /'od zer dkar dmar mthing ljang bar ma chad/ /rang gi gnas bzhir thim pas dbang bzhi thob/ /sgrib dag lam 'byongs 'bras bu sku bzhi brnyes/ /mthar ni bla ma rang la thim gyur te/ /rang sems bla ma'i thugs dang dbyer med 'dres/ /dge des chos dang gzugs kyi sku 'grub nas/ khams gsum 'khor ba dong nas sprug par shog /ces gtsang nyang gi grub chen mi phyed pa'i mos gus dad brtson dam tshig dang ldan pa 'gyur med kun bzang rang grol gyis gter bdag gling pa dbyer med pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig dgos zhes bskul ngor tshe dbang nor bus lcags khyi gro bzhin zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad kyi thun skabs zhig du smras pa dge'o/ /na mo gu ra we/ bdag lus 'dzin med spyi bor 'od lnga'i gur/ /seng ge brgyad dang pad+ma'i nyi zla'i steng / /rig pa r+ghaṃ las kun bzang rdo rje sems/ /rnam pa rtsa ba'i bla ma'i cha lugs la/ /bag dro byin chags rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /'khor los bsgyur ba chas su zhugs par gyis/ /'khor du mchog gsum rtsa gasta~X rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /dpag med sprin gyi phung po thib bzhin gsal/ /bdag gi sgo gsum gus pas

phyag 'tshal zhing / /lus dang longs spyod dpal kun mchod par 'bul/ /tshe rabs thog med nas bsags sdig kun bshags/ /bla med blartsom bsgrub la rjes yi rang / /gsangañdzags bla med chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /'gro don bskal pa rgya mtshor bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /bdag gis dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs kun/ /'gro kun bla ma mchog 'grub du bsngo/ /oṃ ā:rdu badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi rgyu/ kun bzang rdor sems pad 'byung karno/ /rig bdag bla ma mcho ga la gsol ba 'debs/ /nam snying rin chen rdo rje zur chung pa/ /ye shes sku brnyes bla mar gesol ba 'debs/ /dwags bsgom tshul khrims nam 'od tsā ri ras/ /rdo rje thugs brnyes bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /byams 'bum grags dpal rdo rje rgyal po sogs/ /grub pa'i sgron me bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /byang gling tshul 'bum kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel/ /'gro 'dren sprul pa'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /sems dpa' che dang grol mchog kun dga' snying / /bstan pa'i srog shing bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /ye shes rgya mtsho pad+ma ma ṇi sogs/ /sbas tshul 'gro skyong bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /dus 'dir bdag sogs 'gro la smin grol ster/ /drin chen rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /khyed la gdung shugs drag po'i gsol btab mthus/ /bdag sogs dus 'di nas bzung byang chen sar/ /pad 'byung nam snying dngos brgyud sprul pa yis/ /rjes bzung min grol zab dgu'i gdams ngag thob/ /rim gnyis sgom pa'i yon tan gong du 'phel/ /mi rtog lta ba'i gding chen mtha' ru phyin/ /gzhan phan 'phrin las spyod pa phyogs bcur rgyas/ /kun bzang bla ma'i 'bras bu myur thob shog /ces gsol ba gdab/ mthar ni bla ma rang la thim pa yis/ /bdag lus bla ma'i skur zhugs bum dbang thob/ /bdag ngag bla ma'i gsung gyur gsang dbang thob/ /bdag yid bla ma'i thugs gcig sher dbang thob/ /sgo gsum dbyer med rig pa'i rtsal dbang thob/ /chos kun gdod nas spros bral bde chen dbyings/ /zab gsal mnyam nyid ngang du mnyam par bzhag /de yi dge tshogs 'gro la yongs su bsngo/ /de mthus khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can kun/ /glo bur 'khrul pa'i dri ma yongs sangs te/ /mi 'gyur bde chen sku gsum yon tan rgyas/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i go 'phang myur thob shog /ces dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' dang gnyis su med pa 'jigs med dbyangs can dga' ba'i zhal snga nas gang gi ring lugs dri ma med par 'dzin cing rang gi rdo rje slob mar gyur pa la stod lto 'bur pa zhabs drung dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa blo bzang nam mkha' 'jigs med gang gi gsung gis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor bod chen gyi mnga' ris su skyes shing yangs pa'i rgyal khams su chos smra ba rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus gang shar lhug pa nyid du shing byi snron zla'i dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum par shar phyogs kong yul ljon pa lung nas spel ba sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāsti/ bdag gi phung khams gdan gsum dag pa'i dpal/ /spyi bor 'od gur seng khri pad zla'i steng / /rdo rje sems dpa'i rang mdangs gsang ba sbyin/ /pad zhu chos gos gsum gsol cho~X zlochad

rgyas/ /pad dkar rdor dril brgyan pa g.yas su 'dzin/ /pad dmar pod ral mtshan pa yongs su brnyes/ /spyi bor rdor stems thugs kar 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /g.yon na g.yang gnas lha mo bdud rtsi stobs/ /mthong dang dran pathom gyi ye shes skye /bdag la dbang bskur byin rlabs mdzad bzhugs bsam/ /oṃ ā:rdu/ kun bzang rdor sems thugs rjes rang mdangs las/ /gsang bdag in+d+ra bho ti kun dga' bo/ /zla ba grags dang thon mi sasto ṭa/ /zhi snying bai ro tsa na 'jig rten mig /a ro tsā mi rong zom mkhas pa'i dbang / /tshal bsgomasgordo rje gling dang kun skyong gling / /snying rje chen pos sgyu ma ltar sprul sku/ /kun gyi spyi dpal chos kyi rgyal ba'i mtshano/ /dbyangs can dga' ba 'jigs med blo gros gter/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bo gsang ba sbyin pa zhes/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje rang bzhin mkha' khyab dngos/ /dpal ldan bla ma mchog der gsol 'debs kyis/ /thugs rjes gzigs mdzod bdag rgyud yongs brgyan cing / /thun mong grub brgyad khyad par smin grol mchog /tshe 'dir dus 'dir gdan thog 'di nyid du/ /mngon sum grub pa thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /oṃ ā:ma hā gu ru ā bha ya gu ya dā na sidhi pha la hūṃ/mthar ni bla ma 'od kyi gong bur zhu/ /rang snying dbus thim thugs sems dbyer med 'dres/ /de ltar bla sgrub dge ba 'gror bsngo mthus/ /kun kyang bla ma'i go 'phang myur thob shog /ces rje btsun 'jigs med dbyangs can dga' ba'i dbon rigs 'bur pa mi rje gzhon nu dad pa rdo rje lha skyabs kyis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor yul mdo khams kyi rgyud du skyes zhing phyogs kun tu chos smra ba'i rnal 'byor rgyal khams pa tshe dbang nor bus shing bya'i snron zla'i dmar phyogs gang ba'i tshes bzang por kong yul ljon pa lung nas spel ba sarba maṅga lo/ 450

༄ga /rgyal ba kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol 'debs rnal 'byor thun mong ma yin pa byin rlabs yid bzhin gte ra mdzod rtses bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra a kar+ṣa gan+ta ya/ na mo r+ghaṃ: skyabs gnas dkon mchog rtsa gsum 'dus spyi dpal/ /rdo rje slob dpon zhabs la skyabs su mchi'o/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro kun pha ma gyur pa la/ /snying brtse ma hā gu ru bsgrub par bya/ /bdag lus gdod nas lhun grub gdan gsum la/ /spyi bo'i kha dbyings pad+ma'i gur khang dbus/ /rdo rje'i khri la zla'i gdan steng du/ /khyab bdag rdo rje slob dpon kun bdus pa'i/ /pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal 'chang nam mkha'i snying / /bod grub dge slong cha byed chos gos can/ /sku mdog dkar smug sha rgyas paṇa zhu gsol/ /phyag g.yas khro bo'i khu tshur thugs kar byung / /g.yon pa rdo rje khu tshur dku ru brten/ /rdor skyil sku la 'ja' 'od me dpung 'phro/ /spyi bor gu ru gsang ba 'dus pa bzhugs/ /thugs kar badz+ra ho ru ka dpal 'char/ /gnas gsum rdo rje gsum dngos 'bru gsum las/ /'od 'phros rang bzhin du khrod me 'bar nas/ /ye shes spyan drangs dam tshig dbyer med bzhugs/ /bdag gi sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing / /bdag lus longs spyod dpal 'byor tshe bsod rnams/ /gtan gyi 'dun mar bcas pas yongs mchod nas/ /skyabs gnas gcig mchog phur tshugs gdung ba yi/ /gus pa'i yid kyis rab tu gsol ba 'debs/ /oṃ ā hūṃ: rab 'byams rgyal ba rgya mtsho 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bla med bla ma kun gyi gtso bo mchog /dam pa sku gnyis spyi dpal rdo rje sems/ /gu ru nam mkha' snying por gsol ba 'debs/ /he ru ka dpal yongs kyi spyi gyur pa/ /gnyis med ye shes dra1ba yongs sdom mdzad/ /thugs mchog yang dag rdo rje khrag 'thung rgyal/ /dpal chen nam mkha'i snying por gsol ba 'debs/ /chos dbyings mkha' la bde chen sprin 'pho bas/ /phyi nang gzhan gsum yongs spyod mkha' 'gro ma/ /kun gyi ngo bor gyur cing kun gyi bdag /mkha' 'gro nam mkha' snying por gsol ba 'debs/ /ye shes dbyings nas 'bar ba'i cho 'phrul gar/ /ci yang bsgyur zhing 'phrin las rnam bzhi yi/ /byang chub 'bras bu myur du smin mdzad pa/ /chos skyong nam mkha'i snying por gsol ba 'debs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis gnyis med ye shes thugs/ /dam chos rgya mtsho'i sgra dbyangs rtag 'char gsung / /'phags pa'i dge 'dun ma lus 'phro ba'i sku/ /mchog gsum nam mkha' snying por gsol ba 'a~Xdis / /

kun khyab ye shes rtag brtan spros bral ngang / /lhun grub mthug po bkod par nges lnga'i bdag /gang 'dul cho 'phrul sprul pa rgya mtsho'i gzhi/ /sku gsum nam mkha'i snying por gsol ba 'debs/ /mtha' brgyad las 'das stong nyid 'od gsal lta/ /zab gsal bde chen yongs sgrub bsgom pa che/ /chos kun 'ub chub rang rdzogs spyod pa'i rtse/ /rtsal rdzogs nam mkha' snying por gsol ba 'debs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bor yongs grub cing / /sras gyur byang sems rig 'dzin grub chen tshul/ /sgyu 'phrul rgya mtsho 'dod dgu'i gar bsgyur mdzad/ /khyab brdal nam mkha' snying por gsol ba 'debs/ /khyod ni gsang bdag thugs kyi rdo rje sems/ /dngos gyur sprul pas mkha' khams mthar thug khyab/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas las gzhan gyis grangs bzung ci/ /tshad med nam mkha' snying por gsol ba 'debs/ /gdul bya tshur mthong nyer 'tshe snang ngo ru/ /khyed kyi sgyu 'phrul rim gyi gcig car tshul/ /dpe med grong 'khrungs rin chen rdo rje 'dzin/ /bod sngags sbyar grol rtser son shes rab grags/ /'od gsal 'khor yug me tshom dwags sgom tshul/ /mkha' 'gros yongs mchod nam 'od rtsa ris ras/ /byams dpal byams 'bum gzhan phan mkha' ltar brdal/ /e ma ma ṇi rin chen 'gro 'dul mkhas/ /thang dbon grags dpal 'od gsal rdo rje thugs/ /bde chen zhing gshegs ri khrod dar brgyas zhabs/ /zab gter mdzod 'byed byang chub gling pa dpal/ /sangs rgyas blo gros rtsa gsum grub pa'i gtso/ /byang chub sems bsnyes chos kyi rin po che//'ja' lus rdo rje'i skur gshegs bsod nams mchog /lung rigs rnga sgra rgod pa sangs rgyas 'phel/ /rnam dag tshul khrims 'dzin mkhas bzod dpal grub/ /mkhas dbang dam pa ye shes rgya mtsho'i sde/ /sbas tshul sngags spyod pad+ma ma ṇi sogs/ /sprul pa'i 'dod gar cir yang byed pa po/ /sprul bzhi nam mkha' snying por gsol ba 'debs/ /deng dus snyigs ma bdag 'dra'i gdul bya la/ /so skyes rang gzugs tshul gyis 'dul ba'i phyir/ /dge bshes tha mal kun rgyu rnal 'byor spyod/ /byin rlabs cung zad zhugs la sprul pa'i mtshan/ /'chang gyur rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'i sde/ /gzhan phan nus pa'i rtsal shugs ci tsam kun/ /pad 'byung nam snying mthu stobs kho na ste/ /skyabs gcig nam mkha' snying por gsol ba 'debs/ /mgon khyod mtshan tsam gyis kyang byin rlabs mthus/ /'di lta don gnyis sgrub la g.yel
