med pas/ /rang nyid phyir mi ldog pa'i lam la gshegs/ /gdul bya thar pa'i lam la dkri byed pa'i/ /gang 'dul 'phrin las bzhi yi mdzad pa skyong / /'phrin las 'gro 'dul 'gro ba yongs 'dul zhes/ /lcags la gser 'gyur rtsi zhing brgyas 'debs so/ /'dren mchog nam mkha'i snying por gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar rtsa ba'i bla ma'i ngo bo nyid/ /nam mkha' snying por rtse gcig gsol btab mthus/ /bdag sogs gdukā ༵ 'gro kun tshe rabs rtag /dal 'byor phun tshogs mtho ris 'phags nor ldan/ /pad 'byung

nam snying dngos rgyud sprul pa yis/ /rjes bzung nges 'byung dad pa lhag bsam rgyas/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab bslab rtsal rdzogs/ /byang chen go 'phang ring min myur 'grub shog /mdor na pad 'byung nam snying sprul bcas kyi/ /mi dge dus mtha'i skad gcig yun mi spyad/ /dgyes na bskal par dmyal ba mnar med kyang / /yid 'ong grong zhing sprod pas 'jug byed na/ /mgon khyed bsnyen phyir lus srog smos ci 'tshal/ /gtan gyi 'dun ma'ang bla ma mnyes phyir ste/ /rgyal bas bsngags shing dam pa'i rnam thar mchog /ji bzhin dad mos gus la rtag gnas shog /dus kun bdag med snying brtse'i gnyis med pas/ /srid par mi gnas zhi la mi chags par/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bla ma rdo rje sems/ /go 'phang dam pa mngon par thob nas kyang / /ma bsgrub bzhin snang sgyu ma lta bu'i 'gror/ /gang 'dul thabs kyi mdzad pa rgya che la/ /rgyun mi chad pas mkha' mnyam sems can kun/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas sar bdag gis sbyor bar shog /rtsa ba'i bla ma khyed mthu la brten nas/ /bka' yi bla mar yid ches tshul bzhin spyod/ /brda yi bla mas cir snang rang sar grol/ /tshul des rang rig don gyi bla ma mchog /gdod nas rnam dag ngo bo chos kyi dbyings/ /rig pa sangs rgyas kun gyi chos sku mchog /glo bur dri ma'i tshogs spangs mi 'gyur bde/ /rang zhal dus 'dir mthong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe dbang rig 'dzin pad 'byung mkha' dbyings las/ /nam mkha' snying po nor bu 'od zer 'phro/ /bdag blo 'khrul pa'i mun pa yongs gsal nas/ /khyod dang mtshungs pa nyid du bdag mdzod cig /oṃ ā:rdu badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi hūṃ/ de ltar rtse gcig gus pas ltos drag la/ /yun ring gdung bas gsol ba btab pa'i mthar/ /gu ru'i sku las ye shes bdud rtsi rgyun/ /dkar la dmar ldang sngo ba'i 'od 'phro ba/ /mar bab bdag gi tshang ba'i sgo nas zhugs/ /nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sang sang dag /mgrin yan khengs pas bum dbang lam 'bras rdzogs/ /snying ga gsang dbang lte ba sher ye'i dbang / /gsang ba khengs pas dbang bzhi'i lam 'bras rdzogs/ /lus kun yongs khengs rigs rtsal dbang rdzogs shing / /bla ma bdag snying dbus byon 'od gsal ngang / /rtag chad mtha' bral bla ma rang rig 'dres/ /snang grags rig kun bla ma'i sku gsung thugs/ /lam khyer zab gsal bde chen ngang la bzhag /de ltar gu ru nam snying rnal 'byor la/ /'bad pa'i dge kun byang chub chen por bsngo/ /de mthus rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i gtso bo mchog /nam snying sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med par/ /sangs rgyas byang sems mdzad 'phrin ma lus kun/ /bdag gi yongs sgrub 'gro kun 'dren par shog / 38 ces byin rlabs rmad byung gu ru'i rnal 'byor thun mong ma yin pa 'di ni lang 'bro dkon mchog 'byung gnas kyi gdung las sngags 'gyur brtan pa'i gsal byed sgrol phug chen po pad+ma kun gsal 'gro kun pa'i bshes gang gi dang / khyab bdag bon lung pa dpal 'byor tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi yang srid gnyis pa gar dbang blo bzang tshul khrims dpal bzang nas kyang bskul zhing / lhag tu skye mchog chen po 'ba' ra ba'i 4ṭ+wāṃ zlon smra

ba 'jam gling bla ma o rgyan ngag dbang ye shes dpal bzang dang / mkhas gyur rdzogs chen rnal 'byor lha rje dam pa ye shes dpal 'bar drung nas kyang yang yang nan gyi bskul ba mdzad cing / de bzhin snye mo bde gling sde pa rdo rje bkra shis dang / a tha gling gi rta mgrin tshe dbang sogs snye mos 'dus sde dad ldan pho mo thams cad kyis gus pa chen po'i mgrin gcig tu gsol ba btab pa dang / mang mam lcam o rgyan dpal 'dzin nas kyang dngos ngag kho na rgyud nas do gal gyi bskul bas rkyen byes te/ mdo khams kaḥ thog lho rgyud du 'od gsal las bab pa dngu yi rigs su skyes gyur shākya'i dge bsnyen sngags kyi rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu 'phrin las 'gro 'dul 'gro ba yongs 'dul rtsal gyis rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me 'brug sa ga zla ba'i tshes bcu la gzhu yul sa yi thig le 'brong dkar rdzong du thun gcig la grub par byas yi ge pa shes rab bstan 'dzin te/ 'di yang 'gro ba kun gu ru nam mkha' snying po'i go 'phang myur du thob pa'i rgyu gyur cig dge'o/ /bkra shis/

rog /grub pa kun gyi gzhung lam rmad byung ting 'dzin rgyun dbang snying gi bdud rtsi yang dag bla ma'i rnal 'byor bzhugs so/ /oṃ na mo gu ru rgyu/ skyabs yul dkon mchog kun 'dus ngo bo nyid/ /pad+ma badz+ra gu rur skyabs su mchi'o/ /nam mkha'i mtha' las 'gro kun snying re rje/ /kun kyang thar mchog thob phyir bdag sems skyed/ / 1 r+ghaṃ: bdag lus rags pa'i phung po stong par dang / /phra ba gnyug ma'i lus 'di rang rig dang / /sangs rgyas sras slob bcas pa'i yum sher phyin/ /sngags kyi khyad chos sngags bdag rnal 'byor ma/ / 2 chos dbyings gzugs sku me long pra phab bzhin/ /skad cig gsang ye rdo rje phag gdong can//dmar lo gcer bu zhi khro chags pa'i nyams/ /rna ltag g.yas nas gyen lta phag zhal nag / 3 phyag gnyis rdo rje thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ mtshan/ /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum pad nyi bam gdan brdzis/ /dbu rgyan thod skam rdo rje'i 'phreng bas spel/ /thod rlon do shal rdor 'phreng gser dril 'khrol/ / 4 phyag zhabs gser gyi 'khor los rnam par brgyan/ /rus pa'i brgyan 'chang ye shes me 'phung 'bar/ /rdo rje mtshon cha 'phro ba'i gur dbus bzhugs/ /dmar ser ral pa gyen brjes spyi gtsug tu/ / 5 pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng bzhi ldan mgon/ /'khor lo'i dbang phyug rtsa ba'i bla ma'i dngos/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas skyabs yul kun 'dus gtso/ /dmar smug gcer bu rdor dril rol tshul 'dzin/ / 6 ral pa'i thor cog gtsug tor mngon par 'phags/ /rdo rje'i rgyan 'chang dar gyi cod pan phur/ /sang du ye shes mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal dmar/ /ral pa sil bu gri thod yab la 'khyud/ / 7 yab yum rdor pad skyil krung bde ba che/ /mi bzod ye shes 'od dmar rab tu 'khrug /gnas gsum rdo rje gsum dngos ye shes las/ /'od 'phros rab 'byams rgyal ba sras slob 'bangs/ /8 ma lus sku gsung thugs gsang 'khor lo kun/ /yongs bsdus bla ma yab yum lus la zhugs/ /byin rlabs gzi bajid nus mthu mchog rab rgyas/ /gcig mchog nor bu bla ma rin po che/ / 9 bdag rlus longs spyod tshe bsod gtan 'dun bcas/ /kha zhe med par yongs su phul byas shing / /rtse gcig dad gus gdung shugs gsol 'debs mthus/ /yab yum gsang ba'i bdud rtsi dbang bzhi bskur/ / 10 oṃ/ gsang gsum sku yi bdud rtsi rab dwangs pas/ /bdag gi bde chen longs spyod bar kun kheng / /dam tshig phyag rgya rgyas 'debs bum pa'i dbang4 /55/sbyang

thob smin gyur sprul sku'i 'bras rdzogs shog / 11 a/ gsang gsum gsung gi bdud rtsi rab thim pas/ /bdag gi longs spyod chos 'khor bar khengs nas/ /chos kyi phyag rgya rgyas 'debs sher ye'i dbang / /sbyang thob smin gyur chos sku'i 'bras rdzogs shog / 12 r+ghaṃ/ gsang gsum thugs kyi bdud rtsi rab sems pas/ /bdag gi chos nas sprul 'khor bar khengs nas/ /las kyi phyag brgya rgyas 'debs sher ye'i dbang / /sbyang thob smin gyur chos sku'i 'bras rdzogs shog/ / 13 trīḥ gsang gsum ye shes bdud rtsi rab ngom pas/ /bdag gi sprul bde'i 'khor lo yongs khengs pas/ /phyag chen brgya bral rgyas 'debs dbang bzhi pa'i/ /sbyang thob smin pa ngo bo'i sku rdzogs shogs/ / 14 oṃ ā:r+ghaṃ trī: rjes su bla ma yab yum tshang bug nas/ /mar byon snying ka 'khor lo'i dbus bzhugs nas/ /gsang ba'i bdud rtsi mi 'gyur bde chen gyis/ /'khor lo bzhi rgyud lus kun yongs khengs pas/ / 15 sgrib gsum dri ma'i tshogs kun gtan nas bcom/ /mi shig dwangs ma 'gyur med rdo rje gsung / /sangs rgyas kun gyis gsang ba gsum rang bzhin/ /mi 'dzad rgyan gyi 'khor lo rol bar shog / 16 bdag gi sgo gsum bla ma'i sku gsung thugs/ /dbyer med nyag gcig gdod ma'i gshis lugs dbyings/ /sku gsum mtshan dpe ye shes 'khor lo'i khams/ /mnyam nyid zung 'jug rdzogs pa cher thob shog / 17 ho: rdzogs sangs rgyas pa kun gyi gsang ba'i bcud/ /thun drug rdo rje theg pa'i yang snying ni/ /thog dmar smin byed bar du grol byed stegs/ /thun drug 'bru'i tshul lar nyer zhugs pa/ / 18 bla ma'i rnal 'byor ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang / /de ltar bdag gi nyams su len pa'i mthus/ /bzod pa mchog gi sa la ma 'khod par/ /skye ba ji srid kun tu mtho ris kyi/ / 19 yon tan 'phags nor rab rgyas khams drug lus/ /thob dang 'dren pa mdo rgyud nas bsngags pa'i/ /mtshan ldan bla med rjes su nyer bzung zhing / /lam mchog rdo rje theg la rtag 'jug shog / 20 de yang bla ma'i dad gus zla med par/ /rgyas shing dam tshig rnam par dag gyur nas/ /bsrung sdom bral ba kun bzang myur 'grub shog /'gro kun khyab cig sangs rgyas sar 'dren shog / 21 ces bsngags sam thun drug snying po rmad du byung ba gu ru pad+ma'i man ngag bsnyan rgyud rdzogs pa chen po'i srog shing lam zab thun mong du gyur zhing thun mong ma yin pa 'di ni rig 'dzin stag sham nus ldan bsam gtan rdo rje'i zab gter las byung zhing nyams gzhes kyi mthar thug sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma bde chen gling pa'i zhal las thos pa rang gi thun bzhi'i nyams len snying po dang mthun par 'di ni rtsod pa med pa gter ston chos rje gling pa yi rnam par rol pa'i cha can du dpal karma pas gsung gi byin gyis rlabs pa gang de bas nan tan chen pos bskul ba la brten dpal rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus dus kyi pho nya'i lo smin drug zla ba'i tshes bcur kong yul gdan sa 456

chen po dga' ldan ma lor thun bar skabs su ngag 'don klog bde nyung ngur bris pa ste dge legs su gyur cig 'di ni thun bzhi la chags par nyams su len pa phyag bzhes te de ltar gal che zhing / de yang ma gsang na dngos grub yal bar bshad pas shin tu gsang bar bya'o/ /'di snyigs gi bu la 'bog pa'i skabs su rang gi bsgom bzhin byed te dbang bzhi re re bzhin dang bar mtshams su sngags bzla rol mo 'khrol/ mthar me tog gtor shis pa brjod pa smon lam bzang la rgya cher gdab par bya'o/ /de ltar sngags kyi sgor zhugs pa rnams spyir yang bla ma yid dang ma bral bar lha sngags/ chos nyid kyi rol pa chu bo'i rgyun ltar skyongs dgos pa ni gzhir bcas shing / bye brag tu thun tu bcad de sgom pa la yang / bum dbang gi rjes 'brel lha sngags bsgom bzlas/ gsang dbang gi rlung sbyor gtum mo rang lus/ sher dbang gi gzhan lus phyag rgya ma spyod pa/ dbang bzhi'i don khreg chod/ rtsal dbang gi thod brgal sgom pa'i thun 'go thun 'jug tu zab lam 'di thun re res bsgom pa bar chad zhi/ gegs sel/ bogs 'don/ yang dag pa'i lam thob par byed pa ste bka' lung dang rang myong tshad mas grub pa'o/ /lar gyi sngags lam ston pa ni bla ma kho nar rag las shing / de yang dbang bskur gyi gzhi bca'/ dam tshig gi srog phur btsugs/ lam zab ting nge 'dzin gyi bcud len la 'bad pa ni sngags shes rig pa 'dzin gyur ma lus mi lus lus pa med pa gtam gyi snying po kho na ste/ sngags 'chang ba'i spyi 'debs so/ /des na bla ma'i dad dung mos gus chen po dam tshig la rab tu 'bad cing gsol 'debs brtson pa ni shin tu gal che ba las kyang ches che ba 'di kho na'o/ /de ni lam gzhan la rags ma las par tshe gcig la sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang la 'god par byed pa'i thabs rmad du byung ba e ma ho a la la ho/ zhes brjod pa'i gnas so/ /zhes pa yang gong gi 'phros las zhar byung du dpal tshe dbang nor bus gsol ba maṅga lasku tu rgyu/ dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ / 457

༄gi /bla ma'i rnal 'byor bshags smon dang 'brel ba rmad byung bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / swāsti/ skyabs gnas dkon mchog snying nas yongs su bzung / /mkha' khyab 'gro la byang chub sems mchog bskyed/ /bdag lus ho ru ka'i spyi bo ru/ /'khor los mgon po dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /rgyal dbang bka' brgyud 'phrin las shing rta'i zhabs/ /dkar dmar mdangs ldan rab tu byung ba'i chas/ /dbu la cod paṇa pad+ma kha 'bus bcings/ /rdor dril rnam rol phyag rgyas thugs dkar 'dzin/ /spyi bor rig bdag rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /thugs kar bde mchog he ru ka dpal bzhugs/ /bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems kun/ /'dus dpal bde ba chen po'i ngo bor gsal/ /gnas gsum 'bru gsum 'od kyi mkha' khyab kyi/ /rgyal ba kun 'dus bla ma'i ngor bor menyam/ /bdag lus longs spyod dus gsum dge rtsa bcas/ /snying nas dpal ldan bla mar mchod par 'bul/ /bdag ni 'di nas byang chen snying po'i bar/ /ci mdzad khyad shes bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /thog med nas bsags sdig ltung dri ma kun/ /mthol zhing bshags na bdag 'tshang dngos grub stsol/ /o badz+ra gu ru satwa sa ma ya zhes pa nas badz+ra gu ru twe no pa zhes gu ru badzi bha wa sa ma ya sa twa a hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes bsgyur ba'i rdo sems yig brgya ci nus bzla/ mgon po dus gsum rgyal kun 'byung ba'i gnas/ /mgon po dus gsum rgyal kun 'phrin las pa/ /mgon po dus gsum 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /mgon po dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bor 'dud/ /rgyal kun 'dus pa bla ma bdag la dgongs/ /bdag ni 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ /las nyon drwa ba mthug pos rtag tu bcings/ /mi shes rmongs pa'i byis pa nyid du gyur/ /des na bdag gi so thar sdom pa dang / /byang chub sems pa rnams kyi spyad pa dang / /rig pa 'dzin pa sngags kyi dam tshig rnams/ /pham ltung nyes byas khyad bsod nyon mongs dbang / /bag med 'gal la snying nas gnong 'gyod kyi/ /sgrib med mkhyen spyan gyis gzigs thugs rje yis/ /phyag brkyang bdag gi spyi bor gnas gzung ste/ /mtha' med 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las sgrol mdzod/ /nyon mongs shugs drag me chen 'bar ba yi thar pa mchog gi sa bon bsregs la nye/ /kye ma kye hud mgon po thugs rje can/ /brtse ba'i chu rgyun sbreng bar mi 'tshal lam/ /sngon bsags bsod nams zhun ma phra mo zhig /rnyed nas thar pa'i bshul lam mtshon snyam yang /45/zlos kyi shugs drag rlung gi rnal nye na/ /thugs rje 'od stong bdag la ci mi skye/ /'khor ba gting

zab sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las/ /thar 'dod dal 'byor gru la dge ba'i bshes/ /ded dpon bsten yang bdag nyid nyon mongs pas/ /gang der gzo ba'i bya ba ma bgyid pas/ /'jigs rung duḥ kha chu srin gyis gang dbus/ /ded dpon mchog gi thugs rjes ma bzung na/ /don nyams tshong phrug gar 'gro ltos med kyi/ /mgon po thugs rje chen pos yongs bzung 'tshal/ /rgyal kun thugs rje 'dus pa'i rang gzugs nyid/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dngos bla ma ste/ /mtha' med 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i byis pa la/ /thugs rje brtse ba chen posaspu bzung na/ /rang lam bde bar bgrod pa'i 'phags pa rnams/ /mgon po khyod kyi thugs rje ci zhig 'tshal/ /mtha' mal 'jol nyog 'dod chags dbang gyur nas/ /bslabs sdom tshul khrims 'gal ba'i slob bu la/ /mgon po khyod kyi thugs rjes mi bzung na/ /bla med rjes snang thabs kyi nus pa thob/ /nyon mongs lam khyer nus pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /dam pa rnams kyi gnang yang ci zhig 'tshal/ /des na bdag blo nyon mongs drag po yis/ /tshangs par spyod pa'i yid 'ong skyed tshal nas/ /bag med khyim thab mi gtsang 'dam rdzab su/ /'khyams la snying nas 'gyod pas mthol bshags na/ /thugs rje brtse ba chen pos nyes med du/ /dbugs dbyung skad cig dus 'dir bstsal nas kyang / /sgrib med dag gtsang rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /da lta nyid du 'khod par mdzad du gsol/ /mdor na bdag gi sgo gsum chos bzhin du/ /spyod par ma byed pa la dpal mgon mchog /bla ma'i thugs dang 'gal ba gnong pa ste/ /gnong pa da pa'i las la ngos bzung nas/ /'di nas ji srid 'tsho'i bar dag tu/ /nyin mtshan thun drug skabs su bshags tshig dang / /bla ma dgyes phyir sgo gsum dge ba'i las/ /ci nus 'bad pa'ang bla ma chos phyir te/ /de na mgon po khyed kyi dgyes pa'i zhal/ /ston zla gang ba lta bus bdag la gzigs/ /spos kyi glang po'i sna bzhin legs pa'i phyag /bdag gi spyi bor zhog cig dpal mgon rje/ /rang gi las kyi rgyu ba'i dbang nyid kyis/ /bla med chos kyi rgyal sar mnga' gsol yang / /nyon dbang srid pa mu to'i gral du tshud/ /rang gi las la rang gi yi mug ldang / /kye ho sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi/ /nyon mongs can dang sdug bsngal sdang ba la/ /lhag par byams shing brtse bar mdzad lags na/ /bdag la thugs brtse mi mdzad ci shig gu/ /des na dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs rje yi/ /lcags kyus bdag snying dbus nas dus nam yang / /'brel ba med par yongs su rab bzung nas/ /mgon po khyed thugs da ris 'dren par shog /skyabs gcig bla ma'i sku gsung thugs nyid dang / /bdag gi sgo gsum dbyer med gcig 'dres nas/ /mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus mtha' dag kun/ /'dren pa'i sde dpon bdag gis byed par shog /khyad par dam chos 'dul ba'i bstan pa la/ /mi gtsang spyod pa'i khrims nyams rma 'byin pa'i/ /sems can ci tsam yod pa de kun yang / /bdag gi ming thos mdo la 459

sdig pa dag /sgrib med tshangs par mtshungs par spyod gyur cig /bla med zab gsal bde ba chen po'i lam/ /rmad byung don dam tshul khrims sdug bsngal la/ /yongs su 'god pa'i byed por bdag gyur shog /bdag gi nyon mongs yul gyur 'gro kun yang / /sdig zad dge bsgrub legs pa'i yon tan 'phel/ /kun kyang thar mchog lam la gegs med zhugs/ /mi ldog bzod pa'i sa mchog yongs brnyes shog /bdag gi dus gsum dge bsags ma lus kun/ /bla ma'i dgyes bskang 'brel bcas 'gro ba'i don/ /yongs su bsngo mtha'i sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa/ /ji bzhin de nyid ring min myur thob shog /mthol zhing bshags ༄pas sdig ltung nyes sgrib kun/ /byang zhing dag pas dpal ldan bla ma dgyes/ /zla ma zhu ltar bdag gi spyi bor thim/ /snying khar byon nas bdag dang dbyer med cig /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun 'dus rdo rje sems/ /rang rig 'di ka las gzhan sangs rgyas med/ /des na sangs rgyas ci 'dra'i 'phrin las kun/ /ma 'dus bdag gi myur ba nyid 'grub shog /bdag gi bzang 'brel chags pa'i yul gyur dang / /khro 'khrug sdang yul rtsub me'i mnar byed pa/ /kun kyang mnyam gcig byang chub chen po yi/ /lam gyi rgyu ru nges par 'gro bar shog /zhes bla ma'i rnal 'byor bshags smon dang spras pa 'di ni bod yul stod mnga' ris ti se nub phyogs klung seng ge kha 'bab kyi ngogs mang yul ljongs kyi mi yi bdag po lugs gnyis kyis mngon par mtho ba'i go 'phang can he mi sprul pa'i sku mi pham 'jam dpal mthu stobs rdo rje gang gi gsung gis yang nas yang du bskul ba'i ngor dpal gdong chu bya zla ba'i tshes dkar mchog gi bzang po gnyis pa'i snga thun skabs ma yul sa yi thig le shel gyi skyed mos tshal du dpal rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu'i smras pa dge'o/ /dge'o/ /bkra shis/ / 460

khug / dbang khrid man ngag gi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol 'debs ji snyed pa bzhugs so/ /tshe sgrub rdo rje rgya bdud kyi gsol 'debs mi zhig dngas ma dngos grub ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ ā hūṃ trīḥ mi shig dwangs ma rtag brtan g.yung drung gi /ngo bor rab bzhugs bde chen 'khor los bsgyur/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sprul bzhi 'od dpag med/ /tshe bdag mgon po mchog der gsol ba 'debs/ /pad+ma'i rigs can yongs kyi bdag po che/ /rgyal ba sras bcas thugs rje gcig bsdus dpal//lag na pad+mos brgyan pa spyan ras gzigs/ /'jig rten dbang phyug mchog der gsol ba 'debs/ /phyogs dus rgyal ba yongs dang sangs rgyas stong / /mthu stobs byin rlabs gcig bsdus ko ṣa'i mtshor/ /rang byung rdo rje sku rnyed pad+ma 'byung / /ma nor bla ma mchog der gsol ba 'debs/ kha sbyor yan lag bde ba chen po'i sku/ /grub pa'i rgyal mo ye shes mtsho rgyal ma/ /stong nyid kha la snying rje'i gter 'gro ba/ /mkha' 'gro yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs/ /spang rtogs mthar phyin rgyal bar yongs grub kyang //gdul byar sman pa'i gzugs skur cir yang 'char/ /'dren pa yongs kyi gtso mchog bde chen gling / /rig 'dzin 'khor los gyur der gsol ba 'debs/ /gang gi rjes bzung thugs las skyes pa'i sras/ /lung rtogs chos kyi dam pa'i gdung 'tsho ba/ /rnal 'byor rdo rje tshe dbang nor bu'i sde/ /drin chen bla ma mchog der gsol ba 'debs/ /smin dbang chu rgyun grol byed gdams pa'i gter/ /legs par rtsol nas thar pa mchog sbyin mdzad/ /'gro ba'i 'dren mchog bka' drin zla med mgon/ /'dren mchog rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor yongs kyi gtso bo mchog /kun rdzob don dam 'chi med rdo rje tshe/ /'gyur med dngos grub stsol mdzad tshe dpag med/ /gos dkar mgyogs mar bcas la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe yi bar chad sel zhing 'phrin las bsgrub/ /tshangs pa brgya byin phyogs skyong rgyal chen bzhi/ /bdag skyobs lha dang dkar po'i chos bsrung ba'i/ /dam chen rgya mtsho'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar tshe yi dkyil 'khor bla ma lhar/ /rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bdag srog skye ba tshe rabs thams cad du/ /mtho ris yon tan 'phags nor bdun gyis phyug /dal 'byor rten thob bshes gnyen dam pas bzung / /bslab gsum rnam dag theg chen sa lam gyis/ /yon tan ma lus myur thob rtsal chen rdzogs/ /don gnyis phun tshogs rgyal ba'i gnas dam pa/ /bdud sde'i 461

bzhi bcom 'chi med rdo rje'i sku/ /skal pa drug ldan mtha' yas 'gro ba'i dpal/ /srid zhi las 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas/ /bde chen mgon po'i go 'phang la 'khod shog /de ltar tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i man ngag 'chi med rdo rje'i rgya mdud kyi rgyud pa'i gsol 'debs mi shig dang ma yongs 'grub ces bya ba 'di ni zha lu dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa rin chen 'jam dpal chos dar gyis yang nas yang du gsung gi bskul bar brten rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'i drag po lcags sprel cho 'khrul zla ba'i mar phyogs tshes bcu'i thun cha shas gcig tu glo lam dkar nag kyi dbus rtag brtan rin po che de dbu'i skyed/ bsam gtan sgom pa'i spyil po 'chi med g.yung drung 'khyil bar bris pa ste dge'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/rdzogs chen dkon mchog spyi 'dud rgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rgyun khyer yid bzhin gter sbyin zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /gu ru pad+ma sirnyi hūm̐ trī: gdod nas byang chub spros bral bde ba che/ /kun bzang 'od dpag med la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshad med snying rjes gter chen kun tu rgyas/ /'phags mchog nam mkha'i rgyal por gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal kun ye shes 'phrin las gcig bsdus pa/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung la gsol ba 'debs/ /bde chen gnyug ma'i chos dbyings zhing gi bdag /ye shes mtsho rgyal zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /dri med 'od gsal rgyas pa'i rang gzugs nyid/ /rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying por gsol ba 'debs/ /thog med zang thal brtul zhugs spyod pa'i dpal/ /rig 'dzin bdud 'dul rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyun mtha'i sar bzhugs byang sems 'gro ba'i mgon/ /rig 'dzin klong gsal snying por gsol ba 'debs/ /srid zhi spyi dpal kun bzang sgyu 'phrul gar/ /pad+ma bde chen gling par gsol ba 'debs/ /snyigs dus 'gro 'dul dal ba'i 'phrin las pa/ /rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bur gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag rgyud smin grol mdzad pa'i bka' drin can/ /'dren mchog rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i gtso bo mchog /gu ru zhi dang drag por gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro yongs kyi spyi dpal che/ /ḍāk+ki sid+dha mu khar gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar bla bsgrub dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mar/ /rtse gcig gsol ba btab mthus rnal 'byor bdag /dus 'di nas tsam skye ba ji srid du/ /dad gus shes rab las 'bras yid ches ldan/ /dam pas rjes bzung dbang khrid gdams pa rdzogs/ /dam tshig rnam dag bskyed rdzogs yon tan rgyas/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro kun thar lam la/ /'dren pa'i byed por bdag nyid 'gyur ba dang / /mthar thug rang don chos kyis skur grol nas/ /gzhan don gzugs sku rgyun mi chad pa yi/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas 'gro ba 'dren byed pa/ /mgon po 'od dpag med dang mtshungs par shog /de ltar bla bsgrub gsol 'debs yid bzhin gter sbyin zhes bya ba 'di yang sa pho rta yi lo cho 'phrul zla ba'i dmar phyogs gang ba bod yu~X ḍibus 'gyur bsam yas lhun gyi grub pa'i gtsug lag khang dbus su rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus spom rong

rje 'bangs dad pa can gyi ngor brjodapa dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /bkra shis/ /snyan brgyud bla ma yang gsang pad+ma 'od 'bar gyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs yid bzhin tog gi phreng ba bzhugs so/ /o āḥhūṃ trīḥ khyab brdal phyogs bral chos dbyings zhing khams su/ /rang byung ye sangs rgyas pa gdod ma'i mgon/ /rgyal kun mes po kun bzang yab yum la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs/ /r+ghaṃ rgyu r+ghaṃḥ bde chen 'dus ma byas shing zhing khams su/ /sku lnga'i bdag nyid gsung gi rdo rje 'chang / /pad+ma rgyal po 'od dpag med mgon la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs/ /r+ghaṃ rgyu hūṃḥ 'od lnga thig le 'dus pa'i zhing khams su/ /rigs rnams kun 'dus sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gtso/ /rig pa ye shes rdo rje sems mchog la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs/ /r+ghaṃ hūṃ hūṃḥ 'gyur med pad+ma 'od gyi zhing khams su/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas yongs kyi ngo bo nyid/ /mtsho skyes sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyu rtsu t+t+waṃḥ 'pho med dga' bzhi'i dngas ma'i zhing khams su/ /rgyal kun skyed mdzad shes rab pha rol phyin/ /bde chen rgyal yum ye shes mtsho rgyal la/ gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs/ /r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃḥ zag bral gnyug ma rang gsal zhing khams su/ /rig pa'i rtsal rdzogs rgyal ba kun gyi sras/ /bdud 'dul nus ldan rdo rje rtsal 'chang la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs/ /hūṃ r+ghaṃ rduḥ ma tshogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i zhing khams su/ /'gro ba yongs 'dul brtul zhugs nus pa'i bdag /pad+ma nor bu rdo rje gzi brjid la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs/ /r+ghaṃ hūṃ hūṃḥ skal ldan smin cing grol ba'i zhing khams su/ /rig 'dzin chen po yongs kyi 'khor los bsgyur/ /'dren mchog dang ma pad+ma bde chen la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs/ /r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃḥ phyogs med 'gro don skyongs ba'i zhing khams su/ /'brel tshad don ldan mchog gi sprul pa'i sku/ /rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs/ /r+ghaṃ rgyu r+ghaṃḥ spyi gtsug bde chen dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /bka' drin gsum ldan 'khor lo'i dbang phyug che/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs//r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ hūṃḥ snang ba dag pa chos kyi zhing khams su/ /rdo rje slob dpon dbang khrid lta spyod mthun/ /dam tshig chig 'dres rdo rje mched lcam la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs/ /r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ rgyuḥ'aja' lus me dpung thig le'i zhing khams su/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso bo mchog /gtum drag me 'phreng rdo rje gro lod la/ //gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyu hūṃ hūṃḥ gnas gsum dag pa lha yi zhing khams su/ /sgrub mchog rtag tu skyong la g.yel med pa/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro dpa' 463

bos tshogs bcas la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ hūṃḥ mkha' spyod rngam pa sgra sgrog zhing khams su/ /las dang ye shes srung ma kun gyi mthu/ /gcig 'dus nye mgon gzi ldan yab yum la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs/ /hūṃ r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃḥ de ltar snying thig bla bsgrub brgyud pa yi/ /bla ma lha dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong la/ /rtse gcig gus pa drag pos gsol btab mthus/ /khyed kyi rtse chen thugs rje gzi byin gyis/ /nus pa'i shugs phyung skad cig da lta 'dir/ /bdag gi nyon mongs 'khrul rtog kun bcom nas/ /'jig rten 'jig rten las 'das dngos grub kun/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i byin rlabs yongs zhugs te/ /a ti rdzogs chen nyams rtogs rtsal rdzogs shing / /phung khams 'pho chen 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku/ /mngon gyur ye shes yon tan yongs rdzogs shog /de ltar ma thob bar du skye ba kun/ khams drug mngon mtho nges legs brgyan thob cing / /'jigs zhi 'byor rgyas chos min rnam rtog 'gag /dam tshig sel med bla ma'i dgyes dgu 'grub/ /sa lam yon tan gong nas gong 'phel shog /snang srid thams cad 'od gsal gzhom med cing / /sgra grags nā da dran rtog gzung 'dzin bral/ /'ub chung kun bzang dgongs pa'i dbyings nyid du/ /khams gsum 'gro 'dren byed por bdag gyur cig /ces snying thig snyan rgyud bla bsgrub kyi gsol 'debs 'di ni dad ldan sbyin bdag dpon drung tshe dbang dpal 'byor rab rgyas dang chos mdzad ye shes pad dkar chos nyid rang byung snyan grags lnga'i yang yang bskul ngor/ mdo khams kaḥthog lho phyogs 'od gsal lha ris skyes pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu 'gro ba yongs 'dul rtsal gyis stod mnga' ris glo bo smad rgya gar dang bod kyi mtshams bkag pa'i sa mtha' bsam 'grub chos lding du sa bya rgyal zla dmar phyogs nya la 7bla ma'i dus mchod skabs su thun gcig bris pa'o/ /maṅga lo/ bkra shis/rdzogs pa chen po mkha' 'gro snying thig gi brgyud pa bla ma'i gsol 'debs nges don snying po'i bcud len zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /a ho/ ma bcos mtha' bral gdod nas snang ba'i mgon/ /g.yo med ye shes rgyal ba kun gyi dpyid/ /ma skye 'gag med brdal khyab kun tu bzang / /gsol ba 'debs so mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ / 1 dmigs med spros bral 'od gsal mi 'gyur yum/ /rgyal kun thugs mchog rdor sems gsang ba'i bdag /mtshan dpe yongs rdzogs mchog sprul dga' rab rje/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ / 2 rang rig dbang thob rig 'dzin shrī seng / /rdzogs sangs rgyas dngos gu ru pad+ma 'byung / /zag med 'ja' lus mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal la/ /gsol ba dz+ra gsang gter snying thig sgo 'byed las 'brel stsal/ /bstan pa'i sgron me rgyal sras legs ldan pa/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa rang 'byung rdo rje 'chang / /gsol ba dz+ra gsang sngags grub pa'i dbang phyug g.yung ston dpal/ /thams cad mkhyen gzigs karma ka rol rdor/ /gsol ba dz+ra rtogs ldan rgyal po nam mkha' rdo rje mchoki64/lung rtogs bstan pa'i gsal byed tshul khrims 'bum/ /yang dag don brnyes tshul khrims rgyal

ba'i mtshan/ /gsol ba 'debs so dz+ra nges gsang 'phrin las spel mkhas chos 'bum zhabs/ /'dul dka' yongs 'dul ye shes rgyal ba'i mtshan/ /'gro la rtse gzigs chos rje byang chub seng / /rdza yig kun mkhyen chen po tshul khrims rgyal/ /rtse le rig 'dzin bsod nams rnam par rgyal/ /rgyal ba'i thugs sras bstan 'dzin mchog dbyangs zhabs/ /gsol ba 〉 chos nyid mngon gyur kun bzang dpal 'byor ba/ /gsang sngags grub brnyes mdo sngags bstan 'dzin bzang / /rim gnyis mngon 'gyur 'phrin las lhun grub la/ /gsol ba dz+ra gsang chen ston pa 'gyur med rdo rje stsal/ /thugs kyi sras mchog o rgyan rnam grol bzang / /snying po'i don gter dpal ldan bla ma rje/ /gsol ba tsho rab 'byams rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso/ /byin rlabs rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma dang / /yi dam zhi khro mkha' 'gro chos skyong la/ /rtse gcig gus pa'i sems kyis gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag ni deng nas rdzogs sangs ma rgyas bar/ /ngan song gnas spong bde 'gro rtag thob cing / /mtho ris yon tan 'phags nor bdun gyis phyug /yang dag lam nas phyir mi ldog par shog /skye kun mtshan nyid kun tshang bla ma dang / /legs 'phrad thugs kyi dgyes dgu bdag gi grub/ /zab gsang 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i don/ /ma 'dus yongs rdzogs bdag gis thob par shog /chos min las la skad cig mi 'jug cing / /chos bzhin spyod par nyin mtshan dus zla nas/ /sa lam drod tshad ma lus tshe gcig rdzogs/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'bad med lhun grub shog /khregs chod lta ba'i gnas lugs mthar thug rtogs/ /thod brgal mngon gsum sgom pa zad par khyom/ /rnam dag spyod pas 'gro la phan chen 'grub/ /mi slob sa mchog tshe 'di nyid brnyed shog /chos kun gdod ma'i gnas lugs spros dang bral/ /mtha' rgyas las 'das theg dgu'i yongs rtse mchog /yid dpyod byar med 'od gsal rdzogs pa che/ /mngon 'gyur gdos bcas 'od skur yal bar shog /dmigs bsam blo yi bcos mas ma gos pa/ /yid byed kun bral chos nyid mngon sum du/ /snang ba brda don rtags gsum dbyer med lam/ /rtsod bral a ti'i rtogs pa mngon gyur shog /dus kun rgyu 'bras las la yid ches shing / /rgyu 'bras las 'das lta ba'i gdengs tshad thob/ /nam yang gsang sngags dam tshig nyams med bstan/ /ye bsrung spros bral chen por rtag gnas shog /tshe 'di'i bslu brid chos la mi zhen par/ /nges gsang bla med lam mchog la zhugs nas/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa'i dbang phyug che/ /sku gsung rgyal ba'i go 'phang mchog rnyed shog /tshe rabs rtag tu yang gsang rdzogs chen don/ /dbang 'byor rgyal bstan 'gro la phan chen grub/ /'phags nor bdun ldan rgyud 'dzin slob srid rgyas/ /tshom bu gcig tu 'gro kun byang chub shog /ces rdzogs chen mkha' 'gro snying thig gi gsol 'debs su rnam par dkar ba'i las la mchog tu brtson zhing nges gsang rdzogs pa chen por mi phyed pa'i dad 465

gus can skal ldan mi mchog lcags brag sde pa lta bu tshe ring don ldan nam kun bzang nges don rang grol dbang pos gsung gi bskul ngor mdo khams kaḥthog gi lho phyogs lta ban tshe dbang nor bus mang yul skyi grong gra phu chos gling ri khrod du me lug ston ra'i tshes bzang por bris pa dge'o/ /sarba maṅga lo kurban+tu/rdzogs chen mkha' 'gro yang zhun gyi gsol 'debs rtsa gsum byin rlabs 'dren pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ ā hūṃ trī: khyab brdal ye shes g.yo med zhing khams nas/ /rig pa rang byung sangs rgyas kun gyi yab/ /gdod ma'i mgon po 'od dpag med pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur mchog mthun stsol/ /ye shes lnga ldan rang 'od thig le klong / /sgyu 'phrul zhi khro 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /he ru ka dpal rta 'phags yab yum la/ /gsol ba 〉 rgyal ba'i zhing khams mu mtha' med pa ru/ /sngags kyi ston pa mtsho skyes rdo rje sems/ /'gyur med ye shes pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ /gsol ba tshomakha' spyod gsang ba mchog gi dur khrod du/ /bde stong dbang phyug rgyal ba kun gyi yum/ /bdud 'dul drag mo ye shes mtsho rgyal la/ /gsol ba ste/ shākya'i zhing khams bod chen shar phyogs su/ /rgyal kun ye shes 'dus pa'i sras gcig pu/ /dran mchog pad+ma bde chen gling pa la/ /gsol ba smo phyogs med 'gro don skyong ba'i gnas mchog nas/ /gu ru'i lung bstan 'brel tshad don dang ldan/ /rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu la/ /gsol ba 〉 mon yul dben pa'i gnas chog rta gru nas/ /rim gnyis mngon gyur grub pa'i dbang phyug che/ /rdo rje slob dpon o rgyan bstan 'dzin la/ /gsol ba dz+ra spyi gtsug bde ba chen po'i pho brang du/ /bka' drin mtshungs med rigs kun 'dus pa'i gtso/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen la/ /gsol ba mo hrī: dbang chen me rlung 'khrul dkyil zla gam dbus/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor kun gyi spyi dpal gtso/ /pad+ma gar dbang gsung dmar zhi khro la/ /gsol ba mo gnas gsum dag pa rtsa rlung thig zhing du/ /bde chen pho nya yongs kyis dbang phyug skur/ /bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje rnal 'byor la/ /gsol ba 〉 dur khrod me ri 'bar ba'i pho brang du/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas nyid bstan pa bsrung phyir sku/ /ston gyur ye shes mgon po ma ning la/ /gsol ba mo gter gnas smu rdo mkha' 'gro 'bum 'dus nas/ /zab mo'i gter mchog mkha' 'gro snying ti ka /gter srung ma gza' rdor gsum bcas pa la/ /gsol ba tsho smon lam las 'phro dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig kyis bsdus pa'i/ /dag snang chig 'dres mched dang lcam dral la/ /gsol ba ྾ de ltar snying thig bla ma dkyil 'khor lha/ /bka' bstod bcas la gus pas gsol btab mthus/ /chos kyi phyag rgya bskyed rim snang stong 'byongs/ /dam tshig phyag rgya gtum mos bde drod 'bar/ /las kyi phyag rgya dbab ldog dga' bzhi rdzogs/ /phyag chen bde gshegs snying po'i gnas lugs rtogs/ /'od gsal thod brgal snang bzhi mtha' ru phyin/ /zung 'jug rdor sems tshe 'dir thob par shog /zhes rdzogs chen mkha' 'gro yang 466

zhun gyi gsol 'debs 'di ni/ glo bo dom po'i bla ma rin po che dpal ldan grub pa'i dbang phyug o rgyan bstan 'dzin mchog gi zhal mnga' nas bskul ba'i ngor/ mdo khams pa rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu yis lcags kyi chu zla'i dmar phyogs gang ba'i tshes kyi nyi ma rtse shar la mon yul rta gru gnas mchog tu smras pa sarba maṅga lo/bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i dbang lung man ngag gi rgyud pa'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs snying sems bcud len zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru dhe wa dhā ki ni bh+ya: gdod nas rnam dag bri gang yongs bral ba/ /chos sku kun bzang mtha' yas yab yum la/ /gsol ba 'debs so smin grol dngos grub stsol/ /don gnyis lhun gyi grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /rab 'byams zhing khams sprul mdzad gangs can gtso/ /longs sku 'khor los bsgyur ba rigs lnga la/ /gsol ba 'debs so smin grol dngos grub stsol/ /don gnyis lhun gyi grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'gro 'dul rgyal kun sprul bzhi sprul sku che/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho spyan ras gzigs dbang la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dz+ra don gnyis 〉 sangs rgyan kun 'dus sku gsum ngo bo nyid/ /bde chen rdo rje pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ /gsol ba 'debs so 〉don gnyis dz+ra gsung rab rgya mtsho yongs 'char sher phyin la/ /'khor lo'i bdag mo ye shes mtsho rgyal la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mo don gnyis dz+ra 'jam dpal dpa' mo gang chen mi rje'i tshul//bstan pa'i sgron me khri srong lde'u gtsan la/ /gsol ba dz+ra don gnyis dz+ra spyan ras gzigs dbang smon lam gyis bskrun sku/ /lha sras tshul bzung mu tig btsan po la/ /gsol ba mo don gnyis lko gu rus rgyal tshab dbang bskur zab gter bdag /mchog bsgyur sprul sku sangs rgyas gling pa la/ /gsol ba ste/ don gnyis 〉〈 chos bdag yongs gtso dngos grub gnyis brnyes pa/ /sras mchog 'gro 'dul ye shes rdo rje la/ /gsol mo don gnyis tsho dbang chen sprul pa spyi bor rta skad sgrogs/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug sangs rgyas blo gros la/ /gsol 〉〈 don gnyis 〉〈 skyes mchog gdung 'dzin smin grol yongs su rdzogs/ /rigs sngags 'chang ba bsod nams lhun grub la/ /gsol ba 〉 don gnyis mo sbas pa'i tshul gyi gsang sngags yon tan brnyes/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug karma bzang po la/ /gsol ba tsho don gnyis mo gu ru'i bka' gsang gser chos zab dgu yi/ /skal ldan gsos mdzad karma sngags 'chang la/ /gsol tsho don gnyis mo gdams pa'i rgyud kyi 'gro phan bsam mi khyab/ /ye shes ches brnyes grub mchog bzang po la/ /gsol ba dz+ra don gnyis 〉 gter sras bdun rdzogs gdung mthar mkhas grub mchog /lha sras skye mtha' rig 'dzin snying po la/ /gsol ba 'debs so tsho don gnyis dz+ra zab mo'i lam la g.yel med rig 'dzin gtso/ /mngon par grub pa bde chen dar rgyas la/ /gsol ba mo don gnyis mo gu ru'i lung zin 'brel tshad smin grol sbyor/ /mtshungs med rje btsun bde chen rab gsal la/ /gsol ba dz+ra don gnyirwa shes

pad+mas dbang bskur des ston bstan pa'i bdag /rgyal sras rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu la/ /gsol ba tsho don gnyis mo tshe gcig nyams la gtan bde sangs rgyas sar/ /dkri mdzad drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba dz+ra don gnyis dz+ra bla ma'i rang bzhin pad+ma badz+ra rtsal/ /tshom bu dgu rdzogs yi dam rab 'byams la/ /gsol ba 〉 don gnyis lko bla ma'i rol rtsal dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma/ /bka' srung gter bdag grangs med 'char ba la/ /gsol ba dz+ra don gnyis 〉 de ltar bla ma dgongs pa spyi 'dus kyi/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mar/ /rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa'i mthu nus kyis/ /rtsa gsum lha yi byin rlabs snying la zhugs/ /dbang bzhis bdag rgyud yongs su smin gyur zhing / /bskyed rim ye shes dbang phyug myur thob shog /las phran las chen mtha' dag thogs med grub//rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa mchog yongs brnyes shog /rdzogs rim mthar thug rgyal kun bsgrod cig lam/ /ches gsang theg dgu'i rtse'i rgyal rdzogs pa che/ /khreg chos lta ba'i phu thag gting nas chos/ /thod brgal snang bzhi zad par 'khyol bar shog /rdzogs rim gdul bya bye brag la snang chos/ /mtha' bral phyag chen chos kun rang rgyas thob/ /phar phyin yul 'khrul snang grag grogs su gcos/ /tshul de 'phags pa'i bden pa mngon gyur shog /zung 'jug ye shes mkha' 'gro'i gseng lam mchog /pho nya myur 'gyogs steng 'og sgo gnyis kyi/ /rtsa rlung thig le gnad du bsnus pa yi/ /zung 'jug bde chen sku mchog myur 'grub shog /de ltar tshe 'di nyid la mngon sangs rgyas/ /skal brtson dman pas de ltar ma 'grub kyang / /rigs drug 'khor ba'i skye sgo yongs chad de/ /sprul sku'i zhing du dbugs dbyung byang chub shog /gal te srid par skyes kyang las smon mthus/ /dal 'byor lus thob bla ma dam pa mjal/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen bstan tshul ma mkhas shing / /smin grol yongs rdzogs don gnyis lhun grub shog /mdor na bdag ni dus 'di nas tsam ste/ /byang chub snying po thob kyi bar du ni/ /bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ba dang / /rgyu 'bras yid ches mdor len mkhas par shog /khyad par gsang sngags dam tshig snying po ni/ /skyid sdug legs nyes ji ltar gyur kyang rung / /ma nyams rang srog la yang ltos med par/ /rgyal ba kun lam mchog der 'bad brtson shog /de ltar bla ma'i mos gus rnam dag gi/ /yongs drangs stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug gi/ /tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs mtha' yas 'gro ba'i mgon/ /bdag gyur bla ma'i phrin las yongs bsgrub shog /ces bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi dbang khrid lung bcas kyi gter sras nas brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs smon lam bcas pa 'di ni/ long po gying gi zhal ngo nyang rje gtsod pa'i rigs gyur dad gus dpal gyi 'tsho ba bstan 'dzin 'brug grags yab sras kyi yang yang nan tan chen po'i gsol ba btab pa'i ngor shar phyogs bod chen du skyes pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa sngags kyi paṇ+ḍi ta dpal tshe dbang nor bus me sbrul khrums zla'i dmar phyogs gang ba'i dus chen po~X ḍigongs 'dus gter gnas su rin chen 'bar bar thun bar yud cig la bris pa dge'o/ /

byang gter thugs bsgrub yang rig bces sgron khrid kyi gsol 'debs byin rlabs 'dren pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ āḥ rgyu/ rgyal ba kun mes mkha' khyab chos dbyings bdag po kun bzang he ru ka /lhun grub dag pa'i zhing nas ye shes lnga ldan rig lnga bde bar gshegs/ /me ri 'bar bar rgyal ba kun gyi gsang 'dzin lag na rdo rje 'chang / /gsol ba 'debs so rang rig sku gsum mngon gyur dus 'dir thob byin rlobs/ /kun tu bzang mo'i thugs sprul rgyud sde'i bdag mo smug nag dbang mkha' 'gro/ /rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul lha klu'i tshul 'dzin tshang dbang brgya byin 'jog po che/ /mi yi rigs 'khrungs grub pa kun gtso gsang ba'i bdag po rgyal po dza/ /gsol ba ྾ za hor rgyal sras rim dgu theg pa'i mnga' bdag shākya pra bha wa/ /rgyal ba yongs kyi spyi gzugs ye shes zlum pa'i skur gyur pad+ma 'byung / /phyag rgya che mchog brnyes pa dri med bshes dang bal po ngang tshul 'jam/ /gsol ྾ sna nam rigs 'khrungs yi dam lha yi rjes bzung rdo rje bdud 'joms dpal/ /mdzod lnga dbang bsgyur rgod sgro'i phud can dngos grub rgyal mtshan nyi zla 'od/ /de yi thugs sras zab dgu chos kyi sdud po sangs rgyas byams pa bzang / /gsol ྾ se yi rigs las sbyor sgrol nus pa dpag med nyi ma bzang po'i zhabs/ /mgon po bzang po lung rtogs yon tan du mas yongs phyug skal ldan dpal/ /rig chen rgyal mtshan snga 'gyur bstan pa'i srog shing 'chang la lan brgyar mkhas/ /gsol ba ྾ mgon po zla ba chos sbyin phyogs kun dgyes pa'i spyan ras zum med gzigs/ /grub mchog nam snying sprul par zhal bzhes bstan pa'i sgron me byams pa chos/ /gang gi chos sras blo gros rgyal mtshan kun tu rgyas pa nub dgon zhabs/ /gsol ྾ rnam par rig pa grol ba'i sgra brgya rab tu sgrogs mdzad byams pa bzang / /srid gsum rnam rgyal rdo rje'i spo la nges don gsal mdzad kun bzang nyi/ /rtogs pa'i gar mkhan 'od gsal rdo rje snying po rgyas mdzad 'brug sgra bzang / /gsol ྾ rigs pa sngags 'chang rim gnyis yon tan yongs brnyes phrin las lhun grub che/ /sdom brtson rgyal po'i tshul gyis gtsug gi mngon mchod chos dbyings rang grol zhabs/ /'phags chen sa la legs bzhugs rgyal bas lung bstan pad+ma phrin las can/ /gsol ྾spyan ras gzigs sprul sdom brtson mkhas pa'i dbang po pad+ma rig 'dzin dbang / /bla ma'i thugs sras 'brel tshad don ldan tshe dbang nor bu'i sde/ /rang rig dri med chos sku'i rang zhal ston mdzad rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /gsol ྾ yi dam bde gshegs kun 'dus spyi dpal rdo rje drag pa lha yi lha/ /rdo rje phag mo ye shes 'jig rten las kyi mkha' 'gro yongs kyi gtso/ /pho mo ma ning dregs pa'i rje btsan bstan bsrung yongs rdzogs nag po che/ /gsol ྾ rang nyid shes rab phar phyin nyid las gzhan min 'dul bar rag gdongs ma/ /dam ldan bu ltar skyong ba dam can rdo rje 'bar ba thig le rtsal/ /ma mo ༵k+ton ma

stong dpon gter gnas bsrung ma khrom skyes zhing skyong tshogs/ /gsol ྾ de ltar gu ru'i sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las tshab gyur thugs bsgrub kyi/ /yongs snying thugs kyi ye shes mngon byed thugs tshab yang tig gces sgron gang / /rgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang yi dam chos skyong bsrung ba la/ /rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa'i bden mthu byin rlabs nus pa'i stobs dag gis/ /bdag ni skye kun rang gzhan don gnyis spyod la g.yel med nges 'byung skyo shas rgyas/ /skyabs kyi mchog gyur dkon mchog gsum bzung smon 'jug byang chub sems mchog bskyed/ /'gal spang mthun rkyen sgrub la rab sngags rdor sems bsgom bzlas maṇ+ḍal brtson/ /chos kun snying po bla ma'i rnal 'byor la 'bad thugs yid cig 'dres shog /ma dag dngos zhen yongs 'gogs bdag lus snang srid lha yi rol par rgyas/ /gnyis med ye shes rang sgras gnyis snang kun rtags tshogs kun zil gyis gnon/ /gnad bzhi'i rten 'brel la brten sems nyid ma bcos gnyug ma bzo bral nyid/ /rtag tu mnyam bzhag skyon lnga bla ma'i byin rlabs ting 'dzin gyis sel shog /rdo rje r+ghaṃ yig byung gnas 'gror brtags sgo gsum ma 'khrul srangs su bzhugs/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gsung dbyangs rdo rje slob dpon gzugs shar pad+ma 'byung / /de yang rang rig chos skur ngo sprad mdzad po bla ma dbyer med par/ /wem rgyang yid gnyis med par phur tshugs nyid kyi byin rlabs bdag 'jug shog /nam mkha' la brjen skye 'gags gnas bral rig pa rang ngos bar do sgrol/ /dngas gsal man shes snang sems cer grol ye shes mi 'gyur 'du bral med/ //'dzum tshug gzung 'dzin glo bur dri bral 'od gsal rang ngo brtan par rtogs/ /rnam gsum ngo sprod rgyud la sbyar nas ka dag gnas lugs gtan phebs shog /mnyam rjes dbyer med nyid chos ro cig mngon du ma gyur bar du ni//pad 'byung zhal gdams dgongs par brgyad dang mi 'brel yang dag 'jog brtson zhing / /snying po bla mar dad gus mos pa'i gdung shugs nam yang lhod med rten/ /spangs blang gnas rnams kun bzang rdo rje 'chang gi gsung bzhin spyod par shog /mdor na tshe rabs rtag tu rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi bstan bzhugs dam pa mjal/ /smin byed dbang gi yongs smin grol byed rim gnyis bsgom tsam yon tan rdzogs/ /don dam nor 'khrul skyon med yin lugs gtan la phebs pa rang don chos sku grub/ /snying rje'i 'bras bu gzhan don gzugs sku'i 'gro don rtag tu spyod par shog /ces byang gar thugs bsgrub kyi yang snying gu ru pad+ma'i dgongs pa'i tshab rdzogs pa chen po yang tig gces pa'i sgron me'i rgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol ba btab pa 'di ni rgyal bstan 'dren pa'i shing rta gzhung rnam grangs bco brgyad thogs pa med par smras pa'i rab 'byams pa pad+ma rig 'dzin gyi yang nas yang du gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ /mdo khams kaḥthog lho phyogs skye shing rdzogs pa chen po la mos pas spyod pa'i rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'i yongs 'dzin dbyug gu zla ba'i yar tshes bzhi la la stod byang pa bsam rdzongs sta sdus pa'i yi ge'i ris byed ni shākya'i dge slong rig gnas mkhan pad+ma g.yung drung gi bgyis pa'o/ /dge'o/ /

dgezho /dge'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/rdzogs chen phung po zag med kyi brgyud 'debs rin po che'i phreng ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃ hoḥgadod nas byang chub 'dus ma byas pa'i sku/ /ye shes nyid gyur rgyal ba kun gyi yab/ /mtha' bral gshis lugs kun bzang yab yum la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ /'od lnga rang gsal dwangs ma chos nyid dbyings/ /mtshon med khyab rdal sku dang thig le'i gar/ /yongs brtson rigs drug rdor 'chang yab yum la/ /gsol ba ྾ rgyal ba kun gyi thugs kyi ye shes mthu/ /gcig tu bzlum pa rang rig don dam gshis/ /ma bcos sangs rgyas sems dpa' yab yum la/ /gsol ྾ lta ngan mthong 'dir bla med theg pa'i snying / /'od gsal rdo rje'i ston pa gcig pu pa/ /thub pa chen po dga' rab rdo rje la/ /gsol ྾ chos kun dbyer med chos nyid dbyings su thim/ /mi slob lam rdzogs gdod ma'i sa la gshegs/ /thugs rje chen po dpal gyi seng ge la/ /gsol ྾ sangs rgyas kun dngos mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang / /dpal chen por gyur kun bzang thod phreng rtsal/ /o rgyan rgyal po pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ /gsol ྾ rdo rje rnalartso'abyor mi yi gzugs bzung nas/ /gsang sngags rgya chen bka' yi bsdu ba po/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo mtsho rgyal ma/ /gsol ྾ smon lam las sad sbyangs pa mchog dang ldan/ /dag pa'i sar 'khod 'brel tshad smin grol gyur/ /zab gter mnga' bdag tshe dbang rgyal po la / /gsol ྾ bskyed rdzogs mngon gyur thabs lam yon tan brnyes/ /pad+mas lung bstan las skal mchog dang ldan/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug gsang sngags rdo rje la/ /gsol ྾ bla mas rjes bzung yang dag don rtogs shing / /yi dam zhal gzigs mkha' 'gro'i gtad rgya thob/ /rig 'dzin theg chen mchog rang grol rdo rje la/ /gsol ྾ gzhung lugs du ma smra ba'i stobs ldan zhing / /phyi nang rig pa'i gnas rtogs bya bral ba/ /thogs med rab 'byams ngag gi dbang phyug la/ /gsol ྾ sngon sbyangs mthu ldan dam pa'i yon tan smin/ /mun par snang ba bzhi yi rtsal rdzogs shing / /mchog gzigs grub dbang nam mkha' sangs rgyas la/ /gsol ྾ dka' spyad mthar phyin gnas lugs mngon du gyur/ /rlung sems las rung bsgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan gtsugs/ /rnal 'byor grub mchog 'chi med 'od zer la/ /gsol ྾pad+ma'i spyan sngar gzhan phan smon lam mthus/ /snyigs dus sprul pa'i gzugs bstan 'gro 'dul skur/ /snang ba skyes mchog rgyal ba seṅge la/ /gsol ba mo bla ma'i bka' bzhin tshe gcig bsgrub la brtson/ /skye med spros bral 'od gsal rtogs pa brnyes/ /sbas pa'i tshul 'dzin shākya seṅge la/ /gsol ba dz+ra bla ma'i byin rlabs nyams myong rgyud la skye/ /dam tshig tshul 'dzin mkha' 'gro grib ltar 'grogs/ /rnal 'byor gzugs 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu la/ /gsol ba tsho rgyal kun gshegs shul yang dag ༵༵sa pa

che/ /mngon ston bla med dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso/ /bka' drin mtshungs med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol tsho rang lus phung khams dag pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /ye shar rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lha mi tshogs/ /zhi khro rab 'byams dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la/ /gsol ba mo rang byung mkha' klong gnas yul pho brang nas/ /rgyal ba'i bstan srung dam ldan bu ltar skyong / /ma gza' rdor legs dam chen rgya mtsho la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dz+ra gter gnas tshe dpung mi shig bha ga nas/ /zab chos sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa'i bcud/ /skad cig grol byed rdzogs chen zag med la/ /gsol mo sngon gyis smon lam dag pas skal mnyam zhing / /lha dang tha ma gdams ngag gcig gyur pa'i/ /mched dang lcam dral rdo rje spun rnams la/ /gsol dz+ra de ltar rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lhar/ /rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /tshe 'dir zhen pa'i snang ba kun bral bar/ /dben pa'i gnas su bsgrub pa mtha' ru phyin/ /snang bzhi mthar phyin zag med 'od skur 'grub/ /kun bzang rdor sems sa la gshegs par shog /bya ba thams cad 'gro phan nyid 'grub cing / /rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs bcur spel ba dang / /khyad par 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i don/ /ston pa'i sgron me bdag nyid 'grub par shog /mdor na bdag don rdor sems go 'phang thob/ /gzhan don 'brel tshad 'khor ba dong sprug shog /ces sangs rgyas dgongs 'dus kyi rdzogs chen zag med dbang khrid lung dang bcas pa'i rgyud 'debs su bla ma'i bka' dang mchog gi sprul sku karma gar dbang don 'grub kyi gsung gis bskul ngor / mnga' ris gung thang nub ri glo mon bod kyi mtshams sa mtha' ta la zhes par sa sprel hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu bdun bzang por sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa tshe dbang nor bu dpal gyi rgya mtshos smras pa sarba maṅga lo/tshe sgrub rdor phreng rgyud 'debs/ o rgyu/ 'chi med rgyal ba yongs kyi spyi mes che/ /gdod nas byang chub kun bzang yab yum la/ /gsol ba 'debs so smin grol 'bras bu mchog /'chi med rgyal ba dus 'dir 'grub byin rlobs/ /dag pa gzhan dbang stug po bkod pa'i bdag /tshe bdag pad+ma gangs can yab yum la/ /gsol ba 'debs so smin grol 'bras bu mchog /'chi med rgyal ba dus 'dir 'grub byin rlobs/ /sdug bsngal kun spangs bde ldan zhing gi mgon/ /tshe 'od ye shes dpag med yab yum la/ /gsol 〉 'chi med rgyal ba dus 'dir 'grub byin rlobs/ /bzang po'i zhing du thub chen sprul pa'i sku//gsung gi rdo rje pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dz+ra 'chi med rgyal ba dus 'dir 'grub byin rlobs/ /rgyal ba kun gyis gsang gsum dbang bsgyur mdzad/ /mkha' spyod gtso mo'i gzugs 'chang mtsho rgyal la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mo 'chi med rgyal ba dus 'dir 'grub byin rlobs/ /rgyal ba mar me ri rab rgyal po yis/ /sprul pa'i rnam rol gter ston pad+ma gling / /gsol ba 'debs so tsho'achi twenā rgyal ba dus 'dir 'grub byin rlobs/ /gang gi gsung las skyes pa'i sras kyi mchog

gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin grub pa kun 'dus zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so ( 'chi med rgyal ba dus 'dir 'grub byin rlobs/ /pad+ma'i gdams pa chad med yid bzhin gter/ /legs par spel mkhas pad+ma 'phrin las la/ /gsol ba 'debs so 〉 'chi med rgyal ba dus 'dir 'grub byin rlobs/ /pad gling gsung gi 'od zer las sprul pa'i/ /mtshungs med bla ma tshul khrims rdo rje'i zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so dz+ra 'chi med rgyal ba dus 'dir 'grub byin rlobs/ /snga 'gyur ring lugs gsal ba'i sgron me mchog /bon lung dpal 'byor tshul khrims rgyal ba'i mtshan/ /gsol ba 'debs so mo'achi med rgyal ba dus 'dir 'grub byin rlobs/ /mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs nges don nyams rtogs rgyas/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug ye shes dpag 'bar zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so lko 'chi med rgyal ba dus 'dir 'grub byin rlobs/ /byin rlabs brgyud ldan smin grol gter mdzad mgon/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dz+ra 'chi med rgyal ba dus 'dir 'grub byin rlobs/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i ngo bo nyid/ /tshe dpag med mgon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dz+ra 'chi med rgyal ba dus 'dir 'grub byin rlobs/ /tshe yi mthun rkyen bsgrub cing bar chad sel/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong nor lha gter bdag la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mo 'chi med rgyal ba dus 'dir 'grub byin rlobs/ /de ltar tshe sgrub rdo rje phreng ba yi/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs bcas la/ /rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /dam chos sgrub pa'i rten bzang mtho ris lus/ /skye kun rigs bzang gzugs mdzes dbang po gsal/ /nad med tshe ring phun tshogs 'byor ba rgyas/ /rgyu 'bras blang dor la mkhas 'phags nor phyug /ma nor lam ston dge ba'i bshes gnyen mjal/ /dam pa brtan mkhas sngags kyi smin grol nod/ /dam tshig srog las lhag par gces srung zhing / /rim gnyis la brtson yon tan mngon du gyur/ /phung po dag pa lha yi sku ru smin/ /'pho bcas 'chi ba 'pho med dbyings su grol/ /nyon mongs 'dzag med mi 'gyur bde la thim/ /sgrib gnyis lha bu sgrib bral mkha' la sangs/ /mkha' mnyam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs grub nas/ /sprul pas mkha' khyab sems can ma lus pa/ /gang 'dul rol pas srid dang zhi ba yis/ /mtha' grol byang chub mchog la 'god par shog /ces de ltar tshe grub rdo rje phreng ba yi dbang khrid lung gsum ka'i brgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol ba gdab pa 'di ni rdo rje'i slob ma dad gus kyi lang tsho mchog tu bstan pa nyang stod sde ba khang dmar 'chi med rgyal phur gyis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus shing glang sa ga zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum pa la kong yul gsung 'khor gyi phu grub pa'i bste gnas khyung phug tu bris pa dge'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/tshe sgrub 'chi med dpal gter gyis gsol 'debs zab yangs mchog sgrub bzhugs so/47/rdo āḥ

r+ghaṃ trīḥ trīḥ snang ba mtha' yas 'gro kun rjes su skyong / /tshe dpag med mgon 'gro la 'chi med gter//rta mgrin dbang rgyal 'gro ba'i bar chad sel/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas snyigs dus 'gro ba'i skyabs/ /thang stong rgyal por gsol btab bslu ba med/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar chad sel/ /byin gyis rlobs shig 'chi med dngos grub stsol/ /zung 'jug sgyu 'phrul gar dbang gter gzhed gling / /'gro 'dul rig 'dzin gu ru zhi ba 'od/ /pad+ma'i thugs sprul bde ba chen po'i zhabs/ /gang 'dul 'gro 'dren tshe dbang nor bu'i sde/ /bka' drin mtshungs med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol mo byin mo 'chi ba med pa don dam gdod ma'i gshis/ /mi shig dwangs ma 'pho bral rdo rje tshe/ /g.yo med rig pa rang 'byung bde ba che/ /mngon gyur zung 'jug mchog 'bras thob byin rlobs/ /zhes pa yang dbyer med rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa gsang sngags pas nang gi dge slong phyogs su rlom pa tshe dbang nor bu gang shar gza' gtad bral ba des zhi ba sa bya cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes bzang nyer gnyis la ru lag groms rgyang du sbyar ba sarba maṅga lo/ dge'o/ /gsang lam snyan brgyud kyi gsol 'debs byin rlabs nus myur rdo rje'i thol glu bzhugs so/ /oṃ ā hūṃ trī/ dbyings ye gdangs lnga lhun grub dkyil 'khor nas/ /rang byung ka dag gshis lugs kun bzang mo/ /rig grol gdod ma'i rgyal ba kun tu bzang / /gsol 'debs bu la dbang bskur byin rlobs cig /rtsa rlung las rung rlung sems dbu mar chud/ /bde drod rang 'bar nyams rtogs gong du 'phel/ /thig le las rung rang rig rtsal dbang thob/ /nyams len nus pa myur thob byin gyis rlobs/ /zag med bde chen ye shes dkyil 'khor nas/ /rang rig rgyal po gzi brdzid snang mtha' yas/ /'byung khams gnas dag rang rtsal gos dkar mo/ /gsol ba mo rtsa rlung ( thig le mo nyams len dz+radabyings rig lhan skyes rang grub dkyil 'khor nas/ /snang ba thabs mchog dpa' bo rta gdong can/ /stong dbyings shes rab ḍā ki phag gdong ma/ /gsol mo rtsa 〉 thig 〉 nyams len mo chos dbyings bde ba thig le'i pho brang nas/ /rig rtsal dbang thob rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung / /bde chen lhun grub rnal 'byor mtsho rgyal la/ gsol ( mo mo mo dbu ma'i mdud grol ka dag pho brang nas/ /thog med nus ldan maṅga a yu'i mtshan/ /bde 'phel gsang ba'i las mdzad lcam bcas la/ /gsol 〉〈 ste/dz+ra tsho phyogs bral zang thal sgyu 'phrul pho brang nas/ /'jigs med rnal 'byor seng ge'i rtsal rdzogs dpal/ /dgyes bde ldan zhing ḍā ki bcas rnams la/ /gsol dz+ra mo 〉 mo rtsa rlung las rung 'od gsal pho brang nas/ /rnal 'byor 'phrin las 'gro 'dul nor bu'i mtshan/ /bde ba rang grub 'bar mdzad 'od rig bcas/ /gsol ( tsho ྾ 〉 du ma rol gcig shar ba'i pho brang nas/ /snang sems dbyer med mngon gyur bde chen gling / /zung 'jug rgyud la mngon mdzad ye shes mar/ /gsol 474

〉 dz+ra dz+rarimo 'dzin med stong gsal dag pa'i pho brang nas/ /gsang ba'i don ston rnal 'byor chen po'i zhabs/ /bdag grol byin gyis brlabs mdzad ḍā kir bcas/ /gsol ba dz+ra ( tsho 〉dag pa rab 'byams bde chen pho brang nas/ /bka' drin mnyam med rgyal mchog rig 'dzin rje/ /gnas yul mtshan ldan phyag rgya'i tshogs bcas la/ /gsol ba dz+ra mo mo dz+ra gzhon nu bum sku tshom bu'i pho brang nas/ /rgyud sde bzhi drug yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ /mkha' 'gro sde lnga gnas yul skyong ba'i tshogs/ /gsol dz+ra mo dz+ra dz+ra rab 'jig me 'bar bstan srung pho brang nas/ /dpal mgon ma ning zhing skyong gzi ldan che/ /sngags srung dbyings kyi ma mo ral gcig mar/ /gsol tsho dz+ra 〉 tsho r+ghaṃḥ rgyud ldan bla mar gsol 'debs byin phobs cig /yi dam lha tshogs gsol 'debs byin phobs cig /ma sring mkha' 'gror gsol 'debs byin phobs cig /gsol dz+ra bstan srung dam lko byin chen byin rlabs sprin phung thib se thib/ /byin chen thugs rje'i glog zhags khyug se khyug /byin chen drag sngags 'brug sgra 'ur ru ru/ /byin chen dngos grub char pa da phobs cig /bar chad bskrad byed khro chung tha ra ra/ /bag chags sreg byed me phung lhab se lhab/ /dgra bgegs grol byed mtshon cha skar ltar 'khrug /byang chub grub pa'i bar chad da bzlog cig /rnal 'byor lus la ras gos bag re brjid/ /lcang lo rus rgyan kha ṭ+wāṃ byin re che/ /gcer bu'i lus la bde drod zhag re snum/ /dam ldan bu la ye shes da sbor cig /lus la bde drod ngag la nus pa bskyed/ /sems la rang rig rig pa'i rtsa dbang bskur/ /rkyen ngan kun zhi snang srid chos skur rol/ /rtsa rlung thig le sku gsum mngon du bsgyur/ /chos zad blo 'das 'pho med dbyings grol shog /aḥ maḥ haḥ riḥ niḥ saḥ aḥ dhiṣ+ṭhaḥ teḥ rnyiḥ na dzo la aḥ zhes pa rtsa rlung thig le'i gdams pa snyan brgyud yig med kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs nus myur rdo rje'i thol glu 'di nyid/bde ras pa rnal 'byor tshe dbang nor bu'am/ /bsod nams theg mchog bstan 'dzin pas stag yul se'u lung chos grwar sa phag zla'i tshes gsum la sbyar ba dge'o/ /nyams len bu la sngags kyi srung mas grogs mdzod cig tshod lta the tshom mkhan la bka' chad chod/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ spros bral dbyings rig snang mtha' gos dkar mo/ /bde stong zung 'jug rta mchog phag gdong ma/ /zag med 'ja' sku pad 'byung mtsho rgyal ma/ /gsol ba 'debs so smin grol byin dbang stsol/ /bdag cag grub gtso mang ga a yu'i zhabs/ /zang thal spyod pa'i mnga' bdag gter bzhed snying / /rim gnyis mchog brnyes pad+ma ma ṇi'i mtshan/ /gsol ba 〉〈 chos kun ro mnyam pad+ma bde chen gling / /zab gsang mdzod 'dzin bi bhu ti shrī/ /bka' drin mtshungs med rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs/ /gsol snu zab gsang brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam lha/ /mkha' 'gro srung mar bcas par gsol 'debs mthus/ /dbang bzhi'i chu bos bdag rgyud rab tu smin/ /bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug thabs lam pho nya yi/ /zag ༵༵ bde

ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor du/ /dmigs med chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen po'i/ /go 'phang mchog la tshe 'di nyid 'khod de/ /'ja' lus 'od gsal rdo rje'i sku bsnyes shog /ces btsang snye mo'i bsgrub chen kun bzang nyi mas bskul ngor rang bzhin rnal 'byor gyi gzugs 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu gar dbang 'gro 'dul gyis g.yas ru shangs kyi stag nar cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes nyer drug la bkod pa yig rigs o rgyan blo gros dbang po'o/ /bcom ldan 'das drag po lha gsum gyi gsol 'debs byin rlabs myur stsol zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ āḥ r+ghaṃḥ chos rnams kun gyi gdod ma'i gnas lugs nyid/ /rang byung gi rtag kun bzang dang po'i mgon/ /zhi khro sgyu 'phrul rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag gtso/ /gsol 'debs bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs/ /chos nyid zhi las ma g.yol gdul bya'i ngor/ /bdud dang ru tra 'du phyir khros pa'i gar/ /bsgyur mdzad spyan ras gzigs dbang rta mchog dpal/ /gsol 'debs dz+ra rgyal ba yongs kyi gsang gsum dbang bsgyur zhing / /dregs pa kun gyi gnyen po lha yi lha/ /bcom ldan lag na rdo rje sems dpa' che/ /gsol 'debs mo chos mkha' la rig pa sku ru lding / /mi srun gdug pa 'dul mdzad bcom ldan 'das/ /rab 'jigs rdo rje mchu can khro chen gtsor/ /gsol ba 'debs so dz+ra rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje 'phrin las dpal/ /gcig bsdus ci dpal rdo rje khrag 'thung che/ /rig 'dzin mtshur snang pad+ma 'phreng ba la/ /gsol ba 'debs dz+ra rgyal ba kun gyis gsung gi gsang ba gang / /lha mo'i gzugs su shar ba dbyangs can ni/ /bod kyi dpal mgon snang bsgyur mtsho rgyal mar/ /gsol 'debs mo stug po bkod par nges lnga rgyal ba'i gtso/ /snyigs dus 'gro la phan mdzad pad 'byung gi /pho nya'i tshul gzung bdud 'joms rdo rje la/ /gsol 'debs mo skyabs kun ngo bo rdo rje sems dpa' gang / /mi yi srid par rdo rje slob dpon tshul/ /rgyal bas bsngags gyur rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol 'debs smo rdzogs sangs rgyas gang ye shes sgyu 'phrul gar/ /rab 'byams rgya mtsho yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i/ /kun 'dus ngo bo drag po lha gsum la/ /gsol 'debs dz+ra rgyal ba rnams kyis rang gi 'phrin las nyid/ /skyongs phyir ye shes ngang las las kyi tshul/ /ma mgon lcam dral sprul pa'i mched gsum la/ /gsol ba 'debs snu de ltar lhag pa'i lha mchog ho ru ka /rdo rje pad+ma khrag 'thung 'jigs byed gtso/ /bdud bde'i dpung 'joms gtso 'khor bcas pa yis/ /lha yi tshogs dang brgyud pa'i bla ma la/ /bdag gis rtse gcig gsol ba 'debs pa yis/ /rgyal ba'i smon lam thugs rje shugs chen pos/ /ma dor rtse ba'i spyan gyis dus 'dir gzigs/ /byin rlabs dngos grub mthu dbang myur du stsol/ /bdag ni dus rtag lha khyed rjes su gzung / /theg chen ci las khyad par gsang sngags kyi/ /don ston rdo rje slob dpon chos twe~X bzung / /dbang bzhi thob cing de srog dam tshig brtan/ /grol byed bskyed rim lha sku 'od lus

grol/ /sngags dbyangs dhu tir gzhom med nā dar gyur/ /sems nyid 'od gsal chos kyi sku ru grol/ /lha mchog nyid dang mtshungs par byin gyis rlobs/ /dus 'di nas bzung byang chub snying po'i bar/ /yi dam khyed dang mi 'brel rtag tu 'grogs/ /bdag nyid mthong thos dran reg 'gro kun yang / /lha mchog khyed kyi gdul byar 'gyur bar shog /bdag ni tshe rabs rtag tu lhag pa'i lha/ /khyed snyan khyed kyi zhal mjal gsung thos shing / /brtse bas rjes bzung las bzhi grub chen brgyad/ /phyag rgya che mchog dngos grub thob par shog /nang gi gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i bzhin ras mdangs/ /gnyis snang me long la 'phos ma bsrun gzugs/ /bza' klu rgyal sogs dregs pa'i nyer 'tshe kun/ /gnyis med 'od gsal klong du grol bar shog /srid par 'chings byed bdag 'dzin rtog pa kun/ /bdag med stong pa'i dbyings su dag pa dang / /zhi bar gnas pa 'gog pa'i ting 'dzin gang / /snying rje'i sgra dbyangs chen pos sad par shog /srid zhi las grol sangs rgyas kun ye shes/ /he ru ka dpal pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal/ /drag po lha gsum rnam par yongs shar ba'i/ /go 'phang de la bdag ni myur 'khod shog /de ltar drag po lha gsum gyi gsol 'debs byin rlabs myur stsol 'di ni grub pa'i slob dpon rtsa ri ras/ rgyud gtsang rong chung dkar po chos lung dbu rtse'i bla ma gso rig pa tshe dbang gi dus ring bkon bten chen po'i yang yang gsol ba btab pa'i ngor rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu'i dus kyi pho nya zhes pa rta yi lo snron zla ba'i dkar tshogs gu ru'i dus chen tshes bcu la bod yul dbus sa yi thig le lha ldan gtsug lag khang dang mi ring ba'i 'dabs gung thang bla ma zhang gi gzim spyil du thun gcig la smras pa'i yi ge pa shes rab bstan 'dzin no/ /dge'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/snying don gsum gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs so/ /na mo gu ru we/ thugs rjes mnga' bdag spyan ras gzigs dbang po/ /lha sras blo gros rin chen sprul pa'i sku/ /sgrub pa mchog bsnyes te lor grags pa'i zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyi rlobs/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇa chen na ro pa/ /bshes gnyen rnal 'byor mtshan gsol sgyu ma'i sku/ /byams pa'i rnam sprul rje btsun lo tsā ba/ /gsol ba 'debs so mo de sras mtshungs med sems dpa' chen po dang / /ya rtse par grags rin chen seṅge'i zhabs/ /dgra bcom chen po yon tan blo gros la/ /gso9shu ba 'debs so dz+ra lcang lung ba grags mkhas grub gzhon nu'i mtshan/ /gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin mchog ldan legs pa'i blo/ /gzhon nu chos grub dman 'gro pha ma'i mgon/ /gsol dz+ra 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo chos kyi rje/ /lung rigs rgya mtsho ye shes rol ba'i mtsho/ /spyod 'chang dpa' bo 'gro kun grol ba'i mgon/ /gsol ba lko 'phrin las dbang mo bde chen dga' bzhi'i gter/ /gsung rab rin chen rgya mtsho'i ske rag can/ /snying po'i don ston mtha' yas gdul bya'i dpal/ /gsol ba dz+ra kun bzang snying rje'i dbang po 'khor lo'i mgon/ /gang gi thugs las skyes gyur chos kyi sras/ /rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang ༵ṭā bu'i

sde/ /gsol ba 〉〈 thugs rjes spyan ras rtag tu rgyas gyur mgon/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma skyabs gnas kun gyis dngos/ /gzhan yang rtsa brgyud bla ma thams cad la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /sngon 'gro'i chos kyi chos min spong ba dang / /dngos bzhi'i chos kyis rang rgyud smin pa dang / /bsre 'pho'i chos kyis gzhan rgyud grol byas nas/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang de thob shog /ces rje btsun chen po tā ra na tha'i gsung gi 'phro tshe dbang nor bus mthud pa dge'o/ /maṅga lo/zab gsang rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi brgyud pa'i bla mar gsol ba btab pa yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ ā r+ghaṃ ho haṃ k+ṣa/ dang po'i sangs rgyas rnam kun mchog dang ldan/ /'khor 'das sgyu 'phrul 'char dag dus 'khor lo/ /gsol ba 'debs so zung 'jug rdo rje sems/ /bdag gi de ring nyid thob byin gyis rlobs/ /lha ma'i bla ma bla med rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /spros bral mkha' khyab ye shes shākya thub/ /gsol ba 'debs so zung 'jug rdo rje sems/ /bdag gi de ring nyid thob byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyal nyid grub kyang chos sprin dbang phyug tshul/ /chos rgyal rig ldan so lnga gdul bya'i dpal/ /gsol ba 'debs so zung 'jug rdo rje sems/ /bdag gi de ring nyid thob byin gyis rlobs/ /lha dang dbyer med 'od gsal rdo rje'i skur/ /yongs gshegs dus zhabs chen po 'jam rdo rje/ /gsol ba 'debs so 〉bdag gi de ring nyid 〉 mkhas shing rdzu 'phrul 'phrin las ci yang bsgyur/ /mchog gzigs dus zhabs chung ba shrī bha dra/ /gsol ba 'debs so lko bdag gi de ring nyid thob mo rig gnas kun mkhas las bzhi rlung gis grub/ /rgyal ba'i sras po bho dhi bha dra la/ /gsol 〉〈 bdag gi momakhas gyur mi brjed gzungs ldan lta stangs thob/ /ye shes sku rnyes paṇ+ḍi ta zla mgon/ /gsol ba 'debs so mo bdag gi dz+ra gnyis smra brgyud 'debs du mar yongs mkhas shing / /dam pa'i thugs zin 'bro ston shes rab grags/ /gsol ste/ bdag gi ste/ sngags shes bla ma cher dgyes nyams rtogs rdzogs/ /mngon shes nus pa dpag med dkon mchog srung / /gsol ba tsho bdag gi dz+ra yi dam zhal gzigs mkha' 'gros ci bsgo nyan/ /sgrib med mkhyen ldan 'gro don rnams la gzigs/ /gsol ba 'debs so 〉〈 bdag gi 〉〈 sna tshogs yul rnams sprul sgyur sku yi nyul/ /snying po'i don gzigs dad pa'i rgyal po la/ /gsol ba 'debs so 〉〈 bdag gi dz+ra mkhyen pas mkhas kun zil nan rtogs pa yi/ /'jam dbyangs sprul par grags pa'i chos dbang phyug /gsol ba 'debs so mobadag gi 〉 rdo rje phag mo dbyangs can zhal gzigs shing / /lung rigs rtogs pa'i mdzod 'dzin nam mkha' 'od/ /gsol ba mo bdag gi ྾ bcom ldan dpal mo sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul ni/ /lhag med ༵༵'a skur gshegs pa'i jo 'bum ma/ /gsol ba 〉 bdag gi dz+ra bcu bzhi skye bas rdzogs

sangs rgyas gyur pa/ /dus kun mkhyen pa nam mkha' rgyal ba'i mtshan/ /gsol ba mo bdag gi 〉〈'jam dbyangs zhal gzigs blo gsal khyu mchog che/ /chos nyid bden mthong shes rab 'od zer la/ /gsol ba 〉〈 bdag gi 〉〈 'od gsal 'khor yug spangs rtogs yon tan rdzogs/ /sprul pa'i sku mchog kun mkhyen chos sku la/ /gsol ba 'debs so zung 'jug rdo rje sems/ /bdag gi de ring nyid thob byin gyis rlobs/ /mkhyen pa'i dpal rgyas kun spang brtul zhugs kyi/ /nges gsang rgyas mdzad thugs rje brtson 'grus la/ /gsol ba 〉 bdag gi mo 'phags mchog du ma'i thugs kyi bcud bsdud mdzad/ /byang chub sems dpa' rgyal ba ye shes zhabs/ /gsol ba smo bdag gi ( dri med bslab pa gsum gyis yon tan rdzogs/ /snying po'i don spel mkhas btsun yon tan 'od/ /gsol ba mobadag gi )〈 rgyal kun 'phrin las gcig bsdus 'gro 'dul sku/ /rgyal ba'i sras po lag na pad dkar 'chang / /gangs ri'i ljongs su bde gshegs snying po'i lam/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ston phyir mi yi zol/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i mthar thug dol po pa/ /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas shes rab rgyal ba'i mtshan/ /gsol ba mo bdag gi snu chos kyis spyan ldan lung rtogs dbang phyug che/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab phyogs las rnams rgyal la/ /gsol ba 〉〈 bdag gi 〉〈 log rtogs kun 'joms dbu ma chen po'i srol/ /spel ba'i lnga bdag nya dbon kun dga' dpal/ /gsol ba dz+ra bdag gi dz+rargyal rigs kun spangs mkhas shing grub pa yis/ /khyu mchog dam pa kun dga' blo gros la/ /gsol ba dz+ra bdag gi mo 'jam dbyangs sprul pa'i skyes bu skye bar brgyud/ /bden gnyis mngon gyur dkon mchog bzang po'i zhabs/ /gsol ba mo bdag gis bshad sgrub bstan pa'i nyi ma 'od po che/ /smra ba'i seṅge nam mkha' chos skyong la/ /gsol mo bdag gi ྾ dus kyis 'khor lo'i man ngag don kun gzigs/ /lnga rig grags ldan nam mkha' dpal bzang po/ /gsol ba 〉〈 bdag gi 〉〈spyan ras gzigs dbang rang nyid 'phrin las mchog /sprul phyir sprul gar rat+na bha dra'i zhabs/ /gsol ba dz+ra bdag gi mo mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug bsam bzhin sprul pa'i sku/ /grub pa'i dpa' bo kun dga' grol mchog sde/ /gsol ba mo bdag gi tsho sdom brtson grub brnyes lung rigs rgya mtsho'i dbang / /chos sku'i ji lta mngon rtogs lha dbang grags/ /gsol ba mo bdag gi dz+ra rgyal bas lung bstan bar dor mngon sangs rgyas/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa'i dbang phyug ka sna pa/ /yang srid mkhas mtsho'i dbus na yid bzhin dbang / /sngon med legs bshad gsar pa'i lnga gra can/ /'gyur med bde ba'i sar gshegs he ru ka /rdo rje sems dngos tā ra nā tha'i zhabs/ /gsol ba mo bdag gi dz+ra rgyal sras 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgya mtsho'i sde/ /zab gsang bstan srog snying po blo gros zhabs/ / 479

gsol ba tsho bdag gi lko sgrol ba'i mgon po ring lugs snying med par/ /yongs 'dzin bla ma ngag dbang 'phrin las dpal/ /gsol ba mo bdag gi 〉 grangs med sngon nas sgrib rdzogs yongs spangs yang / /rgyal ba'i bstan la rgyal sras mi yi tshul/ /bzung nas thos bsam yon tan kun rdzogs shing / /nyams rtogs mthar phyin zag med mngon shes ldan/ /dkyil 'khor yongs kyi gtso bo bla ma'i skur/ /bzhengs gyur 'dren mchog kun bzang dbang po'i zhabs/ /gsol ba 〉 bdag gi snu yang dag bcud 'chang gdul bya smin grol 'god/ /bka' drin mtshungs med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba mobadag gi tsho rgyal gsung chos kun snying po rnal 'byor che/ /gnyis med dus kyi 'khor lo brgyud pa yis/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro srung mar bcas/ /mi phyed rtse gcig gus pas gsol btab mthus/ /skye kun khams drug rdo rje'i lus thob cing / /skye ma thag tu sngon gnas rjes su dran/ /bdag med spyod spong rnam spyod mchog dang ldan/ /shes rab rtsal rgyas dge la chos 'dun shog /rgyud bde nas bzung mtshan ldan bla ma dang / /legs 'phrad rjes bzung bslab gsum lam la dkri/ /khyad par theg mchog dus kyi 'khor lo yi/ /bcu gsum dbang gis bdag rgyud smin byas nas/ /grol lam sangs rgyas sa la mngon sbyor ba/ /yan lag drug ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor gyis/ /dge ba gsum rdzogs zung 'jug rdo rje sems/ /tshe gcig nyid la mngon du byed par shog /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun dngos thams cad mkhyen/ /dol po pa dang tā ra nā tha yis/ /ji bzhin grub mtha'i snying po gang yin pa/ /bdag gi blo ru dri med yongs su 'char/ /phyir mi ldog pa mthar thug lta ba rtogs/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor rgyud don kun byan tshud/ /mtha' yas 'gro kun byang chen sa la bkod/ /nges don bstan pa nub med byed par shog /mdor na tshe rabs kun tu rgyu dang 'bras/ /'dor len la mkhas dam tshig bsrung sdom brtson/ /bla mar mos gus 'gro phan snying rje rgyas/ /spyod kun byang chub chen po'i rgyur gyur zhing / /rgyal ba'i dbang po rig ldan jo nang pa'i/ /thugs kyi dgyes dgu bdag gis 'grub pa dang / /thugs yid gnyis med de ring nyid nas 'dres/ /de bstan bskal pa rgya mtshor rgyas byed shog /ces dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang khrid lung gi brgyud pa'i bla mar gsol ba btab pa 'di rgyal kun ye shes gcig zlum mtshungs med bla ma rdo rje sems dngos grub pa'i dbang phyug kun bzang dbang po'i rjes su bzung zhing thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa tshe dbang nor bu rdo rje ye shes rnam par rgyal bas zhi ba sa bya dbyu gu zla ba'i yar tshes lnga la stod mnga' ris glo dang mon yul kyi tsha rdo dang chu la rang byung gi me 'bar ba rgyud sde nas bsngags pa'i gnas chen mu khu bi ṣe ṭa zhes zur chag skad du mu ta ṣa ṭa dang / bod kyi chu mig brgya rtsar smras pa'i yig rig ni rigs lung rgyud sde smra ba sprul sku o rgyan 'phrin las bstan 'dzin dpal bzang pos bgyis pa dge'o/ /bka' rdzogs pa chen po sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi bla ma brgyud pa rnams la gsol ba btab pa
