gser gyi pad+ma rgyas pa'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ ā: r+ghaṃ/ rgyal gsungs brgyad khri bzhi stong sgo//kun gyi snying po bla med pa/ /sangs rgyas ye shes spyan drangs thad du/ /ston gyur rdzogs pa cha la 'dud/ /dus gsum yongs kyi 'byung nas ni/ /chos dbyings rnam dag gdod ma'i ye shes te/ /de nyid zhal phyag bral las zhal phyag tshul/ /ston pa kun khyab kun tu bzang por 'dud/ /chos nyid ngo bor gnyis 'dzin spros pa bral/ /gcig pu gnyis min dpyad pa'i yul las 'das/ /mtha' bral ye shes kun bzang yab dang yum/ /mnyam sbyor rgyal ba mchog der gsol ba 'debs/ /ye shes ldog chas rab snang rgyal ba rigs/ /chig bsdus khyab bdag dang po rdo rje sems/ /'khor los bsgyur ba de la gsol ba 'debs/ /lha gnas gsum dang mi yi gdul bya'i ngor/ /rgyal ba 'gro 'dul thabs la mkhas pa yi/ /rgyas sras tshul bzung 'jam mgon sems lhag can/ /dga' rab rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i 'od zer ni/ /ma hā tsi na'i yul du sku 'khrungs zhing / /gnas lnga rig gtso 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku/ /shrī sidha'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /phyogs dus rgyal ba yongs 'dus ngo bo nyid/ /pad+ma ka ra rgyal ba 'od dpag med/ /rab 'byams dkyil 'khor gtso mchog he ru ka /thub chen seṅge de la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jam dpal dpa' bo sa skyong rgyal po'i tshul/ /lha yi me tog bod khams skye rgu'i mgon/ /dbyangs can lha mo'i rang bzhin kun tu bzang / /ye shes mtsho rgyal zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gu ru pad+ma'i sras gyur zab gter bdag /yongs kyi gtso gyur chos kyis dbang phyug zhes/ /'jig rten dbang phyug sprul pa mchog gyur cing / /thugs kyi gter gcig bdag por gsol ba 'debs//de yi rigs sras bka' bab chos kyi bdag /lang gro lo tsā'i rnam sprul pad+ma dbang / /rta mchog zhal gzigs mchog gi dngos grub brnyes/ /rgyal sras mchog gyur de la gsol ba 'debs/ /de bzhin dam pa'i gdung 'dzin chos rgyal mtshan/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i rnam 'phrul kun grol ma/ /bskyed rdzogs gding brnyes chos kyi rdo rje 'dzin/ /sprul sku nor bu 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ /smin grol mdzod 'dzin don yod rgyal ba'i mtshan/ /sprul pa'i sku mchog bshes gnyen nor bu'i zhabs/ /snga 'gyur bstan pa'i srog shing chos kyi dbang / /karma gu ru'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /dam pa'i srol 'chang karma dbang phyug che/ /mang thos bla chen blo mchog rdo rje bstsal/ /rgyal ba'i sras po ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs pa/ /'jam dbyangs lhun grub dpal la gsol ba 'debs/ /nyang rigs grub pa'i sras gyur rig pa 'dzin/ /des sangs rdzogs chen rnal 'byor yongs kyi gtso/ /sbas tshul grub pa'i skyes bu mchog dam pa/ /pad+ma dbang grags zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /de yi chos las skyes gyur sras kyi gtso/ /deng dus sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor bstan 'dzin mchog /mdo khams shar 'khrungs mkhas shing nyams rtogs ldan/ /༵ ḍibang

nor bur grags la gsol ba 'debs/ /zab dgu dam chos yongs kyi snying po 'di/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas lam mchog rdzogs pa che/ /smin grol zab dgu'i yang snying mnyam sbyor kyi/ /de ston rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /shu r+ghaṃ/ne gu gser chos kyi brgyud 'debs rin chen dbang gi 'phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rang bzhin ye grol kun khyab rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /zab zhi 'od gsal shes rab rgyal ba'i yum/ /'gyur med sku gsum ngo bo bla ma mchog /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /rigs drug khyab bdag chos sku rdo rje 'chang / /dbyer med 'ja' lus mkha' 'gro ne+e gu ma/ /sprul pa'i sku mchog khyung po rnal 'byor la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mo 'od gsal gnyis 'dres rmog cog rin brtson pa/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang skyer sgang chos seng ge /mkhyen pa'i dbang phyug gnyen ston chos shes rab/ /gsol ba 'debs dz+ra mchog grub sangs rgyas ston pa brtson 'grus seng / /sgrib med mkhyen mnga' dag pa'i sa brnyes pa/ /shangs pa bka' brgyud rin chen sna bdun la/ /gsol ba 'debs so lko tshul khrims mthar phyin ston gtsang rin chen 'bum/ /bla ma'i thugs sras mkhas grub rgyal mtshan 'bum/ /chos kun mngon gzigs 'jag chen byams pa dpal/ /gsol ba 'debs so dz+ra grub pa'i mnga' bdag chos 'byung rin por che/ /skyes mchog dam pa kun nas dga' ba'i mtshan/ /lung rtogs dbang 'byor shes rab bzang po la/ /gsol ba 'debs so 〉 'brel tshad don yod snying po'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /mkhyen rab yon tan dpal kun 'byung ba'i gnas/ /don gnyis lhun grub bsod nams shes rab can/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /bya ba kun btang kun dga' rgyal mtshan che/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos a nan+ta bha dra/ /'gro ba'i mgon po karma bstan 'phel sde/ /gsol ba 'debs so mogrub pa'i dbang phyug kun dga' chos lhun mtshan/ /rnal 'byor rgyal po kun mkhyen chos 'phel zhabs/ /mkhas btsun grub gyur bsod nams rgyal ba'i mtshan/ /gsol ba 'debs so smo dam pa'i rigs la sprul pa'i sku ru 'khrungs/ /sbas pa'i tshul la mchog gi grub pa brnyes/ /yongs 'dzin 'dren mchog chos dbang rdo rje la/ /gsol ba mo rgyal kun ye shes ngo bo 'dus pa'i gar/ /'od gsal sgyu ma'i gzugs sku yongs shar nas/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas snyan brgyud 'gror ston mdzad/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /dag pa sgyu 'phrul dra ba 'khor los bsgyur/ /rgyud bde'i snying po lnga ldan ye shes lha/ /rig rtsal thogs med dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin rlabs dngos grub stsol/ /rgyal ba'i bstan srung rmad byung thugs rje che/ /myur mdzad mgon po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrub/ /chos min rang sar grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /deng nas 482

bdag gi skye ba thams cad du/ /mtho ris yon tan 'phags nor bdun ldan zhing / /dam pas rjes bzung 'khor bar zhen log ste/ /thar pa'i grong la rab tu 'jug par shog /chos min mi spyod chos nas chos bzhin du/ /le lo med par brtson pas rgyud bskul nas/ /yang dag bla na med pa snying po'i don/ /phyir mi ldog la myur du 'khod par shog /dmigs med spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas phra zab yangs pa chen po gnyug ma'i don/ /brjod bral lhan skyes ye shes ngo bo ste/ /phyi ma'i dus min de ring nyid rtogs shog /pha ma'i rang bzhin mkha' khyab sems can la/ /rang shugs snying rje bzod med nyid 'khrungs te/ /thabs mkhas 'phrin las dpag tu med pa yi/ /'gro la phan bde rgyun mi chad ston shog /byin rlabs rtsa ba zab mo'i don ston pa'i/ /bla ma mchog dang thugs yid gcig tu 'dres/ /dam tshig sel med dgongs pa dgyes dgu 'grub/ /'phrin las mtha' dag bdag gi skyongs bar shog /chos kun yang zhun rna gu'i thugs kyi bcud/ /thabs lam gtum mo'i bde drod rab 'bar te/ /bde chen mi shigs dwangs mar rab tu smin/ /chos kun sgyu mar rtogs zhing mnga' brnyes shog /'khrul pa'i rmi lam rmi lam chen po kun/ /bden med ngo shes chos nyid dbyings su grol/ /byar med gting gsal dpag dka' rang bzhin gyis/ /'od gsal 'dzin med ma bu 'dres par shog /bde chen dbu ma'i lam nas rang rig mda'/ /lhag med sku gsum dbyings su mngon gyur cing / /bar dor sgrib pa'i tshogs kun gtan spangs nas/ /sku gnyis 'bras bu mngon du 'gyur bar shog /sems nyid yid bzhin nor bu phyag chen rtogs/ /bde chen 'du 'brel med pa'i mkha' la spyod/ /rang bzhin 'chi med 'od gsal btsan sa zin/ /lam khyer rgyan rdzogs tshe gcig sangs rgyas shog /mdor na bdag gi sgo gsum bya spyod kun/ /log pa'i las dang btang snyoms mi 'gyur bar/ /rnam dkar las dang rgyal ba'i bstan phan zhing / /'gro kun byang chub mchog sbyor rgyu gyur cig /ces rgyang ston rje btsun ngag dbang rdo rje mchog gi drung du nai gu gser chos rtsa ba chos drug sngon 'gro zhes de nyams su len skabs rmi lam phal cher rang ngo zin zhing ya mtshan gang mang shar zhing mi phyed pa snying la thim mthus bstan ma lugs chos dbyar mo bsil gyi pho brang gtsang jo mo nags rgyal mdun ngos tshe mdo gtsang chab ngogs su rang shong ras gur gru bzhi nang na rnal 'byor pa tshe dbang nor bus me rta hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes mnga' gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pa dge'o/ /tsham pa nas brgyud pa'i phyag rgya chen po lhan gcig skyes sbyor gyi khrid kyi brgyud 'debs nor bu'i phreng ba bzhugs so/ /na mo ma hā mu dra ye/ kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan rgyal kun gtso/ /rigs drug khyab bdag sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang / /gsol ba 'debs so bdag la thugs rjes gzigs/ /rgyal kun ye shes myur rtogs byin gyis rlobs/ /stong nyid rdo rje btsun mo 'od gsal ba/ /shes rab phar phyin bcom ldan lhan skyes ma/ /gsol ba 'debs so mo rgyal kun dz+ra mkha' khyab bdag po'i sgyu 'phrul ༵snyi pa'i

sku/ /'gro til ye shes mar 'byin te lo pa/ /gsol ba dz+ra rgyal kun dz+ra dka' spyad lam sbyangs ye shes chen po rtogs/ /byin rlabs mnga' ba rtsa shas na ro pa/ /gsol ba 〉 rgyal kun 〉 'phags pa'i yul bgrod rgyud sde bzhi mnga' brnyes/ /rtogs pa'i gar mkhan mar ston chos blo gros/ /gsol ba ྾ rgyal kun ྾ snying rus phul byung bsgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /rlung sems mnga' brnyes mi la gzhad rdor la/ /gsol ba mo rgyal kun tsho rgyal bas lung bstan nges don ston pa che/ /sprul pa'i sku mchog dwags sgom lha rje la/ /gsol ba 〉 rgyal kun 〉〈 rgyal ba'i zhing rnams skad cig sprul pas nyul/ /'od gsal rgyun mthar dwags po bsgom tshul la/ /gsol ba 〉〈 rgyal kun 〉〈 gu ru'i thugs sprul gsang ba'i mtshan brgyad ldan/ /skye med snying rje'i gar bsgyur rgyal dbang zhang / /gsol ba mo rgyal kun dz+ra mkha' la lding zhing ri rab zhabs kyi brnyil/ /sbyor sgrol mthar phyin man lung byang chub sems/ /gsol ba 〉 rgyal kun mo sa skyong gtsug rgyan bdud 'joms skye ba brgyad/ /pad+mas byin rlabs sprul sku ston pa la/ /gsol ba mo rgyal kun dz+ra bco lngar rgol ngan tshar bcad rjes bzung nas/ /mkhyen rab chos rgyal 'jam dbyangs grags pa la/ /gsol ba ( rgyal kun dz+ra rdo la me 'bar grub rtags sna tshogs bstan/ /sngags kyi rig 'dzin dpal ldan gzhon nu'i sde/ /gsol ba morgyal kun dz+ra nam mkha' mdzod brnyes rmad byung cho 'phrul la/ /dbang bsgyur grub mchog 'jam dbyangs bsod nams zhabs/ /gsol ba mo rgyal kun dz+ra 'das tshe sgra 'od ring bsrel ngo mtshar byon/ /rtogs pa mngon gyur ye shes dpal ldan la/ /gsol ba tsho rgyal kun tsho mi min dregs pa zil gnon bran du bkol/ /rim gnyis mngon gyur chos skyong 'phags pa la/ /gsol ba 〉〈 rgyal kun 〉〈 phyag rgya mchog brnyes mgon po'i lung bstan thob/ /nam mkha'i rnal 'byor dkon mchog mchog ldan la/ /gsol ba dz+ra rgyal kun 〉〈 yi dam zhal gzigs mchog mthun dngos grub brnyes/ /snang ba dbang bsgyur chos skyong dpal ldan la/ /gsol ba tsho rgyal kun dz+ra byang chub sems 'byongs gang shar ding des spyod/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug sems dpa' chos rje la/ /gsol ba dz+ra rgyal kun 〉 yang dag don rtogs brtul shugs nus pa'i bdag /sprul pa'i skyes bu sngags 'chang me 'bar la//gsol ba dz+ra rgyal kun mo rig gnas kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs sprul par grags/ /ngag gi dbang phyug nyi zla 'od dkar la/ /gsol ba dz+ra rgyal kun mo tshul khrims rnam dag sgrub brgyud rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa chos skyong seng ge la/ /gsol ba mo rgyal kun dz+ra rta mgrin zhal khum phyag rgya'i rig 'dzin brnyes/ /grub pa'i rgyal po bstan pa rgyal mtshan la/ /gsol ba tsho rgyal kun 〉〈dpakā nān dngos mjal gza' rgod bran du 'khol/ /lta ba'i gdengs ldan bstan pa'i nyi ma la/ /gsol

ba mo rgyal kun dz+ra lha sras rnam sprul sbas tshul grub pa'i dbang / /rnal 'byor dam pa bstan 'dzin seng ge la/ /gsol ba ste/ rgyal kun 〉〈 snang sems 'dres pas rdo la phyag rjes bzhag /gnas lugs mngon gyur nam mkha' tshe bstan la/ /gsol ba 〉〈 rgyal kun 〉〈 mnyam bzhag brten thob chos kun sgyu mar gzigs/ /'khrul zhig nam mkha' chos kyi nyi ma la/ /gsol ba 〉〈 rgyal kun )〈 rgyal ba'i gdung tshob byin rlabs chu bo brnyes/ /'dren mchog mgon po rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba dz+ra rgyal kun 〉 khyab brdal dbyings nas sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar/ /che mchog bde ba'i 'khor la yab yum la/ /gsol ba dz+ra rgyal kun ye shes mo shes rab phar phyin gter mdzad dga' chen yum/ /bcom ldan 'das ma badz+ra wā ra hi/ /gsol ba dz+ra rgyal kun lko snying rjes cher khros bdud dang mu stegs bcom//bstan srung bskur ston bya rog mtshan than la/ /gsol ba dz+ra rgyal kun 〉 bla ma dkyil 'khor lta spyod gcig gis bsdus/ /dam tshig srog 'brel rdo rje mched lcam la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag la thugs rjes gzigs/ /rgyal kun ye shes myur rtogs byin gyis rlobs/ /de ltar don dam lhan cig skyes sbyor gyis/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang / /chos skyong srung ma rdo rje mched rnams la/ /rtse gcig gus pa drag pos gsol 'debs na/ /khyed kyi mkhyen brtse byin rlabs nus pa yis/ /bdag blo 'khor ba'i chos la zhen log cing / /nges 'byung byang chub lam la mi phyed gus/ /rtse gcig dbyen pa'i gnas su chos spyod shog /skyabs sems skyes bu gsum gyi yon tan rdzogs/ /gzhan phan snying rje'i brtse dang 'brel med par/ /bya ba thams cad btang snyoms ma lus shing / /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel ba'i sman par shog /rang gzhan sgrib sbyangs tshogs bsags la mkhas shing / /rten 'brel rab 'byams kun rtogs byang chub de/ /ring por mi thogs byang chub chen po'i khab/ /de ru rgyal ba'i mdzad pa bstan par shog /bla ma bstan mkhas mos gus rtse mor phyin/ /skyon bral yon tan rdzogs pa'i dag snang 'byongs/ /ci mdzad legs mthong ci gsung tshad mar 'dzin/ /dam tshig sel med thugs yid gcig 'dres shog /sgrub dang shes rab rnam par dag pa yi/ /nyin mtshan dus 'da' bla ma'i bzhed dgu sgrub/ /sun mngal rang 'dod med par 'gro ba'i don/ /lhur len nges don bstan pa rgyas byed shog /sems kyi me long kun rtogs gzugs brnyan gshis/ /sgyu 'phrul lha yi 'khor lor yongs brtas te/ /bden gnyis 'gyur med thig ler yid 'jug pas/ /g.yo med bde gsal mi rtogs brten par shog /ma bcos dus gsum gzung 'dzin bral ba'i sems/ /rang bab yengs med gnad du bsnun byas te/ /yul snang 'khrul rgyun chad nas rang ngo la/ /lhod chags rtse gcig gnas pa bstan par shog /'gyur med skye 'gag gnas bral rtogs pa'i gding / /spros bral stong nyid mnyam bzhag brten thob cing / /zung 'jug ye she~X 8spyang ba

mngon mthong nas/ /shes rab 'od gsal rgyun ma'i chad par5shog /zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /dri bral lhun grub bde gshegs snying po'i dngos/ /sgrib med dngos su mthong nas ye shes sku/ /yang dag tshe 'di nyid nas thob par shog /lta ba phyag chen bsgom pa rnal 'byor bzhi/ /gzer lngas gegs sel byang chub sems mchog spyod/ /byed cing gtum mos ru ta'i rtsa 'dud bkrol/ /yan lag drug gi stsol cig chos gnyis ma/ /bdag ni skye kun gu ru zhang ston gyis/ /bstan pa'i srog shing 'chang spel byed por shog / 5 ces pa'ang lha rigs gzhon nu tshe dbang nor bus smras so/ /sarba maṅga lo/oṃ ā: rdu ma hā mu tra sid dhi pha la rgyu ā/ rgyal yongs kyi ye shes chig mnyam chos sku rdo rje 'chang / /'od gsal rang bzhin shes rab pha rol phyin sku rnal 'byor ma/ /gsol ba 'debs so gnyug ma'i ye shes phyag rgya chen po gang / /bla ma'i mthu yi de ring mngon rtogs 'bras bu brnyes byin rlobs/ /dza gor yul na bram ze'i rigs la sprul sku te lo pa/ /dpe med grong 'khrungs nā ro ta pa mkhas grub bsnyarwa ṭī6gas bzang / /gsol ba 'debs so mo bla ma'i mthu yis dz+ra mar ston gnyis smra rgyud sde

bzhi brnyes dpal ldan chos blo gros/ /bla ma'i thugs zin dka' spyad mthar phyin mi la ras chen zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so 〉 bla ma'i dz+ra zab gsal rdo rje'i thugs bsnyes dwags po lha rje zla 'od pa/ /sman pa'i rgyal po zhing 'dir sprul bsgyur dpal ldan phag mo gru/ /gsol ba dz+ra bla ma'i dz+ra 'da' bsnun rtogs par co 'dra'i mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug gling ras pa/ /lag na pad+ma ras gos kyis dbyibs 'gro mgon rgya ras zhabs/ /gsol ba lko bla ma'i dz+ra kha ba can gyi dpal rir ye shes gar mkhan rgod tshang pa/ /phyi nang gzhan gsum sgrib med spyan ldan chos rje lha sdong zhabs/ /gsol ba ྾ bla ma'i 〉〈 sbas tshul sgrub pa'i seṅge tshe la mnga' brnyes rgyal mtshan 'bum/ /'od gsal gnas lugs legs gzigs rnal 'byor dbang po shes rab mgon/ /gsol ba ( bla ma'i mo rin chen rgyal ba'i thugs mchog rol gar mngon gyur ku ma ra/ /dri med shes rab rnam dag mkhyen mnga' bsod nams rgyal ba'i mtshan/ /gsol ba 'debs so mo bla ma'i 〉 rat+na bha dra phag grur seng khrir don dam 'od gsal thugs/ /dbus smyon kun bzang ye shes sgyu lus brtul zhugs spyod mdzad gtso/ /gsol ba 'debs so 〉 bla ma'i mo rlabs gsum gyis mdzes dam pa mang po'i gsang 'dzin rnam grol bzang / /mi shigs gsum 'bras chos nyid bden mthong chos skyong rdo rje dpal/ /gsol ba mo bla ma'i ྾ rlung sems las rung spros bral don rtogs yon tan rgya mtsho'i sde/ /sbas pa'i yul bgrod gnyis spangs rnal 'byor shākya bzang po pa/ /gsol ba 'debs so mo bla ma'i mo rim gnyis lam la nam yang g.yo med yon tan rgyal ba'i mtshan/ /gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po ji bzhin mngon gyur karma dpal rdor rje/ gsol ba dz+ra bla ma'i dz+ra dam pas rjes bzung yang dag lam mkhan shes rab gsum gyis phyug /lha sngags ting 'dzin rtag brtson grub dbang o rgyan rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ /gsol ba tsho bla ma'i mosmin grol mthar thug gnas lugs ye shes rgyud la gter mdzad pa/ /bka' drin mtshungs med rdo rje slob dpon mchog gyur rtsa ba la/ /gsol ba dz+ra bla ma'i mo dngos grub mchog gter he ru ka dpal 'khor lo'i bsgyur mdzad pa/ /bde mchog dra ba sdom pa dgyes mdzad dpa' ma wā ra hi/ /gsol ba mobla ma 'i lko gnas gsum la brten lhan skyes bde ba sbyin mdzad pho nya mo/ /rgyal ba'i bstan skyong dam tshig bka' yis srung ma mthu ldan la/ /gsol ba 'debs so 〉 bla ma'i mo de ltar phyag rgya chen po lhan gcig skyes sbyor brgyud pa yis/ /rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams la/ /mi phyed gsol ba btab pas dmigs med ye shes mchog /bla ma'i mthu yis de ring nyid du bdag gi mngon rtogs shog /gsal stong dbyer med nam mkha'i dkyil ltar rab shar rtse gcig nas/ /skye 'gag gnas bral rtogs tshogs rang grol ngo bo spros bral ba/ /gnyis chos gnyis med ro gcig dpe yi 487

'od gsal mngon gyur nas/ /bya rtsol las 'das bsgom med 'od gsal don dam myur thob shog /me long lta bu'i sku dang ye shes zung 'jug bde ba che/ /sangs rgyas gyi thugs mchog chos kyi sku de yongs grub nas/ /nam mkha'i khyon khengs 'gro ngor bsam gyis mi khyab gzugs kyi sku/ /lhun gyi grub pa sems can ma lus byang chub mcher bkod shog /ces pa yang grub pa'i dbang phyug dbus smyon he ru ka dpal kun dga' bzang po nas brgyud pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i bla rabs gsol 'debs 'di ni mdo khams shākya'i dge bsnyen tshe dbang nor bus rang gnyis mos pa'i rkyen gyi lcags kyi rgyal zla'i tshes bzang bcu la mnga' ris glo bo'i rgyal khab smon thang du sbyar ba'i yi ge'i gzugs brnyan du sgyur pa po sprul pa'i sku dam pa 'phrin las bstan 'dzin no/ /dge'o/ /phyag chen lhan skyes bar 'brug nas brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs nyung ngu byin rlabs myu gu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo ma hā mu dra ye/ rdo rje 'chang dbang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /shes rab bzang po dpal ldan rtsa shad pa/ /chos kyi blo gros bzhad pa rdo rje rtsal/ /gsol ba 'debs so phyag chen dngos grub stsol/ /dwags po lha rje 'gro mgon rdo rje rgyal/ /pad+ma rdo rje ye shes rdo rje'i zhabs/ /dbon ras dar seng gzhon nu seṅge la/ /gsol ba 'debs so 〉〈 nyi ma seṅge seṅge shes rab che/ /seṅge rin chen seṅge rgyal po mchog /kun dga' seṅge badz+ra rat+na la/ /gsol ba 'debs ( blo gros seṅge shes rab seṅge dpal/ /dz+nyā rat+na blo gros mchog ldan pa/ /nam mkha'i rnal 'byor 'brug pa rgya dbang rje/ /gsol ba 〉 ngag dbang chos rgyal byar pa chos kyi grags/ /gnyis spang rnal 'byor mi pham pad+ma dkar/ /ngag dbang bzang po shes rab sprin sgra rgyas/ /gsol ba tsho sgom smyon sprul sku phyag rdor nor bu dpal/ /rang rigs ras pa kun dga' rgya mtsho'i sde/ /sbas pa'i sangs rgyas 'jam dbyangs 'phrin las zhabs/ /phyag chen lhan skyes ngo sprod rtsa ba yis/ /bla ma brgyud par bcas la gsol btab mthus/ /tshe rabs rtag tu nges don chos dang 'phrad/ /dbang bzhis rgyud smin gnas lugs lta ba rtogs/ /nor 'khrul yongs spangs sgrub brgyud bstan pa spel/ /bu slob rgya mtsho'i gos can yongs su khyab/ /'khor bar zhen log bla mar mos gus rgyas/ /brtson 'grus mthar phyin rgyu 'bras rten 'brel shar/ /rkyen kun ro snyoms zab mo phyag rgya che/ /de las mi 'da' sku gsum 'bras thob shog /zhes thug chen brgyud pa bar 'brug gdan rabs nas brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rgyas bsdus shin tu mang la dad gi mos pa'i sa bon tsam du tshe dbang nor bus glo bo smon thang du lcags kyi rgyal zla'i tshes bco lngar smras pa'i yig rigs sprul pa'i sku 'phrin las bstan 'dzin gyi bgyis pa dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor bo dong 'jigs med dbyangs can dga' ba nas brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la gsol 'debs rin chen phreng ba bzhugs so/ /na mo ma hā mu dra ya/ gnas spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ /drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /sems gsal stong 'dzin med du 'charwa ༵8 dang / /yul snang stong bden med du rtogs pa ru/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis

rlobs/ /kun la 'dre'o/ /gnas 'og min chos dbyings pho brang du/ /chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen la gsol ba 'debs/ /mo shar bhang ga la yi yul ljongs su/ /te lo shes rab bzang po la gsol ba 'debs/ /mo byang puṣ+pe ha ri'i dgon pa ru/ /mkhas pa nā ro paṇa chen la gsol ba 'debs/ /tsho lho gro bo lung gi pho brang du/ /sgra bsgyur mar pa lo tsā la gsol ba 'debs/ /〉 gnas la phyi gangs kyi ra ba ru/ /dbang phyug bzhad pa rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /mo shar dwags la sgam po'i dgon pa ru/ /lha rje zla 'od gzhon nu la gsol ba 'debs/ /mo gnas phag mo gru pa'i mtha' rtsa ru/ /bde gshegs rdo rje rgyal po la gsol ba 'debs/ /mo gnas sna phu chos lung gi dgon pa ru/ /gling ras pad+ma rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /〉 'brug ra lung gnyis kyi gdan sa ru/ /'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras la gsol ba 'debs/ /tsho shrī rgod tshang shel gyi brag phug tu/ /rgod tshang mgon po rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /〉gnas lha gdongs dpal gyi yar dgon nas/ /sprul sku rgyal mtshan dpal bzang la gsol ba 'debs/ /mo gnas klu rgyal bu le'i gangs khrod nas/ /thugs sras spyan lnga rig ldan la gsol ba 'debs/ /dz+raganas mthar phug dpal gyi dgon pa ru/ /chos rje rin chen dpal bzang la gsol ba 'debs/ /dz+ramus tha gong dpal gyi dgon pa ru/ /bla ma gnyen ston pa chen po la gsol ba 'debs/ /dz+ra mus shu gu 'tshal gyi gtsug rgyan du/ /bla ma shes rab 'bum la gsol ba 'debs/ /mo gnas dngul chu chos rdzong gi dgon pa ru/ /skyes mchog rgyal sras thogs med la gsol ba 'debs/ /ste/ gyam bsam gtan gling gi dgon pa ru/ /'khrul zhig lo chen byang rtse la gsol ba 'debs/ /mo gnas la stod shel dkar gyis chos sde ru/ /lo chen grags pa rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs/ /ste/ gnas chos lding rgyal ba'i zhing khams su/ /paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jigs med dbyangs chen dga' ba la gsol ba 'debs/ /kun mkhyen phyogs las rnam rgyal la gsol ba tsho drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /sems gsal stong 'dzin med du 'char ba dang / /yul snang stong bden med du rtogs pa ru/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /〉 gnas sgo mo chos sde'i dgon pa ru/ /spo pa chos rgyal bzang po la gsol ba mo gnas gar bzhugs dag pa'i dben gnas su/ /sku zhang kun dga' snying po la gsol ba 〉 gnas dpal mo chos sding gi dgon pa ru/ /nyams med shes rab rgya mtsho la gsol ba dz+ra gnas bsam gtan rtse mo'i dgon pa ru/ /mkhas btsun nam mkha' 'od zer la gsol ba ste/ gnas mngon dga' chos kyi pho brang nas/ /chos rgyal nam mkha' rin chen la gsol ba dz+ra gnas bsam gtan zhal gzigs dgon pa ru/ /'dul 'dzin nam mkha'i rgyal po la mo gnas gsang sngags bde chen gyi dgon pa ru/ /mkhas grub nam mkha' dkar po la 〉 gnas 'brangs rgyas 489

bsam gtan gling gi dben gnas su/ /yongs 'dzin nam mkha' nor bu la gsol ba 〉 gnas brang mtsho rdzogs phug gi sgrub khang na/ /'dren mchog 'jam dbyangs 'phrin las la ྾ gnas phyogs med 'gro don skyong ba nas/ /rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu la gsol ba dz+ra gnas spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ /'dren mchog 'khor lo'i mgon po la mo gnas rang lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /yi dam mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs la gsol ba dz+ra gnas mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /yum chen rdo rje phag mo la ( gnas bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod du/ /chos skyong ma mgon lcam dral la mo gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas mchog tu/ /chos bdag dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la 〉 gnas dam tshig gtsang ma'i gzhal yas su/ /mched lcam rdo rje spun grogs la ( drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 〉 sems gsal stong 'dzin med du 'char ba dang / /yul snang stong bden med du rtogs pa ru/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /'jig rten 'di snang blo yi bor nus shing / /zag med dag snang la rang byan chud pa yis/ /mtshan ldan bla ma la phur tshugs dad gus kyis/ /byin rlabs 'pho ba mchog snying myur 'jug mdzod/ /'phral rkyen phyi snang gi bar chad sel ba dang / /'dod don yid bzhin du lhun gyi grub pa yi/ /mchog thun dngos grub kun 'bad med snying brnyes pas/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob byin rlobs/ /zhes pa ma ha paṇ+ḍi ta 'jigs med dbyangs can dga' ba'i zhabs nas brgyud pa'i phyag chen lhan skyes kyi bla ma rnams la gsol 'debs sngar gyi rnying pa la tshig bsgyur bcos kha bskangs ba ni tshe dbang nor bus bag yod smin drug zla ba'i tshes bcu drug la ru lag 'bras spungs su bris pa sarba maṅga lo/yang rgyud sa lugs gcig la/ nam mkha' nor bu nas/ nam mkha' bstan 'dzin dang / des zab gsal chos 'phel te/ de la kho bos legs par 'khum pas/ de ltar na/ gnas chos dbyings rgyal ba'i gdan sa nas/ /chos rje nam mkha' bstan 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas bstas dga' tsan shug khrod nas/ /grub mchog zab gsal chos 'phel la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas phyogs med man chad sngar ltar ro/ /de yang yang tshe dbang nor bus so/ /sarba maṅga lo/na mo bud+dha bho dhi satwa bh+ya: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi ye shes zab gsal gnyis su med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yi man ngag zab mo brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig 'khor ba'i duḥkhas mnar ba'i 'gro ba rnams/ /yang dag lam la dkri bar byed pa rje btsun mchog /'jam dpal dpa' bo bsam gyis mistab sgyu 'phrul gyis/ /snang ba chos kyi nyi ma bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde gshegs snying po gdod nas mi 'jigs stobs la sogs/ /yon tan kun ldan glo bur dris sdi~X0 bde gsal 'bras bu3/ /spangs rtogs phun tshogs rigs mchog sgyu 'phrul sras po lha yi lha/ /

rgyal mchog don grub rin chen snying po de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba nyid du gyur kyang rgyal ba'i sras tshul chos 'phrin gyis/ /dbang phyug chen po rgyal ba'i sras gsum dbang byed 'phags mchog gis/ /rab dkar pad+mo lag dang zur phud lngas rgyan gzhon nu'i lus/ /gsang ba'i rgyal po rdo rje mchog gang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha yi 'gro la phan phyir byang chub sems dpa' chen po nya yi mgrin/ /rab mdzes lha yi lus su sprul bsgyur rgyal sras blo gros rin po che/ /rgyal ba gcig char rtogs pa'i bdag por lung bstan theg chen gyis/ /shing rta mchog gyur dpal ldan mda' bsnun sgra gcan 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas ye shes 'byung gnas 'od shes shākya'i bstan pa'i gdul bya'i ngor/ /rab dga'i sar bzhugs sems pa'i tshul bstan mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku/ /srid gsum dbang po kun gyis mchod pa'i zhing gyur 'jig rten mgon po ni/ /sde snod bzhi yis mdzod la dbang brnyes na ga dzu nar phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi rgyal tshab thu bo dam pa seṅge la yi rgyal pos sras/ /lung rtogs chos la dbang bsgyur ar+ya de ba lha yi lha mchog dpal/ /'phags pa yab sras thugs kyi bcud gyur man ngag gsang ba'i mdzod kun 'dzin/ /'chi med tshe la mnga' brnyes klu yis byang chub de la'ang phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa'i zhabs brtan sras kyi mchog gyur sde snod kun 'chang lus de'i 'og /bde ba can du gshegs gyur byang chub sems dpa' 'am sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po/ /sbyangs pa'i yon tan la spyod theg chen 'dzin mkhas sgra gcan 'dzin bshes gnyen/ /'gro la smin chad yun 'tshor gyur pa klus bshes gnyen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags klu'i rjes 'brang mtshan med lta ba'i srol bstod dge 'dun bsrung ba pa/ /ngo bo nyid med smra ba'i khyu mchog chen por gyur cing ril bu yi/ /rnam min phung po ma spangs rig pa 'dzin pa'i sar gshegs sangs rgyas skyong / /de yis rjes zhugs theg chen mig gyur pad+mo'i blo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skye ba du mar 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi byin rlabs mkhas la mkhas pa'i mchog /rgol pa thar byed ngag gi dbang phyug ngo mtshar mdzad pa du ma'i bdag /mtha' bral don ston 'ja' lus rdo rje'i skur zla ba grags pa'i dpal/ /de yi rjes bzung rdzu 'phrul mchog brnyes srung ba'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bram rigs cher mkhas sing bzang sgeg rdor dpal mo byis sbis zhabs/ /legs bsnyen sde snod bzhir sbyangs shes rab rgyud las chos rgyun ting 'dzin brnyes/ /bsrung pa li ta ba'i zhabs la gsang 'dus bco brgyad tshar nyan drag shul spyod pa yis/ /lung bstan thob nas 'jam dpal sprul pa'i dge sbyong gnyis spangs tshul bzung gyur/ /pad+ma'i spubs su sku 'khrungs 'jam dpal bshes gnyen phyi mar yongs grags pa/ /gang gi sgyu 'phrul bde bar gshegs 'dus bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor mngon bstan nas/ /dbang bskur zhal lung thob pas mchog tu phyag rgya chen po kho na nyid/ /mngon gyur nus pa dpag med sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs la phyag 'ardo~X lo / /

de slob mchog gi bde chen zhing du sangs rgyas 'od dpag med pa gang / /zhing 'dir thub pa'i rgyal tshab tshul bzung o rgyan rgyal po thor cog can/ /rgyal kun 'phrin las byed por gyur pas sangs rgyas kun las 'phags zhes bya/ /bde ba cher grags pad+ma 'byung gnas zhabs la rtag par phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhan yang ye shes zhabs brtan mthong ba'i chos la myang 'das gyur pa ni/ /sgra gcan 'dzin bzang rab zhi bshes gnyen mar me mdzad dpal ye shes dang / /rgyal tshab sar gshegs sangs rgyas zhi sangs chos 'byung gtsug tor sman pa'i zhabs/ /rdo rje slob dpon chen po de sras slob ma'i tshogs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde ba chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas zhabs dang sman pa'i zhabs bsnyen nas/ /rim gnyis yon tan yongs rdzogs rnal 'byor dbang phyug dpal ldan yi ge zhabs/ /de yi rgyud 'dzin dam pa ye shes tshe dbang brnyes pa karna hād/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i phul gyur ye shes dpal bshes zhabs la'ang phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam gnon gtor mi slob dpon byin rlabs nus mthu che ldan klu sgrub mtshan/ /de yi slob ma gangs ri'i khrod du gnyos kyi rigs 'khrungs 'byung po zhes/ /chos rgyal mya ngan med pa'i skye bar zhal gzhes ma hā lo tsā ba/ /yon tan grags zhes mkhas shing grub pa de la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yi rigs sras chos kyi gdung 'tshob rdo rje bla ma nus par ldan/ /jo sras dpal le yi dam zhal gzigs grags dpal mkhas shing chos skyong khol/ /spyod 'chang nag po ngur smrig gos kyi mdzes byas gnas lugs phyag chen la/ /byan chud lha nang pa zhes sangs rgyas ras chen zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stod lung ye shes 'bar ni mkhyen rab phul byung zab gsal bden don rtogs/ /chos 'od gzhung lugs la sbyang 'phags 'od 'od gsal rgyun gyis rnal 'byor gyur/ /mi bskyed rgyal bas byin rlabs mkhas pa'i phul gyur kun mkhyen rin chen grub/ /mkhas shing ye shes che thob byang rtse grags rgyal zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba rnam grol mtha' yas mgon po zhing 'di'i 'gro slad rgyal sras tshul/ /'jigs med dbyangs can dga' zhes lung rtogs bstan pa yongs rdzogs 'dzin pa'i dpal/ /rdo rje sems dang rnal 'byor ma tshogs kun gyi sdug dbyung slob dpon chen po gsang ba sbyin/ /ma hā paṇ+ḍi tar gyur chos kyi rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan de la snying nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi zhabs brtan mi shigs dwangs ma'i sku thob bsod nams mchog gyur mtshan//phra rags dbur thim 'od gsal rgyun brnyes mon rdzong zla ba rgyal ba'i mtshan/ /rgyal bstan snying po 'jigs med bzhed pa legs mkhyen nam mkha' rin po che/ /rtogs pa'i gar mkhan rnal 'byor dbang phyug lha dbang grags par phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdod nas byang chub brnyes kyang snying rje mchog gi 'gro rnams btang min pas/ /rtag tu gzugs sku'i rol pa ston la g.yel med rnam pa thams cad pa/ /pad+ma 'byung gang sdo~X 'chang nag po'i mtshan gyis bsgyur ba'i sgyu 'phrul mchog /sngon med legs bshad spro mkhas

sgrol ba'i mgon po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dam pa'i rigs 'khrungs byang chub sems 'byongs zab gsal nyams myong nam mkha' dkar/ /sdom brtson mang thos bshad sgrub bstan pa spel brtson nam mkha' nor bu'i zhabs/ /sbas pa'i tshul gyis nges don gsal byed sgron me he ru ka dpal dpa'/ /rdo rje slob dpon 'phrin las rab brtan zhabs la rab tu gus phyag 'tshal/ /sngon las bzang pos blo gros pad+mo rgyas shing ris med grub pa'i mthar/ /gus pas zab dgu'i bcud blangs mthar thug snying po ma shig dwangs ma che/ /zab gsal ngo bo sgro 'dogs chod pa bya bral nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa/ /rig sngags 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu 'jam dbyangs rgya mtshor phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba kun gyis bgrod pa gcig gi lam gyur zung 'jug sngags kyi chos/ /zab gsal dbyer med gnas lugs sems nyid ngo bo ston par mdzad pa po/ /rgyal ba kun las lhag pa'i bka' drin che thob rtsa ba'i bla ma gang / /rab 'byams dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i dbang phyug de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos rnams kun gyi snying po zab gsal dbyer med lam/ /sangs rgyas yongs kyi gsang tshig 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi zhal lung kun tu bzang / /dwangs ma gsum ldan mi zhig grol thig mchog tu bde ba'i rang bzhin che/ /rgyud la 'char byed tshig dang yi ger byon pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar zab gsal lung rtogs mnga' bdag bla ma rtsa bar brgyud par bcas/ /kun la rtse gcig gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul bdag sogs sdig kun bshags/ /dge la yi rang chos gsung bskul zhing mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /dge tshogs thams cad yongs bsdus byang chub chen por bsngo bas rgyas gyur cig /sarba maṅga lo/smra ba'i seng ge'i don rgyud gso rig pa gcer mthong du grags pa'i brgyud pa'i bla mar gsol ba btab pa snying po don gyi gter sbyin zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ ā: hūṃ: chos nyid dbyings las nam yang ma g.yos g.yo med spros bral ngang / /rang bzhin dag pa'i zhing na nges pa lnga ldan rgyal ba'i gtso/ /mi mjed gnas na bye ba phrag brgya sprul mdzad shākya thub/ /gsol ba 'debs so rig pa mngon gyur sangs rgyas thob byin rlobs/ /grangs med sngon sangs rgyas yang 'gror rtse rgyal sras 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /skal bzang rnam 'dren drug pa seṅger zhal bzhes dam pa mgon/ /rang rig dri med mngon gyur dam pa sor chud dge 'dun 'bar/ /gsol ba 'debs so tsho mkhyen pas rgol ba tshar gcod bla ma'i thugs zin 'chis der brtson/ /gang gi rigs sras gdams pa'i bum bzang 'dzin mkhas brtson seng zhabs/ /mkhyen brtse nus ldan tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs rgyal sras shes rab 'od/ /gsol ba 'debs so tsho chos rnams ma lus thugs su chud pa kun mkhyen bsod nams dpal/ /rgyal ba ma chags pad+mar skye bar gcig thog kun dga' bzang / /gang gi rigs kyi cung dang chos kyi sras gyur don 493

'grub mtshan/ /gsol ba 'debs so lko rgya yi rig pa zhi byed bstan gsal smon lam shes rab pa/ /chos rjes mkhas btsun blo gros rgya mtsho zhes bya kun mkhyen che/ /rdo rje bstan pa lung rtogs mnga' bdag gnas lugs gzigs pa'i gtso/ /gsol ba 'debs so ste/ rgya mtsho sbyin pa smin grol lam gyi yon tan rdzogs pa'i dpal/ /bde ldan lhun grub lam lnga'i gsang la zhugs nas rang rig rtogs/ /nam mkha' bzang po rim gnyis khrod tshad yon tan yongs su rdzogs/ /gsol ba 'debs so mo dpal 'byor lhun grub byang sems gnyis brnyes rang rig btsan sa zin/ /bkra shis bzang po kun spangs brtul zhugs yang dag rtogs pa'i gding tshad lon/ /'chi med blo brtan snyigs dus zhi byed sgron me 'gran zla bral/ /gsol ba 'debs so mo gnas lugs phyag chen thugs chud rang rig mngon gyur sprul pa'i sku/ /sbas tshul 'khrul zhig rnal 'byor spyod pa 'phrin las rab brtan zhabs/ /gang gi bka' drin smin grol gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'i dpal/ /gsol ba 'debs so 〉 khyad 'phags man ngag rang rig dri med lam/ /mngon par bstan mdzad drin chen chos kyi rje/ /brgyud pa kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mo rgyal kun gshegs shul don brgyud snying po'i chos/ /de yi lam la rtag tu bdag zhugs shing / /bslu med sangs rgyas bla mar skyabs su mchi/ /'gro la lhag bsam byang chub sems bskyed shog /dal 'byor rnyed dka' 'jig sla 'khor ba'i rgyun/ /yun ring duḥ khas mnar la skyo ba skye/ /ma nor lam ston rtsa ba'i bla ma ni/ /sangs rgyas las lhag 'bad pas bstan par shog /dad pa mi phyed mos gus phur tshugs pas/ /rtse gcig gsol ba btab pas bdag sogs 'gro'i/ /sgrib dag bla ma'i byin rlabs snying la zhugs/ /grub thob don brgyud rgyal sa zin par shog /lta ba lta stangs bzhag thabs sems kyi gnad/ /dbang dman rten can rten med lam la bkris/ /dbang 'bring snang rig rtsa bral lam du khyer/ /dbang rab rig pa cog gzhags gding thob shog /ma nor ngo 'phrad de nyid goms 'dris brtan/ /skyon sel yon tan drod tshad 'dzin mkhas shing / /rjes thob chu bo rgyun gyis rnal 'byor gyis/ /tshe la dbang brnyes dam pa mi pham mgon/ /gang gi don brgyud yid bzhin nor bu bzhin/ /rig pa gcer mthong gdams pa mchog de yi/ /lam 'bras yongs rdzogs myur thob byin gyis rlobs/ /ces gso rig pa gcer mthong gi dbang khrid kyi brgyud 'debs su yongs 'dzin smin drug zla ba'i tshes bzang po la stod bud kyi lung mdo sbas yul mkhan pa rdzong gi gnas sgo mkha' 'gro zha mi lha khang 'dabs su rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus rang gi mos pas smras pa'i yig rigs dge slong g.yu rung ngo / /sarba maṅga lo/nā ro chos drug zab khrid sgam po gdan rabs nas brgyud pa thun mong ma yin pa'i brgyud 'debs byin rlabs myur 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rigs kun khyab bdag dpal ldan rdo rje semadī/94/lhan gcig skyes sbyor rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /gsol ba 'debs so thabs lam sngon du gyur/ /

zung 'jug ye shes sku thob byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyal ba'i sras po grub chen te lo pa/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i rnal 'byor nā ro pa/ /gsol ba 'debs so 〉 zung 'jug ye shes smo rgyud sde bzhi brnyes lo tsā chos blo gros/ /ye shes sgyu ma'i sku bsnyes bzhad rdo rje/ /gsol ba 'debs so mo zung 'jug ye shes lkopad 'byung thugs sprul myang smad lha rje'i zhabs/ /rgyud mthil sa brnyes dwags bsgom tshul khrims snying / /gsol ba 'debs so mo zung 'jug mo 'od gsal dkyil 'khor mngon brnyes byang chub grub/ /bslab gsum dri med mkha' chen bye dkar ba/ /gsol ba 'debs so ྾ zung 'jug mo rtogs pa'i dbang phyug snyib sgom chen pa/ /chos kyi rgyal po 'bri gung gling pa mched/ /gsol ba 'debs so dz+razung 'jug mo sgrub rgyud 'dzin mkhas dpal ldan lha lung pa/ /nges don rtogs pa lha sa'i btsun pa che/ /gsol ba 'debs so dz+ra zung 'jug mo gnas lugs mngon gyur jo sras rdo rje blo/ /mtshungs med bla ma chos kyi rgyal ba'i mtshan/ /gsol ba 'debs so dz+ra zung 'jug tsho chos kyi spyan ldan smra ba'i seṅge pa/ /chos kyi dbang phyug 'gro ba'i bla ma che/ /gsol ba 'debs so tsho zung 'jug dz+ramakhas btsun bzang ldan rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ /spyan snga chos rgyal bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sde/ /gsol ba 'debs so tsho zung 'jug mo gnyug ma'i don gzigs bsod nams lhun grub pa/ /sgam po'i seng khri bsrung mdzad mchog rnams la/ /gsol ba mo zung 'jug mo gzhal med mkhas gyur dwags po paṇ+ḍi ta/ /'od gsal rdo rje thugs ldan maṅga la/ /gsol ba dz+ra zung 'jug mo sgrub pa'i skyes mchog dam pa puṣ+yo'i mtshan/ /mchog gi sprul sku nor bu rgyan pa'i zhabs/ /gsol ba tsho zung 'jug dz+ra mkhas shing grub pa spyan snga rin rdor ba/ /'dren mchog rgyal dbang bzang po rdo rje dpal/ /gsol ba 〉 zug 'jug mo sbas pa'i sangs rgyas 'od gsal dbang po'i zhabs/ /rim gnyis drod brnyes tshe dbang dpal nor bu/ /gsol ba 〉 zung 'jug tsho bka' drin mtshungs med rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs/ /thabs lam chos drug brgyud pa'i bla ma lhar/ /rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs mthus/ /srog rtsol rlung kun dhu tir zhugs nas thim/ /'bar 'dzag duḥ kha nyon dag bde ba brnyes/ /yas babs mas brten dga' ba yongs su rdzogs/ /bsam gyis mi khyab rdo rje'i sku thob shog /tsaṇ+ḍa li yi phung khams 'od skur smin/ /sgyu ma'i blo yis dngos por 'dzin pa zhig /'khrul pa'i rmi lam ngo shes rang sar grol/ /'od gsal 'khor yul lta ba'i gdengs thob shog /bar de zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po thob/ /'pho bas btsan thabs sangs rgyas sa brnyes shing / /mdor na srid bzhi'i las grol de bzhin gshegs/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang myur thob shog /tshe rabs kun tu bla med sngags lam 'phrad/ /dbang thob de yis sdom pa nyams med cing / /ma nor dpe don ye shes mngon du gyur/ /tshom bu sprul pas ༵spya kun

don byed shog /de ltar sgam po gdan rabs nas brgyud pa'i chos drug gi yig cha rje btsun grub pa'i dbang phyug paṇ+ḍi ta bkra shis rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa de nyid shin tu legs par snang bas de'i khrid kyi brgyud 'debs su mnga' ris dom po'i bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po o rgyan rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas bzhad ltar mdo khams su skye zhing sngags la blo sbyangs pa'i rnal 'byor tshe dbang nor bus glo bo smon thang gi rgyal po'i khab tu lcags khyi rgyal zla tshes pa'i snga char smras pa dge'o/ /tshe sgrub spyi yi kha skongs gsol 'debs 'chi med bum bzang bzhugs so/ /trī: tshe bdag rgyal ba mgon po 'od dpag med/ /tshe lha sprul pa'i snying rje spyan ras gzigs/ /tshe dbang grub pa'i rig 'dzin pad ma 'byung / /tshe yi mnga' bdag mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe yi lha mo gos dkar man dha ra/ /tshe bdag rgyal mo bde chen mthing 'od 'bar/ /tshe mchog 'od gsal grub dpal rje 'bangs sogs/ /tshe yi rig grub rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe yi gter ston rig 'dzin dbang phyug rje/ /tshe chos bdag po bka' bab rgyud 'dzin dang / /tshe yi dbang bskur byin rlabs rtsa ba yis/ /tshe yi bla brgyud rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe yi yi dam rigs lnga yab yum dang / /tshe bdag 'gyogs ma sgo ma bzhi la sogs/ /tshe bsrungs rgyal chen lo zla zhag dus lha/ /tshe yi dkyil 'khor rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe dkyil brgyud par de ltar gsol btab mthus/ /tshe 'dir tshe ring dpal rgyas bsod nams 'phel/ /tshe dbang rig 'dzin sa la 'khod gyur nas/ /tshe dpag med mgon go 'phang myur thob shog /tshe lha rig 'dzin rnams la gsol btab pa/ /tshe sgrub gang la sbyar kyang rung ba 'dir/ /tshe'i rig 'dzin pa'i dus chen tshes bcu la/ /tshe dbang nor bus gang dran shar kyi bris/ /rang lo bcu bdun skabs su bris pa dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /brda sprod pa dbyangs can mdo gzhung ston byed bla ma brgyud par gsol 'debs dbyangs can dgyes pa'i snyan glu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na maḥ swa ra pra sti ye/ chos dbyings khams la rtag par gnas g.yo 'gro 'ong las 'das pa/ /snang srid kun gyi mgon bcud dwangs ma zab gsal mi 'gyur sku/ /kun khyab bde chen rang bzhin gdod nas rnam dag ye shes ngang / /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi ngang tshul bdag nyid che la 'dud/ / 1 ma skyes mi 'gag mkha' khyab spros bral nyid la rtag bzhugs shing / /bral zhing smin pa'i yon tan yongs rdzogs chub pa'i mthar thug dpal/ /gdul bya'i don la rgyun chad med pa rgya chen rgyal ba'i dbang / /go tam zas gtsang sras po lha yi lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 2 rgyal ba kun gyi bskyed bzhi ma ma 'od gsal bde gshegs snying / /dri ma yongs bral shes rab pha rol phyin ma bcom ldan 'das/ /mi 'gyur bde ba 'dren pa'i dpal mo mtsho byung dbyangs can ma/ /legs bshad rgya mtshos ༵byung gnas rgyud mang 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 3 rig gnas bco brgyad mkhyen pa'i phul

byung gtsang ma'i mchog dam pa/ /phyi nang gzhung lugs khong chud 'phags ma bsnyen la lhod min pa/ /sgrib sbyangs smon lam stobs kyis bcom ldan ma'i zhal mjal nas/ /gsung gi snang ba legs thob rjes sbyor zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 4 gang gi rjes 'brang dbyangs can brda sprod gzhung la legs sbyangs shing / /legs par sbyar ba'i skad kyi 'gro blo'i mun sel nyi ma mchog /gnas lnga rig pa'i dbang po blo gros rgyud mang mgrin pa'i dbyangs/ /sgrogs mkhas 'phags pa'i yul byon brgyud pa'i bla mar phyag 'tshal lo/ / 5 'phags yul sa yi thig le wa ra na sir bram ze'i rigs/ /skur 'khrungs bye brag pa dang rig can rig byed mtha' pa'i gzhung / /sbyangs pa che thob grub 'bras legs sbyar skad mkhas bram ze'i gtso/ /lnga rigs khyu mchog kriṇ+ḍar grags pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 6 'phags yul nub phyogs ku ru k+ṣe tra'i grong khyer chen po ru/ /gnas lnga rig pa chen po gcan gyur stobs bzang po zhes dang / /gcung gyur paṇ+ḍi ta go ku la nā tha mi shra/ /bram ze'i rigs 'khrungs mched gyur dam pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 7 brda sprod dbyangs can gangs ri khrod 'dir gsar 'dren shing rta mchog /spyod 'chang nag po legs bshad seng ge'i nga ro sgrogs phyir du/ /bsam bzhin skye bzhed mkhas la mkhas pa'i mchog chen dpe med pa/ /sgrol ba'i mgon zhes kun dga' snying po de la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 8 ma hā tsi ni yul nas legs byon khams pa a se zhes/ /snga 'gyur grub de'i gdung rigs gnas lnga rig pa'i mkhas pa ni/ /'dar pa ngag dbang phun tshogs lhun grub brda sprod dbyangs can mdo/ /stobs bzang mched pos slar gyur spel rgyas mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 9 brda sprod kun gyi mchog gyur de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rje'i gsung / /dbyangs can mdo gzhung dgongs 'grel legs bshad mdo 'dir bzhugs kun gyi/ /bsdu ba dper gyur zhus chen 'jig rten mig gyur gcig pu ba/ /dge mdzad dpa' bo mi yi gzugs sprul mi pham chos rgyal zhes/ / 10 mngon par mtho dang nges legs du mas yongs brgyan rgyal tshab skur/ /sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i srog shing skyes mchog skye ba 'phreng ba ni/ /mtshar dngar rtag 'char ngur smrig gos 'chang khro bu paṇ+ḍi ta/ /ngag dbang bstan 'dzin dbang po gang gi zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 11 skye ba kun tu dam pas rjes gzung skye ba nyid kyi dang / /sbyangs snying stobs mchog gi mkhas pa'i zhal lung kun 'thung pas/ /dbyangs can cha bsags zla ba'i kun muta pa na'i brda sprod che/ /sdeb sbyor snyan ngag mngon brjod skar rtsis g.yul las rgyal ba sogs/ / 12 rig gnas rgya mtsho'i mthar son deng dus bsil ljongs ra ba 'dir/ /dpe zla bral ba'i mkhas mchog legs bshad smra dbang bslab gsum 'dzin/ /ma hā lo tsā ngag dbang blo bzang bkra shis rnam rgyal zhes/ /'jig rten mig gcig gang gi zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal lo/ / 13 rig pa'i gnas chen bzhi las saṃ skyi ta yi skad lha~X pa / /

ma rmongs don ston brda sprod kun gyis 'jug sgo mchog gyur ni/ /dbyangs can mdo don ma nor 'khrul med don mdzad mkhas gyur pa/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la rab dwangs gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ / 14de ltar brda sprod dbyangs can mdo ston rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul gsol btab dge tshogs byang chen rgyur bsngo zhing / /lha las phul byung yang dag sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas slad du/ /gzhan gyi sgol 'joms rig pa 'dir sbyangs lhag bsam bsod nams kyis/ / 15 bden 'bras nam yang bslu med mchog gi dus 'di nas/ /ji srid kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang mchog la 'khod kyi bar/ /skye zhing skye ba kun tu rigs bzang mtshan legs lus thob cing / /skye 'phral smra shes 'gro shes sngon gnas ma lus rjes dran shog / 16 kun tu bzang mo dbyangs can lha mo'i zhal lung brda sprod mdo/ /brda chad dbyangs dang rang bzhin gsal byed rnam bcad mtshams sbyor lnga/ /rnam dbye gnyis kyi thog ma pi sogs grags gyur nyi shu bzhi/ /rkyen byin pho mo ma nor rtags can dbyangs kyi mtha' las skyes/ / 17 de bzhin gsal byed ha sa'i mtha' can pho mo ma ning rtags gyur dang / /zur bkol rnam 'gyur mi zad sde rigs bud med rkyen 'jug dang / /dbye can zhes grags rgya che'i don la rnam dbye 'jug pa'i tshul/ /tshigs su de phan de kun tshegs med skad cig nyid rtogs shog / 18 rnam pa gnyis pa te sogs rnam grangs brgya dang brgyad bcu yis/ /'jug pas sgra yis rnam grangs mtha' klas ston dang de bzhin kṛta/ /byings ma'i sgrub sogs skad cig gi shes de bzhin gzhung lugs che/ /kun kyang thogs med bde blag nyid du khong chud byan chud pas/ / 19 sgra mdo dngos zin spyi mig shugs bstan don dang de las gzhan/ /'jig rten mkhas bshad nges tshig rig byed gsang tshig ste/ /bsgrub tshul rnam bzhi phul byung sbyor bzhi cho ga rnam lnga sogs/ /'jig rten grub kun gzhan dring mi 'jog rang byung nyid du kun shes shog / 20mdor na bdag ni tshe rabs tshe rgyud ji srid kun/ /ngag dbang lha mos dbang skur sgra snyan sdeb sbyor zlos gar rtsis/ /ma nor 'khrul med nor bu dri med lta bu'i shes bya'i gnas de kun/ /ming tsam rna ba'i bu gar thos de budha nyid gyur nas/ / 21 gzhan gol kun bcom rang lugs skyon med 'jog mkhas ngag gi dbang / /dbyangs can mgrin par rtag zhugs rnam spyod lang tshor su yi kyang / /sdo min mi brjed gzungs dang spobs pa mtha' klas grub pa'i mthu/ /rdo rje pha lam ji bzhin bdag blos gzhan dpyod kun bcom shog / 22 de ltar yi ni srid pa kun nas mtshungs med 'gro 'dren mchog /sangs rgyas bstan la bya ba rtag par ngal med 'chad rtsod rtsom/ /brtson pas rgyal ba'i bstan pa mnyam med gong 'phel phyogs mtha' grur/ /spel ba'i byed po bdag nyid rtag pa nyid du 'grub gyur gcig / 23 ces brda spro~X ༵ dbyangs can mdo gzhung mnasangag gi brgyud pa'i bla mar gsol ba btab pa dbyangs can dgyes pa'i snyan

glu zhes bya ba 'di ni deng dus gangs can bod yul gyi rig gnas pa mtha' dag gi gtsug gi nor bu gcig pu 'jig rten mig gcig ngag dbang bkra shis rnam rgyal zhabs kyi bka' drin la rten nas brda sprod gtsug lag dbyangs can mdo la cung zad sbyangs pa'i ming du/ ngag dbang dbyangs can grub pa'i rdo rje bzhed dang phyogs kun tu grags pa'i ming ma sbas pa'i rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho'am pad+ma theg mchog bstan pa'i gsal byed nges sang grub pa'i shing rta phyogs las rnam rgyal dbang po'i sde zhes pa rang nyid brda sprod kyi ming ston du chu stod zla ba'i tshes bcu gsum seng ge'i dus sbyor skabs su smras pa ste yi ge pa ni dam pa'i gdung rigs pad+ma kun dga' bkra shis rab brtan legs pa'i dpal des so/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /bkra shis/oṃ swāsti/ snyan ngag gi brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa rab tu dga' ba'i tasbu ra zhes bya ba bcom ldan 'das 'phags ma dbyangs can ma phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' khyab gsang gsum dpal 'bar dri med ye shes phung po can/ /'gro la bdud rtsi nyer rtsol mtshan dpe mchog tu gsal ba'i sku/ /srid zhi las 'das phun tshogs dpal rnams ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /tshogs gnyis rgyun stsol lhung bzed 'dzin gyur rgyal der phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /stobs dang mi 'jigs ma 'dres chos rnams yongs su rdzogs gyur cing / /'jigs pa med pa'i ngag ldan kun la phan bde 'ba' zhig sbyin/ /lhar bcas skye dgu'i tshogs zhing ngur smrig rgyal mtshan 'chang ba po/ /rang byung sangs rgyas thub dbang 'jig rten mgon der phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /mkha' ltar yangs pa'i spyan gyi mkha' mnyam 'gro la brtse bas gzigs/ /ston zla bye ba'i kha dog la khu mchog tu dkar ba'i sku/ /tshad gdung sel ba bsil zer ji bzhin khams gsum sdug bsngal gzhil/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas pa ji 'dra spyan ras gzigs der phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /'phags tshems g.yas 'khyil shar ri'i phrag nas nyer 'phos sgra dbyangs kyi/ /lha mo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rab mdzes dpe zla gzhan med pa/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs kun gcig tu bsdus pa'i rgyud mangs phyag na bsnams/ /shes rab phar phyin ngo bo dbyangs can lha mor phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /rgyu 'o srid gsum kun tu srog gyur rlung gi g.yo ba ste/ /yid bzhin nor bu mchog gi 'gro ba'i dbul phongs mtha' dag sel/ /khyod rab snyan pa'i grags dkar 'dzin ma'i khyon gang ngag dbul sel/ /snyan tshig nor bu'i dga' ston 'gyes mkhas paṇ+ḍir phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /bskor ba'i rgyan mi shes rmongs pa'i tshogs rnams gzhan du song nas shes rab 'phel/ /brjed nges yongs su spongs pas gzungs mchog ngag gi dbang phyug grub/ /so skye'i spyod pa las 'das rab mchog grub pa'i dbang por gyur/ /'jigs med slob dpon ngag dbang shī la kanyir phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /the tshom 'gog rgyan sdeb sbyor snyan legs maldas pa'i tshig ni 'apab stegs dkrol la'ang ci/ /bdag med don ston thar pa mchog la 'jug 'di gzhan gyi min/ /de phyir 'phags yul paṇa chen rarna'i mtshan dang phun tshogs lik+ṇi ka ra byed/ /sangs ༵sdu grub

mtha' 'dzin spel yongs su shes pas phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /gangs can bod du bltams yang 'phags yul rnam dpyod blo gros mthu/ /ma rmad rig gnas lnga phrag dag gi rgyud phyug phyogs 'di ru/ /brda sprod sdeb sbyor snyan tshig rgya cher spel mdzad lo tsā ba/ /rdo rje rgyal mtshan blo gros brtan pa mched la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /lag gis ma bkug dbang po'i gzhu ni dbyar gyi lang tsho ste/ /rma yis ma mtshon rig pa'i mda' yi gzhar rgol yongs 'bigs byed/ /gza' skar chu bkra rnam dpyod blo la rig pa'i gnas kun gsal/ /mang mkhar lo tsā mchog ldan legs pa'i blo der phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /mun ma'i tshogs gsal blang dor gnas rnams ji bzhin snang byed par/ /nyin mor byed dang dpang ston lo tsā blo gros brtan pa dag /tha dad yod min 'on kyang nyin byed bem po mkha' la rgyu/ /khyod ni shes ldan rig dbang nyid de de la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /'dzin khri dang bral zab pa'i chu gter byang chub rtse mo rgyas/ /mkhyen rab zla ba skye bri yongs spangs nam mkha' bzang po'i sde/ /rtse ma can spangs 'khor ba'i snang gsal thugs rje chen po dpal/ /grags pa'i rgyal mtshan rab sgreng bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /rig pa'i gnas kun khur blangs bslab gsum rgyan gyis cher slub yang / /ngal med bder spyod 'di ni sred med bu yi stobs rnyed dam/ /yid gnyis gnas gyur rgyal bstan 'dzin pa'i stobs ldan chos skyong bzang / /de sras rin chen bkra shis bcas la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /gangs can brda dang legs sbyar skad la bdag ni mkhas gyur zhes/ /lo chen rin bzang snyem mi 'tshal de kun dga' rgya mtshan yangs/ /phyi ma'i dus 'dir gshin rje rnam rgyal dag gi dbang po dag /brda sprod snyan tshig smra la zla med mkhas der phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /snyan pa'i rgyud mangs mtha' dag rgyud gcig gis zil mnon pa/ /snyan ngag glegs bam kun kyang snyan ngag glegs bam gcig gi 'gog /de lta'i ngang tshul 'di gang mi bdag ngag dbang 'jig med grags/ /de sras snyan ngag mkhan po zla bzang la yang phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /gzhan rgol 'joms pa spobs pa'i shes rab ral gri 'chang bar 'dzin/ /chos tshul mtha' dag gsal ba'i glegs bam shes rab gzugs kyis bzung / /de phyir 'jam dpal dpa' bo yang ni khyod du bdag blo 'khrul/ /ngag dbang sangs rgyas rdo rje mtshan 'chang de la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /dpal mchog bsdus pa rgyud dang de 'brel stong phrag bcu gnyis pa/ /mgrin par yongs brgyan 'phags pos dus zhabs dbye ba gang gi phyed/ /snyan ngag me long me long gsar bkod de tshe paṇ+ḍi pu/ /de 'dra dus zhabs pa dang bod mkhas pa la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sgrub brgyud bstan 'dzin gzhung lugs rgya mtsho smra la 'jigs med pa/ /ngag gi dbang po de ni pad+ma dkar po la yin te/ /bstan 'dzin dbang por yongs des snyigs dus thams cad de dang / /de dang mtshungs gyur bkra shis rnam par rgyal la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /dge'o/ /500

thugs rje chen po dpal mo lugs kyi sgrub thabs gso sbyong dang 'grel ba brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal gsol 'debs tshad med thugs rje rgyun 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo lo ke shwa ra ya/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bla na med/ /tshe dang ye shes dpag med rnams nges pa/ /gzi brjid rgyal po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes bya ma lus mkhyen pa'i bcom ldan 'das/ /'gro ba kun la bu gcig lta bur brtse/ /lhun grub rgyun mi chad pa'i 'phrin las can/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /iṇ+ḍa bho dhis lung bstan 'phags pa bsgrub/ /shing 'phel gnas su mchog gi dngos grub brnyes/ /mkhar sa paṇir cho 'phrul chen mo bstan/ /dpal ldan dpal mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi bzad sdug bsngal lam gyi grogs su shar/ /dad pa'i stobs kyi bla ma 'phags par gzigs/ /bsgrub la brtson pas mchog gi dngos grub brnyes/ /ye shes bzang po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ges lung bstan nas/ /thugs rje chen po sgrub pas dngos grub brnyes/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i bal po paṇ+ḍi ta/ /se nya pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshogs gnyis zung gi dkyil 'khor rab rdzogs shing / /sgrib gnyis g.yul las rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan can//thugs rje chen po dge slong tshul bstan pa'i/ /byang sems zla rgyal zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gus pas bla ma dam pa nyer bsten cing / /bsgrub la brtson pas dngos bsgrub mchog brnyes nas/ /'gro la brtse bas gzhan don lhur len pa'i/ /grub thob nyi phug pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dad dang tshul khrims thos dang gtong ba dang / /ngo tsha shes dang khrel yod shes rab ste/ /'phags pa'i nor bdun ldan pa 'gro ba'i mgon/ /rdo rje rgyal po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sbyin pas bsdus pa'i 'gro la phar phyin drug /snyan par smra nas de bzhin bsgrub 'jug cing / /bdag nyid phar phyin drug la rjes 'jug pa'i/ /zhang ston dgra 'jig zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mthun pa'i yul gnas skyes bu dam pa bstan/ /bdag gi legs smon sngon bsags bsod nams can/ /'khor lo bzhi dang ldan pa chos kyi rje/ /bde ba can pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyes ltung dri ma'i skyon gyis ma gos shing / /g.yel ba med par dge ba'i chos la brtson/ /rgyun chad med par 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /byang sems chu bzang pa la phyag 'tshal lo /dgos 'dod ma lus 'byung ba'i rin po che/ /gnas lugs ji bzhin rtogs pa'i shes rab can/ /yon tan 'bum phrag dpag tu med pa'i gter/ /chos rje shes rab 'bum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thog med dus nas byang chub thugs bskyed 'bras/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyang smon lam mthu'i gdul bya/ /'dren pa'i ded dpon rgyal sras sems pa'i tshul/ /thogs med bzang po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de sras gnod sems 'tshal tshul kun spanges pa/ /blo mdzod dam chos rin chen gyis khengs nas/ /gdul bya'i ༵sdul ba

sel mdzad sems dpa' che/ /chos kyi rin chen zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes don dam sems kyi nam mkha' la/ /bsod nams kun rdzob sems kyi rin chen sprin/ /gzhan phan bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag sems dpa' che/ /bsod nams rin chen zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'byams klas bsod nams klu dbang las byung ba'i/ /phun tshogs bsam 'phel rgyal mtshan 'od kyis rtogs/ /'gro ba'i re 'dod yongs stsol sems dpa' che/ /bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun tu rgyal bstan mang thos glegs bam dang / /rab dga' mkhyen pa'i ral gri zla med 'dzin/ /sems kyi mdud grol phyogs kyi spyod pa skyong / /'jam mgon grol mchog zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun gsal rnam dpyod gru gzings bzang po yis/ /sde snod rgya mtshor dga' bas rab 'jug nas/ /rim gnyis nor bu'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin mkhas pa/ /kun dga' rgyal ba'i mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal bas lung bstan kun mkhyen mchog dga'i gter/ /snying po'i gsal 'byed zla med shing rta che/ /grub pa bye bas phyag byas he ru ka /'jam mgon kun dga' snying por phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun nas mkhyen spyod ma smad che dga' bas/ /rje btsun ye shes sku chen thugs kyi bcud/ /ngom med bdud rtsi rgya mtshor rtag rol mdzad/ /skyes mchog ye shes rgya mtshor phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba gnyis pas rgyal tshab dbang bskur zhing / /shes rab rin chen gsum gyi smin gtong gi /skal ldan rgya mtsho'i tshogs kun tshim mdzad pa/ /rgyal tshab rin chen rgya mtshor phyag 'tshal lo/ /zab lam snying po'i bstan pa 'dzin mdzad mgon/ /blo gros rgya mtsho'i 'jing la dbang bsgyur zhing / /rnam kun rgyal ba'i sras gyur rnal 'byor gtso/ /snying po blo gros zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ngag gi dbang phyug kun nas dga' ba'i dpal/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor bsgrub pa'i 'phrin las rgyun/ /phyogs kun rgyal mdzod dpal ldan chang lung pa/ /ngag dbang 'phrin las dpal laphyag 'tshal lo/ /snyigs dus 'gro la kun tu bzang po nyid/ /rnal 'byor dbang po'i tshul du bskur bstan nas/ /snying po'i bstan pas sa gsum 'gengs mdzad pa/ /rje btsun kun bzang dbang por phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi sku gsung thugs/ /gcig bsdus gdul bya'i 'dren pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /bka' drin gsum ldan 'khor lo'i mgon po che/ /drin chen rtsa ba'i bla mar phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' khyab bla ma sangs rgyas sras bcas la /mkha' khams khengs par rdul snyed lus sprul zhing / /mkha' dbyings kun bzang mchod sprin gyis gtib bzhin/ /mkha' khyab 'gro kun don du phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho kun dngos spyan ras gzigs/ /de la bdag gi snying nas rab gus zhing / /mi phyed dad mos dang ba'i yid bzang pos/ /ngag nas bstod snyan brjod cing lus btud byas/ /sgo gsum dge ba'i rtsa ba bsakāsdu 2'di yi/ /bdag sogs sems can kun gyi thog med nas/ /bsags pa'i mi dge sdig sgrib kun

dag cing / /dge ba'i rtsa ba cung zad chis kun yang / /ma nyams 'grim med byang chub chen por 'bab /kun kyang rgyal ba'i lam bzang theg pa tshor/ /zhum med dga' ba'i sems kyi gzhol bar shog /bdag sogs tshe rabs tshe rgyud thams cad du/ /mtho ris yon tan bdun dang 'phags nor bdun/ /rnam par smin pa'i yon tan bzang po brgyad/ /mi 'brel 'khor lo rtag tu spyod par shog /gzhan rkyen ma ltos sems la rang rdol gyi/ /'gro la rtag tu snying rje'i rgyun 'dzag cing / /byams pas bu bzhin bltas nas gzhan phan spyod/ /de la ldem kyang ngal ba med par shog /khyad par dge mthu 'di yi tshe rabs kun/ /nges pa don gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mchog /mtshan ldan kun mjal thugs kyi brtse bas bzung / /de dgyes las la rtag tu spyod par shog /chos kyi gegs gyur khro 'khon 'dzin pa dam/ /nor la skam dang bag med le lo rnams/ /ring spangs dge ba'i bshes gyur rgyu tshogs kun/ /tshang la ma nyams rnam dag nyid ldan shog /spangs 'os rnam rtog spang zhing rgyun chad nus/ /'os rung dge sems kun 'chang brtan tshugs cing / /nyin mtshan 'khor yug dam chos thos bsam sgoms/ /dge las 'khor lo rgyun mi chad spyod shog /skye kun gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs der/ /nad nyung gdon zhi dug mtshon skal ba nyams/ /mu ge med par sman 'bru phyugs 'byor 'phel/ /'gro kun mdza' bshes dga' bde la spyod shog/khyad par bdag nyid mthong thos dran reg gis/ /'gro ba kun gyi sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras zad/ /dri med tshogs gsum la 'jug yon tan 'phel/ /kun nas kun bzang ji 'dra de thob shog /gnas skabs nub phyogs zhing khams bde ba can/ /me tog pad+ma'i dbus su brdzus skyes te/ /sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la chos nyan cing / /sangs rgyas ma lus mchod pas dgyes byed shog /mdor na 'od dpag med mgon spyan ras gzigs/ /gang gi byang chub bskyed spyod smon lam gang / /de 'dra ji bzhin bdag gi nyer 'grub cing / /de yi go 'phang myur tu thob par shog /de ltar phyag 'tshal rgyas pa dang / 'bring po ni bcu gcig zhal gyi mchog gi dkyus su bstan pa gnyis dang gal te de yang mdor bsdus par 'dod na 'di ltar bya ste/na mo lo ke shwa ra ya/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bla na med/ /tshe dang ye shes dpag med rnam nges pa/ /gzi brjid rgyal po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rjes mkha' ltar brdal ba'i spyan ras gzigs/ /shes rab ngo bo dge slong dpal mos zhabs/ /grub brnyes zla ba gzhan du ye shes zhabs/ /pe nya pa ste rgya bal paṇ+ḍi ta/ /spyan ras gzigs sprul zla ba rgyal ba'i mtshan/ /grub gyur nyi phug spu ston zhang dgra 'jig /mkhan chen rtse 'dul ba dang bde ba can/ /byang sems chu bzang chos rje shes rab 'bum/ /rgyal ba'i sras po thogs med bzang po'i zhabs/ /sems dpa' chos rin bsod nams rin po che/ /bsod nams rgyal mtshan sems kyi mdud 503

grol te/ /mchog gnyis thugs sras kun dga' rgyal ba'i mtshan/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dngos gyur kun dga' snying / /skyes mchog ye shes rin chen rgya mtsho ste/ /snying po blo gros ngag dbang 'phrin las dpal/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rje btsun kun bzang dbang / /mtshungs med rtsa brgyud bla mar phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag gi tshad med byams pa'i chu rgyun gyis/ /thog med nas rengs bdag blo'i tha rgod brlan/ /thugs rje'i gshol gyis yongs su rol byas te/ /byang chub mchog tu dga' ba'i sa bon bskrun/ /sdang sred yongs spangs btang snyoms rlung gise bskul/ /kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi smyu gu la/ /don dam byang chub sems kyi ston 'bras smin/ /byang chub mchog gi bdag po'i mdzod khengs nas/ /phun tshogs kun tu bzang po'i dga' ston gyis/ /mkha' mnyam gdul bya'i yid kyi dbul sel zhing / /mngon mtho'i dpal 'byor mthar thug nges legs 'bras/ /'jig rten dbang phyug go 'phang bkod par shog /ces spyan ras gzigs dpal mo lugs kyi sgrub thabs gso sbyong dang 'brel ba'i brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal rgyas pa'i chos rje shes rab 'bum yan rgyal ba'i sras po thogs med bzang po'i gsung dang / de 'phros su bla rgyud kha skong dang phyag 'tshal bsdus pa gong 'og gi smon lam dang bcas shākya'i dge bsnyen rig pa 'dzin pa rgyal khams pa tshe dbang nor bu'i rab byung bcu gsum pa'i dpal gdong chu bya nag zla'i tshes drug kun mkhyen dol po pa'i dus chen du bod yul stod mnga' ris mang yul ljongs la dwags rgyal po'i kha ṭī waṃ le'i gtsug lag khang 'phags pa bcu gcig zhal gyi sku brnyan lha btsun na ga ra dza'i thugs dam rten mchog bzhugs pa'i ngogs su bkod pa dge'o/ /'di'i brgyud par zla ba gzhon nu dang ye shes bzang po gnyis ka dpal mo'i zhabs la thug pa yin pas rgyal sras chos rdzong bas phyag 'tshal skabs ye shes bzang pos bkod cing / rgyal sras thogs med nas grol mchog bar brgyud pa'i rnam grangs gzhan yin yang / rje rdo ring bas sems pa bsod nams rgyalaspatshan dang / grol mchog zhabs la gsan pas/ sems dpa' chen po dang lhan du bgrang ba yin la/ gzhan yang 'di la brgyud pa'i rnams grangs kha shas yod pa yang shes par bya'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/phyag rgya chen po yang dag pa snying po'i don gyi gter mdzod kyi brgyud pa'i bla mar gsol 'debs byin rlabs myur 'dren zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /ma hā gu ru a dhiṣ+ṭha te na ma/ gdod nas nyid dag ye shes ngang nyid las/ /ma g.yos chos nyid dri bral gnas lugs gshis/ /gdangs rtsal ma 'gag sgyu 'phrul bde chen sku/ /dbang phyug brgyad ldan rigs drug rdo rje 'chang la/ /gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes phyag rgya che/ /bde chen gnyug ma'i ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /brjod bral blo 'das 'od gsal bla med mchog /de ring nyid nas rtogs byin gyis rlobs/ /rdo rje can nyid mi yi gzugs gyur ste/ /rim gsum gang zag blo ngo dang mthun phyir/ /phyogs dang sprul pa rang rgyud tshul ston mkhas/ /bde ba'i 'khor lo chen po te lo par/ /gsol ba 'debs so dz+ra la sogs shwa lo ka gres phyung / /bla med lam la ma'i bka' bzhin du/ /spyad ༵༵ skye ba gcig gi byang chub che/ /sbyor bar de nyid gdul bya la ston phyir/ /phyag rdor mi zol

dpal ldan na ro par/ /gsol ba 'debs so mo 'phags yul grub pa'i man ngag rtogs pa'i bcud/ /bsil ldan ljongs su 'dren nas bskal bzang kun/ /tshim phyir mkha' 'gro'i yab gcig dgyes pa che/ /skad gnyis smra ba'i tshul ston chos blo gros/ /gsol ba 'debs so mo 'jam dpal dpa' bo thos pa dga' ba'i bskur/ /bstan nas 'khor ba'i chos brgyas dmag dpung kun/ /dka' spyad brtson 'grus mtshon gyis mthar byas te/ /sgrub brgyud 'khor lo bsgyur ba mi la ras/ /gsol ba 'debs so lkortsibs skyes gser gyi bu chung 'gro 'dul grogs/ /snying po don gyis bstan pa rgyas phyir du/ /gsung gi rdo rje zhing 'dir snang gyur pa/ /dmyal med lha rjes dpal ldan sgam po par/ /gsol ba 'debs so mosman pa'i rgyal po skal bzang zhing 'di yi/ /'dren pa thog ma 'khor ba 'jig gyur kyang / /thub bstan snyigs dus 'gro la brtse ba yi/ /sprul pa'i bskur byon phag gru rdor rgyal la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dz+raphyag na pad+mo'i lung bstan bde gshegs mjal/ /byin rlabs cher zhugs cig char bsgom med rtogs/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas mda' snun yongs skyong ba'i/ /mchog snyes gling ras pad+ma rdo rje la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dz+ra bla ma'i thugs bcud lhag med ngom par blangs/ /bden don mngon gyur rten 'brel thams cad mkhyen/ /ro mnyam nam mkha'i rnal 'byor he ru ka /gtsang pa rgyal ras ye shes rdo rje la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dz+ra glu mkhan legs bshad rkyen gyi sngon las 'phro/ /pad ma'i tshul bcas mgon rten chos sku rtogs/ /skye ba gcig gi rgyal ba pad+ma'i spyan/ /zhal bzhes rgod tshang mgon po rdo rje la/ /gsol ba dz+ra skye ma thag nas dam pa'i rnam thar 'dzin/ /skye mthar mchog gi mdzad pa ji bzhin skyong / /phyi nang gzhan gsum thams cad mkhyen pa'i dpal/ /yang dgon mi bskyod thugs kyi rdo rje la/ /gsol ba mo mchog gi sprul sku gtsug gi nor bu ru/ /'brel med brten nas thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdzod/ /yongs 'joms don nyid 'bras bu mthar phyin pa'i/ /spyan snga rin chen dpal dang ldan pa la/ /gsol ba mo mkhas shing grub gyur bla ma zung brten nas/ /thugs kyi sras gyur zab dgu'i man ngag rdzogs/ /grub pa mchog brnyes bsgrub pa'i sde chen btsugs/ /shrī zur phug rin chen dpal bzang la/ /gsol ba mo gzhon nu nyid nas bskyed rdzogs drod tshad thob/ /dam pa mang brten smin grol rgya mtsho nod/ /don nyid lhun grub rdo rje 'chang chen po/ /'ba' ra skyes mchog rgyal mtshan dpal bzang la/ /gsol ba mo byin rlabs rtogs pa'i bka' bab legs thob nas/ /don brgyud chu bo gnyis med 'dzin pa'i bdag /bskal bzang skyes bu dga' ba'i rnal 'byor mchog /sgrol ma bsam lding nam mkha' seng ge la/ /gsol ba 〉 bslab pa rnam dag byang chub sems dpa' che/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i mdzod 'dzin 'chang thub kyi/ /mchog gyur grub pa'i bdag nyid dam pa rje/ /kun nas dga' ba chos spya 0spyal po

la/ /gsol ba dz+ra sngon las 'phro sad chos kun sgyu ma'i mar gzigs/ /dbu ma'i mdud grol rtsa rlung rang dbang thob/ /'od gsal gnyis 'dres 'brel tshad smin grol sbyor/ /mon rdzong ra sa zla ba rgyal mtshan la/ /gsol ba mo dus kun dben pa'i gnas las mi 'da' zhing / /bsgrub pa'i go cha dka' spyod mthar phyin te/ /nyams dang rtogs pa klong gyur grub thob che/ /mnga' ris ras chen nam mkha' rdo rje la//gsol ba tsho mang du thos zhing bsam pa'i mthu chen thob/ /mchog brnyes bla mar bsnyen nas mnyes byas shing / /gnas lugs bsgom pas lta ba mngon du gyur/ /rab 'byams chen po lhun grub dpal 'byor la/ /gsol ba 〉 mkhas grub bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la btud/ /bsnyen bsgrub mthar phyin yi dam zhal dngos gzigs/ /thabs lam las rung mnyam nyid phyag chen rtogs/ /'dzam gling mkhas grub sangs rgyas chos 'phel la/ /gsol ba 〉 snyigs dus 'dul dka' 'gro la brtse ba yi/ /smin grol bstan pa'i sgron me sbar ba'i phyir/ /sprul pa'i skur byon 'ba' ra gsum pa rje/ /bya btang chen po karma gsal byed la/ /gsol ba mo mi chos zang zing mi gtsang rtswa ltar spangs/ /sbas yul dben rten tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam/ /'khrul zhig bde chen gnyug ma'i rnal 'byor pa/ /skyid grong ras pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan la/ /gsol ba mo bsam bzhin gdul bya'i don du 'jug pa yi/ /skye bzhed shis bzhin don bsgoms bstan pa mchog /gso mdzad 'ba' ra bzhi pa sprul pa'i sku/ /rje btsun rin chen brten pa'i gsal byed la/ /gsol ba mo dam pa mang brtan thugs bcud bum bzang bltams/ /sbas pa'i tshul la bsgrub pa'i sde chen 'dzin/ /gnas lugs bden pa phyag chen ngo bo mthong / /'dzam gling rin chen blo gros chos 'phel la/ /gsol ba mo dpe mtshon tshig gi brda sbyor ston mdzad cing / /don dam dpe mtshon tshig yul las 'das don/ /byin rlabs 'pho ba thugs nas thugs brgyud pa'i/ /ye shes lnga bdag rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 〉 de ltar chos sku ye shes ngo bo'i gshis/ /'gro kun snying la sar rang ngo rang / /ston byed rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba yi/ /bla ma'i bar byon don gyi shing rta che/ /gsol ba 〉 rten dang brten pa snod bcud dkyil 'khor nas/ /'byung dang phung khams lhan skyes rgyal ba'i dngos/ /dag pa rab 'byams cir snang bde chen 'phrul/ /rgyud sde bzhi rim yi dam lha tshogs la/ /gsol ba mo phyi nang gsang ba'i gnas yul dur khrod nas/ /sku gsum ḍā ki sa gsum dbang bsgyur ma/ /skad cig thogs med 'phrin las sgrub pa'i dpal/ /ye shes 'jig rten las kyi tshogs rnams la/ /gsol ba 〉 bde bar gshegs kyang 'gro la sman pa'i slad/ /rgyal ba'i dka' dang de 'dzin gsungs pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje skur ston dam can rgya mtsho che/ /chos mdzad bu ltar skyong ba'i tshogs rnams la/ /gsol ba mo 'di ltar snying nas gus pa'i gsoswā ༵debs kyis/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs rje rab g.yos te/ /bdag rgyud thog med nas goms

'khrul mun ste/ /de rigs byin rlabs sgron mes gsal byas nas/ /mi rtag 'chi ba snying nas dran pa dang / /chos brgyad zhen log 'jig rten 'khri ba chod/ /rgyu 'bras nges shes spang blang gnas la mkhas/ /tshe 'di blo yis mthong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bla mar mos gus chug med snying la gzer/ /dad pa 'gyur ldog med par rtag tu brten/ /ci mdzad legs par mthong ba'i dag snang 'byongs/ /ci gsung 'da' med bdag gi gnyen gyur shog /bla ma'i byin rlabs snying la zhugs gyur te/ /gnas lugs gnyug ma dag la phyag rgya che/ /mngon sum rtogs nas sa lam gegs med par/ /tshe gcig nyid la rdo rje 'chang byin rlobs/ /thabs lam chos drug gnad du tshud nas kyang / /bde chen sprul longs chos sku lhun grub don/ /zung 'jug mngon gyur 'gro kun 'dren gyur pa'i/ /ded dpon dam par bdag nyid gyur bar shog /ces phyag rgya chen don khrid skye mchog yang mgon pa'i bka' brgyud 'ba' ra rgyal mtshan dpal gyis mdzad pa'i khrid yid chen mo yang dag pa snying po don gyi gter mdzod kyi khrid lung legs par thog pa'i tshe brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs su mdo khams kaḥthog pa 'od gsal lha rigs rngu yi btsun gzugs rnal 'byor tshe dbang nor bu karma rin chen mchog tu dga' ba dge ba'i dpal gyis me lug nag pa zla ba'i dmar phyogs gang ba thub pa'i dus bzang por bal bod kyi mtshams mang yul kyi grong grwa 'jam dpal gling du a lo ke'i mdang la grub par sbyar ba'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /phyag chen lhan skyes gsol 'debs byin rlabs myur stsol zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ ā r+ghaṃ: yan lag bdun ldan rigs drug rdo rje 'chang / /lhan skyes ye shes rdo rje btsun mo che/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug blo gros rin po che/ /gcig 'char rigs grol bram ze sa ra ha/ /gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes mnyam sbyor che/ /chos nyid phyag rgya myur du rtogs gyur nas/ /nyams len mthar phyin blta ba'i gdeng tshad skyol/ /'bras bu myur du thob par byin rlabs stsal/ /chos sgo brgyad khri mchog brnyes klu sgrub snying / /'od gzugs grub pa'i rgyal po sha ba ri/ /byang chub sems mchog mnga' bdag me tri pa/ /gnyis smra'i ngang tshul dgyes rdor chos blo gros/ /gsol ba 'debs so mo sogs sho lo ka 'dres snang / gsang ba 'dus dngos mkha' spyod mi la rje/ /gsung gi rdo rje dpal ldan sgom po pa/ /'khor ba 'jigs byed phag gru rdo rje rgyal/ /chos kyi khyu mchog smar tshang shes ye'i zhabs/ /gsol ba 〉 grub pa'i dbang po sha yangs ye shes rgyal/ /yang dag brtson ldan spyan snga byang chub grags/ /rtogs mchog dbu rtse bsod nams ye shes pa/ /snying po'i bcud len dpal ldan rin chen gling / /gsol ba dz+ra 'jig rten dbang phyug spangs mkhan 'od zer zhabs/ /'khrul grol shing mgo dkon mchog rgyal ba'i mtshan/ /zhig po ru dbon chos kyi rdo rje ba/ /bstan pa'i zla shar dzha na ke ru che/ /gsol ba 〉 lung rtogs gnyis spel byang sems rgyal sing pa/ /grub pa'i mtshan rat+na tra ya ke ru che/ /grub pa mchog thog rong pa tra badz+ra/ /bshad sgrub bstan spel shākya rgyal ba'i mtshan/ /gsol ba 'debs so tsho lta ba klong gyur bho dhi sidha pa/ /mtshu~Xshā med

mchog sprul bkra shis rgya mtsho che/ /tshe gcig grub bsnyes bstan pa seṅge ba/ /gnas lugs mthar phyin chos nyid rgyal mtsho'i zhabs/ /gsol ba ste/ rtogs ldan rgyal po shes rab rgya mtsho dpal/ /snang sems mngon 'dres ye shes rgyal ba'i mtshan/ /rig 'dzin mchog gtso pad+ma bde chen gling / /gdam ngag rjen bshad rtsa ba rgyud pa la/ /gsol ba 〉 de ltar byin rlabs rtogs pa kho na nyid/ /snying po'i don rten gdams brgyud bla ma la/ /rtse gcig dren mchog rtag tu gus pa ches/ /snying nas gsol ba btab pa'i bden nus 'bras/ /gzhi yi gnas lugs lta ba phyag rgya che/ /yod med mtha' bsam blo 'das yid byed zad/ /shing gdong rtsal phro lhun grub spros bral che/ /snang srid chos nyid rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /lam gyi nyams len bsgom pa phyag rgya che/ /bzhi gnas brten skyes lhag mthong mngon du gyur/ /rnal 'byor bzhi yi nyams len mtha' ru phyin/ /chos zad blo 'das rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /'bras bu ma/ngon gyur sku gnyis phyag rgya che/ /stong nyid rang gzugs rang don chos skur thim/ /snying rje'i rang gzugs gzhan don gzugs skur 'char/ /mkhyen gnyis yan lag bdun 'grub byin gyis rlobs/ /ces phyag rgya chen po lhan gcig skyes sbyor gyi brgyud pa smar tshang ba las 'byung ba'i bde chen gling pa las thob pa'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs myur stsol zhes bya ba rnal 'byor pa tshe dbang nor bu dpal gyi rgya mtshos lcags byi zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes nyin la tir ri ljon pa'i ra bar bris pa dge legs 'phel/ /dge'o/ /thugs rje chen po'i brgyud 'debs byin rlabs gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ ā: hūṃ/khyab brdal chos nyid mgon po 'od dpag med/ /thugs rje'i dbang phyug 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus mtsho skyes pad+ma 'byung / /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /rgyal ba bskyed yum dbang mo mtsho rgyal ma/ /gangs can gter ston rgyal po chos dbang phyug /thugs chen bka' bab ma ṇi rin po che/ /gsol ba ྾ 'gro 'dul chos rje ke ru sing ha pa/ /chos nyid don rtogs mthar phyin thugs rje dpal/ /rim gnyis dngos grub mchog brnyes tshul khrims 'bum/ /gsol ba lkospang rtogs rtsal rdzogs dharmā pakhri zhabs/ /bstan pa'i sgron me grub mchog ye shes rgyal/ /'khrul zhig rang grol phyogs med byang chub sems/ /gsol ba mo shes rab gsum rgyas ye shes klong du gyur/ /chos nyid mnga' brnyes bstan 'dzin dbang po rje/ /pad+ma 'phrin las mnga' bdag gu ru dpal/ /gsol ba mosmin grol rtsa lag pad+ma rgyal ba'i mtshan/ /mkhas grub khyu mchog pad+ma blo gros che/ /zab gsang 'gyed mkhas rig 'dzin rnam par rgyal/ /gsol ba dz+ra kun bzang go 'phang mngon gyur khyab brdal lhun/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang pad+ma bde chen gling / /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs/ /gsol ba ྾dngos grub myur gter yi dam zhi dang khro/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ston mkha' 'gro ma/ /bar chad sel sdu~Xd chos skyongs srungs ma/ /gsol ba tsho gter gnas dhe wi ko ṭa'i phug rigs nas/ /sa 'og

gter gcig thug chen yongs snying 'dus/ /mthong thos smin cing grol ba'i dam chos la/ /gsol 'debs tshig khong don chud byin gyis rlobs/ /de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /'phral rkyen kun sel gtan bde'i bzhi ma thing / /stong nyid snying rje rab rgyas 'bras bu smin/ /sku gnyis lhun grub 'khor ba dong sprug shog /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me rdu trī: zhes pa rang gi slob ma dad mos dang nan pa rab 'byams pas yang yang skul ba'i ngor khro lo zhes shing 'brug gi lo stag gi zla ba'i tshes bcu gcig nyin tshe dbang nor bu pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug tsam gyi ting ri ljon pa yid bzhin dbang gi ra bar sbyar ba'i yig rigs bskul ba po nyid do/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dpal mchog dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi man ngag zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs bka' brgyud bla mar gsol ba 'debs pa rgyud 'dzin mchog rgyal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ ā: r+ghaṃ ho/mchog rgyas dang po'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang / /yan lag bdun ldan bcom ldan dus 'khor lo/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje bdag blo zungs/ /rgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar mtshungs byin rlobs/ /e waṃ rdo rje 'chang chen shākya thub/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa gsang bdag zla ba bzang / /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje bdag blo zungs/ /rgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar mtshungs byin rlobs/ /sa bcu'i sems dpa' che dang mkha' 'gro'i gtso/ /rnam sprul chos rgyal rigs ldan sum cu lngar/ /gsol ba 'debs so 〉 rgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar mtshungs byin rlobs/ /grub pa yongs gtso dus zhabs 'jam rdo rje/ /mkhas grub dus 'khor bo dhi sa yab sras/ /gsol ba 'debs so 〉 rgyud pa 'dzin no dz+ra mkhas shing mchog gzigs paṇa chen zla ba mgon/ /'jig rten mi 'gyur 'bro lo shes rab grags/ /gsol ba ( rgyud pa 'dzin dz+ra rdzogs sbyor lam gyis grub brnyes dkon mchog gsum/ /mkha' 'gros chos gyur dpa' bo gnam la brtsegs/ /gsol ba mo rgyud pa 'dzin no dz+ra 'dul 'dzin ye shes ches brnyes dad pa'i rgyal/ /'jam dpal gzhon nu'i rnam 'phrul chos dbang phyug /gsol ba tsho rgyud pa 'dzin no mo lhag lhas rjes bzung mkhas pa nam mkha' 'od/ /mkha' spyod yongs gtso 'ja' lus jo 'bum la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dz+ra rgyud pa 'dzin no lko sa bcu'i dbang phyug nam mkha' rgyal mtshan pa/ /'jam dpal dpa' bos rjes bzung shes rab 'od/ /gsol ba 'debs so mo rgyud pa 'dzin no dz+ra sangs rgyas rab gsal ngo bo chos 'od zer/ /rigs ldan rnam 'phrul kun spangs zhang brtson 'grus/ /gsol ba 'debs so mo rgyud pa 'dzin no mo byang sems chen po rgyal ba ye shes dpal/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i mthar thug yon tan mtsho/ /gsol ba mo rgyud pa 'dzin no dz+ra pad dkar 'chang dngos kun mkhyen dol po pa/ /de bstan 'dzin mkhas phyogs las rnam rgyal zhabs/ /gsol ba dz+ra rgyud pa 'dzin no mo smra ba'i seṅge nya dbon kun dga' dpal/ /'khrul zhig rnal 'byor grub chen kun blo 5spyasdu/ /

gsol ba mo rgyud pa 'dzin no 〉 lung rtogs bstan pa yongs rdzogs dkon mchog bzang / /nges don gsal sgron nam mkha' chos skyong mtshan/ /gsol ba dz+ra rgyud pa 'dzin no dz+ra gnas lnga rig pa nam mkha' dpal bzang po/ /'phags pa'i rnam sprul yongs grags rin chen bzang / /gsol ba ྾rgyud pa 'dzin no mo 'jam mgon grub pa spyod 'chang grol mchog zhabs/ /'dul 'dzin mkhas grub lung rigs rgya mtsho'i sde/ /gsol ba tsho rgyud pa 'dzin no mo 'jigs med shing rta kun rnying rdo rje 'chang / /rgyal tshab gnas brtan rin chen rgya mtsho che/ /gsol ba dz+ra rgyud pa 'dzin no mo zab lam bstan pa'i srog 'dzin blo gros rgyal/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ngag dbang 'phrin las dpal/ /gsol ba dz+rargyud pa 'dzin no ྾ sbas pa'i sangs rgyas chos rje kun bzang dbang / /rgyal sras rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'i sde/ /gsol ba mo rgyud pa 'dzin no mo gdul bya thar lam mchog gyur phyag rgya che/ /ston mdzad mtshungs med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba ྾ rgyud pa 'dzin dz+ra rgyud sde'i mthu drug yi dam yongs kyi gtso/ /dus kyi 'khor lo bcom ldan rdo rje sems/ /gsol ba 〉 rgyud pa 'dzin no 〉rgyud kyi bdag mo rnal 'byor ma rigs brgya/ /bar chad sel mdzad srung ma drug cu la/ /gsol ba morgyud pa 'dzin no mo de ltar zab lam rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi/ /rgyud pa yid bzhin nor bur gsol btab mthus/ /gang gi thugs rje bdag blo dad pa dang / /nges 'byung lhag bsam rnam dag sdom gsum brtan/ /byin rlabs zhugs mthus gzhan stong lta ba'i gnad/ /ci bzhin blor chud rdo rje rnal 'byor lam/ /sgom pas tshe gcig nyid la dbang bzhi'i don/ /ma nor rdor sems 'bras bu thob byin rlobs/ /ces rgyud rgyal dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor pa yan lag drug byin rlabs rgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di yang rgyal khams pa tshe dbang nor bus lho phyogs kyi sham bha la jo nang dpal gyi ri khrod du shing stag nag zla'i tshes nyer gsum ma chos 'chad pa'i thun skabs gcig tu brjod pa'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /thugs rje chen po dmar khrid tshem bu lugs kyi rgyud sde bde chen lcags kyu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ/ phyogs dus sangs rgyas kun gyi bskyed mdzad snying rje yis/ /spyan rab rtag gzigs de dang lhan skyes shes rab kyi/ /pha rol phyin ma don dam 'od gsal rgyal ba kun/ /yum gyur bcom ldan 'das ma de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dri med 'od gsal rang shar rdo rje rnal 'byor mas/ /rjes bzung yang dag don la g.yo med tshem bu pa/ /bde chen mchog brnyes spyi bo lha lagabyang chub 'od/ /'khrul snang bcom mkhas byang chub tshul khrims zhes la 'dud/ /chos nyid ngo bo rab gzigs bsod nams snying po'i mtshan/ /mtha' yas zhing sbyong rgyal sras thugs rjes brtson 'grub zhabs/ /byang sems gnyid mnyes rgyal kun thugs gsang ye shes 'chang / /bslab gsum rtser son yon tan rgya mtsho'i sde la 'dud/ /lag na pad+mo mngon gsuswā ༵gro ngor dol po pa/ /nges don bstan pa'i mnga' bdag nya dbon kun dga' dpal/ /snying po smra

ba'i seṅge nyag phu bsod nams bzang / /yongs 'dzin chen po 'jam dpal bzang po'i zhabs la 'dud//skye kun brtan pa'i gsal byed gnyan pa bkra shis dpal/ /mkhas gyur khyu mchog mi bskyod mthon mthing cod paṇa can/ /rgyal ba 'od mtshan rnam sprul gar dbang lnga pa'i zhabs/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang la 'dud/ /chos rnams ma lus mkhyen gzigs thugs mnga' chos dbang phyug /sa
