bcu'i dbang phyug skye ba bcu pa chos dbyings mtshan/ /bsam bzhin 'gro don skur bzhengs mi shes snying po dpal/ /kun tu sa la g.yo med ye shes rdo rjer 'dud/ /o rgyan mtsho skyes rgyal de gangs ri'i khrod 'di ru/ /'gro 'dren bla mar skur bstan dpal chen chos don grub/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kun 'phrin las chig bsdus bdag gi ched/ /rmad byung mchog sprul byang chub mchog gi rdo rjer 'dud/ /yon tan bkod pa'i zhing na mgon mchog tshe dpag med/ /gyur kyang 'gro la brtse chen gyis bzhugs sprul pa'i sku/ /rgyal sras tshul bzung mngal spang gnyis pa chos kyi rje/ /tre'o byang chub chos kyi dbang por gus pas 'dud/ /skye ba du mar byang chub spyad chos dag pa yi/ /smon lam stobs ldan rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu dpal/ /rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob mkhas zhing grub gyur skyes bu mchog /'brel tshad don ldan rtsa ba'i bla mar phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtha' yas 'gro rnams 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho sgrol byed pa/ /thar lam gru 'dzin dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /dbyer med yi dam rgya mtsho'i rang bzhin dpal/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang yid bzhin nor bu pad+ma mchog /ma mo mkha' 'gro ma tshogs bstan bsrung rgya mtshor bcas/ /dkon mchog rin chen rtsa gsum lha tshogs khyed rnams la/ /mi phyed rtse gcig snying khong gting nas gsol 'debs kyi/ /bdag sogs khams gsum 'gro rnams sdug bsngal myur grol zhing / /'di gzung rdzogs sangs rgyas 'bras nam bsnyes tshe rabs kun/ /gar skye rang dbang thob nas byang chub spyod la bslab/ /mtho ris 'phags nor yon tan yongs tshang phyin drug rdzogs/ /'phags mchog pad dkar 'chang dang mtshams bu chig 'grub shog /de yang bdag ni bzod thob bar du khams gsum gnas/ /yongs spangs bde chen zhing du skye nas byang chub spyod/ /theg chen sa lam yon tan ma lus sngags lam gyis/ /tshe gcig la bgrod dbang phyug brgyad ldan rdo rje sems/ /yid bzhin nor bu bde ba mchog gi gnas dam par/ /rtag tu rgyal ba'i go 'phang myur ba nyid thob pa/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs bskyed smon lam mthu chen pos/ /bdag gi lhag bsam smon lam 'di 'grub byin gyis rlobs/ /de ltar thugs rje chen po tshem bu nas lugs yi dam spyi'i dmar khrid du byung ba de'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'di ni pha chos kyi rgyal po tre+e bo chos kyi dbang pos zhabs bskul spyi bos btud pa'i mdo khams kyi sngags 'chang rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'am/ karma rin chen mchog dga' dge ba'i dpal gyi lcags pho khyi'i lo zhal gsar du ngom pa chu 'phrul zla ba'i tshes bzang po nyi shur/ gangs can ri brgyud pañtsa li'i mdun pa 'dus zhes bod yul gyi mthar thug nas rgya gar yul gyi cha zur chags skad smra ba~X sdu der

don gnyer can 'ga'i bskul ngor smras pa'o/ /maṅga lo/las 'phro'i gter ma thugs rje chen po don gsal sgron me'i rgyud 'debs/ oṃ ā: rgyu trī/ khyab brdal mkha' mnyam chos dbyings zhing khams su/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyal kun spyi dpal che/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang kun bzang yab yum la/ /bdag gi gsol 'debs dngos grub mchog kun stsol/ /ye shes lnga ldan 'od lnga'i zhing khams su/ /ye shes rtsal rdzogs bde ba chen po'i sku/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang rigs lnga yab yum la/ /bdag gi gsol 'debs mo gdul bya rgyas pa snang ba tshogs zhing du/ /rgyud pa gdong sprug khams gsum 'gro ba'i mgon/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang thub pa rigs drug la/ /bdag gi gsol 'debs dz+ra rgyal ba'i 'phrin las rgyun chad med zhing du/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis thugs rjes 'dus pa'i spyi/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang pad+ma 'byung gnas la/ /bdag gi gsol dz+rathabs shes zung 'jug chos kyi zhing khams su/ /rdo rje chos dang dbyer med lha mo'i tshul/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang ye shes mtsho rgyal la/ /bdag gi gsol 'debs tsho smon lam rnam par dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi zab gter rgya bkrol nas/ /skal ldan 'gro 'dul las 'phro gling pa la/ /bdag gi gsol 'debs dz+ra gter chos zhing du gter spyod rig 'dzin gdung / /'od gsal rgya mtsho lung rigs rgya mtsho'i sde/ /bstan 'dzin dbang bsgyur o rgyan 'phrin las la/ /bdag gi gsol 'debs ( pad+mas lung bstan gdung rabs lnga rdzogs mtha'/ /dam chos tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi gzhan phan can/ /rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang pad+ma tshangs dbyangs la/ /bdag gi gsol 'debs 〉 thugs rje chen po'i zab chos zhing khams su/ /don gsal sgron me smin grol khrid kyi rgyun/ /byi bzhin bzhugs gyur tshe dbang nor bu la/ /bdag gi gsol 'debs dngos grub mchog kun stsol/ /spyi gtsug bde chen 'khor lo'i zhing khams su/ /thugs rje chen po'i dbang khrid man ngag mdzod/ /nyer mdzad 'dren mchog rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /bdag gi gsol 'debs mo de ltar 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug /thugs rje chen po'i don gsal sgron me yi/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams la gsol btab mthus/ /sngon 'gro nges 'byung bsam pas brgyud khol zhing / /tshogs bsags sgrib sbyangs lam la ngal med brtson/ /bla ma'i mos gus snying gi dkyil du thebs/ /dbang bzhi'i bdag brgyud ma lus yongs su smin/ /grol byed bskyed pas ma dag dngos snang kheg /sngags kyi nus pas rlung gi 'pho ba dag /ye shes 'khor bcas mi 'gyur bde ba che/ /zab gsal dbyer med gdod nas dag pa'i khams/ /bde gshegs snying po glo bur dri ma'i tshogs/ /yongs spangs rdo rje bzhi'i rang bzhin nyid/ /rgyal shā 1༵zi brjid 'od dpag med mgon che/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang ci 'dra de bzhin du/ /pha ma'i

rang gzhan nam mkha' mthar thug pa'i/ /sems can kun gyis myur ba nyid thob nas/ /kun nas kun tu bzang po'i dkyil 'khor nyid/ /rgyas shing rab tu rgyas pa nyid gyur shog /zab lam ne gu chos drug gi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs sprin phung bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru/ gnas spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /gsol ba 'debs so bla ma rin po che/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag brgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /gnas 'og min chos dbyings pho brang du/ /chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen la dz+ra gnas seng ldeng 'khrig pa'i nags khrod du/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro ne gu la mo nub bde ba can gyi zhing khams su/ /mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor la dz+ra shar mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams su/ /rmog cog pa rin chen bcu bdun la dz+rashar 'od 'phro can gyi zhing khams su/ /dbon ston skyer sgang pa chen po la 〉 shar me tog bkram pa'i zhing khams su/ /gnyen ston sbas pa'i sangs rgyas la dz+ra gnas dag pa shar phyogs kyi zhing khams su/ /'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa la 〉 chos rje ston pa'i zhabs drung du/ /mkhas grub gtsang ma shangs ston la/ /nub pad+mo can gyis zhing khams su/ /khyung po tshul khrims mgon po ྾ steng dga' ldan lha'i bzhugs gnas su/ /bya bral ri khrod ras chen la mo byang sham+bha la yi pho brang du/ /shang dkar ba rin chen rgyal mtshan la mo lha mi 'khrug mgon po'i zhing khams su/ /mnyam med sangs rgyas dpal bzang la dz+ra rje bla ma gong ma'i dag zhing du/ /grub chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la mo zhing me tog pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru la/ /rgya sgom legs pa rgyal mtshan la ste/ gnas phyogs med yangs pa'i rgyal khams su/ /grol mchog sems kyi mdud grol la tsho gnas brag stod chos sku'i pho brang du/ /chos sku lha dbang grags pa la ( gnas sman pa'i rgyal po'i zhing khams su/ /rje btsun tā ra tā tha la dz+ra gnas pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang nas/ /rje btsun ye shes rgya mtsho la dz+ra gnas dag pa sprul sku'i zhing khams nas/ /byams pa yon tan mgon po la mo gnas 'od gsal mkha' spyod zhing khams nas/ /'ja' lus mgon po dpal 'byor la dz+ra gnas mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams nas/ /grub mchog mgon po grags pa la moganas bdud rtsi rgyun gyi yongs rdzogs nas/ /khyab bdag mgon po rnam rgyal la dz+ra gnas 'od yug phyi go dza ra nas/ /rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu la 〉 sems dag pa'i 'du sa nges med du/ /mched lcam rdo rje spun grogs la mo gnas rang lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /yi dam rgyud sde'i lha tshogs la moganas bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod du/ /myur mdzad ye shes mgon po la mo yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas mchog tu/ /chos bdag dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la gsol ba 'debs/ /gsol ba dz+ra mo dz+raphyag chen lhan skyes gsol 'debs nyung ngu bsdus pa bzhugs/ oṃ ma hā mu dra ye/ rdo ༵ zlochang

dbang te lo nā ro pa/ /mar pa mi la dwags po rin po che/ /phag gru gling ras 'gro mgon rgyal ras zhabs//gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol/ /rgyal ba rgod tshang lha gdong spyan snga pa/ /zur phu pa dang skyes mchog 'ba' ra ba/ /stag mtshang ras chen brtson 'grus dar po drung chen kun dga' chu bo ri pa rnam rgyal zhabs/ /gsol ba mo rtogs pa'i gar mkhan dbus smyon kun dga' bzang / /rnam grol bzang po bsod nams blo gros pa/ /chos skyabs chos skyong karma rdo rje la/ /gsol ba 〉 bka' drin gsum ldan o rgyan rgyal mtshan dpal/ /phyag chen lhan skyes brgyud pa'i bla ma lha/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro srung mar bcas pa la/ /gsol ba tsho byin rlabs rgyud pa bla ma'i ye shes mthus/ /bdag rgyud de ring nyid du smin cing grol/ /phyag ces gnyis med ye shes ngo bo la/ /rgya zhes 'khor ba'i mdud pa kun grol ba/ /chen po zung 'jug 'od gsal mngon gyur pa'i/ /'bras bu skad cig ma 'dir thob byin rlobs/ /ces phyag rgya chen po rgyud pa'i bye brag 'di yang 7tshe dbang nor bus lcags khyi rgyal zla'i tshes bzang bco lngar smras pa'i yig rigs sprul pa'i sku 'phrin las bstan 'dzin no/ /phyag rgya chen po yi ge bzhi pa'i don khrid brgyud pa'i bla mar gsol 'debs bsdus pa rin chen 'phreng ba bzhugs so/ /na mo ma ha mu tra shrī he ru ka /gnyis med chos sku yongs zlum rdo rje 'chang / /gsang gsum dbang bsgyur rgyal sras rdo rje snying / /gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes rang ngo shes/ /sku gsum 'bras bu brnyes par byin gyis rlobs/ /rdo rje'i sku brnyes sprul sku te lo pa/ /tshangs rigs mkhas mchog grub chen na ro pa/ /gsol ba 'debs so 〉 'dres 'o sku gsum 'bras su mo gnyis smra rgyud sde'i dbang phyug chos blo gros/ /zad pa'i zil gnon mchog grub bzhad rdo rje/ /gsol ba 'debs so dz+rasku gsum 〉 ting 'dzin khrag khrig dbang thob mtsho mdzad zhabs/ /'khor ba 'jig mdzad dpa' bo phag gru pa/ /gsol ba 'debs so 〉 sku gsum dz+ra 'khrul zhig rnal 'byor sger bsgom zhig po che/ /'od gsal mngon gyur gser lding ku ma ra/ /gsol ba 'debs so dz+ra sku gsum mo mchog gi dngos grub yongs brnyes chos 'od zer/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug thugs rje brtson 'grus dpal/ /gsol ba mo sku gsum mo byang chub sems dpa' rgyal ba ye shes sde/ /mkhas shing grub gyur blo gros bzang po pa/ /gsol ba mo sku gsum tsho gnas lugs mngon gzigs rasmi sidha'i zhabs/ /'od gsal 'khor yug nam mkha' rgyal ba'i mtshan/ /gsol ba smo sku gsum mo mkhas btsun bzang por gyur ba ngag dbang po/ /gnas lnga rig pa stag lung ngag dbang grags/ /gsol ba snu sku gsum dz+ra sbas pa'i sangs rgyas smra ba'i seṅge mchog /phyogs las rnam rgyal gtsang smyon he ru ka /gsol ba 〉 sku gsusngu lho snyan brgyud bstan pa'i sgron me lha rgod gnyis/ /lung rtogs dbang phyug blo gros rab yangs

pa/ /ga—sol ba mo sku gsum mo sgrub rgyud gsal byed grub thob dbang po che/ /des don phyogs mthar rgyas mdzad su ma ti/ /gsol ba lko sku gsum dz+ra rim gnyis grub pa rgyal dbang seng ge'i sgra//sbas tshul mchog grub shākya'i sidha'i zhabs/ /gsol ba mo sku gsum ྾ bla med byin rlabs ye shes brgyud la skye/ /rtogs pa'i gar mkhan tshe dbang nor bu'i sde/ /gsol ba dz+ra sku gsum tsho mtha' bral gnas lugs zab mo phyag rgya che/ /mngon sum 'doms mdzad rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba tsho sku gsum lko rab 'byams dkyil 'khor yongs kyi ngo bo nyid/ /bla ma bde dgyes he ru ka yi dam/ /gsol ba 〉 sku gsum tsho sa gsum la bstan lhan skyes bde ba che/ /rnal 'byor mchog sbyin ye shes pho nya ma/ /gsol ba mo sku gsum lko rang gi ngo bo rnam pa gzhan gyis tshul/ /dam ldan skyongs mdzad ma mgon rgya mtsho la/ /gsol ba mo sku gsum mo de ltar phyag chen rtsa ba rgyud pa yis/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos srung la/ /rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa'i nus sbyin gyis/ /mtha' bzhi rkyen gsum bral ba'i phyag rgya che/ /chos nyid gnas lugs bder gshegs snying po'i don/ /ji bzhin bla ma'i byin rlabs 'pho ba mchog /snying la zhugs pa'i nus pa mngon du byas/ /sku gsum 'bras bu myur du smin par shog /skye 'gag gnas bzhi'i rtsa bral rgyu yi stong / /rkyen bral bzhag thabs drug gi rang ngo 'phrod/ /re dogs gang du mi gnas goms pa chod/ /gnyis med ye shes lam khyer rnam pa drug /he ru ka shrī rdo rje'i rang sgra che/ /phyag rgya chen po yi ge rnam pa bzhi/ /dbang don thun drug lhan skyes gnyug ma'i khams/ /gdan 'di nyid du grub pa thob par shog /a ma na si spros bral chos nyid don/ /lta sgom spyod pa'i rim pa mthar phyin nas/ /rgyal kun thugs rje'i 'phrin las sgo rab 'byams/ /ma lus bdag gi myur du 'grub byin rlobs/ /ces phyag rgya chen po yi ge bzhi pa'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'di ni smon mthong mkhan po chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' phun tshogs dpal bzang pos gsung gi bskul bar brten rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu'i mnga' ris smad glo bo smon thang rgyal po'i khab tu sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ring lugs rgyud sde smra ba'i mchog gi sprul sku 'phrin las bstan 'dzin no/ /phyag rgya chen po snyan brgyud zung 'brel gyi brgyud 'debs byin rlabs gter mdzod 'byed cing nyams rtogs 'bras bu myur du smin byed bzhugs so/ /oṃ ā+oḥ r+ghaṃ: zung 'jug yan lag chen po bdun ldan cing / /dbang phyug yon tan brgyad kyi bdag nyid che/ /rigs drug sangs rgyas bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang / /gsol ba 'debs so byin rlobs rtogs mchog stsol/ /bsam gyis mi khyab bā gi'i dkyil 'khor du/ /zag bral lhan gcig skyes dgar sbyor byed pa/ /mi gnas btsun mo rdo rje rnal 'byor mar/ /gsol ba 'debs so mo rdo rje can bdag sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i gar/ /bden gnyis mtha' klas mdzad pa dpag dka' ston/ /bram ze'i khyi'u 'od ldan te lo ba/ /gsol ba dz+ra lnga rig mthar phyin mkha~X ḍigros

lung bstan thob/ /bcu gnyis dka' spyod dbang don mtha' ru phyin/ /brtul zhug/sa cher spyod bram ze nā ro pa/ /gsol ba 〉 snyad gnyis mthar phyin dka' ba khyad du bsad/ /rgyud sde bzhi brnyes dngos grub rnams gnyid spyod/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug smar ston chos blo gros/ /gsol ba ( bla ma'i lung bstan dpa' spyod bsgrub la brtson/ /rlung sems dbur tshud 'byung lnga rang dbang brnyes/ /'jig rten chos bcom mi la gzhad rdo rje/ /gsol ba 〉 rgyal bas ting 'dzin rgyal mdor lung bstan pa'i/ /mi slobs mthar phyin bsgrub brgyud gtsug gi rgyan/ /mdo sngags gnyis ston snyi bsgom zla 'od gzhon/ /gsol ba 〉 bskal bzang sangs rgyas drug pa seṅge nyid/ /tshangs spyod mthon mthing ban 'chang karma pa/ /dus gsum mkhyen gyur kre bo rtogs grol zhabs/ /gsol ba ste/ yi dam zhal gzigs chos skyong bran du khol//rlung sems dbang tshud 'phrin las bsam mi khyab/ /'khrul zhig ras chen bsod nams grags pa che/ /gsol ba snu byin rlabs skad gcig nyid zhugs bsgom med rtogs/ /mi dang mi min dbang bsdud chos la bkod/ /rgyal sras pom brag bsod nams rdo rje rgyal/ /gsol ba 〉〈 mi mthun kun 'joms 'jigs med rdo rje 'chang / /snang ba dbang thob rdzu 'phrul nus pa'i mthu/ /dpag med zhwa nag can gyur kar pak+shi/ /gsol ba 〉〈 rtogs pa klong gyur o rgyan la sogs yul/ /dgur gshegs brtul zhugs rten 'brel grub pa'i mchog /rnal 'byor dbang phyug seṅge dpal chen por/ /gsol ba 〉 kun bzang rdo rje ljags kyi thal gyur du/ /lung bstan thams cad mkhyen gyur rgyal ba'i dbang / /cod pan gsum pa karma rang 'byung zhabs/ /gsol ba 〉〈 lnga rig la sogs mdo sngags chos spyi la/ /mkhas zhing khyad par gsang chen snying po nyid/ /grub bsnyes gyur pa g.yung ston rdo rje dpal/ /gsol ba lko byang chub sems dpa' bslab gsum snying po'i don/ /legs bstan thogs med mkhyen brtse mthar phyin pa/ /karma sku bzhi rang 'byung rol pa rje/ /gsol ba dz+ra zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin gyur mkha' la spyod/ /rtogs ldan dri med dpal gyis ye shes zhabs/ /gsol ba 〉 'phags mchog lag na pad dkar gdul bya'i ngor/ /nyer brten lung rtogs mthar son sa skyong gis/ /gtsug rgyan karma de bzhin gshegs chos dpal//gsol ba snu rgyal ba gzi brjid mtha' yas byang sems tshul/ /snang nas zab gdams snyan brgyud mdzod/ /mnga' bdag me nyag rnal 'byor blo rin che/ /gsol ba dz+ra ji bzhin gnas lugs rtse mor mngon gzigs shing / /nyams len chos sku'i dgongs pa nyid gyur pa'i/ /tshab bzhir rnal 'byor 'od zer seṅge ba/ /gsol ba mo lugs gnyis dpal gyur bshad sgrub bstan pa nyid/ /rgya cher bskyed mkhas snyan brgyud sgron me mchog /rgyal ba'i sras po jo gdan blo gros grags/ /gsol ba ste/ u rgyan gu ru'i lung bstan phyag rdzogs kyis/ /nyams len mthar phyin ngo mtshar mdzad pa che/ /ston mdzad bya 516

btang blo gros rgya mtsho'i zhabs/ /gsol ba 〉〈 sbas pa'i tshul gyis rim gnyis grub pa la/ /dus mtha' bden gnyis thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /don kun grub pa bkra shis mtshan 'chang ba/ /gsol ba tshogazhan du ma yin phyag rgya chen po la/ /nyams len mchog grub gsang sngags 'chang ba po/ /rlung sems dbur 'dud sangs rgyas rin po che/ /gsol bar sngon sbyang chos tshul zhi lam phyag rdzogs che/ /du ma thugs chud mkhyen rtogs rtsal rgyas pa'i/ /sprul pa'i sku mchog a nan+ta bi dza/ /gso la ba dz+ra sbyangs pa mchog thob grub chen sprul pa'i sku/ /karma'i bstan skyong snyan brgyud snying po'i gnad/ /mngon rtogs blo gros bstan pa'i nyi ma che/ /gsol ba 〉〈 bsod nams gnyis rdzogs gdul bya 'dren pa'i dpal/ /rtogs pa 'gyur med rnal 'byor bzhi mthar phyin/ /snying po'i don ston che tshang lnga pa zhabs/ /gsol ba dz+ra rgyal bu rgod ras sgyu ma'i 'dod gar che/ /legs bsgyur phyogs bral khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang / /dkon mchog kun 'dus legs bshad bstan pa 'dzin/ /gsol ba dz+ra rgyal kun rigs bsdus gsang yum rdo rje 'dzin/ /mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs gsung rab rgya mtsho cher/ /legs spyod 'jam mgon karma rig pa 'dzin/ /gsol ba 〉 byin rlabs rgyud ldan rtogs pa'i chu bo che/ /skal ldan zhing sa brlan mkhas smin grol gnyis/ /ston mdzad mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba mo he ru ka dpal sna tshogs sgyu ma'i bdag /rdo rje btsun mo'i bha gar snyoms gnas shing / /bde bar gshegs gyur bde mchog 'khor lo che/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /gnas yul lhan zhing sngags kyi dhā k+ki'i gtso/ /mam gnas kun gyis rgyud la rtag 'char ba/ /bde ba'i rang zhal rdo rje rnal 'byor mar/ /gsol ba 'debs so rten 'brel gnyis 'char stsol/ /bcom ldan thugs kyi dbyings nas gdul bya'i tshogs/ /zhi bas 'dul min kun btus ye shes mgon/ /tshad med thugs rje sku 'chang phyag bzhi par/ /gsol ba 'debs so rim gnyis bar chad sel/ /'das ma bzhi las gzugs 'char ral gcig ma/ /'dod khams dbang bsgyur sems ma dus sol che/ /bstan pa gnyan srung shan pa srogs bsgrub mo/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'phrin las rnam bzhi stsol/ /de ltar bla ma lha la rtse gcig tu/ /bcos min dad pa'i dung bas gsol btab mthus/ /mos gus dag snang dam tshig brten phur gtsug /zhen log gos med brtson 'grus rgyud la skye/ /snying rje byang sems btang snyoms gzhi ma thing / /zab lam phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bo mthong / /'khor ba brten gyis bsgrub pa'i rkang tshugs zin/ /gdams ngag byan tshud 'khor 'das nyag gcig thim/ /byin rlabs mtsho rdol rkyen ngan grogs su 'char/ /skye shi rtsad chod gnyis snang rdzun khrid yal/ /re dogs sgrog chod gang bgrod ltos bzhi zad/ sku gnyis zung 'jug rtsal snang rgyas byin rlobs/ /ces phyag rgya chen po'i gzhung smin sgrol yongs rdzogs kyi khyad par snyan brgyud rin po che dang 'brel ba'i brgyud 'debs chespya1 rdo byin

rlabs gter mdzod 'byed pa'i lde mig nyams rtogs 'bras bu myur smin thugs rje chu 'beb zhes bya ba 'di ni/ che tshang sprul pa'i sku karma rig 'dzin gyi zhabs bskul gyis bos len pa'i rnal 'byor pa tshe dbang nor bu dpal gyi rgya mtshos kun ldan lcags bya'i dus kyi zla ba bde 'byung gi tshes gza' skar nam mkha'i rtogs dang sna tshogs lha ldan gyi 'grub sbyor nyams rtogs mched pa la sbyar nas smar khams dben rdzong sgar thog du bris pa yin te/ smras pa/ bdag lta sngon sbyangs med pas da lta rmongs/ /da lta'i brtson pas ma phul rig gnas sdug /rten 'brung ma rtogs pas na bsgoms chung yang dben/ /sgra dang snyan ngag mngon brjod yongs mi shes/ /des na rtsom chos byed pa'i spobs min kyang / /gang shar chal chol bris pa'i blo shar tshe/ /'bod rtsom btags bzhin byed pa'ang cher ma grub/ /des na gang dran bris nyes mkhas la bshags/ /legs gyur de bas 'gro kun phyam gcig tu/ /mtha' bral gnas lugs bzhi yi phyag rgya rtogs/ /rnal 'byor bzhi bgrod lam gyis phyag rgya rdzogs/ /sku gsum 'bras bu phyag rgya che thob shog /de skad smra ba po yang tshe dbang lags/ /dge'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/dge'o/ /phyag chen don dam gnyug ma'i bla ma nye rgyud byin rlabs chu rgyun bzhugs so/ /oṃ ā: r+ghaṃ/ rang bzhin rnam dag chos nyid ye shes sku/ /rigs drug khyab bdag sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang / /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud phyag rgya che/ /yang dag rtogs pa mngon shar byin gyis rlobs/ /zag bral bde chen stong nyid ye shes khams/ /kun khyab bcom ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /gsol ba mo yang dag rtogs pa mo gang gi dpe bral ye shes mthar thug nyid/ /yongs gang bde chen sgyu lus sha wa ri/ /gsol ba mo yang dz+ra 'dres 'byung / zab mo'i lam mchog gnyug ma lhan cig skyes/ /snying po'i mnga' bdag dpal ldan byams pa dpal/ /rgyud sde bzhi brnyes lung rtogs gnyis kyi bdag /gnyis smra mar ston chos kyi blo gros che/ /gsol ba tsho yang mo dka' spyad mthar phyin snyan brgyud zab mdzod 'dzin/ /mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug mi la ras pa zhabs/ /gsol ba ྾ yang mo grangs med byang chub mchog bskyed bden gnyis don/ /mngon gyur mtsho byed dwags bsgom rin po che/ /gsol ba ( yang dz+ra mi bskyod sman pa'i rgyal po gdul bya'i don/ /gzugs skur ston pa 'phags gru rdo rje rgyal/ /gsol ba 〉 yang mo rtogs pa'i mthun drug bla na med pa'i lam/ /rab gzigs gling ras pad+ma rdo rje 'chang / /gsol ba 〉 yang mo don dam skye med ngo bo dri bral nyid/ /mngon gyur rgya ston chos kyi bzang po sde/ /gsol ba mo yang 〉 khyad par mchog dang thun mong grub pa rgyas/ /rab brnyes mchog ldan rdo rje drag 'bum pa/ /gsol ba tsho yang mo phyi nang gsang ba kho na nyid gter la/ /longs spyod dpa' bo stag sham nus ldan rje/ /gsol ba mo yang dz+ra chos kun du ma rol gcig nyid du gzigs/ /khyab brdadī stu rje 'dzin dbang bde chen gling / /gsol ba mo yang tsho byin rlabs yon tan du ma'i

gter 'chang zhing / /snyigs rgyas 'gro 'dren rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs/ /gsol ba snu yang ( rmad byung ye shes rtogs pa'i chu bo gang / /rgyud la rang bab mtshungs med chos kyi rje/ /bka' rgyud bla ma mchog la gsol 'debs kyi/ /bdag don chos sku ye shes nyid rab rtogs/ /gzhan don bdag 'brel mthong thos dran reg kun/ /bde chen mchog lam la sbyor phyir mi ldog /don gnyis lhun grub 'gro mgon rgyal ba yi/ /go 'phang de ring nyid nas thob byin rlobs/ /oṃ ā: r+ghaṃ ho sarba sidhi pha la r+ghaṃ ā:zhes phyag chen gnyug ma'i bla ma nye rgyud dpa' bo stag sham gyi gsang ba'i rnam thar nas gsung ba ltar la gsol 'debs su sna tshogs dbyig gi ston zla gsum pa'i tshes bzang nyer gnyis la ngom zhos kun bzang nag khrod gdan sa mthil/'gro mgon badz+ra ra dza yi 'jag spyil sku mdun du tshe dbang nor bu yi smras pa maṅga lo/rgyal ba'i gsung rab mtha' dag gi snying po zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i man ngag gi brgyud pa'i bla mar gsol ba btab pa rin po che 'od 'bar zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na ma shrī mdzi badz+ra gu ru bhe: rgyal ba'i gsung rab mtha' dag gi /snying po zab gsal zung 'jug gi /brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam lha/ /mkha' 'gro'i bcas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba kun gyis thugs kyi ye shes gcig bsdus zab mo gang / /gdul byar brtse bas ye shes rang snang gsal ba gzhon nu'i lus/ /gnyis snang rnyog pa kun dral 'jam pa'i dpal zhes pa/ /kun tu bzang po zur phud lnga pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang gi sprul pas rang slob tshul bzung zab gsal zung 'jug pa'i/ /bden don mngon gyur dkyil 'khor gtso mchog rdo rje slob dpon sku/ /dpal ldan sangs rgyas ye shes 'phags yul grub gyur bye ba yi/ /brgyud gyur 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul mchog la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang de'i slob ma'i tshul bzung bde chen zhing gi bdag po ni/ /zhing 'dir rgyal tshab tshul bzung urgyan sad+dha'i mtsho pad las/ /brdzus skyes rgyal ba mtshan mchog brgyad 'chang bde ba chen po zhes/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dngos pad+ma 'byung gnas zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de dang sman zhabs la brten grub pa mchog brnyes yi ge'i zhabs/ /de'i brgyud 'dzin karma pa dang paṇa chen ye shes dpal/ /gnam gnon gtor ma'i slob dpon zhes te ba ling a tsar+ya/ /'phags pa'i yul byon 'jam gsang slob bshad 'dzin der phyag 'tshal lo/ /ba ling a tsar+ya yi rjes bzung gangs ri'i khrod 'khrungs pa/ /gnyos lo yon tan grags dang de'i rigs sras rim byon pa/ /rdo rje bla ma jo sras dpal le sngags 'chang grags pa dpal/ /spyod 'chang nag po'i rnam sprul lha nang pa la phyag 'tshal lo /de'i chos kyi brgyud 'dzin stod lung dzha na dza la dang / /gser lding chos 'od mkhas grub 'phags bod bu ston rin chen grub/ /mkhas pa'i khyu mchog byang chub rtse mo lo chen grags rgyal pa/ /brgyud ldan bla ma mkhas shing grub brnyes rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags mchog rnams ni bzhi la bzhud min 'gro la thugs brtse ba/ /bsam bzhin skye ba sprul skur yongs bzhes dbyangs can dga' ba zhes/ /ma~Xsdu kun

gtso bor rdo rje sems dang 'phags mos dbang bskur ba/ /ho ru ka dpal grub pa'i 'khor los 'gyur der phyag 'tshal lo/ /de'i zhabs brnyes mi zhig dwangs ma'i sku bsnyes bsod nams mchog /thugs kyi sgo gnyis yongs dgyes mngon shes mthu brnyes zla rgyal ba/ /gnas lugs don rtogs nam mkha' rin chen grub mchog lha dbang grags/ /zab gsal bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rnams la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyod 'chang dpa' bo rgyal bstan rgud pa gsal phyir mi yi gzugs/ /dngos sprul kun dga' snying po zhes bya nges don shing rta tshe/ /mi 'gyur bde ba'i sku mnyes zab gsal ji bzhin ston mkhas dbang / /smra ba'i nyi ma hā ra nā tha'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yi zhabs bsnyes dam pa'i rigs 'khrungs skyes mchog nam mkha' dkar/ /mang thos sdom brtson nam mkha' nor bu'i zhabs dang de'i slob la/ /sbas tshul nyid kyi grub pa yongs gtso 'phrin las rab brtan zhabs/ /de'i chos sras yongs gtso tshe dbang nor bur phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal kun bgrod pa gcig lam zab gsal lam ston bka' drin can/ /'dren mchog 'khor lo'i dbang phyug rtsa ba'i bla mar phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar brgyad khri bzhi stong chos sgo kun gyi snying po mchog /'jam dpal zhal lung grol thig dam pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zab gsal zung 'jug bla ma lha la phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul zhing / /sdug bshags dge rang chos 'khor rgyun 'khor mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs/ /gsol ba 'debs bgyid zab gsal bsgom sogs dge kun yongs sdom nas/ /byang chen rgyur bsngo de'i 'jam dpal go 'phang myur thob shog /de srid skye ba gang dang gang du ji srid bzod thob par/ /dal 'byor rin bzang mtshar sdug yid 'phrog zhi dul byang sems ldan/ /'khor bar zhen log dad nges 'byung lhag bsam yongs rgyas pas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i sgor bzhugs sangs rgyas dgyes byed las 'bad shog /dam chos ston byed mtshan nyid bzang po mdo rgyud nas bsngags kun/ /tshangs pas rjes bzung de yi bka' bzhin spyad cing bslab pa gsum/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab la spyod bslab pa dri med par/ /tshul bzhin nyid kyi rgyal bstan rgyas pa'i byed por rtag gyur shog /rdzogs sangs rgyas 'bras sgrub byed ma nor lam mchog kun gyi snying / /zab gsal zung 'jug lam bzang dang 'phrad de sgor mi phyed pa'i/ /dad pas yongs zhugs de ston bla ma sangs rgyas las lhag pa'i/ /mos gus gyis brten dam tshig las la mda' med nyid spyod shog /dbang bzhi'i rgyud smin grol byed lam mchog zab gsal dbyer med pa/ /zab pa spros pas yongs dben bdag med stong pa nyid chen po/ /gsal ba ye shes ngag med lha yi dkyil 'khor rang snang ba/ /zung 'jug gdod ma'i gshis lugs mi shig 'bras bu mngon gyur shog /mdor na tshe gcig nyid la ye shes sku 'grub rnam pa bcur/ /dbang thob 'phrin las rab 'byams 'bad med dpag bsam yid bzhin nor/ /ji bzhin 'gro ba'i don brtson mtha' yas pha 520

ma'i rang bzhin kun/ /kun khyab cha med sku gnyis ro mnyam tshom bu gcig 'grub shog /zhes e bo dong 'jigs bral thams cad mkhyen pa gsang ba sbyin gyi bstan pa'i thig le zab gsal lta ba ni brgyad khri bzhi stong chos sgo mtha' dag gi snying por gyur pa de nyid kyi khrid rgyun la stod brang so rdzong su bu sprul pa'i sku rin po che bzhugs 'dug pas bstan par lhag bsam gyi 'bad pas zhus zhing slar la stod dpal mo dpal phud kyi chos lding rgyal ba'i bste gnas gang gi bla ma dam pa dad gus dam tshig shes rab kyi rgyan pa kun bzang rig 'dzin dbang po la khrid dga' legs par bshad pas gang bde brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs shig dgos zhes dngos rgyud du mar gsung gi bskul bar brten kun dga' zhes shing stag lo zhal gsar du ngom pa snron zla'i tshes bcu gnyis spyod 'chang nag pos cho 'phrul rten pa'i dus chen de'i dgongs mthun skabs su rgyal khams pa tshe dbang nor bus gdan thog gcig tu smras pa'i yi ge dam pa'i gdung 'dzin bkra shis rab brtan no/ /dge'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/dwags po deng lam gyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs gaṅga'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ ā: hūṃ: thog mtha' med pa'i rdo rje dang po'i mgon/ /lhan skyes ye shes dpal ldan rdo rje sems/ /zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /gnas lugs phyag rgya chen por gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes rdo rje dpal he ru ka /rigs drug khyab bdag badz+ra dhā ra sngo sang sgeg pa'i sku/ /rdo rje dril 'dzin rang 'od yum la rol der phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs kun yum gyur shes rab phar phyin rnal 'byor ma/ /dga' rgyas bcu drug na tshod dmar smug khrod 'dzum ral rjes dbus/ /phag zhal phyag gnyis gri thod 'chang mdzad zhabs ni brkyang bskum gar/ me long rab tu mdzes sgeg lha mo de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i sras po sa bcu'i dbang phyug dpal ldan rdo rje'i snying / /gdul bya'i don du sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul grub mchog til btung zhabs/ /sngo bsangs gcer bu ral pa'i thor tshugs phyag gnyis skyabs sbyin can/ /stag sham rus rgyan rnal 'byor spyod 'chang tshul der phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang gsum bdag po'i rnam 'phrul bram ze'i rigs 'khrungs paṇ+ḍi ta/ /bla ma snyan la 'gran med mkhas pa dpal chen nā ro pa/ /dmar smug zil ldan thor tshugs rus rgyan rnal 'byor tsat+yā'i chas/ /thod khrag la rol mi lpags rlon pa gsol der phyag 'tshal lo/ /dges mdzad dpa' bo rigs sngags 'chang ba'i tshul bstan he ru ka /rgyud sde bzhi yi mnga' bdag mar ston chos kyi blo gros che/ /sha nyams rab rgyas snum brjid phyag gnyis dbus steng sa non mdzad/ /dbu skra lcang lo 'dud dmar ber phyam bklubs der phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam dpal gshin rje 'jam dpal nyid las gzhan min bod yul gyis/ /sgrub brgyud spel bar sprul sku mi la bzhad pa rdo rje 'chang / /sku mdog sngo smug dbu skra ral pa khril bu nag la ser/ /ras dkar gos gsol sa gnon mnyam gzhag bzhugs der phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum rgyal ba yongs kyi ngo bo 'phrin las gcig bsdus dpal/ /'od dpag med mgon 'gro ba'i bla ma pad+ma 'byung 521

gnas zhabs/ /slar yang / thub dbang bstan pa rgyal tshab sprul sku sa bcu'i gtso/ /gnyal smad lha rje sgam po pa zhes zla 'od gzhon nu'i zhabs/ /dkar dmar mdangs ldan tshangs spyod zhi dul dbu la dwags zhwa gsol/ /chos gos rnam gsum ber zlum pad+ma dpung ltar mdzes zhing brjid/ /rdo rje skyil krung phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag ting 'dzin rab bkram brgyar/ /g.yo med ngang bzhugs bsod nams rin chen mchog der phyag 'tshal lo/ /snang bzhi mthar phyin ting 'dzin bzang po skye ba ye shes mtshan/ /gdul bya'i don du gzugs kyi skur snang gar dbang 'ja' mtshon snying / /gzugs mthung dbu sbom dmar smug rab chung cha byad paṇa zhu gsol/ /rdo rje phur gdeng 'ja' yi gshog pa bkra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zla 'od gzhon nu rgyal bar gyur yang zhing 'dis gdul bya'i ched/ /skye ba sprul sku 'brel tshad don ldan bzang po dpal/ /dkar ser zhi 'dzum dge slong cha byed dwags zhu lhun brjid mnabs/ /phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag glegs bam 'dzin la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi nges don bstan pa 'dzin mdzad chos kyi sras thu bo/ /'od gsal brgyud ldan rnal 'byor dbang phyug 'od gsal dbang po ni/ /ngang ser bgres nyams dge slong cha byed zhi zhing 'dzum bag ldan/ /phyag gnyis ḍā ru dril bu 'dzin la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /de'i chos sras gnyug ma'i don gzigs rnal 'byor dam pa ni/ /tshe dbang nor bu bod sngags chas ldan gtsug na do ger can/ kha dog sna tshogs mnyam bzhag phyag steng nor bu 'od 'bar 'dzin/ /rdo rje skyil krung ting nge 'dzin ngang bzhugs de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang lam bla ma'i man ngag byin rlabs don rgyun chu bo gang / /legs gdams bdag rgyud byin gyis rlabs mdzad rdo rje 'dzin dbang che/ /mtshan dpe yongs rdzogs ye shes gzi 'od 'bar ba rdo rje'i sku/ /'dren mchog 'khor lo'i mgon gyur dkyil 'khor gtso la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar rgyal ba'i rgyal sras mnyam med drags po mtsho byed zhabs/ /gang gi thugs bcud ye shes mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag mchog /gsang lam bla sgrub smin grol brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam lha/ /mkha' 'gro chos bsrung bcas la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing / /gsol ba btab mthus bdag gi sems kyi khams 'di mgon khyod kyi/ /thugs rjes nyer drangs skye ba kun tu dal 'byor mtho ris kyi/ /yon tan bdun rdzogs 'phags nor bdun ldan mtshan dpe lus bzang thob/ /yid gzhung mi brjed bzung ldan dam pa'i chos la blo 'jug shog /mdo sngags gnas gsung dge ba'i bshes gnyen rdo rje slob dpon gyis//mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs bla ma dam pas rjes su yongs bzung nas/ /mdo rgyud kun gyi snying po bsam gyis mi khyab gnas lugs ni/ /phyag rgya chen po mnyam med lha rje'i bzhed sgo la zhugs shog /snyed dka' dal 'byor rten 'di nam 'jig cha med 'jig sla nyid/ /snying la zhen pas 'di snang zhen log chos brgyad 'du 'dzi spangs/ /rgyu 'bras las la yid ches gyur pas mi dge'i bya ba kun/ /yongs spangs dge 522

ba'i las la 'dor med brtson pa bskyed par shog /'khor ba'i 'jigs pas lonor skyabs mchog bla ma dkon mchog la/ /snying nas skyabs mchis 'gro drug 'khrul pa'i duḥ khas mnar ba na/ /pha mar shes pas gzod med snying rjes byang chub sems bskyed cing / /bdag gzhan tshogs rdzogs ched du mi dal las la rab spyod shog /bdag gnyis rgyal ba'i yum shes snying gis dbus su brtan g.yo'i bdag /khyab bdag bla ma rdo rje chos mchog pad 'byung zla 'od zhabs/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma bzhugs la snying nas thang lhod med pa yi/ /phur tshugs dad pas rlabs chen byin nyid bdag rgyud la 'jug shog /sems nyid gnas lugs skye 'gags med pa gnas 'gyur gtan phabs cing / /rang rig rjen pa rtse gcig nyon mongs 'thor byed spros bral rtogs/ /phyi nang dbyer med ro gcig rtsol bral bsgom med mngon gyur shog /rdo rje theg pa'i lam mchog zung 'jug gsang lam che/ /phag mo'i skur snang pho nya gsum 'dres snang srid lha sngags rgyas/ /sbyangs rtogs sbar ba'i bdud rtsi dam dbye ro mnyam rgya mtsho yi/ /mkha' 'gro yongs bskangs dngos grub bcud gyur bdag gis myong bar shog /snying por bskyed bya lha dang rtogs bya lha kun rang rig dngos/ /gtan la phab mdzad rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas kun 'dus gtso/ /pad 'byung lha rje dbyer med chos kyi skur snang bde ba che/ /de ltar gsol btab lha sngags rdo rje gsum 'bras mngon gyur shog /gcig mchog bla mar gsol btab sems nyid bla ma chos skur mjal/ /mi 'gyur bde ba'i dam rdzas la myong phyir mi ldog pa thob/ /lta bsgom bogs 'don spyod pa spongs gyur shes pas gzhi thog bskyal/ skye 'chi rmi lam srid pa'i bar do ngo shes rang grol shog /mdor na sngags lam la brten tshe gcig nyid la ye shes kyi/ /sku mchog rnam bcu dbang bsgyur 'phrin las rab 'byams rgya che bas/ /dpag med 'gro ba'i don chen 'bad rtsol med pa yid bzhin nor/ /byang chub chen po'i go 'phang nyid la tshom bu gcig 'grub shog /ces gsang lam bla sgrub kyi dbang khrid bklag lung gsum tshang ba'i bla ma rgyud par gsol ba btab pa 'di ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas snang mdzad byang chub sems pa'i sku sprul pa rdo rje 'dzin mchog 'jigs med gsang ba sbyin pa'i dbon brgyud lugs gnyis mngon par mtho ba chos kyi rje nam mkha' dpal bzang gi dngos rgyud du mar gsol ba btab pa'i ngor phyag chen gyi rtogs ldan rgyal khams pa tshe dbang nor bus kun dga' zhes shing rtag dbo zla'i tshes bcu gnyis la smras pa maṅga lo/ yang / rgyud pa'i rnam grangs gcig ni gter ston 'ja' tshon pa nas bsgam po nor bu brgyan pa/ spyan snga rin chen rdo rje/ mchog sprul bzang po dpal/ des 'od gsal dbang po yang bgrangs mod/ 'di brgyud pa bdun ma rdzogs bar bklag lung thob pas grol bar rdo rje'i gsung gi dam bcas pa yin pas/ des na rgyud thag nye bzhin byin rlabs che bas gong gi dkyus ltar nyid legs so/ /brgyud pa bdun bgrang tshul ni gter ston 'ja' tshon pa nas bgrang rgyu yin pa go dgos la/ gzhan yang chos 'di chos sku ye shes mkha' 'gro nas sgam po par rgyud mchog gi te na mar mi brgyud par ma bgrang 523

yang chad pa'i skyon med la/ phyis brgyud pa'i kha skong dgos tshe rtsa ba'i bla ma'i gsol 'debs mi bsgyur bar de'i gong du bzhugs par bya'o/ /gsol 'debs mdor bsdus la dga' na 'di ltar bya te/ oṃ susti sidhi rastu/ yang dag sangs rgyas mtha' dag bskyed ma 'khyung yum gnas pa'i dal/ /e yig phyag rgya chen mo shes rab phar phyin rdo rje phag /mi 'gyur bde ba mtshan dpes yongs brgyan rgyal ba kun yab ni/ /waṃ yig gsung gi rdo rje pad+ma 'byung sprul sgam po pa/ /dbyer med sgyu 'phrul 'gog pa med las sprul gyur 'ja' tshon snying / /gang gi thugs dang gnyis med rgyal tshab sa brnyes bzang po dpal/ /de yis chos sras thu bo 'od gsal dbang po grub pa'i gtso/ /de sras tshe dbang nor bu sna tshogs spyod pas 'gro ba 'dul/ /gsang lam rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs so kye/ /bdag rgyud byin rlobs skye kun lam mchog 'di dang rtag 'phros nas/ /'khor bar zhen log thar lam la zhugs mchog gsum la skyabs song / /rgya chen sems bskyed tshogs rdzogs la brtson bla mar gsol 'debs shog /gnas lugs phyag chen gnas 'gyu gtan phab rig pa gcer la phud/ /nyon mongs rang grol gnyis snang ro snyam sgom med 'od gsal ba/ /chu rgyun rnal 'byor zung 'jug sku thob yan lag bdun bsnyes nas/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro kun srid mtsho las sgrol 'dren par bdag gyur shog /mdor na tshe gcig sangs rgyas nye lam zung 'jug rtag rnyed cing / /dbang gi ye shes bdud rtsi legs myong spyod lam ye shes rtsal/ /gdod nas yin lugs mngon gyur bar do rnam drug rang sar grol/ /sems nyid bla ma nor bur zhal mjal don gnyis lhun grub shog /zhes pa'ang gong gi gsol 'debs rgyas pa'i khros gdan thog gcig tu sbyar ba po ni rig 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/stod 'brug ma bdun bka' brgyud phyag chen brgyud 'debs/ na mo gu ru bh+ya: gnas 'og min chos dbyings pho brang du/ /rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen la gsol ba 'debs/ /shar za hor nor bu'i grong khyer du/ /te lo shes rab bzang po la gsol ba 'debs/ /byang pul+la ha ri'i dgon pa ru/ /mkhas pa nā ro paṇa chen la gsol ba 'debs/ /lho gro bo lung gi dgon pa ru/ /sgra sgyur mar pa lo tswa la 〉 'brog la phyi gangs gi ra ba ru/ /dbang phyug mi la ras pa la 〉 shar dwags la sgom po'i dgon pa ru/ /lha rje zla 'od gzhon nu la dz+ra dpal phag mo gru yi mtha' rtsa ru/ /'gro mgon phag mo gru pa la dz+ra gnas sna phu chos lung gi dgon pa ru/ /grub thob gling rje ras pa la mo 'brug se ba ri byang chub kyi dgon pa ru/ /grub thob gtsang pa rgya ras la tsho rong dkar po chos lung gi dben gnas su/ /'gro mgon lo ras pa chen po la gsol dz+ra bar 'brog rdo rje gling gi dgon pa ru/ /rgod tshangs mgon po rdo rje lko gnas 524

gung thang mdo chen gyis dgon pa ru/ /chos rje ma bdun ras chen la dz+ra gnas lcogs ri byang chub kyi dben gnas su/ /thugs sras gdan pa rin chen la 〉 gnas dpal ldan lding gi dgon pa ru/ /mnyam med byin rlabs rdo rje la dz+ra gnas nang khong dpal gyi dgon pa ru/ /chos rje sangs rgyas dbon la gsol dz+ra gnas mdo chen dpal gyi dgon pa ru/ /chos rje bsod nams dbang phyug la mo gnas chos rdzong dpal gyis dgon pa ru/ /chos rje bsod nams snying po la lko gnas mdo chen dpal gyi gtsug lag tu/ /mnyam med lhun grub bkra shis la 〉〈 gnas dam pa chos kyi pho brang nas/ /chos rje mgon po dpal la mo gnas gzhan phan lhun gyi grub pa nas/ /chos rje kun dga' gzi brjid la ྾gnas gung thang mdo chen dgon pa ru/ /chos rje che mchog rdo rje la dz+ra gnas bde chen dpal gyi lding khang nas/ /chos rje dkon mchog rdo rje la ste/ gnas gar bzhugs dag pa'i zhing khams nas/ /chos rje nam mkha' lhun grub la ste/ gnas las 'phro dag pa'i zhing khams nas/ /chos rje nam mkha' seṅge la mo gnas tshe bsgrub mthar phyin gyis pho brang nas/ /chos rje nor bu bde chen la tsho gnas mkhyen rab lhun grub gyi pho brang nas/ /chos rje brtan pa'i nor bu la 〉 gnas bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi pho brang nas/ /sngags 'chang rgyal sras seṅge la tsho gnas phyogs med gdul bya'i zhing khams su/ /rigs 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu la mo gnas spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la 〉 gsol ba 'debs so bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /grub rgyal tshe sgrub kyi brgyud 'debs 'chi med bu mo'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ ā: hūṃ trī: trī: tshe dpag med mgon 'dod dgu'i dpag bsam shing / /grub pa'i rgyal mo mtshan dpe me tog brgyan/ /ti pu pa mi rtogs pa'i 'bras bu brjid/ /ras chung rdor grags 'chi med 'chang gis bzi/ /mi la ras chen ting 'dzin nyams kyis myos/ /dwags po lha rje rtogs pa'i nor kyis phyug /phag mo grub pa phag mo'i sku la 'khyud/ /'jig rten mgon po 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon/ /spyan snga grags 'byung spyan lnga mngon shes can/ /yang dgon chos rje yang yang bsgrub rgyud 'dzin/ /thugs sras rig ldan thugs brgyud chos bzhin spyod/ /zur phug pa ni nyams rtogs zur ngom byed/ /skyes mchog chen po skye 'gro yongs kyi mgon/ /nam mkha' rgyal mtshan tshe yi rig 'dzin brnyes/ /'jam dpal rgya mtsho grub pa'i 'khor lo bskor/ /chos kyi rgya mtsho skal bzang 'gro ba'i mgon/ /'jam mgon bla ma mkhyen brtse nus par ldan/ /lha dbang grags pa lha bcas 'gro ba'i mgon/ /sgrol ba'i mgon pos 'khor ba kun sgrol mdzad/ /blo gros rnam rgyal theg mchog rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /kun dga' 'phrin las snying po'i dga' ston spel/ /kun bzang dbang po dbang bzhi'i 'bras bu smin/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma byin rlabs kun gyi swā~Xd / /

'chi med rigs grub rgyud pa'i tshogs bcas la/ /snying nas rtse gcig gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag rgyud byin rlobs tshe yi dngos grub rtsol/ /gdod nas 'gyur med ye shes snying po'i khams/ /glo bur dri ma'i skye 'chi kun sangs ba/ /mi shig dwangs ma 'od gsal rdo rje'i tshe/ /bdag sogs 'gro bas da lta nyid thob mdzod/ /zhes grub rgyal tshe dbang gi brgyud 'debs snying po la/ sgrol mgon ma ha chad kha skong sho lo ka gsum po/ rtsa ba'i bla ma kun bzang dbang po'i bka' yi snang ba thob 'phral sku mdun nyid du tshe dbang nor bus phur bu rgyal zla'i tshes bzang nyer brgyad la sbyar ba sarba bha maṅga lo/bla ma yang tig gi rgyud pa'i phyag 'tshal gyi 'phro ni/ shes bya'i dkyil 'khor rab gzigs shing / /dam chos rin chen mdzod 'dzin pas/ /zab mo'i dgongs gter rgyas mdzad pa/ /kun mkhyen chos rje la phyag 'tshal/ /bde legs yon tan thams cad kyi/ /'byung gnas mkhyen brtse'i rgya mtsho che/ /byams dang snying rje'i gter gyur pa/ /bde legs rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal/ /'khor ba'i bya ba kun spangs nas/ /gcig pu 'od gsal snying po brnyes/ /mkha' 'gro 'bar ba'i sprin phung can/ /bya bral chos rje la phyag 'tshal/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /legs gsung dam chos mdzod 'dzin cing / /bkra shis 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i gnas/ /sangs rgyas bkra shis la phyag 'tshal/ /yon tan rin chen dpal 'bar zhing / /zab mo'i de nyid legs rtogs na/ /'gro rnams smin grol 'god mdzad pa'i/ /gu ṇa shri la mo snang srid ye sangs rgyas pa'i don/ /ma lus thugs su chud mdzad cing / /ye shes mchog gi lam bgrod pa'i/ /sangs rgyas ye shes 〉 sangs rgyas ma lus thams cad kyi/ /thugs kyi sangs ba rin por che/ /snying thig bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan 〉 bslab gsum tshul khrims rgyan gyis spras/ /rdo rje gsum gyi rnal 'byor che/ /bla med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /tshul khrims rgyal mtshan mo bsod nams tshogs chen lhun rdzogs shing / /ye shes rang snang 'od gsal bas/ /srid zhi'i mtha' las rnam pa rgyal/ /bsod nams rnam rgyal la 〉〈 o rgyan slob dpon pad+ma yis/ /rjes bzung shes bya'i don rnams gzigs/ /snying po'i bstan pa 'dzin mdzad pa/ /o rgyan bstan 'dzin tshorgyal ba'i 'phrin las ma lus kun/ /'gro la phan pa'i rlabs chen spyod/ /kun gyis bla ma rin po che/ /karma gu ru tsho dri med tshul khrims pad+ma'i mtshor/ /bla med yid bzhin snying po blang / /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser mchod pa'i/ /pad+ma rgyal mtshan mo blo gsal pad+ma'i skyed tshal du/ /blo gros 'dab stong sbrang rtsi'i bcud/ /blo ldan bung ba tshim byed pa/ /pad+ma ma ti 〉 rnam grol yon tan du ma'i mdzod/ /bkra shis phun tshogs 'dod dgu'i gter/ /dgos 'byung yid bzhin rin po che/ /maṅga rat+na snu chos dbyings gdodā ṭā6sa dag pa'i thugs/ /bkra shis dge mtshan 'bum gyis spras/ /blo ldan smin grol la 'god

mdzad/ /bkra shis blo gros dz+ra rgyal kun thugs kyi pad+ma las/ /legs 'ong mtsho skyes rdo rje'i 'phrul/ /skal ldan dbul sel nor bu mchog /pad+ma nor bu ྾ o rgyan ye shes dhāk+ki yis/ /rjes bzung sngags kyi bstan pa 'dzin/ /bsdu ba bzhi yis 'gro ba 'dul/ /gu ru skal bzang la mo gong gi bkra shis blo gros man ma hā gu ru'i gsung yin lags/snying tig yang rdzong ma'i bla brgyud kha skong ni/ gar gyi dbang phyug dgos 'dod re ba bskong / /mchog brnyes dam pa gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /ya ti dha tsha mkhyen rtse nus pa'i gter/ /mi 'gyur dbang rgyal zab don gsal ba'i dpal/ /kun bzang rnam rgyal rdzogs chen bstan pa'i srog /skyes mchog rin chen gsum la tsho 'brug sgra bzang po smin grol chu khur can/ /bstan pa'i nyi ma sbas pa'i sangs rgyas dngos/ /'jigs bral nam mkha' rdzogs chen rnal 'byor ba/ /bstan 'dzin dam pa gsum la mo rin chen bzang po chos kyi rgyal mtshan par/ /tshe dbang nor bu gzhan phan 'phrin las spyod/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rgyal kun 'dus pa'i zhal/ /mchog thun dngos grub stsol la gsol ba 'debs/ /gar gyis dbang phyug man chad kyi kha bskang rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'i chos 'di'i khrid lung rnams rdzogs par thob pa'i dus su sbyar ba'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/ma cig rgyam thang gsol 'debs kha skong / chos lung byang brtse'i dben gnas su/ /rje btsun grol mchog byin rlabs can/ /brag stod rdo rje'i pho brang du/ /chos sku lha dbang tsho chos lung bde mchog pho brang du/ /lung rigs rgya mtsho tsho khams gsum 'gro ba'i spyi bo ru/ /kun dga' snying po hā zar gyis gsang ri'i dgon pa ru/ /rin chen rgya mtsho dz+ra jo snang dpal gyi ri khrod du/ /snying po mtha' yas tsho dge phu'i ri khrod 'bras spungs nas/ /kun bzang dbang po mo phyogs med gdul bya'i zhing khams su/ /rig 'dzin chen po byin rlabs can/ /byin rlabs can la gsol ba 'debs/ /a ti zab don gyi brgyud 'debs kha skong / mnga' ris dol po chos kyi skyed tshal nas/ /grub mchog o rgyan rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs/ /phyogs med gzhan phan 'phrin las skyongs ba nas/ /rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu la gsol ba 'debs/ /sha'u gter byon thugs rje chen po'i dbang khrid lung gsum brgyud 'debs kha skong / /mon bod sa mtshams gu ru'i sbas yul ngogs/ /zab bzang rdo rje rnal 'byor gad mo sgrogs/ /sbas pa'i rnal 'byor u rgyan rgyal mtshan la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /phyogs med 'gro don skyongs ba'i zhing khams su/ /gu ru'i byin rlabs nam snying thugs sprul ni/ /'brel tshad don ldan tshe dbang nor bu la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /sarba maṅga lo/ 527

rgyud pa'i chu bo kun 'dus grol mchog zhabs/ /chos nyid gnyug ma'i don gzigs lha dbang grags/ /'jig med shing rta mchog gyur kun dga' snying / /mkha' spyod grub gtso 'phrin las dpal dbang po/ /rin chen rgya mtsho gnas brtan rdo rje 'dzin/ /snying po mtha' yas grub brnyes sbas pa'i tshul/ /'khor lo'i mgon po brtse chen kun bzang dbang / /rtsa rgyud bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /khrid brgya brgyud pa kun gyi 'phro mthud de kho na sbyar bas mchog go /sarba maṅga lo/smar khrid rigs bzhi dang rgyal po bka' 'bum gyi rgyud pa'i 'phro rnams chab gcig tu/ zab mo khrid chen brgya dang rtsa brgyad kyi/ /lung rtogs byin rlabs gcig tu sdud mdzad pa'i/ /rje btsun bla ma kun dga' grol mchog zhabs/ /thugs sras lha dbang grags par gsol ba 'debs/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rdo rje 'chang / /rje btsun bla ma kun dga' snying po dpal/ /phrin las dbang mo rin chen rgya mtsho'i sde/ /snying po mtha' yas zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /'khor lo'i mgon po kun bzang dbang po dang / /de sras mthu bo tshe dbang nor bu'i sde/ /gdams zab chu rgyun stsol mdzad bla ma rje/ /bka' drin mtshungs med mgon por gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes khrid chen thams cad brgyud pa mthun par 'dren/ / 528

༄ga /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung gnas la nges pa don gyi sgo nas bstod dbyangs yan lag bdun pa grub mtha' nges pa'i snying po theg chen bstan bcos rgya mtsho'i sgra dbyangs rgyun mi chad pa rin po che'i gabher zhes bya ba bklugs so/ /gu ru pad+ma sirnyi r+ghaṃ trī: rgyal ba rgya mtsho kun gyi ngo bo/ /gsung gi rdo rje 'od dpag med mgon/ /dkyil 'khor rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i gtso bo/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal/ /gdod ma nyid nas yongs grub chos dbyings/ /skye 'gag gnas bral bde gshegs snying po/ /kun khyab kun bzang ngo bo nyid sku/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phra rab rdul 'das rig pa'i ngo bo/ /ye shes sku ni me long lta bu/ /sor rtog bya grub ma 'dres rtsal rdzogs/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal lo chos kun mnyam nyid ye shes yangs pa/ /tha dad ma yin gcig pu dang bral/ /blo 'das spros bral gnyis med thig le/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srid par rtag tu khyod nyid snang zhing / /zhi dbyings rtag tu khyod ni snyoms bzhugs/ /srid zhi kun la khyab pa'i bdag nyid/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor bar gnas kyang 'khor ba'i skyon med/ /mya ngan 'das kyang zhi bar gzim min/ /dri med rgyal ba kun gyi ngo bo/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal/ /khyod ni rtag mthar nam yang ma lhung / /stong zhing bdag med khas len dang bral/ /rtog med ngang la rtag tu mnyam bzhag /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal/ /khyod ni mtha' gnyis gang du mi gnas/ /dbu mar yang ni dmigs pa ma yin/ /smra bsam brjod med skye 'gag las 'das/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal/ /khyod ni nyag cig nyid du gnas shing / /rnam pa thams cad du mar snang ba/ /bsam gyis mi khyab rig pa'i ngo bo /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal/ /khyod ni sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sras kyi mthu bo/ /sangs rgyas yongs kyi bskyed pa'i yab yin/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal/ /khyed ni rgyal ba mtha' dag sprul pa/ /rgyal ba yongs kyi sprul gzhir gyur pa/ /rgyal ba kun la dbang bskur mdzad do/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal/ /'khor 'das kun gyi snga rol nyid nas/ /yongs su grub cing 'khor 'das dbus gnas/ /'khor 'das mthar bzhugs dus gsum dus med/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal/ /'khor 'das med pa'i ngo bo la bzhugs/ /grol 'khrul ming rtags las 'das 529

gshis lugs/ /kun la snang zhing kun gyi gzhir gyur/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal/ /rnam shes tshogs brgyad pad+ma'i dbus na/ /rig pa rang byung spros bral ngang gnas/ /'khor 'das kun gyi dwangs ma nyid gyur/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal/ /'byung gnas 'gro shes ye nas stong zhing / /'byung gnas 'gro min phyogs kyang ma yin/ /'byung gnas 'gro dang min pa'i mtha' bral/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal/ /mtha' dag snang ba gdod nas ma grub/ /ma grub bzhin snang grub dang ma grub/ /snang zhes brjod gzhi gzhi med rtsal bral/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal/ /snang ba sems zhes tshur mang mi bsdud/ /sems min gzhan du nam yang ma grurba/ /ro mnyam zhes su bsre ba'i yul stong / /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal/ /gdod nas gzhi med rtsa bral stong pa/ /stong nyid rig pa gzhom zhig las 'das/ /snang sems glo bur rtag pa kun stong / /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal/ /gshis lugs 'di ni shin tu rtogs dka'/ /ye shes 'di ni ches cher phra ba/ /bsam gyis mi khyab chos nyid gnas lugs/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal/ /sgam pos bcos dang bsgrim pos ma slad/ /kun gyi snying po shin tu bzang po/ /bzang ngan blang dor spros pa bral ba/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal/ /kun khyab sku dang ye shes lus gcig /dri ma'i dbus bzhugs dri mas ma gos/ /rab tu rgya che shin tu phra ba/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal/ /rnam par shes pa'i cha kun yongs spangs/ /ye shes ma lus rtsal kha rdzogs pa/ /spang rtogs 'bras bu mngon du gyur pa'i/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal/ /kun nas brtag pa rang ngos stong zhing / /gzhan dbang don dam ngo bos stong ste/ /stong nyid rig pa yongs grub rtag brtan/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal/ /kun rdzob chos ni nam yang mi brtan/ /don dam bden pa shin tu brtag ste/ /mi shig 'gyur med rdo rje'i rang bzhin/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal/ /brtan pa'i 'dzin rtog dmigs bcas zhen pa/ /brtan dang mi brtan gzhi rtsa stong pa'i/ /chos dbyings ye shes 'pho 'gyur med do/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal/ /gang zag bdag dang chos kyi bdag bral/ /bdag med ngo bo shes rab phar phyin/ /stong pa nyid de mtshan ma smon med/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal/ /'bras bu sdug bsngal rgyur gyur kun 'byung / /spang byed lam gyi thob bya 'gog pa/ /bden bzhi'i rang bzhin gnyug ma'i 'od gsal/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal/ /'khor ba'i gzhi rtsa ma rig ngo bo/ /bdag gces 'khrul pa'i duḥ kha gzir la/ /bdag med stong pa'i seng ge'i sgra chen/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal/ /bdag gi gnyen por bsngags pa'i stong pa/ /der dmigs stong pa bcom phyir bdag med/ /ngo bo chos dbyings don dam bdaswā ༵chog /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal/ /phyi don zhen spangs snang ba sems brtan/ /

sems 'dzin bcom phyir stong par yongs gsungs/ /gnyis ka 'gog phyir zung 'jug stong nyid/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal/ /'gog bden rang bzhin zhi bar gnas pa/ /rang rig rang gsal lhag mthong ngo bo/ /zhi lhag zung 'jug gdod ma'i ye shes/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal/ /gnas zhes ngo bo gzhi rten ma grub/ /'gyu zhes rnam par rtog pas ma skyod/ /gnas dang 'gyu zhes gang du ma dmigs/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal/ /rig pa zhes brjod ming la don zhen/ /don la ming zhes rnam pa yongs spangs/ /mi shig ngo bor khas len bral ngos/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal/ /phung khams dbang yul spang gzhi de gzhan/ /gshegs pa yab yum sems dpa' sems ma/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo rab 'byams spro mdzad/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal/ /gzugs med gzugs gsal mtshan dpe 'od gsal/ /bdag med stong pa rnam rtog spros bral/ /shes bya kun khyab zab gsal dbyer med/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal/ /dri ma 'gyur bcas bdud kun bcom nas/ /dri med mi 'gyur bcom ldan bde chen/ /cha med kun 'gro nyag gcig rgyal ba/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal/ /de ltar 'khor 'das yongs kyi spyi dpal/ /brtan dang g.yo ba kun gyi rang bzhin/ /srog ldan kun gyi mgon dang bcud gyur/ /sku gsum rgyal ba yongs kyi 'byung khungs/ /'khor 'das thog mtha' med pa'i mtsho klong / /rnam shes pad+ma rgyas pa'i dbus su/ /yon tan kun 'byung snying po rig pa/ /mi 'gyur bde chen ngo bor rtag gnas/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos kun gyi rgyal po/ /thugs rje nus mthu rmad du byung gyur/ /ma hā gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas/ /lha mi yongs kyi bla ma mchog der/ /bdag gi sgo gsum gus pa chen pos/ /thal mo spyi bor sbyar nas blo yi/ /rdul snyed lus gos rang bzhin mnyam nyid/ /rab tu phyag 'tshal phyag 'tshal 'dud kyi/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i sgrib kun bcom nas/ /dri med zla ba rgyas bzhin byin rlobs/ /bdag lus longs spyod dpal 'byor dbang phyug /tshe srog rnams dang tshogs gnyis dge tshogs/ /rnam pa kun tu bla ma mchog la/ /bdag med ngang du 'bul gyi bzhes gsol/ /sgrib pa'i ngo bo gdod nas ma grub/ /glo bur rnam rtog dbang gis bsags pa'i/ /sdig pa mi dge ci mchis pa rnams/ /mthol bshags ro mnyam ngang dag gyur cig /ye nas rang byung 'dus ma byas dge /rnam shes kyis bslu 'du byas dge ba/ /'dus dang 'dus ma byas pas sku gnyis/ /ye shes bsgrub la rjes su yi rang / /rgyal ba'i gsung gi rgyun chad mi mnga'/ /gsung dang mi gsung spros pas dben mod/ /yal yol btang snyoms nam yang mi gnas/ /tshur mthong gdul byar chos kyi 'khor lo/ /bsam gyis mi khyab mos ngo dang mthun/ /rtag tu bskor bar gsol ba 'debs so/ /rgyal ba gshegs bzhugs nam yang med cing / /mi rtag 'dus byas chos las 'das mod/ /rtag brtan nyid yin byis pa'i ngor bstun/ /mya ngan mi 'da' 531

gsol ba 'debs so/ /yang dag don la 'khor gsum dmigs med/ /rnam rtog 'byung ba yod pa de srid/ /dge ba bsags dang 'phags pa'i sa lam/ /rgya chen spyod pa'i tshogs gnyis 'bras bu/ /byang sems rgya mtsho dpag klas nyid kyi/ /theg chen rgya mtsho smon lam gang btab/ /dge legs rgya mtsho ji bzhin 'grub gyur/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i 'phrin las mtha' dag /tshe 'di nyid nas 'grub pa'i rgyur bsngo/ /dbang bcu'i mthar thug myur du thob nas/ /sems can kun gyi re bskang nor gyur/ /yid bzhin bde la tshom bu gcig spyod/ /'jam dpal la sogs byang sems mthu chen/ /dbyangs can ma sogs sems ma rab 'byams/ /rgya chen smon lam mthu brnyes mdzad pa/ /mtsho ltar rgyas kun myur 'grub bdag smon/ /de ltar sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung la/ /bstod bsngags yan lag bdun gyi dge bas/ /bdag skye kun tu pad+ma ka ras/ /rjes su bzung zhing theg pa mchog gyur/ /nges don chos 'khor yongs kyi mthun 'jug /bstan pa'i snying po shin tu rnal 'byor/ /ches cher gsal ba'i byed por gyur cing / /nges gsang rdo rje'i snying las 'gro kun/ /rab sbyor grub pa'i gtso mchog pa la/ /rab bzhag byang chen bgrod pa'i shing rta/ /mu bzhi bdud bzhi'i phyogs las rnam rgyal/ /lhun grub rig 'dzin dbang po'i sde 'grub/ /rgyal ba gzhan gyi mdzad 'phrin rab 'byams/ /rgya mtsho kun kyang bdag gi yongs grub/ /rgyal kun mkhyen rtse nus kun 'dus dpal/ /pad 'byung ji ltar bdag 'grub rgyur bsngo/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo mgon po gzi brjid 'od dpag tu med pa pad+ma 'byung gnas la nges pa don gyi sgo nas bstod dbyangs yan lag bdun pa grub mtha' nges pa'i snying po theg chen bstan bcos rgya mtsho'i sgra dbyangs rgyun mi chad pa'i rin chen gter zhes bya ba 'di yang skye ba du ma'i rigs bdag bla ma pad+ma ka ra gang gi sgyu 'phrul shing rta chen po dag dang / rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs snying la cung zad zhugs pa'i nus pas/ grub mtha' la nges pa ji tsam rnyed pa de'i rtogs brjod kyi tshul du/ rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho yi rang lo sum cu'i gung du slebs pa kun dga' shing stag chu stod zla ba'i yar tshes rgyal ba'i bden bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus chen gyi thun skabs shig la phyag 'tshal yongs su rdzogs pa dang / tshes lnga'i snga kha'i thun gcig tu yan lag bdun gyi lhag ma rnams grub par byas pa ste/ rgyal mchog gu ru pad+ma'i sgrub gnas su lag grom pa rgyang du'o/ /'dir smragopa/ tha snyad klog pa'i grar ma zhugs/ /bslab sbyang dpe 'dzin shin tu nyung / /mkhas par zhen pa'i yon tan skor/ /thos bsam mos kyang brtson pas dkon/ /'on kyang rgyal gsung la yid ches/ /bstan 'di la ni srog ltar brtse/ /tshul 'di'i chos la dad pas bltas/ /sbyang pa dus su sad pa'i rkyen/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs snying la zhugs/ /nyams myong rtogs pa cung zad skyes/ /des na mkhas pa mgu nus shing / /rmongs pa dkri ba'i lam la mkhas/ /gzhan la 'gram chu mi ldang zhing / /ha cang bdag mthong nga rgyal med/ /nges don mthar thug lta grub la/ /shes bzhin mi byed tā~X rkang tshugs/ /des na rang gi rtogs brjod tshul/ /yi ger brjod pa 'di dag rnams/ /lag

dal 'bri bsrub skyen po dang / /gzhan gsung nas btus bcos bsgyur sogs/ /byas pa yin te rang blo ru/ /rgyal bka' bla ma'i man ngag dang / /tshad ma'i bstan bcos bsgom pa'i don/ /ji tsam bdag blor 'khyil ba de/ /mkhas 'dod rtsab rtsub kyis la sbags/ /rang dang bskal ba mnyam pa dang / /tshad mar byed pa'ang yod srid na/ /de phan slad du 'di dag bris/ /kha cig rnam rtog 'phro rgod pa'i/ /gang dran kha nas ci thon du/ /khungs med smra ba'i legs bshad nyid/ /rlom yang rgyal bstan gsal byed min/ /mu to gro zhes mkhar 'ga' zhig /tshig snyan sbyor ba'i blo gsal yang / /rgyal bstan gsal byed ga la 'gyur/ /legs kyang srin bu'i shing rjes 'dra/ /de bas tshad ma'i khungs la sdog /rang blos bcad par mi nus tshe/ /sngon rabs mkhas gsungs rjes 'brang gces/ /de ni bstan pa'i gsal byed nyid/ /bdag ni so skye blo dman yang / /tshig 'di rgyal ba'i rjes su 'brang / /des na 'dam gyi pad+ma bzhin/ /skal ldan bung ba'i gso blang 'tshal/ /zhes pa'ang grub mtha' la nges shes cha tsam zhig rnyed pa'i rtogs brjod gu ru pad+ma'i bstod dbyangs su smras pas 'phros pa'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /༄sto /bcom ldan 'das srun ras gzigs dbang / dpal (sprul pa)rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la gsol 'debs rab snyan lha yi ja sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me r+ghaṃ/ mkha' khyab sangs rgyas kun gyi 'khor los bsgyur/ /gzi brjid tshe 'od dpag med bcom ldan 'das/ /'gro ba 'dul phyir rgyal sras tshul bzung zhing / /sangs rgyas kun gyi sprul gzhi byed pa po/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho yid bzhin nor bu mchog /pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor mnga' bdag thugs rje'i gter/ /sems can kun la rtag dgyes spyan ras gzigs/ /'od zer dpal rtsegs rgyal por gsol ba 'debs/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang sprul pa'i zlos gar ni/ /nam mkha'i mthar thug tshad bzung bgrang las 'das/ /bzang mthong zhing 'dir gtso mchog rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bcu phrag brgya dang 'khor los bsgyur rgyal stong / /kun gyi 'phrin las gcig bsdus sirtsa'i mtshor/ /rang byung rig mchog thub chen pad+ma 'byung / /rgyal kun gsang gsum yongs bsdus rgyal tshab tshul/ /gu ru bde ba che der gsol ba 'debs/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang mkha' khyab 'gror rtse bzhin/ /g.yel med skyongs las lhag tu gdul dka' yi/ /lha skal zhal bzhes gdong dmar bod kyi ched/ /spyi bor a mi ta bha'i cod paṇa can/ /mtshan dpe yongs rdzogs chos kyi rgyal po'i tshul/ /rdzu 'phrul bkod pa rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i bdag /ye shes rdo spya~X sku mi

mngon ston pa'i/ /'phags mchog srong btsan sgam por gsol ba 'debs/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang 'dzam gling sī ta'i byang / /bye ba dgu bcu rtsa drug yul bdag po/ /rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bus mngon btud pa'i/ /gangs ldan cha bsags seng khrir mi dbang che/ /lha yi lus gyur 'chi med mtshan dpe can/ / pad+ma dkar po la sogs rigs ldan dang / /sī ta'i lho phyogs o rgyan rgya hor li/ /bal bod sogs su 'jig rten dbang phyug gi /sprul pa'i rgyal po rnams dz+ra spyan ras gzigs dbang bud med gzugs snang ba/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i sprul pa'i zlos gar las/ /dpal mdzad bde ba'i dngos grub mkha' spyod gtso/ /mtsho yi pad+mo grub rgyal nges sbas bdag /du mar 'char ba kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /gangs can 'gro la bka' drin zla med mgon/ /ye shes rgya mtsho rgyas pa'i gter 'chang ba/ /ma cig sprul pa bcas la tsho spyan ras gzigs dbang gcig char skyes bu'i tshul/ /yongs bzung mda' snun chen po sgra gcan 'dzin/ /rab dga'i sa la bzhugs tshul dpal mgon klu/ /de bzhin 'di byang sar gnas thogs med zhabs/ /gru 'dzin bdag por yongs gshegs tsan+d+ra go /byin rlabs chu rgyun bsdud mdzad te lo pa/ /ye shes sgyu ma'i sku shar dga' ba'i bshes/ /mi tra dzo kir grags la 〉 spyan ras gzigs dbang grub chen chos sprin par/ /bzhugs bstan dam pa rgya dkar mi pham mgon/ /rnal 'byor tshul bzung go rak+ṣa nā tha/ /gnas lnga rig pa chen po bod kyi lha/ /mar me mdzad dpal ye shes a ti sha /de bzhin dbus 'gyur paṇa chen 'jigs med 'byung / kha che bsod snyoms par snang shākya shrī/ /skal bzang sems dpa' sprul la 〉 spyan ras gzigs dbang byang chub lam spyod tshul/ /'brom ston rgyal 'byung rnal 'byor dgon pa ba/ /sku mched rigs gsum mgon zhes bka' gdams te/ /jo bo'i rjes 'jug dam pa'i tshogs spyi dang / /yongs 'dzin bshes gnyen blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ /dngos rgyud slob ma'i tshogs dang spyi'i 'dren pa/ /blo bzang rgya mtsho'i rgyal bstan sgron me che/ /yab sras skyes mchog rnams la dz+ra spyan ras gzigs dbang rnal 'byor ras pa'i tshul/ /rje btsun mi la zhu bde'i 'bras bu rgyas/ /ras chung rdor grags mkha' spyod zhing gi bdag /gtsang pa rgya ras 'gro ba yongs kyi mgon/ /lo rgod dbon ras sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i bdag /rgyal mtshan dpal bzang nges don snying po'i mdzod/ /byang 'bum rin dpal phrin las rab 'byams 'chang / /skye rgyud slob tshogs bcas la ྾ spyan ras gzigs dbang nges don ston bsgom tshul/ kha rag sgom chung sgrub rgyud rna ba'i rgyan/ /khyung po tshul mgon sgyu lus grub kun gtso/ /dwags po lha rje pad 'byung thugs las sprul/ /rdor rgyal zhang tshal kun tu 'od sar bzhugs/ /zla rgyal skyer sgang tshel bu dam pa dmar/ /'bri stag skyes mchog gzhan phan rgya mtsho'i sprin/5/ñtsha sprul rgyud 'dzin bcas la dz+ra spyan ras gzigs dbang shākya'i dge slong tshul/ /kun gzigs

chos kyi grags ldan mkhyen brtse nus/ /'dzam gling rgyan gyur dpal chen chos bla ma/ /kun bzang rdo rje ljags kyi thal 'gyur du/ /lung bstan 'phags mchog rang byung rdo rje sems/ /dngos tshul rdo rje'i cod paṇa 'dzin bcu gsum/ /slob tshul pad+ma'i cod paṇa 'dzin nyer gcig /yab sras slob mar bcas la gsol ba 'debs/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang mkhas mchog gnyis smra'i tshul/ /blo sher byams dpal rgyal bstan 'byung khungs che/ /gnas lnga rig gtso sa paṇa 'gro ba'i mgon/ /yongs rdzogs bstan sgron zha lu bo dong ba/ /bde gshegs snying po'i gtam mchog smra ba'i seng / /dol po kun mkhyen shes rab rgyal mtshan dpal/ /blo gros mthu chen mchog ldan legs blo sogs/ /bstan pa'i shing rta rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang rigs sngags 'chang ba'i tshul/ /'jig rten kun mig rong zom chos bzang po/ /zab gter ston pa'i tshul gyur myang ral can/ /chos dbang rgod ldem sangs rgyas gling sogs dang / /phyogs dus rdzogs sangs rgyas kun thugs kyi dpyid/ /ma lus gcig char ston phyir spyan ras gzigs/ /ngag dbang dri med 'od zer dri med bshes/ /rgyal kun ngo bor 'char la mo spyan ras gzigs dbang snyigs dus 'gro 'dren dpal/ /zhi ba sbas pa bde chen rdo rje'i sku/ /rgyal kun gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin sgrol ba'i mgon/ /zhig po 'ja' tshon gter bzhad klong gsal snying / /stag sham rdo rje rol pa bde chen gling / /'khor lo'i dbang phyug karma rig pa 'dzin/ /dpal mchog dang po chos dbang kun bzang dbang / /khyab bdag rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang sprul pa'i rol gar las/ /yongs grub 'gro ba'i 'dren pa mtha' dag dang / /khyad par gangs ri'i khrod kyi skyes bu mchog /gyur kun spyan ras gzigs kyi sgyu 'phrul te/ /mkhas btsun grub pa'i brtul zhugs spyod pa dang / /zhi chags drag po tha mal tshul la sogs/ /ma nges lkog gyur du mas 'gro 'dul mdzad/ /kun la snying nas gus pas gsol 'debs kyi/ /de ltar thugs rje chen sprul bla ma'i tshogs/ /kun la rtse gcig gus pas gsol btab mthus/ /bdag ni dus 'di nas bzung tshe rabs kun/ /bzod pa mchog gyur yongs su ma thob bar/ /ngan 'gro spang zhing mtho ris yon tan bdun/ /'phags nor bdun brgyan dal 'byor rten bzang thob/ /des kyang mi dge'i bshes gnyen yongs spangs nas/ /dge bshes dam pas rjes su bzung bar shog /dad pa brtan tshugs nges 'byung rnam par dag /rgyu 'bras yid ches dge sdig spang blangs mkhas/ /lhag bsam phul byung byang chub spyod par brtson/ /khyad par smin grol gdeng thob slob dpon gyi/ /rjes bzung dpal ldan sngags rgyud nas gsung pa'i/ /dam tshig bcas la 'da' med rnam par dag /rim gnyis yon tan mtha' dag grub par shog /mdor na skye kun lha mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /slob dpon thob nas zhal blta gsung rtag nyan/ /ci mnyes ched du lus srog ltos med 535

bsnyen/ /khyed kyi dgyes dgu bdag gi thogs med 'grub/ /'od dpag med mgon spyan ras gzigs dbang po/ /pad 'byung sprul par bcas pas theg chen gyi/ /smon lam gang btab ji bzhin bdag gi 'grub/ /mgon khyod go 'phang bdag gi myur thob shog /de ltar bdag gi legs spyad dge ba'i mthu/ /yongs bsdoms mkha' mnyam 'gro kun la bsngo bas/ /de dag sdug bsngal sel gyur dge ba thob/ /byang chub che 'bras ring min rnyed gyur cig /sh+lau ka 37 zhes pa'ang ri kha ba can gyi khongs rgyal bstan ris su ma chad par kha tsam ma yin snying nas dag snang gi blo mig rgyas pas grub mtha' tha dad kyi skyes bu chen po yongs grags rnams la gsol 'debs shig 'bri 'dun yod pa las nye lam gtsang snye mo bya go ba thon rigs mi rje phun tshogs bkra shis dbang phyug gi thugs rje chen po'i gsol 'debs shig dgos zhes gsol ba btab pas rkyen byas rang dang bskal mtshungs tshul 'di ltar don du gnyer ba dag la sman —pa'i ched du skyes bu dam pa rnams thugs rje chen po'i sprul par nges pa'i sgo nas rgyas par rgyun gyi kha 'bri 'don du ma bde dog da lam 'phags pa'i sprul pa che long tsam gyi gsol 'debs nyung ngur dril ba ste 'di ni mdo khams kaḥthog lho rgyud 'od gsal lha las bab pa dngu yi rigs su skyes gyur shākya'i dge bsnyen rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho'am kun bzang 'phrin las 'gro ba yongs 'dul rtsal gyis me 'brug sa ga zla ba'i dkar phyogs tshes lnga'i snga char grub par snye mo pa gor be+e ro'i sgrub phug tu bris pa ste/ /dge bas 'gro kun rgyud la ris med dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi byin brlab snying la zhugs shing 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang la myur du 'khod par gyur cig dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /rog /'phags pa sprun ras gzigs kyi bstod pa pad dkar rgyas pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /zho swāsti/ nam mkha'i mthar thug chos dbyings ye shes khams/ /dri med ngo bor rtag bzhugs rgyal kun gyi/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin gcig tu bsdus pa'i gzugs/ /'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 1 dang po'i sangs rgyas kun bzang 'od mi 'gyur/ /tshe dang ye shes dpag med snang mtha' yas/ /sras tshul 'gro kun 'dren mdzad 'phrin las can/ /'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 2 longs spyod rdzogs sku'i zhing na a ro lika /srid zhi kun gyi spyi dpal gnyen gcig pu/ /thub chen 'jig rten dbang phyug gangs can mtsho/ /'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 3 mi mjed 'jig rten 'og min gnas nyid du/ /gtsang ma lha yi bu gyur dbang phyug che/ /sprul pa bye ba phrag brgya'i gzhi sprul pa'i/ /'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /4 mi mjed 'dzam gling ri bo gru 'dzin du/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug tshul bzung srid gsum mgon/ /sdug 536

bsngal che la lhag par brtse ba'i bdag /'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo 5bzang po'i kalpar sgron ma sangs rgyas stong / /'khor los bsgyur ba stong gi sku 'phrul mdzad/ /nam mkha'i rgyal po rgyal ba kun gyi yab/ /'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 6 gang 'dul sku yi rol pa bsam yas pas/ /rigs drug duḥ kha mtha' dag sel mkhas shing / /khams gsum 'khor ba dong nas sprug mdzad mgon/ /'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 7 khyed ni bdag gi tshe rabs yun gyi lha/ /srog gi phyir yang mi spang yi dam ste/ /thags rje'i spyan gyi gzigs shig spyan ༄ras gzigs/ /byin gyis rlobs shig 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon/ / 8 bdag ni dus 'di nas bzung byang chen bar/ /'phags mchog khyed kyi dge ba'i bshes mdzad nas/ /mi dge log pa'i lam nas bzlog pa dang / /byang chub mchog gi bshul du dkri mdzod cig / 9 bdag nyid mthong thos dran reg 'gro kun yang / /'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal bzang po/ /sgrib ldan byis pa nyid nas lta nus shing / /gsung gi snang ba thob cing chos spyod shog / 10 khyed mthu'i bdag cag so skye phal nyid nas/ /'phags chen rgyal ba'i rnam thar rjes su slob/ /'brel tshad thar pa mchog gi sar bkod pa'i/ /rmad byung rlabs chen spyod pa rtag thob shog / 11 bdag sogs 'brel par bcas kun 'chi ba'i dus/ /de ma thag par nub phyogs bde chen zhing / /pad+mar rdzus skyes sangs rgyas sras bcas mjal/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i go 'phang der thob shog / 12 mdor na 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs/ /khyed kyi byang chub smon lam ji 'dra ba/ /mngon mtho nges legs yon tan 'phrin las bzang / /de 'dra kho na bdag gi myur 'grub shog / 13 ces 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs la bstod pa pad dkar rgyas pa zhes bya ba 'di yang sdig sgrib nyes skyon zad par byed pa zad byed lo snron gyi zla bar byang gnam gyi dbu rir grub pa'i slob dpon chen po rgyal ba lo ras kyi sku gdung mthong grol zhig gso yang dag bgyid pa'i skabs rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus smras pa'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/537

rog /rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sku rmi lam du mjal ba la bstod pa mdongs mtha' can gyi gar bsgyur zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ swāsti/ rnam dag rgyal ba'i zhing khams g.yu lo bkod/ /yid 'ong rab maldas mar gad sa gzhi la/ /'dod dgu lhun grub dpag bsam nags tshal 'khrigs/ /ut+pal 'phreng ba rnam par bkra la 'dud//spos kyi sprin lding me tog char pa 'bebs/ /yan lag brgyad ldan bdud rtsi'i mtsho chu g.yo/ /ri dwags bya tshogs rkang drug 'phur lding zhing / /byang chub sems ldan 'gro bas gang la 'dud/ /'chi med grub pa drang srong lha yi tshogs/ /rig pa 'dzin pa du mas yongs gang zhing / /'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug bral ba yi/ /bde ba mchog gi zhing khams de la 'dud/ /de dbus bkod legs khrus kyi rdzing bu'i nang / /'dab stong ut+pal nyi zla sgra gcan steng / /haṃ yig las skyes dus gsum rgyal kun gyis/ /yum gyur 'phags ma de la gus pas 'dud/ /mthing ljags zhal gcig ral mjes spyan gsum ldan/ /phyag gnyis g.yas pas mchog sbyin phyag rgya dang / /g.yon pas pad sdong las skyes byang chub shing / /me tog rgyas pa skyab rgyas 'dzin la 'dud/ /dbu skra rtag par bcing zhing gtsug tor rtser/ /rigs kyi bdag po 'od dpag med pa bzhugs/ /rin chen du ma'i rgyan gyis yongs mdzes shing / /pañtsa li ka'i smad g.yog gsol la 'dud/ /zhal gyi dkyil 'khor rab sgeg 'od zer gyi/ /cha shas zur tsam gyis kyang 'jig rten 'dir/ /tshangs pa'i bu mo 'bum kyang mog mog por/ /byed mdzad 'phags ma sgrol ma de la 'dud/ /zhabs gnyis drang por bzhengs shing gdan la brten/ /bcu drug lang mtsho dkar 'dzin chu 'dzin rgyas/ /zur mig mda' yi zag zad dgra bcom yang / /yid bsrub blang nus rab mdzes khyod la 'dud/ /khyod ni 'das dang da lta ma 'ongs kyi/ /rgyal ba kun gyi bskyed pa'i yum du gyur/ /mtshan thos tsam gyi sdug bsngal kun sel zhing / /bde ba rgyas mdzad bcom ldan ma la 'dud/ /khyod nyid yid byas gus pas gsol btab na//'di dang phyi ma bar do dge ba yi/ /'dod don yongs ster mthun 'jug byang chen yang / /stsol bar mdzad pa'i dam bca' mchis zhes na/ /bdag gi khyod sku sgom zhing gus pa'i yid/ /rtse gcig gdung bas gsol ba 'debs byed kyi/ /'jigs zhi 'byor rgyas dgra bgegs gdug pa sgrol/ /khams gsum dbang du 'ahā 3༵'i dngos grub stsol/ /bdag nyid gang du gnas pa'i yul phyogs der/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa dri

med gong du 'phel/ /rgyal blon dge ldan chab srid dar zhing rgyas/ /mi phyugs nad med dmag 'khrug rtsod pa zhi/ /rdzogs ldan dang po ji bzhin gnas par mdzod/ /khyad par bdag mthong thos dran reg pa'i 'gro/ /kun kyang sgrib tshogs byang nas mchog 'bras smin/ /'chi tshe bar dor lha khyod zhal mthong zhing / /bde ba can gyi zhing du 'dren par shog /mdor na dus 'di nas bzung byang chub bar/ /'phags ma khyod kyis byin gyis brlabs nas kyang / /sa lam yon tan myur rdzogs 'od dpag med/ /ji bzhin bdag sogs 'gro la yongs grub shog /ces mi lam gyi snang bar 'phags ma de lta bu'i tshul mjal bas rkyen byas mon gyi rgyal po zung gi 'chings bsgrigs kyi skabs kag zhes par rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus sbyar ba'i yi ge'i ris ni shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa karma nges don chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis bgyis pa dge'o/ /ho he/ rgyal ba yongs kyi yum gyur sher phyin ma/ /kun tu bzang po de bzhin gshegs gyur ma/ /rab 'byams dkyil 'khor gtso mchog bcom ldan ma/ /khyod zhabs dran pas 'jigs sel rnal 'byor ma/ / 1 yang dag don du rang rig gdod ma'i gshis/ /rdo rje can ma nyid yin 'du 'brel med/ /'on kyang de nyid mngon du ma gyur bar/ /dam ye'i tshul gyi yi dam bsnyen byed bzhin/ / 2 bdag gi yun nas lha yi lha mchog ma/ /khyed bsnyen rtag tu gus pas gsol 'debs na/ /'di ltar gnas skabs blang dor gnas tsam yang / /mi ston g.yel bar bor ba ci zhig byung / / 3 'jig rten 'dre ngan yi dwags phra mo yang / /gus bsnyen byas shing blang dor gnas ston na/ /rtse gcig gsol ba 'debs la bcom ldan mas/ /btang snyoms mdzad na thugs rje che zhes ci/ / 4 bem po'i rang bzhin nor bu 'bar ba yang / /sems can re ba yid bzhin bskang mdzad na/ /khyod ni lha yi lha zhes 'khor 'das mgon/ /grub bzhin bdag gi re ba cis mi bskangs/ / 5 sgrib pa che zhes g.yel bar bor mdzad na/ /sgrib pa med tshe khyod kyi thugs rjes ci/ /bdag ni sgrib ldan skyabs dang mgon med na/ /thugs rje chen mo'i spyan gyis da gzigs shig / 6 las la yid ches bzhin du bden 'bras gang / /btang snyoms bzhag na khyod kyi dam bcas ci/ /mi bzod duḥ khas gzir ba'i skye bo rnams/ /las kyi mthu zhes khyed kyi spangs mdzad na/ / 7 bcom ldan 'das ma tshad med thugs rje can/ /ming tsam kho nas 'gro la ji ltar phan/ /'jig rten lha chen mthus kyang lus 'ga' zhig /ring du spang bar nus na lha yi lha/ /8 khyod kyi nus mthu'i 'gro ba'i las ngan yang / /ring spangs gzhil ba'i 'phrin las cis mi mdzad/ /lha r+bha/ o rgyan yul gyi dbang phyug dkyil 'khor gtso/ /lhan skyes ye shes mkha' 'gros 'khor lo bsgyur/ /9 bcom ldan thugs rje'i spyan ras ma btul zhig /dag pa ye shes snyan gyis mi gsan nam/ /mkha' khyab mkhyen pa'i thugs kyis midagongs sam/ /skad cig rdzu 'phrul zhabs kyis mi bgrod dam/ 5/3910

sngon gyi zhal bzhes bden tshig ma bslu bar/ /'dir gshegs bdag gi 'gro la phan don du/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la lhag par bsam pa'i don/ /'bad pa chen pos gsol ba btab pa 'di/ /11 ji bzhin re ba'i 'bras bu bslu med par/ /dus 'di nyid du gsal bar ston mdzod kyai/ /yang lcags rta lor rje btsun sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pa yin/ /rog /'jam dpal gyi lha tshogs la phyag 'tshal ba rdo rje dga' ba'i rgyud mang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /o swāsti/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kun gzigs 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig thog mtha' dbus med cing / /chos kun ngo bo chos kyi dbyings/ /rtag tu zhi ba g.yung drung che/ /'jam dpal kun tu bzang la 'dud/ / 1 rnam pa thams cad khyed kyi sku/ /de bzhin sgra tshig kun kyang gsung / /yid kyang khyod kyi sgyu 'phrul ste/ /kun kyang 'jam dpal nyid la 'dud/ / 2de lta na'ang sems can gyis/ /blo yi dri ma sbyangs slad du/ /dri ma med pa ye shes sku/ /mtshan dpe kun tu rgyas la 'dud/ / 3 chos kun nam mkha' lta bu la/ /phyogs ris spros pa'i yul las 'das/ /'on kyang gdul bya mos pa'i blo/ /tha dad snang ngor theg pa'i tshul/ / 4 rim par rgyu dang 'bras bu'i chos/ /gsang ba sngags rgyud kri ya dang / /u pa ya dang yo ga dang / /bla med ston mdzad khyod la 'dud/ /5 bya rgyud dpa' bo gcig grub 'jam dpal gzhon nu chu skyes tshul/ /'o ma'i mtsho dbus pad dkar 'dab stong zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng / /gzhon nu brgyad gnyis lang tsho zla ba chu shel ltar dkar sku/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan dang dpe byad brgyad cu yongs su rdzogs/ / 6 phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon pas rtsa ba mtheb srin gyis bzung ba'i/ /ut+pal dkar po snyan thad gyes steng sher phyin glegs bam mdzes/ /dar dkar stod g.yogs sna tshogs smad dkris zhabs gnyis rdor dkyil bzhugs/ /bung ba ltar nag zur phud lnga yis rab mdzes der phyag 'tshal/ / 7 spyod rgyud bya spyod thun mong ma yin gsang ba'i bdag po phyag rdor dbang bskur rgyud chen por/ /'jam dpal nyid dang gsang ba'i bdag po mthu stobs gcig nyid du/ /ston slad rdo rje can gyi mtshon cha rang gi mtshan ma gang / /ut+pal dbus su nyer bzung don chen don ldan rab mdzes pa/ / 8 dkar sngo rin chen prog zhus dbu brgyan phyag g.yas ye shes kyis/ /ral gri snon po 'phyar bas mi shes drwa ba mtha' dag bcod/ /khro 'dzum rdo rje'i gdan gyi pad zla nyi dal la bzhugs pa/ /bcom ldan 'jam dpal rdo rje 'dzin mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 9 'jam 540

dpal sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i glu nyid mtshan brjod zhes kyang bya/ /rgyud rnams kun khyab dang po'i sangs rgyas spyi ti yo ga ste/ /gsang ba'i mdzod de rnal 'byor yo ga'i rgyud kyang kun tu grags/ /mtshan brjod 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' dkar la gser ba'i mdangs/ / 10 do ker lnga bcings phyag bzhi dang po gnyis kyis ral gri dang / /ut+pal glegs bam gyis spras 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu/ /'dzam bu'i chu gser dra ba brgyan 'phreng yongs sprad 'ja' tshon gyis/ /smad dkris pad zlar rdo rje skyil krung mdzad der phyag 'tshal lo/ / 11 bla med pha rgyud gsang 'dus dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i dbang phyug che/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje zhal gsum rtsa zhal sku lus gur gum mdog /g.yas sngo sngon dkar phyag drug dang po rang snang yum la 'khyud/ /bar ma ral gri ut+pal mtha' gnyis mda' dang gzhu 'dzin mdzad/ /12 ral pa zur phud lnga bcings snyan gong ut+pal lteng ka can/ /rin chen rgyan ldan dar gyi chas rdzogs rdo rje skyil krung gi /pad zla la bzhugs rang 'od yum gyur rang 'dra nyid dang sbyor/ /'od zer lnga ldan kun tu 'phro gyur de la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 13 bla med ma rgyud 'khor lo bde mchog 'jam pa'i rdo rje ni/ /zhal drug rtsa zhal sku lus li khri mdangs ldan g.yas g.yon zhal/ /sngo ser ljang dmar steng zhal dkar po rab zhi gzhan kun khros/ /thod skam u rgyan sangs rgyas lngas spras ral pa do ker can/ / 14 bcu gnyis phyag brgya g.yas lnga rdo rje ral gri lcags skyu mda'/ cang te'i g.yon la dril bu ut+pal zhag pa gzhu mtshang mgo/ /mtha' gnyis ma tshangs pags zhabs gnyis bskyang skum pad nyir dregs dus gnas/ /phag mo la 'khyud ho ru ka dpal de la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 15 de ltar rgyud sde rnam pa bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i skur snang mdzad/ /khyab bdag 'jam dpal dpa' bo la/ /snying nas gus pas phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 16 kun rdzob 'dus byas 'byung ba bzhir/ /'dus ma byas pa mkha' khyab gdal/ /ye shes lha yi sgyu 'phrul che/ /bden gnyis zung 'jug la phyag 'tshal/ /17 rang byung dur khrod 'jigs rung rba dong dang por bzhugs pa'i lha/ /'jam dpal sku mdog puṇ+ḍa ri ka ji bzhin dkar ba yi/ /zhal bzhi rab mjes phyag brgyad dang po rdo rje dril bu yi/ /sher phyin ma 'khyud de 'og nyid kyi ral gri ud pa la/ /18 gsum pa mda' gzhu bzhi pa lcags kyu zhags pa bsnam pa'i pang / /sher phyin dmar mo gri khug thod pa 'dzin dang mnyam sbyor zhabs/ /rdo rje pad+ma'i skyil krung dar dang rin chen rus pa'i brgyan/ /yongs spras mtshan dpe rab rdzogs pad zlar bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 19 rang byung dur khrod 'jigs rung rba dong gnyis par bzhugs pa'i lha/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal gshin rje'i gshed po gdong drug pa//zhal drug kun kyang rab khros mthing ka steng zhal lhag par gnag /phyag drug g.yas gsum ra ldan rdo rje tho ba 'phyar/ / 20 g.yon gsum zhags pas khams gsum ma lus 'ching bar byed/ /zhabs drug rdo 541

rje'i skyil krung dor stabs dang ni gar stabs kyi/ /'chi bdag bdud bzhi pho mo rab mnan ye shes me klong du/ /dpa' gtum dur khrod chas brgyan pad nyir bzhugs der phyag 'tshal lo/ / 21 rang byung dur khrod 'jigs rung rba dong gsum par bzhugs pa'i lha/ /dpal chen thugs sprul tshe bdag mthing nag dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad/ /steng gsum khyung dang rma bya kang ka bar gsum khro ba'i zhal/ /mthing dmar dkar po 'og gsum stag seng ma he khros pa'i gdong / / 22 g.yas dgu 'khor lo ral gri rdo rje kha ṭaṃ mdung zhing dbyug /rdo rje rgya gram mda' phur g.yon dgu be con gtun shing dang / /rgyu ma sbrul
