zhags sdig mdzub tri shul dgra sta gzhu mi snying / /dur khrod chas rdzogs zhabs brgyad ru tra rdzi der phyag 'tshal lo/ / 23 rang byung dur khrod 'jigs rung rba dong bzhi par bzhugs pa'i lha/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug 'char kha nag po sku che yan lag rags/ /dbu skra dmar ser thor tshugs rtse mor sku gdung mchod rten dkar/ /g.yas g.yon phyag na mchod rten dmar dang nag po rab tu brjid/ / 24zhabs gnyis bskyang bskum dgra bgegs kun mnan 'khor lo'i gdan la bzhugs/ /thod skam dbu brgyan mgo 'phreng do shal stag sham mi pags gos/ /gdug pa'i sbrul dang rus pa'i rgyan ldan khrag zhags thal chen byug /srid gsum ltor 'chang mi bzad khro bo de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /25 rang byung dur khrod 'jigs rung rba dong lnga par bzhugs pa'i lha/ /sprul pa'i sprul pa las kyi tshul 'chang gshin rje chos kyi rgyal/ /dmar smug spyan gsum sdang mig zhal gdangs mche ba zang yag gcigs/ /skra ser gyen brdzes smin ma sma tshom me yi klog stong 'khyug / 26 thod skam dbu rgyan thod rlon do shal zhing pags stod g.yogs gsol/ /stag sham sbrul dang rus pa'i rgyan spras chu glang sngon po'i khrir/ /btsan skyil gyis bzhugs phyag gnyis khram bam dang ni zhags pa bsnams/ /lho phyogs skyong mdzad srog bdag de la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 27 de ltar chos gnyis skye med ngang / /'gag med gzugs sku'i rol pa ni/ /cir yang ston nas 'gro don mdzad/ /sna tshogs gzugs can la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 28 gangs can bod yul shing lo'i tshal/ /zad pa lho mon rgya gar gyi/ /chu mgo sbas yul dgu rgya la/ /rang byung dur khrod che der 'dud/ / 29 las kyi gshin rje rtag gnas grong / /'jam dpal dpa' bos byin brlabs shing / /rang byung sku gsung thugs kyi rten/ /'gro ba'i dpal du bzhugs der 'dud/ / 30 don dam spros pa'i yul las 'das/ /'gro don gzugs sku cir yang spro/ /bem po'i tshul la sems pa gsum/ /bden gnyis zung 'jug snang der 'dud/ / 31 sku bsnyan rdo rje'i brag la shar/ /gsung dbyangs chu rgyun trī:ṣ+ṭi'i sgra/ /chad med chos dbyings ngang du gnas/ /byin rlabs mthu dang ldan der 'dud/ / 32khyad sdu~X thugs rten bum pa ni/ /rdo rje'i yo las ches 'bur tshul/ /khri 'phang bang rim bum pa ste/ /chos

'khor mngon snang der gus 'dud/ / 33 de ltar brten dang rten pa'i tshul/ /'jam dpal sku gsung thugs rdo rje/ /sgyu 'phrul dpag yas snang ba la/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal gsol 'debs pas/ / 34bdag sogs 'gro ba'i sgrib gnyis dag /tshogs gnyis yon tan rab tu rgyas/ /'jam dpal dpa' bo de ji 'dra'i/ /go 'phang ring min myur thob shog / 35 ces kong yul rgya lha rang byung mchod rten gyi zhabs rtogs su gtsug lag khang gru bzhi 'dom gang pa zhig bzhengs pa'i logs ris bris yig dang lhan cig 'jam dpal lha tshogs la phyag 'tshal ba rdo rje dga' ba'i rgyud mangs zhes bya ba 'di yang rang gi slob ma rnam dpyod kyi snang ba rgyas pa 'jam dbyangs blo gros rab rgyas pas gsol ba btab pa'i ngor 7dpal rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu rdo rje gzi bajid kyis bsrung byed me stag gi lo snron zla'i tshes bzang por bod yul dbus rus cha gzhu tshur mtshams rgyal ba lo ras kyi bste gnas byang gnam dbu ris 'bris pa dge'o/ /dge'o//bya rgyud kyi gtso bo 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud yin yang / bri bde ba'i 'dir dpa' bo gcig grub kyi mngon rtogs ltar dang phyag na rdo rje'i dbang bskur kyi rgyud’bya rgyud shas che yang / mkhas pa kha cig gi spyod rgyud sogs dang thun mong du bkral ba ltar 'dir spyod rgyud du bsdus pa yin la/ de ltar bya spyod rnal 'byor bla med pha ma gnyis kyi lha log g.yas su bris shing / tho dong gi lha lnga ni g.yon logs su 'bri ba yang shes par bya'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/ de bzhin ze phu'i lha khang der/ dbus su ma hā mā ya dang / g.yas su slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dkon mchog spyi 'dus zhi drag seng gsum gyi mtshon pa dang / g.yon ngos su grub thob chen po ku ku ri pa/ ri gli nā ros mtshon ji ltar 'os pa 'bri lugs kyis sa legs par gum/ shu r+ghaṃ/ 543

a+yo /dpal dam pa dang po'i sangs rgyas dus 'khor brgyud pa'i bla ma rgyal sras gyur sham+bha lar seṅge'i gdan can chos rgyal rig ldan rnams la phyag 'tshal ba gangs can zla ba'i chu gter zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /o swā sti sid+dhaskyo/ na mo gu ra we/ na ma:shrī/ kā la tsakra ya/ bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /phan bde'i sprin phung cher dgyes de bzhin gshegs/ /sa bcu'i mnga' bdag kun gyi thugs gsang bcud/ /bdud rtsi'i char gyis skal ldan tshim mdzad pa'i/ /dngos brgyud dpal ldan bla ma rgyal gyur gcig /mchog tu mi 'gyur bde ba chen po'i ngo bo nyid/ /mi shig dngas ma thig le rnam pa thams cad pa/ /kun tu mchog ldan rig pa dpal mchog rdo rje sems/ /kun tu bzang po dus kyi 'khor lor phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdod ma nyid nas rang byung sangs rgyas dam pa dang po'i mgon/ /skye 'jig 'gyur med spros bral kun khyab mi 'gyur bde ba che/ /rnam kun mchog ldan rnam pa thams cad sna tshogs dbang po ni/ /kun tu bzang po 'od mi 'gyur ba rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ / 1 gtsang bde rtag pa bdag gi phar phyin cha med kun 'gro ba/ /thig le chen po yi ge drug dang stong chen yi ge lnga/ /zung 'jug dus kyi 'khor lo nor bu pad+ma sangs rgyas kun/ /'byung gnas e waṃ ngo bo nyid la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 2 kun tu bzang po chos dbyings g.yung drung ngang las ma g.yos par/ /mkha' khyab sgyu 'phrul dra ba rgya mtsho spro dang bsdu bar snang / /rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul dra ba he ru ka shrī dang / /yang dag mnyam sbyor mkha' 'gro sdom pa che mchog rngam pa glog /3 rig pa'i khyu byug kun 'dus rig pa kun byed rgyal po che/ /dpal mchog dus 'khor sna tshogs dbang po a ti yo ga sogs/ /du ma'i mtshan sprad gzugs sku rgya mtsho'i 'char gzhi chos kyi sku/ /thig le nyag gcig ngo bo nyid sku che der phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 4 dang po'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po gdul bya'i don du sku/ /lha mi'i bla ma shākya thub zhes mi mjed zhing gi dpal/ /yongs su snang ste thun mong du yang grangs med bskal ba'i sngon/ /dbang po'i rtogs dang spyan chen po'i zhes yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /5 slar yang 'gro ba'i don brtson shākya'i rigs su nyer bltams nas/ /bcu gnyis mdzad pas gdul dkaswā ༵dul mdzad sgyu 'phrul dra ba can/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje mi 'dzad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i bdag /

thub pa sangs rgyas shin tu zhi ba de la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 6 chos dbyings da la srid gsum rin chen dpung pa'i mchod rten dbus/ /bdud bzhi mnan steng sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar seng ge yi/ /rdo rje'i gdung steg chu skyes 'dab 'bum nyi zla sgra gcan steng / /gser sbyangs btso ma 'ba' zhig las byas mi mjed bye ba brgya/ / 7 nyi ma rab bkram gyis 'khyud 'od mdangs kha dog bsdus 'dra'i sku/ /mtshan dpe rab brgyan rdo rje dkyil krung chos gos rnam gsum gsol/ /bdud 'dul ting 'dzin phyag brgya nyer bcas shin tu drang bar gzhugs/ /dpe med bla ma bcom ldan lha yi lha der phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 8 mu mtha' med pa'i bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa/ /yang dag sangs rgyas kun gyi yab gyur kun gyi gtso bo mchog /'jig rten mgon mdzad snang mdzad dag pa zhi ba zas gtsang sras/ /bsam gyis mi khyab bsam yas yul de dpe med dper bya ba/ / 9 gang sku bskal pa brgya mtshor bltas kyang ngom pas yongs su dbul/ /zhi chags khro gar cir yang ston kyang thugs rje'i dbang gi sdug /mkha' khyab brtan g.yo'i rdul phran gcig gi g.yo ba'ang sgrib med mkhyen/ /gsang gsum mkha' mnyam bde bar gshegs pa de la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 10 de sras bskal chen grangs med du ma'i sngon du sangs rgyas kyang / /gdul bya'i ched du byang chub sems dpa' sa bcu'i rgyun mtha' ni/ /chos kyi sprin chen dbang bsgyur dbang phyug chen po yongs sprul pa/ /nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam sgyu 'phrul rgya mtsho'i bdag la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 11 'dzam gling chung ngu'i byang phyogs sham+bha la zhes yul gyur ni/ /bye ba dgu bcu rtsa dgu'i dbus na mngon mtho kai la shas/ /yongs bskor bye ba bcu gnyis yul gyi snying por ka la pa'i/ /chos rgyal rigs ldan sa bcu'i dbang phyug rnams la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 12 chos rgyal rnams kyi dang po bgegs rnams mthar byed nyi ma'i 'od/ /sngo bsangs khro tshul am rtsig bsdam zhing ral pa wang mig ser/ /rin chen khri la rol pa'i 'dug stangs g.yon bskyangs pad+ma brdzis/ /phyag gnyis me 'bar ral gri phub bsor gar gyi phu dung can/ / 13 dgyes yum rdo rje gzhon nu lha mo rnam rgyal dkar ser mdog /yab la thabs sbyor shak+to ma 'khyud mnyam pa'i zhabs kyis bzhengs/ /ye shes sgyu ma'i 'khrul las bde ldan dbang po'i 'dzin pa'i yul/ /thabs mkhas dge ba'i sgo brgya 'byed par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo /14 rgyal ba kun gyis gsang gsum bdag po lag la rdo rje 'chang / /rdo rje zla ba'i 'od zer bzang po mthon mthing 'bar ba'i mdog /gtsug phud gsum pa rin chen prog zhu rdo rje nor bu'i tog /sku la me tog 'phreng ba rin chen dar gyis rgyan kun rdzogs/ / 15 phyag gnyis rnam rol phyag rgyas thugs kar ut+pal sngo dmar gyis/ /'bras bu rdo rje dang ni dril bus mtshan pa rtsa ba gzung / /sems pa'i skyil krung dag gi zla ba nyi ma pad+ma dang / /rin chen khri bzang dang bcas nor bu bye ba las byas pa'i/54/516

lha yi khang pa mchog gyur drag po 'jug sel dbyig snying dang / /mdzod ldan rnams kyi shugs bcas kyis btegs dbus su brjid par bzhugs/ /sku yi 'od zer mthon ka dngos por thog med mkha' mnyam 'phro/ /bgegs tshogs kun 'dul lha rnams yongs kyi dpa' bo rmad byung ba/ / 17 dgyes bskyed yum mchog rdo rje sgra dbyangs lha mo ni la'i mdog /sngo ba'i gos dang rin chen gyis spras yab gyi bskur brten nas/ /lha yi tasbu ra yi phreng spel yan lag drug cu'i sgra/ /ma lus sgrog mdzad de lta'i yab yum zung la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 18 sa yi snying po chos rgyal lha dbang dmar po rab tu mdzes/ /ral pa mthon mthing thor cog me tog sngon pos thod byas shing / /phyag g.yas ḍā ru g.yon na pad dkar nor bu brgyan pa bsnams/ /stod gcer rin chen rgyan spud lha gos smad g.yog nor bu'i khri/ / 19 gangs brag nags ris bskor dbus rin chen khang bzang dbus su ni/ /rol pa'i stabs bzhugs steng na mkha' lding dbang pos tshad skyobs 'dzin/ /dgyes yum gzugs kyi rdo rje dkar mo 'byor sgegs rgyan kun rgyas//me long 'dzin gyur de lta'i yab yum zung la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 20 gshin rje mthar byed chos rgyal gzi brjid ldan pa gser gyi mdog /ral pa dmar gser thod gtsug me gur 'bar zhing g.yo ba'i tshul/ /sku stod gcer bu 'ja' yis smad dkris stag lpags sham thabs can/ /rin po che dang sbrul gyis mjes rgyan zhabs gnyis rol pa'i stabs/ / 21 phyag gnyis gser gyi 'khor lo skye ba lnga pa'i dung gis brgyan/ /chu glang dmar po brgyad kyi btegs pa'i khri la brjid par bzhugs/ /dgyes yum shin tu stobs ma sngon mo 'ja' yi rmad dkris can/ /gri thod 'dzin gyur de lta'i yab yum zung la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 22 sgrib pa rnam sel chos rgyal zla bas byin pa sbur len mdog /ral pa'i do ker sku stod gcer bu nor bu'i do shal 'phyang / /dar gyi smad g.yog rin chen brag rir rol pa'i 'dug stangs can/ /pad+mar zhabs brtan sku la rin chen du mas mjes par byas/ / 23 ut+pal sngon po'i 'bras bus rdo rje mtshan g.yas pad+ma dmar/ /dril bus spras pa g.yon 'dzin phyag gnyis chos 'chad phyag rgya can/ /dgyes yum reg bya rdo rje sngon mo 'ja' tshon smad dkris can/ /lha gos 'dzin gyur de lta'i yab yum zung la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 24 shes rab mthar byed chos rgyal lha yi dbang phyug dmar 'tsher 'bar/ /dmar ser ral pa'i thor cog gzig lpags stod gos stag sham can/ /pad+ma dkar dmar sbrul gyis chun bo dag gi sku brgyan cing/ /seng ge sngon pos yongs su btegs pa'i rin chen khrir bzhugs zhabs/ /25byams pa'i bzhugs stangs kyis brjid phyag gi dkyil 'khor zung thag ni/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ka gyur dkar dang rin chen zhags pas mdzes par byas/ /dgyes yum kheng byed dkar mo khro mos chos can mi yi mda'/ /gzhu yi phyag brgyan de lta'i yab yum zung la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 26 pad+ma thar byed chos rgyal sna tshogs 546

gzugs ni gangs ri'i mdog /ral pa wang mig dmar ser sku la sbrul gyis chun pos mdzes/ /stod rjen pad+ma'i phreng ba dar gyi smad g.yog rin chen sprad/ /dpa' gtum stag gi btegs byed rin chen khri la rol stabs bzhugs/ / 27 phyag g.yas rin chen snying po las grub thos pa ngom pa'i tshul/ /g.yon na rab rgyas pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgya pa 'dzin/ /dgyes yum rmug byed dmar mo khro mo'i tshul 'chang cang til khrol/ /thod pa yab stobs de lta'i yab yum zung la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 28 nam mkha'i snying po chos rgyal lha yi dbang ldan dbang sngon mdog /thor tshugs me tog sngon po'i phreng bas thod bcing lus kun brgyan/ /lha gos sngon po sha mig sgrib pa'i na bza' lhab lhub gsol/ /rta mchog sngon po gsum gyis drangs ba'i rin chen khri bzang por/ / 29 dal po'i 'dug stangs dag gis bzhugs nas phyag gis pad+mo gathung / /rdo rje'i gri gug dang ni bde skyong bdud rtsis bkang bas brgyan/ /sna tshogs yum gyur dri ma ser mo spos bcas snod dang lha'i/ /me tog 'dzin mdzad de lta'i yab yum zung la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 30 gang zhig dpal mchog dam pa dang po'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /rgyud rgyal dus kyis 'khor lo 'dzin mdzad shing rta cher gyur pa/ /mkha' khyab 'gro la lhan gcig skyes dga' ye shes mchog gi dpal/ /stsol mdzad chos rgyal de lta'i yab yum rnams la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 31 sangs rgyas gnyis dang gnyis su med par dam pa dang po yis/ /rgyud rgyal stong phrag bcu gnyis stong phrag gcig tu bsdus mdzad pa'i/ /ston par yongs bsngags rgyal ba gnyis pa 'jam dpal gzhon nu ni/ /ma lus rdo rje'i rigs gcig bsdus mdzad chos rgyal rigs ldan che/ / 32 'jam dpal grags pa kha dog nyi ma stong gi 'od kyang zil non pa'i/ /dmar ser mdangs 'bar mdzes sdug lhun chags dpral bar mdzod spu can/ /mthon mthing ral pa zur phud lnga 'phyangs yid bzhin bsam 'phel gyi/ /prog zhu mdzes bcings bsnyen gong ut+pal sngon po'i gdan ka 'phyar/ / 33 lha gos lhab lhub nor bu me tog yid 'ong phreng ba ni/ /rab bzang spel legs sku la brgyan cing zhabs gnyis skyil mo krung / /rgyud rgyal glegs bam g.yon bsnams g.yas pa chos 'chad sku'i g.yas g.yon/ /ut+pal pad+ma sngo dkar ral gri dang ni glegs bam brgyan/ / 34 sku yi g.yon na dgyes yum 'phags ma sgrol ma ljang sngon mdzes/ /mtshar sdug lha gos rin chen brgyan spras ut+pal dkar po 'chang / /yab yum gnyis ka rin po che yi gdan gcig la gnas shing / /steng na nor bu'i gdugs rgyas 'og nas seng ge du mas stegs/ / 35 g.yon phyogs blon po byang sems blo gros rgya mtsho ag tshom gyis/ /brang mod gnon pa dar thod phod kha gsol ba thal sbyar 'grengs/ /mdun du drang srong nyi ma'i shing rta la sogs skal ldan mi/ /lha klung du mas yongs btud rgyal ba de la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 36 gsung gi rdo rje 'jig rten mgon po pad+ma 'byu~X ḍinas

ni/ /rdo rje'i rigs ldan pad+ma dkar zhes bde 'byung rgyal po'i tshul/ /rab dkar zla ba 'bum gyis gzi brjid 'phrogs cing mtshan dpes spras/ /lta na sdug pa'i rin chen khri la byams pa'i bzhugs btang gi/ /37 zhabs kyi mthil gnyis chu skyes dkar dmar zung gi ze'u 'bru gnon/ /phyag gi pad+mo tsin+ta ma ni'i phreng dang pad dkar brgyan/ /ri dwags pags pas nu ma g.yon bkab gser gyi tshang skud can/ /bung ba ltar nag ral pa'i thor cog ngos la 'od dpag med/ / 38 nyer rgyan rab tu dkar ba'i 'od la kha dog lnga yi zer/ /bye ba 'bum 'phro snying rje'i spyan ras zum med 'gro la gzigs/ /dgyes yum dkar sham chen mo pus btsug tsog bu rin chen brgyan/ /thal sbyar gtsor btud de lta'i yab yum zung la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 39 gshin rje mthar byed rigs ldan bzang po in+d+ra nī li'i mdog /khros pa'i nyam ldan dbu skra dmar ser tshom bu g.yas su 'khyil/ /stag sham sbrul chun rin chen rus pa'i brgyan gyis rab mdzes shing / /ma ho dreg pas bteg pa'i rin chen khri la rol btabs bzhugs/ / 40 rdo rje'i tog ldan rtsa bar nor bus spras pas dbyug pa ni/ /phyag g.yas mtshan zhing dbang gi lcags sgrog 'bar ba g.yon na bsnams/ /dgyes yum rdo rje ro langs nag mo khro 'dzum thod khrag g.yas/ /bla gos g.yon thog de lta'i yab yum zung la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 41 sa snying rigs ldan rnam rgyal sngo ljang kar ke ta yi mdog /rdo rje dang ni nor bu'i 'phreng bas yongs su brgyan byas shing / /smad g.yog ser po rin chen khri la rol pa'i stabs bzhugs mdun/ /lha yi na chung rnga brdung pi wang rgyud mangs thogs pas mchod/ /42 pad+ma dkar po nor bus brgyan pa g.yas kyi phyag na ste/ /'bras bu rgyas pa'i ljon shing yal ga g.yon gyi phyag nasabacings/ /dgyes yum gzugs kyi rdo rje dkar mo gar stabs phyag pad bskor/ /steng 'og la bsgyur de lta'i yab yum zung la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 43 shes rab mthar byed rigs ldan bshes gnyen bzang po dung ltar dkar/ /gcer bu stag sham sngo ljang gser ba'i sbrul gyis sku la brgyan/ /dmar ser ral mdzes khros pa'i nyams can phyag gnyis nor bu'i tog /rdo rje'i mas brten dbyug pa dang ni rdo rje'i zhags pa bsnams/ / 44 lha yi khye'u rin chen rgyan spras lha min skyes bu ni/ /go mtshon thogs pas yongs btegs rin chen khri la rol pa'i stabs/ /dgyes yum gzhan gyi mi thub ser mo g.yas pa thal mos btud/ /g.yon na zhags thogs de lta'i yab yum zung la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 45 phyag na rdo rje'i rigs ldan phyag dmar baiḍūr sngon po'i mdangs/ /rin chen prog zhu rdo rje phreng ba du mas sku la brgyan/ /'ja' yi smad g.yog rdo rje'i skyil krung phyag g.yas dgra sta dang / /g.yon na tshangs mgo ser po gdong bzhi me tog thod can bsnams/ / 46 seṅge yan lag drug pa glang chen gzugs byas dngul mdosdi ༵sa/ /li khri brang ldan ral pa dmar ser g.yo ba'i khri la bzhugs/ /dgyes yum rdo rje gar+ghaṃ ri sngo

mdzes pa'i nyams 'gyur bcas/ /rdo rjer dril 'dzin de lta'i yab yum zung la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /48 pad+ma mthar byed rigs ldan khyab 'jug sbas pa ches dmar ba/ /u dum wa ra'i mdang 'bar khro nyams dbu skra wang mig ser/ /rin chen sbrul gyi sku lus brgyan cing stag lpags sham thab byas phyag gnyis pad dkar 'dab brgya pa dang rin chen zhags pa bsnams/ / 48 klu rgyal rnams kyis btegs pa rin chen pad dkar nyi ma'i khrir/ /byams pa bzhugs stangs zhabs mthil nyer dga' dga' bos gus pas brten/ /dgyes yum rdo rje ral gcig nag mo sbrul brgyan sprin stag gos/ /gri thod 'dzin gyur de lta'i yab yum zung la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 49 nam mkha'i snying po rigs ldan nyi ma grags pa nam mkha'i mdog /rin chen pad+ma'i khri la 'ja' yi smad dkris sems skyil bzhugs/ /me tog sngon po'i brgyan spud ri dwags lpags gsol thor tshugs can/ /thugs kar chos 'chad phyag rgyas pad dkar ral gri mtshan pa g.yas/ / 50 ut+pal sngon po chos 'byung phyi dkar nang dmar spras g.yon bsnams/ /steng gi mkha' nas rin chen me tog 'thug po char du 'phro/ /dgyes yum rdo rje dri ma ser la dri zhim chu bzang gi/ /dung zhal 'dzin gyur de lta'i yab yum zung la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 51 bgegs rnams mthar byed rigs ldan shin tu bzang po 'thing nag mtsher/ /am gcig glang stag lpags gos rin chen dar brgyan sbrul chun spras/ /skra mtshams thod skam dbu skra dmar ser thor tshugs rdo rje'i tog /phyag gnyis rdo rje'i 'char 'bebs rdo rje dang ni sbrul zhags bsnams/ / 52 tsog pu phyed skyil rin chen khri bzang glang gdong dkar po dang / /phag gdong dmar po srin po smug pas bteg par bajid tshul bzhugs/ /dgyes yum reng byed sor mo 'khor lo nor bu sprad pa'i phyag /khro 'dzum nyam 'bar de lta'i yab yum zung la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 53 'jig rten dbang phyug rig ldan rgya mtsho rnam rgyal gur gum mdog /rin chen khri la rol pa'i stabs bzhugs dar gyi smad dkris can/ /yid bzhin nor bu bsam 'phel las byas dbu rgyan 'phreng ba mdzes/ /do shal 'phyang 'phrul du mas rab sdug lha yi me tog spel/ / 54 nor bu tog gi blo gros kyis spras pad+ma dmar po g.yas/ /zla ltar rab dkar rnyogs pa bral ba'i pad+ma 'dab brgya g.yon/ /dgyes yum ro yi rdo rje sngon mo dung shal shing thog bsnams/ /rin chen dar rgyan de lta'i yab yum zung la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 55 mi g.yo mgon po rig ldan rgyal dka' shin tu dkar ba'i sku/ /tsog pu pus btsug stag lpags sham thab rin chen sbrul chun brgyan/ /skra ser gyen brjes spyan gnyis 'bru tshug ya sos mas mchu gnon/ /gza' yis mda' 'dra me 'bar ral gri g.yas kyi phyag na ste/ /56 rgya mtsho 'jing gi sbrul 'dra zhags pa thugs kar sdig mdzub g.yon/ /seng ge lngas drangs shing rta la bzhugs 'od zer me dpung 'phro/ /dgyes yum khro gnyer spyan ser dbu skra do ker mkha' 'gro'i nā~X/ /gri

thod phyag 'chang de lta'i yab yum zung la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 57 'jam dpal dbyangs ni rigs ldan nyi ma sngo la dngas pa'i lus/ /bung ba ltar gnag thor cog lnga bcings bsnyen gong ut+pal rgyas/ /uta pa la dang rin chen nor bu las byas brgyan brgyad spras/ /'ja' yi smad dkris rdo rje skyil krung klu dang 'dod lha gnan/ / 58 g.yon na gzhu bcas pad+ma dkar po pu snyis mtshan bsnams g.yas/ /mda' dang pad+mar ral gri can 'chang rin chen khri la brjid/ /dgyes yum sher phyin sngon mo rin chen rgyan brgyan mdzes sdug mchog /gri gug thod 'dzin de lta'i yab yum zung la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /59 'dod pa'i rgyal po rigs ldan sna tshogs gzugs ni li khri'i mdog /gcer bu sbrul rigs brgyad dang rin chen pad+ma dmar po yi/ /nyer brgyan stag lpags 'dom dkris dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ /khams gsum dbang bsdud lcags kyu g.yas 'dzin srid gsum zil gnon pa'i/ / 60 pad+ma dmar po'i 'phreng ba g.yon 'chang tsog pu'i phyed skyil kyis/ /rta mchog dkar po bdun gyis drangs ba'i shing rta'i dbus na gnas/ /dgyes yum tsur+ghaṃ glegs bam lhung bzed bsnams dkar lha gos mchog /lhab lhubs kyis mdzes de lta'i yab yum zung la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 61 sgrib pa rnam sel rigs ldan zla 'od pad rtsa ltar dkar ba/ /lha min klu yi dbang po dang ni seng ge dmar pos btegs pa yis/ /rin chen khri la phyed skyil gyis bzhugs dar dang rin chen brgyan/ /phyag g.yas thugs dkar bdud rtsi kheng ba'i bum bzang 'dzin cing g.yon/ / 62 sa gnon mdzad pa'i mtheb mdzub bar na rtsa ba gnas pa yis/ /pad+ma dkar po ra rib med pa'i zla ba rgyas spras 'dzin/ /dgyes yum reg bya rdo rje dkar mo yid 'ong brgyan 'chang mdzes/ /lha gos 'dzin stobs de lta'i yab yum thung la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /63 dbyug pa sngon po rigs ldan mtha' yas pa la sha ltar sngo/ /thod skam dbu brgyan phreng ba do shal sbrul rigs brgyad kyis brgyan/ /mi lpags stod g.yog seng lpags smad g.yog skra ser thor tshugs can/ /g.yas na dbyug pa rtsa rtse nor bu 'i mtshan pa 'phyar/ / 64 g.yon pa sdig mdzub khros pa'i rol stabs pad dkar nyi ma brdzis/ /phag pa nag po bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta la gnas shing / /dgyes yum 'od zer can ma dmar ser phyag gnyis mchog sbyin dang / /a shwa ta 'dzin de lta'i yab yum zung la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 65 kun tu bzang po rigs ldan sa skyong 'char kha'i 'od ltar dmar/ /sku stod gcer bu rin chen dra bas yongs g.yogs sku smad du/ /lha gos lhab lhub rin chen nor bu'i brgyan gyis rab tu spud/ /phyag g.yas gter gyi bum pa thugs kar 'dzin cing g.yon ngal gso/ / 66 gdan la brten pa'i phyag gis pad+ma dkar po nyin byed la/ /bya yi ri mo bkra ba 'dzin cing mtsho dbus pad+mar bzhukāsdu0/ /dgyes yum me tog dkar mo rin chen dang spel me tog brgyan/ /me tog gzhong thogs de lta'i

yab yum zung la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 67 khro bo stobs chen rigs ldan dpal skyongs tshon shel sngo skya'i mdog /thod pa skam pos dbu lus yongs brgyan dar dang rin chen sbrul/ /du mas mdzes tshul khros byas khros tshul am gcig pus btsug phyed skyil kyis/ /bdud kyi lus gnon phyag g.yas kha ṭ+wāṃ dkar po ngom tshul 'dzin/ / 68 g.yon na ma rung 'ching byed zhags pa dang bcas thod pa bsnams/ /glang chen mche drug bdun gyis drangs ba'i shing rta'i dbus su bzhugs/ /dgyes yum lug rgyud ljang khu rin chen rus rgyan lcags sgrogs skyabs sbyin can/ /khro bo'i 'tshul 'chang de lta'i yab yum zung la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 69 mgon po byams pa rigs ldan seng ge dmar ser sbrang rtsi'i mdog /ral pa'i thor tshugs mchod rten gyis brgyan zhabs gnyis skyil krung bzhugs/ /chos 'chad phyag rgyas me tog sngo dmar dbyug gu rtse gsum can/ /pad dkar spyi blug mtshan pa dpung pa g.yas g.yon thad du 'dzin/ / 70ri dwags lpags pas stod g.yog lha yi rgyal po'i tshul du ni/ /rin chen khang bzang me tog 'dzin pa'i lha bzhis btegs dbur bzhugs/ /dgyes yum zla mchog zla ba ltar dkar rma bya'i bsil yab can/ /me tog 'dzin pa de lta'i yab yum zung la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 71 gtsug tor 'khor bsgyur rigs ldan rnams gnon dkar ser be ḍūr mdog /rin chen rus pa sbrul gyis rgyan spras stag lpags sham thab can/ /mkha' lding dbang po kha dog lnga pa mdun gyis nam mkha' la/ /nye bar drangs pa'i shing rta la gzhugs phyag g.yas rtse gsum rtser/ / 72 'khor los mtshan pa bsnams shing g.yon na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po/ /'dzin mdzad dmar ser ral pa thor tshugs zhabs gnyis rol pa'i stabs/ /dgyes yum shin tu sngon mo stag sham sbrul dang rdo rjes brgyan/ /rdor dril 'dzin gyur de lta'i yab yum zung la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 73 sa yi snying po rigs ldan stobs chen kha ba ltar dkar 'tsher/ /rin chen du mas nye bar brgyan bcing dar ser stod g.yog can/ /me tog sngon po'i phreng bas thod bcas zhi ba'i spyan rtsa dmar/ /brag ri'i gdan la g.yas brkyang zhabs kyi rin chen bum pa bajid/ / 74 phyag g.yon ljon shing yal ga 'chang la 'khor lor nor bu'i mtshan/ /g.yas na shing lo 'bras bu dud pa'i chun po rgyas pa 'dzin/ /dgyes yum sa lha ser mo mdun na rin chen gter chen yongs rgyas shing / /phyag na bum thog de lta'i yab yum zung la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 75 phyag na rdo rje rigs ldan ma 'gags dkar po shel ltar dwangs/ /sngo dang ljang khu'i gos su gsol byas nor bu'i rgyan rdzogs shing / /rdo rje'i phreng ba du mas yong ni lus kun mdzes par byas/ /rdo rje 'bar ba g.yas kyis mtheb srin dag ni thugs kar 'dzin/ / 76 phyag g.yon dril bu dkur brten rol pa'i stangs stabs dag gis ni/ /gnod sbyin du mas btegs pa'i rin por che yi khri la bzhugs/ /dgyes yum nor rgyun sngo ljang phyag dag bum bzang rin chen char/ 55/sags

kar skyabs sbyin de lta'i yab yum zung la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 77 khro bo gnod mdzes ri ldan mi yi seng ge kha dog sngo/ /mdzes pa'i ri bo mtsho gling dbus rten shing ltar khang bzang ni/ /gangs seng bzhi dang seng ge gshog ldan gsum gyis 'dren pa la/ /phyed skyil kyis bzhugs rdo rje'i khrab gsol sbrul dang rdo rjes brgyan/ / 78 dbu skra nag po thor tshugs rdo rje'i tog byas phyag g.yas kyis/ /rdo rje'i gri khug sku yi skyed rten g.yon na thod pa 'chang / /dgyes yum shin tu sngon mo sbrul brgyan sbrul lpags gos gsol phyag /dgra sta sdig mdzub de lta'i yab yum zung la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 79 nam mkha' snying po rig ldan dbang phyug chen po nam mkha'i lus/ /rta bdun gyis drangs nyi ma'i rgyab yol pad sngon zla ba'i gdan/ /phyag g.yas sprin dkar gzung zhing der gnas rnyog bral zla ba la/ /ri phong spos phor ljon shing gyis mtshan g.yon ni ngal gso yis/ / 80 gdan la nyer brten pad+ma sngon po yid bzhin nor bus brgyan/ /lha gos sngo dang me tog sngon pos rgyan zhal 'od sngon 'phro/ /dgyes yum zla ba la ni ser mo dri bzang snod bcas 'dzin/ /ngur pa la zhon de lta'i yab yum zung la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 81 spyan ras gzigs dbang rigs ldan mtha' yas rnam rgyal skya rengs mdog /rgya nag bla gos stod g.yog ri dwags lpags pas smad g.yog byas/ /rin po che dang pad+ma zla bar rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs/ /ral pa snag snum thor tshugs bcing byas ngos la 'od dpag med/ / 82 g.yas kyis phyag na rdo rje lcags kyu g.yon na rin chen zhags/ /zla ba ltar dkar 'od zer rab tu 'tsher bas rgyab yol byas/ /dgyes yum ro yi rdo rje dkar mo shel gyi lhung bzed ni/ /bdud rtsis bkang stobs de lta'i yab yum zung la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 83 bcom ldan 'jam dpal drag po rigs ldan lha yi dbang po zhes/ /'khor lo che gyur seṅge brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin chen khrir/ /mnyam pa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs kha dog dmar ser nyi ma'i 'od/ /rin chen brgyan brgyad dar gyis chas lngas nyer spud phyag gnyis kyis/ / 84 chos 'chad phyag rgyas yongs gzung g.yas su pad+ma dmar po la/ /gser gyi 'khor los nyer brgyan g.yon na uta pa la sngon por/ /ral gri glegs bam mtshan pa 'dzin zhing steng na rin chen bdug /lha yi bu dang bu mo mang pos me tog char sogs du mas mchod/ / 85 dgyes yum g.yas su dbyangs can ljang khu tsog pu phyag gnyis kyis/ /lha yi rgyud mangs bskul cing rin chen bye bas yongs su brgyan/ /g.yon na skra can dkar mo thal sbyar pad dkar pod ral gyis/ /spras pa legs 'dzin de lta'i yab yum zung la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 86 'jam dpal dpa' bo rigs ldan 'khor lo chen po thugs rje'i stobs/ /khros nas kla klo'i dpung tshogs ma lus gcod mdzad drag po'i tshul/ /rdo las grub pa'i rta mchog sngon po rlung gi gaṭ+wāṃpyo ldan steng / /rta mchog ting 'dzin la gnas 'dar med rdo rje'i skyil mo krung / / 87 mi

bshig rdo rje pha lam las grub ya lad skur gsol zhing / /klu yi dbang po bcu yis nyer brgyan gzi bajid cher 'bar ba/ /nyi ma stong gi 'od 'phros dmar ser rab tu 'tsher ba'i mdog /'khor lo dang ni mdung thung phyag na byas te bdud tshogs 'joms/ / 88 drag po gdong drug tshogs kyi dbang po 'phrog byed kyis bskor nas/ /dga' 'phrog lha min kla klo'i rigs rnams ma lus 'jom byed nas/ /'dzam gling sa chen kun tu dge ba rdzogs ldan dang po'i dus/ /gsar du 'god mdzad drag po lha mi'i bla mar phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 89 'khor lo can sras sa yi skyil 'khor phyed phyed skyong ba bzungs/ /'jam dpal dbyangs ni rigs ldan tshangs pa ru dza na ya yi/ /me tog ltar dmar rdo rje dril bu rnam rol phyag rgyas 'dzin/ /mdzes byed rma byas btegs pa'i rin chen khri la rol btang bzhugs/ / 90 kha dog sna tshogs ut+pal rin chen rgyan ldan 'ja' rnams can/ /ral pa zur phud lnga byas steng na rma bya'i sgro gdugs mdzes/ /dgyes yum rdo rje chos ma ljang khu spyi bor thal mo sbyor/ /rma bya la zhon de lta'i yab yum zung la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 91 spyan ras gzigs dbang rigs ldan lha yi dbang po sku yi mdog /tī la ka yi me tog lta bur shin tu dkar zhing mdzes/ /nu g.yon ri dwags lpags bkab gser gyi tshang skud thor cog can/ /phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon pa gdan brten pad dkar rab rgyas 'chang / /92 dar kyi smad dkris zhabs gnyis skyil krung mdzes pa'i khri bcas pa'i/ /rtsa yi spyil bo tshang dang brgya byin dag gis btegs dbus bzhugs/ /dgyes yum 'od ldan mar me lha yi na chung 'chor sgeg tshul/ /nor bu 'dzin pa de lta'i yab yum zung la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 93 dum bu'i sa skyong brgyad kyi dang po rdo rje snying po ni/ /rigs ldan 'od bsrung sngo skya ke ke ru yi mdog ltar 'tshar/ /rin chen khri la phyed skyil kyis bzhugs g.yon brkyang zhabs dag ni/ /brag ri'i steng du shing gi lo mar nyer brten lha gos mchog /94 gar gyi phu dung dang bcas rin chen du ma'i rgyan ldan pa/ /phyag gnyis rdo rje glegs bam bsnams shing ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ /dgyes yum phreng ma ljang nag mdog 'tsher rol pa'i gar dang bcas/ /rin chen phreng bsnams de lta'i yab yum zung la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 95 de ltar bde ba 'dzin pa'i yul dbus gangs can ri stegs su/ /rin chen cha kun nyer bsags mdzes pas yongs ni cha bsags zhes/ /rgyal po'i khab der mi 'jigs seṅge gdan la 'gro ba'i mgon/ /'phags pa chen po chos rgyal rdo rje'i rigs ldan rnam sprul nas/ / 96 ma lus 'gro ba mtha' dag 'dren pa'i bla mar gyur pa gang / /de rnams yab yum sras blon 'bangs gyur byang chub sems dpa' dang / /bye ba'i yul der dbang bsgyur lha klu'i rje bo mi bdag tshul/ /rigs ldan dkar gnas dgu bcu rtsa dgu'i tshogs la'ang phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 97 'dzam gling chung ngu'i si ta'i lho phyogs yul na rigs ldan gyis/ /rnam par 'asnro~X pa sku

yi bkod pa yongs su shar gyur pa/ /shin tu sbyor ba dam pa dang po'i sangs rgyas ston mdzad mgon/ /rtsa ba dang ni rgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma'i tshogs rnams la/ / 98 rab tu gus pa chen po'i yid ldan lus ngag mthun sbyor nas/ /shin tu dwangs ba mchog gis phyag 'tshal kun tu phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /bdag gi gzung dang ma gzung yo byad 'jig rten khams kun gyis/ /dal 'byor ma lus bdag blo dag pas khyed rnams la ni 'bul/ / 99 srid 'gro nyams dar byis pa'i blo yis shin tu mi zad sdig /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i spyan sngar de kun so sor bshags par gyis/ /sangs rgyas byang sems rnams dang 'phags pa'i tshogs kyi rnam mang dge /mdzad gyur mthar dag la ni sdig bral byang chub rjes yi rang / /100 byang chub spyad pa spyod byas mthar ni rdzogs sangs rgyas brnyes kyang / /chos gsung mi bzhed snyoms par bzhugs la bdag gis chos 'khor skor/ /bskor bar bskul zhing mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don du rdzogs sangs rgyas su bdag gyur gcig /101 de ltar rgyal ba mchog dang sras gyur sa bcu'i dbang phyug che/ /chos rgyal rigs ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhabs bdag gi /chu skyes yid la dren pa'i mthu yi 'khor ba'i duḥ kha kun/ /bcom byed zhi ba'i rnal du 'jug min thar pa mchog gi grong / / 102 bde bar gshegs pa'i khab tu nye bar yongs su 'jug byas nas/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i tshogs rnams ma lus rang gi go 'phang ji bzhin pa/ /'od kyi pha rol phyin pa'i rgyal ba mchog gi yon tan kun/ /rdzogs pa'i 'bras bu nyid la bdag gzhan 'gro yis myur thob shog / 103 de ltar rgyal ba mchog gi go 'phang bgrod par byed pa'i lam/ /rmad byung zab gsal zung 'jug rdo rje'i rnal 'byor shin tu yi/ /theg pa dpal mchog sangs rgyas kun gyis za ma tog gang e wam/ /dus 'khor man ngag bla ma'i zhal lung yid ches gsum thob lam/ / 104 byang chub snying po ma thob bar du de 'thung ngom med spyod/ /byed cing g.yo med nus pas khu rdul mun pa'i sgrib kun bcom/ /mi shig dwangs ma gsum ldan rdo rje'i rang bzhin mkha' khyab kyi/ /gsang gsum tshe 'di nyid la thob nas 'gro kun 'dren par shog / 105 gal te bdag gi skal ba dman pas mchog gi dngos grub gang / /tshe 'dir thob par ma gyur na'ang 'chi ba'i dus gyur 'chi kha dmar/ /snang gsum sgrib kun yongs bcom shin tu phra ba'i 'od gsal ba/ /mngon byed bzhi lam 'od gsal ro gcig 'bras bu sangs rgyas thob/ / 106 cis kyang skye ba'i srid par snang tshe rgyal ba'i bden pa'i mthu/ /sngags kyis nus pas tha mal skye 'os mngal du mi 'jug par/ /'dod gzugs gtso bo mkha' spyod rig 'dzin grong du sngags lam la/ /spyod pa'i skal ldan lus des byang chen bgrod byed skye 'dzin shog / 107 gal te mi ru sna~X 5bhār gyur na 'dzam gling chung ngu'i byang / /mi bdag sa bcu pas byas sham+bha la yi yul gyi dbus/ /

kai la sha steng lha yi grong bzhin phun tshogs mi yi ljongs/ /rdo rje'i rigs ldan kyis skyong gnas der khams drug ldan pa'i lus/ / 108 dal 'byor rgyan thob skye ma thag tu smra shes 'gro shes shing / /sngon gyis smon lam dran bzhin rigs ldan zhabs kyi pad+mor bsnyen/ /sems dpa' che des brtse bas yongs su rjes gzung smin grol thob/ /lus des dang po'i sangs rgyas go 'phang bar med nyid bgrod shog / 109yang gcig chu bo si ta'i lhor gyur 'phags pa'i yul gyi char/ /skyes par gyur kyang mtha' khob dang ni grub mtha' ngan pa yi/ /rjes su 'brang min dam pa'i chos ston rnam dag shes kyis zin/ /byang chub sems bskyed sngags kyi dbang bskur bskyed rdzogs drod tshad thob/ / 110 bla ma lha yi gnang ba'i mtshan ma thob nas sham+bha lar/ /'jug pa'i blo la nam yang zhum med mtha' yas 'gro ba yi/ /sgrib pa sbyangs slad ke la shar phyin sa bcu'i dbang phyug gi /rjes gzung mchog grub 'gro kun 'dren pa'i dpa' bor bdag gyur shog / 111 mdor na yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mchog /ma thob bar du nges don lta ba rnams rigs dang / /zung 'jug lam mchog a ti zab gsal rdo rje spyod/ /'gro kun lta sgom de la gzhug byed bdag gyur shog /tshe rabs rtag tu sa bcu'i 'phags pa 'jal/ /dbang phyug yon tan brgyad ldan myur du thob/ /ma nor lam la 'gro kun 'dren byed nas/ /tshom bu gcig tu sangs rgyas grub par shog /de ltar 'dzam gling pa yi dum bu lho phyogs 'dzam gling chung ngu'i byang gyur sham+bha la yi dbus gyur kai la shar mi yi bdag po seng ge bden can sa bcu'i dbang phyug rnams kyi sprul bzhi bod du byon pa'i shing rta dam par gyur pa dag gi bzhed pa cung zad mi 'dra ba la brten sku yi bkod tshul yang mang du yod mod/ de las 'dir ni chos rgyal rig ldan sum bcu rtsa gnyis sam sum cu rtsa drug gi sprul bzhi ni/ 'jig rten dbang phyug dol po pa kun mkhyen shes rab rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos gsung ltar la/ sku yi bkod pa de yi rjes 'brang 'bri 'bur mang du bzhugs pa las mchog tu rje btsun dam pa sgrol ba'i mgon po nas jo nang dam chos gling gi mthil khang rdo rje'i rnal 'byor bsgrub pa'i gzim spyil log bris su rang bzhed khyad par ba 'khod pa mdzad pa de shin tu legs shing bkod pa rgyas par mthong bas 'dir yang de don bzhin brjod par byed pa yin no/ /de yang sa bcu'i dbang phyug chos rgyal rigs ldan 'di dag gi mtshan lan gcig thos pas kyang 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las bsgral/ de phyir mi ldog pa byang chub mchog gi lam la nges par bkod pa'i phan yon chen po yid drangs nas mngon rtogs dang bcas pa'i phyag 'tshal ni sngon chad gzhan gyi mdzad pa zhig ma mthong bas rang nyid kyi bri 'dun ring nas byung yang le lor gyur pa las/ slar sa bcu pa 'di rnams kyi sku yi snang ba blo la bkod par 'dod pa dag 'byung srid tshe 'phags pa'i skyes bu mchog gi bkod pa byin rlabs che zhing khungs dang ldan pa 'di ltas shin tu phan par mthong bas bskul nas lhag pa'i bsam pas jo snang yab sras kyi bzhed pa ji bzhin par rgyal dang sa bcu'i dbang phyug rnams la phyag 'tshal ba'i rim pa gangs can zla ba'i chu gter zhes bya ba tshigs su bcad pa dbang po bde 'byung gi grangs dang ldan pa ni/ don grub zhes sa mo lug gi lo sa ga zla ba'i dga' ba gnyis pa kun mkhyen dol po pa'i dus chen skabs su dbu brtsams nas thun bar du tshigakā zlo~Xd re

zung bris pa'i 'phro rgyal ba mngon par byang chub pa'i dus chen tshes bco lnga la grub par rdo rje'i rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu 'khro 'dul rdo rje sems dpa' 'am ming gzhan du 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rjes chu rgyun chad pa med pa'i dpal zhes pas kong yul nyang kha cum ri'i g.yas 'dabs bsam gtan nag khrod du bkod par byed pa'o/ /'dir smras pa/ sangs rgyas sa bcu'i dbang phyug tshul bstan nas/ /de yang rdo rje rig ldan mi bdag tshul/ /'di lta'i mtshan tsam gyis kyang 'khor ba yi/ /sdug bsngal mtha' dag drung nas 'byin byed na/ /gang sku yid la byas nas gus pa yi/ /brten na byang chen dngos la ci mi sbyor/ /de na don chen mchog la rigs 'dod kun/ /tshul 'di rab tu 'bad pas sgrub 'os yin/ /des na bdag gi 'di bgyis dge ba yang / /mi bdag sa bcu'i mgon pos 'phrin las sgyur/ /bsngo mthus mtha' yas 'gro kun rigs ldan ma/ /cher gus zhal mjal dngos grub mchog thob shog /zhes pa'ang dpal tshe dbang nor bus nges par brjod pa'o/ /maṅga lo/ dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /

dzo+o /dpal rig 'dzin chen po'i gsung rtsom las bde chen gling pa'i 'khrungs rabs sogs gsol 'debs kyi skor 'ga' zhig bzhugs so/ /oṃ susti/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma sprul pa'i skye 'phreng la gsol ba 'debs pa yid bzhin nor bu brtsegs pa zhes bya ba/ dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal kun 'byung gnas chos kun gdod ma yi/ /gnas lugs sgrib med rang 'byung rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rnam kun mchog ldan kun khyab bde ba che/ /kun bzang gdod ma'i mgon por phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhi dbyings snying po me tog rgyan pa ru//mchog gi sprul sku'i zhing khams rab 'byams kun/ /mtshan dpe gsal bar sku las nyer sprul mdzad/ /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ /mi mjed skal ba bzang po'i zhing khams 'dir/ /sangs rgyas stong gi bka' yi bsdu ba po/ /gsang gsum dbyer med ngo bo lhun grub pa/ /bcom ldan lag na rdo rjer phyag 'tshal lo/ /rmad byung rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thub dbang gi/ /nye gnas mchog gyur sprul pa'i dgra bcom pa/ /sde snod rnam gsum bka' yi bsdu ba po/ /'phags pa kun dga' bo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thub dbang bstan la smra ba'i nyi ma che/ /rigs pa'i pad tshal kun tu rgyas mdzad mgon/ /smra ba'i seng ge mu stegs ri dwags dgra/ /slob dpon phyogs kyi glang por phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag nyid lta ba'i brag ri mkhregs po kun/ /bdag med smra ba rdo rje dgra brgya pas/ /'joms mdzad spros bral smra ba'i khyu mchog che/ /dpal ldan zla ba grags par phyag 'tshal lo/ /gangs can mgon po'i mi rje spyan ras gzigs/ /srong btsan sgam po'i bka' bzhin dam chos brda'/ /bod du sngar med gsar 'dren ngag dbang phyug /drin can thon mi'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhas shing grub gyur dur khrod phung lung du//dpal chen stobs ldan nag po'i bdag nyid dang / /mtshungs par dbang bskur drag sngags kun gyi bdag /rig 'dzin zhi ba snying por phyag 'tshal lo/ /de dang dus mtshungs bod yul 'jig rten mig /kun gyi 'khor lor bsgyur ba theg dgu'i bdag /'jam dpal thugs dang dbyer med 'od sku gshegs//lo chen bai ro tsa nar phyag 'tshal lo/ /slar yang bsam bzhin mdo smad glo thang du/ /smon lam dbang gi skye ba sprul pa'i sku/ /rdzogs chen sems phyogs nyin ltar brdal mdzad mgon/ /ye shes 'byung gnas zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi nyag yul 'khrungs 'phags pa'i yul du bshegs/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i rtser 557

son grub pa brnyes/ /rdo rje gdan pa'i mtshan can bzhi par gyur/ /tsa mi sangs rgyas grags la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro gnyis dang skyes mchog bzhi'i/ /gdams ngag bcud len khyung po rnal 'byor dang / /de'i thugs sras zhang sgom chos seng ste/ /yab sras thugs brgyud gcig la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de dang dus mtshungs nyid du la stod byang / /'brog ma'i lo ts+tsha'i thugs sras kun gyi mchog /gha ya dha ra'i gser chos gcig char gsol/ /se ston kun rigs zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chu snod zla gzugs ji bzhin sprul pa'i sku/ /'ug pa lung du snga 'gyur bla med chos/ /rgyud lung man ngag nyi bzhin brdal ba po/ /zur chen shāka 'byung zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bstan pa'i 'byung khungs dbu ru lha ldan 'dab/ /sku 'khrungs yin nges bzhi yi rjes su bzung / /phag mos sras gyur gsang ba'i mtshan brgyad brnyes/ /skye med brtson 'grus grags par phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan sa skyar sde snod gsum gyi bdag /'jam dpal dpa' bos byin rlabs 'dzam gling 'dir/ /zla med nyid ltar gsal ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta/ /kun dga' rgyal ba'i mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mdo khams kaḥthog dam pa bde gshegs kyi/ /thugs dang gnyis su med pa slob ma'i tshul/ /sgyu 'phrul 'dus mdo rdzogs chen sgron me sbar/ /gtsang ston rdor rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal gyi cib ri'i nye 'dab lha gdong du/ /snying po'i bstan pa rgyas mdzad 'gro ba'i mgon/ /ye shes dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpon che/ /yang mgon thugs kyi rdo rjer phyag 'tshal lo/ /jo nang gnas su rigs ldan sprul— pa'i sku/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir rdo rje rnal 'byor gtso/ /mi zhig dang ma gsum gyi sku brnyes pa/ /thugs rjes brtson 'grus che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen gling sogs rtsod med gter chen bdun/ /slob mar 'dus shing smin grol dga' ston rgyas/ /thar pa'i ded dpon kong yul bu chur 'khrungs/ /'khrul zhig bde ba yangs par phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi nang gtsug lag kun la dbang bsgyur zhing / /rdor sems phag mos byin rlabs 'jigs med ngag /de gnyis 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho cher rgyas pa/ /bo dong dbyangs can dga' bar phyag 'tshal lo/ /sprul sku skye 'phral gu ru'i zhal gzigs nas/ /ye shes mngon shes rdzu 'phrul bsam mi khyab/ /zab mo'i gter kha brgya dang rtsa brgyad bzhes/ /o rgyan rdo rje gling par phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje'i 'jug pas shangs kyi lha bur 'khrungs/ /zab phu la sogs gter sgo dpag med phyes/ /dregs pa'i skye bo rdzu 'phrul mthu yis btul/ /pad+ma kun skyong gling par phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang 'dul skur ston mdo khams nyag rong du/ /bshan rigs sku bltams g.yung drung bon gter ston/ /mthu stobs nus pas gdug pa tshar gcod mdzad/ /blo gros thogs med grags la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'brong ri smug por bsrungs ma'i zab gter sgo/ /'byed mdzad chu pho rtogs ldan zhes kyang grags/ /de yi ring lugs rgyas mdzad la ston pa/ /nam mkha' rin chen la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshe rabs mang por dpal 558

ldan ka rmakā kās/ /rjes bzung sgyu lus mi lam 'od gsal 'byongs/ /'phags yul mi tra dzo ki'i bstod bsngags yul/ /mi nyag grags rin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de dag dus mtshungs bod yul dbu ru'i char/ /kun bzang grub pa'i dpa' bo dbus smyon pa/ /gtsang gi bya gshong ring lugs smra ba'i dbang / /'bum phrag gsum par grags la'ang phyag 'tshal lo/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan kun gyis brgyan/ /gu ru pad+ma'i zab gter rtsod med bston/ /skal ldan smin grol sar bkod 'phrang phu ba/ /shes rab 'od zer zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /o rgyan mkha' spyod zhing du he ru ka /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro tshogs rje tshogs kyi bdag /sngags kyi theg pa ston mdzad bcom ldan 'das/ /dpa' bo thod pa'i dum bur phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdul bya'i don du skye ba'i 'phreng ba nyid/ /yang yang bltams nas smin grol chos 'khor bskor/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba 'dren pa'i gnyen gcig pu/ /snang mdzad rnam sprul kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtsod ldan snyigs ma'i mtha' la thug dus 'dir/ /gsung gi rdo rjer pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ /thugs kyi 'od zer rnam snang mdzad dbyer med/ /gu ru bde chen gling par phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdul dka'i 'dre srin bdug pa dam la btags/ /dmu rgod sems can mang po mthar lam bkod/ /'brel tshad 'gro kun bde chen mchog la sbyor/ /pad+ma bde chen gling par phyag 'tshal lo/ /gu ru'i thugs bcud mkha' 'gro'i gsang gter ston/ /rang don gdeng bzhi'i drod tshad mngon du gyur/ /gzhan don nges gsang brtan rgyun chad med spel/ /kun bzang bde chen gling par phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma 'ongs dus na slar yang sprul pa yis/ /mi nyag dur khrod phag gdong ri bo nas/ /mkha' 'gro dgongs 'dus zab gter ston nas kyang / /smin grol chos 'khor bskor la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bskal bzang zhing 'di'i sangs rgyas stong mtha' ma/ /sangs rgyas dgu brgya dgu bcu rtsa dgu yi/ /mdzad phrin gcig car skyong ba'i 'dren pa che/ /bcom ldan mos pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar bdag blo mos pa kho na yi/ /rgyal ba'i sprul skur bsngags pa ma lags mod/ /gshis lugs nyid du rgyal ba'i dbang po ru/ /ye grub bla ma mchog der phyag 'tshal lo/ /nges don mkha' khyab rgyal ba yin mod kyang / /gdul bya'i don du 'dzam gling las kyi sar/ /mi yi skyes bu lam nas sems pa'i tshul/ /ston mkhas rgyal ba gnyis par phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig khyed ni 'gro 'ong gnas pa med/ /rnam kun mchog ldan rnam pa thams cad pa/ /'gro ba'i don du skye 'pho'i tshul ston mdzad/ /sprul pa'i skye 'phreng 'dzin der phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po khyed kyi rnam rol chu gter nyid/ /gzhal bar su nus bdag blos kho na yis/ /sor rtse'i chu thig tsam brjod dge 'di'i yang / /mgon po khyed 'grub khyed zhal rtag mthong shog /bdag gi thog med dus nas da lta'i bar/ /dus gsum bsags yod dge ba'i tshogs tha dag /tshe srog lus dang longs spyod dbang thang bcas/ /mgon khyed la 'bul brtse bas bzhes 559

su gsol/ /bdag ni mi shes byis pa ngang bzhin gyis/ /sgo gsum nyes pa'i spyod pa 'ba' zhig pas/ /rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig nyes pa'i cha/ /mchis kun mthol bshags sgrib med dag tshangs stsal/ /mgon khyod la sogs rgyal dang rgyal ba sras/ /slob ma'i tshogs dang so so'i skye kun gyi/ /tshogs gsum dge ba'i bya ba bgyis kun la/ /snying nas gus pa chen pos yi rang ngo / /mtshungs med mgon khyod gang du sku bltams nas/ /dam chos bdud rtsi 'gyed pa'i dus babs tshe/ /de yi sgo 'phar dbye ba'i gsal 'debs po/ /bdag skye ji srid bar du byed par shog /ma dag gdul bya skyo ba bskyed pa'i phyir/ /mgon khyod zhir gshegs bzhed tshe sangs rgyas la/ /btsun da ji bzhin khyed sku bskal pa cher/ /'tsho bzhes gsol 'debs bdag gi byed par shog /bdag gi bla ma mchog la ches gus pas/ /phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul gshags dang yid rang ba/ /bskul zhing gsol 'debs la sogs dge tshogs kun/ /dpal mgon bla ma'i go 'phang thob phyir bsngo/ /dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus thams cad las/ /rang la bka' drin che ba'i sgo nas lhag /des na 'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla mar skyabs su mchi/ /nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam sems can ma lus pa/ /bdag gi drin chen pha ma 'ba' zhig ste/ /kun kyang bla med bla ma'i go 'phang la/ /bkod phyir bdag gi byang chub sems bskyed do/ /mi klog snying po lta ba rnams dag dang / /phyag rgya chen po'i gnas lugs zab mo'i don/ /'od gsal rdo rje snying por mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /khyed gshegs lam de bdag gis brten bgyi'o/ /dus 'di nas rtsom byang chub snying po'i bar/ /bdag gi skye ba tshe rabs ji srid du/ /lus dang srog la nam yang ltos med par/ /rnam kun mgon po khyed dgyes bsgrub par shog /bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la mi dad pa'i/ /'gro rnams bdag gi mthu yi nyer btul te/ /mgon po khyed la mi phyed dad gus kyis/ /sa mchog nyid la myur du bkod par shog /khyed la dad dang gus gyur mi mi min/ /kun kyang tshe ring mnga' thang dpal 'byor 'phel/ /dbang thang mthu stobs che cher rgyas gyur te/ /mgon khyod bstan la bya ba byed par shog /sangs rgyas tha dag dgyes pa'i las gcig chog /dpal ldan bla ma mchog las gzhan yod min/ /de phyir bdag gi lus srog longs spyod kyi/ /tshe rabs rtag tu bla ma mchod par shog /bla ma dgyes byed las la bdag sgo gsum/ /ngal spangs chog shes med par dus rtag tu/ /srid zhu bsnyen bkur gus pa'i zhabs tog dang / /bla ma'i snyan pa bar med brjod par shog /mdor na bla ma'i ci mdzad legs par mthong / /ci gsung dang len le lo snyom las dbang / /cung zad tsam yang ma song dar drag pas/ /thugs su 'jug pa'i las la rtag brtson shog /dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung ba'i dam can/ /bdag gi spyod lam dam tshig gcig tu 'dres//bla ma'i sku la sdang ba'i dgra bo rnams/ /bdag gi skad gcig nyid la tshar gcod shog /bla ma'i thugs 560

su byon pa'i sras nye'i 'khor/ /kun la bla ma ji bzhin blta byas nas/ /de dag la yang sman pa'i bya ba gang / /rtag tu lhur ru blang nas bsgrub par shog /skye ba kun tu shes rab rnam dag dang / /dam chos bsgrub brtson sgo gsum bran du 'bul/ /rin chen 'bru sman dar zab la sogs pa/ /mngon mtho'i 'byor pas bla ma rab mchod shog khyad par dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /'phrin las gcig car sgrub thabs bla ma yi/ /'phrin las spel las yod min de phyir bdag /bla ma'i 'phrin las mchog rgyar rtag spel shog /bla ma dgyes na mnar med dmyal me yi/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor bsregs kyang mi sun cing //bla ma ma dgyes srid zhi'i dpal 'byor kun/ /mi gtsang rdzas bzhin ring du spong bar shog /mdor na rtsa ba'i bla ma rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /dgyes pa'i las la 'khor ma yu gcod cing / /mi dgyes skad cig dus mtha'i yun tsam yang / /yongs spang snying nas gus pas brtan par shog /bdag ni sangs rgyas go 'phang yang mi smon/ /byang sems 'phags pa dag pa'i sa chen po/ /bla ma'i thugs rjes myur thob tshul de yi/ /mkha' mnyam sems can kun gyi don byed shog /dag sar gnas pa'i byang sems smos ci 'tshal/ /gal te bdag nyid rdzogs sangs rgyas srid na/ /mgon khyod sku yi bkod pa bdag gi gtsug /rigs kyi bdag po'i tshul du brgyan par shog /de ltar bla ma mchog la rab gus pas/ /dus gsum kun tu smon lam btab pa rnams/ /mi bslu ji bzhin bden pa nyid 'grub par/ /dkon mchog rtsa gsum rgya mtshos mdzad du gsol/ /zhes dus gsum sangs rgyas ma lus pa'i sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las 'dus pa'i bdag nyid kyi dpal chen po mtsho skyes rdo rje dang dbyer ma mchis pa/ rgyan mchog srog gi dang ma kun bzang pad 'byung bde chen gling pa yi sprul pa'i skye 'phreng ji snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal gsol 'debs smon lam bcas tshigs su bcad pa drug bcu rtsa gsum 'di ni stod mnga' ris gangs ri chen po ri'i se'i nub phyogs klung seṅge kha 'bab kyi ljongs skor gsum las g.ya' yi bskor ba mar yul gyi stod wam le bde chen rnam rgyal du rab byung bcu gsum pa'i dpal gdong chu bya gsar du 'char ba rgyal zla'i tshes bcu lo dus kyi mchod pa'i skabs su/ rje btsun bla ma'i bka' 'bangs thams cad kyi mtha' nas rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu 'jam dbyangs rgya mtshos sde dpal kun tu rgyas pa yi mi phyed snying nas gus pa'i spu long g.yo bzhin du bkod pa'i 'phro cung zad pa ni zla ba de'i dkar phyogs rgyal ba gsum pa rgyal phur gyi 'grub sbyor la grub par byas pa ste/ dge bas skye ba kun tu mgon po de'i rjes su bzung ba'i rgyur gyur cig dge'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāsti/ na mo ma hā gu ru pad+ma sid rnyi ba ra ya/ rgyal ba kun gyi chos nyid kun tu bzang / /rang gzugs stug po bkod bdag rnam snang mdzad/ /rig gdangs rgyud kun bdag po rdo rje can/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i ngo bor gsol ba 'debs/ /thub dbang bka' yi bsdud po kun dga' bo/ /'dzam gling rgyal bstan mdzes rgyan phyogs glang che/ /bdag med smra ba'i seng ge zla ba grags/ /dpal ldan or+yan pa yi 561

dbang phyug de wa ka /gangs can mig gcig thu mi sasto ṭa/ /ṭī nar bslab gsum 'dzin mchog gang ba'i mtshan/ /dpal ldan 'phags yul grags sngags rig 'dzin zhi ba snying / /bod yul mkhas grub yongs gtso bai ro'i zhabs/ /tha dad skur ston don du ngo bo gcig /dpal ldan byang chub sems nyid gsal mdzad a ro rje/ /snga 'gyur bstan pa'i sgron me zur chen pa/ /thub pa'i rgyal tshab rdor sden tsa mi rje/ /dpal ldan mkha' 'gro ne gu'i thugs sras khyung po'i zhabs/ /de'i thugs dang dbyer med zhang chos seng / /'brog ma'i thugs bcud 'jo mdzad sa kun rig /dpal ldan rgya gar dam pa'i slob ma drag po yi/ /bka' bab badz+ra gro dha zhes kyang bya/ /skye med snying rje'i gar bsgyur rgyal ba zhang / /dpal ldan bla ma gnas lnga rig pa kun dga' rgyal ba'i mtshan/ /gang gi thugs dang dbyer med slob ma'i tshul/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpon yang dgon pa/ /dpal ldan kaḥthog dam pa'i rgyal tshab gtsang ston pa/ /jo snang rigs ldan thugs rjes brtson 'grus che/ /bo dong 'jigs med grags gyur gsang ba sbyin/ /dpal ldan zab gter brgya rtsa ston mdzad rdo rje gling / /gang gi rnam 'phrul rtsod med kun skyong gling / /mdo khams bon gter blo gros thog med pa/ /dpal ldan 'brong ri'i gter ston chu pho rtogs ldan che/ /gang gi rigs lugs rgyas mdzad nam rin pa/ /sgyu lus rtsal 'byongs grags pa rin chen/ /dpal ldan kun bzang grub pa'i dpa' bo dbus smyon pa/ /dus mtshungs bya gshongs 'bum phrag gsum pa'i mtshan/ /bsam bzhin sprul sku 'phrang bu gter ston rje/ /dpal ldan mkha' spyod tshogs rje bcom ldan 'das thod dum/ /de sogs rim pa gnyis dang dus gcig tu/ /chu snod zla ltar 'gog med sprul gar can/ /dpal ldan dus 'dir gu ru pad+ma'i rgyal tshab mchog /gdul dka'i 'gro 'dul nges ston bstan srog 'dzin/ /rgyal kun ngo bo pad+ma bde chen gling / /dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla mar gang gi skye 'phreng ngo mtshar rgya mtsho las/ /bdag blo dad pa'i snyim pas cung zad cig /blangs nas brtse gcig gus pas gsal 'debs na/ /thugs rjes gzigs shig dran mchog dngas ma'i mgon/ /bdag ni tshe rabs tshe rgyud thams cad du/ /khyod kyi dngos rgyud sprul pa'i rnam rol kun/ /mi 'bral spyi bo'i brgyan du rtag bzung nas/ /dgyes pa'i las 'khor ma yug spyod par shog /mdor na sngags kyi dam tshig rnam par dag /de yi sa lam yon tan gong 'phel rgyas/ /'bral byed khyab bdag bla ma rdor sems kyi/ /go 'phang mchog la bdag gi bkod par shog /ces dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyi gathugs bka' drin bzhi ldan dran mchog dngas ma'i mgon po kun bzang pad 'byung bde chen gling pa'i zhabs kyi 'khrungs rabs kyi 'phreng bar gsol ba 'debs pa 'di yang gang gi bka' 'bangs thams cad kyi tha shal rig 'dzin rgyal khams pa tshe dbang nor bu 'jam dbyangs rgya mtshos bod yul stod mnga' ris dang kha che'i yul mtshams mar yul wam ler dpal gdong chu bya cho 'phrul zla ba'i yar ngo tshes bcu'i thun bar cig tu bris pa'o/ /dge'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/562

oṃ swāste/ na mo gu ra we/ kun bzang rnam par snang mdzad cho/sa pa che/ /sku gsum rdzogs sangs rgyas la gsol ba 'debs/ /gsang bdag rdo rje can dang kun dga' bo/ /rgyal bka' bsdud pa po la ྾ rgyal po zla gsungs ma ti tsi tra chung / /theg chen gsal bar byed la ྾ phyogs glang zla grags shin+ta gar+pā te/ /'dzam gling mdzes byed gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /drin chen thu mi lo chen bai ro'i zhabs/ /zla med gangs can mig la ྾ a ro ye 'byung zur chen shes rab 'byung / /snga 'gyur bstan srog 'dzin la ྾ khyung po rnal 'byor tsa mi sangs rgyasagrags/ /bod kyi rgyan gyur mchog la ྾ rngog lo sa paṇa bo gdong gsang ba sbyin/ /rgyal bstan mi mchog la ྾ se ston kun rigs jo snang kun yang che/ /lam zab rgyas mdzad nyid la ྾ kaḥthog gtsang ston rog ban shes rab 'od/ /skyes mchog dam pa gnyis la ྾ skye med zhang dang lha gdong yang dgon pa/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rje nyid la ྾gter chen rdo rje gling dang kun kyong gling / /rtsod med sprul sku che la྾ 'khrul zhig bde yan dbus smyon kun dga' bzang / /rnal 'byor dbang phyug gnyis la ྾ g.yag sde paṇa chen bya gshong 'bum phrag gsum/ /smra ba'i khyu mchog gnyis la ྾ chu pho rtogs ldan blo gros thogs med bon/ /gang 'dul gzhan don skyong la ྾ mi nyag grags rin la ston nam rin pa/ /gdams zab rgyas par mdzad la ྾ rtsod med gter ston shes rab 'od zer dpal/ /lung rtogs rgyal mtshan 'dzin der ྾bcom ldan thod dum gnas gsum dpa' bo dang / /mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug gyur la ྾ snyigs dus 'gro 'dul nges don bstan pa'i srog /pad 'byung bde chen gling par gsol ba 'debs/ /ma 'ongs phags ri'i zab gter sgo 'byed mgon/ /sprul sku 'byon gyur la yang ྾ khyod ni rgyal ba'i go 'phangs brnyes bzhin du/ /'gro la phan zhes sprul pa'i rnam rol gar/ /gcig dang du ma chu snod zla gzugs bzhin/ /ngo mtshar ci yang ston la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /snying nas gus pas gang gis skyes pa'i phreng / /mdo tsam nyid la rtse gcig gsol 'debs na/ /des kyang dpal ldan bla med rjes 'dzin shog /bdag ni 'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /rgyal bas bcas pa'i bla ma'i dam tshig kun/ /cung zad tsam yang nyams pa med par spyod/ /'gro ba kun kyang lam mchog der bkod shog /rdo rjer theg pa'i sa lam yon tan kun/ /ring min myur du gdan thog 'dir thob nas/ /rgyal ba'i zhing khams kun tu rgyal ba bzhin/ /'gro kun bde la 'god pa'i byed por shog /ces bka' drin mtshungs pa med pa dran mchog dwangs ma'i mgon po kun bzang pad 'byung bde chen gling pa yi sprul pa'i rnal rol la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di yang gang gi slob ma rnams kyi yang tha rig pa 'dzin pa rgyal khams pa tshe dbang nor bu 'jam dbyangs rgya mtshos rab byung bcu gsum pa'i dpal gdong chu bya cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes bcu gnyis thun bar du mar yul stod wam le bde chen rnam rgyal du 'bris pa'o/ /dge'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/563

oṃ suste/ na mo gu ra we/ kun bzang chos sku mkha' ltar brdal ba las/ /rnam par snang mdzad nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bzhin/ /gang 'dul sprul sku'i 'od zer 'byams klas 'phro/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i ngo bor gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal bka' yongs bsdus gsang bdag kun dga'o/ /rgyal po zla srung ma ti tsi tra phyi/ /phyogs glang zla grags shirnyi gan+ta sogs/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i ngo bor gsol ba 'debs/ /drin chen thu mi lo chen be+e ro'i zhabs/ /a ro ye 'byung zur chen shākya 'byung / /tsa mi zhang dang gtsang ston yong dgon pa/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i ྾ paṇa chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan 'jigs med grags/ /gter ston rdo rje gling dang kun gling / /bde yan chu pho rtogs ldan dbus smyon pa/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i ྾bon sater blo gros thogs med la nam rin/ /'bum 'phrag gsum pa phrang bu gter ston che/ /ho ru ka dpal dpa' bo thod dum can/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i ྾ snyigs lnga bdo ba'i dus 'dir rgyal gzhan las/ /phrin las rmad byung nges don bstan pa'i srog /sangs rgyas kun 'dus pad 'byung bde chen gling / /dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla mar ྾ gang khyed thugs ni mkha' khyab ye shes ste/ /gzugs sku'i bkod pa bde ba can zhing du/ /sangs rgyas 'od dpag med drung byang chub sems/ /sprul par zhal bzhes de la ྾ khyed mtshan brjod par dka' yang dad gdung gi/ /mtshan nas gsol 'debs bdog dgu'i yongs mchod na/ /kun bzang rnam snang pad 'byung be+e ro dngos/ /mgon khyod go 'phang bdag gi myur thob shog / ces sangs rgyas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma dpal bde ba chen po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di yang gang gi gsung las skyes pa'i sras rig pa 'dzin pa yongs kyi tha shal dpal tshe dbang nor bu'i dpal gdong chu bya cho 'phrul zla ba'i dkar phyogs rgyal ba gsum par mnga' ris kyi stod kha che dang nye ba mar yul wam ler smras pa'o/dge'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/ /oṃ susti/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /kun bzang gdod ma'i mgon po rgyal kun yab/ /nges pa lnga ldan bcom ldan rnam snang mdzad/ /mchog gi sprul sku yongs bsrung bsdu ba po/ /gsang bdag lag na rdo rjer phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba mchog gi sprul sku 'dod gar nyid/ /cir yang bsgyur las gangs can kun gyi mig /bstan pa'i sgron me mtshungs med mgon po che/ /be+e ro tsa na'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi sprul nga/'i rnam rol du ma las/ /gtso gyur phrag lnga'i nang nas thugs las sprul/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas thugs kyi 'od zer dang / /lhan gcig trīḥbam gis mtshan pad+ma dmar/ /mdo khams shar phyogs gser rong dmu rdo'i 'dabs/ /pad+ma dpa' bo nyid dang sgrol ma yis/ /byin rlabs yab yum lhums su nyer zhugs nas/ /yos lo ston zla ra ba'i tshes bcu la/ /sprul sku'i bkod pa 'char la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zla ba dgu nas bza' 'gro gtam kun mdzad/ /rak+ṣa thod phreng rtsal dang mthing 'od 'bar/ /sras su zhal bzhes sngon gnas rjes dran tshul/ /dam pa chos kyi spyod 564

pa kho na mdzad/ /rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha dang dam can tshogs/ /ma 'dres chu zla'i rol ba bzhin gzigs shing / /'jig rten lha 'dre bar do'i sems can yang / /gzigs nas 'gro don mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nar son gzhon nu'i skabs su phyug rdzis tshul/ /gshegs tshe chos kun ro mnyam rtogs pa yi/ /g.yangs sa chen po'i brag la bya ltar gshegs/ /rba klong chen po'i chu la nya ltar 'phyo/ /mi min gdug pa can gyis gnas rnams su/ /rtse 'jo'i tshul mdzad de rnams zhi la bkod/ /mthong bas skye rgu gzhan gyi yid 'phrog pa'i/ /gzhon nu'i rol pa ston la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan bla ma 'phrin las mtshan can la/ /thugs rje chen po'i dbang bskur gsan pa'i tshe/ /'phags pa'i dkyil 'khor nam mkha' khengs pa gzigs/ /grogs stobs nus pas der 'dus kun gyi yang / /pad+ma dmar po mkha' la 'phur lding mthong / /thugs rje chen po'i rnal 'byor la 'bad pas/ /snying po'i yi ge drug ma dung phyur lhag /rtse gcig bzlas par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgung lo bco brgyad mtha' ru nges 'byung gi/ /yongs skul dad pa'i grogs dang lhan gcig tu/ /dbus gtsang dag pa'i gnas kun mjal bar phebs/ /de tshe dmu rdo'i gnas su dhā ki lnga/ /kre shod gnas su byu ma gha ye dang / /rkong yul bu chur spyan ras gzigs mjal zhing / /tsa rir pad+ma 'byung gnas dngos byon nas/ /gsung gi blang dor gsal der phyag 'tshal lo khra 'brug zan yang mjal tshe dag pa yi/ /gzigs snang sgyu 'phrul rol pa bsam yas shing / /khyad par 'khrul nang bod kyi rten gtso mchog /shākya mu ne'i spyan sngar byon pa'i tshe/ /gzugs sku'i sems dpa' sum brtsegs rang bzhin gyis/ /gsung gi snang ba dngos su stsal ba'i tshe/ /lhan gcig khod pa'i grogs kyi'ang thos gyur pa/ /rmad byung mdzad pa bstan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gangs can mkhas grub kyi dbang po/ /kun mkhyen dri med kyi 'od zer/ /'od gsal rdo rje yi snying po'i/ /rtsod med theg mchog gi bdag por/ /gsol 'debs bu mchog la dgongs dang / /ka dag spros bral gyi lta ba/ /gzhi thog rigs stong gi ngang du/ /gang shar gsal stong du shar grol/ /lhun grub 'od gsal gyi gzigs mo/ /sgron ma bzhi ldan gyi gru bor/ /snang thong gong 'phel dang tshad phebs/ /sku dang zhing khams kyi snang ba/ /ye nas 'du 'brel du med pa/ /a la la ho r+ghaṃ sirnyi/ /don dam rang rig gi rtsal dbang / /skad gcig dus 'di ru rtsol gcig /ces rtsod med gter ston rig 'dzin chen po chos rje gling pa yi kun mkhyen rgyal ba dri med 'od zer la gsol ba 'debs pa a ri rdzogs chen gyi rang skad ji lta thol byung rdo rje'i gsungs byin brlabs kyi mtshan kha smad du 'byung ba ste sho lo ka yi kha rkang tshig rkang phyed gsum kaḥthog sprul sku rig 'dzin pas so/ /sarba maṅga lo/ /oṃ swāsti/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho kun gyi ngo bo/ /gsang ba rgya mtsho 'byung ba'i gter mdzod/ /ye shes rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag chen po/ /byin rlabs rgya mtsho'i spyi dpal bla ma/ /'khor lo'i mgon po mtsho skyes rdo 565

rje/ /gnyid med 'od gsal phyag brgya rgya chen/ /'dren mchog nam snying bde ba chen por/ /snying nas gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs shig /ces dran mchog rtsa ba'i bla ma snying nas dran pa'i gdung shug kyi gsol ba btab pa shar nyang po rgya mda' yi yul 'dab bā na dza la tsākrar me 'brug mgo zla yi dmar nyar tshe dbang nor bus smras pa'o/ /maṅga lo/oṃ swaste/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho kun 'dus ngo bo/ /gsang ba rgya mtsho kun gyi 'byung gnas/ /ye shes rgya mtsho'i dbang bsgyur mnga' bdag /mtsho skyes rdo rje bde ba chen po/ /phyag brgya rgya chen grub pa'i dbang phyug /nam mkha'i snying por snying nas 'dud do/ /byin gyis rlobs zhig da lta dus 'dir/ /he ru ka dpal khyed mtshungs mdzod gcig /zhes drag po lcags sprel mgo zla yi shes rab kyi cha shas gang bar dran mchog pad+ma bde chen gling pa'i dus mchod skabs su rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus brjod pa dge'o/ /dge'o/ /oṃ ā:r+ghaṃ: rgyal ba kun 'dus o rgyan yab yum mchog /rgyud sde bzhi 'dus gsang bdag he ru ka /lhan zhing sngags 'dus gsang ye phag khros ma/ /las ye dam 'dus ma mgon zhing skyong che/ /khyed la mos gus snying khong rus gting nas/ /rtse gcig phur btsugs drag pos gsol ba 'debs/ /gzigs shig thugs rje'i ma chung lhag pa'i lha/ /mchog thun dngos grub byin chen dus 'dir stsol/ /phyi yi bar chad mi dang mi min gyi/ /gnod 'gal gdug pa zlog mdzad nus ldan lha/ /nang gi bar chad 'byung bzhi 'du 'khrug gnad/ /gdon bgegs 'tshe ba thul mdzod thugs rje can/ /gsang ba'i bar chad las nyon 'khrul pa yis/ /rnam rtog dug lnga zhi mdzod byin rlabs tshan/ /chos min zang zing rnam g.yeng phyi yi bdud/ /gnyis 'dzin rtog tshogs rags rtsub nang gi bdud/ /ma rig gzugs 'dzin dngos zhen rang 'byung bdud/ /bag chags phung po 'dod yon lha bu'i bdud/ /'khrul snang nyon mongs las dbang 'chi bdag bdud/ /thams cad lhag pa'i lha mchog rtsa gsum gyis/ /thugs rjes bden mthus gzi byin rmad byung gi/ /log rtogs bdud dpung 'joms mdzod mthu ma chung / /las ngan sra ba gcod mdzod o rgyan rje/ /bdag sems ye nas 'khrul pa'i smag rum las/ /mgon khyod thugs rje'i nyi ma da ston 'tshal/ /bar chad tshang tshing ma lus 'dul mdzad la/ /'chi med bde chen dbang byin dngos grub stsol/ /ces rang nyid phyogs bsgrod shul du zhugs par phyi 'byung bzhi byed pa tsha grang dang nang nyon mongs rnam rtogs kyi lhong tshad rtsub mo rkyen grwa 'khor chos med dam dred kyi spyod pas rgyud rab tu 'khrug par gyur tshe de nyid rang zhi rang grol ched du rtsa ba gsum la gsol 'debs su rnal 'byor tshe dbang nor bus mdo khams ri bo che yi dgon du khro mo hor zla lnga pa'i tshes lnga la smras pa sarba maṅga lo/ /oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ trī: dkyil 'khor yongs gtso he ru ka /dpa' bo chen po stag sham can/ /pad+ma rdo rje thod 'phreng 'phrul/ /bla mar gsol 'debs bdag byin rlobs/ /gsang ba kun gyi mnga' bdag che/ / 566

gzhan don nus pa'i mchog dpal ldan/ /gsung gi rdo rje rta mchog 'phrul/ /bla mar gsol 'debs bdag byin brlobs/ /rgyal kun ye shes bzlum pa'i dngos/ /bsam gtan mchog la mnga' brnyes pa/ /kun bzang rdo rje 'chang gi 'phrul/ /bla mar gsol 'debs bdag byin brlobs/ /bla med bla ma 'dus pa'i bdag /yi dam kun gyi rigs bdag gsal/ /mkha' 'gro'i yab gcig dpa' bo dbang / /rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol 'debs kyi/ /bdag rgyud smin grol byin gyis brlobs/ /sgrib sbyangs tshogs rdzogs bde 'bras thos/ /byang chub mchog la rab tu 'khod/ /sku gnyis 'bras bu myur smin shog /ces lho gnas glang ma lung gi lte ba srog mkhar chos kyi pho brang du btsun pa o rgyan don bzang gi bskul ngor pad 'byung stag sham rdor mi phyed dad pa mchog tu thob pa'i rnal 'byor tshe dbang nor bu pad+ma gar dbang rdo rjes shing 'brug hor zla drug pa'i tshes bzang bco lngar smras pa dge'o/ /oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ hrī/ rgyal kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo pad+ma 'byung / /dregs pa tshar gcod rdo rje drag po rtsal/ /zhi khro'i mnyam 'bar bla ma he ru ka /zhi drag gsang bar gsol 'debs bdag byin rlobs/ /'od dpag med mgon rdo rje mkha' 'gro lung / /pad+ma gar dbang chen po rta mchog dpal/ /thugs rje'i 'gro ba dbang bsdus gsang ye ma/ /rtsa gsum don sbyor gsol 'debs bdag byin rlobs/ /dkon mchog spyi 'dus bla ma yid bzhin nor/ /sgrubs chen yongs 'dus yi dam rta mchog dpal/ /mkha' 'gro kun 'dus sde lnga khros seng ma/ /dgongs 'dus gsum la gsol 'debs bdag byin rlobs/ /kun gyi spyi gzugs dpa' bo stag sham can/ /gsang ba'i bdag po nus ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /bsam gtan rdo rje dri med ye shes rtsal/ /rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol 'debs bdag byin rlobs/ /tshe rabs sgribs sbyangs bsod nams ye shes rgyas/ /bkra shis bde skyid nyams rtogs gong du 'phel/ /lta ba klong gyur bdag gzhan don gnyis grub/ /rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phangs la sbyor shog /ces par gtam ri khrod du tshe ring dbang phyug gi bskul ngor phyogs med myul ba'i sprang ban tshe dbang nor ldan 'jigs med dgyes pa rtsal gyi shing 'brug hor zla lnga pa'i tshes bcu bdun la bris pa dge'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/oṃ ā:r+ghaṃ: khyab bdag dang po'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang / /rigs kun 'dus pa'i gsang chen rdo rje sems/ /rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs pad+mā ka ri zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag smin mchog thob mdzod/ /gsang ba 'dra ki'i ye shes mtsho rgyal ma/ /snyigs dus 'dren pa nus ldan gter gzhad snying / /sgrub pa'i dbang phyug rin 'dzin bde chen gling / /gsol ba 'debs so bdag smin mchog thob mdzod/ /thugs rje rmad byung gter ston rol rdo rje/ /gsung rab rgya mtsho dbang bsgyur che tshang zhabs/ /rgyud 'dzin rnal 'byor tshe dbang nor bu'i zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag smin mchog thob mdzod/ /de ltar brgyud pa'i bla mar gsol 'debs mthus/ /dbang bzhi'i bdag smin bskyed rdzogs zung gi grol/ /nyams 567

rtogs mthar phyin 'bras bu sngon du gyur/ /don gnyis lhun grub 'gro ba'i dpal du shog /ces pa long po grub chen sangs rgyas rdo rje'i slob ma sangs rgyas lhun grub kyi bskul ngor rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus brag gad pad+ma shel phug mdun du smra pa sarba maṅga lo/oṃ 'khor 'das spyi dpal kun bzang rdo rje sems/ /'gro 'dul 'od sku dga' rab pad+ma 'byung //thugs rjes 'dod gar bdud 'dul bde chen gling / /kun 'dus ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /zhes ye gong du sman chu'i dkor gnyer la phan gyi bskul ngor tshe dbang nor bus bris/oṃ ā:rgyu: kun bzang pad+ma 'byung gnas sgyu 'phrul gar/ /pad+ma bde gling karma rig pa 'dzin/ /gnyis med thugs sras tshe dbang nor bu'i zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod/ /ces rang gi slob ma thub brten gyi bskul ngor rgyal khams pa tshe dbang nor bus kun lung gnas sgo sman chu g.yu rtse'i ri khrod du smras pa/oṃ ā:r+ghaṃ: rgyal ba'i spyi mes kun tu bzang / /dang po'i sangs rgyas dus 'khor lo/ /'dren pa rigs mchog phod pa'i rtogs/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog byin rlobs/ /gsang ba'i bdag po zla ba bzang / /chos rgyal bdun dang rigs ldan lha/ /nyi shu lnga 'gyur thams cad la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog byin rlobs/ /sham+bha la dang rgya bod du/ /rdo rje gnas kun mkhyen pa'i dbang / /mi mchog rig grub lo paṇa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog byin rlobs/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyud sde yi/ /rig pa'i gnas kun smra ba yi/ /dbang phyug ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta/ /'jam dbyangs gsungs rab rgya mtsho'i sde/ /rgyud 'dzin slob mar bcas pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang gsang / /bden gnyis yongs rtogs mkhyen pa rgyas/ /grub chen 'od gsal dbang po'i slob ma rkang ban bstan pas bskul ngor tshe dbang nor bu yis gong 'bras yul du smras so/ /oṃ ā:rtsu: rigs bsdus sgyu 'phrul dpal ldan rdo rje sems/ /rgyal tshab sa bcu'i dbang phyug byams pa mgon/ /'od gsal sgyu ma'i sku bsnyes sha ba ri/ /zlos gar karma rig pa 'dzin pa che/ /rgyud 'dzin thugs sras slob mar bcas pa la/ /gsol 'debs byin rlobs smin grol mchog mthun stsal/ /zhes ye gang 'bras tshal gyi dad ldan gzhon nu ma tshi ring bu khrid kyi bskul ngor rgyal khams pa tshe dbang nor bus smras/oṃ susti/ mkha' khyab rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes thugs/ /chos kyi rdo rje mgon po 'od dpag med/ /snying rje'i rang mdangs gdul bya'i dpal mgon du/ /yongs shar spyan ras gzigs dbang gangs can mtsho/ /de yi ngo bor gyur cing sangs rgyas kyi/ /sprin spung spro bsdu byed po pad+ma 'byung / /nges don bstan pa spel phyir sprul pa'i sku/ /shing rta zla med shes rab rgyal ba'i mtshan/ /slar yang snyigs dus 'gro ba 568

'dren slad du/ /brtul zhugs mdzad pa rmad byung brtson 'grus bzang / /grub pa yongs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba che/ /mtshungs med bla ma mchog der gsol ba 'debs/ /gzhan yang pad+mā ka ra'i sgyu 'phrul rtsal/ /'jam mgon grub pa kun dga' grol ba'i mchog /bstan 'dzin ngag dbang nyi zla bzang po dpal/ /legs bshad gtam gyi 'byung khung kun dga' snying / /de dag rnams kyi bstan pa'i snying po gang / /ma nor shes bzhin 'dzin pa'i snying stobs can/ /nam snying sprul gar tshe dbang nor bu'i sde/ /drin chen rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs rnams la/ /rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa'i mthu nus kyis/ /bdag ni dus 'di nas bzung byang chen gyis/ /'bras bu ma thob bar du tshe rabs rtag /mtshan ldan bla ma mchog gi rjes su gzung / /dam tshig sel med thugs kyi dgyes dgu bsgrub/ /gzhan phan 'phrin las spel la mi g.yel zhing / /bla med thugs kyi sras mchog gyur nas kyang / /theg chen sa lam yon tan ma lus rdzogs/ /dpal ldan bla ma he ru ka dpal gyi/ /go 'phang mchog la myur du 'khod gyur nas/ /nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam 'gro don byed par shog /zhes pa 'di yang dbus chu bo ri lcags zam sprul pa'i sku'i phyag mdzad ngag dbang dge legs kyi gsol ba btab pa'i ngor rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus smras pa rnam kun dge legs su gyur cig maṅga lo/ /na mo gu ru ku ku ri pa ya/ he ru ka dpal gyis thugs rjes rol rtsal las/ /'phags yul dbus 'gyur du rgyal ba'i rigs las 'khrungs/ /gtsug lag na len+d+rar dge slong dngos por gyur/ /rgya gar shar phyogs du phag mos byin gyis rlabs/ /kasku'i brag phug nas rtsa gsum lha yul gshegs/ /snying rje'i dbang gi ni slar yang mi yul byon/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma ku ku'i tshul dang rol/ /o rgyan mkha' spyod nas sgyu 'phrul rgyud chen blang / /spyod pa rnam gsum gyis skal ldan tshom bu bcas/ /grong khyer skya nar nas sangs rgyas sa la gshegs/ /rgya gar grub thob mchog ku ku ri pa yi/ /rmad byung rnam thar gang thos shing dran byas te/ /dad dang gus pa yis lhang lhang gsol 'debs na/ /mkha' spyod dag pa nas thugs rjes spyan gyis gzigs/ /bdag sogs dad ldan la byin brlab 'pho ba'i dbang / /gdan thog 'di nyid du bskur bar mdzad nas kyang / /don dam lhan skyes kyis ye shes zab gsal bde/ /phyag rgya chen po'i don khongs su chud nas kyang / /rab 'byams las tshogs dang grub pa thogs med brnyes/ /mgon mchog khyed rang dang mtshungs par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa yang shar phyogs kong yul shing mo'i tshal lha ri seng nge'i mdun klu nga'i pho brang du grub pa'i slob dpon ku ku ri pa dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyu 'phrul ku ku'i gzugs can sngon dus phyogs der phebs zhing zhabs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi rjes sra mkhregs rdo la legs par bkod par byed pa yang yid kyi yul du gsal snang 'char ba'i mdo la tshigs su bcad pa 'di rnams bris shing de phral nyid du zhabs rjes kyang mngon gsum mig gi mthong bas gtan la phab te chu phag dbyu gu zla ba'i yar tshes brgyad la rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus so/ / 569

'dis kyang 'gro kun he ru ka ku ku ri pa'i go 'phangs la 'khod pa'i rgyur gyur gcig sarba maṅga lam̐ bha waskyo swā hā/o suste/ rgyal gzhan las lhag thugs bskyed dpa' bo che/ /bskal bzang 'dren pa yongs gtso shakya'i sras/ /bdud dpung mthar byed thub chen lha yi lha/ /rgyal kun ye shes ngo bo der phyag 'tshal/ /gsang gsum mi mdzad mkha' kham mtha' thug pa'i/ /rnam pa thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab sku/ /nyid las deng 'dir bdag cag gdul bya'i ngor/ /mtshan dpe yongs rdzogs 'gro ba'i bla mar 'dud/ /gser ri bye 'bum mdangs phrogs khyod kyi sku/ /mig sman bung ba ltar nag dpal 'khyil skra/ /rab mtsher ches dkar mdzod bu 'od 'bum 'khyil/ /gtsug gtor nam mkha'i pha mthar khyabs la 'dud/ /zhal sgo mdzes 'dzum snyan gyi shas ring shing / /shangs legs yid 'phrog spyan ras rab tu dwangs/ /zhal khyim phul du byung zhing sku stod rgyas/ /skal par ltas kyang ngom med mdzes der 'dud/ /phyag g.yas pad gdan snying por sa mnon mdzad/ /g.yon pa mnyam bzhag phyag brgya lte 'og 'chang / /tshangs spyod cha lugs ngur sbig chos gos gsol/ /rdo rje dkyil krung pad zlar bzhugs la 'dud/ /sku rgyab 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rab tu rgyas/ /me tog char dang rin chen gdugs mdzes phub/ /mdangs gsal nam mkha'i dbus su lham me ba/ /bcom ldan rdzogs sangs rgyas la gus pas 'dud/ /rgyal ba'i sku yi g.yas g.yon bar snang la/ /chos rgyal zla bzang rigs ldan 'jam dpal grags/ /sprul bzhi chos kyi sprin gyi dbang phyug che/ /rgyal sras mthu bo zung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang bdag sngo bsang skyabs dang sbyin pa'i rgya/ /thugs ka pus steng pad+ma sngo dmar bcas/ /rdo rje dril 'dzin sems dpa' rin chen chas/ /sems skyil dar gyis smad g.yogs can la 'dud/ /'jam dpal dmar ser chos 'khor phyag brgya yi/ /ut+pal steng na ral gri glegs bam 'dzin/ /sems dpa'i dkyil krung 'ja' mtshon smad g.yogs can/ /rin chen brgyan gyis yongs mdzes de la 'dud/ /rgyal ba'i mdun g.yas sa bzhir spyan ras gzigs/ /sprul pa kun mkhyen dol po sku sha rgyas/ /sa zhu chos gos gsum gsol g.yas sa gnon/ /g.yon pa chos gos gra nas 'dzin la 'dud/ /rgyal ba'i mdun dngos sa bzhir pad+ma 'byung gi/ /rnam 'phrul tā ra nā tha chos gos gsol/ /ngur smrig paṇa zhwa skyabs rgya g.yas thugs kar/ /g.yon pa mnyam bzhag glegs bam 'dzin la 'dud/ /de ltar rgyal ba mchog dang rgyal sras bzhi'i/ /gzugs brnyan gdul bya'i tshogs kyi zhing dam pa/ /rten brten tshul gyur sems dpa' gsum gyi dngos/ /mos pa'i ngo ru snang ba mchog de la/ /mi phyed dad pa'i yid kyi bstod pa'i mthus/ /bdag ni skye ba 'di nas byang chen bar/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras zhal bzang rtag mthong zhing / /rgyal ba'i bstan la lhag bsam bya ba byed/ /mdo sngags dgongs don ji bzhin ma 570

nor ba/ /gzhan la brgya cher ston pa'i 'gro ba la/ /phan pa mchog 'grub rgyal ba sras slob bcas/ /dgyes pa'i las kun bdag gi 'grub par shog /rtag brtan 'gyur ba med pa chos kyi dbyings/ /mi zhig bde ba chen po yongs grub pa/ /kun bzang rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang nyid/ /myur ba nyid thob don nyid lhun 'grub shog /ces ri khrod chen po jo mo nang du ston pa'i zab sku zhal 'byed tshe rgyal khams pa tshe dbang nor bus smras pa te shing stag nag zla'i nyer brgyad rje btsun dam pa'i dus chen skabs su'o/ /maṅga lo/rgyal ba'i mdun na rgyal sras li tsi wi/ /ka la pa ru rigs ldan pad+ma dkar/ /dpal gyi ri la klu sgrub chen por grags/ /'gro mgon jo snang pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /spos nged ldan na chos 'phags sems dpa' che/ /lha ldan grong du srong btsan sgom po ste/ /rnga yab gling du pad+ma 'byung gnas pa/ /shes rab rgyal mtshan zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi blo gros nam mkha'i khyon ltar yangs/ /de bzlos gsung rab nges don rdzogs par dgongs/ /dam chos don du srog kyang 'dor nus pa'i/ /dol pa por grags bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /maṅga lo bha waskyo swā hā/ oṃ a:r+ghaṃ kun khyab spros bral chos dbyings ye shes khams/ /klong chen rab 'byams chos bskur gsol ba 'debs/ /g.yo med dag bsal rang bzhin ye shes lnga/ /dri med 'od zer longs bskur gsol ba 'debs/ /'bad med lhun grub gang 'dul 'gro don mdzad/ /sna tshogs rang grol sprul skur gsol ba 'debs/ /mnyam nyid khyab brdal ma 'dres zung 'jug sku/ /bsam yas ngo bo nyid bskur gsol ba 'debs/ /tshul khrims ut+pal blo gros glegs bam spud/ /ngag gi dbang phyug mkhyen rab ral gri yi/ /mi shes dra ba mtha' dag gcod mdzad pa/ /gzi brjid rdo rje rnon po gsol ba 'debs/ /byar med klong yang nam mkha' dwangs pa la/ /blo gros mchog gi lang tsho stong 'bar bas/ /'gro ba'i blo mun mtha' dag sel mdzad mgon/ /kun bzang thugs kyi rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /thub bstan rtsod ldan snyigs dus mtha' thug 'dir/ /theg mchog rdzogs ldan rdo rje snying po'i chos/ /ma nor bston mdzad pad 'byung bi ma la/ /dngos gyur kun bzang dri med 'od zer la/ /rab dad snying nas sngar thug gsol 'debs kyi/ /brtse chen thugs rjes bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /'gro phan rgyal bstan sgron me ngag dbang phyug /khyed 'dra du ma rtag tu 'byung ba dang / /de brten 'dzin pa rgyu dkar bkram pa bzhin/ /de la che btsan skye rgu dregs pas btud/ /'od gsal snying po'i tshigs don la dga' bas/ /sa gsum mtha' dag khyab par byin gyi rlobs/ /bdag kyang skye kun khyod kyi phrin las pa/ /pad 'byung bi ma'i dgongs gzhed rdzogs pa che/ /ma nor ston byed 'gro ba'i ded dpon mchog /gyur nas khams gsum 'khor ba dong sprugs shog /ces pa 'di yang dkar po'i lo zhal gsar du 'char ba rgyal gyi zla ba'i dmar phyogs rgyal ba dang po kun mkhyen chos rje'i dus chen skabs su snying thag pa nas mos gus gyi spu long g.yo ba'i rang gdang tshigs su bcad pa'i gsol 'debs mnga' rigs gung thang za 'og phug tu rgyal khams pa rig 'dzin tshe dbang 571

nor bus smras pa'o/ /o swāste/ mkhyen rab 'od stong 'bar ba'i ral gri yis/ /mi shes mun pa'i dra ba mthar byed pa/ /brtse ba'i ut+pal shes rab spu stis brgyan/ /'jam dbyangs gzhon nur snying nas gsol ba 'debs/ /gang khyed sangs rgyas kun gyi yab gyur mod/ /sangs rgyas sras kyi thu bor yang ni rdzu/ /snyigs dus 'gro la gshin rje tshul yang ston/ /rin chen grub pa'i rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs/ /dus 'dir bka' drin gsum ldan bla ma gang / /khyed las gzhan med khyod du shes bzhin par/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin rlabs nus pa'i mthus/ /khyed rang ji bzhin 'bras bu myur thob mdzod/ /ces rang gi slob ma zha lu ba chen po sdom brtson rdo rje 'dzin pa byams pa chos kyi rgyal pos bskul ba'i ngor phyogs med rgyal khams pa rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus chos 'khor dpal gyi lha sar gro zhun zla ba'i yar tshes thob pa dang po la bris pa sarba maṅga lo/o swāste/ bskal bzang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rab gsal zhabs/ /sngon nas byang chub rin chen tog zhes bya/ /da lta'ang mngon dga'i zhing na mi 'khrugs mgon/ /zhing 'dir rgyal sras bu ston sprul ba'i 'dud/ /rigs med 'gro la bu ltar brtse chen gter/ /ston pa'i rgyal tshab rin chen bstan pa'i bdag /mkhas grub yongs kyi spyi dpal thams cad mkhyen/ /bu ston rin chen grub la gsol ba 'debs/ /mdo rgyud bstan pa kun gyis mig gcig bu/ /rgyal dgongs 'dren pa'i shing rta mchog khyed la/ /gsol ba btab mthus khyod bstan dar rgyas zhing / /bdag kyang 'gro phan sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog /zhes phyogs med ris med kyi rnal 'byor pa 'jam dbyangs rgya mtshos gus pa chen po gtsang ru lag brgyan byang chub dgon gnas su srin po snron zla'i sher phyogs tshes lnga la bris pa sarba maṅga lo/oṃ mchog gi zab gsal ye shes mkha' mnyam rnyes/ /srid gsum bdud sde'i dpung tshogs phye mar 'joms/ /mchog thun dngos grub char ltar 'bebs mdzad pa/ /dpal ldan bi ru pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /ces na zlum gtsug lag khang du dpal bi ru pa'i gsol 'debs 'di ni bo dong 'jigs bral zhabs kyi bi ru par dngos su gzisas pa'i sku brnyen mjal ma thag thol byung nyid du rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus smras pa dge'o/ /oṃ swasti/ rgyal ba kun gyis mkhyen rab gser gyis 'bras ldan ljon shing nas bltams pa/ /tshad med thugs rje'i blo gros nam mkha'i mtha' klas yangs pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir dpal gyi ri 'dab nyer 'khrungs rgyal ba'i sras mchog gyur/ /bo dong pa zhes lung rigs 'jigs med 'phrog byed dbang po'i spo chen por/ /mdzes pa'i brgyan gcig 'jig rten gsum mgon rjes 'gro de thun mdzes pa'i sprun/ /dbyangs can mgrin zhugs ut+pal rgyas pa'i ge sar 'jam dpal gyis glegs bam ni/ /de gnyis 'dus pas nyer mtshon chos kyi rgyal mtshan sa gsum 'khyon
