kun tu/ /rgyas mdzad dpa' bo dbyangs can dga' ba zhes bya mtshungs med bla ma che/ /thub dbang bstan la gnyis med smra 572

ba'i khyu mchog zla ba grags pa dang / /gangs can mig gcig thu mir grags dang be+e ro tsa na'ang khyod nyid yin/ /rgyun mi chad par 'gro ba'i dpal mgon kun mkhyen bo dong rgyal ba la/ /snying nas phyag 'tshal gus pas bstod do bdag la thugs rjes byin gyi rlobs/ /ces dpal ma dpal khud chos lding dge slong lhun grub bzang po'i ched du rang gzhan gyi grub mtha' rgya mtshor 'jigs pa med par zhugs pa blo gros kyi gru rdzing cha shas thob pa bo dong pa'i lta grub ji bzhin shes gyur dpal rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus bal yul tī ḍo'i gtsug lag khang chen mor na tshod ldan gyi lo zhal gsar du 'char ba rgyal zla'i bzang po gsum pa la bris pa dge'o/ /oṃ suste/ 'gyur med dod nas rnam par dag pa'i khams/ /chos kun mnyam nyid spros dang bral ba'i gshis/ /sna tshogs 'gag med rnam pa thams cad pa/ /gnas lugs chos sku r+ghaṃ nag bde gshegs snying/ /chags med rang byung pad+ma rag dbang phyug /zag med bde ba chen po'i ngo bo nyid/ /'dod dgu longs spyod rdzogs pa rdo rje chos/ /bla med bla ma pad+ma bde chen gling / /thog med nus pas bdud bzhi'i dpung 'joms zhing / /sgrib bral mkhyen pas rdo rje'i ting 'dzin brnyes/ /rgyal ba'i spyod pas sangs rgyas zhing kun khyab/ /he ru ka dpal bdud 'joms rdo rje rtsal/ /oṃ swaste/ rgyal kun thugs rje'i mtshor skyes 'od dpag med/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas res 'ga' kasna ka/ /dbyer med rgyal dbang bka' brgyud 'phrin las sde/ /gang gi thugs dang gnyis su med gyur pa/ /tshe dbang nor bu don dam rdo rje sems/ /de yi byin brlabs bden pa'i nus thus yis/ /dus 'di nas rtsom byang chub snying po'i bar/ /mgon des rjes bzung sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog /ces pa yang rig 'dzin rgyal khams pas smras pa sarba maṅga lo/rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi 'khor lo'i mgon/ /'dren mchog dwangs ma bde chen gling pa yi/ /sku yi sras gyur thugs kyi gdungs mtsho ba/ /pad+ma dbang rgyal zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /bsam bzhin skye bzung mngal gyi dris ma gos/ /chung ngu nyid nas dam pa'i rnam thar spyod/ /nar son tshe na gter bdag gling pa sogs/ /mkhas dang grub mang brten der gsol ba 'debs/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i dbang dang sgrub thabs kun/ /legs nos smin grol lag len lnga rab brnyes/ /phyi nang rnam bcu mchog gi sa la brnyegs/ /rdo rje slob dpon mchog der gsol ྾ ye shes mkha' 'gros rtag par byin rlabs shing / /rtogs pa'i zil gyis lha 'dre mi kun 'du/ /skal ba ldan kun byang chen sa la sbyor/ /rdo rje 'dzin mchog de la gsol ྾ rang don sngon song gzhan don 'phrin las bdag /mthong thos dran reg 'brel tshad don dang ldan/ /skyes mchog dam pa khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag sogs 'gro ba'i don du zhabs brtan gsol/ /rtag tu khyed dang 'brel med 'grogs gyur cig /dam tshig sel med chos kyi bdud rtsi myang / /thugs yid gcig 'dres dga' spro rgyun mi chad/ /byang chub che bar rtag tu 573

bde skyid shog /ces bde chen gling pa'i sras kyi dam pa pad+ma dbang rgyal la snying nas mos pa'i rnal 'byor pa tshe dbang nor bus bal bod mtshams mang yul gyi ri bo dpal 'bar du me lug nag zla'i dmar phyogs ḍā ki 'du'i tshes la sbyar ba maṅga lo/oṃ swāsnyi/ dpal mchog dang po'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang / /snyigs dus 'gro 'dus rdo rje slob dpon che/ /grub rigs dbang po'i skur ston 'khor lo'i mgon/ /rje btsun kun bzang dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /oṃ suste/ kun bzang rdor 'chang shākya seng ge yi/ /mdo rgyud kun tu bla ma sangs rgyas las/ /lhag par bsngags bzhin rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /shes bzhin mi phyed dad pas gsol ba 'debs/ /gangs can 'gro ba'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /snyigs dus gdul byar lhags par brtse ba yi tshad med snying rje'i rang gzugs bla ma'i sku/ /dpal ldan 'brug pa mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /oṃ swāsnyi/ kun khyab rgyal ba'i dbang phyug kun tu bzang / /rigs drug khyab bdag dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /gsang chen rigs gcig bcom ldan rdo rje sems/ /gsol ba 'debs so smin grol dngos grub 46pa/ /oṃ suste/ 'gyur bcas dri kun mi 'gyur bde ba che/ /rab gzhom gnyis med spros med chos kyi dbyings/ /don dam rdo rje thugs kyi rdo rje sems/ /bla ma mchog des bdag la mchog dgyes mdzod/ /ces dpal rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu'i shing khyi sa ga zla ba'i dmar phyogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus tshes 27skabs bal yul tī ḍor ched du brjod pa sarba maṅga lo/ kun nas kun tu bzang po'i rol pa nyid/ /dga' bzhi dga' chen he ru ka dpal la/ /rnam mang 'gro sbyor rnam kun mchog ldan bdag /rgyal gyur rgyal sras de la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes mthu stobs 'jigs med dpa' bo kun dga' rnam rgyal la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di yang rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu'i shing khyi sa ga zla ba'i shir phyogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i tshes nyer dgu la tī ḍor bris pa sarba maṅga lo/mkha' khyab rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje'i dpyid/ /bde chen thig le zung 'jug rdo rje'i khams/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba sdom mdzad ho ru ka /blo bzang chos kyi dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /ces dad ldan karma rdo rje'i gsol ba btab pa'i ngo ga ru dpal rig pa 'dzin pas dngos grub phug bsam brten spyil bo spel ba shulha/ sarba maṅga lo/ bka' drin mtshungs med rdo rje slob dpon rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs rgya mtsho'i sprin pho ba e ma ho/ na mo badz+ra a tsar+ya pa ra marma sarba pā tā ya/ gdod ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang po'i zhal/ /snyigs dus gdul byar bsten mdzad rdo rje sems/ /sgyu 'phrul gar bsgyur pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal/ /bde ba chen pos rtag tu bdag skyongs mdzod/ /nges pa'i don la grangs med mngon rol du/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyang slar yang gdul bya la/ /snying rjes gzugs skur gzheng pa bde gshegs snying / /dren mchog dwangs ma'i mgon po la phyag 'tshal/ /tshe rabs 'phreng bar khyod kyi rjes su gzung / /smin grol zung 'jug rdo rje'i sa 574

la bzhag /dran pa tsam gyi srid zhi'i gdung sel ba/ /pad+ma bde chen gling par gsol ba 'debs/ /mkha' khyab spros bral ye shes mchog brnyes shing / /sgyu 'phrul cir yang ston mdzad sha ba ri/ /phyogs 'dir rtsod med mchog gi sprul pa'i sku/ /bla med bla ma che tshang la gus 'dud/ /lung rigs spob pa dri med mkha' ltar brdal/ /'od gsal thun mi chad pa'i ye shes gzigs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs dang gnyis med pa/ /karma rig 'dzin zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba'i sras gyur gu ru'i lung gi zin/ /rig sngags 'chang ba yongs kyi 'khor los bsgyur/ /bstan pa'i mnga' bdag dpal ldan kaḥthog pa/ /bsod nams lde'u btsan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /dam pa'i rigs 'khrungs rtse gcig bsgrub la brtson/ /yi dam las rung las bzhi thog med grub/ /he ru ka dpal dpa' bo stag ras can/ /bskal bzang bla ma mchog der gsol ba 'debs/ /sbas pa'i tshul gyis spang rtogs yon tan rgyas/ /drang srong gzugs la ras dkar gshog pas mdzes/ /phyogs 'dir rnal 'byor brtul zhugs spyod pa'i gtso/ /kun bzang rin po che la gsol ྾ skyes mchog dam pas rgyal tshab cod paṇa bcing / /bla med bstan pa ris med phyogs mthar 'gyed/ /nges gsar bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin mdzad pa/ /u rgyan bi mut+ta la gsol ྾ bla med byin rlabs zab gter kha byang 'dzin/ /ye shes 'jigs med grags dang dbang chen gyis/ /bka' bab gang 'dul 'gro skyong chos rje gling / /sprul pa'i gter ston gnyis la ྾ bla ma'i sras gyur las smon mchog dang ldan/ /blo gros rab yangs pad+ma dbang rgyal zhabs/ /chos brgyad zhen log nam mkha' rgya mtsho'i sde/ /'brel tshad don ldan gnyis la ྾ gu ru'i snyen pa drangs tshad mthar thug 'atsākha/ /mos gus gcig pu'i lam rdzogs dge 'dun blo/ /mthar lam legs pa'i gros ston chos rgyan skyabs/ /sbas pa'i bla ma gnyis la ྾ zab zhi spros bral rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /gnyos rigs 'dzin sras rin chen rnam par rgyal/ /zla ba'i 'od zer 'phro ba nye ba'i mgon/ /grub pa'i gdung 'dzin gnyis la ྾ pad+ma'i bstan pa spel phyir sad na legs/ /bsam zhing gdul bya'i don du sku sprul zhing / /rnam dpyod mchog ldan smin grol gdams pa 'dzin/ /u rgyan lhun grub zhabs la ྾ sprul pa'i skye ba rgyun mi chad bzhes nas/ /snyan rgyud bstan pa kun tu spel mdzad pa/ /bstan 'dzin mchog dang gar dbang par grags pa'i/ /zur mang sprul sku zung la ྾ o rgyan gu ru'i phrin las kha lo pa/ /grags pa mtha' yas kun dga' bstan 'dzin dpal/ /lung rtogs mnga' bdag si tu chos 'byung zhabs/ /skyes chen bla ma nyid la ྾ stag lung ga zi'i gdung gi tha ma pa/ /rigs sngags 'chang ba bkra shis rnam par rgyal/ /bzang po rdo rje'i rjes gzung 'od gsal dbang / /chos kyi drin ldan nyid la ྾ nus ldan rdo rje'i rigs dbon grub pa'i dbang / /rnam dag tshul khrims rtse chen snying rje'i gter/ /yongs 'chang 575

mchog sprul rig 'dzin rnam par rgyal/ /bka' drin mtshungs pa med der ྾ bdud 'dul dpa' bo mchog gi sku yi sras/ /yi dam lha dang gnyis su med pa yi/ /sngags kyi brtul zhugs grub pa'i rig pa 'dzin/ /tshe dbang rdo rje'i zhabs la ྾ 'od dpag med mgon thugs kyi rnam sprul ni/ /pad+ma'i cod paṇa gyis sgegs brgyad pa'i sku/ /rgyud sde'i nyi ma chos kyi don kun grub/ /'dren pa mtshungs med mchog der ྾ u rgyan gu ru'i thugs sprul 'gro 'dul gyis/ /mdzad pa nyer skyong rgyal kun 'phrin las pa/ /byang chub rdo rje sems pa'i cod pan can/ /rgyal ba'i dbang po'i zhabs la ྾ grangs med skal pa'i sngon nas rgyal kun gyi/ /yab gyur sangs rgyas kun las lhag pa'i mthu/ /ma lus thob kyang slar yang zhing rnams su/ /sprul pas skyongs mdzad tre+e bor mgo bos 'dud/ /dus 'dir gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa che/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i mtha' thug 'gro ba'i mgon/ /byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi snying po zhes/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la ྾ grub pa'i yang srid rdo rje snying po yi/ /lung rtogs rgyas mdzad pad+ma gar gyi dbang / /lang gro lo tsā'i rigs 'khrungs sgrol ma ba/ /snga 'gyur gsal byed gnyis la ྾ ye shes mkha' 'gro ne gu'i gser chos bcud/ /chad med byin rlabs brgyud pa yongs 'dzin pa/ /sbas tshul grub pa'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang / /wastebadz+ra zhabs la ྾ lung rigs smra mkhas ngag dbang rin po che/ /bslab gsum rgyan mdzes bka' bcu su ma dhī/ /nges don spub brtson bsgom chen lha skyabs zhabs/ /bka' drin can gyur gsum la ྾ yi dam zhal gzigs nges don bstan srog 'chang / /mchog gi bdag nyid blo gros chos 'phel zhabs/ /de sras sdom btsan rnal 'byor ngag gi dbang / /'dzam gling yab sras gnyis la ྾ 'khrul pa kun zhi nam mkha' bstan 'dzin dpal/ /rtsa thig las rung zab gsal chos 'phel mtshan/ /zhi dul dge sbyong gu na shi bha dra/ /chos kyi skyong mdzad gsum la ྾ zab gsang bde mchog mkha' 'gro snyan rgyud skor/ /legs 'dzin spros bral blta ba'i gnas lugs rtogs/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug shākya seng ge zhes/ /bka' drin mnyam med zhabs la ྾ nyang rigs sngags kyi rnal 'byor rdo rje 'dzin/ /mtshungs med bla ma pad+ma dbang grags zhabs/ /'tsho mdzad byang chub sems dpa' chos bzang po/ /bka' drin mchog gyur gsum la ྾ rang rig dpa' bos rjes gzung rnal 'byor pa/ /mchog gzigs rje btsun 'phrin las rab brten zhabs/ /tshe gcig sgrub brtson bsod nams chos kyi dbang / /rnal 'byor dbang phyug gnyis la ྾ chos snang rgyas pa badz+ra na tha pa/ /rigs sngags 'chang ba za lung pa rdo rje/ /gang shar gdong 'ded skyong ba gzhon nu blo/ /chos 'brel thob pa gsum la ྾rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi dbang phyug che/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas mi yi skur gzhengs pa/ /rdo rje sems dngos kun bzang dbang po'i sde/ /snying gi thig le dbus su rnam kun 'dus/ /dus 'dir gdul 576

bya rnams la khyod snang sku/ /thos dang bsam pa'i yon tan rab rgyas shing / /mngon shes lnga ldan gdul bya'i bsnyen gcig bu/ /chos rje bla ma'i zhabs la ྾ rigs brgya'i ngo bo kun bzang gdod ma'i maso/na//bde chen sgyu ma'i skur gzheng bi ma la/ /de dang gnyis med gnyag rigs grub pa'i dbang / /rig 'dzin rnam rgyal zhes la ྾ zhes rang lo sum bcu sne zin yan chad kyi rdo rje slob dpon rnams la gsol ba btab pa 'di ni rgyal ba kun las bla ma lhag pa nges shes gting nas thob pa'i mos gus can shākya'i bstan pa la tshang par spyod pa'i dge bsnyen rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus glo bo cong bzhi'i phug tu hor zla dgu pa'i tshes bcu la smras pa'i yig rig ni ris lung rgyud bde smra ba'i khyu mchog dam pa o rgyan karma shwa pa na dha ra shrī ri ma bha dra se nas bgyis pa dge'o/ /o rgyal kun ye shes spyi gzugs rdo rje can/ /sgyu 'phrul bsam gyi mi khyab rol pa las yongs shar sprul pa'i zlos gar mi yi gzugs/ /grub pa'i shing rta mchog der gsol ba 'debs/ /gang 'dul gdul bya'i don du snang ba'i tshe/ /bsam bzhin skye ba'i phreng ba yongs gzung nas/ /gzhan phan rgya chen mdzad pa'i bdag nyid che/ /'dren mchog sprul pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /bsam bzhin skye ba gtsang gi rdzing bu ru/ /thos pa brgya mtsho'i 'o mtshor rab khyil bar/ /bsam pa'i sbu phrengs bye ba rab g.yo zhing / /bsgom pa'i zla rigs can der gsol ba 'debs/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs mngal nas legs thon pa'i/ /sgrib med phyag rgya chen po grub pa'i sku/ /rten 'brel ral pa'i cod paṇa 'khrol bzhin du/ /ro mnyam rgyan 'chang dpa' bor gsol ba 'debs/ /gtsug tor rtse mor rang rigs rje snyem nas/ /gnyug ma'i lag la mi pham mgon po yi/ /rig pa dri med rdor dril cir yang bsgyur/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab mchog der gsol ba 'debs/ /'jigs med dga' ba'i bzhed gzhung zla tshes dang / /gnas lugs nor bu'i mchog spras do ker can/ /dpe med spros bral dga' ma la khyud pa/ /he ru ka dpal bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar 'jam dbyangs phrin las rab brtan mchog /khyed la rtse gcig gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /zhing 'dir zhabs pad bskal rgyar bstan nas kyang / /bdag sogs gdul bya smin grol mchog thob shog /ces rje bla ma dam pa 'phrin las rab brten la gus pa chen pos mdo khams dbus 'gyur gyi sngags 'chang tshe dbang nor bus phur bu dbyu gu zla ba'i tshes bzang bcu la phul ba sarba maṅga lo/oṃ/ srid zhi spyi dpal mgon mchog pad+ma 'byung / /de sras mchog phur bka' babs ku mā ra/ /'gro la rjes chags sprul pa'i zlos gar gzugs/ /cir yang ston par gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /rta nag mchog 'khrung sbas tshul rnal 'byor pa/ /kar ston shāka grags rin chen dpal bzang po/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan thugs rjes bsam 'grub dang / /nam mkha' rdo rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /bod chen yul 'khrungs bslab gsum 'dzin pa'i zhes/ /dam pa'i skyes mthar mang yul phyogs su bltams/ /bla ma'i 577

thugs sras kun bzang rang rigs pa/ /ngag dbang ye shes gang der gsol ba 'debs/ /gsol ba btab thus mgon khyed sku tshe brten/ /brtan nas nges don brtan pa gong du 'phel/ /'phel pa nyams med rgya mtsho'i gos can khengs/ khengs nas 'gro kun rdzogs sangs rgyas thob shog /de skad dad ldan slob ma sher 'byung gi /yang yang gsol ba btab dang nye ba'i lam/ /gang gi zhabs ring dge 'dun grags pas kyang / /nan tu bskul ngor rig pa 'dzin pas smras/ /slob ma'i gsol 'debs bla med rtsam 'os min/ /'on kyang bla mas bskul bas dam pa 'dir/ /dbang 'brel zhus pas bla ma'i grangs gtogs phyir/ /gus zhing dwangs ba'i sems kyi bris pa yin//oṃ susti/ 'gyur medatshogadod nas rnam par dag pa'i khams/ /bral smin rang 'byung rtsal rdzogs kun tu bzang / /mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i dpal mgon rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /lnga ldan rgyal ba'i zhing na a rong mig / gangs can mgon po lag na pad dkar 'chang / /dbyer med thugs rje'i rang gzugs gdul bya'i dpal/ /mtshungs med dpal ldan 'brug par gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal gzhan las lhag thugs bskyed dbang gi ni/ /bka' rgyud snying po'i bstan pa spel slad du/ /phrin las rab 'byams 'dren pa'i shing rta che/ /rnam 'dren sprul sku mchog de gsol ba 'debs/ /gang khyed nges don skye 'chi spros bral yang / /gang 'dul gdul bya'i snang ngor cir bston na/ /zhing 'dir 'gro ba'i mgon du bskal pa brgyar/ /khyed zhabs rdo rje khri bltar bstan gsol 'debs/ /gang gi tshad med thugs rje'i mthu la bsten/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal yongs sel zhing / /nges don snying po'i bstan pa gong du 'phel/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bus sa steng khyab par shog /ces dpal 'gro ba'i mgon po rnam 'dren 'brug pa mchog gi sprul pa'i sku gang gi zhabs pad yun ring du brten pa'i ched du rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus mang yul gung thang 'chi med grub pa ras pa yab sras kyi bsgrub gnas za 'og phug nas phul ba sarba maṅga lo/ /dpal ldan dpa' bo mchog gi sprul pa'i phreng bar gsol ba 'debs pa karke ta yi ma la zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ swāste/ na mo gu ru shrī wa ti wi ra ya/ dpal ldan dpa' bo mchog gi sprul pa'i 'phreng bar gsol 'debs pa karke ta yi ma lā zhes bya ba/ 'od dpag tu med pa'i ngo bo pad+ma 'byung gnas dang gnyis su med pa dpal karma ka yi sras mchog dpal ldan dpa' bo la phyag 'tshal/bzod nas rnam dag ye shes dri ma las/ /yongs su grol zhing slar yang rgyal sras tshul/ /gdul bya 'dren phyir rnam 'gyur cir yang ston/ /mtshungs med dpal ldan bla ma gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba'i zhing khams pad+ma bkod pa ru/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas u dum wa ra dmar po mchog yi/ /spyan sngags byang chub spyod pa nyer spyod pa/ /rgyal sras dam par gyur la gsol ba 'debs/ /mi mjed bzang po'i bskal par rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /kun gyis phrin las byed po pad 'byung dang / /yid 'dzin grub pa'i rgyal mos rjes 578

gzung ba/ /shes rab 'byung gnas zhabs la gsol ྾ mkhas mchog rin 'byung mar me mdzad dbasku zhabs/ /nyer bsnyen rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nyid dang / /dbyer med grub gtso dge slong ma yis tshul/ /bde skyongs bzang mo'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /dam pa mi pham mgon dang mi'i seng ge'i/ /sras kyi thu bo srid zhi yongs grol sku/ /'jam dpal mgon dang dbyer med grub pa che/ /rol pa ye shes zhabs la gsol ba ྾ sten lo nyang ral zhangs dang stags lung pa'i/ /thugs kyi sras gyur rdo bod gdul bya'i mgon/ /rlabs chen chos kyi rgyal srid skyong ba po/ /sangs rgyas rong ston chen por gsol ba 'debs/ /gser sgo klu phug las 'bral tsal rnams kyi/ /don brgyud chu bo 'dus pa'i skyes gcig pu/ /pad+ma'i zab gter mdzod 'chang rig 'dzin che/ /u rgyan rin chen gling par gsol ba 'debs/ /sngon 'brel rtsa ba gsum gyi byin rlabs zhugs/ /sad byed bla med don dam ye shes mtshon/ /zab gter sgo 'byed 'gro 'dul bsam 'grub mgon/ /rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bcas la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang chen mgon po mtsho skyes rdo rje dang / /grub mchog dpal ldan bzang po'i thugs skyes sras/ /brtul zhugs thogs med rol pa'i gar mkhan che/ /chos dbang lhun grub dpa' bor gsol ba 'debs/ /mi 'khrugs rgyal bas u rgyan phul byung gi / /shes rab ral gri 'bar dang lhan cig tu/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i ut+pal rgyas gyur pa/ /yongs rdzogs gtsug lag 'phreng der gsol ba 'debs/ /spyod pa'i rdo rje dbang phyug karma ka'i/ /'phrin las mtha' dag byed por dbang bskur zhing / /sum ldan 'khor los bsgyur ba'i bdag nyid che/ /gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gdul bya kun bzang spyod pas dbugs dbyung zhing //don dam chos dbyings rdo rje 'du 'brel med/ /'gro la phan bde ster ba mdzad pa po/ /gtsug lag kun tu bzang por gsol ba 'debs/ /srid zhi yongs grol 'jig rten mgon po yi/ /thugs kyi chu gter las thon thos sgom kyi/ /bdud rtsi'i nyer gtam 'gro la bde ster mgon/ /gtsug lag 'phrin las rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal kun ye shes chos nyid rdo rje sems/ /gang gi thugs dang gnyis med mnyams yangs pa/ /gdul byar thar mchog byin pa'i ded dpon che/ /gtsug lag don 'grub mchog der gsol ba 'debs/ /byang chub rdo rje dgyes pa'i thugs nyid kyi/ /rgyal tshab dam pa dbang bskur snying po yi/ /bstan pa'i sgron me don rgyud chu bo'i bdag /gtsug lag dga' ba'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' snyigs dus 'gro ba'i don/ /rdo rje slob dpon mchog gi skur snang bas/ /gdul bya thar la bzud pa'i ded dpon che/ /skyes mchog skye ba'i 'phreng bar gsol btab mthus/ /bdag sogs skye ba tshe rabs thams cad du/ /yang dag lam mkhan dpal ldan dpa' bo yi/ /dngos rgyud yul gyur mtshan nyid kun ldan pa'i/ /bla ma dam pas rtag tu rjes bzung shog /tshul khrims bslab pa so thar byang 579

chub sems/ /sngags kyi dbang bskur thob nas de'i bcas pa/ /dam tshig srog gi phyir yang mi btong bar/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i dgyes pa kun bsgrub shog /ting 'dzin bslab pa 'jig rten 'jig rten las/ /'das pa'i zhi gnas skyon med rnam dag grub/ /spyan dang mngon par shes pa'i mthu thob cing / /ting 'dzin gsum gyi yon tan gong 'phel shog /shes rab bslab pa thos pas chos kun 'dzin/ /tshig rjes don sems bsam pa rnam par dag /sgom pa lhag mthong ye shes mngon du gyur/ /shes rab gsum la'ang rang byan chud par shog /bdag ni skye kun mtho ris yon tan dang / /'phags nor rnam smin yon tan gyis mngon mtho/ /nges legs bslab gsum dag pas rgyal dang sras/ /slob bcas 'phags kun dgyes la rtag spyod shog /rnam kun stong nyid snying rje zung du 'jug /phyag rgya chen po mi 'gyur bde bas 'khyud/ /ma grub bzhin snang sgyu 'dra'i 'gro ba kun/ /rdo rje sems pa'i sa la bzhag par shog /ces dpal ldan dpa' bo yi sprul pa'i skye 'phreng la gsol ba 'debs ste/ skye 'phreng de rnams las shas cher rin chen gling pa'i rang gter gyi rgyud dang gu ru'i lung gi gsal bas ngo mtshar gyi gnas su mthong bzhin/ rang gi mos pa'i gsos su 'bri bar ring nas sems bzhin la/ nye bar dpal ldan dpa' bo bdun pa gtsug lag dga' ba'i zhabs gang gi rigs kyi gcung 'phrin las byed po karma do pa su ṣā zhes pas gsung gis bskul ba dang / rim 'gro pa karma tshul khrims kyis kyang yang yang gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ rnal 'byor rgyal khams spyod pa dpal tshe dbang nor bus sa ga zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum pa la/ mtshur gyi gadzha la yang brtse bkra shis kun gsal g.yu drung 'khyil bar bris pa'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/ dge'o/ /oṃ swāsti ra su/ bskal bzang zhing 'dir rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong / /kun gyi 'phrin las gcig bsdus pad+ma 'byung / /zhing gzhan rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med/ /mgon khyod dpe zlar zas gtsang sras las su/ /des na 'phags yul rgyan drug rig 'dzin brgyad/ /grub thob brgyad bcu la sogs ngo mtshar ba'i/ /gnas su gyur kyang khyod dang mtshungs ldan min/ /mgon khyod snying nas 'dud do thugs rjes gzigs/ /gang gi sgyu 'phrul 'phags yul lho phyogs su/ /sku 'khrungs lho phyogs gdul bya skyong mdzad pa/ /sde mtshan bcu gnyis dz+wa ki bla ma ni/ /go rak+ṣa zhes pa srid rtser sgrogs/ /gang khyed mdzad pa dpag dka' ngo mtshar 'di/ /bdag gi gtsug na bde chen gling pa de/ /ma bzhugs rgya gar yul na 'phos kyi dog/ /brtags tshe sku yi rnam pa tha dad 'gag /des na thugs kyi ye shes gcig gnyis bar/ /mthong bzhin dad pa'i rba rlabs lhag par gso/ /mgon khyed zhal bzang myur du lta la ring / /mos pa'i gsos su gzugs sku 'di nyid bris/ /ring min bod kyi rnal 'byor kun tu rgyu/ /tshe dbang nor bu de yang ba bsrung mgon/ /drung du tshogs kyi 'khor lor yongs spyod nas/ /zhing skyes phyag brgya la brtan lhan skyes kyi/ /ye shes don dam sgrib med 'od gsal te/ /mngon byas 'chi med sus bzang yongs grub ste/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas 'gro kun rdo rje sems/ /ci bzhin sa la bdag gi bkod par shog /ces pa yang bod kyi rnal 'byor tshe dbang nor bu'am rgya gar gyi dzā ki skabs su slad mar ming du grags gyur ni tsin+da ma ni na tha zhes pas gro zhun zla ba'i yar tshes gcig la smras pa dge'o/ /580

lus 'di'i steng du chos gdam thob bla mar gsol gdab pa bzhugs so/ / oṃ ā:r+ghaṃ trī: stong gsal 'dzin bral dag snang gsang ba'i bdag /gsal ba'i spyi bor rang pad+ma gar dbang bde ba chen po rig bde chen gling / /rigs rtsal karma'i karma rig 'dzin gsung rab rgya mtsho mtshan dang dbyer med par/ /spros bral gdod ma'i gdangs su lha ger char/ /a ho/ kun bzang rang la gnas pa'i rang zhal/ /bde gshegs snying po'i don chen ston mdzad/ /chos sku'i klong las mi g.yo khyab pa/ /kun bzang bde chen gling pa mkhyen no/ /rig 'dzin ngo bo 'dzin bral dbyings su/ rgyal gsung rab 'byams don kun rdzogs par//rang ngo 'phrod tshe ye shes rgya mtshor/ /longs spyod gsung rab rgya mtsho 'di gnyis rtsa ba'i bla ma yin mkhyen no/ /a ho/ mnyam med rang rig bla ma'i rol stsal/ /klong gsal nges ston bsod nams lde'u skra phud phul ba yang yin tsan/ /smin dbang sgo 'byed au ṭi'i bi rdor snying snod/ mdo dbang dang 'dus nod mug /thabs lam bsrang bcur rlung khrid dang rab 'bar snying gzer ba nos kun bzang rin chen/ /dkyil 'khor mnga' bdag ka la gsang bdag sogs nod bha ṭa/ /bsgrub thabs ster mdzad au ṭi seng gdong sogs nos ni rbe 'di lnga drin chen bla ma yin/ /'du 'phro sgyu 'phrul a de'i ga gdod ma'i kha la gar/ /rtag tu dran no drin chen mkhyen no/ /a ho/ rgyal ba'i bka' brgyas dbang / tshang ma gdung tshob 'di rnams dbang lung gi 'brel pa bskyongs sa rnams yin/ rat+na bi dza/ /thugs rjes rnam rol pad+ma bha khro rol ljags lung dra/ /pad+ma dbang grub rjes snang mang po nos/rgyal sras dbang rgyal/ /chos rgyas tshe dbang 'chi med lnga sgra zhes log nam mkha' rgya mtsho/ /thar lam legs slob chos kyi bla ma/ /mi tri mā ya dharma ka phyag chen rtsa tshig ra/ /mchog dbyangs gnyis gter yongs rdzogs gar brgyad dharma ṭ+wā chos rje gling pa mi/ /gnub chen cho 'phrul dkon mchog spyi 'dus dz+nyā na ye shes 'jigs med a bhā//g.yung po he ru ni ti mchog zhi drag cha ma tshang / sprul/ /gus rta dzo ki saṅga ma ti/ /'brel med 'char gyi rtag tu mkhyen no/ /zhes pa 'di nyid rang lo nyer gsum man gyi chos 'brel thob tshad la gsol ba btab pa ste/ spyir rtsa ba'i bla ma gnyis drin chen bla ma lnga/ chos 'brel thob pa bcu ste/ phyir bsdom bcu 'dun mchis pa lags/ ces 'phar ba nag zla'i tshes gcig la tshe dbang nor bu a yu/ r+yan+d+ra ma ṇi sam pusbyiyā na sa ra ma rnyi ra dha ras bsod nams theg mchog bstan 'dzin gang shar lhug par bris/ dge'o/ /zab gter ston pa yongs kyi gtso bo mchog /nyang dang spangs gi rigs su sku 'khrungs pa/ /nyi ma 'od zer ye shes mkha' dang mnyam/ /gu ru chos dbang chos dbyings dri bral gang / /gsang chen snying po bstan pa'i srog rtsa 'dzin/ /rigs sngags 'dzin grub 'khor lo'i bsgyur mdzad pa/ /gang khyed snyan pa'i rnga sgras srid gsum g.yo/ /gter kha gong 'og grags la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdud 'dul rdo rje brtul zhugs bla na med/ /pad+ma nor bu phrin las 'gro 'dul rtsal/ /pad+ma bde chen be+e ro'i thugs kyi sprul//gang gi bdag cag rnams la dge legs mdzod/ /nam snying thugs sprul mdo khams shar du 'khrungs/ /581

'brel tshad don ldan ye shes spyod pa can/ /sngags kyi rigs 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'i sde/ /khyed la gsol 'debs smin grol dngos grub stsol/ /brtse chen khyed rnams thugs rje'i gzi byin gyis/ /bdag cag skal ldan smin cing grol ba brnyes/ /sa lam gong 'phel yon tan myur du rdzogs/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang yongs thob shog /ces bka' drin gsum ldan rdo rje slob dpon rigs sngags 'chang ba nam mkha' chos rje'i zhabs kyi bka' yi bskul ngor rdzogs chen pa tshe dbang nor bus khrums zla'i yar tshes gsum gyi snga char dpal zhud chos lding grub pa'i bste gnas su sbyar ba'o/ /maṅga lo/ yig rigs sgrub po pad+ma byang chub rgyal mtshan no/ /dpal 'jigs med dbyangs can dga' ba'i zhabs kyi gsol 'debs bsam 'phel dbang gi tshom bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /o āḥr+ghaṃ trī/ rnam dag chos dbyings 'jams klas kun tu bzang / /lnga ldan longs sku rnam snang gangs can mtsho/ /ma nges gang 'dul sprul sku cir yang ston/ /khyab bdag gsang ba sbyin la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang khyed rgyal kun ye shes ngo bo ru/ /yongs grub bsam gyis mi khyab rang bzhin la/ /skye ba'i 'phreng ba nam yang ma grub ste/ /tshur mthong blo mig dman ngor sprul pa'i gzugs/ /skye 'pho'i tshul gzung du mas mthar 'dod kun/ /yang dag lam la bkri ba'i mdzad phrin can/ /khyed la yid ches dad pa'i shugs drag pos/ /rtse gcig gsol ba 'debs so 'jigs med grags/ /gang khyed rgyal bar gyur kyang rgyal sras tshul/ /rgya chen gsang gsum dbang bsgyur rdo rje sems/ /sde snod chos kyi sdud po kun dga' bo//ye shes spyan ldan iṇ+ḍa bhu ti dza/ /mtha' bral smra seng zla grags rin po che/ /phyogs 'dir rgyal bstan 'byung gnas sasto ṭa/ /mkhas las cher mkhas lots+tsha ro'i zhabs/ /sprul pa'i skye bston kun mkhyen bla mar 'dud/ /rnam mkhyen rdor sems skur gyur zur po che/ /grub par yongs grags mkhas pa rong zom pa/ /'phags yul rgyal ba'i bstan 'dzin tsa mi'i zhabs/ /lnga ris blo rgyas kun dga' rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /yid 'phrog mkhas dbang dri med 'od zer sde/ /rab gsal gter sgo brgya 'byed rdo rje gling / /don dam 'od gsal thugs mdzes kun skyong dpal/ /sprul mdzad paṇa chen 'bum phrag brgya par 'dud/ /dbyangs can dga' ba 'jam dpal rdo rje sems/ /grub pa'i dpal ldan yongs kyis 'khor los bsgyur/ /mdo sngags tshig don ma lus ston pa la/ /phyogs dus rgyal ba rnams kyi dbang bskur bas/ /'jigs med grags pa 'og min bar du khyab/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'khrungs ston pa gnyis par gyur/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhabs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /khyed kyi thugs ni don dam 'od gsal mchog /pad brgyan zhing na rnam grol mtha' yas mgon/ /byang chub chen por gyur kyang snying rje'i ldang / /zhing 'dir sprul pa'i rol gar cir yang ston/ /'chi med go cha chos kyi nyi ma dpal/ /dbus smyon kun bzang shes rab 'od zer sde/ /kun mkhyen ye shes lus can sgrol mgon zhabs/ /rnam 'dren 582

pad+ma bde ba che yang grags/ /ma 'ongs dus na skal bzang sangs rgyas kun/ /'phrin las gcig bsdus rgyal ba mos par snang / /sdug bsngal gnas kun stong mdzad dpa' bo che/ /khyed la bdag gi sgo gsum gus mchod 'bul/ /mchod bstod phyag 'tshal gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /gang gsung de nyid 'dus chen bstan pa rgyas/ /mdo sngags lung rtogs bshad bsgrub nyams med 'phel/ /bslab gsum 'dzin pas sa 'di khengs gyur gcig /sangs rgyas grub mtha'i rtse mo dbu ma che/ /mtha' bral bde gshegs snying po'i gnas lugs de/ /sngags lam la brtan dri bral mi shig 'bras/ /gdul byar gyur pas myur thob byin gyi brlob/ /mdor na tshe 'dir 'dod dgu bsam don 'grub/ /phyir ma'i ldog pa'i sa brnyes dbang bcu thob/ /yid bzhin nor bu rdor sems gsang ba sbyin/ /ci 'dra'i go 'phang bdag sogs gis thob mdzod/ /ces ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta 'jigs med dbyangs can dga' ba'i zhabs kyi gsal 'debs 'di ni lcam bu tsam du ma yin par gang der yid chos kyi dad pa thob pa'i blo can mdo khams kaḥthog lhor skyes pa rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu pad+ma theg mchog bstan pa'i gsal byed nges gsang grub pa'i shing ltar grags des gro zhun zla ba'i dmar mchog tshes bcur dpal khud gnas mchog chos lding du rang gi mos pa dang / mi rje blo ldan gsang sngags 'chang bas yang bskul ba'i rkyen la rten te bris pa dge'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/na mo ma hā gu ru myu la dharmā aṇ+ḍi ye/ dgu ldan rgyal ba rgyal sras ma lus kyi/ /chos dbyings rnam dag mkhyen rtse ye shes kyi/ /dbang phyug khyab bdag rdo rje 'dzin chen po/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang khyed yang dag nges pa'i don du ni/ /thog med nyid nas rang byung byang chub ste/ /bdag nyid khyab brdal rgyal mchog kun tu bzang / /nges pa lnga ldan mgon mchog tshe dpag med/ /ma nges 'gro 'dul 'phags chen spyan ras gzigs/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ma chags pad+ma sogs/ /sku gsum sgyu 'phrul rol pa 'jam klas pa'i/ /mnga' bdag bla ma dam par phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar gdod nas rgyal ba nyid grub kyang / /thugs rje'i zhing 'di'i gdul bya drangs pa'i don/ /shākya'i tog drung gsang bdag in+d+ra dza/ /theg mchog shing rta klu grub te lo pa/ /byang chub sems mchog zhi mtsho phyogs glang po/ /snyan brgyud mdzod 'dzin ḍom+bi ti bu pa/ /de sogs rig 'dzin grub brnyes paṇ+ḍi ta/ /ston mdzad bla ma dam par phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhan yang sprul pa'i zlos gar rab bsgyur nas/ /sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul skye ba'i 'phreng / /dgra bcom blo bzang bla chen dgongs rab gsal/ /gsang bdag sgrol phug spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar/ /skyobs pa 'jig rten mgon dang som brag pa/ /rtsal sde grub chen mtshur bu 'jam dbyangs sogs/ /mtshungs med mi seng 'gro ba'i mgon du ma/ /snang mdzad bla ma dam par phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la sogs te mi mjed 'dzam bu'i gling / /kun tu gdul bya'i don du rab brtse ba'i/ /rang mdang sprul pa yang sprul ye shes gar/ /bsam gyi mi khyab bde chen bkod pa'i bdag /mchog khyod skye sprul tshur 583

rol byis pa yi/ /blo yis gzhal bya'i yul du ma gyur kyang / /gdul bya 'di ru grags sam cung zad mtshan/ /brjod bzhin gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyad par rtsub 'gyur rtsod ldan tha ma'i dus/ /gangs can 'dul dka' 'gro rnams bder 'dren pa'i/ /thugs bskyed rmad byung rlabs chen las skyes pa'i/ /mchog sprul mngal spangs gnyis pa chos rgya mtsho/ /gdul bya smin grol yid bzhin dpag bsam dbang / /rgyal bstan 'dzin mdzad nya ma dar rgyas sde/ /mtshungs med 'gro mgon bsam bzhin srid pa ru/ /skye bzhes bla ma dam par phyag 'tshal lo/ /dmigs med chos kyi sku yi ngang nyid las/ /gzugs sku sprul pa'i dbang po dam pa che/ /don gnyis lhun grub mdo sngags chos rab 'byams/ /rgya mtsho'i mnga' gsum dang la ldan chos kyi rje/ /dri med byang chub rgyal ba yongs kyi gtso/ /bde chen snying po mchog la mnga' brnyes pa/ /bla med dkyil 'khor kun bdag he ru ka/ /'gro mgon bla ma dam par phyag 'tshal lo//skyon bral yon tan dpag med gter 'chang zhing / /snying rje'i mdzod 'dzin mchog dman gdul bya kun//thar gling 'dren mdzad bla ma dam pa che/ /chos kyi dbang po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar sku gsum mchog gsum rtsa ba gsum/ /kun gyi ngo bo rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs/ /bdag gi sku gsum dad mos gus pa yis/ /rab tu dang ba chen pos phyag 'tshal zhing / /dngos dang yid las skyes gyur chod pa'i sprin/ /phyi nang gsang ba bla na med pa'i rdzas/ /dpag med nam mkha'i khams gang 'dod yon tshogs/ /blos blang bdag tshogs rdzogs phyir 'bul gyis gzhes/ /bdag sogs 'gro rnams thogs med nas 'khrul dbang / /mi dge log lci mtshams med sdig bsags dang / /bslab sdom gsum la nyes par gyur pa kun/ /rab tu 'gyod pas bshags kyi dag gyur cig /phyogs dus so skyes nyan rang byang chub sems/ /rgyal gyur yang dag lam bzang bsgrub pa'i las/ /bskyed byed phye phra mchog gyur ma lus par/ /dga' 'gu yid rang bdag gis bskyed gyis 'o/ /spangs rtogs mthar phyin bri gang bral ba'i lam/ /mnga' bdag rdo rje sems dpa' mi yi gzugs/ /ston gyur rdo rje slob dpon sprul byed gang / /gsang gsum chos 'khor rtag tu 'khor bar bskul/ /rgyal bar nges don skye 'chi mi mnga' yang / /tshur rol blo dman snang ngor bshegs bzhud 'tshul/ /mi ston bdag sogs zhing 'di'i gdul bya'i don/ /bskal brgyar zhabs pad brtan par gsol ba 'debs/ /mthong na mi mthun med pa zhi dul sku/ /ris med chos kyi sgra sgrogs zab yang gsung / /stong nyid snying rjes yongs gang byang chub thugs/ /mnyam med mchog sprul bla ma chen po nyid/ /zhabs pad bskal pa rgya mtsho'i bar du ni/ /brtan par snying khong gting nas gsol 'debs kyi/ /bslu ba med par mchog gsum bden nus mthu'i/ /nges pa nyid du 'grub par gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar lhag bsam rnam par dkar ba yi/ /gsol ba btab pa de nyid legs 'grub cing / /bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 584

ci bsags kun/ /rigs med mkha' khyab sems can la sngos mthus/ /brgal dka' srid pa'i chu klung chen po las/ /'gro kun dam pa khyed kyi thugs rje'i grur/ /rab bcug gtan bde'i yang dag bla ma'i sar/ /bdag de ring nyid nas 'god par shog /rgyal gyur bla ma'i sku tshe 'tsho bzhes brtan/ /bstan pa phyogs dus kun tu nyams med rgyas/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i thugs yid rab tu mthun/ /rgyal ba'i lam mchogs 'gro kun gyis thob shog /ces mkhan chen zhi ba tsho yi sprul pa'i skye bar gyur cing / /nges pa'i don du rgyal mchog tshe dpag med kyi thugs de rje'i zlos gar las snang ba rje btsun chos kyi dbang po zhes snyan pa'i rnga sgra sa gsum khyab cing gangs can skyes mchog rnams kyi gtsug gi brgyan du mdzes shing / gsar rnying gi chos tshul ris med rgyal bstan mtha' dag gi sgron me gcig pu pa de nyid kyi sku tshe zhabs pad brtan pa'i ched du/ me rta chos 'phrul zla ba ḍāk+ki 'dul ba'i dus chen tshes bcur rgyal ba gong mi bste gnas chen po ru mdo khams kaḥthog nye ba'i re kher lha rigs su skyes pa'i sngags 'chang rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu bsod nams theg mchog bstan 'dzin gyi gsol 'debs yan lag bdun pa 'di nyid phul ba'i yi ge'i rig byed o rgyan blo gros so/ /dge'o/ bkris/ gu ru pad+ma'i slob ma rig pa 'dzin/ nam mkha'i snying po'i thugs sprul 'gro ba'i mgon/ /he ru ka dpal tshe dbang rdo rje sems/ /snying nas gsol 'debs mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ /zhes cong bzhi phug gi bla ma nam mkha' chos rje'i bskul ngor tshe dbang nor bus spel/ sarba maṅga lo/rgyal ba'i ye shes dpag med 'od klong nas/ /yon tan bkod pa'i ston pa 'od dpag med/ /zhing 'dir rgyal sras tshul bzung tre bo zhes/ /mtshan gsol chos kyi dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /1 'byor dbang phyogs glang kasna pa dang / /shan+ta rak+ṣi bla chen dgongs rab gsal/ /gsang bdag sgro phug spob brag o rgyan pa/ /dam pa cir yang ston la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 2 'jam dbyangs don 'grub 'od zer chos rgya mtsho/ /dpag bsam dbang po bstan pa dar rgyas zhabs/ /mchog gi skye srid bsam bzhin 'gro ba'i don/ /skur gzhengs mngal spangs bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ / 3 dus 'dir bstan dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /rmad byung bla ma blo bzang chos kyi dbang / /mthong thos reg kun don ldan mkhas btsun bzang / /yon tan rdzogs sprul de la mchod pa 'bul/ / 4 gang khyed nges don skye 'pho mi dmigs kyang / /gdul ngor cir yang ston las da dus 'dir/ /zhi bar gzim 'tshul ston tshe dad gus can/ /bdag blo gdung bas khyod mtshan gus mchod na/ / 5 thugs rje mchog gi gzugs brnyan sprul pa'i sku/ /myur gzheng thugs dam thugs skyed dus la bab/ /bdag ni skye kun mgon po mchog khyod kyi/ /'phrin las rab spel don gnyis yongs grub shog / 6 ces bka' drin mnyam med tre'o bzhi pa zhi bar gzim pa'i dus chen de nyid kyi skabs sprul pa'i 'phrin las bstan 'dzin gyi gsung gi bskul ngor rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus glo bo smon thang rgyal khab tu smras pa skye kun bla med rjes su bzung bar gyur cig 585

rgyal kun thugs rje 'phrin las 'dus pa'i dngos/ /rang byung mtsho skyes rdo rje pad+ma 'byung / /gnyis med grub dbang pad+ma bde chen gling / /mgon mchog gsung rab rgya mtsho rdo rje 'chang / /mchog gi sprul sku chos kyi dbang po dang / /gdul bka' 'dul mkhas tshe dbang rdo rje sems/ /khyed la bdag cag gus pas mchod pa 'bul/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /zhes snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa'i ring lugs 'chang ba mdo bo che'i gdung rigs 'khrul med las skyes pa'i sngags 'chang chen po rgyal sras seṅge yi bskul ngor rgyal khams pa tshe dbang nor bus smras pa'o/ /rgyal ba'i yab gyur rgyal sras tshul/ /mchog sprul chos kyi dbang po'i sde/ /gang khyed nges don gshegs bzhud kyi/ /spros pa bral yang tshur mthong 'gro/ / 1 byis sbis snang ngor gzugs kyi sku/ /chos kyi dbyings su btul ba na/ /bdag sogs gdul byar gyur pa rnams/ /snying nas khyod dran mya ngan med/ /2 ches gdung mgon khyod thugs rje yi/ /bzod dam nyams med ye shes las/ /sprul pa'i gzugs brnyan dus 'di ru/ /'byon par gsol 'debs 'grub byin rlobs/ / 3 ces rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chos kyi dbang po'i sprul sku myur byon gsol 'debs su mar bu'i blo dpon karma dpal 'byor gyi gsung gi nan du bskul ngor sngags 'chang rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus 'dzam gling chu bzhi'i mgo bo ti se'i mdun du smras pa'o/ /oṃ ā r+ghaṃ: chos sku bya rtsol las 'das zhing gi dbyings/ /longs sku lhun grub zhing dbyings me tog rgyan/ /sprul sku rab 'byams mi mjed 'jig rten khams/ /de ru snang ba'i sku gsum sgyu 'phrul che/ /dpag tu med dngos rig 'dus pad+ma 'byung / /gar brgya'i rol pa gdul bya'i dpyid 'char ba/ /grangs med ston las khyad par snyigs dus skyabs/ /g.yu sgra snying sprul rig 'dzin rnam par rgyal/ /bsam bzhin sprul pa'i skye ba'i rgyal ba'i sras/ /rig pa 'dzin mchog ā yu tiṣ+ṭha khyed/ /snying por skye 'chi 'jigs bral rtso rje'i sar/ /g.yo med gnas kyang bdag sogs gdul snang ngor/ /gzugs kyi chu shel chos sku'i stong la nub/ /bdag cag cong rong thun gsum sar gnas rnams/ /gdung ba'i 'chi 'khrug dad pa'i spu g.yo bas/ /bde chen dag pas zhing nas 'dir gzigs nas/ /bdag lus gus pa'i mthal mo gtsug sbyar nas/ /mos blos dngos sprul kun bzang rgyan bkod pa'i/ /mchod pa'i sprin dpung dpag med 'di 'bul gyi/ /bdag sogs tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir dgyes gzhes nas/ /bdag gi 'gal 'khrul gyis sbag thams cad kun/ /bzod par gzhes nas tshangs pa'i byin rlabs stsol/ /slar yang bdag sogs 'gro don ched du ni/ /chos nyid spros mtshan bral ba'i sgo 'byed nas/ /gzugs sprul mchog sku'i mtshan dpe'i 'od byed pa/ /myur du 'char nas gdul bya'i don brten rgyal/ /yul nas gsol 'debs bslu med 'grub par shog /ces mchod phreng dang sprul sku 'byung gyur gyi gsol ba 'debs pa zhig mdzod zhes mdo khams kaḥthog gi gser khrir brjid pa rgyal sras bsod nams lde'u'i bskul tshig stsal ba la rten nas rnal 'byor tshe dbang nor 586

bus lcags byi zla ba dang po'i tshes 3la 'dzar kha gsang sngags gling du bris pa'i yi ge'i rig byed bu slob tha shal ba 'phrin las bstan 'dzin gyi bris/ /oṃ swāsti/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab yongs kyi bcud mchog ni/ bla med bla ma rdzogs pa chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor ston mdzad bla ma mchog de ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid dang dbyer yod min/ /des na bka' drin 'dren pa'i bla med pa/ /snying thigs smin byed ston mdzad rdo rje 'chang / /pad+ma rig 'dzin dbang rgyal rnam 'dren rgyal/ /gang khyed ye shes spyan gyis dus 'dir gzigs/ /bdag gi sems gyi bting nas g.yo rgyu dang / /mi gus bsam pa ye nas med mos kyang / /'on te dus ngan snyigs dus skyes pa'i dbang / /rang shug las ngan nyon mongs hrags pa yi/ /kun bzang rdo rje sems pa'i bka' lung du//bshad pa'i dam tshig rtsa ba yan lag kun/ /tshul bzhin bsrung ba'i zhe gdengs yod na yang / /dbang med tshor dang ma tshor dam tshig la/ /'gal nyams ral pa'i skyon gyur phra rag sbom/ /mchis kun snying nas 'gyod pas mthol zhing bshags/ /mgon khyed dgongs pa'i dbyings su dag tshang bar/ /sgrim med bzod bzhes mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ /bdag la 'di phyi'i bar do sgrib med par/ /skye kun mtshan ldan bla ma nyid lta bu'i/ /rjes gzung gsang sngags dam tshig rang srog las/ /lhag ltas bla ma dgyes byed la brtson shog /mdor na bdag gi nyes tshogs yongs bshags shing / /dge gyur 'dus dang 'dus ma byas pa kun/ /byang chub chen po'i rgyu ru yongs su bsngo/ /de 'bras da lta nyid nas smin gyur gcig /na mo rar+ha tra yā ya/ tabyathā pañtsa pri ya a wa bho dhe na ye swā hā/ zhes pa rang la bka' drin che ba gsum ldan rdo rje 'chang rig 'dzin pad+ma dbang rgyal gzugs sku chos dbyings su bsdus pa'i gdung brten bzhengs ba'i mchod sprin mtshon tsam dang byang ri rgyal bkra bzang gi sgrub sder zhag bdun gyi dge rgyun dam pa de nyid dgongs rdzogs su dmigs nas bgyid par rang gzhan gyi sdig sbyangs kha ton tu kaḥthog rig 'dzin sprul skur grags pa tshe dbang nor bus yongs 'dzin chu stod zla ba'i tshes bzhir spel ba'i yi ge pa ni shākya dge slong g.yung rung ngo / /sarba maṅga lo/oṃ ā:r+ghaṃ phyogs dus rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing gi khams/ /dpag med dag tu bzhugs pa'i sku gsum tshogs/ /zhi dang khro gar yi dam rig 'dzin dang / /dhāk+ki chos bsrung rdul rnyed bcas rnams kun/ /rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las gzugs kyi skur/ /dpag med mdzad phrin ngo mtshar brgya mtsho cher/ /bkod nas skad gcig yud tsam gcig gi ni/ /'gro ba'i don du gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /de ltar mchog gsum rtsa gsum tshogs rnams kun/ /rnam mang 'gro ba'i don du skur sprul rnams/ /dri med thabs shes nyi zla pad+ma'i steng / /rab dgyes 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs su gsol/ /bdag dad sgo gsum grangs med rdul rnyed cher/ /rab tu sprul nas rgyal ba sras bcas la/ /yan lag lnga btags rnal 'byor chen po yi/ /rab tu gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing dang lha 587

ma'i longs spyod sogs/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul 'dod yon mchod pa'i sprin/ /phyi nang gsang ba bla med mchod pa rnams/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras tshogs la 'bul bar gyis/ /bdag gi thog med nas bsags da lta'i bar/ /'khrul pa'i dbang gyur las dang nyon mongs pas/ /mi dge'i dbang gyur sdom pa gsum dag gi/ /'gal mnyam gyur rnams mthol zhing bshags par bgyi/ /kun tu so so skye bcas nyan thos dang / /dgra bcom rang rgyal byang sems rgyal sras tshogs/ /'gro ba'i don mdzad dge tshogs bgyis pa la/ /bdag sogs rab tu dwangs bas rjes yi rang / /rgyal ba'i zhing rab rgya mtsho'i rdul kun la/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas nas bdud rtsis chos mchog ni/ /gsung bar mi gzhed snyobs par gang bzhugs pa/ /'khor lo dpag med bskor bar bdag gi bskul/ /rgyal ba gang dag gdul bya rdzogs dgongs dang / /zhing gzhan gshegs dgongs mya ngan 'da' bzhed la/ /de dag nam yang mya ngan mi 'da' bar/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar dge rtsa lhag bsam des thog drangs/ /bdag gi dge ba bgyis dang bgyid stsal kun/ /mkha' mnyams sems can yongs la bsngo byas te/ /kun kyang byang chub snying myur thob par shog /ces yan lag bdun pa 'di ni nyer gcig lon pa'i dbyar me tog rgyas pa'i zla ba la shar phyogs mdo khams rdo rje gdan kaḥthog gi dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang phyogs tha dag gi dge 'dun thams cad la mchod pa 'bul zhing sku gsung thugs rten smad byung mjal tshe rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus bris pa dge'o/ / 588

༄ga /dpal rig 'dzin chen po'i gsung 'bum las/ bshes gnyen ris su ma chad pa la ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad 'bul ba ji snyed pa bzhugs so/ /na mo shrī ri ma hā badz+ra dha ra dharmā sid+dharba/ rgyal kun spyi me gdod nas byang chub che/ /ngo bo chos sku kun bzang 'od mi 'gyur/ kha sbyor bdun ldan bde chen 'khor lo'i bsgyur/ /rang bzhin longs sku gangs can 'od dpag med/ /bye ba phrag brgyar mtshan dpe mchog spras pa/ /thugs rjes sprul sku dkon mchog yan lag che/ /sku gsum rnam 'gyur rab 'byams rol pa kun/ /dbyer med ngo bo nyid sku rdo rje 'chang / /mi mjed gdul bya'i don du o rgyan mtshor/ /rang byung rgyal ba pad+ma 'byung gnas nyid/ /dus 'dir gangs can mgon po karma pa'i/ /phrin las grogs byon bskal bzang 'dren pa mchog /gar gyi dbang phyug sku bzhi'i 'dus pa'i dngos/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag yon tan brgyad bsnyes pa/ /mtshan thos tsam gyis ngan 'gro'i 'khrul snang kun/ /sgrol mdzad dpa' bo sdug bsngal yongs bral bdag /bde chen zhing gi rgyal po dpal mtha' yas/ /gsung gi rdo rje sgyu 'phrul chen po'i sde/ /'jig rten gsum mgon 'od mtshan cod pan gyis/ /rab sgeg mtshungs med dkon mchog yongs kyi gtso/ /chos rnams ma lus mkhyen gzigs rgyal kun gyis/ /don dam ye shes ngo bo nyid lhun grub/ /gsang gsum brgyud sde rgya mtshor dbang bsgyur zhing / /sku gsum bstan pa'i nyi ma 'od po che/ /mchog khyed zhing 'di'i gdul bya bdag sogs don/ /bskal pa grangs yas rnam mang rgya mtsho'i bar/ /mtshan dpe sku yi rdo rje 'gyur med brten/ /'chi med tshe yi g.yung drung 'pho bral 'tsho/ /mdzad pa bzang po'i gdug chen sa gsum kheb/ /'phrin las mi nus rgyal mtshan srid rtser steng / /lung rtogs chos 'khor rgyun chad med bskor zhing / /zhabs pad brtan par snying nas gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar bslu med dgu ldan bla ma che/ /theg rim rgyud sde bzhi drug yi dam lha/ /gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs/ /kun gyi bden stobs nus pas gzi byin mthus/ /nges pa nyid du rtsa ba'i bla ma yi/ /zhabs pad bstan par gsol 'debs 'grub par shog /bdag sogs 'gro kun mgon khyed thugs rje yi/ /thar lam mchog brnyes phyir mi ldog byin rlobs/ /ces rgyal ba kun las thugs bskyed smad 'byung bde chen rgyal po yi thugs kyi ye shes rang gzugs zhing 'dir ston pa 'od mtshan cod paṇa 'dzin gyur sku brgyad pa gangs can bstan pa'i nyi ma 'gran bral thams cad 589

mkhyen gzigs pad+ma gar dbang dpal chen dkon mchog chos kyi don 'grub rab 'byams rgyud sde brgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag mchog gi zhabs pad yid bzhin nor bu brten pa'i ched du kaḥthog stags phu'i nags ljongs su skyes pa'i lha btsun tshe dbang nor bu bsod nams theg mchog bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos me stag gtsug lag zla ba dang po'i yar tshes bzhi la kha zhe med par gsol ba btab pa lags/ sarba maṅga lo/ /na maḥkārma ta yi si tu dhārma ka ra ye/ rab 'byams rgyal kun thugs rje'i chig zlum 'phrul/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag dpal ldan karma pa'i/ /'phrin las spel phyir byams mgon mi yi zol/ /mngon gyur ta yi si tu rab grags nyid/ /chos kyi dbyings las gzugs sprul brtan pa yis/ /'byung gnas legs par bkod pa'i gdug dkar can/ /'phrin las kun khyab ye shes zer spro mkhas/ /'gro ba'i dpal mgon lam bzang mchog ston so/ /khyed ni bdag sogs 'gro don bskal pa rgyar/ /mchog gsum rtsa gsum drangs srong bden pa'i mthus/ /sku mchog mchog sku 'pho med mkha' ltar du/ /ma rigs gdong lnga mi shig rdo rje'i khrir/ /tshe yi g.yung drung rtag brtan brten gyur nas/ /mdzad pa ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos mchog rgyas/ /'phrin las rgya mtsho'i gos brgyan yongs khyab zhing / /gzugs sku'i snang brnyan 'pho med mda' bral bar/ /'chi bdag las rgyal 'chi med rdo rje brnyes/ /g.yo med rtag par zhabs pad brtan gyur nas/ /bdag sogs smin grol byin rlabs gsol ba 'debs/ /ces karma si tu bdun pa chos kyi 'byung gnas nyid zhabs pad brtan pa'i phyir du mdo khams sa yi thig le kaḥthog gi lha stag bu zhes pa'i nags tu skyes pa sngags ban phyogs su nor skyong ltar du nyul ba tshe dbang nor bu bsod nams bstan 'dzin bzang pos dben rdzong chos sgar zur mang du kun ldan lcags bya'i sprel zla'i nyer gcig la 'phul ba bkra shis so/ /na mo dza ya in+d+ra kārma ka bho dhe badz+ra/ phyogs dus rgyal dang rgyal sras ma lus kyis/ /thugs bskyed thugs rjes 'phrin las gcig bsdus pa'i/ /dpal ldan dpal mchog seng ge karma pa/ /'gro ba'i bla ma bla med rigs kun gtso/ /mi skyod rdo rjer mthon mthing cod paṇa can/ /mthong thos dran pas srid pa'i sdug bsngal kun/ /drung nas 'byin mdzad bde chen kun tu 'chang / /byang chub rdo rje mchog gi bdag nyid can/ /khams gsum 'gro ba ma lus 'dren pa'i rje/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyis yab gcig pu/ /srid gsum 'di na 'dren bral yon tan gter/ /sa gsum snyan pa'i rnga sgras khengs mdzad pa/ /mtshungs med rgyal ba yongs kyi dbang po che/ /thar pa yang dag sa mkhan rje btsun khyed/ /ci srid gdul bya'i khams kun ma zad bar/ /de srid nyid du zab gsang mtshan dpe yi/ /thugs gsung sku yi dkyil 'khor rin po che/ /nges pa'i don la g.yo 'gyur mi mnga' yang / /tshur rol byi pa'i snang ngor sku tshe la/ /bar chad nyes tshogs gang gi'ang mi tshugs par/ /thugs mchog gzhad don dgyes dgu lhun gyi grub/ /gsung mchog chos 'khor rgyun ma'i 'chad par sgrogs/ /sku mchog 'gyur med mi shig rdo rjer brtan/ /tshe mchog g.yung 590

drung ma 'gyur rtag mtsho zhes/ /mdzad bzang yar zla lta bur gong du 'phel/ /'phris lan nyams med dbyig 'dzin khyon khyab cing / /zhabs pad bskal mang rdul snyed rgya mtsho'i bar/ /brtan par snying nas gsol ba 'debs pa'am/ /sku gsum rtsa gsum mchog gsum rab 'byams che/ /bsrung mar bcas pa'i nus mthu bden stobs kyi/ /bslu ba med pa nges par grub gyur te/ /bdag sogs 'gro kun smin grol byin gyis brlobs/ /de lta dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi spyi gzugs gangs can mgon mchog 'gran bral mthon mthing cod paṇa 'dzin gyur kārma ka'i sku bcu gnyis pa dkyil 'khor yongs gtso khyab bdag byang chub mchog gi rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid kyi zhabs pad yid bzhin nor bu brten pa'i ched du/ mdo khams bod chen sa yi thig le kaḥthog nas mi ring bar gsang sngags kyi 'byung gnas ma la ya dang gnyis med gnas/ stag phu re khe'i nags khrod du lha rig tha shal du skyes pa phyogs kun rgyu rnal 'byor gzugs tsam 'dzin gyur tshe dbang nor bu bsod nams theg mchog bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos me stag gtsug lag zla ba dang po'i yar tshes bzhi la kha zhe med par gsol ba btab pa lags/ sarba maṅga lo/na maḥm ha gu ru sarba dzha puṇ+ḍa ri ka ye shes khyab brdal mnyam nyid 'od dpag med/ /thugs rje'i rang rtsal 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /rgyal kun rigs 'dus ngo bo pad+ma 'byung / /dbyer med rol gar kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar/ /slar yang 'gro ba'i don du 'dren pa che/ /dkyil 'khor rab 'byams yongs gtso rigs kyi bdag /mtshungs med mi pham mchog gi sprul pa'i sku/ /mi shig rdo rje lta bur bstan bzhugs gsol/ /ngo bo dri med ji ltar mkhyen pa'i thugs/ /rang bzhin 'bad med bde chen mchog gi gsungs/ /thugs rje'i rnam rol byang chub mchog gi sku/ /mi 'gyur g.yung drung lta bur brtan bzhugs gsol/ /sku tshe ri dbang bzhin du rab tu gnas/ /mngon par mtho ba'i bka' brgyud sa rnying khri/ /nges legs sgrub rgyud sha ra bhe'i 'dog lding / /chos kyi 'khor lo rab bsgyur dam pa khyed/ /mdzad pa bcu gnyis khyim bdag bzhin du rgyas/ /'phrin las lha rdzing bzhin khyab bstan pa'i sde/ /mi nub rgyal mtshan lta bur brtan bzhugs gsol/ /zhabs pad bskal brgyar 'tsho bzhes rab brten nas/ /mkhyen pa'i go 'byed che nas rtsa ba yin/ /nam mkha'i glang po rab 'phro smin grol gyis/ /sprin gyi mu tig gsal bya'i zhing sa la/ rab 'bebs bskal bzang dga' ston cher brgyas shing / /nam mkha' mtha' klas srid pa'i 'gro ba kun/ /'dren mchog khyed kyi thugs rje'i rdzing bzang la/ /brten nas byang chub yang dag bde chen sa/ /myur ba nyid du sgrol bar gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar bdag gi rnam dkar lhag bsam chos/ /gsol ba 'debs pa'i bden tshig bslu med pas/ /mchog gi sprul sku'i sku tshe nyams med par/ /'phrin las yongs khyab khyab brdal rtag gnas shog /ces rgyal ba pad 'byung thugs kyi zlos gar nā ro ta pa dang gtsang pa rgya ras sogs sprul pa'i skye ba bsam bzhin len pa 'brug pa thams cad mkhyen pa zhabs kyi sprul sku rin por che brtan bzhugs su mdo khams kaḥthog stag phu'i phyogs su skyes pa'i sngags 'chang rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus 591

phul ba'i yig rig blo gros dbang po'i bgyis pa dge'o/ /ma naḥm hā gu ru a yu si dhe trī: phyogs dus rnam 'dren rgyal dang rgyal ba sras/ /bka' brgyud rigs grub yi dam rgyud sde'i lha/ /ḍā k+ki chos bsrung bcas kyi bden nus gzis/ /deng 'dir brten bzhugs 'grub pa'i byin rlabs stsol/ /dus bzhi rgyal ba'i thugs 'phrin 'dus pa'i dpal/ khyab bdag o rgyan gu ru'i thugs klong las/ /legs shar mtshungs med mchog gi sprul pa'i sku/ /mi shig rdo rje khri la brtan bzhugs gsol/ /mthong na mi mthun med sku'i yid bzhin nor/ /nges don mtshan dpe'i 'od zer dgos 'dod dpung / /'dzad med gdul bya'i khor gzugs mtshim byed pa'i/ /sku mchog rdo rje lta bur brtan gzhugs gsol/ /thos pas gdung sel gsung gi gser 'dzin las/ /sde snod bcu gnyis sprin gyi myu gu'i rgyun/ /rgya cher dbab nas gdul bya'i tshad bsal ba/ /gsung dbyangs rdo rje lta bur brtan bzhugs gsol/ /dran pas byin rlabs thugs kyi mthing zhun dngos/ /kun mkhyen tshad med nam mkha'i bstog ltar mdangs/ /rlims pas srid pa'i 'khrul mun sel byed pa/ /thugs gsang rdo rje lta bur brtan bzhugs gsol/ /sku gsum rgyal ba kun 'dus rgyal ba'i dbang / /gsang gsum theg pa'i mdzod kyi chos kun 'chang / /bslab gsum po la gdul bya dkrir mkhas pa'i/ /mchog gsum kun 'dus mchog gi sprul pa'i sku/ /ngag gi dbang phyug skal ldan re bskang mkhan/ /rnam kun dga' bder 'gro rnams 'dren pa che/ /mdo sngags bstan pa yongs 'dzin chos kyi rje/ /dpal ldan bka' rgyud gzhung bzang snying po'i sde/ /rgya cher 'grem mdzad 'chang thub mi yi seng / /'gro ba'i mgon khyed rnyings bral gdong lnga'i khrir/ /bdag sogs gdul bya'i don du bskal pa brgyar/ /g.yo med rtag par zhabs pad brtan gyur nas/ /theg mchog bstan pa'i mdangs 'bar yongs brdal te/ /log rtogs bdud sde'i mthun gsum yongs bcoms shing / /skal ldan pad tshal yongs su rgyas gyur te/ /gdul bya'i tshogs kun yongs grol sangs rgya shog /de ltar bdag gi lhag bsam dge ba'i tshig /de nyid brjod 'di'i rten 'brel bslu med mthus/ /de yis nus pas mchog sprul sku tshe na/ /de bzhin nyid du brtan par gsol ba 'debs/ /ces pa'ang gsang sngags gsar rnying gi bstan pa ris med du skyongs ba'i skyes chen dam pa mchog gi sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang kun dga' bstan 'dzin dpal bzang po'i sde chen po de nyid o rgyan gu ru'i sprul pa 'khrul med du mthong ste mos pa chen po thob tshe mdo khams kaḥthog gi lho phyogs stag phu zhes pa'i tshal du skyes zhing / mkhas grub pad+ma blo gros kyi brten khrir gnas zhing cod paṇa 'chang rlobs pa'i phran bu phyogs kun tu rgyu ba'i rnal 'byor tshe dbang 'jigs med gzhan phan nor bu dpal gyi rgya mtshos rang lo nyer gnyis lcags byi hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes dge ba la brten 'chi med gu ru'i sku yi snang brnyan dang bcas te dben rdzong sgar nas phul ba maṅga lo/ /na maḥm ha badz+ra ā tsar+sā pad+ma bi byā dhā ren+d+ra dza ya/ rnam kun 'gyur med bde gshegs snying po 592

nyid/ /dri ma yongs bral smin thob mngon gyur pa/ /rgyal kun ye shes ngo bo chos kyi sku/ /spros dang bral las rang mdangs gzugs kyi sku/ —/zung 'jug mtha' bral rang bzhin sgyu 'phrul che/ /cir yang ston mdzad pad+ma ka ra zhes/ /sangs rgyas kun yab kun tu bzang de yi/ /rigs dang yon tan kun 'dzin phrin las kyi/ /dbang phyug rgyal ba yongs kyi gdung 'tshob dpal/ /bdag nyid rdo rje theg pa'i shing rta ni//dus 'dir nam mkha' tshe dbang rnam rgyal zhes/ /rdo rje sems dngos bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /theg lhun rgyu 'bras bang rim gyis mdzes gtser/ /mchog gyur a ti 'chi med mdun sa ru/ /lung rtogs yongs rdzogs stobs ldan mgo mang khrir/ /mkhyen brtse phul byung gsal byed stong spras shing / /bla med 'od gsal zho mthung rus rtse brgya/ /'khyor 'dzin zer gyi 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dpung / /kun bcom lta ngan thags bzang klad pa 'gem/ /skal bzang nyid med lam mchog gi mtsho ba/ /smin grol bdud rtsi'i dga' ston 'gyed btson zhing / /byang chen yongs sbyin grub pa'i sde dpal che/ /rgyal bstan sgron me rdo rje slob dpon gyi/ /dbang po mchog der gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /gang khyed yang dag don la skye pho yi/ /kun btags zad kyang byis sbis gdul snang ngor/ /sku yi snang brnyan bskal pa rgya mtsho'i bar/ /dri med zhabs kyi pad+mo brtan bzhugs gsol/ /mi shig dwangs ma 'gyur med rdo rje'i gur/ /zab gsal gzhom med a ham nyi zla'i khrir/ /'pho med gzung 'jug rang rigs don gyi sku/ /'chi med rdo rje lta bur brtan bzhugs gsol/ /mtshan dpe sku yi rgyal mtshan nub med brtas/ /tshe yi g.yung rung nyams med sra zhing brten/ /mdzad bzang yon tan yar zla bzhin du 'phel/ /'phrin las gdugs dkar yon tan dbyig 'dzin shog /de ltar bdag sogs rab dkar lhag bsam gyis/ /rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa 'di ji bzhin/ /bslu med mchog gsum rtsa gsum rgyal rgyal sras/ /kun gyi bden stobs nus pas yongs grub shog /ces gnyag rig gsum ldan rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i dbang phyug gang der gsang ba snying thig dbang bzhi yongs su sa bya byang chub dus chen la rdzogs par gnos pa'i dga' ston skabs su bsil ljongs kyi la stod don grub gling du phul ba'i yig rig ni dam pa'i rig 'khrungs blo gros rab yangs sku skye rin por tshe dbang pad+ma gsang sngags bstan 'dzin dpal bzang pos bgyis pa dge'o/ /dge'o/ dge'o/ /na mo mu la ma hā gu ru tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra trī: dag par rab 'byams mtha' klas phyogs dus zhing / /gzhugs pa'i rgyal dang rgyal sras byang chub sems/ /dgu ldan bla ma rig 'dzin grub pa'i tshogs/ /rgyud sde bzhi drug yi dam zhi khro lha/ /ldan zhing 'du sngags nyer 'du'i dhak+ki ma/ /rgyal bstan bsrung ma bka' bzhin skyong kun gyi/ /slu med drang srong bden nus gzi byin mthus/ /brtan bzhugs 'grub pa'i mthun 'gyur byin rlabs stsol/ /e ma ho/ ngo bo ka dag stong pa kun bzang dbyings/ /rang bzhin lhun grub 'od gsal rdo rje sems/ /thugs rje zung 'jug rig pa pad+ma 'byung / /dbyer med zlos bsgyur nus ldan 593

rdo rje yi/ 'gro ba'i don du rnam rol sgyu ma'i gar/ /mtshungs med mchog sprul dren mchog 'khor lo'i mgon/ /rig pa 'dzin pa bsod nams lde'u btsan nyid/ /'gyur med rdo rje'i khri la brtan gzhugs gsol/ /mthong bas bskul zhing nus pa rmad byung sku/ /nor bu gtsug tor nam mkha' 'khor lo'i mthar/ /bde chen kham gyi dwangs mas yongs gang gi/ /ngo mtshar rdo rje'i sku mchog brtan gzhugs gsol/ /thos pas smin grol sar sbyor rmad byung gsung / /mchog phra'i mdud zhig las rlung dus sbyor 'gag /ye shes dag rlung gsung gsang 'khor los bsgyur/ /ngo mtshar rdo rje'i gsung mchog brtan bzhugs gsol/ /dran tsam byin rlabs mchog btsol rmad byung thugs/ /chos nyid kyis gang 'bri ba yongs bral ba/ /zab gsang ting gsal brjod 'das thig le che/ /gsang gsum mdzod la mnga' brnyes chos kyi rje/ /dus gsum mngon gzigs mkhyen gnyis spyan yangs pa/ /rgyal ba yongs dbang rgyal ba'i 'phrin las pa/ /pad 'byung rdu mdzad rig pa'i khye'u chung 'phrul/ /dkyil 'khor yongs gtso gsang bdag ho ru ka /rgyal ba'i sras gyur rgyal kun gdung 'tshob dpal/ /'gro 'dul nus ldan bsod nams lde'u btsan/ /rdo rje 'dzin khyed bdag sogs 'gro ba'i don/ /mi shig rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dkrig pa'i dbus/ /dwangs ma lnga 'dus mi 'gyur g.yung drung lter/ /mi 'jigs 'chi med aḥhaṃḥn da'i dbyings/ /bde chen 'pho med 'chi bdag g.yul las rgyal/ /gsang chen ring lugs pa yi zla ba'i khrir/ /mi rnying rtsal ldan gdong lngas btegs pa'i steng / /zhabs pad bskal rgya'i bar du mtsho zhes brtan/ /mdzad 'phrin bzang po'i gdugs dkar nor 'dzin khyab/ /log pa'i mda' lnga sa yi dal byin bcom/ /bstan pa'i sgron me nub med rtag brtan shog /'di ltar bdag gi lhag bsam rab dkar ba'i/ /snying nas zol med gsol 'debs bden tshig mthus/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sku tshe mdzad phrin kun/ /nyams med bskal pa'i bar du brtan gyur nas/ /brgal bka' srid pa'i chu bo 'khrug pa las/ /dam pa khyed kyi thugs rjes grur brtan nas/ /gtan bde byang chub 'od gsal rdor snying par/ /mkha' mnyams 'gro kun yongs su grol bar shog /ces pad 'byung bdud 'dul rdo rje bsam bzhin du sku bzhengs pa mdo khams sa yi thig le kaḥthog rdo rje gdan gyi gser khrir chos kyi 'khor los sgyur ba rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras bsod nams lde'u btsan rdo rje 'chang chen po'i de nyid sku tshe dang zhabs pad brtan pa'i phyir dang phyogs kun tu rgyu ba'i sngags smyon tshe dbang nor bu yis chu stag hor zla dang po'i tshes bzang gsum la 'dren mchog bla ma'i bsti gnas rol lam du bris rten gdan rdo rje'i de wā can gyis mtshon de phul ba bkra shis/ dge'o/ /oṃ swāste/ tshe dpag yab yum 'chi med pad+ma 'byung / /rab 'byams rdul snyed rgyal dang rgyal sras che/ /des gsung brten la spyod dang bsrung ma'i tshogs/ /kun gyi bdag smon 'di 'grub nus byin stsol/ /pad 'byung rdor sems thugs kyi ye klong nas/ /ma 'gag r+ghaṃ dkar rig pa'i khye'u chung / /'phrin las 594

rnam rol sprul bsgyur rig pa 'dzin/ /'gro 'dul gzhan phan nus ldan rdo rje stsal/ /rab 'chang rdo rje 'dzin gyur dam pa khyed/ /bdag sogs gdul bya'i don du bskal pa brgyar/ /mi shig rdo rje'i gur chen gtams pa'i dbus/ /'gyur med rdo rje'i dkrigs pa'i gdan mchog la/ /sku yi zhabs pad gser lhun ltar du brtan/ /gsung chos bcu gnyis khyim bdag bzhin du khyab/ /thugs mkhyen mkha' ltar khengs bzhin 'gror brtse bas/ /gzigs nas brtan par bzhugs la gsol ba 'debs/ /sku tshe lha rdzing bzhin du rab tu brtan/ /mdzad pa yar zla bzhin du gong 'phel rgyas/ /'phrin las chu gter bzhin du yongs su khyab/ /snyan pa dbyar rnga bzhin du grags gyur nas/ /zab gter chos kyi lta 'od rab brdal ste/ /lus med snying stobs can gyis dal byin bcom/ /skal ldan re yid gnyis tshims yid dga' byed/ /don gnyis ma rgyu bcud du longs gyur cig /brgal dka' 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'khrug pa las/ /'gro rnams ded dpon mchog khyed thugs rje yi/ /gru rdzing che la brten nas gtan bde ba/ /rin chen gling du yongs su phyin par shog /ces pad 'byung bdud 'dul rdo rje dang rak+shi gter ston pad+ma rig 'dzin gnyis su med pa'i sprul gar du gyur zhing zab gter mchog la longs spyod pa'i pad+ma 'phrin las 'gro 'dul stsal lam/ karma badz+ra du grags par brtan gzhugs su gsol ba 'debs par phyogs kun rgyu'i sngags 'chang rig 'dzin zol 'chang tshe dbang nor bu pad+ma gar dbang yongs 'dul rdo rje drag po rtsal gyis shing sprel zla ba'i tshes bzang gsum la spu bo rdzong mgor bris nas phul ba dge'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/ gdan sa'i drung skal bzang u rgyan bstan 'dzin lags/oṃ swāsti/ chos nyid mkha' las thugs rje'i rol pa yi/ /rang stsal gzugs sku mtshan ldan mi la rje/ /skal ba bzang ldan o rgyan chos dbang khyed/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje khri la brtan bzhugs gsol/ /sku mchog mi g.yo rdo rje'i ri bo ltar/ /'pho med gdugs dkar yongs su khyab pa bzhin/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin chab srid rgyas gyur gcig /rab gnas rdo rje'i sku gzugs brtan bzhugs gsol/ /gsung mchog 'gag med yan lag drug cu'i sgras/ /dam chos chos char 'beb la mkhas gyur te/ /skal ldan yongs su tshim de smin byed pa'i/ /gsung gi rdo rje mi 'gyur brtan bzhugs gsol/ /thugs mchog rang 'byung khyab brdal dag pa'i klong / /'gro la brtse ba gzigs pa'i thugs rje bdag /yongs su khyab pa 'gro ba'i gnyen ji bzhin/ /'pho med rnam kun rdo rje brtan bzhugs gsol/ /de ltar zhing 'dir sku gsung thugs mchog nyid/ /mi 'gyur bstan par bzhugs nas 'gro ba'i don/ /'bad med lhun grub theg bstan rab rgyas shing / /'phrin las mthar phyin 'gro rnams smin grol du/ /gyur nas bstan pa nus med rtag brtan shog /ces 'di nyid gser 'chang zhes me byi dbyar zla ston pa byang chub shing drung du sangs rgyas pa'i dus chen tshes bco lnga der sprang ban tshe dbang nor bus phul ba'o/ / sku drung du/ /tshogs bsags maṇ+ḍal dngos po'i rgyur gyur pa/ /rab dkar gos chen sngon po bzang sgrom gsum/ /thugs rjes brtse bar dgongs te bzhes 595

su gsol/ /bdag rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mdzad du gsol/ /rnam dag grib bral ngo bo ka dag chos las ni/ /rnam mang 'gro la rang bzhin lhun grub zlos gar che/ /rnam pa rigs med thugs rjes cha shas yongs spro mkhas/ /rnam kun mgon gyur dpal ldan bla ma gang khyed nyid/ /bskal pa rgya mtsho'i mngon par nas sri mong kun/ /rnam grol rgya mcho1re sa la bdag sogs dkrir gsol zhes/ /zhes sa mo phag lo zla ba dang po'i tshes rnam par dge ba la bka' drin can o rgyan rnam grol zhabs su tshe dbang nor bus 'phul ba'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/ bkra shis/oṃ swāsti/ dkon mchog rtsa gsum rgyal dang rgyal ba sras/ /kun dngos skyabs gcig rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung / /yab yum sras bcas sku gsung thugs bden mthus/ /bdag smon 'di nyid 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /o rgyan spyan sngar rgyal sras sad na legs/ /dam pa'i skye 'phreng smon lam bzang po'i mthus/ /don nyid lhun grub rig 'dzin gdung tshob che/ /gsang chen snying po'i sgron me dam pa khyed/ /gdul bya'i don du bskal pa rgya mtsho'i bar/ /mi 'jigs seṅge sra brtan rdo rje'i khrir/ /theg chen chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bzhin du/ /zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol 'debs 'grub par shog /bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i sku tshe rabs tu brtan/ /bstan pa 'bri med yar zla ltar du 'phel/ /bstan pa'i gdul bya skar tshogs bzhin du bkra/ /bstan snying dar zhing rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces rig 'dzin rol pa rdo rje'i rigs kyi gcung chos kyi sras dam par gyur pa/ bla ma u rgyan lhun 'grub la rten 'brel gyi ched du rnam pa dkar ba'i lha reg dgongs pa 'dus pa'i glegs bam tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang bcas de mdo khams kaḥthog gi stag phu rig 'dzin gyi bar du spyod 'chang ba tshe dbang nor bus khro lo sa ga'i tshes bzang la phul/ sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ rnam kun mchog ldan gdod ma'i ye shes sar/ /'pho ba ches bsnyes lnga rigs dri med shes/ /dus 'dir ngur smrig gis dgeg dge ba'i bshes/ /rig 'dzin dbang rgyal bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog /rgyal gsung chu gter dbus nas snga 'gyur gyi/ /ring lugs 'dzin pa gdengs can dbang po rtser/ /yid bzhin dbang ltar mngon mtho bla ma rje/ /sku tshe snying nas brtan par gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhyen rtse 'jam mgon sdom brtson zhi ba mtsho/ /grub pas pad+ma ka ra'i rje 'gro ba/ /mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /rdo rje 'dzin dbang khyod zhabs rtag brtan shog /gcam bu ma yin snying nas gus pa yis/ /dad ldan slob mas gsol ba btab pa'i don/ /ji bzhin mgon khyod sku tshe brtan pa dang / /snying po'i bstan pa dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas shog /ces rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang dang rnam dbyer med pa'i nub dgon pa pad+ma rig 'dzin dbang rgyal gang gi zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol 'debs 'di ni bod chen dbus 'gyur lho phyos/sa kyi rgyud du skyes pa'i rig sngags 'chang ba tshe dbang nor bus lcags phag zla ba'i tshes bzang por byams pa sprin gyi gtsug lag khang du smras pa'i yi ge'i gzugs su bsgyur ba po ni las smon rnam par dag pa'i mthu 596

bskal bzang por grub pa shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa o rgyan ngag dbang ye shes dpal bzang po'i bgyis pa dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /rgyal kun ye shes spyi gzugs rdo rje can/ /sgyu 'phrul bsam gyi mi khyab rol pa las/ /yongs shar sprul pa'i zlos gar mi yi gzugs/ /grub pa'i shing rta mchog der gsol ba 'debs/ /gang 'dul gdul bya'i don du snang ba'i tshe/ /bsam bzhin skye ba'i phreng ba yo ngas gzung nas/ /gzhan phan rgya cher mdzad pa'i bdag nyid che/ /'dren mchog sprul pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /bsam bzhin skye ba gtsang ma'i rdzing bu ru/ /thos pa rgya mtsho'i 'o mtshor rab khyil bar/ /bsam pa'i spu phreng bye ba rab g.yo zhing / /bsgom pa'i zla rim can der ྾ bla ma'i byin rlabs mnga' nas legs thon pa'i/ /sgrib med phyag rgya chen po grub pa'i sku/ /rten 'brel ral pa'i cod pan 'khrol bzhin du/ /ro snyoms brgyan 'chang dpa' 'or ྾ gtsug gtor rtse mor rang rig rje snyems nas/ /gnyug ma'i lag la mi pham dgon po yi/ /rig pa dri med rdor dril cir yang bsgyur/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab mchog der ྾ 'jigs med dga' ba'i gzhed gzhung zla tshes dang / /gnas lugs nor bu mchog spras do ger can/ /dpe med spros bral dga' ma la 'khyud pa/ /ho ru ka dpal bla mar ྾ de ltar 'jam dbyangs phrin las rab brtan mchog/khyed la rtse gcig gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /zhing 'dir zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan nas kyang / /bdag sogs gdul bya smin grol mchog thob mdzod/ /ces rje bla ma dam pa 'jam dbyangs phrin las rab brten la gus pa chen pos mdo khams dbus 'gyur 'chang gi sngags 'chang tshe dbang nor bus phur bu dbyu gu zla ba'i tshes bzang bcu la phul ba sarba maṅga lo/oṃ mchog gsum rtsa gsum rgyal ba sras bcas kyi/ /thugs rjes byin rlabs bden nus gzi byin gyis/ /dpal ldan bla ma mchog gi sprul sku khyed/ /sku tshe bar chad mtha' dag yongs zhi nas/ /mdzad pa nyams med yon tan gong du 'phel/ /bskal brgya'i bar du zhabs pad brtan gyur gcig /zab gsang chos kyi nyi ma phyogs mthar brdal/ /kun tu kun nas 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog /ces gral mtsho sprul skur rig sngags 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus 'phul ba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ dpal ldan grub pa'i dbang phyug 'khor lo'i mgon/ /don rgyud snying po ston pa rdo rje 'chang / /byin rlabs chu bo 'dren pa'i shing rta che/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma 'phrin las rab brtan zhabs/ /gdul bya'i don du bskal pa rgya mtsho'i bar/ /zhabs pad brtan gnas smin grol chos kyi char/ /legs rtsal zung 'jug myur thob byin gyi rlobs/ /ces yongs 'dzin dam pa'i zhabs pad du tshe dbang nor bus phul ba dge'o/ /oṃ swāste sidhi rastu/ grub pa mchog tu gyur pa rgyal ba'i bstan/ /snying po rtog pa sgrub brgyud don 597

gyis bdag /dpal ldan sprin gra can gyi bstan pa mchog /'dzin skyong spel la g.yel med snying stobs can/ /sngon bsags smon lam dag pa'i mthu byin gyis/ /dam pa bstan mkhas tha snyad gtsug lag kun/ /yongs su 'dzin mkhas ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta/ /ngag dbang bkra shis rnam par rgyal ba'i zhabs/ /bstan 'gro'i don du zhing 'di'i gdul bya'i don/ /sku tshe 'jig med rdo rje ltar brnyes shing / /mdzad 'phrin bzang po yar ngo'i zla ba ltar/ /'phel brgyas bskal pa'i bar du gnas gyur gcig /ces rang nyid tha snyad gtsug lag ma lus pa'i blo snang rgyas par byed pa bka' drin zla med kyi re paṇ+ḍi ta 'jig rten mig gang gi zhabs brtan du rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus bag yod chu glang lha bab zla ba'i tshes bzang por phul ba maṅga lo/ bha waskyo/ / oṃ swāste/ ngag gi dbang phyug tshad med thugs rje gter/ /yongs 'dzin rin chen rgyal bstan gsal byed ni//smra ba'i seṅge ngag dbang rin por che/ /gdul bya'i don du bskal brgyar zhabs brtan gsol/ /gangs can mgon po blo bzang grags pa yis/ /lta grub skyong la 'jigs med snying stobs can/ /bstan pa yongs rdzogs bslab gsum 'dzin pa'i dpal/ /mkhas pa'i khyu mchog khyod zhabs bstan gyur cig /ces dga' ldan phun tshogs gling gi ring lugs smra ba'i khyu mchog dam pa ngag dbang rin chen zhabs kyi brtan bzhugs su tshe dbang nor bus snying nas gus pas gsol ba 'debs par rten don ldan du gyur cig maṅga lo/ dge'o/ /rgyal kun thugs phrin gcig bsdus sangs rgyas pad 'byung gi/ /rdo rje'i gsung gi rab bsngags gangs can 'gro ba'i mgon/ /snyigs dus nyam thag 'gro rnams skyong bar mkhyen rtse nus/ /gzhan las lhag pa'i mthu thob dpal ldan bla ma mchog /mgon po tshe 'od dpag med rnam sprul chos don 'grub/ /rgyal ba'i dbang phyug bskyod med byang chub rdo rje sems/ /thams cad mkhyen lam ma nor sa mkhan gang khyed la/ /rtse gcig gus pa'i slob bu'i snying nas gsol 'debs kyi/ /zhing 'di'i 'gro phyir sku tshe bskal pa rgya mtsho'i bar/ /zhabs pad mtsho bar gyur gcig dkon mchog gsum gyis mthus/ /thugs kyi bzhed don yongs grub mdzad 'phrin chu gter gos kun khyab/ /gangs ljongs bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i nyid khyod yun gnas shog /ces yab sras kyi zhabs brtan gsol 'debs 'di nyid mtshur phu bzhi ba grwa tshang gi slob dpon snying pa dar ma dpal 'byor gyi nan tu bskul ngor/ gu ru pad+ma'i gzhung lugs 'chang zhing karma ka la mi tshad gus pa'i blo ldan rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus 'dzam gling sa'i thig le chu bzhi mgo gangs ri ti se'i ngogs su lcags kyi snron zla ba'i tshes bzang por smras pa'i sidhi rastu/oṃ swāsti/ rab sangs cher brgyas bdud brtsi'i 'byung gnas mgon/ /rab legs rtag zhi bdud rtsi dam pa'i chos/ /rab bskrad tshogs mchog bdud rtsi spyod pa'i dpang / /rab mchog bla med bdud rtsi'i rtag bsrung mdzod/ /phung po'i bdud bcom dkyil 'khor 'od gsal sku/ /'chi bdag yongs yongs mi shig snying po'i khams/ /nyon mongs kun bral 'gyur med bde ba che/ /lha bu'i bdud bcom 'dod dgu'i 598

dbang phyug che/ /bdag gtsang rtag bde rgyal ba tshe dpag med/ /gcig dang du ma'i spros bral mkha' khyab gzugs/ /dri med rang gi ngo bor ro gcig pa/ /bden gnyis zung 'jug tshe dbang mchog gi gter/ /bslu med mchog tu bden pa de yi mthu'i / /'jig rten mig gyur 'gro 'dren bla ma mchog /chos kyi 'byung gnas gzugs sku gdul bya'i ngor/ /'chi med skal chen yun du brtan gsol 'debs/ /ma grub bzhin snang ris med 'gro ba kun/ /dam pa mchog de'i gdul bya gcig tu zlum/ /dad mos gus thob skal bzang lam la spyod/ /tshe gcig 'chi med mgon po'i gnas thob shog /'chi med lam gyi 'jug ngogs bde ba che/ /phyir mi ldog pa nges don snying po'i gtam/ /mthun drug 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i don/ /spyod pa kho nas sa gsum khengs par shog /bde legs kun gyi 'byung gnas byang chub sems/ /bde ba nyam med rgyal ba'i rgyal srid che/ /bde chen bsam gyis mi khyab gnas thob nas/ /bde ba'i gnas der sems can kun bkod shog /ces 'jam mgon bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi 'byung gnas mchog gi zhabs pad yun ring du 'tsho zhing bstan pa'i slad du dkar po'i lo zhal gsar du 'char ba rgyal gyi zla ba'i dkar phyogs rgyal ba dang po la mnyam bzhag gi ngang du gang shar lhug par skad cig mar rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus 'chi med brnyes pa ras pa yab sras kyi bsgrub gnas mnga' ri gung thang za 'og phug tu bkod nas phul ba kun tu dge legs rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig sarba maṅga lo/ bha waskyo/ kun mkhyen bla ma mchog gi zhabs pad du sku tshe rdo rje'i ri bo ltar brtan pa'i gsol 'debs tshigs su bcad pa phul ba'i rten cing 'brel 'byung rten gyi mtshon byed tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i sku brnyan/ 'phags yul ma hā sidhā dgong lo lnga brgya dang brgyad bcu bzhugs par grags pa mi pham mgon po'i rnam par thar pa rgyas pa'i rtsis su byas pa 'phros bzhi byed kyi skor kha shas bcas pa'i glegs bam sgros rtsang dang / bho dhe tsirta'i bsgrang phreng rgya dang rtsa brgyad pa//lha gos rnam dkar srid du ring ba gdan dkar rdo rje'i re kha bcas dngos po snal ma ltar nyag shin tu nas phra yang lhag pa'i bsam pa ma smad cher sbom pos spras de phul ba kun tu dge legs kyi rgyur gyur cig sarba maṅga lo/ bhā waskyo/ bkra shis/oṃ swāsti/ rab 'byams rgyal ba sras slob bcas rnams kyi/ /sku gsung thugs dang byin rlabs bden pa'i mthu/ /ma lus gcig tu sdom nas dengs bdag gi/ /gsol ba 'debs 'di bslu med 'grub mdzod gcig /rgyal ba yongs kyi 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i gter/ /yongs sdom 'jig rten dbang phyug 'gro ba'i mgon/ /gang gi thugs dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal/ /thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes/ /pad 'byung rdo rje'i ljags kyi lan du mar/ /chos kyi spyan ldan byang chub sems dpa' cher/ /lung bstan bstan pa'i nyin byed 'gro ba'i mgon/ /rgyal sras thu bo mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mdzad/ /yongs 'dzin mgon khyod yang dag nges don du/ /skye 'chi'i spros pa gdod nas yang mod kyang / /gdul 599

bya'i blo ngor sku yi snang brnyan 'di/ /'chi med mgon po 'od dpag med ji bzhin/ /bskal pa 'byams klas bar du mtsho zhing bzhes/ /mi shig rdo rje'i tshe la g.yung drung sku/ /rtag brtan 'gyur med bde ba chen po'i ngang/ /bstan 'gro'i don du zhabs pad bstan gsol 'debs/ /gang khyed sku tshe rdo rje'i ri bo bzhin/ /gnas zhing mdzad bzang yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel/ /snyan pa brjod la sa gsum 'gro kun g.yo/ /'phrin las nam mkha'i phyogs kun khengs gyur gcig /'gro kun bla ma chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi/ /sku tshe bskal pa rgya mtsho'i bar du ni/ /mtsho zhes brtan par gdul byar gyur rnams kyi/ /brtse gcig gus pas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di/ /ji bzhin mchog gsum rtsa gsum bden mthu ches/ /nges par 'grub nas rnams 'dren mchog khyed kyi/ /zhal blta gsung gi bdud rtsi rtag myong bas/ /zung 'jug 'gyur med sa la sbyor bar shog /ces pa 'ang rje btsun bla ma'i sku tshe brtan pa'i ched du dmigs mdzes khrig ma yin par snying nas smon mdun drag po yi bod kyi tshe brag dpal chen chu bo ri nas rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus me 'brug chu stod zla ba'i yar tshes bzhi la phul ba de ji bzhin du 'grub gyur cig sarba maṅga lo/ /oṃ swāsti/ mi shig 'gyur med gdod nas dag pa'i khams/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal bde ba chen po'i gshis/ /mkha' khyab yongs kyi dwangs ma mgon dang bcud/ /dpal ldan bla ma 'tsho bzhes zhabs brtan gsol/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal yongs gtsang zhing bde/ /'pho babs dri bcom 'pho med brtags pa'i sku/ /bzung 'dzin bdag spang don dam yongs grub bdag /dpal ldan bla ma 'tsho bzhes zhabs brtan gsol/ /dag pa gnyis ldan rgyal ba kun gyi dngos/ /lnga ldan nges pa rgyan gyis 'khor lo'i bdag /ma nges 'gro 'dul sgyu 'phrul rgya mtsho'i gter/ /dpal ldan bla ma 'tsho bzhes zhabs brtan gsol/ /dri med sangs rgyas yongs kyi ngo bo nyid/ /sde snod lung rtogs ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rgya mtsho 'phro mdzad pa/ /dpal ldan bla ma 'tsho bzhes zhabs brtan gsol/ /'gro blo rmongs pa'i drwa ba mtha' dag pa/ /mkhyen rab ral gris skad cig gcod mdzad mgon/ /phul byung yon tan du ma'i zur phud can/ /dpal ldan bla ma 'tsho bzhes zhabs brtan gsol/ /rgyal ba'i rnams kyi nges pa'i don nyid du/ /bdud bzhi dpung bcom skye 'chi bral mod kyang / /tshur mthong gdul bya'i snang ngor cir yang ston/ /des na mgon khyed skal pa rgya mtsho'i bar/ /gzhom med rdo rje'i gsum ldan dwangs ma'i skur/ /mi 'jig seṅge rtag brtan g.yung drung khrir/ /tshe 'od dpag med mgon dang dbyer med pa/ /rgyal ba'i 'phrin las bstan pa'i nyin byed gang / /zhabs pad brtan par snying nas gsol 'debs na/ /mchog gsum rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i bden mthu dang / /lha dang drang srong rig 'dzin tshogs bcas kyi/ /bdag gi re ba ji bzhin zhabs brtan shog /ces da lta'i dus na gangs chen ri bo'i khong 'dir gzhung lugs rgya mtshos mnga' bdag rgyal ba'i 'phrin las pa chen po rnam 'dren rdo rje 'dzin dbang kun mkhyen bstan pa'i nyin byed gang gi zhabs pad 600

bskal par brtan pa'i ched du snying nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di ni sngags 'gyur gyi ring lugs kaḥthog rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus lcags bya sa ga zla ba'i mar phyogs tshes bzang por rtag brtan rin chen spung phul ba sarba maṅga lo/o swāsti/ rnam kun mchog ldan gnyis med bde ba che/ /zung 'jug 'gyur med gdod nas dag pa'i khams/ /bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal ba bcol ldan 'das/ /'chi med mgon po dus 'dir dge legs stsol/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba sras dang de gsung chos/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor los bdag po bla ma lha/ /ma tshogs mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho yi/ /bdag gi gsol 'debs 'di 'grub byin gyi rlobs/ /rgyal ba kun gyis tshad med snying rje'i gter/ /gcig tu zlum pa'i snying po pad dkar 'chang / /'gro la phan bzhed sdom brtson rgyal po'i tshul/ /gangs can mgon po bskal brgyar zhabs brtan gsol/ /khams gsum dri ma yongs spang dwangs ma gsum/ /rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor gnas bzhin pa/ /rnal 'byor gsum gyis nyer bskrun 'chi med skur/ /gangs can mgon po bskal ྾ rol dang bcud len bsgrod pa 'pho bcas khams/ /pho med gnyis spangs dbyings su 'bar ba'i zhugs/ /mi skem rgyun 'dren bde chen rdo rje'i skur/ /gangs can mgon po ྾ nyi khri chig stong drug rgya drwa ba'i tshogs/ /yongs gsal mi 'chi gzhom med gzhon nu'i 'gros/ /'od gsal bde ba'i klong du rtag gnas pa/ /gangs can ྾ chos nyid ngo bo rdo rje snying po'i khams/ /bden gnyis zung 'jug a ham 'khor lo'i 'gros/ /gzhig bral 'khyam brdal rdo rje'i gur khung dbus/ /gangs can ྾ rgyal ba'i sku ni mkha' khyab ye shes yin/ /de la 'du 'brel kun tu ma dmigs mod/ /mos snang mkha' las sngags kyi sgyu 'phrul bzhin/ /gangs can ྾rtsa dag mdud bral rdo rje'i gur khang dbus/ /rlung dag lnga ldan rdo rje sa bzhi la/ /dag pa'i thig le 'chi med rdo rje'i dpal/ /gangs ca na ྾ mtha' yas 'gro ba kun gyis nyer mtsho'i dpal/ khyad par rtsod snyigs kyis mnar 'gro ba rnams/ /bde bu'i sa bkod dge ba'i dbugs dbyung mdzod/ /gangs can ྾ de ltar bdag mos lhag bsam dag pa yi/ /rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa'i 'bras bu gang / /rgyal ba'i thugs rjes dus las yol min par/ /mgon khyed zhabs pad sa skyong bye ba yis/ /spyi bos 'dud bzhin mtha' bzhi'i phun tshogs dpal/ /gangs can 'dir 'du snyan pa lha yi rnga/ /srid rtse'i bar khyab yongs rdzogs rgyal ba'i bstan/ /yar zla ltar 'phel rgyas par byin gyis rlobs/ /ces 'gro ba yongs kyi 'dren pa dam pa yongs kyi spyi phud gangs can phan bde'i 'byung gnas lags na pad+mo gangs can mgon po rgyal mchog bdun pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mo yun ring du bsten par ched du brjod pa'i gsol 'debs 'di ni bod chen dbus 'gyur du skyes zhing rgyal khams kun tu rgyu ba chos smra ba'i zol chen rig 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus mi na tshod ldan gyi lo zhal gsar du 'char nye ba rgyal zla'i yar tshes bzang po bal yul tī zlo'i gtsug lag khang nas gus pas phul ba de kho na bzhin re 'bras don du stsal du gsol/ / 601

o/ bla med bla ma mchog gsum bden nus kyi/ /bdag gi gsol 'debs 'di nyid 'grub gyur cig /'phags yul grub mchog rgyal sras lwa wa pas/ /byin rlabs sprul pa dpal ldan bla ma rje/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug blo gros chos 'phel zhes/ /bka' brgyud rgyal po 'ba' ra'i bstan pa'i srog /legs 'chang zab gsang tshad med 'di rmi lam snang bar dhā ki'i gsung snyed pa las ngo jo'i mu cor ni smra gal med pas ma lags so/ /stsol mdzad pa/ /mchog khyed ljongs 'dir bskal pa rgya mtsho'i bar/ /'chi med rdo rje ltar du sku tshe nyid/ /gdul bya'i don du 'tsho bzhes rtag brtan nas/ /thar mchog gru bo nub med snyen pa yi/ /ba gdan srid mthar thugs par rgyas gyur cig /ces 'bar chos zab gsang gi rgyun/ skye grong 'jam gling bla ma blo gros chos 'phel drung du legs snos grub 'phral/ rje de nyid kyi sku tshe brtan pa'i ched du/ mdo khams kaḥthog gi char 'od gsal lta ris su skyes shing / rang bzhin rdzogs chen rnal 'byor pa dngos slob tshe dbang nor bu'am karma rin chen mchog tu dga' bas kun nas dge ba'i dpal gyi sa ga zla ba'i dkar phyogs dus tshes 13la rnam par dge ba la phul ba maṅga lo/o swāste/ 'chi med rgyal ba rgya mcho'i dkyil 'khor bdag /gzhom bral che'i dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das/ /'od snang mtha' yas
