dpal de'i bden pa'i mthu'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma rtag par zhabs brtan shog /rgyal ba'i bka' lung dri med dam pa'i chos/ /rgyun ldan rin chen phreng 'dra ster mdzad mgon/ /bzang po'i yon tan gyis phyug rdo rje 'dzin/ /dpal ldan bla ma 'chi med zhabs brtan gsol/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir chos snang phal cher nub/ /de tshe mun gsal rin chen 'od 'phro bzhin/ /yid kyi ngal sel rdo rje 'dzin bzang po/ /dpal ldan bla ma 'chi med zhabs brtan gsol/ /thos pa'i bang mdzod bsam pas yongs su phyug /bsgom pa'i rin du mas nyer brgyan pa/ /bzang po'i dpal 'bar rdo rje 'dzin dbang che/ /dpal ldan bla ma 'chi med zhabs brtan gsol/ /mgon khyod rdo rje'i thugs mchog 'od gsal ba/ /skye 'chi spros bral nam mkha' rang bzhin te/ /tshur mthong gzugs sku'i spros pa mi stong bar/ /gdul bya'i ngo ru 'chi med zhabs brtan gsol/ /smin grol ston pa'i rdo rje slob dpon ni/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po nyid dang dbyer med zhes/ /rgyal ba kun gyi mgrin gcig yongs su bsngags/ /de don shes bzhin khyed la 'dud phyag 'tshal/ /bdag ni byis pa'i rang bzhin nyon mongs dbang / /nga rgyal gyis non rtogs ge'i dri mas sbag /mnyam par ma bzhag pa na bla ma yir/ /mthong ba'i nyes byed mchis sogs snying nas bshags/ /mgon khyod tshe 'od dpag med bskur gzheng nas/ /snying po'i bstan pa spel dang bdag sogs mgon/ /bskal pa'i yul du sku tshe 'tsho bzhes brtan/ /smin grol chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /ces thog mar rang la rdzogs chen snying thig gsan pa'i slob ma dang /rjes su smin grol chos kyi tshul mang po rang gi bka' drin zhu ba'i yul rdo rje 'dzin dbang rin chen bzang po'am dkon 602

mchog bzang po'i mtshan can gang gi zhabs pad yun ring du brtan pa'i gsol 'debs gcam bu dang zol sbyor tsam ma yin pa snying thags pa nas bgyis pa tshigs su bcad pa bkra shis rtag gi grangs ldan 'di ni bod chen dbus 'gyur dam pa'i chos smra ba'i go sar skyes zhing yangs pa'i rgyal khams kun tu rgyu ba dpal rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus phul ba ste bkra shis dge legs su gyur ciga.oṃ swāste/ tshe rabs kun tu bla ma he ru ka /dbang bzhi bskur nas rgyud brlan ye shes brnyes/ /ma nor 'khrul med thar pa'i lam mchog ston/ /nor bu ji bzhin 'dod dgu'i chos 'char 'babs/ /'khor lo'i mgon po tshe dbang nor bu'i zhabs/ /bskal brgya'i bar du sku tshe 'tsho bzhes nas/ /'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i bstan pa mchog /spel zhing nyams med phyogs kun 'phel rgyas shog /o rgyan spyan sngar smon lam bzang po brnyes/ /shes bya ngag dbang ye shes 'char ba'i gar/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i chos las skyes pa'i sras/ /bskal bzang 'gro ba'i mgon po rdo rje 'dzin/ /bka' brgyud gter brgyud chu bo chig 'dres su/ /bka' bab o rgyan ngag dbang ye shes dpal/ /sku tshe bskal brgya'i bar du 'tsho bzhes nas/ /bstan pa phyogs dus kun tu rgyas gyur cig /ces mang yul skye grong 'jam gling bla ma pad+ma phyag rdor dbang phyug dang shes rab 'byung gnas sku mched kyi gsol ba btab pa'i ngor tshe dbang nor bu'i ma bsam thol 'byung tshig bcad du smras pa'i yig rigs gzhung lugs smra ba'i mkhas pa 'phrin las bstan 'dzin no/ /oṃ/ rgyal ba rgyal sras rab 'byams rgya mtsho yi/ /bden pas bdag gi gsol 'debs 'grub gyur cig /dri med zla shar thugs rje'i rgya mtsho las/ /smon lam rgya mtsho yongs bskrun gzhan phan gyis/ /'od dkar gdul bya'i dpal du lham me ba/ /pad 'byung rdo rje gsung gi lung bstan cing / /rje btsun bla ma'i thugs las skyes pa'i sras/ /dpal ldan bla ma ngag dbang ye shes ste/ /gang khyod gdul bya'i dpal du bskal pa brgyar/ /mi shig rdo rje rtag brtan g.yung drung khrir/ /tshe dpag med ltar sku tshe 'tsho bzhes shing / /smin grol chos kyis snyan grags rgyun mi chad/ /mdzad 'phrin yar ngo'i zla ltar yongs su snang / /kun tu dga' ba'i dpal gyi nor 'dzin khyab/ /zung 'jug go 'phangs bsgrub pa'i bsgrub rgyud rgyas/ /rtag brtan dge legs rab tu 'phel gyur cig /ces skyes mchog chen po 'ba' ra ba gang gi mi 'jig seng ge'i khrir chos smra ba'i rdo rje 'dzin pa o rgyan ngag dbang ye shes dpal bzang por mched du bsngags pa'i zhabs brtan du rig 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus khyab bdag bla ma'i gdan sa dkar cog tu brjod pa dge'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ mkha' khyab dang po'i rgyal ba kun tu bzang / /lnga ldan longs sku'i zhing bdag rdo rje chos/ /mchog gi sprul sku dkon mchog yan lag zhabs/ /sku gsum rgyal ba mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhing 'dir 'gro ba 'dren phyir rgyal sras tshul/ /'od dpag med dang spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug /a kar la ti srong btsan sgom po'i dus/ /lho phyogs rgyal khams dam chos la 'jug phyir/ /rgyal po ud 603

tam ke sar zhes byar grags/ /a dkar ma ti pad+ma 'byung gnas su/ /sprul nas bod kyi gdul bya 'dul ba'i tshe/ /de yis thugs sras ye shes dbyangs zhes pa/ /lus de mngon sum bde ba can du gshegs/ /slar yang bsam bzhin sprul gar du ma las/ /mchog tu zhwa dmar cod paṇa 'dzin pa zhes/ skye ba brgyud mar 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ /dus 'dir cod paṇa 'dzin pa bcu pa ni/ /mi pham dpal ldan chos grub rgya mtsho sde/ /rgyal bstan nub pa med pa'i sgron me ru/ /yun nas yun bzhin bskal par zhabs brtan gsol/ /dam pa mchog rnams nges don skye 'chi spangs/ /tshur mthong du yang dus 'dir gdul bya'i don/ /bskal pa'am ni bskal pa las lhag par/ /'chi med mgon po ji bzhin zhabs brtan gsol/ /gang gi mdzad bzang nyi zla'i bsgrod pa bzhin/ /'phrin las rgya mtsho'i gos can yongs su khyab/ /mnga' thang dbyar gyis chu bo bzhin rgyas pas/ /nges don bstan dang bstan 'dzin 'phel bar shog /ces zhwa dmar sprul pa'i sku bcu pa'i zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol 'debs su si tu thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal snga nas bka'i bskul ba la brten/ 'chi med grub pa'i slob dpon mang pos brten pa'i gnas jo mo kha rag gi 'dab nas rig pa 'dzin pa rgyal khams pa tshe dbang nor bus me 'brug rgyal zla'i tshes bco lnga la phul/ sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāsti/ 'gyur med bde ba chen po chos kyi sku/ /sna tshogs cir yangs 'char ba gzugs kyi gar/ /zung 'jug rdo rje'i rang bzhin bla ma'i sku/ /yun nas yun bzhin 'chi med zhabs brtan gsol/ /gdod nas rnam dag rgyal ba'i ngo bo la/ /'gro ba'i don du rgyal ba'i sras kyi gzugs/ /mi brjod gzung thob sa nas sems dpa' che/ /ldan ma rtse mo yang dag rdo rje'i thugs /dus 'dir 'gro ba'i 'dren pa mtshungs med mgon/ /bstan pa'i nyi ma chos kyi 'byung gnas gang / /'chi med 'tsho bzhes rdo rje'i ri bo bzhin/ /bskal pa rgya mtsho'i bar du zhabs brtan shog /gang gi 'phrin las dge ba'i go 'phar brgya/ /kun tu dbye bas phun tshogs 'dod dgu'i skyid/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i nyer 'tshor yongs 'phel zhing / /kun kyang snying po'i bstan la spyod par shog /ces si dhu thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi 'byung gnas gang gi zhabs pad yun ring du 'tsho zhing bzhed pa'i slad du rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus sa 'brug rgyal zla'i tshes bco lngar 'chi med grub pa'i slob dpon mang pos bsnyen pa'i gnas jo mo kha rag gis 'dab nas phul ba sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ kun khyab rnyog med gdod nas dag pa'i kham/ /kun bzang gdod ma'i mgon po rgyal kun yab/ /kun snang dam pa sku gnyis spyo dpal che/ /kun tu rtag brtan g.yung drung ngo bo nyid/ /'pho 'gyur mi mnga' 'chi med rdo rje 'chang / /mi shig dang ma tshe bdag 'khor lo'i bsgyur/ /gang gi bden gnyis zung 'jug nus pa'i mthus/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs pad brtan par mdzod/ /rgyal dang de sras thu bo dam pa rnams/ /rtsa ba 'pho bcas rlung 'gag de'i rang gzugs/ /'chi bdag bdud dpung yongs su bcom byed na/ /skye 'chi'i spros pa nam du'ang mi mnga' mod/ /'on kyang gdul bya 'dren phyir 604

kun rdzob ngor/ /'jig rten mthun mjug mdzad pa cir yang ston/ /des na mgon o rang rigs rdo rje sems/ /yid bzhin zhabs pad rtag tu brtan gsol 'debs/ /stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis rdo rje'i gur/ /nyi khri chig stong drug brgya gzhom med sgra/ /a haṃ nyi zla kha sbyor rdo rje'i tshe/ /bdud bzhi las rgyal 'jigs med seṅge'i spor/ /snang srid bde chen 'gyur med rdo rje'i khrir/ /srog lnga dag pa lnga ldan rdo rje'i gdan/ /'pho spangs zhabs zung rdo rje'i dkyil mo krung / /'pho chen zag med 'od gsal sdo rje'i sku//don dam gdod nas dag pa mchog bsnyed pa/ /kun rdzob gdul bya'i snang ngo nyid du yang / /bskal chen rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i yun de srid/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bzhin zhabs brtan gsol/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir ris med rgyal ba'i bstan/ /khyad par nges don snying po'i ring lugs gang / /ji bzhin 'dzin mdzad dpal ldan 'gro ba'i mgon/ /mchog khyed zhabs pad snying nas brtan gsol 'debs/ /ces rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs je'i rang gzugs lag na pad+mo mi yi zol 'gro ba'i mgon po gang gi skye ba'i phreng ba sprul par mdzad pa kun gzigs rje btsun 'brug pa sprul pa'i sku mchog dam pa rgyal dbang bka' brgyud phrin las shing rdzi zhabs pad brten par gsol 'debs pa 'di yang 'dzam gling chu bzhi'i mgo bo ri rgyal ker ra dang nye ba skar ma phun tshogs rtse nas de la dong chu bu gro zhun zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes bzang por rig 'dzin rgyal khams pas phul ba sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ zung 'jug mi shig gdod nas rnam dag pa/ /phung khams rdo rje'i rang bzhin gnyis yang dbyings/ /rgud med gnas su dpal ldan bla ma'i sku/ /yun nas yun bzhin rtag par zhabs brtan gsol/ /gzhom med yi ge'i rang bzhin gzhon du nā da'i dbyangs/ /rdo rje'i rang sgra rgyun mi chad pa'i tshig /dam pa chos kyis 'khor lo bla ma'i gsungs/ /yun nas yun bzhin rtag par zhabs brtan gsol/ /'pho bcas dri ma yong spangs 'pho med dngos/ /rtag brtan g.yung drung bde ba chen po'i gshis/ /spros bral 'gyur ba med pa bla ma'i thugs/ /yun nas yun bzhin rtag par zhabs brtan gsol/ /mkha' khyab sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba gsum/ /spro dang sdud po'i byed po rdo rje sems/ /dus 'dir dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma che/ /rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyis khyab bdag dpal/ /rgyal kun thugs rje'i chu gter dbang bsgyur nas/ /bka' lung mdo rgyud rin chen nor bu'i mdzod/ /spel ba'i 'phrin las nam yang g.yel med mgon/ /thar pa'i gru rdzing mchog gi shing rta gang / /gdul bya'i dbul sel zla med yid bzhin dbang / /snyigs dus 'gro ba'i 'dren pa gcig pu pa/ /rgyal dbang bka' rgyud phrin las shing rta'i sde/ /zhabs pad mtsho bzhes brtan par gsol ba 'debs/ /phyogs dus nyan rang byang sems 'phags tshogs kyis/ /yongs bskor rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor 'jam slas pa'i/ /bden pa'i mthu byin nus pa bslu med kyi/ /dpal mgon bla ma zhabs pad brtan gyur nas/ /'dzin pa'i khyon kun nges don snying po yis/ /bstan pa rab rgyas bstan 'dzin mchog kun thun/ /bden mthong grub slob 605

'bum phrag tshom bur tshogs/ /rgya che rgyun mi chad gnas bkra shis shog /ces dpal ldan sprin sgra can gyi sgrub rgyud 'dzin pa tha dag gi spyi phud 'gro ba'i mgon po mtshungs pa mi mnga' ba dus 'dir yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i rtsa lag chen po rgyal ba'i dbang po rgyal dbang bka' rgyud phrin las shing rta mchog gi zhabs pad yun ring du brtan pa'i rten 'brel dge ba'i ched du gsol 'debs tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni phyogs grol ris med rnal 'byor rgyal khams pa dpal rig pa 'dzin pa rdo rje tshe dbang nor bu yi na tshod ldan sbo zla'i yar tshes bzang po la bal yul rang byung mchod rten chen po'i bya 'dab tī zlo'i gtsug lag khang du phul ba kun tu dge legs su gyur cig sarba maṅga lo/o mchog gsum rtsa gsum rgyal ba sras bcas kyis/ /thugs rje'i byin rlabs bden nus gzi byin gyis/ /dpal ldan bla ma mchog gi sprul sku khyed/ /sku che'i bar chad thams cad yongs zhi nas/ /mdzad phrin mnyam med yon tan gong du 'phel/ /bskal brgya'i bar du zhabs pad brtan gyur cig /zab gsang chos kyi nyi ma mchog mthar brdal/ /kun tu kun nas 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog /gram tsho sprul skur rigs sngags 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus phul/oṃ swāste/ kun tu bzang po'i rang bzhin bde ba che/ /gsung gi rdo rje orgyan gu ru yi/ /ring lugs dri med 'dzin pa'i snying stobs can/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan dpal ldan bla ma mchog /zhabs zung mi shig rdo rje'i ri bo ltar/ /'chi med 'tsho bzhes brtan nas mkha' mnyams 'gro/ /'od gsal rdo rje'i snying po'i grub mtha' la/ /bzhugs nas tshe gcig rgyal ba'i gnas thob shog /ces dol bo bla ma zho rgyan rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas la ched du brjod pa'i zhabs brtan tshigs su bcad pa 'di yang rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus dkar po'i lo smin drug zla ba'i dkar phyogs bzang po dang po la smon thang nas phul ba sarba maṅga lo/pad+ma thod 'phreng bde gling rigs kyi sras/ /dbang bzhi smin grol brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /rgyal ba'i sras mchog 'chi med rdo rje 'dzin/ /mgon khyod bskal brgyar mtsho bzhes zhabs brtan shog /ces pa 'di yang rig 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus smras pa dge'o/ /oṃ swāsti/ rab 'byams rgyal ba yongs kyi ngo bo nyid/ /'chi med lta ba'i lha mchog tshe dpag med/ /yon tan bkod pa'i rgyal po gang de yi/ /bden pa'i mthu yi bdag smon 'di 'grub mdzod/ /bsod nams chu gter che las legs mthon pa'i/ /phyogs bral nam mkha'i khyon khengs nam mkha' yi/ /gdul bya'i zhing sa smin mdzad dpal ldan mgon/ /mtshungs med bla ma bsod nams phyogs glang gang / /mi shig a wa dhu ta'i gur khang dbus/ /mi 'gyur a haṃ nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor la/ /rang rig 'chi med rdo rje'i srog tu smin/ /gzhom pa mi mnga' bskal pa'i yun nyid du/ /zhabs bzung rdo rje'i ri bo ltar brtan cing / /chos yon legs dgu'i mdzad pa gong du 'phel/ /gangs can 'gro bas dga' bde'i dpal spyod 606

sheg /ces sa skyongs chos kyi rgyal bo pokre gtsugasha brgyan mchog tu gyur pa shel stod sprul pa'i sku rin po che bsod nams phyogs kyi glang po gang gi zhabs stegs gser gyi 'khor lo g.yo med bzhes pa'i slad du bod chen po'i yul du skye shing yangs pa'i rgyal khams kun tu chos smra ba'i go 'phang can rig pa 'dzin par sgro btags pa des lcags rta smin drug zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes dge ba la gnyal smad dge ri nas phul ba don ldan du gyur cig sarba maṅga lo/ /oṃ gāste/ rgyal ba rgya marjo kun sdi spyi dpal mchog /tshe dang ye shes gzi bajid 'od dpag med/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal yongs sel bdud rtsi mgon/ /lhag pa'i lha des 'chi med dge legs stsol/ /gang zhig thub bstan mthar thug nges pā'i don/ /rdo rje'i gsung gi legs par dgrol mdzad pa/ /klu grub rnam 'phrul 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon/ /gang gi bstan 'dzin yongs kyi gtsug nor che/ /lha sras sprul pa snyigs dus 'gro ba'i skyabs/ /mtshungs med bla ma chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs/ /nges don bstan pa spel phyir zhing 'di rung / /'chi med mgon po ji bzhin zhabs brtan gsol/ /da lta thub bstan snyigs ma'i mtha' la thugs/ /nges don bstan 'dzin re 'ga' tsam du gyur/ /des na snying po'i bstan pa rgyas mdzad phyir/ /dpal ldan bla ma chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs/ /mi shig a wa rgyu ti'i gur khang dbus/ /bzhom med a wam nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ /tshe'i rang bzhin rdo rje 'chang chen skur/ /'pho med rtag tu brtan par gsol ba 'debs/ /'phags pa mchog rnams nges pa'i don nyid du/ /skye 'chi rang rgyud mtshan ma spangs mod kyang / /gdul bya'i don du sna tshogs spyir yang ston/ /de tshe mgon khyod dzu 'phrul rkang pa la/ /nyer brtan bskal ba 'am ni bskal pa las/ /lhag par yon tan bkod pa'i mgon po bzhin/ /dus 'dir gdul bya rnams kyi 'dren pa ru/ /zhabs pad rdo rje'i ri ltar brtan gsol 'debs/ /gang gi mdzad pa yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel/ /'phrin las dbyig 'dzin khyon kun yongs su khengs/ /snyan pa sa gsum kun tu rab grags pas/ /gdul byar gyur kun phun tshogs dpal spyod shog /ces rnam 'dren 'bri gung mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rin po che dkon mchog chos kyi rgyal po gang gi zhabs pad yun ring du brtan pa'i ched du rig pa 'dzin pa rgyal khams pa tshe dbang nor bus snying thag pa nas gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba gdab pa 'di yang skye bdag gi lo gsar du 'char ba tshur lug gi zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang 'dab nas thal mo sbyar ste phul ba sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ phun tshogs yongs kyi 'byung gnas rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /tshe dang ye shes 'od zer dpag med rgetso/ /de la rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus pas/ /skor byas gsol 'debs 'di 'grub byin gyi rlobs/ /gang zhig 'jig rten 'di na sgron me mchog /dam chos rin chen nges don snying po yi/ /bstan pa brgya cher spel phyir mig mi 'dzum/ /dpal ldan rtsa shad can gyi bsam bzhin du/ /sprul pa'i zlos gar bsgyur ba 'gro ba'i mgon/ /rgyal dbang bka' rgyud phrin las shing rta che/ /gang khyed gangs can 607

ljongs 'dir gdul bya'i ched/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa nyid la mnga' brnyes pas/ /bskal pa 'am ni bskal pa las lhag par/ /'chi med rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyi/ /dgongs pa gtad de yon tan mgon po yi/ /zhing gi bdag po ji bzhin zhabs brtan shog /'dzin pa'i khyon 'dir nges gsang snying po yi/ /'od zer phyogs brgyar 'gyed pa'i nyin byed mgon/ /gang de dus kyi me las grol ba bzhin/ /bskal bzang pad tshal rgyas phyir zhabs brtan gsol/ /snyigs dus sems can las kyi snyog ma yi/ /phan bde brgyad ldan chu bo slad na yang / /'gro ba'i mgon khyed ke ta'i dbang po bzhin/ /'gro la dge legs rtsol phyir zhabs brtan gsol/ /rgyal gsang ma dros rgya mtsho las 'ongs ba'i/ /smin grol khyod thugs shing rta'i rgyun bzang po/ /chad med bskal ldan re ba bskang ba'i phyir/ /zhabs pad g.yung drung lta bur brtan gyur cig /ces rnam par 'dren pa rgyal dbang bka' rgyud phrin las shing rta mchog gi zhabs pad yun ring du 'tsho bzhes brtan pa'i slad du rgyal khams pa dpal rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus skye bdag gi lo zhal gsar du 'char ba cho 'phrul zla ba'i yar tshes bzang po la sa la spyod pa'i 'og smin tshur gyi gtsug lag khang nas phul ba sarba maṅga lo/ /zhabs pad brten pa'i tshigs bcad bkra gis brtag pa'i ri bo zhes bya bsgrubazhugs so/ /oṃ swāste/ zung 'jug ye shes mchog gi phung po can/ /'gyur med gdod nas rnam par dag pa'i khams/ /bde chen rdo rje'i rang bzhin bla ma'i sku/ /rtag par rdo rje'i khri la brtan bzhugs gsol/ /gzhom med kun la khyab pa nā da'i mdangs/ /yan lag drug bcu'i ngo bo nam mkha'i khams/ /sna tshogs 'gro phan sgra dbyangs bla ma'i gsung / /chad med rtag tu snang bzhin rtag gzhugs gsol/ /spros bral zab dbyings zhi ba 'od gsal ba/ /chos nyid snang ba gsum brtsegs 'dus ma byas/ /phun tshogs gter gyur dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs/ /mkha' khyab g.yung drung zhing 'dir brtan bzhugs gsol/ /rgyal ba kun gyis yon tan nam mkha'i mdzod/ /mdzad med 'phrin las 'gro phan bde bster mgon/ /snyigs dus gdul bya'i skyabs cig lha yi lha/ /gangs can mgon po bskal brgyar zhabs brtan gsol/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos gsung gi rdo rje chos/ /pad 'byung gsung gi tshangs pa lha'i me tog /sprul pa'i zlos gar gangs can bde ba'i rtsas/ /bsngags 'gyur bla ma bskal brgyar zhabs brtan gsol/ /sngon sgom blo can smon lam bzang po yi/ /bskal dus bzang por bsgyur ba'i mthu stobs can/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho bdag nyid 'jig rten mgon/ /mchog gi bla ma bskal brgyar zhabs brtan gsol/ /'gro ba'i mgon po mtshungs med dam pa'i zhabs/ /snyigs dus nyams thag 'gro la brtse ba yi/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor rtag brtan rdo rje ltar/ /snying nas zhabs pad brtan par gsol ba 'debs/ /gang gi tshad med thugs rje'i gru rdzing la/ /rten nas gangs can skye dgu'i rnam mang kun/ /phral dang yun gyis dge legs dpal kun 'phel/ / 608

mchog tu bde ba'i dga' ston rgyas par shog /ces gangs ri'i khrod kyi lha yi lha 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po thams cad mkhyen gzigs rgyal ba mchog gi zhabs pad yun ring du 'tsho bzhes brtan pa'i ched du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di ni bod chen gyi mnga' ris su chos smra ba'i go sar skyes shing phyogs med kun tu rgyu ba'i rgyal khams dā ri ba ḍa pa rig pa 'dzin pa phran gyur ā yur+ya sha ma ni badz+ra gyi iṅka ra char nye ba mgo zla'i dkar phyogs rgyal ba dang po la grub pa'i gnas chen rgyal gyi rtsib ri nas gus pas phul ba dge legs rten 'brel bzang po'i rgyu ru gyur cig dza ya dza ma su dza ya/zhabs pad yid bzhin nor bu yun nas yun du gyur pa bskal pa rgya mtshor bzhes gsol ba 'debs pa'i ched du brten mtshon byed du/ sku rten rgya gar shar li khyad 'phags gsang 'dus dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i bdag po rdo rje mi bskyod pa'i sku brnyan smad byung / gsung brten rang nyid gzhon du'i skabs su ye shes mkha' 'gros 'bog par rlom pa'i tshe grub bka' rgya can/ thugs brtan rgyud sde khungs ldan rnams nas sgrol ma dmar mo sogs kyi bzlas 'phreng du mchog tu shis par bsngags pa pad+ma'i phreng ba zhes tsan dan dmar mo 'bras bur 'dod pa 'di yang ne pal rgyal pos bdag la sbyin pa la nye legs par bzung nas rgyan dang dngul gyi bcu grangs gsar du sbyar ba/ mi 'jigs seng ges nye bar mtshon pa'i gnad dkar rdo rje'i re kha can/ she bal gyi dong rtse'i 'phreng ba brgya dang rtsa brgyad/ lha yi reg bya rnam par dkar zhing 'jam mdzes srid du ring ba dang bcas te/ phran bu las kyang phran bu bya bral dā ri ḍa bar gyur pa yi 'bul ngos cher phra yang / mchog gyur rnams kyi mtha' dag gzigs ngor yangs shing mnyam pa'i thugs rje chen po'i spyan ras kyis byab cing zhabs pad mchog gi sku tshe 'tsho bzhes rdo rje'i ri bo ltar brtan par gsol ba 'debs pa ji bzhin re 'bras don ldan du mdzad du gsol/ a yu dā rarga sarba ka lja wadartse/ rdo rje mi bskyod pa'i sku 'di 'phags phul lnga brgya'i gtsug brgyan ā tsar ya tsan drwa kidhe'i thugs dam rten yin la/ de ji ltar yang ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi thugs dam rten yin nges glo bo rgyal po a ba dpal la/ dad pa'i rten du rtsal ba rim rgyud smon thang mkhar zur la snang ba bdag gi rten tshab 'phags mo'i sku brnyan legs pa zhig sprad nas gong sar 'bul rgyur byas pa lags/oṃ swāste/ gdod nas mi 'gyur dwangs ma ye shes dngos/ /ma lus 'khor 'das gnyis med spyi dpal che/ /kun mnyam kun phro rin chen snying po'i gter/ /rnam kun mchog ldan rgyal kun ye shes gar/ /mtha' yas 'gyur bcas 'gro la thugs rje'i spyid/ /dpag med sgyu 'phrul yongs ston 'phags pa mchog /sngags rigs gtsug na mngon mtho rin chen dbang / /rnam mang 'gro 'dren rgyal ba'i sras mchog ni/ /gzhom 'gyur yongs spangs rdo rje'i khri bzang por/ /'od dpag med bzhin sku tshe mtsho bzhes brtan/ /gdul bya'i re bskang yid bzhin rin chen bzang / /phyogs las rnam par rgyal bar bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /pad 'byung rdo rje'i gsung gi 'gyur med par/ /rma ban rin chen phrin las sprul pa ru/ /yongs bsngags rnam kun rgyal bstan sgron me mchog /dpal ldan bla ma bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog/mgon khyod 'gyur bral zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku/ /nye bar brten las tshad med thugs rje'i grub/ /gdul bya don nyid rin chen gling bzang por/ /yongs dkris rnam kun rgyal ba'i sar bkod shog /ces mnga' 609

(snga)'gyur ring lugs 'dzin pa mtha' dag gi gtsugs na mngon par mtho ba slo rgyan smin grol gling gi seng ge khri skyong mdzad rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i gdung rdo rje theg pa'i brtan pa'i nyi ma gang gi zhabs pad yun ring du brtan slad mdo khams kaḥthog lho rgyud du skyes shing ri kha ba can gyi khongs kun tu rgyu ba'i ming dpal rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus gus pa chen pos sa pho rta yi dbo zla dmar phyogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i tshes nyer gnyis la ched du brjod de phul ba maṅga lo/ /oṃ swāsti/ bcom ldan dpal chen mche mchog he ru ka: kun tu bzang po che btsan khro bo'i rgyal/khams gsum rnam rgyal 'jigs byed 'jigs pa'i sku/ /'khor lo bde mchog dpal ldan bde ba che/ /mkha' 'gro mkha' 'gro ma yi drwa ba bsdoms/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor yum dang gnyis su med/ /khyed kyi sku gsung thugs kyi bden pa'i mthu'i/ /bdag gi gces skyongs snying las skyes pa'i sras/ /rgyal kun phrin las byed por dbang bskur ba/ /karma ka dpal bdud 'dul rdo rje gang / /sku tshe brtan cing 'phrin las gong du 'phel/ /mdzad bzang yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel bar shog /ces bzod mi rnal 'byor 'gro 'dul rdo rje sems pa mtshur chu rgyun rin chen rgyun gyi ngogs su 'bris pa bkra shis so/ /oṃ swāste/ rgyal kun thugs kyi ye shes rgya mtsho cher/ /brtse chen snying rje'i pad+ma'i sdong po las/ /legs 'khrungs sku nyid spyi dpal pad+ma 'byung / /de dang gnyis med dbyings phyug nor 'dzin ma/ /gang gi thugs las nyer skyes bran mo'i tshul/ /bde ba'i dpal mo smon lam dag pa'i mthu'i/ /nyer skyes paṇa chen shes rab 'byung gnas sogs/ /dam pa'i skye srid chu snod zla ba bzhin/ /cig dang du ma 'gog med char ba las/ /dus 'dir dpal ldan dpa' bo snyan pa'i rnga/ /che cher rgod pa gtsug lag dga' ba'i zhabs/ /'chi med mgon po ji bzhin 'tsho bzhes shog /mchog gsum rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i bden nus dang / /drang srong lha chen smon lam 'grub kun gyi/ /bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i gsol 'debs 'di/ /bslu ba med pa ji bzhin 'grub pa yi/ /rnam 'dren sprul sku gtsug lag dga' ba'i zhabs/ /gzhom med rdo rje'i srog gi ka ba btsugs/ /gzhig med g.yung drung tshe yi lang tsho ltas/ /phrin las mkha' khyab rtag tu gnas par shog /ces rnam 'dren dpa' bo sprul ba'i sku bdun pa gtsug lag dga' ba'i zhal snga nas gang gi zhabs brtan gsol 'debs su dpal rig pa 'dzin pa kaḥthog sprul sku'i chu phag dbo zla ba'i yar tshes rgyal ba dang po la gu ru'i gnas chen kong yul ljon pa lung nas phul ba sarba maṅga lo/ /oṃ ṭ+wāste/ rgyal ba kune gyi 'phrin las gcig bsdud dpyid/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ /de dang mtha' mi dad kyang tha dad tshul/ /rgyal sras lha rje o rgyan chos rje gling / /gang gi byin rlabs sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i gdangs/ /'jig rten dbang phyug 'gro 'dren sprul pa'i sku/ /gang khyed gdul bya'i dpal du bskal pa brgyar/ /mtsho bzhes brtan cing 'phrin las rgyas gyur shog /ces ras chung phug rnam 'dren sprul pa'i sku rin chen chos rje gling pa'i yang srid gang 'tsho bzhes brtan cing 'phrin las rgyas pa'i ched du rgya bal 610

bod yul kun tu ma sbas pa'i ming rig pa 'dzin pas lcags bya'i lo smin drug zla ba'i yar tshes la mthang 'brog smin grol gling nas ched du brjod par byas pa'o/ /oṃ swāsti/ gu ru pad+ma'i grub gnas sbas chags su khod pa rnams nas spyod lam bya bzhag dga' chags mi rjes 'god pa'i bcas yid 'di don las mi 'da' bar tshangs mas spangs blang ngos/ dpal mgon gter chen rin 'dzin mchog stag sham can dang chos rje gling pa ste yab sras zung gi zab chos gtsang mar spyod pa gal che bas de ltar 'tshal/ zhes rgyal dbang pad+ma'i slob ma gangs can du khyab par gyur ba'i ming rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus don grub sa lug zla tshes bzang po la'o/ /maṅga lo/ /oṃ swāste/ rig 'dzin chen po chos rje gling pa de pad+ma bde gling pa'i gter kha 'dir lung gsal bar bstan cing / 'dra min khams nas byung ba de yang shin tu 'grig pas nges pa can dang / rje stag sham pa'i mtsho rgyal rnam thar las kyang / de la 'grig sham pa'i phyogs de'i/ rā dza'i ming can brtul zhugs can gyi bton: zhes pa yang rje bo dang rgyal po yang sgra cung zad tha dad kyang don du gcig pas chos rje zhes pa dharma swa mi dang dharma ra dzā gnyis ka 'jug rung can yin pas 'di yang bzhugs nas ras cung phug shasbu'i phyogs su lan cig snang ba'i nges pa bcas de las gzhan mi gsal gyi/ nges pa nyid du bdag gi rnam par rtog pa las so zhes pa yang tshe dbang nor bus bris/ bkra shis/oṃ swāsti/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i phrin las gong bu cig /yongs brlum o rgyan rgyal po thod phreng rtsal/ /gang gi rigs lugs dri med 'dzin pa la/ /gzhar yang g.yel ba med pa'i snying stobs can/ /dpal ldan bla ma gar dbang 'phrin las mtshan/ /zhing 'di'i gdul bya'i ched du bskal pa brgyar/ /gzhom med 'od dpag med ltar 'tsho bzhes brtan/ /mtha' yas gdul bya'i smin grol sar 'god shog /ces dbyangs chos rnam 'dren sprul pa'i sku dam pa gang gi sku tshe 'tsho bzhes yun ring du brtan pa'i slad du rgyal khams pa rig pa 'dzin pas phul ba sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ rgyal ba kun gyi gsang gsum gcig btus dpyid/ /bla med sngags kyi ston pa rdo rje sems/ /o rgyan rgyal pos pad+ma thod phreng gi/ /sras gyur du mas byin rlabs dam pa mgon/ /gang 'dul phrin laspu spro mdzad rdo rje 'dzin/ /gang khyed ljongs de'i gdul bya rnams kyi ched/ /sku tshe 'tsho bzhes gzhan phan phrin las rgyas/ /sel med sngags kyi bde chen rgyas par shog /ces rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang dag gi byin rlabs zhugs shing gter sgrub mang pos rjes su bzung ba'i dam pa bla ma 'phrin las rdo rje gang de'i ched du brjod pa 'di yang ming yongs su grags pa dpal rig pa 'dzin pa zhes rang gzhan gyi grub mtha' rgya mtsho ma 'jug pa'i blo gros kyi gru rdzings can de'i smras pa sarba maṅga lo/ /oṃ ṭ+wāste/ dam pa'i sgyu 'phrul cir yang mi 'gog pa/ /nam yang gdul bya'i gnyen 'gyur mkha' 611

bzhin dwangs/ /tshe bdag rgyal ba'i lung bstan mi yi dbang / /gang khyed 'tsho bzhes bdag gzhan dge legs shog /ces rten 'brel gyi ched du dmigs te rgya bal bod yul kun tu ma sbas pa'i ming rig pa 'dzin par brjod pa kaḥthog sprul skus so/ /sarba maṅga lo/o swāsti ā+oṃ rā dza dza ma ku ru rgyu/ /rgyal ba rab 'byams rgya mcho'i tshogs rnams dang / /rgyal sras slob bcas 'phags tshogs zhing gi rdul/ /gsung rab dam pa lung dang rtogs pa'i chos/ /bsrung mar bcas pas bdag mos 'di 'grub mdzod/ /'phags mchog mig mi 'dzum gyi nyer gzar ba/ /bsil ldan ri'i bskor 'bum phrag brgya yi yul/ /ljongs 'dir skye dgu yongs kyi bde legs dpal/ /mngon gyur sa skyong byang chub sems pa che/ /bsod nams stobs kyi 'khor lo bsgyur ba po/ /chos kyi rgyal po gang gi zhabs pad mchog /gzhig med rdo rje'i khri rkang mi 'jig pa/ kaseng ge'i zer stong rtag brtan g.yung drung khrir/ /bde ldan bdag po ji bzhin bskal pa'i bar/ /sku tshe nyams med rdo rje'i ri bo ltar/ /mdzad pa yar ngo'i zla ltar gong du 'phel/ /mnga' thang kalpa'i shing ltar rgyas par shog /phyi nang mi mthun skyon kun nyer zhi zhing / /phyogs kyi sa skyong rnams kyi bsngags shing btud/ /nad mug mtshon zhi dge legs dpyid du 'phel/ /gangs can bde ba'i dpal gang zhabs brtan shog /ces gangs can sa yi dkyil 'khor ma dbang bsgyur ba mi yi bdag po chos rgyal byang chub sems dpa' gang gi zhabs pad yun ring du 'tsho bzhes brtan pa'i ched du snying thag pa nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di ni kaḥthog sprul sku rig pa 'dzin pas dbo zla'i dkar phyogs kyis rgyal ba gsum pa la phul ba sarba maṅga lo/o badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā: tshe mi 'gyur bde chen rdo rje'i khams/ /tshe nam yang gzhom pa med pa'i dngos/ /tshe 'bri gang las 'das gdod ma'i gshams/ /tshe rdo rje sems dpa'i bkra shis shog /tshe rga shi las 'das g.yung drung sku/ /tshe 'gag pa med pa nā tā'i dbyangs/ /tshe pho 'gyur bral ba rdo rje'i thugs/ /tshe dpal du 'bar zhing nyams med zhabs/ /dpal tshe 'od dpag med byin rlabs kyi/ /dpal 'gro ba'i mgon po 'brug pa rje/ /dpal bka' brgyud 'phrin las shing rta'i zhabs/ /dpal 'tsho bzhes nyams med zhabs brtan gsol/ /tshe 'od du 'bar ba nyid zla'i khams/ /tshe gas chags med pa bskal pa'i shing / /tshe g.yo 'gyel med pa lhun po che/ /tshe 'bri gang gting zab chu gter rdzings/ /tshe phun tshogs dpal ldan tshangs pa'i tshe/ /tshe 'dod dgu bsgyur ba 'khor los bsgyur/ /tshe nges pa lnga ldan rgyal ba'i tshe /tshe bkra shis bum rtsen lha mo brgyad/ /dpal g.yang du 'khyil ba de kun gyi/ /dpal mtshan ldan bla ma'i sku tshe srings/ /dpal bka' brgyud 'phrin las shing rta'i zhabs/ /dpal sku tshe nyis med brtan bzhugs gsol/ /tshe nges don bde gshegs snying po'i khams/ /tshe ye nas nyams pa med mod kyang / /tshe kun rdzob bden pa glo bur cha/ /tshe pho 'gyur rnam par snang kun yang / /tshe dpag med sangs rgyas mchog de dang / / 612

tshe lha gyur drang srong rig 'dzin mthus/ /tshe nyi zla lhun po dpag bsam bzhin/ /tshe yun ring gnas par byin rlabs nas/ /mchog dpal dang bla ma'i sku tshe sring / /mchog bka' rgyud phrin las shing rta'i zhabs/ /mchog phrin las sa gsum khengs kyi bar/ /mchog 'chi med zhabs pad brtan gsol 'debs/ /ces pa bsgrub brgyud 'dzin pa thams cad kyi spyi phud 'gro ba'i mgon po 'brug pa mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rgyal dbang bka' brgyud 'phrin las shing rta'i zhabs sku tshe 'tsho bzhes yun ring du brtan par gsol ba 'debs pa 'di yang na tshod ldan pa sa ga zla ba'i dkar phyogs thub dbang byang chub mchog gi dus bzang por rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus snying nas gdung shugs kyi gang shar mug par brjod pa de/ de kho na bzhin re 'bras don ldan chen por byin gyis brlab tu gsol/sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ tshe 'od dpag med gsung gi rdo rje 'chang / /dbang phyug brgyad ldan mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /yid bzhin nor bu bla ma pad+ma 'byung / /gang bde'i 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ /nges don snying po'i brtan pa spel ba'i ngag /nyams med dbang po dge ba'i sgra dbyangs can/ /o rgyan rgyal ba'i lung las nyer zin pa/ /ye shes gzhon nu'i byin gyis rlabs gyur gang / /dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'dzin bzang po/ /gang khyed a haṃ nyi zla'i gur khang dbus/ /mi shig dhu ti srog gi ka ba tshugs/ /tshe yi rang bzhin g.yung drung nyid du bstan/ /bskal pa'am ni bskal pa las lhag par/ /'tsho bzhes 'chi med rdo rje yongs grub shog /gzhan phan phrin las bzang po kun tu rgyas/ /lhun grub rgyal ba'i rgyal sa nyid thob shog /ces pa yang skyi grong 'jam gling gi gdung rigs skye mchog 'bar ra ba'i seng ge'i khri bsrung bar byed pa po chos kyi rje bla ma dam pa ngag dbang ye shes dpal bzang po yi sku tshe 'gal rkyen sel ba'i ched du dpal rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu'i 'chi med grub pa'i dpa' bo ras pa yab sras kyi sgrub gnas ra la za 'og phug nas spel ba sarba maṅga lo/ / 613

gag /dpal rig 'dzin chen po'i bka' 'bum las grub dbang pad+ma nor bu'i 'khrungs rabs dang rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs pa'i rim pa ji snyed pa bzhugs so/ /oṃ ā:r+ghaṃ: rang bzhin spros mtshan dang bral chos kyi lhums/ /rang mdangs 'du 'phro gnyis med e waṃ dpyid/ /rang shar rol bar gzugs kyi thig 'char brgyud/ /rang ngor snang gdod rgyal bar gsol ba 'debs/ /nges snang dag pa'i zhing na longs spyod rdzogs/ /rigs brgya gcig bsdus dpal ldan dang po'i rgyal/ /sgyu 'phrul rdo rje sems dpa' lha yi lha/ /rgyal gyur gtso bo mchog der gsol ba 'debs/ /yang dag bde gshegs sa nas lhag sems cher/ /gdul bya'i don skur bzhengs pa nye sras las/ /byang chub sems dpa' rgyal sras byams pa mgon/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug de la ྾ me rigs 'bar bar rta mchog he ru ka /thugs kyi ye shes las skyes gsang ba yi/ /bsdud pa dpa' bo thugs kyi rdo rje zhes/ /rdo rje chos mchog de la ྾ mi mjed 'dzam bur shākya'i tog gi drung / /'phags pa'i nyan thos mchog gyur brgyad las ni/ /'dul ba 'dzin mchog 'dul ba'i rgyud pa che/ /dgra bcom nye ba 'khor la ྾ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du rgyan drug las/ /mchod brten rnam dag dri ma med pa nas/ /'dul ba'i lung ston mkhan po yon tan 'od/ /bslab pa'i brgyan gyur de la ྾ bde byed rtseg nas gsang sngags sgrub pa'i rgyal/ /lung brgyad sgrom bu mkha' 'gro'i rgya dgrol tshe/ /yang dag thugs kyi dkyil 'khor bka' babs pa/ /rig 'dzin r+ghaṃ ka ra la ྾ sngags kyi ston pa rgyal dbang pad+ma'i drung / /me tog shar babs thugs kyi sgrub pa thob/ /rdzu 'phrul mkhar lding brag la phur pa bsnun/ /grub chen nam mkha'i snying por ྾ brag rgya bo ru dpal chen nyid du grub/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs ldan gsad pa bos bar mdzad/ /rdzu 'phrul thogs med blta sgom rtse mor phyin/ /zur chung shes rab grags la ྾ grub thob khyung po'i thugs gsang snyan brgyud mdzod/ /yongs 'jos khams zad 'od gsal snying po'i spubs/ /rnal mkhas shangs pa rin chen brtson 'grus zhes/ /rmog cog grub thob de la ྾ /spyan ras gzigs sprul gu ru chos dbang gi/ /rjes bzung byams pa 'bum kyi thugs kyi sras/ /thugs rjes chen po'i grub thob dngos grub brnyes/ /ma ṇi rin chen zhabs la ྾ gtsang phyogs la stod dam pa'i zhi byed chos/ /legs 'chang mdo sngags chos tshul yongs rab 'byams/ /'khrul zhig dpal chen shes rab 'od po zhes/ /bstan pa'i nyi ma de la ྾ 614

rab 'byung zhwa mar zhabs kyi thugs rje yi/ /rta ljang gis bskul don gnyis pad+mo'i tshal/ /rab gzhad skal ldan bung ba tshim byed pa/ /ri khrod chen po'i zhabs la ྾ mkhon gyis gdung las sde snod gnyis kyi bdag /dgyes pa rdo rje dkyil 'khor mngon sum grub/ /yon tan mthar phyin sa skya bzang po dpal/ /mkhas mchog dam pa de la ྾ mkhyen pa'i rtsal rgyas sgrub pa'i dngos grub thob/ /bstan pa snying po'i sgron ma sbar mdzad pa/ /nyams rtogs mkha' 'dra sangs rgyas dpal ba zhes/ /rnal 'byor dam pa de la ྾ dpal thang srin mo'i mtsho nas o rgyan gyi/ /thugs gter 'khor 'das rang grol spyan drangs te/ /skal ldan don mdzad rtsol med gter ston pa/ /byang chub gling pa'i zhabs la ྾ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dgongs 'dus yang gces chos/ /zab rgya gsang thig gter nas bton mdzad nas/ /nyams len lhag med rig 'dzin sar gshegs pa/ /grwa pa badz+ra grags la ྾ brag dkar rdo rje'i tshal nas drag sngags chos/ /yang zab snying gi me long la sogs pa/ /gter nas bton mdzad zla ban gzi brjid 'bar/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug de la ྾ lho brag mkho mthing gnas su grub chen pa/ /pad+ma dbang gi dngos grub gnyis brnyes zhing / /rdzu 'phrul dbang 'byor rnal 'byor rtsa ri pa/ /grags pa'i dbang phyug de la ྾mdo khams ka:thog rdo rje gdan chen por/ /sgyu 'phrul bka' bab sems sde klong du gyur/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa spel mdzad tshul khrims 'bum/ /bstan pa'i sgron me de la ྾ mnyam med sa skya'i gnas grub thob che/ /rlung sems dbur 'dus lam 'bras mtha' ru phyin/ /ye shes zang thal thogs med brtul zhugs spyod/ /bdag smyon kun dga' legs par ྾ o rgyan chen po'i thugs bsgrub brgya rtsa yi/ /yang snying sbas chos mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod chos/ /ston mdzad gsang mtshan pad+ma drag rtsal zhes/ /zab gter mnga' bdag de la ྾ lho brag phyogs su sngags 'chang chen po'i sras/ /tha mal tshul gyi gsang sngags snying po'i don/ /lhur blang gsang bdag thugs kyi rnal 'byor pa/ /grags pa'i mtshan 'chang de la ྾ gtsang gi zab lung nye bar sbas tshul gyi/ /sngags spyod rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor la/ /bsnyen bsgrub yan lag bzhi brnyes rnal 'byor pa/ /bsod nams mtshan can de la ྾ thugs bskyes chen pos 'gro don sprul pa'i sku/ /bla slob gter ston chos dag rgyal blon tshul/ /brngon pa bshan pa smad 'tshong tha mal tshul/ /du mas gdul bya skyong la ྾ de la sogs te skye ba'i phreng ba ni/ /sna tshogs 'gro 'dul sprul pa'i zlos gar che/ /ma nges grangs med skal ldan kha lo sgyur/ /gang 'dul de mtshungs ston la ྾ khyad par 'bri rgyud re khe'i gdul bya'i don/ /stag 'ur dam pa'i gdung rigs las bskrun te/ /skyes nas bag chags bzang sad gsang sngags chos/ /legs 'chang mchog sprul de la ྾ nar son gter grub du mas rjes bzung nas/ /thugs sras dbang bskur rgyal tshab cod paṇa byin/ /smin grol 615

mnga' brnyes pad+ma nor bu zhes/ /rgyal sras dam pa de la ྾ dkyil 'khor rab 'byams bsnyen grub drod tshad thebs/ /stong nyid don rtogs snang sems dngos sum 'dres/ /bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen man ngag don byan tshud/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug de la ྾ rnga yab dpal ri gu ru pad+ma'i drung / /dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs bskur nas gsang ba'i mtshan/ /gu ru zhi ba'i blo gros zhes bya bar/ /grags gyur rig 'dzin de la ྾ kun bzang dri med rdo rje gzi brjid dang / /pad+ma chos dbyings 'phrin las 'gro 'dul rtsal/ /pad+ma dbang grags pad+ma rnam rol te/ /sku gcig mtshan mang grags la ྾ pad+mas zab gter bdag por mnga' gsol zhing / /'brel tshad don dang ldan par dbugs rab dbyung / /skye ba'i phyi mar kha byang 'dzin lung bstan/ /dus gsum 'gro don mdzad la ྾ khyod kyi dgongs pa phyag rgya chen po'i gshis/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i gsang dang dbyer med par/ /'thims kyang slar yang sprul pas 'gro ba'i don/ /rgyun chad med par mdzad la ྾ lhun grub phyag rgya'i sku yi gnas lnga nas/ /spro bsdus 'od zer 'gyed las khyad par du/ /thugs dbyings sa bon rgyu mtshan yang 'char ba/ /slar yang gdul bya skyong la ྾ lho brag phyogs nas thugs gter gsang ba che/ /zhal phyes skal ldan smin grol don la sbyor/ /dus snyigs bzlog pa'i brtul zhugs pad+ma'i mtshan/ /'byung 'gyur phyogs sprul de la ྾ de ltar rgyal ba rgyal sras rab 'byams tshogs/ /sku dang ye shes rol ba dpag med pa/ /stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug las 'char ba'i/ /rten 'brel rol par rgyas la ྾ thams cad shis mdang rtsal cha dbyer med par/ /'gro don lhun grub gdul bya'i sna tshogs bzhin/ /rtog med ngang shar sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul che/ /bsam mi khyab ston mdzad la ྾ 'dir snang ngor khyed skye ba'i srid grags gyur/ /grub pa'i ba spu nyag gcig bye ba 'bum/ /gshag 'tshal 'od zer tsam gcig zhugs gyur sprul/ /ming 'dzin tshe dbang nor bur gsol ba 'debs/ /skyes nas mchog gter ston pas rjes bzung zhing / /dam pa drug gi zhabs zin gdams pa'i gnas/ /legs 'jos rang rig rtogs pa'i ngo bo mthong / /bag chags cung zad de la ྾ o rgyan chen po'i gsang ba'i mdzod bzang por/ /legs spyod nyams len sbas tshul bsgrub la brtson/ /dman pa'i tshul 'dzin gang 'dul gzhan don skyongs/ /rnal 'byor tsam pa de la ྾ de ltar rig 'dzin chen po'i skye ba yis/ /'phreng bar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyi/ /bdag nyid skye kun mtshan ldan dam pa yi/ /rjes bzung dam tshig sel med thugs yid 'dres/ /dbang bzhis rgyud smin skyed rdzogs rdzogs pa che/ /rab grol bdag gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub/ /mi gnas chos sku stong la rtags brnal ngang / /gang 'dul gzugs skus 'gro don spyod par shog /ces pa mkhas shing grub pa'i rnal 'byor pad+ma nor bu'i skye ba'i phreng bar gsol 'debs su sbyar ba ste/ bdag ni de'i sprul par grags kyang rang la gang nas ltas 616

kyang yon tan mi ldan par gyur tshe dam pa de lta bu'i sprul sku min par nges kyang dad ldanadhegyi grogs 'ga' shig gi nan tu bskul ngor sprul sku yin rdzu'i gsol 'debs sa cang tsam du bris kyang kun gyi thugs kyi bya ba'i gnas ci zhig lags/kwa yi sprul skur grags pa de lta bu/ /grub pa'i skye ba mu tig phreng ba la/ /so skyes bdag ni zhe ne rdog po bzhin/ /mdzes par mi 'gyur 'gro ba'i ya gi rgyu/ /rang la yon tan brjod rung rgyu med pa/ /snyim pa'i chu la chu gter brjod pa dang / /byi bar glang chen che drug sar bsngags mtshungs/ /des na rmongs las ches rmongs bdag tu 'khum/ /zhes shar 'byung du gleng lags/ rang lo nyer gnyis pa dpyid gsum lo ma 'bus pa'i dus rol lam drags yo le/ nags klong gru bzhi mdom gang yangs pa can du tshe dbang nor bu pad+ma gar dbang 'gro 'dul rdo rjes byung rgyal du sbyar ba'i yi ge'i rig byed rab 'byams pas bris pa dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o//oṃ ā rdu/ dang bo'i sangs rgyas kun bzang thugs kyi klong / /rig 'dus rdo rje sems dpa'i sgyu 'phrul rgyal/ /'khor lo sdom pa rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung / /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /'phags yul yangs dag rig 'dzin hūṃ ka ra/ /bod yul grub pa'i dbang phyug nam mkha' snying / /zur rigs sngags 'chang rig 'dzin shes rab grags/ /gsol ba ྾ snyi yi gdung las 'khrul zhig nyi ma seng / /'khon gyi gdung las grub brnyes bzang po dpal/ /gsol ba ྾ la stod dpal thang gter ston byang chub gling / /kaḥthog phyogs su tshul khrims 'bum pa dang / /'bras yul skyid tshal kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel/ /gsol ba ྾ stag 'ur rig 'dzin pad+ma nor bu'i mtshan/ /de sogs grub pa'i zlos gyur gar mkhan dpyid/ /du mar snang mdzad dpal ldan bla ma la/ /gsol ba ྾ tshe 'dir 'khrul zad chos sku'i thugs klong grol/ /dbang phyug yon tan brgyad snyed sku nyid 'grub/ /nor 'khrul ma mchis thams cad mkhyen pa thob/ /'brel tshad sangs rgyas 'bras bu mchog 'grub shog /ces dwags po klu mkhar zhabs drung pa'i gsang yum rang bzhin don gyi rnal 'byor ma ye shes lha mo zhes pas bskul ngor phyogs kun rgyu ba'i sngags 'chang tshe dbang nor bu'i shing 'brug hor zla'i tshes la spu bo yid 'ong du bris maṅga lo/ /rig 'dzin pad+ma nor bu'i skye rabs kyi 'phreng bar gsol 'debs byin rlabs char 'bebs gzhugs/ oṃ ā:rgyu mi shig ma skyes stong nyid rdo rje mkha'/ /sgyu 'phrul 'gag med sna tshogs rol pa'i rtsal/ /bden gnyis zung 'jug cir yang snang ba'i bdag /khyab bdag rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /grangs med mngon sgom thugs skyes tshogs gnyis kyi/ /mdzad pas rgyal ba'i go 'phangs 'khod bzhin du/ /'gro ba'i don du gang 'dul sprul bsgyur 'gyed/ /rdor sems chos kyi bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /zhen med sgyu ma'i ngang tshul ṭ+wān dam nyid/ /'gyur ba mi mnga' bsam bzhin thugs rje yi/ /gdul byar rtse bas 'gro 'dren sprul pa'i sku/ /skye ba'i 'phreng bar ston la ྾ shākya'i tog drung dgra bcom nye ba 'khor/ /'phags yul phyogs kyi rig 'dzin rgyu ka ra/ /pad+ma'i spyan sngar grub dbang nam 617

mkha'i snying / /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyi rlobs/ /zur rigs sngags 'chang zur chung shes rab grags/ /snyi gdung rtog pa'i dbang phyug tshul khrims snying / /rog ban chen po sur+ya sidha'i mtshan/ /gsol ba ྾ pad+ma dbang grub rnal 'byor tsa ri pa/ /spyan gzigs 'phrin las ma ṇi rin po che/ /dgyes rdor mngon brnyes mkhon rigs bhā dra shrī/ /gsol ba ྾ grags seng rjes bzung ri khrod dar rgyas zhabs/ /mdo khams kaḥthog bstan 'dzin tshul khrims 'bum/ /lung rtogs thar phyin dwags rab chos kyi rgyal/ /gsol ba ྾ drag sngags mnga' brnyes rig 'dzin gzi brjid 'bar/ /mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug grwa pa badz+ra mtshan/ /zab gsang mdzod 'dzin byang chub gling pa dpal/ /gsol ba ྾ ye shes zang thal dag myon kun dga' legs/ /'khrul med grub bsnyes dbang 'khrul zhig dbang grags rgya mtsho'i gsung gi sprul pa pad+ma nor bu thugs kyi sprul pa mi 'gyur rdo rje / /the ma tshom gcig the tshom na gyis/ nga la ni phan gnod med/ gang dga' bgyis/ ha ha/ chen drag po rtsal/ /yang dag mchog tog pad+ma nor bu'i mtshan/ /gsol ba ྾ snyigs dus 'dul don sprul pa'i cho 'phrul gyi/ gdul bya'i kha lo gyen du sgyur mdzad pa/ /ngo bo gcig la rnams pa sprul dpag med du/ /ston mdzad bla ma mchog der gsol ba 'debs/ de ltar bla ma mchog gi skye ba'i phreng / /dam par gus pas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /bdag gi 'khrul 'dzin dri tshogs yongs dag nas/ /bde chen sku gnyis mchog grub byin gyis rlobs/ /ces dad bskal mchog dang ldan pa du mas bskul ba'i ngor/ rdzogs chen rnal 'byor zol 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus shing sbrul ston 'bru bcud smin pa'i dus su kong yul brag gsum mtsho rdzong du smras pa dge'o maṅga lo/'dren bral grub pa'i dbang phyug pad+ma nor bu 'phrin las 'gro 'dul gyi skye rgyud gsol 'debs yid bzhin dbang gi phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/ oṃ ā:rgyu khyab bdag rgyal kun yab gcig 'od ma'i 'gyur/ /lhun grub 'od gsal gsang chen rdo rje sems/ /zung 'jug rang shar rig pa pad+ma 'byung / /rig bdag sku gsum bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /chos nyid rnam dag spros bral ngang nyid las/ /thugs rje'i rol rtsal rten 'brel gyis snang sku/ /gdul bya gang 'dul 'dir ston rgyal ba'i dbang / /mtshungs med rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog khyed nges don 'pho 'gyur kun bral ba/ /zab bzhi 'od gsal ngang du g.yo med kyang / /'gro ba'i don du 'pho dang 'jug pa'i tshul/ /skye ba'i 'phreng bar ston la ྾ chos kyi dbyings su rdo rje'i sa chen por/ /kun bzang sems dpa' mchog gi skur snang zhing / /dgongs pa'i rang mdangs thugs kyi rdo rje chos/ /rig 'dzin 'khor los gyur der gsol ba 'debs/ /sprul gzhi de las sprul pa sna tshogs pa/ /bsam gyis mi khyab nam mkha' mtha' dang mnyam/ /gdul bya'i don du rgyun mi chad pa'i sku/ /snang mdzad dpal ldan mchog der ྾ 'phags yul thugs kyi zab mdzod 'dzin pa'i gtso/ /rig 'dzin rgyu ka nam snying gi bla ma yang yin thugs rgyud gcig 618

ra la gsol ba 'debs/ /bod yul mkhar chur phyag rgya che mchog grub/ /gnub ban nam mkha' snying por gsol ྾ brag rgya'i bo ru yang dag mchog mthun brnyes/ /zur chung shes rab zur chen shākya 'byung gnas kyi slob ma dbon gyur/ grags la gsol ྾ ri bo shirnyir dgongs pa kha ltar brdal/ /dwags sgom tshul khrims mnyam med dwags po lha rje'i slob ma sku dbon gnyis ka yin/ snying por gsol ba ྾ nges med gnas su 'od gsal 'khor yug 'dres/ /zhig po nyi ma gseng rgyal ba re ne rgyu pa'i slob ma yin/ ger ྾phyogs kun yig bdun myong grol 'gro don spel/ /ma ṇi gu ru chos dbang slob ma rin chen zhabs la ྾'jag kyi gnas su mkha' 'gro bsnyen ne gu li/rgyud 'dzin/ /rgyal mtshan shang ston gtsang pa'i slob ma 'bum gyi zhabs la ྾ sa skya'i gnas su rim gnyis yon tan rdzogs/ /rje btsun bzang po dpal la ྾mtshur gyi gnas nang nges don sgron me sbar/ r+sha/ri khrod dar rgyas zhwa dmar grags seng slob ma zhabs la ྾snye nam gser phug zab gter chos 'khor bskor/ /bya ston byang chub gling par gsol ྾ kaḥthog gdan sar smin grol bstan pa'i bdag /tshul khrims 'di yi spu lung gnas sgo yang gsal bar mdzad/ 'bum par grags la ྾ kong yul snying phur dgongs 'dus gser chos 'dzin/ /mtshan ldan ma tir 'di yi bag chags da lta yang cung zad dran/ sangs rgyas gling pa'i gdung rgyud yin/ grags la ྾ stag lung sku 'khrungs zab chos nyi 'od gdal/ /ngag dbang grags pa'i 'bri gung dbang gi bla ma mdzad/ zhabs la ྾ mngon mtho nges legs kyis phyug 'phags gru ru/ /gong ma kun dga' legs par gter ston rat+na chos bdag yin/gsol ba ྾ gtsang rong skyid tshal lung rtogs 'brug sgra sgrogs/ /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel la gsol ྾ gang dkar gnas su bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /mkhas pa'i rdo rje gdan pa'i slob ma kun dga' mchog grub de grol mchog gi bla ma yin gsung / 'khyu mchog de la ྾ ri bu glang rur 'khrul shig smyon pa'i tshul/ /bdag smyon legs pa'i sngon chad 'di yi skul ni bdag gi ma 'tshal yang lung bstan ltar na pad+ma nor bu'i skye ba gong ma 'dra zhig snang 'dug go/ /zhabs ྾ sngags rigs pad+ma'i zab gsang phyogs kun spel/ /kun dga' gter ston rat+na'i gdung mthal/ bstan 'dzin zhabs ྾ de ltar bsam bzhin skye ba'i bsam gzung nas/ /gdul bya 'brel tshad thar pa'i lam ston mkhan/ /gang 'dul chu gnod zla gzugs ltar bkra ba/ /sgyu 'phrul rab 'byams 'chang der gsol ྾ khyad par mdo khams re kher sprul pa'i sku/ /mchog gyur ho ru ka dpal rig pa 'dzin/ /lha gdeng sbyor sgrol nus pa mthar phyin pa'i/ /pad+ma 'gro 'dul nor bur gsol ྾ gang khyed rgyal dang rgyal ba sras bcas kyis/ /byin rlabs dbang bskur rgyun mi chad mdzad cing / /gter grub du ma'i lung las cher bsngags pa/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab 'di yi byin gyi rlabs pa zhig bdag yin par rtags so/ /khyed la ྾ bla med lam mchog phyir ma'i ldog thob cing bar 619

dor dpal chen thugs kyi ye shes klong / /dbyer med lhun grub sa la gshegs gyur ngang / /gang 'dul sprul skur ston la ྾ da lta sbas tshul rnal 'byor kun tu rgyu/ /phyi ma lho phyogs dhe wi ko ṭa nas/ /zab mo'i gter spyod bod khams bde bar ston/ /rgyal dbang pad+ma'i sras der ྾ de nas bde chen pad+ma 'od klong du/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas thugs dang ro gcig ste/ /sku gsum chos nyid ngo bor zla med par/ /byang chub che brnyes de la ྾ gzhan yang rdor sems pad+ma'i thugs nyid dang / /mi gnyis nam snying sprul pa bsam yas zhing / /dus der sprul pa lnga dang yang sprul nyer lnga brgya rtsa byin gyi brlabs pa'i brgyad/ /'gro 'dul snang bar gsung la ྾ de ltar 'dren mchog khyed kyi dag pa yi/ /skye phreng chu gter dbus nas mos gus kyi/ /snyim par snang ba skal ldan dung sel bcud/ /yid kyi bdud rtsir rten nas gsol ba 'debs/ /mi phyed dad pa'i nga ros mtshan nas 'bod/ /dbang med dung ba'i spu g.yo mchi ma 'khrug /rtse gcig 'di phyi'i re ltos khyed bgyis na/ /thugs rjes ma 'dor 'phrin las 'gro 'dul rtsal/ /byin gyi rlobs shig dri med gzi brjid rtsal/ /bdag brgyud smin mdzad gu ru zhi blo gros/ /grol bar mdzod gcig thugs mchog bde gshegs snying / /bar chad gsol cig gu ru dbang grags rtsal/ / pad+ma nor bu'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs/ bdag sogs tshe rabs rtag tu mgon khyod dang / /'brel med thugs kyi dgyes dgu yongs 'grub cing / /pad 'byung nam mkha'i snying dang tshom bu gcig /gyur nas kun kyang rdo rje'i sar grol shog /de ltar grub pa'i dbang phyug pad+ma nor bu'i skye brgyud gsol 'debs shig dgos zhes rje btsun mi lha la gzhad pa rdo rje mchog gi sa brnyes pa'i gnas brag dkar rta so'i gdan sa karma chos 'phel zhes g.yu sgra snying po'i phrin las kyi sprul pa de yi yang srid 'phrul med bla ma dkar ma mchog ldan dang / rig 'dzin chen po bstan gnyis gling pa'i gdung rus dri ma med pa las grub pa'i yos lo'i gnas kyi bka' babs shing drag sngags nus pa'i mthu grub pa dad dam mchog gyur rdzogs chen rnal 'byor nyi ma seng ge'i yang yang bskul ba dang / gzhan yang grub chen bsam gtan rdo rje sogs gus ldan mang pos gzhad pa bkang phyir rje btsun bla ma'i byin rlabs cung zad zhugs pa'i rnal 'byor pa tshe dbang nor bu'am karma rin chen mchog dga' dge ba'i dpal gyi me lug smin drug zla ba'i yar tshes bcu gcig par mnga' ris mang yul gung thang chos rgyal pho brang khyung rdzong dkar po'i yang rtser mar me'i ldang la smras pa'i yig rigs kyang rang gnyis kyis bgyis pa'o/ /gzhan yang thugs brgyud gcig gyur rin chen brtson 'grus/ /shangs pa bsod nams mchog gyur/ dwags rab pa 'khrul zhig dbang grags rgya mtsho/ zab lung mi 'gyur dbang rgyal sogs kyang 'dren pa dang gong du smos pa rnams kyang dus mtshungs su byung ba yang yod/ sprul pa so sos ngang tshul du snang ba'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/ /oṃ ā r+ghaṃ/ gzhom bral chos dbyings 'dus ma byas pa'i ngang / /rang mdangs 'gag med cho ral sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /cir snang gdul bya'i don du bsam bzhin du/ /sprul pa'i skye 'phreng 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ /nges pa'i don la rdo rje sems dpa' ru/ /grub kyang ma nges 'gro ba 'dren pa'i phyir/ /chu zla'i 620

rol rtsed bzhin du pho dang bltams/ /du mar snang mdzad khyod la ྾ thugs kyi rdo rje rig 'dzin rgyu ka ra/ /nam mkha' snying po zur chung shes rab grags/ /dwags po sgom tshul dge slong nam mkha' 'od/ /ma ṇi rat+nar grags la ྾ bzang po dpal dang ri khrod dar rgyas zhabs/ /byang chub gling dang kaḥthog tshul khrims 'bum/ /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel dang kun dga' legs/ /kun dga' bstan 'dzin grags la ྾ snyigs ma'i dus 'dir sngags kyi brtul zhugs la/ /sus kyang 'dren du med pa grub pa'i dbang / /gsang mtshan gu ru zhi ba 'od ces pa'i/ /rig 'dzin 'khor los bsgyur der ྾ gang khyed gdul byar rjes su chags pa'i mdang / /sprul pa'i zlos gar bsam gyi mi khyab las/ /sbas tshul mchog kun rgyu ba'i spyod pa can/ /tshe dbang nor bu'i zhabs la ྾ de ltar dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma yi/ /skye ba'i phreng bar gyur la gsol btab mthus/ /bdag brgyud yongs su smin cing grol gyur te/ /tshe gcig nyid la rdo rje 'chang thob shog /ces gtsang la stod sos sngar gyi dbu mdzad bsod nams chos grags kyi gtsos grwa tshang spyi dang / lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i gdung las 'khrungs pa'i brang po dga' ldan sde pa bsod nams lhun grub kyi nan tu bskul ngor rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus phur bu zla tshes bzang por smras pa'i yig rigs sprul sku au rgyan phrin las bstan 'dzin dpal bzang pos bgyis pa dge'o/ /oṃ swāste/ he ru ka dpal ngo bo pad+ma 'byung / /res 'ga' brtul zhugs spyod pa kasnal/ /thugs kyi 'byung gnas 'ja' lus sman pa'i zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ /phyag rgya che mchog brnyes pa nam mkha' snying / /yang dag grub pa'i gtso bo shes rab grags/ /'od gsal rdo rje'i thugs mnga' tshul khrims snying / /gsol ba 'debs so ྾ rgya chen spyod 'chang lo tsā mi tri shrī/ /zab gter mnga' bdag byang chub gling pa dpal/ /mkhas pa'i khyu mchog sangs rgyas 'phel ba'i sde/ /gsol ba ྾ 'ja' lus dwangs ma'i skur gyur bsod nams mchog / gnas brtan gzhung lugs 'chad mkhas bzod dpal grub/ /yongs rdzogs bstan 'dzin ye shes rgya mtsho'i sde/ /gsol ba ྾pad+mas rgyal tshab dbang bskur smon lam mthus/ /sangs rgyas bstan srog 'dzin cing 'gro ba 'dul/ /sprul pa'i rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /de ltar rtser gcig gus pas 'khor lo'i mgon/ /rtsa ba'i bla mar gus shing dwangs ba yis/ /yon tan rjes su dran pas gsol btab na/ /pad 'byung nam snying ci 'drar bdag gyur shog /ces rang gi slob ma dad pa'i dpal gyi drag tu 'tsho bar gyur pa dga' ldan phun tshogs rtag brtan chos sde'i sku mtshams pa snying po bsten pa rab rgyas dang / rab byung blo bzang dpal 'bar so'i lnga'i bla ma kun bzang dngos grub bzang po/ lho zam gsar pa'i sde pa tshe dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho/ rang dang nye bar spyod pa pad+ma bstan 'phel rnams kyi gsol ba btab pa'i ngor rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus rang nyid kyi sbas yul 'bras ljongs byang phyogs 'bri mtshams gsang rir shing yos nag 621

zlar smras pa dge'o/ /maṅga lo/ /oṃ swāsti/ kun khyab gnyug ma'i ye shes gdod ma'i mgon/ /kun bzang ye shes a li ka li'i 'phreng / /zung 'jug rang rig bcom ldan rdo rje sems/ /sku gsung ngo bor shar la gsol ba 'debs/ /thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul sprul pa rgya mtsho'i bdag /thugs kyi rdo rje spyod 'chang kasna pa/ /nam mkha' snying po rin chen rdo rje 'dzin/ /grub pa'i 'khor lo bsgyur der gsol ba 'debs/ /bsgom tshul nam mkha' 'od dang byams pa mgon/ /byams pa dpal dang tsa ri ras pa'i zhabs/ /ri khrod dar ma gter ston byang chub gling / /sprul pa'i skye 'phreng 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ /snyigs dus 'gro 'dren shing rta sgrol ba'i mgon/ /mnyam med thugs kyi ye shes rgya mtsho'i sde/ /'gro ba'i dpal du 'char ba yid bzhin mgon/ /rdo rje tshe dbang nor bur gsol ba 'debs/ /mgon khyod mi shig zag med dwangs ma'i skur/ /bskal bar 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /bdag sogs 'gro la smin grol chos kyi sgra/ /rgyun chad med par rtag tu bskor bar shog /gangs can 'gro kun bde zhing skyid pa dang / /bstan 'dzin skyes bu mtha' dag phan tshun mdza'/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i chab srid mi nyams brtan/ /rdzogs ldan ji bzhin rgyal khams bde bar shog /de skad zhwa lu bla ma dge ba'i bshes/ /rin chen 'jam dpal don grub kyi bskul ngor/ /rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus sa lug gi/ /chu stod tshes bcur skad gcig gang shar spel/ /lgang la shrī dz+wa la dzamyu dī pā lkang ra bha wan+tu/oṃ sāsnyi/ kun khyab dang po'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang / /nges so lnga ldan rgyal ba rdo rje sems/ /'gro 'dul thub chen rgyal ba pad+ma 'byung / /rigs bdag sku gsum bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /'phags bod yul du grub pa yongs kyi rgyan/ /spyod 'chang nag po pa dang nam mkha' snying / kha cher mchog brnyes rig 'dzin badz+ra sogs/ /grub mchog dpal ldan bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /zhang sras skye med mngon gyur nam mkha' 'od/ /tsa ri ras chen byang chub 'bum dpal ldan/ /lung rtogs dbang phyug kaḥthog byams pa 'bum/ /bstan pa'i sgron me bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /grags pa dpal dang ma dhe paṇ+ḍi ta/ /byang chub gling pa kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel/ /de sogs gang 'dul sprul pa'i zlos gar mkhan/ /drin chen bla ma mchog der gsol ྾ snyigs lnga bdo ba'i dus 'dir nges sangs kyi/ /bstan pa spel slad 'gro 'dul sprul pa'i sku/ /rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu rgya mtsho'i sde/ /rje btsun rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /gang khyed bdag sogs zhing 'di'i gdul bya'i ched/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor sku tshe 'tsho bzhes bstan/ /mdzad pa yar ldan 'phrin las gong du 'phel/ /chos brgyud 'dzin pas 'dzin la yongs khengs shog /gzhan yang gangs can skye dgu mtha' dag pa/ /dga' bde rdzogs ldan ji bzhin spyod pa dang / / 622

chos kyi rgyal po'i chab srid bstan pa dang / /nges don snying po'i bstan pa dar rgyas shog /ces shar phyogs kong yul sa'i thig le ljon pa klung gi bla ma kun bzang 'phrin las klong grol gang gi gsung gi bskul ngor rig pa 'dzin pas rnga chen chu stod zla ba'i yar ngo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus chen tshes bcu la skad gcig mar smras pa dge'o/ /oṃ swāste/ kun khyab 'od gsal gzhom med rdo rje mdangs/ /a 'phreng ka 'phreng zung 'jug ye shes gar/ /rang rig dang po'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang / /he ru ka dpal bla mar skyabs su mchi/ /thub dbang bstan la sngags kyi 'khor los bsgyur/ /'od dpag med dngos pad 'byung thugs kyi sras/ /spyod 'chang nag po'i rnam 'phrul nam mkha'i snying / /rig 'dzin 'khor los bsgyur der phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang thugs chos nyid spros pa las 'das kyang / /smon lam dbang gi sgyu dra sprul pa'i gar/ /rgya che rgyun ma'i chad pas gdul bya rnams/ /thar pa mchog la dkri der mgo bos btud/ /bsam mi'i khyab las mos ngo nyi tshe ba/ /rin chen rdo rje tshul snying nam mkha' 'od/ /'byams 'bum drag dpal rdor rgyal byang chub gling / /sangs rgyas 'phel sogs dam pa rnams la 'dud/ /gzhan yang bzod dpal brag dkar sems dpa' che/ /'jigs med shing rta a nan+ta gasgo/ /dam pa de rnams byin rlabs nyer zhugs pa/ /rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bur gsol ba 'debs/ /dus gsum rgyal bas gsang sngags don ston mdzad/ /de ni sangs rgyas kun las lhag ces bsngags/ /des na smin grol don ston bla ma la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyi rlobs/ /dus 'di nas tsam bdag gi tshe rabs kun/ /rigs bzang blo gsal nga rgyal med pa dang / /bslab gsum rnam dag bla ma'i dgyes dgu bsgrub/ /smin grol sa lam yon tan rtsal chen rdzogs/ /mthong thos dran reg 'brel bcas 'gro ba kun/ /sdug bsngal las grol thar pa mchog la bzhags/ /kun kyang 'phyams gcig zag med bde ba'i dpal/ /kun gzigs rgyal ba'i go 'phang la 'khod shog /ces mdo khams ljang chu'i ngogs brag dmar gyi bla ma kun bzang 'phrin las kyi gser gyi me tog dang gsol ba btab pa'i ngor sa 'brug sa ga zla ba'i tshes bcu la bal yul mchod rten chen po bya ri kha shor gyi ngogs su da sar+ṣa ri shrī shrī rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus smras pa'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/ /oṃ swāste/ kun bzang ho ru ka dang gnyis med mgon/ /dpa' bo thugs kyi rdo rje gsol ba 'debs/ /lung rtogs bstan pa'i rtsa lags rmad 'byung ba/ /rgyal sras shan+ta de war gsol ba 'debs/ /brtul zhugs rol pa'i gar gyi 'dzam gling brgyan/ /grub thob nag po spyod par ྾ phyag rgya che mchog rig 'dzin sar gshegs pa/ /bod grub nam mkha' snying por ྾ gnas lnga kun gzigs dregs pa bran du bkol/ /rong zob chos kyi bzang por ྾ rdzogs chen snying thig nyin ltar brdal mdzad mgon/ /dri med 'od zer 'phro der ྾ rnam smin rig 'dzin mchog bsnyes maphyo pa'i gter/ /rje btsun sgrol ba'i mgon por ྾ kun kyang las lus ma yin sprul pa'i gar/ /smon lam dbang gi 'gro ba'i don 623

mdzad pa/ /rlabs chen rgyal ba'i 'phrin las byed pa po/ yang yang skye ba'i 'phreng ba ston der 'dud/ /bka' drin gsum ldan rdo rje slob dpon ni/ /rgyal kun ngo bor rgyal bas yongs bsngags na/ /rdo rje 'dzin dbang de kun dus 'di ru/ /rtsa ba'i bla mar shes bzhin gsol ba 'debs/ /dpal ldan bla mar snying nas gsol btab mthus/ /byang chen grangs med lam la mi ltos bar/ /skye ba gcig la lam lnga sa bcu rdzogs/ /byang chub chen po'i 'bras bu myur thob shog /gnas skabs tshe ring nad med 'byor pa rgyas/ /dbang phyug che thob 'dod don 'bad med 'grub/ /bya byed kun kyang byang chen lam du bzhol/ /'brel bcas gtan bde mchog la bkod par shog /smon lam de dag bslu med nyid 'grub par/ /dkon mchog kun 'dus bla med byin gyis rlobs/ /ces rgyal po dad pa dang ldan pa ā na tha yi dad pa'i rten dpal nam mkha' snying po'i sku brnyan ri mor bkod pa'i rgyab byang du rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus rab myos lcags rta gsar du 'char ba cho 'phrul zla ba'i yar tshes bzhi la mnga' ris smad kyi rgyal phran smon thang gi khab tu brjod pa la'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/ /pad+ma ka ras rgyal tshab dbang bskur bas/ /smon lam mthu yi sangs rgyas bstan srog 'dzin/ /phrin las 'gro 'dul sprul pa'i rig pa 'dzin/ /tshe dbang nor bu'i dpal la gsol ba 'debs/ maṅga lo/dus gsum rgyal kun ngo bo pad+ma yi/ /thugs kyi 'od zer 'gro 'dul nor bu mchog /dri med rdo rje bsam bzhin sprul pa'i sku/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /khyed kyi thugs rjes ye shes gzi byin gyi/ /bdag gi 'khrul rtog sgribs pa'i phyogs kun bsal/ /rang rig ye shes rgyal ba'i dgongs pa rtogs/ /don gnyis lhun grub sa zin byin gyi rlobs/ /me lug lor tshe dbang dang tshe ring lhun grub la snang ba'o/ /oṃ ā:r+ghaṃ rgyal kun thugs 'phrin gcig bsdus rdo rje'i chos/ /mtsho skyes pad+ma 'byung gnas 'phrin las kyi/ /pho nyar gyur zhing thugs dang dbyer med pa/ /grub chen nam mkha' snying por gsol ba 'debs/ /gang gi rjes chags 'gro 'dul sprul pa yi/ /zlos gar cir yang ston las da dus 'dir/ /thugs kyi 'od mdangs tshe dbang nor bu'i sde/ /rig pa 'dzin mchog de la gsol ba 'debs/ /'gro ba'i snang ngor dag dang ma dag pa/ /ji ltar snang yang rang ngor lkog 'gyur nas/ /gzhan med 'brel tshad don ldan nus pa'i mthu/ /thob par gyur pa de la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang khyed chos gnyis dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /rang mdang gdul bya'i don du zhi chags khro/ /phrin las bzhi yi rol gar dpag med pa/ /rgyun chad med par ston la gsol ba 'debs/ /mdor na dad ldan slob mas kha zhe'i tshig /so sor med par rtse gcig gsol btab na/ /mchog 'bras bde blag ster bar som nyi med/ /des na gsol 'debs bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /ces glo bo chos rgyal ma la dpal gyi gdung rigs dri ma med pa las 624

'khrungs pa'i dad dam shes rab kyi nor ldan zhabs drung gtsug rgyan nor bu'i gsung gi bskul ba dang / /gzhan yang sa bdag bla ma kun bzang rnam rgyal dang / bar phug sbyin bdag yon tan sogs don nyer mang pos nan du bskul ngor tshe dbang nor bu rang nyid kyi smras pa'i yig ris sprul pa'i sku 'phrin las brtan 'dzin gyis mdzad do/ /oṃ rgyal ba yongs kyi thugs rje phrin las dpal/ /tshig bsdus o rgyan mtsho skyes pad+ma 'byung / /thugs kyi rnam rol snub chen nam mkha' snying / /gang gi snyigs dus 'gro la phan bzhed nas/ /dpag med sprul par 'char las cha shas gcig /nges ston bstan la mi phyed snying stobs can/ /rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu rgya mtsho'i sde/ /gang khyed khams drug rdo rje'i sku 'di nyid/ /dag sogs snang ngor 'gog med brten 'di yi/ /'pho chen zung 'jug sku mchog nam brnyes bar/ /sku tshe rtag brtan ther tshul mi phyed pa/ /mgon po 'od dpag med ltar bzhugs gyur cig /nges don snying po mthar thugs rdzogs chen gyi/ /bstan pa phyogs kun dar rgyas yun ring gnas/ /tshe dbang nor bu'i theg chen smon lam gang //btab kun bslu med phun tshogs myur 'grub shog /bdag sogs skye ba kun tu mgon po mchog /pad 'byung nam snying dngos rgyud sprul pa'i sku/ /rjes gzung rdo rje snying po dga' ston la/ /rab spyod byang chub snying po yongs thob shog /ces gus can mang pos skul zhing rten 'brel la yang babs pa bcas rnal 'byor pa tshe dbang nor bu rang nyid kyis chu glang mgo zla'i nyer gsum la gtsang ru lag 'bras spungs su smras pa sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ bkra shis kun tu dge ba chos kyi dbyings/ /dbyings nyid g.yo ba med pa bde gshegs snying / /snying po dri ma bral ba de bzhin gshegs/ /gshegs pa bcom ldan rgyal des rtag tu bsrung / /bsod nams phung po dpag bsam ljon pa'i dbang / /ye shes dkyil 'khor mkha' dbyings dbus su brdol/ /dri med dge ba'i lo 'dabs rab tu g.yur/ /phun tshogs 'bras bu g.yur de dge legs mdzod/ /nam mkha'i mtha' snyam 'gro ba ma lus kun/ /gtan bde byang chub sa la ma bzhags bar/ /rgyal ba'i sras po tshe dbang nor bu gang / /'gro ba'i don du 'tsho zhing bzhes gyur gcig /bkra shis mchog kun khyab pa nam mkha'i khams/ /khams nyid 'gyur ba mi mnga' rtag cing brtan/ /brten g.yo kun la khyab pa ngo bo dpal/ /dpal des bdag cag rnams la rtag tu bsrung / /zhes rang gi slob ma kun spang pa kun bzang nges don dbang pos sam sgo ra zhig byin par thog mar dge legs kyi ched du gang nyams tshar gyi lag pa'i rol rtsed du gro zhun zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi dga' ba la ru lags 'bras spungs gang der spel ba dge/ maṅga lo/ dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /oṃ swāste/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho 'dus pa'i spyi gzugs mchog /ho ru ka dpal pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal/ /thugs kyi ye shes rang mdangs nam mkha' snying / /dpa' bo thugs kyi rdo rjer gsol ba 'debs/ /gang gi byin gyi rlabs la sprul pa'i sgra/ /pad 'byung zab gter kha byang 'dzin mnga' gsol/ /sbas tshul rnal 625

'byor gang 'dul spyod pa skyong / /rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bur gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol btab na/ /mchog mthun dngos grub yid bzhin 'grub po zhes/ /rdo rje theg par rgya cher sgrogs pa na/ /bdag gi gsol 'debs de bzhin dngos grub stsol/ /tshe rabs kun tu mgon khyod rjes bdag bzung / /dam tshig sel med bla ma'i dgyes dgu bsgrub/ /sa lam yon tan yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel/ /tshom bu gcig tu byang chub che brnyes shog /ces rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus te yer sa klu phug gong du bris pa'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/ shangs 'ba' ra yi gdan sa ba 'jam gling bla ma'i thugs dam can tsakā 'di'i rgyab yig tu bris pa gda'/oṃ swāste/ 'dzam gling 'di na grub pa kun gyi gtso/ /rgyal ba shākya'i rgyab tshab pad+ma 'byung / /gang gi pho nya gnub chen nam snying gi/ /shes rgyud byin gyis brlabs nas sprul pa'i skur/ /grags pas gangs ri 'dzin ma yongs khengs shing / /lkog 'gyur gzhan med rang gzhan don gnyis mchog /bsgrub la tshes brtson tshe dbang nor bu zhes/ /bskal brgyar mtsho bzhes zhabs pad brtan gsol 'debs/ /khyod la 'dod don gsol ba btab 'di'i mthus/ /re ba ji bzhin 'grub cing gang khyod kyis/ /byang chub mchog thugs bskyed nas theg chen gyis/ /smon lam btab kun bdag gi 'grub par shog /ces rtsa ba'i bla ma rdzong phu sprul pa'i sku'i bka' rtsal thod du bcing nas bya bral rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus smras pa'i yig rig mkhas mchog dam pa 'phrin las bstan 'dzin no/ /oṃ swāste/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes 'dus pa'i gar/ /mtshungs med bla ma mtsho bskyed rdo rje sems/ /gnyis med thugs kyi rol rtsal nam mkha'i snying / /snying nas gsol 'debs bdag brgyud byin gyi rlobs//tshe rabs rtag tu mgon khyod rjes su bzung / /ma nor theg chen sngags lam tshul khrims dag/ /sa lam yon tan rtsal rdzogs rdor sems kyi/ /go 'phangs thob nas 'gro kun 'dren par shog /ces dad ldan rab 'byams pa 'jam dar dang 'ba' ro tshogs bdag yar phel zung gi gsol ba btab pa'i ngor tshe dbang nor bus spel ba maṅga lo/ /oṃ swāste/ kun mkhyen cho rol ā li kā li'i 'phreng / /mi 'gyur bde chen snying po pad+ma 'byung / /gdul bya'i don du rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sku/ /dran mchog dwangs ma'i mgon por gsol ba 'debs/ sarba maṅga lo/ 'bras spung nas sgrol ma ba la gnang ba'o/ /oṃ swāste/ 'chi med mgon po pad+ma badz+ra yi/ /rdo rje'i bsrung gi dbugs dbyung rgyal ba'i sras/ /tha mal lcags khams ye shes gser 'gyur cing / /ji bzhin rgyas btab sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa/ /tshe dbang nor bu phrin las 'gro 'dul gyi/ /gzugs sku'i snang brnyan 'gag med mtsho zhing brtan/ /mdzad phrin bzang po yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel/ /theg chen smon lam btab kun yongs 'grub shog /ces snga 'gyur 626

rgyagoba'i ring lugs bstan pa'i gsal byed sgrol phug pa chen po'i gsung gi ngor mgo zla ba'i tshes bcur kong yul rtsa gang du rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus brjod pa'o/ /maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ bde chen khams gang sems can brgyud la ltar/ /spyod 'chang kasna dang nam mkha' snying / /rin chen rdo rje sgrol ba'i mgon po yis/ /rjes su bzung la sprul pa'i rnam rol tshul/ /snyigs dus gdul byar rang gzugs kyis 'dul ba/ /phyi nang rig pa'i gnas dang gnas lugs don/ /yongs 'dzin gu ru 'phrin las 'gro 'dul zhes/ /rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bur gsol 'debs kyi/ /'chi med rdo rje sku ru grub pa yis/ /gdul bya'i dpal du 'pho 'gyur med pa dang / /theg chen smon lam bzang po ji btab pa/ /bslu med dge 'bras da lta nas smin shog /ces kong yul dung mdo yi khyim bdag 'byor pas phyugs cing dad pa'i dpal dang ldan pa tshe dbang chos 'phel mchogs rgyas dang / rnam rgyal bkra shis mched kyi gsol ba btab pa'i ngor sa rta mgo zla'i tshes nyer gcig la gnas de nyid du tshe dbang nor bus brjod pa'o/ / maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ dpal bla ma'i sku ni 'gyur ba med/ /mkha' 'dra skye 'chi gzhom zhig spros dang bral/ /gdul bya'i mos ngor yang ni 'od snang mgon/ /ji bzhin sku tshe brtan par gsol ba 'debs/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i gsung ni na di'i sgra/ /gang gi rgyun ltar chad med rdo rje'i dbyangs/ /gdul bya'i mos ngor yang ni snang mdzad gsung / /ji bzhin chad pa med par gsol ba 'debs/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs ni gsal grib bral/ /'pho med bde chen rdo rje'i ngo bo nyid/ /gdul bya'i mos ngor yang ni rgyal ba'i thugs/ /yun nas yun bzhin bstan par gsol ba 'debs/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i sku gsung thugs rang bzhin/ /ye nas rdo rje gsum du gnas mod kyi/ /gdul bya'i mos ngor yang ni rdo rje bzhin/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor 'tsho bzhes bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /'phrin las gcig tu mdzad pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /bdag la sangs rgyas las lhag bka' drin can/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma bskal brgyar bstan bzhugs gsol/ /sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /'gro ba'i don la gang du su bzhugs dang / /tshe rabs rtag tu 'dren pa dpal mgon mchog /dpal ldan bla ma 'chi med bstan bzhugs gsol/ /bdag ni tshe rabs tshe brgyud thams cad du/ /skyes bu mchog rnams sku tshe bstan bzhugs kyi/ /gsol 'debs byed po 'phags pa tsun+da bzhin/ /rtag tu skye zhing smon lam thob gyur shog /dge ba des kyang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba rnams/ /'chi bdag 'khor ba'i spung las yongs rgyal te/ /'chi med bde chen rdo rjer btsan sa mchog /ring min myur ba nyid du thob gyur gcig /de skad kong yul sa yi thig le mchog /bu chu zhes grags rang 'byung 'phags pa yi/ /sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang gi rtsog tu/ /chu phag nag pa zla ba'i tshes bzang por/ /rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu yi/ /bskal bzang dam ldan rdo rje slob ma zung / /tshe dbang phun tshogs tshe dbang phyogs rgyas kyi/ /lhag bsam 627

dag pas ra sa ya na yi/ /sgrub chen skabs su 'phro la gsol 'debs zhig /dgos zhes bskul ngor smras pa dge legs shog /sarba maṅga lo/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i brtan bzhugs kun ṭhab rdo rje'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃswāste/ kun khyab mi shig gdod ma'i ye shes khams/ /ma skyes 'gags med sgyu 'phrul rgya mtsho bdag /rang rig stong gsal don dam bla ma mchog /lhan skyes chos kyi 'khor lor brten bzhugs gsol/ /cir snang chos kun brda' yi ye shes te/ /gang shar rtogs tshogs drwa wa rang sar bcod/ /'khrul spangs rang gsal brda' yi bla ma mchog /dbang yid yul du rtags par brtan bzhugs gsol//dpe med bsam bral gdod ma'i ye shes nyid/ /thabs mkhas rgyal bas brda' thabs tshigs gi yul/ /nyer mtshon byin rlabs don rgyud bla ma mchog /'pho med bde chen 'khor lor brtan bzhugs gsol/ /don brgyud rtsa ba'i bla ma byin rlabs can/ /cir snang brda' yi bla ma rang grol mkhan/ /don dam gshis kyi bla ma rang rig dngos/ /bla ma rnam gsum 'brel med brtan bzhugs gsol/ /cir snang chos nyid rang mdangs bde ba che/ /ngo bo bsam gyis mi khyab chos kyi sku/ /gang 'dul 'gro kun dge legs ston mdzad mgon/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma bskal brgyar zhabs brtan gsol/ /'pho bcas rtogs tshogs dri ma yongs dag pa/ /'pho med mi 'gyur bde ba kun tu bzang / /'chi med don dam bden pa rdo rje'i tshe/ /gzhom bral mchog tu rmad byung gang de nyid/ /bdag cag tshom bur bcas pas yongs 'grub cing / /de srid mngon gyur bar du snang ba'i tshul/ /dpon slob mi 'brel lhan gcig dgyes dgu spyod/ /srid bzhi phun tshogs dpal kun 'phel bar shog /ces pa yang shar phyogs shing lo'i tshal kong yul 'chim gyi mi yi bdag po sngags spyod tshe dbang dge legs phun tshogs bsod nams rab brtan bzang po'i sde gang gi gsol ba btab pa'i ngor bod chen dbus 'gyur 'chang du skyes pa'i rnal 'byor pa ri kha ba can gyi sngongs tha grur chos smra ba'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus tshang pa rgyas pa'i bu ro hi dra klung 'gram rang bzung rgyal ba'i gnas chen chu bo g.yas khyil du chu phag zla ba drug pa'i tshes bcur skad gcig gang shar du smras pa sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ chos dbyings 'byams klas snying po 'dus ma byas/ /ngo bo nyid sku rang rig rdo rje sems/ /kun khyab spros bral bde ba chen po'i khams/ /mi shig dwangs— ma 'gyur ba med pa'i dngos/ /dmigs med snying rje mkha' ltar gsal ba'i thugs/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas rnam pa thams cad pa/ /dngos grub kun stsol yid bzhin nor bu mchog /rje btsun bla ma dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /ces mulbe'i rgyal po bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi mdun na 'don rin chen dpal 'byor gyis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor rig pa 'dzin pas so/ /sarba maṅga lo/ oṃ swāsti/ mkha' khyab rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes dpyid/ /gcig gyur mi 'gyur bde ba chen po'i 628

gzugs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dpal ldan dang po'i mgon/ /rje btsun bla ma'i ngo bor gsol ba 'debs/ /ces mar yul rgyal po'i drung yig brten skyong rgya mtsho'i ngor rig pa 'dzin pas so/ /shu r+ghaṃ/oṃ swāsti/ gdod nas rnam par dag pa chos dbyings khams/ /ma rnyog sgrims med rang rigs rdo rje sems/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /rje btsun bla ma'i ngo bo gsol ba 'debs/ /ces mar yul 'tsho byed sman bla rdo rje'i ngor rig pa 'dzin pas so/ /shu r+ghaṃ/oṃ swāste/ kun khyab rgyal ba tshe mchog 'od dpag med/ /thugs rjes dbang phyug mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /yid bzhin nor bu bla ma pad+ma 'byung / /kun gyi ngo bo drin can bla ma mchog /skyabs gnas dam par rtse gcig gsol btab mthus/ /dus 'di nas tsam skye ba ji srid du/ /mtshan nyid kun ldan bla mas rjes su bzung / /dam tshig sel mi thugs yid gcig tu 'dres/ /sa lam yon tan yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel/ /'brel bcas 'gro kun thar pa'i lam la bkod/ /kun kyang kun tu bzang po'i go 'phangs mchog /ring min myur ba nyid du thob par shog /ces snye nam gnas po dad pa can karma bzang po gang gi gsol ba btab pa'i ngor rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus chu sprel nag zla'i dkar phyogs kyi rgyal ba dang po la smras pa'o/ /oṃ swāsti/ mkha' khyab 'gro ba kun gyi nyer mtsho'i dpal/ /mkha' ltar brdal ba tshad med thugs rje can/ /mkha' dbyings yongs khengs rgyal ba sras bcas kyis/ /mkha' klong dbyings su dbyer med rdo rje sems/ /don dam rdo rje ye shes rgyal kun dngos/ /dmigs med snying rje sems dpa' ye shes sku/ /rtag brtan 'gyur med bde chen ho ru ka /spyod 'chang nam mkha' snying por gsol ba 'debs/ /gang sku rnam pa thams cad 'gro ba'i don/ /tshad med sgyu 'phrul rol gar cir yang bsgyur/ /dus 'dir bdag cag 'dren pa 'khor lo'i mgon/ /dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /gang gi rmad byung thugs rjes lcags kyu yis/ /bdag sogs gdul bya'i snying nas nyer bzung nas/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho che las yongs bsgral te/ /gtan bde byang chub sa la drongs mdzad kyi/ /bdag ni tshe rabs tshe rgyud thams cad du/ /'khrul med dpal mgon bla mas rjes su bzung / /de dgyes las spyod sngags kyi sa lam rdzogs//ring min rdor sems go 'phang thob byin rlobs/ /ces gangs ri chen po ti se'i nub phyogs bod yul gyi stod mar yul rdzogs pa'i mtha'/ 'bru na dang stod hor gyi mtshams nub ra mgon po'i sku brnyan rang byung mchog tu gsal zhing lha stong yang 'od zer gyi phreng ba rtag tu 'phro ba'i ngogs mgon cig rtse yi bla ma sgrub po/ dpe'u ring ngam bka' rgyud chos 'phel rgya mtshos gsol ba btab pa'i ngor dpal rig pas 'dzin pa dpal gdong chu bya stod zla ba'i mar phyogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus thob pa gnyis par ho mi skyed tshal du smras pa dge'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/oṃ ṭ+wāste/ rab 'byams rgyal ba ma lus thams cad kyi/ /thugs rjes byin rlabs gcig tu 'dus 629

pa'i dpyid/ /mtshan nyid kun ldan rdo rje slob dpon te/ /de ltar tshe rabs rtag tu rjes 'dzin shog /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i dpa' bo ru/ /grangs med bskal pa'i sngon nas dam bcas nas/ /da lta snyigs dus 'gro 'dus 'dren pa ru/ /skye ba'i srid pa 'dzin der gsol ba 'debs/ /'phags pa'i sar gnas smon lam mthus sprul pa'i/ /'brel tshad don ldan u dum wa ra 'dra/ /brgya ma lan gcig mjal ba'i dus skabs su/ /legs bsnyen dgyes pa mtha' dag bsgrub par shog /mtshan ldan bud med rgyal kun ye shes khams/ /mtshan ldan yongs su bskyed la ches bsngags na/ /mtshan ldan gzhon nu'i lus bzang rtag thob nas/ /mtshan ldan bla ma mnyes pa'i las bsgrub shog /ces kha che zangs dkar gyi skyes ma dkar rgyud chos sgron gyi dad pa'i yid gso ba'i slad du dpal rig pa 'dzin pa rgyal khams pas dpal gdod chu bya khrums zla ba'i dmar phyogs tshes bcu mar yul gyi chu mgo su ra chos sgar du bris pa'o/ /dge'o/ /oṃ swāsti/ rgyal kun 'phrin las gcig bsdus pad+ma 'byung / /dpa' bo thugs kyi rdo rje nam mkha' snying / /rgyal ba'i sras po tshe dbang nor bu'i sde/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma tshe dbang nor bu yis/ /theg chen smon lam gang btab bslu med 'grub/ /skye kun pad 'byung nam snying sprul pa yis/ /rjes bzung byang chen smon lam myur 'grub shog /ces mnga' ri'i btsun ma lnga rang gnas su 'gro bar kha 'don gsol 'debs su tshe dbang nor bus shing 'brug zla ba dang po'i tshes bco brgyad la gnub khu lung du bris/ maṅga lo/oṃ swāsti/ rje btsun rgyal ba kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /nor mdzod mtsho gling sku 'khrungs rdo rje chos/ /'od nang mtha' yas sangs rgyas kun gyi yab/ /pad+ma badz+ra rtsal la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang gi thugs kyi ye shes rang 'od las/ /yongs snang rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi gtso/ /thugs kyi rdo rje dpal chen nam mkha' snying / /grub pa'i dbang po mchog der gsol 'debs/ /khyod ni 'phags chen sa la yongs bzhugs pas/ /sprul pa'i sgyu 'phrul bsgrangs mi bzod pa las/ /so skyes rang gzugs tshul dang byin rlabs las/ /sprul mtshan tshe dbang nor bur gsol ba 'debs/ /bka' drin gsum ldan rdo rje slob dpon la/ /rtse gcig gus pas gsol ba btab gyur na/ /byang chub chen po dus 'dir stsol gyur zhes/ /rdo rje theg par rgya cher bsngags pa bzhin/ /bdag gi rtse gcig gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe rabs rtag tu mgon khyod rjes su gzung / /sngags brgyud nas gsung dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung / /bla ma'i thugs kyi dgyes dgu bsgrub byed shog /chos rnams bdag med rtogs pa'i stong nyid dang / /'gro rnams nam yang dor med snying rje yi/ /srid bzhi las grol gdod nas bde ba che/ /rdo rje sems pa'i go 'phangs myur 'grub shog /theg chen thun mong thun min sa lam gyi/ /yon tan ji bzhin rgyas zhing rtsal myur rdzogs/ /kun gzigs ji bzhin sangs rgyas sa sbyangs nas/ /mtha' yas 'gro kun 'dren par bdag gyur shog /ces 630

pa 'ang shar phyogs kong po 'chims yul dga' chags kyi mi rje rnam spyod kyi ge sar mchog tu rgyas shing dad dam gyi dpal dang ldan pa 'phrin las lhun grub gang gi gsung gi ngor mdo khams lho rgyud rig sngags kyi rnal 'byor gyis smras pa dge'o/ /maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ gdod nas rnam dag rgyal ba kun tu bzang / /rigs drug 'dus pa'i spyi dpal rdo rje sems/ /rmad byung phrin las mnga' bdag pad+ma 'byung / /sku gsum kun 'dus ngo bo nam mkha' snying / /thugs kyi sgyu 'phrul tshe dbang nor bu'i sde/ /rtsa ba'i bla mar brtse gcig gsol 'debs na/ /bdag ni tshe rabs tshe rgyud thams cad du/ /mgon po khyod kyi rjes su gzung gyur cig /dam tshig sel med thugs kyi dgyes dgu bsgrub/ /'phrin las spel la rab tu brtson byed cing / /rdo rje theg pa'i sa lam yon tan rdzogs/ /tshom bu gcig tu sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces snye mo a tha gling pa'i rje btsun pad+ma bde chen mtsho sgron dpon g.yog gi gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus smras pa dge legs su gyur cig sarba maṅga lo/oṃ rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje'i mthu/ /gcig bsdus pad+ma thod 'phreng rgyal de dang / /dbyer med nam snying sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i gar/ /phrin las 'gro kun 'dul der gsol ba 'debs/ /skyabs mchog khyed kyi thugs rje'i nus pa yi/ /bdag gi rnams g.yeng 'ching ba ngan 'gro spangs/ /sdug med chos kyi blo gros rab rgyas na/ /byang chub snying po'i go 'phang myur thob shog /ces grang po smad zhal ngo phun tshogs dar rgyas kyi gsol ba btab pa'i ngor gu ru pad+ma'i slob ma tshe dbang nor bus dbyug gu zla ba'i tshes bco lngar brang mtsho dkyil mthong du spel ba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /rab 'byams dkyil 'khor yongs kyi spyi dpal che/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje 'gro ba yongs kyi mgon/ /dbyer med nam mkha' snying por gsol ba 'debs/ /gang gi sgyu 'phrul rol pa 'byams klas pas/ /phyogs 'dir bdag sogs gdul bya'i snang ngo ru/ /sngags kyi rnal 'byor spyod gyur rig pa 'dzin/ /tshe dbang nor bur grags la gsol ba 'debs/ /bka' drin gsum ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol 'debs phan yon tshad gzung las 'das pas/ /rgyal dang sras bcas rnam kun gsung mdzad na/ /bdag ni snying nas bla mar gsol 'debs mthus/ /dus 'di nas gzung byang chub snying po'i bar/ /pad 'byung nam snying sprul pas rjes bzung zhing / /theg chen sa lam yon tan gong 'phel rdzogs/ /'gro phan rdo rje sems 'bras myur thob shog khyad par lus 'di bor bar gyur ma thag /o rgyan mkha' la spyod pa'i
