zhing skyes nas/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams dang bskal mnyam zhing / /ye shes tshogs kyis 'khor lo longs spyod shog /gzhan yang gang skyes de nas skad gcig la/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i drung skyod rdzu 'phrul mthu/ /thob nas khrag mthung tshe dbang nor bu yi/ /zhabs bsnyen rdo rje theg la 631

khugs par shog /mdor na tshe rabs tshe rgyud thams cad du/ /ma nor 'khrul med mtshan ldan bla ma yi/ /rjes bzung de yi 'phrin las yongs bsgrub nas/ /mkha' sbyor yan lag bdun ldan langs spyod shog /ces 'dus 'byung bde gling sde pa'i sras mo dad pa can mdzes sdug gi nyi ma'i nan rten chen pos gsol ba btab pa'i ngor rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus smras pa'o/ /oṃ swāste/ he ru ka dpal gdod nas kun tu bzang / /thub pa'i bstan pa brtul zhugs rol pa'i rgyan/ /mtshungs pa mi mnga' spyod 'chang kat+na pa/ /khyed la gsol ba 'debs so bdag byin rlobs/ /dus 'dir smin grol ye shes byin rlabs mthu/ /ji bzhin rten mdzad rdo rje slob dpon yang / /ho ru ka dpal khyed kyi cho 'phrul ste/ /rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol 'debs bdag byin rlobs/ /bdag ni tshe rabs tshe rgyud thams cad du/ /rdo rje 'chang bsnyes bla ma mchog dang mjal/ /de yis rjes gzung dam tshig rnam par dag /rig min rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas thob shog /ces dad pa can tshe lha sgrol dkar gyi bskul ba'i ngor phyogs med rgyal khams pa rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus chos 'khor dpal gyi lha sar gro zhun zla ba'i yar tshes dga' ba gnyis pa la bris pa sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāsti/ chos nyid dag pa rnam 'gyur sgyu ma ru/ /rang shar bden gnyis zung 'jug don rtogs shing / /rgyal ba'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin du ma'i dpal/ /rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bur gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe rabs rtag tu mgon khyod rigs bdag thob/ /dbang thob dam tshig rnam dag bdag rgyud grol/ /gzhan phan 'phrin las yid bzhin gter du grub/ /dpal mgon bla ma'i go 'phangs myur thob shog /ces la stod dpal mo chos lding sgrub sde'i dbu mdzad nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi gsol ba btab pa'i ngor rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus drang srong srin po rir smras pa sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ kun khyab mi shig dwangs ma gsum ldan mgon/ /kun bzang bde ba'i thig le mi 'gyur dpyid/ /kun dga' phun tshogs dpal kun 'byung ba'i gnas/ /kun tu dpal ldan bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /gang gi thugs rjes tshe rabs ji srid du/ /dam pas rjes bzung ma nor lam la zhugs/ /bslab gsum rnam dag don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub/ /rgyal mchog go 'phangs myur du 'grub par shog /ces rje drung tshe dbang mchog ldan khams go 'jo'i bla mar 'gro gdong rig pa 'dzin pas brjod pa sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ kun khyab spros bral rang rig rdo rje sems/ /o rgyan zhing gi gtso mchog thugs rdo rje/ /gang gi smon lam mthu las 'phags bod du/ /spyod 'chang nag po pa dang nam mkha' snying / /rig 'dzin mchog grub slar yang rjes chags kyis/ /sprul pa'i skye srid du mar 'dzin mdzad pa/ /bka' drin gsum ldan drin chen bla ma mgon/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag brgyud byin gyi rlobs/ /gang gi zhabs bzung mtha' bral rdor dkyil ni/ /lte gsang sang gi chu skyes rgyas pa'i mkhar/ /snying mgrin bde chen nyi zla rin 632

chen gter/ /gzhom med rdo rje lta bur zhabs brtan shog /sa gsum nges don snying po'i chos smras khyab//'od gsal rdzogs chen bstan 'dzin kun tu rgyas/ /bdag sogs rjes 'jug mchog mthun dngos grub brnyes/ /tshom bu gcig tu 'od dpag med 'grub shog /ces pa yang tsang rong chos gter gling gi rnam 'dren 'od mchog sprul pa'i sku bskal bzang 'jigs med lhun 'grub dpal bzang po'i gsung gi bskul ba'i ngor rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus snar thang du smras pa sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāsnyi/ gdod nas snyog med rgyal ba 'od mi 'gyur/ kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan tshe dpag med/ /rgyal kun phrin las byed po pad+ma 'byung / /sku gsum kun 'dus ngo bo bka' drin can/ /snyigs ma'i dus su 'gro 'dul rgyal ba'i sras/ /mtshungs med rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag ni tshe rabs tshe rgyud thams cad du/ /thar pa'i lam ston mtshan ldan bla ma mjal/ /dgyes pa'i rjes bzung dam tshig rnam par dag/ /bdag gi sgo gsum bla ma dgyes la spyod/ /bslab gsum rnam dag sa lam yon tan kun/ /yar ngo'i zla ltar gong nas gong du 'phel/ /'brel bcas 'gro yang tshom bu cig pa ru/ /byang chub che 'bras myur du thob par shog /ces dad ldan lcam phun tshogs lha mos bskul ba'i ngor dpal rig pa 'dzin pas spel ba sarba maṅga lo/oṃ mchog gsum rtsa gsum rgya mtsho kun 'dus dpal/ /dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma'i ngo bo nyid/ /'od dpag med mgon spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug /pad+ma ka ra snying nas gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag gi dus gsum bsags yod dge ba kun/ /'od dpag med mgon ci 'dra de thob pa'i/ /rgyu ru yongs bsngo bslu med gegs med par/ /rigs min rdzogs sangs rgyas de 'grub gyur shog /de srid skye kun mtho ris 'phags pa'i nor/ /phun tshogs thob cing bshes gnyen dam pas zin/ /tshogs gsum gong 'phel sa lam yon tan rdzogs/ /'brel bcas 'gro kun mthar mchog la bkod shog /ces gtsang nyang stod pa rnam srang phug gi sde pa blo gros kyi nor ldan chos grags gang gi gsol ba btab pa'i ngor rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang 'dabs su smras pa sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ gdod nas rgyal ba mchog tu kun tu bzang / /nges pa lnga ldan longs sku 'od dpag med/ /'gro 'dul sprul sku tshe dbang pad+ma 'byung / /kun 'dus spyi dpal drin can bla ma'i zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe rabs rtag tu bla ma mchog gi zin/ /sa lam yon tan yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel/ /rgyal ba'i gnas thob 'gro kun 'dren par shog /ces yul mdo khams zhe zhe 'on gyi bla ma bsod nams grags pas gsol ba btab pa'i ngor dpal rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus smras pa sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ gzi brjid 'od dpag med mgon pad+ma 'byung / /brtul zhugs grub pa yongs gtso 633

kasna/ /mtshungs med 'khor lo'i mgon po bde ba che/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i ngo bor gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag ni tshe rabs tshe rgyud thams cad du/ /mtho ris yon tan 'phags nor bdun gyi phyug /gshes gnyen mchog gi rjes bzung bslab gsum dag /ring min rdo rje 'chang 'bras myur 'grub shog /ces yul kasmi ra yi mtsho la dwags rgyal po'i blon po dad pa can dge slong chos 'brug brgyas dang / bla ma rgya mtsho mched kyi ngor dpal rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus smras pa dge'o/ /oṃ swāste/ kun khyab spros bral kun gyis snying dbus su/ /rtag brtan g.yung drung bde ba chen po'i sku/ /dpal ldan dang po'i rdo rje sems dpa' che/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog rje btsun bla ma gang / /bdag gi chos kyis 'khor lo 'dab rgyas rtsa/ /mos gus ge sar ze'u 'bru mdzes pa'i dbus/ /byang chub snying po'i bar du brtan bzhugs shing / /bdag gi sgo gsum bla ma'i sku gsung thugs/ /dbyer med zung 'jug mi shig rdo rje 'chang / /'du 'brel med pa'i ngo bor lhun grub cing / /mtha' yas 'gro ba yongs kyi 'dren pa mchog /kun gzigs rgyal ba ji 'dra myur thob shog /ces sprul pa'i sku ring 'dzin yon tan rgya mtsho gang gi bskul ba'i ngor rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus sa sbrul gyi lo snron zla ba'i tshes bzang por brjod pa dge legs su gyur gcig sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ rgyal ba kun gyi gsang gsum mkha' khyab dpal/ /kun gyi snying po gangs chen rigs cig bdag /sku dang ye shes zung 'jug rdo rje sems/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i ngo bor gsol ba 'debs/ /oṃ swāste/ kun khyab 'gyur med spros bral bde ba che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs kyi ye shes nyid/ /bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' chos kyi bskur/ /gsol ba 'debs so che mchog dngos grub stsol/ /sku dang zhing khams 'du 'brel med pa'i bdag kha sbyor zung 'jug mnyam nyid rgyal kun gsung / /bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' longs spyod rdzogs/ /gsol ba 'debs so ྾ thugs rje rol rtsal mkha' khyab gdul bya'i mgon/ /gang 'dul sgyu 'phrul bral ba rgyal ba'i thugs/ /bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' sprul pa'i skur/ /gsol ba ྾ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs ngo bo/ /chos longs sprul sku kun gyi spyi dpal che/ /ngo bo nyid sku bla ma rdor sems la/ /gsol ba ྾ lhag pa'i lha mchog bla ma rdor sems mthu'i/ /bdag lus phung khams lhan sku phyag rgyar grol/ /bdag ngag gzhom med rdo rje'i dbyings su shar/ /bdag gnyis rdor sems thugs dang ro mnyam nas/ /nam mkha' mthar thug sems can kun gyi don/ /'bad med lhun grub yid bzhin nor bu ltar/ /phan bde dge ba'i rtsas su yongs grub nas/ /kun kyang rdor sems go 'phang la bkod shog /ces ma yul gung thang du sngags 'gyur gyi rig sngags 'chang ba mtshar du mngar ba mdo 'o che yi gdung las byon pa sngags 'chang rgyal sras seṅge'i gsung gi bskul ba'i ngor rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu'i stod mnga' ri'i cha tsan yul zangs thang dmar po'i 'dabs rgyab skyib zhes par sa sbrul snron zla'i dmar phyogs kyi rgyal 634

ba gsum pa la smras pa sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ rgyal kun 'dus zhal mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang / /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab dpal ldan nam mkha'i snying / /snyigs dus 'gro 'dul gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /tshe dbang nor bur snying nas gsol 'debs kyi/ /tshe rabs rtag tu yongs 'dzin dam pa yi/ /rjes bzung dbang bskur gdam pas rgyud grol nas/ /theg chen sa lam yon tan rtsal chen rdzogs/ /myur du rdo rje sems dpa' nyid 'grub shog /ces dad ldan bla ma 'gyur med dang lcam sring la nor bu chos mdzom zhes pas gsol ba btab pa'i ngor rig 'dzin rgyal khams pas smras pa sarba maṅga lo/a haṃ/ phyogs med rgyal khams yangs pa ru/ /bde chen dga' mar stag rtsen nas/ /chags can ros myos glu mchog mkhan/ /yan pa blo bder gsol ba 'debs/ /chos dbyings 'od gsal bha ga ru/ /rig pa'i rdo rje bsnun byed nas/ /lhan skyes dga' ba'i gad mo sgrogs/ /'khyal po de la gsol ba 'debs/ /ces grub chen o rgyan bde chen dbang phyug gi bskul ngor smyon pa tshe dbang nor bus smras/oṃ swāste/ ji bzhin 'od gsal srid pa'i mun bcom pa/ /snang ba mtha' yas sangs rgyas kun gyi yab/ /mkha' khyab gdod ma'i mgon po chos kyi skur/ /gsol 'debs smin cing grol bar byin gyi rlobs/ /tshad med thugs rje'i spyan ras yangs po yi/ /mtha' yas 'gro la rtag gzigs gangs can mgon/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur/ /gsol 'debs smin cing ྾ rgyal kun ye shes gcig bsdus pad+mo nas/ /rang 'byung spros kun bral nas rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje mchog gi sprul pa'i skur/ /gsol ba 'debs ྾ sku gsum rgyal ba kun kyang ro mnyam zhing / /chos nyid snying rjes zung 'jug ngo bo nyid/ /bdag sogs dpal mgon rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs ྾ de ltar sku gsum dbyer med bla ma la/ /zol med snying nas gus pas gsol 'debs na/ /byin gyis rlobs shig mtshungs med 'gro ba mgon/ /dbang bzhi bskur zhing dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i gtso/ /theg chen sa dang lam gyi yon tan kun/ /skad cig gdan thog 'di ru rdzogs bsgrod de/ /mkha' khyab gdul bya sems ldan ma lus kun/ /sku gsum rgyal ba'i sa la bkod par shog /ces mnga' ris smad ma yul gung thang gi ri khrod pa dge slong rdo rje 'dzin gyur dpal 'byor rgya mtshos gsol ba btab pa'i ngor rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus lo paṇa dam pa mang pos bste ba'i gnas yang dog nags mtsho lo tsā ba'i mchod rten ngogs su dkar pos lo snron zla'i dmar phyogs rgyal ba gnyis pa la smras pa sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ kun gyi rang bzhin spros bral chos kyi dbyings/ /ye shes lnga ldan dam pa dang po'i mgon/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i phun tshogs kun 'byung bzhi/ /khyab bdag rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /rang ngo chos nyid gzhan ngo thugs rje'i dpal/ /rab 'byams dkyil 'khor spro zhing bsdud pa 635

po/ /mkha' 'gro drwa ba sdom mdzad he ru ka /yang dag rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /gdul bya'i snang ngor grub pa'i brtul zhugs kyi/ /'phags yul rgyan gyur dpal ldan kasna pa/ /bod yul 'di na thugs kyi grub brnyes gtso/ /nam snying rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /gang gi sprul pa chu snod zla gzugs bzhin/ /rin chen rdo rje bsgom tshul nam mkha' 'od/ /kaḥthog byams 'bum chos lung byang chub 'bum/ /sprul gyur rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir gzhan phan 'phrin las can/ /klong chen rab 'byams rje btsun kun dga' snying / /gang gi ring lugs 'chad spel snying stobs can/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /rang la bka' drin bzhi ldan bla ma ni/ /sangs rgyas kun las lhag zhes rgyal bas bsngags/ /des na drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /snying nas rtse gcig gus pas gsol 'debs kyi/ /bdag cag dus 'di nas bzung byang chen bar/ /tshe rabs tshe brgyud kun tu dal 'byor brten/ /phun tshogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen mchog gi zin/ /bslab gsum rnam dag sa lam yon tan 'phel/ /'brel bcas 'gro kun mthar mchog la tri shog khyad par mtshan ldan rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /dbang bskur dam tshig rnam dag bskyed rdzogs drod/ /myur thob tshe gcig rdor 'chang sa bsnyes nas/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba 'dren pa'i byed por shog /ces mdo chen gyi rigs sngags 'chang ba'i gdung dri ma med pa las nye bar byon pa sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i rnal 'byor pa gsang bdag rgyal sras seṅge'i gsung gi bskul ba la rten rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus rab byung bcu gsum pa sa 'brug mgo zla'i dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum pa la gung thang ra la za 'og phug nas smras pa sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ rgyal kun mkha' khyab ye shes gdod ma'i gshes/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal zung 'jug rdo rje sems/ /gdul bya'i snang ngor rdo rje slob dpon gzugs/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /'phags yul grub pa'i slob dpon spyod pa ba'i/ /smon lam mthus grub bod grub nam mkha' snying / /gang gi rjes chags cha shas byin rlabs pa/ /'phrin las 'gro kun 'dul der gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag ni tshe rabs tshe brgyud thams cad du/ /yang dag bla mas rjes bzung dam tshig brtan/ /smin grol drod thob sa lam yon tan rdzogs/ /rdo rje 'chang 'bras ring min myur 'grub shog /ces mdo khams yul klung gi btsun pa mtsho byed kun bzang blo gros kyi gsol ba btab pa'i ngor rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus jo mo kha reg gi 'dabs su smras pa sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ khyab brdal rang byung sangs rgyas kun tu bzang / /lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs sku rdo rje 'chang / /sprul pa'i sku mchog rgyal ba shākya tog /sku gsum ngo bo kun 'dus pad+ma 'byung / /sku bzhi bdag nyid 'dren mchog dang ma'i mgon/ /drin chen rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /skad cig ma 'dir bdag gi lus ngag yid/ /dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po'i/ /sku gsung thugs dang dbyer 636

med gcig tu mnyam/ /mthos thos dran reg mtha' yas 'gro ba kun/ /de lta'i go 'phang mchog la yang dag par/ /'god pa'i byed por bdag gi myur thob shog /ces bod chen ljongs kyi shākya dge slong dad pa can bla ma rin chen don yod kyi gsol ba btab pa'i ngor dpal rig pa 'dzin pas smras pa dge'o/ /oṃ swāsti/ na mo gu ru/ 'gyur med spros bral rang byung chos kyi dbyings/ /bla ma sangs rgyas chos skur gsol ba 'debs/ /bde chen lhun grub nges pa lnga yi bdag /bla ma sangs rgyas longs skur gsol ba 'debs/ /gang 'dul der ston phan bde kun gyi dpyid/ /bla ma sangs rgyas sprul skur gsol ba 'debs/ /zab gsal bde chen dbyer med kun tu bzang / /bla ma ngo bo nyid skur gsol ba 'debs/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog rtsa gsum yongs 'dus dpal/ /brtan g.yo kun gyi mgon bcud dwangs ma'i mgon/ khyab bdag 'dren mchog rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /snying nas rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /bdag gzhan 'gro ba'i rgyud la ye bzhugs pa'i/ /gdod ma'i sangs rgyas bde gshegs snying po'i khams/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal bri gang bral ba'i dbyings/ /rang byung glo bur dri ma kun spangs shog /ma 'khrul sangs rgyas mngon du byed pa'i lam/ /ston mdzad rtsa brgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs/ /rnam rtog rang bzhin dran pa g.yengs med nas/ /bde gsal mi rtog zhi gnas mngon byed shog /gnas 'gyur dbyer med dran pa'i rang ngo brtan/ /rtse gcig gnas pa'i bsam gtan rtsal rdzogs shing / /rtog med dran pa 'gyu ba rang sar grol/ /spros bral mi g.yo shes rab mngon gyur shog /yul dang yul can gnyis med rang mdang gshis/ /mnyam nyid ro gcig rtogs pa rtsal rdzogs nas/ /dran pa rang nub rig pa mngon du 'gyur/ /lhun grub bsgom med rgyal thabs dbang bsgyur shog /rang don lhun grub dri med chos sku bsnyes/ /gzhan don gzugs sku nyid kyi 'phrin las kyi/ /mtha' yas 'gro kun kun gzigs rgyal ba yi/ /go 'phang mchog la myur du 'god par shog /ces bod chen nyi 'og gi ljongs su bltams pa/ thos bsam bsgoms pa'i nor gyi phyug pa'i lo tsā ba chen pos lo ri sprul pa'i sku dge slong rdo rje 'dzin mi pham bstan 'dzin srid zhi yongs grol zhes bya bas gsung gi skul ba'i ngor dpal rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus skad gcig mar yul gung thang gi cha ra la za 'og phug tu smras pa'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ rgyal ba'i sras gyur rgyal ba'i sgyu 'phrul gar/ /'phags mchog rnams kyi mdzad pa blo yi yul/ /yongs 'das bsam gyi mi khyab nyid lags pas/ /dwangs ba'i sems kyi de la gus phyag 'tshal/ /gsang gsum bdag po dpa' bo thugs rdo rje/ /gang gi 'od zer r+ghaṃ kar nam mkha' snying / /zur chung shes grags bsgom pa tshul khrims snying / /mtshungs med bla mar snying nas gsol ba 'debs/ /lha ri nam 'od zhig po bdud rtsi'i zhabs/ /ma ṇi rin chen ri khrod dar rgyas pa/ /rtsod bral gter ston byang chub gling pa ste/ /skyes mchog bla mar snying nas gsol ba 'debs/ /tshul khrims 'bum dang kun mkhyen sangs 637

rgyas phel/ /kun dga' legs dang kun dag 'a bstan 'dzin pa/ /rig 'dzin grub gtso pad+ma ma ṇi'i zhabs/ /'gro 'dul bla mar snying nas gsol ba 'debs/ /gang gi skye bar mtshan gyis byin rlabs pa/ /phyogs med kun rgyu'i rnal 'byor rig pa 'dzin/ /zab chos sgo brgya byed mkhas blo mthu can/ /tshe dbang nor bur grags la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar rtsa ba'i bla ma skye ba'i 'phreng / /kun la gus pas rtse gcig gsol btab mthus/ /tshe rabs rtag tu pad 'byung nam snying gis/ /rjes gzung rdor sems go 'phangs myur thob shog /ces bod chol kha gsum gyi mnga' bdag bla chen sa skya bdag nyid chen po rnam rje 'dzin pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bkra shis zhabs gang gi spyan sngar phar tshad kyi gzhung lugs smra ba blo gros kyi lang tsho mchog tu rgyas gyur rab 'byams pa kun dga' mtsho bzhes pas gsol ba btab pa'i ngor rgyal khams phyogs med rig med kyi rnal 'byor pa tshe dbang nor bus shing stag sbo zla'i dmar phyogs kyi gral tshes rgyal ba gsum pa la ru lags 'bras spung su smras pa'i yig rig dam pa'i gdung gyur bkra shis rab brtan no/ /sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ tshe rabs kun tu bla ma ho ru ka /du mas rjes gzung rnal 'byor grub pa'i dbang / /ma nor mang dag lam ston rdo rje 'dzin/ /skyes bu mchog khyed bskal brgyar zhabs brtan gsol/ /skyabs gnas bslu med dkon mchog rnam pa gsum/ /kun 'dus spyi dpal rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /khyed la kha tsam ma yin snying khang nas/ /phur tshug dad pa'i shugs kyis gsol 'debs mthus/ /bdag sogs tshe ring nad med dpal 'byor rgyas/ /snyan grags mnga' thang 'phel brtan thun mong gi/ /'dod don bkra shis lhun grub khyad par mchog /rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang myur 'grub shog /ces dad gus shes rab kyi nor ldan mi rje 'tsho mdzad tsha rong tshe brtan bkra shis dang / grub chen rin chen 'gyur med kun bzang rang grol/ rig gnas pa kun dga' dpal 'byor gyi bskul ngor gu ru pad+ma'i rig sngags 'chang ba tshe dbang nor bus thun mong gro zhun zla ba'i dmar phyogs tshes bcur gang dran smras pa dge'o/ /rgyal kun ye shes 'dus dngos pad+ma 'byung / /mi 'gyur bde chen rang gzugs mtsho rgyal ma/ /'od gsal 'pho chen bsnyes pa'i bi ma la/ /snying thig brten pa'i gsal byed klong chen zhabs/ /zung 'jug mchog brnyes bdud 'dul rdo rje rtsal/ /kun gyi ngo bo pad+ma bde chen gling / /rgyal tshab mchog gyur 'gro 'dul rig pa 'dzin/ /tshe dbang nor bu dpal la gsol ba 'debs/ /skyabs mchog khyed la gus pas gsol btab mthus/ /bdag sogs tshe rabs rtag tu khyod rjes gzung / /mngon mtho nges legs thar lam yon tan rdzogs/ /'phags chen sa brnyes rdor sems myur 'grub shog /ces kre pa stod kyi rje dpon dad 'byor du mas brgyan pa a jo gro nam zhal ngo rnams kyi bskul ngor tshe dbang nor bus spra bdun gtsug lag khang 'dabs su lcags khyi gror zhun zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad la smras pa sarba maṅga lo/rab 'byams rgyal ba'i 'phrin las gcig bsdus pa/ /pad+ma thod 'phreng thugs dang dbyer med 638

pa/ /grub mchog gnub chen nam mkha'i snying po yi/ /sprul pa'i 'dos gar snyigs dus 'gro ba'i don/ /snang ba rig pa 'dzin grags mdo khams pa/ /tshe dbang nor bu zhes la gsol ba 'debs/ /'di phyir bar do dus kun mgon khyod kyis/ /rjes bzung byang chen sar 'dren byin gyi rlobs/ /ces gtsang la stod cung ri bo che yi phyag mdzod o rgyan lhun grub kyi gsol ba btab ngor lha gdong du smras/oṃ swāste/ rnga yab rgyal po pad+ma thod 'phreng gi/ /skye ba kun tu rjes bzung rig pa 'dzin/ /lkog 'gyur gzhan med 'gro la lhag bsam can/ /rang don bsgrub mkhas khyod zhabs rtag brtan shog /tshe dbang nor bu gdod ma'i rnal 'byor pa/ /bla ma'i thugs sras mkha' 'gro'i mdza' 'o khyed/ /bskal bzang gdul bya'i don du bstan bzhugs nas/ /bdag kyang khyod dang go 'phang mnyam sbyor shog /a ho/ /rgyal ba yongs kyi thugs phrin ma lus kun/ /rab rdzogs kun bzang pad 'byung yab yum gyis/ /rjes bzung bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu mchog /gsang bdag rnal 'byor tshe dbang nor bu khyed/ /nges pa'i don du mnyam gnyis ye shes khams/ /bde gshegs snying po til mar bzhin du/ /snang las rgyal ba'i thugs rjes rmad byung bdag /rdor sems pad 'byung r+ghaṃ dkar nam snying gis/ /byin rlabs rol gar byang chub sar gnas shing / /gdul bya drang don ma nges du ma'i gzugs/ /gang 'dul chu zla'i rol rtsed bsgyur mkhas pa/ /deng dus rig 'dzin las kyi rdo rje zhes/ /lus ni legs nyes ma nges smyon spyod sku/ /ngag ni sna tshogs ma nges chal chol gsung / /yid ni grol 'khrul ma nges ban bun thugs/ /yang yang 'gro 'dul thar lam shes bsnyen che/ /de la kha zhe med par gsol 'debs kyis/ /mgon khyed snyigs dus 'dul dka'i 'gro ba rnams/ /'dul zhing bde sbyor rdor gsang 'od gsal gyi/ /rten 'brel bskal bzang smin grol ched du/ /sku yi ngo bo tshe yi rang bzhin la/ /'gal rkyen gang gi ma tshug rab tu gnas/ /thugs kyi 'pho 'gyur med par khams drug sbub/ /yun ring mtsho bzhes rab tu brtan gyur gcig /de ltar zhabs pad brtan par gsol 'debs 'di/ /dkon mchog rtsa gsum bden pas yongs 'grub cing / /bdag ni byang chub che bar khyod nyid dang / /'brel med smin grol rdo rje 'chang thob shog /de skad gnas mchog zab phur bzhugs pa'i sdom brtson bla ma o rgyan tshul khrims/ rje drung ye shes rnams rgyal/dkon gnyer rigs 'dzin dbang po dang / zla ba 'jam dbyangs rnams kyis yang yang bskul ngor/ mdo khams pa lha btsun tshe dbang nor bus zab phu lung du me rta khrum zla'i tshes gnyis la gang shar du smras pa'i yig rig sprul pa'i sku 'phrin las bstan 'dzin bzang pos bgyis pa dge'o/ /oṃ ā:r+ghaṃ dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyal ba kun gyi yab/ /kun bzang rdo rje sems mchog pad+ma 'byung / /thugs kyi ye shes gcig bsdus rang gzugs mdangs/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /sgyu 'phrul zhi khro rab 'byams rgyud sde'i lha/ /he ru ka dpal kun gyi phyag rgya che/ /thugs phrin 639

bdag nyid rdo rje can gyi 'phrul/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /stong nyid mkha' la snying rje'i sprin 'phro ba/ /gsang chen bdag mo kun gyi byang chub che/ /bla med mdzod 'dzin dpa' bo che ba'i mchog /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba kun gyi rjes chags thugs rje yi/ /sa gar khyod nyid snang nas gdul bya yi/ /don mdzad mtshungs med rdo rje 'dzin dbang rje/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang khyed zhing 'dir bdag sogs gdul bya'i don/ /skyo dub med par zhabs pad rtag brtan cing / /mdzad phrin mnyam med chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur/ /kun kyang smin grol rdo rje 'chang thob shog /ces rig sngags 'chang ba badz+ra ra ḍa pa yi byin gyis bslabs pa zhing / tshang pa'i me tog gi kha lo skye ba'i tha ma sprul pa'i sku rig 'dzin yon tan rgya mtsho 'am mtshan gzhan du pad+ma stobs ldan dpa' bo dbang shug 'chang rdo rje snying po rtsal gyi nan tan du gsol 'debs zhig dgos zhes gsung ngor rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus phur bu zhes pa sprel zla ba dang po la za 'og phug tu smras pa'i yig rig 'gyur med phun tshogs dge legs kyi bgyis pa'o/ /dad pa'i chu stod las skyes bla ma'i gsol 'debs pad+ma'i phreng ba bskal bzang rkang drug dga' ba'i bcud 'dzin bzhugs so/ /a ho/ chos nyid ka dag khyab brdal chen po'i klong / /'khor 'das lhun grub 'od gsal rol pa che/ /rig pa stong gsal bde gshegs snying po'i khams/ /kun bzang gdod ma'i sras der gsol ba 'debs/ /dag dang ma dag khams kun chos nyid shis/ /'du bral med pas sbyangs smin cho 'phrul mchog /ston nas ma tog 'gro kun yang dag lam/ /sbyor mdzad sprul pa'i sku der gsol ba 'debs/ /sgyu ma'i ngang du chos nyid rol pa'i rtsal/ /dpag par dka' ba ye shes chen po'i 'phrul/ /grangs med dus zhes sna tshogs ma ma mas/ /gnyug ma'i snying po rtogs der gsol ba 'debs/ /med bzhin yod snang sems zhes phra ba 'di/ /kun bzang thod 'phreng can gyi yang nas yang / /thugs rjes lcags kyus drangs nas lhan skyes mchog /snyegs gyur dpa' bo dam par gsol ba 'debs/ /ci ltar snang yangs ngo bo skye med shar/ /ma nges gang 'dul snang ba cir yang ston/ /bya bral ngang la bya ba gdod dgur bsgyur/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug mchog der gsol ba 'debs/ /snyigs dus gdul bya rang gzugs kyi 'dul phyir/ /gu ru'i rjes 'jug gsang sngags don la spyod/ /ral pa'i gdeng can gang shar spyod pa skyong / /rig pa 'dzin mchog de la gsol ba 'debs/ /khyed la snying nas nga ros gsol btab na/ /bdag brgyud byin rlobs rgyal kun ye shes mthu/ /gcig 'dus bla med don gyi snying po de/ /de ring nyid nas rtogs par mdzad du gsol/ /ces pa 'di rang la yon tan ga nas ltas kyang med gshis rang gi rang ma gsol 'debs bri ba shin tu mi 'os kyang bskul ba po yul gnyen bshes mtshon tsam bde gshegs snying po'i 'gro la khyab don bzhin bgyis pa 'di ni rang gi snying gi bu pad+ma gung tsan thugs kyi 'dod gar dpa' ba rdo rje shug chang gter dang / bdud btsom byin 640

rlabs brtsod bral gter ston gar dbang snying po'i sprul sku dang / cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi sprul pa karma gar dbang don 'grub dang / yan lung 'khrul zhig chen po chos kyi nyi ma dang / sbas pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug bkra shis rgya mtsho sogs kyi yang yang bskul ngor mdo khams kaḥthog lho phyogs pa lha yi btsun pa tshe dbang nor bus mnga' ris gung thang glo bo bod kyi mtshams bas mtha' bra lar sbo zla'i dmar phyogs kyi tshes bcu gnyis la bris pa maṅga lo/ dad pa byas na khyi sor ring srel dper 'dren no/ /dge'o/ /oṃ swāste/ kun khyab rgyal ba'i spyi me kun tu bzang / /'khor 'das kun la khyab pa'i bde gshegs snying / /rang rig dri bral chos dbyings rdo rje sems/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i ngo bor gsol ba 'debs/ /srid dang zhi ba'i phun tshogs ma lus kyi/ /'byung nas sems nyid chos sku rin po che/ /rang ngo shes bzhin yin lugs gdod ma'i gshis/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i ngo bor gsol ba 'debs/ /gdod nas chos sku'i ngo bor rtag gnas kyang / /rang byung glo bur dri ma gsal phyir du/ /ma yengs rig pa lam byed bsgoms kyi mchog /dpal ldan bla ma'i ngo bor gsol ba 'debs/ /tshogs drug spyod lam bde sdug btang snyoms kun/ /rang rig rang mdangs rgya mtsho'i rba lam bzhin/ /rang bab rang grol ngang du rtags spyod pa/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i ngo bor gsol ba 'debs/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas sku gsum yongs kyi dpal/ /che ba'i yon tan kun kyang rang rig pa/ /dri med mngon du gyur las gzhan yod min/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i ngo bor gsol ba 'debs/ /chos kun rang rig de nyid ji bzhin pa/ /ngo sprod byed po dpal ldan bla ma ni/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus sangs rgyas kun las lhag /de la snying nas gsol 'debs phur tshugs mthus/ /bdag gzhan gnyis 'dzin rtogs pa'i dri ma kun/ /bdag med stong pa'i mkha' la 'ja' ltar yal/ /dam pa sku gnyis phun tshogs yon tan kun/ /'bad med lhun gyi 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /byang chub mchog gi go 'phang ma thob bar/ /skye kun rdo rje 'chang gi mchog dang mjal/ /dam tshig rnam dag sher rtson mchog ldan pas/ /rang gzhan don gnyis rgya mtshor spyod par shog /ces rnam spyod lang tsho dang ldan pa zhal ngo kun shar gyi lcam sring chos mdzad ma bsod nams chos dar dang kun dga' zung gi bskul ba'i ngor gangs can bod yul kun tu rgyu ba'i mi rig pa 'dzin par brjod pa tshe dbang nor bus jo mo gangs dkar la'i ngogs su brjod de bskur ba sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes mkha' khyab ni/ /chos dbyings spros bral bde ba chen po'i khams/ /de ni dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma'i thugs/ /bla ma chos kyi sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /ye shes rang snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar/ /sku dang zhing khams 'brel med 'od gsal dbyangs/ /de ni dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma'i gsung / /bla ma longs spyod rdzogs skur gsol ba 'debs/ /spros pa med dang tshad med thugs rje'i mthus/ /gang 'dul rnam pa thams cad rol pa'i sku/ /de yang dpal ldan bla ma'i sku yin te// 641

bla ma sprul pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /'khor 'das bstan g.yo ma lus thams cad kyang / /dpal ldan bla ma'i cho 'phrul rol pa ste/ /kun kyang phan bde thar ba'i lam mchog ston/ /'dzad med rgyan gyi 'khor lor gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar gsang sngags don ston rdo rje 'dzin/ /dpal ldan bla mar shes bzhin dad pa yi/ /rtse gcig gus pas gsol ba 'debs pa'i mthus/ /sku gsum 'bras bu myur du 'grub byin rlobs/ /gang zhig zung 'jug mchog sku ma thob bar/ /tshe rabs kun tu mtho ris rten bzang thob/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos bla mas rjes su bzung / /bla med dkyil 'khor mchog gi dbang bskur thob/ /dam tshig rnam dag rim gnyis drod gdengs brnyes/ /phyir ma'i ldog pa'i go 'phang myur thob nas/ /'brel bcas 'gro ba kun kyang de ji bzhin/ /'od dpag med mgon sa la 'khod par shog /ces snye mo mdo mkhar rje bo'i btsun ma karma chos bzang dbang mos gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ rgyal khams pa rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus me stag chu stod zla ba'i tshes bzang por jo mo gang dkar ma'i ngogs su spel ba sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ gdod nas grub pa'i sems rgyud byin rlabs mthus/ /tshe 'dir mthos bsam bsgom pa'i yon tan rgyas/ /dbang gi rgyal po pad+ma ka ra yis/ /rjes su bzung mthus gzhan dring mi 'jog par//rang stobs gnyis kyis don gnyis lhun grub skyongs/ /ma nor lta ba'i gnas lugs tshul bzhin rtogs/ /tam bu ra ltar 'chad brtsam sgo brgya bsnyen/ /mkhyen brtse nus ldan bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /khyed la kha zhe med par gsol btab na/ /pad+ma ka ra'i bden tshig bslu med pas/ /bdag cag gdul bya smin grol la sbyor nas/ /ring min rdo rje sems thob gdon mi za/ /ces gser bzang grub mchog dam pa'i gdung 'dzin pad+ma 'gyur med nor bus gsung gi bskul ngor/ rang spangs rtog yon tan cha phra rung / rgyal ba pad+ma'i gsung gi byin gyi rlabs pa kho nar sems nas byi ba glang chen dper brjod rang bstod tshig bcad gsum po 'di yang shing rta nag zla'i tshes bzang lnga la spel ba dge'o/ /maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ kun khyab bde chen ye shes bzang po'i gar/ dbang phyug brgyad ldan rdo rje 'chang chen po'i/ /sgyu 'phrul dkyil 'khor yongs gtso bla ma'i sku/ /gang der gsol 'debs bskal brgyar zhabs bstan shog /pad+ma ka ras tshe rabs du ma ru/ /rjes bzung 'jig rten dbang phyug jo nang pa'i/ /lta grub ma nor skyong mkhas rig pa 'dzin/ /khyod la cam bu ma yin gsol btab na/ /bdag ni skye kun khyod kyi rjes bzung zhing / /smin grol rdor sems 'bras bu myur thob par/ /byin gyis rlobs mdzod bdag sogs 'gro don du/ /mgon khyod zhabs pad rdo rje ltar brtan shog /ces chos grwa chen po gtsang g.yas ru gser mdog can gyi dge slong blo bzang rin chen pas bskul ngor rgyal khams tshe dbang nor bus ri khrod chen po jo nang du sa ga zla ba'i tshes drug la bris pa sarba maṅga lo/ 642

༄gi /rdzogs chen thun mong spyi'i sngon 'gro'i ngag 'don rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ swāste/ rdzogs chen thun mong spyi'i sngon 'gro ngag 'don rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba/ dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma sangs rgyas la/ /snying nas thal sbyar skyabs 'chi gsol ba 'debs/ /snying thig lam zhugs rnal 'byor gyi/ /sngon 'gro ngag 'don snying po 'dir bshad bya/ /thun gyi dang po tho rengs kyi skabs su dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi ḍa ma ru dang dril bu'i sgras/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad ma rig gnyis las sad par bsam la/ gnyid slangs kyi tshig 'di ltar brjod par bya ste/ kye ma kye hud skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /ma rig gti mug dbang gi ma non par/ /brtson 'grus ngar skyed da ltar yar long dang / /thog med dus nas da lta thug gi bar/ /ma rig ngang du nyal yun des mchog gis/ /da ni ma nyal sgo gsum dge la 'bung / /skye rgas na 'chi sdug bsngal mi shes sam/ /de ring tsam yang rtag pa'i go skabs med/ /sgrub la brtson 'grus bskyed pa'i dus ma bab/ /da res gcig pu gtan bde sgrub dus 'dir/ /skom las ngang la bsdod pa'i dus ma yin/ /'chi ba sems la bsgrub pa tha ru skyol/ /tshe la long med 'chi rkyen bsam mi khyab/ /de tshe mi tsher gdeng gcig ma thob na/ /skyes bu khyod nyid gson pas ci zhig rung / /chos rnams stong zhing bdag med spros dang bral/ /sgyu ma smig sgyu rmi lam gzugs brnyan dang / /dri za'i grong khyer brag cha lta bur spyod/ /chu zla chu lhar mig yor sprul pa sogs/ /shes byed sgyu ma'i dpe bcu de bzhin du/ /'khor 'das chos rnams khyod kyi shes par gyi/ /chos rnams rang bzhin skye ba med pa de/ /gnas med 'gag med 'gro 'ong med pa'o/ /dmigs med mtshan ma med cing bsam brjod bral/ /don 'di rtogs par byed pa'i dus la bab/ /de nas dad pa nges 'byung lhag bsam ched du bskul phyir 'di ltar tshig rje don la sems te/ kye ma kye ma mi rtag 'khor ba'i chos/ /thar med las kyi rgya mtsho dong ring du/ /las kyi mnar ba'i 'gro rnams snying re rje/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i skems par byin gyis rlobs/ /ma rig las kyi mnar ba'i 'gro ba rnams/ /bde ba 'dod phyir sdug bsngal las la spyod/ /mtha' ma'i mkhas pa'i 'gro rnams snying re rje/ /nyon mongs las sgrib dag par byin gyis rlobs/ /nga bdag bzung 'dzin bcing ba'i brtson ra 'dir/ /ri dwags rgyar chud slar yang 'jug pa ltar/ /ma rig gti mug can rnams snying re rje/ /'khor ba dong 643

nas sprug par byin gyis rlobs/ /thar med las kyi grong khyer drug po 'dir/ /gcig nas gcig tu zo chud khyud mo bzhin/ /thar med las kyi 'gro rnams snying re rje/ /rigs drug skye sgo chod par byin gyis rlobs/ /skye rgas na dang 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal rnams/ /ji tsam mthong yang mi 'jigs snying bsran can/ /yengs ma lam la dal 'byor mi tshe zad/ /mi rtag 'chi ba dran par byin gyis rlobs/ /mi rtag blo gtad med par ma shes pas/ /da rung 'khor ba 'di la zhen cing chags/ /skyid 'dod ngang la mi tshe sdug gis gda'/ /'khor ba'i zhen pa zlog par byin gyis rlobs/ /snod kyi 'jig rten mi rtag me chus 'jig /bcud kyi sems can mi rtag lus sems bral/ /dbyar dgun ston dpyid nam zla'i dus mi rtag /skyo shas gting nas skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /na ning da lo nam zla'i stod smad dang / /zhag dang nyin mtshan skad cig dus mi rtag /legs par bsam na rang nyid 'chi bas btug /sgrub la snying rus nus par byin gyis rlobs/ /dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu rnyed dka' yang / /'chi bdag nad kyis nye bar btab pa'i tshe//chos med 'gro rnams stong log snying re rje/ /long med rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /kye ma kye hud dkon mchog thugs rje can/ /rgyal ba khyed la brtse ba'i thugs mnga' bas/ /bdag sogs rigs drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las/ /da lta nyid du thar bar byin gyis rlobs/ /gong dang 'di nyid gu ru'i chos spyod chen mo las gsungs pa'o/ /de nas skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ skyabs yul gsal la thal mo spyi bor sbyar/na mo budhā ya sha ra ṇa gats+tsha mi/ na mo dharma ya sha ra ṇa gats+tsha mi/ na maḥsarta ya sha ra ṇa gats+tsha mi/ na mo gu ru bh+ya: na mo de wa bh+ya: na mo ḍāk+ki bh+ya: na mo oṃ ā:r+ghaṃ bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum la skyabs su mchi'o/ /chos sku longs sku sprul sku gsum la skyabs su mchi'o/ /lta ba sgom pa spyod pa gsum la skyabs su mchi'o/ /gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu gsum la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rtsa dang rlung dang thig le gsum la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bde dang gsal dang mi rtog gsum la skyabs su mchi'o/ /ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bla ma sangs rgyas chos kyi sku la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bla ma thugs rje sprul pa'i sku la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bla ma ngo bo nyid kyi sku la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bla ma mi 'gyur rdo rje sku la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bla ma mngon par byang chub sku la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' drin can la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rgyud pa'i bla ma byin rlabs can la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'dren pa'i bla ma thugs rje can la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam tshig dbang gi bla ma rnams la skyabs su 'chi'o/ /shes rab rgyud kyi bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /man ngag lung gi bla rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /nyams chags 644

rkang ba'i bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /na mo/ rgyal ba dgongs rgyud bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi'o//rig 'dzin brda' rgyud bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'dre'o/ /gang zag snyan rgyud bla ma rnams la ྾ mkha' 'gro gtad rgyud bla ma rnams la ྾ smon lam gter rgyud bla ma rnams la ྾ bka' bab lung bstan rgyud pa rnams la ྾ shog ser tshig rgyud bla ma rnams la ྾ dam rdzas myong grol rgyud pa rnams la ྾ thugs rjes byin rlobs rgyud pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /na mo/ snod kyi 'jig rten dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la ྾ bcud kyi sems can lha dang lha mo'i tshogs la ྾ snang srid dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la ྾ na mo/ lus la sku yi byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ /ngag la gsung gi byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ /yid la thugs kyi byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ /dbang bzhi skur bar byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ /sgrib bzhi dag par byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ /lam bzhi sbyong bar byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ /sku bzhi thob par byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ /rtogs pas bdag grol bar byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ /thugs rjes gzhan grol bar byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ /rten 'brel thabs la mkhas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan par byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ /bdag blo chos su 'gro bar byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ /dam chos lam du long bar byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ /lam gyi 'khrul pa zhig par byin gyis rlobs tu gsol/ /'khrul snang ye shes su 'char bar byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ /chos min rnam rtog 'gags par byin gyis rlobs tu gsol/ /nyin mtshan chos la 'da' bar byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ /zhes dang / nam mkha'i gnas su nam mkha' gang ba yi/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang / /sangs rgyas chos dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la/ /bdag dang 'gro kun gus pas skyabs su 'chi/ /zhes ci nus sam tshar gsum du bklags/de nas sems bskyed pa na/ na mo/ dkon mchog gsum po dgongs su gsol/ /'di bzung byang chub ma thob bar/ /ma sgral bsgral dang ma grol dgrol/ /dbugs dbyung mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur gcig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'brel bar gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang nyid dang bral ba'i blo btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig /zhes pa dang / bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams/ /ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa la/ /yin par shes pa'i bdag nyid du/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /zhes ci nus sam lan gsum/ de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas ni/ rang gi spyi bor pam las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i steng du/ r+ghaṃ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa de yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka sku mdog dkar po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje 645

dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dkar mo/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang dar dang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyi brgyan pa/ snang la rang bzhin med pa'i thugs dkar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du r+ghaṃ yig gi mtha' skor du/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa mā ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra ho ru ka twe no pa/ tiṣ+ṭha ḍi dho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sidhe m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+ta shrī ya ku ru r+ghaṃ/ ha ha ha ha ho/ bha ga wan/ badz+ra he ru ka ma me munargyu/ he ru ko bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya sa twa aḥju phaṭa: ces pas bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa byon nas gnyis su med par thim/ yi ge brgya pa brgya stong gang 'grub bzlas pas rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dkar dmar nar gyi byung nas rang gi spyi bor babs pas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad nag 'dur 'dur 'og sgo dang rkang pa'i sen mtshams ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir bud/ lus kyi nang thams cad bdud rtsi dkar dmar gyis gang / lus shel gong dri ma med pa ltar dag par bsam la/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon po'i skyobs mdzod gcig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rjes chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi//sku gsung thugs dang rtsa ba yan lag gi dam tshigs nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig pa dang sgrib pa nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig oṃ ā:hūṃ/ zhes brjod pas rdo rje sems dpa' rang la thim par bsgoms pa'i ngang du mi rtog par bzhag cing mthar bsngo ba dang smon lam bya'o/ /de nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni/ slob dpon chen po bye ma la mu tri gsang ba snying thig las byung ba'i sku gsum zhing gi maṇ+ḍal ni/ oṃ ā:r+ghaṃ/ rin chen maṇ+ḍal yid 'ong mchod pa'i sprin/ /rgyal ba'i 'byor tshogs dpag med dang ldan pa/ /dpag yas nam mkha'i rgyan gyur gang 'di phul bas/ /rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing la spyod par shog /oṃ ā:r+ghaṃ/ 'og min bde chen rin chen gzhal yas khang / /sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin gyi bla re can/ /nam mkha' gang bar dmigs te phul ba yis/ lhun grub longs sku'i zhing la spyod par shog /oṃ ā:hūṃ/ 'od gsal lhun grub ye shes rigs lnga'i zhing / /sku dang thigs les ye nas brgyan pa 'di/ /rang snang dag pas legs par phul ba yi/ /kun bzang chos sku'i zhing la spyod par shog /zhes dang / ma ha gu ru pad+ma ka ra yis phyi nang gsang ba'i maṇ+ḍal ni/ oṃ ā:r+ghaṃ/ phyi nang snod bcud stong gsum gzhal yas dbus/ /ri rab gling bzhi rdul snyed mchod sprin gtib/ /lha mi longs spyod dpag med ji snyed kun/ /bla ma dkon mchog sprul sku'i zhing du 'bul/ /thugs rjes brtse bar 646

dgongs te bzhes nas kyang / /bdag sogs 'gro kun sprul sku'i zhing spyod shog /oṃ ā:r+ghaṃ/ rang lus rtsa khams dag pa'i gzhal yas su/ /dbang po rnam lnga bkrags dang mdangs kyi brgyan/ /khams dang skye mched yongs su dag pa 'di/ /bla ma dkon mchog longs sku'i zhing du 'bul/ /thugs rjes brtse bar dgongs te bzhes nas kyang / bdag sogs 'gro kun longs sku'i zhing spyod shog /oṃ ā:hūṃ/ sems nyid chos sku dag pa'i gzhal yas su/ /spros med stong gsal 'dzin med ngang du gnas/ /gdod nas dag pa'i spros bral gnyug ma 'di/ /bla ma dkon mchog chos sku'i snying du 'bul/ /thugs rjes brtse bar dgongs te gzhes nas kyang / /bdag sogs 'gro kun chos sku'i zhing spyod shog /oṃ gu ru dhe wa dhā ki ni sarba budha bho dhe maṇ+ḍal puts+tshas mun+d+ra spa ra na sa ma ya āḥr+ghaṃ/ zhes pas phul smon lam ni/ mnyes byed maṇ+ḍal bzang po 'di phul bas/ /byang chub lam la bar chad mi 'byung zhing / /dus gsum bde gshegs dgongs pa rdzogs pa dang / /srid par mi 'khrul zhi bar mi gnas shing / /nam khams mnyam pa'i 'gro rnams sgrol bar shog/ces dngos su 'byor pa'i mchod pa dang yid kyi sprul pa'i mchod dang / blos blang ba'i mchod pa 'bul zhing / khyad par du'ang rang gi lus longs spyod kha rje dbang thang / tshe dang bsod nams gang yod blo yi ltos pa med par 'bul zhing 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab pas ji ltar 'dod pa'i don tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing sgrib gnyis sbyangs byas nas rang gzhan gnyis don 'bad med lhun 'grub tu 'byung ba'o/ /de nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang lus spyan ras gzigs bsam dpal rdo rje sems dpa' dang / he ru ka rdo rje rnal 'byor mar sgom pa'i spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du oṃ ā r+ghaṃ las ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam pa dang po'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dpal kun tu bzang po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gi bzhugs pa/ phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag mdzad pa'i pang du yum kun tu bzang mo sku mdog mthing ka rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa gnyis ka'ang dar dang rin po che'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ rgyud pa drug ldan gyi bla ma thams cad 'ja' dang 'od kyi rnam par byon nas bla ma la thim/ sangs rgyas kyi tshogs dpag tu med pa byung nas bla ma la thim/ dam pa'i chos kyi tshogs dpag tu med pa byung nas bla ma la thim/ dge 'dun gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa byung nas bla ma la thim/ yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams kyi tshogs dpag tu med pa byung nas bla ma la thim/ mkha' 'gro chos skyongs bsrung ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pa byung nas bla ma'i zhabs dang bzhugs khri la thim par bsgoms la/ gsol 'debs paṇ+ḍi'i ta'i dbang thob bye ma la mu dras mdzad pa'i bla sgrub nas 'byung ba ni/ oṃ ā:rdu/ ngan 'gro 'jigs las skyobs mdzad pa'i/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 647

su mchi/ /nges pa'i don la sems bskyed pa/ /'gro la phan phyir bla ma bsgoms/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas/ /skye med bla ma gshegs su gsol/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i pho brang nas/ /gsal dag bla ma gshegs su gsol/ /sprul pa'i sku yi pho brang nas/ /thugs rje can rnams gshegs su gsol/ /'ja' dang 'od du khyil li li/ /sku dang thigs le shig se shig /spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan stengs su/ /bdag dang gnyis med brtan par gzhugs/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal/ /phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul/ /sku gsung thugs kyi nyams chag bshag /smin grol dbang dang sdom pa zhu/ /o sku skye 'chi med pa gsal ba dang / /rdo rje'i sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /lus bde drod 'bar bar byin gyis rlobs/ /aḥgasung skye 'gags med pa sngags kyi sgra/ /a li ka li la gsol ba 'debs/ /ngag la nus pa 'bar bar byin gyis rlobs/ /r+ghaṃ thugs ka dag chen po kun bzang klong / /bīr mi dgongs la gsol ba 'debs/ chos rnams zad par phyin par byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po bkod pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che 'byung ba nas byung ba'i gsol 'debs ni/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa ni/ /khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnyen gcig bu/ /'gro ba mgon med rnams kyi skyabs/ /thar pa'i lam skas chen po te/ /ma rig sel ba'i sgron me la/ /mun pa'i tshogs bdag skyabs su mchi/ /'khor ba 'dams kyi tshogs dag tu/ /bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs/ /dug gsum nyi mas brlan bral ba'i/ /sdug bsngal skem la gnas pa la/ /thugs rje chu rgyun bdag la phob/ /rtsub 'gyur dmyal ba'i me chen 'bar/ /rang bzhin brlan gyis skems par mdzod/ /bla ma rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha/ /lha yi lha khyod phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bdag ni bskal pa thog med nas/ /lus kyi bcings ba'i sems can bdag /'byung ba snod dang bral gyur nas/ /'od gsal dri med lus ldan shog /smra mang ngag gi bcings pa dag /'khrul pa'i gtam rgyud zung zad nas/ /brjod du med pa'i don ldan shog /'gyu ba sems kyi rtog pas bcings// /ma rtogs gsal ba snang mthong nas/ /bsam 'das 'du 'phro chad par shog de ltar lus ngag sems rnams la/ /byin gyi rlabs pas sku gsum gyi/ /'bras bu tshad la phebs par shog /ces gsol ba nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du btab pas sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs brjod kyi mi long ba byung zhes rdo rje tshigs slob dpon chen po pad+ma sam bha wa/ bye ma la mu dra bal bo shi la mañdzu'i mdzad pa'i bla ma'i rim par drangs ltar ste de la nan du dbye ste/ yang ma ni bzhi bskor du grags pa yang / 'gro ba ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma rgyal ba'i dgongs pa'i rgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs so/ /'gro ba ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma rig 'dzin brda'i rgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /'gro ba ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad gang zag snyan khung rgyud pa la 648

gsol ba 'debs so/ /'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad 'dren mchog drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so/ /zhes pa yang skabs su ci nus bya ste sngon snying thig mkhan snying pa la shin tu grags pa'i deng sangs yongs grags ma nam bzhi 'di la bslan par snang ngo / /de mthar dam chos rdzogs pa chen po la gsol ba 'debs/ /rang snang zhi khro'i lha tshogs la gsol ba 'debs/ /bka' bsrung mkha' 'gro chos skyong la gsol ba 'debs/ /kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /sems can sdug bsngal zad par byin gyis rlobs cig /las ngan sdig sgrib dag par byin gyis rlobs cig /rkyen ngan bar chad zhi bar byin gyis rlobs cig /'chi ba rjes su dran par byin gyis rlobs cig /mi rtag rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs cig /'chi kha gnad gcod med par byin gyis rlobs cig /gong ma'i rnam thar 'khyongs bar byin gyis rlobs cig /pha rjes bu yis zin par byin gyis rlobs cig /sems nyid rang ngo shes par byin gyis rlobs cig /gnas lugs rten la phebs par byin gyis rlobs cig /bdag 'dzin 'khrul pa zhig par byin gyis rlobs cig /'od gsal nang nas 'char bar byin gyis rlobs cig /ye grol blo 'das rtogs par byin gyis rlobs cig /rang 'bab mngon du gyur par byin gyis rlobs cig /chos nyid mngon sum mthong bar byin gyis rlobs cig /nyams snang gong du 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs cig /rig pa tshad la phebs par byin gyis rlobs cig /chos nyid zad par khyol bar byin gyis rlobs cig myur du sangs rgyas thob par byin gyi rlobs cig /bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs cig /gdan thog 'di ru byin gyis rlobs gcig /gnas khang 'di ru byin gyis rlobs cig /'dug pa 'di ru byin gyis rlobs cig /myur ba nyid du byin gyis rlobs cig /da lta nyid du byin gyis rlobs cig /skad cig nyid la byin gyis rlobs cig /de nas bla ma kun bzang yab yum gnyis su med pa'i gnas gsum nas 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum bar mi chad du byung rang gi gnas gsum thim/ sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ mthar bla ma yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs mgrin pa yan chad khengs pa'i bum pa'i dbang thob/ snying kha yan chad khengs pas gsang dbang / lte ba yan chad khengs pas shes rab ye shes lte ba rgyud rkang thil sor rtse'i bar lus yongs su khengs pas dbang bzhi pa thob/ mthar bla ma 'od du zhu rang gi snying khar thim/ bla ma rang rig zab gsal bde ba chen po'i dang dbyer med rang ngo rjen pa mngon du gyur/ dbang bzhi'i 'bras bu brnyes par bsam la mnyam par bzhag rjes cir snang bla ma'i nga rgyal dang mi 'brel bar/ snang ba thams cad bla ma kun bzang yab yum gyi sku/ sgra grags sngags/ dran rtog thugs su mos te/ snang srid bla 649

ma'i rol par blta dge ba bsngo/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /bdag gi snying kha pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru la/ /'brel ba med par rgyun tu bzhugs nas kyang / /bka' drin chen pos byin gyis rlobs tu gsol/ /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang / /'brel med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod cing / /sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs te/ /rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog /skye zhing skye ba dag ni thams cad du/ /rigs bzang blo gsal nga rgyal med pa dang / /snying rje che zhing bla ma la gus pa'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i dam tshig la gnas shog /gzhan yang bsngo dang smon lam bzang po/ ci nus su rgyas btab bo/ /rdzogs chen gyi sngon 'gro chos spyod spyi la 'jug pa 'di yang bla ma gong ma'i gsung bzhir bzhag la go rim dang tshig zur dag par byas pa ste byin rlabs kyis rgyun dang ldan pa yin pas nan tan tu bya'o/ /de ltar rdzogs chen lam zhugs spyi yi chos/ /bla med 'di yang dam pa'i zhal lung bzhin/ /'jug sde'i phyir du 'dir bkod dge bas yang / /'gro kun dpal ldan bla ma myur 'grub shog /ces pa rdzogs chen thun mong spyi sngon 'gro ngag 'don rin po che'i phreng ba 'di yang sa skyong chos kyi rgyal po'i bla ma'i chos gnas snga 'gyur ring lugs 'dzin pa'i dbang phyug nyang rigs grub pa'i gdung gyur mnga' bdag 'gyur med gsang sngags bstan 'dzin drung gi gsung gi bskul bar brten rgyal khams pa rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus rab byung bcu gsum pa me yos chu stod zla ba'i dmar phyogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus chos 'khor dpal gyi lha sar 'bris pa'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/ 650

gag /yang gsang bla na med pa rdzogs pa chen po'i chos spyod ngag 'don yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /bdag gi spyi bor pad zla'i gdan gzhugs nas/ /bka' drin chen po'i sgo nas rjes bzung ste/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /skyabs 'gro ni/ nam mkha'i gnas su nam mkha' gang ba yis/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang / /sangs rgyas chos dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la/ /bdag dang 'gro drug gus pas skyabs su mchi/ /sems bskyed ni/ bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams/ /ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa la/ /yin par shes pa'i bdag nyid du/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /sku gsum gyi maṇ+ḍal ni/ rin chen maṇ+ḍal yid 'ong mchod pa'i sprin/ /'dod dgu'i 'byor tshogs dpag med dang ldan pa/ /dpag yas nam mkha'i rgyan gyur 'di phul bas/ /'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /'og min bde chen rin chen gzhal yas khang / /sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin gyi bla re can/ /nam mkha' gang bar dmigs te 'phul ba yi/ /'gro kun longs sku'i zhing la spyod par shog /'od gsal lhun 'grub ye shes rigs lnga'i zhing / /sku dang thig les ye nas brgyan pa 'di/ /rang snang dag pas legs par 'phul ba yis/ /kun bzang chos sku'i zhing la spyod par shog /ces maṇ+ḍal 'bul lo/ sdug bshags yig rgya ni/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa mā ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra sa twa twe no pa/ tiṣ+ṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/a nu rak+to me bha wa/ sarba sirnyi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+t+waṃ shrī ya ku ru rdu/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ sarba ta thā ga tā badz+ra mā me muñtsa/ badz+rī bha wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥ oṃ badz+ra sa twa r+ghaṃ/ mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yi/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon po'i skyobs mdzod cing / /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rjes chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad mthol zhing bshags so/ /sdig sgrib nyes rtsang dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor la gsol 'debs ni/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa ni/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnyen gcig po/ /'gro ba mgon med rnams kyi skyabs/ /thar pa'i lam skas chen po ste/ /mun pa'i tshogs bdag skyabs su mchi/ /'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs dag tu/ /bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs/ /dug gsum nyi mas 651

brlan bral ba'i/ /sdug bsngal skams la gnas pa la/ /thugs rjes chu rgyun bdag la phebs/ /rtsub 'gyur dmyal ba'i me chen 'bar/ /rang bzhin brlan gyi bskems par mdzod/ /bla ma rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha/ /lha yi lha khyod phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bdag ni bskal pa thog med nas/ /lus kyi bcing ba'i sems can dag /'byung ba'i snod dang bral gyur nas/ /'od gsal dri med lus ldan shog /smra ba ngag gi bcing ba dag /'khrul pa'i gtam rgyud zung zad nas/ /brjod du med pa'i don ldan shog /'gyu ba sems kyi rtog bcing / /mi rtog gsal ba snang mthong nas/ /bsam 'das 'du 'phro chad par shog /de ltar lus ngag sems rnams la/ /byin gyi rlabs pas sku gsum gyis/ /'bras bu tshad la phebs par shog /ces gsol ba nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du btab pas sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs brjod kyi mi langs 'byung zhes bkod pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che 'byung ba'i rgyud nas 'byung rdo rje'i tshig rdzogs chen gsang ba snying thig bla ma'i rim pa na gsung ba ltar ro/ /skabs 'dir spro na brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyang bya/ dbang len pa ni/ bla ma'i sku yis bdud rtsis yis/ bdag gi 'khor lo bzhi brgyud khengs/ /sgrib dag dbang bzhi'i rtsal chen rdzogs/ /sku bzhi'i 'bras bu mngon du gyur/ /de nas rjes bsngo smon ni/ dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag /bla ma sangs rgyas 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba cig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /skye zhing skye ba dag ni thams cad du/ /rigs bzang blo gsal nga rgyal med pa dang / /snying rje che zhing bla ma la gus pas/dpal ldan bla ma'i dam tshig la gnas shog /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang / /'brel med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod cing / /sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas/ /kun tu bzang po'i go 'phang myur thob shog /ces rdzogs chen gsang ba snying thig gi sngon 'gro rgyun gyi nyams len chos spyod snying por dril ba ste rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus sbyar ba'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/ byā 652

༄ga /bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i snying po yang gsang rdzogs pa chen po gser gyi yang zhun gyi thun mong sngon 'gro chos smyod ngag 'don gyi rim pa bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru dhe ba ḍa k+ki nī rtsu/ bka' gsang ba rmad du byung ba bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i yang snying rdzogs chen snying po gser gyi yang zhun ma yi sngon 'gro rdo rje theg pa spyi dang thun mong las snying thig gi lugs chos spyod ngag 'don gyi rim pa ni/ dang po phyi nang gsang gsum gyi skyabs su 'gro ba 'di skad do/ na mo 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi/ /rgyun chad med par 'gro la dgongs mdzad pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi/ /zhi ba chags bral don dam bden pa'i chos/ /theg pa gsum gyi phyir mi ldog pa'i lam/ /dam pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi/ /ma nor lam gnas tshogs mchog kun gyi zhing / /nyon mongs dri ma rab dben 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /dge 'dun rnams la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi/ /r+ghaṃ trī: dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /gsang ba bla med dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso/ /bla ma rnam la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi/ /chos sku skye med spros pa'i mtha' bral yang / /'gro ba'i don phyir zhi dang khro gar sprul/ /yi dam lha la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi/ /dag pa'i gnas mchog bde chen phyogs rtsol zhing / /dam tshig can la dngos grub gter mdzad ma/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi/ /legs nyes btang 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod cing / /bka' bzhin rjes su sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod la/ /dam can tshogs la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi/ /ā:ye nas stong nyid spros dang bral ba las/ /spros med 'od gsal 'dus ma byas pa'i sku/ /'dzin med blo 'das ngang du skyabs su mchi/ /ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje ka nas dag /mnyam rdzogs klong gsal chen po'i rang bzhin las/ /rtog med rang sems rjen par skyabs su mchi/ /lhun grub rang bzhin ye nas sku lnga'i bdag /ye shes lnga ldan 'od kyi rang bzhin las/ /'dzin med rang gsal ngang du skyabs su mchi/ /dbyings rig stong gsal thig le dkyil 'khor du/ /rang rig 'od gsal rdo rje lu gu rgyud/ /mngon gsum 'du bral med par skyabs su mchi/ /ma 'gag rang gsal kun khyab thugs rje can/ /cir yang sprul pa bde chen thugs rjes can/ shar sgrol mtha' bral chen por skyabs su mchi/ /thugs rje rang bzhin nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi/ /rtog med ngang du 'gro ba'i mun sel ba/ /dus gsum thog mtha' med par skyabs su mchi// 653

gnyis pa sems bskyed pa'i ngag 'don ni/ /na moḥ 'gro drug sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /de nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob bar/ /byang chub sems mchog dam pa bskyed par gyis/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa mchog nyid dang / /sdom pa yid bzhin lhag pa'i tshul khrims dang / /dge ba'i chos rnams ma lus bsdud pa dang / /'gro ba sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gi nam du yang ni mi spong ngo / /'gro ba sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag ni sdom pa brtan por bzung bar gyis/ /lus dang srog la ltos pa med par ni/ /khyed kyi rjes su 'jug cing bdag slob na/ /tshad med thugs rjes nye bar dgongs nas kyang / /kun nas thugs rjes byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /gsum pa sgrib sbyong gi ngag 'don ni/ rang nyid mtha' mal du gsal ba'i spyi bor/ pad zla'i gdan la rdo rje rtse lnga rgyu dkar po'i mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ bskul don gnyis byes 'dus pa las 'byung ba'i/ dpal rdo rje sems pa sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa rdo rje thugs kar gtod de 'dzin cing / g.yon dril bu sku la brtan pa cung zhig 'gying ba'i tshul can/ zhabs dkyil krung phyed bcas kyi g.yas pa'i the bo rang gi spyi bor reg pa/ zhal 'dzum pa/ spyan mdangs rab tu dgyes pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi cod paṇa rin po che'i rgyan du mas spras pa'i thugs kar/ zla ba rgyas pa'i steng du hūṃ yig dkar po'i mtha' skor du/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra sa twa twe no pa/ tiṣ+ṭha dṛ ḍho bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rasto me bha wa/ sarba sirnyi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+t+waṃ shrī yaḥ ku ru r+ghaṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ sarba ta thā ga tā trī da ya/ badz+ra mā me muñtsa/ badz+rī bha ba ma hā sa ma yā sa twa aḥrdu phaṭa/ces pa'i sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od 'phros te/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs la bstem/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ paju/ puṣ+pe/ dhu spru/ a lo ke/ ghadhe/ nai wi bya/ shaja puts+tsha ho: ru bla/ shalda/ ghadhe/ ra su/ spak+ṣe puts+tsha ho/ bho dhi tsi ta ho/ dharma dhar du ho/ sarba puts+tsha ho/ ho:ma skyes rdo rje thabs kyi rang bzhin ni/ /dmigs med shes rab yum gyi ngang du gsal/ /thabs dang shes rab che la mnga' skyes pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas mchod bstod cing dmigs pa ma zin bar gsal btab nas bzlas pa bgyis pa'i tshe/ rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs dkar bskor ba'i sngags kyi 'phreng ba thams cad g.yas su ka ra ra 'khor ba las/ 'od zer skar ma'i 'phreng ba ltar 'phros pas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi brgyud bskul sems can thams cad kyi las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa sbyangs zhing / slar yang 'od zer tshur 'dus rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs la phogs pas/ sku gsung thugs kyi brgyud bskul zhing / sku gsung thugs nas 'od zer gyi rgyun bab zhabs mthe bong nas ngang nar gyi byung bas/ rang gi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu gar zhugs te/ 'khor ba 654

thog med nas bsags pa'i las dang nyon mongs sdig sgrib dam tshig chag nyams 'gal 'khrul du gyur pa'i nyes byas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi brgyud la ci gnas pa thams cad sang sang dag cing mi gnas par/ lus shel gong dri ma med pa ltar ram/ 'od kyi rnam par gyur nas mthar bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' rang la thim pas dbyer med du gyur pa'i ngang du ji gnas su bzhag par bya'o/ /rgyun sring bar 'dod pas/ slar gong ltar yang yang gsal zhing / yi ge brgya pa dang / oṃ a hūṃ trī: badz+ra gu ru de wa ḍāk+ki ni sarba sidhe pha la r+ghaṃ: badz+ra dz+nyā na sa to ma ma kā pha wā ka tsit+ta sa ya/ a:a: badz+ra sa twa rgyu/ ces chu bo rgyun ltar bzlas par bya'o/ /bzhi pa maṇ+ḍal gyi ngag 'don ni rin chen sman 'bru'i maṇ+ḍal rims par dngos 'byor yid sprul gyis phul bzhin/ rgyu trī: lha dbang klu dbang gnod sbyin mi dbang 'byor pa'i dpal/ /sa 'og sa steng sa bla yang ni rgya mtsho'i gling / /gaṅga las byung sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul bla ma yi dam lha la phul/ /r+ghaṃ trī: rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa la sogs nad mdzoms shing / /gso bskyes rdzas mchog khyad par rmad byung ba'i/ /ro bcud dri ngad kun ldan maṇ+ḍal brgyan du bkram/ /bla ma dkon mchog yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul/ /hūṃ trī: rgyal ba'i thugs rjes 'gro ba'i dpal 'byor las byung ba'i/ /rnam pa mang po bcud kyi snying po 'bras bu'i tshogs/ /bkres skom gdung sel kha dog gzugs can du mar bcas/ /mchod pa'i zhing gyur rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bdag gzhan 'gro ba'i bsod nams ye shes dpal gyi zhing / /rgya cher rab spel 'dod 'byung yid bzhin rmad po che/ /rgyu rkyen las 'das rtsol med lhun gyis grub nas kyang / /smin grol mthar phyin bde 'bras bsten pa thob gyur cig /oṃ ā: r+ghaṃ trīḥ badz+ra gu ru de bā ḍāk+ki ni/ sarba budha bho dhi sa twa maṇ+ḍal la puts+tsha ā: r+ghaṃ: gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba'i maṇ+ḍal ni/ oṃ ā rgyu/ phyi nang snod bcud stong gsum gzhal yas su/ /ri rab gling bzhi rdul rnyed mchod sprin gtibs/ /lha ma'i longs spyod dpag med ji snyed kun/ /bla ma dkon mchog sprul pa'i zhing du 'bul/ /thugs rjes brtse bar dgongs te gzhes nas kyang / /bdag sogs 'gro ba sprul sku'i zhing spyod shog /oṃ ā:r+ghaṃ/ rang lus rtsa khams dag pa'i gzhal yas su/ /dbang po rnam lnga bkrag dang mdangs kyi brgyan/ khams dang skye mched yongs su dag pa 'di/ /bla ma dkon mchog longs sku'i zhing du 'bul/ /thugs rje rtse bar dgongs te gzhes nas kyang / /bdag sogs 'gro ba longs sku'i zhing spyod shog /oṃ ā:rgyu/ sems nyid chos sku dag pa'i gzhal yas su/ /spros med stong gsal 'dzin med ngang du gnas/ /gdod nas dag pa'i sgros bral nyug ma 'di/ /bla ma dkon mchog chos sku'i zhing du 'bul/ /thugs rjes brtse bar dgongs te bzhes nas spyang / /bdag sogs 'gro kun chos sku'i zhing spyod shog /oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā khrijisab muṅgā snyo dhe sa zhwa maṇ+ḍal la burdzothe ga sa muskyo spa ra na 665

sa ma ye a r+ghaṃ: lnga pa bla mar gsol ba btab pa'i ngag 'don ni/ trī: 'og min bde chen mkha' dbyings pho brang nas/ /kun bzang snang ba mtha' yas he ru ka /snang stong yab yum bde stong zag med sku/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas de la gsol ba 'debs/ /trīḥ lhun grub rang gsal 'od lnga'i gzhal yas su/ /rgyal tshab rigs lnga drug pa rdo rje 'chang / /ston pa rdo rje sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs/ /dgongs rgyud longs spyod rdzogs la gsol ba 'debs/ /trīḥ thugs rjes 'gro 'dul sprul pa'i pho brang nas/ /dgongs pa yongs rdzogs zag med 'ja' ltar snang / /dga' rab rdo rje 'jam dpal bshes gnyen rtsal/ /dgongs pa mkha' ltar gsal la gsol ba 'debs/ /trī+oḥ dur khrod rab 'jigs rngam pa'i pho brang nas/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs kyi gdug pa ma lus 'dul/ /shrī sidha rin 'dzin chen po'i sku/ /brda' brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /trī: dri med tsho gling pad+ma'i ge sar las/ /legs skyes mchi med mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang / /gnyis med yum chen lha lcam mad+dha ra/ /'phrin las mthar phyin mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /trī: bsam yas lhun 'grub chos kyi gtsug lag nas/ /khri srong yab sras lo paṇa skyes mchog 'dzin/ /shes rab rje mo ye shes mtsho rgyal de/ /snyan brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /trī: gu ru'i zhal skyin thugs rje'i pho brang nas/ /rgyal kun thugs bcud dgongs 'dus gser chos mdzod/ /legs 'byed o rgyan sangs rgyas gling pa zhes/ /gter brgyud spyi dpal de la gsol ba 'debs/ /hrī:gang gi smin grol rgyun 'dzin rigs sras mchog /gu ru'i lung bstan ye shes rdo rje rtsal/ /sangs rgyas blo gros bskyed rdzogs drod kun thob/ /grub brnyes yab sras gnyis la gsol ba 'debs/ /trī: sbas tshul gsang sngags bcud 'dzin bsod nams lhun/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan skar ma bzang po dang / /grub mchog bzang ste gdung rigs dri med las/ /dgongs 'dus brgyud pa'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /trīḥ rang sras rab bdun gdung rdzogs ka ma ru/ /lha sras yang srid rin 'dzin snying po'i mtshan/ /des gsung bdud rtsi legs gsol rnal 'byor gtso/ /bde chen dar rgyas zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /trī: pad+ma'i gdung 'tshob dgongs 'dus pad+ma'i srog /smin grol zab khrid skal ldan 'gror stsol mdzad/ /'brel tshad don ldan 'khor lo'i mgon po mchog /bde chen rab gsal zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /trī:o rgyan gu ru'i lung gi pho nya ba/ /nges don ston pa'i gsal byed 'gro ba'i mgon/ /rgyal ba'i sras po'i rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku/ /tshe dbang nor bu'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /trī: rang snang rnam dag dkyil 'khor chen po nas/ /zhi dang khro gar ston mdzad yi dam lha/ /sprul dang yang sprul yab yum sras 'khor bcas/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs/ /trī: phyi nang dur khrod nye ba'i dur khrod nas/ /dpa' gtum rol pas bstan pa bsrung mdzad cing / /gar gyi dbang phyug mkha' 'gro chos skyong 656

tshogs/ /dam chen rgya mjo'i rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /trī: bdag sogs 'gro ba mos pa'i bu rnams la/ /skyabs mgon rnams kyi thugs rje skyabs mdzod la/ /byin rlabs dbang gi bcud char dbab tu gsol/ /lus ngag yid gsum smin par byin gyi rlobs/ /tī: bde gshegs snying po bka yi yang dril 'di/ /da lta mngon sum gtan la phabs nas kyang / /yang dag rtogs pa'i gdeng can thob pa dang / /grol ba mthar phyin dgongs pas bzung tu gsol/ /zhes pa dang / gsol ba phur tshugs su btab pa ni/ mos gus rtse gcig pa'i sgo nas/ trī: dus gsum gyi bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur cing / mdzad pa'i 'phrin las la mtha' dad mi mnga' bar gyur pa/ o rgyan slob dpon chen po gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs/ lus ngag yid gsum smin cing grol bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes phur tsugs su mi byed pa'i dad pa mos gus thun mong ma yin pa rgyud la lhang lhang ma skyes kyi bar du gsol ba gdab bo/ gzhan yang 'dod gsol 'dod sbyar dang bcas pas gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /mdor na maṇ+ḍal phul zhing / snying thag pa nas gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ gnas skabs thun drug thams cad du/ bde legs kyi yon tan spel zhing mi mthun phyogs thams cad gzhom par byed pas nges par rnam pa thams du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba dang / gsol ba btab pa la rab tu brtson par bya'o/ /'di ni ngo bo nyid kyi gnad la byan chud pas kyang / nang du maṇ+ḍal phul zhing / nang du gsol ba gdab pas/ gzhan don thugs rje'i rtsal myur ba dang / 'phel che ba la sogs pa'i dgongs chos mang ba'o/ /de yang ma zad dbang khrid ngo sprod la sogs bla mas snang zhing slob mas zhu ba'i mtshams sbyor la yang 'di nyid gal che la/ rang gi nyams su len pa'i dus na yang / rang dang dam pa'i lhu 'brel ba gnad zab mo yang 'di nyid mchog phyi rtsol ba'i maṇ+ḍal ma grub kyang / yid kyi sprul la phul zhing / gsol ba gdab pa la yang / skad kyi gdangs cher ma nus pas kyang /dad pa mos gus kyi shugs drag po skyes te gu ru lugs su gda' par bya'o/ /zhes gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi gsung bas 'bad pa'i chos/ de ltar bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i snying po rdzogs pa chen po gser gyi yang zhun gyi smin khrid ji bzhin par shar phyogs kong yul ljon pa lung gi 'dabs kha lhag kyi ri khrod chos nyid 'od gsal gyi pho brang du/ khyab bdag gu ru pad+ma'i sgyu 'phrul rtsa ba'i bla ma grub pa'i dbang phyug kun bzang rang grol bde chen rab tu gsal mdzad zhal snga ru legs par gnod pa'i skal bzang la spyod pa'i skabs su khrid ka de yi thun mong sngon 'gro chos spyod ngag 'don gyi rim pa 'di lta bla ma'i bka' yi gnang zhing lam 'dir zhugs pa'i gang zag rnams kyi dran pa'i gsos/ rgyun gyi nyams len la phan par mthong bas gzhung rgyas pa rnams snying thig rigs mthun nas rdo rje'i gsung khyer bde blang zhing mthor thabs su gnas pa'ang go rim ltar gsal ba mdo khams kaḥthog lho rgyud pa'i rigs su skyes gyur rdzogs chen gyi rnal 'byor pa tshe dbang nor bu'i me sbrul cho 'phrul zla ba'i dga' ba gnyis par bsam gtan gyi thun bar sbyar ba dge'o/ / 657

rog /rdo rje sems dpa' snying thig gi chos spyod ngag 'don gyi rim pa chu 'babs su bkod pa bzhugs so/ /oṃ na mo badz+ra sa twa r+ghaṃḥ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sku/ /thig le nyag gcig rdo rje sems/ /dam pa dang po'i mgon de yi/ /ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma 'dud/ /theg dgu'i rtse rgyal rdzogs pa chen po yi/ /rgyud sde 'bum phrag drug bcu'i yang snying bcud/ /dpal ldan rdor sems snying gi thig le yis/ /'jug ngogs chos spyod ngag 'don 'di na kwa/ /mdun gyi nam mkha' la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams bzhugs par bsgom ste: mos shing gus pas 'di skad do: oṃ āḥhūṃ:rkang gnyis gtso bo sangs rgyas dang : zhi ba cha bral dam pa'i chos: tshogs mchog zhing gyur dge 'dun la: bdag sogs 'gro drug skyabs su mchi: byin rlabs 'byung ba'i bla ma rje: dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam lha: bar chad sel ba'i mkha' 'gro ma: bdag sogs 'gro drug skyabs su mchi: brdal khyab chen po chos kyi sku: gsal mdangs chen po longs spyod rdzogs: sna tshogs 'dzin grol sprul pa'i sku+oḥ bdag sogs 'gro drug skyabs su mchi: ho: mchog gsum rtsa gsum sku gsum dgongs: 'di nas byang chub ma thob bar: 'gro drug ma bu'i 'du shes kyi: byang chub smon par sems bskyed do: ho: sngon gyi rgyal ba'i sdom bzung ltar: da nas 'khor ba ma stong bar: ma sgrol sgrol dang ma bsgral bsgral: 'gro don byed par sems bskyed do: ho: dkon mchog gsum bzung mi btang ngo : bla ma yi dam mi spang ngo :sku gsum gnyis dang 'brel mi bya: rang sems gtsang mar dpang 'dzugs so: oṃ ā:r+ghoṃḥ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum: rang bzhin gnas nas 'dir gshegs gcig: spyi gtsug nyi zla pad+ma'i steng :gnyis su med par bzhugs su gsol: lus ngag yid gsum gus pa yi: rtsa ba gsum la phyag 'tshal lo: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rnams: dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul nas 'bul: lus ngag yid gsum sdig sgrib bshags: rang gnong 'gyod pas bshags par gyis: gsang sngags bla med sgrub pa la: bdag ni rjes su yi rang ngo : nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can la: smin grol chos kyis 'khor lo bskor: 'khor ba'i 'doms nas ma sprug par: sems can don la bzhugs su gsol: dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba rnams: thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa ru bsngo: bdag gzhan sems can ma lus kun: bla med go 'phang myur thob shog: e ma: phyi nang snod bcud 'jig rten zhing khams su: dngos 658

'byor yid sprul bla mas mchod pa'i rdzas: rang snang dag pas bshams pa'i maṇ+ḍal 'di: sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum la 'bul: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum la 'bulaḥ chos sku longs sku sprul sku gsum la 'bul: bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyis: sku gsum lhun grub 'bras bu thob par shog: oṃ ā:r+ghaṃ rig pa stong gsal 'ja' 'od gzhal yas su: r+ghaṃ las rdo rjes sku mdog dkar la 'tsher: zhal gcig 'dzum mdangs rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes: blta bas mi ngom rdo rje dril bu bsnams: nyi zla pad gdan phye skyil 'gying tshul bzhugs: snying nas sangs rgyas sum bcu rtsa drug dang : dung khang khrag 'thung lnga bcu rtsa brgyad sogs: rtsa nang thub drug mkha' 'gro dpa' bos gang :gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid gnyen lcug 'khril: gnas gsum thig le 'bri gsum dkar dmar mthing : mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ge'i khri: pad+ma nyi zla dar zab steng : yid ches bla ma thod phreng rtsal: sku mdog mthing gsal nam mkha' mdog: zhal tshur gzigs nas gzi brjid ldanaḥ chos srung thugs kyi brtse bar mdzad: rin chen rgyan ldan mtshan dpes spras: phyag g.yas dbang bskur bum pa 'dzin: g.yon pas ngo sprod pu ti bsnams: gsang yum dmar mo sku la 'khril: gnyis med bde ba'i nyams dang ldan: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i bla mas bskor: snang la rang bzhin ma grub pa: gsal la zhen pa med pa ni: 'ja' 'od gur gyi dbus su bzhugs: sku gsung thugs las 'od zer 'phros:rgyal ba kun 'dus dbyer med pa'i: bum pas dbang skur smin par byed: po ste'i ngo sprod grol byas nas: phar thim tshur thim gnyis med bsres: bkrags dang gzi mdangs ldan par bsgom: oṃ ā:rgyu: gu ru pad+ma badz+ra sa twa ā: ha ri ni sa sirnyi rgyu/ oṃ ā rgyu: chos dbyings dag pa'i gnas mchog nas: sangs rgyas kun yab dang po'i mgon: chos sku kun tu bzang po la: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs: lnga ldan thig le gnas mchog tu: mtshan dpe'i yongs rdzogs bde chen mgon: longs sku rdo rje sems dpa' la: gsol ba 'debs so ྾ thugs rjes kun khyab gnas mchog tu: sa bcu'i dbang phyug byams pa mgon: sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje la: gsol ྾ gar bzhugs dag pa'i gnas mchog tu: rgyal kun 'phrin las bsdus pa'i mgon: sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung gnas la: gsol ba ྾mdzad pa mthar phyin gnas mchog tu: 'phags pa'i sprul pa 'jig rten mgon: mkhas mchog bai ro tsa na la: gsol ba ྾ 'od gsal bde ba'i gnas mchog tu: rgyal ba kun gyi gsang bdag mgon:mkha' 'gro bde chen rgyal mo la: gsol ba ྾ bsam bzhin sprul pa'i gnas mchog tu: rdor sems snying thig zung gi mtsho brag nas/ dang po ru: ston mdzad rdo rje gling pa la: gsol ba ྾ 'phrin las skyong ba'i gnas mchog tu: rdor sems snying thig gter gnyis pa: ston mdzad kun skyong gling pa la: 659

gsol ba ྾ ye shes yongs grub gnas mchog tu: rdor sems snying thig gter khams khra bo brag nas gsum poḥ ston gyur stag sham rdo rje laḥ gsol ba ྾ 'od gsal rgyun mthil za phu ma tshor rdo rje skye brag nas gnas mchog tu: rdor sems snying thig bka' bab gsum: gcig 'dus bde chen gling pa la:gsol ba ྾ sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu: snying thig bstan 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras: rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu la: gsol ba ྾ chos dbyings mkha' khyab bde chen klong : rtogs pa'i rtsal rdzogs grub pa brnyes: o rgyan ngag dbang ye shes la: gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobasoḥ spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan steng nas: rgyal ba kun gyi gdung tshob pa: drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la: gsol ba ྾gdod nas rang shar gnas mchog tu: 'dus ma byas pa rang shar sku: yi dam rdo rje sems dpa' loḥgasol ྾ snying kha dung khang gnas mchog tu: rang byung rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mchog: zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya la: gsol ba ྾ rtsa thig rlung dag gnas mchog tu: sgyu 'phrul rol pa rgya mcho'i bdag:dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams la: gsol ba ྾ bka' dang dam tshig gnas mchog tu: legs nyes gtang 'dzin rmad byung ba: chos skyong gter bdag pho mo la : gsol ྾ rgyal ba dgongs rgyud rnams la ྾ rig 'dzin brda rgyud rnams la ྾ gang zag snyan rgyud rnams la ྾ mkha' 'gro gtad brgya'i rgyud pa la ྾ tshig shog ser rgyud pa la ྾ bka' bab lung bstan rgyud pa la ྾ smon lam dbang bskur rgyud pa la ྾ grub thob rnal 'byor rgyud pa ྾ byin rlabs dam rdzas rgyud pa la ྾kun 'dus bla ma mchog la ྾ 'ja' lus bum pa'i dbang mchog bskur du gsol: ye shes rlung gi gsang dbang bskur du gsol: bde chen thig le'i sher dbang bskur du gsol: mngon gsum rig pa'i rtsal dbang bskur du gsol: mi rtag 'chi ba dran par byin gyis rlobs: chos nyid mngon sum mthong bar byin gyi rlobs: nyams snang gong du 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs: rig pa tshad la phebs par byin gyis rlobs: chos rnams zad par 'khyol bar byin gyis rlobs: bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: oṃ ā:r+ghaṃ trīḥ sarba sidhi pha la r+ghaṃ:a: de rjes bla ma'i gnas bzhi pa'i: yi ge oṃ ā+oḥr+ghaṃ trī las: 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ljang 'phros: bdag gi gnas bzhir thim pa yi: bum gsang shes rab rtsal dbang thob: lus ngag yid shes sgrib pa bcom: phung khams rtsa rlung thig le sbyangs: bskyed gtum phyag rgya phyogs chen 'byong : sprul longs chos sku mngon 'bras thob: slar yang bla ma bdud rtsir zhu/ /dbyer med rgyal ba'i sa thob gyur/ /de ltar bla ma'i bsnyen grub la/ /'bad mthu'i bdag gi tshe rabs su/ /rdor sems bla ma'i skal ba thob/ /mnyes pa'i zhabs tog kun 'grub cing / /mi brnyes skad gcig yang mi spyad/ /bla ma'i thugs rje sras gyur shing / /bka' blo smin grol kun thob nas/ / 660

nyin mtshan chos la bar med spyod/ /des kyang bla ma'i mos gus rgyas/ /stong nyid snying rje mngon du gyur/ /dam pa sku gnyis thob nas kyang / /'gro drug sangs rgyas sar 'dren shog /gzhan yang smon lam bzang po ci rigs gdab bo/ /rgya chen don kun gcig tu bsdus pa yi/ /gsang chen rigs gcig rigs rnams kun gyi bdag /gang gi snying thig dga' rab pad 'byung gi /snyan rgyud yang zab rdzogs chen 'di rmad byung / /de yi 'jug ngogs ngag 'don ni/ /khyer bde don che don bzang po/ /'di ltar sbyar ba'i dge bas kyang / /mkha' mnyam 'gro kun rgyal gyur gcig /de ltar gter gzhung tshig la kha skang 'os pa sbyar zhing dbang khrid lung gi rigs rgyud rnam grangs du mar kho bos thob na yang / gter kha gsum du byon pa'i bka' bab chu bo mi nas mir rgyud pa kun pad+ma bde chen gling par 'dus pa ma zad/ stag sham pa sku dngos mthun nang dang rdor gling kun skyongs kyi ye shes sku thun min gyi snang bcas brgyud gcig byin rlabs 'pho ba'i dbang brnyes zhing / rang gi yang gnas lugs don gyis rtogs pa rje btsun bla ma de las thob pa dang / gzhan rnams kyi blor yang bklag bde bar gnyer pas/ tshul 'di kong yul tsā nang du kaḥthog sprul sku tshe dbang nor bus sbyar ba dge'o/ / 661

gag /zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor smyor ba yan lag drug gi 'jug ngogs chos spyod ngag don snying po zung 'jug lam sbyin zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ ā:r+ghaṃ:ho haṃ k+ṣa:kā la tsakra na mo rgyu: rnam kun mchog ldan bde gshegs snying po'i khams/ /'gyur ba med pa stong gzugs phyag rgya che/ /zung 'jug dus kyi 'khor lor rdo rje sems/ /dbyer med rtsa ba'i bla mar gus phyag 'tshal/ /bla med rgyud sde'i snying po mchog /thun drug rdo rje'i rnal 'byor che/ /nyams len 'jug ngogs chos spyod kyi/ /rim pa nyung gsal 'di na spel/ /gang zhig skal ldan dad brtson dam tshig can tshe 'di nyid la zung 'jug rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang mngon sum sbyor ba'i rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sbyor ba yan lag drug nyams su len par/ sngon 'gro thun mong thun min khyad par te rnam pa gsum du bstan la/ de yang thog mar chos kun 'jug ngogs skyabs sems bskyed/ skyon spangs legs spel yig rgya maṇ+ḍal khrid/ /gnyis pa bla mas dngos grub kun gyi srog /bla ma'i rnal 'byor lam 'di'i snying mchog yin/ /gsum pa rdzogs rim rten du rab bsngags pa/ /bskyed rim snying po lhan skyes bstan pa'o/ /kun gyi rjes 'gro 'dod pa'i don rnams dag /gsol ba btab pa bsngo smon bkra shis te/ /zhes pa'i thog ma la bzhi yi/ dang po ni/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ chos rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong bsrung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bla ma dkon mchog rin po che rnams kyi bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ /gnyis pa ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par bya/ de'i phyir du zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor bsgom par bgyi'o/ /sems can bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'brel ba gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig /gsum 662

pa ni/ rang gi spyi bor paṃ las pad+ma dang / āḥlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du r+ghaṃ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la r+ghaṃ gi mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus hūṃ la thim/ de 'od du zhu ba yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum rdo rje snyem ma dkar mo gri khug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyi brgyan pa/ rdo rje dang pad+ma'i dkyil mo krung gi bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par ā: thugs dkar r+ghaṃ/ thugs ka'i rdu las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin rlabs ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rnam par spyan drangs/ dza hūṃ baṃ ho gnyis su med par stem/bcom ldan bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa mā ya/ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra ho ru ka twe no pa/ tiṣ+ṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rasto me bha wa/ sarba sidhim+me pra yats+tsha sarba karma su tsa me tsit+t+waṃ shrī ye ku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga lān/badz+ra ho ru ka ma me muñtsa/ he ru ko bha wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa aḥrgyu phaṭa: bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /dam tshig
