las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon po'i skyobs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyi rlobs tu gsol/rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu te rang la thim/ rdo rje sems dpa' khyed sku ci 'dra dang / /'khor dang sku tshe'i tshad dang zhing khams dang / /khyed kyi mtshan mchog bzang po ci 'dra ba/ /de 'dra kho na bdag kyang myur thob shog /bzhi pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gsal btab la/ de nas phyag 'tshal skyabs 'gro maṇ+ḍal rnams bya ba ni/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/ /skad gcig gnyis la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje spyan zhabs pad la 'dud/ /gang gi bka' drin 'od kyis gsal byas bdag nyid kyi/ /de nyid rin chen 'od kyi tshogs kyi mun bcom nas/ /mig skyon med rnams rol par bcas pa'i steng du ni/ /lta gyur bla ma nyi ma de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod ni ma dang khyod ni pha ste khyod ni 'gro ba'i bla ma khyod ni gnyen dang grogs bzang yang / /khyod ni mgon po khyod ni byed po phan dang sdug 'phrog khyod ni go 'phang phun sum tshogs pa dang / /khyod ni 'ba' zhig gnas dang khyod na yon tan mchog gi gnas de skyon rnams bcom pa khyod 663

nyid do/ /khyod ni dman pa rnams kyi mgon dang yid bzhin nor bu rgyal ba'i dbang po khyod la bdag skyabs mchi'o/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dus gsum sangs rgyas rin po che la skyabs su mchi'o/ /oṃ badz+ra bhu mi ā:r+ghaṃ/ gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du/ oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥr+ghaṃ/ phyi lcags ri'i khor yug gi bskor ba'i dbus su/ rgyuḥri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling / nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ sgra gcan/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ dus me/ dbus su lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa gang yang ma tshang ba med pa/ 'di nyid rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rje 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis rlobs tu gsol/ bdag gzhan lus ngag yid gsum dus gsum dge tshogs bcas/ /rin chen maṇ+ḍal bzang po kun bzang mchod pa'i tshogs bcas pa/ /blo yi dmigs nas bla ma dkon mchog rnams la 'bul/ /thugs rjes dbang gi bzhes nas byin gyis rlobs tu gsol/ /sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing me tog bkram/ /ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te 'bul ba yi/ /'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /thun mthar/ mchod yul rnams 'od du zhu ste rang la gnyis su med par thim/ dge ba 'di yi skye bo kun/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing / /bsod nams ye shes las 'byung ba'i/ /dam pa gnyis po thob par shog /gnyis pa thun min dngos grub kun gyi srog snying bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ gnas khang dag pa'i zhing du gsal ba'i dbus su/ seng khri nyi zla'i pad+ma gdan la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po/ sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ rdo rje dril bu thugs dkar bsnol nas bzung ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gi bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyi brgyan pa/ mtshan dang dpe byed thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing / rang la dgyes pa'i zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ 'od dang 'od zer gyi tshogs mtha' yas pa 'phro ba'i sku can/ mtha' bskor du brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa nyan rang chos skyong bsrung ma thams cad bzhugs par gyur/de la yid kyi sprul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mchod pa blos 'phul la/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /mchod do/ /sdig pa gshags so/ /dge la rjes su yi rang ngo / /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul lo/ /mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs so/ /dge ba bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bgyi'o/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /bla na med pa'i lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /bdag la thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ zhes brjod cing don bsam/ bar 'dir spro na rtsa 664

brgyud gyi bla ma'i gsol 'debs logs na yod pa bya zhing / bsdus pa dga' na ma byas kyang chog nges par gdung ba drag pos gsol ba 'di ltar btab ste/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo chos rje dpal ldan bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so/ /sku bzhi'i bdag nyid bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so/ /skyabs mchog mtshungs med bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so/ /ma rig mun sel bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs su gsol/ bdag rtse gcig sgrub pa nus par byin gyis rlobs su gsol/ sgrub pa la bar chad mi 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs su gsol/ sgrub pa'i snying po nyams su len par byin gyis rlobs su gsol/ sgrub pa rab kyi mthar phyin par byin gyis rlobs su gsol/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems 'byongs bar byin gyis rlobs su gsol/ zhi gnas lhag mthong zung du 'brel ba'i ting nge 'dzin la dbang thob par byin gyis rlobs su gsol/ nyams myong dang rtogs pa khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs su gsol/ bla ma'i sku yi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par ā: snying khar rdu: lte bar ho rnams las/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bor bzhugs/ oṃ las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ rang gi dpral bar thim/ lus kyi sdig sgrib dag bum pa'i dbang thob/ sku yi byin rlabs zhugs/ ā las 'od zer dmar po 'phros/rang gi mgrin par thim/ ngag gi sdig sgrib dag /gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/r+ghaṃ las 'od zer mthing nag 'phros/ rang gi snying gar thim/ yid kyi sdig sgrib dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ ho las 'od zer ser po 'phros/ rang gi lte bar thim/chags rtog gi bag chags dag bzhi pa ye shes rdo rje'i dbang thob/ ye shes rdo rje'i byin rlabs zhugs/slar yang mos gus dung ba dang yid kyi gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas byang sems 'khor gyis tshul du bzhugs pa rnams bla ma nyid la thim/ de nyid shin tu dgyes pa'i tshul gyi rang gi spyi bor byon/ 'od zer ram bdud rtsi'i tshul du zhu ste rang la thim/ bla ma dang rang sems dbyer med pa'i ngang la cung zad mnyam par bzhag skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang / /'brel med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod cing / /sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas/ /rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog /gsum pa khyad par rdzogs rim rten bskyed rim gyi snying po lhan skyes bsgom pa ni/ oṃ ma ha shu n+ya te dzha na badz+ra su bhā wa at+ma kophoḥhaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid skad gcig dus 'khor lhan skyes su gyur pa ni/ 'byung ba bzhi'i ri rab pad zla nyi ma sgra gcan rnams brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ bdag nyid dpal dus dkyil 'khor lo/ sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yon pa dkar po bskum pas dbang phyug dkar po dang / g.yas pa dmar po 665

brkyangs pas 'dod lha dmar po'i snying khar mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang / yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang / zla ba phyed pas dbu la brgyan pa/ rdo rje'i brgyan dar/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thab can/phyag sor rnams kha dog lnga pa dang / sor tshig rnams kha dog gsum pa/ rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan cing / me ris kha dog sna lnga pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ khro lcags 'dres pa'i nyams can no/ /de las 'khyud pa'i sna tshogs yum/ sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud cing / zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas yab dang sbyor ba/gcer bu rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing / dbu skra phyed grol ba'o/ gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par ā/ thugs kar hūṃ/ lte bar ho/ gsang gnas su su/ gtsug tor du ha rnams 'khod par gyur/rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang / bcud thams cad dus kyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs su gyur/ de thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ lha sku gsal stong de la ci nus su mnyam par bzhag skabs 'dir sngags bzla ba na/ oṃ r+ghaṃya swā hā/ zhes bzla/ thun 'jog pa'i tshe lha sku 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang du sbyangs/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /dus kyi 'khor lo 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'khod par shog /de nas rjes kyi rim par/ thog mar 'dod don yan lag drug 'grub par gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ lha bde bshegs snying po'i bka' drin gyi/ /yid rnam rtog 'gyu ba so sor bcad/ /nyams 'od gsal stosas bcu rdzogs gyur pas/ /lam sor bsdud 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /lha bde gshegs snying po'i bka' drin gyis/ /yid rlung sems ngag rnams mi g.yo zhing / /nyams shes rab rtogs spyod dga' bde 'phel/ /lam bsam gtan 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /lha bde gshegs snying po'i bka' drin gyis/ /rtsa ro rkyang rlung bcu dbu mar chud/ /nyams gtum mo 'bar bas haṃ yig zhu/ /lam srog bcol 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /lha bde gshegs snying po'i bka' drin gyis/ khams 'dzag med thig le dpral bar brten/ /nyams zhu bde 'gyur med rgyud la skyes/ /lam 'dzin pa 'byongs bar byin gyis rlobs/ /lha bde gshegs snying po bka' drin gyis/ /lus rtsa 'dabs bde chen thig les gang / /lam phyag rgya gsum la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /lam rjes dran 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /lha bde gshegs snying po'i bka' drin gyis/ /rtsa 'khor lo drug po bde bas gang / /nyams spros pa med la dbang sbyor ba'i/ /lam ting 'dzin 'byongs bar byin gyis rlobs/ /lha bde gshegs snying po'i bka' drin gyis/ /lus byed bcings gnas dang ma bral zhing / /chos ma nor man ngag zab mo yi/ /lam sbyor drug 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /de nas bsngo ba ni/ chos dbyings byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /bdag sogs sems 666

can thams cad kyi/ /dus gsum bsags dang rtog pa yi/ /'gro drug sems can ma lus pa/ /sku lnga yongs rdzogs sangs rgyas myur thob shog /smon lam ni/ rigs su skyes dang dam tshig can/ /smyo byed dus kyi 'khor lo ston/ /bla ma la gus snying brtse ldan/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol/ /zab mo'i chos na klog pa dang / /btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam za can/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang / /des gsungs tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te/ /bden pa de yi lha mo de dag gi /bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /de las byung ba'i dge ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i blo yi mun gsal nas/ /bde chen thar pa'i lam la 'god pa dang / /kun khyab bde chen snying po mngon gyur shog /bkra shis ni/ skyabs gsum 'gyur ba med pa'i dge legs dang / /don dam rtag brtan bden pa phun tshogs kyis/ /nges ston snying po'i rgyud rgyal dus 'khor lo'i/ /'phrin las dar shing rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /de ltar zung 'jug sgrub pa'i lam zab/ /rgyud sde kun gyi snying po'i mthar thug rdo rje'i rnal 'byor nyams su len pa na chos spyod 'di nyid chu bo'i rgyun bzhin thun drug rtag tu 'bad pa chen pos blang bar bya'o/ /e ma rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i lam gyi mchog /mthar thug zab gsang rdo rje gsum rnal 'byor/ /nyams su len pa'i chos spyod zab dgu'i bcud/ /kun mkhyen rgyal ba jo nang yab sras kyis/ /zhal lung ci bzhin rang bzos ma rnyog par/ /khyed bde bkod 'di'i dge bas 'gro ba kun/ /rgyal ba de yis grub mthar zhugs byas shing / /brtan pa bzhi ldan go 'phang myur thob shog /ces pa sngags rgyud thams cad kyi sbas don gsal ba dang po'i sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa' mchog gi rdzogs rim rdo rjes rnal 'byor gyi 'jug ngogs chos spyod zung 'jug lam sbyin 'di ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo jo nang kun mkhyen gyi bzhed pa ji bzhin sgrol ba'i mgon pos mdzad pa'i khrid gzhung nas rang bzos ma bslad pa'i ngag 'don khyer bde byung ba'i ze rigs su/ shākya'i dge bsnyen rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus rang lo sum bcu'i bgrang byar son pa thun mong sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lngar 'dzam gling chu bzhi'i mgo bo ma pham g.yu mtsho'i ngogs su sbyar ba las/ slar yi ge gnyis par thams cad mkhyen pa gsang ba sbyin gyi bste gnas sa stod lho dpal mo steng gzim chung du spel ba ste/ ma gyur 'gro rnams dus kyi 'khor lo'i lam du zhugs shing dge legs phun tshogs dpal kun rgyal ba'i rgyu gyur cig dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o/ /yig brgya bzlas pa'i rjes su/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /rdo rje dang po kun tu bzang / /phyag 'tshal rdo rje sems dpa' la'o/ /bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /sogs brjod pa'ang rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal gdams so / 667

༄ga /zab lam ne gu gser chos kyi 'jug ngogs chos spyod ngag 'don gyi rim pa nges sangs snying po'i sgo 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ swāste/ na mo gu ru/ pha bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsol ba 'debs so skyabs su mchi'o/ /byin gyis rlobs cig nges pa don gyi mthar thug pa/ /gsang ba sngags kyi snying po'i bcud/ /ston mdzad rdo rje slob dpon la/ /phyag 'tshal thugs yid dbyer med shog /zab lam ne gu'i man ngag gi/ /nyams len chos spyod ngag 'don gang / /'jug pa bde phyir 'dir bkod na/ /bla ma lha yi byin gyis rlobasaglu/ /'dir zab lam ne gu gser chos nyams su len pa'i 'jug ngogs rnal 'byor chos spyod ngag 'don du bya ba'i rim pa la gsum ste/ sngon 'gro skyabs sems maṇ+ḍal thun mong chos/ /thun min dag byed stong ri'i gsol 'debs dang / /bye brag gsol 'debs bla ma'i rnal 'byor yin/ /rjes su smon lam bkra shis bsngo ba'o/ /de yang dang po la gsum gyi thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ rang nyid gang du gnas pa'i khang khyim dang / /yul phyogs kun kyang dag pa'i zhing du mos/ /mdun mkhar seng khri pad+ma nyi zla'i steng / /rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa'i sku de ka /bkrag mdangs gzi bajid 'od du 'bar ba yis/ /dgyes pa'i zhal ras 'dzum bcas bdag la gzigs/ /de ni mchog gsum rtsa gsum kun 'dus te/ /spyi dpal rtsa ba'i bla ma mkhyen snyam bya/ /de la rang gi tshe 'di'i pha ma dang / /gnod byed dgra bgegs yul gnas gzhi bdag gi /gtso byas khams gsum sems can thams cad kyi/ /rang dang lhan cig skyabs 'gro byed par bsam//ngag tu ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ skyabs kun 'dus kyi ngo bo bla ma rin chen la skyabs su mchi ba lags so/ /zhes ci nus brjod cing skyabs 'gro'i 'dun pa drag pos dung dung ba rgyun chags su bya/ thun mthar bla ma 'od du zhu rang la thim/ dbyer med bsam ngang cung zad mnyam par bzhag /gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ mkha' khams yongs khengs sems can 'di thams cad/ /bdag gi drin can pha mar ma gyur med/ /'di rnams bde 'dod sdug bsngal snying re rje/ /des na bde ba dam par 'god bya'i phyir/ /bdag gi sangs rgyas go 'phang thob bya ste/ /de yang dam chos don bsgoms las byung bas/ /zab lam mthar thug mkha' 'gro ne gu yi/ /zhal lung man ngag nyams su blangs bar bgyi'oske/ /ngag nas 'di skad ces/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du/ 668

rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ zhes dang / de yi phyir du zab lam ne gu'i chos drug nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /des mtshon ne gu'i phyag rgya chen po/ ne gu'i lam khyer rnam gsum/ ne gu'i 'chi med rang grol/ zhes nyams su len pa gang yin pa der tshig bsgyur la dal bus brjod nas don la nan tan bsam bzhin du bya'o/ /gsum pa maṇ+ḍal ni/ lugs 'dir maṇ+ḍal gyi dmigs khrid gud du mdzad pa gsung yang / skyabs sems bla ma'i rnal 'byor bar skabs rnams su ci nus 'bul ba ste/ de yang shangs pa'i maṇ+ḍal bka' rgya ma ni/ bkod pa shin tu mdzes pa'i maṇ+ḍal mchog/dbus kyi ri rgyal gling bzhi gling phran bcas/ /gsal byed nyi ma zla bas bskor zhing mdzes/ /phyi rol lcags ri bar ni rol mtshos brgyan/ /rin chen dpag bsam shing dang 'dod 'jo ba/ /rgyal srid sna bdun rin chen gter brgyad dang / /ma rmos lo tog yan lag brgyad ldan chu/ /phyi nang gsang gsum mchod sprin bsam mi'i khyab/ /dag dang spro bar byed pa'i maṇ+ḍal 'di/ /don gnyis sgrub par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /brtson pa'i stobs kyi bla ma yi dam dang / /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul bar gyis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gdung 'dzin rnal 'byor pas/ /mnyes byed maṇ+ḍal bzang po 'di 'bul bas//nyes skyon dri ma'i tshogs rnams kun byang nas/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /zhes pa ste/ gzhan yang maṇ+ḍal gyi tshig khungs ldan ci rigs kyang 'bul ba'o/ /spyi don gnyis pa la'ang / dang po dag byed a yi stong ri'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi spyi bor gdan bzhir bla ma'i sku/ /gsal la mos gus gdung shugs cher skyes pas/ /ngag tu/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po che/ bdag gi nad gdon thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ sdig sgrib thams cad dag par mdzad du gsol/ ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ ces gsol ba bdos drag la yun ring du btab pa'i mthar bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang gi spyi bor thim/ mgo yi stong par chos 'byung dkar dwangs dbus/ /bla ma rang rig dbyer med spros bral ba/ /skye med a dkar 'od 'tsher bdud rtsi yi/ /sdig sgrib gnad gdon sbyangs dmigs a bzlas 'bad/ /a a a/gnyis pa gdams pa'i snying phur bla ma'i rnal 'byor bye brag gi gsol 'debs ni/ bdag lus phung khams 'dzin med snang ba yis/ /spyi bor bzhi rdzogs gdan la 'khor lo'i mgon/ /sangs rgyas las lhag rtsa ba'i bla ma gsal/ /snying nas phur tshugs gus pas gsol ba btab/ /ne gu'i gser chos lnga yi rtsa ba chos drug las/ /gtum mo la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po che/sems can thams cad kyi don du/ bdag gi lus la bde drod kyi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skye bar mdzad du gsol/ sems la bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skye bar mdzad du gsol/ zhe gsol 669

ba drag tu btab/ mthar bla ma bdud rtsi'i ngo bo zhu/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs te thim pas sgo gsum tha mal du snang ba dag ye shes lha yi sku gsung thugs su gyur/ yang rang nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i spyi bor bzhugs pa'i bla ma la mchod pa bzhi rdzogs su phul ba dmigs shing / dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin chen la/ phyi me tog gdug spos/ nang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ gsang bde stong gi ye shes/ yang gsang de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa dam pa rnams 'phul lo/ /bzhes nas bdag la dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ bla ma'i sku las bdud rtsi'i bde rgyun 'bab/ spyi bo nas zhugs 'khor lo bzhi brgyud de/ lus kun khengs pas dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs thob/ mthar ni bla ma rang nyid dbyer med gyur/ zhes srid pa'i dbang zhu ba'o/ /yang 'di ltar bsgom te/rang nyid skad cig lhag pa'i lha skur gyur/ /steng gi nam mkhar rtsa ba'i bla ma gsal/ /de yi thugs ka nas byung 'od zer gyi/ /rtsa rgyud bla ma yi dam rab 'byams tshogs/ /phyogs dus sangs rgyas lung rtog dam pa'i chos/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun mkha' 'gro chos skyong kun/ /bsdus te bla ma'i sku la yongs su thim/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs te/ /de la bdag gi pha ma dgra bgegs dang / /gzhi bdag kyis bcos 'gro drug ma lus shing / /'byung bzhi las kyang gsol ba 'debs pa'i sgra/ /bdag gi ram 'degs 'ur sdug sgrogs par bsam/ /gsol 'debs ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po che/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gi bdag 'dzin blos thongs bar mdzad du gsol/ dgos med rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa ni gsol 'debs thams cad kyi gzhir bzhag nas/ tshigs rkang gsum pa nas mtha' bsgyur ba kho na ste/ de yang sgyu lus la/ sgyu lus 'byongs par mdzad du gsol/ mi lam 'byongs par mdzad du gsol/ 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub/ da lta nyid du/ myur ba nyid du/ 'dug pa 'di nyid du thob par byin gyis rlobs su gsol/ zhes sbyar ro/ /de bzhin du rmi lam skabs su/ rmi lam zin par mdzad du gsol/ mi lam 'byongs bar mdzad du gsol/ mi lam spel nus par byin gyis rlobs/ rmi lam sprul nus par byin gyis rlobs/ rmi lam sgyur nus par byin gyis rlobs su gsol/ yul gnad brten la phebs par mdzad du gsol/ zhes tshig re re bzhin rmi lam khrid rkang so sor rim pas sbyar ba dang / 'od gsal la 'od gsal zin par mdzad du gsol/ 'pho ba la/ bar dor sangs rgyal bar mdzad du gsol/ bar do la/bar dor longs sku thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa rnams go rim bzhin dang / chos drug gdan thog cig tu dril nas nyams su len pa la ni/ gong gi sgyu lus kyi gsol 'debs ltar la/ sgyu lus rmi lam sbyongs par mdzad du gsol/ zhes bsdoms pa tsam ste/ sgyu lus dbang po tha ma'i gsol 'debs kyang 670

'di nyid do/ /sdong po phyag rgya chen po la yang sgyu lus kyi gsol 'debs de ka'o/ /'od gsal phyag rgya chen po rtogs par mdzad du gsol/ zhes tshig rkang gsum par 'don/ yal ga lam khyer gsum bgyis dang po/ bla ma lam khyer la/ cir snang bla mar 'char bar mdzad du gsol/ gnyis pa yi dam lam khyer la/ cir snang yi dam 'char bar mdzad du gsol/ gsum pa sgyu ma lam khyer gyi snang ba sgyu ma lam khyer la/snang ba rang sems su rtogs par mdzad du gsol/ rmi lam sgyu ma lam khyer la/ cir snang sgyu ma rmi lam du 'char bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa'o/ me tog mkha' spyod dkar dmar gyi gsol 'debs gzhan du shes par bya la/ 'bras bu 'chi med 'chug med la ni/ sems 'chi med rang grol du rtogs par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa ste/ de ltar chos drug rmi lam man dang / khrid chen lhag ma gsum gyis gsol 'debs su/gong gi bzhi de la/ tshig rkang gsum pa bsgyur ba kho na la'o/ /'bri bsnan gzhan bya rgyu med cing / de yang gong gi mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa rnams su byin gyis rlobs su gsol/ zhes 'don pa gang bde byed pa nyid do/ /de ltar gsol 'debs 'di rnams bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang nas grub thob chen po 'ba' zhig gyur pa'i rgyud ldan bla ma'i gsung gi rgyun la/ so skyes kyi rtog bzo spros pa'i bsre bslad ma byas pa'i byin rlabs mtshon kha ches che ba kho na yin pas/ bsam pa dang klog pa'i sgo nas rgyun du nyams su blang ba shin tu gal che zhing gces pa'i chos so/ /de yang gsol ba 'debs dus su tshig phyir 'brang ba'i yul tsam pa ma yin par rig thog tu rdo rus thug par byas pa yi/ gsol 'debs skad che ba/ chung ba dang /skabs su yid la bsam nas bgrang ba sogs nan tan chen po'i sgo nas rnal 'byor du bya'o/ /skabs su rtsa rgyud bla ma'i gsol 'debs du ma gzhan na 'byung ltar shes shing spro na bya/ gsol 'debs kyi thun mtshams rnams su/ pha bla ma pha bla ma/ pha bla ma rang mkhyen/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma khyed la gsol ba 'debs so/ /zhes mos gdung snying la 'brab pa cig byas nas de yi ngang la klod kyi bzhag de ltar mos gus gsol 'debs kho nas thun gyi dngos bzhi bskyang ste/ thun 'jog khar/ tshar gsum khug pa dbang gi man ngag bcas/ bla ma 'od du ltem ste zhu/ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ de ka'i ngang la sems dug gsum gyis rnam rtog spangs nas lhod de bzhag gzhan yang skabs 'dir rang gi nyams len gang la byed pa de la 'jug par bya la/ de yi mthar rjes kyi rim pa rnams bya'o/ /de nas spyi don gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la gsum las dang po ni/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad gnad med pa/ /sangs rgyas nyid du 'gro ba yi/ /lam de nyid du grub gyur cig /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gi bgrol/ /rnal 'byor gtsug lag bstan bcos la//da lta nyid du gnas par shog /ces smon lam btab/ gnyis pa ni/ legs pa'i yon tan rab rdzogs pa// 671

bla ma yi dam bkra shis shog /'phrin las thams cad sgrub mdzad pa/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong bkra shis shog /ces shis pa brjod/ gsum pa ni/ dge ba'i tshogs rnams bsags pa kun/ /bdag gir yongs su bzung med par/ /sems can ma lus kun don du/ /chos dbyings bla na med par bsngo/ /ces dge ba byang chub tu bsngo nas spyod lam la 'jug go /'di dag kyang shes na smon lam dang / bkra shis/ de bzhin bsngo ba bka' brgya mar grags pa rnams skabs su ci nus byed pa nyid do/ /de yang dus kun mi rtag 'chi ba snying la zug pa yid 'di snang zhen pa bcad cing / lam rtsa bar bla ma'i rnal 'byor mos gus ldem rkyang med par gsol ba btab cing dam tshig srogs las lhag par blta ba dang / chos thams cad sgyu ma/ rmi lam bar do yin snyam gyi dran pa dang mi bral zhing / gzhan yang bsre ba lam khyer kyi lha dgu/sgyu lus/ 'od gsal/ rang shar rang grol phyag rgya chen po'i dbyings su bskyal ba chu bo rgyun gyi rnal—'byor la 'bad par bya'o/ /de ltar bka' la gzu lum ma gyur cing / /rnying pa'i gtam la gsar pa'i lang tsho can/ /tshul bzhin sbyor bar nus pa'i blo mthu 'di/ /bla ma'i thugs rjes bdag 'dra'i bskal shar bas/'di 'dra bgyis pa'i dge bas 'gro ba kun/ /nges sangs snying po'i lam bzang 'di thob nas/ /ring min he ru ka dpal 'bras bu la/ /rab tu spyod pas dga' ston rgyas par shog /zhes ye shes mkha' 'gro ne gu'i gser chos khrid chen bzhi thun mong gi 'jug ngogs/ chos spyod ngag 'don gyi rim pa slad med khyer bde bkod pa zhig ma mthong bas/ chos tshul 'dir zhugs pa rnams la phan pa'i slad du nang pa'i grub mtha' la gus pa mchog tu thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa dpal tshe dbang nor bus rang lo bzhi bcu'i bgrangs bya la 'khod nye ba me sbrul dbyug zla lha bab dus bzang por kong yul sa yi thig le gu ru'i gter gnas su ri rin chen 'bar bar sbyar ba'o/ /dge'o/ / 672

༄sto /'phags pa thugs chen po'i srun ras gzigs kyi lam rim dmar khrid spyo'i 'jug ngogs sngon 'gro'i ngag 'don bzhugs/oṃ swāste/ rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje gcig bsdud pa/ /mtshan tsam 'dzin pas phyir mi ldog la bkod/ /bla ma spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal nas/ /dmar khrid ngag 'don mdo tsam 'dir bkod bya/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gi sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog /bdag gzhan lus ngag yid gsum dus gsum dge tshogs bcas/ /rin chen maṇ+ḍal bzang po kun bzang mchod pa'i tshogs bcas pa/ blo yi dmigs nas bla ma dkon mchog rnams la 'bul/ /thugs rjes dbang gi bzhes nas byin gyi brlab tu gsol/ /oṃ ur+ghaṃ badz+ra gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni maṇ+ḍal pu tsa me gha sa mu tra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye ā+oḥr+ghaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa mā ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra sa twa twe no pa/ tiṣ+ṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ sarba sirnyi m+me pra ya ts+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/tsit+t+waṃ shrī yo ku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga lān/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñtsa badz+rī bha wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa aḥ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /bdag gi spyi bor pad+ma'i gdan steng du/ /bka' drin chen po sgo nas bzhugs nas kyang / /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ ā r+ghaṃ/ 'od dpag med pa rgyal ba kun gyi yab/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang 'gro 'dul snying rje'i gter/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus pad+ma sam+bha wa/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag sogs thugs rjes bzung / /gangs can mgon po 'phags mchog srong btsan sgam/ /'phags yul grub mchog mi tra dzo ka'i zhabs/ /sprul pa'i gter ston gu ru chos kyi dbang / /gsol ba ྾ byang chub sems brnyes zla ba rgyal ba'i mtshan/ /sbas tshul rnal 'byor chen po tshim bu pa/ /rmi lam sgyu ma'i sku grub skyer sgang zhabs/ /gsol ba ྾ smin khrid chu bo kun 'dus grol mchog rje/ /lung rig rgya mtsho kun mkhyen sgrol ba'i mgon/ /rin chen rgya mtsho kun dga' 'phrin las dbang / /gsol ba ྾ 'jigs med go cha tre+e bo chos dbang po/ /'gro 'dul bla ma tshe dbang nor bu'i ste/ /sbas pa'i sangs rgyas karma bdud 'joms zhabs/ /gsol ba ྾ man ngag kun gyi snying po dmar khrid kyi/ /bdag rgyud yongs su smin mdzad 'khor lo'i mgon/ /'dren mchog dwangs ma 673

rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba ྾ de ltar rgyud pa'i bla mar gsol btab mthu'i/ /mi rtag 'chi dran chos brgyad zhen pa log /nges 'byung dag snang rab rgyas dam tshig dag /smin grol gdeng thob rim gnyis 'bras smin shog /bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bla ma chos kyi sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bla ma sprul pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bla ma nyid kyi sku la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bdag rgyud smin grol byin gyi rlabs su gsol/ /zhes ci nus brjod/ bla ma'i gnas bzhir oṃ ā:r+ghaṃ:trī las/ /yig drug dkar dmar mthing ljang bdag gnas bzhir/ /thim pas dbang thob sgrib gnyis lam bzhi 'byongs/ /sku bzhi'i 'bras bu mngon du gyur bar bsam/ /oṃ ā:hūṃ trī: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me rdu/ rjes su bla ma rang gi snying kar thim/ /rang nyid spyan ras gzigs dang dbyer med gyur/ /ma yengs mi bsgoms lhan ner ci gnas bzhag /de las ldang tshe khyer so gsum ldan bya/ /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang / /'brel med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod cing / /sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs te/ /rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog /bsod nams 'di yi thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas nas/ /skye rgas na 'chi'i rba rlabs 'khrug pa yi/ /srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba sgrol bar shog /'jam dpal dpa' bos ji ltar mkhyen pa dang / /kun tu bzang po de yang de bzhin te/ /de dag kun gyis rjes su bdag slob cing / /dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo/ /de ltar thugs rje chen po yi/ /dmar khrid spyi yi 'jug ngogs su/ /rig pa 'dzin pas sbyar ba ste/ /'gro kun 'jig rten mgon thob shog /ces smyon rig sbyor phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyi gsol ba btab pa'i ngor rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'i ding ri blang 'khor du brjod pa dge'o/ / 674

༄ga /chos zab dgu kun gyi yang zhun bla sgrub dmigs pa'i rkang grangs 'dzin tshul pad+ma'i 'phreng ba bzhurgas so/ /chos zab dgu kun gyi yang zhun bla bsgrub kyi dmigs pa'i rkang grangs 'dzin tshul pad+ma'i 'phreng ba zhes bya ba/ bde chen 'khor lo'i dbang phyug pad+ma 'byung gnas yab yum sras rgyud par bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yang mtshan ldan rdo rje slob dpon gyi bskal bzang slob ma rnams la lam zab bla bsgrub srog gi dwangs ma'i khrid skyongs bar byed pa'i skabs su sla chos tshar rkyen du ma song bar smin khrid du byed par shin tu gal che la/ thog mar khrid zhu tsho 'dus dus yig brgya 'ur ldir bklags nas 'dus shing gral la mtho man nges nges tig tig med par spus 'dus su byas nas 'tshogs pa dang rgyas kyi rten 'brel yod gsung / de nas phyag dang bcas te gral la 'khod nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor skad rta gdangs dang dbyangs mthun par tshar gcig ston mthar chos skyong spyi dang khyad par sgos kyi bsrung ma mgon po ma ning dang ma gza' dam gsum la gtor ma rgyan ldan dzā gad bcas nges par gsung dgos/ de nas yan lag bdun sngon du 'gro bas maṇ+ḍal phyag len ltar tshom bu so bdun ma dus rtag tu re re dang / ngo sprod sogs chos khrid gnad che ba la gsum gsum 'bul/ de nas chos bshad kyi mtshams sbyor ci ltar 'os pa brjod cing / khyad par khrid rkang gi tshig rnams ma nor ba/ ma 'khrul ba/ ma 'dzing ba/ dag pa/ gtsang ba/ gsal ba/ sgros dod par rang rang gi blo gros dang / nyan pa po'i blo dang bstun pa bshad ces so/ /dmigs rkang thun mthar dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba maṇ+ḍal bcas/ chos thun byung res bzhin de dag ma chags pa rten 'brel gyi gnad zab mo yod pas gal che'o/ /de nas dmigs pa rkang grangs bstan pa ni/ dang po blo chos su 'gro ba'i 'khrid la/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' tshul/ rgyu yi sgo nas rnyed par dka' ba/ de bzhin don dang dpes gtan la phab ste bsgoms pa ste/ thun chen gcig 1 mi rtag par bsam pa la/ pha ma gnyen tshan dgra bo btang snyoms bar mi 'gro ba sde dpon yul khams rgyal po/ bla chen/ 'khor los bsgyur ba/ tshangs dang brgya byin rnams mi rtag pa dang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyang mya ngan 'da' tshul ston pa dang / snod kyi 'jig rten chags 'jig la bsam pa ste dmigs rkang thun chen gcig 2 las 'bras bslu med kyi ngang tshul gtam rgyud dang bcas pa dmigs rkang thun chen gcig 3 thar pa'i phan yon la chos la brtson 'grus bskul ba dmigs rkang thun chen gcig 675

4 de sngon 'gro blo ldog rnam pa bzhi ni chos pa'i rkang yin pas blo rgyud chos dang ma 'dres bar du dpe don lo rgyus du mas bstan te smin 'khrid skabs dmigs rkang sa bcad bzhi yin na'ang thun grangs dang /zhag grangs nges pa med kyi slob ma'i blo 'di nang dgos med ma shar bar du skyongs 'jug la/ rkyang khrid kyi skabs su yang blo ldog bzhi po re re la zhag bdun lnga gsum gang rigs brkyangs 'jug pa shin tu gal che'o/ /i thi/ gnyis pa chos lam du 'gro ba la dang po skyabs 'gror/ thog mar skyabs 'gro dang dge bsnyen sdom pa gang rung 'bogs la/ de sgom rim phyi mdo lugs/ 1 nang gsang sngags lugs/ 2gsang ba mdo sngags dril ba/ 3 de kho na nyid don dam pa ste/ 4 dmigs rkang bzhi thun bsdu rim rnams rtsa ba la/ yan lag ni ci snyed spros chog go /i thi/ gnyis pa sems bskyed la/ thog mar sems tsam dang dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed 'bogs pa'i cho ga ltar nod pa shin tu legs mod/ de ltar ma thob kyang sems bskyed kyi 'khrid ka ston pas 'thus la/ de yang rtsa ba smon 'jug gnyis su 'du yang /khrid tshul phyag len la byams pa bsgom pa/ 1 snying rje bsgom pa/ 2 byang chub sems bsgom pa/ 3gsum ni rtsa ba yin zhing / de nas smon pa tshad med bzhi bshad pa/ 4 'jug pa phar phyin drug gi go don dang / 5 thams cad ye shes tshogs su bsgyur thabs bstan pa drug kun gyi don dril nas bshad pa ste/ 7 rtsa ba'i sa bcad bdun yin la/ bskyed rim gyi phan yon rgyas par bshad/ spros na tshad med bzhi la thun bzhi/ phar phyin drug la thun drug sogs rgyas par bstan pa'o/ /i thi/ gsum pa tshogs bsags khyad par can maṇ+ḍal gyi 'khrid la/ phyag len mthong ba rgyud pa ltar du lus kyi las tshom bu bkod pa/ ngag gi las tshig bcad brjod pa/ yid kyi las dmigs pa gsum bgrang nas phyi yi maṇ+ḍal 'bul te/ da yang tshogs bzhi gsal nas phyi yi maṇ+ḍal phul/ 1 nang gi maṇ+ḍal phul ba/ 2 gsang ba'i maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba/ 3 de kho na nyid du zla ba ste/ 4 rtsa ba'i dmigs rkang bzhi la maṇ+ḍal gyi phan yon rgyas par bstan zhing / spros na snod bcud 'jig rten chags tshul mngon pa dang mthun par bshad do/ /mṛ thi/ bzhi pa sgrib sbyong rdor sems kyi bsgom bzlas ni/ thog mar rdor sems kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang thos na legs la/ de ltar ma gyur kyang ting nge 'dzin dbang bskur cig byas na yon tan che bas bya la/ de nas phyi bya rgyud ltar bsnyen pa/ 1 nang spyod rgyud ltar nye bar bsten pa/ 2 gsang ba rnal 'byor ltar bsgrub pa/ 3 yang gsang bla med ltar sgrub pa chen po/ 4 de kho na nyid bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug la bzla ba bstan la/ 5 sdig bshags pa gnyen po stobs bzhi'i tshul legs par bshad cing ci rigs pa spros so/ /de ltar blo sdog nas dmigs pa gong 'og thams cad la thog mar 676

sems bskyed rjes su rang 'dod med par bsngo smon bzang pos mtshams sbyar ba ni dmigs thun thams cad ma chags par gal che bar bya'o/ /khṛ thi/ de ltar chos lam du 'gro ba dmigs chen nyi shu thams cad de tshogs kyi lam che 'bring chung ngu rnam par bgrod lags byed pa'o/ /spyi don gsum pa lam gyi 'khrul pa zhi bar byed bla ma'i bsgrub pa dngos bzhi bsgom la/ thog mar rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bla med rgyud sde gang yang rung ba'i dbang yongs rdzogs thob par byed pa shin tu gal che ba yin la/ de nas bla bsgrub kyi man ngag nyams su blang bya rtsa ba tshogs bshad/ khyad par zhal gdams te/ dang po la rdo rje slob dpon gyi phyi bsnyen/ nang bsgrub pa/ gsang ba nye bar bsgrub pa/ yang gsang bsgrub chen po ste rtsa ba'i sa bcad rnam pa bzhi yin la dmar khrid du dang po phyi bsgrub la yang rang lus yi dam lhag pa'i lha yi skur gsal zhing snang stong du sbyong ba/ 1 de nas spyi bor 'khor lo'i dbang phyug rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom pa'i thog mar 'od gur gdan dang sa bon bskyed pa/ 2 de yi 'od zer gyi rigs drug gi gnas kun khyab cing snod dag pa bcud dag pa sku dang zhing khams su sbyangs pa ste/dmigs rkang zhib mor bstan skabs dmyal ba'i snod bcud sbyangs pa/ 3 yi dwags/ 4 byol song /5 lha min/ 6 lha/ 7 mi yi snod bcud sbyangs pa/ 8 de drug thun chen gcig yin no/ /de nas 'od zer gyi rgyal ba sras bcas dgyes par byed pa/ 9 sa bon la rtsa gsum rab 'byams thams cad bsdu ‘ba/ 10 sa bon bla ma'i skur bsgyur ba/ 11 bla ma'i thugs ka dang / 12 dung khang /13 mgrin pa/ 14 lte ba/ 15 gsang gnas su lha dkyil 'khor gsal btab pa/ 16 sku yi gnas thams cad du lha yi gsal btab pa/ 17 brgyud pa'i bla ma phreng bar bsgom pa/ 18 'khor khrom tshogs yi dam sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun bsgom pa/ 19 dad mdun blo ling gtad kyi maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba/ 20 yid rtse gcig pas rtsa sngags kyi thugs rgyud bskul ba/ 21 gsol 'debs tshigs bcad gdung shugs 'o dod kyi gsol 'debs/ a/ 22 ba sngags kyi gsol ba 'debs pa 23ste de yan gyi phyi ltar bla ma bsnyen pa blo sbyangs lha khrid kyi dbang dman rjes su bzung ba ste sbyor lam gyi drod thob par byed pa'o/ /skabs 'dir rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbye ba rtsa ba yan lag gi bla ma'i tshul/ bla ma'i rten tshul/ dam tshig bsrung tshul/ nyes na gso tshul rnams shin tu nan che bas bshad do/ /i thi/ gnyis pa nan bla ma bsgrub pa la 'khor yi dam sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun rnams gtso bo la bsdu ba/ 1 de rnams dge 'dun oṃ chos āḥ sangs rgyas r+ghaṃ yi dam trī 'am ho ru gsal nas gtso bo'i gnas bzhi'i yi ger bstem pa/ 2 de nas bum dbang blang ba/ 3 gsang dbang blang ba/ 4 sher dbang blang ba/ 5tshig dbang blang ba/ 6 mthar cig char gyi spros bsdus te/ 7 de nas bla ma bsgrub pa ting nge 'dzin gyi 677

dbang bskur mchog tu zab pa dbang po bar ma rjes su bzung ba ste/ sbyor lam gyi rtse mo thob par byed pa'o/ /skabs 'dir dbang spyi yi rnam bzhag dbang / khyad par du ting nge 'dzin dbang bskur ba'i phan yon/ de dag gi sa bcad rnams spros nas bshad do/ /mṛ thi/ gsum pa gsang ba bla ma nyer bar bsgrubs te/ bla ma rdo rje bzhi yi rang bzhi can dhu ti nas snying dbus su spyan 'dren pa/ 1 bdag nyid lhag pa'i lha yi nga rgyal 'pho ba/ 2 bla ma yab yum kha sbyor du lta ba/ 3 sa bon la yig bzhag pa ste/4 skabs 'dir sems dpa' gsum rtsegs kyi go don legs par bshad 5 de nas sngags 'phreng bkod pa/ 6 dzab kyi dgongs pa legs par bstan pa ste/ 7 de ni bla ma gsang ba rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du nye bar bsgrub bskyed rim thams cad kyi don gcig tu dril zhing / 'phrul 'khor rgya che ba dbang rab rjes su 'dzin pa ste sbyor lam gyi bzod pa thob par byed pa'i rim pa'o/ /skabs 'dir lha bskyed rim sngags bzlas pa dmigs pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam bzhag rgyas par bshad par bya'o/ /i thi/bzhi pa yang gsang bla ma bsgrub pa chen po nyams su len pa la/ bla ma yab yum gyi sku 'gyur med thugs kyi sa bon du bsgyur nas gsol ba btab pa/ 1 las bzhi lhun grub kyi dgongs pa/ 2 zhi ba/ 3rgyas pa/ 4 dbang / 5 drag po/ 6 mchog don du gnyer ba 7ste/ de ni yang gsang bla ma bsgrub pa chen po lha sku gcig sngags 'bru gcig ting 'dzin gzer gcig gis grol ba dbang rnon rjes su bzung ba ste sbyor lam gyi chos mchog thob par byed pa'i rig pa'o/ /skabs 'dir bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug myur lam thabs kyi man ngag kyang ci rigs bshad par bya'o/ / mṛthi/ de ltar lam gyi 'khrul pa zhi bar byed pa man ngag kun gyi mthar thug bla ma bsgrub pa'i zab chos srog gi dwangs ma lta bu'i zab khrid dngos bzhi'i rim pa spyi don bzhi la chos thun gyi rkang sdom pas bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi pa ste sbyor lam gyi nges 'byed bzhi dang sbyor nas bstan pa'o/ / mṛ thi/ gnyis pa khyad par zhal gdams la 'ga' zhig ni gong gi sa bcad skabs su song la shin tu gsang ba rgya ba'i don mdor bsdu na bum dbang dang 'brel ba dkyil 'khor bskyed rim gyi man ngag gi zhal gdams dang bcas bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug tu bsre ba/ gsang dbang dang 'brel ba rdor bzlas gtum mo'i rim pa/ sher dbang dang 'brel ba thabs lam pho nya'i gdams pa rnams yin la/ tshig dbang dang 'brel ba ni 'og tu bstan te/ 'dir ni sa bcad tsam ste/chos thun gyi rkang grangs ni zhal las shes so/ /ghardzir u pa de sha gu h+ya khri bī/ spyi don bzhi pa 'khrul snang ye shes su 'char ba bla ma de kho na nyid kyi bsgrub pa la snying kha'i bla ma rdzu yig tu gnas pa hril sdud dam/rim bsdud kyi mthar thig le stong pa nā dar gzhil ba/ 1 phung khams yongs su sbyangs pa/ 2 sgo gsum bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med ngang du bzhag pa 3ste/ rtsa ba bstan pa'i dmigs rkang 678

gsum yin la/ de dang 'brel ba stong nyid lhar gsad pa'i gdams pa dang / 1 gzhan yang yan lag tu/ bza' ba dang / 2 gyon pa dang / 3 'gro ba/ 4 'dug pa/ 5 gnyid pa/ 6 dmigs pa kha bsgyur rnams kyang skabs 'dir spros te bshad pa gnad che/de ltar skyabs sems nas bzung rtsa ba'i dmigs rkang 'di rnams la khrid lugs rab 'bring tha ma gsum ste/ de yang rab la dngos nyams rmi lam gyi rtags mtshan thob pa/ 'bring la zhag grangs bdun lnga gsum du le lo med par sbyangs/ tha ma yang zhag re re sbyangs nas dmigs rkang ma 'dzol zhing zin nges par bya la/ yam khrid shad shud ye nas mi rung ngo / /sems la rdo rus thug nges par sbyangs par shin tu gal che'o/ /de yang sbyor dngos rjes kyi khrid rim thams cad la thog mar 'gro don du sems bskyed pa/ bar du dge sbyor la yid rtse gcig tu 'jog pa/ mthar dge la mi zhen zhing rnam smin re dog med par byang chub chen por bsngo ba rnams shin tu gal che bas dus rtag tu ma chags par bya'o/ /de ltar bla ma de kho na nyid kyi sgrub pa sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje gsum sgo gsum dang gnyis su med pa zla ba ni mthong lam gyi yon tan thob par byed pa'i rim pa'o/ / i thi/ 'dir khyad par gdams pa bla ma dang rang sems ro gcig tu bsres nas dbu phyag khreg chod kyi gnad sems dang po mi gnas pa gnas par byed pa/ gnas pa brtan pa/ brtan pa grol bar byed pa gsum las/ thog mar dngos po phra mo/ 1 lha sku/ 2 yig 'bru/ 3 phyag mtshan/ 4 thig le/ 5 rlung dang / 6 thig le 'dzag la bslab pa/7 sogs pa'i man ngag bla ma'i phyag bzhes ltar brtan nas gnas 'gyu rig pa ngo zin nges byas nas zhi gnas gtan la dbab/ gnyis pa byung gnas 'gro gsum rtsad gcod drag po byas nas sems nyid kyi ngo bo gtan la phab nas ngo sprad cing zhi lhag zung 'jug gi nyams skyongs gsum pa nyams zhen gyi blo zhig nas ma bcos skye med spros bral lhag mthong gi rtogs pa ngo mthong ba dang / rtsal bskyed pa dang / mthar thug mngon gyur 'od gsal khor yug ma bu gcig tu ma 'dres par skyongs so/ /de dag kyang rgyal ba'i bka' lung gi don ma 'khrul bar rtogs ldan bla mas nyams 'khrid du ston pa las rang gi rtogs chos rlom nas bka' don dang 'gal ba'i bla bcos kyi chos khrid/ rang nyid kyi ma rtogs par dpe bshad na mi dang rtog go'i brtag dpyad kyi bsre bslad byed pa ni nam du yang mi rung la/ rgyal ba'i bka' zung 'jug thob pa rnams kyi gsung ma 'khrul bar ston par gces so/ de yang khrid ston pa po rab rtogs pa can/ 'bring nyams skyes pa/ tha ma yang bla ma'i gsung ma nor bar ston nus shing gzhung don ni go nges pa zhig dgos/ de bas rang gi myong chos rtog chos yin par rlom shing rgyal ba'i bka' las 'das par bstan na rdo rje dmyal ba'i rgyu yin pa gzab 'tshal/ des na nyams rtogs brtan pa ma thob yang khrid kyi 679

go don ma nor ma 'khrul go ba zhig ni shin tu gal che'o/ /blo rmongs nyams brang brang skyes pas chos bshad pa las/ blo gros ldan pa go ba yang dag thebs bstan pa phan thogs che bar 'gyur zhing / slar slob ma'i mos gus kyi gnad kho nar rag lus pas/ bka' chos zhus pa'i bla ma la ni nam du yang dad pa ldem rgyang med par rdo rje sems dpar blta bar bya zhing / spyir nyams dang rtogs pa'i shan 'byed cing 'dra 'tshungs gol shor dbang du ma song bar shin tu gal che'o/ / mṛ thi/ bla ma rang sems bsre ba'i gnad thun mong ma yin pa khreg chod rgal gyi don zung 'jug tu nyams su len pa ni bla ma dam pa'i zhal las blang bar bya'o/ / mṛ thi/ de ltar bla bsgrub kyi sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi dmigs pa'i rkang la chos bzhi'i dang por dmigs rkang bzhi/ gnyis par nyi shu/ gsum par bzhi bcu zhe bzhi/ bzhi par rtsa ba gsum yan lag bdun te dmigs rkang bdun bcu rtsa brgyad tham pa'o/ /de nas dngos po phra mor thun gyi rtsa ba byas la/ de nas sku la nyi shu rtsa lnga/ yig 'brur lnga/ phyag mtshan bdun/ thig ler bdun/ rlung gi bslab pa lnga/ thig le'i sbyang bar bzhi ste dmigs rkang dril bas drug bcu ste/ gong ma dang bsdom pas brgya dang sum bcu rtsa bdun gyi rdzogs pa ste/ slob ma'i rgyud tshod dang bstun te dmigs pa'i bsgyur dgos ni mtha' gcig tu ma nges pa slob dpon gyi myong ba can gyi blos bstan la/ zhal shes gdam pa 'ga' zhig ma rtogs dmigs rkang ma tshang med pa yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /de ltar nyams su len pa la go ba dang nyams myong shan dbye/ nyams dang rtogs pa ma nor bar dpal ldan bla ma nyams rtogs ldan pas myong khrid nyid du bya la/ spyir nyams dang rtogs pa'i nor po gol pa 'dra 'dra ni dbang po 'bring man chad la shin tu mang zhing / gzhung nas bshad pa'i nyams len gyi sa mtshams dang mtshungs mi mtshungs ci rigs pa 'byung la/ dbang po rab rnams la de ltas bu mi rdzi zhing / blo gros mchog thob pa rnams kyi yang shan 'byed pa la mkhas pa'o/ /de ltar ma yin pa rnams ni nyams 'dra min gol shor med par rtogs ldan bla ma'am rgyal ba'i bka' yi/ bla ma la zhun thar bcad pa mchog tu gces pa ste/ phyi rol mu stegs kyi grub mtha' lta 'dod la la dang / dbu ma 'dzin pa rnams la khyad cha shas phra mo res 'byed pa yin zhes shing rta mchog gyur rnams kyi bzhad la/ spyir lta ba ma 'khrul spyod pa ma log pa ni mchog tu rgyal ba rnams kyi gsung ba'i gal 'gag go/ /mdor na lta ba nam mkha' lta bu la/ rdzas thob sgyu ma lta bu chos kun rang sems su thag chod cing / rgyu 'bras rten 'brel du shes pas mdor len la mkhas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma ni sangs rgyas kun las lhag par shes shing lus srog ltos pa med par dad gus zhabs tog dam tshig ye nas g.yel ba med par snying khung rus pa'i gting nas kha sems med pa ngos lkog med pa skyid sdug med pa zhig shin tu nas gal che'o/ /gal che'o de ltar ches dran pa'i mi gcig la chos gcig gis chog pa chos 680

gcig ni tshe gcig la zung 'jug rdo rje sems dpa' thob par byed pa'i lam ma tshang ba med pa/ don zab pa rgya che ba bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgrub thabs ches cher rmad du byung ba/ chig chog ri chos zab pa'i mthar thug pa ste/ yang dag pa'i lam don du gnyer ba rnams srog ster bar byed pa bdud rtsi lta bu chos 'di kho na'o/ /de bas las bskal mchog dang ldan pa rnams kyi brtson 'grus drag pos nyams su longs shig bsgom cig bsgrub cig ston cig shod cig chos kyi snying por bzung zhig shin tu gces par gyis shig tsit+ta dha thim/ phar phyin theg pa rnams kyi bskal pa grangs med bgrangs byang chub bsgrub pa sngags 'og ma rnams skye ba grangs can gyi thob par byed pa dang / bla med rnams kyi 'di phyi bar dor byang chub chen por rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang rnyed par 'dod pa yin te/ de yi gnad bla ma la mos gus dam tshig rnam par dag pa gal che zhing / dam tshig rnam par ma dag na rdo rje dmyal bar snye bas dper na sbrul smyag dong du bcug pa lta bu rdo rje theg pa'i lam ste dad mos dam tshig la rab tu brtson par gces so/ /spyir tha snyad kyi gzhung lugs la lo brgyar 'bad pa las/ nges don rtogs par blospephyogs nas glegs bam spyi bor bzhag pas byang chub la nye zhing / thos bsam 'dus byas kyi dge ba ci snyed bgyis pa las/ yang dag 'jog thun gcig gi byang chub la nye zhes/ rgyal ba'i bka' mdo rgyud du ma nas gsung zhing zung 'jug brnyes pa rnams kyi yongs su bsgrags pa yid ches pas nyams len don gyi snying po bsgom bsgrub la 'bad par byos shig 'bad par byos shig bdag lta bu'i skye bo la deng sang yid rton par mi byed pa bden yang / bdag gis smra ba 'di dag ni rgyal ba'i bka' dang mchog brnyes pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rnams ci ltar gsung ba'i don/ rang bzos ma brnyog par gzhan phan gyi lhag bsam 'ba' zhig gis bshad pa yin pas des na chos kyi tshig don la yid rton du bya bar rigs so/ /de ltar bla ma bsgrub pa'i khrid rim gyi sa bcad mig long gi snar khrid lta bu shin tu gsal bar bkod pa zab bo/ /'di bris nyes gyur thams cad 'khor lo yis/ /dbyugs dbyung dran mchog rdo rje sems par bshags/ /'di phyi'i sgrib bral rnam dag dbu dbyugs zhing / /legs dges 'gro kun bla ma'i sar brnyes shog /ces bla bsgrub dmigs rkang pad+ma'i 'phreng ba 'di nyid las skal chog dang ldan pa'i slob ma dad dam brtson 'grus can rnams kyi lan gcig ma yin par yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ dpal chen po rdo rje khrag 'thung thod 'phreng rtsal gyi thugs dang gnyis su med par gnubs nam mkha'i snying po yi mtshan tsam kho nas byin gyis brlabs pa yul mdo khams pa lha rigs su yi bya bral ba rig sngags 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho'am ming gzhan du pad+ma theg mchog bstan pa'i gsal byed nges gsang grub pa'i shing rta phyogs las rnam rgyal grub chog dbang po'i sde zhes bya ba phyogs kun tu rgyu ba yi rang lo sum bcu'i sne la zin nye ba zhi ba zhes sa bya ston zla ra ba'i tshes bzang 681

nyer gsum la bod yul stod mnga' ris cha glo mon bod kyi mtshams gung thang nub ri'i bas mtha' ta le'i yang rtse ru bkod pa'i yig ris ni mdo khams stag phu'i btsun pa bsod nams rab bstan bgyis pa'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /maṅga lo/ shu lha/༄ga /bla skub bsnyen pa'i grangs tshad 'dzin tshul mdo tsam ston pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /bla bsgrub bsnyen pa'i grangs tshad tshul mdo tsam bstan pa bya ste/ mtsho skyes rdo rje sems dpa'i pad+ma bde ba chen po karma rig 'dzin tha dad med par phyag 'tshal lo/ /de lam zab kun gyi yang zhun snying po bla ma sgrub pa'i bsnyen pa la gsum ste/ rtags kyi bsnyen pa/ dus kyi bsnyen pa/ grangs kyi bsnyen gsum yin la/ de dag gi gong ma gnyis rgyas par 'dir ma spros shing / mdo tsam 'og tu smos la/ 'dir grangs kyi bsnyen pa ngos 'dzin pa ste/ spyir yi dam gang rung ba'i sngags yig 'bru'i grangs mnyam 'bum phrag gi bsnyen par 'gyur la/ 'bru re la 'bum phrag bzhi bzhi bzlas pas ni nges par bsnyen par 'gyur zhing / 'bru sum cu yar rgal ni 'bru re la khri re bzlas par bshad pas gong ltar 'bru re re khri bzhi bzhi bzlas na bsnyen pa'o/ /des kyang bsnyen pa'i skabs su yid la ma yengs par rtse gcig pas bzlas na yin/ yengs zhing bzlas pa ni ma yin no/ /de yang dang po skyabs sems la 'bum/ de nas maṇ+ḍal 'bum/de nas lus kyi sgrib sbyangs su phyag 'bum/ ngag gi sgrib sbyangs su yig brgya 'bum yid kyi sgrib sbyangs bla bsgrub skabs su 'byung / /('di nas ma dpe ldeb bu gnyis chad)dus kyi bsnyen rab lo gsum phyogs gsum/ 'bring zla ba drug gsum ste bco brgyad/ tha ma zla ba drug gi thim pa'o/ /rtags kyi bsnyen pa rab chos nyid bden pa mthong ba/ 'bring bla ma lha yi zhal mjal chos gsung byin gyis brlabs pa tha ma sdig sgrib dag cing tshe bsod rgyas pa'i rtags spyi dang mthun zhing khyad par bde gsal mi rtogs pa'i nyams skye ba'o/ /rtags mdor bsdu na bla ma la dad mos sngar las che ba/ dam tshig phyir du lus srog 'dor nus pa/tshe 'di snang snyan grags longs spyod la zhen pa ldog pas nga rgyal phrag dog chung ba/ las rgyu 'bras la yid ches pas chos gsha' mar blo 'jug ste rtags de ni yang dag pa'i lam yin la/ de las log na phral rtags ji ltar snang yang bar chad kyi rgyu yin no/ /des na gnad 'di snying la bzung bar bya'o/ /rtags kyi mthar thug pa ni nam zhig tshe chos nyid du dri bral gyi ngo bo mthong zhing chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur zhen med mi 'gyur bde bar byas shing / rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'o/ /de ltar bla ma bsnyen 682

pa'i rim pa gsum gyi tshul mdo tsam smras pa ste rgyas par slad mar kho bos bri bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dad gus dam ldan rdo rje slob dpon ma rgya gar gyi cha mon yul ku thang be'u phug gi bla ma brtson 'grus dang mang yul skyid grong gnas kyi sgrub pa po chos dbyings dpal 'bar/ gus thang nub ris rta sga'i sgrub pa nam mkha' nor bu rnams kyi skul ngor tshe dbang nor bu rdo rje sems dpa' rtsal gyi bod yul mnga' ris tshal gung thang nub ri mon dang bod yul gyi mtshams ta la dbu brtsegs sa bya gro zhun gyi zla bar bkod pa maṅgalo/ dge'o/ /rdza /bla med theg pa'i yang snying lam zab bdud rtsi'i thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru bi kā la tsakra ya/ mi 'gyur bde chen stong gzugs phyag rgya che/ /zung 'jug a li ka li mnyam sbyor ba/ /rnam kun mchog ldan rnam pa thams cad mkhyen/ /dpal ldan bla ma dus kyi 'khor lo 'dud/ /bla med sngags lam snying khu mchog /smin 'phel byang chub chen po'i bar rim pa lam zab zhes bya ba/ /bla ma'i man ngag bzhin bshad bya/ /rnal 'byor pa bde ba'i gdan la mnyam par bzhag te bdud rtsi'i myang nas/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /bdag gi phung po khams skye mched/ /yul bcas ma dag 'dzin pa'i cha/ /spros bral rang bzhin rnam dag pa/ gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor dngos/ rang snang dag pa spyi bo'i gtsug bde ba chen po snying gi dkyil/ khams ye lnga ldan lag gi mthil/ /phyogs bral khyab bdal nam mkha'i dbyings/ /'byung lnga 'od kyi 'khor lo'i dbus//pad+ma zla nyi sgra gcan te/ /rig pa r+ghaṃ las kun rdzob dus/ /don dam 'khor lo'i bdag nyid che/ /dpal mchog dang po'i sangs rgyas ni/ /dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma'i dngos/ /rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka /kun byed rgyal po kun tu bzang / /sngo sang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku/ /zhi khro 'dres pa chags pa'i nyams/ /spyan gsum mche bzhi'i myu gu mdzes/ /rdo rje'i rgyan dang stag sham can/ /dbu skra bung ba ltar nag cing / /'tshog mar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lter/ /rigs bdag bskyed mdzad rgyal bas brgyan/ /thor cog g.yon du zla tshes dang / /rtse mor nor bu 'od 'bar ba/ /lta bas mi tshugs bsam mi khyab/ /phyag gnyis sor mo mthe bong nas/ /brtsam rim ser dkar dmar nag ljang / /phyag sor rtsa ba nas brtsam ste/ /tshig 'phreng rim gsum nag dmar dkar/ /phyag mthil pad+ma ltar dmar zhing / /phyag mtshan rdo rje dril bu bcas/ /yum la rnam rol phyag rgyas 'khyud/ /zhabs g.yon dkar po g.yas dmar po/ /bskum dang brkyang ba'i 'og tu 683

ni/ /dkar po dbang ldan mi gsum pa/ /rtse gsum thod pa 'dzin kha sbub/ /dmar po 'dod lha me tog gi/ /mda' lnga gzhu 'dzin gan rkyal mnan/ /dbang ldan 'dod lha'i chung ma yis/ /gus pas zhabs sor dpral btud de/ /lag gi brtan yang g.yo med par/ /ri dbang ltar brjid der 'khyud pa'i/ /sna tshogs yum gyur gser gyi mdog /spyan gsum khro 'dzum dbu skra grol/ /phyag rgya lngas spras gri thod 'dzin//g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang mnyam par rol/ /rdor pad e waṃ zung 'jug snyoms/ /mtshan dpe yongs rdzogs yab yum sku/ /'od zer ye shes me lnga 'bar/ /de ltar gsal ba'i sku yi gnas/ /spyi mgrin thugs te gsang gtsug tor/ /o āḥr+ghaṃ ho swā hā drug /dkar dmar nag ser ljang mthing mdog /yig 'bru rnams las 'od zer ni/ /mkha' khams ji srid kun khyab te/ /rtsa rgyud bla ma dkyil 'khor lha/ /rab 'byams rgyud sde bzhi drug gi/ /yi dam rab 'byams rgya mtsho dang / /sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang 'phags/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor zhing skyong ba/ /chos bsrung dam can tshogs bcas kun/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs shing / /de rnams la ni mchod pa'i sprin/ /nyer spyod 'dod yon sha bdud rtsi/ /snyoms 'jug bde chen mnyam pa nyid/ /mchod dgyes dkon mchog rtsa gsum tshogs/ /bla ma dus kyi 'khor lo la/ /yongs thim dbyer med ro gcig pas/ /kun 'dus yid bzhin nor bur gyur/ /de nas gus pa'i yid kyi rtse gcig pas rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo dkon mchog rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bor phur tshugs su gsol ba bta pa ni/ gang la rgyu dang mtshan nyid med/ /g.yo dang de bzhin ris med pas/ /kā la tsa krar mngon brjod pa/ /gnyis med de la gsol ba 'debs/ /de bzhin dus 'khor bde chen po/ /sku gsum mchog dang dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje gsum mchog rdo rje'i dbyings/ /'gyur ba med la gsol ba 'debs/ /phra rags rdul gyi chos nyid 'das/ /pra phab sa yi rang bzhin can/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan ma/ /phyag rgya chen mor gsol ba 'debs/ /bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun ste/ /kun gyi byed po bla ma yin/ /rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /khyod ni 'gro ba'i bla ma yang / /pha ma gnyen dang grogs bzang po/ /khyod ni sdig grogs phan byed mgon/ /khyod ni go 'phang phun sum tshogs/ /khyod mchog 'ba' zhig yon tan gnas/ /skyon bcom dman rnams mgon gyur khyod/ /yid bzhin nor bu rgyal ba'i gtso/ /bla mar bdag ni skyabs su mchi'o/ /skye rga 'chi ba na kra yi/ /chu srin la sogs 'jigs rung ba/ /mi zad 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /mgon pos bdag ni bsgral du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba nan tan du btab/ de ltar tshig sho lo ka bdun snga ma gsum ni 'phags 'grel dri med 'od na gnas pa rgyud tshig dang phyi ma gcig po yang 'gyur khyad kyi 'phags 'grel la lar mi gsal yang /dus 'khor rgyud las byung ba zhig dang / bzhi pa sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i tshig dang / lnga pa drug pa zung ni dus 684

'khor bsdus brgyud nang le yi mtha' dang / 'jam dpal zhal lung tshig sgros mthun pa las blangs ba ste rgyud tshig sha stag go /de mthar thal mo sbyar te/ sgrib pa thams cad bcom pa yis/ /dus kyi 'khor lo khyod la 'dud/ /mchog tu mi 'gyur bdes gang ba/ /ye shes sku khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pas/ /byang chub sems ni 'gyur med gang / /dbang bskur de yi bdag la ni/ /mgon po da ni bka' drin mdzod/ /zhes pas lan gsum du gsol ba btab/ dpal ldan bla ma dus 'khor lo/ /yab yum mdzod spru nas 'od dkar/ /zla zhun 'dra byung bdag dpral nas/ /zhugs shing phyi nang lus kun sbyangs/ /dbyibs snang dga' ba bum dbang gi/ /smin grol sbyangs thob las kun byas/ /bla ma yab yum sbyor mtshams nas/ /dkar dmar 'dres pa thig le'i rgyun/ /bdag lce steng bab lce chung nas/ /dbu ma'i nang rgyud lus kun khengs/ /sngags mched khyad dga' gsang dbang gi/ /smin grol sbyang thob las kun byas/ /bla ma yab yum thugs kha nas/ /lnga ldan 'od zer srang bu bzhin/ /bdag gi snying gar yongs thim nas/ /phyi nang 'od zer dra bas g.yogs/ /chos thob mchog dag sher dbang gi/ /smin grol sbyangs thob las kun byas/ /bla ma yab yum snying dbus nas/ /gsal dod rab 'tsher rgyal ba'i sku/ /mi 'gyur bde bar mtshon gang pa/ /bdag gi gtsug nas snying kar thim/ /nyer thob lhan dga' dbang bzhi pa'i/ /smin grol sbyangs thob las kun byas/ /de ltar ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang yid rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag nas ci nus su blang bar bya'o/ /de nas bla ma dus 'khor lo/ /yab yum rang gi spyi bor byon/ /'od zhu bdag gi sgo gsum dang / /dus 'khor sku gsung thugs mnyam pas/ /rang nyid dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i bdag /dang po'i sangs rgyas dus 'khor lo/ /me long sngags kyi pra phab bzhin/ /rdul bral ye shes sku ru gyur/ /de ltar lha sku cha med rnam pa gsal ba rnam rtog gzhan spangs te ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag cing / gal te rnam rtog 'phro ba sel phyir ram sngags bzla bar spro na/ dus 'khor thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ /snang ba dag pa 'od gsal zhing / /'gro kun dus kyi 'khor lo'i sku/ /ye shes rol pa chen por gyur/ /zhes snang srid dag par brtas te mnyam par bzhag pa'am/ /yang oṃ dz+nyā swā hā/ zhes bzla skyon lnga spangs te bzlas sam yid bzlas sogs ji ltar 'dod pa bya'o/ /mthar snri thun bsdu ba na/ snang srid zhing khams lha tshogs kun/ /'od zhu rang nyid yum yang yab/ /rab phra'i thig ler gyur dpal stong / /slar yang rang nyid lha skur ldang / /de nas rdzogs rim bsgom par 'dod na skabs 'dir yan lag drug gang rigs bsgom par bya'o/ /de yang 'dir yan lag drug snying po'i don gnad du dril nas gdan thog gcig tu nyams su len pa ni bsam gtan gyi gdan la lus drang zhing skyil krung khu tshur brla bzhag sogs byed cing gnad dang ldan pas rlung ro legs par gsal te ṭ+wā bar nas 'bras 685

thar tsam du byas te rlung re zhig rang 'babs su bzhag mig ha cang gi bzlog pa ma yin par smin phrag thad du 'byed btsum ran pa mi g.yo bar nam mkha'i mun pa nag thing nge bar gtad la/ sems rnam rtog gi spros pa dang bya bar de ltar g.yo med gsum ldan du bzhag par bya ste/ sor sdud skabs stong gzugs shar rung de la ched gnyer med pa nam mkha' la gtso bo ba dang / bsam gtan ni 'dzin stong gzugs mi shar tshe nam mkha' dang shar phyin stong gzugs gi byas te gnad gzhan zhig pa nyid do/ /de yang du ba smig rgyu me khyer mar me mkha' snang ser dkar dmar nag dang glog 'od thig le chen por grags pa'i rtags snang kun stong gzugs zhis sems la ma mchis pa'i stong nyid rang bzhin 'od gsal gyi rang mdangs 'khrul shes kyi ma slad pa 'khrul ba'i rnam kun mchog ldan gyi phyag rgya chen po rnam pa thams cad pa ste/ de ni dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi chos skad yang dag pa'o/ /de ltar sor bsam la goms pa'am ma goms kyang rung / thog mar dbugs rang 'babs la brda' 'gyur rdo rje'i bzlas pa ci nus su 'bad cing / de nas dal gyi rlung ji nus 'gog kyin rdor bzlas sbyar la de ltar mthar bum can rang grub tu yong bar bzhed la/ rlung 'gog pa'i rdor bzlas ni 'gog bzlas lta bu ma yin gyi/ rngub dgang bteng gsum sdom par 'bru gsum tshar gcig dang sbyar ba las mang mi dgos shing drag rlung bum pa can sogs la gzhil zhes 'byung yang dgang ba dang btang ba'i bar mtshams su las khyad par can byed rung ngo bo ni dgang ba las logs su med la/ de ltar rdor bzlas dang sbyar ba'i rlung sbyor ni srog rtsol dngos dang stong gzugs dang bsre ba ni thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /de ltar srog rtsol gyi nus pas rlung dbu mar zhugs gnas thim pa'i bya ba lte ba man chad grub nas/ slar 'khor lo gong ma rnams dang gsang ba bcas par bzhugs gnas thim gsum khyad par can gyi dpyid thig kha sbyor la byang nas yas brtan dag pa dang po'i sa thob par byed pa ni 'dzin pa ste man ngag zur du byas pa yod kyang grub pa'i slob dpon phal ches ni man ngag rtsol kho nas rung la des grub pa'i 'bras bu 'dzin pa yin par bzhed do/ /de nas rjes dran dngos ni/ phyag rgya gsum la brten yas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi pa'i mthar thug rjes dran bcu drug gi yon tan yongs su srog grub nas/ de yi 'bras bu'i tshul du ting nge 'dzin mas brtan gyi dga' ba bcu drug yongs su rdzogs pa yan lag bdun dbang phyug brgyad zung 'jug nyer gsum gyi yon tan grub pa rdo rje sems dpa' yi gnas thob pa rnams dngos gnas kyi sbyor ba yan lag drug gi rim pa dang /de ltar yan lag phyi ma gsum mos pas lam du byed pa'am de yi rgyu tshogs khyad par can bsgrub par gtum mo'i rnal 'byor la 'bad par sngags te/ de yang rang nyid dus 'khor yab yum du gsal btab pa'i rang gi lus dbus su rtsa dbu ma mtshan nyid bzhi ldan mda' smyug tsam lte ba man ljang khu de yan chad 686

mthing kha g.yon ro brkyang dkar dmar dbu ma las 'dab 'gyur phra ba yas sna sna bug g.yas g.yon dang mas sna dbu mar chud pa ste dbu ma'i nang lte 'og sor bzhi'i mtshams su tshangs pa'i me dbyug pa'i dbyibs can lte bar/ hoḥser/ snying kar r+ghaṃ sngon/ yas snar haṃ can ba nu lta bu ste/ de yang zar ma'i 'bras bu ltar bzlum pa'i dbus ba nu ltar cung zad nar te 'phyang bas dbu ma'i yas sna bkag pa'o/ /de nas rlung ro bsal rlung sbyor ba bzhi ldan la/ dmigs pa ro brkyang rgyud dbu ma'i yas sna rlung zhugs tshangs pa'i me 'bar hoḥyig la reg hoḥyig la me ser shas che ba'i kha dog drug pa 'bar rim pas je mthor song ste snying kha'i r+ghaṃ bsreg spyi bo'i haṃ can la reg bdud rtsi'i zla zhun ltar dkar 'tsher 'od zer 'phro ba bab snying kha'i rdu gsos lte ba'i hoḥl thim zhing / de yang me bdun la haṃ can la rtse reg tsam bar mi chad dang thig le rgyab nas hoḥyig bar mi chad bab te thim pa 'bar 'dzag skra shad 'dzing ba ltar bya ste/ de ltar nyams su blang ba'i mgor rlung ro legs par gsal/ bar du rlung btang ba'i skabs kun tu rlung zhabs 'dzin pa dang / mthar thun bzhag skabs lus g.yas su bcud de thig le dkar cha kun spyi bor haṃ la thim/ g.yon du bcun dmar cha kun lte ba'i hoḥl thim/ de nas thig le dkar dmar 'dres par bsam la rlung gi dug 'don hag sprug yang dag par byas rjes dmigs med du rlung zhabs bar rlung du 'dzin pa rnams bla ma'i man ngag bar ma chad pa yin la/ lam phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la yang shin tu gal che bar rje btsun mi las mnyam med sgom po par nged kyi a thung 'di bsgom dang da bzod ngo bo mthong gsung bas kyang nges par mtshon no/ /lhag tu lha sku gtum mor 'bar 'dzag kun stong gzugs dang bsre ba ni dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi rdzogs rim khyad chos phul du byung ba'o/ /de nas thun mtshams la 'jug par 'dod tshe/ dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag /dus kyi dkyil 'khor 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /rigs su skye dang dam tshim can/ /snyon med dus kyi dkyil 'khor ston/ /bla ma la gus snying brtse ldan/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang / /btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas can/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /zhes sogs bsngo smon ci rigs pa bya la de ltar rdzogs rim bsgom pa'i mtha' 'am mi bsgom kyang rung thun las ldang bar 'dod tshe dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba dang smon lam gyi rgyas btab pa yang nges par ma chad par gces so/ /de ltar bla med rdo rje theg pa mtha' dag gi snying khu lam zab khyad par can 'di rtsa ba'i khungs 'phags yul gyi grub pa'i slob dpon rdo rje gdan pa 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pa'i man ngag dpal sga lo dang rgyal ba zhang / yang dgon pa rnams kyi thugs dam yang snying zhang gi bka' 'bum dang / yang dgon pa'i ri chos su che thang du ma mdzad pa nyid gzhir 687

bzhag de yang zhang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma 'khor los sgyur ba'i chas can dang / rdo rje 'chang du byas pa gdam po can/ ri chos su bde mchog tu byas pa yod kyang 'dir dus 'khor du byas pa dang / dus 'khor lhan skyes rol pa'i rdo rje'i gzhung rje btsun sgrol mgon gyi khrid rim du grangs pa'i don bzhin rgyud rgyud kyi shes pas bla ma'i man ngag rgyud don ma 'khrul bas kha cung zad bkang ste byas pas nor 'khrul med pa zhal lung rgyun ma chad pas byin rlabs ma nyams pa dang sbyor drug gdan thog gcig pa'i snying po ni myong khrid kyi srol ka ma nyams pa las byung ba'o/ /de ltar rgyal ba'i dbang phyug gi /bka' gsang rgyud sde kun mthar thug /thugs kyi 'phrin las phul byung chos/ /lam zab shing rta'i srol 'di rmad/ /tshul 'dir bdag gi 'bad bgyis dge mchis kun/ /'gro mgon bla ma dgyes slad mkha' mnyam 'gror/ /yongs bsngo de mthus tshe dbang rgyal ba yi/ /go 'phang yid bzhin nor bu'i gnas thob shog /ces bla med sngags chos kyi snying po'i bcud len lam zab bdud rtsi'i thig le zhes bya ba 'di ni sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i mnga' bdag dpal ldan 'brug pa zhes snyan pa'i ba dan srid rtser 'phyo ba gang gi spyi phud yongs kyi 'dren pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgyu 'phrul 'gog med pa'i rang gzugs rje 'gro mgon rin po che'i sprul pa'i sku mchog kun mkhyen rgyal dbang bka' brgyud phrin las shing rta zhal snga nas gang gi bka' stsal dgyes pa bsgrub pa'i slad du rang gi nyams len snying po dang mthun par rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i bgrang bya rnga chen gyi lo sa ga zla ba dmar phyogs gyi tshes bcu mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus bzang po kong yul nyang cha lcub ri 'owa gsal lding du rnal 'byor pa tshe dbang nor bu rdo rje dpal 'bar gyi sbyar ba sarba maṅga lo/ / 688

༄ga /bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i sgrub thabs khrid kyi yi ge sku gsum lam rim mchog gi sgo 'byed rtses bya ba bzhugs so / /na mo gu ru budha bho dhi sa twe bh+yaḥ bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes 'od dpag tu med pa'i sgrub thabs khrid kyi yi ge sku gsum lam rim mchog gi sgo 'byed zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba kun gtso 'od snang mtha' yas/ /tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa/ /'od mi 'gyur ba gdod ma'i mgon po/ /de la mgo bos rtag 'dud phyag 'tshal/ /gang gi sgrub thabs khrid yig /skal ldan 'jug ngogs lam rim/ /mchog sgo 'byed zhes bya/ /'di ru cha shas bshad bya/ /de la dam pa'i chos kyi skal ba dang ldan pa'i gang zag byang chub sems la blo sbyangs shing / rim pas rgyud smin par byas nas gdams pa bstan pa 'di la don gsum ste/ phyi bde chen zhing sbyongs kyi bsnyen pa/ nang bskyed bzlas rdzogs pas sgrub pa/ gsang ba rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyis las la sbyar ba'o/ /dang po ni khrus dang gtsang sbra la gnas pas dben pa'i gnas su bde ba'i gtan la gdong nub tu phyogs te 'khod zhing /thun gyi thog mar skyabs sems bya ste/ de yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' la skar ma bkram lta bu dang / rang gi mdun gyi steng ta la'i srid tsam du rtsa ba'i bla ma bzhugs par bsam la/mkha' khyab sems can thams cad snying khongs su bcug pa'i lhag bsam gyi skyabs 'gro sems bskyed gyi tshig 'dir ltar brjod do/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams 'di dag gis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas myur du 'grub par bgyi'o/ /zhes pad+ma lam rim gyi chos spyod sil bu nas 'byung ba'i tshogs bcad de/ /rang gi skyabs sems brjod pa dang lhan cig dgra gnyen bar ma'i 'gro ba dang 'byung bzhi'i rdul phra rags nas kyang 'ur ldir grags par bsam la ci nus su brjod/ thun smad du sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim zhing rtsa ba'i bla ma rang gi spyi bo'i steng thad du rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam par bzhugs pa'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab nas sgo gsum sdig sgrib sha khrag rus pa dang bcas pa thams cad dag nas rang lus shel sgong dri ma med lta bur bsam la yi ge brgya pa ci nus su bzlas/mthar bstod bshags byas te bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' tshangs pa'i bu ga nas rang la thim pas gnyis su med pa rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang du dar gcig blo bzhag rjes dge ba bsngo/ de nas zhing sbyongs 689

nyams len dngos bzhir 'jug pa la rang gi mdun nub phyogs kyi char mi mjed 'jig rten las cung zad steng du 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams bde ba can khyon tshad pa dbyibs zlum po'i rnam pa dpe maṇ+ḍal bar snang du bzhag pa lta bu ste/ zhing de'i che ba'i yon tan 'od dpag med kyi mdor ji ltar gsung bzhin dran par byas te/ mos pas zhing khams gsal btab pa'i dbus su rin po che'i khri rmad du byung ba la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la dpag tu med mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i cha byad chos gos gsum gsol zhing phyag mnyam bzhag be+eḍūr+ya yi lhung bzed bdud rtsis bkang ba snam pa/mtshan dpe yongs su rdzogs dbu yi gtsug tor bltar mi tshugs pa 'od zer mu mtha' med pa 'phro ba sku rgyab byang chub shing la phyogs te bzhugs pa/ sangs rgyas byang sems nyan thos 'phags pa tshad med pas bskor ba sgom la/mi mjed zhing 'dir bdag gi lus tha mal du gnas pas mgon po 'od dpag tu med pa la lus ma lnga sa la phabs pa'i phyag 'tshal bzhin rang gi lus rdul snyed du mos pas sprul pa dang 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyi phyag 'tshal bar bsam la/ na mo mañdzu shrī ye su hā/ na mo ut+ta ma shrī ye swā hā/ na maḥsu shrī ye swā hā/ zhes phyag brgya stong ji nus thun du bcad de 'bul ba ni thun phran dang po'o/ /yang mgon po 'od dpag med la sangs rgyas sum cu rtsa lngas bskor te bzhugs par bsam/ de'i spyan sngar bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang / khyad par tshe 'dir bsags pa'i sdig pa ji bgyis yid la dran par byas te/ 'gyod pa drag pos ngag nas 'thol zhing bshags pa dang / slad mar sdom sems bcas phung po gsum pa'i mdo zhes byang chub ltung bshags ci nus bklag nas sdig pa ji bgyis yid la dran par byas te/ 'gyod pa drag pos ngag nas mthol zhing bshags pa dang / slad mar sdom sems bcas phung po gsum pa'i mdo zhes byang chub ltung bshags ci nus bklag nas phyag 'tshal ba ni thun phran gnyis pa'o/ /de nas rang lus byang chub sems dpa' 'khor los bsgyur ba'i gzugs can lta bur mos bzang spyod nas byang chub yan lag bdun pa dmigs pa gsal bas tshar gang mang brjod pa ni thun phran gsum pa'o/ /de nas maṇ+ḍal gyi bya ba rang nyid ār+sā dzam+bha la lta bu gsal te/ phyi 'jig rten khams kyi lha ma'i dpal 'byor ma lus pa dang / nang rang gi dgra gnyen bar ma'i 'gro ba 'dod dgu'i longs spyod bcas pa dang / bar bdag gi lus srog tshe bsod nams 'dus dang 'dus ma byas pa'i dge tshogs bcas kha tsam ma yin pa snying thag pa nas mgon po 'od dpag med 'khor dang bcas pa la 'bul ba bsam te/ ngag tu/ bdag gzhan lus ngag yid gsum dus gsum dge tshogs bcas/ /rin chen maṇ+ḍal bzang po kun bzang mchod pa'i tshogs bcas 690

pa/ /blo yi dmigs nas bla ma dkon mchog rnams la 'bul/ /thugs rje'i dbang gi bzhes nas bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes sogs maṇ+ḍal gyi lugs dag tshig ji snyed pa brjod cing dmigs pa gsal bas 'bul ba thun phran bzhi pa'o/ /rang nyid dzam+bha yi lus dwangs shing gsal ba'i dbus su dbu ma rag dung kha gyen ston lta bu shel dwangs ma ltar rnyogs pa dang bral ba'i snying ga'i thad du rnam shes thig le dkar po shin tu 'tsher ba cog ka'i sgo nga tsam gcig gnas pa dang / bde ba can du sangs rgyas 'od dpag med pa'i mdun phyogs su rin po che'i pad+mo kha 'bus gcig kyang gsal/ de nas sngar bzhin yan lag bdun lan kha shas bya ba ni thun phran dang po'o/ /de nas sangs rgyas 'od dpag med pa'i dpral ba'i mdzod spu las 'od zer dkar po shel gyi spu gu lta bu zhig byung nas bdag gis lus de yi nang du chud pas dga' bde tshad med pa skyes par bsam pa thun phran gnyis pa'o/ /slar yang rgyal ba 'od dpag med kyi mdzod spu nas 'od zer phra grim rtse mo rno ba lcags kyu'i dbyibs can gcig sngar gyi 'od spug de yi nang nas tshur byung / rang gi tshang bug nas mar brgyud snying ga'i thig le'i la reg ma thag can gyi blo skad cig gi bde ba can du drangs nas mdun gyi pad+mo'i dbus su thig le zhugs shing 'od kyi spu gu yang rang yal/ lus kyi khog te je mtho je 'phel nam mkha' la song ste mchod pa'i sprin spung chen por gyur nas rgyal ba sras bcas mchod cing sems can rnams la zas skom gos sman 'bras bu ram rin po che yi char rgyun chad med par bab nas sdug bsngal ser bar bsam pa ni thun phran gsum pa'o/ /rang sems thig le'i rnam pa pad+ma'i spugs su zhugs pa de/ byang chub sems dpa'i lha yi bu mo'i gzugs mtshar sdug yid du 'ong ba zhig tu gyur cing / de ma thag sangs rgyas 'od dpag med pa'i 'od zer gyi reg pas pad+ma kha rab tu gyes te sangs rgyas kyi zhal dngos su 'jal bar bsam pa ni thun bran bzhi pa ste/thun chen gcig sbyor lam 'pho ba'i rim pa chos thun gnyis pa'o/ /rang nyid byang sems lha yi khye'u des sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med zhal mjal bas dga' ba dang bde sim pa dang / dad pa mos gus kyi shugs tshad med dpag tu med pa thob nas phyag 'tshal ba dang / sdig pa bshags pa dang / maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba/ yan lag bdun gyi bya ba rim par byas pa ni thun phran dang po'o/ / de nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med kyi phyogs glang po che'i rna ljang lta bu phyag mthil bkra shis pa'i ri mo brgya phrag gi gtam pa de/ bdag gi spyi bor bzhag nas rigs kyi bu khyod ring por mi thog par sems can gyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes bka' yi gnang ba byin pas rab tu dga' ba'i sa thob nas mtshan dpe'i rjes mthun pas spras par bsam pa ni thun phran gnyis pa'o/ /de nas rang gzhan gyi don tshad med pa 'grub la chog tu dga' ba chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med la 691

bka' drin ched du mchod sprin gyi mchod par bsam la/ mchod sprin gyi gzungs sngags tshar gsum gyi rjes su/ mdo dkon mchog ta la nas gsungs pa'i mchod tshig mchod yon phal che mchod yon bla bra dang / zhes pa sogs pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ me tog byin gyis rlabs pa'i sngags me tog phul bas me tog sangs rgyas kyi dbus gtsug tu gdug ltar 'khyil bar bsam pa ni thun phran gsum pa'o/ /de nas rang nyid gnas de las ma g.yos bzhin du sprul pa'i lus brgya phrag tu byas pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgya phrag zhugs nas sangs rgyas brgya la dgyes pa'i mchod pa spros zhing / sangs rgyas re re la ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo re re thob cing de snyom par 'jug pa dang ldang ba sogs yon tan brgya phrag 1du ma la dbang 'byor zhing sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin pa gtso bor spyod pas sems can brgya phrag mang po'i don byed par bsam pa thun phran bzhi pa ste/ de bzhi sdom pas thun chen gcig mthong lam dbugs dbyung gi rim pa chos thun gsum pa'o/ /'di yan chad zhing sbyong rtsa ba'i dmigs thun dngos yin no/ /rang nyid byang chub sems dpa' mtshan dpe rjes mthun pas brgyan pa bde ba can mgon po 'od dpag med kyi spyan sngar gnas pa gong ltar la sprul pa'i lus stong 2dang / de nas 'bum 3dang / de nas bye ba phrag brgya 4dang / stong 5dang /bye ba phrag 'bum 6dang / bye ba phrag phrag 7khrig gi bar thun go rim bzhin spros te/ de rnams sangs rgyas kyi zhing de snyed du 'jug cing / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong nas bye ba phrag khrid la/ mchod pa'i sprin gyis yongs su mchod pa'i mos 'dun rnam dag byas pas sangs rgyas rnams kyi phyag gi rang gi spyi bor byung nas byang chub mchog tu lung ston pas ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo stong nas bye ba phrag phrag khrig bar thob cing pha rol du phyin pa tshul khrims nas thabs kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i bar brtan pa lus mtshan dpe yang je gsal du song zhing sa gnyis pa dri ma med pa nas bdun pa ring du song ba'i bar thun go rim bzhin bsgom pa thun phran drug go/ /de nas rang gi lus mtshan dpes brgyan pa snga ma las ches khyad du 'phags pa sangs rgyas dang rjes su mthun pa las sprul pa stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams 'bum phrag gi rdul phrag rags dang mnyam pa dang / de nas 'jig rten khams grangs med 'bum phrag bcu yi rgyu ba 9phra rags dang / de nas phyogs bcu'i zhing khams brjod du med pa yang brjod du med rdul phrag rags kyi grangs dang mnyam pas 10sangs rgyas kyi zhing de snyed du sangs rgyas de snyed mnyes par byas shing /phyi ma'i skabs su byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas mchod cing / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'od zer chen pos dbang bskur ba dngos dang / snga ma gnyis la yang de dang phyogs mthun par bsam/dbang bskur ba po sangs rgyas de rnams yang / sngar sangs rgyas mchog gi sprul skur snang ba/ skabs 'dir rang gi sgrib pa spangs pa'i rim pas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yi chas dang / dngos dang mthar 692

thug pa nyid du mos par bya dgos la/ sems can gyi yang don 'grub tshul sangs rgyas dang rjes su mthun pa dang / mthun pa nyid dang ji bzhin mdzad pa smon lam dang stobs dang ye shes kyi pha rol phyin pa sa brgyad pa dang / dgu pa/ bcu pa rnams rim pas thob mos pa'i dmigs pa thun phran gsum mo/ /thun phran dgu po gcig tu bsdom pas thun chen gcig sgom lam sems la sbyangs pa'i rim pa ste chos thun bzhi pa'o/ /rang nyid mtshan dpe sangs rgyas dang cha mthun pa'i lus can zhing khams rab 'byams su sku yi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab dang ldan pa des byas pa med pa rang bzhin gyi mchod sprin kun tu bzang po'i smon lam las byung ba lta bu nam mkha'i khams yongs su khengs pas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ma lus lus pa med par mchod cing byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi smon lam las byung ba'i mchod pas rang — nyid la nye bar mchod pa dang bcas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dus gcig tu 'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur ba dang lhan cig par rdo rje'i lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi spang bya mtha' dag bcom ste mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i go 'phang brnyes pa'i sku'i cha bsam du med kyang gdul bya'i snang ngor tsam du gzugs kyi rang bzhin sangs rgyas 'od dpag med pa'i skur gyur pa de yang / bde ldan zhing gi bdag po dbyer med ro gcig pa chu chu dang mnyam pa bzhin du gyur nas gdul bya rnams la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba sogs mdzad pa 'phrin las rgya mkha' khyab rgyun dus ji srid du chad pa med par ston par bsam la sems ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag pa ni thar lam mi slob pa'i rgyal bzung ba ste chos mthun pa'o/ /chos thun phyi ma 'di gnyis lam tshang phyir gong gi 'phros su bkod pa ste/ 'bras bu la mos pas lam du byed pa'i phyir yon tan khyad par can gyi sa bon rgyas par byed pa'o/ /de rnams kyi pha rol phyin pa'i lam sngags phyi rgyud kyi phyogs dang mthun pa'i nyams len gyi bsnyen pa'i rim pa sprul pa'i sku lam du khyer tshul gyi skabs de dang po'o/ /de nas spyi don gnyis pa tshe dang ye shes 'od dpag tu med pa'i bsgom sgrub bstan pa la thun gyi thog mar skyabs sems ltar song mtshams yan lag bdun pa'i dmigs pa nan tan byas la mthar skyabs yul kun rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dus shing / de sangs rgyas 'od dpag med mchog gi sprul sku'i cha lugs can rang gi spyi bor byon te bzhugs par bsam la 'od dpag med kyi gzungs sngags bzla bar bya ste/ de yang / na mo rat+na tra yā yā/ na mo ār+ya a mi tā bhā ya/ ta thā ga ta ya/ arta te samyakle bud+dha ya/ tabya thā/ oṃ a mṛ te/ a mṛ tar+bha we/ a sbo ta saṃ bha we/ a bṛ ta gasne/ a bṛ ta sirnyi/ a skṛ te dze/ a bṛ ta bi kran+ta ga mi ne/ a mṛ ta ga ga na kisti ka re/ a sbo ta/ durtse bi su re sarba arba sā dha ne/sarba karma kle sha k+ṣa yam kā ri swā hā/ zhes gsal la dag par ci nus bzlas pas 'od dpag med pa'i sku 693

las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun byung / bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi spyi bor bab lus kyi phyi bkrus/tshangs bug nas nang du zhugs pas bdag gzhan gyi 'khor ba thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung mtha' dag sang sang dag cing rang gi lus nang gi sha khrag rus pa nang khrol thams cad 'og sgo nas phyir thon rim pa dgu'i 'og tu song zhing rang lus dri ma med pa shel gyi gang bur bsam la/ de nas bla ma'i dpral mgrin snying ka lte ba las dkar dmar thing ljang 'od zer thig le bar mi chad pa rang gi gnas bzhir thim pas dbang bzhi thob/ sgrib bzhi dag lam bzhi sbyangs/ 'bras bu sku bzhi thob par bsam/ mthar bla ma rang la thim/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med du sems ji gnas su mnyam par bzhag pa ni sbyor ba sngon du 'gro ba ste chos thun dang po'o/ /de nas dngos bzhi bskyed bzlas rdzogs gsum las/ dang po sku bskyed pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shurtseḥsarba dharma su bhā shu rnyo karma ko3 r+ghaṃ/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra su bha wa at+ma ko3rgyu/ zhes brjod gzung 'dzin gnyis bsdus kyi chos thams cad stong par gyur/ stong nyid rang gi rig pa snying rje sgyu ma lta bu'i rkyen la brten yi ge hriḥdamar du gyur/ de skad cig gi tshe dang ye shes 'od dpag med pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku kha dog dmar po pad+ma'i ra ga'i lhun po bye ba'i 'od 'phrog cing nyi zla phrag khrig zil gyi gnon pa mtshan dpe mchog tu 'bar ba zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyilangamo krung du pad+ma dang / nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs shing / phyag mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgyas 'chi med bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa dpag bsam shing yid bzhin nor bu'i 'bras bu can gyi kha rgyan can 'dzin pa dar dang rin po che'i rgyan du mas yongs su mjos shing zhal gyi dkyil 'khor gyi mtshon ba spu re yi khyon yang bskal pa rgya mtshor bltas kyang ngom pa med pa rang bzhin lhun gyi 'grub pa'i sku rang 'od kyi yum bde ba chen po longs spyod pa rnyog dang bral ba zla ba'i rgyab yol byas pa'i sku ru gsal btab ste/ sku yi cha shas phra rags la sems rim par bzung zhing goms nas sku yongs rdzogs la yid ma yengs par ji gnas su mnyam par bzhag pa ste chos thun gnyis pa'o/ /de nas gsung bzlas pa'i rim pa la rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gliḥgaser zhun ma lta bu de las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs dus rgyal ba ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i thugs rje byin rlabs tshe bcu dang lhan cig 'byung ba lnga khams gsum dwangs ma thams cad dngos grub kyi tshul du bsdus te rang la thim par bsam la tshe'i snying po 'di lta ste/ oṃ s+dzar+ghaṃ trīḥbadz+ra a yu ṣe hūṃ rgyu dz+ra dzaḥsirnyi pha la rgyu āḥzhes yid ma yengs par ji nus su bzlas pa ste/ de yi phan yon ni ji skad du/ zhags re la ni brgya rtsa bzlas/ /de ltar rgyun tu bzlas gyur na/ /tshe srog yun du bstan par 'gyur/ /'das tshe nub phyogs bde ba can/ /'od dpag med kyi spyan sngar skye/ /'di la the tshom yod re kan/ /zhes gsungs so/ chos thun 694

gsum pa'o/ /de nas thun rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ rang gi snying gar pad+ma dmar po la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de la bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes 'od dpag tu med yab yum kha sbyor bde ba chen po'i sku
