rdo rje dang pad+ma'i skyil krung gi bzhugs pa zla ba chu shel dbang po ltar dkar ba las kyang ches dkar ba mnyam bzhag tshe bum bsnams pa/ longs sku'i rgyan cha byad rdzogs pa gsal btab 'jam rlung bum pa can bzung bas yab yum sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi'i dkar dmar 'dres pa drod ba yi 'o ma 'jog ma thag pa tsam bab nas lus kyi nang thams cad mer gyi gang ba'i zer ma ba spu'i bu ga zla ba la rdo rje phyed pa phra mo 'ba' zhig pas gtam shing / zab gsal bde ba che po'i ye shes yang dag rgyud la skyes par bsam/rlung bum can la ci nus su 'bad/ thar rnam par rtog pa gsum bral ba rang rig dmigs med rang bab gnyug ma so ma lhug par ji gnas su mnyam par bzhag pa'o/ /de'i phan yon yang 'di skad ces/nad gdon tshe yi bar chod ni: dus gsum kun tu 'byung mi 'gyur: dus min tshe yi bar chod ni:'byung ba'i dwangs ma 'khrugs pa yis: tshe yis bar chod byed pa yin: de bas dmigs pa 'di bsgom na: rgyun du 'byung ba mi 'khrugs pas: lo brgya'i bar du 'chi mi 'gyur: zhes pa ste chos thun bzhi pa'o/ /mthar snod kyi 'jig rten bde ba can gyi zhing dang bcud sems can kun tshe dang ye shes 'od dpag tu med pa/ sgra grags thams cad gzhom du med pa tshe yi rang sgra/ dran rtog thams cad rang grol chos nyid gnyug ma'i ngang du skyong zhing skabs su 'od gsal 'jug ljang yang bya la/ mtshan mo nyal ba'i skabs rang gi snying 'od kyi gong bu'i dbus su thig le me long lta bu rnyog pa med pa shin tu dang ba'i nang du bde ba can gyi zhing gzugs brnyan ltar gsal ba'i dbus su tshe 'od dpag med kyi sku gsal btab ste sems ma yengs par yang yang bslab/ rmi lam du bde ba can gyi zhing blta bar bya'o snyam pa'i 'dzin stang yang nan tan byas rmi lam du bde ba can gyi zhing dang sangs rgyas tshe 'od dpag med pa mjal bar gyur te/ lam gyi khyer so rjes kyi rim pa nyal ba'i rnal gyi chos thun lnga'o/ /de ltar chos thun lnga po des ni sngags bla med dang mthun pa'i nyams len nang bsgrub rim pa sangs rgyas longs spyod pa'i rdzogs pa'i sku mos pas lam du byed pa'i tshul ste skabs gnyis pa'o/ /da ni spyi don gsum pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa dngos nyams su len pa la/ thun gyi thog mar skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa sgrib sbyangs dbang bzhi blang ba rnams gong ltar byas shing / bsam gtan gyi gdan la lus chos bdun ldan du bcas te/ ngag rlung ro lan gsum du gsal rjes rlung rang bab tu bzhag sgo mig phyed bkab phyed blta g.yo 'gul med par/yul sprin bral gyi nam mkha' 'am/ gseng med kyi mun yang ste/ de la sems yul la dmigs gtad med pa'i lhug pa/ bsgom bya dang bral ba'i tha mal/ bcas bcos med pa'i gnyug ma/ lung ma bstan dang 695

rnam rtog gi bskyod pa'i mtha' spangs pa'i so ma ste mtshan nyid bzhi ldan gyi ngang du mnyam par bzhagade ltar yun ring du bsgom pas/ snang snyam dang shes snyam gsum gyi mi khyab pa 'char ba/ de kun yang dga' spro snyem 'phrig med par rig pa'i rang mdangs su shes bzhin lam du khyer ba ste chos thun dang po'o/ /de nas rang nyid bcom ldan 'das tshe 'od dpag tu med pa'i sku snang la rang bzhin ma grub pa me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bur gsal la rlung ro lan gsum du gsal nas dbugs rang bab tu bzhag pa'i nang du tub tshe oṃ dkar po 'od zer dang bcas pa sna bug g.yas pa nas zhugs/ khong du gnas pa'i skabs āḥdamar po 'od zer 'phro bzhin lte bar snang ba dang / phyir dbyung tshe r+ghaṃ mthing ka 'od zer dang bcas sna bug g.yas nas thon pa la yid ma yengs rtse gcig tu byas pas/ yon tan khyad par 'phags pa rnams rgyud la skye bar 'gyur te chos thun gnyis pa'o/ /yang rang nyid tshe 'od dpag med sku yi nang dbus su rtsa a wa sgro ti phyi dkar nang dmar/ srab dngas rnyog pa med pa mda' skug 'bring po tsam yar sne tshangs pa'i sgo/ mas sna lte 'og sor brgyad du bstan cing shin tu drang ba/ yas sna la nye bar trīḥdakar mgo bo'i thur du bstan pa/ lte 'og sor bzhi'i mtshams su trīḥdamar po/ snying kar trīḥmathing ka rnam gsal zhing / rlung bzung ba dbu ma'i mas sna nas zhugs te/ trīḥyig dmar po la phog pas gtum mo'i me 'bar/ snying ga'i trīḥphug spyi bo'i trīḥl reg pas/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung snying ga'i trīḥl phog gzi 'od shin tu 'bar zhing / de las rgyud bdud rtsi'i rgyun lte ba'i trīḥl bab pa'i 'bar 'dzag skra shad 'dzings pa lta bur mtshams med pa la sems gtad bzhin rlung sbyor ji nus dang lung sbyong yang bya la/ thun mthar rnam par mi rtog pa'i nam mkha' ltar rgya yan du bzhag pa ste chos thun gsum pa'o/ /rang nyid tshe 'od dpag med du gsal ba'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' trīḥyig dang bcas pa skabs gnyis par bshad bzhin gsal btab sems ci gnas su bzung / de nas rang gi gdan rgyab yol rgyan cha rnams sku la thim/ lha sku yang me long la has btab pa dbus su 'dus pa ltar snying ka'i ye shes sems dpa' la thim/ ye shes sems dpa' yi rgyan sogs sku dang / sku thugs ka'i trīḥyig la thim/ de yi rnam bcad ra yig dang de ha/ de gi gu la thim/ de nā da'i rang bzhin du je phra je phra shin tu phra ba skra rtse brgya stong gi tshad tsam nas yal bar bsam la sems dmigs med spros bral ngang du ci nus bzhag slar yang sngar ltar sku sems dpa' gsum brtsegs su gsal nas yang bsdud pa la gong bzhin yang nas yang du bslab pa ni ril 'dzin gyi 'od gsal stong pa nyid du bsdud pa ste chos thun bzhi pa'o/ /yang sngar bzhin sems dpa' gsum brtsegs su gsal ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' trī las 'od zer 'phros ye shes sems dpa' la phog shin tu tsher ba'i sku de yi 'od zer gyis dam tshig sems dpa' 696

la phog rab tu gsal ba'i 'od kyi 'jig rten khams khyab snod thams cad rang bzhin rnam dag 'od gsal dag pa'i zhing khams/ bcud kyi sems can tshe dang ye shes 'od dpag tu med par gyur cing / de nas zhing khams lha sku la thim/ lha sku dam tshig sems dpa' la thim/ de ye shes sems dpa' nas nā da stong par yal ba dmigs med spros bral du bzhag pa ril 'dzin skabs ltar dang / slar 'od gsal las lha skur ldang zhing / yang 'jug pa yang yang du bslab pa ni spro ba dang bcas pa'i bsdud rim rjes gzhig 'od gsal stong nyid kyi rnal 'byor ste chos thun lnga pa'o/ /de ltar chos thun lnga ni sngags bla na med pa'i man ngag rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi gsang ba las la sbyar ba chos kyi sku lam du byed pa'i rim pa ste skabs gsum pa'o/ /skabs gsum po de re res kyang khrid bka' tshang ba yin pas so so'i blo dang mthun par gang 'od dum dum du 'chad pa dang / rim pa gsum ka dril bas khrid kyi lus mtha' rgyas su 'gyur zhing / khrid rim dang po'i skabs thog mtha' gang bde tu 'od dpag med pa bkod pa mdo zhes bam po gsum pa bklags shing don dkrol nas phan yon gyi spro ba skye ba dang / bde ba can du bskyed pa'i las sems bskyed 'gyur ba bcur gsung ba ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku bsnyen gtsug lag khang dang / sangs rgyas kyi bka' glegs bam dang / ring sel gsum gang rigs bzhugs pa'i mchod rten ste/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten/ sems can spyi la phan pa bsam pa/ bye brag srog bslu/ de lnga rang gi bsgrub pa dang /gzhan la bskul ba gnyis su phyes pas bcu yin no/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyas mthong ba dang mi bral ba'i las brgyad ni/ klu yi rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa las/ klu yi bdag po chos brgyad dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnams sangs rgyas mthong ba dang mi 'brel bar mi 'gyur te/ brgyad gang zhe na 'di lta ste/sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa yid la byed pa'am1/ de bzhin gshegs pa la bsnyen bskur dang mchod pa byed 2pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsngags pa rgyun du brjod pa 3dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs byad du 'jug po 4dang / de bzhin gshegs pa blta bal yang dag par 'dzud pa 5dang /sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang na de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs pa thos pa der skye bar smon lam 'debs 6pa dang / rgyud zhum pa med cing rgya chen po mos pa 7dang / sangs rgyas kyi ye shes 'dod pa 8ste/ klu yi bdag po chos brgyad po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnams sangs rgyas mthong ba dang bral bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa la bsnyen bkur dang mchod pa byed pa ni/ dus skabs 'dir sangs rgyas kyi ring sel byang chub shing ngam/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rten la mchod pa 'bul ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi dus chen skabs su dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa sogs 697

sangs rgyas pa'i las su dmigs pa mtha' dag yin no/ /khrid rim phyi ma dag pa'i skabs su/ ldang ba dang khrus dang / gos bgo ba dang / kha zas/ 'gro sdod nyal ba rmi lam gyi rnal 'byor yang thun mong dang /thun mong ma yin pa spyi ltar shes pa dang / chos thun la thug pa'i thog mar skyabs sems dang mthar tshogs rdzogs byang su bsngo smon gyi rgyas theb par bya la/ dus kun nyin snang thams cad sgyu ma ltar shes shing rmi lam ngo shes pa dang / srid pa bar do yin pa'i mos stang dang / srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyi yid dub cing / mi rtag 'chi ba snying nas dran pas 'di snang gi zhen pa ldog pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung la yid ches pas las 'bras kyi 'dor len bslab sdom spyi dang bla ma'i mos gus stobs su gyur pa dang / le lo'i dbang du ma song bar dam pa'i chos la shin tu brtson pa rnams ni lam rim spyi'i chos te 'bad par gdams bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ rgyal ba'i zhing mchog bdag po/ /chos kyi rdo rje'i sgrub thabs//phun tshogs dpal kun 'byung gnas/ /'chi med lam 'di rmad byung / /kun tu dge legs stsol mdzad lha mchog /tshe 'od dpag med lam rim bshad 'di/ /dge bas sems can dpal mgon dbang phyug /byang chub nor bu myur thob gyur shog /zhes tshul 'di ni 'jig rten mgon pos byin gyis brlabs pa rtsod dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa nges don gyi bdag nyid chen po si tu rin po che chos kyi 'byung gnas zhabs kyi bka' yi bskul ba la brten rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yul dus gdul bya'i snang ngo dang mtshams par rdo rje slob dpon gyi skur sprul pa rig 'dzin rgyud pa'i zhal lung las byon pa la rung mthun man ngag gi kha bskang ste khrid kyi gzhung rang rkang tshugs pa nyid du rig pa 'dzin pa rgyal khams pa tshe dbang nor bus gangs ri'i khrod kyi grub pa'i rgyan gyur ras pa mi la yab sras kyi bsgrub gnas mnga' ri gung thang ra la za 'og phug tu dkar po'i lo sbo zla'i yar tshes rgyal ba gnyis par dbu brtsam la rgyal khams pas gsung pa'i thun mtshams su grub par sbyar ba'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ / 698

༄sto /dpal phyag rgya chen po rang babs kyi man ngag ga'u ma'i rtsa sdom sa bcad zhib mor smos pa rgyal ba'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo ma hā mu dra ya/ rigs kun khyab bdag sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang / /dbyer med bla ma'i zhabs la phyag byas te/ /rgyal kun bgrod cing phyag rgya chen po'i lam/ /kun gyi yang snying grub pa che rnams kyi/ /ga'ur bcang pa bla med rgyud sde'i srog /khrid kyi rkang sdom gzhan la phan slad bri/ /de la sngon du 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis/ /sngon 'gro spyir btang dal 'byor rnyed dka' dang / /mi rtag 'chi dran 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam/ /las 'bras bslu med thar pa'i phan yon bcas1/ /skyabs su 'gro ba byang chub sems bskyed ste2/ /'di rnams chos kyi sngon du 'gro ba yin/ /dag byed a yi steng ra gsol 'debs dang / /sgrib sel 3nad 4sel gdo 5na sel rtags tshad bcas/ /byin rlabs bcud len bla ma'i rnal 'byo 6ra ni/ /brten bskyed maṇ+ḍal gsol 'debs dbang blangs stim7/ /de ni thun min khyad par sngon 'gro ste/ /de yan sdom pa sngon 'gro'i rim pa grub/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la yang sbyor dngos rjes/ /ston pa'i chad du rdul mtshon dkyil 'khor la/ /'khor lo'i bdag po gsal zhing brten byas nas/ /phyag rgya chen po'i byin rlabs sgo dbye dbang / /phyi nang gsang tshang ma nor bskur ba'i thabs/ /sbyor ba lus ngag yid kyi rang bab gsum/ /thun gsum yang ni thun gcig nyid du bstan/ /'di ni sems 'khrid rtsa ba lta bu yin/ /de nas sems gnas pa dang sems tshol ba/ /zhi gnas lhag mthong khrid rim gnyis yin te/ /dang po dag dang ma dag sems 'dzin dang / /lta stang steng 'og g.yas g.yon dbus thad ka/ /ring thung byas pas lta stang rnam pa bcu/ /kha thon thugs rin ring po che rigs bzhi/ /spyod lam sna tshogs zas za gtam smra ba/ /'gro ba dal ran bral ba nye ring drug /'chag dang nyal ba gnyis te sdom pas bcu/ /de bzhin tshor ba bde sdug bar ma gsum/ /dben dang tshogs su yun du sbyangs byas nas/ /zhi gnas nyams kyi rkang pa tshugs pa gces/ /gnyis pa skyabs sems bla ma'i rnal 'byor rjes/ /rang bab gsum dang rig pa'i rang zhal blta/ /de nas sems ngo blta dang rnam rtog 'tshal/ /dang por ngo bo gnas yul skye 'gag 'tshol/ /gnyis pa rtogs tshogs nyid dang yul la dpyad/ /de ltas lhag mthong sems nyid gtan la phab/ /de ltar sbyor bar grags pa nyams len gnas/ /ne gu zhabs nas sngon 'gror ston zhes grags/ /spyi don gnyis pa dngos gzhi ngo sprod par/ /bar chad mi 'byung 699

byin brlab 'jug pa'i phyir/ /bla ma mgon por maṇ+ḍal me tog phul/ /phur tshugs gsol 'debs lus gnad lta stang bcas/ /de nas skyon bzhi rang grol ngo sprad de/ /nye grags ngo ma shes pa'i skyon grol ba/ /stong gsal ngo bzung bral ba'i sems nyid sprad/ /de bzhin bzang grags blor ma shong ba'i skyon/ /zab grags ngos ma zin dang sla grags pas/ /yid ma ches pa'i skyon rnams rang grol bas/ /gshis lugs chos sku ngo shes 'gyur med dang / /dran pa rgyun 'chang rten pa'i man ngag bstan/ /spyi don gsum pa rjes dang rjes shes gnyis/ /dang po sku gsum rang bzhin ngo sprod cing / /gnyis par bogs dbyung ba dang gegs sel gnyis/ /dang por mos gus snying rje'i thabs lam gsum/ /gsum par shes pa lha sku zung 'jug rlung / /bsre ba gsum gyi sngags kyi phyag chen bsgrub/ /gegs sel nyams la gsum dang rtogs pa gsum/ /tshul des rjes kyi rim pa'i khrid rkang rdzogs/ /de yang slob ma'i nyams rtogs skye rim bzhin/ /myong ldan bla mas khrid tshul mkhas bya la/ /dmigs pa'i grangs nges mtha' gcig nges bzung med/ /'on kyang rgyud ldan bla ma'i phyag bzhes rgyun/ /ma mnyam rgyas sdus ji ltar 'tshams pa ru/ /bstan las rang bzo'i 'phri bsnan spangs byas shing / /rtsa ba'i rgya las 'da' bar mi bya phyir/ /bla ma'i man ngag gsung rgyun yi ger bkod/ /de ltar mdo rgyud dgongs bcud khyad par can/ /ne gu su kha sirnyi me tri pa'i/ /man ngag phyag rgya chen po'i ga'u zhes/ /grub chen khyung po'i gces nor rmog cog par/ /rtsal las mnyam med sgam po'i phyag rgya che/ /gnas lugs gnyug ma'i bcud kyang yongs sbyar te/ /mkhas grub bye ba'i bste gnas ngo mtshar mchog /rmad byung chos gang rtsa ba'i sa bcad tshul/ /kun mkhyen bla ma sgrol ba'i mgon po yi/ /bzhed pa ji bzhin 'di ru smras pa ste/ /'on kyang de la nyes pa mchis pa na/ /dpang gyur la bzod nyes med dbyugs dbyung stsol/ /dge mchis nam mkha' mtha' mnyam 'gror bsngo bas/ /de mthus bla ma'i byin rlabs snying la zhugs/ /skyon bzhi rang grol lhan skyes phyag rgya che/ /rang gsal bde chen myur du mngon byed shog /zhes pa'ang dbus kyi stod lung gi sa yi cha dbon ston skyer sgang pa chos kyi seng ge'i thugs dam 'bum pa la zhig gso bgyis skabs su rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus bris pa ste me 'brug snron zla'i tshes lnga la'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/ dza ga tai/ dge'o/ /dge'o/ / dmigs rkang sngon 'gro dngos gzhi gnyis ka sdom pas lnga bcu rtsa brgyad yod la rtsa sdom 'di la tshig bcad nyi shu rtsa gnyis la phyed kyi lhag pa'o/ /sarba maṅga lo/ /700

༄ga /phyag chen ga'u ma'i khrid yig sa bon tsam gyur bdud rtsi'i thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo ma hā mu dra ya/ rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi sku dri ma med pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ skyabs su mchi'o/ /byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rnam kun mchog ldan rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /zab zhi spros bral 'dus ma byas pa'i chos/ /gang shar phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bo nyid/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal/ /rgyal ba yongs kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ /grub gyur skyes bu kun gyi 'byung khungs che/ /mdo rgyud ma lus snying por gyur pa'i chos/ /gnas lugs phyag rgya che zhes yongs su grags/ /chos kun rtsa ba sems kyi gnas lugs nyid/ /gtan la phab byed yin ces rgyal ba sras/ /slob mar bcas pa kun gyi rab bsngags pa/ /de don ji bzhin lam 'dir cis mi gus/ /des na 'di ru gdul bya'i bsod nams dang / /rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i 'jug pa yongs snang ba'i/ /rang shar phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag che/ /rdo rje 'chang gi zhabs lung khyad par can/ /grub gyur rnam pa gsum gyi thugs kyi bcud/ /rnal 'byor khyung po'i gcer chos ga'u ma/ /rmad byung gdams pa'i snying khu mchog de yi/ /khrid yig sa bon tsam zhig 'dir bkod bya/ /de ltar phyag rgya chen po ga'u mi gdams pa nyams su len pa la/sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum las/ dang po sngon 'gro la yang thun mong dang thun mong ma yin gnyis/ thun mong du spyir 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du shes shing / de las grol ba thar pa ste de'i mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob 'dod dang / de sgrub pa'i rten dal 'byor mi lus shin tu rnyed par dka' la/ de mi rtag shing myur du 'jig cing g.yo bas yid brtan med par bsam pa ste/ dam pa'i lha chos snying nas dran par byed pa la/ 'di dag shin tu gal che bas bstan pa spyi'i lam rim te/ des na nyin re bzhin thun gyi grangs su bzung nas bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar 'khor ba las sgrol ba'i lam gyi 'jug sgo ni/ skyabs 'gro dang yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i rgyu byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed ste/ de la 'dir skyabs kyi mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo rang gi rtsa ba'i bla mar yongs su dmigs pa yin la/ gzhan yang dam pa'i chos 'phags dge 'dun/ yi dam lha mkha' 'gro chos skyongs thams cad 'dus par bsam nas/ bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyi byang chub snying po'i bar/ de la skyabs su 'gro bar zhe thag pa nas 'dun pa dang / mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad pha mar shes nas snying brtse ba yis/ de dag 701

sangs rgyas sar bkod phyir bdag sangs rgyas bsgrub pa dang / dge tshogs bsngo shing dbugs kyi dge sdig btang len lhan du bsgom pa ste/ de yan thun mong sngon 'gro'o/ /gnyis pa la/ dag byed a yi stong rar dang byin rlabs bla ma'i rnal 'byor gnyis/ dag byed stong rang spyi bor bla ma bsgom nas nan tan gyi gsol 'debs gsum byas bla ma rang la bstem/ mgo stong ra chu'i sbu ba lta bu'i nang du chos 'byung dkar po/ de dbus a dkar bsam/ a brjod pas de la bdud rtsi dkar pos rang lus sbyangs bkrus khengs nas sdig sgrib thams cad dag par bsam/ de bzhin tsha grang rlung nad la bdud rtsi dkar dmar ser pos sbyangs pa dang / gdon la khro chu me bdag mtshon cha yis sbyangs par bsam la/ kun gyi mthar dmigs med bzhag bla ma'i rnal 'byor rang yi dam snang stong gi spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sku'i rnam pa de ka'am rdo rje 'chang bde bsgom la/ yan lag bdun 'bul zhing gsol 'debs bzhi yis phur tshugs su gsol ba btab nas/ tshar gsum khug pa'i dbang blang mthar bla ma rang la bstem nas gnas lugs dang mnyam pa bzhag cing dge ba bsngo'o/ /des thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro grub/ spyi don gnyis pa dngos gzhi la yang sbyor ba rang babs rnam gsum/ dngos gzhi skyon bzhi rang grol/ rjes sku gsum rang shar khrid dang gsum las/ dang po rang bab la yang / sems gnas dang sems tshol gyi khrid sam/ zhi gnas lhag mthong gi khrid zhes kyang bya la/ dang po la skyabs sems bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'jur ba cig byas rjes/ lus rang babs rnam snang chos bdun/ ngag rlung ro gsal ba tsam ma rtogs pa bcos rang babs/ sems yul la gtad pa dang tshur nang du bltas nas sgrim pa lta bu yin par ma bcos rang babs su bzhag par bya ba ni rtsa ba ni/ de las rnam rtog thos skyes sbad gcod/ ngo bo la blta ba/ 'phro 'du la blta ba/ dran pa'i rtsis bzung ba rnams gang bde gnad du 'gro ba de byed/ 'di dus skyo shas dang sems mi dga' ba/ dga' yal sogs gang byung bzo bcos dang / ngag sgrub med par de ga'i ngo bor bltas te skyong bas mthar sems nyid gshis su rang dngas 'gro ba yin/ de dag gi skabs su lta stang la bslab par/ steng 'og thad ka g.yas g.yon/ de thag nye ring byas pa bcu dang / de nas sngags bzla mdo 'don la bslab pa/ sngags dang mdo thung ngu ring po gnyis/ spyod lam la bslab pa/zas za ba/ gtam phar smra ba/ tshur nyan pa/ de bzhin 'gro ba/ dal bral/ 'chag dang nyal ba/ gcig pu dang mang po'i gseb rnams su sems kyi rang ngo la ma yengs par bskyangs nas dge sbyor gyi rtsal 'don pa yin/ de yan sems gnas par byed pa zhi gnas kyi khrid do/ /gnyis pa sems 'tshol ba lhag mthong gi khrid/ sngon du skyabs sems bla ma'i gsol 'debs gong ltar/ rjes rang babs rno gsum ngang la/ chad gtad kyi bsgrim pa yin pa'i sems kho rang kho rang gi ngo 702

bor che re bltas nas bsgom nas nam zhig na sems kyi gnas lugs rig pa stong gsal brjod las 'das pa gcig 'char ba yin/ de la dge sbyor skyes pa zhes bya 'di sems 'tshol thams cad kyi rtsa ba lta bu ste/ gang zag dbang po rim pas nyams rtogs ci rigs par skyed thon yong ba yin/ gzhan sems kyi ngo bo la tshur bltas pa lta bus/ de la dbyibs kha dog dang / mthong thos reg bya'i dngos por grub ma grub la yang legs par bltas pas stong pa'i gshis lugs go ba tshod 'jog min pa gtan phab/ de bzhin lus phyi nang gi cha/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya sogs la ji ltar gnas dang / de dag la mi gnas na/ rig rig po tsam du snang ba'i sems ji bzhin 'dug legs par brtag pa dang / yang sems 'di skye 'gag 'dug gam mi 'dug dang / rnam rtog gi mtshan nyid dang / 'khrul snang gi mtshan nyid ji ltar bgyi legs par dpyad nas/ sems nyid kyi ngo bo skye 'gag gnas bral du gtan la phab pa ste/ de rnams sems tshol lhag mthong khrid zhes bya'o/ /don gnyis pa dngos gzhi skyon bzhi rang grol du ngo sprad pa ni/thog mar maṇ+ḍal phul zhing rgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol ba phur tshugs su btab nas lus gnad lta stang bcas mnyam par bzhag nas ngo sprad pa dngos nye grags nas ngo ma shes/ zab grags nas ngo ma zin/ sla grags nas yid ma ches/ bzang grags nas blor ma shong ba'i skyon bzhi sel ba ste/ dang po ni sems kyi ngo bo ngos bzung med pa rig stong bde bar 'char ba 'khor ba thog med nas bral ma myong yang yal gas sdong po sgrib pa bzhin gzung 'dzin gyi skyon dang / mi spyang grung 'jom pa dang / dge bshes pu ti mang por thos pa byas pa tsho yang ha re long du gyur rang res ni bla ma'i byin rlabs rang gi mos gus/ gdam ngag gi lde rtse nang du bsgyur ba gsum gyis yin lugs gong du bshad pa de tshul bzhin ngo shes pas/ nye grags nas ngo ma shes pa'i skyon las grol/ gnyis pa ni sems nyid gsal stong 'dzin med du shar ba 'di 'chad pa dang / spyir dus dang rnam pa thams cad du sems 'od gsal ba'i gnas lugs kyi ngo bor 'gyur med rtag par yod la/ bye brag tu gnyid dang pho mo 'khrig sbyor ba'i skabs su yod kyang ngos ma zin pa las/ 'dir bya mas ngo sprad la brten/ de ltar gyi yin lugs shes pas zab grags nas ngos ma zin pa'i skyon las grol lo/ /gsum pa ni/ de ltar sems kyi ngo bo spros bral gsal stong rjen par 'char ba de kha brten pa thob par byed pa ste/ de yang gnas lugs de ka'i rang ngo bzo med rtag tu skyong bas sla ches nas yid ma ches pa'i skyon las grol lo/ /bzhi pa ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi sku zhes bya ba ni/ sems gsal la ngos bzung med pa spros pa'i mtha' las 'das pa'i dbyings 'di ka las gzhan nam yang med kyi de ma yin pa'i stong pa thog med dam/ gsal snang rgya chen po'am de nas khyab che ba lta bu zhig med kyi/ de dag ni kun rdzob rgyu 703

rkyen gyi rten 'brel tsam yin la/ chos kyi sku ni sems nyid kyi gnas lugs da lta ngo sprad pa 'di las bzang ba zhig gzhan nas 'tshol du med par kho thag chod pa ni/ bzang grags nas blor ma shong ba'i skyon las grol lo/ /de ltar skyon bzhi rang grol te/ de yang rang gi blo mthus snying por dril nas sems kyi ngo bo gzhi med rtsa bral du ngo 'phrod/ de'i yin lugs rang ngo shes tsam pas ngo bo ngos zin de ma yengs dran bskyangs bas yid ches de sems nyid chos sku'i gnas lugs su thag chod pa dang bzhir 'du'o/ /de dag dngos gzhi'i skyon bzhi rang grol gyi khrid do/ /don gsum pa rjes sku gsum rang shar gyi ngo sprod ni rnam bzhag tsam las dbyer med zung 'jug tu snang ba ni longs skur rang shar te/ de ltar sku gsum kyang rang bzhin gyi rang shar gdod nas rang bzhin gyi gnas lugs las gsar du bcos nas byung ba yang ma yin la/ da phyin chad de mngon du gyur pas na rang shar zhes bya'o/ /da ni spyi don gsum pa rjes shes lam du byed pa'i rims pa la/ bogs 'don pa dang / gegs gsal ba gnyis dang po la yang gsum/ thog mar mos gus khyad par can gyi bogs 'don ni/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i mos gus gdung shugs drag tu bskyed cing sku'i rnam pa spyi bo snying ga sogs lus kyi gnad dang /bzhugs gnas sam dag pa'i zhing khams/ yang na mkha' khyab tu shes nas gsol ba phur tshugs gdab nas bla ma'i snang ba mos gus kyi blo sna rnams la ce re bltas nas rang shar phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la bzhag pas nam zhig phyag chen gyi ngo bo bla ma'i mos gus shar ba ste/ mos gus phyag rgya chen por grags pa de yong ba yin/ 'di ni med thabs med pa'i bogs 'don tsam du ma zad/ gsang sngags yongs kyi srog rtsa lags pas ci kyang 'bad pa'i gnas so/ /gnyis pa tshad med pa'i snying rjes bogs 'don pa ni/ thog mar rtsa ba'i bla ma drin bzo'i snying po skyes nas de dag phyag rgya chen po ngo bor bskyang nas snying rje dang tha mi dad du yong bar bya/ des rigs 'dres rim pas rgya che bar bslab nas mkha' khyab bar du snying rje sgom pas/ phyag chen gyi ngo bo snying rjer shar ba ni/ snying rje phyag rgya chen po zhes bya'o/ /gsum pa thabs khyad par can gyi bogs 'don pa ni/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshigs gsal las/ tha mal shes pa rlung dang bsre/ /sna tshogs ma rig 'gags par 'gyur/ /lha sku gsal stong rlung dang bsre/ /rtogs pa yar ngo bzhin du 'gyur/ /zung 'jug shes pa rlung dang bsre/ /sku gsum lo zla tsam gyi 'grub/ zhes don du bcad pa las/ dang po ni/ dmigs byas kyi spros pa gzhan med par sems ngos bzung bral ba'i gsal stong ngang du rlung bum pa can bzung bas sems kyi gzhon pa las rlung 'gags nas mig gnyis gsal ba rig pa 'od gsal gyi byung ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ lha sku gsal ba dang sems ngos bzung bral ba'i stong pa gdod nas zug tu snang ba de rlung bum can bzung bas yang dag pa'i rtogs pa zab gsal gyi ngo bo gong 704

'phel du 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa ni/ gsal cha lha sku la gnas lugs stong nyid spros bral/ rang mdangs bde ba chen pos rgyas btab cing rlung bum can bsgom pas mthar zab gsal bde ba sku gsum gyi ngo bo myur du 'grub pa ste/ 'dis ni sngags kyi phyag rgya chen po rtsod pa med pa dngos grub pa yin no/ /gnyis pa gegs gsal nyams kyi cha dang / rtogs pa'i cha gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bde gsal mi rtogs par zhen pa ste/ /de la dgag sgrub med par rang bab du skyong ba'o/ /gnyis pa chos kun rnam rtog gi rang grol stong nyid du shar bas dge sdig 'dor len g.yel zhing / snying rje dang mos gus ma skyes pa rnams yin pas/ snying rje mos gus gnad du bsnun pa'o/ /de ltar phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag shin tu ces pa ga'u ma yi dmigs rkang gi snying po dril nas bstan pa ste/ de mdor bsdus na yengs pa'i dran pa zin tsam las/ gud du gnas lugs phyag rgya chen por dmigs yul du grub pa'i bsgom pa med pa cir snang phyag rgya chen por shar ba'o/ /de rtogs pa rtsa ba'i bla ma'i byin rlabs kho na yin rtsa ba'i bla ma mi dges med gang dgyes sgrub dgos pa gzhir bzhag dus rtag tu snying gi dkyil nas sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus shing sangs rgyas las kyang lhag pa'i mos gus kyi nyin mtshan med par gsol ba gdab pa ni med thabs med pa ste sngags chos kyi rtsa ba der thug de'i grogs su sems can snying rje bsgom pa yang theg chen lam gyi rtsa ba'o/ /de nas bla ma'i mos gus sems can la snying rje/ gnas lugs phyag rgya chen por shar ba 'di gsum la rab tu 'bad pa'i chos zhes gal po cher gdam pa ste/ gzhan mtha' dag ni yi ge lam du bri ga la lang / spyir yang zab mo nang gi gnad rnams dpe bshar bklag tsam gyis don ston pa ma yin la rtsa ba'i bla ma mtshan nyid ldan pa'i zhal lung nyan pa dang byin rlabs kyi 'pho ba thob pa kho na yin no/ /zhes pa yang shes par bya'o/ /de ltar phyag rgya chen po'i gdams pa ni/ /rmad du grub pa'i zhal lung ga'u ma'i/ /khrid yig rnam grangs du mar snang ba las/ /'dir ni snying po mdor len byang tshul/ /rang dang las mthun 'gu ba bskyed bslad du/ /rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus bkod pa yin/ /mdo sngags thos bsam thar rigs rgyud tsam/ /tshul bzhin bsgom na mthar 'bras myur du 'grub/ /gzhan glu sgra tshad rtog ge'i rig pa dang / /khe grags gyis slad thos rgyas ci zhig bya/ /deng sang snyigs dus tshe thung myur du 'chi/ /phyag chen bsgom mdzod kho bos gros chen gdab/ /de ltar bdag blo dag pas smras pa 'dir/ /dge mchis 'gro bsngo nyes tshogs bla mar bshags/ /'khor ba ji srid dam pa'i chos 'di gnas/ /de yis ma lus kun bzang sar bkod shog /ces tshul 'di la mos pa du ma yis dus ring mo smrengs shing nye bar yongs kyi 'dren mchog gangs can mgon po'i lag na pad dkar chang ba ngur smrig gar gyi rol pa'i sku gong zhabs bdun pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mor bsnyen pa'i rim 'gro bas nan tan chen po bskul ba la brten/ thaḥthog sprul ltar brjod pa rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang ha cang gi mi ring ba/ zhang 'gro ba'i mgon po'i gdan sa gung thang 705

pyer chen po'i bum par sa rta snron zla'i dmar phyogs kyi tshes bcu'i dus mchod kyi skabs thun cig gi khongs su phyag ṭīd yig sa bon tsam gyi dbu nas mthar tshang ba bkod pa'i yi ge gnyis par spel ba po ni dge slong kun bzang / phan te/ 'gro kun gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa myur du skyes nas byang chub chen po thob paldi rgyur gyur dge'o/ dge'o/ /dge'o/ /maṅga lo/

༄ga /rtsa ba'i bla ma che tshang drug pa karma rig 'dzin gyi zhal gdams tshig gsum gyi don gsal bar bstan pa gser gyi zhun ma lta bu bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs lags/swā ste/ gang thugs rgyal kun ye shes mngal nas nyal/ /gang gsung sangs rgyas yongs kyi gsang bar grub/ /gang sku bde gshegs ma lus gdung tshob dpal/ /gang de 'dren mchog che tshang drug par gyur/ /mgon der byang chen thob kyang spyi bos mchod/ /des gsung zab don tshig gsum 'di na bstan/ /de yang / nyams su len rgyu'i gal 'gags tu gyur pa ni/ bla ma la mos gus sems can la snying rje ma yengs pa'i dran pa gsum ste/ de dang po chos kyi snying po/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba ni rdo rje slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig rnyed dgos pas/ deng sang dus dbang gi ji bzhin tshang ba zhig ni dka' la skyon nyung zhing yon tan mang ba khyad par du rgyud pa dam sel med pa bskyed rdzogs la goms 'dris che ba zhig ni nges par dgos/ de yang thog mar bla ma de nyid lo dang zla ba'i bar du gser bzhin brtag la/ rang nyid kyi dad mos skyes shing bla mar bsten thub pa zhig 'dug na dbang khrid zhu ba'i gsol ba btab nas sngon 'gros rang gi rgyud thul bar byas nas dbang bskur zhus zab khrid dmigs rkang rnams sla chos spyod rtsing du ma song bar gtan la phab te zhu zhing / shes rab dang bsgrub pa dang lus ngag yid dang / tha na yang zang zing gi dgyes par byas la log rtog spu tsam ma shor bar rang gi srog las lhag par lta zhing spyi bo'i gtsug gi nor bu ltar bskur/ skyid sdug gang byung de la blo gtad 'cha' ste/ 'di phyi'i bde 'bras thar pa'i sa bon de yin pas gal che nges yin/ deng sang dus kyi bla slob 'bral brtag long med par gsar rob tu gsar nges kyi chos re zhu/ mthar skyon cung zad re mthong bas dad blo log te rang gi rang dam nyams su bcol/ mthar pa'i lam 'gag pa'i rgyu ru 'gro bas dbang chos zhu ma zin pa'i gong du brtag pa gal chen du gda'/ dbang chos zhig zhus phyin log rtog ma shor ba gal che/ spyir mos gus dkar po chig thub zhes bka' brgyud pa rnams kyi bzhed la/ der mkhas pa la las dgag sgrub byas yod kyang / dpal sa skya pa yab sras kyi gzhung la legs par spyad na gong ma rang rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma la tshul ji lta bu'i dad mos gnas sus kyang mi dpogs pa ming lam zab tu btags pa de dang gnad cig pa yin la lam 'bras bu'i dbang rab grol ba'i chos kyang bla ma'i rnal 'byor de kho na ste/ de nas dgag 707

bsgrub kyi gnas med la/ spyir yang skyes bu dam pa yul dus dgongs pa'i dgag sgrub tshig re la rgyud 'dzin 'ga'i rmongs zhen gyi tshig tshogs bsgreng ba la snying po med par shes dgos kyi/ dgongs pa can la yid 'dzer na/ yon tan 'ga' zhig yod na dkyil 'khor gtso bo dngos grub rtsa ba bla ma mos gus med kyang sla zhes par 'gyur te/ mos gus med na dam tshig yang med par 'gyur bas na spyir theg chen khyad par gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa las phyir phyogs pa'i tshig de sus 'dod/ mos gus la dkar po chig thub btags par skyon na gnang chung mod/ de bas dad mos gus pa ni/ chos kyi srog rtsa dam pa yin pas 'dor ba'i gnas med do/ /rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma de ni spyir sangs rgyas thams cad dang / bye brag tu rang re'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med dang / shākya thub pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ gu ru pad+ma yang rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid yin par kha tsam tshig tsam min par snying khong rus pa'i gting nas bskyed la dus kun tu mi brjed par spyi bo'i gtsug gam mdun gyi nam mkha' snying ga'i dbus gang der bsgom nas 'di phyi bar do thams cad kyi blo gtad phur tshugs su gsol btab te/ de yang gsol ba 'debs ris mang rung / khyad par tshig bdun gsol 'debs dang / bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi phur tshugs gsol 'debs gu ru pad+mas mdzad pa 'di dag ste/ e ma hoḥtrīḥ dus gsum bla ma yi dam/ mkha' 'gro sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur cing mdzad pa 'phrin las tha dad mi mnga' bar gyur pa o rgyan slob dpon chen po gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs so/ /lus ngag yid gsum smin cing grol bar byin gyi brlab tu gsol/ e ma ho: sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /gu ru'i sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes gsung / /gu ru'i gsung la gsol ba 'debs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes thugs/ /gu ru'i thugs la gsol ba 'debs/ /bde gshegs kun dang dbyer med pa'i/ /gu ru'i thugs rje bdag bzung 'tshal/oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi r+ghaṃḥ zhes ci nus bzlas par bya/ spyir na rung / 'chi rung / skyid rung /sdug rung / bde rung / mi bde rung / dka' rung / sla rung / bla ma'i mos gus ldem rgyang thang lhod med par gal che nges yin mchis/ bla ma gcig la dam sel song na kun la 'gro ba yin pas/ dam tshig la brtson pas chos kyi srog yin/ /bla mar brten mi brten yang gang yin thog ma nyid nas legs por brtag dgos d+nghaso/ /rang gi log lta ye nas ma shor na bla ma la dgyes rung dngos grub 'gyangs shing ngan 'gror skyes yang rdo rje'i dmyal bar ba ma yin zhes bshad la/ rang gi dad log na/ bla ma ji ltar dgyes yang rdo rje dmyal bar skye bas rang gi snang ngor bla ma'i mdzad pa legs nyes ci lta bu'i tshul du shar yang /dag pa'i snang ba sbyang bar bya ste/ rang las sgrib bsrab na bla ma'i ji mdzad legs par mthong zhing / 708

rang las sgrib thug na bla ma'i mdzad pa'ang skyon can du mthong ste/ shākya'i dbang po la legs skar gyi skyon 'ba' zhig mthong ba ste/ des na skyon mthong ba rang gi sgrib par ngos bzung zhing chos bsgrub pa la bdud kyi bar chad brtsam par shes par byas la bla ma'i ci mdzad chos sku'i rol pa yin pas/ dag pa'i snang bar mtshams med par sbyang zhing / dad gus rgyun mi chad/ dam tshig srog las lhag par brtson 'tshal/ dam tshig la nyams chags byung ba yang lo zlas bar chod rim bzhin nyes pa che zhing lo gsum 'das na gsor mi btub pas lo zlas ma chod par bshags pa la 'bad do/ /bla ma'i gsol 'debs kyi snying po ni badz+ra gu ru las lhag pa gzhan med pas de nar 'bad dgos/ spyir yig brgya yig drug sogs kyang de dang 'dra'o/ /don gnyis pa sems can la snying rje zhes pa ni/ theg pa chen po mtha' dag gi gzhi thun mong ma yin pa ste/ des na de'i bslab sdom dang mi 'gal ba gal che ba nyid ni/ de'i bslab bya bsam gyis mi khyab kyang mdor bsdus na smon 'jug gi sems bskyed la 'dus/ de yang smon pa'i sems bskyed ni tshad med bzhi ste/ byams snying rje dga' ba btang snyoms so/ /byams pa ni bu gcig pu ma yi byams pa lta bu ste/ snying rje ni mthab tu tshig pa bu yis ma bzod pa lta bu/ dga' ba ni bu gcig po byes su song nas yun sor ma 'phrad pa slar 'phrad pas ma ches dga' ba lta bu/ btang snyoms ni chags sdang med pas gzhi lta bu ste/ de ltar nus pa rnams gong 'phel dang / ma nus pa yang blos mi btang bar ci nus bgyis snyam pa'i 'dun pa bya/ 'jug pa'i sems yang / mdor phar phyin drug yin la/ de yang ci nus su spyad pa dang / mi nus pa yang blos mi dor ba dang ba'i bsam pas rtag tu spyad 'dun bya'o/ /don gyi snying po rang nyid zhi bde'i blo med par sems can gyi don la 'bad 'dun nan tan du bgyis pa mi klod/ skyes bu chen po blo dang ma bral ba nyid do/ /'dus byas kyi dge ba phyag bskor kha thon 'bru gcig brjod na yang 'gro ba kun dang thun mong du byas te bsngo zhing rgyu des rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par smon lam btab/ 'dus ma byas pa'i dge ba bsam gtan thun gcig tsam la yang de bzhin du bsngo smon byed cing sems can la phan bsam blos ma btang ba kho na'o/ /don gsum pa ma yengs pa'i dran pa zhes bya ba ni/ spyir nang don nyams len mtha' dag gi mthil yin te/ de yang dran pa zhes pa yang / sems mno bsam sngar gyi 'phro mi mthud/ da dran rgyu mi bslang / da lta'i blo la sgom yin min/ bde mi bde/ gsal mi gsal/ 'phro mi 'phro sogs kyi dpyad pa la zhugs pa rang bab bzo bcos dang bral bar bzhag ste/ de yang dbu ma chen pos yongs grub phyag chen gyi gnas lugs/ rdzogs chen pas gdod ma'i ye shes zhes pa de mngon du byed pa la ma yengs pa'i dran yod pa de kho na nyid ste/ dran pa de yang kha cig 'jur bu blo de 709

la ngos 'dzin 'ang / de lta bu ni ma yin kyi ma yengs pa'i dran rdzi mdo tsam las gang shar ma bcos bzo med nyid gal che zhing / sngags gsar snying gnyis nas dran pa rig pa gcig mi gcig mang du dpyad kyang / mthar thug dbyings su so so ba ga nas mchis mos/ nyams su len pa'i skabs su ni las thag nye ring khyad tsam ni yod pas bla ma'i man ngag legs par rtogs dgos la/ 'dir ni go bde bar de dag gi don dran pa zhes mdor dril na blos brtag dpyad kyi slad pa'i babs gnas lugs so ma nyid du skyongs ba de kho na yin te de yang bsgom snyam pa'i 'dzin pa dran pa blo yin/ yengs ba rgya 'byams ni ma rig 'khrul ba'i ngo ti yig ngo shes kyi dran pa yod rnam rtog mu mthud nas rtog lu rgyu yin/ shes pa rang bab bzo med skyong ba 'di'i go mi chod par de las lhag pa 'dod zhig shar na gong bgrod ltos bzhi'i 'ching ba yin/ mi bde ba la bde 'dod/ mi gsal ba la gsal 'dod/ mi gnas pa la gnas 'dod sogs mdor na sems rang bab rang sems bzhin bzhag pa las lhag pa gzhan zhig btsal 'dug na gnyen po'i shor ba yin te/ des na bsgom du med/ yengs du med/ grong bgrod ltos gzhi me/ spang gnyen gyi bya ba med/ yengs rung ma yengs rung / gnas rung 'gyu rung / dga' rung mi dga' rung gang ltar spang blang med pa'i rigs rang thog tu bzhag pa ste/ de yang bzhag zhes ming btags tsam las bzhag bya bzhag byed kyi yul las bzlas shing gang yang yid la mi byed pa rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes chen po/ rnam rtog spros pas dben pa la sna tshogs cir yang ma 'gags par 'char ba/ skye 'gags kyi mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa'i rang rig ngo bo gdod ma'i sangs rgyas yin lugs ma bcos pa'i chos nyid smra bsam brjod pa'i yul las 'das pa rang rig brjen pa 'di ka yin la/ sgom yengs thams cad rig pa'i rang rtsal gzhan du ma grub pa ste/ dper na chu bslab rgya mtshor thim pa bzhin sgom yengs spangs blang byar med bsgom rgyu 'dug na bsgom/ yengs rgyu 'dug na yengs/ rang rig las ma 'das pa'i chos nyid gser gling du phyin pa'i skyes bur sa rdo phal pa'i snang ba 'gags pa bzhin gang shar spang blangs med par nyams su len pa las gzhan med pas/ de ltar nyams su blangs shing de la goms par byed pa ni chu bo'i rgyun bzhin rnal 'byor la nyin mtshan thang lhod med par skyongs dgos te ji skad du/ bsgom pa yin goms yin/ ces so/ /gzhan yang 'gro mgon gyi/ lam gang shar la spang blang med pa dang /zhes pa'i don de tshig tu ma song bar don thog tu khel bar dgos gda'o/ /rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu rang nyid kyi zhe phug nyams len ni/ 'di bya 'di mi bya dang bral/ /'di yin dang de yin kyang med/ /spros pa bral zhing mi spros pa yang med/ /sgom 'dzin dang spangs dogs kyang ha cang che ba med/ /gzhan gyi tshul snang dang mi mthun rung rang gi rang la dgod bro ste/ /lags khrid khrid khad khad kyi bya ba 710

gang med smyon pa gu yangs po zhig yin gyi/ /tig tig po ci ga nas mchis/ 'on kyang kho bos lta ba mtho ba'i khas blangs byed pa ni ma yin gyi/ rang gi gnas tshul de 'dra zhig ni 'dug pas phyag rgya chen po'i gzugs brnyan tsam pa ni yin par byed/ de ltar mdo sngags kyi chos mtha' dag kyang tshig gsum po der 'dus ste/ pha rol du phyin pa theg chen mtha' dag gi rtsa ba ni byang chub kyi sems ste/ de yang sems can la snying rje zhes pa der 'dus zhing / sngags rgyud mtha' dag nas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor bsngags shing rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa zhes pa yang bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ba'i mos gus ldems kyang med pa de nyid la 'du la/ mdo sngags kyi chos tshul mtha' dag gi snying po dbu phyag rdzogs chen du grags pa de yang dril na chos nyid gdod ma'i gnas lugs rang rig brjen pa nyid de/ de skyongs bar byed pa yang ma yengs pa'i dran pa'i dang po tshugs pa nyid la 'du ste/ des na 'dir mi 'dus pa'i chos gzhan 'tshol mi dgos te/ nyams su blangs nus na tshe gcig sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu 'dis ster bar byed pa yin la/ nyams su blangs bar gal che'o/ /nyams su ma blangs na pu ste brgya la shar sbyangs byas mkhas nga rgyal seng ge las che zhing / bshad pa rgya mtsho'i rlabs ltar g.yo yang gnas lugs don la kha phyi phyogs pas rgya mtsho'i 'gram na gnas pa'i yi dwags skam grib mchi ba dang 'dra bas tshig dang go yul du ma lus par nyams su len pa gces/ de ltar mdo sngags kyi chos kyi bsdus don tshig gsum po 'di ni/ dpal kam tshangs snyan rgyud pa che tshang mchog gi sprul sku karma rig 'dzin gsung rab rgya mtsho zhes rgyal kun 'dus pa'i spyi gzugs gang gi zhal snga nas stsal bar mdzad cing / de don la lo bcu gnyis bar du rang sems la goms 'dris byas te nyams su ji ltar myong tshul dang bstun mdo tsam du bkod pa 'di ni dad ldan mang pos bskul zhing rang dang skal ba mnyam pa rnams la phan snyams blo dang / nye lam glo bo rgyal po'i bka' blon rnam dpyod du mas spud pa/ purtse dharma war+bha yis yang nas yang du gsol ba btab pa'i ngor rgyal khams pa a wa snyo ti pa dpal tshe dbang nor bus rdo rje rnal 'byor dgyes pas lcags phag nag zla'i dmar tshogs tshes bdun gter ston rol pa rdo rje rtsal gyi dus chen gyi skabs su sug bris su bgyis pa'i dge bas 'gro kun mos gus snying rje nyams rtogs rab tu rgyas te khyab bdag rtsa ba'i bla ma karma rig 'dzin go 'phang la myur du 'khod par gyur cig sarba maṅga lo/

gag /rdo rje phag mo rme ba brtsegs ma'i bsgom bzlas mi gtsang kun 'joms rdo rje pha lam bzhugs so//bcom ldan 'das rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /o rgyan chen po'i gsang mdzod man ngag bzhin//rgyal ba kun yum shes rab pha rol phyin/ /rdo rje khros nag me ba rtsegs pa yi/ /sgrub thabs snying po zab gsal 'dir bstan bya/ skyabs sems yan lan bdun pa sngon du 'gro bas dben pa'i gdan la 'khod de 'di ltar bsgom par bya'o/ /r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ/ chos rnams stong nyid sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang / /gzhal yas chos 'byung pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dbus/ /de steng a las rdo rje khros ma nag /spyan gsum dmar zlum sdang mig phyogs bcur gzigs/ /sma ra smin ma ag tshom me ltar 'bar/ /dud sprin mdog 'dra mi bzod cher khros sku/ /zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche gcig dug rlangs 'khrig /shangs gnyer bskal pa 'thor ba'i dus rlung g.yo/ /dmar nag 'bar 'phyang ral gseb phag zhal dur/ /thod skam mgo phreng rus rgyan mi g.yang gsol/ /gser gyi rna cha stag sham sbrul mchun spras/ /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gru mo kha ṭaṃ bsten/ /phyag g.yas 'bar ba'i e sgrom mkha' la 'phyar/ /g.yon pa dag byed khrus bum thugs kar 'dzin/ /phag zhal steng du pad zla nyi ma yi/ /gdan la 'dren mchog rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / /dbyer med pad 'byung rdor sems cha lugs can/ /spyan ma mtsho rgyal yum dang gnyis med 'khyud/ /gtso mo'i phyogs bzhi'i 'dab mar 'byung bzhi yi/ /mkha' 'khro rang mdog 'byung 'dzin sngags sgra sgrogs/ /kun gyi gnas gsum oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ mtshan las/ /'od 'phros ye shes spyan drangs dam me 'dres/ /ting 'dzin gyis sprul lha mos mchod cing bstod/ /thugs kar rang 'dra dha ki mtshon gang pa'i/ /snying dbus rdo rje nag po nas 'bras tsam/ /lte ba a yig spus bris lta bu'i mthar/ /sngar 'phreng 'gal me lta bu 'khor ba yi/ /'od zer drag rtsub rno myur me 'bar bas/ /lus kyi phyi nang snod bcud khor yug khengs/ /thog med nas bsags sdig sgrib nyams chags dang / /sel yug mjo gdon the la 'thab 'khon grib/ /za gos ro bag byi ba grib la sogs/ /sgrib rigs thams cad gzhob thul bsreg byas shing / /rdor sems yab yum sku la ye shes rlung / /rab tu g.yos pas sngags kyi me dpung cher/ /'khrug pas grib gdon lhag med gzhom par byas/ /oṃ āḥrgyu swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa āḥ mgar khar ching ཿ kha bhi ma na ye utsusma ma hā kro ti r+ghaṃ phaṭaḥ zhes dmigs pa ma yengs par rtse gcig tu bsnyen pa 'bum phrag gsum bskyal bas nad gdon sdig sgrib nyams chags dag pa'i ltas spyi dang mthun pa 'byung la bsnyen pa tshoms nas gnas skabs su rtsa 712

sngags brgya stong khri gang rung bzlas nas grib rigs thams cad sel bar 'gyur zhing / rtag tu phag mo 'di'i bsgom bzlas la brtson na 'go ba'i nad dang gza' klu sa bdag rgyal bsen sogs gdon bgegs 'byung po'i gnod pas mi tshugs shing bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len la brtan pa dang / ye shes mkha' 'gro'i rjes su bzung nas bar dor mchog ster bar 'gyur ro/ /thun skabs su 'byung ('di nas ma dpe ldeb bu gcig chad)

༄ga /rnam thar sgo gsum gyi ming don gsal bar bstan pa 'jigs med dpa' bo'i mtshon cha zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo ma hā gu ru weḥ rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gtso che ba'i mchog /dran pas srid zhi'i gdung sel 'khor lo'i mgon/ /pad+ma bde ba che dang rig pa 'dzin/ /zhabs pad bdag gi spyi bos dus kun mchod/ /mdo sngags kun gyi gzhung don lam gyi dngos/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum zhes grags pa/ /don de ston la tshig nyung don gsal ba/ /go bde'i ched du kho bos 'di na spel/ /de yang bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung theg pa chen po'i mdo rnams las rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum zhes shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i sgo mtha' dag gi snying po de gsum la 'du ba nyid yin gyi/ de gsum gang zhes na/ stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa dang rnam gsum ste/ tshul de la pha rol phyin pa'i rang skad kyi skabs su shing rta chen po rnams kyi bzhed pa bying gcig na'ang / gnad phra mo mi gcig pa'i dbye ba du mar snang na yang / 'dir tshul de dag bkag bzhag gi spros pa ma byas shing / rang lugs snying por brjod na ni/ stong pa nyid la phal cher khas len du med par bzhag na'ang / 'dir ni bde gshegs snying po'i rig rgyud chad pa med par so so rang rig pa'i ye shes rnam pa thams cad du char ba me long lta bu/ chos kyi dbyings dang 'du 'brel ye nas yod ma myong ba de la/ glo bur gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i cha rnam par stong zhing sgrib pa med pas na stong pa nyid de rnam par thar pa'i sgo dang po'o/ /de bzhin 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa dang / kun rdzob dang / don dam dang / snang ba dang / sred pa dang /bdag dang / gzhan dang / rnam shes dang / ye shes dang / cha de dag las rnam par grol ba brjod du med pa'i ngo bo de/ mtshan ma med pa ste rnam par thar pa'i sgo gnyis pa'o/ /de ltar rnam par grol ba'i ye shes de 'ang rgyar ma chad/ phyogs su ma lhung gnyis su med cing rnam pa thams cad du chos kyi dbyings las mi 'da' ba'i spang gnyen dang bral ba de ni/ smon pa med pa ste/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum pa'o//de ltar rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum po de ni blta ba'i gzhi/ bsgom pa'i lam/ mthar thug 'bras bu'i skyed pa nyid yin la/ de yang sngags kyi theg par 'di skad bdag gi zhes pa'ang 'di la rag las pa yin gyi/ ci phyir zhes na/ rgyud kyi gleng gzhi thams cad e waṃ la 'du ste/ e ni rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga yin zhing / bha ga zhes pa ni de skad du bcom pa zhes te/ bdud bzhi bcom pa'i don yin te/ de bcom par byed pa'i gzhi ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ de ngo bo ni rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum yin no/ /714

des na e waṃ gzung sgrub kyi skabs su yang rgya yig gi e la zur gsum du yod pas kyang rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum du bgos so/ /de la waṃ yig gis brgyan pa ni sngags kyi khyad chos yin no/ /mchog ston ni/stong nyid mdo dang thun mong de la mi 'gyur bde bas khyad byas pa ni waṃ yig gi don no/ /lar rnam thar gyi sgo 'di la mdo sngags kyi khyad par cung zad yod la 'dir ni ma spros so/ /da lta'i nyams su len rgyu'i snying por dril ba ni bka' brgyud gong ma rnams kyi bzhed pa la/ ma yeng / mi bsgom/ rang babs su 'jog pa gsum la 'dus kyi/ nyams su len pa de kho na ltar legs pa yin/ chos 'di dbu ma/ zhi spyod/phyag rdzogs mtha' dag gi nyams len snying po yin mod/ lhag tu gcod yul ba rnams la 'di med thabs med pa yin yang / deng sang gi gcod yul ba rnams kyi thar sgo gsum gyi mtshan yang mi nges na don tshul bzhin nyams su len pa ni nyin mo'i skar mar zad do/ /de bas na don tshul bzhin nyams su len na rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum dang ldan par bgyi zhing gsang ba'i spyod nyams su len pa gal che/ de skad tshe rabs du mar mdo sngags lam/ /cung zad sbyang mthus don de tshe 'di la'ang / /mdo sngags don la ma rmongs ji bzhin gtam/ /mgrin pā'i rol mor spel bar nus des so/ /'di bris dge bas mtha' yas 'gro ba kun/ /rnam thar gsum thob de bzhin gshegs brnyes shog /zhes rang gi slob ma lcags sprag dge slong kun bzang nges don gzhan phan tshul khrims bzang pos snga mo nas bskul ba dang / rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang dar rgyas kyis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus spel pa'i yi ge pa ni bskul ba pa'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /

༄ga /sdug bsngal zhi bar byed pa dam pa'i chos mchog chu shel snying po'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /srid kun nyon mongs sems kyi rba klong mtsho/ /nye bar zhi ba'i lam bzang bdud rtsi'i mtsho/ /rnal 'byor sems la rol pa'i dga' ston bzang / /ston mdzad dam pas de ring bdag blo skyongs/ / 1 de yang 'di ru 'gro blo'i bye brag bzhin/ /rgyal gsung rgya cher ston las gsang chen chos/ /kun kyang chos sku'i rang zhal mjal ba'i thabs/ /kho na nyid las des na myur lam chos/ / 2 kun gzhi ma rig rkyen blang gzung 'dzin gyi/ /bsdus nas srid par 'chings rnams zhi bde'i sar/ /bkrol byed bde bar gshegs pa'i shul snyeg pa'i/ /kun tu bde chen lam chen 'dir ston bya/ / 3 de la'ang thog mar lam du 'jug pa'i stegs/ /mi rtag rgyud blang thob dka' yid la 'chang / /rgyu 'bras spang blangs skyabs dang sems sdom 'jug /tshogs bsags sgrib sbyangs bla ma'i byin brlabs blangs/ / 4 de nas sgo gsum 'khor ba'i bya ba kun/ /dben par zhi ba'i chos nyid ngang klong la/ /gnyug ma blo 'das so ma lhug par bzhag /dran rig rang grol zhi ba'i dbyings su btod/ / 5 de nyid skal ldan dbang po'i go rim khyad/ /rim gyis thod rgal cig 'char sgrim klod gcun/ /zhi las mi 'da' mi bzung mi yan par/ /rang ngo dran pa dran klong dran rgyun brten/ / 6 de snang nyid las ma g.yos lam go rim/ /rim gsum sa nyid bye brag so sor ston/ /cer mthong rang zhi zhi grol grol ba'i dngos/ /'khrul pa rang zhi zhi bde bde chen sar/ / 7 bsgrod pa dang po dbang rab brda' don nyid/ /sprad thag zhi grub chos nyid rjen par rtog /snang ba rang grol sgyu ma lta bur rig /chos rnams ma 'dres nyams rim shugs kyis rdzogs/ / 8 de yang yin chos blo la mi bzhag par/ /yin nas yin lugs gnad du brtson pas phab/ /yin min re dogs spang blangs ma yin par/ /shugs grol nyid yin yin thog grol ba'o/ / 9 gnyis pa 'bring snang chos nyid zhi ba'i chos/ /char tshul rim gyis cha la rim pa nyid/ /ma 'dres gdams pa sems kyi rgyud la 'char/ /mtho dman 'jam rtsub sna tshogs ci yang 'char/ / 10 de tshul blo yi dpyad khris ma zhugs par/ /rang shar nyams blang blang bral dang 'jog la/ /ma bcos bcos min zhi ba'i ngang du khyer/ /gong don ma 'dres myur rdzogs zhi sangs rgyas/ / 11 gsum pa dbang dman rim gyi skye ba'i tshul/ /bde sdug 'jam rtsub zhi ba'i lam khyer bas/ /bde gsal mi rtog zhi bde'i ros zhe khengs/ /go mgo rlung rlabs bral ltar rang dngas 'char/ / 12 de la zhen med dran rig ngo bo nyid/ /ma yengs ma sgribs 716

gnyug ma'i ngang du blta/ /thun chung grangs mang zhi la snying rus bskyed/ /ma 'gag ma sgrub so ma gcig tu bzhag / 13 de ni zhi byed thugs phrad dang po zhes/ /nyon mongs mgo non mi rtog rang bzhin bskyed/ /phung po'i bdud zhi bla ma sprul skur shes/ /las kyi sgrib pa ngang gi bcom pa'o/ / 14 de nas blo 'das zhi ba'i ngo bo nyid/ /'dzin bral brjod med tshogs drug rnam rtog zhi/ /yin bzhin stong par kho thag rbad chod pa/ /dper na go 'gyed rdul dang bral zhing rtog / 15 de nyid stong par blo la mi byed par/ /gang shar ngos su dran rig lhod klod la/ /stong pa nyid la snying rje'i bogs 'don te/ /rang bzhin rang ngo g.yo ba med par bzhag / 16 de bzhin zhi byed thug phrad bar ma zhes/ /rnam rtog rtsad chod stong nyid shugs la 'char/ /nyon mongs bdud zhi bla ma longs skur shes/ /nyon mongs sgrib pa ngang gi bcom pa'o/ / 17 de nas mnyam pa zhi ba'i ngo bo nyid/ /'khor 'das dbyer med gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa zhig /tshogs drug zang thal zhi ba'i gshis pa thim/ /'dzin zhen zhi ba rgya mtshor rlab thim 'dra/ / 18 de nyid mi bzung mi bsgom rang babs gshis/ /gcos min zhi ba dbyings su rang grol ngang / /snang sems rdo gcig cig tu 'dzin med par/ /zab dang zhi ba'i chos mchog ngang der bzhag /19 de ni zhi byed thug phrad gsum pa zhes/ /'khrul pa ye shes chos kun mnyam nyid 'char/ /lha bu'i bdud zhi bla ma chos skur shes/ /bag chag sgrib pa ngang gi bcom pa'o/ / 20 de nas lhun grub zhi ba'i gshis lugs nyid/ /kun gzhi'i sgrib bral dbyings kyi 'od gsal mar/ /rig pa'i 'od gsal ma bu gcig tu 'dres/ /bya rtsol las 'das kun bzang yang par bzhag / 21 de ni zhi byed thug phrad ma mo zhes/ /dbyings grol zung 'jug lhun gyis grub par rtogs/ /'chi bdag bdud zhi bla ma ngo bor 'dres/ /shes bya'i sgrib pa ngang gi bcom pa'o/ / 22 de ltar rim gsum zhi lam myang 'das sar/ /phyin pa'i chos nyid yin la lam gegs sel/ /bogs su byung rnams ma 'dres nad gdon stig/ /sbyangs nas sa lam 'bras bu sar spel byung / / 23 de bzhin zhi ba'i man ngag dam pa'i chos/ /chos mchog mchog 'di khams gsum srid sdug bsngal/ /bsngal ba rab zhi zhi ba myang 'das chos/ /chos sku'i snyeg lam lam 'di bla na med/ / 24 de 'dra'i lam bzang bzang 'di sus rtsod med/ /sdug bsngal ma zhi sangs rgyas sa mi thob/ /de phyir 'dis ni srid 'khrul sdug bsngal kun/ /kun tu zhi la srid rtse'i zhi bde min/ /25 e ma de ltar zhi ba myang 'das byed lha lam/ /de la dam pa'i mkhyen pa'i chu shel 'char/ /de mdangs thugs rje'i bdag blo'i kun+da 'dzum/ /de snang gzhan yid dga' 'phreng 'di spel lo/ / 26 'di dge'i khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rnams/ /'dis zhi bde chen kun mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sar/ /'dis snyeg gzhan min sangs rgyas rang rig nyid/ /'di ka mngon gyur chos dbyings zhing bdag shog / 27 ces 717

pa 'di ni rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog gi thugs rjes rjes su bzung ba'i mthus gnas lugs rang rig don gyi bla ma yang cha tsam zhal mjal ba'i rnal 'byor pa tshe dbang nor bu yi rmi lam gyi snang bar dam pa mi pham mgon gyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan ma cung zad thob pas rkyen byas sdug bsngal zhi byed gang gi rim rang blor shugs byung gi 'char cha lhug par rang lo nyer gnyis pa khrums kyi zla ba'i tshes bcur mdo khams btsan ri rdo rje'i brag gi g.yas ngogs rtsan chen ri khrod du bris pa ste gnas lugs rtogs pa mthar ma son pas don la mi 'jug pa yod par srid tshe bzod par mdzod cigadage ba mchis pa 'gro ba kun la bsngo ba'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig maṅga lo/thug /rnal 'byor grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po kun bzang 'gyur med klong grol la gsol 'debs bla ma'i rnal 'byor mchog gi gter sbyin zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes snying po'i gar/ /bde chen gnyug ma'i rang mdangs bla ma'i skur/ /songs gzhengs khyab bdag bla ma mchog de la/ /sgo gsum gus pas rtag tu phyag 'tshal zhing / /khyed la gsol ba 'debs pa'i cho ga ni/ /mchog kun 'dus pa'i snying por yongs bsgrub nas/ /gnas lugs gshis kyi gter mchog mngon 'char byed/ /mos gus rnal 'byor lam mchog 'di ston bya/ /de yang gnas gtsang dben yid dang mthun par/ /dus bzang po spyi dang khyad par dmar phyogs tshes bcu sogs gnas skabs nam yang rung la/ /rten dam tshig bris sku 'am dbu lo gdung rus sogs dang med kyang yid kyi mos pas kyang yongs shing mdun du gtor tshogs spyi dang mchod pa legs par bshams nas rang nyid gdan la bde bar 'dug de nas bdag nyid skad cig gis gnyug ma'i he ru ka yi skur gyur par bsam/ sngon gter ram̐ yo khaṃ gi bas sbyangs/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ ha ho hriḥs byin gyis brlabs nas/ dzeḥdang 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas gtor mgron rnams bkug a ka ros bsngos la/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin po gzhan dag la/ /gsang spyod don du sa phyogs 'dir/ /bdag zhu khyed kyi stsal du gsol/ /zhes dang / gnod mdzes sngags thun spos rol gyis brab cing / khro sprin me mtshon dang bcas pas bgegs thams cad sdug bskrad brlag par byas tshur 'dus pa las khro bo rol pa'i gur khang ye shes kyi me 'bar bas phyogs mtshams thams cad bcings te cis kyang mi shig par bsrungs ba'i 'khor los khyab par bsam mo/ /de nas ma gyur sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god pa'i ched du zab mo'i rnal 'byor la 'jug 'dod kyi lhag bsam bzang pos rang gzhan sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi 'jigs te skyabs zhu ba ni ci mdzad bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen 718

snyam pas/ oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa skyob mdzad pa/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /nges pa'i don du sems bskyed nas/ /gzhan don bla ma bsgom par bya/ /zhes skyabs sems lan gsum dang / mchod rdzas byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ bdag gi thugs las ram̐ yo khaṃ 'phros pas/ /mchod rdzas dngos 'dzin nyes skyon bsreg gtor sbyangs/ /rnam kun mchog ldan stong pa'i sgyu 'phrul las/ /rang byung phyi nang mchod pa'i phung po ni/ /zag med 'dod yon cir yang 'char ba yi/ /kun bzang mchod sprin nam mkha'i khams gang gyur/ /oṃ ma hā pu dza sarba sa ma ya urdu /zhes dang nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas spel lo/ de nas dngos gzhi ni/ oṃ aḥr+ghaṃ/ chos sku dmigs med stong pa'i gshis dbyings las/ /kun snang snying rje zung 'jug rig pa'i dngos/ /skad cig rang mdangs snang dag lha sku pad/ /rang nyid thugs gsang 'dus pa zhal gsum mjos/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar rtsa zhal sku mdog mthing / /zhal 'dzum spyan dgu che gtsigs 'od zer 'bar/ /phyag drug dang po rdor dril yum la 'khyud/ /lhag mas 'khor lo rin chen pad ral 'dzin/ /rdor dril zhi tshul longs sku rgyan cha rdzogs/ /rang 'od yum sbyor seng khri pad zlar bzhugs/ /mdun mkha' dag cing 'od gsal gzhal med dbus/ /rgyal kun spyi gzugs 'gro 'dren sprul pa'i sku/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma grub pa'i dbang phyug ni/ /'gyur med klong grol ye shes kun gyi bdag /gdul rol gzugs snang dar yol bgres nyams 'dres/ /sha rgyas dkar dmar snum mdangs dri zhim 'phro/ /zhal rgyan dkar nag se bo thugs kar slebs/ /dbu ral sbom leb gnyis kyi sku dpung nen/ /pad+ma'i mdangs 'phrog gangs zhu rtse zlum gsol/ /spyan skum zhal 'dzum bag dro gzi byin 'bar/ /phyag g.yas rin chen 'phreng ba ngom stabs 'dzin/ /snyan gyi thad dkar rab rgyas pad dkar gyi/ /yu ba phyag g.yon dag gi thugs kar bzung / /sems pa'i dkyil krung ras dkar smad g.yogs dang / /ras dkar mu ran dar dmar bla gos gsol/ /dmar ser sgom thag tshad ldan 'gul du 'chang //pad dkar zla ba'i gdan la zhi tshul bzhugs/ /sku mthar rgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma dang / /yi dam zhi khro sangs rgyas byang chub sems/ /mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho spren du 'khrigs/ /thugs dbus 'od klong bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi/ /lha tshogs ma 'dres ye shes sems tshul bzhugs/ /spyi bor rigs bdag pad 'byung gter bdag gling / /lte bar gsang ba ye shes tshogs bcas gsal/ /de ltar gsal ba'i khyi bor oṃ dkar po/ /mgrin par s+dzadamar thugs kar rgyu sngon po/ /rgyal ba rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bo gyur/ /thugs ka'i rgyu las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyi/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /chos sku 'gyur med ngang las gzugs sku'i sprin/ /rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnam par spyan drangs gyur/ /spos rol bcas te oṃ/ chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas/ /skye med bla ma gshegs su gsol/ /longs spyod rdzogs 719

sku'i pho brang nas/ /gsal dag bla ma gshegs su gsol/ /sprul pa sku yi pho brang nas/ /thugs rje can rnams gshegs su gsol/ /'ja' dang 'od du 'khyil li li/ /sku dang thig le shig se shig /'khor du yi dam lha tshogs dang / /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi bskor/ /khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub phyir/ /byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol/ /gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la/ /bsgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi bskur/ /bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzā dzaḥr+ghaṃ baṃ hoḥ ye shes dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams/ /mkha' la sprin ltar gshegs nas kyang / /mdun gyi tshogs zhing la thim pas/ /gnyis med dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs/ /de nas phyag mchod kyi tshogs bsag pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i lha mo rnams dang sems can thams cad bya byed thun mong par gyur te/ phyag dang mchod pa'i las la 'jug par mos te/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun ste/ /kun gyi byed po bla ma yin/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /mkha' ltar khyab pa'i rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor la//bdag dang mtha' yas 'gro r+pā ma lus pa/ /lus 'di zhing rdul grangs med rab sprul nas/ /sgo gsum gus pas rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes phyag bya/ de nas mchod pa ni/ oṃ dpag med nam mkha'i khams nyid las/ /mchod yon bsam yas lhun 'grub pa/ /rab 'byams nam mkha'i khams bkang ste/ /gus pa'i blo yi 'bul bar bgyi/ /oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ de bzhin du mchod yon zhabs bsil nas rol mo'i bar dang / ar+ghaṃ gnas su shabha'i bar bcug pas mchod/ tshul khrims lte ba la sten pas/ /rnam 'byed shes rab rtsibs rno zhing / /ting 'dzin mu khyud kyis bskor ba'i/ /'khor lo rin chen dbul bar bgyi/ /tsakra rat+na badz+ra su dzi te aḥr+ghaṃ/ bsod nams rgya mtsho las thon zhing / /blo yi mun stug rab gsal nas/ /dgos 'dod kun 'byung dad pa yi/ /nor bu rin chen dbul bar bgyi/ /ma ṇi rat+na badz+ra pu dzi te āḥr+ghaṃ/ /rang bzhin gnyug ma'i ye shes sku/ /gzhom med gzugs sgra reg byas 'khyud/ /mi 'gyur bde chen bskyed mdzad pa'i/ /btsun mo rin chen dbul bar bgyi/ /satri rat+na badz+ra pū dzi te aḥr+ghaṃ/ bla ma mchog gsum rje bor gus/ /rnam dag dge bcu'i chab srid bskyang / /dran shes bag yod nor gyi phyug /blon po rin chen dbul bar bgyi/ /pu ru kha rat+na badz+ra pu dzi te āḥr+ghaṃ/ mang thos pad+ma'i mtsho la rol/ /bdag med rtogs pa'i lus stobs rgyas/ /mtshan 'dzin rtogs pa 'joms byed pa'i/ /glang po rin chen dbul bar bgyi/ /ha ri rat+na badz+ra pū dzi ti aḥrgyu/ dbang bzhi lus mdzes bco brgyad kyi/ /grol lam 720

mgyogs pa'i 'gros bzang pos/ /'dod don myur du 'grub byed pa'i/ /rta mchog rin chen dbul bar bgyi/ /a shra ba rat+na badz+ra pu dzi te aḥrdu/ gang shar ngos la gcer lta yi/ /shes rab rig pa'i mtshon rnon pos/ /rnam rtog dgra las rgyal byed pa'i/ /dmag dpon rin chen dbul bar bgyi/ khasga rat+na badz+ra pū dzi te āḥrgyu/ dga' bzhi bcu drug nyams rgyas pas/ /rdo rje rig ma bcu drug dang / /gsang ba phyag rgya bzhi'i sbyor ba/ /zag med bde ba bskyed phyir 'bul/ /ma hā su kha pu dza hoḥ gtsang rmi'i rtog bral bdud rtsi'i sman/ /nyon mongs chags med rak+ta'i mtsho/ /bza' bca' btung ba'i 'don yon spos/ /'khor gsum dmigs med nyid du 'bul/ /a mṛ ta rak+ta ba ling ta pu dza hoḥ de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs/ /dpag med zhing na gang 'chis pa/ /de kun blo yi blang nas 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /sarba ma hā pu dza ho/ de nas yan lag bcu 'bul zhing gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che/ /yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas la/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su 'chi/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod/ /sdig pa ma lus so sor bshags/ /dge ba kun la yi rang zhing / /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /mya ngan mi 'dar gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'grub par shog /zhes lan gsum/ gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ oṃ skye 'chi med sku gsal la dngas/ /rdo rje sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /lus la bde bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sku yi rdo rje bdag grub shog /āḥ'agag med gsung dbyangs chos kyi sgra/ /ā li kā lir gsol ba 'debs/ /ngag la nus par byin gyis rlobs/ /gsung gi rdo rje bdag grub shog /r+ghaṃḥ ka dag bde chen kun bzang klong / /cir mi dgongs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zad par 'khyol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /thugs kyi rdo rje bdag 'grub shog /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa ni/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnyen gcig pu/ /'gro ba skyabs med rnams kyi skyabs/ /thar pa'i them skas chen po te/ /ma rig sel ba'i sgron me la/ /mun pa'i tshogs bdag skyabs su mchi/ /'khor ba 'dams kyi mtsho nang du/ /bying ba'i skyabs med bdag la skyabs/ /nyon mongs me yi gdung ba la/ /thugs rje'i char gyis bsil bar mdzod/ /ma rig 'khrul pas bcings pa yi/ /rdos bcas sha khrag lus rnams kun/ /rang rten 'od kyi rang bzhin du/ /lhag med mya ngan 'da' thob shog /bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che/ /bdag la re sa gzhan na med/ /deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /skyid sdug re stos khyed mkhyen pas/ /mgon med bdag la thugs rjes gzigs/ /nad gdon bgegs dang bar chad sel/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal/ /zhes snying khong rus pa'i gting nas dad gus kyi spu g.yo mchi ma 'khrugs pas gsol ba drag tu btab pas byin rlabs mtshan kha dman 'bying rab kyi rnam par skye ba ste/ stsol med kyi mos gus skye na/721

yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi byed/ gar gtad du dmigs pa brtan nas bskyed rim dang mchog gi gzhi gnas brtan thob/ /rang byung gi ye shes lhag mthong rang zhal mjal nas gdod ma'i btsan sa zin par 'gyur ba te/ gang rung ma skyes bar du gsol ba 'debs pa la brtson no/ /bla ma'i sku las 'od zer bye ba'i rgyun/ /dkar gsal 'phros pas rang lus yongs su gang / /nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag /bde chen ye shes nyams rtogs che cher gsol/ /de yi ngang las khyad par sngags kyi sgra/ /bung ba tshang zhig ltar grags snang srid kun/ /mer khrom 'ur 'ur rab tu g.yos par gyur/ /'gro kun sgo gsum ye shes 'khor los rgyas/ /khyad par bla ma dam tshig sems dpa' yi/ /snying gar ye shes bde gshegs kun 'dus sku/ /gar dbang spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs dbus su/ /ting 'dzin ut+pal dmar po nyi ma'i steng / /spyo:ltar mtshan sngags snying po rang sgra ldir/ /'phro 'dus don gnyis byas mthar snod bcud kun/ /bde chen bla med rdo rje gsum du gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra gu ru ar+ya pa lo la k+ṣa ra at+ma ko sirnyi pha la r+ghaṃ āḥ zhes ci nus zlas mthar dbang blang ba ni/ bla ma'i sku yi gnas gsum yi ge las/ /dkar dmar mthing gi 'od zer rim cig char/ /byung bas rang gi spyi mgrin snying khar thim/ /lus ngag yid dang snang gsum sgribs pa sbyangs/ /dbang bzhi'i rim par thob nas sku gsung thugs/ /ye shes rdo rje'i byin gyis rlabs par 'gyur/ /oṃ āḥ ho zhes pas dbang bzhi blang ngo / /mthar tshogs mchod spro na rdzas rnams la bdud rtsi gtor te/ rang nyid thugs gsang 'dus pa'i thugs ka nas/ /ram̐ yi khaṃ 'phros me rlung chur gyur pas/ /dngos 'dzin nyes skyon thams cad sregs gtor bkrus/ /rlung me thod pa'i sgyid bur a yid las/ /byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che'i nang / /sha lnga bdud rtsir sa bon bcu yi mtshon/ /rlung g.yo me sbar rdzos khol blang pa yi/ /'khor zlas bdud rtsi'i dngas ma zhu ba'i rgyun/ /'dres pas zag med 'dod yon bdud rtsir gyur/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho trī:sa byin gyi rlabs la/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od kyis mdun gyi mkhar/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos bsrung tshogs/ /sprin phung thib pa bzhin du spyan drangs nas/ /tshogs zhing rnams dang dbyer med bzhugs par gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza:hūṃ baṃ ho/ de nas phud cha bzhir spros la/ dang po mchod pa ni gzugs sgra dri ro reg ldan pa'i: 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di: gus pa'i blo yi 'bul lags na: dgyes pa'i gar gyi bzhes su gsol: ga na tsakra pu tsa kha hi: bar pa bshags pa ni/ thog med dus nas da lta'i bar: sgo gsum mi shes bag med pas:nyams chags 'gal 'khrul ci mchis pa: de dag thams cad bshags par gyis: yig brgya yang bzlas/tha ma bsgral stob ni/ cha gsum pa'i 'dod yon lha mo rgyu zhes rang la bsdus/ rmi tri badz+ra asku sha dza dza:r+ghaṃ baṃ ho sa/ bsgral bya bstib la rgyu/ nga ni za byed chen po te/ khams gsum ma lus bsgral ba dang / /gdul 722

dka' ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir/ /sha rus la sogs za bar bya/ /mā ra ya phaṭaḥ zhes dang ma ye shes kyi 'khor lo gnas spor/ /snyigs ma dum bur btub cing bdud rtsir sbar te/ ma hā me sa rak+ṣa kom ni ri ti a sbo ta khā hi/ zhes stob bo/ /de nas rol ba ni/ rang lus lhar gsal ba'i sku la rtsa gsum lha tshogs til gyi gang bu ltar bzhugs par mos la tshogs rdzas lag pa'i sgang blug gi lte ba'i thab khung du gtum mo'i mes bsregs pa'i bdud rtsi'i dngas mas lus kyi lha tshogs rnams brnyes shing tshim par mos la longs spyad mthar tsaṇ+ḍa la'i spyi bo'i haṃ bzhu ba'i zhu bde'i rang gdangs bde stong lhan skyes kyi ye shes kho na nyid kyi dbyings su la bzla bar byas la/ te ru ka dpal grong khyer du/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba yi/ /bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'grub par shog /zhes smon lam btab/lhag ma'i ting lngar phud cha bzhi pa yang bsres la/ /oṃ ā:r+ghaṃ ha ho trī: dam tshig gi kha phru btab pas lhag ma'i gtor ma 'dod yon gyis phung po zas mi shes par bsam la/ 'bar rgya dang bcas te phem zhes mgron dgugs la/ r+ghaṃ mkha' 'gro ging dang dbang phyug ma/ /ma bdun sring bzhi 'bar ma brgyad/ /pho nya la sogs lhag bdud tshogs/ /dpal gyi pham phab 'di gsol la/ /bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub pa mdzod/ /oṃ uts+tshace ba ling ta kha kha khā hi/ zhes phyi rol du 'bul lo/ /thun bsdu ba ni/ bdag gi sgo gsum gyi mtshon snang srid kun/ /bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi klong du 'dus/ /de nyid chos sku skye med dbyings thim pas/ /dmigs med bsam brjod bral ba'i ngang du gnas/ /de las snang stong sgyu ma'i bskur mang nas/ /cir snang bla ma'i rol par sad par gyur/ /'di mtshon bdag gi dus gsum dge ba rnams/ /rang don zhi bde'i dri mas ma gos par/ /mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams ma lus pa /bla med byang chub thob pa'i rgyur sngo'o/ /rgyal ba kun dngos rje btsun bla ma yi/ /dus gsum kun tu brtse bas rjes bzung ste/ /'gro kun sgrol phyir gsang chen rdo rje'i lam/ /dka' ba med pa myur du bgrod par shog /zhes bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ /de ltar gsol 'debs man ngag cho ga ni/ /bskal bzang mchog gi lam bzang dga' don shar/ /rgyal ba kun las rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid/ /bsnyan lhag rgyud sde kun nas yang bshad cing / /mchog gi gtso bo bla ma nyid yin cing / /bya ba gzhan spangs bla ma gcig pu mchod/ /des ni nges gsang snying po'i bdud rtsi ste/ /skad gcig nyid la thob par gdon mi za/ /lam bzang 'di yi dge bas 'gro ba kun/ /gdod nas mi 'gyur gzhom pa med pa yi/ /ye shes klong du 'phyam gcig grol gyur te/ /khams gsum 'khor ba'i gzhi rtsa stong par shog /ces bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa'i cho ga mchog gi gter sbyin bya ba 'di ni rig 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rjes gter bdag gling pa'i thugs kyi sras thu bo dam pa grub pa'i dbang phyug 'gyur med klong grol mchod pa'i cho ga zhig dgos zhes rje de nyid kyi sku gsung thugs kyi sras mchog pad+ma 'gyur med nor bu dpal ldan gzhon nu theg mchog yongs 'du dbang 723

pos sde bka' nan chen pos bskul bas/ gzhung rnams snyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa dhar ma shrī ri mdzad pa'i bla mas mchod pa'i cho ga de nyid tshad ma'i gzhung nas bsdus shing tshig don shin tu legs par mthong bas de nyid slad med gzhir bkod de mngon rtogs sogs tshig bsgyur cung zad sbyar ba ste mdo khams dbus 'gyur gyi chos smra ba tshe dbang nor bus mang yul dpal 'bar bdud rtsi'i phug tu sa sprel hor zla lnga pa'i tshes nyer gsum gyi dus sbyor gcig gi tshod la grub par bris pa dge'o/ /dge'o/ dge'o/ / 'di'i lung yang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dpal rig 'dzin chen po/shes 'byung / a nan+da/ des so/ /

chab shog khag bzhugs so/ /lha bcas skye rgu yongs kyi gtsug gi nor bus mchod pa'i yul 'jig rten mgon po ngur smrig gar gyi rol pa kun gzigs bla ma chen po'i zhabs stegs chu skyes rnam par bzhad pa'i ngogs su/ gus pas zhu gsol/ gdod nas bri gang las 'das dang po'i mgon po nyid du rgyal ba yongs kyi spyi mes su brnyes shing mkha' khyab 'gro la dmigs pa med pa'i snying rjes rnam kun mchog dang ldan pa'i 'od gsal gyi rang gdangs rnam pa thams cad pa 'gro ba rnams kyi dpal dang mgon du gang la gang 'dul gyi sgyu 'phrul gyi rol pa tshad bzung las 'das bzhin sangs rgyas nyid dang / de'i sras dang slob ma'i tshul dang / de bzhin 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po dang / stobs kyi rgyal po blon po khyim bdag dang / yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang / dpag bsam gyi shing sogs rten dang brten pa sna tshogs pa'i gzugs kyi sems can gyi re ba yid bzhin du bskong bar byed cing mthar thug thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam la yang dag par sbyor cing gnas skabs su phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal ma lus shing lus pa med pa ster ba'i ded dpon dam par gyur pa rgyal ba rnams kyi 'phrin las kyi rang gzugs nyid du nges bzhin deng dus thub bstan lnga bdo'i 'gro ba rnams la phan pa dang bde ba dang dge legs mtha' dag rtsa ba'i slad du/rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i rang gzugs gsar du bdo ba yi ngur smrig gar gyi rol pa mtshan dpe'i sku nyin byed 'bum gyi sneng ba yang zil gyis gnon pa'i bdag nyid can 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral bas phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba 'phrog byed dbang po'i khri la lhan ne lhang nger 'tsho zhing bzhes te bzhugs pa'i srid na zla bos dben pa nyid du gyur/ 'dir gnas phran bu las kyang phran bur gyur pa bya bral dang / ri dra pa yang skyabs gyur dpal mgon dam pa rnams kyi thugs rje la brten 'tsho ba ma brnyil zhing dge ba'i 'dun pa nyams med dam pa'i rnam thar la slob pa'i mos pa ci nus 'bad bzhin da lta la stod rgyal gyis shrī'i 'dabs su bgrod pa'i gnas skabs su mchis/ ched du gsol 'os/ rgyal ba rnams ni yang dag pa'i don du skye 'chi'i spros pa mtha' dag bral ba zab zhi spros bral bde ba chen po rtag brtan g.yung drung gi ngo bo la 'pho 'gyur bgres rgud thams cad las 'das pa mkhar ltar gdal ba'i sku can la bskul ba dang gsol gdab kyi bya bar ma dmigs kyang 'gro ba'i don du shar ba'i gzugs kyi sku ni gdul bya rnams skyo ba bskyed pa dang / spro bsring ba'i slad du gdul bya nyid dang mtshungs par skye 'chi'i spros pa cir yang ston zhing bskul ba dang gsol gdab tshul la yang ltos par 725

mdzad na/ deng dus snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i 'gro ba spyi dang bye brag gangs can gyi gdul bya nyon mongs shing nyams thag pa bdag cag rnams kyi dpal dang mgon dang dpung dang gru gzings dang bde ba'i gling dam par gangs can 'gro ba yongs kyi lha yi lha 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po lag na pad+mo can gang khyed kyi zhabs pad bskal pa rgya mtsho'i bar du brtan par snying nas gsol ba 'debs par dngos po'i yo byad ni pad+ma'i snal ma'am ku sha'i rtsa ltar shin tu nas kyang phra ba'i rang bzhin du gyur rung lhag pa'i bsam pa ni da lta'i gnas skabs 'di nyid kho na tsam ma yin pa yun ring mo nyid nas dung dang zla ba ku mud pad rtsa ltar gcig tu dkar ba'i blos lo dus su sku'i gsal rkyen zhi ba'i rten 'brel bsgrig dgos mchog tu gal che bar gsal snang du 'char bzhin rten 'brel bsgrigs tshul mtshon byed ched du bsngags te tshigs su bcad pa bkra shis pa'i grangs ldan dang rten 'brel gyi yo byad phran bu bcas phul ba 'di bzhin par thugs rje brtse ba chen po'i spyan ras kyi byab cing / zhabs pad bskal pa rgya mtsho'i bar du brtan par dgongs pa gtad pa mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen brgya phrag du ma'i bar gsol ba 'debs pa re 'bras don ldan du mdzad pa nas ris su ma chad pa'i 'gro ba 'phags chen rnams kyi thugs rje chen po'i do rar ye nas chub bzhin gnas pa yin mod kyang rang nyid byis pa'i blos 'dod gdung gis bdag cag ltos par bcas pa kun thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor nas lhag par mi bor bar gsol ba 'debs pa yang chos dbyings tshom 'khrungs med pa'i klong du 'jug pa mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen/ zhes brtse chen thugs rje chen po'i rang bzhin kyus ring spyan ras g.yo bar byed pa'i rten lha yi reg bya srid du rings bas bcings te aṅgi ra yi lo zhal gsar du 'char nye ba mgo zla'i dkar phyogasaukyi rgyal ba dang po la rgyal gyi rtsib ri'i 'dab nas phul ba'i zhu yig sarba maṅga lo/ zhabs pad mchog tu rang gi gnas tshul lhug par gsol ba'i zhu chung sarba maṅga lo/ zhabs pad yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che/ rang gi gnas tshul la brten bsngo smon skyabs 'jug zhu 'os grub pa'i gnas mtshur gyi ghasdo la nas thon te rkang nad kyi bro ba sel ba'i dbu ri'i chu tshan brten par zhag shas 'gor zhing / der don du gnyer ba'i skye bo kha shas la thugs rje chen po'i smar khrid dang yig drug gi dge bskul than thun las gzhan mar thud zho yi skyes phran bu'i ngo 'dzin gyis rang nyid dge sbyor la gnod cing gzhan phan ji bzhin ma yin pas dub par gyur/de nas thon ste char zhod kyi tshogs che bzhin chu bem la brgyud jo mo gangs dkar mdun du sngar gtor chen kha shas re gtong bas spyi dang bye brag yul de'i mi phyug la shin tu phan par byung song bas 'di res kyang lha 'dre rnams mgu ba'i phyir gtor chen zhig sbyin/ de nas dal 'gros kyi zab phur 'byor/ bod du grub pa'i gnas chen bzhi dang / zab phur mkha' 'gro'i 'du ba phal cher yongs gsungs ltar mkha' 726

'gro nges par 'du ba'i ltas sngar nas yong bzhin 'di res kyang de rnams kyi 'du ba'i tshogs ci rigs pa mthong / der gtor tshogs ci nus su bgyis der gnyan chen po thang lha dang / dam can rdo rje legs pas bod yul du mtha' dmag mi 'jug pa'i rten 'brel bsgrig dgos tshul byung yang da ni bdag lta so skye nyams nyes pa zhig gi de lta rngo mi thog pa'i nges pa yid la bcag bzhin ci bder bzhag de nas rgya mtsho phug rdzongs su de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku brnyan kha shas gzhengs shing / yul de'i gdol pa kha shas la gter sbyin bzang pos mgu bar byas nas lo gsum gyi rings lcags sbrul mi gsod pa'i tha tshig blang zhing dpang po yang mi khungs ldan la bcol/ de skabs nas bod yul gyis lha 'dres 'thab 'khrug gi tshul shugs mi che tsam zhag shas kyi ring du byung zhing / sngar 'di rigs shugs che ba ni 'phral dang shugs mi che ba ni 'gyang tsam nas zi 'byung ba la ltar bar 'dug 'on kyang bar skabs zhig nas cung zad zhi song /de nas sog po 'dzul khung du grags pa rang byung zhabs kyi gnas zhal phyes shing / rdo rje gling pa'i gter gnas skye bo phal pa rnams kyi zab phu dang mtshungs par rtsi 'dug kyang / don du ni zab phu'i gnas phran du gyur pa der zhag shas gtor tshogs ci nus bgyis/ de skabs rang la rgya 'dre 'gong po'i 'tshub lhong gi 'dzer ba'i rnam pa byung yang ji mi snyams pas lam khyer du byas/ don du gnyer ba rnams la zab lam ni gu'i chos drug sogs bshad nas bya rgod lding la brgyud a la phug dang g.yag gi 'brog gnas rnams su tshe dbang ma ṇi'i dge bskul bcas thon/ de bar gzhan gyi sbyin pa'i dngos po bdag gir cher ma bzung zhing cung zad blangs pa yang lam bar tshes bcu yig drug 'dzugs pas bsgrub mchod kyi rgyu 'ba' zhig tu spang dag tshul du sbyar/ mdzad brtsams bal yul du rgya gar ba rnams kyi su yi bhu s+t+ya ta zhes rang byung mchod rten chen po sangs rgyas rin chen gtsug tor can gyis dpral ba'i mdzod spu'i 'od zer las grub pa'i yin tshul bdag cag gi ston pa'i gdul bya de yi rjes su 'brang ba'i bstan bcos ches mang ba dang bal yul du dkar chags da lta yang gnas zhing / sngon slob dpon chen po dbyig gnyen gyis kyang yul dbus nas bal yul du rang byung mchod rten gzigs par phebs pa lo rgyus khungs ma rnams nas 'byung zhing / jo bo rje dpal ldan ma ti sha yang bod du phebs pa la rang byung mchod rten gzigs pa'i zol mdzad pa sogs 'phags yul nyid du shin tu grags che zhing bod yul bar skabs mkhas dang grub pas glang ru lung bstan gyi mdor gsungs pa'i mchod rten go ma sa la gad+dhar ngos bzung zhing / bod yongs su 'phags pa shing kun tu grags pa de zhig grum gog nyams shin tu che ba yis/ de la zhig gso'i blo 'dod bya ri kam sho ma'i zhig gsos grub pa nas tsam ring mo zhig nas byung yang res rang gi brtag pa ma 'chub/ res dus kyi 'gyur bas rim 'gyangs su gyur ba 'di lo yo byad sngon nas sta gon ma byas 727

stabs zhig gso ji bzhin pa 'grub par dka' yang srog shing yo ba bsrang ba dang / gser zangs kyi char kheb zhal gso tsam phul thub na yang phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab par shes te nam dus kyi gtugs shing chu mi snyom pa dang / tshad pa che yang rgyal ba dgyes phyir rang gi lus srog ltos med kyi bal por 'gro bar thag bcad mdzad tshun chad du dad pa can gyi sbyin pa'i yo byad phal cher bdag tu bzung nas gser dngul du dril ba'i khul byas/ lam zhor du jo nang sku 'bum la mchod 'bul dang / sgrub sder zhabs tog phran bu bcas shing / de zhor dge phu'i ri khrod du rang gi khrid brgya'i khrid rgyun dang / dus 'khor sbyor drug smin par zhus pa'i rdo rje slob dpon sbas tshul grub pa'i sa la nges par bzhugs pa dpal brtse ba chen po'i sku gdung la gus pa'i phyag dang nyin zhag bdun gyi bar du ci nus pa'i mchod pa dang phyi nang gsang ba'i tshogs 'khor rgyud sde nas bshad pa nyid dang rjes mthun du bsgrub/ sngar sems dben mthar thug gi ye shes skyed tshul la dpyad pa phra mo zhig yod pa 'dir nyams rtogs dngos min yang yid gnyis spang pa yang dag pa'i go ba zhig rgyud la skyes/ bla ma'i sku gdung mchod pa'i byin brlabs la nges shes lhag par rnyed/ der bal po'i rgyal po dang / ri brag pa gor+ṣa rgyal pos kyang shing kun zhig gso la bkag 'gog mi byed cing grogs ldan phran bu byed tshul gyi yi ge yang dga' bas gtang ba 'byor la/ lha rtse rgya mtsho la brgyud la stod rgyal gyi shri zhes 'dzam bu gling du dpal gyi ri bcu gsum yod pa'i ya gyal de yi 'dabs su 'byor/ de skabs 'jig rten kyi lha chen po gzhon nu gdong drug dang /ga ṇa pa ti'i gzugs kyi snang ba gsal ba zhig mthong ste/ bal yul sa yi phyogs la lhag par dbang byed pa'i lha yin par 'dug pas bal por 'gro ba'i rten 'brel yin nam snyams pa byung / snga sor mtshur phur sdod pa'i skabs nyid nas/ gong sa mchog gi zhabs pad du zhabs brtan zhig phul na rten 'brel gnad che'i ltas byung yang blo khum pas 'bul ma spobs shing / de rjes gang gi zhabs rim mkhyen pa mchog tu rgyas pas rten 'brel bzang po'i mthun sbyor sku tsher dmigs pa'i rim gro legs tshul phebs pas kyang bzang po'i las kyi gsos su thob bzhin gnas chen rnams su zhabs pad brtan pa'i smon 'dun ci nus bgyis/ des spob pa skyes te spyan lam rngo thog min ci ltar yang dngas shing gus pas zhabs brtan 'bul bar/ rang dang lhan —gcig spyod pa dge slong bstan 'dzin rdo rje ched du lha ldan zhabs pad du bcar ba brdzangs/ rang nyid 'di nas 'phral du thon te rgyal bas lung bstan pa'i gnas zhi byed kyi ring lugs pa rnams kyi rdo rje gdan lta bu ding ri glang 'khor dang / grags pa'i mtsho chen bzhi'i ya gyal gnas pa'i dpal ma dpal thang brgyud/ mchod rten gyi shing gor+ṣa rgyal por ltos dgos pa'i stabs skyid grong nas brgyud bal por ci myur 'jug pa'i rtsis su lags shing / de ltar rang nyid kyi 728
