mkhos la dpag pa'i rnam dkar dge ba phran bu bsgrub pa rnams byang chub mchog gi go 'phang gi bar 'dzad pa med pa'i bsngo smon gyi skyabs 'jug dang / bal yul du bgrod pa'i lam zhugs dang rang byung mchod rten chen po'i zhig gso bsgrub pa'i skabs nyid du mi dang mi ma yin pa'i bar chad 'tshe ba mi 'byung ba'i thugs smon bsrung gur rdo rje'i ra ba nas mi bor ba'i skyabs 'jug ci nas kyang mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen/ de ltar rang gi gnas tshul rdzing bu nas 'khyor bas blang ba'i chu thig tsam rags rim 'di snyan dbang yid bzhin gyi nor bur gsol zhing / de la chos dbyings tshom 'khrungs nam yang mi 'jug pa nas tshad med pa'i thugs rje chen pos khyab pa'i bka' lung 'phags chen rnams kyi 'phrin las kyi rang gzugs/ mthong mdzes/ thos snyan reg bde/ drang srong ri ṣi'i bu yi mgo skyes lha mo'i rgyun bzang po ltar chad pa med par rtag tu stsol ba ci nas kyang mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen/ zhes lha yi reg bya dri bral rnam par dkar bas bcibs te rig 'dzin rgyal khams pas phul ba'i zhu chung sarba maṅga lo/gangs ri'i khrod kyi lha yi lha rgyal ba mchog gi 'phrin las pa snang chen po'i sku zhabs su/ rig 'dzin rgyal khams pas zla 12tshes 1la sman stod rdzongs nas thon par phul ba'i zhu yig 'di gal chen yin pas lam bar du bsgor 'gying bor brlag med par ci myur 'bul lugs zhu zhu zhu/gangs ri'i khrod kyi lha yi lha rgyal ba mchog gi 'phrin las snang chen po'i mdun sar/ zhu ba/ deng dus 'phags mchog lag na pad+mo yi 'phrin las kyi gdugs dkar rtsib stong mngon bkra ba yis 'degs shing dkar po gyen du 'phags shing brtan par bzhugs pa nas/ 'dir gnas bya bral ba rgyal khams dā ri dra ba la dgyes pa'i spyan ras bzang pos legs par byab pa'i bka' mchid kyi glegs bu lha gos rnam par dkar bas bcibs pa phyag rgya'i re kha nyams med ding ri mkhan pa rdzongs glang 'khor dpal gyi ri bor son pa bka' drin chen por gyur/ ngos kyang dam pa'i rnam thar la slob pa'i mos 'dun ma bor tsam du gzugs phung khyo re ba'i ngang du mchis shing / snga sor skabs nas 'dzum lang dang bal yul yam bu rgyal po dang 'phags yul gyi cha shas 'bum phrag brgya yi mnga' 'bangs can ti ra hu ti'i bdag po chen po sogs nas rang rang gi yul phyogs su yongs dgos tshul byung yang 'gro ba'i spros pa bskyungs zhing / 'di lo dgun spa gro stag tshangs phyogs su bgrod rtsis yin yang 'phral bal po'i rgyal pos yong dgos tshul nan bskyed pa dang / rang nyid nas kyang bya rung kha shor gyi zhig gso grub mtshams 'phags pa shing kun gyi zhig gso bgyid 'dod dung dung pos zhe dam bcas pa yin yang / 'brug lo rang la ltas ma chub cing / sbrul lo'i gzhug gung g.yog rnams kyi srog skyobs khur lci'i dub bzhin pas bgrod ma nus pa dang / rta lo'i mthar slar yang dus 'gyur gyi lha sar yong dgos sogs pas rim 'gyangs su gyur 729

pas/ 'di lo bal po rgyal pos kyang yong dgos tshul nan bskyed kyi bskul ba dang / gor+ṣa rgyal po la mchod rten srog shing blang pa'i snga sor nas yig dan yod kyang mon pa'i rgyal po blo 'gyur bla ba bcas 'phral du pho nya gtang bar sngar dan bzhin yin tshul byung zhing de lta na yang rang gi sngar nas bdag 'dzin yo byad 'phra zhing 'phral du blang khul kyang 'byor pa srab pa bcas zhig gso mthar phyin zhig dka' rung mchod rten gyi srog shing phul ba tsam gyis phan yon bsam gyi mi khyab pas 'di lo mtshur phur karma pa'i zhu don 'bras sdod yun ring stabs tshad par nam dus kyi gtug rung bal yul du 'phral mar 'gro rtsis dpal thang dang nye ba sman khab stod kyi char 'byor skabs lags pa yang gnas tshul dang / ched du gsol 'os la dwags rgyal pos ring mo nyid nas yong dgos tshul yi ge bar mi chad byung zhing / snga sor na tshod gzhon nu'i skabs zhig o rgyan gardzo ba yi yul du bgrod na snyams shing / de yi lam zhor du 'khel stabs yongs rgyu'i rtsis smras kyang dus phyis zhwa dmar ba'i skor sogs kyi yang bod yul dbus su yun ring 'gor zhing / da cha na tshod kyis gtugs shing lhag tu rang nyid skye yul mtha' 'khob tu gyur par ma zad/mi gshis kyi rgyal po rnams kyi mdun na 'jug pa'i mkhas 'jug bkra lag de ma shes stabs chen po rnams kyi mdun na 'jug shos shig yong gi med pa ni kun gyi dgongs mnga' ltar lags na stod phyogs su phan tshun legs bzlum dmag 'khrug zhi zhing stod nor bzlog pa sogs phan yon shin tu che ba yin snang na yang / re zhig bal yul mchod rten chen po'i zhig gso'i khyad bcas stod phyogs su 'gro bar mi spro la/ lar ni lcags pho khyi yi lo la stod hor bod du 'byung bar gu ru'i lung bstan mang du gsal zhing /de la yang dus tshig rim pa kha yar yod pa'i gcig ni me lug dbus gtsang dus zir byung nas lo shas kyi lcags khyi de yin pa dang / de bzlog phyir mang yul ri bo dpal 'bar du rten 'brel bsgrigs dgos tshul gu ru'i lung bstan byung bzhin me lug dang sa sprel gyi lo snga phyir bsdom pa lo gcig nye ba tsam du de yi rten 'brel la rang nyid kyis 'bad par byas pas de skabs lung bstan du lo nyi shu rtsa lnga'am sum cu so bdun gyi bar stod hor gyi dmag bsring ba dang / de nas kyang rten 'brel bsgrigs tshul gyi lo ci rigs bsring ba'i thabs yod la/ rten 'brel gyi gnad 'chug na dpyad log pa lta bu dus thung ngur mi dges par 'char ba gsung ba zhig byung mod/ de tshul dus de skabs nyid du rang la yid brten pa'i slob ma rnams la smras pa tsam las gzhan dmangs la ni dgongs pa mi che bas ma smras shing / chen po kha cig la gsol bar de legs gso'i tshig byung na yid mgu ba las zang zing gi dngos po re 'dod mi bdog kyang gzhan dbang gi khral brdas byed pa las ma byung / 'on kyang de skabs rten 'brel gyi rtsa ba de dang / da dung yang bsgrigs tshul kha shas ma 'chug na re zhig ni phyir bsrings nus par sems la/ lcags glang gi 730

lo mthar nged mdo khams su yod skabs lung bstan zhig tu rgya nag gi bod la dbye 'byed lan gsum byas pa'i mthar bstan rim la ma brtson na stod hor 'byung bar gsung na/ des na dbye 'byed gsum pa slar 'byung 'dra snyams shing / de rjes bod la stod hor gyi nyen shin tu che ba zhig yod 'dra/ yang shing yos kyi lor bod kyi rje bo mchod yon tshul bzhin du rten 'brel bsgrigs nas spa gro stag tshangs kyi gter thon na mchod yon mdza' shing bod spyi la bde ba'i rten 'brel can gu ru'i lung bstan byung yang mi dbang chen po de nyid kyi thugs ches mdzad pa'i stod phyogs bla ma kha cig nas 'di ni zog po'o/ /lhag tu ga ge mo dang / che ge mo dang nang gshim pa zhig go/ /zhes pa la brten 'tshams 'dri'i zhu yig tsam yang ma gzhes nas lo kha shas song gshis/ de tshul snyan du 'bul ma bde zhing / rang yang tshegs che gshis ci bder 'jog dgos byung / de bzhin gong sa skyabs mgon mchog gi sku tshe'i 'gal rkyen zhi ba'i rten 'brel gu ru'i lung bzhin lan kha yar bsgrigs pa na ning rta lo'i dus 'gyur skabs de khong yus dang bcastse ngo sor 'phyags te gsol bar 'dus sde chen po gsum gyi rten 'brel las lhag pa khyod rnal 'byor pa gcig gi ham par zad do/ /zhes gzhung sa nas bka' phebs pa sogs 'di rigs spros pa bskyung ba'i gnas su go zhing / lhag tu da ni rnal 'byor rgad po mchi kha ma zhig gi bod spyi la phan pa'i bya ba rngam chen 'grub pa zhig dka' la de bas yul mtha' 'khob rnam g.yengs chung ba'i nags gseb zhig tu sngar thos pa byas pa'i chos rgyun dkon po kha shas spel thub na dang nus na dge sbyor byed/ mi nus na sos dal gyi sdod pa zhig la yid smon bca' kyi yod/ de lta na yang stod phyogs su 'gro ba phral ltas ma chub la/yang ltas 'chub nges rigs rang la byung tshe swa yo bhu rtsu ta zhig gso grub mtshams lha bcas 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon mchog la yang thugs dam gsal rtags bcas skabs su ci ltar bab kyi 'phros slad mar zhus chog pa zhu rgyu dang / rang nyid kyi blo 'dod la ni bal yul mchod rten gyi zhig gso grub mtshams mdo khams rgyal mo dang sde dge sogs rgyal phran du mar gyur pas bskul zhing skye yul gyi dgon khag nas kyang lo re bzhin pho nya btud mar btud pa bcas mtha' 'khob kyi phyogs su rang nyid zos bde zhing skyid la rgyal ba'i bstan pa la yang ci nus sman pa'i slad du bgrod 'dod mchis la/ gang cir bal por sleb mtshams gnas tshul zhib mo zhig kyang 'bul bar spro zhing / de ltar rang gi gnas tshul gang yin ma bcos lhug par bu tshas pha mar smreng ba bzhin mdzes 'khrig med par gsol ba la chos dbyings tshom 'khrungs mi mnga' ba nas de zhabs mi yi rje bo mchog gyur rnams kyis dkyus ring thugs rje'i spyan ras kyi nam yang mi bor ba'i phebs 'os mes po'i ral rlung lta bur chad pa med pa ci nas kyang mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen zhes brgya phrag du mar gsol ba 'debs pa'o/ /zhes dkyus ring thugs rje'i spyan ras g.yo bar 731

byed pa'i rten lha yi gos rnam par dkar ba pā ra dza'i me tog lta bus bcibs te dpal ma dpal thang dang nye ba sman stod rdzongs nas dā ri dra pa phran bu las kyang phran bur gyur pa rig 'dzin rgyal khams pas rgyal zla'i yar tshes dga' ba dang po la phul ba'i li khi tam sarba maṅga lo/rnam par 'dren pa thams cad kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba lha bcas 'gro ba'i gtsug gi nor bu'i rtse mor mngon par mtho ba kun gzigs bla ma chen po'i zhabs mthil gser gyi 'khor los nye bar bsnyen pa 'jig med seng ge'i khri ngogs su/ gus pas zhu gsol/ mkha' khyab ye shes spros dang bral ba'i dbyings las nam yang ma g.yo bzhin ma dmigs pa'i snying rje chen pos sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal drung nas phyungs pa'i phyir nyin mtshan dus drug tu smon lam pha rol phyin pa'i spyan gyis gzigs par mdzad bzhin lag na pad+mo'i zhing khams su lag na pad+mo rang nyid ngur smrig bgo ba gsum gyis nye bar spras pa sdom 'dzin rgyal po'i tshul gyis 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi'i rol pas gdul bya rnams 'phral dang yun du bde ba'i sar bkod pa'i byed por khams drug gzugs sku'i snang brnyan phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba mi 'jig seng ge'i khrir 'tsho zhing gzhes te bzhugs pa nas 'dir gnas bya bral rgyal khams dā ri dra pa phran bu las kyang phran bur gyur na yang rgyal ba rnams kyi ni ches dman pa'i 'gro ba yang brnyas par mi mdzad pa rang gi rnam par bzhin thugs rje 'gog pa med pa'i gzigs pas thog ma dang mtha' ma bar du dge ba'i tshig bzang zhing don bzang ba gzos sgo gnas tshul dang bcas pa'i chab shog yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che ji 'dra mang yul gyi rong bal yul sa yi char ur+ṇa'i mjes rgyan du phebs pa yid kyi rgud pa mtha' dag dbyings su zhi ba'i skyes kyi mchod rab dam par thob/ phran bya bral rig pa 'dzin pa yang na tshod khur gyis dub cing bgrod dka' cong rong ngam 'brog gi ljongs su lus kyi ngal ba sbyangs kyang rang gi yi dam bcas pa bzhin nem+bhal la yi rang byung mchod rten chen po mchod pa'i phyir dga' zhing dngas ba'i sems kyi sngon tsha ba shod zhes bya ba'i yul da lta nem dpal rdzongs su brjod pa der 'byor nye'i skabs su mchis pa gnas tshul dang / stod phyogs su spyi dang bye brag sems can gyi bde thabs la 'gro dgos tshul bka'i 'khor lo rin po ches khyab pa/ rang gi na tshod gzhon dar gyis skabs stobs nus kyi shin tu dbul yang bstan 'gro spyi la sman pa'i lhag bsam mi dman pas mkhos dpag 'bad rtsol bgyid khul tsam mchis kyang / da ni na tshod bab dang / gtso bor rang gi las kyi rgyu ba dang ngang tshul du mas kyang dub pa'i tshe/ tshe 'dir thos bsam bsgom pa'i bya ba cha shas phra mo la spyod pa 'di kho na don ldan las gzhan kun chu shing snying po ltar rtogs pas nam 'chi cha med kyi tshe lhag mtha' 'khob dben pa'i ri sul zhig tu ci bder sdod 'dod snga sor bka' shag gi phebs lan du zur tsam gsol 732

zhing / lhag tu stod phyogs 'gro ba ltas kyang ma chub pas bshol rtsis mchis rung / da lam yongs kyi skyabs mgon bod kyi lha gcig rgyal ba mchog gi dag pa ye shes can gyi gzhan phan du 'gyur ba gzigs pa gor ma chags gshis bka' lung rin po che ldog par ni mi spob kyi bal yul rang byung mchod rten chen po'i zhig gso 'bad rtsol ci ches bsgrub nas de grub mtshams sgyu lus mi bde ba tshab che med cing gsar 'gyur gyi rigs gzhan ma byung na rgyal dbang dam pa mchog gi 'phrin las kyi bya ba gangs can bde ba'i brtsas su bka' yi cod pan thod du bcings nas rang nyid kyi ngal dub dkar brtsegs sbyangs spyod la ma ltos par la dgas phyogs su nges par 'jug rgyu zhu la/ 'on kyang yul de ni rgyal khag du ma'i mtshams su gyur gshis/ ldan pa dang 'dus pa'i nad kyis sman dpyad bzhin shin tu bya dka' bar ma zad/ deng dus bod rnams kyi stod hor du 'dod pa dngos gzhi pak+ṣa bdag po ni ma kha nas byung ba'i ḍi li'i rigs te mu sur mal gyi grub mtha' rtsa ba'i bdag po nyid du gyur gshis shin tu brten par dka' la 'grogs mi spro ba zhig ste/ des na la dgas nang 'khrug gi zhu tshig thal ba'i skyon ches na bya shin tu dka' bar ma zad/ lhag tu sbyong 'gar nas kyang bka' blon gyi rgyab rtsa brtsad gcod byed skad bcas de yang mi bde ba'i rnam pa che zhing / spyir ni deng sangs snyigs dus kyi dad sa gsar 'grog las sla tsam las chos bzhin dkon pa dang / rgyal po rnams ni lhag tu brten par dka' ba bcas rang stobs kyi gzhan phan 'grub min ma nges rung gangs can 'gro ba'i mgon po mchog gi tshad med pa'i thugs rje'i mthu la brten phran gyi byas pa don ldan sems la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung ba'i thugs smon kyi skyabs 'jug dang /'dir mchod rten gyi zhig gso ngang tshul 'gro gdong lam yig zhu dgos sogs gnas tshul 'bul 'os rnams slad nas rim pas phul mchog pa zhig dang / gang cir bstan 'gro yongs kyi phan bde'i rtsa lag chen por dpal mgon dam pa mchog nyid kyi zhabs pad brtan pa rdo rje'i ri bo rtag pa g.yung drung chen po/ rgud pa med pa'i rgyal mtshan du 'tsho zhing gzhes pa gsol ba 'debs pa re 'bras don ldan du ci nas kyang mdzad pa nas bka' yi 'khor lo yang skal ldan shing rta'i bgrod pa bzhin chad pa med pa mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen/ zhes dkyus ring thugs rje'i spyan ras g.yo bar byed pa'i rten skem bral gyi phung po gcig tu bsdus ltar dkar zhing / chu shel dbang po ltar mchog tu dngas ba pā ra dzaḥyi lo ma ltar reg 'jam lha gos srid du ring bas bcibs te aṅgi ra chu sprel gyi lo cho 'phrul gyi zla ba'i dkar phyogs dga' ba gnyis pa la bal yul ri yi rgyal po nī la kaṇ+ḍa'i rgyud a ru ra dang da sā la'i nags tshal 'thug por gnas pa mjal 'du ma nas rig 'dzin rgyal khams pas phul ba'i zhu yig sarba maṅga lo/gangs ri'i khrod kyi lha yi lha rgyal ba mchog gi 'phrin las pa snang chen po'i sku zhabs su/ rig 'dzin 733

rgyal khams pa'i zhu yig 'di gal che nges yod pas lam bar du bor zag med cing chu tshod 'gor med gtang rgyur zla 1tshes 9kyi nyi gros la bal yul mjal 'du ma nas thon par phul ba sarba maṅga lo/ gangs ri'i khrod kyi lha yi lha rgyal ba mchog gi 'phrin las pa snang chen po'i mdun sar/ zhu ba/ sngon nas rgyal ba du ma brnyes par byas shing / tshogs gnyis kyi mthu brtas pa la brten de deng dus lag na pad+mo can gyi 'phrin las kyi byed por gangs can rje bo'i go 'phang chen por mngon par 'phags te bzhugs pa nas/'dir gnas phran bu dā ri dra pa la'ang dgyes pa'i thugs kyi yongs su khyab pa yis bka' mchid kyi glegs bu rab dkar reg 'jam lha yi gos kyi klub par bka' rtags kyi ri mo 'dzum bzhin bal yul gyi yul mtshams su nye bar son pa bka' drin chen pos khyab/ ngos kyang 'tsho ba ma brnyil tsam nas tshod khur dang 'byung ba ma snyoms pas lus brtser ba'i khur gyi dub kyang sangs rgyas la yid ches pa'i dad pa dang / lhag bsam gyi mkhar ba brtan po la khras te da lta bal yul tsha bshod du 'byor nas rang byung mchod rten chen po'i srog shing ched du gor+ṣa ra dza'i khabs su nye bar gnas/ ci ltar bka' lung gi don rang nyid mkhos stobs nus pa chung zhing nyams nyes par ma zad na tshod khur gyi 'gro bskyod shin tu lci zhing yul chos kyi mi bzo ba dang / lhag tu stod phyogs su 'gro ba ltas kyang ma chub pa yis mi nus tshig gi sbyangs ba'i rtsis su snga sor zhu yig ru cung zad gsol ltar lags kyang / yang skyar mi yi bdag po'i mdun sa nas bka' mchid nan chen len du ma phebs gshis mi yi rje bo snang chen rnams gsung rang 'dod spyi brtol kho nas bzlog pa'i gnas su ma gyur pa dang / lhag tu 'gro ba'i gtsug rgyan skyabs mgon mchog nas kyang skye rgu bye brag pa dang spyi'i bde thabs su kasmi ra'i yul mtshams mar yul phyogs su bgrod par 'os zhes bka' lung nan tan phebs pa na ye shes spyan gyis 'gro phan du 'gyur bar gzigs pa gor ma chags pas lan dang rnam smin la mi re ba ni/ byang 'phags de sa las bdag lta mos spyod gsar bu ba ni lan dang rnam smin la shin tu ltos rung lhag bsam gyi gzugs brnyan ma yal tsam du bal yul rang byung mchod rten chen po'i zhig gsos 'phral rtsol ci ches grub mtshams da lta'i bro ba 'di ci ru ma song zhing gsar 'gyur gyi rigs ma byung tshe stod phyogs su bgrod rgyu rang gi sgo gsum bka' tshegs ngal dub dngas lan gyi bka' bzhin zhu 'dod yin la/ 'on kyang yul phyogs de ni rgyal po mang po'i sa mtshams su gyur zhing / bod rnams kyi stod hor du 'dod pa pak+ṣa'i rgyal po ni kla klo'i rigs rgyu 'bras blang dor la mi mkhas shing bod la yang brnab sems shin tu che zhing la dgas blon sras nas zhu thal ches na bskyil bar ches dka' ba dang / lhag tu sbyongs 'gar nas kyang la dgas bka' blon gyi rgyab rtsa rtsad gcod byed skad de yi ngang tshul ni kun gyi rtogs bzhin/ des na ldan pa dang 'dus pa'i 734

nad la sman dpyad kyi sbyor ba shin tu dka' ba bzhin rigs dang bsrol lugs mi mthun pa mang po'i dbus su rgyu ba spro ba'i gnas ma yin pa dang / snyigs dus kyi dad pa ni gsar ngas sla chos ldem rgyang can du ma zad rgyal po rnams ni brton par dka' ba bcas gzhan phan rgya che 'grub min ma nges shing /de yang rang nyid rnal 'byor bya bral gyi na'i spyod pa la zhugs na 'gro phan byung ma byung la ci mi snyams las gcer gcer du ma dmigs rung da lam gangs can lugs gnyis kyi mngon par mtho ba dbyings sa nas bkas gnang zhing / rgyal ba mchog gi 'phrin las kyi ched du bsngags par 'gro phan rlabs chen du ma gyur na blo bag shin tu khums kyang bka' stsal gyi khur dngas su len pa las 'os gzhan ma gyur yang /der zhabs pad du rgyal blon gnyis ka'i pho nya yod na smos med dang / la dwags rgyal po'i phyogs kho na'i pho nyar brten bgrod na rgyal rigs rnams dogs pa che gshis/ de'i phyogs can du 'char ba'ang srid pas snga thabs phan tshun so sor nged 'grig skum la yong rgyu de bar 'khrug gzing gnang na mi yong tshul gyis yi ge zhig mchod rten zhig gso cung zad 'gor tshe dang / de ltar min yang lhus mthing khyad kyis gtang bar skabs babs sems rung / rta bshad kyi bka' lan 'gyang gzhir gyur dogs gnas tshul rgyas pa 'bul ma thub yang bal yul gyi zhig gso'i ngang tshul dang thon gdong lam yig sogs gnas tshul zhu 'os rnams slad nas rim pas 'bul chog pa zhu rgyu dang / gang cir slad nas kyang legs lam gyi phebs 'os gser mngal can gyi ral pa'i rlung ltar chad pa med pa ci nas kyang mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen/zhes pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar yangs pa'i spyan ras g.yo bar byed pa'i rten pad rtsa ku muta chu shel gangs kyi ri bo ltar gcig tu dkar ba'i kha dog can lha yis reg byas bcibs te yul gyi ri rgyal nī la karī 'dab sā la'i shing dang a ru ra'i nags tshal 'thug por gnas pa 'jal 'du ma nas asgo ra'i lo cho 'phrul gyi zla ba dkar phyogs dga' ba gnyis pa la phul ba li khi te/ sarba mang ga lo/rnam par 'dren pa thams cad kyis spyi phud gangs can lha bcas 'gro ba yongs kyi dpal mgon rgyal ba mchog gi zhabs stegs chu skyes kyi ze ba mngon par mdzes pa'i ngogs su/ dngas bas zhu gsol/gdod nas rnam par dag pa bri gang las 'das pa'i chos dbyings nam du yang rnyogs pa med pa 'dus ma byas pa'i ngo bor rang gdangs go ma 'gags par mkha' khyab kyi sems can sgyu ma lta bu la phan pa dang bde ba'i rtsas byang chub mchog gis sems kyis 'du byas te bskal pa rgya mtshor rgyal ba dang rgyal ba'i sras slob mnyes par byas shing tshogs gsum gyi phung po rab tu brtas bzhin deng dus 'gro ba mtha' dag sa yis ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes/ lhag par snyigs dus kyi gdul bya'i mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen/ gling dang gru gzings dam par snang ba gang sku rdo rje'i rang bzhin mtshan dpes brgyan pa 'phrog 735

byed dbang po'i khri la lhan ne lhang nge 'tsho zhing gzhes te bzhugs pa'i bka' drin ni srid 'dir zla bos dben pa nyid du gyur/ 'dir gnas bya bral rnal 'byor phran bur gyur pa yang 'tsho ba khyo re ba'i ngang sangs rgyas la snying nas dad pa'i blos yongs su bskul te lho byang tsha grang gi reg bya 'khrug cing chu mi snyoms las lus ngal dub nad kyi mnar bzhin/ da lta mchod rten srog shing bya ba tshegs che shos su snang ba de bsgrub pa la zhugs shing zangs gser gyi bya ba la yang 'jug pa'i skabs su mchis rung / yam bu rgyal po ni spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dad cing sgos phran la yang dges pa'i stobs kyi zhig gso myur du grub par gyis zhes yang yang gsung rung mdun na 'don dang las byed rnams yul lugs skyid chos nyams su myong ba yis 'gor gzhi che tsam yong 'dra snyams shing / stod phyogs mnga' ris mang yul gyi dmag dpung yang / dus snyigs dus dbang gi sems can spyi bye brag la mi bde ba rngam po che'i rgyur byed pa zhi ba'i phyir/ zhabs pad mchog gi bka' lung rin po che phebs ltar 'phral du bgrod dgos bcas yid zing yang / skyabs gyur dam pa rnams la rtse gcig gsol ba btab ste rgyal ba'i dgongs bzhed kyi 'phrin las bsgrub par mos 'dun rtse gcig pa'i ngang du mchis/ ched du gsol 'os/ 'di ka'i mchod rten gyi srog shing sbom ring stobs che ba yi 'dren pa la da dung zla gcig ring 'gor 'dra snyams shing / des na hor zla gsum pa'i 'jug tsam la 'di nas thon rtsis yin yang snga 'gros lhus mthing khyad la dgas rgyal po khu dbon so sor yi ge re sgar thog bar rta zam steng nas dang / de nas ched bsngags kyi pho nya rgyal po khu dbon so sor brdzangs te phran ci myur yong rtsis de ring phan tshun 'thab 'khrug mtha' dmag gi sna 'dren pa sogs mi rung tshul don 'thus ze reg bcas bka' shag gi zhu yig tu yul ltar lags shing / de yi lan rta shad stengs nas ci myur yong ba gzhir bcas kyi der bstun 'di nas shad rtsol gyis 'gro rtsis bgyis na snyam pa yang sems la gang shar gsal por gsol ba lags shing / de yang ci ltar legs bka' lung gser gyi 'khor lo lta bu'i kun tu khyab pa dang / deng dus rtsod ldan snyigs ma'i sems can nyams thag rnams kyis dpal dang mgon du zhabs zung rdo rje'i gdan bskal pa'am bskal pa las lhag par 'tsho zhing bzhes par snying nas gsol ba 'debs pa re 'bras don ldan du ci nas kyang mdzad par mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen/ zhes tshad med thugs rje'i rgyun mi chad pa'i spyan ras ut+pal gyi 'dab ma la lta bu/ g.yo bar byed pa'i rten rnam par dkar ba lha yi reg bya srid du ring bas bcibs te zla tshes dge ba bal yul rang byung mchod rten chen po'i 'dab tī ṭo yi gtsug lag khang nas phran rig pa 'dzin pa rgyal khams pas phul ba'i zhu yig sarba maṅga lo/rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs rje'i rang gzugs lag na pad+mo can gyi 'phrin las kyi kha lo pa gangs 736

can bde ba'i brtsas gyur mi'i lha chen por gyur pa gang gi mdun sar zhu ba/ sngon rab du ma nas bsod nams tshogs kyi phung po mngon par mtho ba yis deng dus gangs can phan bde'i gru 'dzin 'phags mchog 'jig rten mgon po'i zhabs kyi pad+mo nye bar bsnyen te gnas pa 'phags mchog srong btsan sgam po yi mdun na don ji bzhin nyid las gzhan du ma gyur pa mdzad bzang nam mkha'i mu 'khyud kun nas khengs par mdzad bzhin bzhugs pa nas thugs rje brtse bas ma bskyud pa'i bka' lung chab shog yang yang phebs pa bka' drin ches che bas byab/ 'dir gnas phran gyur bya bral rig pa 'dzin pa yang gzugs phung rgyun du khyo re ba'i ngang lhag tu lho byang tsha grang gi reg byas mnar zhing chu mi snyoms pa bcas bro 'tshal bas dub kyang sangs rgyas la snying nas dad pa'i blos da lta srog shing gi bya ba tshegs che shos su snang ba de sgrub pa la zhugs shing / zang gser gyi bya ba la yang 'jug pa'i skabs su mchis rung / yam bu rgyal po ni spyir sangs kyi bstan pa la dad cing / sgos rang nyid la dges pa'i stobs kyis zhig gso myur du grub par gyis cig zhes yang yang gsung rung/ mdun na 'don dang las byed rnams yul lugs skyid chos nyams su myong ba yis 'gor gzhi tshe tsam yongs 'dra snyams shing / stod phyogs mnga' ris yul gyi dmag dpung yang dus snyigs ma'i dbang gis sems can spyi bye brag la mi bde ba rngam po che'i rgyur byed pa zhi ba'i phyir mdun 'don lon chen po rnams kyi lung dang / rgyal ba mchog gi bka' yi cod pan rin po che phebs ltar 'phral du bgrod dgos dang / 'dir zhig gso sne 'dom gyi yid zing yang skyabs gyur dam pa rnams la rtse gcig gsol ba btab nas gangs can bde ba'i rtsas rgyal ba mchog gi dgongs bzhed kyi 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i mos 'dun rtse gcig pa'i ngang du mchis mod/ 'on kyang 'di ka'i mchod rten gyi srog shing snga ma gcig ni shing stobs che zhing la 'thur zug pa yis 'jog dgos byung la/da dung bskyar nas blang rgyu yang sdom ring stobs che ba yi 'dren pa la zla gcig lhag tsam 'gor 'dra snyams shing / des na hor zla gsum pa'i mjug la 'di nas thon rtsis yin yang snga mkha' 'gros lhus mthing khyad la dwags rgyal po khu dbon so sor yi ge re sgar thog bar rta zam steng nas dang / de nas ched mngags kyi pho nya rgyal po khu dbon so sor brdzangs pa ste phran ci myur yong rtsis/ de ring du phan tshun 'thab 'khrug mtha' dmag gi sna 'dren pa sogs mi rung tshul don 'thus ze reg bcas phul ba 'di lta ste/ 'di dang lhan du rgyal ba mchog gi zhabs pad nas bsam yang bka'i gung chen po nas kyang la dgas khu dbon rgyal blon nang ma gshis pa mi legs pa'i rang bzhin yin 'dug pas de la rgyal ba mchog nas gangs can gyi rgyal rigs sde tshan ris su ma chad pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag la phan pa dang bde ba'i rtsas kho nar dgongs pa yis la dgas pa rang gi dad mos kyi khyad kyi rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku yang 737

khyed rang phan tshun 'grig skum gyi ched du 'di ka nas ched bsngags kyis bka' gnang nas de phyogs su bsngags yod la/ 'on kyang khong pa bal yul mchod rten chen po'i zhig gso la zla shas 'gor zhing / de 'phral bgrod rgyur dgongs pa zhus byung bas/ des na kho pa ma sleb kyi bar phan tshun 'thab 'khrug mtha' dmag gi sna 'dren sogs ye nas mi rung tshul dgongs slad kyi bka' shog zhig kyang gnang zhing / sgar thog nas so sor ched bsngags kyi bang mi re gtang na khyad che 'dra snyams shing / de'i lan rta shad steng nas ci myur du yong ba gzhir bcas kyi der bstun 'di nas shad rtsol gyis 'gro rtsis bgyis na snyam pa yang sems la gang shar gsal por gsol ba la srin 'bu me khyer gyis rta bdun shing rta can la gsal 'debs lta bu'i chos dbyings tshom 'khrungs med pa nas ci ltar legs kyi bka' lung gser gyi 'khor lo lta bus legs par byab pa dang / dge ba'i phebs tshogs kyang gangs ri'i bdag po'i gtsug gi lha mo'i rgyun ltar chad pa med pa yang nas yang du stsol ba ci nas kyang zhu zhu/ zhes tshad med thugs rje'i yongs su khyab pa'i spyan ras ut+pal gyi 'dab ma lta bu'i yul du rgyu ba'i rten lha gos rnam par dkar ba srid du ring bas bcibs te bal yul rang byung mchod rten chen po'i 'dab tī ḍo'i gtsug lag khang nas phran bu las kyang phran bur gyur pa rig 'dzin rgyal khams pas phul ba'i su zhig sarba maṅga lo/zhabs pad du/ ched du gsol 'os/ phran gor+ṣa'i rgyal khab tsha ba shod du srog shing gi ched du zhag shas 'gor zhing / de nas bal po'i rgyal po yis yong dgos tshul nan gyi mchu ba yi zla 2tshes 3la bal po mthil du sleb/ de 'phral rta zam zhu yig 'bul rtsis byas kyang gnya' skyid kyi lam kha ba ches pa'i grags kyi cung zad 'then par byas shing / bal por sleb mtshams 'phrad mkhan sogs rnam g.yeng du mas gzing zhing lhag tu zla 2tshes 11skabs skye bo sna tshogs 'dus par dbang bskur bgyis pa'i rkyen gyi zhag bco lnga skor khams shin tu dub pa byung zhing / de las cung zad grol 'phral zhu yig phul ba 'di bzhin pa la chos dbyings tshom 'khrungs med par legs slob nyes sel pha mas bu tsha lta bur bka' yis 'khor los khyab pa yang cis kyang zhu zhu sarba maṅga lo/rnam 'dren rgya mtsho'i gtsug rgyan gangs can mgon po lhar bcas 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon mchog gi zhabs stegs gser gyi 'khor los nye bar bsnyen pa'i chu skyes dbang po'i ge sar mchog tu mdzes pa'i ngogs su/ dngas shing gus pas zhu gsol/ bgrangs yas bskal pa'i sngon nas byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed cing gzhan phan kho nar dgongs te sangs rgyas bye ba phrag mnyes par byas shing tshogs gsum gzhal bar dka' ba yongs su rdzogs par byas te rgyal ba mchog gi go 'phang mngon par bgrod nas bgrod bzhin snyigs dus nyams thag pa'i 'gro ba rnams la phan pa dang/ bde ba'i brtsas su mngon par 738

mtho ba dang nges par legs pa'i ded dpon mkhyen rab kyi ral gri dang 'gro ba mtha' dag la brtse ba'i rang gzugs pad+ma dkar po'i phyag rgya zung du 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can srid na mngon par mtho ba gru 'dzin gyis spor 'phrog byed yongs kyi dbang po 'jig med ha ra pak+shigyi nye bar bstegs pa'i gdan la rdo rje'i sku g.yo ba med par 'tsho zhing gzhes te bzhugs pa bka' drin gyi zho sha ches chen pos khyab/ 'dir gnas bya bral rgyal khams pa phran bu las kyang ches phran bur gyur pa la'ang thugs rje chen po'i do ra nas nam yang ma bskyud pa'i snga sor phran gyi zla bo dge slong par rtsal ba'i bka' lung gnang skyes bzang po rang byung mchod rten chen po nye bar mchod pa'i brtsas rin chen dang po srang gi 'khor lo dbang po'i grangs lhan dang da lam bya ma rta rim brgyud nas skye rgu spyi dang bye brag gi bde ba'i brtsas dam par dgongs nas/ mnga' ris stod du 'gro ba'i bka' lung bskyar ma dgos mkho lam yig sogs kyang bka' drin chen pos bskyangs rgyu dang / khyad par mchog tu phran gyi byas pa don ldan gzhan phan gyi 'khor lo kun tu rgyas pa'i rang bzhin rgyal ba'i 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa can du rdo rje'i thugs kyi legs par smon cing tshangs pa'i gsung gi bden stobs kyi byab par mdzad pa ni dus kun mi bslu ba 'phags pa'i bka' yis yang dag dbugs dbyung bar mdzad pa ni dge ba'i bya ba kun kyang chu thig rgya mtshor zhugs pa bzhin du ma zad/ spyod lam mtha' dag lcags la gser 'gyur rtsi bzhin kun tu dge ba'i rang bzhin can kho nar byin gyis brlab pa gdon mi za ba'i bka' drin gzhal du med pa kho nar gyur/ bal yul mchod rten chen po'i nyams gsos skor srog shing 'dren pa tshad dus dang thug pas ston gzhug bar bsring dgos dang / sngon gtsang smyon chen po dang gnas ram pas zhig gso mdzad pa'i rtsis gzhi ltar na gser ni ldang nges tsam byung yang zangs cung zad 'dzangs shing / gdugs dang chos 'khor bra rnams sngar gyi zangs gser la bal po nor la ches 'jung pas zangs shin tu bsrab pas slad nas dus dbang gi zhig gso byed pa po yang dkon par gyur pa yi da lam zangs thug brling rang blos ci 'khyud zhig byed rtsis kyi chos 'khor kha shas kyi zangs bzo las ma grub rung stod mar yul phyogs kyi dmag 'khrug yang bye brag la gal gnad che bzhin bka' ltar bgrod rgyu snyan dbang rin po cher 'bul zin gshis rang gi dam bca' yid kyi tsher mar gyur pa dang / 'gro ba mang po'i 'jigs skyobs gzhan phan che ba bcas stod phyogs su 'gro ba rang la ha cang ltas ma chub yang rten 'brel sgyu ma lta bur dmigs nas rgyal ba dgyes phyir lus srog ltos med kyi da lam bka' rgya phebs 'phral lam du 'jug pa'i sta gon byas shing / da lta rang byung mchod rten chen po'i ngogs nas thon ste bal yul gyi gnas chen dzo ki a khar zhes rdo rje gdan bzhi'i gnas su 'dod pa der 'byor ba'i skabs su dang / gzhan yang gnas tshul phran bu kha cig ni 739

gung du phul ltar ste/ gang spyir tshig tsam ma yin par bstan 'gro rnal 'byor nam mkha'i dod zur chag pa/ yongs kyi phan bde'i brtsas su mgon po mchog khyed kyi zhabs pad rdo rje'i ri bo ltar brtan par snying nas gsol ba 'debs pa de kho na bzhin re 'bras don ldan chen por ci nas kyang mdzad du gsol/zhes thugs rje chen po'i spyan ras kyi rtsal bar byed pa'i rten lha yi reg bya rnam par dkar ba gangs ri'i kha dog lta bus bcibs te aṣ+ka ra nag zla'i dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba dang po la grub pa'i bste gnas mkha' 'gro mngon sum du 'du ba'i ljongs rnal 'byor nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gyi ngogs nas phran rig 'dzin rgyal khams pas phul ba'i zhu yig sarba maṅga lo/zhabs pad yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po cher/ 'di phyogs rang gi gnas tshul gsol 'os rgyal gyi shri'i ngogs nas mgo zla'i tshes 15la thon te g.yas skor gyi tshul du bong chu brgal/ ding ri'i phyogs su sleb lha btsan sgang dmar sogs mi ma yin dregs pa can rnams kyang dga' ba'i ngang tshul bcas bal yul zhig gsor dmigs pa'i gser mang du 'byor/ glang 'khor dam pa'i sku nga thim par grags pa dang sku gdung ke ru sogs rten gsum khyad par 'phags shing / dam pas gnas nyid rdo rje gdan dang mtshungs pa ltar bur bsngags pas snang gsal gyi mchod pa der stod ring nyin mtshan bar mi chad phul zhing / skye bo mang po la sman pa'i slad du gtor chen dang / zhi ba'i sbyin bsreg nan zhig kyang byas/ de bzhin 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i gtsug lag khang dge lding bzhi'i ya gyal na brlum dge steng du sngon bo dong 'jig bral birlu pas lam 'bras mngon sum du gsung nas thim par grags pa birlu pa'i log ris byin brlabs shin tu che ba de la yang mchod pa'i bye brag ci 'byor phul zhing / dge ba'i smon lam ci nus btab/ sman khab smad dang stod brgyud dpal ma dpal khud gzhung lam kho na bsrangs/ jo mo bya mar grags pa'i ri'i mgul nas slob dpon chen po srin po 'dul bar phebs pa'i gung thang la thog gam bya lar grags pa'i dang nye bar bya brgyud la brgal rdzongs dkar zhag shas bsdad cing / 'di'i bar mi ma yin 'du che ba'i gnas rnams su dam pa'i zhabs brtan 'gro ba'i bde thabs su dmigs pa'i gtor ma chen po re dang / nyi ma re re bzhin skye bo sum brgya dang lnga brgya dang stong phrag gnyis gsum gyi mtshon pa la dka' tshegs la ma ltos par tshe dbang re dang lhag tu yig drug bsgom bzlas kyi lung phog nas lo bcu gnyis yar btags pa rnams la nyin re bzhin yig drug sum brgya re chags med kyi dam bca' bskul/ skabs 'gar byang sdom 'bog pa sogs rang nyid yon tan gyi dben kyang / gzhan blo chos la 'jug gang thub khul du byas/ de nas skyid grong byams sprin dang 'phags pa wa ti la yang sngar rgyun ltar snang gsal gyi mchod pa rgya gang che dang bcas pa'i smon lam rgyas par btab/ yul tshan so so nas khrom 740

dbang dgos tshul nan che yang spros pa bskyung 'phral du rgyal zla'i tshes 22la bal yul gyi lam du zhugs/rdo rje bswe byin ma'i pho brang dang nye bar zhabs pad mchog gi bka' rgya son/ bal yul lam du zhugs zin stabs lan gcig bal por bgrod rgyur byas/ bse thang de gu ru'i gnas chen yin 'dug pas ci 'byor gyis tshogs 'khor rgyas pa zhig byas/ de nas zla gam gnam sgo'i chu klung gi ngogs pa ḍū dang / ri yi rgyal po nī la kar+sā'i chu klung gi ngogs sgang thog mdung lang zhes ta mangs kyi rigs zur pa smra ba de rnams la khong rang tsho'i 'dod ltar gtor dbang yig drug gi lung dang / de nas bal bod kyi mtshams nags klung stug po sing ga ba na zhes pa de nyi ma gsum du brgal nas bod mkhar brgyud rig byed kyi gzhung du gsang ba'i gaṅgar 'dod pa'i chu klung de brgal tsha ba shod du mchod rten srog shing ched du zhag bco lnga skor sdad nas bram ze 'dod pa'i rigs sngags zhu ba mang du byung ba la lo tsa brgyud nas rjes gnang mang du byas/ gor+ṣa rgyal po rang nyid kyang rab tu gus pa'i tshul ston cing rigs sngags blang 'dod 'dug kyang rten 'brel dbang gi 'di res 'then/ der bal po'i shing bzo ba rnams ma byung bas sems 'tshig ste lam du zhugs par shing bzo ba rnams lam bar du 'phrad/ rmi lam du re zhig phyogs der bsdad nas dge ba'i ltas byung yang rang nyid ci brtol dang bal po'i rgyal pos kyang 'phral du yong dgos tshul nan che gshis bal yul mthil du yong / srog shing gi bya ba ma grub par gor+ṣa dang yam bu phan tshun 'thab 'khrug mi byed pa so so nas yi ge blang / na ga ga mir yam bu rgyal po ngos dang bal po'i skye bo khri phrag du mas mdun bsus/ rang nas sangs rgyas kyi bka' rtags phyag rgya bzhi dran bzhin skye bo de rnams kyi skor te yam bu'i grong du zhugs/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dang gzungs sngags bsgrags shing dge ba'i smon lam ci nus btab/ sems la ni mi rtag pa'i skyo shas lhag par che zhing 'di yis dgong mo gnyid yang mi khug pa tsam byung / de nas rang byung mchod rten chen po'i 'grams bal skad kyi kista zhes gtsug lag khang rnying pa zhig tu re zhig gnas phab/ rang byung mchod rten chen por tshogs dang mchod 'bul ci nus yang yang bgyis shing / kha shor du yang de bzhin bgyid 'dod la gnas dus kyi der gnyug mar gnas pa rnams dkon mchog gi dkor la 'phri bcom gzhog slong che zhing skabs su der brten 'khrug pa 'dra yang 'byung gi 'dug pas dngul srang lnga bcu lhag tsam gyi mar me las mchod 'bul gzhan spros pa skyung dgos byung bal por sdod ring chos 'khor gyis zang gser rnams grub na/ snyams pa ther zug byas shing / rgyal pos kyang de don ltar do khur gang che mdzad song yang las byed 'go mi rnams bal po'i yul lugs kyi cher grub pa zhig mi 'dug pas stod mar yul phyogs kyi dmag 'khrug zhi phyir 'gro ba de yang gal che nyid du rtogs shing / slar yang skyabs mgon mchog gi zhabs pad nas bka' rgya rin po che 741

bskyar te phebs pa bcas la dwags phyogs su bgrod rgyu'i lam zhugs phral du byas/ bal po'i yul der sngar sangs rgyas kyi grub mtha' mang zhing / mu stegs kyi grub mtha' nyung ba yod 'dug la/ yul dbus shrī bi kra ma'i gtsug lag khang nub nas lo brgya phrag lhag tsam gyi bar du bal po'i yul du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa lhag par dar bar 'gyur/ de rjes paṇ+ḍi ta nags kyi rin chen gyi skabs dang / de yi rjes thog lo mang tsam gyi bar du yang bstan pa ma nub par yod par snang / deng sang ni dus kyi bstan pa ming gi lhag ma tsam las thams cad phyi rol gyi grub mtha' kho nas khyab pa'o/ /de yang sngar yul pa ṭa li su tra nas rgyal rigs mu stegs byed pa zhig du ru ka'i rgyal po dang 'thab pas/ pham nas g.yog 'khor mang po dang bcas bros te kho khrom du chags/ rgyal po des bal po'i rgyal rigs rnying pa rnams gnon par byas te mu stegs kyi grub mtha' dar rgyas su gtang / de nas mi rab kha shas nas rgyal po de'i rigs brgyud zhig yam bu'i bdag por gyur/ de nas da lta'i bar lo nyis brgya dang drug cu rtsa drug 'gro zer/de srid du rgyal rigs de rnams ram tsam sangs rgyas la ltar snang tsam du bas snying nas mos pa cher ma byung zhing / da lta'i yam bu rgyal po 'di ni sangs rgyas la mos shing / dus kyi 'khor lo'i gdams ngag nyan pa sogs phugs ci ltar yang da lta chos la mos mos 'dra ba zhig snang / 'on kyang blon po sogs nye 'khor kun mu stegs 'ba' zhig tu gyur gshis/ de rnams ni sangs rgyas la gus pa mi bskyed pa sha stag tu snang / gzhan yang deng sang rtsod ldan snyigs ma'i mtha' la thug pa'i dbang gi rgya gar gyi phyogs su yang mi bde ba dmag 'khrug ches mang zhing lo shas kyi gong ma nas da lta'i bar rgya gar shar phyogs bhang ga la dang yul dbus pa tra na dang / lho phyogs ri bo 'big byed dang nye ba'i yul rnams dmag 'khrug gi shin tu rgud cing / pa tra nar nyi ma gcig la 'bum phrag lnga g.yul ngor bsad pa dang / nub phyogs ḍi li rang du yang blon po kha shas ngo log gi dbang gi dmag 'khrug yang yang byung yod 'dug cing / lhag tu kha che'i nub byang sa la gangs ri yang chags pa'i yul du gnas pa'i ḍi li'i na babs al+la mā mar zhes pa dpung 'bum phrag tu ma yod pa zhig ḍi li dang ma 'chams nas 'di lo bo la 'phyo ba'i rtsis yod 'dug kyang blon po shes rab can zhig gi ḍi li'i bdag po dang na babs de legs bskum byas nas lho nub kyi ngo log zhig 'dul bar ṭi lis brdzang ba yi de yis dmag nyen med ces wa ra ṇa se'i tshong pa zhig bal por slebs pa'i gtam du ste/ bden min ci ltar yang rang gi thos pa'i tshul snyan dbang rin po cher gsol ba chos dbyings tshom pa med pa dang / da lam bal yul du bgrod par lam mi bde tsha grang gi reg bya mi snyoms pas ngal ba ches che ba byung yang rgyal ba'i sku gdung mchod rten gyi ched du goms gang 'dor ba'i dge ba yang tshad med par bsngags bzhin des mtshon bdag gi dge ba byas dang byed gyur kun nam du 742

yang nyams pa med pa byang chub mchog gi rgyur yongs su bsngo bar mdzad pa gsol ba 'debs pa'i rten ka shi'i ras gur gum gyi tshos can zung dang bcas nag zla'i dmar phyogs kyi bzang po dang po la grub pa'i bste gnas dzo ki a khar nas phran bu las kyang phran bur gyur pa rig 'dzin rgyal khams pas phul ba'i zhu chung sarba maṅga lo/lha yi lha gangs can mgon po mchog gi 'phrin las pa dge bcu'i khrims kyi byed pa po gangs can bde ba'i brtsas mi yi lha chen por gyur pa rnams kyi mdun sar/ zhu ba/ sngon rab du ma nas bsod nams tshogs chen po nam yang ma smad pas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rdzogs ldan du spyod pa yul kha ba can du 'jig rten mgon po'i 'phrin las kyi byed por gyur te gangs can phan bde dge legs kyi brtsas su dus las yol ba med par bzhugs pa nas skye rgu spyi dang bye brag la sman rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur zhing / bal yul rang byung mchod rten chen po'i nyams gsos skor srog shing 'dren pa tshad dus dang thug pas ston gzhug bar du dus bsring dgos dang / sngon gtsang smyon chen po dang gnas ram pas zhig gso mdzad pa'i rtsi gzhi ltar na gser ni ldang tsam byung yang / zangs kyi cung zad 'dzangs shing / gdugs dang chos 'khor bra rnams sngar gyi zangs gser la bal po nor la ches 'jung pas zangs shin tu bsrab pas slad nas dus dbang gi zhig gso byed pa po yang dkon par gyur pa yi da lam zangs thug brling rang blos ci 'khyud zhig byed rtsis kyi chos 'khor kha shas kyi zangs bzo las ma grub rung stod mar yul phyogs kyi dmag 'khrug yang spyi dang bye brag la gal gnad che bzhin bka' ltar bgrod rgyu snyan dbang rin po cher 'bul zin gshis rang gi dam bca' yid kyi tsher mar gyur pa dang / 'gro ba mang po'i 'jigs skyobs gzhan phan che ba bcas stod phyogs su 'gro ba rang la ha cang ltas ma chub kyang rten 'brel sgyu ma lta bur dmigs nas rgyal ba dgyes phyir lus srog ltos med kyi da lam rgyal dbang mchog gi bka' dang mdun na 'don chen po rnams kyi lung phebs phral dang len gyi lam du 'jug pa'i sta gon byas shing / da lta rang byung mchod rten chen po'i ngogs nas thon ste bal yul gyi gnas chen dzo ki a khar zhes rdo rje gdan bzhi'i gnas su 'dod pa der sleb pa'i skabs su ste lam yig dgos mkho sogs kyang yong tshul phebs pa thugs la btags/ 'on kyang rang dang lhan gcig spyod pa rjes 'brang bcas ngan ngon nyung mtha' lnga bcu skor dang mang dus brgya 743

lhag rgyun du 'grogs pa yi de rnams kyang rgan rgon dang nang bu can shas che bas gos dang mal cha 'tsho chas kyang mi theg par sems brtse bas cung zad ngal ba las rang gi ni gang du bgrod kyang zang zing dngos po rnam dkar dge rgyun 'gro na las 'tsho chas gon pa ldang tsam gyi chog shes ci nus 'bad pas byas shing / gang du yangaci chen po rnams la phyag rten nam khyos ma rngam chen phar la yang mi bdogs cing tshur la yang blang bar mi spro bas des na la dwags rgyal blon la yang sman pa'i legs bskum dam pa'i bka' bzhin bgyid pa las zang zing gi khe spog ni sngar gzhon dus su ma grub na da rnal 'byor 'chi kha ma zhig gi mi 'grub par smon/ 'on te bsgom chung gsar pas gser mi 'dod/ bsgom chen rnying pas lham krad bsdud/ zhes pa ltar 'dug kyang / re zhig dos dang sa rim tshegs su 'gro ba ma mchis shing rang la dgos nges glegs bam ci rigs dang / nye spyad kha shas yod pa ni dad slong gi steng du 'gro bar snyam pas 'phral du de lta dang / nges med zhu dgos byung tshe slad nas thugs rje'i do ra nas mi bskyud pa ci nas kyang mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen zhu rgyu dang / sngar rang lo nyer gsum nas bzhi bcu la ma reg gi bar bzhon pa spang ba yin yang / de ni yong bgrang khur gyis gtug pas shad kyi 'gro bar rkang nad kyi bro 'tshal ba yis rta yang ha cang bde bar ma gyur gshis/ da lam mgyogs myur gyis bgrod de phyogs nas mi skogs dogs/gro shod phyogs su gzhung gi chibs kha mchis tshe slar ngo ma'am tshab rin gang rigs 'bul chog pa byas nas mgyogs byang goms pa'i rta drel re mos gsar rgyu lnga drug tsam zhig g.yar snang zhu 'dod lags pas thugs stabs mi 'grig pa ma byung tshe brtse ba'i dbyings nas mi 'dor ba zhus na cir gnang tshom pa med par 'jug pa dang / gang cir gnas tshul gsol 'os rnams kyang slad nas rim bzhin phul chog pa dang / legs lam bzang po'i phebs 'os kyang sngar mu las g.yo ba med par gser gyi 'dren pa'i chu klung chen po'i rgyun ltar nam du yang chad pa med par stsol ba ci nas kyang mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen/ zhes mkhyen pa'i 'dren byed pad+ma'i 'dab ma lta bu g.yo bar byed pa'i rten lha yi gos mi snyems pa rtsa ba'i kha dog lta bus bcibs te chu sprel nag zla'i dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba dang po la nem pa la yis ljongs nas rig 'dzin rgyal khams pas phul ba'i li khi tai sarba maṅga lo/ jid lam bka' rgya rin po che ma phebs gong du phul ba'i zhu yig nang tshan la dwags la bskur rgyu rnams da lta nged rang la dwags su 'phral 'byor lam zhugs su yin na yang / yi ge de rnams snga thabs su gtang na dus 'khrug phyir bsring ba sogs phan 'gyur las gzhan du ma gyur gshis sngar zhus ltar bka' drin che ba zhu rgyu dang / 'brug thams cad mkhyen par 'bul rgyu'i zhu yig 'di yang 'phral gnang thugs rje che ba mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen sarba maṅga lo/ 744

gong zhabs mchog tu chu sprel zla 9tshes 29la bde mchog lha ri dkar po nas phul ba'i chab shog /rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje'i rang gzugs gangs can mgon po phyag na pad+mo ngur smrig gar gyi mdzes pa pa shing kun/ u gra ta ra dang / go kaṇ+ḍa sogs grub pa'i bste gnas rnams kyi nags tshal la me phyug glang pos brdzi bar mi byed pa'i zangs yig zhu bar gra ngo lo tsā ba sbrags ched bsngags brdzangs par rgyal po yang dga' bzhin du zangs yig la gser chus byugs te/ rgyal po rang gi rigs kyi lha nag po dgu thog tu/ u ma'i ngo bo de wī tā le dzu yi mgrin par zhus don zangs yig btags te/ rgyal blon rnams kyi phyin chad de las mi 'da' ba'i dam bca' ji bzhin blang ba'i dge ba rnam par dag pa nyid du grub cing /slar gu ru bal por ci myur yong dgos tshul gyi yi ge de yi bskul ma byed pa bal po'i badz+ra tsar+ya dpon g.yog gnyis bcas bang r+shayang bde bar 'khod/ de nas rim par bgrod de rdo rje gdan gyi byang shar lha mo re wa tī'i pho brang phyi rol rig phyed mkhan gyi lha chen po'i gnas khyad par can du brtsi ba ting pha ri'i mtsho bdag de sngar pa sprel lor bal por 'gro skabs thog mar cho 'phrul dang bcas mthar dam tshig blang ba byung bas de'i chu klung gi 'gram du gtor chen zhig gtang / sang nyin yang gu ru'i tshes bcu'i dus chen yin pas tshugs bcag nas tshogs gtor ci nus bcas smon lam bzang po btab/ de nas rim pas mang yul skyid grong du yul grong so sos rang ma khos la dpag pa'i bsu ba bcas/ sngon jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha yi yun ring du bsti ba'i ljongs gnas zhes par jo bo'i phyag mdzub kyi bris pa'i yig drug mjal bar phyin/ der mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'du ba ni shin tu che/ mang yul byams sgrin du zhag shas chu snyoms pa'i ched du bsdad/ gtor chen yang lan kha yar gtang / gtsug lag khang la rang mkhos la dpag pa'i phyag dang mchod pa ci 'grub byas/ rang gi 'khor g.yog rnams chu nad bro bas dal 'gros kyi rdzong dkar phyin zhing / der yang zhag kha shas bsdad/ 'dus pa'i skye bo stong phrag du mar byang sdom dang / thugs rje chen po'i bsgom lung yang nas yang du bshad/ snron zla'i tshes bcu'i mchod pa der bgyis/ la dwags phyogs su rang nyid 'gro bar snyan du phul zin zhing / ngos kyi shad rtsol ni ci tsam stobs bskyed kyang 'phral du mi 'byor stabs/ mang yul phyogs su 'thab 'khrug dang mtha' dmag sna 'dren sogs byas dogs blo khol gyi rang gi zla bo dang la dwags pa'i bang mi sbrag rgyal po khag la yi ge bcas shad rtsol sngon la brdzangs/ rdzong dkar nas gza' skar legs pa la lam du zhugs lo tsā ba rgyal ba'i tshul khrims gyis gdan sa yang thog mchod rten la rgyang nas phyag byas/ sngon sgyu 'phrul gyi bshad grwa ring du byung ba'i gnas 'om phug pad+ma dkar po zhes da lta sgrub btsun phran bu gnas pa de'i 'dabs su tshugs phab/ dgon de'i bla mas 'dir sngar yang rdo char kha shas byung 'dug 'di lo yang rdo char tho re ba 752

byung ba ji ltar yin 'dri bar phral sel gyi rim gro phogs/ de nas stag khyer lar srid pa'i lha gnyan mang po'i pho brang mngon gshis gtor chen zhig btang bstan 'gror phan pa'i 'phrin las bcol/ lha 'phreng gi rnam pas kha char che zhing stod du 'gro ba'i lhongs kyi rta 'drogs nas brdab pa sogs 'tshub pa'i mtshan ma yang kha shas shar bas de sel la dmigs la brgal mtshams tshugs bcag gtor chen zhig gtang / khams nas bla khag dang sde dge'i yi ge snga phyir byung ba'i lan ma song ba'i 'byor lan bcas khams kyi pho nya mang zhig de nas brdzangs/ nged rang ngo g.yog rnams bod yul mthu chen bzhi'i ya gyal bse yi skyes bu gnod sbyin gdod nas gnas pa'i mkhar btsan yul zangs thang dmar po dngos gzhi da lta gro shod du grags pa'i ljongs su rim pas zhugs pa'i lam bar du mu khun k+ṣe ṭa'i rgyal blon dang dzusla rā dza yi nang blon gsol kha ba sogs pho nya rim par byung ba dang 'grog pra dun gtsug lag khang dang nye ba legs brtser mos ldan rnams kyi don gnyer bzhin tshe dbang chos 'brel phran bu dang / mon pa rnams kyang bod pa'i lugs/ gsos 'dod chos rigs gtad than thun zhu yang / rgyal blon de rnams grub mtha' ni sa n+ya'i shi la mos shing lha ni khyab 'jug gi chung ma largyu mchod par byed pa zhig go /mu khun k+ṣe ṭa'i rgyal blon spyi dang dzusla ra dza yis bang mi snga mar skyes bzang po dang bcas de nas bzlog bang mi phyi ma de rigs khungs che gras min 'dug kyang / rgyal po'i gsang ba'i bya bar 'chug pa snang chen du snang bas yul phyogs de'i 'gro ba la phan slad rgyal po la zhib mor bya dgos khyad rjes su dkris te ro nyi ta tshangs pa sangs rgyas pa'i klung gru brgal te rgyal thabs byang du tshugs phab/ der dzum rā dza la nged re zhig phyogs der yong mi thub tshul dang / rgyal po chen po rnams rim pa chad pa'i skye rgu bde bar skyong ba yin pas dmag 'khrug gi bya ba mi rung tshul sogs sems mgu thabs kha gsag lcam bu dang bcas don du gzhan la phan pa'i bsam sbyor rnam par dag pa yi rgyal po'i spun dang blon gtso kha shas dang lhag tu rgyal po rang la yi ge dang rten dngos su dge rgyur bsam nged rang gi gzhon pa dngos ma/ gser srang kha yar dang kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i dbang po mchog nas bka' rgya rin po cher rta zam rim brgyud sgar nas der phebs pa'i gnang skyes zab gos bzang po de yang bskur nas phyogs de'i skye rgu la lo 'dir bde ba'i brtsas su 'di res kyang 'bad pas bsgrub dgos byung / lar sa phyogs 'dir snga phyir du mar rang sems rnam par dag pas lus srog thed bor gyi da lta dran yang yid bsun pa 'ba' zhig gis gzhan la phan pa rgya cher bsgrub pa sus kyang shes par mi byed na/ slad mar ni de rigs gtan nas mi thub nges pa'i gtam kho pa shes ldan yin rgyu'i khul rnams phyi tshig snying la slan pa lab/ rang gi zla bo'i khrod nas nad pa dang bgrod par mi bskyod pa mang po zhig glo bor brdzangs chu stod zla ba'i tshes bcu mchod pa 753

rags sam du byas/ de nas gro shod las 'das te mar yul ljongs brgyud de'i la brgal 'phags yul gyi ma no pa ra zhes ma pham g.yu mtsho'i ngogs su snga phyir gtor chen mang du gtang zhing tshogs mchod sogs dge sbyor 'grus par byas/ ri'i rgyal po ke ta ra yi mdun dkar leb ma gos g.yag tu la dwags rgyal po khu dbon gyi bsu ba rim pas 'byor/ der mon yul ku ma rgyal po'i tshong dpon dang mchod gnas dzo ki zhig yang 'phrad par byung / rgyal po de ni sngon dus 'dzam gling 'di na grags che ba tsan+d+ra bdun brgyud kyi rigs dri ma med pa yin 'dug cing da lta rgyal po 'di yi ming dis gling gi zla ba tsan+d+ra ste grub mtha' ni slob dpon chen po go rak+ṣa nā tha yis slob brgyud dzo ki la mchog tu gus pa zhig yin 'dug pas sems dga' bar byung / yul phyogs der yang na ning pak+ṣa'i bka' la mi sdod pa'i durka'i rigs 'bum phrag kha yar gyi dpung gis nyer 'tshe che bar byas nas da lta phyogs gzhan du song yang da dung yongs rgyu yin 'dug pa de la phan pa'i thabs bcos dri ba skad byed/ de nas bya rgod lding la brgal mnga' ris skor gsum las mar yul gyi stod sgar thog tu 'byor/ rgyal ba mchog gi tshad med pa'i thugs rje chen pos khyab pa'i mthus sgar dpon dag nas yang phran la mkhos su phebs pa snang byung / gro zhun zla ba'i tshes bcu mchod pa der byas/ rang gzhan la phan pa'i slad du gtor chen yang lan kha yar btang / 'di lo zla bo rnams chu ma 'phrod pa'i rgyu la brten nad sna tshogs kyi lhag par gtser bas zhag shas 'phrod rten la rmo'agor zhing la dwags nas mi dpon sogs mdun bsu phyi ma rnams der 'byor/ la dwags nang khul gyi lab chings hor zla bdun pa'i nang du 'grub na ltas legs pa byung yang phral du snyegs ma thub stabs/de rjes hor zla brgyad pa cung legs pa yis rgyal po khu dbon rnams dpung mang po ma yin pa rags 'thus su la dang stod waṃ ler phebs dgos tshul snga 'gros gtang zhing rang nyid kyang rim pas brgyud sgar pa yid 'ong gi sku lha de bod yul nub phyogs kyi sgo bsrung mthu che ba zhig yin par snang bas de la gtor ma sbyin zhing las kyi bdo ba yun ring bzlog par dka' 'ang mar yul rgyal po phan tshun mdza' bshes du 'gyur ba'i 'phrin las bcol/ de nas bod dang la dwags kyi mtshams gu ru'i gnas bde mchog lha ri dkar por sman chu'i 'phrod rten bcag mal gcig byas shing / dmar phyogs kyi tshes bcu dang 'grigs pas gtor tshogs rgyas par gtang / skyid grong nas brtsams 'di yi bar skabs su mi ma yin gyi 'tshubs lhong tho re byung ba 'di skabs cung zad 'jam song / sgar thog nas brtsams 'di skor du mon khu nu ba pho mo 'phrad mkhan ches mang zhing skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa len pa yang ci snyed zhig byung / de rnams kyang bod skad shes pa ni nyung phal cher mon skad kho na ste/ de'i rgyal po'i rigs ni gu ge lha btsan po nas gyes pa yin la/ rgyal po la sku mched ni med/ kho rang lo bcu gsum 'gro/ rigs khyad par 'phags pa'i mthu 754

yis yul gzhan du dkon pa'i sman nus ldan 'ga' yang byung zer/ rim pas la dgas ljongs rgod yul brgyud su ri la brgal kha sbyor du zhag gsum bsdad/ der lab chings kyi skor thog mar legs lam che ba la mthar rten 'brel gyis bcos ma byas na cung zad 'dzer ba'i ltas shar/ mung pa de'i yul bdag srid pa'i ma mo mthu chen mo des 'khor rnams kyis yang yang bsu ba'i tshul dang / gtso mo rang yang dga' ba'i nyams 'gyur gyis der son pa rmi lam du mthong / gzhan yang yul de'i dkar phyogs kyi lha 'dre rnams nged lhag bsam gyis yong bar shes bzhin mgu ba'i rnam 'gyur dang / nags phyogs rgya 'dre 'gong po'i tshogs ni khro 'khrug mi dga' ba'i nyams 'gyur mi rnams kyang ldem rgyang nem nur yid gnyis mang po 'phel bar byed pa sogs rtsal 'gran pa'i rnam pa can du mthong / der dmigs kyi mchod gtor dang lan chags sbyangs ba dngos dang ting nge 'dzin gyis sgo nas nyin re bzhin ma chad pa'i khul phal cher nar ma nyid du byas/ kha sbyor nas waṃ ler la dwags rgyal blon gyi bsu ba'i bkod pa bzang po bsham pa dang lhan du phyin/ khrum zla'i tshes bcu'i mchod pa der bgyis/ la dwags sa byon yang mul lbe rgyal po 'phral du ma 'byor zhing / snga thabs kho rang gi bka' blon ched bsngags son pa'i gtam du la dwags pa'i pho nya kha cher song ba khong cho'i lam bsdam pas zin pa kha che'i yi ge slebs mkhar gyis mnga' 'og dmag a khu la brdeg na 'di nas kyang dpung ci dgos grogs su yong tshul gyi yi ge mthong nas yong ma bde tshul sogs dab dib mang zhig zer bar rang gi rgyal ba mchog gi bka' lung dang du blangs te bal yul rang byung mchod rten chen po'i zhig gso bgyid 'phro gshol lam bar du bka' tshegs sbyangs spyod thams cad khyad du bsad khong rang rnams kyi 'dod pa ltar 'dir yong ba la da dung dus su mi 'byon pa'i kha che'i dmag skad mang po ci zhig gu snyam nas sesam lhag par 'khrug pa zhig byung / rang nyid bya bral spyod pa'i skabs dang 'di res ma 'dra gshis khong shong yangs por bskyed/ yul phyogs der gtso bo rgya 'dre 'gong po'i mthu las lam du mi rgyug par mthong ba nus pa cher ma mchis kyang deng sang rnal 'byor gzugs can rnams kyi spyi nor zong gi dregs pa can rnams ting nge 'dzin gyis gcun zhing / la dwags slebs mkhar rgyal blon la nged 'dir yong bar shes bzhin kha che'i dmag bskul gtong ba'i rgyu mtshan dang / mul lbe bka' blon la lab chings skabs lam bsdams bkrol rgyu la la dwags pa'i pho nya 'dzin pa'i rgyu mtshan sogs dris par la dwags pas na ning lug lo hor zla bcu gcig pa'i nang du pho nya gtang ba las khyed 'dir yong bar shes nas min tshul dang / mul lbe blon pos khyed kyi wam ler yong dgos tshul yi ge ma phebs pa'i sngon du pho nya zin pa las shes bzhin min tshul sogs rang rang gi gnas tshul rgyas par smrengs/ de nas stod smad gnyis ka'i blon po che kha rnams slar yang mdun du bsdus te 755

khyed rnams kyi zer tshul der ltar yin tshe khyed rang rnams 'di phyi kun tu bde ba'i ched du gangs can mgon po rgyal ba mchog gis nged 'phrin las kyi byed por phyogs 'dir mngags par mdzad bzhin rang rang rnams kyi tshe 'di las kyang phyi ma'i khe nyen la gzhigs ste kha che dang sngar 'brel bzang po'i rgyun ma chad pa las dmag gi sna 'dren sogs bstan 'gro'i bde thabs la gnod pa ye nas mi 'tshal zhing / kha ches kyang khyed rang rgyal po phan tshun gnyis ka'i rgyab rtsa byed par khas blang ba 'di yang dkrug sel gyi rnam pa can du snang na/ de don thugs kyi mkhyen 'os dang / nged la dwags mthil du re zhig 'gro bar ma shar bas/ rgyal po bkras nam yang 'phral mar 'dir 'byon dgos tshul dang / la dwags pho nya bsgor ba kha che'i yi ge bcas 'phral gtang ma byas na mi 'gab pa dang / der yang ma zad kha cher 'go nad gdug pa med phyin tshong pa'i lam bsdam kyang rgyal khams 'khrug pa'i rgyu yin pas lhod dgos tshul bcas smras bzhin mul lbe'i zhabs phyi ngo ma zhig la dwags rgyal po'i rta shad steng nas 'phral rdzongs byas/ slebs mkhar rgyal po phun rnams 'bod par brdzangs yang nged la dwags mthil du sleb re'i yin zhes 'phral du ma byon 'dug pas rgyal po 'di chung ngu'i dus spyang grung 'dzom pa yod rgyu'i khul dang / da ni thugs ka mi bde skad zer yang gang ltar khong rang nang khul gyi legs lam ni phugs legs lam 'gro min mi shes stabs re zhig dpyad dgos 'dug kyang 'phral khu dbon legs skum slad yang skyar 'bod par brdzangs/yang kha che'i dmag yong rgyu'i gtam chol de bden med 'gro yang / nges med bden par srid tshe mi dge ba'i rgyu chen por dogs la dwags rgyal po dang mul lbe rgyal po gnyis ka nas zhabs phyi do chod nges re la yi ge/ da cha nged khu dbon nang 'grig pa yin pas kha che nas dpung 'degs dang / chings sgrigs la da lam 'byon mi dgos tshul kasma ra yi na mu sur lam gyi skad du na bcas rgya nag gi tsong du 'phags yul gyi se na pā te don gcig par snang / babs dang rdzong dpon gnyis kar la yi ge bskur rgyu nged rang gi mig bstar byas/ 'di la kha che'i mu sur mal gyis se na pā ti kha cig bod du rgyu bar spro zhing gnag pa'i sems yod pa skad byed pa de nges tsho bod rgyal po'i mi bod kyi dzo ki zhig gi lab ching byas pa'i gtam ha cang gi khyab che na mi legs pa'i rgyur shes te 'di skabs gzos shing legs pa'i sgo nas pho nya la yang man ngag cha bcas khrums zla'i dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum pa la 'phral myur thon par brdzangs lar 'di phyogs las sne rags par ma zad phra mo tshun gyi gzos par ma byas na spyi mthun las kyi dus snyigs ma'i mtha' la thug cing du ru ka yi dmag kyang rten 'brel mthus phyir ma bsrings na lhung ba'i dus kyang ha cang gi mi ring gshis rang nas ni de don yid la bzung zhing tsen ne ba'i ngang du byas/ la dwags 'dzin mar 'khod pa kha che'i sa mtshams tshun gyi skye dgu spyi yi ni rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen gzigs mchod 756

yon mchog nas rig pa 'dzin pa 'dir brdzangs pa bka' drin shin tu chen pos khyab pa yin/ gzhan ni da lta 'thab 'khrug yo lang chen por bya ba las ma 'das kyang / 'di lo dpyid bla ma lab chings la 'byon rgyu'i yi ge 'byor pa nas dbu bzung phan tshun gnyis thad nas ci rigs pa zhi 'jam du song ba yin/zhes tshig tu mthun cing dga' tshor chen po'i khul byed 'dug pa de gcam bu min par don la yang gnas nges su go/ /'grig skum byed par nged yong rgyu'i bka' rgya ma phebs na/ 'di lo'i dbyar gung tsam phyogs 'dir yo lang 'thab 'khrug rngam chen byung tshar ba gdon mi za bar nges par snang bas/ rgyal ba mchog gi bka' rgya rin po cher mchod rten chen po'i srid zhu las lhag pa bstan 'gro'i phan bde sgrub thabs ma mchis mod kyang mkhon 'gras legs bzlum gyi phan bde'i gnas thob tshul la mngags pa'i bka' lung phebs pa ni lkog 'gyur ji bzhin gzigs par nges pa yis 'phral la dwags phyogs kyi skye rgu zhi bde rnal du phebs pa'i dge tshogs brlab po che yin 'dug snyam pa'i dga' ba gsar thob byung /snying por zhu gsol/ da lta rgyal po phan tshun legs bskum 'dzom dus btab pa dang / kha cher snga khyad kyi bang mi brdzangs grub cing khu dbon bar du ni 'thab 'khrug gi gzhi che ba med nges yin 'dra yang /blon po'i sras mo mul lbe rgyal po'i khab tu gnas pa yi/ des rgyud bskul te blon sras kyi rgyab skyor rkang tshugs par mdzad gshis 'gal tshom du gyur par snang zhing / stod nas bka' blon la khrims 'bebs kyi gzhi blon pos g.yo sgyu'i rgyal po'i mnga' thang gsum cha gcig lhag kho rang ngo thog gis blang ba yin zhes ho mi sprul pa'i sku dang rgyal po phun rnams dgongs pa gcig dril/ rgyal mo bcas blon po kha shas 'thus te g.yang skyur gtang ba yin 'dug cing / bka' blon de pha mes bdun brgyud nas 'brug pa'i sbyin bdag rtsa bar gyur gshis/ he mi nas blon sras spun gyis srog skyobs ni snying thag pa nas byas pa yin par snang yang / chos byas nas dgon par sdod tshul la kho pa blos ma blangs nas bros pa yin 'dug gang ltar phan tshun da lta'i char 'char rgyags gtang ba yin na las lab gzhi ho bag che bas 'grig dka' tsam yong 'dra snyam la/ 'di skor phan tshun gnyis da ni 'dzom par nye bas gnas tshul zhib mo slar rim gyis phul bar chos dbyings tshom pa med pa nas legs spel nyes sub ji ltar bya tshul gyis bka' slob yang rim can du phebs pa ci nas kyang mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen dgu ldan du gsol ba 'debs pa lags/rang re la ni mul lbe rgyal po dang blon sras dad pa che che tsam yin la/ stod nas he mi sprul pa'i sku dang /rgyal mo yang da lta ni gus pa che tsam mdzad 'dug lar 'di phyogs su lo kha shas nas ltas kyi bye brag sna tshogs pa zhig byung bar skad la/ kha che'i la mtshams nas tshur la res skyes pa gzhon nur brdzus nas gzhan la lto slang zhing / phal cher rnga mong gi gzugs su bsgyur nas dngos su phan gnod kyi bya ba sna 757

tshogs byed pa zhig ring tsam rgyu ba dang / sa rnyen ste hor sog gi la mtshams su chu klung chen po'i nang nas nya bo che dang / sha ba'i gzugs su thon nas des mi skad lta bu'i gtam sna tshogs dngos su smra ba sngon dang 'di lor byung ba dang / zhang zhung dgra lha tsa mun ma yis rtse mo nas glo bur du mi bzod pa'i chu klung drag po brdol ba dang / ma no sa ra nas gnam lcags ur mo'i sgra bcas me 'dag 'phro ba sogs legs nyes ci ltar dpyad dka' ba'i rnam grangs du ma zhig yul 'dir ma zad tha gru kun tu byung bar skad pa sogs thos tshul ltar lags shing / pak+ṣa'i rgyal po rang nas khrims ji bzhin rnal ma med pas spun rigs zhig gi rgyal thabs blang skad dang / phyogs der yang dmag 'khrug gi bya ba mang zhing / pa ṭa na yis dpung 'bum phrag du ma zhig kyang ḍi li'i yul mtshams kyi dpung dang 'thab par gzas pa sogs rgya gar gyi yul gru rnams su da lta rgyal po rgyal phran mtha' dag 'thab 'khrug kho nas skye dgu mnar ba rtsod ldan gyi snyigs ma'i mtha' la thug par gyur pa'i ngang tshul shin tu che bar snang zhing / mar yul phyogs su rgyu rkyen med par phra ma dang stong 'ur lta bu'i g.yul sprod du nye ba yang byung 'dug cing / sems can gyi las dang mi ma yin gyis 'phrul gyis mdza' ba yang glo bur du 'khon zhing pha ma spun zla dpon g.yog thams cad gcig yid gcig la mi brton pa dang / drang por spyod par 'dod pa rnams kyang rang dbang med par rnal du mi phebs pa dang / tshig kyang mdun rgyab snga phyi mi mtshungs shing tshad 'dzin dka' ba yis snyan du 'bul rngo yang mi thogs pa sogs sgyu ma'i 'phrul 'khor ji bzhin par spyod pa phyogs 'di'i gnas tshul dang / gangs ri'i khrod ni deng dus rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje'i rang gzugs 'jig rten mgon po lag na pad dkar 'chang ba ngur smrig gar gyi rol pa gang gis byin gyis brlab pa'i mthu la brten skye rgu rdzogs ldan gyi dga' ston bzang pos 'tsho bar mdzad pa bka' drin gyi zho sha chen pos 'tsho bar khums/ des na gangs can bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde'i rtsa lag gcig pu pa gnyis su med pa lha yi lha 'gro ba'i bla ma gang gi zhabs zung mi shig rdo rje'i mdud pa g.yo med seng ge'i khri la nges pa lnga ldan 'chi med tshe mtha' yas pa'i ngo bor rtag pa brtan pa g.yung drung chen por bskal pa'i bskal pa las lhag pa'i bar du 'tsho zhing bzhes te bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs pa de kho na nyid re 'bras don ldan nyid du mdzad du gsol/ /de skad mna' bo bzang po'i lugs srol bzhin/ /rang gi gnas lugs ngang tshul mdo tsam du/ /ji bzhin lhug par gsol la mkhyen pa'i dbyings/ /khrel tshom med par snying nas gsol ba 'debs/ /sngon dus bla slob rgyal blon spyir btang du/ /bag phebs gsong por smra ba dam pa'i srol/ /bye brag bgyid 'os las la bsngags rnams kyis/ /lhag par gnas tshul zhu 'os khrims su bsgrags/ /deng dus las byed phal pa mang zhig ni/ /gzhung don la g.yel rang don gnog pa yis/ / 758

sub brngan gyis bral gnas tshul brjod pas khob/ /de dang 'phran tshul mthun pa yang ma gyur/ /khye'u pha mar rang gi bya gzhag gang / /sgrib med gsol la 'dzem par mi byed bzhin/ /gang shar g.yo zol chung byas lhug pa'i ngag /chags pa'i mkhyen pa'i spyan mngar gsol ba ste/ /deng dus tshul 'di gzhan la ma bris kyang / /mnyam pa'i spyan yangs brtse ba'i pad dkar 'dzin/ /'jig rten mgon des dges pa'i dbugs dbyung nas/ /mngon mtho nges legs chab gcig stsol bar nges/ /zhes mar yul wam le'i bi ha ra nas khrums zla'i tshes bzang por phran bu las kyang phran bur gyur pa bod chen 'dzin mar skyes shing chos smra ba rig 'dzin rgyal khams pa ā yurmi sho ma ṇi badz+ra gyis phul ba'i zhu yig sarba maṅga lo/gong zhabs su chu bya mar yul nye mi nas phul ba/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs rje'i rang gzugs gangs ri'i khrod kyi lha rnams kyi lha gru 'dzin bdag po 'jig rten dbang phyug mchog gi zhabs stegs chu skyes kyi ge sar rnyog pa med pa'i ngogs su/ dngas bas zhu ba/ gdod nas rgyal ba nyid du gyur kyang srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' gnyis spangs pa'i gzhan don kho nar byang chub chen po'i bsgrub pa nyid kyi mkha' khyab rgyal ba'i 'phrin las rtag par rol zhing thub bstan snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus 'dir rgyal ba gzhan las lhag pa'i thugs bskyed rmad du byung bas 'dus byas pa'i mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku gangs can sa yi thig le mi 'jig seng ge'i khrir zhabs pad 'tsho gzhes rdo rje'i ri bo ltar brtan pa yangs pa'i rgyal khams spyi dang bye brag par bka' drin gyi zho sha chen pos byab/ 'dir gnas phran gyur rig pa 'dzin pa rgyal khams pa yang 'byung 'dus kyi phung po mi snyoms pas brtson zhing rnam g.yeng gi brlab drag tu 'khrug kyang lhag bsam gyi gru gzings bzang po brtson pa'i skya ba la brten yid kyi ngal bso dge ba'i stegs bur gzhol ba nyid du gnas la/ snga sor snyan dbang rin po cher gsol ltar khu dbon lab ching wam mer legs pa'i ltas byung bzhin der lab ching brlum legs par zhib tshag phra mo byed rgyu tsam las zla mtshams la grub par byas shing / gzhug tshag kyang der grub na snyam zhing / la dwags mthil du 'gro 'dod ye nas ma shar yang rgyal po khu dbon gyi nan bskyed dang legs bzlum rjes kyi bya ba yang gtso rgan dmangs spyi'i dbus su bgyis na slad mar glan ka byar med cing mtha' btsan par re tsam dang / la dwags rgyal mo yang khye'u btsas ran gyi mthil du spyod par ring zhing / mtha' 'o ma sogs rgyal sras bzhugs pa kho nas thag chod pa 'dug na yang / mul lbe rgyal blon nas rgyal mo ma bzhugs par nem nur mdzad kyi 'dug gshis la dwags mthil du 'gro ba'i sgo dod/ de tshe la dwags rgyal po yab yum rnams hor zla lnga pa'i tshes bdun la la dwags su bskyod song zhing / nged ni la dwags mthil du 'gro bar ltas ma chub pa'i keg sel du dmigs gtor chen sogs yang yang gnang nas mul lbe rgyal po dang lhan du tshes 759

11la lam du zhugs wam le'i chu shin tu lci bas lam bar du bgrod mi bzod cing / 'phags yul dzo ki'i mkhas pa kha gcig nas la dwags ljongs 'di gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i mthe bong ma ru'i gnas su 'dod pa/ don la yang gnas nges su snang la/ da lta yang la dwags kyi yul mtha' gar+shad ri 'phags dang nye bar gtsug lag khang rgya gar gyi bzo bos bcos pa'i dbus su rdo yi ling ka mthe bong gi gzugs can la mthe bong ma tur brjod pa dang / la dwags kyi phyogs 'dir spyir shing gal pa dang rtsa sogs ches dkon zhing lhag tu gar+shad dang nye bar rong zhes pa'i sa khyon du ni gshag ma dang bye ma dang / rdza dang /zangs kyi ri bo lta bu'i brag ri'i phung po 'ba' zhig las dbyar dgun gyi dbye ba yang chu la chab rom yod med tsam las gzhan mi rtog pa ma ru'i mtshan nyid tshang ba'i lam 'phrang de dag ngal dub dang sbyangs gcod chen pos yongs su bgrod nas la dwags mthil gyi yul mgo he mi las mar mi bgrod pa'i rtsis byas kyang / yul bdag ma de'i cho 'phrul gyi nged dang po la dwags mthil shel kho nar bgrod rgyu'i zhes pa'i gtam 'chol la brten/ rgyal sras rin po che dang rgyal mo bcas der bskyod grub 'dug gshis tshes bcu gnyis la nged kyang der son par byas/ zhag shas kyi ring lus shin tu ma bde bas bgyid dgos rnams ji bzhin ma long sems bal por 'gro ba'i ring khyad ches che ba bcas nyin re bzhin legs bskum gyi mtha' tshags dgos pa rnams bgyis kyang lab rgyu dang gleng rgyu lhag par 'phel ba yi zla ba gcig lhag gi bar du 'phro zhib tshags de skyong dgos byung / sngar legs bzlum dngos gzhi waṃ ler legs ltas byung ba de la yang nges shes khyad par can skyes 'gor chen po'i mthar hor zla drug pa'i yar tshes bdun la thag gtsang mar chod de bcu gcig la bcad yig bklags bcu gnyis la la dwags stod pa'i blon po dang / rang re'i gra ngo bcas sler brdzang nas blon bu spun gyi nang rdzas rags rim sprad pa dang / kha che'i mi sna tshang ma 'dus pa'i dbus su kha che dang / la dwags bar gyi lam bde ba'i zangs yig bklags nas kho rang tsho la rtsis sprad/ de skabs kha che'i khur pa gyad kyi rigs zhig kyang der gsar du son nas kha che'i yul khams su da lta bde 'jags yod tshul dang / 'di lo ma kha'i yul nas kla klo'i btsun pa darnye sha zhig gi glang rkang pa brgyad pa zhig dang / glang lhag pa'i dngos su sha yi ral pa khru gang lhag tsam yod pa dag khrid nas kha che'i grong yul bskor ba sogs sngon chad med pa'i mi dang byol song gi rnam 'gyur gnas skabs mtshar ba ltar la don 'tshub cha chen por bram ze sogs rgan po nyams can rnams kyi gleng ba dang pak+ṣa nas blon po che kha zhig la skyon phabs te dpung khri phrag lnga tsam zhig gsod par byas kyang blon po ngo thog yul mtha' rgya mtsho'i do zhig tu 'jug pa yin 'dug zhes pa dang / nub phyogs bha lag kha dang /bhang kha sogs ma 'ongs bod du nges par 'phyo bar lung bstan pa'i stod hor gyi sde de dag rnams kyang da 760

lta 'thab 'khrug gi g.yul bshams kyi sbyor ba la gnas pa sogs kyi gnas tshul yod 'dug nged kyang tshes bcu gsum la rgyal po yas mas nas thon rdzangs kyi rnam par gser dngul gyi snod nye bar bkang zhing kha che'i gur gum ma'i ge sar mtshar du mngar ba sogs ci ltar 'byor ba'i yo byad bstab kyang se ba gang ngam skar ma gcig gam 'jag ma tsam yang bdag gir ma byas shing mul lbe rgyal po'i mgyogs 'phyang la brten de lam bar grong tshan rnams la yig drug gi dge bskul bcas ho mir son/ de'i nyi ma phyi mar skye bo khri phrag nye ba la dbu ma lugs kyi byang sdom dang / thugs rje chen po'i rjes gnang bsgom lung phogade nas 'bu srin nur 'gros kyi bal yul du spyod pa'i lam zhugs su gnas/ 'di phyogs kyi mi ma yin nag po'i phyogs rnams sngar las cung zad zhi yang gting nas da dung 'tshur nges ldog par ma mthong bas lo shas bstan rim la 'bad dgos dang / bstan rim la tshul bzhin 'bad na lo shas bde ba snyam byed pas de don bzhin gsang por smras kyang nyan par ni dka' bar sems mod/ phyogs 'di'i khu dbon sogs tshang ma bde 'jags kyi rgyu rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' yi gnang ba'i mthu las byung ba yin tshul yang yang smras bzhin mar yul rje bo'i thugs su yang shin tu 'phrod pas de yin bstan pa la bya ba mdzad bzhed kyi dge dgon dpe thub khri rtse la yang dge rgyun mchod gzhis phran bu sbyor rtsis rgyal sras rin po che nas mdzad kyi 'dug lu dngos 'byor skyes cher 'bul rgyu mi 'dug kyang / zhabs pad mchog gi bka' drin dran nas bka' drin che gsol bar la dwags stod kyi mnga' 'og tu dpon khag da lta mkhar gyi las mtshan mthon por gnas pa'i spun 'bri gung dgon gyi bla mar byas pa zhig mul lbe'i bka' blon bcas nged sgar thog tu sleb mtshams gting zin rgyur byas song zhing 'di phyogs su rang gi gnas tshul cha shas rags rim sgrib med du phul ba de ltar dang / gzhan yang rang nyid bye brag pa mdo khams phyogs kyi gnas tshul cung zad zur du gsol ba la chos dbyings tshom 'khrungs med pa dang / gang cir bstan dang 'gro ba'i don du zhabs pad bskal pa las lhag par rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa la brten te bzhugs par snying nas gsol ba 'debs pa de kho na bzhin re 'bras don ldan du mdzad du gsol/ zhes tshad med thugs rje'i spyan ras g.yo bar byed pa'i rten rkang 'thung dbang po tsi tra ka yi pa ṭa ltar rnam par gsal ba'i gos reg 'jam zla ba'i zhun ma 'khyil ba lta bu'i bcib te dpal gdong chu mo bya yi lo zla tshes dge ba la phran gyur dpal rig pa 'dzin pa rgyal khams pas mar yul he mi'i skyed tshal nas phul ba'i zhu yig sarba maṅga lo/rgong sa mchog la/ bkra shis dge ba'i 'khor los rnam par mdzes pa'i zhabs kyi nye bar bsnyen pa'i yid 'phrog dbang po'i ngogs su dngas shing sim pa chen pos zhu ba/ snga sor phran rang gi blang dor 761

gyi gnas bka' lung zhu 'os don tshan gsum du bcad pa tshang mar smin grub gnam bskos gser gyi phyag rgya'i re khas brgyan pa tshangs pa'i mdzes rgyan du phebs pa snying gi bdud rtsi dam par gyur/ 'di nas bal yul phyogs lam 'phrang dogs pa dang / lhag tu rgyal khag phan tshun 'khrug zing che zhing rang byung mchod rten chen po'i zhig gso 'grub na lus srog ltos med bgyid 'dod kyi phyogs 'dir 'gor ches lo yang mang gshis/ zhig gso'i rgyur dngos po rnams gzhung sa'i phyag tu phul nas rang nyid dben pa'i gnas yul 'dod lags kyang bal yul mchod rten chen po'i zhig gso phran rang dngos bgrod kyi legs tshul bka' lung phebs pa yi de don snying la gzhag nas bgrod pa'i lam zhugs skabs su gnas/ kaḥthog gi bskor snga sor snyan 'bul zhus bzhin hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes nyer lngar zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen par khri 'don gyi rnam pa tsam byas 'dug la/ de la sde dge bsod nams mgon nas kyang ji ltar gnas tshul gyi yi ge dang / sngar kaḥthog rgyal sras bsod nams lde'i btsan rang nyid kyi gdung tshabs su bkog gzhag byas pa'i sras sba kha'i ri bla ma sogs kyi yi ge byung ba yang / thugs rje chen po'i spyan ras kyi gzigs yul du phul ba 'di bzhin lags shing / kaḥthog sku skyes khul 'ba' phyogs su byung ba de yang zhwa dmar sprul pa'i sku kaḥthog tu khri 'don skabs yod 'dug pas kho pa dang lhan tu kaḥthog rgyal sras rang gi dbon rigs yin nges bkra shis phun tshogs nas kyang kaḥthog gi zhig gso sgrub chog pa dgos tshul snga phyir nan bskyed dang / 'di res kyang do gal byas 'dug par zhig gso byas chog tshul gyi 'a5sa kyang sde dge bsod nams mgon po la btang ba'i ze reg kyang bu tshas pha mar legs nyes gsol ltar gzigs lam du phab pa chos dbyings tshom pa med pa dang / lar kaḥthog 'di sngar mdo dang sgyu 'phrul sems phyogs 'ba' zhig gi bstan pa 'dzin par bsreg bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin dbon rabs dang gdung rab lta bu ma yin pa mdo dgongs pa 'dus pa dang / sgyu 'phrul gsang ba snying po/ sems phyogs kun byed rgyal po ma bu rnams kyi rnam bshad 'bru non nges/ rang blos spel bar nas pa'i klog dang / bsam pa sdom gsum dag pas bla ma'i thugs zin gyi thog mar nye gnas mdzad cing / sgom pa sems phyogs kyi nyams len mi g.yo ba'i nyams la sogs pa ting nge 'dzin bzang po skyes pa la rgyal tshabs su rim par brgyud pa bla ma gdan rabs bcu gsum gyi bar de kho na ltar byung 'dug cing / de rjes kyang dz+nyā na ke ru nas tsam bu 'bor bkra shis rgya mtsho'i bar de yi sgrig lam phyogs mthun la sems khrid nyams len gyi mthil smar tshangs bka' brgyud la 'brel che ba byung 'dug cing / de rjes bla rabs kha shas kaḥthog drung pa zhes dbon brgyud kyi bskyang zhing btsun tshugs ma shor tsam las thos bsam bsgom pa'i srol cung zad dman pas dgon pa'i lar rgya yang phyis gting sde dges bdag gir byas shing /762

de mtshams gter ston klong gsal snying po la sde dge sangs rgyas bstan pas dgon pa tshang 'gril phul zhing drung pa'i chos gzhis gnyis su bsgos te phyed gter ston la phul/ phyed sde dge'i lo skar 'du ba'i thes su sbyar/ gter ston klong gsal snying po'i sras bdag gi bla ma bsod nams lde'u btsan te/ des bdag kaḥthog gi khri la sdod par nan gyis gnang yang las kyi dbang gi rgyal khams kho nar blo rtse gtad pa yi kaḥthog cha shas tsam yang sdod rgyu ma byung tshul sngar nas snyan dbang nor bu'i ngogs su gsol ltar la/ da cha rang nyid ni 'chi cha med du gnas pas bla ma'i thob thang dang re ba dang dogs 'tshang rgyab mkhan mang yang ci bder bor na nam zhig zog po grub dzus 'dres khyer dam nyams zhig gi dgon pa de bzung nas rnam par dag pa'i chos tshul kun nub par byed pa gdon mi za bar snang bas des na zhwa dmar sprul sku'i skye phreng nyi shu rtsa gcig bar 'byung zhes o rgyan pad+mas sngon gyi gter ston rnying pa mang po'i lung du yod dzir thos na de tshe khong la khri bzung ba'i mtshan skyong tsam zhig mdzad par gsol nas/gdan sa ji bzhin dngos gnas rnying ma'i gdung rigs khung ldan zhig gam/ /de min 'os bab zhig brtag rtsis byas kyang dus kyi dbang gi dam pa'i chos bzhin du spyod pa tshe 'di snang shas chung ba zhig rnyed par ches dka' bar ma zad phyogs ris chags sdang mang po'i co 'dri ba yi bod chen rgyal khams bye brag kaḥthog mnga' ris gdul bya spyi mthun gyi bsod nams las ma grub par 'di la dkon mchog chos bsrung ye shes spyan ldan rnams kyi ma dgos tshe bdag lta kaḥthog nas sa yul ring po'i gnas su bskal pa'i bya bral 'khos stobs phra mor gnas pa nam 'chi cha med zhig gi brlab chen rgyal bstan gyi bya ba ji ltar bgyid snyams nas rang las yin kyang yus dkon mchog la 'tshong dgos shar zhing kaḥthog gi grwa spyi sbyin bdag ris su ma chad pa'i 'dod mthun du skye bo rnams grags rjes 'brang ba shas che gshis zhwa dmar mchog sprul lta bu la thams cad mos par nges yang tshang ma 'dod mthun du ma gyur pa dang gzhan yang gcig shos bkos na gcig shos kyi blo la mi ran pa sogs nged rang ngos kyi mdo khams su sleb na las gzhan ci ltar byas kyang phyogs lhung chags sdang skye 'phel med pa zhig mi yong 'dug pas da cha lar rgya'i mtshan skyong zhwa dmar ba la bsngags nas dgon pa'i khur len dngos gzhi chu 'bab nyid du gzhag na snyam pas de ltar legs sam yang na 'di nas bsgo gzhag dmigs gsal zhig bgyis na legs snying thag pa nas rang gi gnas tshul gsong por gsol ba lags na thugs rje chen po'i do ra nas mi bskyud par ye shes chen po'i gsal snang gi khyab pa'i bka' lung bzang po dang / bod chen dbus 'gyur rgyal bstan snying po 'od gsal rdo rje rtse mo'i ring lugs kyang bslad med ma nyams yun ring du gnas pa'i thugs smon bzang po'i skyabs 'jug kyang brtse ba chen po'i ma bor ba ci nas kyang mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen zhu rgyu 763

dang / gzhan yang mdo khams kyi phyogs bdag gi skye yul dngos gzhi der yang sngar nas dpon po med cing khrims 'og tu ma chub pa la dgon pa'i bla gtso che kha nas cung zad legs spel spyi 'ching byed srol 'dug kyang da lta ni dus kyi dbang gi dgon khag rnams la yang rtsi med rdo ru bod zhing lhag tu rkun khrims jag khrims bsdam pa la zhe 'khon du bzung nas bla grwa kha shas smas la bkod pa sogs de bzhin yul mtshan phan tshun yang tshab cher 'khrug gi yod 'dug pa na ning chu spre'u lor yul phyogs de yi dgon khag spyi nas 'thab 'khyug byung tshul dang de la ci ltar legs kyi 'phros rgya khar rdzong dpon brgyud gzhung sa'i rta bshad steng nas nged la dwags bgrod pa'i lam bar pra dun rtser zla 6tshes 6la byung yang yig lan 'phral gtang ma thub la/ 'di lo khams phyogs kyi pho nya dngos ma kha yar la dwags rang du 'byor byung ba 'thab 'khrug sngar las kyang che ba song skad kyi dmu rgod kyi 'gro ba bdag lta'i ngag bkod nyan par dka' yang cung zad phan re nas dgon khag dang yul khag 'os pa 'os pa la na ning rta bshad steng nas byung ba'i yig lan tshul du legs spel gyi yi ge bka' shag brgyud mdo khams su gtang rgyur byas pa yang bu tsha'i skyid sdug pha ma la smreng ltar gsong po'i ngag gi snyan dbang yid bzhin gyi nor bur gsol ltar chos dbyings tshom 'khrung skad cig kyang med pa nase mtha' 'khob kyi skye rgu de rnams bde legs su 'gyur ba'i thugs smon gyi skyabs 'jug ci nas kyang mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen zhes zhu rgyu dang /yang 'di lo phran bal por bgrod pa yis lam bar dang bal yul mthil du dge ba'i bya ba bgyid 'os la mi dang mi ma yin pas bsam ngan sbyor tsub kyi 'tshe bas mi tshugs pa thugs dam rdo rje'i go ra bsrung ba'i 'khor lo chub pa yang thugs brtse'i dbyings nas mi bor ba ci nas kyang mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen zhes dgu ldan du gsol zhing bka' 'chid bzang po yang gser gyi 'dren pa'i chu klung bzhin chad med du stsol ba ci nas kyang mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen zhes dkyus ring thugs rje'i spyan ras kyi byab par byed pa'i rten sum brtsen yongs 'du'i 'dab ma la 'khu ba'i lha gos bzang pos bcib te mar yul he mi nas phul ba'i zhu chung sarba maṅga lo/gong zhabs su/ rang gi sgo gsum ngal ba brgya phrag du ma dngas su blang nas phyogs 'dir dge bsgrub bgyid pa rnams rdzogs byang chen por bsngo bar gsol ba 'debs pa'i zhu yig rnam par 'dren pa thams cad kyi spyi phud gangs can mgon po mchog gi zhabs pad du/ dngas ba'i yid kyi ched du gsol ba/ rgyal ba mchog gi bka' skye rgu yongs kyi bde thabs su dgongs te phyogs 'dir mngags par mdzad pa'i lam bar dang bod snga rabs kyi yi ger mar yul dang da lta mu sur mal gyi ka ra ri bar du brjod cing / bod rnams kyi la dwags su sgrogs pa yul mthil shel gyi bar phyin zhing / bal yul nas 764

mar yul lam du zhugs nas da lta'i bar lo phyed gnyis la nye bar gyur pa de srid du rags rtsis skye bo 'bum phrag gsum la nye bar dbu ma lugs kyi byang sdom dang thugs rje chen po'i bsgom bzlas lung dang rjes gnang gang gcogs chu sbyin gyi lung rnams sgo gsum 'bad pas dam pa chos kyi sbyin par dmigs pa dang / gzhan yang bsnyen gnas bsnyung gnas dang so thar skyabs sdom gyi sdom pa len pa yang ches mang zhing tshangs spyod kyi dge bsnyen chos kyi sgor zhugs pa yang snga phyir brgyad brgya nye ba tsam byung ba dang /gtso bor mar yul gyi rje 'bangs rnams mkhon sel sbyangs nas mthun gshib legs spel la bkod nas gangs can bde ba'i brtsas su bsgrubs pa sogs rang gi 'khos la dpags pa'i bsdu dngos bzhi'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ji snyed bgyid pa de kun mkha' khyab kyi 'gro ba pha ma'i rang bzhin yong dang thun mong du bgyis shing / des kyang bdag tshe rabs kun tu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'phrin las kyi byed po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi bran du gyur te khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mtha' dag sel ba'i byed por 'grub par bsngo smon gyi rgyas 'debs ci nas kyang bka' drin chen po'i khyab pa dang / de ltar dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'i dge ba rlabs chen gyur pa de yi mthu byin yang dus skabs 'dir ni gangs ri'i khrod kyi lha yi lha 'jig rten mgon po mchog khyed nyid kyi zhabs pad brtan pa dang / gzhan yang bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam par gyur pa rnams kyi sku tshe
