brtan zhing thugs mthun pa dang / rgyal bstan 'khor lo'i gsum po rgyas pa dang / mthar thug nges don snying po'i bstan pa mchog tu dar ba'i ched du bsngo ba ste de kho na bzhin 'grub par yang thugs smon gyi do ra nas nam yang mi bskyud pa ci nas kyang mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen zhes gsol ba 'debs pa'i rten dngos po pad+ma'i rnal ma ltar phra yang mos dge kun bzang rol pa'i sprin du dmigs nas phul ba nyid dang / 'chi med bskal pa'i shing gi pad+mo ltar rnam par dkar ba lha yi reg bya srid du ring ba'i maṇ+ḍal la 'phags yul gyi rū pa kar+sha pā ṇa nyi shu rtsa bdun tshom bur bkod cing / bha lag kha yi gser gyi kar+sha pā ṇa dbang po'i grangs ldan gyis kyang mjos par byas pa snga sor bka' rgya rin po che lhan du phul du byung ba'i gnang skyes zab gos ji snyed pa rnams rnal ma gcig yang chud zos ma song ba legs spel gyi rgyu song zhi nga/ su waṇi srang gi 'khor lo snga ma lnga/bar ma gcig phyi ma gsum ste khyon srang gi 'khor lo dgu ldan phebs pa de yang gong smos phran gyi rnam par dge tshogs sgrub pa rnams byang chen snying po'i bar nyams med rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'i rten du gus pas phul ba rnam kun thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor du chub pa mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen sarba maṅga lo/kha che dang la dwags bar sku 'grul tshong pa rnams ma dus phyi ma mthar thug gi bar phan bde'i che ba'i brtsas su zangs yig lnga bgyis pa'i gcig kyang rnam dkar dge rgyun zhabs 765

brtan gyi tshul zhabs pad du phul ba'i pā tra saza maṅga oṃ/ le kha spel margo ma na/ oṃ swāste/na maḥs ra me shwa ra ya/ bod dang 'phags yul gyi mtshams su rgyal khag mang po 'dus pa'i sgo mar yul ljongs kyi khu dbon blon 'bangs tshang ma'i bde thabs bsil ljongs kyi rwa bas yongs su bskor ba'i — bstan 'gro yongs la smanadzā pa'i brtsas su dmigs te mar yul rgyal blon rnams kyi mos ngo dang mthun par phyogs med ris med kyi rgyal khams pa sgo ṭa dzo ki ha ri nā tha 'di nas ched du mngags bzhin yun lo zla'i bar tshegs che btul te mar yul ljongs kyi rjedzha'abangs tshang 'jags che legs spel bgyis pa'i so so'i blo la 'bab gshim sim par gyur pa rang rang gi sems gsal don yig brtsig rgyab yig tu bkod nas tshul bzhin gnas rgyu rang rtags kyi re kha mdong gsol du phul bzhin mtha' bsdom dkon mchog rtsa gsum chos bsrung ye shes dang 'jig rten 'phel zad nus pa mthu ldan dregs pa can la dpang du gsol nas rje blon 'bangs bcas tshang mas yig dan bzhin blang dor ma 'khrul bar byed rgyu mna' chu 'thung zhing bro lan grangs du mar bor ba yin 'dug pa da cha slad mar bstan 'gro spyi bye brag pa'i bde thabs de las 'gal ba byas tshe chos bsrung rnams kyi bka' yi chad pa drag po 'beb cing 'di nas kyang gnyer du gtad pa yin la blang dor ma nyams tshul bzhin bgyid pa po la 'di phyi kun tu dge legs su 'gyur ba'i bsngo smon bzang po'i rgyas 'debs bgyid pa yang mchog dman mtha' dag gi thig ler nges par bgyis/zhes gangs can ri'i khrod kyi gru 'dzin mngon par mtho ba dang nges par legs pa'i so brang chen po nas dpal gdong chu bya zla tshes la bris/zha dmar dang si ngu la chu bya mar yul la dwags he mi nas/ rnam 'dren zhwa dmar mchog gi sprul pa'i sku dang thams cad mkhyen pa si tu rin po che yab sras zhabs pad du/ der gsang gsum rdo rje'i rang bzhin rnyog pa med par mtha' yas 'gro ba rnams kyi dpal du lhan ne lhang nger bzhugs pa bka' drin bla lhag tu gyur/ 'dir gnas bya bral rgyal khams pa yang bsil ldan gyi ljongs bod dang bod chen po'i rgyal khams mtha' dag pa la phan pa dang bde ba'i brtsams bla na ma mchis pa rgyal ba mchog gi 'phrin las kyi ched du du ru ka'i dmag dpung bcil bar mar yul gyi phyogs su son cing chu sprel gyi lo kha che nas dpung brdol du cha ba yang rang bzhin gyi zhi 'dug cing / sbyongs khar gyi rgyal po pha tshan zla ba ba dur gyi bkum nas des rgyal po byas yod 'dug la/ stod hor gyi yul dngos gzhi bha lag kha dang bho khar dang / tsa ma ra rnams da lta nang 'khrug dang nang 'khrugs med par bde tshe bod kyi yul du dpung 'jug rgyu yin skad 'dug gang ltar phyogs 'dir 'di lo re ni bde song lar ltas spyi phyi nang gang la dpag na bod spyi yi bde thabs rten 'brel phyogs la gal che dgos su snang / de ka yab sras mchog gi zhabs pad 766

kaḥthog rdo rje gdan mi 'jig seng ge'i khrir nye bar bkod de rten 'brel legs tshogs kyi sgo 'du bar mdzad pa ni bka' drin bla lhag lasaspyang bla lhag tu gyur/ snga 'gyur gyi ring lugs kaḥthog gi lta grub dang dpal karma kai tshang pa chen po'i ring lugs gnas nas dbyer med du grub bzhin slad nas kyang kaḥthog gi seng ge'i khrir gdan chags shing 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i bstan pa dang / snying po phyir mi sdog pa 'khor lo'i gtam/ gnyug ma rlung sems dbyer med gdams pa rnams gcig tu bskyangs nas mtha' yas pa'i sems can rnams nyer 'tshor brgyal bstan ji srid gyi bar du gnas pa snying nas gsol ba 'debs pa re 'bras don ldan du thugs kyi dpal be'ur bskyi ba dang / yang sku zhabs yab sras phyogs su 'phrin las skyong ba'i skabs su zhal skyin dang rgyun du'ang dgon pa che kha'i bzhin thur 'chad rdo rje slob dpon zhig bsko gzhag byas na yang rnam pa bde ba'i brtsas su 'gyur ram snyam pas de yang skabs su gang babs slar 'phros zhu rgyu dang / gzhan yang spyi bye brag gi ngang tshul sgo gang zab dgongs pas dpyad de gnang lugs dang / da lam rta zam steng nas zhu yig zhib rgyas ma long yang slar ched mngags bang mi zhig zhabs pad du bcar rtsis te/gang spyir rgyal bstan yongs kyi sgron me mgon po yab sras mchog gi zhabs pad rdo rje'i ri bo ltar bskal pa'i bskal pa las lhag par 'tsho gzhes brtan par snying nas gsol ba 'debs pa de kho na bzhin re 'bras don ldan du mdzad du gsol/ zhes tshad med thugs rje chen po'i spyan ras g.yo bar byed pa'i rten lha gos rnam par dkar ba dang stod hor bha lag kha'i gser gyi pā ṇa ma sa nyi shu bcas dpal gdong chu bya zla tshes bzang po la mar yul he mi'i skyed tshal nas phul ba'i zhu yig sarba maṅga lo/yang si tu rin chen gud du ched gsol/ bdag snying mdzes par byed pa'i tog kun gzigs bla ma mchog gi zhabs stegs ge sar rnam par mdzes pa'i ngogs su/ gud du ched gsol/ da lam 'di phyogs gnas tshul zhib rgyas phul bar shin tu spro yang gzhung sar 'di ka'i legs bskum gyi bskor yig tshogs mang po zhig 'bul dgos dang / sde dger yang zhwa dmar khri 'don gyi skor zhib mor brjod dgos bcas dang / rang nyid kyang mar yul nas thon pa'i lam zhugs su gyur pa bcas da lam res rgyas par 'bul ma thub yang sde dge bsod nams mgon po'i drung la song ba'i yi ge dngos ma'i nang nas btus pa dang /zur gsal gyi yi ge'i reg gzigs de kar phul ba gzhan la gsung 'os mdzad khyab de ltar gnang rgyu dang / sku 'bum ring mo'i zhig gso 'tshub cha chung la gshis 'jam shing rten 'brel rtsa ba che gshis rang cag nas gnang rgyu dgongs par bzhugs pa nas bka' khyab gnas skabs thig pas mi brdung zhing /rkun bsrung dkon mchog gnyer zhig kyang 'jog na snyam pas de lugs/ dam can khang sogs nas 767

'tshub nyams shin tu che bar mthong bas zhing skyong rang nas bcos 'dod yod tshe chu 'bab tu bor ba nyid 'os su che bar mthong bas yang gsang ba'i gnas tshul dang / lar me yos lo 'jug nas kaḥthog gi bsrung ma rnams 'khrug pa'i ltas byung zhing / de mdo khams spyi la yang 'tshub pa'i mtshan nyid yin 'dug pa rten 'brel gyi bcos la nges par 'bad dgos su snang / gu h+ya pa tram gyi skor yang phugs ji ltar ma nges ga shis nang tshags de nas yang bab pa byed kyi mi 'dug pas sngar thag gcod ma tshar phyin da ni chu 'bab zom 'jog legs par snyams pas dgongs spyad dang / kho bo kun mkhyen gyi sprul pa'i sku'i skor ni rong zhabs phyogs rje dbon bsam 'phel drung la gtsug phud phul ba de la bdag rkyen legs tsam gnang na snyams la gang cir nges 'grong slar 'bul rtsis zhu/ bod spyi'i bstan rim sogs dang lhag tu rten 'brel sgrig phyogs thabs la ma mkhas na stod hor ram du ru ka'i yang da ni shin tu lhung nye ba'i ltas mang zhig yod 'dug lags na yang 'di lo'i res ni de yi rgyu rkyen 'gro ba rnams zhi bar byas yod/ sngar lcags rta lor sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya bklags dgos pa'i ltas gsal po zhig byung bas sngar bod kyi dpe rnying phal cher tshig 'dra min gyi dpyad mi bzod pa dang gnyan 'gyur jo nang rje btsun gyi rgya dper gtugs pa de yang yig mkhan gyi rkyen gyis ji bzhin nges pa ma 'grong gshis 'phags ma rang nyid la gsol ba rtse gcig btab ste/ jo bo dang lo chen rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur rnyed na snyam yang bal yul nas rgya dpe 'byung ba'i mtshan ma thob bzhin bal po nas rgya dpe rnyed de shus pa 'di bzhin bod dber med pa'i sngags sogs lhug pa dang / la la ni sngags kyi rnam par snang yang tshig lhug yin nam snyam pa'i dogs pa can yang snang la/ gang spyir de zhabs nas zhib dpyad kyi legs par bsgyur nas rta bshad steng du 'phral gtong yod pa zhu/ 'di byin brlab ni shin tu che/ mtshon gyi bskal pa yang zhi bar bsngags pa yin/ mgon khyod zhabs pad rdo rje'i ri bo ltar yun ring du brtan pa gsol ba snying nas 'debs pa re 'bras don ldan du gyur cig rten gser gyi dong rtse bcas phul/ lags/ sde dge bsod nams mgon po'i yi ger gsal ltar sku 'bum ring mor de zhabs kyi grwa pa rdzi gsang yod pa zhig mchod 'bul sku gnyer du bzhag dgos shin tu gal chen gtang snyoms su ma lus pa dang / de yi gzungs bzhugs dpe rnams yig 'bru gcig yang chud zos ma song bar mchod rten so so'i de rags rtsis kyi so sor phad bu'i nang du brdzang nas slar zhig gsos skabs so sor 'bul chog pa byed rgyu 'di sngon la gzhan sus kyang ma thos par gsang thabs kyi ma byas na k+ṣe ṭa sogs kyi thos tshe des rku thabs kyi blang ba'i drag tu gtor ba sogs chud zos kyi rgyu brlab po che byed par nges pas des na de lugs kyi zon bskyor steng nas gnang khyab yod pa ci nas kyang zhu zhu/ gang cir 'di nas gra ngo zhig 'phral du gtang rtsis mchis da lam rta shad 768

steng nas song gshis kha seng gi 'byor lan tshang ma 'bul ma thub pa chos dbyings tshom pa med pa zhu ba sarba maṅga lo/kun mkhyen 'drug pa la chu bya mar yul zhe mi nas/ bsgrub brgyud 'dzin pa thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bu rgyal dbang drug pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mor dngas ba chen pos btud pa'i zhu yig deng dus zab gsal bde ba chen po rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin las g.yo ba med par 'gro ba'i nyer 'tshor bskyed pa'i rtsa lag bla na med par lhan ne lhang nger bzhugs pa'i bka' drin bla lhag tu che/ 'dir yang 'tsho ba khyo re ba'i ngang legs spel ni mthar phyin pa grub/ na ning chu spre'i lor kha che'i dpung brdol la nye ba byung 'dug 'di lo ni da lta phan dus bde/ bka' brgyud yang sgar thog tsam nas brdzong rtsis lags/ rgyal sras rin po che nas gsung 'bum par du brko rgyu de'i legs 'bul nged nas sde dge'i bka' 'gyur spus gtsang nges zhig btab rgyur byas pas/ des na sngar gyi par yig glegs bam rnams zhus dag yang bskyar dgos rigs yod na 'phral du thugs rje che lugs dang / da ni bdag kyang na tshod kyi gtug pa'i nam 'chi cha med yin na par de yang sde dge bsgrub bgyid rtsis lags pa zab dbyings rin po cher 'jug pa dang / gang cir mi ring bar dngos su mjal nas thugs kyi dgongs pa yang ji bzhin bskang nus par smon/ slob dpon gang ba rdo rje'i man ngag gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi bsnyen tshad rtags ldan zhig 'phral du gnang na snyam pa de ltar yang zab dbyings rin po cher 'jug pa ci nas kyang mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen/ dpon slob mi 'brel lhan gcig 'grogs/ /sku tshe mi 'gyur bsra zhing brtan/ /ja bzang gzhes spro rgyun mi chad/ /skyid la chos 'phel bkra shis shog /zhes zla tshes bzang po la mnga' ris mar yul he mi'i skyed tshal nas phul ba'i zhu yig sarba maṅga lo/dpal gdong chu bya mar yul la dwags rgyal po khu dbon rje 'bangs legs spel skabs mdo khams n+de dge rgyal po bsod nams mgon bo'i drung la kaḥthog rdo rje gdan gyi skor sogs shur+ghaṃ/ bod chen po'i rgyal khams su dge bar byed pa'i 'byung gnas 'dzin ma chos bzhin du skyong ba po lha las bab pa mi yi rje bo mchog gi sku gzhogs su/ zhu ba 'dir bya bral rgyal khams pa yang bal yul rang byung mchod rten chen po'i zhig gso zhig 'grub par re nas bal yul du bgrod par byas kyang / gangs can rgyal ba chen po'i bkas la dwags khu dbon nang 'khrug pa'i rgyu la brten/ du ru ka'i dmag dpung g.yo nas gangs can spyi'i bde ba 'jom par yang gzas pas des na mi bde ba'i duḥkha sel zhing bde ba'i go skabs dbye ba'i slad du gangs can ljongs kyi stod kyi yul mthar thug pa mar yul zhes kha che'i yul mtshams rgya gar bhak+ṣa rgyal po'i mnga' 'og der 'gro dgos tshul phebs bzhin gangs 769

can spyi'i bde thabs la bsam ngal dub dka' ba khyad du bsad nas der phyin ste da lta rgyal po phan tshun gyi legs spel thar son grub cing / 'di lo'i res stod hor gdug pa du ru ka'i dpung yang phyir bcil ba sogs gangs can spyi la drin du yod pa byas na da ni nam 'chi cha med sems skyo shas kyi dub kyang 'tsho ba ji srid kyi ring rgyal ba'i bstan dang sems can gyi don g.yel bar gtang bya yo yin pas da cha bal yul rang byung mchod rten chen po'i zhig gso bsgrub pa'i ched du bgrod pa'i lam zhugs su gnas/ de kar lha btsun bla ma'ibyong dang / lcam drung snga phyir sku gshegs pa gnas lugs ma legs byung 'dug kyang / 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid mtha' dag mi rtag pa rmi lam dang glog dang chu sbur ltar mkhyen nas thugs ngal mi 'tshal la/ sku gshegs de rnams kyi dgongs rdzogs nyid rang nas ser sna'i mdud pa yongs su dkrol nas 'phang med kyi sbyin gtang mdzad 'dug pa ya rabs dam pa'i rnam thar du 'os shing rig pas rjes su yi rang / nged la yang sngar sa skya brgyud nas bal yul du lcam drung gi dgongs rdzogs ltos che dang / bzang po can nas gzhung gi rta shad brgyud bla ma'i drung dang lcam drung bcas kyi dgongs rdzogs rten dngos/ de rjes zhwa dmar ba khri 'don ched du dang / ched bsngags nyid kyi drung du bang mi brdzang bar yang rten dngos bzang po gnang 'dug pa bdag rang ni chung ngu nas zang zing gi dngos po la de tsam gyi cer cer po med la/ 'on kyang dge 'dun gyi sde gtsug lag khang rten gsum gyi ched du las bdag gir 'dzin pa ha cang mi mang zhing / des na bal yul phyogs su lhag par brim pa kha shas 'dir gzhag yod la/ gzhan ni da lam rta bshad steng nas ma bde yang 'di nas mnga' ris stod kyi rgyal khag rnams legs bskum yang dag grub cing du ru ka'i dmag dpung zhi bar snyan pa'i gtam rgyal ba mchog gi zhabs pad dang / mdun na 'don chen po rnams la la dwags rgyal po nas mi sna 'phral gtang zla ba drug pa'i nang du thon nges 'dug pas de dang lhan du 'di nas kyang gra ngo zhig bzang po can gyi rjes zin nam ma zin yang tshong pa rnams dang sne 'phrad byed rgyur brdzang rtsis te/ de yang kaḥthog gi zhig gso skor gnad du ma song na mi legs par snyam nas re zhig bshol ba ste/ kaḥthog nyin dgon 'di sngar rang re'i pha mes rngu yi bla mas btab pa kaḥthog rang gi thugs dpe'i gnas su dam pa gong ma rnams kyi bsngags kyang / dus phyis zhing gcod zung gi blo bde zhi med du byas 'dug pa rten 'brel spyi dang bye brag kaḥthog gi yul bdag dang sbyin bdag gi gtso bo sde dge rgyal po rang nyid yin na de yi rten 'brel la yang gnod tshab che ba zhig byung bar shes la/ de ltas zhing skyong rang nas rang lhag tu dbon po bkra shis phun tshogs nas dpal spung brgyud zhig gso byed dgos tshul yang yang 'phros byung rung re zhig 'then pa yin na'ang da cha sems can spyi mthun las 'gog tu yang med cing / lhag tu gtsug lag khang yang snying chos nas 770

zhig ral du gyur na mi legs pa bcas gtsug lag khang rnying pa la bcos bsgyur cung zad yang ma song zhing sa rdo rnying pa bor zag mi gtang bar mi byed dka' med kyi ka gdung yo 'khyoms bsrang ba thig tshag byed dgos las gzhan 'di snang mkhas 'dod che 'dod kyi nam du yang mi rung bar bka' khyab pa dang de yang zhing skyong rang nas lo mang po'i snga rol nas kaḥthog gi zhig gso la bsnyad pa'i rgyal khams thag ltar du sbran chu ltar du nyul rnyed dgu bsdus te gzhag kaḥthog gi zhig gso rig 'dzin chen po'i bkas ma gnang zhes dkor rdzas bag med khyim gyi gso sbran la gtang zhing gtsug lag khang gi rkun bsrung gi do gal tsam yang mi byed pa skabs su mi che bas des na dad can gyi gtsug lag la mi dmigs te phul ba'i dkor gtsug lag khang gi zhig gsor ma gtang na sdig nyung mi zad pa'i rgyur che bas de tshe 'di lo zhing skyong can nas kyang ci yod nges par spung dgos dang / dbon bkra shis phun tshogs nas snga sor gtsug lag khang gi zhig gso dgos tshul do gal zhu ba dang bab thob yang yod bzhin kho pa lus mi bde ba med tshe sku zhabs yab sras dang nged kyi ngo tshab zhig gsol 'go mi khong la bka' yi khyab pa dang / gzhan yang sde dge'i sku tshab las byed 'go mi zhig yang sku zhabs si tu rin po che la brtag pa gang 'bab bka' gros zhus nas chos mthun blo gtsang zhig stab bde byung na 'jog rgyu legs 'dug pas de yang 'os min dgongs par dpyad gnang / 'di nas kaḥthog zhig gso'i mthun rkyen 'di lo bal yul rang byung mchod rten chen po'i zhig gso dang sne 'dom gyi mang po zhig phul rgyu ma byung yang bslad med rgya dngul bod dngul 'dres pa srang phyed dang nyis brgya dang / de nas lcam sku gshegs kyi dgongs rdzogs su dgongs pa'i sku rgyan dngos gtsang phon che 'dir gnang 'dug pa nas phyogs 'dir brim pa phran bu re zung las gzhan rnams 'di phyogs las khams su rin gong che gshis de kar phul ba 'di ka'i rin thang la dpag na der dngul srang brgya phrag tu ma 'gro nges snyam pa de kaḥthog gi zhig gsor stsal ba dang / gzhan zhwa dmar mchog sprul dang sku zhabs si tu rin po che nas spyir rnam dkar dge ba bye brag rang nyid rten 'brel dbang gi khri 'don gdan sar dgongs te dngos chas 'os mtshams gnang rgyu dang / slar bal yul zhig gso grub mtshams 'di nas da dung yang ci nus phul 'dod ste gang cir de rnams sngar zhig gso rnyed pa'i rdzas ltar ma song bar da lam zhig gso'i rgyur 'gro nges dgos pa de nas bka' yi gnang khyab nan tan yang gal che bas de ltar dgongs bzhugs dang / las ka'i do khur zhing skyong dpon g.yog nas byed rgyu la bdag gi bskur ba'i dngos po rnams dad pa can gyi rdzas chud zos song na mi legs pas de phyir chud zos cung zad yang ma song ba zhig gso'i rgyur 'gro ba'i de khur de nas gnang khyab bka' drin che dgos zhu rgyu gal chen dang / 'on kyang sde dge sku ngo rnams kaḥthog zhig gso legs par grub 771

nas rab gnas kyi skabs nges par 'byon zhing rten 'brel bzang po'i sgrig lugs dang / de min zhig gso tshugs nas ma phebs nas legs par sems la/ de yang spyir gtsug lag khang gi rab gnas 'di ni gal che zhing gzab dgos dang / bye brag mdo khams smad du kaḥthog rdo rje gdan dang gtsang khro gnyis pa'i gnad zer ches che ba yin pas kaḥthog gtsug lag khang 'di kaḥdam pa bde gshegs kyi gzhengs te rab gnas kyi skabs phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad byon nas rab gnas mdzad par gzigs pa dang / gu ru pad+ma seng ge sgra sgrogs su sprul nas rab gnas lan gsum mdzad par grags pa sogs gtsug lag khang 'di ni bod spyi'i bde thabs rten 'brel che na mdo khams smad nyer 'khor rnams la smos ci 'tshal bas/ des na rab gnas skabs nged rang dngos sleb thub na smod med dang / de min zhwa dmar mchog sprul dang si tu rin po che phebs nas rab gnas mdzad rgyu kho na ci kyang gal che ste/ rab gnas skabs si tu rin po che ni mi phebs ka med byed dgos thugs kyi dpe'ur bsnyi rgyu las gzhan tshe 'dir che grag lo 'dod mkhan gyi rab gnas su rdzus pa'i zol sbyor byas na phyogs de'i rgyal bstan dang / srid skyong gi mnga' thang mtha' dag la nges par gnod tshab che bar 'gyur ba 'di ni chags sdang gi bslad pa'i rdzun sbyor sogs cung zad yang min nges mchog gsum dpang gzhag lags pas des na rang rang 'dod khyer du ma song ba de lugs dgongs par gzhig cing bkas khyab pa zhu/ de yang zhig gso grub ma thag rab gnas bsgrub dgos dgos gal che bas de lugs sku zhabs si tu la snyan 'bul da lta nas zhu dgos/ nged 'dir bral g.yeng ches che bas sde dge lha bla ma'i drung lcam dral la da lam mtshams 'dri las gnas tshul zhib mo phul ma thub song bas de nas gnang 'os gsung gi khyab pa yang 'tshal/ kaḥthog sku 'bum ring mo 'di dam pa gong ma rnams kyi gzigs ngor dpal ldan 'bras spung gi mchod rten dang mnyam pa zhes gsungs zhing sngar yab rje chos kyi rgyal po de nyid zhal bzhugs pa me sbrul lor nged kyang khams su myur 'byor zhig gso 'phral 'grub byed rgyu'i rtsis byas nas shing yang phon che btu bar mdzad kyang nged bod phyogs su 'gor ches rim 'gyang gi da bar 'grub pa zhig ma byung yang de la re zhig thig tshag sogs zhig ral du ma song zhing rkun bus nang rdzong mi blang ba'i bsrung cha tsam kaḥthog gi dbang thang steng nas dkor rdzas la spyod pa rnams nas byas dgos rgyur snang ba kun la gsal yang / de yang ji ltar byas yod dgongs par dngas ba yod pa gzhir bcas/ de phyin zhig ral rkun shor med pa bkas khyab pa zhig cis kyang mkhyen mkhyen zhes dgu ldan du gsol ba ste/ zhig gso dngos yab rje chos rgyal de nyid kyi zhal gzhes nged rang nas do gal du dmigs par byed shis nged rang sleb na dang de min ngo tshab zhig gtang nas si tu rin po che la gsol nas zhig gso byed 'dod yin pas de lugs dgongs par 'jug 772

pa ci nas kyang zhu zhu zhu/ kaḥthog gi grub mtha' sogs lar rgya'i skor nyid nas zur du yi ge gnang 'dug pa yid la nges shing de yi lan gsal zur du phul yod pa dgongs pa'i dpe'ur bste ba zhu/gzhan de kar sku rim bsgrub 'os dang brtag pa'i skor sogs kyang zur du phul yod la/ de lta na yang brtag pa zhes lkog 'gyur gyi gnas tshul ji bzhin du rngo thog pa ni ma dag gdos bcas kyi phung po dag pa ye shes sgyu ma'i sku mi 'gyur bde ba chen po'i sa la phyogs kyi bar nyon sgrib ma spang las snang dang 'dres pa'i dbang gis ji bzhin rtogs par bka' bas/ des na rgyal ba yab sras sogs skyes chen dam par gyur pa rnams las nged lta bu las dang po pa'i rnal 'byor zhig gi rngo mi thog mod/ der ma zad lkog 'gyur gyi grub pa'i sa la bzhugs pa ni mang du yod pa gzhir bcas/ sngon gyur ni dus kyi dbang gi phyogs gang du yang dkon tsam yod pa 'dra/ des na 'di rigs sngar rang nyid na tshod gzhon nu dus chos brgyad dkor grib ma non skabs gsal snang shar ba gzhan la cung zad smra kyi yod rung dus phyis dkor grib kyi chung ngu'i skabs ltar mi gsal bar mi zad de yang tho cor song dogs shas cher mi smra ba dam bcas pa yin yang / da lam cha cung zad zhib khul du phul ba yang dgongs par 'jug zhu la/ lar rnal 'byor bya bral smyon pa rgyal khams pa zhig nam 'chi cha med snang ba gdong 'ded gang shar gtad med har sang yan pa blo bde'i spyod pa skyong ba zhig de la nges nges dang tig tig ga la yong / 'dus byas kyi rang 'tshang ma ston tshe mdo khams kyi phyogs su sleb shing 'phrad par yang snying nas smon la/ 'di phyi bar do kun tu dge ba'i skyabs 'jug bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yang dag par bgyid pa yang dgongs pa'i do rar 'jug pa zhu zhu/ zhes rten mtshon byed kho nar lha yi gos rnam par dkar ba srid du ring ba dang /yul stod hor bha lag kha nas byung ba'i gser gyi kar+sha pa na rgyal srid rin po che'i grangs ldan sngags kyi yang dag par byin gyi brlab pa'i phur mdud zung bcas zla tshes dge ba la mar yul ho mi'i smon shing gi ra ba nas spel ba'i li khi tai sarba maṅga lo/ lha las bab pa mi yi rje bor gang gi snyan dbang rin po cher gsol 'os/ kaḥthog sgrub mtha'i skor sogs phebs pa de yang kaḥdam pa bde bar gshegs pa de dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi sprul par zhal gyi gzhes shing khyad par ma 'ongs bskal pa skar ma bkram pa lta bur rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshe dpag med du sangs rgya bar mi 'jig bden pa'i tshig gi gsung ba sa bcu'i mgon po nyid du grub pa de ni dpal phag mo grub pa dang ma spun ngo thog yin/ rtsa ba'i grub mtha'i 'jug pa dzam 'gro ba'i mgon po zhes mdo dang sgyu 'phrul sems phyogs la lhag par mkhas pa de la thugs bsnyen rdzogs zhu pa yang khong yin sems ngo yang der 'phrod pas rtsa ba'i bla ma de la mdzad/ gzhan yang ma gcig zha ma sogs gsar rnying ris su 773

ma chad pa'i bla ma mang du brten/ lam 'bras sogs man ngag gi bka' lung dang / bde mchog dges rdor/ gdan bzhi sogs gsang sngags gsar ma'i rgyud la yang gsan pa shin tu che/ phag mo grub pa dang phar slob tshur slob mdzad/ karma dus gsum mkhyen pa'i tshes bcu'i tshogs mchod byin brlabs kyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro tshim tshul la dgyes pas dbang bskur gsan te rjes sngar mched grogs phyis slob ma gshegs pa'i 'og tu kaḥthog gi gdan sar rgyal tshabs su gyur pa gtsang ston 'gro ba'i mgon po dang /'gro mgon sangs rgyas ras chen thugs yid gcig tu 'dres te 'gro mgon ras chen gyi/ gtsang ston la rdzogs chen gyi chos kyang mang du gsan pa grags che/ gtsang ston gyi gdan sa ba byams 'bum dang rgyal sras spom brag pa dag thugs yid gcig 'dres yin/ dpal karma pak+shi'i kyang bsnyen rdzogs zhu sa spyan snga byams pa 'bum la mdzad mdo rgyud sems kyi chos kyang mang du gsan/ rje mi bskyod zhabs kyi dus mkhyen nas karma pak+shi'i bar don brgyud kyi chu bo dam gtsang byams gsum 'dren 'os zhes gsung tsher lung drung pa kun dga' rnam rgyal gyi kai tshang snyan brgyud chos 'byung du bris snang kaḥthog nam mkha' rdo rjes karma pa rol pa'i rdo rje la rdzogs chen mkha' 'gro snying gi khrid zhus de yi brgyud pa ni las 'bral rtsal nas rgyal sras legs ldan rang byung rdo rje sngags 'chang g.yung ston/ des rol pa'i rdo rje la yin/ de'i dbang lung gi rgyun yang ma chad par grags che zhing kho bos khyang khum/ des na kaḥthog kai tshang gdod nas bstan rgyun gcig tu gnas pa nas sngar ye nas ma 'dres pa zhig nged kyi blo bzos gsar du bsres pa min/ da ni dus kyi dbang gi kaḥthog 'di rang bzhin de gar gzhag na snyigs dus 'gro ba bslu byed kyi zog po grub rdzun gter rdzun log 'dres khyer dam nyams kyi chos rgyud dang 'dres nas nges don snying po'i bstan pa la tshab chen gyi gnod par dogasanas bstan 'gro sems can la blo yom bzod nas bdag gi ngo khur byas te zhwa dmar ba de nyid skye ba nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar sprul sku 'khrul med rim can du 'byung ba au rgyan pad+ma'i lung sngar gyi gter rnying rnams su yod pa thos pas des na zhwa dmar ba khrir mnga' gsol te rtag tu bzhugs thub min ci ltar yang mtshan skyong mdzad na chos log dri ma can gyi 'phral du mi 'jig pa zhig yong ngam snyam pa'i re ba yin/ kaḥthog rnying ma'i chos lugs kar lugs su ga la bsgyur/ karma pa yab sras ni sngar nas kyang dkar brgyud rnying ma dbyer med yin cing da dung yang ka kai grub mtha' dbyer med las gcig shos spang nas gcig shos su 'jug pa ma yin mod/ des na zhwa dmar ba kaḥthog gi khrir bkod pa 'di ni shes ldan gzur gnas thams cad kyi 'os shing 'thad pa cis mi mdzad/ 'on kyang kaḥthog dgon gyi bla ma'i ming g.yar nas dkor rdzas la hab sha byed pa rnams kyi blo la ni rang gzhan phung bar ma shes pas za thang dkor la rngam rgyu ma byung dogs rgyud drag tu 'khrug te mi skya ar jag rkun ma 774

mno shes kyi bsam sbyor tsam yang ma gnas par/ sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sku la bod rdo ba'i khas len pa 'tshol ba sogs dkor zas za ba la 'khran te mi zad sdig pa mtshams med kyi las la yang mi tshom med par 'jug 'dod de rnams kyi ngang tshul bdag gi rgyang ring nas zhu ma 'tshal gyi der snyan du dngas shing thugs su gsal ba gor ma chags pas mtshan nyid ci 'dra zhig yin 'dug des kyang mkhyen par 'gyur bar nges/ zhing skyong rang nyid ngo bo bzang ngan ci ltar yin ni bdag gi kha tshon ga la gcod bzang po yin nyan yod/ kaḥthog gi bstan pa la ni phan pa cher mi 'byung ba'i ltas sngar nas kyang shar mod/ da lta kho pa gdan sar 'khod nas yun de snyed la dge 'dun gyi sde ci tsam 'phel thos bsam bsgom pa'i gra ci tsam tshugs dngos gsal dang gtsug lag khang zhig gso sgrags te rgyal khams kyi yo byad bsdus tshe 'di'i kheng grags kyi ched du khyim gyi so 'dzin lcags mdud jag dpon gyi bu mo blang /de btsan par re ba yin 'dug kyang don rang rang bsod nams dang byin brlabs kyi mthu med na lcags mdud dang gnyen bsdeb byas pas ga la skyobs phaṭa ci dga' bgyis/ dgos nges kaḥthog gi gtsug lag khang la zhabs tog cung zad yang ma byung bar ma zad dam pa bde gshegs nas sngar bla rabs ji snyed mi lo bdun brgyar nye ba'i ring gtsug lag khang la zhig ral phran bu las ma byung na kho pa gdan sar bsdad nas zhig ral sngar mi grags yong ba 'di lta dang / de bzhin bla rabs gong ma rim can gyi sku gdung mchod rten sku 'bum ring mor grags pa byin brlabs kyi gzi 'od mchog tu 'bar ba de rnams sngar nas da ltar thugs nang rdzong blang ba ma thos na deng dus bkur sti zhabs tog med pa'i khar rkun bsrung gi do gal tsam yang ma byas nas mtshams med spyod pa la dga' ba'i rkun ma rnams kyi nang rdzong blang nas rgyal khams spyi bye brag mi shis pa'i rgyur byas pa de rnams ya re cha/ kaḥthog dgon rnying de sngar dam pa bde gshegs nyid kyi yang thugs kyi gnas su dgongs nas 'dir sgrub sde tshugs na kaḥthog gi bstan pa ches dar zhes gsung zhing / grub chen thang stong rgyal po'i yang de ltar bsngags shing / bu 'bor ba bkra shis rgya mtsho'i skabs su bsgom gra tho re ba yod/ de rjes rig 'dzin gar gyi dbang phyug gi lung gi gtsang chen badz+ra ho rus bla brang gi rmang gting de rjes rang re'i yab mes sam khu bo bla ma rim can du byon nas bsgrub pa'i sde yang dag 'dzugs par mdzad pa de yang dkor zas za ba la ring nas rtsa lag tu gtang ba sogs bstan pa la phan min ni da cha nged kyi gsar du brjod ma dgos pas des rtogs par 'gyur/don du ni chos dang mi mthun pa'i spyod pas dkon mchog dang bsrung ma rnams ma dgyes te gtsug lag khang zhig grum gyi rab gnas byin brlabs nyams nas phyogs der mi dge ba'i dbu tshugs par mngon te rten 'brel sgrigs phyogs ma mkhas na de yi mtshan nyid rim par ston par 'gyur gyis 'dir mang du smra 775

ma dgos/ kaḥthog gi dgon gnas bar skabs rten 'brel nyams pa de cung zad sor chud par re nas zhwa dmar yab sras kaḥthog gi khrir mnga' gsol ba la kho pa rnams kyi mdzad tshul de 'dra zhig gi phyogs der phan bde'i brtsas su 'gyur thabs kyi rten 'brel da ni shin tu sgrig dka' ba nyid du song 'on kyang sngar dbang chos kyi 'brel pa 'dra gsan tshar na ci bde btang snyoms su bor ba las gnod 'tsher 'gro ba ni gnang mi rung ste/ ji skad du mdo dgongs pa lung ston las/ gal te dam pa ma yin kyang / /dam pa'i tshul du bsnyen zin na/ /rjes su de la smod byed pa/ /de ni mnar med dmyal bar 'gro/ /zhes pa ltar dgongs zab tu bsti ba dang / sngar yab rje chos kyi rgyal po de nyid skabs nas nged la kaḥthog gi bstan pa la bya ba bgyid dgos sogs yong dgos tshul yang yang phebs shing rang gi yang rtsa ba'i bla ma'i 'phrin lan sgrub pa'i ched dang kaḥthog rgyal sras bsod nams lde'u btsan gyi snga phyir kaḥthog gi gdan sar sdod dgos tshul bka' nan dang / lhag tu chu stag lor rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bskur nas seng ge'i khrir mnga' gsol gdan sar sdod par bka' stsal yang / re zhig dbon pa'i ri khrod dam phyogs med rgyal khams su gzhan phan che bar shes te bka' yi gnang ba nan tan zhus/ des na de yi thugs kyi dgongs pa yang dag par bskang ba'i ched du mdo khams phyogs su yong rgyur byas kyang rnam 'dren si tu rin po che dang tshe rabs yun du 'grogs par snying nas dam bcas bzhin karma pa yab sras kyi 'phrin las ched du bod phyogs su yang yun ring zhig 'gor/ yab rje chos kyi rgyal po de nyid zhi bar gshegs nas kyang lha btsun bla ma'i drung zhi gshegs dang sku mched tshang ma lhag tu nyid nas kyang nan bskyed kyi yong dgos tshul phebs kyang snga sor bal yul mchod rten chen po bya rung kha shor gyi zhig gso dang da lta ni stod hor gyi dmag dpung zhi ba'i ched du dang / 'di nas kyang bal yul 'phags pa shing kun gyi zhig gso'i ched du 'gro rgyu ste 'dus byas kyi chos mi rtag pas de yi rang 'tshang phral du ma bstan tshe mdo khams phyogs su sleb pa'i mos 'dun ci nas kyang bgyid la/ de'i ring kaḥthog gi lar rgya'i mtshan skyong zhwa dmar bas mdzad na legs tshul gong du smos ltar lags shing / zhwa dmar mchog sprul rgyal khams kun tu 'phrin las skyong dgos kyi kaḥthog rang du rtag sdod kyi rgyal tshab 'phrin las pa zhig kyang dgos par sems pas slar zhwa dmar mchog sprul sku zhabs si tu dang nyid can mol bsdur byas nas 'jog rgyu byung na de bzhin bgyid rtsis mdo phug med par gsong por gsol ba lags/ gzhan de bya bral rgyal khams pa ni na tshod gzhon dus su 'chi ba snying nas dran te dgos med zhen log gi 'di snang gi bya ba gtang rgyu'i khul byas na rnal 'byor 'chi kha ma zhig gi kaḥthog gi dgon gnas la bdag 'dzin zhen sred kyi dgos pa cung zad yang ma mchis te da lta dgon gnas dang grwa 'khor dgos na phyogs dang phyogs med kun tu ci 776

dgar spyod chog pa mngon sum 'di ka lags/ lar sde dge rgyal po rang nyid kyi bla yang kaḥthog gi dgon par chags pa ltar snang bas dgon pa de 'dzin pa'i bla ma tshad ldan dang / dar rgyas ci che yi dgong pa gtad dgos rgyur 'dug kaḥthog gi gtsug lag khang 'di ches rnying pa skyes chen dam pa brgya phrag du mas byin gyis brlabs shing rab tu gnas par mdzad pa zhig gso gnad smin ma byung tshe byin brlabs yal ste rgyal khams spyi bye brag la mi shis pa'i rgyur dogs sngar 'then par byas pa yin yang kaḥthog 'dzin khul rnams nas bzo skyor byed rgyu yin tshul snga phyir yang nas yang du lan gcig min par nan bskyed che ba byung gshis spyi mthun gyi las 'gog dka' dang lhag tu gtsug lag khang zhig ral 'gyel tshab che na mi legs pa yi da cha zhig gso byed 'dod yod pa rnams dam can khang sogs bla brang gtsug lag khang skor mi bcos ka med la zhig gso chog par bka' gnang rgyu zhu yig ma mor gsal ltar dang / gtsug lag khang gi rten gtso byang chub chen po'i bzhugs gnas der chu shor ba dang / thig pas ma brdung tsam las yo 'khyom thog stib pa sogs med phyin gsar bcos ma mdzad na snyams shing / nges med gsar bcos byed dgos byung yang nang gi lha sku logs ris la skyon med ci nas kyang mdzad dgos snyams kyang nged kyi zhig gso bkas ma gnang zhes de la thig chags tsam yang ma byas nas da lta thig pas kyang cung zad rkyen byas tshul thos pas snying 'dar yang bdag ni sa phyogs 'dir gnas bya thabs kyi dben pa nyid du gyur kyang / nyid ni spyir mdo khams smad sa yi dkyil 'khor phal cher la dbang bsgyur zhing lhag tu kaḥthog gi mnga' bdag sbyin bdag dngos gzhi yin na 'jig rten gsum na dkon pa'i rten de dag 'jig par 'phang pas bka' yi khyab pa ci nas kyang zhu rgyu'i snying po zhig lags/ sku 'bum ring mor/ lcam gyi dgongs rdzogs rten zhig gso'i rgyur slar der phul rgyu rnams kyang zhig gso las byed pa nas pham tshong spus gzhag tu ma song ba rin thang tshad ldan zhig gsor phan pa dgos tshul bka' yi khyab pa yang zhu zhu zhu/gong gi kaḥthog gi gnas tshul de rnams kyang sngar nas shes rung gzhan gyi kun bslang nyid du sems dpa' las mi yong 'gro snyam nas ma smras pa da cha zur gnas drang po'i ngag gis cha tsam zhig gsol ba de rnams kun blangs tshig gi slad pa ni nam yang med de/ mtshan nyid ji bzhin da dung rim pas rtogs par 'gyur bar nges/ des na rgyal bstan ris bral kaḥthog gi bstan pa la lhag par bya ba bgyid rgyu'i zhal bzhes gnang ba bka' drin mchog tu che bas de don thugs kyi dpe'u nas nam yang lhod pa med pa ci nas kyang zhu zhu/ zhes spyan ras kyi byab par byed pa'i rten dri med lha gos rnam par dkar ba srid du ring bas bcibs te zla tshes rnam par dag par dge ba la mnga' ris stod kha che dang stod hor gyi mtshams mar yul ne mi'i ljon shing gi ra ba nas phul ba'i li khi haṃ: sarba maṅga lo/

sāste/ brtag bab sku rim sgrub pa'i tho/ sde dge'i lar rgya spyi ni khyi rta stag gsum cung zad dogs cing / bye brag de kha'i yab sras sger du bya khyi phag gsum la sku rim nan ltar gal che la/ yul spyir rgya 'dre 'gong po'i gnod pa che zhing / gtsug lag khang rnying pa yi bsrung ma dang / dkor bdag snying pa 'khrug pa dang / gzhan gyi sbod gtong dang / lhag tu sngar yab mes skabs phar sbod gtong byas pa'i nus pa yang tshur ldog pa'i ltas shar bas/ de sel gyi rim gror/ sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya ngo thog bye ba nas dung phyur bar/ seng gdong ma'i snying po yi ge 'bru bcu gcig pa dung phyur las mi nyung ba/ pho brang dngos gzhi dang / rdzong gzhis gzhan du yang nges don snying po'i mdo sde rgyun sgrog pho brang rnams su chu sbyin spyi dang khyad par yi dwags chu sbyin dge slong brkad gra nas re zhig ring ma chad pa/ de bzhin nyin re bzhin cha gsum gtor ma/ sgrol dkar la brten pa'e tshe sgrub rgyun 'dzugs/ gur drag phur pa/ bka' brgyad kyi gtor bzlog skabs su gling bzhi'i spyi mdos/ sri bzlog rgyas pa rnams bya ste/ sku rim de rnams bskyar 'dab nan tan byas na lo shas kyi ring bde bar 'gyur la gang cir re zhig sku rim 'bad 'bung dang bya ba nges par bzo ba gal che'i ltas shar/ nged nas kyang dus kun dge ba'i skyabs 'jug bsrung ba'i 'khor lo snying thags pa nas bgyis pa yang dgongs par 'jug pa zhu/gong zhabs su chu sprel waṃ le nas zhabs pad rin po cher/ yang gsol 'os/ he mi sprul pa'i sku dang bkra shis rnam rgyal ni mngon par mkhon pa'i skabs su snang yang bdag gi mdzes lam du 'gyur thabs he mi sprul sku bdag dang lhan du bar ching gi grogs la dgos tshul tsam smras/ la dwags rgyal por rgya nag gi tham ka gnang bar grags pa ni bdag la ston par tham ka hor yig gsar bod bzo yin nam snyam pa zhig 'dug pas rgya nag nas yin min ma nges/ de mthun mul lbe rgyal po bkra shis rnam rgyal la yang tham ka zhig yod rgyu yin 'dug gshis/ 'di skor kha che la rgyal khag gzhan nas brjod na las kho rang nang khul nas ni gnas skabs kyi 'phyar tsam las kha che la zhu thub rigs min pa 'dra snyams pa shar ba lags/ bal po rgyal po'i yi ge 'di yang nged la gtang ba dang lhan du 'byor byung ba rgyal ba mchog gi zhabs pad du 'bul grogs dgos tshul byung ba bka' lan yod pa yang thugs rje che la/ mar yul rgyal pos kha che na bab dang rdzong dpon la phul ba'i yi ge dang / nged nas dzusla ra la gtang ba'i yi ge 'dra shus kyang bka' blon rnams kyi yi ger mchis pa chos klong tshom med dbyings su 'jug pa mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen/ sarba maṅga lo/bka' blon rnams la/ gangs can lha yi lha rgyal ba mchog gi 'phrin las byed por dbang skur ba mi yi rje bo'i tshogs su gyur pa'i mdun sar/ zhu ba sngon rabs ring mo zhig nas 'phags mchog lag na 778

pad+mo'i spyan sngar byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed cing 'phags mchog de yi 'phrin las kyi byed por smon lam bzang pos 'du byas pa la brten deng dus 'phags mchog lag na pad+mo rang nyid kyi bdag gir bzung ba'i zhing khams gangs ri'i ra bas yongs su bskor ba'i khrod du lag na pad+mo ngur smrig gar gyi rol pa'i mdun sar bzang po'i smon lam ji bzhin skye dgu'i gtsug na mngon par mtho ba bka' yi gung blon chen por grub pa gangs can bde ba'i byed po sngon gyi rab 'dzangs 'phrul blon chen po thu mi 'gar sogs dang rnam dbyer gtan nas ma mchis par bzhugs pa ni bka' drin chen pos khyab/ 'dir gnas rig pa 'dzin par sgro btags pa snyoms chung rgyal khams pa phra mo yang 'gyur ba'i rang bzhin rgas dang rnam par smin pa'i rang bzhin 'byung 'khrug gi rtser yang / byings pa mchog gi bka' lung lhod par ma spobs pas gangs can spyi dang bye brag stod phyogs bde ba'i brtsas su dmigs lam 'phrang ngal dub tsha grang reg bya mi snyoms sbyong spyod kun dngas su blang ste da lta mar yul gyi stod grub pa'i bsti gnas waṃ ler gnas skabs te/ de yang sgar thog nas rgyal po phan tshun la so so'i phebs bsu ba'i khrod nas snga 'gros pa brdzang ste phan tshun dpung tshogs bzang po ma yin par rags 'thus waṃ ler 'phral 'dzom dgos tshul smras bzhin/ nged rgod yul su rig la brgal nas waṃ le dang nye ba'i kha sbyor du hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes gcig la sleb la/ de'i nyi ma phyi ma la dwags stod kyi rgyal sras dang rgyal mo rnams waṃ ler phebs yod 'dug la/ ngos ltas kyi khyad par gyis zhag gsum bsdad/ snga sor sgar du phebs bsu bas gleng 'bug 'bug zhig 'dug kyang bden par ma byas rung / 'dir ched mngags kyi blon po rdzang nas rgyal po phun rnams zhal lta ma zhig dang 'cham nas gros 'debs su la yang ma gsan nas zur du bzhugs song tshul dang / lugs gnyis chab srid rgyal sras sprul pa'i sku rin po che dang rgyal mos mnyam por skyong rgyu yin pa'i gnas tshul nged la dal bus smra dgos tshul phebs byung zhes zer yang 'phral du btang snyoms su gzhag don du yang khu dbon nang 'dum las nang tshags kyi skor 'di tshegs yang che bar shes te re zhig lan ma btab/ tshes 4la kha sbyor du rgyal sras sprul pa'i sku/ drung 'khor rags 'thus bcas phebs bsur byung zhing / de dang lhan du wam ler son/ chos khrid 'dra thugs bzhed 'dug pa 'phral tshugs dang / mi ma yin mthu ldan mang po 'dus pa'i ltas su mthong bas tshes la gtor chen zhig gtang ba gtor spra 'phral du ni legs pa byung / phyi mi rnams nas blon por dgong phog sogs rgyal mos byas zhes grags che yang nang rgyal po spun rnams rang gi bslad pa'i nges khung zer gshis rgyal po spun rnams rang yang 'dzom na legs par snyam pas ched mngags 'bod mkhan brdzang / rgyal po bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi bka' blon ngo theg 'gyang gzhi che sems tshes 17la 'byor byung / rgyal po mi phebs pa'i rgyu mtshan dris 779

par rgyal po phebs pa'i lam zhugs ma rags la/ la dang rgyal po'i pho nya cher song ba khong tsho'i lam bsdom pas zin pa pho nya'i lag tu kha che'i yi ger/ slebs mkhar gyi mnga' 'og dmag a khu la bdeg na/'di nas kyang ci dgos grogs su yong tshul gyi yi ge mthong nas yong ma bde tshul byung bar kham gshis 'khrug kyang sngar rang nyid rnal 'byor byung rgyal skyong ba'i skabs dang ma 'dra ba/ da lam rgyal ba mchog gi 'phrin las byed por mnga' gsol gshis dkyel che dgos snyam khog pa rgya bskyed/ slebs mkhar rgyal po rten zhal la khyed rnams kyi gzhung sar snyan 'bul zhus/ nged lab ching yong rgyu'i snga 'gros yi ge mthong bzhin kha che'i dmag dpung sna 'dren gtong ba nged la ral gcod kyi rnam par snang tshul dang /mul lbe rgyal po bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi bka' blon la nged 'dir sleb nas khyed rnams kyi la dwags rgyal po'i pho nya 'dzin pa yang mi legs shing / kha che'i la sgo 'gag pa yang 'os min yin tshul lab par la dwags rgyal blon gyis ni khyed bal yul nas yong ba'i yi ge 'byor bas kha che'i dmag 'dren gyis bya ba cung zad yang ma brtsam pa dkon mchog dpang bzhugs yin/ na ning lug lo hor zla drug pa'i nang du a khu'i kha che'i mi sna bos par brdab sig che zhing na bab rtsa ba nas ni nged rnams la spyan brkyang che gshis/ nam phug yo lang chen po byung tshe ram zla dgos tshul lug lo hor zla bcu gcig pa'i nang du brdzang ba a khu'i lam bsdams kyi da lta'i bar ma thar ba las gsar du dmag bskul sogs med tshul dang / mul lbe rgyal po bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi bka' blon nas kha che rang nas dmag yong 'dod za 'dod che ba las nged rnams kyi dmag ched du bskul ba med la/ la dwags par dmag gtong na nged la yang dmag rogs dgos tshul ni zhus/ da lam pho nya 'dzin pa yang khyed kyi waṃ ler yong dgos tshul gyi yi ge ma phebs sngon du yi ge de ltar thal ba las yi ge sleb nas ma yin tshul dang / bka' blon rang la thun mong ma yin pa'i ngag la ni khyed la dwags mthil du yong e thub kyi 'dod gdung gi cung zad 'gyang pa las gzhan med tshul yang zer ba re zhig de la cha 'jog khul dang / yang stod smad gnyis ka'i blon po che kha rnams mdun du bsdus te/ da khyed rnams kyi zer tshul de ltar yin tshe khyed rang rnams kyi bde thabs ched du gangs can mgon po rgyal ba mchog gis nged 'phrin las kyi byed por phyogs 'dir mngags par mdzad bzhin rang rang rnams kyi tshe 'di las phyi ma'i khe nyen la gzhig ste kha che dang sngar 'brel bzang po'i rgyun ma chad pa las dmag gi sna 'dren sogs bstan 'gro'i bde thabs la gnod pa ye nas mi 'tshal zhing / lar kha ches kyang khyed rang rgyal po phan tshun gnyis ka'i rgyab rtsa byed par khas blang ba 'di yang dkrug sel gyi rnam pa can du snang na/ de don thugs la 'jog dgos dang nged la dwags mthil du re zhig 'gro bar ma shar bas rgyal po bkras rnam yang 'phral mar 'dir phebs dgos tshul dang / la 780

dwags pho nya bsgor ba kha che'i yi ge bcas 'phral gtong ma byas na mi 'gab tshul smras bzhin kho rang gi zhabs phyi ngo ma zhig da lam gyi rta shad steng nas 'phral rdzong byas/ rgyal po phun rnam 'bod par brdzang ba yang nged la dwags mthil du sleb re yin zhes 'phral du ma 'byon 'dug pa rgyal po 'di chung ngu'i dus su spyang gung 'dzom pa zhig yod rgyu'i khul dang / da lta ni thugs ka mi bde skad zer yang / gang ltar khong rang nang khul legs lam ni/ phugs legs lam 'gro min mi shes stabs re zhig dpyad dgos 'dug kyang 'phral khu dbon legs spel slad yang skyar 'bod par brdzang la dwags phyogs sngar mi rnams chad brtsan par rtsi yi 'dug kyang deng sang ni dus dbang gi chad brtsan par dka' bar ma zad mi ma yin gyi mthu'i gtam 'chol sna tshogs kyi zing gzhi 'byung ba zhig lo shas tshun byung 'dug pa/ kha che'i dmag gi gtam skad yang lkog gyur du gleng gshis/ bden tshe mi legs par nges pa yis la dwags mul lbe rgyal po so so nas da cha nged rang khu dbon nang tshags legs zlum bzang po grub pa yin pas kha che'i mi sna yong mi dgos tshul do chod re gtang na 'thad tshul nan gyi smras te zla tshes la pho nya thon par byas/ rgyal po bkra rnam kyang dpon g.yog ma nyung tsam dang da lta lam zhugs su yod 'dug pa 'dir tshes mtshams la 'byor rtsis dang / de yang la dgas kyi lab ching 'di hor zla bdun pa'i nang du 'grub na ltas legs nges byung kyang rang nyid kyi bgrod pa bul nas ma 'byor/ de 'og tu brgyad pa cung zad dge yang kho pa tshos rim 'gyang gi gang ltar phyogs 'dir phug gi ltas shin tu rtsub cing phral du yang mi rnams rtag mi thub cing mtha' mtshams kyi mi ru song gshis brtan par dka' ba bcas tshegs cher gyur kyang mthar thug legs bzlum grub thub na dbyings sa mchog gi bka' gnang don ltar rang gi yang dge tshogs che rung bgyid bkas ni blo 'khol che ba'i ngang du mchis lags/ la dwags 'dzin mar 'khod pa kha che'i sa mtshams tshun chad kyi skye rgu spyi yi ni rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po nas rig pa 'dzin pa 'dir brdzang bka' drin chen pos khyab pa yin gzhan ni da lta 'thab 'khrug yo lang chen por bya ba las ma 'das kyang 'di lo dpyid bla ma lab 'ching la 'byon rgyu'i yi ge 'byor ba nas dbu bzung / phan tshun gnyis 'thad nas ci rig pa zhi 'jam la song ba yin zhes tshig tu mthun cing dga' tshor chen po'i khul byed 'dug pa de cam bu min par don la yang gnas nges su snang bas des rang gi yang mchod rten zhig gso 'phral du ma grub pa'i blo ngal de zhi zhing sems la dge tshogs kyi rgyu brlab po che yin 'dug snyam pa'i dga' ba gsar thob re byung ba yang gnas tshul dang / mtha' 'doms skabs su sgar dpon gcig phebs na zhes snga sor snyan 'bul zhus pa rgyal po phan tshun so so'i zhu ngag don bab ltas kyi bcad mtshams dgos tshe phug kyi khyad la de ltar yin yang / la dwags rang nas kha che'i mi snas thos dogs 781

'dzem bag cung zad kyi 'dug pa kha che hor sog gi mi sna da lta nam dus kyi 'byor nye yin 'dug gshis slar bab ltas kyi 'phros rim pas 'bul dgos dang / la dwags pas kha che'i na bab dang / rdzong dpon la phul ba'i 'dra shus bcas spyan bstar rgyur phul zhing / nged khar sin yar lam ni 'gros tshad las ma thub cing / dus kyang dbyar du song gshis 'khyog 'phyang gi sa bon smin grub bka' drin tshad med pas khyab kyang sgar dpon rnams la yang tshegs su 'gro dogs ma zhus/ rang nas lab ching gi rten 'brel kho nar dmigs gro shod phyogs nas rta/ kha shasartsosbyin mkhan byung ba nas spus gtsang gras bcu gcig tsam bdag gir byas pa de steng nas la dgas sku dngos la rta dang zab gos sogs snga thabs kyi gnang skyes grub la/mul lbe rgyal po sogs gzhan la da bgyid dgos dang / rgyal po khu dbon da ni ci myur 'dzom rtsis da lta 'char gyi yin na las tshig he bag che gshis 'grim zlum rab tu dka' ba lta bur snang la gang ltar gnas tshul 'bul 'os slar rim rim gyis phul chog pa dang / 'on kyang 'di phyogs kyi gtam 'ur che zhing tshig snga phyi mi 'phrod pa sogs 'phral du gsol dka' bar gnang rung bden rdzun ji ltar yang sa mtshams kyi bya ba rngam chen du gyur gshis rang gi thos tshul gsol ba la chos dbyings tshom 'khrung skad cig kyang mi 'jug pa dang legs slob nyes sel gyi bka' yi 'khor los yang nas yang du khyab pa ci nas kyang mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen/ gang ltar rgyal po khu dbon 'dzom nas 'phros bab gnas tshul snyan sgron ci myur 'bul rgyu/gang cir phyogs 'dir gnang khyab bka' yi 'khor los yang yang khyab pa ci kyang mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen/zhes mkhyen pa'i spyan pad+ma'i 'dab ltar yangs pa g.yo bar byed pa'i rten lha gos rnam dkar srid du ring bas bcib ste khrums zla'i dmar phyogs tshes bzang por mar yul stod waṃ le nas rig 'dzin rgyal khams pas phul ba'i zhu yig sarba maṅga lo/gong zhabs su chu sprel mnga' ris mang yul wa le nas/ lha bcas 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig mtshungs pa med pa 'jig rten mgon po ngur smrig gar gyi sgeg pa rnam 'dren mchog gi zhabs stegs chu skyes ge sar rnam par bzhad pa'i ngogs su/ dwangs shing gus pas zhu gsol/ gdod nas rnam dag rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rang bzhin lhun grub rtag brtan g.yung drung ngo bor bri gang med par gnas bzhin mkha' khyab gdul bya rnams la tshad med snying rje bde ba chen po'i gar gyi gdul bya'i dbang khams rigs dang mthun pa'i sku gang la gang 'dul sgyu 'phrul gyi rol pa dag par bzhugs pa rnams kyi yang gzhal bar bka' ba'i ngang tshul can sa bcu pa rnams kyi mgon po sa bcu'i dpal dang ldan pa yang ste rab tu dkar ba'i chu skyes ze phol nyag rer byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos kyang gzhal bar dka' ba'i 'jig rten gyi bkod pa can gyi phyag gi dkyil 'khor nye bar brgyan pa thugs rje'i gter chen gang 782

gi snyigs ma lnga bdo'i 'gro ba rnams la phan pa dang bde ba'i btsas su gang sku'i sprul pa'i rol pa sdom brtson rgyal po'i tshul gyur gangs ri'i khrod kyi lha yi lha khyed zhabs pad mi 'jig seng ge'i khri la rdo rje lta bur brtan par bzhugs pa ni bka' drin tshad bzung las 'das pa'i zho sha chen pos byab/ phran la dwags kyi yul mtshams bde mchog lha ri dkar por 'byor skabs zhabs pad du gnas tshul rags pa'i zhu yig phul zin pa'i rjes thog khrums zla'i tshes la mul lbe rgyal po'i chab shog dang lhan du 'phral du la dwags su bgrod dgos tshul bka' rgya rin po che lha gos rnam par dkar ba dang chab gcig phebs pa dang / de nas rang gi gnas lugs phyogs 'di'i ngang tshul cha cung zad zhig sa dbyug zla'i tshes 3la la dwags stod waṃ le nas thon par phul zin nas yun mi ring bar bde mchog lha ri dkar po nas phul ba'i bka' len zab gos bzang po yug yon tan gyi grangs bcas dbyug zla'i mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i tshes bzang por phebs/ de yi bka' lan 'phral du 'bul rgyur ring khyad che bar bgyis kyang bka' rgya rin po cher rgyal sras rgyal mo dang spun rnams nang tshag gi gnas tshul ji ltar gyi mtshan nyid 'os tshul phebs pas zer tshod tsam gyi gtam la cha 'jog dka' gshis thog mar zhib dris nas rgyal sras rin po che dang khri phun tshogs rnam rgyal 'dod gcig lugs legs su lan grangs du mar bgos kyang phan tshun tha dad nas rang 'dod snying la zhen ste khreg pa'i rdo la chu yi bran pa bzhin go med kho na mdzad gshis chu 'bab tu gzhag na mnyam pa ring zhig byung yang de la brten te phyogs kyi rgyal khag mang pos bsnyad dkri dang nang tshag tu yang 'khon sel je cher 'gro ba'i sgo gsal zhing / mul lbe rgyal po las kyang mtha' dmag gi sna 'dren ni 'di che che tsam du mngon pas rgyal ba mchog gi bka' lung rang la phebs pa nyid dwangs su blangs te tshegs la ma 'dzem par thabs sgo du ma nas legs spel bgyis pa'i skabs nyid du wam le nas phul ba'i lan bka' rgya rin po cher zab gos yug lnga bcas smin drug zla ba'i tshes 7la son/ der yang rang gi bgyid 'os gsal ba'i bka' slob kyi don yid la bzung nas rgyal po phun tshogs dang rgyal sras kyi skor slad nas 'phar gleng med pa'i skor yang bcas smin drug zla tshes 25la thag gtsang mar chod nas phan tshun nas chod yig dgos tshul do gal gyi bskul bzhin chod khra yang mgo zla'i tshes 3la grub par byas/ tshus tshes la so so'i 'dod blo gang yin gyi rgyab yig blang / de la rgyal ba mchog gi zhabs pad du mgo 'chan zhig rgyal bas phyogs 'dir phran 'phrin las kyi byed por mngags don la brten zhus na skabs bab tu sems bzhin 'char bstan la/ a yum bu khrid nas kyang gus pa chen pos 'dod babs kyi gsol 'debs byed kyi 'dug la/ da lta phan mar yul phyogs sa bod nas lung bzang pos bsngags pa tsam las bcad khra mgo 'chan can ye nas ma byung / 'dug kyang lam legs spel tshogs 'dir kha che'i 783

mi sna yang med gshis bcad khra 'dra gsum gyi gcig la mgo 'chan zhu rgyu legs pa'i rgyu 'bras can du sems nas bka' blon rnams kyi zhu yig tu phul ltar de la phyag rgya'i bkod pa tshar du mngar bas rnam par brgyan par gsol ba btab pa yang zab dbyings rin po cher 'jug pa dang / mul lbe rgyal po bkra shis rnam rgyal la snga sor sgar thog tu sleb 'phral nas kho pa'i phebs bsu'i gras nas mi do chod nged kyi yi ge bcas 'phral du waṃ ler yong dgos tshul dang / de rjes waṃ le nas mul lbe rgyal po rang gis bka' blon gzim dpon thun mong nas kyang 'phral du phebs tshul yi ge bang mi tshar lnga tsam song zhing / nged nas kyang rgyal po khu dbon nang 'grigs kyi kha che nas dpung sogs mi dgos tshul gtso bor dang / de bzhin kha che'i la sgo phye bas nas 'phral phebs legs tshul yi ge lan kha yar gtang bar kha cher khu tshan nang 'grigs kyi dpung mi dgos tshul gtong yod 'dug la/ de bzhin kha che'i 'tshang sgo yang hor zla brgyad pa'i gzhug tsam nas phyes song yang khong wam ler phebs rgyu'i skor la dwags pa'i rgyal kha ches byas nas yar byon shul rdzong la skyon gyur 'am/ nged dang ma 'phrad pa'i lam bar du la dwags pas rgol ba zhig 'byung ngam snyam pa'i thugs rtogs yod tshul skad dang / de yang kar ḍa war gyi byad kas thugs rnal mi phebs pa sngar nas yod 'dug pa de ldang ba yin 'dra smrengs kyang ji ltar rung snga sor gnas tshul zhu yig tu phul ltar spyi bye brag mi bde ba'i rgyu nag phyogs gdon gyi byed las can du shes shing / de la skyabs mgon mchog nas kyang thugs dam skyabs 'jug bzang pos byab cing / dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs la yang bstan rim bsgrub par mdzad pa sogs rmad byung thugs bskyed bzang po'i bka' drin zla med las kyang zla med pas khyab cing / phran rang nas kyang gangs can mgon po rgyal ba mchog gi zhabs brtan skye rgu'i bde thabs su dmigs pa'i mar yul ljongs zangs dkar rgyud bcas grub mtha' ris med dge 'dun stong phrag tu long par mang ja lag 'gyed kyi rnam par dngul srang nyis brgya la reg pa dbyug zla'i lha babs kyi dus chen la thon nas smin drug zla 'gor 'grigs par byas pa dang / nar ma'i rnal 'byor tshul du der dmigs kyi gtor ma dang / gcod dmigs sogs nan bskyed bgyid par mgon po mchog gi thugs rjes cung zad rim 'jam song ba snyam byed cing rgyal sras rin po che dang phun tshogs rnam rgyal skor ni 'phral 'grig par ma zad phug yang las kyi bdo na las gzhan 'phar gleng mi 'byung ba'i brtan brling du grub pa'i khul dang / mul lbe rgyal po ni da dung ma 'byor zhing / yong rgyu'i rtsis kyi bya ma rta yang yang byung yang thog tu khel min mi/ ma gtogs nged la dwags mthil du yong tshul phyogs gnyis ka'i rje 'bangs tshangs mas smre ngag kyang sngar nem nur tsam dang / da ni bgrod mi thub par thag bcad zin/ des na mul lbe rgyal po nges med ma byung tshe re zhig bzang dus lta bu zhig la 'jog 784

dgos sam snyam shing / mar nam rang nyid ni 'chi cha med la bal yul rang byung mchod rten chen po'i zhig gso de snying nas bgyid 'dod thun mong ma yin pa yin yang mul lbe rgyal po'i rnam rtog du ma'i byed las kyi lo 'dir yang ni dus phyir 'gyang su bkod pa yi sems la duḥkha mchog tu lci ba bab kyang thabs kyi dbon pa lta bu'i dub par gnas/ don du ni la dwags rgyal po dang khu dbon nang ma bzlum tshe mul lbe rgyal po rang la skyon che ba las/ la dwags rgyal blon la ni da lta'i char de tsam gyi khyad che ba med pa 'dra zhig 'dug rang la ni la dwags las kyang mul lbe rgyal po mos gus che ba tsam yin yang yul spyi chags kyi thugs bsam lam 'gro med pa zhig da lta'i bar byung song / de yang yul phyogs kyi spyi bye brag gi chags su mngon/ phran yang phyogs 'dir sbyin bdag dad pa can gyi gus pas bsnyen yang blo yi bab kyi ha cang sdod par ma spro bas rong mtshams kyi gangs shin tu che bas lam 'gag par ma gyur tshe gar+sha jo bo dang sngon 'phags pa klu grub kyi nyer bar bsnyen pa'i gnas gaṇ+ḍad gi ri tsam du sleb na snyam shing gang cir phran rang gi blang dor gyi gnas kha shas zur du phul ba yang chos dbyings rnyog pa med pa nas bka' yi 'khor los 'phral du khyab pa yang mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen dgu ldan du gsol zhing / phyogs 'dir dgos chas sgar pa nas blang chog phebs pa'i bka' drin tshad bzung med par gyur kyang / kha che'i mi sna che ba 'dra ma byung na bdag rang gi dngos pos mdangs tsam yong 'dra la/ sngar ni sgar nas ja sgam gcig gi snga skyi zhu dgos tsam las gzhan rang 'khos steng nas ster sbyin gtang dgos tshang ma bgyis pa lags shing /gnas tshul zhib mo slad nas gsol bar 'dun cing / yongs kyi dpal mgon phan bde'i rtsa lag gcig pu pa gang khyed zhabs pad rdo rje'i ri bo ltar brtan cing bdag cag ltos par bcas pa rnams la brtse ba'i spyan ras kyi byab cing thugs rje'i bsrung 'khor nas mi bor bar bka' phebs kyang tshang gtsug gi rlung ltar chad pa med pa ci kyang mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen zhes/ thugs rje'i spyan ras g.yo bar byed pa'i rten lha gos rnam par dkar bas bcib ste zla tshes dge ba la waṃ le bde chen rnam rgyal nas phran rig 'dzin rgyal khams pas phul ba'i zhu yig sarba maṅga lo/gangs ri'i khrod du lugs gnyis kyi mngon par mtho ba thub bstan yongs rdzogs kyi mnga' bdag lhar bcas 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po gang gi zhabs mthil gser gyi 'khor lo'i nye bar bsnyen pa ka sa ra yi ngogs su phran rig 'dzin rgyal khams pas blang dor gyi zhu 'os gal chen/ bkra shis 'khor lo'i ri mos brgyan pa'i zhabs stegs chu skyes rnyog med ge sar rnam par rgyas pa'i ngogs su/ bdag rang gi blang dor bka' lung zhu 'os gal chen/ rang nyid lo nyi shu rtsa grangs nas bod yul du dam pa'i chos kyi phyir du 'byor nas rang gi yul phyogs de'i bla ma dam par gyur 785

pa rnams kyi mdo khams phyogs su ci kyang yong dgos zhes bka' lung rim can dang / nged bod yul du rgyun ring bas de rnams kyang rim gyis gshegs pa'i sku gdung sbyang rgyu bdag la bsngos pa'i bka' chems bcas shing / yul phyogs der yang bstan pa'i bya ba phran bu bgyid 'dun gyi mdo khams phyogs su bgrod rtsis mchis rung / las kyi dbang gi bal yul rang byung mchod rten chen po'i zhig gso la sems zhen pas der bgrod kyang skye sngon rten 'brel gyi gnad ka zhig gi lo mang po'i sngon nas rim 'gyang dang / chu sprel lo gzhug 'dir grub par re yang mul lbe rgyal po'i 'gor gshis de yang phyir nur bar 'gyur gshis 'di nas o rgyan gyi lam bar du pak+ṣa dang pa ṭha na 'thab pa'i mi bde ba yod 'dug kyang rgya gar yul chos kyi nang pa'i dzo ki dang / phyi rol pa'i se n+ya shi/ bai ra ga dza gi/ kla klo yi darje sha la 'tshe ba mi byed par thos pas o rgyan dang phyogs 'di shin tu khad nye ba yi rang nyid gcig pu dzo ki'i chas su zhugs te bgrod na ci ma rung snyam la/ 'on kyang brtson pa chen por ma gyur pas ye shes kyi goms shugs chung zhing /rlung gi nus pas rtsa thig yang ba ma thob pa yi lus lci zhing / spyir btang rang bzhin gyi lang tsho nyid kyang rgud cing na ba du mas gzir ba bcas gnas skabs tshegs su gyur pa ltar snang yang 'bu srin nur 'gros kyi dal 'byor don ldan la sbyor ba'i zhig tu re la de tshe sang phod hor zla bdun pa'i mtha' tsam du kasmi ra yi sner zin pa zhig dgos 'dug cing gal te o rgyan yul dngos gzhir bgrod par ma spyod na yang kasmi ra yi rtsu ta ka ni ka dang / me tog mdangs 'phrog gi tshal 'bar ba 'dzin pa'i yul gazlo tsam bgrod par mdun la de yang rang nyid tshe yi phan pa gang du rdzogs kyang de la cer cer po de tsam ma mchis rung / bdag lo nyi shu zin nas da bar rgyal khams chu bzhin nyul ste bsgom bsgrub kyi gegs su che yang dam pa'i chos la sred pas thos pa'i gzugs brnyan bgyis par/ chos rgyun mang zhig rang gnas chos kyi dbyings su gshegs zin 'dug kyang / de yi lhag ma cha shas khrid rgyun rnam grangs bcu phrag yang du mar longs ba nyid rang gis lhag bsam gyi sngon gyi las smon dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs rjes nos pa rnams kho bos skyas 'degs pa dang lhan gcig tu 'grogs par ma gyur cig snyam pa'i blo yi lhag ma tsam las gzhan ma mchis na de yang ci ltar rung thugs dam gsal gzigs kyi bka' yis 'khor los mi bskyud pa dang / tshul de thugs dam gyi ra bar chud par gyur na/ de tshe bal yul gyi zhig gso'i dngos po rnams ring bsrel dang ldan pa'i mchod rten la dmigs bsngos pa'i yo byad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rang nyid kyis kyang spyad par ma gnang na chud zos dogs shin tu nas kyang sems khur lci bas dngos po rnams gzhung sar phul ste/ de nas zhabs rim do chod kyi zhig gso mgo 'dren zhus na snyam pa yang ci ltar legs bka' lung gser gyi 'khor lo lta bus khyab pa dang / gong du gsol ltar phran rang 786

sngar mdo khams kyi phyogs su bgrod 'dod kyi rtog pa dung dung po yin yang / da cha yul phyogs de ru dus snyigs kyi ngang tshul mang po zhig ston gshis der phyin na spyod lam 'jam rtsub chos dang mthun min ji snyed pas sems g.yengs kyi dogs phyogs der bgrod 'dod cung zad phyir phyogs pas da cha 'phags yul gyi phyogs sam/ mon mtshams grub pa'i gnas chen zhig tu lo shas sdod par byas legs sam rang gi blo yi 'char cha ste de ltar min yang bod phyogs su lo shas 'gor ba'i nam 'chi cha med tshe yi nges pas gtug pa yi mdo khams kaḥthog rdo rje gdan zhes yul phyogs de'i snga 'gyur gyi ring lugs 'dzin pa'i nying khung khul ste snga sor kaḥthog rgyal sras bsod nams lde'u btsan gyi bdag la sgo gnyer gdan sa gtad kyang rang nyid phyogs med bya bral gyi 'dun pas dgon der yun sdod kyi go skabs ma dbyes kyang gting du bstan la lhag bsam ma chad tsam mchis kyang / nged bod yul dbus 'gyur phyogs su yun ring ba yi bar skabs su bdag la gnang zhu byas pa dang / yang rang rang 'dod khyer gyi bla ma'i rnam grangs mang zhig dang / bdag gi bla ma bsod nams lde'u btsan gyis sprul skur grags pa du ma byung ba las/'ba' phyogs kyi sngags rgyud zhig shes sgo gsal khul gyi kho rang dgon du phyin nas nged dang si tu'i tshad mar byas pa'i rdzun bag la brten sde dges kyang chu 'bab tu gzhag 'dug rung blo bab med gshis/ khong rang yang shas cher 'ba' phyogs su sdod yod 'dug lags/ bdag rang phyogs der sleb pa 'phral 'gyang che gshis bla bsko zhig dgos gal che bar mthong yang kun gyi tshad mar gyur pa zhig 'phral 'grig ma byung bas/ si tu rin po che dang yang 'brel che rang gi dbang khrid gdams ngag legs par phul zhing nyams rtogs ji bzhin skyes pa'i slob ma dang / zha dmar mchog kyang de ltar re nas re zhig zhwa dmar mchog sprul khrir bkod rgyu rang gi ngag bkod bcas da lo'i dbyar mi 'gros brdzang tshar la/ slar zhwa dmar bod yul dbus su bzhugs gdan 'jag dgos kyi kaḥthog rang du gtan sdod kyi bla bsko zhig dgos gal che gshis/ de yang kaḥthog dgon pa thog mar ka dam pa zhes spob pa mtha' yas kyi rags rtsis mkhon dkon mchog rgyal pos sa skya btab nas yun mi ring ba zhig tu kaḥthog btab/ de nas lo bdun brgya la khad nyer song ba'i de srid du gter ston klong gsal snying po yab sras gnyis kho na las bla rabs gzhan thams cad rten dge slong gi dngos po sha stag bslab gtsang 'ba' zhig las gzhan srol rgyun ma byung stabs/ da dung bslab tshugs zin nges zhig ma byung na bstan pa la gnod par dogs pa yi kaḥthog rgyal sras kyi sprul sku'i rnam grangs su gyur pa las dbus lho kha sbyor rab sprul pa'i sku bgres pa'i gcung lo nyi shu skor lcags rta lo nas nged kyi gam du yod pa de shes blo shin tu brtul ba zhig yin 'dug kyang / da lta'i cha la dpag na bslab tshugs ni zin 'dra snyam pa zhig 'dug la/ na ning zhabs pad du 787

bstan pa la phan min brtag zhu steng nas phan par shar tshe bsnyen rdzogs zhig blang 'jug rgyu'i rtsis la dus 'gyur gyi de skabs snyan 'bul ma thub pa de dang / yang kham khe nang nas mthu stobs lde'u pha ni rigs sngags 'chang khung ldan/ ma ni lcags mdud jag dpes rgyud btsan dang / hor mtshams pha ma'i rigs rgyud la tre shod nas g.yung drung / sa ngan sde dge'i yul mtshams kaḥthog drung pas ngos 'dzin byas pa zhig dang / da lta grags tshul de rnams nas sam/ de min gzhan nas kyang rung ste kaḥthog gi bstan pa la sman par gyur pa su zhig ye shes kyi gzigs pas rol nas bka'i 'khor los khyab pa dang /yang spo bor bdag gi bla ma'i yang srid du grags pa kun bzang pha ma gnyis ka rigs khung ldan bstan 'dzin zhes pa sngar nas kaḥthog tu 'brel rgyun zab pa zhig yin la de yang ste/ su zhig thugs dam bab pa de nyid zhabs pad mchog tu bsnyen rdzogs zhig blang nas/ kaḥthog tu bsko gzhag byed 'dod yin la/dgon der ni bslab shes las kyang bslab tshugs zin pa gtso ba zhig snang bas/ de don ltar thugs dam thugs rje brtse ba chen po'i rol pa mi lhod pa dang / gzhan yang phran rang chung ngu nas rab tu byung ba'i phyogs la shin tu gus shing / bsnyen par rdzogs pa la 'jug pa'i blo 'dod dung dung po yod rung / rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' drin can byin brlab can dran mchog dngas ma'i mgon po dpal bde ba chen po'i zhabs nas mkha' 'gro'i 'phrin las byed par snang zhing zab gter gyi rten 'brel bsgrigs dgos sogs dkar chas kho na legs zhes bka' nan tan gnang ba yis tshangs par spyod pa'i dge bsnyen nos rgyal bas gsung pa'i gnang bkag la ci nus spyod khul tsam la dbus gtsang phyogs su sleb nas me rta lor pha tre'i rin po cher bsnyen rdzogs zhig zhu dgos tshul snyan 'debs phul bar des kyang gong dang cha 'dra phebs pas shol shing / zab gter ni tshe 'dir mchog gter lnga gang rung zhig dang 'grig na de dang gter phran rnams spel bar snang yang / mchog gter lnga ji bzhin ma 'grig phyin gter phran kha yar byung ba dag kyang rten 'brel gyi gnad ka gzhan dang gzhan gyi ldab gter du sbas nas bka' ma dang gter rnying skyong bar bsngags bzhin tshe 'di'i rten 'brel gyi sgo ni gong gi phyi ma nyid du grub par gyur song la tshul 'di yang gsang sgo can du gu rus bsngags shing gzhan la 'chal na 'di phyi'i rten 'brel la gnod par gsungs pas des na gsang ba bsrung ba gnas yin yang mgon po mchog gi spyan sngar gsong por gsol nas/ da cha bsnyen par rdzogs pa zhig bsgrub na sngags kyi spyod pa ni sngags kyi sdom gsum yar ldan gyi dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa ru bsngags par gyur pa yis shin tu rung bar snang yang phran bya bral gyi spyod pa gyi na nyid dang mdo khams phyogs su bgrod na yul chos kyi blang dor mang pos ji bzhin bsgrub par dka' yang dam pa'i chos 'dul ba la mos pa'i stobs kyi rje gtsang pa rgya ras kyi gsung nas 'byung 788

ba der 'gro bar 'dug kyang nam 'chi cha med kyi re zhig bar ma rab byung lta bu zhig bsgrub nas de yi rtags blang bar 'dod na de yang rten 'brel la nyams ji ltar 'gyur ye shes kyi gzigs pa mchog gi dpyad pa'i bka' lung rin po che phebs pa ci nas kyang mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen dgu ldan du gsol ba 'debs pa re 'bras don ldan du mdzad du gsol/ /deng dus 'dzam gling 'di na rgyal ba'i bstan pa yongs rdzogs 'khor lo gsum gyi 'khor los bsgyur ba chen po lugs gnyis kyi mngon par mtho ba bstan pa'i mnga' bdag chen po yin par ma zad/ mgon po mchog khyed o rgyan gu rus tshangs pa lha yi me tog smon lam bzang pos sprul pa'i zlos gar du rdo rje'i ljags kyi bsngags par mdzad pa lkog 'gyur gzhan gyis ma bslad pa'i dpang por rang nyid che ba yis tshul des yid dga' gshis dag pa'i snang bas drangs nas sems la gang mchis lhug par gsol ba la chos dbyings tshom 'khrung skad cig yang mi mnga' ba nas bka' mchid yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i phung pos re ba'i yid kyi shing rta phyur bur khengs pa ci nas mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen zhes ye shes kyi spyan ras 'bab par byed pa'i rten dri ma med pas nam yang ma rnyog pa'i zla ba zhu ba'i khu bas lan du mar byug pa lta bu'i lha gos dang rgya yul chen po nas byung ba'i gser gyi pa ṇa yon tan gyi bgrang cha bcas dpal gdong chu bya'i lo zhal gsar du 'char nye ba mgo zla'i dkar phyogs gang ba'i dus bzang por waṃ le bde chen rnam rgyal nas phran gyur dpal rig pa 'dzin pas phul ba'i li khi te sarba maṅga lo/zhabs pad yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po cher/ gus pas zhu gsol/ deng dus ri kha ba can gyi khrod du yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag gangs can mgon po mchog dang de sras thu bo dam pa ngur smrig gar gyi rol pa gang dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rang bzhin gcig tu 'dus te smin grol chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen bskor bar mdzad pa ni 'gro ba thams cad kyi kye ma 'o 'di ni 'jig rten mdzes par byas so/ /kye ma'o 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bcas so/ /kye ma'o 'di ni skye dgu mtha' dag la sman par byed pa'i rgyu'o/ /zhes 'og min gyi bar du sgrogs par nges na 'dir gnas phran bu sa 'og 'bu srin grog ma'i mchod zlar gyur pa bdag kyang yid dngas shing sim par gyur pa ni chu skyes kha 'bus pa lta bu'i snyim pa'i dkyil 'khor spyi bor bzlum bzhin pas legs 'bul mtshon byed yul kasmi ra nas byung ba'i gos mchog 'phags rgyal gyi ras be'u yi do zlar byas pa yul 'dir zla bral 'phags yul gyi rū pa na drug cu las mi dman nges pa'i rin thang can dngos po pad+ma'i rnal ma lta bu ches cher phra yang lhag bsam mos dge gyen phyur gyi ngos ltar yang sa rlom bzhin phyag bcas phul ba'i zhu yig sarba maṅga lo/zhabs pad yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che gnas tshul zhu chung / 'dir rgyal sras rin po che bslab 789

pa gso na sems kyang rgyal rigs kyi bu dregs cing brgyag pa 'dod pa'i lang tsho bdol ba yi de lta ci tsam brjod kyang skabs su ma gyur pas de tshe kho pa rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma 'brug pa thams cad mkhyen pa la bshags 'bul zhig bgyis na legs tshul smras kyang thog mar blo la de yang shin tu 'jug dka' zhing mthar las 'bras dam tshig gi mtshan nyid ci rigs bshad cing 'jam pos dkris pas cung zad khug ste bshags 'bul byed rgyu'i rtsis su byas song ba gnas tshul lags shing / phyogs 'di'i bgyid 'os la sman pa'i bka' tham rin po che zhig zhu ba skabs babs 'gyur min snyan dbang yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po cher phul bar/ de la bka' stsal ma phebs pa da cha la dgas mthil du bgrod rtsis min gshis/ rdon des zhu bar mi nus kyang bdag gi gnas tshul tshig nyog gi 'phreng bas gzigs ngor ma spyod pa min na rung yang chos dbyings tshom 'khrung rgyur gyur pa ni ma lags sam snyam pa'i blo ngal byung bas des na zab dbyings rin po che tshom 'khrung med par mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen dgu ldan du gsol ba 'debs pa de kho na bzhin thugs rje chen pos gzigs pas byab par mdzad du gsol/rgyal ba mchog gi rab 'byams 'phrin las bgyid pa po sa yi tshangs pa chen por gyur pa rnams kyi mdun sar/ zhu ba/ gang zhig mi mthun smag rum bcil zhing mnga' ris skye dgu'i pad tshal 'dzum pa'i byed po nyin mor byed pa'i thig le rgyal ba mchog gi 'phrin las 'dren par byed pa'i kha lo blo gros kyi dpal gar cir yang bsgyur ba'i go la'i rta mchog mtshar ba nam yang brnyil med phan bde'i 'khor lo 'khor bzhin bzhugs pa nas 'dir gnas bya bral phran bu las kyang phran bur gyur pa la'ang dges pa'i spyan ras kyi ma lhod pa'i chab shog 'char byed kyi 'od la jo 'dri ba zab ling bzang po'i rten bcas phyag rgya'i re kha ma rnying bar 'phrul ldan shugs 'chang rkang pa'i gar can gyis snyim pa nas 'dir son pas yid dga' ba'i lang tsho cir yang rgyas pa'i rtsas su gyur la/ 'dir gnas bya bral ba yang 'tsho ba sngar mu bzhin khyo re ba'i ngang da lta waṃ ler gnas shing / der mar yul bdag po rgyal sras dang rgyal po phun rnam rgyal mo bcas te rten zhal rnams kyi legs spel rang gi blo nus la dpag pa/ las kyi bde ba med phyin brling chags mtha' btsan 'phar med du grub pa'i chod yig mdun rgyab can du byas pa'i 'dra gsum gyi gcig la gong sa skyabs mgon mchog gi zhabs pad nas mgo 'chan gnang rgyur phyogs 'di'i cha rgyus kyi steng zin bris bcas phul ba de don sor gzhag thugs rje che gnang dang / mul lbe rgyal po bkra shis rnam rgyal ni snga sor sgar thog nas kho rang gi phebs bsu ba'i khrod nas jo khag khul zhig 'phral brdzang waṃ ler hor zla 8mgor nges 'byor dgos tshul dang waṃ ler 'byor nas kyang nged nas yi ge snga phyir yi ge kha shas dang kho pa rang gi drung 'khor yod dgu gcog gam snying po gzim dpon sgar thog dang bka' blon waṃ 790

ler 'phral 'byor byung ba kho pa gnyis nas kyang la dwags pas nyer 'tshe mi byed nges can yin 'dug pas 'phral bskyod legs tshul bang mi snga phyir tshar lnga gtang sogs kyang kha che na bab kyi la dwags pa'i rgyab gnyer byas nas kho sar dmag 'jug yong ngam snyam pa'i dogs pa yin tshul gyi yi ge byung la/ der yang ma zad mon bhal ti'i jo khag zhes dpon po zhig gi chung ma kho pas bag rgod du blang bas de'i nyer 'tshe la yang 'dzem pa yin nam zer la/ nged kyi 'phros byas ltar kha cher khu dbon nang 'grig tshul gyi gnas tshul pho nya dang / kha che'i tshong lam ni gtang 'dug 'di ru 'byon rgyu'i skor ni sngar 'byon thang bshol thang bcu phrag du ma'i rang bzhin gyi da lta thug phebs ma byung la/ khong gi 'gor gzhis 'di lo bal yul mchod rten chen po'i zhig gso ni phyir 'gyang smos med du song bas yid khong bur mchod bzhin par gnas/ nged la dwags mthil du yong dgos zhes rgyal khag phan tshun tshang ma 'dod mthun du byung bas ltas kyang cung zad ma chub cing lhag tu blo 'dod la ma bab ste/ sngar sa sbrul lor glo bo rje 'bangs nas yong dgos tshul nan bskyed ches pas 'gro 'dod med bzhin der phyin de skabs sku mched 'khrug par dgung g.yog rnams kyi srog skyobs rang gi lus srog la ma 'dzem par 'bad pas mi brgya lhag tsam gyi srog thar ba yang dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum gyis mkhyen ngor gsal ba yin yang / rta lo dus 'gyur skabs srog skyobs byas pa rnams nas khrel ldan re zung las drin bzo byed par dkon na mkhyen ldan gzhan nas rjes bsngags re ba la de lta zhog las khung nas skabs min gyi bka' 'dri lci ba'i rgyur song ba sogs 'gro 'dod med pa'i gnas su 'gro sdod de yang shin tu bag khum gyi rim 'gyang nas da cha la dgas mthil du bgrod mi thub pa'i thag chod kyi 'phros gtang zin cing / des mul lbe rgyal po bkra shis rnam rgyal lam zhugs kyi 'phros byung ba bden na khu dbon rgyal blon lab ching 'grig par re yang / 'di phyogs nas kyang nyan shin tu mi bzod pa'i drag shul che zhing / mul lbe rgyal po yang go ba ma chags pa'i spyi brtol can zhig yod 'dug pas phan tshun gtam yang he bag che zhing sngar kha che na bab kyi gcod mtshams yi ge zhig yang yod 'dug pa bcas 'grig bzlum yang shin tu dka' 'dra snyam la/ yang rgyal po dbyar dro dus mi phebs na deng dus phyogs 'dir grang ba'i reg bya ral gri'i so las kyang tsha na de la bag khum dang lhag tu thugs gdon bskyod kyi yang ma phebs par shar na re zhig bzang dus lta bu zhig bgyid dgos rgyu yin nam snyam pa dang / lar phyogs 'dir dus snyigs kyi rang mdangs spyi dang bye brag 'tshub ltas su che ba'i mi rnams kyang rmu ches cher rgod pa yi don med pa'i stong skad kyi 'ur zings/gcig gi gcig la phra ma sems ngan dang / de brten g.yul bsham du 'cha' ba lta bu'am 'tshub lhong sogs kha sin thog mar dpag par dka' ba zhig 'dug kyang / des na rgyal ba mchog gi thugs rje'i 791

skyabs 'jug dang bstan rim yang mdzad pa'i bka' drin gyi deng sang cung zad 'jam chags su song la/rang nyid la ni la dgas rje 'bangs nas bda' ba'i zas skom bstab cing gus pas bsnyen yang rang rang 'dod dbang las smras pa'i gtam la ni shin tu nyan par dka' ba yis lab ching 'grig sdum tshegs che tsher ma'i dong ngam shig nad kyi bro 'tshal ba las kyang lhag par dub cing ngal yang bgyid 'os bstan 'gro'i don rgyal ba mchog gi bka' bod yul gyi 'dun na 'dun chen po'i 'phris las kyi ched du'o snyam nas da bar lhag bsam gyi 'khar ba khrang por brten ste mchis la/ da cha phyogs 'dir blo yi bab kyi ha cang sdod par ma spro bas rong mtshams la gangs shin tu che bas lam 'gag par ma gyur tshe gar+shad ri 'phags sogs mjal na snyams shing / de min 'di lo dgun 'os mtshams zhig tu sdod 'dod lags pa yang gnas tshul dang phyogs 'dir dgos chas sgar sa nas blang chog phebs pa bka' drin chen pos khyab kyang kha che'i mi sna che kha 'dra byung na de ltar dgos rigs snang yang / da lta kha che dang sa than gyi dpung lhag par 'thab pa'i skabs su snang gshis kha che nang duḥkha'i rang bzhin gyi snying rje'i gnas su gyur kyang phyogs 'dir 'di lo ni kha che'i dmag nyan med par bde ba'i go skabs can gyis 'dir rgyal po phan tshun rnams la ni rang gi dngos po ldang tsam yong re dang / sgar nas sngar ja sgom gcig gi snga skyi las gzhan rgyal ba mchog gi zhabs brtan bstan 'gro'i spyi rim du dmigs pa'i mar yul gar+shad si tu bcas kyi dge 'dun tshangs mar mang ja lag 'gyed phran bur dngul srang gnyis brgyar reg pa dang / la dwags rgyal blon rnams la 'phros rten dgos rigs bcas tshang ma rang 'khos steng nas byas shing / nges med ma ldang dgos nges byung na las sgar nas zhu rtsis med la/ gong zhabs mchog nas bka' rgya rin po che snga phyir gnang skyes zab gos yug brgyad dang / de bzhin 'dun na 'don chen po'i chab shog rten zab yug gnyis phebs pa nas sngar gos yug bzhi las gzhan tshang ma yod pas slad char dgos rigs snyan 'bul zhu skabs las zab gos skyes gnang re zhig mi 'tshal la/ 'di skor gyi gnas tshul slar zhib 'bul bgyid rgyu dang / da lam mgo 'chan zhu rgyu sogs bka' lan 'di phran sdod 'gro yi ring khyad che ba lags na bka' yi 'khor los phral mar khyab pa yang ci nas kyang mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen zhes spyan ras g.yo bar byed pa'i rten rnam par dkar ba lha yi reg bya srid du ring ba dang / yul kasmi ra yi zab gos dmar po gser gyi ri mo mngon par bkra ba mar yul rang du dngul srang nyi shu rtsa lnga'i rin thang can dang /'phags yul gyi pa ṇa bkra shis pa'i grangs ldan bcas zla 11tshes 29bzang po la mar yul stod waṃ le bde chen rnam rgyal nas phul ba'i li khi rta sarba maṅga lo/lags/ chos dbyings tshom 'khrung mi mnga' bar gsol ba 'debs pa nas rje 'brug pa dang /792

mtshur phu mdzod pa la 'bul rgyu'i yi ge 'di yang de nas 'phral 'phrod thugs rje che gzigs dang rje 'brug pa'i yig lan ni zhu mi dgos shing mtshur phu nas dpe zhig blang dgos yod pas yig lan kyang ci nas zhu rgyu dang / rkong po ljon pa klung du bod rje mchod yon gyi zhabs brtan du dmigs pa'i sgrub sde lo re bzhin rdo rje sems dpa'i yang snying dung phyur gtsos byas/ cho ga chos spyod 'phros tshugs nas lo skor nye bar song zhing / de mtshungs mchod rten rnam dag tu lo re bzhin badz+ra gu ru bye ba kha yar tshugs nas lo ma nyung tsam song ba de rnams gzhan rkyen gyis bshol nye byung yod 'dug pa/ ngo bo zhabs brtan rnam dkar dge rgyun yin yang 'dzugs mkhan nged du song gshis sger dpon lta bu'i don gnang chung 'di gong sa mchog gi zhabs pad du smos ci 'tshal mi yi rje bo 'dun na 'dun rnams kyi snyan 'bul zhu rin chog pa zhig mi 'dug kyang / dge rgyun phra mo de re zhig ma chad na snyams nged phyogs der ma slebs kyi bar slar mu bzhin tshugs dgos kyi sa bon zur gsal la gnang gtad sa bon zhu rten ma gyur tshe bka' tham thugs rjes gzigs nas yig chung 'di dang lhan gcig ljon klung rdo rje slob dpon la 'phral gnang thugs rje che ba ci nas kyang mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen zhes gzigs rten lha gos dngul gnyis bcas zla tshes dge ba la phul ba'i zhu chung sarba maṅga lo/chu sprel la/ rgyal ba'i 'dun na 'don sems dpa' chen po lhan rgyas mchog gi sku gzhogs su/nang lugs stabs bder 'phul ba chos dbyings rnyog med ngos/ deng dus der rgyal ba mchog gi zhabs rim g.yel med du bzhugs pa bka' drin che/ ngos kyang phyogs 'di'i 'gro ba dmu rgod kyi rba klong 'khrug pa'i dbus su lhag bsam gyi gru bo ma gzhig tsam du gnas/ ched du gsol 'os/ sngon rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po lnga bas thugs kyi ze'ur rab tu gces shing 'bad pas btsug pa'i rnam rgyal grwa tshangs su grags pa/ rgyal ba mchog gi rdo rje theg pa'i smin grol gyi rgyun cho ga phyag gzhes dag pa de phyis rtses thang du 'phos shing / de nas dbus gtsang dus zing skabs nyams par gyur pa de tshugs na ci ma rung snyam pa ring mo nyid nas yid du brtan zhing / thabs 'khos phran bu bgyis kyang rten 'bral gyi gnad ka zhig gi sgrub par ma nus kyang / da dung yid la dung dung po mchis kyang bdag bya bral gyi na bas thabs mkhas su ma gyur rung / deng dus rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po seng ge'i khrir bzhugs te gangs can lugs gnyis kyi mnga' bdag mdzad pa'i skabs su/ de tshugs pa skabs bab nyid du nges shing / de yang dbus gtsang du grub mtha' mang gshis cung zad mi mdzes tshe kong yul phyogs zhig tu 'dzugs na snyam la/ kong po nyang kha'i sa khugs du mchod khong rtse zhes zhal snga bka' brgyud kyi grangs su 'gro ba sngar grwa pa drug cu skor gyi 'tsho chas phyid pa'i sa yin zer/ sku skye rim byon gyi 793

sku skye sa grwa tshang shing glang lor ma 'tshams nas bla ma des dgon dbang ris bdag thob nged la 'bul dgos zer kha 'dzin byed 'dod ma shar bas ma byas/ de tshe se ra'i rab 'byams pa zhig der bos yod 'dug kyang 'jag gnas gtan tshig ji bzhin pa ma byung yod skad bcas/ der grwa tshang rnying pa 'dzugs 'os skabs su che 'dra snyams pa dang / gzhan rtsa 'dra tsā gong brag gsum mtsho rdzong sogs gang legs rgyal ba mchog gi ye shes kyi gzigs ngor dpyad de rnam rgyal grwa tshang rnying khung 'di rgyal ba gong ma rnams kyi dgongs rdzogs su dgongs nas ci nas kyang 'dzugs pa zhig gsol ba 'debs pa lags shing / de la phran rang stobs 'byor gyi zhabs rim bsgrub par bka' yang rten 'brel gyi sgrigs phyogs sogs zhabs 'og tu gang 'gyur zhu 'dod lags na de don skyabs mgon mchog gi snyan dbang yid bzhin gyi nor bur phul nas phran la ci ltar gyis dka' yis 'khor los khyab tshe phran yang phral du ma shi na der sman gyi bgyid 'os khyad kyang 'dug pas 'di 'dzugs par shar tshe gzhan la re zhig gsang rgya ma mdzad na bar chad brtsom pa po mang bas de lugs kyang zab dbyings rin po cher 'jug pa zhu zhu zhes gzigs rten lha yi reg bya rnam par dkar bas bcib ste zla tshes dge ba la rgyal khams pas phul ba'i li khi tai sarba maṅga lo/ring nas mdza' ba'i bshes mkhyen pa'i gter gyur sde pa mda' dpon zhabs drung rin po che gang gi sku gzhogs su/ nang lugs stabs bder phul ba dgongs dbyings rnyog med ngos/ deng dus sku yi dkyil 'khor dngas shing 'dren pa yongs kyi spyi phud rgyal ba mchog gi 'phrin las kyi bgyid 'os mi lhod par bzhugs pa bka' drin mchog tu gyur/ ngos kyang tsha grang reg bya dub pa kun dngas su blangs nas mar yul ljongs su 'byor nas dmu rgod kyi 'gro ba kha lo dka' ba yi tshegs che'i ngang du gnas/ de zhabs su zhu yig 'dra 'bul 'dod che yang rta shad du song shis gzhan ngor ma mdzes dogs 'bul ma bde zhing / da lam mtshams 'dri mtshon byed zhu yig 'di bzhin ste der sku yi rim gror sngar mu ltar le shor med pa dang de yang nges don mdo sde dang sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya la 'bad cing / lha mo'i gsol mchod la ci nus brtson/ rgyal ba mchog gi thugs rjes bod yul gcig pu bde ba tsam las rgya gar kha che sogs yul kun tu 'thab 'khrug gi sgra ldir che ba'i ngang du 'dug gang cir slad mar dngos su mjal bar 'dun la/ dus kun dge ba'i skyabs 'jug bgyid pa dgongs par 'jags pa zhu/ zhes rten mtshon byed bcas zla tshes bzang po la mar yul waṃ le nas phul ba'i li khi te sarba maṅga lo/mkhyen gter mi rje paṇ+ḍi ta dang zhabs drung khri lcam lhan rgyas mchog gi sku zhabs su/ nang lugs stabs bder phul ba la chos dbyings rnyog pa med pa nas/ deng dus sku'i 'tsho gzhes dngas shing mdzad khyab bzang po gong 'phel du bzhugs pa gzhir bcas/ ngos kyang 'tsho ba khyo re ba'i ngang lam bar gyi tsha 794
