grang dka' tshegs mang po dngas su blang zhing mar yul phyogs su 'byor yang dmu rgod 'gro ba kha lo 'dzin par shin tu dka' bas sbyang bzhin par mchis/ gang ltar gnas tshul rtse dang shod bka' shag gi zhu yig tu gsal ltar lags shing / ring nas thugs nang gshim pa'i stabs yi ge 'bul 'dod byung yang ma bde bas da lam mtshams 'dri mtshon byed tsam ste dus kun dge ba'i skyabs 'jug bsrung 'khor bgyid pa yang zab dbyings su 'jug pa zhu zhu/ zhes lha gos dang 'phags yul gyi pa ṇa brgyad bcas waṃ le nas phul ba'i li khi rta sarba maṅga lo/chu sprel la dwags waṃ le nas/ yangs pa'i rgyal khams spyi dang bye brag kong yul ral gsum/ khyad par jo rdzong gzhis sdod las sne mor mngags sleb bcas shing / lhag tu ljon mdzes dang 'bral gyur kun gyi nges dgos/ rig 'dzin rgyal khams pa 'di sa mdo khams yul rang tshan du skyes shing / kaḥthog gi mtshon snga 'gyur ring lugs 'dzin pa chos smra thams cad kyi rtse mor gyur pa yul der skyid chos rang dbang gi nyams su myong chog pa zhig rang yul du skyid chos spyod pa de rtswa bzhin dor nas yangs pa'i rgyal khams kun tu lo nyi shu nas dam pa'i chos 'bab zhig gi ched du lus srog ltos med kyi dka' ba mang du bcad cing bstan 'gro'i dge ba'i btsas su bod yul dag pa'i zhing du yun ring du bsnyen pa las lto gos rnyed 'tshol gyi ched du 'khyams pa zhig ni min tshul zer ba dus snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i mthar thug 'dir bden pa las brdzun pa brim/ tshug thub pa las mgo bde brim/ chos las chos min brim/ tshul ldan las zog po brim zhing rdzun zog can ches mang ba'i dus skabs 'dir kho pa yang rdzun zog gi khengs pa zhig yin shas kyang che/ de mi mngon pa'i nga rgyal can zhig ste gang ltar kho pa nyang kha ri khrod du sbas pa'i sangs rgyas kun bzang bde chen rab gsal zhabs su dgongs 'dus rdzogs chen snying po gser zhun sogs khrid chen bzhi dang / khrid phran kha yar gyi rgyun legs par nyan pa'i skabs/ mdzes mo skyid 'dzom mi ngo rdzogs skabs chos skyong chen po dpe har bab nas bskul ba yin zhes/ mo rang gi dbang ris bdag thob rig 'dzin rgyal khams par phul ba'i ngo chen du cub ri grub thob sbas pa'i sangs rgyas dang / 'brug chos steng sprul sku sbran pa dang / ljon pa klung gi gzhi bdag drag shul can/ de rnams kyi yang bdag gir byed dgos tshul gsol ltar/ gzhung sar snyan sgron zhus pas kyang legs tshul phebs pas lcags sprel lor rtsis blang ba/ gzhis ngo thog sku rten blo bzang dpal 'bar gyi pha gzhis them rkang gcig la bzhi zur gcig bsnan pa yin 'dug pa/ sku rten pa dar rgyas skabs shu lha gser khyim kha gcig gis mgo gtad byas pa yis gzhung 'bab kong po'i srol dmag rta rin brgyad zur gcig 'khri ba/phu 'brog kong po sa khul yang stabs sngar nas mar khal kha yar zhig rdzong du phul nas ham pa su ches 795

mtshang bsrol byung 'dug pa/ phyis gnyer pad rab nas rdzong 'bab kyi mar gyi steng du mar khal kha shas bsnon ma byas nas 'brog rtsa 'jags byas 'dug pa tsam las gzhan pa khul mi che zhing / sngar skyid 'dzom rang gi gzhis bzung skabs kyi bun gyi kha skor dgos pa/ de phyin gnyer pa rang gi thabs skyi ba sprul gsum la brten dngos po yar ldan du song bar/ dad pa'i phul ba'i nor rdzas ser sna 'jur gegs kyi bcing pa'i dngos po chud zos mi 'gro bar rnam dkar dge ba la lcags sprel lo nas chu khyi bar pad+ma rab brtan nas do khur gyi badz+ra gu ru dung phyur gnyis dang yig drug dung phyur gcig rnams rim can du bsgrub dgos 'dug cing / chu khyi lor rig 'dzin rgyal khams pa rang nyid spo bo nas kong por 'byor thog ljon pa klung de gu ru'i gnas chen zab phu lung dang mtshungs par bsngags pa'i der bstan 'gro yongs kyi bde thabs dam pa mchog gi zhabs brtan du dmigs/ sgrol ma 'byung ba bla na med pa'i sku brnyan thog tshad dang bcas pa'i gtsug lag khang gzhengs/ chu phag lor sgrub sde btsug nas bsgrubs po nyi shu rtsa brgyad las mi nyung ba smin drug zla ba sa ga zla ba'i bar sgo gsum chig dril gyi cho ga chos spyod khri phrag lhag long ba dang / rdo rje sems dpa'i yang snying yi ge drug pa dung phyur kha bskong bye ba'am sa ya kha shas yang ste da lta bar chags 'bri med par tshugs pa dang / shing glang lor sleb dkon gnyer kho rang brgyud pa rdzogs nas gzhis chung rnam dkar dge rgyun la sbyor rgyur phul ba de rten lo re bzhin mchod rten rnam dag tu ljon klung bsgrub sde der bskyod nas badz+ra gu ru bye ba gsum las mi nyung ba sogs bstan 'gro'i bde thabs rnam dkar 'ba' zhig bsgrub pa las gzhan med pa kun gsal yin 'dug kyang mjes gnyer pad+ma rab brtan grong nas khams kyi mi ngan kha shas kong po'i ser gzugs kha shas kyi dkrug sel gyi bsgrub sder gzings shing mang du byung 'dug pa'ang khams phyogs kyi grwa pa dkrug shing 'gro ba gnyis gnas dbyung thog mar bsgrub sde 'jags pa'i bkod khyab rig 'dzin rgyal khams pa rang nas byas 'dug pa bzhin/ da dung mi ngan re zung gi gzhung gi khral zhing la gnod pa byas tshul zer yang shu r+ghaṃ dpon po kha cig gi brgyud pa rdzogs pa'i sa zhing khyed rang rnams nas gzhung la dbu skor gyi spug zog byas pa/ gnyer pa rab nas de blang nas rnam dkar dge rgyun la sbyar 'dug pa/ lar phyogs der che phra med nas gzhung la dbu bskor gyi sbug zog gang thub byed kyi yod 'dug kyang / gnyer pa rab kyi gzhung la snyan 'bul med pa'i sbug zog byas skad mi 'dug lar gzhung sa mchog gi mnga' 'og tu rig 'dzin rgyal khams pa la sa khul yod med gang zer yang / de ka gcig bu las gzhan gzhung sa 'phang med dang / them rkang du ma la longs spyod pa ni kho pa la ye mi 'dug na/ de la khyed nyang kha ba rnams mig de tsam tsha rin mi chog pa 'dra/ them rkang gcig dang bzhi zur gyi sa dad pa can gyi nan 'bul bla ma'i 796

gsung ma cag nas blang / gzhung sa mchog nas kyang 'jags su bcug pa de rtsa ba byas/ gzhan mang zhig rgyal khams pa kho rang gi lag 'don gyis kyang brgyan nas mchod yon gyi zhabs brtan bstan 'gro'i bde thabs rnam dkar dge rgyun tshogs bsags pa'i le'u bgyis pa la zer zer gleng gleng mang po 'di nag phyogs lha 'dre rnams kyi lhong yin 'gro/ gzhan sa khul chung ngu 'di la gleng rgyu mang po de 'dra yong rgyu yin tshe/ gzhung gi sa nas them rkang bcu phrag mang po dang 'bru khal stong phrag mang po yog zas yog chur spyod pa po rnams la brtser bsun med pa chu tshod gcig gi yun yang ga la yong / rig 'dzin rgyal khams pa sngar nyang kha phyogs su lo shas las smon gyi 'khod pa de/ khyed nag phyogs kyi lha 'dre rnams gu dogs pa bden ste/ da ni kho yang phyogs der ring sdod bzhed med 'dug pas yid dga' bar 'tshal/ de yang sa bon nyung ngu zhig byas na spug zhus su dogs mang po zhig byas na gyong zer du 'gro kyi 'dug kyang nyang kha rnams kyi spug zhus zer na/ da 'di rnams sbug zhus yin min legs par ma nos la sbug zhus med pa rnams yid sbrungs shig lar tshegs chung 'di rigs dpon po la snyan 'bul snga phyi kun tu zhu rin mi chog bzhin zhu bar 'dzang ba'i rang bzhin gyi cher zhu kyi med 'dug kyang / sgrub sde de lo re tshugs na yang gong gsal ltar/ rdor sems yang snying dang badz+ra gu ru sogs rnam dkar dge sgrub de 'phel rgyu yin 'dug gshis/ de la dmigs nas sgrub sde dang 'dzengs gnyer gyi blo 'dod ltar snyan 'bul zur tsam pa ste/ de yang rnam dkar dge rgyun rig 'dzin rgyal khams pa rang gi skabs ltar ma chad pa rdzong dpon gzhis sdod kun gyi dpang po thub pa'i mthun grub byung na sa gzhis phra mo de yis bdag po sus byas kyang khyad mi 'dug mod/ 'on kyang bstan 'gro spyi'i bde thabs rten 'brel khyad phran bu yod pa yin 'dug gshis/ rig 'dzin rgyal khams pa kho rang der ma sleb bar 'jags su bcug pa yin pas dge las de la nyer 'tshe med pa zhig skya ser tshang ma'i blor nges dgos/ de ltar yi ge mthong bzhin sgrub sde dang mthun rkyen gzhis chung la ral gcod che na bsgrub 'os 'di gzhung gi bstan rim yin 'dug gshis/rgyal khrims kyi chad pa drag pos gzir bar ma zad/ las rgyu 'bras bden cing chos skyong dam can dregs pa can yod tshe bka' yi chad pa drag po yang yong bar nges de don ci nas kyang kun gyi spang blang 'dzol med yod pa bgyis/ zhes chos 'khor dpal gyi lha sa nas chu bya zla tshes bzang po la bris shu r+ghaṃ/gong zhabs su chu sprel lo la/ lhar bcas 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig mtshungs pa mi mnga' ba 'dren pa yongs kyi spyi phud rgyal ba mchog gi gser gyi 'khor lo rnam par bkra ba'i zhabs kyi nye bar bsnyen pa'i chu skyes dbang po'i ge sar ngogs su dngas ba chen pos zhu gsol/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi ye shes ro mnyam pa thugs rje'i gong bu gcig tu 'dus pa'i rang gzugs thub bstan snyigs lnga bdo ba'i 'gro ba rnams kyi 797

dpal dang / skyabs dang mgon dang dpung gnyen dam par ngo mtshar rdo rje'i sku brnyan gdul bya'i zhing sar smon lam gyis 'dus byas pa gang mi 'jig pa seng ge'i khri la 'tsho gzhes brtan par bzhugs pa ni bstan 'gro spyi dang bye brag yongs su bka' drin do zlas dben pa nyid du gyur/ 'dir gnas bya bral phran bur gyur pa yang / lus sems 'dus byas kyi rang 'tshang ma bstan tsam khyo re ba'i ngang ches dmu rgod pa'i 'gro ba'i dbus su rnam g.yeng khur gyi dub kyang lhag bsam gyi mkhar ba dang chos nyid kyi ngal stegs la brten de ji bder gnas pa'i khul du mchis la/ ljongs 'di'i sems can spyi mthun las kyi byed pas ci ltar 'gyur ma nges kyang / spyi dang bye brag gi bde thabs la dmigs dkon mchog la gsol ba btab cing rang gi thabs 'khos la dpag pa'i bsam sbyor lhod med du mchis na'ang / da lam 'di phyogs gnas tshul zhu 'os kha shas blos chod dka' bas sngon 'phros su bka' shag tu phul ltar dang / da ni 'grig zlum yong min ci ltar yang / ring min ci myur du thag chod dam snyam pa dang / la dwags/ mul lbe/ bhal ti nang tshags kyi 'grigs zlum byung na smos med dang / de ltar ma byung tshe re zhig bzang dus tsam mam stod hor sogs mtha' dmag rngam chen gyi sna 'dren mi byed pa'i mtha' 'dom tsam bgyis na byed yong ngam re zhing / de yang ci ltar legs bka' yis 'khor los phral du khyab pa zhig ci nas kyang mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen/ zhes dkyus ring thugs rje'i spyan ras g.yo bar byed pa'i rten lha gos rnam par dkar bas bcibs te zla tshes bzang po la 'phul ba'i zhu yig sarba maṅga lo/ zhabs pad mchog tu zhu chung / hor zla dgu pa/ bcu gnyis pa/ dang po rnams su lha 'dre'i 'tshub gi 'dzer ltas phran bu shar bas de sel gyi rim gro yang bka' yi 'khor los khyab pa gsol ba 'debs pa ste/ bdag lta bu'i byis pa'i 'khrul shes kyi ji bzhin rngo thog pa ga la 'gyur yang / snying nas dung dang ku mud lta bu'i lhag bsam gyi gsol bar chos dbyings tshom 'khrung med pa cis kyang mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen sarba maṅga lam̐/rgyal ba mchog gi 'phrin las kyi byed po gangs can bde ba'i rtsa lag kha lo pa chen po rnams kyi mdun sar zhu ba/ sngon nas legs smon dge tshogs mang po 'dus byas pa yi rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs rje'i rang gzugs lhar bcas 'gro ba'i mgon po mchog gi 'phrin las kyi rtsib stong mngon par 'phags pa'i yu ba nas bzung ste/ dge ba'i byed las phyogs brgyar g.yas su 'khyir ba'i byed po mtho ris kyi dpal bzang po la spyod bzhin gdan 'jags te bzhugs pa bka' drin che la/ 'dir gnas bya bral gyi nar spyod pa phra mo las phra mor gyur pa'ang 'byung 'dus kyi 'tsho ba sngar mu bzhin khyo re ba'i ngang rtsod ldan snyigs lnga bdo ba'i mthar thug dmu rgod kyi kha lo spyod par dka' ba/ ma he sgo nga shugs 'chang rgod sogs mi bsrub sems nas mang pos 'tshog pa'i dbus su rnam par brtson pa bzhin ji ltar bgyis 798

kyang bag mi phebs shing / gang ltar bgyis kyang kha lo mi 'chun pas thun khongs rer yang ngal dub kyi khur brgya phrag du ma spung par byed na/ zhag zla du ma'i khongs su ni de bas kyang smos ci 'tshal te/ de lta'i ngang tshul du ma'i bsir bus yid kyi rdzing bu rnam par g.yo bar byed kyang zab mo don gyi gdeng kar brten rang gi rang la dbugs dbyung ngang du mchis/ ched du gsol 'os/ 'di phyogs rgyal po khu dbon gyi legs bzlum skor snga song zhu yig tu gnas tshul phran bu gsol ltar/ mul lbe rgyal po khar sin sgar thog tu nged la bsu mi'i gdong du rgyal po rang yang 'khor ba yid dbyung ba'i lha chos mdzad 'dod yin tshul byung yang tshig de gtang snyoms su byas nas lab ching sgrig par waṃ ler phral yong dgos tshul nan bskyed pho nya brdzang bar phral du yong rgyu'i yi ge rim can du byung yang / rgyal po phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyi skor la byed bde'i khyad/ yang skyar gyis lan du mar bang mi brdzang ste yong dgos tshul smras yang sang yong gnang yong gi zla ba du ma 'gor gshis/ la dwags rgan gtso hrag bsdus drug cu skor mi rta kun tshegs ches la dwags rgyal sras dang rgyal po phun rnam sku mched legs spel 'bad pas sgrub zin par byas shing / mul lbe rgyal po 'gyang ches 'di lo bal yul bgrod pa bshol yang / rgya gar gyi gnas chen kha shas su tshogs gtor smon lam bzang po'i khyad du 'jug nas de ring bzang dus dang / de nas tshur 'khor mtshams khu dbon legs spel stabs bde zhig yong bar 'char bzhin de rtsis byas kyang mul lbe nas shad rtsol gyi pho nya brdzang nas phyogs 'gro ma byas gong du mjal chog pa cis kyang gal che tshul kho pa rang yang smin drug zla tshes 20la ci nas kyang 'byor rgyu yin zhes yig ngag 'byor bas la dgas rgyal blon la khu dbon rang tshan pa ris rtsod med blon bu gnyis la bab 'brel gyi sa ri sprad cing phan tshun zhe 'khon med par legs spel dgos tshul ngag bkod byas bzhin phyogs mthun nyan rtsis byas song bas gra ngo kha shas mul lbe rgyal po'i phebs bsur gtang zhing / de rtsis la rgyal po'i thugs rlung khams kyi nem nur ches pas rim 'gyang gi mthar mgo zla tshes 7la mul lbe nas lam zhugs gnang zhing lam bar du yang phyir ldog mdzad rtsis lan kha yar bcas thog mar dpon g.yog stong phrag nye ba dang / mthar rags rtsis kyi bzhi brgya skor bcas la dwags shel du 'byor nas rgyal sras dang rgyal po phun rnam sku mched yang legs spel skabs su mi che la/ rgyal sras chos par sdod pa las la dwags rgyal srid la the regs bya mi 'os shing /rgyal po phun rnam zol 'jog dang / rgyal mo bla ma'i ngor da lam srog skyon mi byed la rang gnas su ldog pa dang / la dwags blon po'i khyod nas nyes can kha shas la rtsad gcod byas te la dgas kyi rgyal srid tshang ma khong rang nas byed rgyu ste/ de lta yong na dang / mi byed na phyir ldog yin tshul gyi 'phros sngar nas byung yang 'phyar yin nam snyam la/ da cha yang tig gi mdo 'gag tu sgril bas de tshe lab chings ches dka' 799

ba'i gnas dang / yang rnam grangs gcig ni rgyal sras dang rgyal mos bla mar rtsi med kyi khong lam bar du rkun bsad gtang yong bas yong mi nus tshul yang nas yang du smreng zhing sngar mul lbe rang du bzhugs skabs yang dogs zon mtshungs pa med pas dmag mi hrag bsdus rtag tu 'khor bzhin mi ser la yang brdab sig che skad dang / des na da lam phebs lam du smos ci 'tshal ste/ gang ltar mtshan thog thag rnal ye nas med par zhabs phyi yang bco lnga skor re mos kyi mal rtsed nam langs bar 'khyol bar mdzad nas/ nam langs na mnal mdzad pa sogs rnam rtog rgod pas thugs bsun ni shin tu che ba yod 'dug na/ tshul des shel du da cha zla ba phyed gnyis tsam song zhing phyogs der rtswa shing sogs sgo du ma nas sun brtser shin tu che bas la dwags stod kyi sku ngo mi ser tshang mas nad mi theg tshul bcas/ rgyal po phral du phyir ldog bya dgos tshul zer yang thabs kyi blo khrid gang mkhas dang / mul lbe rgyal po yang sngar thugs smyo yod pa 'phar ba yin nam snyam nas rang 'khos la dpag pa'i skyes dang 'jam brid gtam bcas kyi 'dir khug thub na yul chags mi ma yin nag phyogs skyon gyi blo bslad pa yin tshe ngos 'phrad byin brlabs 'dra byas na las kyi rgyu ba tshab chen gyi ma bdas phyin cung zad phan du re bas snga phyir bang mi du ma du ma'i bar du brdzangs shing / de yang yul bye brag keg chag mtha' dmag gi kha rlang rgya 'dre 'gong po'i 'tshub lhong lta bus gang du yang brling chags kyi skye bo dkon pa'i rgyu dang / mul lbe rgyal po rang gzhi nas thugs rtog lhag par za ba yin 'dug pas gzhung sa nas kyang kho sar mgo bskor lta bu'i zhig yin nam snyam pa'i/ sgar dpon ru thog sogs la yang dogs pa che ba byed kyi yod 'dug gshis/ de sel bar re nas kho pa'i bang mi gnyis zla 12tshes 17la 'byor ba'i gdong du la dgas pa'i bka' blon drag gras tshangs ma dang / sgar gyi ngo tshab bcas nas rgyal po la kha bslus ngan bshom gtan nas med tshul gyi bro tshig bcas 'phral brdzang byas kyang / da lta'i bar sngar mi lus bskyed pa zhig ma byung zhing / da cha yar ma byon pa sngar mur shel du yun ring na 'thab 'khrug gi rgyur dog blo khol yang che bzhin pa'i ngang du gnas la/ de yang gangs can mgon po mchog gi thugs rje'i skyabs 'jug dang / dbyings sa mchog nas kyang bstan rim la 'bad pa'i byin brlab kyi phyir bsring ba zhig yong ba gzhir bcas bzhin phyogs 'dir 'khrug zing gi rgyu brlab chen zhig byed dam snyam pa 'dug la/ phran rang ni mdo khams sbas (thul lung skyog zhig tu skyes/ rgyal khams su chos phyir 'grim pa'i bya bral phra mo zhig rgya gar kha che'i yul mtshams kyi rgyal po 'khrug pa'i dbus su dka' tshegs sbyangs spyod chen pos sgo gsum ngal ba brgya phrag lhu ru blang dgos 'di sngon las myang 'os zhig las gzhan du ma gyur zhing / de yang bde skyid 'byung ba bla ma dkon mchog thugs rje dang / sdug bsngal mi bde ba tshab che kun rang gi sngon las su yin pa yin bzhin shes 800

par zad la lhag tu da lam bgyid dgos 'di ni rgyal ba mchog gi bka' 'dun na 'don chen po rnams brgyud de yang gangs can bde ba'i brtsas su phebs pa yin na zhum pa med pa'i sems kyi spa lo bskyed 'os nyid dang / yang dag pa'i don du ni kun rdzob kyi bden pa rnam rtog gi ri mo de don dam gyi bden pa chos nyid gnyug ma'i dbyings su pha rgod bla ma'i drin gyis la bzla ba las 'os gzhan ma mchis pas skabs skabs su phaṭa re rgyab kyin gnas/ 'on kyang kun rdzob rten 'brel gyi bden pa 'di yang gtso che ba zhig snang bas rang 'khos la dpag pa'i thabs mkhas kyi 'jug pa ci nus bgyid kyi yod kyang / gtso bor de nas rgyal ba mchog la thugs dam skyabs 'jug gi zhabs bskul sogs cis nas kyang brtse ba'i do ra nas mi bor ba mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen/ spyir gnas tshul zhib mo 'bul dgos nges las nam dus grang stabs rta shad dka' tshegs su 'gro dogs cing lhag tu kha sing mgo zla ba'i tshes 10la thon pa'i rta shad kyi bka' lan phebs bstun gnas tshul zhib mo 'bul rtsis yin yang / da cha phyogs 'di'i bya ba chegs che blos ma chod nas 'di bzhin 'phral 'bul la bka' lung gi 'khor lo bzang pos 'phral du khyab pa yang ci nas kyang mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen zhes mkhyen spyan pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar g.yo bar byed pa'i rten lha gos rnam par dkar bas bcib ste zla tshes bzang po la waṃ le bde chen rnam rgyal nas phul ba'i li khi rta/sarba maṅga lo/gong zhabs rin po cher chu bya zla tshes la mar yul stod waṃ le nas phul ba/ lha bcas 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs gnas lag na pad+mo ngur smrig gar gyi rol pa gang gi bkra shis rtsib stong gi 'khor los yongs su brgyan pa'i zhabs mthil gyi nye bar bsnyen pa'i rnyog med chu skyes rnam par bkra ba'i ngogs su/ dngas bas zhu gsol/ bri gang las 'das gdod ma'i ye shes sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo rtag bde gtsang dag chos kyi sku yi rang bzhin kun rdzob glo bur dri ma'i cha yongs su spangs te dam pa sku gnyis kyi spyi dpal chen por bgrang yas bskal pa'i sngon nas brnyes bzhin gdul byar thugs rje'i spyan ras kyi rjes su chags pas de srid du smon lam gyi dbang gi sprul pa'i rnam par bkod pa 'byams klas pa las da lta snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i mthar thug 'dzam bu gling gi yul ljongs kun duḥkha gsum gyi yongs su mnar ba sel ba'i phyir dang bye brag gangs ri'i khrod kyi skye rgu rnams kyi skyabs dang mgon dang gling dang dpung gnyen dam pa rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs 'dzin pa'i mnga' bdag ngur smrig gsum gyi rgyal mtshan mdzes par 'dzin pa'i ded dpon ma 'dris par 'gro ba yongs kyi mdza' bshes mgon po nyi ma'i gnyen gyi rtsa lag dam par skur snang ba gangs can bod yul gyi dbus 'gyur 'chang nges par don gyi gru 'dzin chen por 'jig med seng ge'i khri la 'tsho zhing gzhes te bzhugs pa ni bka' drin gyi zho sha bla na ma mchis pas 801

khyab/ 'dir gnas phyogs med kun tu rgyu ba rig pa 'dzin par sgro btags pa dzo ki rgyal khams pa yang chu sbur lta bu'i 'dus phung 'dus byas kyi rang 'tshangs sngon du ma gyur tsam nas snyigs dus dmu rgod kyi 'gro ba dus kyi bdo bas lhag par nyen pa'i khur du mas du ma brtsegs pas dub cing ngal bar gyur kyang dam pa mchog gi bka' lung u dum wa ra'i 'phreng ba thod du bcings nas lhag bsam ma zhum pa'i mkhar ba brtan po bzung zhing / gzhan phan rnam dpyod kyi goms stabs ma 'chug tsam du dpal mgon dam pa rnams kyi thugs rje la brten nas gnas/ 'di phyogs gnas tshul cung zad rim brgyud snga ma'i khongs su phul ltar la 'di lo bstan rim dang lhag tu rgyal ba mchog gi skyabs 'jug thugs rje chen po'i rol pa la brten kha che hor sog gi tshong pa gnyug mar rgyu ba yang phon che ba ma byung zhing / kha che nas na bab kyi la dwags la zhib gcod phon cher yongs 'dod kyi yi ge phyi nang gnyis kyi phyi ma mul lbe rgyal po'i lag tu zin pa'i 'phros snga sor snyan dbang du dngas ltar dang / yi ge nang ma kha che'i tshong lam mul lbe gcer sun byed par brten mul lbe rgyal po rtsa 'joms byed rgyu'i skor yi ge snga ma dang lhan du yod pa lam bsdem gyi 'gor 'gying gi hor zla dang por la dgas rgyal po la 'byor song ba sogs sgo du ma nas dpung dngos mi yong na yang rjes mthun pa zhig yong ba'i sta gon zhugs pa yin 'dug kyang 'dir legs spel ba 'byor gshis la dgas nas nged la sne len ma byas pa dang khu dbon legs bzlum grub tshul yi ge song bas kyang cung zad bsring zhing lhag tu sa than gyi dpung gi yul kha shas mang po blang ba dang / glo bur gyi 'thab 'khrug gi kasmi ra rang du yang mi bde ba'i rnam pas kha che'i sgyu 'phrul che ba rang bzhin gyi 'gag pa sogs 'di lo legs lam du che bar gyur zhing / mul lbe rgyal po yang gzhi nas thugs rtog hrag shing lhag tu yul phyogs mi nges pa 'byung ba'i mtshon gzhi'i snga sor nas gsol ltar mi ma yin nag phyogs lha 'dres legs spel bzang bskum la 'khu zhing 'tshub lhong gi rnam pa che ba yang nas yang du thun mong dang thun mong ma yin par ston zhing mul rgyal shel du zla ba gnyis sdod ring zhabs rim shes ldan gzur gnas kyi snyan 'bul la lhag par khro zhing 'tshig pa dang nyin mtshan 'khor mar dogs pas go mtshon dgra chas zon cha dang mi 'brel ba sogs keg chags 'tshub lhong gi rnam 'gyur mang tsam ston pa la der dmigs kyi rim gro dkon mchog la gsol 'debs mi ma yin dkar po phyogs la 'phrin bcol/ nag po'i phyogs la glud gtor gnad la phab pa sogs rten 'brel thabs 'khos bgyis shing / gtso bor rgyal ba mchog gi thugs rje'i skyabs 'jug la brten mul lbe g.yog rigs lnga brgya skor shel nas phyir log dang / dpon g.yog brgya lnga bcu skor hor zla 1tshes 20la waṃ ler son zhing / 'dir ma sleb pa'i nyin lam tsam gyi sa nas lam na bar 'gor gzhi byas pa la yid gnong dang bag khum gyi skyi zings byed pa 802

dang / shel du sdod ring gi phar gsung 'phros dang tshur zhus pa rnams phal cher yid la mi dran pa sogs byad gdon gyi bslad pa las cung zad grol ba'i dbu tshugs shing / 'dir 'byon nas zhag shas 'phrad rtsis ma byas kyang ngo chen sbran cing tsab tsab po mang du mdzad par tshes 22la 'phrad par byas/ de nas gnyid sad pa ltar rim lhings kyi gtan 'ching yong ba zhig dgos tshul gsol 'debs nan che yang /phan tshun go med spyi brtol che bas yid lhag par du bsun pa yis/ re zhig bzang mtshams las bgyid rgyu min tshul nan gyi lab par de ltar bzang mtshams bgyis na mul lbe rgyal po nas nyung tha lo bcu gnyis dgos tshul dang / la dwags rgyal pos lo bzhi las mi byed tshul byung yang / re zhig bcu gnyis kyi bar du bgyid rgyu'i rtsis su byas khu dbon bar mkhon 'jug gi rgyu rkyen rnams phan tshun zhib nyan bgyis te 'degs 'bab bgyid 'os gzur gnas kyi 'phros gtang ba sngar gyi ltar go med spyi brtol bskyed ma song zhing / 'phral zor yang khyad bzang mtshams su brdzus mthar thug chod yig tu gtan 'ching nyid du bya rgyu'i rtsis su lags shing / da lta khu dbon gyi sa ris skor sogs thag song chod kyi mjal 'dzom legs spel ji bzhin grub la/ blon bu dag la dwags su sdod nas sa ris 'os mtshams yong rgyur dan song yang kho rang der sdod 'dod med par mul lbe sdod dgos zhus par de la cung zad ma dan pa byed 'dug kyang khu dbon bar gyi legs spel grub phyin rgyal blon bar legs bzlum yong ba gzhir bcas kyi bde ba'i dbang du byas pa da lam gnas tshul snga thabs dang / gang ltar chod yig sogs legs spel gzhug tshag grub bstun rim brgyud gnas tshul zhib mo 'bul rtsis lags pa yang chos dbyings zab mo'i do rar 'jug cing / dus rnams kun tu thugs brtse ba chen po'i spyan ras kyi lhod pa med pa'i skyabs 'jug gi gur khang du 'jug pa ci nas kyang mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen zhes dang mchog tu gsol ba 'debs pa gangs can bstan 'gro yongs kyi phan bde'i rtsa lag dam par zhabs pad bskal pa'i bskal pa las lhag par 'tsho gzhes brtan par rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa la mnga' brnyes pas de ltar byin gyis brlabs par snying nas gsol ba 'debs pa de kho na bzhin re 'bras don ldan du mdzad du gsol/ zhes tshad med thugs rje'i spyan ras g.yo bar byed pa'i rten lha yi gos 'chi med shing gi pad+mo'i kha dog gi yun zlar byas pas yongs su bcibs te dpal gdong chu bya zla tshes bzang po la rgyal khams pa bho ṭa dzo kis phul ba'i zhu yig sarba gaṅga lo/zhabs pad mchog tu zhu chung / 'di ka'i legs spel zhib mo grub bstun la dgas dang mul lbe yis blon gtso drag pa re/ rgyal ba mchog gi bka' drin chen pos khyab pa legs 'bul rnam par rdzang na snyams shing / 'on kyang phyogs 'dir yo byad spyir bkren zhing mig phra ba bcas dngos po'i skyes ni cher 803

yong rig mi 'dug kyang la dgas rgyal po nang bzlum gyi kha che'i dpung brdol ba'i gzhi yang phyir bcil ba rgyal ba mchog gi 'phrin las kyi snyan pa shar phyogs tsi na yi 'gro ba rnams kyi ngor yang mdzes sam snyam pas de yang ci ltar skabs su bab bka' phebs chu tshod steng nas phral gnang bka' drin che ba zhu rgyu de/nged kyang 'di nas gzhug tshag chod yig sogs grub phral skar rtsis mkhan rnams kyi la la na dang rā sa na yi rgyu ba dhu tir dag pa'i rang gzugs phyed nyen yod zhes gleng bar thos pas de grol bar du dge sbyor gyi khyad phyogs 'dir sdod pa'i rtsis su lags pas des na gong don bka'i 'khor los phral du khyab pa yang mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen ka 'dra yan+tu/bka' blon lhan rgyas la mar yul stod waṃ le nas/ gangs can 'gro ba'i mgon po rgyal ba mchog gi 'phrin las kyi kha lo pa 'dzin ma'i mdzes rgyan mnga' bdag chen po rnams kyi mdun sar zhu ba 'dzam gling chu bzhi'i mgo bo lha las bab pa'i rdul gyi nyer spras tshad sel bsil ldan gtsang ma'i ljongs bod yul zhes snyan par grags pa'i 'dzin ma'i khyon lhar bcas skye rgu kun gyi spyi bor tshad skyobs dbang po'i tog bzhin 'jig rten dbang phyug ngur smrig gar gyi rol pa yis 'phrin las kyi zhabs 'degs rtsib stong rnam par bkra ba'i rgyud bzhin skye rgu'i gdung sel 'phrin las kyi kha lo g.yas su 'khyil ba snyan pa'i phur ma lhab lhub g.yo bzhin par bzhugs pa bka' drin gyi zho shas khyab cing 'dir gnas rig pa 'dzin par sgro btags pa rnal 'byor rgyal khams phyogs med dā ri 'dra pa yang 'dus phung ma zhig tsam du gangs can bde ba'i bcas mgon po mchog gi 'phrin las kyi ched du sgo gsum ngal ba brgya phrag lhu ru blangs nas mi bsrun dregs pa'i blo can dus ngan ngang tshul 'dren pa'i shugs 'chang rnams rang sgo'i spyi brtol bskyed pa du mas sun yang gangs can mgon po'i bka' lung lha yi me tog lta bu dpral ba'i brgyan du spud cing mdun na 'don blo ldan rnams kyi snyan pa'i bskul tshig rna ba'i rgyan du bzung nas bzod pa'i snying khams lhag bsam mkhar bar 'khras bzhin 'bad pa du mas mar yul bdag po bstod smad legs spel legs par grub nye'i skabs su lags shing / de yang spyir snyigs dus kyi ngang tshul du kha tū pa ka g.yo gyur snga ltas kyi phyogs 'dir mi ma yin dregs gyur mang po lhag par 'khrug pas mi rnams kun kyang rang dbang med par sems rgyud 'khrugs te gcig gis gcig la gdeng khel med pa'i ngang tshul ches cher ston yang gzhung sa mchog nas bstan rim la 'bad pa dang / lhag tu gangs can mgon po thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po yi thugs dam skyabs 'jug bzang pos khyab pa'i mthu la brten phral tshegs che byung yang mthar hor zla dang po'i tshes la mul lbe rgyal po'ang 'dir son zhing / 'di dang khad nyer bar zhag gcig gi gong tsam nas sngar nag phyogs gdon gyis bslad pa las cung zad grol bas 804

yid skyi zing byed cing dad pa'i shugs kyang 'phel ba skad du grags la/ shel du bzhugs ring kyi blo ldan gzur gnas kyi zhus pa'i tshig dang kho rang nas gsung ba rnams kyang phal mo che mi dran pa lta bu byung snang zhing 'dir sleb nas kyang nged dang 'phrad pa'i thog mar lus g.yo 'dar dang bcas pa rgyal thabs su gyur pa sogs gdon las cung zad grol te sngar gshis las ches ldog pa dang / 'on kyang phyogs 'di'i mtha' dmag gi kha rlangs lta bu'i mi ma yin rnams kyi cho 'phrul dang 'tshub lhongs thun mong du rtogs pa dang / lkog gyur gyi gnas su grub pa yang bzod dka' bas legs bzlum la shin tu mtho mtshams par gyur kyang rim gnyis lam khyer gyis dbyings su cung zad bcil ba'i khul bgyis shing / phan tshun dge sdig blang dor gyi khe bshad nyan dkrol yang yang byas par brten khu dbon phan tshun sa ris lha phyag sogs bzang po'i srol rgyun bzhin legs spel rags pa nag zla'i dkar tshes bzang por grub cing gzhug tshag skyong 'os phran bu dang / blon po rnams la dwags su sdod nas sa ris 'os mtshams sprod par dan song yang / no no nas sdod gnas mul lber dgos tshul gyi zhu ba nan che byed 'dug pa des cung zad bshad dka' snang yang don du ni 'grig bzlum gyi gzhi grub par gyur song ba snga 'phros kyi gnas tshul lags shing / snga sor mul lbe rgyal po shel du sdod pa de skabs kyi gnas tshul zhig yang phul yod pa sku zhabs su 'byor pa gzhir bcas shing / de'i bka' len sngar gnang ma tshar tshe mul lbe rgyal po 'dir 'byor gshis gnas tshul de 'gyur ba'i rang bzhin/ gong gsal ltar phyi ma dgos par snang la/ 'on kyang rang gi sgo gsum gyi ngal ba du ma lhur blang bgyis pa nyid bstan 'gro dge ba'i btsas rgyal ba dgyes pa'i mchod sprin bzang por dmigs pa chud mi za ba thugs rje brtse ba'i do rar 'jug pa ci nas mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen/ la dwags rgyal po sku mched kyi legs spel chod yig mgo mchan zhu rgyu'i skor lan stsal cho 'phrul zla bar yid kyi rgud pa sel ba'i bdud rtsi thob cing / snga phyir gnang skyes phon che yang yang stsal ba 'byor/ 'dir gtong 'os phal mo che grub zin gshis zhu bar 'dzangs shing / gang ltar bka' glegs de'i lan zhu zhib mo yang 'di'i legs spel grub pa'i gnas tshul rim brgyud phul skabs 'bul rgyu chos dbyings rnyog pa med pa'i klong du 'jug pa zhu zhu zhu/ zhes byams pas yongs su 'khyud pa'i spyan ras g.yo bar byed rten lha gos rnam par dkar bas bcib ste dpal gdong chu bya zla 2tshes 19bzang por phul ba'i li khi haṃ sarba maṅga lo/shing phag ki ṭo nas 'ba' ra bla ma/ nges don bstan pa'i srog shing skyes mchog 'ba' ra ba'i seng ge'i khri srung bar byed pa po 'jam gling chos rje rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog gang gi sku'i ga la bar/ nang lugs stabs bder 'bul ba/ sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i mnga' bdag chen po dpal ldan stod 'brug gi 805

sdong po dpa' bo thugs kyi rdo rje'i rnam 'phrul skyes mchog rgyal mtshan bzang po'i ring lugs pad+ma'i rnal ma ltar phra mor gnas par gyur pa la dam pa khyed kyi thugs bskyed rmad du byung zhing smon lam bzang po'i bskrun pa yi dben gnas gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa'i nyams gso phul byung grub pa dang chos 'chad spel gyi rgyun mi 'dzad pa brgyan gyi 'khor lo'i rgyu tshogs spel ba dang / 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi'i gdul bya'i gyur pa kun tu bzang po'i lam la zhugs pa sogs skyes mchog chen po 'ba' ra ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu gdan sa der chos 'chad spel sgrub tshugs nyams len can nam mkha'i skar tshogs lta bur gyur yang mdzad pa phyag rjes kyi sgo nas nyid dang mtshungs pa tsam ma byung na lhag pa ni smos ci 'tshal/ de bas na skyes mchog chen po'i 'phrin las kyi rgyun 'dren pa'i shing rta rmad du byung bar mthong bzhin khyed kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba rjes su yi rang ba'i lan brgyar bsngags/ nged ni 'tsho ba sngar mu ltar la snying nas dam pa'i chos bsgrub pa la bdud kyi mthus rnam par g.yeng ba gong 'phel gyi chos brgyad rba rlabs drag tu g.yo bas yid bsun zhing btser bzhin pa'i ngang du gnas/ 'on kyang ltar snang du rgyal po chen po rnams kyi mchod cing / mi ma yin mthu ldan rnams kyi byams pa byed pa dang / dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams 'du zhing dam pa chos kyi bgyi ba yang ci nus 'bad de mchis/ nyid nas sngar yan lag dang nying lag la skyon med pa'i rta mchog gser dngul gyi skyes/ da lam yang gser dngul gyi skyes phon che bcas bstab pa ni rdo rje slob dpon mchod pa'i bya ba rgyud nas bshad bzhin par rjes su yi rang zhing / phon che de ltar blang bar 'dzang yang 'dir 'byor zin phyir bzlog byas na dgongs pa ma dgyes dogs bdag gir byas nas de kun rnam par dkar ba dge ba'i las 'ba' zhig par dag par byas pa yang zab klong du bsti ba dang / gang cir 'phral du 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid du ma gyur tshe 'os pa'i gnas zhig tu lan gcig nges par mjal bar smon la/ rnam kun dge ba'i smon lam bzang po'i bcing ba yang dgongs par gcags pa zhu zhes gzigs rten sngags mdud lha gos rnam dkar srid du ring ba dang de kar skyes mchog chen po'i gdan sar rten gzheng sogs mdzad pa rgya cher gnang ba'i legs 'bul du zab chen rdo rje'i gseng lam yug bcas zla tshes dge ba la bal yul tī ḍo'i gtsug lag khang chen po nas dpal rig pa 'dzin pas spel ba'i pa tram̐ sarba maṅga lo/lags/ skyes mchog chen po'i skabs dang mthun pa'i tshogs khang bsgros gtsang zhig zhig gso thub na shin tu legs/ skyes mchog chen po sku bltam pa'i gnas su mchod rten zhig bsgrub na legs par khum/ lags/ rtsa bsgrub ni bdag mdun dbyer med du bstan/ nang bsgrub la man ngag yang gces kyi sngags 'khor sbyor shin tu rung / lus dkyil 'di gong 'og bsgyur dgos cung zad 'dug pa rdor gling / 806

kun skyong / rgod ldem/ nyang dang chos dbang / pad+ma las 'bral rtsal/ mchog ldan rdo rje rnams kyi gter 'byon mkha' 'gro'i las byang zhu dag 'pher rung phyogs mthun byung ba rnams sgo bstun te khrig chags zhig byed thub na snyam pa sngar nas byung yang / le lo'i dbang du gyur mod slad mar de rigs bsgrub thub pa'i smon 'dun zhu sarba maṅga lo/mar yul bdag po/ mar yul bdag pos yab yum lhan rgyas mchog gi sku zhabs su/ nang lugs stabs bder phul ba/ de kar da lta sku'i 'tsho gzhes ma rnyog pa nas gsung bris ma yig dang bu yig len tshan gsum gsham ma'i zhu tshig gnyis dang / skyabs rje 'brug par 'bul rgyu'i zhu yig bcas hor zla'i tshes la mar yul byams sprin du son zhing / yi ge rjes ma ring drag che nges byas pa de yang chu tshod 'gyang med du de las sngon tsam du 'byor byung / 'dir nged kyang rgyal khag mang po'i mi sna 'dzom nas da lta bral g.yeng shin tu che ba'i skabs su gyur mod 'on kyang yi ge sleb 'phral skyabs yul re gnas bcas pa'i slob ma dang sbyin bdag yin gshis snying thag pa nas dkon mchog la gsol ba gdab cing / chos skyong bsrung ma la 'phrin las bcol nas de ka rten zhal la phan pa'i smon lam nan drag por btab yod/lar ni tshes 12skor nas za zi'i ltas dang / tshes nas gnam stong bar du lhag par che ba byung de nas chung ngu song lar de phyogs kyi lha 'dre mtha' 'dre gsar sleb rnams 'khrug pa bcas mtha' dmag gi kha rlang yin 'dug pa lo shas kyi ring zab dgos tshul sku rim gyi khyad 'dra yong snyams sngar rgyal blon tshang ma snyan bsun bsun du gsol ba'ang / da lta thugs la gnas pa gzhir bcas/ thugs sras kyi ya do 'gangs pa bkra shis kyi bya ba 'os min bgyis par gshams ma'i blo la phog ste de la bshad sbyangs dgos tshul gshams mas zhus yod 'dug kyang zhu brda' ma 'phrod pa'i bar mtshams su zom lus kyi mthar gshams ma khros tshul zhig thos/ des na mnga' 'og la khrims snyoms shing mi ngan re yi zhus dbang du mi gtang la/ zhabs tham sger bzung mang po dgyes tshul sngar nas zhus zhus ltar ste/ da dung yang de don dgongs 'jug dang / phyogs 'dir phebs pa ni re zhig gzhan ngor mi mdzes pas 'then pa nyid legs/a khu rgyal pos ni nges kyi 'ching bzlum gtan tshigs bgyis nas da bar de la kha phyir 'chus ma mdzad nges can yin 'dug cing / da dung yang mi byed nges pas/ des na thugs rtog gi rigs gnang ma dgos la/ 'on kyang yi ge yang yang nang gshim mdzad pa yang gal che/ don tshan kha shas la zur du mchan 'debs byas nas phul yod/ lhag tu rgyal blon dmangs bcas thun mong la 'jam yig skyabs rje 'brug pa la yang zhabs bskul zhus nas do gal gang che de ka yab yum sras bcas la snying nas brtse sems kyi 'phral du bskur yod pa kun la dril bsgrags kyi 'jam chags 'tshal/ snying thag pa nas skyabs 'jug 807

bsrung gur bgyid pas yi ge 'di ma 'byor gong du skyon du che ba med phyin yi ge 'byor nas sku rim la 'bad 'bung rten 'brel sgrigs phyogs ma 'chug na nyes skyon zhi bar phyogs pas/ de lugs kyi thugs tshab tab tab po med par brling lhod brtan gyi ngang sku rim la dpung bskyed pa gal che/ lar sngon las med phyin snying nas skyabs 'dug gi nus pas phan par nges/ de lta'i skabs phyogs 'dir bod mon bal po yi mi sna mang po sne 'dzom zhing bya ba rngam chen mang po bsgrub dgos kyi bral ba shin tu che ba'i skabs su gyur yang / de ka yab yum sras bcas la snying thag pa nas brtse bas skyabs 'jug bsrung dmigs nan tan dang / da lam rim brgyud 'gyang cha ma song bar tshes la thon par gtang yod/ yig lan zhib pa ni mi 'gyangs par 'bul rtsis yod pa dgongs 'jag zhu zhes rten lha gos dri ma med pas bcib te zla tshes dge ba la spel ba'i pa tram sarba maṅga lo/shing phag bkra bzang pa/ snga 'gyur gyi ring lugs 'chang ba rdo rje 'dzin gyur dam pa gang gi gsung bris gnas tshul rten lha gos snga ma spong rong rje dbon brgyud pa dang / gting ma ched mngags bang mi'i gdong bcas chab gcig tu zla 7tshes 25la mang yul skyid grong dngos grub phug tu son/ de dang nyin snga phyir bkra shis lhun po dbyings sa mchog gi bka' gleng yang phebs shing / khams lung mi ngo bla ma rig 'dzin lags nas snga phyir dgon gnas nged la do khur dgos tshul yang yang byung rung bdag gi skabs su ma che tshul smras kyang nan bskyed kyi mthar kho rang grong khar yang / kha chems la yi ge che chung gnyis gzhag 'dug la/ khams lung sku skye rin po che dang yum gcig pa'i dbon rang nas bla ma yong rgyu'i khul gyi rim 'gyang mthar/ legs lung nas mi 'gros byung 'phral kha che yi ge rtsad gcod gtang bar/ngam ring rdzong dang dar rgyas gling du snyan 'bul tsam las/ gzhan bla ma 'os 'thu sogs phul ba med pa'i khyed kyi ci kyang do khur rtsis len dgos tshul do khur rgya bcas byung bzhin/ dgon de'i grwa rigs rnams kyi yang gya tshom spyod pas bla ma 'das po'i sku chas rnams tshang 'dril grwa pa so so nas bgo bsha' byas 'dug pa/ de yang 'thor gyag tu 'os su ma che gshis rtsis len grwa pa kha shas brdzangs shing / gzhis gnyer yang 'os bsko tshar la/ gang ltar bdag ni phyogs 'dir yun ring mi sdod cing sdod kyang rung dgon pa'i 'dzin spras sngar ma gcogs bzhin nyid yab sras ngos kyi ltos bcas rtsa slob yin gshis/ bla brang dbyings sa chen po nasatshokyang der dgongs kyi thugs rje che ba yin 'dug bzhin/ drin shes kyi dbyings sa rtse shod kyi zhabs brtan nan tan chen pos bsgrub dgos thugs kyi thig ler gzhag 'os su snang la/ nged 'dus byas rang mtshang 'phral du ma bstan phyin sang phod bar legs lung dgon gzhis gzhan 'khyar med pa 'di nas do khur dang / nged dpal ma chos steng du sleb mtshams ngos 'phrad skabs 808

mol bsdur 'os 'thad bzhin/ legs lung dgon gzhis ci ltar 'os pa'i gnyer snying nas brtse ba chen pos de ka yab sras la 'bog rgyur mchis pa yang thugs kyi dpal be'ur bsti bar gyis/ zhes rten lha gos dang bal ṭaṃ brgyad phyir 'bul bcas zla tshes dge ba la mang yul byams pa sprin gyi gtsug lag khang 'dab nas spel ba'i pa tram sarba maṅga lo/lags/ bkra shis lhun po'i dbyings sa nas kham lung gong ma'i skye ba bkra bzang la byung ba de yin zhes khyod kyi yi ge mig ston byung bas de la cha 'jog byas pa yin pas 'thus pa zhig e yong tshul phebs pa yang gnas tshul du gsol la/ stag rtse mkhan por g.yu thog snyan brgyud ni brgya mkhar ba dang thugs stabs ma che re zhig 'then chog 'dug pas de lugs zhu/ sarba maṅga lam̐/si rtu la phul ba/ swāste/ dpal karma pa chen po skye ba'i 'phreng bar 'jig rten mgon pos byin gyi brlabs pa las byung ba/ bcu gsum yan o rgyan gu ru lung gi brten cing lha 'di nyid kyang o rgyan gyi slob dpon gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma sam bha was rdo rje'i gsung gis dbugs byung bar nges na/ des na 'di yan chad bslad med du grub cing / deng phyin chad dus kyi dbang gi ci ltar 'gyur bar gshegs pa'i rjes su chos srid lugs zung zhwa dmar skye 'phreng gi skyong ba las/ karma pa'i yang srid cod pan bcing ba dngos ni yan gyi rdzogs par gyur pa yis zhwa dmar khrir 'god rgyu don 'di slad nas gzhan sus kyang 'grub par dka' ba yi dpal rgyal ba thams cad kyi 'phrin las pa chen po karma pa bcu gsum pa'i spyan sngar de don gsol ba la dgongs par 'jug gam mi 'jug snyam pa'i yid 'dar bzhin pas dal gyi bsed bgrol zhus par thugs la mi 'bab pa med par bdag gi tshig de don gyi bden par dgongs shing / rang nyid kyi skye ba'i 'phreng ba dran tshul kha shas kyang gsang ba'i bka' phebs bcas mthar chos dbyings pho brang du/ dpa' bo rin po che dang / nged sgar gong 'og gi phyag mdzod 'dus par phyag bris bka' tham yang dag par gnang song ba da lam chu yi mi 'jig pa'i tshes bzang po dang bcas sku zhabs kyi zhu yig tu phul yod la/ karma pa bcu gsum pa dang da lam zhwa dmar 'di pa'i sku thog thugs yid gcig 'dres rten 'brel mi 'chug pa shin tu gal che nges yod pa yang dgongs dbyings rgya mtshor 'jug pa dang / gang spyir legs tshogs bzang po gong nas gong du 'phel bar smon bzhin 'grub par gyur cig sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ rje 'gro ba'i mgon po mchog gi sprul pa'i sku gang gi gnas kyi slob dpon du gyur pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po gtsug lag du ma la dbang 'byor ba rje rat+na sa mu dra zhes dam pa gang gi gsung mchid chab shog rten dang bcas rtags kyi ri mo nyams pa med par sgrub gnas chen po mu tig spa ma gong 809

du khrums zla'i dkar phyogs kyi dga' ba gsum pa la son pas yid kyi bde ba'i tshor ba sbom por gyur/ngos kyang dam pa chos bzhin du spyod pa'i mos blo ma bral ngang du mchis/ ci ltar gsung phebs ltar thugs rje chen po'i bcu gcig zhal gyi bsgom bzlas gnang ba shin tu nas kyang legs 'dug la/ thugs rje chen po'i mdo rgyud gzungs sngags thams cad kyi nang nas bcu gcig zhal gyi sgrub thabs 'di rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du rlung ltar grags shing lcam dpal mdzad la mi bzad pa'i nad kyis gdung ba la bcu gcig zhal gyi gzungs sngags la brten nad las grol bar ma zad 'phags pa'i zhal mjal nas rdo rje'i sku brnyes pa dang / jo bo rje la slob ma rnams kyi byin brlabs che la myur ba'i sgrub thabs zhig dgos zhus par bcu gcig zhal gyi sgrub thabs gnang bas mtshon sangs rgyas rnams kyi dgongs pa gtad nas byin gyis brlabs tshul gyis nan ltar byin brlabs che zhing myur ba lags na de yi nyams gzhes la brtson pa bskyed na shin tu legs par khums/ 'on kyang 'di ni bya rgyud sogs phyi rgyud gsum du bzhed pa yang yod la/ klu sgrub dang tsan+d+ra go ma'i ni rnal 'byor gyi rgyud du gzhag cing / slob dpon pad+mas ni bla med du bkral ba yang mchis la/ gang ltar rtsa ba yi gzungs snga 'gyur gyi skabs su bsgyur ba dang / sgrub thabs ta ra nā thas bsgyur ba 'di yang rtsa ba 'di bstan bcos ma yin pa rgyud kyi tshig kho nar nges pas des na der nges pa bskyed pa'i phyir de'i dpe rang gi 'bral spang du byas pa 'di bzhin 'bul lam zhus pa rtsis gzhes nas/ slad mar nyams gzhes lhu ru blang bar zhu la/ yi dam gyi lha bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi ngo bo ni gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa de/ de'i nyams gzhes la ci nas kyang 'bad par 'tshal zhing / phyag rgya chen po ni gang shar chos nyid kyi rol pa la zla ba yin na bskyed rim lha yin no snyam pa'i dran rtog kho rang la ce re ltas pas ngo bo nges bzung gi spros pa thams cad nub pa'i ngang la gnas pa de ka phyag rgya chen po nyid yin pa dgongs pas chod bzhin te/ dus rnams kun tu yengs med kyi dran pa dang / bla ma'i mos gus/ sems can la snying rje gsum mi 'brel bar byas na tshe gcig rdo rje 'chang gi sa la reg par 'gyur ba lags / dpal rig pa 'dzin pas spel ba sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i 'phrin las shing rta gang ma smad gyen du 'dren pa'i snying stobs can/dam pa mgon gyi byin brlabs mi'i khyu mchog /rat+na'i rig 'dzin bsam 'phel mchog de la/ /thos mang rnam dag yan lag brgyad ldan rdzing / /bsam pa rnam dag gdeng ka bdun pa'i bdag /don bsgom rnam dag nor bu phud bu can/ /lhag bsam rnam dag klu dbang de'i zhu mchid/ /deng dus bod chen nor 'dzin lto ba ru/ /tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs gser gyi khye'u yi/ /do zlar gyur pa snyigs dus 'gro ba'i mgon/ /yab sras 'phrin las 'phel gnas bdag yid tshim/ /gang gi mdun na 'don gyur 810

dam pa nyid/ /'tsho gzhes dngas shing dge ba'i bgyid 'os rnams/ /nam yang ma nyams legs byas rin chen mdzod/ /du ma rgyas shing bzhugs par rjes yi rangs/ /bdag kyang rgyal dbang pad+ma'i thugs rje'i mthu'i/ /ris med rgyal bstan rin chen gdugs dkar po/ /rgud med gyen du 'degs pa'i snying stobs kyi/ /gser gyi yu ba mngon par brjod de gnas/ /'on kyang da ni na tshod gyis gtug shing / /lus rgas sems zhum 'tsho ba yang dman pas/ /dben pa'i nags tshal zhig tu gyi na ru/ /'jug pa snying nas smon bzhin ngang du mchis/ /da ni dus ngan snyigs ma'i mthar thug pas/ /mi bde du ma'i 'phreng bas bod yul 'di/ /mnar bar dogs mod snga phyi gnas tshul kun/ /khong du chud bzhin snying nas skyo ba skye/ /des na mgon dang skyabs med 'gro ba'i don/ /sa gnas sems dpa' yab sras dam pa rnams/ /sku tshe brtan zhing bstan pa 'phel rgyas nas/ /bdag gi 'bad pas bgyis kun don ldan shog /nyid kyang dam pa'i don la sman slad du/ /byang chub sprul dbyings tram mtshan 'od zer mdangs/ /lha phran 'phos pa'i spyi bor bzhugs pa'i mthu'i/ /smon lam 'phen pas rang bzhin bzang por nges/ /des na ston 'khor tshom bu gcig pa ru/ /bzang po'i rten 'brel gyis bsdus yang nas yang / /dge legs rgyas pa'i dga' ston dam pa la/ /bar chad med par rtag tu spyod kyang smon/ /bdag gi sgo gsum 'bad pa drag po yi/ /ring mo nyid nas bgyis pa'i dge 'dis kyang / /nges don bstan 'dzin rgyal ba yab sras kyi/ /bzhed dgu chos bzhin gegs med 'grub par shog /zhes pa yang rig pa 'dzin pa rgyal khams pas sa la spyod pa'i 'og min mtshur gyi gasdo la nas zla tshes bzang po la spel ba'i li khi haṃ/ sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste/ kun gzigs 'dren pa yongs kyi spyi dpal mchog /lag na pad+mo'i rnam sprul 'gro ba'i mgon/ /rje btsun sprin sgra can gyi byin rlabs mthus/ /ngag gi dbang phyug thob khyed rtag tu rgyal/ /1 skye thob shes rab zhing sa pad+mo'i tshal/ /sbyangs stobs rnam dpyod sā lu sbrang rtsi'i bcud/ /blo ldan skye rgu bung ba'i yid kyi gsos/ /mkhas pa'i rnam par thar la bdag yi rang / /'jig rten dbang phyug gzhon nur gyur pa'i tshul/ /gang gi gnas su nye bar bsnyen pa 'di/ /dge legs bya ba ring nas goms pa yis/ /smon lam bzang po'i mthu las gzhan ci zhig /dam pa'i rnam thar dad pa'i gtsug ngal las/ /sngon goms mos gus stobs rgyas ma brgya ba'i/ /snyan tshig skya rengs kun bzang gser 'khor lo/ /phun tshogs mchod sprin rtsas su 'khyir 'di rmad/ /mos dang dge gyur gser gyi sa gzhi las/ /rten 'brel legs byas rtsa 'thung sum brtsen skyes/ /smon lam bzang po'i rang bzhin dge 'bras 'bum/ /rgud med tshe rabs rtag tu cis mi rgyas/ /'gro kun la khyab chos khams dge ba can/ /dri med sems nyid rin chen rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /don gnyis phun tshogs rgya mtsho'i dpal gyur gang / /ring min yongs su 'grub pa'i 811

rgyur yang smon/ /snyan snyan tshangs pa'i bu mo'i mgrin pa'i rnga/ /legs legs dge ba'i lo 'dab rgyas pa'i gsos/ /bzang bzang tshe rabs kun tu bzang po'i rgyu/ /grub grub phun tshogs dpal kun 'di grub shog/ces rje btsun 'gro ba'i mgon po kun mkhyen 'brug pa mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rin po che gang gi gnas kyi slob dpon bslab gsum yon tan du mas phyug pa'i mkhas pa chen po rin chen rgya mtsho gang gi dngas ba'i thugs kyi ched du bsngags pa'i yun du 'tsho ba'i shis brjod snyan tshig kun tu bzang po'i 'khor lo ngo mtshar phul du byung ba'i re kha can rten 'brel bzang po'i skyes su gnang bar ched du brjod pa rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus so/ /sarba maṅga lo/rnam dpyod nam mkha' las 'ong snyan pa'i tshig /bya ka kun bzang 'khor lo rtsib brgya pa/ /dge mtshan du ma'i ngo mtshar 'phro ba 'di/ /legs par brtag shing ngo mtshar yul du gyur/ /tshul de legs byas dpal du che'o zhes/ /skyes len mtshon byed bslad med sa le sbram/ /ngang pa'i bu mo'i kha dog 'phrog pa yis/ reg byas 'khyud de song ba bha waskyo/swāste/ mgon po nyid las legs 'ong bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /grub pa'i nying khu phyag chen ga'u zhes/ /snyan par grags pa de yi 'dzin ma'i khyon/ /kun tu rgya che rgyun mi chad pa dang / /de bzhin dang po'i sangs rgyas mkha' lding dbang / /sna tshogs sku can gang gi zhal mjal zhing / /gsung thos thugs kyi dgongs pa gnyis med 'grub/ /rab 'byams las rnams thog pa med pa ru/ /bdag gi 'grub par mgon po khyod nyid kyi/ /smon lam gdab par 'os zhes yang nas yang / /gsol ba 'debs par lags na de don ltar/ /rtag tu dgongs pa'i dbyings su 'jug kyang zhu/ /de skad rgya bod yul dbus sbas pa'i gnas/ /pad+ma bkod kyi nub byang sa yi mthil/ /rtag brtan rin chen spungs pa'i gtsug lag nas/ /kaḥthog sprul sku zhes byas phul ba yin/ sarba maṅga lo/rgya nag tu gung mgon po skyabs la dri ba mdzad pa/ oṃ swāste/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal rigs sku 'khrungs shes rab gzigs pa yangs/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la lhag bsam mchog brnyes pa/ /khyim bdag byang chub sems dpa' paṇ+ḍi ta/ /dam pa'i rnam thar 'chang ba gang de la/ /rang gzhan grub mtha' rgya mtshor zhugs la zhum med blo gros kyi/ /gru rdzing thob rlom gangs ri'i khrod skyes dpal ldan rig pa 'dzin/ /de yi phyogs 'dir sngon chad ma myong gsar du legs bshad gtam/ /ji snyed thob par 'dod nas dri ba 'di la don ldan mdzod/ /de yang gtsug lag mkhyen pa'i spyan ras mchog tu yang ba gu yi gung chen por gyur pa la ched du gsol 'os/ rgya nag chos 'byung du ṭi'u yis rgyal rabs bzhi pa'i skabs bdag cag gi ston pa thub pa'i dbang po sku bltams par bzhed bzhin/ 'od srungs sogs sangs rgyas snga ma rnams kyi skabs su rgya nag gi rgyal thabs la rgyal po 'di yod kyi mtshan gsal yod dam med/ rgya nag tu dam pa'i chos han ming tis skabs su byung bar 812

grags shing / de tshe sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo stong lhag tsam lon zhes grags pa dang / bod kyi rgyal rabs yig tshang rnying par rgya nag tu chos byung nas khri srong lde'u btsan gyi skabs lo stong lon zhes brjod pa dang / rgya gar gyi chos 'byung khungs ma kha cig tu sangs rgyas kyi gtad rabs bdun pa dgra bcom pa legs mthong gi rgya yul chen por dam chos kyi sa bon gzhag zhes gsung ba sogs 'grigs dka' bar snang yang / gsung rab rnams su rgya yul dang rgya yul chen po gnyis yang nas yang du gsung bar sngon gyi mkhas pa chen po rnams rgya yul ni sman rtse'i rgyal khams dang / rgya yul chen po ni de'i byang phyogs su yod par gsungs na/ rgya nag rang du de'i ngos 'dzin ci ltar 'tshal dang / li yul 'di yang ngos 'dzin tshul mi gcig pa mang ba yi de nas mdzad pa'i chos 'byung du li yul ljang du ngos bzung ba ni bod sngags rnying pa'i gzhung lo rgyus rnam dag rnams su li yul lcang ra sgrug po sogs kyi khung dang 'brel zhing 'thad par snang yang / rgyal po sa nu'i bdag byed pa'i yul drug dus sbyor skabs ni li yul ni bod yul gyi byang phyogs su yod dgos par snang bas mkhas pa rig ral sogs snga rabs dang / phyis 'byung kha cig gis kyang sa nu byung ba'i yul zi ling gi byang phyogs char yod par brjod na/ de yang bden min dang / yul drug li yul gyi ngos 'dzin rgya nag tu ji ltar bzhed phebs gsal dang / / 2 lo 'dir bdag cag gi ston pa sku bltams pa'i lo mi 'dra ba mang zhing / rgya nag chos 'byung du 'dod tshul mi 'dra ba mang du yod tshul tsam gsung nas gtso bo bsam gtan mkhan rnams kyi 'dod pa de bzhin gshegs pa shing stag la 'khrungs nas don dgu chu sprel la gshegs par mdzad pa ni tshal pa'i yig rnying bslad med zhig dang shin tu mthun zhing / de nas da lta'i bar lo ci tsam song / chos 'byung rgyal rabs kyi lo nas tsam bdag gi rags rtsis su bgrang bas nyis stong bzhi brgya lnga bcu nga lnga tsam rab nyi'i mtha' me stag yan la song 'dra snyams kyang / da lam de nas lo rtsis nges gsal zhig phebs gsal dang/ 3 lhag tu rgya nag rgyal rabs yig tshangs su thang che dang bod rgyal dus mtshungs rnams kyi gshegs 'khrung gi lo nges gsal yod 'dug pa gnam ri srong btsan nas khri ral gyi bar 'khrungs gshegs kyi lo tshigs zhig ci nas kyang gal che bar snang bas phebs gsal dang / 'phrul snang gi rdo ring la rgya bza' kong jo snga ma cang kon gyi lo la bod du byon pa dang / phyi ma keng lung gi lo la bod du byon par bris 'dug na lo ming de gnyis snga sor si tu rin po ches nyid la dri ba mdzad pa'i lan du rgyal po so so'i srid ming yin zhes nges shes rnyed pa gnang 'dug kyang kong jo snga phyi bod du phebs pa'i lo ming 'byung khams zhib mor byas pa zhig ci nas kyang gal che bar snang bas phebs gsal dang / 4 bod kyi yig tshang tshal pa'i deb gter khra bo sogs su me nyag ngu rgu'i brgyud kyi rgya nag gi rgyal srid byas par brjod kyang rgyang rtse bdag po'i deb ther 813

dang / lhag tu de nas mdzad pa'i rgya nag chos 'byung du me nyag rgyal pos rgya nag gi rgyal thabs byas par ma gsungs pas de yang ci ltar gyis phebs gsal dang / 5 yang skar rtsis kyi dus sbyor rnams la shin tu gal che ba thub shing gi grib ma 'phags yul dbus kā shi nas 'big byed kyi lho tri ling ga yi bar byang bgrod mthar thug skabs grib ma rtsa ba nas dag pa dang / bal por grib ma khab sbom tsam dang / bod yul la stod du lnga cha dang / bod yul dbus su bzhi cha lhag tsam grib tshad du snang zhing / pho brang chen po si king du/ grib ma'i tshad ci tsam 'gyur zhu bar 'dod cing / lhag tu rdo rje gdan gyi shar phyogs gi ri wadhe dang / de dang nye ba ri po ṭa la yod par grags kyang rgya nag chos gzhung du/ rgya nag gi yul dbus su thub shing grib ma dag par gsung 'dug pas/ de tshe rdo rje gdan dang shar nub dgos byung bas yul de gang gi phyogs su yod phebs gsal nges can dang / 6 nyi ldog yang mkhas mchog bu ston zhabs sogs dam pa mang pos snga rung 'gro bar gsungs zhing / yid bzang rtse dang / lhag tu phug pas nyi ldog snga bar mi 'dod pa ste bod 'dir rtsis mkhan rnams kyi dpyad gzhi shin tu che ba gnyis byung na/ rgya nag gi gtsug lag tu nyi ldog snga bar bzhed dam mi bzhed kyi phebs gsal nges can ci nas kyang zhu bar 'dod la/ 7 yang bod 'dir lo mgo stag zla ngos 'dzin tshul mi gcig pa gsum 'byung la/ khri srong yab sras kyi skabs su lo mgo rgyal zla stag tu 'dod zhes dang / bdag nyid chen po sa skya pa dang / hor rgyal mchod yon tu gyur pa'i skabs mchu zla lo mgor mdzad de/ de stag zlar bzhed pa yin zhes dang /hor gyi rgyal pos pan rnyed pa'i zla ba yin pas lo mgor bzhed pa yin zhes sgrogs tshul gnyis dang /phug khyung rjes 'brang sogs mang zhig ni mgo zla stag tu 'dzin yang 'phags yul du stag zla'i tha snyad med par sgrod pa re lor rtsi skabs nyi ldog nas brtsam mod kyang stag zla yin min dpyad gzhi shin tu che ba yis rgya nag tu dpe 'khyud med par stag zla dngos gang la ngos 'dzin kun rdzob rten 'brel rtsis la yid brton pa rnams la sman pa'i slad du phebs gsal dang / 8 bod rnams lo gsar tshes gcig stag gi nyi mar 'dod kyang / rgya nag ri thu shes pa rnams la dris tshe/ de yang ma nges par snang tshe des na zla ba dang zhag gi pho mo'i dbang thang ci ltar bsdeb dang / lo la rme ba dbus zhugs sug ston dang khyung nag kong ston pa gsum 'dod tshul mi 'dra tha dad du byung ba/ da lta rgya nag rang gi lug lo me dbus zhugs gang la ngos 'dzin sogs nag rtsis kyi skor tshegs chung don che'i gnas ci rigs lhug par zhu 'dod dang /9 nyi ma byang bgrod mthar thug skabs kheng che'i yul du mtshan mo ja yun las mi 'byung ba/ bod 'dir sngar nas de lta'i gtam ci rigs byung 'dug kyang btang snyoms su byas rung nyid nas chos 'byung du bkod snang bas/ de phyin tshad mar grub pa yi yul de pho brang chen po si ging phyogs gang du yod kyang 814

dpag tshad ci tsam la mchis/ da lta rgyal po gang gi mnga' 'og la gnas/ khing cha phan chad du mtshan mo'i yun/ de dang cha 'dra ba yod dam de las ring thung gzhan yod kyi phebs gsal yang bka' drin che ba zhu rgyu dang / 10 don yod lcags kyu'i gzungs sogs gzhung tshad ma rnams la dpag na chu bo shi ta yang rgya nag gi yul mthar thug pa o ro su dang mtshams sam de brgal ba'i pha rol tsam du 'bab dgos par snang na der chu bo chen po shi ta'i ngos 'dzin can yod dam med/ lar byang phyogs kyi brgyud du sham bha la yod par yul phyogs de yi skye bo dra ma rnams la yongs su grags pa zhig yod dam med/ yongs su grags pa yod tshe yul phyogs der tsi na'i skye bo brtson 'grus can gyi sngar sham+bha lar bgrod pa byung ngam ma byung gi phebs gsal zhig kyang zhu bar spro zhing / 11 de bzhin rgya nag gi bsam gtan mkhan tsung men gyi grub mtha' 'di ni bod rnams kyi sna tshogs gleng yang gnub kyi bsam gtan mig dang mdo brgyad cu'i lung khung sogs la dpag na theg chen gyi lta ba rnam par dag pa dang / bod du yang a ro'i man ngag la rgya gar sprul sku bdun brgyud dang rgya nag hwa shang bdun brgyud kyi man ngag 'dus par sngar gyi yig rnying khung thub rnams la 'byung yang / dus phyis bod pa spyi yi cal sgrogs la brten/ lo rgyus de rnams bsgros med du song 'dug rung / rang gi ni rnam par dag pa'i lam du byis pa'i skabs nas rtogs shing / nyid nas rgya nag chos 'byung du zhib mor phyes 'dug pa gtan tshigs su/ /zhus nas kun gyi dngas shing dad pa yis/ /rang rtags phyag rgya'i ri mo bkod pa'i tshe//ji srid bar du gnas par gdon mi za/ /zhes pa yang dpal rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bus so/ /dpa' bo rin po che la rtsal ba/ klong gsal mkha' 'gro'i snying thig gi las byang rtsa 'phreng gi bzlas pa ni phyi nang gsang ba'i sngags spyi dril du yin 'dug la/ de yang oṃ ā:r+ghaṃ gsum ni bde gshegs thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi snying po ste phyi dang / oṃ hūṃ tram̐ trīḥ.aḥ.e yam̐ ram̐ waṃ lo bcu ni bde gshegs rigs lnga yab yum bcu ste nang gi dang / trī ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya bcu ni mkha' 'gro yab yum ste gsang ba'i snying po ste/ tsit+ta hring hring dza dza ni lha dbang du bsdus shing las la gcun pa'i sngags su mngon/ des na 'di spyi dril gyi sngags kyi dbang du ci ltar mtshams pa las dmigs gsal gyi grangs bzung ma dgos/ nang sgrub kyi snying po 'di ni mkha' 'gro thod brgal du bsgrub pa ste shin tu rno zhing myur bar bzhed/ dus rgyun chags su bzlas pa'i gtso bo ni yig 'bru bco lnga pa ste/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hri ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa trī ya dza hūṃ zhes dang / yang na oṃ āḥr+ghaṃ hri ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsit+ta hring hring dza dzaḥzhes kyang bzla ba ste de gnyis rgyun bzlas la khyad med pas gang bde gtso bor bzla ba lags/ kha sing dpe ma bzhugs pas phyag tu 'bul ma thub shing da lam khams nas byung ba'i klong gsal mkha' 'gro snying thig gi cha lag gsang ba ye shes kyi skor phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang gi sgrub thabs las byang dang bcas pa las mtha' dbang sgrub yab thugs rje chen po'i phyi bsgrub dang sgrub thabs gnyis/ kun gyi kha bskang gtor ma'i las rim/ rta phag yab yum gyi gsang bsgrub klong gsal mkha' 'gro snying thig gi rtsa bsgrub dang 'brel ba de rnams kyi kha bskang bskang ba kho bos byas pa rnams da lam phul yod pa nged rang la dpe cha thob yod gshis rtag tu phyag dper mdzad pa dang / smon lam gtad rgya byas nas phul ba lags pas nyams gzhes yang dag par mdzad par zhu/ gzhan snying thig ya bzhi'i skor ni bklang lung las bla ma yang thig gi dbang dang khrid thob phyin bi ma snying thig gi dbang khrid nges par thob/ mkha' 'gro yang thig gi dbang khrid thob pas mkha' 'gro snying thig gi dbang khrid thob pa'i go nges par chod pa bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsung rgyun dang phyag gzhes lags/ 'on kyang lung rgyun ni tha dad du zhu ba'i srol ka byung 'dug pa yang dgongs mtshor bsti ba zhu/ snyigs dus 'dir sa thag nye ba'i bla ma rnams la bka' chos gsan snga yang dam tshig bsrung shin tu dka' gshis chos thos pa las kyang dam tshig gtso ba dgongs mnga' ltar gyi slad nas bka' chos gsan gzhed bla ma rnams la brtag dpyad nan tan byed pa shin tu gal che bar snang / deng sang dus kyi dbang gi chos 'brel re zhu zin rjes bla ma des kyang slob ma'o zhes chos brgyad kyi brgyag ste thub thub sogs slob ma la rtag tu brnyas par byed pa yang bla ma mtshan nyid mi 817

ldan pa'i rang gzugs te deng sang de 'dra byed pa yang ches mang bar mthong mod/ nged rang gi bla ma'i gnas la ni de 'dra ye med do/ /de dag yang sems la 'char tshul lhug par gsol ba sarba maṅga lo/ yang gcig la/ lags/ klong gsal mkha' 'gro snying thig gi skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni sgrub khog nas 'byung ba de ka'i yang na sngon 'gro yi skabs su bshad pa'i skyabs 'gro sems bskyed de ka yang byas chog pa yin la/ de yang skyabs 'gro gang du 'don na kha cig gi mtshams bcad grub nas 'don pa dang / kha cig gi thog ma nyid nas 'don pa sogs rnying ma nang khul du yang mi 'dra ba kha shas 'dug kyang lugs 'dir ni skyabs sems sngon du byed pa phyag len lags/gangs can gyi ris med grub mtha' spyi dang rnying sngags rnams la sman pa'i slad du rang gi dzi wa la 'phang med kyi zhu tshig seng ge'i rgyun dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /sa'i dkyil 'khor la dbang bsgyur ba mi yi bdag po paṇ+ḍi ta chen po gang gi tsa ra ṇa rnam par bkod pa rin po che'i khri ngogs su/ bkra shis pa'i me tog gi snyim pa bkang ste ched du zhu gsol/ gang nyid sngon nas rnam par dkar ba'i bsod nams nam yang mi dman pa'i phung po bsags shing / byang chub mchog gi bsam pas kun nas kun tu thar pa mchog gi 'bras bur yongs su dmigs pa'i dge 'bras kyi gnas skabs dus 'dir yang mngon par mtho ba'i go 'phang bzang por 'bad rtsol gyi bsgrub pa ma yin par lha bcas 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon lag na pad+mo can gyi sgyu 'phrul ngur smrig gar gyi sgeg pa rgyal ba mchog gi shis pa brjod cing gong ma 'jam dbyangs chen po'i lung gi gangs can gyi rje bor dbang bskur nas mtha' yas pa'i mnga' 'bangs bde la bkod pa'i rang gzugs 'di lta ni 'gro kun yid kyi rgud pa sel ba 'chi med bdud rtsi chen por gyur cing / phran bu bya bral ba yang gnyal du sdod skabs ngang tshul de lta rna ba'i bcud du thob pa yis bshol med rgyal zla'i yar tshes tsam la mi yi rje bo khri la gsar phebs kyi mjal phyag zhu ba dang / lha mi'i bla ma gong sa mchog gi zhabs kyi pad+mo la phyag bgyid pa'i bslad du bcar rtsis yod bzhin par/ bka' rgya rin po cher bla ma'i ris mang zhig dbang gi ngag shugs ma ldog nas bya ba sna tshogs zhig bgyis skad dang /khyod kyang dbang gi bla mar gyur gshis de ltar byas yod med kyi dri ba bgyid dgos kyi phral du yong na legs tshul chab shog son phral dbang gi ngag shugs ma ldog nas gong sa mchod yon la de lta'i byed ngan mi lam du yang ma bgyis na dngos su smos ci 'tshal zhes pa'i gnas tshul zhu yig rta zam steng nas yang 'phral du phul zhing / phran rang yang lam du zhugs nas dus tshes bzang por lha ldan du 'byor zhing /mchod yon gyi mjal phyag legs par zhus/ de rjes zla 12tshes 25la sku tsha zung byon nas dbang de par dogs pas/ khyod kyi yang ci ltar byas gsang por gsol na legs tshul bka'i 'khor los khyab pa la rang gi rdzun med bden pa'i tshig gi skad ces gsol ste/ 'jig rten 'di na rgyal po ni che zhing gnyen pa yin na ngo bsrung gi bya ba ci rigs dgos pa ni gzhir bcas/ de bas bdag bya bral sprang po zhig gi rgyal po'i ngag shugs ldog par mi nus pa'i las ngan la zhugs dgos pa tsam gyi ngo bsrung ni nam du shākya rin po cher dpral ba gtug chog pa yod la/ spyir yang rang lo nyer gsum mar btags phran skye ba'i yul der drag sngags la rtsis su byed pa'i srol gyi rang yang der dga' zhing / yul der nus pa yod bka' 'dri mchod yon lhan rgyas nas yin phebs byung yang / gong sa thams cad mkhyen pa ni 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa'i skyabs gnas ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bo/ sems can thams cad la brtse ba'i pha/ byams pa'i ma/ 'khor ba sgrol ba'i gru/ thar pa bgrod pa'i lam/ tshad med pa snying rje chen po'i mnga' bdag yin par nges shing grub pa dang / rang dang yang skye ba du mar las smon bzang po'i 'brel bar yid kyi gsal snang du shar rung / zhabs pad du yang yang bcar bar ma bzod pa tsam las gnong du 'gro ba gzhan cung zad kyang med pa de dag pa ye shes spyan gyis gzigs pa gor ma chags pa dang / yang kha cig gi sa skyong mchog dang chos rje nu mod hu'ang nas bka' 'dri yin par gleng yang / chos rje nu mod hu'ang sngar rang gi dngos su ma mjal rung / dam pa de ni yul chos kyi bcos ma dang bral ba/ gzu bor gnas pa/ drang por spyod pa/ lha chos kyi thos pa che zhing / sde snod mang pos mgrin pa rgyan pa tshul khrims kyi phung po rnam par dag pa/ byang chub sems gnyis kyi thugs rgyud yongs su sbyangs ba/ dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i slob dpon chen por brnyes pa'i gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin par gyur nas rgyal ba'i yongs 'dzin dam par bskur ba zhig yin par snang ba dang / spyir yang byang chub sems dpa' rnams byams pa'i thugs/bzod pa'i go cha la ches cher goms pa'i shugs kyi nyes pa can la yang lhag par brtse bar mdzad na/nyes pa med bzhin skyon phab pa lta ga la zhig tshul des phran la bka' 'dri 'di ltar phebs pa ni/ deng sang dus snyigs kyi 'gro ba dmu rgod sna tshogs dang / phran la brnag par blta ba kha shas kyang srid tshe/ de rnams nas gzugs med gzugs dang / ming med ming btags kyi snyan khra zhus dbang gi sa skyong chos kyi rgyal po mchog gi phran la dgong pa tshom khrel gyi bka' 'dri stsal ba la mchod yon lhan rgyas nas phebs pa yin zhes mdzes lam gyi sbyor ba ma lags sam snyam pa'i yid bag khum par gyur mod/ de lta na yang rang la nyes pa'i skyon gyur cung zad tsam yang med pa sku tshab zung gi mdun du gsol ltar las zhu ba gsar 'phar lhag mar gyur pa cung zad tsam yang med nges lags pa chos dbyings zab mo'i klong du rtag tu nyams pa med pa g.yung drung chen po'i ngo bor 'khyil ba dang / bdag lha ldan du sdod ring sngar nas 'cham rims kyi nar mar brtser ba dang / skye bo mang po'i thugs 'phrad kyis kyang yid bsun pas sa skyong snga ma dag gis skabs su yang phyogs 'dir sdod mi dgos pa'i dgongs pa nan zhus bgyis pa dgongs mnga' ltar gyi da lam yang zla ba 'di ka'i yar ngo dus tshes bzang ba zhig la thon nas sngar rgyun ltar phyogs med rgyal khams gnas yul gang bzang du rim gnyis dge sbyor ci nus bgyid par bgrod pa la lam yig zhig kyang thugs rje chen po'i do ra nas mi 'dor ba ci kyang mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen zhes gsol ba 'debs pa re 'bras don ldan du mdzad pa dang / gzhan yang 'phros su sems la gang shar gsang 820

por zhu 'os/ 'di ltar lo 'pho mtshams su dus gnyen por mchod gnas kyi khung sngags btsun kha yar khrims rar bcug ste bka' 'dri drag po dang / sa bdag klu gnyan gyi gnas su rdzas ngan sbyar ba'i mnan gtad khru slog mdzad pa ni mi legs par go ste/ rgyal po sngon rabs kha shas nas kyang de ltar mdzad pas mi shis pa'i lo rgyus mang zhig dang / nye bar yab rje chos kyi rgyal po'i skabs su ngan sngags mkhan rtsad gcod dang mnan gtad 'don pa yang 'tshub cha chen po'i rgyu ru song ba dgongs dbyings rin po cher mnga' bzhin pa dang / lar ni deng sang dus dbang gi mngon spyod byed par rlom pa re bzung tsam las mang zhig dpe klog 'ol ci las lag len gnad la reg pa dka' ba dang / lhag tu dam tshig gtsang mar bsrung ba yang dkon gshis/ mnan bsreg 'phang ba'i nus pa yang 'ol ci tsam du gyur rung / mnan gtad 'don na rang bzhin shugs kyi 'tshub lhong re yong ba yin pas des na mnan gtad dogs gnas yod pa rnams su lag len rnam dag gi gtad rul/ gtad sbyangs gtad dgrol rnams 'jug na/ mnan gtad kyi nus pa zhi bar nus pa yin zhing / de rnams kyang 'chi bdag gshin rje gshed srog gi 'khor lo nag po'i rgyud nas gsung ba nyid stobs nus che la/ gzhan yang gdugs dkar/ rnam 'joms kyi gzungs bsgrub/ gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba'i bsrung bzlog de'i las tshogs byad 'grol gyi cho ga de kun rnam par dag pa 'grub na 'phas kyi sbyor ngan byas pa kun zhi zhing 'tshub lhong med par phan yon chen po thob pa yang zab dbyings rin po cher 'jug pa zhu 'os dang /yang 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po la ngan thabs byas so zhes pa'i gtam 'di lta dbus gtsang dus zing skabs nas da lta'i bar rang gi gleng tsam yang ma thos shing don du yang byed don mi 'dug la/byed mkhan yang med pa snying nas sems mod/ 'on kyang da lam tshul de ltar dgos dbang gi stsal ba yin srid kyang / da lta rgya bod 'dres mar spyod pa'i stabs/ rgya mi bod skad byang ba dang / bod pa yang sna tshogs pa byas/ gtam de rim pas 'phel te gong ma chen po'i snyan dbang du dngas na rtsad gcod gnang bar dogs shing de tshe nga bden khyod bden gyi lugs srol sna tshogs nas mang zhig rgya nag tu 'gro dgos sam/ srog bkum par bzas tshe bya thabs kyi dben zhing bklog par dka' bas rgyal bstan la rma 'byin pas mdzad pa la yang mi mdzes sdig pa'i rgyu ru dogs pas des na tshig 'di yang da lta nas sgros med 'jam chags su gzhag na snyam pa yang rang 'dod kyi dri mas cung zad kyang ma sbag par bod kyi rje bo mchod yon mchog gi sku tshe zhabs pad brtan pa'i rim gro dge tshogs ched dang / gangs can smongs kun bde ba'i rten 'brel la dmigs sems la gang shar 'dzem bag med par snying nas lhag bsam dag pas zhu ba la tshom 'khrungs med pa mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen/ 821

da lam mngon spyod kyi rtsad gcod mnan gtad khru slog yang rten 'brel cung zad tsam gnod par dogs pas/ des na nyes pa kun las rnam par grol ste legs tshogs bzang po'i rten 'brel mtha' dag zla ba yar gyi ngo ltar gong nas gong 'phel du 'grig pa dang / gangs can bstan 'gro yongs kyi phan bde'i rtsa lag mchod yon nyi zla zung 'brel thugs yid mdza' gshim gcig 'dres da lta las ma g.yos pa zhig gsol ba 'debs pa de lta'i re 'bras don ldan du mdzad du gsol/ de yang bdag lta phran bu snyoms chung gyi na ba rgyal khams pa dā ri dra pa tsam du ma zad da lta gzigs phyogs kyi bka' 'dri'i yul du gyur pa bcas 'di ltar zhu ba mi 'os shing skabs su mi che yang / bod kyi rje bo mchod yon yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po cher/ dga' ba dang / dngas ba dang / dad pa dang / gus pa chen pos yid kyi kun nas bskul te 'phros zhus gang shar mjes khrig gi sgrib shing med par bu tshas pha mar gsol ltar bdag bde'i ched tsam ma yin par bod yul bde ba'i brtsas kho nar smreng ba la dgongs dbyings rin po che 'byung gnas klong du khrel tshom med par bde bar 'jug cing brtse ba'i thugs kyi mi bskyud par ci nas kyang mkhyen mkhyen/ mkhyen zhes brgya phrag du ma'i bar du gsol ba 'debs bzhin pa'o/ /zhes dkyus ring thugs rje'i spyan ras g.yo bar byed pa'i rten yang gnyen bde 'jam lha yi reg bya zla ba'i khu bas lan brgyar byug pa lta bu gcig tu dkar zhing srid du ring bas bcib nas bshol med rgyal zla'i dkar phyogs rgyal ba gnyis pa la bod yul sa yi thig le sprul pa'i pho brang lha ldan rgyal po'i khab kyi bya 'dab blo gsal mdun na 'don gyis gnas rab mjos me tog ljon shing gi skyed mos tshal nas rgyal ba pad+ma'i lung gi pho nya ba gdod ma nyid nas grub pa'i rnal 'byor rig pa 'dzin pa rgyal khams dā ri dra phran bur gyur pa des phul ba'i zhu yig kun tu dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāsti/ rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gter chen po/ /gcig bsdus gzi brjid 'od dpag med pa zhing 'di'i mgon po mchog /thub dbang rgyal tshab tshul ston o rgyan slob dpon mchog de dang / /dbyer med dran mchog dngas ma'i mgon po mchog de dang por mchod/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal kun bskyed dang spro ba'i byed po 'od dpag med pa spyan ras gzigs/ /snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus mthar 'gro la phan bzhed ngur smrig gar gyi rol pa rgyal po'i tshul/ /lha bcas 'gro ba'i skyabs gnas gangs can mgon po bskal bzang gdul bya'i gnyen gyur rgya mtsho'i sde/ /gang gi zhabs zung gser gyi 'khor lo rnam par bkra ba'i drung du mgo bos 'dud phyag 'tshal/ /mchog de'i 'phrin las byed por gangs can skye rgu yis/ /gtsug tu gong ma'i lung gi mngon par dbang bskur ba/ /dbang phyug che brnyes mkhyen spyod bsod nams rgya mtsho'i bdag /mi'i dbang po gang khyed rtag tu rgyal gyur cig / 822

'dzam gling phan bde'i rtsa lag mchod yon gyis/ /bka' lung gser gyi me tog lhung ba'i tshe rang gi ngang tshul ji bzhin gleng ba'i gtam/ /dri med shel gyi me long tshul 'di phul/ /zhes mchod par brjod pa sngon du gtang nas 'dir gsol 'os/ rje bdag nyid chem/ po la ni rang nyid mchog tu gus pa thob pa yin zhing / der yang ma zad rgyal ba'i bstan 'dzin skyes bu dam pa gang na su bzhugs par mos pa dang ldan pa zhig lags/bka' 'drir dbang yab kyi dus bya byed kyi skor gzur gnas shes ldan gyis mig dang rna ba'i yul du gsal bzhin dang / dus kyi chos nyid du gyur pa la 'pho 'debs dang / zhal bzhugs la dbang bskur sogs byas pa ni rang gi mtshan nyid ma shes dbang gi de ltar gyur la gnong las 'os ci yod/ sku mched bar dang / gung g.yog srog bslu'i skor phyogs gnyis ka'i zhabs rim da lta lha ldan du yod na/ de dag gi mkhyen bzhin las bdag gi sger du zhib mor zhu ma dgos shing / spyir kho bo la nyes pa yod do zhes pa thams cad 'di dang rigs mthun du grub/ gong sa skyabs mgon mchog gi sku'i tshe 'phrang drug las/ rje drung rin po che dang / rang gi gsal ba ni snyan du phul zin/ de bas gangs can gyi dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde'i gsal thub min gyi skor/ dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde'i de rnams su rgyun zhugs nas dgra bcom 'phags pa'i bar dang / gzhan yang byang sems 'phags pa dang / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa yang ji snyed bzhugs pa gzhir bcas pas de dag gi gsal mi thub so zhes pa bka' lung ma stsal bar yid la skad cig kyang ma shar ba ci phyir smra/ rang gi rten 'brel bzang po'i sgrig phyogs tsam snyan du phul ba la ni skyon yod par ma sems ste/ sngon bdag cag gi ston pa 'brog dgon pa seng ge'i 'jigs pa can du gshegs pa'i skabs su khyi'u gnyis dag gi rnga sga dang mda' gzhu'i sbyor bas/ de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i 'jigs pa las skyobs par 'dod pa dge ba'i rtsa ba des ma 'ong thar pa 'bring po thob pa lung bstan pa dgongs mnga' ltar gyi/ de la kun dga' bos/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa dang bral bas khyod kyi de ni mi rig pa chen po zhes kyang ma gsungs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor na tshangs pa dang brgya byin sogs 'jig rten gyi lha mthu bo che dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa ro ldan gyi bdag po rdo rje can sogs mchim na khyod kyi ma 'os zhes lhag bsam can gyi khye'u dag sun phyung bar ma mdzad mod/des na rang gi rten 'brel bzang po'i bsgrigs phyogs bgyis pa'i khong yus kha ru 'tshang ba'i zhu ba tshig sbyor ma mkhas pa tsam byung na chos dbyings tshom 'khrungs med pa mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen/ zhes gsol ba 'debs pa la dge ba'i dbugs dbyung bzang po stsal du gsol/ khams nas yong ba'i don chos sha stag sgrub rgyu la 'gro ba'i brlag thabs kho na byas so phebs par dbus gtsang dus zing gyi skabs nas da lta la 823

thug gi bar bstan dang bstan 'dzin la sman pa'ismon 'dun las gzhan med tshul kha sang tshes brgyad nyin zhu chung zhig phul ba'i nang du yang gsal gshis 'dir rgyas par 'bul ma spobs/ mdo don snying por phran rang ngos nas ni/ gong sa rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa mchog la gus zhabs zhus pa las ngan thabs kyi bya ba rmi lam du ma spyod zhes kha seng sngon du zhus pa las da gsar du ni bka' 'dri ci tsam gnang yang 'bul rgyu med nges yin/ gzhan gyi ni rang nyid mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku bsgrub 'dod yin kyang / de ma thob nas da lta yid ngal bzhin par gnas na mngon shes lnga ma thob bzhin du/ 'di'i 'di byas so zhes 'chi ba'i srog la bab kyang smra bar mi nus shing / don du yang med nges lags pas de la chos dbyings tshom 'khrungs med pa mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen zhes brgya phrag du ma'i bar du gsol ba 'debs so/ /so sor dkon mchog las 'bras dpang gzhag dgos tshul phebs pa/bdag byis pa nas da lta la thug gi bar las 'bras kyi 'dor len rags pa ni ci nus su 'bad de byas/dus snyigs dbang gi nyes byas phra mo ni shugs kyi gos kyi 'dug kyang bshags sdom dang / gtso bor yang dag nyid la yang ltos/ /yang dag mthong na nyes pa dag /zhes pa der 'jog khul yin/ /bye brag bka' 'dri snga phyi phebs pa'i zhu ngag dang yi ger phul ba kun rdzun zog cung zad kyis kyang ma bslad pa yin pas dkon mchog gsum dgongs pa khrel ba'i rgyu ni nam yang mi bdog nges can lags/ 'on kyang yul chos kyi tshig gi brjod pa ma dag pa/ mi gsal ba/ mi mdzes pa mchis pa la ni brtse chen chos kyi dbyings nas tshom 'khrungs med par gsol ba 'debs bzhin pa'o/ /'di lta bdag la bka' 'dri phebs pa yang / ston pa'i rgyal tshab 'phags pa 'od srung gi kun dga' bo bco bas spyos pa'i nus pas 'phags pa'i dgra bcom pa la bkod pa bzhin bdag gi sems kyi sgrib pa yongs su sbyangs nas byang chub mchog gi sa la myur du 'god pa'i byed las can du mthong ba yi snying nas dga' 'gu sim pa bskyed bzhin mchis pa yang rang gi gnas tshul du gsol ba'o/ /bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i bzhin ras la/ /ltar snang dri ma'i skyon gyi gos srid che/ /yin lugs tshig gi khrus chu 'dis dkrus tshe/ /gzur gnas me long ngos su mdzes snang byas/ /zhes gangs can sa'i thig le rgyal po'i pho brang nas bka' lung gser gyi me tog bzang pos byab pa'i tshe rang gi yin lugs lhug par gsol ba'i shis tshig lha gos bzang pos bcibs nas phral du phul ba chos dbyings zab mo'i dbyings su 'jug pa nas thugs rje chen pos nam yang mi bskyud pa'i phebs 'os kyang skal ldan shing rta'i rgyun bzhin chad pa med pa stsol ba ci nas kyang mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen sarba maṅga lo bha wan+tu/bal yul yam bu'i blon 'bangs la za 'og phug nas sa sprul lo/ /oṃ swāsti/ na mo gu ru we/ 824

dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i dpal/ /o rgyan mtsho skyes pad+ma bde chen gling / /bdag gi spyi bo'i rgyan du rtag tu rol/ /byang chub go 'phang brnyes kyang gtang 'os min/ /'di na gangs can bod yul mi yi rigs/ /bud+dha mārga dzo ki rgyal khams par/ /bal yul rgyal po'i blon po blo gros can/ /yid kyi bshes gyur de yi 'di skad lo/ /khyod la mkho ba'i yo byad ci 'os pa/ /bal po'i rgyal khams 'di nas gtang ngo zhes/ /tshig gi tam bu ra brgyud dngas ba yi/ /sor mos bskul ba'i snyan tshig spyir yang legs//'on kyang bdag ni mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don/ /gtan bde byang chub go 'phang bsgrub pa la/ /'di snang zang zing dgos pa 'ga' ma mchis/ /de yi mtshan nyid cung zad 'dir bshad na/ /bal po'i yul der bzo rigs mkhas pa yis/ /bskrun pa'i lha sku'i 'byung khung yin lags kyang / /bdag ni rang shar lha sku brten brten nas/ /gser zangs tsan dan sku la do gal med/ /de bzhin bal yul rig byed 'byung ba'i gnas/ /brda' sprod sngon brjod glegs bam mang na yang / /bdag ni gzhom med sgra la blo 'jug pas/ /tha snyad glegs bam dag gis dgos pa med/ /'phags pa'i yul dang nye bas ka shi'i ras/ /dbang po'i gzhu 'dra bal yul nas byung yang / /bdag ni khrel yod ngo tsha'i gos bzang la/ /smon las shing bal ras kyi 'dod pa med/ /bod du dkon pa'i sman mchog bal po'i yul/ /mang mod bdag ni sdug bsngal sel ba'i sman/ /dam pa chos kyi bdud rtsi brten brten nas/ /bal yul la sgo'i sman la smon dgos med/ /gzhan gyur bal po'i yul nas zangs lcags spyad/ /skye bo phal la nyer mkho 'byung mod kyang / /bdag ni 'dod byung chog shes rnam pa des/ /zangs lcags mkhar ba'i rdzas la skyug mer brgyab/ /'bras dang ka ra bu ram sran ma sogs/ /bal po'i yul mi rnams kyi kha zas kyang / /bdag ni ngan ngon srog 'tshos chog shes pas/ /mngar zhim zas la 'dod zhen rdul tsam med/ /bya dang ri dwags spu ris ngo mtshar can/ /gsung snyan dus tshod 'dzin shes gnas skabs su/ /mtshar bar srid kyang rmi lam gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /yang dag don la 'dod zhen rdul tsam med/ /des na bal po'i yo byad ngo mtshar yang / /zhen med rnal 'byor pa la dgos pas dben/ /'dod chung chog shes ldan pa 'phags pa'i nor/ /'di'i kho bo rtag tu phyug par gnas/ /'on kyang bal yul grub pa'i gnas yin pas/ /bdag la bya ba bgyid 'os 'ga' mchis pa/ kha cig grub mod kha cig da dung ni/ /'phags yul skad du su yam bhu rtsu ta/ /gangs can rnams kyi 'phags pa shing kun zhes/ /deng dus zhig gso skabs su bab mthong bas/ /rgya bal bod yul kun gyi bde thabs su/ /rang 'dod med pa'i zhabs tog bgyid snyam la/ /bal yul rje 'bangs spyi'i bsod nams kyi/ /snga sor 'phros pa'i dus su don ma smin/ /da cha bal po'i 'dzin ma la 'khod pa'i/ /rā dza ka shing blo dang ldan gyur pas/ /shing kun mchod rten zhig gso legs grub nas/ /bsod nams tshad 825

med thob par 'gyur ro kye/ /phyogs der bdag gi 'dod pa de tsam ste/ /gzhan gyur lhag pa'i bsam pas yang 'di lta/ /ris med 'gro ba bde zhing skyid pa dang / /rgyal po phan tshun rtag tu mdza' zhing gshim/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas byed cing / /'gro kun thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam/ /bzang por gzhug par 'dod pa'i gdung sems las/ /rang nyid tshe 'di'i zas nor gos kyi ched/ /snyan par grags pa'i gtam la don gnyer ba/ /nam yang ma mchis de shan+ta ri pa/ kha ba can gyi dzo ki'i mtshan nyid de/ /bal po rgyal blon rnams kyi shes par 'tshal/ /gang zhig bdag mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba/ /mtha' dag ring po mi thog byang chub kyi/ /lam bzang la zhugs 'khor ba'i sgo bcad nas/ /rtag tu zhi ba g.yung drung de brnyes shog /zhes bal po yi rje blon spyi dang bye brag mdun na 'don chen po rnams la gangs can ri bo'i khongs su skyes pa'i dzo ki de shan+ta ri pas ched du dkar po'i lo rgyal gyi zla ba'i tshes bzang por bsring pa sarba maṅga lo/rnam 'dren 'phags mchog sprul pa'i sku la/ rgyal kun ye shes mtsho klong du/ /tshad med snying rje'i pad+ma dkar/ /srid zhi yongs grol phyag rgya can/ /'phags gyur de yi zhabs stegs ngogs/ /'dir gnas thos mtshor 'jug pa la/ /bsam pa'i gru rdzing ma sman cing / /yang dag 'jog pa'i nor bu gang / /thob rlom ded dpon ngang tshul can/ /sngon goms gser gyis zar bu la/ /sbyangs stobs 'phrog byed tsar mas g.yogs/ /ma smad spobs pa'i sor mo yi/ /rgyud bskul shugs 'byung ngag 'di gsol/ /khyod ni bskal mang pha rol nas/ /byang chub sems bskyed sa bon de/ /tshogs gnyis sher gyi yongs dkrun pas/ /deng dus yongs 'du dbang por grub/ /sngon gom bag chags mthu bzang po/ /nam yang yol ba med pa yis/ /ris med chos tshul rgya mtsho la/ /spyan yangs khyed las cis mi bsngags/ /'phags rnams chos mig rdul bral ba/ /thob pas chos tshul mtha' yas kun/ /chu klung rgya mtshor 'jug pa bzhin/ /rgyal ba'i chos dbyings la 'jug par/ /rgyal bas yongs su bsngags gsung bzhin/ /mgon khyed skye ba'i 'phreng ba kun//rnam par dag pa'i chos tshul rnams/ /gcig tu 'dzin par mdzad 'di rmad/ /dam pa khyod kyang dges pa yis/ /yang yang bdag gi gtam gleng zhing / /bdag kyang khyed la 'gu thob nas/ /dga' ba'i sems kyi gcig tu dkar/ /des na shul lam ring po yis/ /cung zad skal yang phan tshun yid/ /zla 'od ut+pal dkar po bzhin/ /chos mthun tshogs pa gcig tu byas/ /mgon khyod sbas pa'i yul ljongs der/ /bstan dang 'gro la phan pa yi/ /lhag pa'i bya ba mdzad pa
