la/ /bdag kyang snying nas yid rang thob/ /nges kyang gangs can dbus 'gyur du/ /skyes mchog bsod nams ma smad pas/ /'dun par chos bzhin spyod pa yis/ /bag yangs zhum pa med par gnas/ /de ni ring po ma yin par/ /mdo khams 'dzin ma'i khyon 826

yangs por/ /rgyal bstan bya ba bgyid dgos kyi/ /yid kyi shing rta mchog de mchis/ /des na re zhig 'tsho ba na/ /phan tshun dge legs bzang po yi/ /'brel pa gong nas gong 'phel du/ /smon no dpal ldan 'gro ba'i mgon/ /de skad ma bcos gnyug ma'i tshig /gang shar lhug par spel pa'i gtam/ /yin lugs drang por brjod pa'i ngag /'di ko dam pa dgyes pa'i 'phrin/ /sa spyod 'og min 'tshur bu yi/ /gtsug lag rtse nas rgyal khams pa/ /gdod ma nyid nas grub pa yi/ /rig pa 'dzin de'i li khi rta/ /sarba maṅga lo/gang la sprul sku la/ sa yi dkyil 'khor mnga' brnyes dbang phyug che/ /bsod nams bye bas gtam pa ral pa'i khrod/ /khyod zhabs zla ba tshes pas mngon brgyan te/ /gangs can lha yi lhar gyur mgon de'i zhabs/ /rgyal bstan gzhung mang rgya mtshor 'jug pa la/ /'jigs med blo gros gru rdzing legs thob nas/ /thos bsam nor bu bsgom pa'i bsam 'phel gang / /thob rlom ded dpon de'i zhu ba'i mchid/ /khyed ni grub rig lha yi rdzing bu ru/ /thog med ye shes rlung shugs kyi spyod kyang / /mos ldan gdul bya'i yid kyi rdzing bu ru/ /gang sku zla ris gsal char 'di rmad byung / /gdod nas dge ba'i chos khams yid bzhin snying / /tshogs gnyis dge ba'i byi dor gyis dag la/ /don gnyis lhun grub sa dbang rgyal mtshan rtser/ /bkod tshe 'gro ba'i re 'dod cis mi bskang / /ris med grub mtha' 'byung khams du ma'i bcud/ /nges don snying po 'chi ba med pa'i chab/ /gang gi bde blag btung ba'i nus pa yis/ /khams gsum 'khor los mi 'jig khyod rtag rgyal/ /lag na pad+mo'i zhing khams bsil ldan ljongs/ /'chang thub ri dwags sde rigs du ma'i dbus/ /sa dbang gang gi ri bo'i rtse mo ru/ /mngon brjid sing ha khyed las gzhan su zhig /stobs ldan go be la yi gtsug tor rtser/ /'phags mchog chos kyi rgyal po bsti zhes yang / /lnga bdo'i mtha' 'dir sa skyong chen po yi/ /gtsug na khyed brjid 'di dang rnam dbye ci/ /bdag cag bod chen shar dang la stod lho/ /skye ba'i yul gyi tha dad snying skal yang / /yid kyi ngang pa sa skyong rdzing bu ru/ /gcig tu dkar bas 'jug 'di e ma mtshar/ /des na khyod ni grub pa chen po'i sa/ /brnyes par grags bzhin don du'ang de lta na/ /skye 'chi spros pa'i mtshan ma spang zin mod/ /'on kyang 'gro ba'i snang ngor cir yang ston/ /deng dus gdul byar gyur rnams skyo bskyed phyir/ /cung zad brnyes pa'i tshul ston gyur ro zhes/ /chos kyi rgyal po dpal gyi mgur nas ste/ /de yi bdag blo ngal ba'i lam du drangs/ /des na lhag bsam dag pa ku mud ta/ /chu shel nor bu zla ba gangs kyi ri/ /pad+ma dkar po snyem med rtsa lag bzhin/ /gcig tu dkar bas dge ba'i rten 'brel du/ /brtan bzhugs tshigs bcad la ka'i rdzas dang bcas/ /lho phyogs sa'i thig le 'thung spyod 'dabs/ /gnyal smad grub pa'i bsti gnas dge ri nas/ /dpal chen rig pa 'dzin pa de yis phul/ /rten 'brel 'di'i mthu'i mgon khyed bde ldan 827

mgon/ /ji bzhin gangs can bde ba'i rtsa lag tu/ /bskal pa'am ni bskal pa las lhag par/ /'tsho gzhes zhabs zung brtan pa'i rgyur gyur cig /zhes rab myos lcags pho rta yi lo smin drug zla ba'i yar ngo rnam par dge ba'i tshes bzang po la phul ba'i zhu yig sarba maṅga lo/rdo rje brag rig 'dzin chen po lcags rta lha sa nas/ swāste/ gang gi gnyen gshim thugs kyi yongs bcing zhing / /dag pa'i snang bas bskul ba'i tshig bcad gsung / /rnam dkar reg byas sbol te phyag rgya yis/ /re kha nyams med son la 'gu ba thob/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos mtsho skyes rdo rje yi/ /ring lugs gcig gyur rdo rje'i mdud pa des/ /phan tshun yid dbang gcig tu 'ching byas nas/ /rnam par dka' ba'i lang tsho 'di ko rmad/ /'dir gnas bzod nas grub pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /gu ru'i lung gi pho nyar rlom pa yang / /da lta lha ldan rgyal po'i pho brang 'dab/ /rim gnyis dge sbyor gong nag gong 'phel mchis/ /'on kyang las snang 'gog pa med pa yis/ /gtad med sgyu 'dra brag cha lta bu tshig /rgyal gsung 'khor lo'i gsum pa nges don gyis/ /mthar thug khyod kyi smra ba mi 'thad dang / /mnga' rir skye mang srog la mi 'jigs pa/ /byams pa'i sbyin pa byas 'di ci zhes dang / /ris med rgyal ba'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin la/ /lhag par bya ba byas 'di gnong ngo sogs/ /de 'dra ltar snang tshig gi rgyud mang nyid/ /chen po'i sor mo'i bskul te thon no zhes/ /rab dga'i snyan pa'i glu ru sgrogs pa des/ /bdag blo dge ba 'phel ba'i grogs su song / /gangs can rje bo mchog dang 'phrin las pa/ /kun kyang mthun pa'i tshig gi me tog gang / /legs so'i rnga sgra sgrogs dang chab gcig par/ /rig 'dzin rgyal khams pa la byab skabs lags/ /bdag ni chos bzhin spyod pa'i mal sa ru/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs dro 'jam gos kyi klubs/ /gnas lugs lta ba'i bza' bas zhe kha kheng / /lam khyer gnye 'bol la brten bde mor mchis de bzhin theg brgyad lta ba'i gyen phyur brtser/ /rnam par rgyal ba a ti'i khang bzang du/ /rnam kun mchog ldan lha mo dpal 'phreng la/ /rang rig dbang pos dga' 'gur spyod bzhin gnas/ /de skad nang lugs lhug pa'i gnas tshul nyid/ /byang bdag rig 'dzin mchog gi sprul pa'i sku/ /dgyes pa'i slad du 'phrul snang rgyal khams nas/ /phul ba 'dis kyang legs lam gong 'phel shog sarba maṅga lo/mkhas grub chen po lo ri sprul pa'i sku la stsal ba/ rdo rje'i slob ma dam pa'i yang srid mos kyis mchog gi brtul shugs can gnas lnga rig pa gang gi sku'i ga la bar/ nye lam nang lugs stabs bder phul ba der sku'i 'tsho gzhes dwangs shing nges don snying po'i nyams len gong nas gong du 'phel ba dang chab gcig bla ma'i mos gus stobs su gyur zhing 'di snang zhen log dgos med rgyud la skye ba yi gdod nas rang byung grub pa'i gnas chen ho ru ka yi da lar bsgrub pa'i sa sde btsug ste bzhugs pa nas tshig 828

dang don du legs pa'i ngag gi sbyor ba dbyangs can mgrin par bzhugs pa'i rang gzugs can la nye dge zhing legs pa'i rten dang bcas rtags kyi ro kha nyams pa med pa 'dir son pas snying thag pa nas rjes su yi rang ba'i gsos su thob/ snyigs ma lnga bdo ba dus kyi mthar thug 'di lta bu'i skabs su nges 'byung zhen log bla ma'i mos gus srog phur gtsugs shing gnas lugs don gyis nyams rtogs rgyud la skyes pa nyin mo'i skar ma dang mtshungs par gyur kyang nyid ni sngon gyi las 'phro bzang pos gzhi 'thing smon lam bzang po'i mtshams sbyar mtshan ldan dam pas zin gnas lugs kyi nyams rtogs skye grub pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba 'di lta bu ni bka' brgyud gong ma'i gdung 'tshob par gyur zhing don gnyis lhun grub kyi btsas chen por gyur pa 'di lta la de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang slob mar bcas pas yongs su bsngags pa'i gnas su gdon mi za ba nyid du gyur la/ de bzhin bdag gi ming kho na la brten gsol ba 'debs pa ni nyid rang dag snang gar bur gyur pa'i rang gzugs su nges kyang bdag ni so so skye bo dang po'i rang bzhin du gyur pa yi yid brtser bar 'dug rung / sngags rgyud nas sems nyid chos kyi sku ru ngo sprod par byed pa po rtsa ba'i bla ma gang yin pa de ni sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i byin rlabs can du rdo rje sems dpas bsngags par mdzad na bden pa de yi dge legs su 'gyur bar sems/ spyir gsang sngags kyi chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba ni bla ma'i mos gus kho na la rags las pa thugs la mnga' ltar lags/de yang sems nyid ngo bo brjen par mthong yang de yi rtsal rdzogs pa'i ched du rlung rdo rje'i bzlas pa la gnad du dril na shin tu legs pa ste 'bru gsum gnas pa aḥdang sbyar ba gsar rnying gnyis kar shas che yang rang re rtsa ba'i man ngag las ni r+ghaṃ yig gnas pa dang sbyar ba gtso bor byed pa lags/ 'on kyang 'di'i man ngag sngar nas kho bos byas pa 'than 'thun yod lags/ lhag tu 'di lo kun mkhyen si tu zhabs nas bskul bar mdzad nas mdo don gsal bar byas pa'i yi ge zhig yod pa slar 'bul thub pa zhu/ bsam pa lhun grub kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi gzhung 'di rtsa 'bul zhus shing / dbang mchog ni rig 'dzin rol pa rdo rje yi bla ma rgyal ba 'dus pa'i dbang bskur dang shin tu mthun zhing de la lha dbang gi skabs su lha bcu gsum po bsam pa lhun grub kyi tshig gi bskur ba dang bgrangs 'phreng gi skabs su sngags tshan bcu gsum gyi bzlas lung sbyin pa tsam las gzhan khyad par med/ de ltar sngar yi ger btab pa ni med/spyir bdag ni bka' ma dang gter rnying kho la lhag par dga' ba zhig lags/ nyams len nus na gter chos gsar rnying ji snyed pa 'di lta la/ bdag rang gi mthong snang dang nyam shar la cer cer po ye nas byed du ma 'dod pa yi phal che ba lan tshwa chu la thim pa ltar rang gi lus la rang nyid nub par gyur pa lags/ de lta yang bsam pa lhun grub kyi chos skor 'di smon lam gtad rgya rgyas nas der bskur ba 829

lags pas rang gis nyams su len pa dang gzhan la 'chad spel sogs ci bde bar byos shig bzlas pa'i dmigs pa'i skabs su zla dkyil ril mo dang / leb chags dmigs gsal can so so dang gzhan gang bdes 'thus la/ /dmigs gsal can ni dper na rdo rje sems dpa' rgyan gcig gi sgrub thabs su ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar zla ba leb chags kyi dbus su rdo rje rtsa lnga pa 'grengs thabs su gnas pa'i lte bar zla ba ril mo'i dbus su hūṃ yig la o badz+ra sa twa hūṃ bkod pa lta bu dang yang dag zla gam gcig pa'i gzhung du nyi zla ga'u kha sbyor lta bu'i dbus su rin chen zur brgyad la rdo rje phyed pa'i lte bar zla ba leb chags la r+ghaṃ yig bkod pas mtshon de ltar rnam grangs du mas mtha' gcig gi nges bzung mi nus la/ gsang sngags gsar ma'i gzhung bde dgyes kyi man ngag khyad par ba kha cig tu rang byin gyis brlabs pa'i dmigs rim gyi rtsa ba dran pa gcig par ni zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dmar skya leb chags sen mo'i khyon tsam la shin tu dkar ba'i thig le nyung kar tsam zhig bsgom nas sems ma yengs par gtad de yun ring du bsgom na rlung sems dhu tir chub ste spyan dang mngon shes 'char ba gsung pa sogs dang /yang skabs 'gar zla ba ril por bsgom pa'i steng du thig le yung kar tsam bsgom pa sogs spyir gtang dmigs gsal gyi dbye bas byed pa lags/ thugs bzhed bzhin gsol 'debs kyang bris nas phul mchis shing der bzhugs ring bsgrub pa'i yon rje btsun 'gro ba'i mgon po'i thugs rje'i mdzod nas 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung ba gzhir bcas kyang yul dbang gi 'bru cha shin tu dkon pa'i stabs de la thug phan thogs res chen pos gung sku zhabs su lo gsum gyi ring dpon g.yog gnyis kyi gsol phog su hreng nas blang chog pa'i bka' 'dzin 'di bzhin bskur yod pas 'bru gang dgos de nas blangs lugs dang / yang slad mar gnas chen gzhan du bzhugs par gyur tshe yang phan thogs gang drag bgyid 'dun byed la/ gang cir slad nas thugs dam dge sbyor gyi rim pa yar ngo'i zla ba ltar gong 'phel ngos gsung 'os kyang skal ldan shing rta'i bgrod pa lta bur 'tshal/ zhes rten lha gos rnam par dkar ba dang /kar+sha pa ni nyi ma'i grangs ldan sngags mdud dang bcas zla tshes dge bar sgrub pa'i bsti gnas ra la za 'og phug nas spel ba sarba maṅga lo/ dge'o/ /bkra bzang pa la/ swāste/ sngags rigs mngon par mtho ba'i spo/ /grub pa'i gdung gyur lta na sdug /dam pa khyod ni mig stong can/ /dam pa rdo rje 'dzin de'i ngogs/ /gzhung lugs nags rlung stug po na/ /rnam dpyod ldan lang tshos rab myos shing / /myong ba'i ghi wang 'dzag gyur pa/ /thabs kyi thal ka can de'i mchid/ /khyod ni sngon bsags gser gyi gzhir/ /legs byas bdud rtsi nyer bskyed pa/ /smon lam dag pa yongs 'du'i shing / /dge ba'i 'bras bu g.yur de rmad/ /pad+ma ka ra gdeng can dbang / / 830

gang bde'i thugs rje chu khur can/ /legs par bsngags pa sprin gyi sgra/ /shis brjod me tog khyod la 'thor/ /gang khyed dam pa'i bag chags mchog /dus bu sad par gyur pa yis/ /bla ma'i mos gus snying stobs brtas/ /des ni rtag tu dge bar nges/ /don des phyi ma'i dus dag kyang / /bdag cag nam yang 'du 'brel med/ /lhan gcig rnga yab dpal ri tu/ /tshom bu gcig tu me re re/ /rtag tu 'tshog par snying dkyil nas/ /smon lam 'debs mchis 'grub par nges/ /skal bzang rdo rje'i slob ma dang / /'brel bzang byang chub bar 'grogs shog /ces bod yul kun tu mi yongs su grags pa kaḥthog sprul sku zhes bzod ma nyid kyi rnal 'byor pa tshe dbang nor bus rang gi slob ma bkra bzang zhabs drung la ched du brjod pa'i li kā ra maṅga lo/me lug lor skyid grong 'phags pa wa ti'i sku mdun nas chos rje blo gros chos 'phel la phul ba/ sngon bsags bsod nams shing rta las drangs pa'i/ /legs byas mkha' la ye shes gzi dpung can/ /dri med snying rje'i rang gzugs kyis spras pa/ /skal ldan ku mud gnyen gyur de yi drung / /lags/ deng dus rim gnyis gang 'phel bzhugs nas kyang / /gzhan don skyong bar thos pas rjes yi rang / /mtshams zhu/ phyag bris rten ldan 'bel mchid 'dir 'byor spro/ /bdag gi skye yul chos lugs gang yin zhes/ /dri rmad mdzad cing sba 'phri med dgos zhes/ /rtsal yang rang nyid yon tan ldan bzhin du/ /sbas tshul spyod pa zhig ni ma lags shing / /thos bsam bsgom pas dben pa'i snyoms las mkhan/ /phyogs med rgyal khams gnas bskor pa gcig lags/ /'on rang skye yul mdo khams snang gsum dbus/ /bu 'bor sgang dbus kaḥthog lho yi phyogs/ /o rgyan sbas gnas re khe ljongs gnas yin/ /chos lugs pad+ma'i rjes 'jug rdzogs chen yin/ /da lam dur khrod brgya rtsa 'grim 'dod lags/ /khar sing zhus ltar yang dgon ri chos skor/ /zhu mos mchis rung de kar thugs bral gyis/ /long khyab yod med bka' mchid stsal ba dang / /'ba' ra'i bka' 'bum dkar chags le tshan dang / /phyag chen rnal 'byor bzhi khrid mjal kha zhu/ /chud zos med par 'phral du 'bul lam zhu/ /de skad rten bcas rig sngags 'dzin pas phul/ dge'o/ /bod chen 'bri rgyud re khe ljongs su dran mchog rtsa ba'i bla ma gdan sar mngon par mtho ba'i gzeng bstod phyir du grob 'ja' tham kha mtshal chu'i byugs pa rtsa ba'i bla ma'i 'phrin las la dmigs nas snying thag pa yis gnang ba yang dag pa dpal rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu 'phrin las 'gro 'dul gyis mnga' ris gung thang dang nye ba nas bskur ba mak+ṣa ra sa tai sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāsti/ rab 'byams rgyal ba kun gyi mgrin gcig tu/ /dam chos ston mdzad yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes/ /sngags kyi rdo rje slob dpon khyad par du/ /rang sems chos skur ston mdzad mgon po de/ /sangs rgyas kun mnyam sangs rgyas kun las lhag /sangs rgyas zhing mang tsan dan phye ma yi/ /byab las bla ma'i ba spu'i bu ga gcig /dri bzang chu byug phan yon che zhes pa/ /rgyud sde kun tu tshig don mthun 831

par bsngags/ /des na bdag gi tshe 'dir dkyil 'khor gtso/ /bka' drin mtshungs med pad 'byung bde chen gling / /'jam mgon karma rig 'dzin nyid du nges/ /des na tshe rabs 'dren pa pad 'byung dang / /spyod 'chang dpa' bo nam mkha' snying po yang / /mgon po de dang tha dad yong ye med/ /bdag gi sgo gsum dge bcas de la 'bul/ /bla ma'i sras dang btsun mo bran g.yog yang / /bla ma lta bur blta bar yongs bsngags te/ /des na rang gi rtsa ba'i slob ma nyid/ /gyur yang bla ma'i rigs sras gyur pas na/ /brnyas dang dman pa'i bsam pa yongs gtang zhing / /che thang go sa gzengs bstod gyur pa yis/ /rang gi yun ring mi lo bco lnga'i bar/ /nyi bzhin rgya bal bod yul kun khyab pa/ /rin chen rmad byung gu ru'i mtshan brda' can/ /pad+ma rā ga bzhus pa'i khu ba nyid/ /lan brgya'i nying khu lta bu dbang gi mdog /nyi ma 'char kha'i 'od dang rab 'dres pa/ /snod mchog zla ba chu shel las byas bzhin/ /sna tshogs dar gyi cod pan klub bzhin du/ /'phrog byed dbang po ji 'dra gzi byin can/ /yid 'ong sgrom bur 'gying bzhin pa 'di dang / /sngags skyes blo gros snang ba ma rnying pa'i/ /lang tsho rgyas pa'i nā ri ma ṇi sār/ /'di yang bde chen ye shes skyed pa dang / /rigs kyi phreng ba spel slad sbyin bgyis na/ /rten 'brel bzang po kun tu rgyas bzhin ngang / /phrin las rgyun ring bar du gnas pa'i phyir/ /dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma 'gro ba'i mgon/ /tshe dbang nor bu 'phrin las 'gro 'dul gyis/ /skal ldan bsod nams chos skyong dpal ldan la/ /snying nas brtse bas bka'i gnang ba dang / /chab gcig kon 'ja' lhag bsam kyis sbyin mthus/ /dge legs dpal mchog lang tsho rtag rgyas shog /ces rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dran mchog dngas ma'i mgon po pad 'byung bde ba chen po'i sar bzhugs pa'i rigs sras bsod nams chos skyong dpal ldan la kon 'ja' tham kha dmar po rang gi yun du spyad pa dang bcas bstab pa'i skabs su mnga' ris gung thang dang nye ba dga' brgyud mtsho gling nas dpal gdong chu bya smin drug zla ba'i yar tshes dga' ba dang por dpal rig pa 'dzin pas ched du bskur ba kun tu dge bar gyur cig sarba maṅga lo/zha lu dge slong la/ swāsti/ rgyal bstan bsam 'phel rin chen gang / /rnyed par dka' ba yang shes te/ /rin chen gser phye cha shas nas/ /bsags pa bzhin la gcig car du/ /sde snod mtha' dag nos pa'i yul/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir dka' bar 'gyur/ /des na sangs rgyas rab gsal gyis/ /rnam sprul bu ston rin chen tog /gang gi ring lugs las 'ong pa'i/ /chos tshul ji snyed 'dus pa der/ /rgyal ba rnams ni thabs mkhas pas/ /gdul bya dang mthun 'dul byed sku/ /cir yang ston par mos byas nas/ /dag pa'i snang bas lam bzang por/ /dogs pa med pa'i shing rta la/ /brten nas chos rgyun tshang pa'i chud/ /sngon bsags skal ba bzang po can/ /bdag 'dra shing rta bcu pa yi/ /skal dang mtsham par yongs 'joms pa/ /'di yang legs byas nyid du gyur/ /gang zhig chos kyi 'brel pa ni/ /'brel pa kun 832

gyis mchog dam par/ /bden pa'i ljags ldan des gsung na/ /'di yang don ldan phul du byung / /nges pa'i don la chos thams cad/ /sgyu ma ltar yang rgyal bas gsungs/ /de bzhin gang la yang cher cher po/ /zhen med blo bde rnyed pa 'di/ /bcings grol las 'das sems kyi gshis/ /dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma'i mthu/ /cha shas rtogs pas blo bde'i gdeng / /ji bzhin brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor lags/ /'on kyang rgyu 'bras rten 'brel chos/ /khyad du mi gsod dang blang ba/ de yang gnyis med gzigs pas gsungs/ /des na tshigs bcad gcig nyan pa'i/ /yul yang 'phags par mos byas te/ /rnam kun bsnyen pa'i gnas gsung na/ /bdag kyang tshe rabs thams cad du/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma mnyes gyur na/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor mnar med mes/ /gdung yang bzod pas len nus shog /yan lag bla ma mchog dang dman/ //tha na tshigs bcad rkang pa gcig /zhus par gyur pa de dag kun/ /dgyes pa'i las la sgo gsum gyi/ /sdig med dge spyod khyad par du/ /shes rab mchog gi dgyes byed shog /de skad tshigs su bcad pa yis/ /zhu yig 'di ni rgyal khams pa/ /rang gzhan grub mtha' rgya mjo'i gnas/ /legs smra spobs pa can de'i phul/ sarba maṅga lo/chos rje kun bzang dbang po la phul ba/ o swāsnyi/ mi shig dngas ma'i ngo bo nyid/ /stong gzugs phyag rgyas nyer 'khyud pa/ /e waṃ bde ba chen po'i dngos/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs pad du/ /gang gi bka' 'bangs tha shas pa/ /rgyal ba'i sras su rlom gyur ni/ /yul kun myul ba'i rnal 'byor gzugs/ /sgrol mgon 'phrul des 'di skad gsol/ /e ma mgon po mchog khyed nyid/ /gru 'dzin bdag las gzhan ci zhig /des na 'khor ba ji srid du/ /'gro don ched du rtag bzhugs nges/ /'on te bdag sogs gdul bya'i ngor/ /skal ldan 'gro ba 'dren slad du/ /phyogs der zhabs pad rdo rje bzhin/ /brtan gsol 'debs kyi grub mdzod kyi/ /zhu ba'i snying po de lags kyi/ /nam yang ma dor thugs rje can//gzhan yang bdag rmongs nyon mongs pa'i/ /dbang bsgyur sgo gsum las rnams kun/ /mthol zhing gsol tshe 'phags khyod kyi/ /dag gtsang dbugs dbyung cis mi mdzad/ /bdag ni ring por mi thogs par/ /dus kyi 'khor lo 'grub gyur pa'i/ /thugs 'dun smon pas ma dor bar/ /yang nas yang du mdzod gcig kye/ /de skad kaḥthog sprul sku yis/ /shugs 'byung dad pas glu ru 'bul/ /zhes kong yul shing lo'i tshal nas nag po spyod pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i sprul pa dpal tshe dbang nor bus phul ba'i zhu yig bkra shis par gyur cig dge'o/ /ri bo gangs can gyi khongs kyi chos kyi rgyal po stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba chen po gang gi sku zhabs su phul ba'i zhu yig dpyid kyi dpal mos bgrang pa'i ko ki la yi klu dbyangs zhes 833

bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ swāste/ legs byas bsod nams bgrang yas pas/ /ma lus pa can rang stobs kyi/ /dbang bsgyur mnga' thang rgyas pa'i bdag /mi yi lha mchog zhabs stegs ngogs/ /tshe rabs du mar rgyal ba'i dbang / /pad+ma ka ras rjes bzung zhing / /ma nor rdo rje theg lam gyis/ /rnal 'byor phran bu de'i zhu yig /swā sti/ kun bzang rnam par ji bzhin bsod dpal thugs bskyed rin chen 'byung gnas las/ /kun nas dge ba'i mdzad pa nam yang nyams med lhun po mchog tu brjid/ /kun la khyab pa'i 'phrin las stobs ldan snang byed go la yang por spyod/ /kun tu mngon mtho nges legs rgyas gyur dbang phyug che de'i zhabs stegs ngogs/ /'dir gnas lugs gnyis 'khos kyi spros pas shin tu dben pa nyid gyur kyang / /dam pa'i rnam thar slob la cig tu zhen pa'i bya bral dā ri dra/ /phyogs kun myul ba dzo ka'i gzugs 'chang surba'i phyogs skyes chos smra ba/ /phran bu pa des shis pa'i suju khyor gang ur+ṇa'i rgyan bcings nas/ /gus pa'i mchid gsol yin lugs lhug par mgrin pa'i sbyor las skyes/ /'di lta gcam bu ma yin bdag blo'i 'char ba'i ngang tshul nyid du ko/ /nyid ni bgrang yas bskal pa du mar bsod nams tshogs chen bsags pa'i mthus/ /gsung gi rdo rje 'od dpag med pa zhing 'di'i 'gro 'dren pad+ma 'byung / /gang gi rjes bzung bzang po'i smon lam rgya mtshor spyod pa'i rang gzugs ni/ /chos kyi yul dbus 'dzam gling spyi phud gangs can skye dgu'i dpal dam pa/ /sa chen ma lus bde bar skyong bar dge bcu'i khrims kyi 'khor los bsgyur/ /rgyal bstan rab 'byams srid zhu byed pa'i chos kyi rgyal por yongs su grub/ /kye ma zas gtsang sras kyi bstan 'dzin lnga brgya phrag bcu tha ma'i dus nye bas/ /'dzam gling dum bu shī ti'i lha yul bye ba dgu bcu rtsa drug gang / /chos kyi 'byung gnas 'phags yul lags kyang shar dang lho nub yul gling phran/ /cha shas tsam min phal che li tsā bi dang mu stegs grub mtha'i nyid kyi khyab/ /ma hā tsi na yang ni phal che du ru ka dang zin shing gyur/ rgyal khab cha na dge 'dun cung zad gnas mod de yang nyi tsher spyod/ /de bas yul gling ji snyed cha kun thar pa'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan/ /mi snang mun par spyod pas skye bo'i tshogs kun dge ba'i 'bras bu dman/ /de lta na yang yul drug dbus 'gyur bsil ldan ri bos yongs gtam pa/ /bho ṭa zhes grags byang chub sems dpa'i rigs kyi skye bos bzung ba'i ljongs/ /'di lta rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag lag na pad+ma dkar 'dzin gyis/ /bdag gir bzung ba'i mthu las 'di na rgyal ba'i bstan pa ma lus pa/ /snang mod de yang rin chen chos dag dkon la rtag tu 'tshe mang bas/ /bstan pa'i ngo bo cha shas tsam las dus kyi sde mtshan nyung ngur gyur/ /rtsod ldan dbang gi bstan pa nyid kyang gang zag blo yis dri mas brtsod/ /mi rnams kun kyang dmu rgod shin tu gdul dka' las la rab tu g.yo/ /de ltar thub bstan tha ma snyigs ma lnga yi spyod pa'i dus 'di ru/ / 834

rdzogs ldan bzang po'i dga' ston bkyed slad rgyal ba kun gyis thugs rje'i shugs/ /gcig tu byas nas rgyal bstan gyen du 'degs par byed pa'i stobs chen gyad/ /mchog khyed gru 'dzin nas sam rnga yab gling nas ljongs 'di'i dpal bzang po/ /thugs bskyed smon lam dus las g.yel med 'gro ba'i bsod nams mgron mchog tu/ /legs par byon te sa yi dkyil 'khor ma lus rang stobs dpung pa yis/ /nyer spyod legs nyes bden brdzun shan 'byed gtang 'dzin sngon rabs rgyal ba'i srol/ /ji bzhin bzang pos skye dgu dbang med dge bcu'i khrims la bkod byas shing / /khyod kyi bsod nams zil gyi mtha' yi rgyal po kun kyang zhi bar spyod/ /hor sogs snyigs ma'i dpung gi dregs pa'i tshogs kyang phyogs 'dir byol bar byed/ /mtha' ljongs rnams su rgyal po rgyal phran ji snyed skye bo g.yul dag la/ /rtag par spyod kyang bod yul sa chen khyod khrims kho nas bde bar 'tsho/ /mchog tu 'jig rten kun na 'byung bar dka' zhing ches cher dkon pa ni/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin chen 'di ste ma lus phun tshogs dpal/ /dge legs kun gyi gzhi rten 'byung gnas byed po srid 'dir rnam kun tu/ /mtshungs pa'i zlas dben de ni dam pa'i chos dang de 'dzin de lags pa/ /gang de snyigs ma'i dus su gyur yang rgyal bstan rdzogs ldan skabs ji bzhin/ /bsti stang bgyid las 'dul mdo mngon pa thun mong thun min gsang ba sngags/ /ma 'dres nyid gsal rtsod pa yang min za 'og dar bzhin 'bral la mdzes/ /ngang tshul bzang po de ltas gangs can rgyas par 'tsho 'di khyed kyi drin/ /kye ho/ rin sel snying po can gyis rgyal ba'i sku gzugs mchod sdong gtsug lag khang / /sa 'dir ji tsam mchis la mchod pa'i 'khor lo rgya chen rgya mtsho'i sprin/ /gzhan du yang ni bha hir dha dang nel pāl la dang de bzhin du/ /ma hā tsi na la sogs rgyal khab gzhan du snang ba'i dkon mchog rten/ /ma lus ji snyed kun la rab dkar mchod pa'i sprin bzang 'phro byed cing / /phu dud ri mor bgyid la g.yel med sngon dus rgyal sras mchog spyod ltar/ /de bzhin rdzogs sangs rgyas dang ho ru ka dpal rnams kyi byin brlabs pa'i/ /gnas chen du ma kun kyang nyid kyi bsod nams mthu yi rgyas par byas/ /e ma/ yongs kyi 'dren pa spyan ras gzigs sprul bla ma chen po bur smrig 'chang / /de bzhin 'phags pa'i sgyu 'phrul skyes bu dam par gyur pa gang 'dir gnas/ /ma lus gtsug gi legs par mchod pa'i srid zhu rtag mdzad rnam dkar gyi/ /'phrin las bzang po gong du bstod pa 'di yang nyid kyi rnam par thar/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu dge 'dun dpung gyur ma lus mchod la g.yel med cing / /gangs can 'dzin ma'i lto na theg chen snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs bzang pos khengs/ /don bsgom rnal 'byor spyod kun dben pa'i ri bor 'tshe med yang dag 'jog /chos mthun gang zag kun gyis blo spang ma zhum rgyab 'di nyid kyi mthu/ /gangs can 'di na grub mtha' ris med kun gyi phun 835

tshogs dpal bzang po/ /ma 'dres rang lugs phan tshun rtsod med bzo bder spyod pa 'di 'dra ba/ /chos kyi rgyal po me dbon ral pa can gyur gshegs pa nas brtsam ste/ /da lta'i bar byon srid 'dzin rgyal po rnams nas dpe zlas dben par gyur/ /deng dus 'di ni mkha' la 'char ba'i zla ba chu snod du ma ru/ /cha shas ma yin lus rdzogs ji bzhin rgyal bstan grub mtha' tha dad par/ /nge/ dang de la lhag bsam phu dud ri mor rgyas gyur phan pa mchog /stsal bar mdzad pa 'di ni 'phags pa'i rnam par nyid las su zhig smra/ /sngon dus bzang po lags kyang tshul 'di zhugs tshe snying stobs can rnams yang / khur gyis lci mod deng sang snyigs ma 'di 'drar ngal ba med pa yis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi 'byung gnas gsung rab rin chen rgya mtsho zhes/ /ring bsrel mchog tu gyur pa chos zhes sde snod gsum dang bzhi pa yis/ /glegs bam rin chen las byas brgya phrag du ma nyid kyang chad med bsgrub/ /grangs med 'char ba'i ma ma bskrun pa las kyang bsod nams 'dzad med spyod/ /rtag tu bklags pa'i chos sgras yang ni srid pa gsum 'di mdzes par byed/ /'brel kun byang chub chu rgyun rgyas mdzad deng dus srid 'dir khyed las su/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir rlabs chen rnam dkar spyod pa de 'drar rgyal dang sras/ /rnams kyi shis pa'i me tog char chen nyid la 'bebs dang lhan gcig tu/ /tshangs dang brgya byin dbang phyug che rnams dga' bas kun tu gar bsgyur zhing / /'jig rten skyong sogs rgyal ba'i bstan bsrung kun kyang phyogs 'dir gus 'dud nges/ /kye ho/ gdul bya skyong phyir legs nyes khrims kyi gtang 'dzin tshar gcod rjes bzung mkhas/ /rgyal bstan lhag par spyod 'di chos rgyal mya ngan med pa'i ngang tshul dran/ /rtsod ldan snyigs ma'i dus 'dir rdzogs ldan bzang po'i dga' ston dpal mtha' dag /mchog tu rgyas par byed 'di rigs ldan drag po'i 'khor lo can du dran/ /de ltar gsol ba 'di yang bsngags 'os bsngags par byed pa sngon dus kyi/ /dam pa'i ring lugs las byung dpal mgon klu dang dpal ldan dpa' bo sogs/ /'phags pa'i sa la bzhugs pa'i mkhas rnams kyis kyang mi yi bdag po che/ /dam par gyur pa rnams la brgya phrag tshig gi mngon par yongs bstod mdzad/ /de phyir nyid kyi rnam thar gcig tu dkar ba'i mdzad pa rgya mtsho las/ /thig pa tsam zhig snying nas yi rang dga' ba'i shugs kyi mgrin nas thon/ /mtha' dag brjod par su yis nus ste ma hā tsi na'i rgyal po ni/ /'jam dpal sprul par smra bzhin bho ṭa'i yul gyi rgyal por gyur pa gang / /rgyal ba'i bstan la lhag par bya ba byed la zla med chos skyong ba/ /'di 'drar snying rje'i bdag de'i thugs rje'i mthu las byung zhes cis mi smra/ /gang zhig snyigs dus 'dul dka' 'dul mdzad 'gro la sman slad rgyal po'i tshul/ /'phags rnams bsam bzhin 'jug pa'i rnam par blo yi gzhal bya nam yang min/ /des na sa yi mnga' bdag mi yi dbang phyug mgon khyed 'gro rnams kyi/ /bde 836

skyid dpal kun bsrung zhing rgyal bstan kun tu rgyas slad ljongs 'di ru/ /'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po dung gi 'jig rten 'di kun skyong gi bar/ /tshangs chen rgyal po'i tshe dang gcig tu byas te bsod nams gzi 'bar sku/ /nam yang gzhom pa mi mnga' rdo rje lhun po ji bzhin g.yo med par/ /mi 'jig sha ra ṇa yi yongs 'degs rtag pa sha shwa ta yi khrir/ /mtha' bzhi'i mi bdag kun gyi pi roḥkhyed kyi tsa ra ṇa yar 'dud/ /zla med kun tu mdzes pa'i go 'phang che mtho dbang phyug 'bum gyi rtser/ /sum brtsen bdag po de dang spun zlar byas te mtha' yas dge ba yi/ /dpal 'byor nam yang nyams med gong nas gong 'phel dkar phyogs dge ba ltar/ /dga' ba ma sim spro ba bde ba 'ba' zhig rol pa'i lang tsho che/ /kun tu bzang por spyod gyur 'khor lo bsgyur rgyal rtsib kyi mu 'khyud bzhin/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i chab srid kun tu rgyas shing yongs su bltas/ /tshul de bzhin du zhabs pad brtan par rtse gcig mos 'dun drag po yi/ /gsol ba 'debs kyi dge ba'i bsam pa ji bzhin bslu ba med pa ru/ /grub gyur legs byas dpal du 'bar nas srid rtse'i bar du khyab par shog /de ltar smon pa 'di ko legs rtogs khong du chud gyur kun gzigs pa/ /bdud bzhi'i dpung kun 'joms mdzad dpa' dang sras gyur gzhan phan rgya chen bdag /slob gyur zhi bar gzhol bcas kun gyi bden mthu nus pa'i gzi byin gyi/ /ji ltar smras pa'i don kun yongs grub mi dbang mchog gang rgyas gyur mdzod/ /de skad bdag blo'i khri shing nas/ /zhu ba'i yi ge ko ki la/ /yin lugs lhug pa'i dbyangs sgrogs bzhin/ /rab dkar gos kyi sgro gshog lding / /bya ma rta yis rlung gi bskyod/ /phun tshogs dpyid kyi dpal mo'i khab/ /dbang phyug chen po'i zhabs kyi stegs/ /pad+ma rgyas pa'i ngogs der zhugs/ /kun tu bzang po'i dpal la spyod/ /snyan tshig bzang po'i 'jig rten khengs/ /rten 'brel bzang po yar zla bzhin/ /dge legs bzang po 'phel rgyas shog maṅga lam̐ bha wan+tu/ ces shar phyogs shing lo'i tshal kong yul nyang kha ri khrod 'bol chu mig nas don grub sa lug gi sbo zla'i tshes brgyad la dpal tshe dbang nor bus phul ba'i li ka raḥ maṅga lam̐/gangs can 'gro ba yongs kyi 'dren pa gong sa bdun pa skal bzang rgya mtsho'i zhabs su zhu yig phul ba ngang pa'i bu mo'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ swāste/ bskal bzang 'gro ba yongs kyi mgon/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i ngo bo nyid/ /gangs can skye dgu'i gtsug gi rgyan/ /bla ma chen po'i zhabs stegs ngogs/ /kun bzang rgyal ba'i ring lugs gang / /dri med 'dzin pa rdo rje yis/ rnal 'byor snying po gzhol 'dun can/ /phran de'i dad pa'i zhu yig so/ /swa sti/ lha mi blo ldan bgrang yas gtsug na mngon par mchog tu 'phags pa bzang po nyid/ /bskal bzang 'gro ba'i 'dren par thub dbang nyid mtshungs ngur smrig gar gyi rnam rol ba/ /rgya mtsho'i gos la 'khod kun thar pa mchog la dkri 837

byed yongs kyi 'dren pa che/ /srid 'dir zla bral kun gzigs ngo bo gang gi zhabs stegs chu skyes ga la bar/ /phran bu gangs ldan 'char phyogs skyes bu kun spang bar rlom kun tu rgyu/ /pad+ma ka ras rjes bzung tha shas gang gi ring lugs 'dzin blo can/ /'khrul pa'i snang bar rab tu spyod kyang rnal 'byor ye shes rgya yi zol/ /gyi nar gnas de'i len byed 'khri shing gser sgor tshangs pa'i skye gnas ltar/ /'dud de ches cher gus pa'i yid ni rgod ma'i khab nye rlabs ldan bzhin/ /shin tu dngas pa'i blo ni 'jig rten sgong ngar skyed de hai ṭa'i bzhin/ /sim pa chen po'i yong bskul mgrin sbyor mche las skyes kyi ha ta bzhin/ /snyan par brjod pa'i gzugs gang mtshun dbang sring gi mchog gyur rgyud mang bzhin/ /gsol ba mgon khyed bzod mar 'od zer dpal brtsegs rgyal bar yongs brnyes kyang / /kun khyab snying brtse'i dmigs med thugs rjer yongs gom sgyu 'phrul cir yang snang / /kun nas 'dren mdzad mchog gyur gru 'dzin bdag gi pad dkar 'chang yang bya/ /sna tshogs dge ba'i dpal sbyin lha mi'i bla ma mtshungs pa mi mnga' ba/ /yongs kyi mgon por gyur kyang gangs can 'gro ba'i bde skyid lhag par bskyed/ /'khor 'das mnyam nyid gzigs kyang lung rtogs dam chos rin chen lhag par spel/ /rgyal ba gzhan las lhag pa'i thugs bskyed thugs rje rmad byung mchog mnga' bas/ /rgyal kun 'phrin las gcig car grub byed kun bzang ji 'dra mkhyen pa can/ /snyigs lnga bdo ba'i dus 'di nam yang bskal pa rdzogs ldan bzang po yi /dga' ston bde legs mchog gi rgya mtsho kun tu 'phel zhing rgyas mdzad pa/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa phul byung 'gro kun 'dren mdzad snyan pa'i rnga bo che/ /'og min che bar yongs sgrog sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i sras kyi mtshungs zlar nyid/ /nges pa'i don du bdud bzhi'i dpung tshogs ma lus rmengs med 'jom pa yi/ /dpa' bo de lags rang snang longs spyod 'khor lor gzhom gzhig snang min yang / /bdag sogs gdul bya blo dman byis pa'i rtog dras bcings la 'phags mchog rnams/ /skye 'pho'i ngang tshul brton pa ltar du snang ba de gang gzhom slad du/ /gsol ba 'debs pa 'di lta lags kyi mgon khyed dgongs pas yongs ma dor/ /bde ba can gyis zhing gi bskal pa'i yun tshad ji tsam de srid du/ /lag na pad+mo'i bdag gir bzung ba rang gi gdul bya'i zhing gi gtso/ /mi phyed bzod pa can zhes 'jig rten khams gyur de yi mchog gi sa/ /drag pos yongs bzung e yi cha byad suṇ+ḍa sa du paḥnye bar brgyan pa'i 'disaḥ yul gyur drug gi yongs bgod ba ra ta yi cha gyur lha babs kyis spud ljongs/ /'gro 'chang dbus gyur gru 'dzin zhes brjod pu ra shrit+t+waṃ rang gi bsti ba'i gnas/ /sa la gnas pa'i bde ldan mchog der sharta la yi yongs 'degs rin chen khrir/ /mig mi 'dzin pa'i rang bzhin khyed ni 'chi med mgon po mchog gi skur/ /yongs su gzhes te mtshan dpe'i rgyan sku rdo rje'i ri bo ji bzhin par/ /skye 'jig na gegs kun ni gnyis 838

spang mi shig dngas mar yongs su dag /g.yo 'gyur nā da'i tshogs ni ye shes mchog gyur gzhom med srog la thim/ /'pho bcas shu kra mi 'gyur bde ba chen po'i dbyings su kun nas zhi/ /sgrib gsum dri ma'i tshogs kun spangs ba 'chi med rdo rje'i ting 'dzin gyi/ /'chi bdag bdud sde'i dpung tshogs ma lus phye mar yongs su 'thag byas te/ /gangs can sa gsum la 'khod 'gro ba'i tshogs gyur ma lus thams cad rnams/ /dri ma'i tshogs spangs gdod ma'i gnas lugs ji ltar ji snyed chos khong chud/ /grol ba'i mthar thug de nyid mngon du ma byas bar du mgon khyed nyid/ /a haṃ nyi zla'i gur khang dbus su tshe zhes lnga ldan rdo rje yi/ /rang bzhin rtag pa brtan pa 'jig med ka ba nyid du yongs 'thas shing / /rtsib stong ri mos nyer 'khyud bgrod byed rdo rje'i gzugs byas 'phrog byed khrir/ /legs bkod gdul bya thugs rje nam yang dor min ting 'dzin phyag rgya'i ngang/ /zhabs pad brtan par gzhag nas rang gi thugs bskyed thugs dam ji bzhin pa/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor bying rnams zhi ba'i lcags kyus bde bar rab drangs shing / /zhi la gnas kun snying rje'i sgra yi yongs sad mtha' bral mchog gi sar/ /bkod par mdzod zhes rgyal dang rgyal sras rab 'byams kun gyi khyed bskul nges/ /de lta na yang gdul byar gyur pa gang gis dad pas yongs bskyed pa'i/ /gsol gdab tshig la rgyal ba rnams ni mi dgyes nam yang mi mnga' bas/ /'gro la phan bzhed mgon po zhabs pad brtan par ched du gsol 'debs tshig /'di 'dra bstan 'gro'i brtsas su lhag bsam bzang po'i yongs bskul brjod lags na/ /dgongs par gzhes nas rdzu 'phrul rkang pa la brten zhing 'di'i don nyid du/ /tshe 'od dpag tu med pa ji bzhin 'tsho zhing gzhes nas bzhugs gyur te/ /bdag sogs gdul byar gyur kun khyed kyi thugs rje'i gru chen la brten nas/ /gnas skabs nyid nas phun tshogs dpal 'byor dbang phyug che kun stsal ba dang / /mchog tu 'gro rnams brgal dka' 'jig rung brlab 'phreng rtag par 'khrug pa las/ /yongs su sgrol byas gnas skabs thar pa tsam po yang ni ma yin par/ /mi gnas bde ba'i khab gyur rdo rje can grub kun gyi gnas dam par/ /bkod par mdzod ces gsol ba gdab kyi re ba yid bzhin 'grub mdzod kyi/ /kye ma rab tu gus pa'i yid kyi yongs btud zhu ba de skad na/ /dbang po'i tha grur shing lo'i tshal zhes rkang 'thung tshang tshing 'khrig de nas/ /bik+ṣa rnams ni dri bzhon dag ni gar byed bdag ni dad pa'i gar/ /na dī rnams ni 'bab rgyun ca co'i sgra 'byin bdag gi gus pa'i glu/ /gha na rab dkar brtsegs pa'i bzhin ngom bdag ni dngas bas 'phyor zhing sgeg /brisbyi rgyun bzang chun po'i 'phreng 'phyang bdag ni dga' ba rin chen 'phreng / /de ltar 'gro ba'i mgon la bdag ni dga' gus dad dang rang bzhin gzugs/ /de dang lhan gcig bem po'i tshogs kyang sgegs sogs bya ba byed bzhin 'gyur/ /gyur pa 'di yang nam du mi dman 839

blo yis kun bzang sprin 'thug por/ /'jig rten dbang phyug sgyu 'phrul mchog de mchod pa'i slad du 'phro bar gyis/ /yang gcig bdag blo ma la ya ri sa brtol mig yang mdzes pa'i shing / /shes rab snang ba sa mchog mchog gang yongs rgyal dkar 'dzin brtas pa'i klung / /snyan pa'i ngag sbyor dri bsung srung bzang me tog zur mig 'khyug cing g.yo/ /zhu ba'i yi ge sim gyur ngad pa 'bras g.yur bde ba'i reg bya spyod/ /rnam par spyod pa gang ni gser mngal can gyi bu mor gyur pa de yi glu/ /yid 'ong gtam du sbyor ni gang gi tam bu ra yi sgra ru nyer bcug 'di/ /kun mkhyen kun gzigs rgyal ba'i ngo bo rgyal ba rdo rje rnon po'i phyag rgya can/ /kun mdzes kun dpal ut+pal gdengs can mchog gi mchog khyed dgyes pa'i rol mor byas/ /de ltar bdag blo'i rdzing bu las/ /legs thon zhu yig ngang pa'i gzugs/ /snyan tshig gser gyi g.yer kha can/ /lha gos bzang po'i sgra gshog can/ /pho nya'i rlung shugs la brten te/ /gru 'dzin 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho'i dbus/ /mig mi 'dzum pa'i zhabs kyi stegs/ /yid 'ong pad tshal der zhugs gyur/ /legs par dgyes pa'i rgyur gyur nas/ /legs pa'i 'dren byed dkyus ring pos/ /legs par skyong nas phun tshogs che/ /legs pa'i dpal kun stsal yang gsol/ /maṅga lo bha wan+tu/ ces shar phyogs shing lo'i tshal zhes kong yul nyang kha ri khrod 'bol chu mig nas don grub sa lug gi lo sbo zla'i tshes bcu gcig la dpal rig pa 'dzin pas phul ba'i li ka raḥ maṅga lo/stod kha che dang bod kyi yul mtshams la dwags rgyal por gnang ba/ oṃ swāste/ dge legs bsod nams 'bum gyi gzi 'bar bas/ /sa chen dkyil 'khor dbang bsgyur dngos grub mchog /yongs thob mi dbang rigs kyi thig le che/ /skye dgu bde 'tsho mgon de'i sku gzhog drung / /bod chen sa yi lte bar yongs skyes shing / /phyogs med rgyal khams kun rgyu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /mang thos zab chos sgo brgya 'byed mkhas pa/ /nges gsang rdzogs chen pa des zhu ba'i mchid/ /mnga' ris kasmi ra yi yul mtshams su/ /gnas gyur mi mchog sa bdag gang bde la/ khyab bdag sangs rgyas yongs kyi gtso bo mchog /o rgyan sin dhu'i mtshor 'khrungs bde ba che/ pad+ma ka ra 'od dpag med mgon de/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyi ma dor rtag skyong zhing / brtse ba'i phyag gi bkra shis me tog char/ /srid zhi'i dge legs kun dang lhan gcig tu/ /mi yi rje bo de la phyag byas nas/ /snyan pa tshang gnas bar du rgyas gyur shog /gang khyod dge ba'i gzigs pa yangs po yis/ /'dir gnas rig pa 'dzin pa yang nas yang / /phyogs de'i bstan 'gro'i brtsas su 'ong 'os zhes/ /snyan tshig rnga sgra bzang pos bskul gyur pas/ /de don gegs med 'grub par yongs smon mod/ /re zhig bod yul shar phyogs shing lo'i tshal/ /nye ba'i 'thung spyod tsā ri tra blta bar/ /bskyed 'dun lags pa'ang dgongs par gzhol ba dang / /de bzhin bod chen phyogs nas 840

'khor dang bstun/ /sa bdag mi rje khyed kyi gsung ji bzhin/ /phyogs der nges par sleb byed dus de ru//'gro phan rgyal bstan bya ba chos bsgrub spro/ /de srid kun tu khyod sku 'tsho gzhes shing / /gzi mdangs ches rgyas chab srid gong du 'phel/ /sa gsum 'gro bas khyod kyi snyan pa'i gtam/ /brjod pas bral cing bde bas 'tsho bar shog /de skad lhug par brjod tshig ngang mo la/ /tsi na'i 'phrul lag kyis bsgrub gshog pa yis/ /mdzes byed ru lag 'bras spung gtsug lag nas/ /kun dga' shing stag nag zla'i tshes bzang por/ /lhing ste song ba sa skyong mi yi bdag /chos bzhin mdzad de'i thugs mtshor 'jug dgyes smon/ /maṅga lo/gtsang stod gye re lo tsā ba chen por phul ba'i zhu yig gnas lnga rig pa'i nyi mar yangs gyur pas/ /'jig rten 'di na blo ldan blta ba'i mig /mkhas gyur skye bo'i gtsug na mngon mtho ba/ /ngag dbang bkra shis rnam rgyal zhabs pad du/ /mang du thos pa'i rgya mtsho las 'ong pa'i/ /rnam dpyod lang tsho rgyas pa skye lnga'i dung / /legs bshad gtam gyi nga ro sprog spobs pa'i/ /grags ldan gzhon nu de yi zhu ba'i mchid/ /mgon khyed skye ba du mar legs spyad 'bras/ /byang chen yongs bsngo smon lam bzang po yi/ /dus 'dir dam pa mgon gyi rjes su bzung / /ma nor sgrub brgyud snying po'i grub mtha' zhugs/ khyab bdag bla ma'i rim gro chos bzhin spyod/ /tha snyad gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i pha mthar rol/ /nges don la mos mi phyed gdeng rkang tshugs/ /rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs ngur smrig gos kyi klub/ /bstan pa'i 'byung khung rig gnas rgya mtsho spel/ /legs sbyar smra ba'i seng ge gcig pu pa/ /blo ldan yongs kyi phyag 'os bkur ba'i 'os/ /de ni bdag gi slob dpon kho nar dran/ /tshul 'di 'dra ba'i skyes mchog 'jig rten mig /gang de deng dus ru bzhi'i gtsang gi stod/ /ru lag skye re rig gnas lding khang na/ /khams drug rdo rje'i sku mchog bsnyel med cing / /ji snyed rnal 'byor lang tsho rgyas bzhin du/ /ji ltar phyag chen nyams len mnyam gzhag dang / /skal ldan don du 'tsho bzhugs snyan pa'i gtam/ /thos pas bdag sems 'chi med gsos su gyur/ /'di na gnas pa'i bya bral gyi na ba/ /ming gi bla btags tshe dbang nor bu zhes/ /gdan sa'i khur bor sprang po'i gral snyegs shing / /lhag tshugs rgyab skyur dam chos don gnyer zhing / /khengs grags spang nas rang gzhan 'gro ba'i don/ /rang 'dod med par spyad blo mchis mod kyang / /'di snang chos brgyad gaṅga'i rlabs phreng bzhin/ /nam yang 'dor med bdag blo'i skyed 'di dub/ /'on kyang mtshan ldan bla ma'i bka' drin las/ /gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bo mthong / /mdo rgyud dgongs don ji bzhin smra yang spob/ /mkhas khrod zhum zhing blun khrod nga mi rgyal/ /dam sdom dag cing gzhan phan lhag bsam ldan/ /rgyal bstan srog ltar btsa' ba'i zhe gdeng dang / /dad ldan slob ma mi bslu snyam pa 841

bcas/ /rbad zhod tsam min snying khung gting nas shar/ /tshul der sku skyer grags pa'i zhabs ma drang / /rang yang dal 'byor 'di nyid chud ma zos/ /de dag gnas lugs lhug par brjod pa'i gtam/ /dpon slob thugs yid gcig 'dres stabs kyi gsol/ /mtshams kyi zhu mchid gser gyi ri bo la/ /gnas bcas 'dab chags gser du 'gyur ba bzhin/ /rig pa'i nyi ma 'jig rten mig gcig pu/ /mkhas mchog khyed kyi thugs rje la brten nas/ /legs sbyar dbyangs can ka tsan pā ni'i mdo/ /cha lag smra sgo sum rtags bstan pa'i gzhi/ /de bzhin snyan par smra ba daṇ+ḍi'i gzhung / /mkhas mchog rin chen 'byung gnas prabha ra/ /gzhan yang dkar nag rtsis gzhung g.yul rgyal bcas/ /thos bsam klog pa'i skal ba cung zad kyi/ /tha snyad gtsug lag blta ba blo ma zum/ /rig pa'i gnas la phro ba cha shas rnyed/ /bdag gi tshul de gzhan las ma yin gyis/ /gtsug lag slob dpon gcig mchog rgyal po ni/ /ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta gyur skye re ba/ /maṅga'i mtshan can bka' drin kho nar nges/ /tha snyad blo gros bskyed mdzad shes rab rgyud/ /slob dpon de ni pha las lhag go zhes/ /kun bzang rdor sems rdo rje'i ljags kyi bsngags/ /mdo las pha ma 'phags dang mnyam zhes gsungs/ /don des shes rab slob dpon bdag gi pha/ /mtshan nas 'bod do bkra shis rnam par rgyal/ /ngag gi dbang phyug mkhyen rab rgya mtsho'i gter/ /gang gi bka' drin rgya mtsho'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /de ltar shes shing go bo paṇ+ḍi ta/ bdag ni tshe rabs 'di nas byang chen bar/ /skye kun khyed dang mi 'brel lhan gcig 'grogs/ /byang chub spyod pa lhan gcig nyid tsam nas/ /theg chen sa lam yon tan gong 'phel zhing / /mtha' thug bdag ni rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i tshe/ /tshom bu gcig tu byang chub mchog thob pa'i/ /smon lam snying nas 'debs so bka' drin can/ bdag ni tha snyad rig pa'i gnas rnams la/ /dga' bzhin brtsigs su mkhas pa'i rgyu yin bzung / /'on kyang tha snyad gnas la mi zhen gyis/ /ci zhes rnam rtog bcos mas bslad par go/ /de yang stong nyid snying rje'i zin pa yis/ /byang chen bsngos na de yi rgyur 'gro mod/ /'on kyang 'bras bu myur du bsgrub pa la/ /tshul 'di do gal che ba'i gnas ma yin/ /de bas bla mar sangs rgyas las lhag pa'i/ /mos gus gzhi bzung dam tshig srog phur btsugs/ /gzhi yi phyag chen rang bzhin bde gshegs snying / /blo bur 'khrul pa'i dri ma gsal byed lam/ /yin lugs phyag chen bsgom yeng byar med gshis/ /rtsol bral gnyug ma'i rang zhal rtag blta bas/ /nges 'byed rnal 'byor bzhi yis sa lam bgrod/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas go 'phang thob de smon/ /de lta na yang rig stong bsgom pa'i gnad/ /mnyam bzhag brtan pa thob na ji snang kun/ /phyag rgya che las gzhan min snang srid kun/ /sku gsung mkhas len nyid la su zhig bsnyon/ /bka' brgyud mchog gi rnam rtog chos kyi skur/ /bzhed tshe rig gnas rnam rtog yin smra bzhin/ /rig gnas rnam rtog chos sku yin don ci/ /bsgom chen 842

rig gnas gshe rnams 'di dpyad 'os/ /gsong por smra na rig gnas la mi smod/ /'dus byas dge la de bas kyang mi smod/ /gnas lugs don bsgom rgyu 'bras 'dor len 'bad/ /dam tshig tshul bzhin myong rtogs rdo rus gtug /brtan pa ma thob bar du dben bsgom gtso/ /brtan pa thob na cir snang bsgom gyi grogs/ /bstan 'gror phan na rlabs chen spyod yin pas/ /skabs re bsgom pa las kyang thos bsam bzang / /lhag bsam gyis zin byang chen rgyur bsngos na/ /bya ba phal che dge ba'i 'khor lo yin/ /rang 'dod 'di snang khe grags kyis 'ching na/ /ltar snang bsgom bsgrub bdud kyi zhags pa yin/ /bdag ni sngon sbyangs bla ma'i thugs rje yis/ /lung rtogs bstan la blo mig ma zum pas/ /de ltar shes shing khong du chud lags kyi/ /gzhan gyur rnal 'byor 'ga' yi ngag nas ni/ /bsgom chen tha snyad gtsug lag mi slob zhes/ /dam bca' 'cha' zhing bdag sogs bslab sbyangs la/ /khrel tshul byed pa rna bar son lags pas/ /phyogs rer zhen pa'i 'ching ba bzlog slad du/ /zur gnas brtse ba'i sems kyi yin lugs tshul/ /dpyod ldan blo nor legs bshad nyid du spel/ /de yang shes rab slob dpon bka' drin can/ rig pa'i nyi ma gang gis snyan lam du/ /pha mar bu tshas gnas tshul gsol ba bzhin/ /brjod la nyes pa'i skyon yod ma yin gyis/ /legs par shes la dgyes pa'i thugs rje che/ /zhal ras 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyi byab kyang gsol/ /bka' drin che 'o ma hā lo tsā na/ /dga' ba'i yid kyi nyin mtshan 'khor mo yug khyed zhal blta bar bdag nyid ches gdung zhing / /dam pa'i 'bel mchid bgyid la rab spro mod/ /de lta na yang sngon las rnam g.yeng gi/ /dal med bral bas rtag tu mnar bzhin dang / /lhag tu brang so dpal ldan bla ma mchog /tshur mthong skye bo'i snang ngor bro 'tshal bar/ /yang yang pho nya btud nas 'ong dgos tshul/ /phebs shing bla ma'i ched du gal che gshis/ /phyogs der 'gro ba'i sgo dod lam zhugs shing / /rim pas kong yul tsā rir bskyod 'dun lags/ /des na phyis su mjal ba'i smon lam dang / /re zhig ma mjal bar der sku 'tsho gzhes/ /dngas shing rim gnyis dge sbyor gong 'phel dang / /bstan pa'i gsal byed nyid du brtan bzhugs gsol/ /bdag ni tshe rabs tshe rgyud thams cad du/ /shes rab dbang 'byor dbang phyug chen po thob/ /ma nor grub mtha' gtsug nor bzhin 'chang ba'i/ /slob bu kun kyang tshom bu gcig 'grub nas/ /shes rab gsum la 'jam dpal dbyangs can bzhin/ /gyur nas mkha' mnyam sems can ma stong bar/ /chos kyi sbyin pa rgyun mi chad 'gyed nas/ /rgyal ba sras bcas dgyes kun bdag 'grub shog /shes rab rgyud sogs slob dpon bsnyen byas dge/ /skye kun tha snyad gtsug lag ma bslab par/ /rang shes shes rab 'jam dpal dpa' bo bzhin/ /mkhas kun mchod 'os bdag nyid 'grub par shog /de skad zhu yig 'phral gyi bral ba yi/ /snyan ngag dper brjod blta bar ma long pas / 843

blo la gang shar chu 'bab gnyug ma'i tshig /snyan ngag rgyal srid rang bzhin rgyan nyid kyis/ /tshigs su bcad pa bcu phrag bzhi lhag pa/ /bcud ldan rkang 'thung dbang po'i 'dab bam dang / /rin chen zla mdangs dong rtse yan lag brgyad/ /shis tshig gyis spras rnam dkar dar bzang pos/ /spud byas kun dga' chu stod zla ba yis/ /yar tshes rgyal ba dang po'i dus sbyor ba/ /seng ge'i skabs su ru lag grom pa rgyang / /gu ru pad+ma'i sgrub gnas bya skyib nas/ /gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs ldan pa/ /'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor ni/ /bya bral rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu dpal/ /'jam dbyangs rgya mcho'i sde yis gus pas phul/ /yo rgyan smin grol gling gi khri rig 'dzin rin chen rnam rgyal la phul ba/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi dpal 'phur 'gro'i rgyal po thor cog can/ /gang gi ring lugs dri med theg rgyal rtse dgu'i rdzogs pa che/ /'dzin skyong spel la 'jigs med rgyal ba'i sras po rdo rje 'dzin/ /snga 'gyur bstan pa'i gsal byed thig ler gyur pa de'i zhabs drung / /dam pa mgon gyis rjes bzung dal 'byor rten/ /cung zad don ldan rnam dpyod ma smad cing / /nges don snying po'i don bsgom rgyal khams pa/ /bya bral rig pa 'dzin des zhu ba'i mchid/ /deng sang thub bstan ches snyigs khyad par du/ /snga 'gyur rlung 'tshub mar me tshong 'dus 'o/ /ji bzhin gyur cing rdo rje theg pa yis/ /thos bsam bsgom pa'i srol ka nyams dmas yang / /grangs med sngon nas thugs bskyed smon lam gyi/ /'jig rten mig gyur rnam par snang mdzad bsrung / /gang gi sprul pa'i zlos gar 'gro ba'i mgon/ /gter chen bla ma 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig de'i/ /thugs bskyed shar ri'i phrag nas snying bstan gyis/ /'od dkar gsar du shar bas gdul bya yis/ /blo mun srid mthar gzhil zhing skal ldan gyis/ /ut+pal dkar po rgyal byas rmad du gyur/ /de lta na'ang 'gro 'di'i bsod dbang gis/ /ma shong ba yi rdo rje snying po yi/ /bstan pa'i dgra bo nag po'i rtsa lag can/ /de yi re zhig rgud par gyur na yang / /dpag med bsod nams mthu yi lugs gnyis kyi/ /mngon mtho nges legs yongs 'chang spyi dpal che/ /gang gi thugs rje mthu las slar yang ni/ /gsang chen snying po'i rgud pa sel byed ni/ /dam pa rgyal ba'i sras gyur khyod nyid kyi/ /drin las snga 'gyur chos kyi lang tsho dpal/ /legs par ston pa'i dga' ston bzang po 'di/ /bdag sogs dpyod ldan yongs kyi spyi nor gyur/ /des na mgon khyed skal bzang gdul bya'i ngor/ /gzugs sku'i snang brnyan nam yang 'gog med par/ /bskal pa rgya mtsho'i bar du 'chi med mgon/ /'od dpag med ltar zhabs pad brtan gyur cing / /mtha' yas 'gro la theg chen dam chos kyis/ /dga' ston rgyas par mdzod kyi rgyal ba'i sras/ /tshul 'di kha dpag cam bu tsam min gyis/ /snying nas smon pa'i rten 'brel ji bzhin shog /'dir gnas rdzogs 844

chen par rlom rgyal khams pa/ /bdag kyang lnga 'dus so sor ma gyur bzhin/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la snying nas lhag bsam ngang / /pad+ma'i lung bzhin 'gro don bsgrub khul mchis/ /mtshams kyi zhu khol bod chen mnga' ris nas/ /bla ma'i go sa 'dzin pa zung cig kyang / /snga 'gyur rgyud sde'i bshad bka' bsgrub chen gyis/ /phyag len bslab phyir ched gnyer der brdzang pas/ /da lam phyag rten dngos po phra 'dug kyang / /sngar gyi mna' gzhung phyi thag la dgongs nas/ /lugs gnyis bdag rkyen khyad 'phags gnang 'os zhes/ /gzur gnas blo yi gsol ba dgyes kyang 'tshal/ /bdag la'ang dus kun dge ba'i skyabs 'jug ni/ /rang gzhan don gnyis rgya chen yongs 'grub pa/ /tshe 'di nyid la zung 'jug rdo rje sems/ /brnyes pa'i thugs smon bzang po byab kyang 'tshal/ /de skad zhu yig ma bcos lhug par brjod pa'i ngang mo la/ /lhag bsam mos pa'i zhen gyis g.yer kha rab 'khrol zhing / /ma hā tsi na'i 'phrul lag kyis bskrun lha gos gshog rgyang pa/ /mang mkhar bsam 'grub rdzong nas smin grol chos kyi rgyal khab che der phul/ /maṅga lo/me lug zla tshes la ri bo dpal 'bar nas rje blo gros chos 'phel la stsal ba/ rgyal bstan snying po'i rtsa lag rdo rje 'dzin de'i drung du/ zhu ba/ deng dus ji lta'i maphyo pa mngon gyur mtshor/ /ji snyed bye brag ma 'dres kha dog bkra/ /gzhan phan dal rlung kyis bskul thugs rje'i rlabs/ /che g.yo smin grol chu rgyun 'bebs der spro/ /phran ni mchog kun ngo bo pad 'byung gi/ /thugs rje gor+sha'i la rten nyes byas kyi/ /tshad dub las ring don gnyis bag yangs su/ /spyod pa'i ngang tshul ri mo tsam du gnas/ /mtshams zhu/ rje nyid grangs med nas goms thugs bskyed mthus/ /snyigs dus 'gro ba 'dren la ches ring bas/ /chang thub mang brten gsar rnying chos kyi bcud/ /du mar longs spyod gyur la bdag yi rang //des na bdag kyang phyogs med rgyal khams su/ /yul dang chos kyi bdud rtsir rten khul te/ /phyogs 'dir rten 'brel shugs kyi legs 'grigs mthus/ /nyid sras dge slong rin 'dzin dam par ri chos nos gyur phral/ /drung du bcar 'dod sku khams stabs kyi/ /dus der mjal ma thub kyang dngos 'di nas/ /bcad rgya grol bstun sngar nas snyan gsol bzhin/ /byang gling kun bzang thugs gter gyis gtsos pa'i/ /gsar rnying 'dod chos 'ga' zhig zhu mos pas/ /thugs rje chen pos bya gtang yin phul gyi zang zing dngos po'i maṇ+ḍal ni 'bul rgyu mi 'dug pas thugs mi khrel ba gnang ba'i skabs dbye gsol/ /de skad zhu yig stong min rten dang bcas/ /bod chen 'dzin mar yongs su grags pa'i ming / /tshe dbang nor bu zhes grags bya gtang des/ /ri bo dpal 'bar nas phul dge gyur cig /me yos bla ma rin chen bzang po la stsal ba/ der gnas thos ldan dam pa'i rigs gyur bla ma gang de la/ /bsam bzhin smon lam dbang gi srid par 'jug pa'i grags ldan ni/ /mdo khams sar skyes 845

ris med grub mtha' rgya mtshor 'jug pa la/ /'jigs med blo gros gru rdzing legs thob kun tu chos smra de'i 'phrin/ /gang gi sgra 'dzin bu ga legs par bsal te thugs bum du/ /'jug par 'os so bstan la sems te smrengs 'di brgyad ldan chab/ /kye ho/ rgyal bka' 'bum phrag grangs ldan ngo mtshar sngags rgyud 'phreng ba gang / /bklags lung rgyun dang ldan pa yin zhes don du'ang ldan nges pa/ /gang zag brgya phrag du ma'i grangs las yang ni lhag pa yis/ /bod dang bod chen kun tu khengs so tshul de rnyed dka' min/ /'on kyang sgrol mgon mchog gi rnam 'phrul pad+ma ma ṇi yi/ /yongs 'dzin bstan pa'i nyi mar 'bod pa gang de las 'ong ba'i/ /rgyun la rmongs zhen kho nas khyod la yang yang kho na ru/ /'bod pa bgyis rung bdag gi ngag kyang chud zos par /dam pa gong ma'i dgongs pa bskang bar mi mdzad 'di ci zhig bstan pa'i nyi ma'i chos rgyun chad 'di 'phang ngo bor phod dam/ /bdag ni thos bsam bsgom la ro bro cung zad blta zin cing / /da ni lang tsho nyid kyang yol bar nye mod 'on te chos/ /thos na snyams pa'i lhag bsam bskyed kyang grogs byed ma mchis 'di/ /gzhu med mda' 'dra des na bstan pa'i nyi ma yab sras kyi/ /dgongs pa bskangs thabs zad kyi mi mngon dbyings nas dgongs ma khrel/ /gang khyed lang tshos gtug pa bden mod rgyal bstan rin chen la/ /lhag bsam bskyed na ngal ba kun kyang 'bras ldan nyid yin gyi/ /don med gyi nar spyod pas ci bya de bas bstan la dgongs/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bstan la lhag bsam dag pa nyin skar tsam/ /rgyun ldan bla ma dkon mod de bas yang ni rtsol ldan gyi/ /slob ma u dusmra ra 'dra bas bdag gi stsol ba bskyed 'dir gzigs/ /g.yel bar ma dor bstan pa'i nyi ma'i bstan la lhag bsam mchog /bskyed par 'tshal lo sngags skyes rat+na bha drar bdag gi 'bod/ /bdag ni mdo khams nyid du'ang grags ldan go sa nyid du skyes/ /rgyal khams kun tu 'phrin las skyong mod da lta che dgu yis/ /bkur yang dregs khengs bsam pa spang nas gang khyod chos kyi rgyun/ /btung bar 'dod pa 'di yang dam pa'i rnam thar yin min som/ /dam pa'i rnam thar yin pas g.yel bar ma bor bla ma kyai/ /'chi bas mi tshugs sa phyogs gang du'ang med mod phyogs 'di ru/ /'chi 'pho ston yang dam pa mang bzhugs dge ba'i ngang tshul rgyas/ /des na tshegs che gnog chung 'tshe mang zhing khang de yi ci/ /bstan pa'i nyi ma'i bstan la dgongs nas tshur byon 'dir gshegs mtshal/ /gal chen nyid du de tsam gsol nas gsan par mi mdzad na/ /bstan la brtse ba'i go cha chung bar zad pas de bas na/ /rdo rje theg pa'i g.yar dam gnyan la dgongs shig rin chen bzang / /des na yang yang gsol ba'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod gcig gu/ /sngar gsol dus nas phyogs 'dir byon na dam chos kyi/ /bya ba chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zin da bar 'gyang ba 'di/ /don med 846

song ste da ni don ldan brtson pa bskyed kyang rigs/ /bsam pa lhag mar ma gyur phan tshun yid kyi re ba yi/ /shing rta 'dod don nor bus phyur bu nyid du yongs khengs bar/ /smon no de don ji bzhin bslu med nyid du 'grub par shog /ces pa gangs ri'i khrod kun tu ma sbas pa'i ming rlung ltar du grags pa dpal chen po'i ṭ+wāṃg/ pa 'dzin pa rgyal khams pas 'phrul snang rgyal po'i khab nas me yos chu stod zla ba'i tshes dge ba la spel ba sarba maṅga dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas dbyer ma mchis pa'i khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po mchog gi zhabs pad rin po che'i drung du/ bdag shākya'i dge bsnyen rnying ma'i rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho'i bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs 'phel zhing khyab bdag rtsa ba'i bla ma thun mong ma yin pa/ dpal pad+ma bde chen gling pa dang gsung rab rgya mtsho'i zhabs kyi dgongs pa bskang ba'i mchogargyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che rigs su ma grub par thos bsam gyi khul las mchog tu ston pa'i gsung gi mthar thug 'khor lo gsum pa'i dgongs don phyir mi ldog par gzhan stong seng ge'i sgra srid rtse'i bar du sgrogs pa kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po dol po shes rab rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i sde dang / rje btsun rdo rje 'chang sgrol mgon zhabs kyi gsung rdo rje'i tshig rgyun ma chad pa ji tsam bzhugs pa de nyid/ dus 'dir rigs brgya'i khyab bdag dkon mchog mtshungs med/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa kun bzang dbang po'i zhabs gang nyid kyi thugs rjer brten thob par gyur pa'i bka' drin gyi mtshon byed tsam dang khyad par du bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo'i smin byed dbang gi bka'/ sgrol byed khrid kyi bka'/ rgyud 'grel bshad kyi bka' rnams legs par stsal ba dang / gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa'i dbang khrid ṭik+ka'i lung dang / mdo sngags kyi chos tshul rgya mtsho'i khrid dka'i rgyun bcu phrag gsum dang gcig gi lhag pa'i brgya phrag legs par thob pa'i bka' drin ni bskal pa rgya mtsho'i mthar yang gzhal bar mi nus mod/ 'on te mos pas tshe srog bsod nams 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas pa'i dge tshogs cha shas bcas te 'bul bar bgyid pa gtso bo dang / skabs 'dir zang zing dngos po phra mo tshan grangs tsam du thog mar dbu zhwa/ sku 'gag /mnab bzan/ de nas bdun tshan bdun du byas pa'i thog mar dkon mchog gi rten gyi le tshan/ sher phyin gyi sku chos rje yang dgon pa'i thugs dam rten/ slob dpon pad+ma'i sku/ ta ra nā tha'i sku thang phyag nas ma/ bka' gdams glegs bum spus gtsang / byang sems chos 'phags kyi 'phel gdung / 'jigs med dbyangs can dga' ba'i sku tshal khrag ma/ ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta smri ti'i phyag tshwa/ thub dbang gi sku de bdun tshan/ bdun tshan gnyis pa mchod pa'i yo byad kyi le tshan/ bum pa/ ka pa la margyu'i stegs bcas/ mar me ting bdun/ ting shag spos phor/ spos bam po 847

bzhi ste bdun tshan/ bdun tshan gsum par rin po che'i le tshan/ gser gyi me tog zho gang / dngul bal ṭaṃ so bdun/ dung gi 'phreng ba rgyan ldan/ 'chang 'phreng / g.yu byi ru spos shel gyi do shal/ mu men gyi lag gdub brgyan ldan/ shel 'phreng bcas bdun tshan/ bdun tshan bzhi pa nyer spyad kyi le tshan/ gzhes dkar stegs shubs can spus gtsang / rgya shing gi bzhes can gos can gyi shub bcas/ seng ldeng gi gsol ldong rag shan ma/ li sder/ bse sder/ gsol par/ rag sdig spus gtsang bcas bdun tshan/bdun tshan lnga par dar ras gos chen gyi le tshan/ kha btags nyin mtshan bde legs ma/ ma hañtsi/ gos mthing kha 'bral/ gos ljang yug la dar khra bo yug sa ra ha/ pa ri dkar po cha bcas bdun tshan/bdun tshan drug pa gcan shun la snam gyi le tshan/ stag lpags/ gzig lpags/ wa lpags/ snam dmar cha/ snam dkar cha/ sle'u cha/ shing sgam cha bcas bdun tshan/ bdun tshan bdun par nyer mkho'i spyad par ras sogs kyi le tshan/ sa ri khra bo/ sbu la'i lham/ ga'u spus gtsang / bal zam sngon po/ mon kha ser po/ zangs dkar yug bcas bdun tshan/ de ltar bdun tshan gyi dngos po yid kyi kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin chen por byin gyis brlabs ste/ mgon khyed bskal pa rgya mtsho'i bar du zhabs pad brtan pa'i phyir du 'bul bas 'dod don ji bzhin du 'grub pa dang / bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib tshogs mtha' dag yongs su byang zhing / khyad par du rdo rje slob dpon rtsa ba dang yan lag rnams kyi spyan lam du gsang sngags kyi dam tshig gzhung bzhin du ma bsrung pa/ bka' bzhin du ma 'grub pa/ tshor te nyams dang / ma tshor te nyams pa/ sgo gsum bag med pa'i dbang dang / nyon mongs pa shugs ches pa/bdud kyi byin gyis non te nyams chags 'gal 'khrul du gyur pa thams cad rtsa ba nas dag cing sgrib pa med pa tshangs pa yid bzhin du gyur te/ bdag rdo rje'i rnal 'byor pa tshe dbang nor bus tshe 'dir dang po'i sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa' rang bzhin zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku nges par thob pa dang / gnas skabs su grub pa brgyad dang lta stang sa bcu gnyis sogs las rab 'byams la dbang 'byor zhing /mkha' mnyam sems can gyi don rlabs po che 'grub pa'i dpang po rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa bka' drin gsum ldan chos kyi rje kun bzang dbang po'i zhal snga nas gtso bor gyur pa'i rgyun ldan bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong bsrung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyi mdzad nas myur du 'grub par gyis shig de ltar yang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpas sngags kyi rgyud sde thos pa dang / de nyid ston pa'i rdo rje slob dpon bsnyen cing gus par bgyi ba'i phan yon 'jam klas par gsung na/ bdag gi dge 'bras 'di'i nus pa yang nyams med gong du 'phel zhing / 'phral du'ang dus de ring nas bzung 848

rags pa 'khrul rtog spun po nges par chad de/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes bde gshegs snying po'i yon tan yongs su rdzogs shing / gzungs dang / shes rab dang / spobs pa dang / dbang rnam pa bcu/mi 'jigs pa bzhi ldan rnams gdon mi za bar da lta nyid du thob nga/ra gyur cig mdo chos kyi mthar thug gzhan stong dbu ma chen po rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin rtogs pad nga / sngags rgyud bde dges/gsang 'dus/ khyad par du dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud don ma lus shing lus pa med pa dpyis phyin par rtogs na/ de thams cad kyi kyang bka' gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba mtshan tsam gyis kyang srid pa'i 'phrul 'khor 'jig par byed pa theg dgu'i rtse rgyal a ti rdzogs pa chen po'i dgongs pa 'dren pa'i shing rta chen po'i 'jug ngogs yang dag par gyur ste/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi rdo rje chos dpal pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / dri med bshes gnyen/ dri med 'od zer zhabs kyi dgongs don mthar phyin pa bde blag tu ma nor zhing ma 'khrul bar rtogs nas tshe 'dir tshogs gnyis kyi mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po dang skal ba mnyam zhing / bdag dang 'brel 'gyur gyi 'gro ba mthong thos dran reg kun kyang de'i go 'phang la 'god nus par gyur cig de skad kha zhe med par smon lam gdab pa 'di nyid nges par 'grub pa'i dpang po 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas pa/ kun rdzob dang don dam gyi dkon mchog sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun rnam pa gsum gyis mdzod cig ston pa tshad ma rdo rje sems dpa' yis/ /rgyud sde tshad ma sngags rgyud nas gsung don/ /yid ches tshad ma bla ma mnyes pa yi/ /dge 'bras tshad ma dus 'du nyid thob shog /ces sa ga zla ba'i dus chen bco lnga la gus pas phul ba dge'o/ /na maḥshri ka la tsakra ya/ rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan zhing / /rang bzhin gyi ni 'od gsal ba/ /zab gsal mi 'gyur bde ba che/ /dus kyi 'khor lo de la 'dud/ /gang zhig sgrib gsum dri ma yongs su bcom pa dus gsum rgyal ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bor dbang bskur rdo rje theg pa'i ston par mnga' gsol ba/ /rdo rje slob dpon gang ni 'gro ba kun gyi mchod 'os bkur 'os bstod par 'os/ /des na bdag gus mi phyed bla mar mchod pa kun bzang sprin 'dir spros/ /de yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la ris su ma gyur kyang / rgyal ba'i bka' 'khor lo gsum pa nges don gyi bstan pa ston par mdzad pa kun mkhyen jo nang pa'i bstan pa 'di gsang chen rnying ma'i ring lugs kyi lta ba dang shin tu mthun zhing sngags gsar mar gyur pa rnams kyi yang snying rtse rgyal du gyur pa yin 'dug na'ang / deng sang dus kyi dbang gis nyag shin tu nas phra zhing ming gi lhag ma tsam du nye bar gyur pa'i skabs su snang bas/ nyams smad pa'i chos de gso thub na phan yon bla lhag tu che bar mthong ba dang / rang nyid kyang skye ba snga ma'i las dang 849

smon lam rnam par dag pas tshe rabs gtan gyi bla ma slob dpon pad+mas rjes su bzung zhing / des byin gyis brlabs pa gang yin pa/ tshe 'di'i rtsa ba'i bla ma dpal pad+ma bde chen gling pa dang gsung rab rgya mtshos mtshams sbyar nas/ dus deng sang la dpag pa'i phyag rdzogs kyi lta gdeng drod tshad chung ngu'i sne tsam mdo khams su sdod ring nas thob par byas shing de nyid rtogs pa gong 'phel du gtang bar 'dod nas/ tsā ri tra sogs gnas dben pa zhig tu rang gcig bur ri dwags smas ma'i spyod pa skyong bar 'dod kyang / skye sngon skal bas de ltar ma gyur rung / skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi zhabs la blta ba dang yul gyi bdud rtsi gnas rten mjal phyir ru bzhi mnga' ris rgyal khams mtha' dag nyul nas rang gzhan don gnyis ci 'grub byas shing / dam pa rnams la zhi gcod/ phyag rdzogs/ rna gu/ nā ro/ sbyor drug sogs gdams pa'i rgyun rnams rang skal dang mtshams par thos shing / de dag ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen la yang brten tshul rgyud sde dang gang mthun du dus deng sang la dpag par ci nus kyi rang nyid go sa skye brgyud dang gzhung lugs kyi rnam dpyod nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan phra mo yod pa'i khengs pa rnams bor zhing / bla ma rnams la khams rmongs kyi dpyad pa med pa dang / /sku 'gang che chung la ma ltos par chos kyi bka' drin nos pa'i bla ma de la ches gus pas rang nyid dma' ba'i gdan la 'dug gus pas zhabs spyi bor blangs/ tshig gi zhe sa 'bul/ bla ma rnams kyi bstan pa dang 'phrin las spel ba'i thabs la 'bad par byas shing / de yang ngas byas yus dang mi 'brel ba ni rang nyid kyi ngang tshul lags shing / des na dam pa rnams kyi thugs su ni mngon par mkhyen pa yang gor ma chags mod/ gzhan gyur ni dus snyigs ma'i mir gyur pas ji ltar byas kyang mgu dka' rung / ltos pa yang mi 'dug kyi de ni zhar byung gi 'phros su gtang ste/ don gyi snying po rang nyid kyi tshe 'dir rang gzhan gyi don gnyis phun tshogs kyi gnas kun sangs rgyas pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi bstan pa'i sgor zhugs pa 'di nyid kho nas 'grub mod kyang / rgyal ba'i bstan pa ris su ma chad par lhag pa'i bsam pa nyid dang / khyad par du slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi mdo phyogs lta ba'i grub mtha' tshul bzhin skyong ba ni kun mkhyen jo nang pa yab sras su nges shing grub pa dang / de bzhin rang nyid kyi 'khrul pa'i snang bar skye ba snga ma'i rim pa du ma zhig mi lam du dran pa las/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam sprul kun mkhyen dol po pa'i slob ma'i thu bo zhig kyang yin snyam pa rab rib shar ba dang / khyad par rje btsun kun dga' snying po 'am ta ra nā tha gang gi chos sras kyi thu bo dam par ting skyes rgyal po'i sras chos rje 'jam dbyangs par skyes pa ni re gsal dran pas de skabs kyi chos tshul thos pas yang rim gyis dran nas tshe 'di'i bslab sbyangs nan bcas la ltos ma dgos par rang gi blo gros mthus/ rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i 850

sna grub mtha'i rnam dag ma rmongs par tshul bzhin du 'chad la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa de lta kun gyis spyan lam du bab pa 'di yin/ de nas rje btsun chen po tā ra nā tha nas brgyud pa'i chos bka' mi'i gang zag nas brgyud pa bar ma chad pa thos 'dod skom pa chu la 'dod pa bzhin byung bas/ phyogs mtha' dag tu 'tshol 'dod la gser mdog can chos mdzad kyi gtsang stod 'bras spungs su bde chen chos rje bya ba sbyor ba yan lag drug gi rnal 'byor sbas tshul du bzhugs pa yod ces thos pas yid la dga' spro dpag tu med pa byung zhing / de don kre bo chos kyi dbang por zhus pas/ de bzhin du legs zhes yi rang yang gnang bar rten me rta lo la phyogs 'dir yong kyang stabs 'grigs ma byung bas/ snga phyi pho nya'i lam dang / rang nyid kyang la che chung 'phrang gi dka' bar rnams khyad du bsad gong du smos bzhin go sa sogs tshe 'di snang gi rtag tshugs rnams rgyab tu bor/ kun mkhyen rgyal ba jo nang pa'i bstan pa'i don du gnyer nas rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs pad du sa bya lo la thog mar bcar nas sbyor ba yan lag drug gi nyams khrid sogs ji rigs zhus shing / slad mar lcags phag gi lo gzhug nas/ da lta kun dga' shing stag lo bar bya ba gzhan thams cad che gzhag chung bshol gyi lcam de gzhag nas dbang khrid gdams pa kho na don du gnyer ba sngon dus bskal pa bzang po'i chos mdzad kyi rnam thar rjes su mthun par byas nas dbang bka' rnams rgyud don la nor 'khrul med pa rang nyid kyi blo gros mthus ji bzhin lag len du bkal/ byin rlabs kyi rgyun thugs rje nus pa'i mthu/ rje btsun kun bzang dbang pos ston nas bar chad kyi 'tshe ba med par kun mkhyen jo nang pa'i bstan pa'i rgyun deng sang skabs bzhugs pa rnams lhag lus med par legs par bum pa gang 'jo'i tshul du legs par thos shing / dam tshig sel med par bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan du mas yongs su khyab pa'i mthar kun dga'i lo nyi ma kaṅka ṭa'i khyim du zhugs pa yar ngo rgyal ba gnyis pa'i tshes rnam par dkar ba la/ bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo bdag po dang bdag po chen po'i dbang rgyud sde nas gsung bzhin zhu ba'i bka' drin gtang rag gi g.yon du tshon tsam pa dang / dpal ldan bla ma dam pa zhabs pad skal brgyar brtan pa'i ched du bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rnam pa gnyis rdzogs pa byang chub chen po'i rgyur yongs su bsngos te/ rab shes rab kyi mnyes par byed pa/ bla ma la thos pa'i smin grol gdams pa mngon par 'khrul pa med pa gzhan la 'doms par byed pa maṇ+ḍal gyi mchog phul du gyur pa dang / rang nyid kyi kyang sgo gsum le lo med par 'jig bde dus gsum gyi lha sngags kyi ting 'dzin gyi rol par ci nus su brtson pa ni bla ma dgyes byed kyi maṇ+ḍal 'bring po'o/ /tha ma sgo gsum gyi zhabs tog gis dgyes par byed pa ste/ phyag bdar dang mngag zhugs las rnams yin 'dug na'ang / de ltar ni 851

5sngon gyi las skal gyis ma grub yang / de dag dang sgo mthun pa'i dod mtshungs su rang nyid kyi skye ba go sa rig pa'i yon tan gyi khengs pa rnams rgyab tu bor nas lus kyi phyag sngon du 'gro bas/ zhabs spyi bor len zhing ngag gi sgo nas snyan pa phyogs bcur brjod/ sems kyi sgo nas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dus kyi 'khor lo dang tha mi dad pa'i mi phyed pa'i dad pa brtan por ldem 'gyang med par brtan por byas pa 'di ni/ maṇ+ḍal mtha' dag gi gzhi bzung du byas nas yang mtha' zang zing gi maṇ+ḍal mtshon byed tsam la deng dus kyi bla slob rnams kyi ni 'di la gnang che che por mdzad 'dug dpal rdo rje sems dpa' ni yang mtha' zang zing gi maṇ+ḍal du gsung mod/ rang nyid kyi sems la yang gnang ha cang gi che che po zhig ni ye nas mi shar rung / yul lugs dang bstun pa'i zang zing gi dngos po maṇ+ḍal mtshon byed tsam du dbang bskur ni zhus su rgyud sde nas bshad bzhin gyi maṇ+ḍal zang zing ci 'grub dang / khrid bka' lung de dag gi skabs su yang rang gi dngos po spus bzang ngan ci byung bar ma chad par rim pas phul ba mtshon cing / cha shas ni dug cha yin par gsung na'ang / zang zing gi dngos po byung tshad 'phral du phyag tu gtang ba dang / rin po che'i rigs ni spang dag gi tshul gyi zang zing maṇ+ḍal gyi tshul te/ 'di ni ngo thon drin yus lta bu ma yin gyis/ phyin chad du dbang khrid zhu zhing bla ma brten pa rnams kyi kha stong lag stong du ma song bar 'di ltar dgos rgyur 'dug ces dper brjod du smras pa yin la/ spyir rdo rje sems dpa' gnang chung ngu gsung 'dug rung rang nyid la zhen pa yod phyin zang zing gi maṇ+ḍal 'di bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs pa'i thabs zang zing la rags lus nga/ lta bur 'dug pas 'bul ba lag len btab pa gal che nges su yin/ de lta na yang dad pa mos gus yod cing zang zing ye nas med pa la ni ma rtogs so/ /de skad skabs kyi 'phros don dang / 'dir da lam skabs kyi zang zing maṇ+ḍal mtshon byed tsam ni phyag dang rin po che dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal tshom bu so bdun bkra shis dge legs tshigs su bcad pa'i dar gyis bcib te phul ba sngon du byas nas rnam grangs kyi thog mar/ ka shi ka'i ras la rdo rje 'chang he ru ka gtso bor byas pa'i dus 'khor bla brgyud dang / rgyud ris sham+bha la'i bkod pa/ mdo ris nges don snying po'i mdo/ mdo lnga mi'i gling bzhi'i bkod pa/ nor 'khrul med pa'i phun sum tshogs pa'i ri mo rnam par bkra ba'i yol thang gling gsum gyi gong ba gos sngon thag bzang shos kyi sgrog dan dngul gyi a waṃ/ 'ja' gos dmar ser/ shan bu ling gi byas pa rgyu 'gro dngul bal ṭaṃ brgya dang bcu lhag nges 'gro ba'i spus legs/ sku yi rten gyi mtshon byed dang / gsung gi rten du nges don gyi pu sti drug sbyor drug khrid rtsa ba dang lhan thabs/ ngo sprod gsang don rab gsal zhes phyogs las pas mdzad pa/ kun mkhyen dol po pa'i rnam thar/ mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam thar pu ste ka rnams kyi mtshon pa dang / thugs 852

rten rdo rje rtse dgu gter byon dang / yon tan gyi rten du rin po che'i sgrum bu gru bzhi pa dang / rin chen dngul gyi ga'u/ 'phrin las kyi rten du zangs dung skad po che/ zhal dkar stegs bcas/ bzhugs gdan rdo rje'i ri mo bkra rnams dang / bdun tshan dang por bkra shis pa'i rdzas shing 'bras bil wa/ kham gser zho gang / khams dngul spus legs dngul srang brgyad dang zho do/ mdzod gos ser po rgya yig kha gang /byang dar dmar po yug ljang khu yug pa ri yug bdun tshan gnyis par dung chos/ ol thag spos shel lnga dang byi ru bcu bzhi mu men sogs yod pa/ gos chen mi sha kha kha gru/ a la ca kha do/ byang dar ljang khu yug gcig sman yug gcig so ra ha ti yug bdun tshan gsum par rdor dril/ ltag tshar g.yu lnga/ byi ru nyer bzhi/ spos shel bzhi/ spos shel gyi 'phreng ba dang dung 'phreng brgyan ldan/ a ma mu tig gi thod phu/ gos chen tshos gnyis kha gang / byang dar ser po yug snam dkar gnyis/ bdun tshan bzhi par rnam rgyal bum pa dang me bum/ g.yu drug dkar gyi gzer g.yu/ mchong 'phreng rgyan ldan gnyis dang ba so'i 'phreng ba mchod kong / rag gi nang mchod ka pā li/ ting bdun tshar/ bdun tshan lnga par shel dkar dri ma med pa/ gla rtsi/ zangs chas gras 'ga' khru/ ga'u gnyis/ gtor theb cha gcigazangs chung gcig li sder gcig rag 'gag gcig ka ṭo ra gcig shing cha'i gras zhib phor bzhi/phor pa che chung dgu/ shing sder gsum/ ser sder gsum/ gyon pa'i gras phyu pa rgya khra/ ske rags sbo cha dang bcas pa gnyis/ rgya tshos rgyan ldan/ sbrang ldong sbrang rtsi'i dri bzang dang bcas pa/ bkra shis rtags brgyad re kha tshang ba'i mdzod thag gangs ri'i mdangs ldan rnams te/ de ltar yan lag bdun dang ye shes lnga'i yon tan rnams rdo rje slob ma tshe dbang nor bu'i rgyud la myur du rtsal rdzogs pa'i mtshon byed du bdun tshan lnga yi dngos po maṇ+ḍal gyi tshul du phul ba dang / shes rab sgrub pa sgyu lus zang zing gi dge ba bsags pa rnams kyi nus pas bdag gi tshe rabs gzhan dang tshe 'di ru mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba rnams la phan pa'i phyir du lhag pa'i bsam pas theg pa chen po'i smon lam btab zin pa dang / da 'debs bzhin pa dang / slad mar 'debs par 'gyur ba rnams bslu ba med par skad cig ma 'di nyid du 'grub pa dang / dus sbyor 'di nyid du 'grub par byin gyis brlab par gsol ba 'debs/ de kho na bzhin 'gyur ba yang de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje sems dpa' dpal rab 'byams rgya mtsho rdo rje slob dpon bsnyen par ma ngags pa'i bden chen tshig dang / bdag gi 'dus dang 'dus ma byas pa'i dge rtsa mtha' dag gi nus pas theg pa chen po'i smon lam rnams bslu med gegs med par dus de ring nyid nas 'grub par gyur cig maṅga lam̐/na maḥbadz+ra sa twa gu ru bh+yaḥ rgyal kun ye shes kun 'dus ngo bo nyid/ /mtsho skyes bla ma tshe rabs kun 853

gyi skyabs/ /de dang tha dad mi dmigs 'khor lo'i mgon/ /pad+ma bde gling gsung rab rgya mtsho rgyal/ /'od dpag med mgon rgyal sras pad+ma 'byung / /gang gi rnam sprul kun mkhyen jo nang pa'i/ /bstan 'dzin skyes mchog mi yi seng ge gang / /kun bzang dbang por grags la gus phyag 'tshal/ /zhes ched du brjod nas/ kun dga' shing stag snron zla'i tshes mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i nyer gnyis snga char bdag po dang /bdag po chen po'i dbang bskur bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin ni nam mkha'i mtha' yang shong bar dka' zhing / rmad du byung ba'i thugs rje mchog gi 'dzin pa la maṇ+ḍal du 'dus dang 'dus ma byas pa'i dge tshogs kun byang chen rgyur yongs su bsngo ba nyid dang / gnas skabs su yang shes rab sgrub pas gzhi bzung / sgo gsum gus pas phyag sngon du 'gro zhing / yang dag don la rje btsun bla ma dus rnams kun tu kho bo'i spyi gtsug gnas las gzhan du mi g.yo mod/ 'on kyang tshur mthong skye bo'i snang ngor tsam du slad mar mjal bar smon cing / bdag re zhig phyogs med gdul bya'i phyir du 'gro bar 'gro phyag gi rten mtshon byed tsam du/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis pa'i tshig bcad kyi ri mo bkra ba'i lha rdzas rnam par dkar ba/ rin chen dngul gyi dong rtse so bdun tshom bur bkod pa gser g.yus spras pa maṇ+ḍal mtshon byed tsam dang rnam grangs mtshon pa'i bdun tshan lnga yi dang por/ dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal rgya thur gyi srang gang zho lnga/ ltag tshar g.yu gnyis/ spos shel bcu dgu/ byi ru bco lnga/ mu men gsum dang mchong bcas yod pa/ hor dar dmar po kha do 'bral/ sman rnying kha 'bral/ rgya zam yug bcas/ la dkar yugather ma dkar po sbug rnams/ bdun tshan gnyis par kong rna a bskor g.yu bcas/ kha btags/ sman kha 'bral/ rgya zam yug sham thab snam brgyad/ ser sked/ ther ma dkar po sbug rnams/ bdun tshan gsum par khrom tshar/ kha btags sman kha 'bral/ stod dar kha 'bral/ mon sked sran thig ma/ snam dkar ring thung gnyis rnams/ bdun tshan bzhi par kong rna g.yu bcas/ kha btags/ sman snying kha/stod dar li dbang kha 'bral/ sle'u rnam pa/ 'ga' snam/ snam dkar sbug bcas/ bdun tshan lnga par mchod kong li ting bdun tshar/ yas 'gu/ mas 'gu/ rag thur gnyis/ lcung 'gag ga'u gnyis/ li sder bcas bzang drug sman snas gang ba/ bkra shis pa'i lha rdzas bcas bdun tshan lngas mtshon dngos po'i maṇ+ḍal cha phra bar yang rnam par dkar po'i bsam pas rdo rje sems dpa'i gsung la yid ches pa nyid kyi slob dpon mchod pa la dga' ba dang / spro ba dang / kun nas dung ba dang / mi phyed pa'i yid kyi byang chub chen po'i rgyur myur du 'jug par 'dod cing / smon lam rnam par dag pa dang bcas pas rgya mtsho chu thig bzhin bgyis pa na/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor pa tshe dbang nor bus skye ba 'di nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang nam thob bar du/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun tshogs kyi 854

dpal ma lus shing lus pa med par thob cing / sangs rgyas sras dang slob mar bcas pa dgyes pa'i las la brtson pa dang / /rdo rje slob dpon dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten tshul mdo rgyud nas gsung pa ji bzhin nyams pa med par spyod nus pa dang / bdag nyid mthong thos dran reg gi 'gro ba rnams kyi sdug bsngal rtsad nas bcad cing bde ba mchog la bkod pa'i mthu sangs rgyas sras gyur gzhan thams cad las lhag pa bdag gi bsgrub nus par gyur cig sarba maṅga lo/na mo ma hā mu dra ye/ gdod nas rang gi ngo bo dri ma dang bral yang / /dri ma'i gnas lugs rtag par bzhugs kyang de mi skyon/ /nam yang ma gos kun gzhi bde gshegs snying po zhes/ /de yi rang zhal gsal bar bstan mod bla ma rje/ /gang gi zhabs sen zla ba tshes 'dra ba/ /skal ldan bde 'byung don du nyer bcings pas/ /skye dgu'i 'khrul mun yang nas yang gsal mdzod/ /gang de srid gsum mgon du rtag brtson mdzod/ /grub pa'i shing rta bzhi pa'i dbang gi don/ /phyag rgya che zhes grags pa'i man ngag mdzod/ /rdo rje slob dpon mchog gyur gang khyed kyi/ /zhabs la phyag byas tshogs gnyis mchod sprin spel//zhes gus pas phyag dang bcas te ched du brjod pa sngon du gtang nas bka' drin gsum ldan rdo rje slob dpon 'jam dbyangs 'phrin las rab brtan gang gi spyan sngar bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi tshogs rnam par gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i ched du zang zing gi maṇ+ḍal mtshon tsam phul ba/lha rdzas gangs ri'i mdangs ldan/ gos chen ngur smrig kha gru/ ja nag po shag brdar/ sman kha do 'bral/gser spus gtsang zho gang / rdo bcud rna pa la'i dong rtse so bdun/ ras dkar yug ras sngo yugarnam dkar spus legs yug rag sdig spus legs/ lcags skyogs spus legs/ gtor thebs gcigagos chen tshos gnyis ma kha 'bral/ g.yu gcig dung 'phreng rgyan ldan gcig bcas rnam grangs bco lnga rgya mtsho chu thig ltar 'bul lam zhus nas 'dod don gsol ba/ bdag ni skye ba 'di nas byang chen bar/ /khams drug lus thob mtshan ldan bla ma mjal/ /rgyal bstan sgor zhugs theg chen lam la spyod/ /sngags lam smin grol gdams pa myur thob shog /'khor ba la sun zhen log rgyud la skyes/ /thar pa'i lam ston bla mar mos gus brtan/ /rgyu 'bras 'dor len dam tshig bsrung la bston/ /bka' brgyud bla ma'i brgyud pa zin par shog /gnas 'gyu'i bar lag 'gyel ba'i rtse gcig rtogs/ /rnam rtog gzhi med rtsa bral spros bral shar/ /gnyis chos mnyam nyid rtogs pa'i ro gcig myong / /bsgom med rgyal ba'i gdan sa zin par shog /mdor na bka' brgyud rgyal po 'brug pa yi/ /rnam dag 'dzin pa rgya chen 'phrin las ldan/ /ma nor 'khrul pa med pa'i rnam rtog kun/ /de ring nyid nas bdag gi thob par shog /ces brang so rdzong phu'i sprul pa'i sku 'phrin las rab brtan zhabs dgyes par byed pa shes rab dang / sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal gtso bor gsungs 855

pa'i rjes mthun tsam dang / gnas skabs dngos po'i maṇ+ḍal cha shin tu phra ba cung zad 'bul ba'i 'bul yig tu rgyal khams bya bral rtogs ldan tshe dbang nor bus smras pa'i yig ris mkhas pa dam pa 'phrin las bstan 'dzin no/ /maṅga lo/dge'o/ /lags/ gnas shar pa'i bu mo yi skor ni/ nyid kyi bka' phebs ltar rong pa blo 'gyur sla ba yin nam/ khar sing dang por yul 'dir chos mgo mi thon pas khams su 'gro chog cing skra phud blang chog pa zhus byung / 1 de nas yul 'di'i bu mo chos mgo thon srol med pas dge ma rtsa ba nas mi byed pa'i dgongs pa zhu byung / 2 de nas bdag gi btsun mor byed rgyur 'dug pas 'gro mi nus zhes smras 'dug 3 de nas lam bar du phru gu byung tshe bdag gi bor 'gro zhes smras byung / 4 de nas skyid sdug ci byung yang chos snying nas dran pa yin zhes skra bcad tshangs par spyod pa'i dge bsnyen 'bog nas khams su 'gro bar thag bcad cing / bu mo rang yang pha mes cis kyang ma gtang na lkog tu yong dgos tshul thag bcad song / 5 da cha nyid kyi sku gzhogs su gzhag dgos tshul zhus 'dug rung / lar blo mi brtan 'di 'dra chos gsha' ma zhig yong bar dka' 'am snyam la/ bye brag tu khong rang nang tshang rnams kyi bsam byung thams cad tshig gi nga ros phyogs bcur 'bod cing 'gro gzhan bkur 'debs byed rten bsags pa'i las la rgod bro ba zhig byung / spyir kho bo nag mo la mig nye che rigs shig yin gshis/ de la dpag nas 'ol gtam gyi lung pa 'gengs pa 'di la de bas kyang rgod bro/ lar tshig spyod ci rigs smra ba 'di rna ba cung zad sun yang don dam sgyu ma'i ngo bor ci lto snyams/ lar rang ngos la nyes pa che ba med gshis kho rang rnams log lta shar las che rung 'gyod blo med cing spyir rgyal khams pa bdag kyang gzugs chung rung ma bcos gdod nas snang ba'i rnal 'byor gcig yin no snyam pa 'di klog 'gyur med tsam lags pas/ bstod smad phal gyi phan gnod la mi rtsi zhing khong rang tsho gang dgyes smras pa las 'os ci yod/'on kyang dam pa nyid kyi thugs bskyed rnam par dag pas khong rang tsho 'di phyi'i duḥkha mi myong ba'i thabs bzhed na/ kho rang gnas shar nub
