tsho la log lta mi byed pa'i bkod khyab gnang mdzod/ nga la ni khyad mi 'dug rje btsun nyid bdag gi yongs 'dzin du bzung ba'i drin can bla ma lags pas bka' gyen bzlog zhu ba ga la spob kyang / da lam ni khong rang pha spad kyi 'gro'am sdod blo la gang shar de thog gzhag pa las 'gro dgos pa'i nan bcir/ sdod chog pa'i yang cha gang yang zhu nus mi 'dug pas/ dgongs dbyings nas khrel 'khrungs med pa mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen/ rten lha reg la rgya zhus nas phul/na chung yongs kyi snying nor yan pa blo bde ma bcos gdod ma'i zog pos/ snying gi thig ler rab mdzes shākya'i dge slong gang gi sku mdun du/ phul lags/ snying gi thig ler rab tu mdzes pa bla ma o rgyan ngag dbang ye shes dpal bzang po'i ga la bar/ stabs bder phul ba'i yi ge/ deng skabs bcu 856

drug cha shas seng ge mo yi bu las thar ltar/ sku'i dkyil 'khor nyes tshogs las grol te bzhugs pa mchog tu dga' ba'i yid bde thob/ 'dir gnas rigs sngags 'chang ba yang / bstan 'gror lhag bsam lhod med rim gnyis brtson khul ngang du gnas/ mtshams zhu/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa gzhan don gzigs rkyen la brten thugs rlung skyes pa sngon las 'phral rkyen gang yin phebs pa/ 'phral g.yeng dbang gis rmi lam nges tig ma byung yang / yid la ni/ phal la sdug bsngal byas pas yul der gnod kyang / bla ma'i ched du sdug bsngal gyis mchil ma sran tsam bklags pas yang / skal pa re yis sgrib pa dag par bshad pas na/ bla ma zhing gzhan gshegs pa'i skyo shas kyi nad khams de ltar bskyed pa ni/ sngon las sku tshe phyi mar smin 'os shig tshe 'dir dag nas/ phyis kyi nyer len bcom par gor ma chags sems byung / 'on kyang 'phral rkyen cha shas tsam ni/ gnas rnying mtshun 'dre zhig gi 'tshub ldog ltas kyang shar bas/ mdos bskang gi skar bcos ci rigs dang / gnyen po drag bsnyen la 'bad na legs pas dgongs 'tshal la/ khyad par du/ sems kyi 'tshub nyams/ sdug bsngal/ yeng ma yeng snyam pa'i blo sogs/gang mi bde ba de ka spang gnyen grim klod byar med/ kho rang de ka bsgom yin/ dran pa yin/ rig pa yin gyi/ yid mi bde ba de las gzhan pa'i sems dang / sems las gzhan pa'i yid mi bde ba med de/sems nyid dang rnam rtog gnyis tshan dang / bye brag nam du yang ma byung bas/ yid bde mi bde la spang blang ci yod/ gang shar gdong 'ded ngang la lam du khyer ba ste/ lam khyer zhes pa ste yang gnyen sprad rgyu ni med mod/ dpal dwags po yab sras kyi ma yengs dran par btags pa de ka ste/ dran pa zhes pa de yang / bsgom 'dun dang rig rig tur tur po ga la yod/ yang dag pa'i dran pa ni dper brjod bsam pa'i yul thams cad las 'das pa ste/ de'i gnad thun mong ma yin pa rdzogs chen nas rig pa cog gzhag tu grags te/ las dang po'i skabs su gzhag thabs grim slod du ma bshad kyang / lhag mthong rgyud la skyes tshe dran pa'am/ rig pa 'di bya 'di byed 'di bsgom de bsgom med pa'i yan pa blo bde bya ba de lags te/ bde sdug gang yang lta ba las gzhan du ma grub pa de ka de dang la rgyun chad med par nyams su len pa lam khyer ste/ yang dag pa mthar thug tshe nyams su len bya len byed kyang gzhi med rtsa bral ye stong du thag chod pa nyid de/ gang yang bya rgyu med pa'o/ /ci zhu na sdug bsngal 'tshub nyams de nyid lam du khyer ba'i yul mthil po lags pas de ltar 'tshal/ des ni rkyen ngan gyi steng du grub pa thob zhes pa de yong ba lags/ de dag thugs nang ches dag dam tshig 'dres la brten dgongs par dus su babs snyams nas phul ba thugs la 'jug pa dang / phyis ngos su mjal bar gyur na zhib mol rgyas par spro lags/ thugs la babs pa'i chos bka' 'dra yang phul bzhed do/ /de srid dus rnams kun tu rang 857

rig dag pa cho 'phrul gyi 'khor lo ru g.yel med brtsa bar bgyid kyi dgongs par 'tshal/ da lam bsnyun las grol ba'i legs skyes su/ /dkar dmar reg bya thabs dang shes rab mtshon/ /lnga ldan rdor mdud sku dang ye shes ste/ /sna gsum der phul tshe 'phrang gsum grol shog /de skad rta mchog byin rlabs btsan yul byang / /gu ru'i zhabs bcags zla gam 'bar ba yis/ /phug nas sngags 'chang yan pa blo bde bas/ /thun mong gro zhun zla 2pa'i tshes 3la spel/rje btsun bla ma rin po che blo gros chos 'phel zhabs kyi rnam thar sngar gnang ba de la bsnon 'os rnams bsnon pa dang mya ngan 'das 'byung bcas rgyas pa zhig gnang ba dang / phyag chen bla brgyud 'ba' ra nas nam mkha' rgyal mtshan bar yid la ma nges 'dug pas shog tshar zhig kyang gnang tshal/ lags/rje btsun bla ma dam pa rdo rje 'chang khams longs sku zhabs kyi rnam par zhig phyis kyi chos brgyud la 'kho kha gces par 'dug rab sku zhabs rang nas gsung rtsom dang / ma gnang na/ zhal las lo rgyus gnang ba rnams ma bor bar bsdu ba dang / thun min rnams kyang skal ldan dngas pa 'dren phyir cis kyang gnang ba'i gsol ba 'debs pa la brtson dgos lags/ shin tu gal che che'o/ /rnam thar bsdu ba po 'os su bab pa nyid kho na mthong bas dgongs par le lo med par zhu zhu/ zhes rten 'byung ba'i shu kra zla ba rgyas 'dra dus kyi grangs ldan phul/ shes bya'i gnas la blo gros kyi pad+mo rgyas pa dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa gang gi sku drung du/ skye re yang dben nas rig pa 'dzin pas/ pad+ma'i spyan sngar smon lam rnam par dag/che mchog phur pa'i bka' bab rig pa 'dzin/ /ye shes gzhon nu'i 'od zer brgya phrag 'gyed/ /des byin rlabs khyod rtag tu rgyal gyur cig /deng dus khams drug rdo rje sku g.yo med/ /'tsho zhing gzhes nas rdo rje gsum dkyil 'khor/ /bsgom bzlas ting 'dzin rol par rtag brtson zhing / /rang gzhan don gnyis bsgrub la rjes yi rang / /'dir gnas rgyal dbang pad+ma'i pho nya bar/ /gang des rdo rje'i gsung gi dbugs dbyung pa'i/ /rig pa 'dzin zhes ming skam phyogs tha grur/ /khyab pa de yang lnga phung snyoms khul mchis/ /rang cag skye sngon smon lam bzang po'i mthus/ /tshe 'di la yang 'phrad cing bdag blor gshis/ /de bzhin khyod blo dad pa'i bum bzang la/ /mos gus lam 'gyangs med pa'i bcud kyis gtam/ /nged dang me lug lor 'phrad da lta'i bar/ /dam tshig sel med dpag bsam shing ltar mjes/ /slad mar ji srid 'tsho yi bar dag tu/ /bar chad bdud kyi nam yang phyed min pa/ /pha lam rdo rje'i ri bo ji bzhin du//dam tshig gnyen las 'da' med spyod par smon/ /ring po ma yin myur ba nyid 'phrad nas/ /dam pa'i dga' ston 'bel mchid bgyid kyang spro/ /dus rnams kun tu dge ba'i bsrung 'khor gyis/ /ra ba dag las khyod nyid 'dor min pas/ /nam zhig pad+ma 'od du pad 'byung gis/ /spyan sngar tshom bu gcig tu 858

'khod par sems/ /de skad skye re rig gnas sgrub phug nas/ /chu glang hor zla drug pa'i tshes 23bzang por/ /lha rdzas rnam par dkar ba'i rten dang bcas/ /lhag bsam dge ba yid kyi legs par spel/rdo rje'i slob ma las skal ldan pa gang de'i sku drung du/ rig sngags 'dzin pas phul/ lags/ /gnas tshul stabs bder 'bul ba'i yi ge/ 'dir gnas pa dpal gyi bhu ṭa dang / lha gdong / rgyal gyi shri sogs brgyud nas bu le gangs kyi ra bar bgrod pa'i lam zhugs su gnas shing / phyogs der 'khod pa'i mi dang mi ma yin pa rnams la sman pa'i bsam blo mi dor bar 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i bstan pa spel 'dun bcas mchis zhes 'di ka'i gnas tshul dang / de nas 'di lo 'ba' rar phebs thub pa zhig byung na bka' brgyud gong ma'i bstan pa phan thog 'byung ba dang / nyid kyi yang bar chad 'ga' zhig sel bar 'gyur ba'i legs lam che bar ltas yod rung / chos la 'tshe ba mang ba ji bzhin du bol ba de cung zad rten 'brel la gnod mod kyang / rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor la gang shar gdong 'ded las ched 'dzin ni byar ci yod/ des na re zhig 'ba' rar ma phebs phyin tshe'i bar chad sel ba'i rten 'brel legs lam gang 'grigs kyi ngos khreg chod lta ba'i gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bo la/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba thod brgal gyi nyams len zung 'jug tu spel ba mthil du btsugs/ lha sngags rlung thig gi rtsal spar te lo re'i sum cha gnyis bcad rgya dang / sum cha gcig gzhan phan gyi 'phrin las la brtson par thugs la bzhugs pa gal che zhing / spyir gsang bar 'os pa cung zad zhig 'dir brjod na/ bdag tshe dbang nor bu la sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba gsung gi rdo rje chos 'od dpag tu med pa/ gu ru pad+mas lung bstan pa ltar na rang gzhan gyi don gnyis 'grub nges pa'i slob ma bdun cu rtsa lnga/ thar pa'i lam rkang zin nges pa bdun brgya/ phra ma chos kyi 'brel pa khri phrag long ba ru lung bstan pas/ de dag rnams kyang bdag gi skye ba 'di gcig bur ni ma nges la de yang lho brag mkhar chu gnam skas can gyi thugs gter gu ru chos dbang dang / gsang gter ni rat+na gling pas spyan drangs tshar ba nyid ste/ zab gter ni kho bo la dbang bar lung bstan pa lags na yang skye ba snga ma 'ga' zhig gi rten 'brel la brten nas tshe 'dir rngo thog pa zhig mi yong ba 'dra bas/ des na skye ba phyi mar zab gter de 'don skabs gong du lung bstan pa phal cher kyang 'grig par mngon/ lho brag gi zab gter thon pa'i skye ba de nas las rlung gi rgyu ba chad de/ da lta'i sprul pa'i rigs rgyun 'di ka sprul gzhi badz+ra te ru ka'i go 'phang la nges par bzhugs pa rig 'dzin thugs kyi rdo rje'i dgongs klong du thim par bshad ste/ de dag ni gsang bar 'os pa'i tshig yin kyang skal ba dang ldan pa'i slob ma nyid la gnas tshul ma sbas par smras pa yin la/ 'dir brjod bya'i dngos po ni gong gi 'phros rang gzhan gyi 859

don gnyis lhun gyi grub nges pa'i slob ma bdun cu rtsa lnga'i nang nas mchog gi skyes bu sum cu rtsa drug las nye ba'i bu brgyad kyi nang nas gcig dam pa nyid yin ste/ de yang gsang ba'i lung byang las/ da lta'i dzha na ku ma'i rnam sprul ni: mang yul ri rgyal dpal 'bar shar gyi char: sngags skyes dz+nyā na'i ming can snying sme can: byang sems shes rab ldan pa'i skyes bu 'byung : zhes pa'i lung don ltar som nyi med par nyid yin gyi/ des na phyogs der slob ma'i thu bor gyur pa snying gi bu bzhi'i nang tshan sprul pa'i sku pad+ma 'gyur med nor bu de dang / rje nyid rang lung zin gyi slob ma lags pas chos kyi brgyud bzung la gzhan don gyi 'phrin las nam yang mi slod par theg chen spyi dang / khyad par sngags/ dgos su bka' brgyud kyi rgyal po dri ma med pa stod 'brug rang lugs kyi man ngag phyag rgya chen po'i khrid chen brgyad dang bcas pa/rdzogs pa chen po klong gsal mkha' 'gro snying thig gi man ngag gzhan las khyad par du ma byas pa'i smar khrid rnams skal ldan gyi slob ma rnams la skyo dub med par gang nus su spel bar 'tshal zhing / des ni dus gsum gyi rgyal ba rnams kyi dgongs pa bskangs shing brgyud pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyi thugs kyi dges dgu 'grub la/ de bzhin du gdul bya'i don du yang srid 'jug par rlom pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu'i yang a la rjes su yi rang shing / gzhan don du dbugs dbyung ba dang gzeng bstod do/ /ci'i phyir zhe ne/ tshe 'dir dam sel med cing rim gnyis kyi sbyor ba la brtson na da ste rags pa'i skye ba bcu gnyis bgrod mthar ho ru ka'i go 'phang la reg ste rang cag dpon slob thugs yid gcig tu 'dres shing tshom bu ru 'khod par 'gyur ro zhes pa tha tshig go /'on kyang 'dir ltar smra bar/kha cig gi blo ru mi shong zhing yid gnyis kyi chu rlabs drag tu g.yo ba'i rkyen du 'gyur bas brjod pa'i go skabs med kyang / nyid kyi yang nas yang du do gal chen pos bskul tshe gsung gcog pa'i nyes byas su dogs nas 'dir brjod pa yin gyis/ de la gzhan dag mgu dang mi mgu ji ltar shar yang rang gi drang po'i gtam tshig sbyor ba la ya nga ba dang bag tsha ba ma mchis te/ gang zhe na/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi gsung snga rabs gter ston tshad ldan gyi lung du ma nas ni rang nyid bsngags/ 'phags chen gyi sa la bzhugs pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi ni gzengs bstod/ khyad par du bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs snying la zhugs pas lta ba'i gnas lugs ma 'khrul ba mthong bas na rang gi rang la dbugs dbyung / bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams nyams dang mi lam gyi snang bar yang yang mjal zhing rgyud byin gyis rlabs/ tshe 'di snang gi zhen pa ni sngon las kyi 'phen pas byis pa'i dus nas cha phra bas rang 'dod g.yo sgyu'i gzhan mgo bskor ba ni gtan nas med/ khyad par mi chos bla ma'i rdzun ni/ so thar gyi pham ltung dang / byang sems kyi rtsa ltung du 'gyur zhing / rig 'dzin sngags kyi skabs su yang ngag gi nus pa 860

bden tshig las 'byung phyir des na de lta bu'i brdzun tshig ni smra ba'i do gal ci la mchis pas/ tshul bzhin brjod pa'i gtam la gzhan mi 'gu bar srid kyang / don des rang nyid zhum pa ma mchis so de ltar da lam gnas tshul las 'phros te tshad ma'i lung gi skye 'phreng gi snying po gsal bar byas shing / cha shas 'ga' zhig ni rten 'brel la dmigs te slad mar gleng bar 'dod do/ /zhes rten tsaṇ+ḍa li'i kha dog can gyi dar rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum gyi brgyan ste lcags phag hor zla bcu pa'i yar tshes 4la la stod rgyal gyi shri'i ngogs nas rig pa 'dzin par grags pa des spel/ sngon bsags bsod nams dag pa'i las 'bras kyi/ /mngon mtho rnam par dge ba'i rigs 'khrungs shing / /nges legs bslab gsum yon tan yongs kyi spud/ /bshes gnyen dam pa rdo rje 'dzin de'i drung / /rnam mang 'du 'dzi'i rgya mtsho 'khrug pa'i dbus/ /lhag bsam gser gyi gling la yong brtan nas/ /don gnyis rin chen blang la ches brtson pa'i/ /sprul pa'i ming tsam 'dzin pa des smra mchid/ /rnam dkar dge bas spyod pa'i blo mtsho la/ /dri med zla shar byin rlabs zla ris kyi/ /yongs 'khyud snyigs dus 'gro ba'i tsha gdung rnams/ /sel mkhas snying gi bu khyod rgyal gyur cig /khyod kyi blo la nyes pa'i skyon med na/ /gcal sgrogs gtam gyi sgrib par 'gyur min gyis/ /cha shas srid kyang stobs bzhi tshang ba yis/ /bshags pas deng nas sor chud bdag dbugs dbyung / /'on kyang rtag tu mnyam gzhag dran pa yi/ /phyin chad g.yo med dam tshig che skyong 'tshal/ /khyod dang bdag gnyis smon lam dag pa'i mthus/ /skye ba 'ga' ru tshom bu gcig tshogs sems/ /dam sel ma byung skye ba phyi ma yang / /rtag tu 'grogs par 'gyur la the tshom med/ /de phyir 'di phyi dge ba'i legs smon la/ /'bad pa chab gcig g.yel ba med kyang 'tshal/ /de skad rang bzhin rdzogs chen rnal 'byor pa/ /ku yangs khyab brdal spyod pa'i smyon pa ni/ /tshe dbang nor bu gza' gtad bral ba yis/ /ru lag gyong nas zla tshes dge la phul/ /maphyo pa'i spyan ras pad+ma ltar rgyas pa dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa gang de'i sku drung du/ zhu ba/ deng dus gdul bya'i chu snod du sku'i zla gzugs 'gog pa med pa nyer 'tshe'i rlabs kyi ma bslad par bzhugs pa nas gsung shog rten gyi phung po rtags kyi re kha nyams pa med pa snga phyir stsal ba rnams snyim/ par son pas dga' ba'i sprin phung cir yang rgyas/ nye lam zhu 'os/ rdo rje slob dpon ches che ba rdo rje 'dzin pa pad+ma rig 'dzin dbang gi rgyal po'i zhabs gzugs sku chos dbyings su bsdu ba'i skabs de khar dgongs dbyings rin po che khrel tshom gyi rnam pa cung zad brten tshul rim par thos pas yid spyo shas las kyang ches skyo zhing mchi ma bku ba'i gnas su gyur kyang re zhig gzhan byar ma byung / 'on te rang blo la mi gus pa log lta khyad gsod brnyas bcos tshul min gyi bya ba byed blo gtan nas med par gzhan rkyen gyi dbang 861

kho nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dgongs pa tshom par gyur na thar 'bras phyir bsring ba sogs spyir nyes pa dpag tu med mod/ yin na yang rang blo la log lta gtan nas med phyin rtsa ba'i dam nyams su ni mi 'gyur bar sa bcu pa'i rnam 'phrul rje btsun bla ma'i zhal lung las 'byung gi lhag tu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig ni gser dngul gzhom pa dang 'dra bas gso bar bsngags pa dang / khyad par du dam pa nyid du nyid kyi thugs la bslad spu tsam med par nges tshe sgrib pa chen po ni ci la 'gyur/ de lta na yang gsum ldan rdo rje slob dpon thugs ma dgyes par ni ma legs pas gong ma de nyid kyi dgongs pa bskang ba'i cho ga drag por rang byung rang shar gyi rgyud nas bshad pa ltar ji bzhin par 'grub na nyes byas cha shas nas dag par sems la/ gang ltar yang bshags pa'i cho ga grub pa'i mtshams sam de las 'gyangs tsam zhig nas nyams sam rmi lam gyi snang bar sgrib pa dag cing nyes pa med par dbugs dbyung bar yang 'dod do/ /de ltar rang la nyes pa chen por med kyang nyams chags zhes mi snyan pa'i tshig 'byung ba 'di yang sngon gyi las su nges te/ de gang zhe na/ nyid kyi skye ba mang zhig 'das pa'i snga rol du nam mkha' rdo rje ces bya ba'i rnal 'byor par gyur te rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid mya ngan la 'da' la nye ba'i skabs sgrub gra'i rdo rje slob dpon du brko bar bzhed de 'bod par gnang na yang rten 'brel gyi dbang gi lam dus ring du dkar bas zhal ma mjal ba de nyid nyes byas phra mor gyur pa'i 'bras bu/dus 'dir mi snyan pa'i gtam dang / nyams chags chung ngu'i rgyur gyur pa las de yi bskyed par mngon te/ de yang tshur mthong gis dpyad na/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bka' bcag pa'i blo ye nas med par le lo'i dbang cung zad kyi gshegs khar ma mjal ba la nyes byas phra mo yang yong dogs ma kha na'ang / rtsa ba'i bla ma'i dam tshig rnams ni cha phra mo yang shin tu gnyan no zhes pa'i don yin gyi des na tshor ba rnams ni smos kyang ci 'tshal zhing / ma tshor ba'i nyams chags phra mo rnams kyang bshags sbyangs drag por 'bad pa dang / lus dang srog la ltos pa med par dam tshig rnam par dag pa byed dgos pa ni rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba chos kyi nying khu yang dag pa'o/ /nyid lta bu'i gzhung lugs legs par mkhyen pa'i dam pa la 'di ltar zhu dgos pa ni ma lags kyang / mjes tshon med par phebs gsal dgos zhes gsung gi bskul ba ltar rang gi blo la ji ltar 'char ba bzhin lhug par brjod pa lags pas dgongs 'jug zhu/ zhes gzigs rten lha rdzas rnam par dkar ba gangs ri'i mdangs ldan dngas gsal sgrib med dam tshig rnam par dag pas mtshon gtsang ru lag smyug gu lung nas rig pa 'dzin pa tshe dbang nor bu'i spel/dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa gang gi sku gzhogs su/ stabs bder zhu ba/ deng sku 'tsho dngas shing mdzad khyab gong 'phel du bzhugs pa yid kyi sman yon du gyur/ kho bo cag kyang lnga phung bde ngos dge blo 862

dor med du mchis/ mtshams zhu/ rin chen chos dag dkon la rtag tu 'tshe ba mang / /zhe pa ltar yin pas/ spyir 'ba' rar phebs ma thub pa de rten 'brel la gnod pa dang lhag tu da dung yang sku tshe mdzad 'phrin la bar chad kyi ltas phran bu shar bas/ re zhig bsgrub pa gtsor 'don 'tshal/ zhes yar tshes bzang por bkra bzang nas phul/lags/ nang lugs stabs bder 'bul ba/ ngos kyang da lta khams snyoms zhing pha tre bo yi sku 'bum la rab gnas bsgrub pa'i—ngang du mchis/ khar sing nas der mi gcig gtang 'dun lags kyang da bar 'gyang song / si tu yang tshes tsam phebs sam snyams pa 'dug de bar rab gnas brgya rtsa sgrub rtsis yin/'on kyang sgrol phug pa yang byung bar/ chos sad sud 'dra thun bar du 'chad dgos yang 'dug tshes 15la dus 'khor sdom pa chen po'i dbang zhig zhal lu ba'i don gnyer rnams la bskur rtsis yin/ des nyid de nas thugs stabs nam bder phebs chog la/ lhag tu tshes 13la 'dir 'byor tsam gnang na legs 'dra lags/ 'phral du ngos mjal yongs stabs gnas tshul zhib pa 'bul ma thub/ gzim shag yang 'dir sleb phral phyag mdzod la zhus nas legs po gcig yong ba yod lags/ zhes tshes la phul/skyes mchog rdo rje 'dzin pa gang gi sku gzhogs su/ zhu ba/ deng dus sku yi dkyil 'khor mchog tu dwangs shing gzhan phan 'phrin las kyi 'od dkar 'bum du 'phro bas skal bzang snying gi ut+pal dkar po rgod par byed pa gdul bya'i dpal du lhan ner snang bas bka' drin mchog tu che la/ ngos kyang sngar mu bzhin 'tsho ba snyoms khul nas rong phyogs kyi chos kyi 'brel pa bgyid dgos rnams grub pas da lta kham bu lung du 'gro skabs su mchis/ mtshams zhu/ de nas phyag bris rten gyi dngos po gya nom pa dang bcas pa 'dir son pas yid kyi dga' ba bla na ma mchis pa thob cing / zab phur bdud rtsi sman gyi cho ga bar chad med par rnam par dag pa thar son du grub pa rjes su yi rang zhing / mchod sman gyis 'phur ma rtsal ba yang thob pas rten 'brel legs par shar/ hor zla dang po'i skabs su brtan bzhugs tshig bcad 'bul mi zhig gtong dgos yod kyang le los 'gyang rung / da lam phul bar tshogs su 'phral 'dzugs dang / slad mar ji myur mjal bar 'dun cing / der zab khrid rnams kyang 'phel gang che bka' drin che 'tshal la/ khyod kyi slob brgyud 'dzin pa gaṅga'i rgyun ltar chad pa med cing / bsgrub brgyud 'dzin pas sa 'di khengs par shog zhes snying nas smon pa lags/ zhes 'degs rten lha gos rnam par dkar bas bcibs te pha bla ma'i gdan sa rong dkar cog nas zla tshes 23dge bar rig pa 'dzin pas spel/bdag snying mjos par byed pa'i rdo rje slob ma gang gi sku drung du/ nang lugs stabs bder 'bul ba deng sku'i dkyil 'khor mchog tu dwangs shing / mdzad 'phrin bzang po gong 'phel du bzhugs pa ni 863

shin tu nas spro/ ngos kyang lnga phung gi 'tsho ba snyoms shing bstan 'gror lhag bsam mi dman pas gzhan phan gyi 'phrin las go yangs por da bar kong po khul gyi gnas yul gyi bdud rtsi'i spyod par 'gor zhing /da cha sbas pa'i yul pad+ma dkar po zhes spu bo'i phyogs su bskyod rgyu dang / de nas mdo khams su kaḥthog rdo rje gdan gyi zhig gso rnams sgrub par phyin pa'i de dag legs par grub bstun/ slar yang dbus gtsang su yong ngos nailnga la sogs 'phags yul du bskyod rtsis bcas/ mi ring bar mjal bar 'dun cing / de srid du sku'i 'tsho gzhes dang / rim gnyis kyi nyams gzhes sogs lhod med gong 'phel du yod pa mdzad 'tshal/ zhes spyan ras g.yo rten lha rdzas rnam par dkar ba bcas zla 2tshes 5dge bar dpal rig pa 'dzin pas kong yul brag gsum gyis ljongs nas phul/skyes mchog 'ba' ra ba'i seng ge'i khri bsrung ba dge ba'i bshes gang gi sku gzhogs su/ nang lugs stabs bder phul ba/ deng sku 'tsho dwangs shing mdzad 'phrin gong 'phel du bzhugs pa gzhir bcas/ ngos kyang lnga phung 'tsho ba snyoms pa nas gzhan phan 'phrin las kyi sgo yangs por spyod cing mdo khams su lam bgrod skabs su mchis/ slad char mi ring bar yang mjal bar smon cing / de srid du sku nyid nas kyang rang don rim gnyis dang gzhan don 'phrin las kyi 'jug sgo mi dman par sngar mu bzang po bzhin g.yel ba med pa gnang dgos pa mkhyen tshor gcags pa zhu zhing / dus kun dge ba'i bsrung 'khor ra ba nas kyang g.yel med bgyid 'dun bcas dgongs dbyings su 'jug pa 'tshal/ zhes rten lha rdzas rnam par dkar ba bcas mal gro'i lam bar dkar grong nas dpal rig pa 'dzin pas tshes dge bar phul ba'i zhu yig go/ /bsgrub brgyud bstan pa'i ring lugs pa chen po gang gi sku drung du phul/ dpal rig pa 'dzin pa'i zhu yig go /bsgrub brgyud bstan pa'i ring lugs pa chen po gang gis sku drung du/ zhu ba/ deng dus lhag bsam gyi thugs bskyed ma smad pas grub pa'i bste gnas chen por zhig gso dang / bstan pa la 'phel bskyed gang che mdzad pa rjes su yi rang lags/ ngos kyang lnga phung gi 'tsho ba snyoms khul nas gzhan phan gyi 'phrin las 'jug sgo yangs por mchis/ mtshams zhu/ de yang shar phyogs ljon pa'i tshal nas yar bskyed de gnyal nas brgyud/ khra 'brug bsam yas rnams su mchod pa'i sprin gyis mchod par byas shing /de bzhin snga 'gyur gyi ring lugs pa chen po smin grol gling du khri rin po che dang / rje btsun drung gi gtsos blo dang ldan zhing don du gnyer ba tshom bur gyur pa la rdzogs chen klong sde dang / man ngag gi sde/yang gsang bla med snying thig gnyis kyi dgongs pa 'dus pa bcas kyi dbang khrid lung gis thugs kyi re ba bskang bar byas shing / de nas kyang lha ldan du sa dbang chen po'i mjal phyag zhus nas rim pas stod 864

lung mtshur phur dpal karma pa'i khri 'don bgyis shing / dpal dam pa dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang bdag po dang bdag po chen po'i dbang gi bar dang / bhi ma la'i snying thig gi dbang lung khrid bcas phul zhing / de nas slar yang da lta lha ldan du sleb ste sa dbang chen po'i mjal phyag zhu zin la/ re zhig bod yul phyogs su sdod par bka' phebs kyang / re zhig lo khams phyogs su 'gro ba'i dgongs pa zhu rtsis su byas pa gnas tshul dang / bdag ni chos su rlom pa'i chos brgyad kyi khrod du 'di ltar brdzi ba yis nyin mtshan med par rnam g.yeng kho nas lus ngag yid gsum sbyongs bzhin du gnas/'on te bstan pa la bya ba bgyi 'os yang mang du grub/ da ni mi ring bar shar phyogs shing lo'i tshal du bskyod 'dun yin mdo khams nas sde dge'i pho nya ched gnyer yang byung / slad mar mjal bar yang 'dun zhing / dus kun dge ba'i skyabs 'jug yang dag bgyid pa dgongs pa'i do rar 'jug pa zhu zhu/zhes lha rdzas rnam par dkar ba bcas zla 4tshes 28dge bar dpal rig pa 'dzin pas 'khrul snang gtsug lag khang gi shar 'dabs nas phul maṅga lo/rang bstan gsal bar byed pa snying dbus kyi thig ler mdzes par byed pa gang gi sku drung du/'bul 'bras/ deng phun sum tshogs pa'i dge mtshan bco brgyad kyi khyad par du byas pa'i rten bzang po don yod pa'i mdzad pa mtha' dag gi rab dang phul dang / rtse mo dang mchog tu gyur pa zab mo'i de kho na nyid kyi rnal 'byor las gzhar yang mi g.yo ba nas mnyam rjes dbyer med rig stong spros bral chen po'i klong du 'byams klas pa nas gzhan phan 'phrin las kyi rnam rol ma 'gags par 'char ba kun tu dge ba'i ngo mtshar 'ba' zhig tu grub pas phan bde'i lang tsho gsar bzhin pa nas phyag bris/ rten gyi dngos po snga phyi rnams nyams bral 'byor bas dpa' spro bltas/ ngos kyang sa dbang chen po'i mjal kha rnams zhib lhod kyi legs par grub nas da lta chos gling sprul skur chos bka' la sogs gdams ngag zab rgyas kyi grol bar bgyid skabs su mchis/ mtshams 'bras/ da lam tho don bzhin phyag dpe rnams 'di khar ngos rang la 'dug pa dang dogs chod bcas phul yod lags shing / med rigs rnams sprul pa'i skur g.yar po zhus shing phul bas rtsis gzhes dang / phyag dpe kyang sa'i rtsa ba ma zad slar thugs nang dag pa'i khyad kyi de ka'i phyag bris rten dar dkar dmar rnams chos gling sprul skur phul nas phyag bris zhig kyang bskur dgos tshul smras nas thul yod/ ces sman sgrub kyi legs gso bcas ṭaṃ kha btags bcas rig pa 'dzin pas chos gter gling nas phul/rang bstan gsal bar byed pa rdo rje 'dzin pa gang gi sku drung du/ stabs bder 'bul 'bras/deng dus nges don mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku yi snang brnyan gyi zla gzhon gdul bya'i chu snod du nam 865

yang 'gog pa med par 'char bzhin las/ thugs rje yis bsil zer kun nas 'phro bas skal bzang ku mu ta yis 'phreng ba bzhad par mdzad nas bzhugs lags sam/ ngos cag 'dir snang ba yang lnga 'dus kyi phung po gro ba drag pos ma mnar tsam nas gzhan phan gyi khur bsam nam yang 'dor ba med pa'i ngang nas rgyal bstan gyi bya ba ci nus su 'bad de 'dzin khul mchis/ gzhan yang zhu 'os/ kha sing nyid phebs pa'i zla 'phros der/ snga 'gyur bstan pa'i rtsa lag bras sprul pa'i sku dpon slob phebs par/ bka' chos kyi thugs kyi bzhed pa gong 'phel du bskang zhing / de nas lam 'bras zhu bar lha khud rje drung du bcar yang / rgyud lam gyi dbang tsam nod cing / slar thos bsam gling gi mkhan por gsang rir lam 'bras yongs su rdzogs pa lan gsum nos pa'i skabs su mchis/ 'dir rang gi phar chos 'chad pa'i bral ba yang phal cher bsrang ba'i skabs su yin lags/ snga phyir shang stag sna ba'i bang chen mang bar byung bas phyogs der zla ba gsum pa'i nang la sleb pa'i chad don byas pa yin rung / 'on te rang re'i rten 'brel 'char sgo dang bstun lha ri gang bzang gang rigs su thog mar bgrod rtsis yin/ spyir 'di lo rmi lam 'tshub 'gyur che zhing / ltas rgya ma do du ma 'char ba bcas 'phral kong yul phyogs su 'gro thub na bsam pa'i 'dun pa yod/ de nas yang skyes mchog chen po'i bstan pa lhag bsam khur gzhes kyi kho rang tshos don du gnyer mi gnyer gang yin kyang / dbang khrid lung sogs bstan rgyun la gang phan mdzad 'tshal gyis/ 'on kyang pho nya ba'i ngag bsgros ltar na/ de kha'i rtogs ldan btsun ma rgan gzhon kun chos kyi gra dri chen po mi gos pa 'dra zhig yod tshod 'dug lags/ skyes mchog chen po'i gdan sar bstan pa mtha' la thug pa de 'dra zhig yod 'dug bsam yid ma rang ba dang / snying nas skyo ba zhig byung / 'on kyang lhag bsam gyi thugs bskyed dor ba med pa nas skyes mchog chen po'i bstan pa la phan sleb gang che dgongs par 'jug 'tshal/ kho bos kyang rtag tu bsrung ba'i do ra nas 'dor med ngos/ dge ba'i skyabs 'jug yang dag bgyid pa chos klong dam par bzhugs pa 'tshal/ zhes 'degs rten lha gos rnam par dkar ba bcas sting skyes kyi gsang ri nas zla tshes bzang por phul/lags/ kha sing ra lung du rtse 'dzom tsam phebs na zhus pa yin rung / 'on te kho bo cag gi rmi ltas 'gyur nyams che ba'i stabs shis gnyan khrod zhig 'gram mam mnyam pa'ang yod pas/ des na rtse 'dzom thub min the tshom zhig byung lags kyi/ de phyir/ chos 'chad nyan don gnyer ba yod na der bzhugs pa dang / de bzhin med na phyogs der bzhugs par dgos pa ha cang ma che bas/ re zhig dbus gnas gzigs pa dang / lhag tu mi dbang chen po la mjal phyag zhig zhus na mi legs sam/ gzhan sde pa rje btsun drung la yang yi ge nar ma chad pa 'tshal gyi/ de bas dus snyigs ma'i mi 'di 'gyur ldog tsha ba 866

'dug pas ltos pa dgos phyin brtsan phyogs gang legs kyang 'tshal/ 'on kyang da lam phyogs gar phebs kyi gnas gtso bor da gongs pas bcad pa zhig dang / lhag tu sku 'dra yid bzhin nor bu'i mdun du rtags sgril zhig nyams mtshar dbang gi zhus na legs 'dra/ yang dbus su 'phral phebs ma shar na/mi dbang chen por zhu shog zhig phul ba ni gang spyir legs so/ /tshes 25bzang por phul/ yig chung 'bul 'bras/ nyid 'ba' rar bzhugs pa dang / 'grig na skyes mchog chen po 'i gdan sa der stag snar 'gro ba'i zhor du khyug tsam gang sleb rtsis byed cing / 'di nas lha ri dang / spa gro stag tshang thag nye tsam 'dug pa bcas stabs gcig la spa gror rib tsam 'gro shas che zhing / phyogs der 'brum pa yod skad 'dug pas nyid kyi ma thar ba bcas de phyogs su phebs rtsis gnang gzhan 'dra zhing / der thugs yun bud pas phebs par bzhed na/ bka' brgyud kyi 'byung gnas rin po che ra lung ha bo gangs bzang su rtse 'dzom yong ba phebs pa zhu lags shing / nga de bar dbus gnas rnams skor grub par dgos tshe phral du phebs pas slar kho bo stag snar sdad skabs mjal yong 'dug pa/ gang ltar de nas babs gzigs kyi thugs stabs gang bde zhig gnang ba zhu/ ra lung phyogs su phebs par shar tshe sku chas 'phral dgos chib pa bcas las/ bying 'ba' ra rang du 'jog pa gnang bas thugs stabs gang bde mdzad nas phebs pa zhu zhing / gang ltar de kha nas bab gzigs gnang bas chog pa chos klong du gcags pa 'tshal 'ba' ra ba rang la'ang yi ge zhig bskur yod pas khong rang tsho don gnyer byed pa 'dug na/ da lam phebs pa'i dgos don yin pas re zhig der bzhugs pas chos 'chad gnang 'tshal/skyes mchog dam pa'i seng khrir bste ba dpal ldan bla ma dam pa gang gi sku zhogs su/ nang lugs stabs bder zhu ba/ deng sku yi snang ba rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du mngon par gsal zhing mdzad phrin bzang po gong 'phel du bzhugs pa ni mchog tu spro la/ ngos kyang lnga 'dus kyi 'tsho ba snyoms pa nas/'bri gung / te gro/ dbu ru brgyud kong yul nags ma'i ljongs chen por 'byor zhing / bstan 'gror lhag bsam mi dman pas gzhan phan gyi 'phrin las sgo yangs por spyod pa dang / dben pa'i gnas rir bskyed rdzogs don bsgom la brtson par mchi/ mtshams zhu/ dam grub che chung brko rgyu'i dpe bris gnang rgyu phul ba 'khod gang snyoms 'gad gtsang spud legs zhig gnang grogs ci nas 'tshal zhing / 'di nang 'ong dus kun dge ba'i skyabs 'jug g.yel med bgyid lags pas chos klong su 'jug pa 'tshal/ zhes 'degs rten lha tshas rnam par dkar ba bcas zla 3tshes 3dge bar phul/dad gus dam tshig gi lang tshos 'byor pa dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa gang gi sku'i ga la bar/ nye lam gsol 'os/ deng dus thugs bskyed kyi 'dzin ma las bsod nams kyi ljon shing / mngon mtho'i me tog 867

nges legs 'bras bu'i khur gyi dud bzhin pa nas rang gi gdul byar gyur pa'i 'gro ba rnams thugs rje'i grib bsil gyi 'tsho bar mdzad pa nas bla ma la dad gus kyi lang tsho nyams pa med pa'i rang gzugs su snga sor lcags mdud dpon gyi sras smon lam rgya mtsho can la mtshams 'dri dang / da lam gsung bris rten gyi dngos po rdo bcud kyi dong rtse bcu phrag bcu dang lha gos rnam par dkar ba bcas ched mngags kyi bya ma rta yig dmar mgo zla'i dkar phyogs kyi dga' ba dang po la kong yul gu ru'i gnas chen ljon pa lung du gtsug lag khang gsar gzheng grub pa'i rab gnas grub 'phral tshe dbang skabs su 'byor bas snyigs dus kyi slob ma'i rang gzugs ma yin par rgyu 'bras dam tshig la 'phrin cung zad tshud pa dam pa'i rnam thar du mthong bas yid dga' ba bzang po rnyed/ ngos kyang snga sor skye yul gdan sa rgyab tu bor chos brgyad 'dzin pa'i dos thag bcad de 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku e thob kyi re bas rgyal khams su zhugs pa yin kyang bar chad kyi bdud rnam g.yeng du brdzus te ming bla mar sgro btags pa 'dis tshe gcig sangs rgyas kyi bdud du gnyer te lang song / da ni mdo khams rgyal rong sde dge sogs sde dpon mtha' dag pa dang / de bzhin dgon sde che phra du ma yi mgrin gcig dbyangs gcig tu mdo khams phyogs su yong dgos tshul dang / bla ma che bgres zhi bar gshegs pa mtha' dag gis kyang zhal chems kyi tshul du yi ge 'jog nas yong dgos tshul 'dug pa bcas 'phral mar ma shi na bla ma gong ma rnams kyi dgongs pa bskang ba'i slad du mdo khams kaḥthog rdo rje gdan gyi bstan pa la bya ba cung zad bgyid blo dang /gzhan yang ris su ma chad pa'i rgyal bstan la rim gro ci nus bgyid rtsis kyi bod chen phyogs su bgrod rtsis lags shing / des na 'phral du gnas yul gyis bskal bas dngos su mjal bar ma gyur kyang /dngas ba'i thugs kyi mi bskyud pa gnang na dge legs kyi brtsas su 'phel bar nges pa dgongs par gcags par 'tshal la/ yun ring ma shi gnas tshe 'phrad par yang smon la/ gang cir rnam kun dge ba'i skyabs 'jug yang dag bgyid pa dgongs par gcags pa dang / skyes mchog 'ba' ra ba'i bstan pa rta rnga ltar nyag phra ba'i skabs 'dir de yi gdan sa rin po che la zhabs 'gyur gang che yod pa ci kyang zhu zhu/zhes kaḥthog gi mnga' ris su chos smra ba'i go sar skyes shing rgyal dbang pad+ma ka ras dbang bskur ba'i mthu la brten yangs pa'i rgyal khams kun tu gzhan drin ma yin rang gi 'phrin las skyong ba kaḥthog sprul sku'i sngags mdud lha gos ma hardzi kha bru zung gnyis 'brel ba kong snam spus gtsang dkar po yug gsum bcas zla tshes dge ba la spel sarba maṅga lo/dam pa'i ring lugs 'chang ba sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po gang gi sku'i ga la bar/ nang lugs stabs bder 'phul ba deng du der sku'i dkyil 'khor dngas shing rim gnyis dge sbyor 'phel bar 868

bzhugs pa shin tu nas kyang legs/ ngos kyang dpal ma chos steng nas rim pas la stod lho byang brgyud srad dang pho lhar zhag shas bstes shing / sgrub gnas ra lung ya 'brog sogs grub pa'i gnas chen kha yar mjal/ lho brag nas gnyal du 'byor skabs zla tshes la bod kyi dus 'gyur chen po de tshugs shing bcu pa nyis brtsegs kyi phyi mar ngos kyang lha ldan du mchod yon gyi mjal khar gcar zhing de skabs bka' drin sna tshogs pa gnang bar lan ji bzhin rnal ma rnam par dag pa yi sgo nas rdor smin gyi mtshon snga 'gyur gyi ring lugs la yang sman par byas shing / gang cir lhong tshad dang tshar tshad tshul bzhin rdzogs pa'i khul lags shing / da lta mtshur gyi gasdo lar gzhan phan gyi 'khor lo sngar mu ltar gong 'phel du mchis/ de kar don grub gling gi zhig gso mdzad rgyu bstan pa'i zhabs tog tu mngon par 'phags/slad nas yang dge ba'i mdzad 'phrin nyams pa med pa nas gsung 'os kyang 'tshal la/ 'on kyang lug dang bya lo rnams bod spyi bstan rim la brtson na bzlog par nges la dus rtsub par shar ba yis/ nyid kyang dge blo 'phel ba'i gnas su stis na mnyam/ gang spyir bla ma'i mos gus stobs su gyur pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi rim pa la 'bad pa ci nas kyang gal che ste/ snyigs dus kyi tshe ni bar snang gi glog ltar yun du mi gnas gshis 'khor ba la skyo shas nges 'byung gis bsam pas yang nas yang du bskul gcags gnang ba yang gal che bar rigs/ zhes zla tshes dge ba la dpal rig pa 'dzin pas spel ba sarba maṅga lo/bsgrub brgyud bstan pa'i sgron me skyes mchog 'ba' ra ba'i seng ge'i khri bsrung bar byed pa po sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po gang gi sku gzhogs su/ nye lam gsol 'os/ deng dus der sku'i 'tsho gzhes mchog tu dwangs shing rim gnyis kyi nyams gzhes gong 'phel gzhan phan 'phrin las kyi 'jug sgo bzang po yol ba med par bzhugs pa nas gsung bris gnas tshul zhib 'khod rten ldan rtags kyi ri mo ma nyams pa 'dir son pas yid dbang brtas/ de kar sku mtshams bcad rgya la gzhol ba legs mod/'on kyang dam pa snga rabs kha gcig gi rnam thar ltar phyi mtshams su/ gzim spyil las gzhan du mi 'da' ba'i khog tu yar ngo la chos don gnyer rnams la dbang bskur chos 'chad kyi bya ba dang / mar ngor mtshams dam pos nang gi yang dag 'jog la 'bad rtsol gyis na gzhan phan dang rang don zung du 'jug pa yis legs par khums la/ lus kyi srog chags spong ba ni dge ba'i ltas yin par yang srid la/rnal ltas rtsub mo sogs ni ci mi snyam gyi ngang dge sbyor la 'bad pas dbyings su grol bar 'gyur la/ da ni bdag kyang na tshod kyi gtugs shing chung ngu nas dam pa'i chos kho na yid la gzhag ste lhag med rdo rje'i sku 'grub pa zhig re ba yin yang da ni bla gzugs chos brgyad kyi 'dams su bying nas ro gog bor la nye ba'i ngang tshul du yod/ des na mi rtag pa'i skyo shas lhang lhang pa'i ngang du gnas/ nyid rang bdag dang 869

sngon rabs du mar 'brel che rten 'brel can yin bzhin ring lugs bzang po dang 'phrad bzhin de la gzhol nas 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa mi dman par 'tshal/ 'dus byas rang mtshang ma bstan zhing phyogs de dang khad nyer sleb tshe ngos su 'phrad par yang 'dun cing kun tu dge ba'i smon lam skyabs 'jug yang dag bgyid pa yang dgongs mtshor rol ba zhu/ zhes ri mo sgren bur ma gyur pa lha'i gos rnam par dkar bas 'phur zhing sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i phur mdud bcas zla tshes dge ba la mang yul byams pa sprin gyi gtsug lag khang 'dab nas spel ba'i pā tram̐ sarba maṅga lo/oṃ swāste na mo gu ru we/ rgyal bas gsung pa'i chos tshul thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba snying po rgyud rnams kun gyi gtso/ /bdag nyid rgyud la 'doms mdzad mgon po che/ /sngags 'chang chen po rgyal sras seng ge gang / /zhi bar gshegs pa'i thugs dgongs rdzogs ched du/ /gang gi chos las skyes pa'i sras kyi mchog /tshe dbang nor bu'i rgyal ba'i sku brnyan 'di/ /'bad pas gzheng par byas pa'i dge rtsa des/ /sgyu 'phrul gsang ba snying po'i smin grol rgyun/ /nam yang chad med phyogs dus gnas skabs kun/ /dar rgyas yun ring nyams med gong du 'phel/ /skye dgu kun bzang lam bzang 'dir zhugs cing / /bla ma la mos dam tshig rnam par dag /shes rab mchog gi rgyud don gsal bar rtogs/ /'bad med sngags kyi sa lam yon tan rdzogs/ /pha ma'i rang bzhin 'gro kun bder bkod shog /ces pa yang rje btsun bla ma sngags 'chang chen po rgyal sras seng ge sku gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs zhal thang gi rgyab byang du rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bus chu sprel snron zla'i tshes bzang brgyad la snang gsal mar me'i mdangs su bkod pa dge'o/ /me me 'gyur med la yi ge/ kha sing sngags 'chang chen po'i sku sprur nged rang nas zhugs 'bul bgyid rtsis yin kyang / khyed rang tshos gros nyes kyi bzhugs 'bul tshar 'dug pa 'gyod pa che/ nged nas sngags 'chang chen po'i dgongs rdzogs su dmigs zhe dgu ma rdzogs bar bdun tshigs bzung zhing /'phags pa byams sprin rnams la mchod 'bul gang 'byor de bzhin dang / 'di phyogs chos sde rnams la mang bkol/ phyag 'gyed sogs bgyis shing dgongs rdzogs su dmigs pa'i thang sku rnams la gong gsham dang rab gnas/ rgyab byang smon lam bris nas ba skur yod pa der mchod 'bul yang dag byed pa gal che/da dung yang dag gi dpe de gang rnyed tshol rgyu dang / las lung nas byung ba yin zer ba'i sgyu 'phrul gyi glegs bam de nged kyi rjes zin pa zhig g.yar po bskyal gtang kyang 'tshal la/ da lam mdo chen bla brgyud gser 'phreng dpe ni da lta cung zad shu ma grub pas g.yar por bsgor yod/ der o rang rnams nang mdza' gshim gra gang 'grigs byed sgo gal che/ nged nas kyang dge ba'i skyabs 'jug bgyid pa blor 870

gcags/ ces rten bal ṭaṃ bcu gnyis dang lha gos bcas 'phral du spel ba sarba maṅga lam̐/dad pa dam tshig la 'gyur ba med pa mdo chen bla ma'i zhabs drung du/ zhu ba/ snga sor phyag bris rten ldan kun tu ru ga ṇa tsakra gnang ba nyams med 'byor pas dga' nyams bla lhag tu brtas/ phran yang lnga lus ma zhig tsam du dal med gzhan phan yin khul gyi bral bzhin du gnas/ mtshams zhu/ dus rtag tu lha dang bla mar yi byed pas gsol 'debs la 'bad pa dang / tshe'i sgrub pa la brtson na tshe 'phrang bar chad sel bar 'gyur/ tshe 'phrang ni zhe drug dgu dang lnga bcur che zhing / de las grol na re zhig 'tsho/'phos nas re zhig gnas gzhan dang / de nas dal 'byor lus thob nas nam mkha'i snying pos byin gyis rlabs pas rjes bzung nas rdo rje theg la dkri bar 'gyur zhes rten sngags mdud chu rdo rje sems dpa'i ril bu bcas 'phul/ dam rdzas ni 'di phyogs ma 'byor bas phul ma thub lags/ mi 'gyur dad pa'i gar bu mchog dang ldan pa mdo chen rgyal sras seng ge yab sras gang bder/ 'bul 'bras/ deng sku khams bzang zhing rim gnyis gong 'phel du bzhugs pa nas phyag bris rten ldan 'byor bas spro ba brtas/'dir gnas rig pa 'dzin pa'ang / bstan 'gro'i bde thabs gong du spel ba'i lhag bsam 'dor med du gnas/ mtshams zhu/ gnas pa'i bu mo'i skor/ kha sing g.yang ra dkar po nas yi ge 'bul bzhin las/ da lam gsar 'phros zhu rgyu ma mchis pas/ de lugs dgongs par dpag pa'i dbyings gzigs 'tshal/ slad mar dngos su 'phrad par yang smon la/ de srid du legs smon skyabs 'jug g.yel med bgyid pa dgongs 'tshal/ zhes 'degs rten sngags mdud bcas rig pa 'dzin pas spel/dad ldan bla ma mdo chen sngags 'chang rgyal sras seṅge gang bder/ stabs bder zhu yig deng sku dkyil dwangs shing mdzad khyab legs ngos su bzhugs pa nas phyag bris rten ldan son pas spro/ gang spyir khyim 'dzin skor ni/ sa sprel lor ri bo dpal 'bar du nyid phebs skabs thog mar bla ma mnga' bdag pa'i sras mo 'dra zhig yong ngam zhus kyang / phyogs gzhan gyi bu mo yul lugs las kha'i stabs kyi lan lde'am khyim 'dzin mi yong 'dra gsung stabs/ gnas pa'i bu mo thugs babs bzhin khyed rang yab sras nas/— bdag la 'di phyi'i blo gtad gnang gshis thugs phan thog na mtshams sbyor byas pa de kha lags kyang / gnas pa'i bu mo sdod brling gi bya ba mi 'dug par thos shing / de don las la 'phrin 'dra gtang nas sdod 'jags kyis smras pa yin yang / da dung de ltar sdod ma nyan phyir so sor gyes pa las 'os mi 'dug pas/ de don ltar sde pa'i sku gzhogs su yang zhus yod pa dbyings bzhugs dang / dus rtag tu yab sras rnams yid la gcags pas bsrung dmigs lhod med bgyis yod pa dgongs 'jug zhu/zhes rten sngags mdud ṭika gsum la rgya zhus te g.yang ra dkar po nas 'phul/ dge'o/ / 871
